Hi khau kivaw min tupna le hi ciangkhutte — en hen, akua neisa ziam?,” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Judah in tua vanhte ciamtee a, “Ama maan hi. Ka tapa Shelah taw ka teensak tu hi napi ka teangsak bua hi — ama atu ka vaipuak a lel ka hi hi,” ci hi. Tuaciang Judah in ama omkhop pui kik ngei nawn ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Nausua hun a thet ciang naupeang a nei tu sia kimu hi."},"28":{"text":"Nausuak tu a tut laitak naute khat in a baan kilawtsak hi; nausuaksak syanu in tua baan zamhin khausan khat a khut tung khii a, “Hisia suak masa hi,” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahizong a khut dawk kik a tuaciang a suapuipa hong suak masa hi. Tuasia ciang nausuaksak syanu in, “Hi bangin na sua natu lampi nangma in hong tawm ni hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom ama min Perez kiphuak hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a khut tung a khausan taw a suapuipa hong suak a, ama min Zerah kiphuak hi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ishmael mite in Egypt ah Joseph paipui a, kumpipa ii uliante sung pan khat ahi, kumpi inncing ngalkap bupa Potiphar tungah zuak hi.","title":"Joseph le Potiphar ii Zi"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Joseph panpui a, nasep zosak hi. Ama sia Egypt mi a topa inn ah teang a,","ref":"Sawl 7:9"},"3":{"text":"Topa in Joseph panpui ahikom a nasepna theampo ah a zawsakna thu a topa in mu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama tungah Potiphar lungkim a, ama aituam naseam tu in koi hi; tua ahikom a inn le a neisa theampo uksak hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua hun a kipan Joseph hangin Egypt mi Potiphar te innkuan, a inn sung le a lo sungah a neisa theampo Topa in thupha pia hi."},"6":{"text":"Potiphar in a na theampo Joseph et tu in aap siat a, a anneak tu ngawl buang bangma dang thinbot in nei ngawl hi. Joseph sia a khanpha in a mealhoi a,"},"7":{"text":"tawmvei zawkciang a topa zi in Joseph lungngul in luppui tu in kunh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in nial a, “En in, hi sungah keima om ka hikom ka topa in inn sungah bangma thintoi ngawl hi. A neisa theampo ka et tu in hong aap siat hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi inn sungah ama taw kibangin a thu neiza ma ka nei a, nangma simngawl buang kei atu in khaam hong nei ngawl hi. Tua ahiciang hi bang ngamtat pha ngawl vawtin Pathian tungah maw thei tu khi ziam?” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"A topa zi in Joseph luppui tu ni khat zawk ni khat in kunh hi napi ama in luppui nuam ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahizong ni khat ni in Joseph sia inn sungah ama ii na seam tu in a tum ciang tualai ah inn naseamte kuama om ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"A tonu in Joseph puantual pan man a, “Kei taw lumkhawm tawng,” ci hi. Ahizong a tonu khut sungah a puantual nusiat a, suakta in a pua sangah tai hi."},"13":{"text":"A tonu in a puantual nusia in inn pan a tai a mu ciang,"},"14":{"text":"ama in a inn naseamte samin, “Hi sia en vun! Ka pasal ii inn ah hong ciapui, hi Hebrew sia pa in ei hong zawnsak vawt hi. Ama ka inndoi sungah hong tum a, buanin khialpui tu in hong kipan hi, ahizong a nging theiza in ka cik-au hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in ka cik-au a zaak ciang a puantual kei kungah nusia in doipua ah tai hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Joseph ii topa, inn ah hong cia dong ama in Joseph puantual keam hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaciang a pasal tungah ama in thupiang a son ngei teng ma son a: “Hi lai ah nong ciapui Hebrew sila pa in ka inndoi sungah tumin, kei hong zawnsak vawt hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahizong ka cik-au ciang a puantual ka kungah nusia in doipua ah tai hi,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Joseph ii topa a thin uuk mama a,"},"20":{"text":"Joseph mansak in kumpipa ii thongtaakte a koina thong sungah khum hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang thong ukpa ii Joseph tungah a lungkim natu in Topa in Joseph panpui a, thupha pia hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:9"},"22":{"text":"Ama in Joseph sia thongtaak dang theampo uk tu in koi a, thong sungah nasep theampo vaipuak neisak hi."},"23":{"text":"Joseph ii nasepnate thong ukpa ii et kik kul ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in Joseph panpui a, a nasepna theampo zosak hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawk hun khat ciangin Egypt kumpipa ii sapittui piapa le anluum empipa in kumpipa thin uuksak hi.","title":"Joseph in Thongtaakte ii Mang Khiaksak"},"2":{"text":"Hi naseam ulian niite tungah kumpipa thin uuk in,"},"3":{"text":"Joseph kikhumna mun, kumpi inncing ngalkap bupa inn sungah thongtaaksak hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate khuangeipi ma thong sungah om a, tua ngalkap bupa in Joseph sia amate naseamin koi hi."},"5":{"text":"Zan khat tua thong sungah sapittui piapa le anluum empipa in mang khat veve man a, a mangte in khiakna tuam tetek nei hi."},"6":{"text":"Zingsang in amate kungah Joseph a pai ciang thinngim a, a om sia mu hi."},"7":{"text":"Joseph in amate tungah “Banghangin tuni in na thin uh ngim tuak mama ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in, “Mang khat veve ka man uh a, tua mangte ii khiakna hong son thei tu hi sungah kuama dang om ngawl hi,” ci in zo hi. Joseph in, “Mang khiak theina hong pia sia Pathian hi, na mang uh hong son tavun,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuasia ciang sapittui piapa in, “Ka mang sungah sapitkung khat ka mai ah om a,"},"10":{"text":"tua tungah sapitbaak thum om hi. A teete a meen po ciang hong mom in sapitngate min hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa hai ka toai a; sapitngate ka lo a, hai sungah suukin ama ka pia hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Joseph in, “A khiakna hi bang hi: sapitbaak thum sia ni thum hi."},"13":{"text":"Ni thum sungin kumpipa in nang hong suatak tu a, hong maisakin na nasep ngei hong pia kik tu hi. Ama sapittui piapa na hi lai a, na sep ngei bangma in a hai na pia tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahizong na dau a pai ciang nong hesuakna in kei hong phawk kik ta'n a, hi thongsung pan ka suatak thei natu in kumpipa tungah ka thu teng hesuakna taw hong sonsak ta'n."},"15":{"text":"A tatakin ci leang Hebrew ngam panin kei hong kiman hi a, hi lai Egypt ngam zongh ah thong sung hong kikhum natu in bangma ka vawt bua hi” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Anluum empipa in sapittui piapa ii mang a khiakna sia thupha hi ci in a mu ciang ama in Joseph tungah, “Kei zongh mang khat man khi hi; anluum law thum thuapin ka lu tungah ka pua hi."},"17":{"text":"A tungbel law sungah kumpipa atu in moh namcin om a, vacimte in tuate ne uh hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Joseph in, “A khiakna hi bang hi: law thumte sia ni thum ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ni thum sungin kumpipa in nang hong pusua tu a, — tuaciang na ngawng hong tan tu hi! Tua zawkciang ama in na luang khuam khat tungah hong khai tu a, vacimte in na sa ne tu uh hi,” ci in zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Ni thum zawkciang kumpipa suani in, ama in a uliante theampo atu in poai khat khaam a; sapittui piapa le anluum empipa sia ama in tha in, a uliante mai ah paipui hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in sapittui piapa sia a nasep ngei ma pia kik a,"},"22":{"text":"ahizong anluum empipa sia thatlum hi. Joseph son bang tatakin hi teng theampo piang siat hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahizong sapittui piapa in Joseph phawk ngei nawn ngawl hi — ama ii thu theampo mangil cip hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawk kum nii zawkciang Egypt kumpipa in mang man a, a mang sungah Nile ngunhui ah ding a,","title":"Joseph in Kumpipa Mang Khiaksak"},"2":{"text":"Nile ngun sung panin khuipui a thau, a zol sali pusuak to in, lopa ne tu kipan uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a ngawm, a ngu nguak a om khuipui salite pusuak to hi. Tua teng hong pai a, Nile ngunhui a khuipui dangte kungah dingin,"},"4":{"text":"a ngawm khuipui salite in a thau khuipui salite netum uh hi. Tuasia ciang kumpipa khanglo hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama mu kikin mang dang khat man hi. A hui bup taknei in a min, taanghui sali sia kung khat tung pan hui hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaciang senneal vui in theapsak in a ngeau singseng taanghui dang sali hong po hi,"},"7":{"text":"a theap taanghui teng in a tak nei taanghui teng valhtum hi. Kumpipa khanglo a, mang maman ahi sia tel hi."},"8":{"text":"A zingsang ciang ama thinngim ahikom mitbum thiamte le Egypt mipil miciim theampo samsak hi. Ama in amate tungah a mang teng son a, ahizong kuama in a mang khiaksak thei ngawl hi.","ref":"Dan 2:2"},"9":{"text":"Tuasia ciang sapittui pia pa in kumpipa tungah, “Tuni in ka khialna kong pualaak kul hi."},"10":{"text":"Kei le anluum empipa tungah na thin uuk a, kumpi inncing ngalkap bupa inn sung thong sungah nong khum hi."},"11":{"text":"Zan khat ka nii in mang khat veve ka man uh a, ka mangte uh in khiakna tuatuam nei hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua munah kumpi inncing ngalkap bupa ii silapa, Hebrew tangvalno khat kote taw omkhawm hi. Ama tungah koma mangte ka son uh ciang a khiakna hong son hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama son bang tatakin piang a: kei sia ka nasep nong pia kik a, ahizong anluum empipa sia na thatlum hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa in Joseph samsak a, thong sung pan thakhat ma in hong kipaipui hi. Joseph a mul meet thiangin, a puante a laih zawkciang kumpipa omna ah pai hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama tungah, “Mang khat ka man a, kuama in a khiakna hong son thei ngawl hi, nang sia mangkhia thei ci in hong kison hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Joseph in, “Kumpipa awng, kei hi thei hi ngawl hi, ahizong Pathian in mang khiakna maan hong son tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Ka mang sungah Nile ngunhui ah ka ding a,"},"18":{"text":"limci in a thau khuipui sali, ngun sung pan hong pusuak to a, lohingte ne tu in kipan hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a ngawm a ngu nguak a om a dang khuipui sali hong pusuak to hi. Tuate sia Egypt ngam sungah ka mu ngei khuipui zawngkhal belte ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Khuipui ngawmte in khuipui thaute netum a,"},"21":{"text":"ahizong kuama in a neak hunlam he ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile amate sia nidang bangma in ngawm veve hi. Tuasia ciang ka khanglo hi."},"22":{"text":"Mang ka man kik a, taangkung khat tung pan a hui bup taknei in a min taanghui salite ka mu hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaciang senneal vui in theapsakin a ngeau singseng taanghui sali hong po a,"},"24":{"text":"tuaciang a theap taanghuite in a taknei taanghuite valhtum hi. Mitbum thiamte tungah ka mang ka son a, ahizong amate khat zongh in ka mang khiakna hong son thei ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Joseph in kumpipa tungah, “Na mangte nii ii a khiakna sia kibang hi; Pathian in a sep tu teng nang tungah hong son zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Khuipui thau salite sia kum sali hi a, taanghui a taknei salite zongh kum sali ma hi; a khiakna kibang hi."},"27":{"text":"A khak sang a hong pusuak khuipui ngawm sali le senneal vui ii a ngeausak singseng taanghui theap salite sia kialpi kum sali ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuasia kong sonsa bangma hi — Pathian in a sep tu teng nang tungah hong lak zo hi."},"29":{"text":"Egypt ngamsung theampo ah kum sali sung an kihau mama tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kum sali sung kialpi tungin an hau hun kum teng kimangil cip tu hi, banghang ziam cile kialpi in ngam lalsak tu hi."},"31":{"text":"An hau hun teng kimangil bit tu hi, banghang ziam cile hong zui tu kialpi sia lauhuai mama tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Mang nii a kipee in na matna sia Pathian in hi thu kipsak zo a, hai ngawlin tungsak tu cinopna ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"“Tu in mipil miciim thuhe pasal khat teal in a, ngam uk tu in koi in."},"34":{"text":"A dang vaihawm uliante ngam sungah koi kul a, kum sali an hau hun sungin lo ante ii see nga sua see khat la khol in."},"35":{"text":"Thu pia in a, hong tung tu kumphate sungah an theampo kaikhawmsak in, tuaciang amate thuneina taw khuapite sungah an kholin a, cingsak in."},"36":{"text":"Hi ante sia Egypt ngam ah hong tung tu kialpi kum sali sungah ngam sungah zeak tu in, a kikhol kholsa suak tu hi. Hi bang vaihawmna taw mihingte pukthi ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Kumpipa le a uliante in hi vaihawmna lungkim a,","title":"Egypt Ngam Ukpa in Joseph Kikoi"},"38":{"text":"kumpipa in amate tungah, “Joseph sangin a phazaw mi ih mu ngei buatu hi, ama sia a sungah Pathian thaa a nei mihing khat ahi hi,” ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Kumpipa in Joseph tungah, “Pathian in nang tungah hite theampo hong lak zo hi, tua ahikom nang saang a, a ciim zaw le thu thuk mu zaw kuama dang om ngawl ahi sia kilangh hi."},"40":{"text":"Ka ngam ukpa tu in nang kong koi tu a, nangma thupiakte ka mihingte theampo in zui tu hi. Nangma thuneina tungsia ah keima bek ka om tu hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:10"},"41":{"text":"Tu in Egypt ngamsung theampo a ukpa tu in panmun kong pia hi,” ci hi."},"42":{"text":"Kumpipa in a min tupna khutzungbu, a khutme pan suutin Joseph khutme ah bunsak hi. Ama in puantual neal a pha khat silhsakin a ngawng ah khamh khi khat awsak hi.","ref":"Dan 5:29"},"43":{"text":"A to natu in kumpi siphu ngalleang niina sia pia a, ama a cing ngalkapte a mai ah pai in, “Lam na awn vun! Lam na awn vun!” ci in ausak hi. Tuabangin Joseph sia Egypt ngamsung theampo a ukpa in panmun pia hi."},"44":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama tungah, “Keima in kumpi ka hi hi — nangma oaina om ngawlin Egypt ngamsung theampo ah kuama in a khut a peang ngawngawn laam thei ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Ama in Joseph sia Zaphenath Paneah ci in Egypt min thak pia a, a zi tu in Heliopolis khua thiampi khat ahi Potiphera ii tanu Asenath pia hi. Joseph sia Egypt kumpipa na a sep kipatin kum sawmthum pha hi. Ama sia kumpi zum nusia in ngamsung theampo ah khualhaw kawkoai hi.","merge":"46"},"47":{"text":"An hau hun kum sali sung in leitang pan an tam mama piang a,"},"48":{"text":"tua teng theampo Joseph in kaikhawmin khuapi tengah kholsak hi. Ama in khua kiim a lote panin a piang ante sia a khuapi tek ah khol hi."},"49":{"text":"A ankholte sia tamlei ahikom Joseph in sim vanglak ngawlin, tee nawn ngawl hi — tua teng sia tuipi vaal senvui taw kibang hi."},"50":{"text":"Kialpi kumte hong tun ma in Joseph in Asenath taw tapa nii nei hi."},"51":{"text":"Ama in, “Pathian in ka thuakna theampo le ka pa innkuanpui theampo hong mangilsak hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom a tapa masa min Manasseh phuak hi."},"52":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka ngim thuakna munah Pathian in tate hong pia hi,” ci ahikom a tapa niina ii min sia Ephraim phuak hi."},"53":{"text":"An hau in Egypt ii nopsakna hun kum salite hong bo a,"},"54":{"text":"Joseph sonsa bangin kum sali kialpi kipan hi. Ngamdang theampo ah kialpi tung a, ahizong Egypt ngamsung teng ah an om hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:11"},"55":{"text":"Egypt te ngilkial tu hong kipat ciang kumpipa tungah an ngen uh hi. Tuaciang kumpipa in amate Joseph kungah pai in, ama ci bang a vawt natu in thupia hi.","ref":"Jn 2:5"},"56":{"text":"Kialpi nasia vaial in ngam bup ah hong kizel a, tua ahiciang Joseph in ankholna inn theampo hongin Egypt te tungah antang zuak hi."},"57":{"text":"Mun theampo ah kialpi nasia mama tung ahikom leitung mun theampo pan mihingte Joseph kungah antaw tu in Egypt ah hong pai uh hi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jacob in Egypt ngam ah an a omna thu a heak ciang a tapate tungah, “Banghang hi bang om thawthong nu ziam?","title":"Joseph ii Suapuipate Antaw tu in Egypt ah Pai"},"2":{"text":"Egypt ah an a omna thu za khi hi, ih pukthi ngawl natu in va pai in antaw tavun,” ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:12"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Joseph ii suapui sealh sawmte Egypt ah antaw tu in pai hi,"},"4":{"text":"ahizong Jacob in Joseph suapui laipee Benjamin in amate zuisak ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile ama tungah bang khat pawpo a pian thaak tu lau hi."},"5":{"text":"Canaan ngam sungah kial tung ahikom midangte taw Jacob tapate antaw tu in pai hi."},"6":{"text":"Egypt ngamukpa a hina taw Joseph in leitung mihing theampo tungah antang zuak hi. Tuabangin Joseph suapuipate hong pai a, a maitang uh leipha in ama mai ah kun uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Joseph in a suapuite a mu ciang tel hi, ahizong a he ngawl bangin kivawt hi. Ama in a suapuite tungah kamngam taw, “Koisung pan hong pai nu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Amate in, “Canaan ngam pan antaw tu in kong pai uh hi,” ci in zo uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Joseph in a suapuipate a tel hang a suapuipate in ama tel ngawl uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Joseph in amate taw kisai a mangmatnate phawk kikin, “Note sia thukankute na hi uh a; koma ngamsung thaneamna mun teng a dawp tu in hong pai nu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 37:5-10"},"10":{"text":"Amate in, “Hi ngawl hi, topa awng, antaw tu in na silate bangin hong pai khu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ko teng unau khat hi ung. Topa awng, ko sia thukankute hi ngawl a, mi thumaante ka hi uh hi,” ci in zo uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Joseph in amate tungah, “Hi ngawl hi! Ngamsung thaneamna mun teng a dawp tu in hong pai nu hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in, “Topa awng, ka vekpi unau sawm le nii ka pha uh a, Canaan ngammi khat ii tapate ka hi uh hi. Ka suapui khat thi a, a nobel sia tu in ka pa uh taw om hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Joseph in, “Kong cisa bangma hi. Note thukankute nu hi."},"15":{"text":"Note hi bangin hong kisit tu hi: kumpipa min taw ka kiciam a, na nau nobel sia hi mun hong thet mateng note cia ngeingawl tu nu hi."},"16":{"text":"Note sung pan khat pawpo in na pui tavun. Na thu uh a thian dong, thumaan son na hi hunlam a kisit thei mateng a dang teng sia thong sungah kong khum tu hi. Tuabang ahibuale a nungta kumpipa min lo in ka sonsa bang hi, note sia thukankute hi nanak tu nu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuabangin Joseph in ni thum sung amate thong sungah koi hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni thum ni in Joseph in amate tungah, “Keima in Pathian kiita mihing khat ka hi a, thu khat hangin na nuntakna uh kong khoaikhe tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Thumaan mi na hina a kilak natu in note hong kikepna mun thong sungah khat om tu nu hi, a dang teng in ngilkial a om na innkuanpuite, na an leisa teng puak thei tu nu hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua zawkciang na nau nobel uh sia kei kungah nong paipui tu uh hi. Tuabangin note thumaan son na hi uh sia hong kilangh tu a, kong that buatu hi,” ci hi. Tuasia bangin amate lungkim uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaciang khat le khat tung ah, “Hi hi, ih suapuipa Joseph tuabang ih vawtsiat hu in tu in ih thuak hi ; ngimna lian a thuak ih mu a, hu ngen in hong thuum napi ih nadon bua hi. Tua hu in tu in hi ngimna sungah ih om hi,” ci uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Reuben in, “Ih naupa vawtsia heak vun hong ci khi hi, ahihang ka thu hong ni ngawl nu hi. Tu in ama ii thina thaman hong lo kiksak hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 37:21-22"},"23":{"text":"Tuabang a pau sia Joseph in tel siat hi, ahihang amate in tuasia hunlam he ngawl uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate in kampheen zanghin Joseph a paupui hang ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Joseph sia mundang ah pai in kap hi. Tua zawk a pau thei kik tu ciang hong heak kik a, amate sung pan Simeon tangkal in a mai ah khaukhitsak hi."},"25":{"text":"Joseph in a suapuite ip teng dim antang a hensak natu, mi khat sim ii sum sia a ip sung tek ah a koisak kik natu le lampi ah a neak tu nguai an a piak natu in thupia hi. Tuabang ma in kivawtsak hi.","title":"Joseph ii Suapuite Canaan ah Cia kik"},"26":{"text":"Tua unaute in a antang lei teng a laate tungah suanhin vaiding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua zan a ngiana munah amate sung pan khat in a laa an pia tu in a ip a hon le a tungbel ah a sum mu hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in a suapuite tungah “Ka sum hong kikoisak kik hi, hilai ka ip sungah om hi!,” ci hi. Amate thinkiam in lau a, “Pathian in eite tungah bang hong vawt thong ziam?” ci in khat le khat kidongh hi."},"29":{"text":"Canaan ngam a pa Jacob kung a thet ciang amate in thupiang theampo a pa tungah son hi:"},"30":{"text":"“Egypt ngamukpa in kamngam taw in hong paupui a, a ngam thu kanin hong mawsiat hi."},"31":{"text":"‘Kote thukankute hi ngawlin mi thumaante ka hi uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Kote unau sawm le nii ka pha uh a, pa khat ii ta ka hi uh hi. Ka suapuipa khat thi a, a nobel sia ka pa uh taw Canaan ah om lai hi’ ci in ka zo uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua pa in, ‘Hi bangin na thumaanna uh kong kan tu hi: note khat hi sungah kei taw om tu nu hi; a dang teng na innkuanpui ngilkialte atu in antang puakin cia tu nu hi."},"34":{"text":"Na nau nobel sia hong paipui tavun. Tuasia ciang note thukanku hi ngawlin thumaan mi na hina uh kong he tu hi; na suapuipa kong pia kik tu hi, tuaciang hi munah om in, sumlei sumzuak thei tu nu hi,’ hong ci hi.”"},"35":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a ipte a sua uh ciang amate khat simin a sumbawm tek mu a; a sum a mu uh ciang amate le a pa Jacob patau uh hi."},"36":{"text":"A pa in amate tungah, “Ka tate theampo hong sumsisak nuam nu ziam? Joseph bo zo; Simeon bo zo a; tu in Benjamin paipui nuam nu hi. Kei sia a thuakbelpa ka hi hi!” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahihang Reuben in a pa tungah, “Benjamin kong ciapui kik bua ahile ka tapate nii thatlum in. Ama sia keima kep tu in koi in a, kong ciapui kik tu hi,” ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahizong Jacob in, “Ka tapa no taw paisak thei ngawl tu khi hi; a upa thi zo a, ama bek taang hi. Lampi ah bang khat po tawk thei tha tu hi. Kei ka huai zo a, tuabang nong khuangaisaknate in kei hong thatlum tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Canaan ah kialpi nasia seseam a,","title":"Joseph ii Suapuite Egypt ah Benjamin taw Heak kik"},"2":{"text":"Jacob innkuanpuite in Egypt pan a antang lei teng a neak siat zawkciang, Jacob in a tapate tungah, “Pai kik tavun a, antawm va taw tavun,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Judah in a pa tungah, “Tua mipa in na naupa nong paipui bua uh le ka mai nong mu thei buatu uh hi, ci in ka kidop natu uh ngat takin hong vaitha zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka naupa nong zuisak le kote pai in nang atu an ka taw tu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuabang na oai buale pai ngawl tu khu hi, banghang ziam cile tua pa in na naupa nong keng bua uh le ka mai nong mu thei buatu uh hi, hong ci sa hi” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Jacob in, “Tua pa tungah suapui dang nei lai khu hi ci in na sonna uh taw banghangin hi zata thinngim hong pia thong nu ziam?” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in, “Tua pa in eite thu le ih innkuan thu hong dongh top a, ‘Na pa uh nungta lai ziam? Suapui dang na nei uh ziam?’ hong ci hi. Ama thu dokte ka zo nanak uh kul hi. Na naupa hong paipui tavun, ama hong ci tu sia bangbangin hekhol thei tu khu ziam?,” ci in zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Judah in a pa tungah, “Tangvalpa kei taw paisak in, ding kik pai tu khu hi. Tua hile eite ih pukthi buatu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka naupa atu in ka nuntakna taw kong kiciam hi. Nang kungah ciidam in kong ciapui kik bua ahile a tawntungin mawsiatna ka thuak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Eite ngei mama ngakin vaikai bualeang tu in niivei kilee a, ih thet kik natu hi zo hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"A pa in amate tungah, “Tuabang hi tu ahile ngamsung pan a piang a phabel te: thingnaai tawm, khuaitui tawm, hel namtui tawm, pistachio nga le almond ngate tun in ngamukpa tungah piak tu in keng tavun."},"12":{"text":"Na ip ngong sungah nong ciapui uh na sumte na ken kik uh kul tu ahiciang na sum uh a zaa nii in keng vun. Sum hong khiak khial zong hi thei tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Na suapuipa paipui vun a, hong ciapui kik pai tavun."},"14":{"text":"Ama in na suapuipa le Benjamin sia no hong piak kik natu in Vaanglianbelpa Pathian in tuasia pa, no tungah hesuakna thin neisak tahen. Kei, ka tate a khuai siat tu ka hile zong thuak ka heu tong,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahiciang unaute sia letsongte le dangka a zaa nii in keng a, Egypt ngam ah Benjamin taw pai uh hi. Joseph kungah amate ki aap uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Joseph in amate taw a om Benjamin a mu ciang, ama in a inn uk naseampa tungah, “Amate ka inn ah paipui in. Sun ciang amate kei taw an nekhawm tu ahikom ngan khat ngo in a, kinging in,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama thupiak bangin naseampa in Joseph inn ah unaute paipui hi."},"18":{"text":"Inn ah amate a kipaipui ciang amate lau a, “A masa lai a sumte ih ip sungah a om kik hu in hi munah hong kipaipui hi. Amate in thakhat thu hong sim tu a, ih laate hong laaksak zawkciang sila hong suaksak tu hi,” ci in ngaisun uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaciang amate Joseph a inn uk naseampa omna kongkha ah pai in"},"20":{"text":"“Topa awng hi lai ah antaw tu in khatvei kong pai zo uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Inn ka cia lam ka ngiaphual ah ka ipte ka hon uh ciang ka ipngong sung tek ah ka sumte — a vekpi ma in ka mu uh hi. Tua sumte kong keng kik uh hi."},"22":{"text":"An a tamzaw lei natu in sum dang zongh kong keng thua uh hi. Ka ip sungah ka sumte uh akua in hong koisak kik ci sia ka he bua uh hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Naseampa in, “Thinngim om bo, lau heak vun. Note ii Pathian, na pa ii Pathian in na ip sungah note atu in sum hong koisak hi nanak tu hi. Na antang man uh a cingin ka nga hi,” ci hi. Tua zawkciang ama in amate kungah Simeon paipui hi."},"24":{"text":"Naseampa in unaute inn sungah paipui hi. Ama in a peang sil natu in tui pia a, a laate an pia hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate ni sun ciang inn ah hong cia Joseph taw an nekhawm tu ci ahikom a piak tu letsong teng kinging khol uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Joseph inn hong thet ciang amate in a letsong puakte inn sung ama kungah paipui in ama mai, lei ah kunsuk uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in amate tungah na dam uh ziam ci in a dok zawkciang, “A thu nong sonsa na pa huai — ama bangbang ahi ziam? Cidam in a nungta lai na ziam?” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in, “A kiniamkhiak na naseam pa, ka pa uh nungta lai in a ciidam hi,” ci in zo uh hi. Tuaciang amate khupdin in ama mai ah kunsuk uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Joseph in a naupa Benjamin a mu ciang, “Tua ahile, hisia kei tung a nong son uh na nau nobel sia ahi ziam? Ka tapa awng, Pathian in nang thupha hong pia tahen,” ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joseph sia a naupa ciliaphuai sa in a neno ahikom thakhat thu in pusuak hi. Ama in thuak zo nawn ngawl ahiciang a inndoi sungah pai in kap hi."},"31":{"text":"A mai a phia zawkciang hong pusuak a, ama le ama tha la tawmin an thuukin sawl hi."},"32":{"text":"Joseph atu sabuai khat ah an kilui in, a suapuite atu sabuai dang khat ah an kilui hi. Tualai ah an a ne Egypt te sia a tuamin kinesak hi, banghang ziam cile Egypt te in Hebrew te taw ankuang uum khop sia zano kisa hi."},"33":{"text":"Joseph mai sabuai ah a suapuite ama maingat in a haambel pan a moibel dong a kizomin tosak hi. Tuabangin amate a kitosak a mu uh ciang lamdang sa in khat le khat ki en uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Joseph ii sabuai tung pan amate an kipia a, Benjamin sia a dangte sangin a zaa nga tamzaw in kipia hi. Tuabangin amate Joseph taw anne tuidawn in nuamsa uh hi."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joseph in a inn uk naseampa tungah, “Hi pasalte ip sungah a puak zawk zaza nguai an hensak in a, amate sum tek a ipngong sungah koisak in.","title":"A Bo Hai"},"2":{"text":"Ka ngunn hai sia a moibelpa ii ipngong sung a tungbel ah antawk natu sumte taw koikhawmin,” ci in thupia hi. Ama in a kisawl bangin seam hi."},"3":{"text":"Zingsang tuungin a laate uh taw unaute ciasak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Khuapi pan tawm a pai zawkciang Joseph in ama inn uk naseampa tungah, “Manlang in tua pasalte del ta'n. Na phak ciang amate tungah, ‘Thupha sia banghang a sia taw hong thuk nu ziam?"},"5":{"text":"Banghangin ka topa ngunn hai ngu nu ziam? Ka topa tui neakna hai hi a, aisaan na in a zak hi. Khialna nasia mama khat vawt nu hi!’ na ci ta'n,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Naseampa in amate a phak ciang, hi kammal teng ma son kik hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in, “Topa awng, hi bang teng na pau bang na cinopna ziam? Hi bang lawlawmin ngamta ngawl khu hi ci in ka kiciam uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Na heaksa bangin ka ipngong sungah ka mu uh sumte Canaan ngam panin nang kungah kong paipui kik uh hi. Tuabang hi a, na topa ii inn pan ngunn ahizong khamh ahizong banghangin ngu tu khu ziam?"},"9":{"text":"Topa awng, khat pawpo tung pan na mu le tua pa kithat tu a, ko a dang teng na sila kong suak tu uh hi,” ci in zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in, “Hi hen; ahizong tua hai a la sia bek ka sila suak tu a, no a dang teng na pai vahial thei tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahiciang amate in manlang takin a vanhte lei ah khiasuk uh a, amate ip tek hong uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Joseph naseampa in a haambel pan a moibel dong pha takin tok a, tua hai Benjamin ii ip sungah mu hi."},"13":{"text":"Unaute in khuangaina taw a puante balkeak in, laate tungah a vanhte suanhin khuapi ah heakkik uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Judah le a suapuite Joseph inn a thet uh ciang tua munah Joseph om lai hi. Amate Joseph mai ah kunsuk a,"},"15":{"text":"Joseph in, “Bang seam thong nu ziam? Keima dinmun ah a om mihing khat in aisaanna zanghin note hong man zo veve tu cisia he ngawl nu ziam?” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Judah in, “Topa awng, nang tungah bang hong ci thei tu khu ziam? Bangbangin hong nial thei tu khu ziam? Bangbangin kiphel thei tu khu ziam? Pathian in ka mawna uh hong kilanghsak hi. Tua hai a kimuna pa bek hi ngawlin kote theampo zongh tu in na sila ka hi uh hi,” ci in zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Joseph in, “Oh, hi ngawl hi! Tuabang vawt ngeingawl tu khi hi! Hai a kimuna pa bekma ka sila hi tu hi. No a dang teng na pa kungah ciidam ludam in cia thei nu hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Judah in Joseph kungah paito a, “Topa awng nong hesuakna in, na tungah hi vahial in thu hong sonsak ta'n. Kei tungah hong thin uuk heak in; Nang sia kumpipa tatak bang na hi hi.","title":"Judah in Benjamin atu Hesuak Ngen"},"19":{"text":"Topa awng, nangma in, ‘Pa ahizong suapui dang ahizong na nei uh ziam?’ ci in nong dongh hi."},"20":{"text":"Kote in, ‘Pa huai khat le a huai zawkciang a nei suapui naupa khat ka nei uh hi. Ama ii suapuipa thi a, nu khat tate sung pan ama bek nungta lai hi; a pa in ama it mama hi,’ kong ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa awng, nangma in ama na mu thei natu in hi lai ah hong paipui tavun nong ci a,"},"22":{"text":"tangvalpa in a pa nusia thei ngawl tu hi; nusia le a pa thi tu hi ci in kong zo uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuasia ciang nangma in, ‘A nobel na suapuipa uh taw nong pai bua uh le ka mai nong mu thei buatu uh hi,’ nong ci hi."},"24":{"text":"“Ka pa kungah ka cia kik uh ciang nangma ci bangin ka son uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuasia ciang ama in, pai kikin, antawm taw lai tu in hong sawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Koma in, ‘Ka nau nobel ngawl taw tua pa kung hong kitumsak ngawl tu ahikom ko pai thei ngawl tu khu hi. Ka nau nobel zongh hong pai le tuasia ciang bek pai thei tu khu hi,’ ci in ka zo uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka pa uh in ko tungah, ‘Ka zi Rachel in tapa nii bek hong neipui sia na he uh hi."},"28":{"text":"A khat sia in keima hong nusia zo hi. Ama hong nusiat a kipan tu dong mu kik ngawl ka hikom, ngamsate in ama balneen zo hi nanak tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Tu in, hisia kei kung pan paipui in bang khat po tawk thong le haam zo ka hi bangma nong khuangaisakna in kei hong thatlum tu hi,’ hong ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Judah in, “Tua hi a, tu in topa awng, ka nau ngawl taw ka pa kungah cia kik thong leng ka naupa kei taw cia khawm ngawl hong mu po ciang ama thi tu hi. Ka pa nuntakna sia ka naupa nuntakna bek mitsuan in nungta a, ama haam mama zo ahikom ama ka khuangaisakna in thisak tu hi.","merge":"31"},"32":{"text":"Tua bek dom ngawlin ka naupa atu in ka pa tungah ka nuntakna ka khaam hi. Ka naupa ama kungah ka ciapui kik bua ahile ka nuntak sung theampo mawsiatna ka thuak tu hi, ci in ka son hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaciang tu in topa awng, ka naupa taangin keima na sila in hi sungah kong om tu a; ama a suapuite taw paisak in."},"34":{"text":"Ka naupa kei taw hong om buale bangbangin ka pa kungah cia kik thei tu khi ziam? Ka pa tungah hi tuasiatna a tun ka mu tu sia kei thuak zo ngawl tu khi hi,” ci hi."}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joseph in a naseamte mai ah a nenona khaam zo ngawl ahikom a inndoi sung pan a naseam theampo a pusua natu in thupia hi. Joseph in a suapuite tungah ama akua ci in a kison laitak kuama dang om ngawl hi.","title":"A Suapuite tungah Joseph Kison","ref":"Sawl 7:13"},"2":{"text":"Joseph nasia tak kap ahikom Egypt te in za a, tua thu kumpi inn sungah thang hi."},"3":{"text":"Joseph in a suapuite tungah, “Keima Joseph khi hi. Ka pa nungta lai ziam?” ci hi. Ahizong hi thu a suapuite in a zaak ciang amate lau mama ahikom zo thei ngawl uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joseph in amate tungah, “Hesuakna taw hong neak tavun,” ci hi. Amate in neak a, ama in, “Egypt te tungah na zuak uh na suapuipa Joseph khi hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi lai ah nong zuak uh manin nuammaw sa in kimawsiat heak vun. Mihingte nuntakna ngum tu in note mai ah Pathian in kei hong paisak khol hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu kum sia ngam sungah kialpi tun kum niina hi pheang a, lotho ngawl, anlaak ngawl tu hun kum nga sung om lai hi."},"7":{"text":"Note le na suan na paalte nuntak thei natu le hi bang a lamdangin note kong suatak thei natu in note mai ah Pathian in kei hong paisak khol hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hi a, hi munah kei hong then sia no hi ngawl het a Pathian ahi hi. Pathian in kumpipa ii ulianbel in hong koi hi. Ama ngam bup thuzeakpa ka hi a; Egypt ngam theampo a ukpa ka hi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tu in, ka pa kungah manlang in cia tavun a, na tapa Joseph in hi bang hong ci hi ci in son tavun: ‘Pathian in Egypt ngam theampo a ukpa in hong koi zo hi; kei kungah hai ngawlin hong pai ta'n.","ref":"Sawl 7:14"},"10":{"text":"Kei taw nong kinai thei natu in Goshen ngam ah — nangma, na tate, na tute, na tuute, na kealte, na khuite le na neisa theampo taw na teang thei tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Goshen ah nong om le kong khoi thei tu hi. Kialpi hun kum nga bang om lai hi; nangma, na innkuanpuite le na ngannote na pukthi tu uh ka dei bua hi” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Joseph in a thuson zom a, “Tu in note theampo le Benjamin awng, nang zongh in Joseph tatak ka hi sia nong mu thei hi."},"13":{"text":"Hi lai Egypt ngam sungah ka vaang neizia le na mu theampo ka pa tungah son tavun. Tua zawkciang manlang in ama hi munah hong paipui tavun,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Joseph in a suapuipa Benjamin koai in kap a; Benjamin zongh in koai in kap hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang Joseph in a suapui teng khat zawkciang khat kap kawmin ngawngkoai in namh hi. Tua zawkciang a suapuite ama taw thuson tu kipan hi."},"16":{"text":"Joseph suapuite hong paina thu kumpi inn sung dongah theng a, kumpipa le a uliante lungdam hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa in Joseph tungah, “A ngante vanh suanhin, Canaan ngam ah a heak kik natu in na suapuite sawl in."},"18":{"text":"A pa le a innkuanpuite puisak in a, hi lai ah pai kiksak in. Egypt ngam sungah leitang phabel sia amate ka pia tu a, amate nuntak khomna za sangin a tamzaw nei tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"A zite, a tanote le a pa to natu in Egypt pan leang a ken natu zongh son in."},"20":{"text":"Amate in a neisa te a nusiat tu sia thinbot heak hen; Egypt ngam bup leitang phabel sia amate aa hi tu hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Jacob tapate in a kisawl bangin ngamta hi. Kumpipa thupiak bangin Joseph in leangte le lampi a neak tu nguai an pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Joseph in amate puan laih natu zongh puansilh khat tek pia a, ahizong Benjamin sia ngunn dangka 300 le puan laih natu silh nga pia hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in Egypt ngam pan a piang na phabelte laa sawm ii puakkhop le antang, anluum le lampi a neak tu nguai an laa sawm ii puakkhop ma a pa thaak hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in a suapuite tha a, amate tungah, “Lampi ah kihau heak vun,” ci in vaitha hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate Egypt ngam pan dingin Canaan ngam a pa Jacob inn ah cia kik uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in a pa tungah, “Joseph nungta lai hi! Ama sia Egypt ngam theampo ukpa hi!” ci in son hi. Jacob in lamdangsa mama in um zo ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahizong Joseph ii kam vaithak teng a son ciang le ama Egypt ngam ah a pai natu in a kipuak, leangte a mu ciang, a pa ingh liangin a omna teng veng hi."},"28":{"text":"A pa in, “Ka tapa Joseph nungta tatak lai ziam! Ka kat sia tu teng ma hi ei! Ka thi ma in pai in va kimu nanak tong,” ci hi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jacob in a vanh nei theampo heangin Beersheba ah pai a, tua munah a pa Isaac ii Pathian tungah biakpiakna nei hi.","title":"Jacob le A Innkuanpuite Egypt ah Pai"},"2":{"text":"Tua zanin Jacob ii mukholna sungah Pathian in paupui a, “Jacob, Jacob awng!” ci in sam hi. Jacob in, “Hi hi, hi sungah om ing,” ci in zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in, “Keima in Pathian, na pa ii Pathian ka hi hi,” ci hi. “Egypt ah na pai tu sia lau heak in; na suan na paalte tualai ah minam lian khat in ka siam tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Egypt ah nangma taw kong paikhawm tu a, na suan na paalte hi ngam le lei ah kong ciapui kik tu hi. Na thi ciang Joseph sia nangma taw om tu hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Beersheba pan Jacob vaiding hi. A tate in a ma, a tanote le a zite, Egypt kumpipa ii a puaksak leangte tungah tosak hi."},"6":{"text":"Canaan ngam pan ngannote le a vanh nei teng taw kithoai in Egypt ngam zuan hi. Jacob in a suan a paal theampo ahi:","ref":"Sawl 7:15"},"7":{"text":"a tapate, a tupate, a tanute le a tunute a vekpi in paipui hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama taw Egypt a zuan Jacob ii innkuanpui teng sia a tapa lianbel Reuben,"},"9":{"text":"tuaciang Reuben ii tapate: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron le Carmi,"},"10":{"text":"Simeon le a tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar le Canaan numeinu ii tapa Shaul,"},"11":{"text":"Levi le a tapate: Gershon, Kohath le Merari,"},"12":{"text":"Judah le a tapate: Shelah, Perez le Zerah, (Judah ii tapa dangte Er le Onan hi a, Canaan ah thi uh hi.) Perez ii tapate: Hezron le Hamul,"},"13":{"text":"Issachar le a tapate: Tola, Puah, Jashub le Shimron,"},"14":{"text":"Zebulun le a tapate: Sered, Elon le Jahleel ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Hi tapa teng sia a tanu Dinah banah Jacob atu Leah ii Mesopotamia ah a nei tate ahi hi. Leah taw a nei a suan le a paal a vekpi in 33 pha hi."},"16":{"text":"Gad le a tapate: Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arod le Areli ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Asher le a tapate: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah le a suapuinu uh Serah ahi hi. Beriah ii tapate sia Heber le Malchiel ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Hi sawm le luk te sia Laban ii a tanu Leah a piak, a sila nu Zilpah taw a nei Jacob ii suan le paalte ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Jacob in a zi Rachel taw tapa nii nei a: Joseph le Benjamin ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Joseph in Heliopolis khua thiampi Potiphera ii tanu Asenath taw Egypt ah tapa nii nei a, Manasseh le Ephraim ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 41:50-52"},"21":{"text":"Benjamin ii tapate sia Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim le Ard ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Hi sawm le lite sia Jacob le Rachel suan le paalte ahi uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Dan le a tapa Hushim."},"24":{"text":"Naphtali le a tapate: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer le Shillem ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hi salite Laban ii a tanu Rachel a piak a sila nu Bilhah taw a hin, Jacob ii suan le paalte ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Egypt ah a pai Jacob ii a suan le a paalte a vekpi in 66 hi a, tuate sungah a tapate ii zite kihel ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Joseph in Egypt ah tapa nii nei a, Jacob innkuanpuite tua mun a thet ciang a vekpi in 70 pha uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:14"},"28":{"text":"Goshen ah Joseph ii amate a mua natu a son tu in, Jacob in Judah pai kholsak hi. Amate a thet ciang,","title":"Jacob le A Innkuanpuite Egypt ah"},"29":{"text":"Joseph, a siphu ngalleang tung to in a pa muak tu in Goshen ah pai hi. A kimu ciang Joseph in a pa ngawngkoai in ngei hialma kap hi."},"30":{"text":"Jacob in Joseph tungah, “Tu hile na meal kong mu zo a, na nuntak lai hunlam hong he zo ka hikom kei a thi tu kinging khi hi,” ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joseph in a suapuite le a pa innkuanpui dang teng tungah, “Kumpipa kungah ka na pai tu a, Canaan ah a teang ka suapuite le ka pa innkuanpui theampo ka kung hong zuan zo hi, ci in ka son tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Note sia tuucingte le ngan khoaite hi a, na tuute na ngante le na neisa dang teng theampo nong paipui uh sia ka son tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Kumpipa in note hong samin, bang na seam nu ziam ci in hong dok ciang,"},"34":{"text":"ka taanghpupite bangma in ka khan tawntungin ngankhoai na seam ung, na ci tu uh hi. Tuabang na ci uh ciang ama in Goshen ngam ah hong teangsak tu hi,” ci hi. Egypt te in tuucingte sia thu a sim ngawl ahikom Joseph in tu a bangin a ci ahi hi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Joseph sia a suapuite nga taw kumpipa kungah pai hi. Ama in, “Ka pa le ka suapuite Canaan ngam pan a tuute, a ngannote le a neisa teng theampo taw hong pai zo hi. Tu in amate Goshen ngam ah om uh hi,” ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in kumpipa mai ah a suapuite paipui hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Bang na seam nu ziam?” ci in amate dongh hi. Amate in, “Topa awng, ka taanghpupite bangma in tuucingte hi ung."},"4":{"text":"Canaan ngam ah nasia tak kialpi tung a, ngantha natu mun om ngawl ahikom hi ngam ah a teang tu in kong pai uh hi. Hesuakna taw Goshen ngamkhen ah ka teen thei natu uh in thu hong pia ta'n,” ci in zo uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa in Joseph tungah, “Tu in na pa le na suapuite hong theng zo ahiciang"},"6":{"text":"Egypt leitang sia amate aa hi. Leitang phabelna mun ahi, Goshen ah teang tahen. Amate sung pan naseam thiam a om le ka ngannote a uk tu in koi in,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Joseph in kumpipa mai ah a pa Jacob paipui in aap hi. Jacob in kumpipa thupha pia hi,"},"8":{"text":"tuaciang kumpipa in ama tungah, “Kum bangza pha ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"9":{"text":"Jacob in, “Vak kawkoai in ka nuntak zawk kum za le kum sawmthum pha zo hi. Ka taanghpupite ii kum tampi a vak kawkoai sia za zongh hi ngawl lai in, kum tawm napi ka haksa hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"10":{"text":"Jacob in kumpipa sia vaithakna thupha pia in nusia hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaciang Joseph in a pa le a suapuite kumpipa thupiak bangin Egypt ngamsung lei phabelna Rameses khuapi nai ah mun pia in teangsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Joseph in a pa, a suapuite le a pa innkuanpui dang teng theampo a moibel dongin an pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Kialpi nasia mama ahikom in mun theampo ah an om ngawl a, Egypt te le Canaan mite ngilkial in a tha hong zawm uh hi.","title":"Kialpi Hun Sung"},"14":{"text":"Joseph in mite ii an leina sum teng kaikhawmin kumpi inn sungah koi hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt le Canaan ah sum teng a kizak siat zawkciang Egypt te Joseph kungah pai in, “Ko an hong pia ta'n! Hong thisak heak in. Khat pawpo hong vaihawmpui ta'n! Ka sum uh teng bo siat zo hi,” ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Joseph in, “Na sumte a bo siat zo le na ngannote hong paipui tavun; an taw kitheak tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahiciang a ngannote Joseph kungah paipui uh a, ama in a siphute, a tuute, a kealte, a khuite le a laate thena in an pia hi. Tua kum in ama in a ngannote theampo a thena in an pia hi."},"18":{"text":"A kum kik ciang amate Joseph kungah pai in, “Topa awng, thumaan sia na maitang ah ka iim thei bua uh hi; ka sum uh theampo bo siat zo a, nganno theampo nangma aa hi zo hi. Ka pumpi uh le ka leitangte simngawl, kong piak tu bangma taang ngawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Hong thisak heak in. Khat pawpo hong vaihawmpui ta'n! Koma lote vaalthongsak heak in. Koma le ka leitang an taw hong lei ta'n. Kote, kumpipa ii sila suakin, ka leitang uh ama ii neisa hi tu hi. Ka nuntak natu in an hong pia ta'n a, lote ah ka ciin tu uh thaicii hong pia ta'n,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Joseph in Egypt leitang theampo kumpipa atu in lei hi. Kialpi nasia mama ahikom Egypt mi theampo a leitang a zuak ngawlin phamaw a; tuaciang leitang theampo kumpipa ii neisa suak siat hi."},"21":{"text":"Joseph in Egypt ngam mong khat pan mong khat dong mihingte sila suaksak hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in thiampite neisa leitang bekma lei ngawl hi. Kumpipa in amate nuntak khom natu an pia ahikom a leitangte zuak kul ngawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Joseph in mite tungah, “Na mu uh bangin, tu in note le na leitangte kumpipa atu in kong lei zo hi. Na lo ah na ciin tu anciite hi sungah om hi."},"24":{"text":"Anlaak hun ciang see nga sua see khat kumpipa na pia tu uh hi. A om lai teng sia, thaicii tu le noma le na innkuanpuite ii anneak tu in zangh thei tu nu hi,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate in, “Nangma in kote nuntakna nong hun zo a; kote tungah nong thuthiam hi, topa awng, tuaciang kote sia kumpipa ii sila ka hi tu uh hi,” ci in zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Joseph in Egypt leitang taw kisai, lo an a piangte ii see nga sua see khat kumpipa ii neisa a sua thei natu thukham khat vawt hi. Hi thukham sia tuni dongin kizangh lai hi. Thiampite leitang bek kumpipa ii neisa suak ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Israel te Egypt ngam Goshen ah teang a, tua munah amate hau in, ta tam mama nei uh hi.","title":"Jacob ii A khakbel Hesuak ngetna"},"28":{"text":"Jacob kum 147 a phak dong Egypt ah kum sawm le kum sali sung teang hi."},"29":{"text":"A thi tu hun a nai ciang ama in a tapa Joseph samin, “Ka phei kawmah na khut koi in, Egypt ah nong phum ngawl natu in kiciamna khat vawt in.","ref":"Pian 49:29-32; 50:6"},"30":{"text":"Ka pate thaan ah kiphum nuam khi hi; Egypt ngamsung pan hong tua ta'n a, amate thaan ah hong phum ta'n,” ci hi. Joseph in, “Nong ci bangin ka vawt tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Jacob in, “Ka vawt nanak tu hi ci in hong kiciam ta'n,” ci hi. Joseph in kiciamna vawt a, tuaciang Jacob sia a lupna tungah lungdamko hi."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hun khat zawkciang a pa dam ngawlna thu Joseph tungah kison hi. Tua ahiciang a tapate nii, Manasseh le Ephraim taw a pa ve tu in pai uh hi.","title":"Jacob in Ephraim le Manasseh Thupha Pia"},"2":{"text":"Jacob tungah na tapa Joseph in hong ve tu in hong pai hi, ci in a kison ciang, ama in a tha saanin lupna tungah toto hi."},"3":{"text":"Jacob in Joseph tungah, “Canaan ngam Luz khua ah Vaanglianbelpa Pathian in kei tungah hong kilangh a, thupha hong pia hi.","ref":"Pian 28:13-14"},"4":{"text":"Pathian in kei tungah, ‘Ta tam mama kong pia tu hi, tuabangin na suan na paalte sia minam tam mama te suak tu uh hi; keima in na suan na paalte tungah a tawntung a nei tu in hi leitang ka pia tu hi,’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Jacob in a pau zomin, “Joseph awng, hi lai ah kong pai ma in Egypt ah na nei na tapa niite keima aa hi; Reuben le Simeon bangma in Ephraim le Manasseh te sia keima tapate ma ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tapa a tamzaw na nei lai le amate sia kei aa ci in kingaisun ngawl tu a; a nga uh ngamhluana sia Ephraim le Manasseh tungtawnin hong pai tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Na nu Rachel hangin hi bangin ka vawt ahi hi. Mesopotamia pan ka heakkik lai in, Canaan ngamsung Ephrath khua taw kikhuala ngawlna ah ka khuangaibel natu in na nu hong thi hi. Ephrath paina lamhui ah ama ka phum hi,” ci hi. (Ephrath sia tu in Bethlehem kici hi.)","ref":"Pian 35:16-19"},"8":{"text":"Jacob in Joseph tapate a mu ciang, “Hi panote akua te ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"9":{"text":"Joseph in, “Ka tapate hi, hi lai Egypt pan Pathian hong piak hi,” ci in zo hi. Jacob in, “Thupha ka piak thei natu in ka kungah hong paipui ta'n,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"A kum tam zo ahikom Jacob ii mitte mang zo a, pha takin khuamu thei nawn ngawl hi. Joseph in a tapano te a kungah paipui a, a pa in amate koai in namh hi."},"11":{"text":"Jacob in Joseph tungah, “Nang hong mu kik tu in ka kimuangmaw ngei bua a, tu in Pathian in na tate ngawngawn hong musak hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joseph in Jacob kaang pan a amate la in, a pa mai lei ah kun hi."},"13":{"text":"Joseph in Jacob veisang ah Ephraim, a ziatsang ah Manasseh koi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahizong Jacob in a khutte kithatheaksak in, a nau zaw hi napi Ephraim lu tungah a khut ziatsang nga in, a uzaw Manasseh tungah a khut veisang nga hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in Joseph thupha pia hi; “Ka pate ahi Abraham le Isaac te ii a na a sepsak Pathian in hi panote thupha pia tahen! Tuni dongin keima lam hong pui Pathian in amate thupha pia tahen!"},"16":{"text":"Natna satna theampo panin keima hong suatak vantunglalang in amate thupha pia tahen! Hi panote tungtawnin keima min le ka pate ahi Abraham le Isaac min nungta top tahen! Amate in ta tam mama nei in suan le paal tam mama nei tahen!”"},"17":{"text":"A pa in a khut ziatsang Ephraim lu tungah a koi, a mu ciang Joseph a thinnuam ngawl hi; tua ahikom Joseph in a pa khut, Ephraim lu tung pan Manasseh lu tungah khiin tu in la hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in a pa tungah, “Pa awng, tuabang hi ngawl hi. Hi sia ta uzaw hi a, na khut ziatsang a lu tungah koi in,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"A pa in nial a, “He khi hi, ka tapa awng, he khi hi. Manasseh ii suan le paalte zongh minam lian khat suak veve tu hi. Ahizong a naupa in ama sang in lian zaw tu a, ama suan le paalte minam liante suak tu hi,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuabangin Jacob in tua ni in amate thupha pia a, “Israel mite in thupha a piak uh ciang na minte zangh tu hi. Hi bangin Jacob in Manasseh mai ah Ephraim koi hi.","ref":"Heb 11:21"},"21":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jacob in Joseph tungah, “Nong mu bangin kei thi nai tu khi hi, ahizong Pathian in nang hong panpui tu a, na taanghpupite ii ngam le lei ah hong ciapui kik tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Amor mite tung pan ka namsau le ka thal taw ka laak, leipha ngam Shechem sia na suapuipate atu hi ngawlin nangma atu kong piak ahi hi."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jacob in a tapate samin, “Hong kikhawmtua tavun, mai sangah note tung a hong piang tu thu kong son tu hi:","title":"Jacob ii Kammal Khakbelte"},"2":{"text":"“Jacob ii tapate awng hong paikhawm tek tavun a, hong ngai tavun. Na pa Israel thu son ngai vun."},"3":{"text":"“Ka taciil Reuben awng, nang sia ka thahatna Tuaciang pasal ka tanna in, ka ta masabel na hi a, ka tapa teng sung pan a kiphasakbel le a thahatbel na hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang in tuipawm khat taw na kibang a, Ahizong a thupibel na hi buatu hi, Banghang ziam cile ka zino na luppui a, na pa ii lupna na paksak hi."},"5":{"text":"“Simeon le Levi unau khat na hi uh hi. A ngalhiamte ngongtatna in zangh uh hi."},"6":{"text":"A thuku sonna ah ka kihel buatu a, A kikhopna ah ka kipawl buatu hi, Banghang ziam cile a thin uuk uh ciang mihing that a, Kimaina in khuitalte ii a peangbaisak hi."},"7":{"text":"A thin uukna ah haamsiatna thuak hen, banghang ziam cile a thin uukna nasia leih hi. A thinsona ah haamsiatna thuak hen, banghang ziam cile a thinso nasia leih hi. Israel ngam sungah amate ka thethaang tu hi. A mipuite sungah amate ka khentham tu hi."},"8":{"text":"“Judah awng na suapui te in nang hong pok tu hi. Na ngalte a ngawng pan na man hi.
