Kuama in ama nawngkaisak ngam ngawl hi.","ref":"Mi 24:9; Tpl 5:5"},"10":{"text":"Judah in kumpi ciangkhut len tu a, A suan a paalte in ngamuk tawntung tu hi. Minamte in ama tungah phiangshia puak tu a, Thunitna taw ama mai ah kun tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in a laano sia sapitkung khat ah khit a, Sapitkung phabel sia tung ahi hi. Ama in a puante chi bangin a san sapittui sungah sawp hi."},"12":{"text":"Sapittui a neakna in a mitte san ngingu a, Noai a neakna in a hate paak hi."},"13":{"text":"“Zebulun sia tuipi hui ah teang tu hi. A tuipi vaal sia teambawte tawlngakna khat hi tu hi. A ngam Sidon ciang dong theng tu hi."},"14":{"text":"“Issachar sia a tung tona ipte kawm ah kizia in a lum, Laa khat sangin phazaw ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahizong ama in a tawlngakna mun ii phatna mu a A ngam a lei nuamsa hi. Tua ahiciang a nungzaang ah vanh pua tu in ama kunsuk a, Sila khat bangin na kiseamsak hi."},"16":{"text":"“Dan sia a mipuite ii a ukpa hi tu hi. Amate Israel minam dangte bangma hi tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Dan sia lampi hui ah a om ngul khat, lamzin hui ah a om ngul ngu nei khat hi tu a, Tua ngul in siphu khuatul pan tu hi, A tungto pa a nung sangah a kilot thal natu hi."},"18":{"text":"“ Topa awng, nong hut tu ka ngak hi."},"19":{"text":"“Phalakte pawlkhat in Gad sim tu a, ahizong Gad in amate kileesak kikin sul zui tu hi."},"20":{"text":"“Asher ii leitang pan an tam mama piang tu hi. Kumpi khat ii neak tu in a kilawm an, ama in pia tu hi."},"21":{"text":"“Naphtali sia a ithuai tanote a nei, a tai vavil sangai khat ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"“Joseph sia ciktui hui khat ah a om ngamlaa khat taw kibang a, Mualpangh ah a om ngam siphuno khat taw kibang hi."},"23":{"text":"A ngalte in nasia takin sim a, A thal le a thaltangte taw del hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahizong Jacob ii Pathian Vaanglianbelpa ii vaangletna le Israel a Dal pa, Tuucingpa hangin A thal kinging top a, A khutte a tha kihatsak hi."},"25":{"text":"Nang hong hu, na pa ii Pathian, Thupha hong pia Vaanglianbelpa Pathian in Vantung pan thupha ngua taw Leinuai tawngh pan tui taw Khoai le vul tam mama, tu le ta tam mama thuphate taw,"},"26":{"text":"thupha antangte le paakte, Taanghlai mualte ii thuphate, Tawntung mualte panin, nopsakna te, Hi thupha teng Joseph ii lu tungah A suapuite sung pan a kituam koi pa ii mitkhu tungah tawlnga in, tung siat tahen."},"27":{"text":"“Benjamin sia a hang mama ngiapui khat taw kibang hi. Zing le nitak sa thatlum in ne tum hi,” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Hi te sia Israel minam sawm le niite hi a, hi thu sia amate tetek taw a kiphu a kilawm tu in a son a pa ii a tapa khat sim tungah vaithakna kammal ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jacob in a tapate tungah, “Tu in ka mipuite thina ah a pai tu ka hi a, ka pate taw in suanghawng thaankhuk ah hong phumkhawm tavun, tua thaankhuk sia Hit mi Ephron ii lo sung hi a,","title":"Jacob Thi na le Kivuina"},"30":{"text":"Canaan ngam Mamre ii nisuana sang Machpelah ah om hi. Abraham in hi thaankhuk le lo sia thaan mun tu in Ephron tung pan lei hi.","ref":"Pian 23:3-20"},"31":{"text":"Tua munah amate in Abraham le a zi Sarah; Isaac le a zi Rebecca phum a; tuaciang keima in Leah ka phum hi.","ref":"Pian 25:9-10; Pian 35:29"},"32":{"text":"Tua lo le thaankhuk sia Hit mite tung pan a kilei ahi hi. Tua munah hong phum tavun,” ci in thupia hi."},"33":{"text":"Jacob in a tapate a vaithak zawkciang, ama lumsuk kikin thi hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:15"}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joseph, a pa tungah kisepsuk a, kapin a pa maitang namh hi."},"2":{"text":"Tuaciang Joseph in a pa luang a muat ngawl natu vawt tu in thupia hi."},"3":{"text":"A luang muat ngawl natu nasepna sia a ngeina bangin ni 40 sung hai hi. Egypt mite sia ama atu in ni 70 sung khuangai in kap uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Khuangai hunte a ven ciang, Joseph in kumpipa ii uliante tungah, “Hesuakna in kumpipa tungah hi thu hong sonsak tavun:"},"5":{"text":"‘Ka pa a thi mahiat in Canaan ngamsung, ama atu in a kinginna sa thaankuul ah ka phum natu in kamciamna hong vawtsak hi. Tua ahiciang hesuakna in ka pa a phum tu in hong paisak ta'n, tua zawkciang kong cia kik tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 47:29-31"},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Kamciamna na vawt bangin, pai in na pa phum ta'n,” ci in zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Joseph a pa phum tu in pai hi. Kumpipa ii ulian theampo, ama zumsung upate le Egypt ngam lampuite theampo Joseph taw pai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama ii innkuanpui, a suapuipate le a pa ii innkuanpui a om lai teng theampo ama taw pai uh hi. A tanote, a tuute, a kealte le a khuite bek ma Goshen ngam ah taang hi."},"9":{"text":"Siphu ngalleang tung le siphu tung a to mihingte zongh ama taw pai tek uh a; mihing tam peuma hi."},"10":{"text":"Jordan ngun nisuana sangah a om Atad ancilna mun a thet ciang, amate ngei hialpo khuangai in nging takin kap uh hi, tuaciang Joseph in ni sali sung khuangai kaana hun in zangh hi."},"11":{"text":"Canaan ngammite in Atad ah tua mihingte khuangai in kap a mu ciangin, “Egypt te in a ciliap huai khuangai kaana nasia takin vawt hi ta a!” ci uh hi. Tua ahikom tua mun sia Abel Mizraim kici hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Jacob thupiak bangin a tapate in seam uh hi;"},"13":{"text":"amate in Canaan ngam ah a pa luang pua in thaan mun tu in Abraham ii Hit mi Ephron tung pan a lei, Mamre nisuana sangah a om Machpelah lo sung thaankuul ah phum uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:16"},"14":{"text":"A pa a phum zawkciang Joseph, a suapuite le mithi phumna ah a zui theampo taw Egypt ah cia kik uh hi."},"15":{"text":"A pa thi zawkciang Joseph suapuite in, “Joseph in hong ngaimaw lai hen a, ama tungah siatna ih vawt theampo thuk kik hong sawm thong le bang law tu ziam?” ci uh hi.","title":"Joseph in A Suapuite Thinnuamsak"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in Joseph tungah, “Ih pa a thi ma in,"},"17":{"text":"ama in, ‘Na suapuite ii nang tung a kong vawt khialna lian sia hesuakna taw maisak ta'n,’ ci in nang tungah hesuak ngen vun hong ci hi. Tu in na pa ii Pathian naseam kote ii vawt khialna sia pan hesuakna taw hong maisak ta'n,” ci in kam vaitha uh hi. Joseph sia hi kam vaithak a zaak ciang kap hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a suapuite hong pai in, ama mai ah kun uh hi. Amate in, “Hi lai na mai ah na silate bangin om ung,” ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahizong Joseph in amate tungah, “Lau heak vun; Pathian dinmun ah keima le keima kikoi thei ngawl khi hi."},"20":{"text":"Note in a sia nong sawm uh hi, ahizong tua thupiang sia hu in tuni a, a nungta mihing tam mama te ii nuntakna a huu tu in, Pathian in tuasia a pha lam in hong heisak hi."},"21":{"text":"Bangma no lau natu om ngawl hi. Note le na tate kong khoi tu hi,” ci hi. Tuabangin Joseph in a suapuite thinsung lungsung kha tu in kamthiam kamneam zanghin a suapuite thinnuamsak hi."},"22":{"text":"Joseph, a pa innkuanpuite taw Egypt ah teang khawm tan a; kum 110 a phak ciang thi hi.","title":"Joseph Thina"},"23":{"text":"Ama in Ephraim ii tate le tute a mu dong nungta hi. Ama in Manasseh ii tapa Machir ii tate zongh a nuntak lai in ama innkuanpui in nei hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in a suapuite tungah, “Kei a thi nai tu ka hi hi, ahizong Pathian in note hong keam tatak tu a, hi ngam pan, Abraham, Isaac le Jacob te tungah a ciliap huai takin a kamciamna ngam ah hong paipui nanak tu hi,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joseph in a mite kiciamna khat vawt tu in sawl hi. Ama in, “Pathian in tua ngam ah hong paipui ciangin noma taw ka luang paipui tu khu hi ci in hong kamciam tavun,” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 13:19; Jos 24:32; Heb 11:22"},"26":{"text":"Tuabangin Joseph kum 110 a phak ciang Egypt ngam ah thi hi. Amate in Joseph luang a muat thei ngawl natu in vawtin, mithi kuang khat sungah koi hi."}}}}},"2":{"info":{"name":"Pusuana","shortname":"Exod","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt ah a innkuan puite tek le Jacob taw a pai, Jacob tapate sia,","title":"Israel te Egypt ah Kivawtsia"},"2":{"text":"Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah,"},"3":{"text":"Issachar, Zebulun, Benjamin,"},"4":{"text":"Dan, Naphtali, Gad le Asher ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 46:8-27"},"5":{"text":"Jacob suan hi mite a vekpi in 70 pha hi. A tapa Joseph sia Egypt ah omkhol zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Khua hong ngei vaial ciang Joseph, a suapuite le a khanngual a om laite theampo thi siat hi,"},"7":{"text":"ahizong amate suan le paal Israel te in ta tam mama nei in pung a, Egypt ngam sungah dimin thahat mama uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:17"},"8":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joseph ii thu a he ngeingawl kumpi thak khat Egypt ngam ah hong khang hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:18"},"9":{"text":"Ama in a mite tungah, “Hi Israel te pung mama in, thahat ahiciang ei atu in lauhuai hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngal om luilam thong le, ei hong sim tu in ih ngalte taw kipawl in, ngamsung pan suakta tha tu hi. Amate hong tam vaial ngawl natu in, ih khaam zawk natu lampi zong tawng,” ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:19"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Egypt te in a thinno thei natu in nasep ham seamsak a, amate tungah sila ukte koi hi. Kumpipa an khol natu in Israel te in Pithom le Rameses khuapite saat uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahizong Egypt te in Israel te a nenniam vaial ciang, Israel te pung vaial in, ngamsung teng ah kizel seseam hi. Egypt te in Israel te hong kiita hi,"},"13":{"text":"tuaciang nuntak man om ngawl za dongin zawthawk vawt a, sal ngimngate suaksak uh hi. Amate in a inn saknate ah le a lote sungah naseamsakin, hesuak vet ngawl uh hi.","merge":"14"},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang Egypt kumpipa in Hebrew nupite nausuaksak syama niite ahi, Shiphrah le Puah tungah thu sonpui hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in, “Hebrew nupite nau na suasak uh ciang, a nau sia pa ahile thatlum vun a; ahizong numei ahile nungtasak vun,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahizong nausuaksak syamate in Pathian kiita ahikom kumpipa thu ni ngawl hi; amate in panote nungtasak hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaciang kumpipa in nausuaksak syamate samin thu dongh a, “Banghang hi bang ngamta nu ziam? Banghangin panote nungtasak nu ziam?” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in, “Hebrew numeite Egypt numeite taw kibang ngawl hi; amate ol takin nausuak a, ko thet ma in a nau suak zo uh hi,” ci in zo uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Nausuaksak syamate in Pathian kiita ahikom, Pathian amate tungah pha in, amate suan le paal pia in innkuan tek neisak hi. Tuaciang Israel te pung tawto in, thahat hi.","merge":"21"},"22":{"text":"A khakbel ciang kumpipa in a mite theampo thupia a: “Hebrew pano suaktuung theampo la vun a, Nile ngun sungah vawk vun, ahizong numei theampo nungtasak vun,” ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:19"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hunsung in Levi minamte pasal khat in ama minampui numei khat teenpui a,","title":"Moses ii Suana"},"2":{"text":"tua nu in tapa khat neipui hi. A tasen bangza in pha cisia a nu in a mu ciang tha thum sung a tapa phual hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:20; Heb 11:23"},"3":{"text":"Ahizong a nu in a tapa a phual zawk nawn ngawl ciangin, pumpa taw kivawt khum khat la in, tui a tum thei ngawl natu in, kattaza taw zut hi. A nu in tuasung ah nauno sialin, ngunhui lopa thukna ah koi hi."},"4":{"text":"Nauno ii suapuinu in a khuala thithimna ah dingin, bang a tat ziam ci in en hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa tanu kibual tu in ngun sungah tuak hi, tua laitakin a naseamte ahile ngundung ah vak uh hi. Thakhat thu in ama in lopa thukna ah a om tua khum mu a, a sila numei khat tua khum la tu in sawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa tanu in tua khum hong a, nausen pano khat mu hi. Tua nauno kakap ahiciang ama in khuangaihuai sa hi. Ama in, “Hi sia Hebrew nausen khat hi ta a,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuasia ciang nauno suapuinu in, “Hi nauno a omh tu in, Hebrew nupi khat kong sam tu ziam?” ci in tua nu dongh hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa tanu in, “Hesuakna taw hong sapsak ta'n,” ci in zo hi. Tuaciang numeino sia pai in nausen ii a nu hong paipui hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumpipa tanu in tua nu tungah, “Hi nausen la in a, kei atu in hong opsak ta'n, na thaman kong pia tu hi,” ci hi. Tua ahiciang tua nu in nausen la a, opsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Patang hong khan ciang, a nu in kumpipa tanu kungah paipui a, kumpipa tanu in ama tapa sua hi. Kumpipa tanu in, “Tui sung pan ka laak ahiciang a min Moses ka phuak hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:21"},"11":{"text":"Moses hong let ciang, a mipui Hebrew te kungah haw in, zawthawk thu taw a kisawl nasep haksa a sepsaknate mu hi. Egypt te khat in Moses ii mipui Hebrew mi khat a thalup ngawngawn mu hi.","title":"Midian ah Moses Suakta","ref":"Heb 11:24"},"12":{"text":"Moses in a kiim a paam enin, ama a en kuama a mu ngawl ciang Egypt mi pa thatlum in a luang sen sungah phual hi."},"13":{"text":"A zing ciang ama pai kik a, Hebrew te nii kihau mu hi. Ama in a khial pa tungah, “Banghangin na Hebrew mipui sia pa saat ni ziam?” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua pa in, “Kote hong uk tu le thukhen tu in, akua in nang hong koi ziam? Egypt mipa na thalup bangin kei hong that tu ni ziam?” ci in zo hi. Tuasia ciang Moses lau a, “Ka ngamtatna teng ngual in hong mu zo hi ta a maw,” ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:23-28"},"15":{"text":"Tua thupiang teng kumpipa in a zaak ciang Moses thalup tu in zongsak a, ahizong Moses sia Midian ngam ah teang tu in tai hi. Ni khat, Moses tuikhuk khat paam ah a to laitak, Midian thiampi Jethro ii tanu salite tuitoai tu in hong pai uh a, a pa ii tuu le kealte atu in tuikuang teng tui dimh hi.","merge":"16","ref":"Sawl 7:29; Heb 11:27"},"17":{"text":"Ahizong tuucing pawlkhatte in Jethro tanute notkeak uh hi. Tuaciang Moses in amate suatakin, a ngannote tui piaksak hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate a pa kungah a cia uh ciang, a pa in, “Banghang tuni hong cia pal nu ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in, “Egypt te khat in tuucingte khut sung pan hong suatakin, ko atu in tui ngawngawn hong toaisak a, ih ngannote tui hong piaksak hi,” ci in zo uh hi."},"20":{"text":"A pa in a ta numeite tungah, “Tua pa koi sungah om ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Banghangin tua pa tualai ah nusia nu ziam? Pai tavun a, eima taw an nekhawm tu in sam tavun,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuabangin tualai ah a teang tu in Moses thukim ahikom, Jethro in a tanu Zipporah taw kiteangsak hi,"},"22":{"text":"Zipporah in tapa khat neipui hi. Moses in, “Hi ngam ah ngamdangmi khat suak ka hi ciang, a min Gershom ka phuak tu hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Kum tampi zawkciang Egypt kumpipa thi a, ahizong Israel te a saltanna hangin thuumin, tau a, hu ngenin kap lai uh hi. A kaana awte Pathian kung thengin,"},"24":{"text":"ama in amate taunate a zaak ciang Abraham, Isaac le Jacob taw a thuciamna phawk hi.","ref":"Pian 15:13-14"},"25":{"text":"Ama in Israel te saltanna mu in, amate atu in thinbot hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in Midian thiampi, a sunghpa Jethro ii tuu le kealte cingin a om laitak ni khat ni in a ngannote sennealngam kaantanpui in mual thiangtho Sinai theng hi.","title":"Pathian in Moses Sam"},"2":{"text":"Tualai ah Topa vantunglalang sia sawlpaang khat ii sung pan a pusuak meikuang khat bangin ama kungah kilangh hi. Moses in sawlpaang a kaangh in mu a, ahizong sawlpaang sia kaanghtum ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in, “Hi sia paw lamdang ei! Banghang sawlpaang sia kaanghtum ngawl ziam? Kei pai in, a nai neakin va en tong,” ci in ngaisun hi."},"4":{"text":"Moses ii a nai a neak vaial Topa in a mu ciang Topa in sawlpaang sung pan, “Moses! Moses!” ci in sam hi. Ama in, “Hi khi hi, keima hilai ah om khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian in, “A naizaw in hong neak heak in. Na peangdap suut in, banghang ziam cile mun thiangtho tungah ding ni hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in na taanghpupite ii Pathian, Abraham, Isaac le Jacob te ii Pathian ka hi hi,” ci hi. Tua ahiciang Moses in a mai hum hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian en ngam ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa in, “Egypt ah ka mite bang zata vawtsiatna thuak cisia ka mu zo hi, sila ukte khut sung pan suakta nuam in a kaana aw zongh ka za zo hi. A ngim thuakna theampo ka he siat hi,"},"8":{"text":"tua ahiciang Egypt te khut sung pan a hun tu le Egypt pan la in lei phana le ngam zaina munah a paipui tu in kong tuaksuk zo hi, tua ngam sia a zai, a hau le leihoi leipha hi a, tu in Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite le Jebus mite teang uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka mite kaana aw ka za takpi zo a, Egypt te ii a zawthawk vawtzia zongh ka mu zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu in ka mite Egypt ngam pan lam na pui thei natu in, a kumpipa kungah nangma kong puak tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:30-34"},"11":{"text":"Ahizong Moses in Pathian tungah, “Kei sia bangma ka hi bua hi. Kumpipa kungah pai in Israel te Egypt pan bangbang paipui thei thong tu khi ziam?” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Pathian in, “Nang taw kong omkhawm tu a, Egypt pan Israel te na paipui ciang, hi mual tungah nong bia tu hi. Tuasia in nangma hong paisak tatak ka hina, a kilakna hi tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahizong Moses in, “Kei Israel te kungah pai in, ‘Na taanghpupite ii Pathian in note kungah kei hong paisak hi,’ ka ci ciang, ‘Ama min akua ziam’ ci in amate in kei hong dongh tu hi. Tua ahikom bangbang son thei tu khi ziam?” ci kik hi.","ref":"Pu 6:2-3"},"14":{"text":"Pathian in, “Keima sia Keima ka hi hi. Amate tungah hisia na son hamtang tu hi: ‘KEIMA a kici khat in note kungah kei hong paisak hi.’","ref":"Tpl 1:4,8"},"15":{"text":"Keima, Topa a taanghpupite ii Pathian, Abraham, Isaac le Jacob te ii Pathian in amate kungah nang kong paisak sia Israel te tungah son in. Hi sia in a tawntung ka min hi; maisang hong piang tu khang theampo in hi bangin keima hong sam tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Pai in a, Israel lampuite kaikhawmin, Keima Topa a taanghpupite ii Pathian, Abraham, Isaac le Jacob te ii Pathian in note mai ah hong kilangh ka hi sia amate tungah son in. Amate kungah ka pai zo a, Egypt te ii amate tungah a vawtna teng ka mu hunlam amate son in."},"17":{"text":"Nasia tak vawtsiat a thuakna Egypt pan amate ka pusua pui tu a, leihoi leiphana mun — Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Periz mite, Hiv mi te le Jebus mite teenna ngam ah amate paipui tu in ka khensat zo hi."},"18":{"text":"“Ka mite in nangma thuson hong ngai tu uh hi. Tua zawkciang Israel lampuite taw Egypt kumpipa kungah pai in a, ama tungah, ‘Hebrew te ii Pathian Topa sia kote tungah ama le ama hong kilaak zo hi. Tu in sennealngam sungah Topa, kote Pathian tungah sangaw biakpiakna ka piak thei natu uh in, kote ni thum sung khual hong hawsak ta'n,” ci tu ni hi."},"19":{"text":"Zawthawk thu taw a kisawl bua nale Egypt kumpipa in note hong paisak ngawl tu cisia ka he hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahizong ka vaangletna zanghin, a lauhuai nate tua munah ka vawtna taw Egypt daan ka pia tu hi. Tua zawkciang ama in note hong paisak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"“Ka mite a pai ciang, khut nguak masuan in a pai ngawl natu in Egypt te in note kong upatsak tu hi.","ref":"Pu 12:35-36"},"22":{"text":"Israel numei theampo in a innpaam Egypt te le a innkuanpui Egypt numei pawpo kungah pai in nik le puan, khamh le ngunn, suang manphate na ngen tu uh hi. Israel te in tua nate a tapate a tanute in silhsakin, Egypt te hauna teng laaksak siat tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Moses in Topa tungah, “Ahizong Israel te in kei hong um ngawlin ka thuson hong ngai ngawl tu ci tawng. Amate in nang tungah Topa hong kilangh ngawl hi, hong ci thong le bangbang hi tu khi ziam?” ci in zo hi.","title":"Pathian in Moses A lamdang Vaang Pia"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Topa in, “Nang bang toai ni ziam,” ci in dongh hi. Ama in, “Ciangkhut khat toai khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in, “Na ciangkhut lei ah lawn in,” ci hi. Moses in a ciangkhut a lot ciang ngul khat suakin, tua sia kung pan Moses tai hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa in Moses tungah, “Kunsuk in a, a mei pan zamh in,” ci hi. Tuaciang Moses in kunsuk in man a, ciangkhut suak kik hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in, “Amate taanghpupite ii Pathian, Abraham, Isaac le Jacob te ii Pathian nang tungah hong kilangh ahi hunlam sia Israel te ii tel natu in hi bangin vawt in,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Na khut na puan sungah koi in,” ci kik hi. Moses in a thu ni hi; a khut a laak kik ciang a khut tungah vuuk bangin a kaangpawl ciptepte in tuam hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa in, “Na khut na puan sungah koi kik in,” ci hi. Moses in koi kikin, a laak kik ciang a pumpi dangte taw kibangin dam kik hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in, “Amate in nalamdang lakna a khatna sia taw hong um thei buale zong tu a sia taw in nang hong um tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi nalamdang lakna niite taw zongh hong um zo bualai a, na thu hong ngai ngawlin hong nial le, Nile ngun pan tui tawm la in lei ah sung in. Tua tui sia chisan suak tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahizong Moses in, “Hi thei bo, Topa awng kei hong sawl heak in. Thu son ka thiam ngei bua a, nangma nong paupui ciil a kipan tu dong thuson ka thiam tuan bua hi, kampau ka thiam bua hi, ka aw tawn in ka pau awk hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Mihingte ii kam le muk akua in pia ziam? Akua in nangong le kampau thei ngawlin vawt ziam? Akua in khua musak a, akua in mittawsak ziam? Tua in Topa Keima ka hi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu in, va pai ta'n! Na kampau kong hu tu a, na thuson tu kong hil tu hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahizong Moses in, “Hi thei bo, Topa awng, nong hesuakna in midang khat pawpo sawl zaw ta'n,” ci in zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Moses tungah Topa thin uuk a, “Levi mi, na suapuipa Aaron bangbangziam? Ama pha tak a pau thei sia ka he hi. A tatakin ci leang nang taw kimu tu in, tu in ama hong pai a, nang hong mu tu lawp mama tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama tungah thu son thei tu ni hi, a son tu teng hil in. Na nii in na thuson kong hu tu a, na vawt tu uh teng kong hil khawm tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama sia nang taang in a paupa hi tu a, mite tungah thuson tu hi. Tuasia ciang nangma Pathian bang na hi tu a, a ci tu teng na son tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Hi ciangkhut keng ta'n; banghang ziam cile tuasia taw nalamdang laknate na vawt tu hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Moses sia a sunghpa Jethro kungah pai kik in ama tungah, “Egypt ngam ah ka mealheakte a nungta lai ziam maw a vil tu in nong hesuakna in hong ciasak ta'n,” ci hi. Jethro thukim a ciidam in va cia ta'n ci hi.","title":"Egypt ah Moses Heak kik"},"19":{"text":"Midian ah Moses a om lai in Topa in, “Egypt ah heak kik ta'n, nang hong that nuamte thi siat zo hi,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaciang Moses in a zi le a tapate a laate tungah tosakin Egypt zuan uh hi, Pathian ii a sawl ciangkhut sia keng hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Tu in Egypt ah cia kik tu na hi ciang nalamdang lakna theampo a vawt thei tu in vaangletna kong piaksa hi a, kumpipa mai ah vawt tatak tu ni hi. Ahizong kumpipa thin ka sahsak tu a, ama in mihingte paisak ngawl tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuasia ciang nangma in kumpipa tungah, keima Topa in ‘Israel sia ka tapaciil hi."},"23":{"text":"Keima hong biak thei natu in ka tapa paisak in, hong ci khi hi, ahihang nong nial hi. Tu in, na tapaciil thatlum tu khi hi,’ ci in na son tu hi” ci kik hi.","ref":"Pu 12:29"},"24":{"text":"Egypt paina lampi, ngiaphual ah Topa in Moses taw kimu in thalup sawm hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuasia ciang a zi Zipporah in suanghiam khat la in a tapa ii vunteap attansak a, tuasia taw Moses ii peang kithuthasak hi. Vunteap at ngeina zeksa hangin a zi in Moses tungah, “Nang sia kei tungah chisan taw kipawl ka pasal hi ni hi!” ci hi. Tua ahikom, Topa in Moses ii nuntakna khoaikhe hi.","merge":"26"},"27":{"text":"Tua hunsung in Topa in Aaron tungah, “Moses taw kimu tu in, sennealngam sungah pai in,” ci hi. A sawl bangin mual thiangtho ah pai a; Moses taw a kimu ciangin namh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaciang Moses in Egypt ah heakkik in a ci lai a, Topa kam vaithak theampo le Topa ii sep tu in a sawl nalamdang lakna tu thute zongh Aaron tungah son siat hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Moses le Aaron Egypt ah paikhawmin Israel lampuite theampo kaikhawm uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Topa ii Moses tungah a thuson teng Aaron in amate tungah son kik siat hi, tua zawkciang Moses in mite mai ah nalamdang lakna theampo vawt hi."},"31":{"text":"Amate in um uh hi. Amate kungah Topa pai in kivawtsiatna a thuaknate Topa ii a mu sakna thu teng a zaak uh ciang amate kunin Topa bia uh hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang Moses le Aaron Egypt kumpipa kungah pai in, “ Topa Israel te ii Pathian in, ‘Ka mite sennealngam ah kei zatak piakna poai khat a khaam thei natu in paisak in’ hong ci hi,” ci hi.","title":"Egypt Kumpipa Mai ah Moses le Aaron"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “ Topa sia akua ziam? Banghangin ama thu ngai in Israel te paisak tu khi ziam? Tua Topa ka he bua hi; Israel te ka paisak buatu hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in, “Hebrew te Pathian sia kote tungah ama le ama hong kilangh zo hi. Topa ka Pathian tungah sangaw biakna pia tu in ni thum sung sennealngam ah hong paisak ta'n. Tuabang ka hi bua uh le ama in natna taw ahibuale ngal taw in kote hong thatlum tu hi,” ci in zo kik uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in Moses le Aaron tungah, “Mipite in a nasep a nusiat natu in na vaihawm uh sia bang na cinopna uh ziam? Naseam tu in hi salte kuansak kik vun!"},"5":{"text":"Egypt te sangin no tam phazaw zo nu hi. Tu in a nasep tawlngasak nuam nu ziam!” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ni ma in kumpipa in sal a uk Egypt te tung le Israel naseam ukte tungah thupia a:"},"7":{"text":"“Uksuang vawt natu in mihingte tungah taangphaw na piak uh tawlnga vun. Amate paisak in zongtawmsak vun."},"8":{"text":"Ahizong uksuang nidang a den za ma, khat zongh kiam ngawlin deangsak vun. Amate in a sep khom tu nasep nei ngawl ahikom a Pathian tungah sangaw biakna pia tu in ka paisak natu hong ngen tan viuveu hi!"},"9":{"text":"Hi mite nasep haksa zaw seamsakin, komlasak vun, tua hile leilot thusonte ngai man ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Sal ukte le Israel naseam ukte pai in Israel te tungah, “Kumpipa in taangphaw ka pia nawn buatu hi."},"11":{"text":"Noma pai in na mutheina mun pawpo ah zongtawm tavun, ahihang uksuang na den ngeiza uh ma vawt tu nu hi hong ci hi,” ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahiciang mite sia Egypt ngamsung theampo ah taangphaw zongin kuan uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Sal ukte in taangphaw a kipiak lai a, uksuang a den ngeiza ma ni sim uksuang a den natu in sawl ngawp hi."},"14":{"text":"Egypt mi sal ukte in nasepna uk tu in a koi Israel naseam ukte saat hi. Amate in “Nidang a uksuang na vawt za uh banghang vawt zo ngawl nu ziam?” ci hamtang uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuasia ciang naseam ukte kumpipa kungah pai in, “Kumpipa awng, banghangin kote tungah hi bang hong vawt thong ni ziam?"},"16":{"text":"Taangphaw hong kipia ngawl hi, ahizong uksuang deang tu ma hong kisawl veve hi! Tu in ko hong kisaat hi. A khial sia na mite hi,” ci in a lungkim ngawlna teng son uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Note datham in na seam nuam ngawl nu hi, tua hangin Topa tungah sangaw biakna pia in pai tu hong ngen nu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu in na nasepna zuan kik tavun! Taangphaw hong kipia ngawl tu a, ahizong uksuang na den ngeiza ma deang veve tu nu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Nidangin na den ngeiza ma ni simin na deang tu uh hi ci thu, naseam ukte in a heak ciang thinngim uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate hong pusua ciang, amate a ngak Moses le Aaron taw kimu uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in Moses le Aaron tungah, “Na nasepnate uh Topa in hong mu zo hi, kumpipa le a uliante in kote hong ensansak na hi uh kom, daan hong pia tu hi. Kote hong thalup natu in a paulap tu khat a pia na hi uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa sangah Moses kiheak in, “ Topa awng, na mite banghangin vawtsia ni ziam? Banghang hi sungah kei hong paisak ni ziam?","title":"Moses in tung Lungkim ngawl"},"23":{"text":"Nangma atu thu son tu in kumpipa kung ka pai pan kipan amate vawtsia hi. Tua hi a, nangma in amate hu natu bangma na seam bua hi!” ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa in Moses tungah, “Tu in kumpipa tungah ka sep tu te na mu tu hi. Ka mite a paisak natu in ka seam nanak tu hi. A tatakin ci leang a leitang pan ka mite a hawlkeak tu in ka sawl nanak tu hi,” ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Pathian in Moses tungah, “Keima in Topa ka hi hi.","title":"Pathian in Moses Sam","ref":"Pian 17:1; 28:3; 35:11; Pu 3:13-15"},"3":{"text":"A Vaanglianbel Pathian in Abraham, Isaac le Jacob tungah ka kilangh a, ahizong Topa ci in ka min thiangtho taw amate ka hesak bua hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngamdangmite bangin a teenna Canaan ngam sia amate tung piak tu kamciam in amate taw thuciamna zongh ka vawt hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu in Egypt te ii salin a mat Israel te tauna ka za zo a, ka thuciamna ka phawk hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Israel te tungah, ‘Keima in Topa ka hi hi; Egypt te sal panin note kong hun tu a, kong suaktasak tu hi. A thahat ka khut laamin amate tungah a lauhuai daan ka tungsak tu a, note kong hun tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Note keima mihing kong suaksak tu a, keima in note Pathian ka hi tu hi. Egypt saltanna pan kong suataksak ciang na Topa na Pathian ka hina nong he tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Abraham, Isaac le Jacob tungah piak tu in ka ciamsa ngam ah kong paipui tu a; tua ngam sia note neisa tu in kong pia tu hi. Keima in Topa ka hi hi,’ ci in, son ta'n,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Moses in Israel te tungah hi thu teng son a, ahizong amate in nadon ngawl uh hi, banghang ziam cile a sila tanna ah kivawtsia in a thin uh tamhtham zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa in Moses tungah,"},"11":{"text":"“Egypt kumpipa kungah va pai ta'n a, Israel te na ngamsung pan pusuaksak hamtang in ci ta'n” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahizong Moses in, “Israel te ngawngawn zongh in ka thuson hong ngai ngawl tu ci leang bangbangin kumpipa in hong ngai tu ziam? Kampau thiam ngawl mama pa ka hi hi,” ci kik hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah: “Egypt ngam pan Israel te pusuana ah lampui tu in noma thu kong piak sia Israel te le Egypt kumpipa tungah son tavun.”"},"14":{"text":"Jacob taciil Reuben in tapa li nei a: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, le Carmi hi a; amate min a putsak bee le phungte ii pianna taanghpupite ahi uh hi.","title":"Moses le Aaron Innkuan Tepteena"},"15":{"text":"Simeon in tapa luk nei a: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar le Canaan numei khat taw a tapa Shaul hi; amate min a putsak bee le phungte ii pianna taanghpupite ahi uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Levi in tapa thum nei a: Gershon, Kohath le Merari hi; amate min a putsak bee le phungte ii pianna taanghpupite ahi uh hi. Levi sia kum 137 nungta hi.","ref":"Mi 3:17-20; 26:57-58; 1 Khang 6:16-19"},"17":{"text":"Gershon in tapa nii nei in: Libni le Shimei hi a, amate in suan le paal tam mama nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Kohath in tapa li nei a: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel ahi uh hi. Kohath kum 133 nungta hi."},"19":{"text":"Merari in tapa nii nei a: Mahli le Mushi ahi hi. Hite sia Levi bee le phungte le a suan a paalte ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Amram in a pa suapuinu Jochebed teenpui in, Aaron le Moses nei hi. Amram sia kum 137 nungta hi."},"21":{"text":"Izhar in tapa thum nei in: Korah, Nepheg, le Zichri ahi uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Uzziel zongh in tapa thum nei a: Mishael, Elzaphan, le Sithri ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Aaron in Amminadab ii tanu, Nahshon ii suapuinu Elisheba teenpui a; Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar le Ithamar nei hi."},"24":{"text":"Korah in tapa thum nei a: Assir, Elkanah le Abiasaph ahi hi; amate Korah bee le phung hong pianna taanghpupite ahi uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Aaron ii tapa Eleazar in Putiel ii tanute khat teenpui in, Phinehas nei hi. Hite sia innkuan lutangte hi a, Levi minamte ii pianna bee le phungte ahi uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Aaron le Moses tungah Topa in, “Israel minamte lampui in Egypt pan pusuapui vun,” ci in a sawl ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Amate sia Israel te suatak natu in, Egypt kumpipa tungah thusonte ahi uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Egypt ngamsung Moses tungah Topa in thu a son lai in,","title":"Moses le Aaron tungah ii Thupiak"},"29":{"text":"ama in, “Keima in Topa ka hi hi. Kong son theampo Egypt kumpipa tungah son in,” ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahizong Moses in, “Nong heak bangin kampau ka thiam bua hi; banghangin kumpipa in ka thuson hong ngai thong tu ziam?” ci in zo hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in, “Kumpipa mai ah nang, Pathian bangin kong vawt tu a, na suapuipa Aaron in na kamsaang bangin ama paupui tu hi."},"2":{"text":"Kong thupiak theampo Aaron tungah na son tu a, ama in kumpipa tungah Israel te a ngamsung pan a pusuasak natu in son tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahizong kumpipa a thin ka sahsak tu a, Egypt ah a lauhuai na tam mama vawt kaleng awlmawk ngawlin na thuson hong ngai ngawl tu hi. Tuasia ciang Egypt te tungah nasia takin daan ka pia tu a, ka mite ii minamte tua ngam pan ka pusuapui tu hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:36","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Keima in ka khut laam in Egypt te tungah ka thahatna ka lak ciang le Israel te a ngam pan ka pusuapui ciang, Egypt te in Topa ka hina hong he tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin Moses le Aaron in seam uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa tungah a thuson hunin, Moses kum sawmliat pha in, Aaron kum sawmliat le kum thum pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah,","title":"Aaron ii Ciangkhut"},"9":{"text":"“Kumpipa in, hong ki up thei natu in, nalamdang khat hong lak tavun, hong cile, nangma Moses in Aaron tungah a ciangkhut la a sawl in kumpipa mai ah lawnsak lete, tuasia ngul khat suak tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Moses le Aaron kumpipa kungah pai in Topa thupiak bangin seam uh hi. Aaron in kumpipa le a uliante mai ah a ciangkhut lawn a, ngul khat suak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuasia ciang kumpipa in a mipilte le mitbum thiamte samin a mitbum thiamna taw a kibangma in vawt uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in a ciangkhutte lawnin ngul suak siat hi. Ahizong Aaron ciangkhut in amate aa teng valh hi."},"13":{"text":"Bangbang hikale kumpipa thinsak veve a, Topa cisa bangma in kumpipa in Moses le Aaron thu ngai ngawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa in Moses tungah, “Kumpipa thin sah mama a, Israel te paisak tu nial hi.","title":"Egypt ah Lalna Theng Chisan"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahiciang zingsang in kumpipa Nile ngun ah a pai ciang, pai in a kimu ta'n. Ngul a suak thei na ciangkhut kengin ngunvaal pan ama ngak in."},"16":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kumpipa tungah, ‘ Topa Hebrew te Pathian in amate ii sennealngam sungah ama a biak thei natu in, a mihingte na paisak natu a son tu in kei hong sawl hi. Ahizong tu dong ciang a thu na ni bua hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu in kumpipa awng, Topa akua hi cisia ama nasep tu sia taw na mu tu hi Topa in hong ci hi. En in, hi ciangkhut taw nguntui ka saat tu a, nguntui chisan suak tu hi.","ref":"Tpl 16:4"},"18":{"text":"Ngasate thi tu a, nguntui uih mama in Egypt te in tua tui ne thei ngawl tu uh hi,’ ci in, son ta'n,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Aaron tungah na ciangkhut la in a, Egypt ngamsung ngunte, a kitotawm tuiluamte le tuicingte theampo tungah na ciangkhut vaan in. Tuite chisan hong suak tu a, ngamsung mun theampo le thingbealte, suangbealte sung ngawngawn ah chisan om tu hi, ci in son in,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa thupiak bangin Moses le Aaron te in seam uh hi. Kumpipa le a uliante mai ah Aaron in a ciangkhut laamin nguntui saat a, tui theampo chisan suak hi."},"21":{"text":"Ngun sungah a om ngasate thi in, ui mama ahikom Egypt te in tua tui ne thei ngawl uh hi. Egypt ngamsung mun theampo chisan om hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuasia ciang kumpipa ii mitbum thiamte in a mitbum thiamna uh taw tuabang tatak ma in vawt a, kumpipa sia a thinsak ngei bangma in sak veve hi. Topa cisa bangin kumpipa in Moses le Aaron thu ngai ngawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Hi zata in thupiangte ngawngawn zongh kumpipa in awlmawk vet ngawlin a kumpi inn ah heakkik zaw hi."},"24":{"text":"Egypt te theampo in tua nguntui ne thei ngawl ahikom ngundung ah a tui neak tu tuikhuk to uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa ii Nile nguntui a saat zawk ni sali pha zo hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in Moses tungah, “Kumpipa kungah va pai ta'n a, Topa in, ‘Keima hong biak thei natu in ka mite paisak in.","title":"Ulolte"},"2":{"text":"Ka thu nong nial le na ngam sungah ulol dimsakin daan kong pia tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Nile ngun sungah ulol dimleet tu a, ngun sung pan pusuak in na kumpi inn sung, na lupna inndoi sung, na lupna tung, na uliante le na mite inn sung, tuaciang na meikhuk le na kuangte sung ngawngawn dongah hong zuan tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ulolte in nangma tung, na mihingte tung le na uliante theampo tungah hong leangto tu ci hi,’ ci in na son tu hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Ngun tung, a kitotawm tuiluam tung, tuicingte tungah a ciangkhut vaan in, ulolte pusuaksak in a Egypt ngamsung dimsak in ci in Aaron tungah son ta'n” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Aaron in a ciangkhut tui omna theampo tungah vaan a, ulolte pusuak in ngamsung dim hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahizong mitbum thiamte zongh in mitbum thiamna zanghin ngam sungah ulolte pusuaksak hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in Moses le Aaron samin, “Hi ulol teng a laakkeak natu in, Topa tungah thungen vun, Topa tungah sangaw biakna a piak thei natu in, na mite ka paisak tu hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Moses in kumpipa tungah, “Nang atu in thu kong ngetsak tu ka lungdam hi. Nangma, na uliante le na mite atu thu kong ngetsak tu hun ciangtan in. Tuasia ciang, hi ulolte sia Nile ngun sung simngawl mundang ah om nawn ngawl tu hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Zing ciangin thu hong ngetsak ta'n,” ci in zo hi. Moses in, “Nong sawl bangin ka seam tu a, tuaciang kote Pathian Topa taw a kibang pathian dang a om ngawl hunlam he tu ni hi."},"11":{"text":"Ulolte sia nangma, na uliante le na mite taw kipeal in Nile ngun sung bek ah om tu hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Moses le Aaron te kumpipa nusia in ama ii kumpipa tung dongah a puak ulolte a laak kik natu in, Moses in Topa tungah thungen hi."},"13":{"text":"Moses ii nget bangin Topa in naseam a, inn sung suumsung le lote sungah a om ulolte thi hi."},"14":{"text":"Egypt te in ulol thite a lom a lom in seng a, ngamsung theampo uihsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa in ulol thite a mu ciang a thinsak kikin Topa ci sa bangma kumpipa in Moses le Aaron thu ngai ngawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Aaron in a ciangkhut taw lei a saat natu sawl in a, tua hile Egypt ngamsung leivui theampo thokaang suak siat tu hi,” ci hi.","title":"Thokaangte"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Aaron in a ciangkhut taw lei saatin, Egypt ngamsung leivui theampo thokaang suak a mihingte le nganhingte tungah dim hi."},"18":{"text":"Mitbum thiamte in a mitbum thiamna zanghin thokaang piansak tu hanciam a, ahizong vawt thei ngawl uh hi. Thokaang mun theampo ah hong om hi,"},"19":{"text":"tuaciang mitbum thiamte in kumpipa tungah, “Hi sia in Pathian nasepna hi zo hi!” ci uh hi. Ahizong kumpipa thinsakin, Topa ci bangma kumpipa in Moses le Aaron thu ngai ngawl hi.","ref":"Lk 11:20"},"20":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Ngun ah kumpipa a pai ciang kimu tu in zing ciang zingsang tuungin pai in a, Topa in, ‘Amate in kei hong biak thei natu in ka mite paisak hen.","title":"Thote"},"21":{"text":"Na kidop natu panin ka thu nong nial le daan kong pia tu a, nangma tung, na uliante tung, le na mite tungah tho honpite kong puak tu hi. Egypt te ii inn te tho taw kidim tu a, lei sia tho honpi taw kituamcip tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahizong ka mite teenna Goshen ngam sia tho om ngawl tu in ka khe tu hi. Keima Topa in hi ngam le lei ah naseam hi ci in nong heak natu in hi bangin ka vawt tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Ka mite le na mite kilaklaw ah kilamdanna khat ka vawt tu hi. Hi nalamdang lakna sia zing ciang in hong piang tu hi,’ ci in son ta'n,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in, kumpipa inn sung le a uliante inn sungah tho honpite puak hi. Tho in Egypt ngamsung buppi lalsak hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuasia ciang kumpipa in Moses le Aaron samin, “Pai in hi ngam sungah na Pathian sangaw biakpiakna pia vun,” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Moses in, “Tuabang hi tu pha ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Topa ka Pathian tungah nganhingte taw biakpiakna in Egypt te thin uuksak tu hi. Egypt te mu theina ah hi ngannote taw biakpiakna vawtin amate thin uuk thong le kote suang taw hong deanglum tu uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama hong thupiak bangin Topa ka Pathian tungah sangaw biakpiakna pia tu in, ni thum khualhaw in sennealngam sungah ka pai uh kul tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “A khuala mama na ah pai bua po le uh te, sennealngam sungah Topa na Pathian bia tu in kong paisak tu hi. Kei atu in thu hong ngetsak tavun,” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in, “Ka pusua po ciang, zing ciang tho honpite in nangma, na uliante le na mihingte kung pan a tai siat natu in Topa tungah thu ka ngen tu hi. Ahizong mite ii Topa tungah sangaw biakpiakna a vawt tu khaamin, hong theam kik peuma ngawl tu ni hi,” ci in zo hi."},"30":{"text":"Moses in kumpipa kung pan pusuakin Topa tungah thungen hi,"},"31":{"text":"Moses nget bangin Topa in pia hi. Tho honpite kumpipa, a uliante le a mihingte kung panin khat zongh kikhe ngawlin tai siat hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahizong hi hun zongh ah kumpipa thin sah veve in, ama in tua mite paisak ngawl leleau hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Kumpipa kungah pai in, Hebrew te ii Pathian Topa in, ‘Kei hong biak thei natu in ka mite paisak hen.","title":"Nganhingte Thina"},"2":{"text":"Na paisak nuam bua leleau ahile,"},"3":{"text":"no daan kong pia tu a, na ngannote — siphu, laa, kalaoh, khui, tuu le kealte tungah a lauhuai natna ka tungsak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel ngannote le Egypt ngannote kilaklaw ah kilamdanna khat ka vawt tu a, Israel te nganno ngawl teng ka thisak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima Topa in, hi teng zing ciang mama in ka seam tu hi hong ci hi,’ va ci ta'n,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"A sonsa bangin a zing ciangin Topa in naseam a. Egypt te nganno theampo thi siat hi, ahizong, Israel te nganno khat zongh thi ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa in bang thupiang ziam ci in dongh a, Israel te nganno khat zongh a thi ngawlna thu teng ama tungah kison hi. Ahizong a thin sah veve a, tua mite paisak tuan ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah, “Meikhuk pan khutpham dim vut la vun; kumpipa mai vui sungah Moses in tua vutte lawn tu hi.","title":"Uilut Meima"},"9":{"text":"Tuate Egypt ngamsung theampo ah leivui bangin kithethaang tu a, a thetna mun po ah uilut meima piangsak in, mite le nganhingte uilut veeisak tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahiciang amate in vut tawm la in kumpipa mai ah ding uh hi; Moses in tua vutte vui sungah lawnin tua vutte in mihingte le nganhingte tungah uilut meima piangsak hi.","ref":"Tpl 16:2"},"11":{"text":"Mitbum thiamte Moses mai ah kilaak thei ngawl uh hi, banghang ziam cile a dang Egypt te theampo taw kibangin uilut meima veei siat uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahizong Topa in kumpipa thin sahsakin, Topa cisa bangma kumpipa in Moses le Aaron thu ngai nuam ngawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa in Moses tungah, “Zing ciang zingtuung in kumpipa taw kimu in a, Hebrew te Pathian Topa in, ‘Kei hong biak thei natu in ka mite paisak hen.","title":"Ngial"},"14":{"text":"Leitung theampo ah keima taw kibang khat beak a om ngawl hunlam na heak natu in tu tungin na uliante le na mihingte bek daan pia ngawlin nangma zongh daan kong pia tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Nangma le na mite tungah ka khut laamin natna hong tungsak leng note na mong siat tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahizong leitung bup ah ka minthanna a kizel natu in nang tungah ka vaangletna hong lak nuam in kong nungtasak zo hi.","ref":"Rom 9:17"},"17":{"text":"Ahizong nangma na kisathei veve a, ka mite na paisak bua hi."},"18":{"text":"Zing ciang, tu hunin Egypt ngam taanghthu sungah a kihe ngeingawl, vui le ngial kithua a nasia mama khat ka piangsak tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu in na ngannote le nadang tuatuam a pua sangah na nei theampo kidalna buk sungah a koi natu in thupia in. A pua sangah a om lai kidalna nei ngawl mihingte le ngannote tungah ngial kia tu a, amate thi siat tu hi,’ ci in va son ta'n,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa thusonte hangin kumpipa ulian kimkhatte lau in a silate le a ngannote kidalna buk sungah paipui uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahizong pawlkhatte in Topa thupiakte awlmawk ngawlin, a silate le a ngannote doipua sangah nusia uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa in Moses tungah, “Na khut van ah laamto in tua hile Egypt ngamsung buppi — mihing, nganhing le lo sung ankung theampo tungah ngial kia tu hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Moses in a ciangkhut van ah laamto a, Topa in vantosak, ngial kiasakin khualengsak hi. Topa in"},"24":{"text":"a tee vazal kawkoai khualeng taw a kithua vuipi le ngial kithua nasia mama khat piangsak hi. Tua in Egypt te taanghthu sungah a heak ngei sung pan a nasiabel vuipi suangval ahi hi.","ref":"Tpl 8:7; 16:21"},"25":{"text":"Egypt ngamsung theampo doipua sangah a om mihingte theampo le nganhingte theampo ngial in deangcip hi. Lo sung ankung theampo puksakin, thingkung theampo talsak siat hi."},"26":{"text":"Israel te teenna Goshen ngam bekma ngial kia ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa in Moses le Aaron samin, “Tutungin keima maw khi hi; Topa maan a, ka mite le keima khial khu hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa tungah thungen vun! Hi vanto le ngialkiate kicing zo hi. Note paisak tu in kamciam kong pia a; hi lai ah no om tu kul nawn ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in ama tungah, “Khuapi pan ka pusua po ciang ka khutte laamin Topa tungah thu ka ngen tu hi. Vanto nawn ngawl tu a, ngialkia nawn ngawl tu hi. Tuasia ciang hi leitung sia Topa aa hi ci in na he tu uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahizong nangma le na uliante in Topa Pathian na kiitak ngawl lai uh sia ka he hi,” ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ngial in anthul le mangtaangte lalsak siat hi, banghang ziam cile mangtaang a min laitak hi in, anthul sia a mom laitak ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahizong zungtaang a lal om ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile tuate min ngawl lai hi."},"33":{"text":"Kumpipa kung pan Moses khuapi pua sangah pai in a khutte laamin Topa tungah thungen hi. Vanto le ngialkia tawlnga in nguazu nawn ngawl hi."},"34":{"text":"Kumpipa sia thupiang teng a mu ciang khial kik leleau hi. Ama le a uliante thin a sak ngei in sak a,"},"35":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungtawnin a sonkhol bangma in kumpipa in Israel te paisak ngawl hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in Moses tungah, “Kumpipa kungah pai in a, va kimu ta'n. Hi bangin amate sungah nalamdang laknate ka vawt thei natu in ahizong","title":"Khaumawte"},"2":{"text":"nalamdang ka lak ciang, Egypt te a mawmaw bang ka sua sakna thute, na tu na tate tungah na son thei natu ahizong ama le a uliante thin ka sahsak hi. Note theampo in Topa ka hina nong he tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"“Tua ahiciang kumpipa kungah Moses le Aaron pai in, “ Topa, Hebrew te ii Pathian in, ‘Kei tungah nong kiniamkhiak tu, bang tanvei hong nial lai tu ni ziam? Kei hong biak thei natu in, ka mite paisak in."},"4":{"text":"Nong nial lai le, zing ciangin na ngam sungah khaumaw kong puak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Khaumawte tam mama tu a, lei maitang teng siincip tu hi. Ngial ii a lalsak ngawl, thingkung a taanglaite ngawngawn tuate in netum siat tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuate sia na kumpi innte, na uliante le na mihingte inn teng theampo dim tu hi. Tuate sia na taanghpupite mu ngeite sangin sia zaw tu hi,’ hong ci hi” ci uh hi. Tua zawkciang Moses kiheak in paisan hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa uliante in kumpipa tungah, “Bang tanvei hisia pa in eite ngimna hong pia tu ziam? Topa a Pathian a biak thei natu in, Israel mite paisak in. Egypt ngam lal zo ci sia tel ngawl ni ziam?” ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Moses le Aaron kumpipa kungah kipaipui kikin kumpipa in amate tungah, “Note pai in, na Topa Pathian uh bia thei tu nu hi. Ahizong akua teng tatak pai tu nu ziam?” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Moses in, “Koma patangte le khanghaamte zongh pai siat tu khu hi. Kote in ka tapate le tanute, ka tuute le kealte, le ka khuite keng tu khu hi, banghang ziam cile Topa zatak piakna in poai khat vawt tu kul hi,” ci in zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Na numeite le patangte kong paisak ngeingawl tu sia Topa min taw ka kiciam hi! Note in kei leedo nong sawm uh hunlam kician hi."},"11":{"text":"Suak thei ngawl hi! Na deina uh tuabang ahile pasal teng bek pai in Topa bia thei nu hi,” ci hi. Tua teng taw Moses le Aaron, kumpipa kung pan kihawlkeak hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in Moses tungah, “Khaumawte hong kipuak natu in, Egypt ngam le lei tungah na khut laamto in. Tuate hong pai tu a, thingkung po theampo le ngial ii lalsak mong theampo netum tu hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Moses in a ciangkhut laamto a, Topa in nisuana sang pan sun le zan tawntung ngamsung vui vasak hi. Tuasia in a zingsang ciang khaumawte hong puak hi."},"14":{"text":"Khaumawte a hon a hon in hong theng a, Egypt ngamsung bup ah teang hi. Tua in a kimu ngeingawl le a kimu kik ngeingawl tu khaumaw hon tambel ahi hi.","ref":"Tpl 9:2-3"},"15":{"text":"Tuate in lei maitang vom mitmet in siin siat hi; ngial ii den mong theampo le thingkung tung thingnga theampo ne siat hi. Egypt ngamsung theampo ah thingkung le ankung tungah a hing khat zongh taang ngawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuasia ciang kumpipa in manlang takin Moses le Aaron samin, “ Topa na Pathian le note tungah ka maw zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu in, khatvei ka mawna hong maisak tavun a, hi a nasia daan piakna kei tung pan a laak keak natu in, Topa na Pathian tungah thu hong ngetsak tavun,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Moses in kumpipa nusia in Topa tungah thungen hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in nisuana sang vui sia, a hat mama nitumna sang hui suaksak a, tua vui in khaumawte lento in Suez Tuidok sungah muutkeak hi. Egypt ngamsung theampo ah khaumaw khat zongh om nawn ngawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahizong Topa in kumpipa thin sahsakin ama in Israel te paisak ngawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa in Moses tungah, “Van ah na khut laamto in, tuaciang a saa mama hunlam a kiphawk tham liang khuazing taw Egypt ngam hong kituam siat tu hi,” ci hi.","title":"Khuazing"},"22":{"text":"Moses in a khut van ah laamto in, Egypt ngamsung theampo ni thum sung khuazing bikbek hi.","ref":"Ps 105:28; Tpl 16:10"},"23":{"text":"Egypt te khat le khat kimu thei ngawl a, tua hun sung kuama pusuak ngawl hi. Ahizong Israel te teenna munah khuavak nga hi."},"24":{"text":"Kumpipa in Moses samin, “Note pai in, Topa bia thei nu hi; numeite le patangte zongh keng tavun. Ahizong na tuu na keal le na khuite hi lai ah nusia tu nu hi,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Moses in, “Tuabang ahile Topa ka Pathian tungah meihal biakpiak natu le sangaw biakpiak natu ngannote nong sik kul tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Hi ngawl hi, ka ngannote paipui tu khu hi; khat zongh kinusia ngawl tu hi. Topa ka Pathian sangaw biakpiak natu in ngannote koma ii teal kul hi. A mun ka thet mateng, a bang nganno taw ama bia tu cisia ka he buatu uh hi,” ci in zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in kumpipa thin sahsak a, amate paisak nuam ngawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpipa in Moses tungah, “Ka muna ah om heak in! Nang hong musak kik nawn heak in! Kong mu kik ni in thi tu ni hi!” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in, “Nangma maan ni hi. Kei nong mu kik ngei nawn buatu hi,” ci in zo hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in Moses tungah, “Egypt kumpipa le a mihingte tungah khatvei bek daan ka pia lai tu hi. Tua zawkciang note hong paisak tu hi. A tatakin ci leang ama in, hi lai pan note theampo hong hawlkeak tu hi.","title":"Moses in Taciil Thina Thu Thangsak"},"2":{"text":"Tu in Israel mite theampo in a innpaamte tungah khamh le ngunn suangmanphate a nget natu in son ta'n,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in Israel te sia Egypt te in zaktasak hi. Uliante le mihingte theampo in Moses sia mi thupi mama khatin ngaisun takpi uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaciang Moses in kumpipa tungah, “ Topa in, ‘Zankim hun khawngin Egypt ngamsung teng ah ka pai tu a,"},"5":{"text":"Egypt te tapaciil theampo, kumpi tokhum a lua tu, kumpipa tapa a kipan an ngoaina ah naseam sila numei ii tapa dongin thi tu hi. Nganhing a no suakciil theampo zongh thi tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Nidangin a om ngeingawl le mai sangah a om kik ngei nawn ngawl tu kaana awnging Egypt ngamsung theampo ah om tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahizong Israel te ahibuale, a ngannote ahile ui ngawngawn in nak ngawl tu hi. Tuasia ciang Keima Topa ii Egypt te le Israel te kilaklaw ah kilamdanna khat ka vawt na he tu uh hi, hong ci hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Moses ii a thukhupna panin, “Na ulian theampo hong pai tu a, ka mai ah kunin ka mite theampo ka paipui natu in hong thuum tu hi. Tua zawkciang ka pai tu hi,” ci hi. Tuaciang Moses thin uuk mama in kumpipa nusia hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Egypt ngam sungah nalamdang lakna tamzaw ka vawt thei lai natu in kumpipa in na thu hong ngai ngawl veve tu hi,” a ci sa hi."},"10":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in kumpipa mai ah nalamdang hi zata lak zo hikale, Topa in a thin sahsak ahikom, a ngam sia Israel te in nusiasak nuam ngawl hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt ngam sungah Topa in Moses le Aaron tung a cina ah:","title":"Paisan Poai"},"2":{"text":"“Tu tha sia note atu in kum kipat tha hi tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 23:5; Mi 9:1-5; 28:16; Thkna 16:1-2"},"3":{"text":"Israel mi bup tungah hi bang kihilna te son tu ni hi: Tu tha ni sawm ni in pasal sim in tuuno khat ahibuale kealno khat a innkuan atu in teal nanak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Nganno pum bup khat a ne tu in a innkuan a tawm leih le, mihing khat ii neak zawkza taw kizui in mihing phaza en in a innpaamte hawm thei tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Nganno sia kum khat a pha, a talno na teal thei tu a, ahihang a mealhem ngawl tuu ahibuale keal hi tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaciang tua tha ni sawm le ni li nitak ciang Israel mi bup in tua ngante ngo tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Mipite in a chisan pawlkhat la in, tua sa a kineak natu inn kongkha khuamte nii le a vathaang tungah noai tu nu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua zanin a sa na em tu uh a, tol saw ngawl anluum le a kha meeteete taw na ne tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"A sate a sial ahizong tuihuan ahizong na ne buatu uh a, a lu, a peangte le a sungkua dong takin a vekpi em in ne tu nu hi."},"10":{"text":"Zingsang dongin neakmong peuma na omsak buatu uh hi; neakmong a om le na hal kul tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Hi ante manlang takin na ne tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile khualhaw tu in peangdapte thua in, na khut sungah ciangkhut toai a, na kithoai uh kul tu hi. Tua in keima Topa tungah zatak piakna Paisan Poai ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tua zanin Egypt ngamsung tengah ka pai tu a, mihing le nganhing te ii tapaciil teng thatin, Egypt pathian theampo daan ka pia tu hi. Keima in Topa ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Kongkha khuamte tungah chisan a kinoai teng noma teenna inn teptee natu lim ahi hi. Chisan ka mu ciang note kong kaantan tu a, Egypt te daan ka piak ciang note bangma kong law buatu hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima Topa in bang vawt khi ziam ci na phaw natu in hi ni sia biaknapoai khatin vawt tu nu hi. Mailam hun theampo ah tua poai vawt suak tavun,” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 23:15; 34:18; Thiam 23:6-8; Mi 28:17-25; Thkna 16:3-8"},"15":{"text":"Topa in, “Ni sali sung tol kisaw anluum peuma na ne buatu uh hi — tol kisaw ngawl anluum bekma na ne tu uh hi. Ni masa ni in na inn uh pan tol theampo heam tu nu hi, banghang ziam cile tua ni sali hunsung khat po in tol kisaw anluum a ne le, ama keima mi in a kisim nawn buatu hi.","title":"Tol saw ngawl Anluum Poai"},"16":{"text":"Ni masa ni le ni sali ni in biak kikhopna nei tu nu hi. Tua ni nii sung, na na seam buatu uh a, ahizong an neak tu vawt thei nu hi."},"17":{"text":"Hi poai bosak ngawl tu nu hi, banghang ziam cile tua ni in na minamte Egypt pan kong pusuapui hi. Mailam hun ah zongh tua ni in poai vawt nanak tu nu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tha masabel ni sawm le ni li nitak pan ni kul le ni khat nitak sang dong tol kisaw anluum ne ngawl tu nu hi."},"19":{"text":"Ni sali sung tol peuma na inn sungah koi ngawl tu nu hi, banghang ziam cile tualmi ahizong, ngamdangmi khat pawpo in tol kisaw anluum a ne le keima mi khat in kingaisun nawn ngawl tu hi,” ci hi.","merge":"20"},"21":{"text":"Moses in Israel lampui teng samin amate tungah, “Na innkuan tek in Paisan Poai na vawt thei natu in, tuuno khat ahibuale kealno khat tealin ngo vun.","title":"A Masabel Paisan Poai"},"22":{"text":"Hyssop sip khat la vun a, kuang sungah a om nganhing chisan sungah papin, na inn kongkha khuamte nii le a vathaang tungah noai vun. Zingsang khuavak mateng inn pan khat zongh pusuak ngawl tu nu hi."},"23":{"text":"Egypt te a that tu in Egypt ngamsung teng ah Topa a pai ciang, kongkha khuamte le a vathaangte tungah a kinoai chisan mu tu a, Thina ii Vantunglalang sia na inn te sungah hong that tu in tumsak ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Heb 11:28"},"24":{"text":"Hi zui tu ngeinate nangma le na tate in a tawntung zui tu nu hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa ii kamciam hong piakna ngam ah na tum uh ciang hi a zeksa ngeina sia seam hamtang tu nu hi."},"26":{"text":"Na tate in, ‘Hi, a zeksa ngeina sia, bang a khiakna ziam’ ci in hong dok ciang,"},"27":{"text":"‘ Topa tungah zatakna in ih piak Paisan Poai sangaw biakpiakna hi, Egypt ah Israel te ii innte hong paisatna hang ahi hi. Ama in Egypt te that a, ahizong eite hong khoaikhe hi,’ na ci tu uh hi,” ci hi. Israel mite in khupdin in bia uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa ii Moses le Aaron tungah a thupiak bangin amate pai in seam uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Zankim laitak Topa in Egypt ngamsung tapaciil theampo, kumpi tokhum a lua tu kumpipa tapa pan kipan leinuai khuazing sung thongtaakte ii tapate dongin that siat a; nganno suakciil theampo zongh that hi.","title":"Taciil Thina","ref":"Pu 4:22-23"},"30":{"text":"Tua zanin kumpipa, a uliante le a dang Egypt mite theampo khanglo siat hi. Tapa thi ngawl inn khat beak om ngawl ahikom Egypt ngamsung teng ah kaana awnging nasia mama hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua zan ma in kumpipa in Moses le Aaron samsak in, “Nangma le na Israel mite pusuak tavun! Ka ngam nusia tavun a; nong nget bangin pai in, Topa bia tavun."},"32":{"text":"Na tuu, na keal le na khuite la in pai tavun. Kei atu zongh thupha hong ngetsak tavun,” ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Egypt te in a ngam manlang tak a nusiat natu in tua mite sawl a; “Na pai bua uh ahile ka thi siat tu uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Israel te in tol saw ngawl anvuite anluum emna bealpeute sungah heangin, puan taw tunin a liangko ah pua uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Moses ii a ci bangin Israel te in Egypt te tungah khamh le ngunn kizepna, le puansilhte ngen uh hi.","ref":"Pu 3:21-22"},"36":{"text":"Topa in Israel te sia Egypt te in zaktasak ahikom Israel te nget bangin pia uh hi. Tuabangin Egypt te hauna teng Israel te in paipui uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Israel te a peangin pai a, Rameses pan Sukkoth zuan uh hi. Amate numei le patang kihel ngawl pasal tulzaluk bang pha hi.","title":"Israel te in Egypt Nusia"},"38":{"text":"Midang tam mama le tuu, keal le khui tam mama te zongh amate taw paikhawm uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Amate in Egypt pan a ken tol saw ngawl anluum em uh hi, banghang ziam cile thakhat thu in amate Egypt pan kihawlkeak ahikom a an neak tu ahizong tol saw anluum ahizong kinging man ngawl uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Israel te Egypt ah kum 430 sung teang hi.","ref":"Pian 15:13; Gal 3:17"},"41":{"text":"Kum 430 a bo ni in Topa mite ii minam theampo in Egypt nusia uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua zan sia amate Egypt pan pusua pui tu in Topa ii kep ni zan hi a; tua zan sia ma Israel te ii mailam hun theampo ah a kepcing nanak tu zan khat in Topa tungah aap uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah, “Hite Paisan Poai ah zui tu ngeinate ahi hi: Ngamdangmite kuama in Paisan Poai an ne thei ngawl tu hi,","title":"Paisan Poai ah Zui tu Ngeinate"},"44":{"text":"ahizong na leisa sila pawpo a vunteap atsak masa po le uhte ne thei tu hi."},"45":{"text":"A peam pak khat, a kicial naseam khat in ne thei ngawl tu uh hi."},"46":{"text":"An theampo a kihuanna inn sung bek ah kine tu a; a pua ah kipusua pui ngawl het tu hi. Tuaciang tua nganno ii ngute khat zongh thiaktan heak vun.","ref":"Mi 9:12; Jn 19:36"},"47":{"text":"Israel mi bup in hi poai vawt tu a,"},"48":{"text":"ahizong vunteap at ngawl sia in ne thei ngawl tu hi. Note sungah hong teang ngamdangmi khat in Topa zatakna Paisan Poai a vawt nuam le amate innkuan sung pan pa peuma vunteap atsak masa tu nu hi. Tuasia ciang Israel mi tualsuak khat taw a kibangin poai sungah kihel thei tu hi."},"49":{"text":"Hi zui tu ngeinate sia ma, Israel mi tualsuakte le note sungah hong teang ngamdangmite a kibangin na zui tu uh ahi hi,” ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Topa ii Moses le Aaron tungah a thupiak bangin Israel te theampo in thu ni in, seam uh hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ni in, Topa in Israel minamte Egypt pan pusuapui hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Taciil Aapna"},"2":{"text":"“Tapaciil theampo kei tungah aapna hong nei tavun, banghang ziam cile Israel tapaciil theampo le nganno suakciil apa theampo keima aa ahi hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mi 3:13; Lk 2:23"},"3":{"text":"Moses in a mihingte tungah, “Egypt ngam sal na tanna mun na nusiat ni — tuni phawk tavun. Tu ni sia Topa in ama ii vaangletna taw hong pusua pui ni ahi hi. Tol saw ngawl anluum ne tu nu hi.","title":"Tol saw ngawl Anluum Poai"},"4":{"text":"Tha masabel Abib tha, tu ni in note Egypt nusia nu hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in na taanghpupite tungah Canaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite teenna ngam piak tu in ciliap huai takin hong kamciam hi. Tua ngam leihoi leiphana ngam ah hong paipui ciang kum sim tha masabel sungin hi poai vawt nanak tu nu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ni sali sung tol saw ngawl anluum na ne tu uh a, ni sali ni in Topa tungah upatna poai na vawt tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ni sali sung tol kisaw anluum peuma na ne buatu uh a, tol ahizong tol kisaw anluum peuma na ngam sungah a om buatu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua poai na vawt uh ciang na tapate tungah Topa in Egypt pan note hong paipui ahi hu in hi bangin poai kivawt hi, ci in son tu nu hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi ngeina poai vawtna in na khut ah ahibuale na tal tungah na khat a kikhit bangin, tua in Topa thukham hong phawksak tawntung tu hi. Tua in Topa thukham na sin tu le na sim tawntung natu in hong phawksak tu hi. Banghang ziam cile Topa in a vaangletna taw Egypt pan note hong pusuapui hi."},"10":{"text":"Kum sim a ciangtan hun a tun simin poai vawt tu nu hi."},"11":{"text":"“ Topa in na taanghpupite tungah a kamciamsa Canaan ngam ah note hong paipui tu hi. Tua ngam note tungah hong piak ciang,","title":"Taciil"},"12":{"text":"tapaciil theampo Topa tungah pia nanak tu nu hi. Na ngannote a pa suakciil theampo Topa neisa hi a,","ref":"Pu 34:19-20; Lk 2:23"},"13":{"text":"ahizong ama tung pan laa pa a suakciil theampo sia tua taang in tuuno khat piakna taw tan kik tu nu hi. Tua laa na tan kik nuam bua ahile a ngawng thiaktan in. Na tapaciil peuma tan kik tu nu hi."},"14":{"text":"Mailam sangah na tapa in hi bang a ih sepnate bang a khiakna ziam ci in hong dongh le, ‘ Topa in a vaangletna zanghin ih saltanna Egypt pan eite hong paipui hang ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa a thinsakin eite hong paisak nop ngawl ciang Topa in Egypt ngamsung tapaciil theampo le nganhing suakciil a pa theampo thatlum siat hi. Tua ahi hu in tapaciil le nganhing suakciil a pa theampo Topa tungah sangaw biakna in kipia a, ahizong ih tapaciilte sia kitan kik hi."},"16":{"text":"Hi bang ngeina poai vawtna sia nung thu hong phawksak kik tu in ih khut tungah ahibuale ih tal tungah tepteena a kikhit bang hi tu hi; tua in Egypt pan Topa in a vaangletna taw hong pusuapuina thu hong phawksak tu hi,’ ci in son tu nu hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa in Israel te a paisak lai in, Philistia tuipi hui ah a paito lampi sia lam banbel hikale, Pathian in totpui ngawl hi. Pathian in, “Amate ngal a sim kul tu ci in a mu ciang a thin kikheal a, Egypt ah a heak kik tu ka oai bua hi,” ci in ngaisun hi.","title":"Meei Khuam le Mei Khuam"},"18":{"text":"Tua lampi taangin ama in sennealngam kiimkot a, San Tuipi sangah masuan hi. Israel te in ngalsim natu ngalhiamte pua uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Joseph in Israel te tungah a sep tu in ciliap huai kamciam a vawtsak bangin, Moses in Joseph ii luang tonpui hi. Joseph in, “Pathian in note hong suatak ciang, hi mun pan ka luang nong pua hamtang tu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 50:25; Jos 24:32"},"20":{"text":"Sukkoth nusia in Israel te dingin, sennealngam mong Etham ah ngiaphual saat uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate sun ahizong, zan ahizong a khualhaw thei natu in sun hunin lam a lak tu meeikaai khuam khat taw, zan hunin khuavak a pia tu in meitaang khuam khat taw amate mai ah Topa pai hi."},"22":{"text":"Israel te mai ah sun hunin meeikaai khuam le zan hunin meitaang khuam om tawntung hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"San Tuipi Kaantan"},"2":{"text":"“Israel te heak kikin Baal Zephon nai, Migdol le San Tuipi kilaklaw Pi Hahiroth ii mai ah ngiaphual a saatna tu in son in."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in Israel te ngam sungah vak kawkoai a, senneal in khakcip in ngaisun tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama thin ka sahsak tu a, nang hong del tu hi. Kumpipa le a ngalkaphonpi ka zawna pan pataakna ka nga tu hi. Tuasia ciang Egypt te in Topa ka hina hong he tu uh hi,” ci hi. Israel te a kisawl bangin ngamta uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel te a suatakna thu Egypt kumpipa tungah a kison ciang ama le a uliante a thin khealin, “A bang teng seam thong hi ziam? Israel te ih suaktasak zo a, ih sila te ih bosua zo hi!” ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa in siphu ngalleang le a ngalkaphonpi kithoaisak hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in a siphu ngalleang phabel 600 kihel in a leang theampo taw a ngalkapmangte in uksakin kuan uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa ii a thin a sahsak kumpipa in zawna taw in a pusuak Israel te del hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt ngalkaphonpi in a siphu theampo taw, siphu ngalleangte le a hawlte in Israel te del a, Pi Hahiroth le Baal Zephon nai San Tuipi hui a ngiaphual saatna ah pha uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel te in kumpipa le a ngalkaphonpi in a del a mu ciang lau mama a, Topa tungah huna ngen in au uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in Moses tungah, “Egypt ah thaan om ngawl ziam? Hi lai sennealngam ah a thi tu in nang hong paipui kul ziam? Egypt pan nong pusuapuina, na nasepna sa teng en in!"},"12":{"text":"Ih pusua ma in, hi bang teng piang tu ci hong son zo hi ngawl khu ziam? Egypt te sal ahi tan tu in ko nguak hong nusia lel ta'n kong ci uh hi. Hi lai sennealngam ah thi sangin tua munah sila hi tu phazaw lai hi,” ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Moses in, “Lau heak vun! Kip takin ding vun a, tu ni in Topa hong hutna mu tu nu hi; hi Egypt te mu kik ngeingawl tu nu hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in no atu ngal hong simsak tu a, note sep tu bangma kisam ngawl hi,” ci in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Banghangin huna dei in au nu ziam? Israel te maisang a pai natu in sawl in."},"16":{"text":"Na ciangkhut laamin, tuipi tungah vaan in. Tui hong kikhen tu a, Israel te leiko tung tawnin paisuak thei tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt te thin ka sahsak mama tu a, Israel te del veve tu uh hi, tuaciang kumpipa, a ngalkaphonpi, a siphu ngalleangte le a hawlte ka zawna taw patoaina ka nga tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate ka zaw ciang Egypt te in keima Topa ka hina hong he tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Israel ngalkaphonpi mai ah a om Pathian vantunglalang sia kikhiin in nungsangah pai hi. Meeikaai khuam zongh"},"20":{"text":"Egypt te le Israel te kilaklaw dong hong kikhiin hi. Meei in Egypt te atu in khuazingsak a, Israel mite atu in khuavaksak ahikom zankhuateakin ngalkaphonpite khat le khat kineak thei ngawl uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Moses in tuipi tungah a khut a vaan ciang, Topa in nisuana sang pan vui thahat khat taw tuipi kinilsak hi. Tua vui sia zankhuateak va in, tuipi leiko suaksak hi. Tui kikhen a,"},"22":{"text":"Israel te in leiko tung tawnin tuipi kaantan a, a lang le a lang ah tui pangte hong om hi.","ref":"1 Cor 10:1-2; Heb 11:29"},"23":{"text":"Egypt te in a siphu theampo, a siphu ngalleangte le a hawlte taw tuipi sung dongin del uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in khuavak mahiat in meitaang le meeikaai khuam tung pan Egypt te ensuk in, patausak ek hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in a ngalleang muite awksak ahikom haksa takin kikhiin hi. Egypt te in, “ Topa in Israel te sang pangin eite hong do hi. Hi lai pan tai tawng,” ci uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Tuipi tungah na khut vaan in, tua hile Egypt te le a siphu ngalleangte le a hawlte tungah tui hong kinil kik tu hi,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Moses in tuipi tungah a khut vaan a, khuavak ciang tui hong heak kikin a ngeina bangin om hi. Egypt te in a suatak natu hanciam a, ahizong Topa in tuipi sungah amate lawn hi."},"28":{"text":"Tui heak kikin tuipi sung dongah Israel te a del Egypt ngalkap theampo, a siphu ngalleangte le a hawlte khuum hi; khat zongh kikhe ngawlin khuum siat hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahizong tuipi kaantan in leiko tungah Israel te pai uh a, a lang le a lang ah tuipangte om hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ni in Topa in Egypt te khut sung pan Israel mite hun a, tuipivaal ah a thite Israel te in mu uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Vaangletna lianpi taw Topa in Egypt te a zawna thu Israel te in a mu uh ciang amate in Topa lamdang sa a; Topa le a naseampa Moses muanna nei uh hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang Moses le Israel te in hi la Topa tungah sak uh hi: “Ama in a minthang ngalzawna khat nga ahikom, Topa tungah la ka sa tu hi; ama in siphute le a tung tote tuipi sungah lawn hi.","title":"Moses ii La","ref":"Tpl 15:3"},"2":{"text":"Topa sia a thahat hong dalpa hi a; Ama in kei hong hunpa hi.
