A khu sia mei phualpi khu bangin kaato in, mi theampo liinglawng ngawp uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:11-12"},"19":{"text":"Lemle aw hong nging vaial hi. Moses in paupui a, Pathian in vanto taw in zo kik hi."},"20":{"text":"Sinai Mualdawn ah Topa hong tuaksukin, mualdawn ah Moses sam hi. Moses kaato a,"},"21":{"text":"Topa in ama tungah, “Keima en tu in mite hong pai ciang ngamngi tepteena a kan ngawl natu in paisuk in va son ta'n; tuasia hong kan le tam mama thi tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Kei kung hong pai tu thiampite zongh a kithiansua phot kul tu hi, a kithiansua buale daan ka pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Moses in Topa tungah, “Mipite hong paito thei ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile nangma in mual sia thiangtho hi ci in ngaisut tu le tua ii kiimkot ah ngamngi tepteena khat vawt tu in thu nong pia hi,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in, “Tuaksuk ta'n a, Aaron hong paipui kik ta'n. Ahizong thiampite le mipite in kei kungah paito tu in tua ngamngi kaan ngawl het tu hi, tuabang a kaantan le amate daan ka pia tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuasia ciang mipite kungah Moses tuaksuk a, Topa ii ci teng amate tungah son hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in hi bang kammal teng son hi:","title":"Thupiak Sawmte (Thuhil kikna 5:1-21)"},"2":{"text":"“Keima in note saltanna Egypt pan hong pusuapui Topa na Pathian ka hi hi."},"3":{"text":"“Keima simngawl pathian dang bia heak vun."},"4":{"text":"“Vantung ahizong, leitung ahizong leinuai tui sungah ahizong note atu in na khat pawpo ii lim vawt heak vun.","ref":"Pu 34:17; Thiam 19:4; 26:1; Thkna 4:15-18; 27:15"},"5":{"text":"Milim khat pawpo mai ah kun heak vun, ahibuale bia heak vun, banghang ziam cile keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi a, hong demte ka dual bua hi. Kei hong ngaimawte le amate ii a suan a paalte tungah khang thum khang li dongin daan ka pia tu hi.","ref":"Pu 34:6-7; Mi 14:18; Thkna 7:9-10; 20:7; Thiam 19:12; 20:8; Pu 16:23-30; 31:12-14"},"6":{"text":"Ahizong kei hong it in, ka thukhamte a zuite ahile ka itna a khang tul tampite tungah ka lak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"“Keima min, a sia vawt natu in zangh heak vun, banghang ziam cile keima Topa na Pathian in ka min a zangh khial pawpo daan ka pia tu hi."},"8":{"text":"“Sabbath tang vun a, tua ni thiangthosak vun."},"9":{"text":"Note na na sep natu in ni luk na nei uh a,","ref":"Pu 23:12; 31:15; 34:21; 35:2; Thiam 23:3"},"10":{"text":"ahizong a ni sali ni sia keima atu a kikoituam tawlngak ni ahi hi. Tua ni in kuama — nangma, na tate, na silate, na ngannote le na ngam sungah hong teang ngamdangmite khat zongh in naseam ngawl tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ni luk sungin Keima Topa in leitung, vantung, tuipi le tuate sung a om theampo ka vawt a, ahizong ni sali ni in ka tawlnga hi. Tua ahi hu in Keima, Topa in Sabbath thupha pia in tua ni ka thiangthosak hi.","ref":"Pian 2:1-3; Pu 31:17"},"12":{"text":"“Keima kong piak ngam le lei ah khansau in na nuntak thei natu in na nu le na pa zakta vun.","ref":"Thkna 27:16; Mt 15:4; 19:19; Mk 7:10; 10:19; Lk 18:20; Eph 6:2; Eph 6:3"},"13":{"text":"“Mihing that heak vun.","ref":"Pian 9:6; Thiam 24:17; Mt 5:21; 19:18; Mk 10:19; Lk 18:20; Rom 13:9; Jas 2:11"},"14":{"text":"“Palngul mawna vawt heak vun.","ref":"Thiam 20:10; Mt 5:27; 19:18; Mk 10:19; Lk 18:20; Rom 13:9; Jas 2:11"},"15":{"text":"“Nguta heak vun.","ref":"Thiam 19:11; Mt 19:18; Mk 10:19; Lk 18:20; Rom 13:9"},"16":{"text":"“A maan ngawlin khat pawpo mawsiat heak vun.","ref":"Pu 23:1; Mt 19:18; Mk 10:19; Lk 18:20"},"17":{"text":"“Midang khat ii inn lungngul heak vun: a zi, a silate, a khuite, a laate ahibuale a neisa khat pawpo lungngul heak vun,” ci hi.","ref":"Rom 7:7; 13:9"},"18":{"text":"Mipite in khualeng vanto le lemle awngingte za in, khualeng le meikhu suak mual a mu ciang, lau in liing a, a khualana ah ding uh hi.","title":"A Mite ii Launa (Thuhil kikna 5:22-33)","ref":"Heb 12:18-19"},"19":{"text":"Amate in Moses tungah, “Nangma in ko nong paupui le kong ngai tu uh hi; ahizong Pathian in kote hong paupui le ka thi tu lau khu hi,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Moses in, “Lau heak vun! note na khial ngawl natu hong sit tu in Pathian hong pai hi bek a, ama thu ni tawntung tu in hong vawt hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahizong mipite a khualana ah ding veve a, Pathian omna meeivom nai ah Moses bek pai hi."},"22":{"text":"Israel te tungah Moses ii son tu in Topa in thupia a: “Keima, Topa in vantung pan note kong paupui na zia mu zo ni hi.","title":"Biaknataute taw kisai Thukhamte"},"23":{"text":"Keima nong biak banah note biak tu in ngunn le khamh pathiante vawt heak vun."},"24":{"text":"Lei taw kivawt biaknatau khat kei atu in vawt vun a, na tuute le na khuite taw meihal biakpiakna le kipawlkhop biakpiaknate tua biaknatau tungah pia vun. Kei nong biak natu in kong koi tuamsak mun teng ah kong pai tu a, thupha kong pia tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Kei atu in suang taw biaknatau na vawt uh ahile, a ki attan suang taw sa heak vun, banghang ziam cile suang tungah sikkhu na zak uh ciang tua suang sia kei atu in zak tham man ngawl sua nu hi.","ref":"Thkna 27:5-7; Jos 8:31"},"26":{"text":"Kei atu biaknatau na sak uh ciang a tungah kaato natu in keallei vawt heak vun; na vawt uh le a tung na kaato uh ciang noma sealno teng kilanghsak tu nu hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Israel te tungah a nuai a thukhamte pia in:","title":"Silate a Kivawtna (Thuhil kikna 15:12-18)"},"2":{"text":"Hebrew mi sila in na lei uh le, kum luk sung na hong sepsak tu hi. Kum sali kumin bangma pia ngawlin kisuaktasak tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Na silapa sia na sila a sua lai in zi nei ngawl ahile hong nusiat ciang a zi tonpui ngawl tu a, ahizong zi neisa ahile a zi tonpui thei tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 25:39-46"},"4":{"text":"A topa in zi neisakin, tanu tapa a nei le a zi le a tano teng a topa ii neisa hi tu a, ama nguak pai tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahizong silapa in ka topa, ka zi, ka tate ka it hi ci in suataksak tu a nop ngawlna thu hong pualaak le,"},"6":{"text":"a topa in ama biakpiakna munah paipui tu hi. Tualai kongkha ahibuale kongkha khuam neal in ama dingsak tu a, a bil vutvangsak tu hi. Tuaciang a nuntak tawntung ama sila hi tu hi."},"7":{"text":"“Mihing khat in a tanu sia sila tu in a zuak le, pa silate bangin suakta thei ngawl tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua nu a zi tu in a nei nuam khat ii tungah kizuak a, ahizong tua pa in a dei bua le, tua nu sia a pa kungah kizuak kik tu hi; a topa in ngamdangmite tungah zuak thei ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile ama in tua nu a phatvawt ngawl sa ahihang hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasal khat in a tapa a piak tu in sila numei khat a lei le tanu khat bangin vawt tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing khat in zi ni a nei le a zi masa sia nidang a piak ngeiza an, puan le a nga tuakte a kibangin pia suak tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in a zi masa tungah hi bangin a vawt tu te a khuangkhim buale liausum bangma la ngawlin a suataksak kul tu hi."},"12":{"text":"“Mihing khat vua in a that sia peuma kithatlum tu hi.","title":"Ngongtatna taw kisai Thukhamte","ref":"Thiam 24:17"},"13":{"text":"Ahizong thalup sawm ngawlpi khutkhial tha ahile ama atu ka tealsa munah ngammuangin om tu a, suakta thei tu hi.","ref":"Mi 35:10-34; Thkna 19:1-13; Jos 20:1-9"},"14":{"text":"Ahizong mihing khat thin uuk in midang khat a thatlum lui le ka biaknatau beal tu in a tai zong kithat veve tu hi."},"15":{"text":"A nu ahibuale a pa a vua sia kithatlum tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihing khat zuak tu ahizong, sila in khoai tu ahizong a ngu sia kithatlum tu hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:7"},"17":{"text":"A nu ahibuale a pa a haamsiat sia kithatlum tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 20:9; Mt 15:4; Mk 7:10"},"18":{"text":"Mihing nii kihau in, khat pa in a dang khat pa suangtum taw suu ahibuale a khuttum taw thong a, ahizong a thatlum buanale tua pa daan kipia ngawl tu hi. Tua a thuakpa sia lupmuntung ngak ahihang, tua zawkciang tho thei in doipua a paina ah ciangkhut zak a kul le, dam ngawlin a om hun sung a supna teng a thaman liau tu a, a dam dong ou tu hi.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"Mihing khat in a silapa ahibuale a silanu mol khat taw saatin thakhat thu a thi paih le, a saatpa daan kipia tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahizong a sila sia ni khat, ni nii in a thi bua le, a topa daan kipia ngawl tu hi. A neisa a sup sia a kicing daan ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Mihingte kihau a naupaai numei khat nasakin, a tuamdang khat pawpo taw a liam hi ngawl napi a nau a lal le, a nasakpa in tua numei nu pasal ii a ngetza, thukhente thu khen bangin liau tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang tua numei a kiliamsua le tua daan sia nuntakna atu nuntakna ma,"},"24":{"text":"mittang atu mit, hatang atu ha, khut atu khut, peang atu peang,","ref":"Thiam 24:19-20; Thkna 19:21; Mt 5:38"},"25":{"text":"meikaang atu meikaang, liamna atu liamna, chidup atu chidup ma hi tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Mihing khat in a silanu ahibuale a silapa saatin a mit a taw le, a mittang atu in tua sila sia suaktasak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"A ha tang khat a tongsak le a ha taangin tua sila sia suatakna pia tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Khuital khat in mihing khat a siilum le tua khuital suang taw kideanglum tu a, a sa kine ngawl tu hi; ahizong a neipa daan kipia ngawl tu hi.","title":"Ngan Tote ii Vaipuak"},"29":{"text":"Ahizong tua khuital in ngual a sik zongsang sa hi in, a neipa tungah a kidop natu kison zo napi khum ngawlin — mihing khat a siilum le tua khuital sia suang taw kideanglum tu a, a neipa zongh kithatlum tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahizong tua a neipa sia a nuntakna a kihuukna in liausum a kipiasak le, a nget zaza a piak kul tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Khuital khat in patangno khat ahibuale numeino khat a silum le tua zui tu ngeina sia taw ma a kibang hi tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Khuital in sila numei khat ahibuale sila pa khat a silum le ngan neipa in sila topa tungah sum ngunntang sawmthum pia tu a, tua khuital suang taw kideanglum tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Mihing khat in dum sitna a hon hang ahibuale dum to in a sit ngawl hu in, khuital ahibuale laa khat tua dum sungah a taak le,"},"34":{"text":"ama in tua nganno ii man liau nanak tu hi. Ngan neipa tungah a sum pia tu a, tua nganhing thi sia ama in tang thei tu hi."},"35":{"text":"Mihing khat ii khuital khat in midang khat ii khuital a silum le amate nii in a nungta khuital sia zuakin, a sum hawm tu hi; khuital thi sia ii sa zongh hawm tu uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahizong tua khuital sia ngual sik tu a zongsang khat hi ci in, kihe a, a neipa in khum ngawl ahile a dang khat pa tungah ama khuital nungta khat taw lo kik hamtang in sumsisak ngawl tu hi, ahizong khuital thi sia ama in tang tu hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mihing khat in khuipui ahibuale tuu khat ngu in a ngo, a zuak le ama in khuipui khat taangin khuipui nga, tuu khat taangin tuu li pia hamtang tu hi.","title":"Liausum taw kisai Thukhamte"},"2":{"text":"Ama in a nguk sia atu liau hamtang tu hi. Ama in bangma a nei buale a nguk sa teng a liau natu in ama sila in kizuak tu hi. A nguk nganhing sia khui, laa, tuu a nungta in ama khut sungah a kimu le ama in a zaa nii in liau tu hi. “Nguta khat in zan lai in inn phuul a, a kithatlum le a that pa sia mithat in kimawsak ngawl tu hi. Ahizong tuasia sun hun sung a piang ahile mithat in kimawsak tu hi.","merge":"3"},"5":{"text":"“Mihing khat in a ngannote lo ahibuale sapithuan khat ah tha in a tatsak laitak a ngante puapial in midang khat ii lo ah ankungte a neaksak le, ama lote ahibuale a sapithuante pan a bo teng lo kik tu hi."},"6":{"text":"“Mihing khat in ama lo pan meikuang khat kipan a, ngual dangkhat ii lo kipeesak in a kikhol ante ahibuale ankungte a kaangh le mei a kaanghsakpa in a lal teng liau tu hi."},"7":{"text":"“Mihing khat in midang khat ii sum ahizong, na manpha dangte ahizong kepsak tu in thukim a, ama inn pan kingu in, a ngupa a kikan zo le a zaa nii in kiliausak tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahizong a ngupa a kimu buale vanh manphate a keampa sia biakna munah kipaipui tu a tua munah a nguksak ngawlna thu kiciam tu hi."},"9":{"text":"“Khui, laa, tuu, puansilh ahibuale nadang a bo khat pawpo taw kisai thuneina theampo ah tua na a kituu te nii sia biakna munah kipaipui tu hi. Pathian ii maw hi a ci sia pa in a langkhat pa tungah a zaa nii in liau tu hi."},"10":{"text":"“Mihing khat in ngual laa, khui, tuu nganhing dang khat kepsak tu thukim a, tua nganno thi, liam ahibuale a kitaipuisak ahihang tetti a om buale"},"11":{"text":"biakna munah ngan keampa paipui tu a, ngual ngan a nguksak ngawlna thu a kiciam kul tu hi. A kingu ahibuale a neipa a sumh hi tu hi, tua pa in liau ngawl tu hi;"},"12":{"text":"ahizong a kingu ahile a nei pa tung liau hamtang tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ngamsate ii thalup ahile a neakmongte tetti in a lak kul hi; ama in ngamsa ii thalup sia atu liau kul ngawl hi."},"14":{"text":"“Mihing khat in ngual ngan zawng a, a nei pa om ngawl sungin a liamsak ahibuale, a thisak le tua pa in liau tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahizong a nei pa om sungin, tuabang thu piang ahile liau kul ngawl hi. Man piak tu in a kizawng ahile a zawn man teng taw kisi tu hi."},"16":{"text":"“Mihing khat in a kidongh ngawl lai ngaknu thiangtho khat zolin a ompui le moman teng a piak kul a, tuaciang teenpui tu hi.","title":"Ngamtatna le Biakna taw kisai Thukhamte","ref":"Thkna 22:28-29"},"17":{"text":"Ahizong a numei ii pa in a kiteen tu a oai buale tua ngaknu khat atu moman za sia a sum in a pa tungah pia nanak tu hi."},"18":{"text":"“Bum le ai toai numei peuma kithatlum tu hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:10-11"},"19":{"text":"“Nganhing khat taw a khialpa peuma kithatlum tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:23; 20:15-16; Thkna 27:21"},"20":{"text":"“Keima., Topa simngawl, pathian dang tungah sangaw biakpiakna a vawt peuma kithatlum tu hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:2-7"},"21":{"text":"“Ngamdangmi khat vawtsia ahibuale zothaw heak vun; Egypt ah ngamdangmite na hina uh phawk vun."},"22":{"text":"Meingong ahibuale tanga peuma na vawtsia heak vun.","ref":"Pu 23:9; Thiam 19:33-34; Thkna 24:17-18; 27:19"},"23":{"text":"Na vawtsia uh le Keima Topa in amate ih hu hong ngetna aw ka zaak ciang ka zo tu a,"},"24":{"text":"ka thin uukin ngal sungah kong that tu hi. Na zite meingong tu a, na tate sia pa sel tu uh hi."},"25":{"text":"“Keima ii mi ahi a zawng khat pawpo tungah sum na pukthaak uh le sum pukthaak pa bangin om heak vun a, summeet na la heak vun.","ref":"Thiam 25:35-38; Thkna 15:7-11; 23:19-20"},"26":{"text":"Hong lo kik natu kikhapna in khat po ii puanvan silh lai na laaksak le, nitum ma in pia kik tu ni hi,","ref":"Thkna 24:10-13"},"27":{"text":"banghang ziam cile a khualumna tu in a neisun sia tua puanvan bek ahi hi. Ama bangdang silhin mutthip thei tu ziam? Ama in kei tungah hu ngen a, hong au ciang zo tu khi hi, banghang ziam cile ngual hesuak thei khi hi."},"28":{"text":"“Pathian na sonsia heak vun a, na minam lampuite na haamsiat heak vun.","ref":"Sawl 23:5,22-25; Thiam 17:15"},"29":{"text":"“Na lo an, na sapittui le na olive thau sung pan kei nong piak tute hong pia tavun. “Na tapaciilte kei hong pia tavun."},"30":{"text":"Na khui le na tuu a no suakciilte hong pia tavun, Tua a suakciil a pa sia ni sali sung a pui taw omsak in a, a ni liat ni in kei hong pia tavun."},"31":{"text":"“Note sia keima mihing na hi uh ciang ngamsate ii matsa nganhing ii sa peuma ne ngawlin uite pia zaw vun."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“A maan ngawl kamdawn kizelsak heak vun a, a maw sia hu nuamin leilot tetti pang heak vun.","title":"Thutang le A pha a kilawm thukhenna","ref":"Pu 20:16; Thiam 19:11-12; Thkna 5:20"},"2":{"text":"Mihing a tamzawte ii khialna a vawt ciang le thutang khenna pan lam a pialsak tetti a pan ciang amate zui heak vun."},"3":{"text":"Mizawng khat thu a kisitna ah ngum tuan heak vun.","ref":"Thiam 19:15"},"4":{"text":"“Na ngalpa ii khui ahibuale a laa a tai na mu uh le ama kungah puak kik vun."},"5":{"text":"Ama ii laa a vanh taw a puk na mu le a laa phokpui vun a; paisan heak vun.","ref":"Thkna 22:1-4"},"6":{"text":"“Mizawng khat thukhenzum a thet ciang thutang khenna taansak heak vun."},"7":{"text":"A maan ngawlin ngual mawsiat heak vun a, mawnei ngawl khat that heak vun, banghang ziam cile tuabangin a sia a vawt peuma ka mawsak tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Sumnguk ne heak vun, banghang ziam cile sumnguk in mihingte a maan bang musak ngawlin, a maw ngawlte mailam lalsak hi.","ref":"Thiam 19:15; Thkna 16:19"},"9":{"text":"“Ngamdangmi khat vawtsia heak vun; ngamdangmite ii a thinsung thuakzia na he uh hi, banghang ziam cile Egypt ah note ngamdangmite na hi uh hi.","ref":"Pu 22:21; Thiam 19:33-34; Thkna 24:17-18; 27:19"},"10":{"text":"“Kum luk sung na lo ah thai na ciing tu uh a, an piang teng na kaikhawm tu uh hi.","title":"A Kum Sali Kum le A Ni Sali Ni"},"11":{"text":"Ahizong kum sali kum sia tawlngasakin tua lo pan a piangte bangma la heak vun. Lo sung pan a lipote mizawngte in ne tahen a, a taanglai teng ngamsate in ne tahen. Na sapithuan le na olive kungte zongh tuabang ma in hi tavun.","ref":"Thiam 25:1-7"},"12":{"text":"“Nipi khat sung ni luk naseam in, ahizong ni sali ni in naseam heak vun, tua hile note na hong sepsak na silate le ngamdangmite, na ngannote zongh tawlnga thei tu uh hi.","ref":"Pu 20:9-11; 31:15; 34:21; 35:2; Thiam 23:3; Thkna 5:13-14"},"13":{"text":"“Keima, Topa ii kong son theampo hong ngai tavun. A dang pathiante tungah thungen heak vun a; a min zongh lo heak vun."},"14":{"text":"“Keima patoaina in kum khat sung thumvei poaipi khaam vun.","title":"Poaipi Lian Thum (Pusuana 34:18-26 ; Thuhil kikna 16:1-17)"},"15":{"text":"Kong thupiakna sa taw kizui in Egypt na nusiat tha ahi, Abib tha sungin Tol saw ngawl Anluum Poaipi khaam vun. Tua poaipi ni sali hun sung tol taw kivawt anluum peuma ne heak vun. Biakpiak natu khat keng ngawlin kei hong bia tu in hong pai heak vun.","ref":"Pu 12:14-20; Thiam 23:6-8; Mi 28:17-25"},"16":{"text":"“Anlaak tu na kipat uh ciang Anlaak Poaipi khaam vun. ‘Na sapithuan le na thingnga huan pan thingngate na kaikhop uh ciang tangngam hun sungin Anlaak Poaipi khaam vun.","ref":"Thiam 23:15-21; Mi 28:26-31; Thiam 23:39-43"},"17":{"text":"Kum sim hi poaipi thumte ah keima, Topa na Pathian hong bia tu in na mite theampo hong pai nanak tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"“Nganhing khat taw biakpiakna nong vawt uh ciang tol saw anluum hong pia heak vun. Hi poaipi te sungah sangaw biakpiakna nong vawt uh ciang nganhing thaute sia a zingsang ciang dongin koi heak vun."},"19":{"text":"“Kum simin na lo anpal sia Topa na Pathian inn sungah hong paipui tavun. “Tuuno ahibuale kealno sa, a nu noaitui sungah huan heak vun.","ref":"Thkna 26:2; Pu 34:26; Thkna 14:21"},"20":{"text":"“Na khualhawna ah hong cing tu le ka vawtkholsa munah hong paipui tu in na mai ah vantunglalang khat ka paisak tu hi.","title":"Kamciamnate le Kihilnate"},"21":{"text":"Ama thudon in, a thu ni tavun. Ama leedo heak vun, banghang ziam cile keima sawl hi a, tuabang leedona sia hong maisak ngawl tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahizong ama ii thu ni in kong thupiak theampo na seam uhle na ngalte theampo kong simsak tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Na mai ah ka vantunglalang pai in, Amor te, Hit te, Periz te, Canaan te, Hiv te le Jebus te ngam ah hong paipui tu a, tuaciang amate ka sucip siat tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate ii pathiante mai ah kunin bia heak vun, amate ii biakna ziate zui heak vun. A pathiante suksiat sakin a suangkhuam thiangthote sutham vun."},"25":{"text":"Topa na Pathian keima nong bia uh le an le tui taw thupha kong pia tu a, note natna theampo kong laaksak siat tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Na ngam na lei ah numei nautol om ngawlin, a tasel zongh om ngawl tu hi. Keima in note khansauna kong pia tu hi."},"27":{"text":"“No hong langpan mihingte in keima hong kiitak natu in ka vawt tu hi; na do ngalte sungah buaina ka omsak tu a, note kung pan na ngalte theampo kilee in ka taisak siat tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Na ngalte ka patausak tu hi; note maisang nawt in na pai uh ciang Hiv mite, Canaan mite, le Hit mite ka notkeak tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Kum khat sungin amate ka notkeak siat buatu hi; notkeak siat thong leng tua ngam sia ngamtongta suak tu a, note atu in ngamsate tam leih tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua sangin tua ngam a lua khom tu mihing na om thei mateng tawtawm in ka not tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Na ngamngi uh kong vawtsak tu a, Aqaba Tuidok pan Mediterranean Tuipi dong le sennealngam pan Eupharates Ngun dong hi tu hi. Tua ngam ah a teangte tungah vaang neina kong pia tu a, maisang na manaw uh ciang na notkeak tu uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Amate taw ahizong a pathiante taw ahizong thukimna peuma vawt heak vun."},"33":{"text":"Tua mihingte na ngam sungah teangsak heak vun; na teangsak uh le amate in kei tungah na maw na khial natu hong vawt tu hi. A pathiante na bia uh le note atu in hong thisak thei thaang hi tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Nangma le Aaron, Nadab, Abihu le Israel lampui sawmsalite ka kung mual tungah hong kaato tavun a; a khuala thithimna ah na om uh laitak kunin hong bia tavun.","title":"Thuciamna Kikipsak"},"2":{"text":"A dangte hi ngawl, nangma bek in ka kung nong pai tu hi, midangte kuama in hong neak ngawl tu hi. Mipite sia mualtung ngawngawn zong ah kaato ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Moses pai in a mipite tungah Topa thupiak teng le zui tu thu teng son a, mihing theampo in, “ Topa ci theampo ka vawt siat tu uh hi,” ci in zo uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa thupiak theampo Moses in at siat hi. A zing ciang zing tuungin mualpeang ah Moses in biaknatau khat sa in, Israel minam sawm le niite atu in suangtum sawm le nii phut hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in tangvalte sawl a. amate in meihal biakpiaknate le khui pawl khat ngoin kipawlkhop sangaw biakpiakna te Topa tungah vawt uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Moses in nganhing te ii chisan a lang la in kuang sungah koi a; a lang sia biaknatau ah the hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Moses in Topa thupiak teng a ki at, thuciamna laibu la in mipite tungah nging takin sim hi. Amate in, “ Topa thu ka ni tu uh a, ama thupiak theampo ka vawt siat tu uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Moses in kuangte sung pan chisan la in mipite the hi. Ama in, “Hi chisan sia Topa ii hi thu teng hong piak lai in, ama ii note taw a vawt thuciamna a kipsak chisan ahi hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 26:28; Mk 14:24; Lk 22:20; 1 Cor 11:25; Heb 10:29; Heb 9:19-20"},"9":{"text":"Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu le Israel lampui sawmsalite mual tungah kaato a,"},"10":{"text":"amate in Israel te ii Pathian mu uh hi. A peang nuai ah vancii bang ahi, sapphire suangpheak khat taw a kibang om hi."},"11":{"text":"Pathian in Israel lampuite bangma law ngawl hi; amate in Pathian mu a, tua zawkciang amate an nekhawm tui dawnkhawm uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Keima kung mual tungah hong kaato ta'n a, hi lai ah na om sungin mihingte kihil natu in keima at sa thukham teng theampo a om suangpheak nii kong pia tu hi,” ci hi.","title":"Moses Sinai Mual tungah"},"13":{"text":"Moses le ama a hupa Joshua kithoai a, mual thiangtho ah kaato tu in Moses kipan hi."},"14":{"text":"Moses in lampuite tungah, “Kong heak kik uh mateng hi lai ngiaphual pan hong ngak tavun. Aaron le Hur, note taw hi lai ah om hi; tua ahikom thukhen tu buaina a nei pawpo in amate kungah pai thei tu nu hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Sinai Mual ah Moses kaato in, meei in tua mual tuamcip hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa ompuina khuavak taang velvol sia mual tungah hong theng suk hi. Tua khuavak taang sia Israel mite atu in mualdawn ah a taang meikuang khat taw kibang hi. Ni luk sung meei in mual tuamcip in, a ni sali ni in meei sung pan Topa in Moses sam hi.","merge":"17"},"18":{"text":"Mualtung meei sungah Moses kaato hi. Tua munah Moses sun sawmli le zan sawmli om hi.","ref":"Thkna 9:9"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Puanbuk Thiangtho atu Sumpite (Pusuana 35:4-9)"},"2":{"text":"“Kei tungah sumpi hong piak natu in Israel te son in. A pia nuam khat pawpo ii sumpite saang in."},"3":{"text":"Hi sumpite sia: khamh, ngunn le taau;"},"4":{"text":"puanneal, vancii, a sandup le a san samulpuan; kealmul taw kivawt puan;"},"5":{"text":"a san a kinimh tuuvun, savun neal, acacia thing;"},"6":{"text":"meidet sathau, noi sathau le ngimnamtui atu hel namtuite;"},"7":{"text":"Thiampi Lianbel ii ephod tung le awmdal te tungah bul tu suangsante le suangmanpha dangte ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate sungah ka teen thei natu in, kei atu in mite in puanbuk thiangtho khat vawt tahen."},"9":{"text":"Tuasia le a sung nazak tu te theampo kong lak tu ngealna bangin vawt tahen."},"10":{"text":"“Acacia thing taw thingkuang a sau centimetre 110, a zai centimetre 66, a saang centimetre 66 khat vawt in.","title":"Thuciamna Thingkuang (Pusuana 37:1-9)"},"11":{"text":"A sung a pua khamh ciitak taw tuam in a, a mong kiimkot khamh taw zial in."},"12":{"text":"A zawn natu khamh kual li vawt in a, a pangh lang le lang ah nii veve, a peang lite tungah bul in."},"13":{"text":"A zawn natu in acacia thingpum sui in a, khamh taw tuamin,"},"14":{"text":"thingkuang pangh veve ah a kibul khamh kualte sungah thun in."},"15":{"text":"Tua thingpumte khamh kualte sungah kinusia tu a, kila nawn ngawl het tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaciang nang kong piak tu thupiak teng a ki at suangpheak niite thingkuang sungah koi in."},"17":{"text":"“A sitna khamh ciitak taw vawt in, a sau centimetre 110, a zai centimetre 66 hi tu hi.","ref":"Heb 9:5"},"18":{"text":"A kiseakpeak khamh taw cherub nii ii lim vawt in a,"},"19":{"text":"a sitna mong veve ah koi in. A sitna taw kipee, a sakhat tu in vawt in."},"20":{"text":"Cherub niite ii lim sia a sitna tungah khat le khat kimaingat tu a, a tha kiphalte in tuasia liap tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Suangpheakte nii thingkuang sungah koi in a tungah a sitna koi in."},"22":{"text":"Tualai ah kong kisikpui tu a, cherub te ii a thate nii kilaklaw, a sitna tung panin Israel mite atu, ka thukhamte theampo nang kong pia tu hi."},"23":{"text":"“Acacia thing taw a sau centimetre 88, a zai centimetre 44, a saang centimetre 66 sabuai khat vawt in.","title":"Pathian A Kipia Anluum lui natu Sabuai (Pusuana 37:10-16)"},"24":{"text":"khamh ciitak taw tuamin, a mong kiimkot khamh taw zial in."},"25":{"text":"A kiil kiimkot millimetre 75 zaisakin, khamh taw tuam in."},"26":{"text":"Khamkual li vawt in a, a peang omna king li ah bul in."},"27":{"text":"Tua khamh kualte sabuai zawn natu thingpumte thun natu hi a, sabuai kiil ah bul tu ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"A thingpumte acacia thing taw vawt in a, khamh taw tuam in."},"29":{"text":"Sapittui biakpiakna ah a kizangh tu pakante, haite, haitungte le kuangte vawt in. Hi teng khamh ciitak taw kivawt tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Sabuai sia Thuciamna Thingkuang mai ah kikoi tu a, kei hong kipia anluum thiangtho sia tua sabuai tungah kilui tawntung tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 24:5-8"},"31":{"text":"“Khamh ciitak taw meivakna khuam vawt in. A tawdap le a khuamte a kiseakpeak khamh taw vawt in; a zepna paakte, a momte le paakpalhte zongh meikhuam taw sakhat hi tu hi.","title":"Meivakna Khuam (Pusuana 37:17-24)"},"32":{"text":"A khuam panghte pan baak luk kaasak tu a, a lang le lang ah baak thum veve om tu hi."},"33":{"text":"A baak luk te khat simin almond paak bangin a mom le a palh taw a kithua paak nam thum nei tu hi."},"34":{"text":"A meikhuam sia almond paak bangin a mom le a paakpalh taw a kithua kizepna paak pha nam li nei tu hi."},"35":{"text":"Kop thum a pha a baakte sim ii nuai ah a mom khat tek om tu hi."},"36":{"text":"A momte, a baakte le meikhuam sia a kiseakpeak khamh ciitak bek khat taw a kivawt hi tu hi."},"37":{"text":"A mai sang a taan thei natu in tua meivak khuam tungah meivak sali de in."},"38":{"text":"Taiteete le kuangdalte khamh ciitak taw vawt in."},"39":{"text":"Hi meikhuam le a nadang teng vawt natu in khamh ciitak kilogramme 35 zangh in."},"40":{"text":"Mual tungah kong lak ngealna sia bang tatak in, tua nate pha takin vawt in.","ref":"Sawl 7:44; Heb 8:5"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Kong ompuina Puanbuk, a thiangtho puanbuk sungsang sia vancii, a sandup, le a san tuumul taw a kitak puanneal bek sawm taw vawt in. Tua puante cherub limte taw zeam in.","title":"ii Ompuina Puanbuk (Pusuana 36:8-38)"},"2":{"text":"Tua puante a letna kikim tu a, metre 12 sau in metre 2 zai veu hi tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua puan ngate khatin khuikhawmin, a dang nga teng zongh tuabang ma khuikhawm in."},"4":{"text":"Na puan pee khop khat simin a puasang puanbek ii mong tung teng ah vancii puan kualte vawt in."},"5":{"text":"A puan masa sia tungah kual sawmnga koi in a, a niina puan sia tung zongh ah a kibangin kual sawmnga ma koi in kisituasak in."},"6":{"text":"Tua puante nii sia puan khai khat in na pe thei natu khamh taw kivawt a khilna koaite sawmnga vawt in."},"7":{"text":"“Puanbuk ii a tung sit natu in kealmul taw kivawt puanbek sawm le khat vawt in."},"8":{"text":"Tua teng a letna kibangsak in, metre 13 sausak in, metre 2 zaisak in."},"9":{"text":"Tua puanbek nga teng khatin khui khawm in a, a dang luk teng khatin khuikhawm in. A lukna puanbek sia Puanbuk mai ii tung san ah thep nii in thep in."},"10":{"text":"Na khuikhop puankhai khat ii puanbek khakbel sia ii mong tungah a kual sawmnga vawt in a, a dang khat sia mong zongh ah a kual sawmnga vawt in."},"11":{"text":"Puante kipee khop natu in taaukoai sawmnga vawt in a, a sitna khat suak tu in a kikhui khawmsa puante nii ii a kualvangte sungah thun in a pe in."},"12":{"text":"Puanbuk nungsangah tua puanbek vaal ii a lang sia kaaisuksak in."},"13":{"text":"Tua puankhai sia a sau lamin a mong vaal centimetre sawmnga veve sia Puanbuk pangh tek ah kaaisuksak in."},"14":{"text":"“Puanbuk sit natu a sanin a kinimh tuutal vun taw kivawt a sitna khat le savun neal taw kivawt a sitna dangkhat te ngeal vawt lai in."},"15":{"text":"“Acacia thing taw Puanbuk a kalpheak dingtangte vawt in."},"16":{"text":"Tuate khat sim a sauna metre 4, a saana centimetre 66 hi tu a,"},"17":{"text":"a kipee thei natu in a meang nii vawt in. A kalpheak theampo tuabangin vawt siat in."},"18":{"text":"Thang sang atu a kalpheak kul,"},"19":{"text":"a nuai phaa tu ngunn taw kivawt tawdap sawmli vawt in a, a meangte a len tu in ngunn tawdap nii tek koi in."},"20":{"text":"Puanbuk saksang atu a kalpheak kul,"},"21":{"text":"a kalpheak khat ciang tawdap nii veu, ngunn tawdap sawmli vawt in."},"22":{"text":"Nitumna sang Puanbuk nungsangah a kalpheak luk,"},"23":{"text":"le a kingte atu in a kalpheak nii vawt in."},"24":{"text":"Hi a king a kalpheakte sia a bul pan pe in a dawn dong kizom siat tu hi. Tua king nii a piangsak a kalpheakte nii sia, tubangin kivawt tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuabangin a kalpheakte liat om tu a, khat simin tawdap nii veu, ngunn tawdap sawm le luk om tu hi."},"26":{"text":"“Acacia thingzawl sawm le nga vawt in, Puanbuk a kalpheakte atu in a pangh khat ah zawl nga veu,"},"27":{"text":"a langkhat ah a kalpheak nga le a nungsang nitumna sang khakbel ah a kalpheak nga vawt in."},"28":{"text":"A lai zawlsau, a kalpheakte nii ii lang kikhenna ah a kithung sia Puanbuk langkhat pan langkhat dong, a tuantung hi tu hi."},"29":{"text":"A kalpheakte khamh taw tuamin, a zawlte tum natu khamh kualte bulin a, a zawlte zongh khamh taw tuam in."},"30":{"text":"Mual tungah kong lak ngealna sa om bangin Puanbuk sa in."},"31":{"text":"“Vancii, a sandup le a san samul taw a kitak puanneal puankhai khat vawt in. Tuate cherub te ii limte taw zeam in."},"32":{"text":"Ngun tawdap li tungah a kiphut, vanh khaina a koaite a kithua khamh taw a kituam acacia thing khuam li tungah tua puan khai in."},"33":{"text":"Puanbuk innciing nuai ah puankhainate pan puankhai khaksuk in a, tua puan nungah suangpheak niite koina Thuciamna Thingkuang koi in. Tua puan in Thiangtho Mun le Thiangthobel Mun kidaakna ahi hi.","ref":"Heb 6:19; 9:3-5"},"34":{"text":"Thuciamna Thingkuang sitna thua in."},"35":{"text":"Thiangthobel Mun ii pua sang, Puanbuk ii saksang pangh ah sabuai koi in a, thangsang pangh ah meidetna khuam koi in."},"36":{"text":"“Puanbuk sung tumna puankhai tu in vancii, a sandup le a san samul taw a kitak thiamngelte taw a kizeam puanneal puankhai khat vawt in."},"37":{"text":"Hi puankhai atu in khamh taw a kituam le puankhaina khamh koai a kibul acacia thing khuam nga phut in; tua khuamte atu in taau tawdap nga vawt in."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Acacia thing taw biaknatau khat vawt in. Tua in king li nei tu a, a sauna metre 2.2, a zaina metre 2.2, a saanna metre 1.3 hi tu hi.","title":"Biaknatau (Pusuana 38:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"A king li dawn teng doksak in. Tua a dok teng biaknatau taw sakhat suak tu in, taau taw kituam siat tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Sathau baang vut koi natu in bealpeute le kawkeaute, kuangte, thikkoaite le meikam luana daalpheakte vawt in. Hi nazakte theampo taau taw kivawt tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Taau taw saaksai khat vawt in, a king li ah toai natu taaukual li koi in."},"5":{"text":"Tua taau saaksai sia biaknatau ii a lang dong a bat natu in biaknatau bitha nuai ah koi in."},"6":{"text":"A zawn natu Acacia thingpumte vawt in, taau taw tuam in."},"7":{"text":"Biaknatau a kizawn ciang a panghte nii ah a om a kualte sungah thingpumte thun in."},"8":{"text":"Mual tungah ngealna kong laksa bangin biaknatau sia thingpheak taw vawt in a, a sung vangsak in."},"9":{"text":"“Kong ompuina Puanbuk tu sia puanneal puankhaite taw doituam khat uum in. Thangsang pangh puankhaite sia metre 44 sau tu hi.","title":"ii Ompuina Puanbuk Doituam (Pusuana 38:9-20)"},"10":{"text":"Tua puan sia taau tawdap khat tek a nei taau khuam kul tungah na khak tu uh a, tua khuamte tungah ngunn taw a kivawt puankhainate le a zawlte om tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Doituam ii saksang pangh zongh ah tuabang ma in vawt in."},"12":{"text":"Nitumna sangah metre 22 a sau puankhaite, khuam sawm le a dap sawmte taw om tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Nisuana sang, kongbiang omna ah a doituam zongh metre 22 zai tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Kongbiang ii a pangh veve ah puankhaite metre 6.6 veu, khuam thum le a tawdap thumte taw om tu hi.","merge":"15"},"16":{"text":"A tumna kongbiang san ah vancii, a sandup, le a san samul taw a kitak thiamngelte taw a kizeam metre 9 a sau puanneal puankhai khat om tu hi. Tua in tawdap li taw a kiphut khuam li tungah kikhak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"A kiimkot uumna khuam teng ngunnzawlte taw kizom a, vanh khainate ngunn taw a kivawt hi in a tawdapte taau taw a kivawt hi tu hi."},"18":{"text":"A doituam sia metre 44 sau, metre 22 a zai le metre 2.2 a saang hi tu hi. Puankhaite puanneal taw kivawt tu a, a taw teng taau taw kivawt tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Puanbuk atu a kizangh vanh theampo le puanbuk atu le a doituam tu in, a kizangh khetphin theampo taau taw kivawt tu hi."},"20":{"text":"“Nitak simin meiinn a kidet thei natu in olive thau phabelte nang kung hong puak natu in Israel mite thupia in.","title":"Meivak Kepcingna (Thiampite 24:1-4)"},"21":{"text":"Kong ompuina Puanbuk sung, Thuciamna Thingkuang mai, puankhai pua sangah Aaron le a tapate in meiinn koi tu uh hi. Tua mun keima omna ah nitak pan zingsang dong mei de tu uh hi. Hi thupiak sia Israel te le a suan a paalte in a tawntung a zui tu uh ahi hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Na suapuipa Aaron le a tapate Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar le Ithamar te sam in. Keima tungah thiampi na a sep thei natu in amate Israel mite sung pan tuamkoi in.","title":"Thiampite Puante (Pusuana 39:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Na suapuipa Aaron sia a vaang nei natu le a et hoi natu in thiampi puante vawtsak in."},"3":{"text":"Keima na a seam tu in a ki aap thiampi khat a sua thei natu in thiamna ka piaksa khut thiam naseamte theampo samin Aaron ii puansilhte khui tu in sam in."},"4":{"text":"Amate in awmdal khat, ephod puan khat, puantual khat, thiamngel taw kizeam laktong khat, dialkhip khat le kawngsawmna khau khat a vawt natu in sawl in. Amate in ka na a seam thei thiampite a sua natu in khutthiamte in na suapui pa Aaron le a tapate atu in hi thiampi puante khuisak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Khutthiamte in vancii, a sandup, a san samul, khamh khau le puanneal phate zangh tu hi."},"6":{"text":"“Amate in ephod sia vancii, a sandup, le a san samul, khamh khau le puanneal phate taw vawtin, thiamngel taw zeam tu hi."},"7":{"text":"A kikhit thei natu in, a liangko lang le lang ah a sawmna khau nii om tu hi."},"8":{"text":"A dangte taw a vawtdan a kibang, pha tak a kitak kawng sawmna khau sia ephod taw sakhat tu in a tungah thuap tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Suangmanpha san nii la in, a tungah Jacob tapa sawm le niite min at in,"},"10":{"text":"amate pianna suana taw kizui in a min luk te suang khat tungah at in, a dang luk te ii min teng suang dang khat tungah at in."},"11":{"text":"Suang manpha a zeamthiamte khat in hi suangte nii tungah Jacob tapa sawm le niite min atsak in a, tua suangte khamh dapphate tungah suang in."},"12":{"text":"Tuate Israel minam sawm le niite taangin ephod liangkhai puan tungah koi in. Tuabangin Aaron in a minte a liangko tungah pua tu a, tuasia ciang keima Topa in ka mite ka phawk tawntung tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Khamh dappha nii na vawt zawk uh ciangin,"},"14":{"text":"khamh ciitak taw a kivawt zam nii te khau bang a kipheak sa in ngui nii vawt in, khamh dappha sia taw na khii khawm tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"“Pathian ii deina heak thei natu in, a kizangh awmdal khat Thiampi Lianbelpa atu in vawt in. Tuasia ephod vawtnate taw ma kibangin a kivawt, thiamngel taw a kizeam hi tu hi.","title":"Awmdal (Pusuana 39:8-21)"},"16":{"text":"A tung a phei a kikim king li nei thep nii in kithep tu a, centimetre 22 sau, centimetre 22 zai hi tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua tungah suangmanpha ngual li in na suan tu a; ngual khatna ah ruby khat, topaz khat le garnet khat hi tu hi;"},"18":{"text":"Ngual niina ah emerald khat, sapphire khat le diamond khat;"},"19":{"text":"ngual thumna ah turquoise khat, agate khat le amethyst khat;"},"20":{"text":"le ngual lina ah beryl khat, carnelian khat le jasper khat hi tu hi. Hite khamh dapphate sungah kisuang tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel minamte taangin Jacob tapa khat tek ii min a ki at suang sawm le nii na koi tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Awmdal atu in khauhual taw kibangin a kipheak khawm khamh ciitak khi ngui vawt in."},"23":{"text":"Khamkual nii vawt in, awmdal tung sang kingte veve ah suan in."},"24":{"text":"Tua khamh khauhual te nii sia, a kual te nii tungah khit in."},"25":{"text":"A khauhual ii mong te nii sia dappha te nii tungah khit in a, tuaciang ephod ii liangkhai maisang ah thua in."},"26":{"text":"Tuaciang khamh kual nii vawt in, awmdal a nuai king veve ephod mong sung sangah suan in."},"27":{"text":"Khamkual nii vawt in, ephod maisang liangkhai nuai ah khitin pha tak a kitak kawngkhau tungah sawm in."},"28":{"text":"Kawngkhau tungah pha tak a om thei natu le awmdal a kol ngawl natu in, awmdal khaute ephod khaute tungah khau vancii khat taw sawm khawm in."},"29":{"text":"“Keima Topa in ka mite ka phawk tawntung natu in, Thiangtho Mun ah Aaron a tum ciang Israel minamte min a ki at awmdal silh tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuabangin a thiangtho kong ompuina sungah Aaron hong pai ciang a ken thei tu in ama awmdal sungah Urim le Thummim koi in. Israel mite atu in ka deina a heak thei natu in tuabang hun ciangin tua awmdal ama in silh tawntung tu hi.","ref":"Mi 27:21; Thkna 33:8; Ezra 2:63; Neh 7:65"},"31":{"text":"“Ephod puan nuai ah silh tu puantual sia vancii samulpuan siuseu taw kivawt tu hi.","title":"Thiampi Puan dangte (Pusuana 39:22-31)"},"32":{"text":"Lu thun natu a vang om tu a, tua a vang kiimkot sia a ek ngawl natu in a kitak sa puan taw tuam thua tu hi."},"33":{"text":"A nuai kiimkot ah vancii, a sandup le a san samul puan taw a kivawt talee nga te khamh tengeng te taw a kithatheak in koi in.","merge":"34"},"35":{"text":"Aaron in thiampi na a sep ciang tua puantual silh tu hi. Ka ompuina Mun Thiangtho ah ama hong pai ciang ahibuale a pusua ciang tengeng nging kiza tu a, ama kithatlum ngawl tu hi."},"36":{"text":"“Khamh ciitak taw kizepna khat vawt in a, a tungah ‘ Topa atu Kitavaw’ ci in at in."},"37":{"text":"Tua kizepna sia lu khipdial mai ah vancii meal khau khat taw khit in."},"38":{"text":"Mite in biakpiakna a vawt ciang khialna pawlkhat a vawt hial zong, Israel te ii kei tung hong aap biakpiakna theampo ka san natu in Aaron in tua kizepna sia a tal ah suang tu hi."},"39":{"text":"“Puanneal pha taw Aaron laktong le lu khipdial le thiamngel taw a kizeam kawngsawmna khat zongh vawt in."},"40":{"text":"“Aaron tapate ii vaang nei natu le et hoi natu in, laktong, kawngsawmna le lukhu vawt in."},"41":{"text":"Hi puante na suapuipa Aaron le a tapate silhsak in. Tuaciang amate in ka na a seam thei thiampite ahi natu in thupha piak kipsakna le aapna in olive thau taw zut in."},"42":{"text":"A ci a sa a kimu ngawl natu in a kawng pan a pheizang ciang a pha ngoaipuante khuisak in."},"43":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate in a sealno teng a kimu hu in, thalupna a thuak ngawl natu in ka omna Puanbuk ah hong pai ciang ahibuale Mun Thiangtho ah thiampi naseam tu in biaknatau hong neak ciang tua ngoaipuan teang tawntung tu hi. Tua in Aaron le a suan a paalte atu in a zui tu ngeina kip ahi hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Aaron le a tapate ka na a seam thiampi tu in na aap ciang hi bangin na vawt tu hi. A mealhem ngawl khuital moi khat le tuutal nii keng in.","title":"Aaron le A Tapate Thiampi Kipsak natu Hilnate (Thiampite 8:1-36)"},"2":{"text":"Tol saw ngawl zungtaang vui phabel zangh in olive thau taw anluum pawlkhat, olive thau ngawl taw anluum pawlkhat le sathau taw a kizut moh pawlkhat vawt in."},"3":{"text":"Tuate khum sungah koi in, khuital le tuutalte nii biakpiakna in na ngaw uh ciang hong pia tavun."},"4":{"text":"“Aaron le a tapate kong ompuina Puanbuk tumna kongbiang ah hong paipui in, amate a zeksa kibualna neisak in."},"5":{"text":"Tuaciang Aaron sia thiampi puante — laktong, ephod, ephod nuai ah a kisilh puantual silhsak in, awmdal le kawngkhau thuasak in."},"6":{"text":"A lu tungah dial khimsakin, tua tungah, ‘ Topa atu Kitavaw’ a kici a thiangtho ki aapna lim kizepna sia suang in."},"7":{"text":"Tuaciang noi sathau la in, a lu tungah buakin, noai in."},"8":{"text":"“A tapate paipui in puante silhsak in;"},"9":{"text":"a kawng ah kawngsawmna khau sawm in, a lu tungah lukhu khusak in. Hi bangin Aaron le a tapate thiampi naseam tu in thupha pia in kipsak tu hi. Amate le a suan a paalte in a tawntungin thiampi panmun taw ka na seam tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"“Ka omna Puanbuk mai ah khuital hong paipui ta'n a, khuital lu tungah a khut a ngak natu in Aaron le a tapate son in."},"11":{"text":"Tualai a thiangtho ka ompuina Puanbuk tumna kongbiang ah khuital ngo in."},"12":{"text":"Khuital chi tawm la in, biaknatau dokte tungah na khutme taw noai in. Tuaciang a om lai teng biaknatau bul ah sung in."},"13":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a sungthau theampo, a thin sa phabel na mun le, a nauta te nii le nauta a tuam a thaute la in, keima biakna in biaknatau tungah hal in."},"14":{"text":"Ahizong khuital satak, a vun le a sungkua theampo ngiaphual pua sangah hal in. Tua biakpiakna ii a ngimnam in keima hong lungkimsak hi.","ref":"Eph 5:2; Php 4:18"},"19":{"text":"“Ki aapna in a kizangh tuutal — tuutal dangkhat sia — la in a, Aaron le a tapate in tua sia ii lu tungah a khut a ngak natu in sawl in."},"20":{"text":"Tua tuutal ngoin, a chi tawm la in Aaron le a tapate bil ziatsang dawn, a ziatsang khutpi tung, le a ziatsang peangpi tungah noai in. A om lai chi teng biaknatau pangh li tengah the in."},"21":{"text":"Biaknatau tungah a om chi tawm le noi sathau tawm la in Aaron le a puante tung, a tapate le a puante tungah the in. Aaron, a tapate le amate ii puante kei tungah hong ki aap tu hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tuutal thau, a meici thau, a sungthau, a thinsa phabelna, a thau, a nautate nii le nauta a tuam a thau, a ziatsang phei hoaikeak in."},"23":{"text":"Kei tungah nong piaksa anluum khum sung pan a nam simin: olive thau taw kivawt anluum khat, olive thau kihel ngawl anluum khat le moh phaang khat tek la vun."},"24":{"text":"“Hi an theampo Aaron le a tapate khut sungah koi in a, kei tungah a letsong tuam khat in hong aap natu in son in."},"25":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate tung pan anluumte la in a, biaknatau tung, meihal biakpiakna tungah an taw keima nong biakpiakna in hal in. Hi tuu awmsa baak sia nangma atu ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"“Thiampi khat thupha pia in a kikipsak ciang, a kizangh tuu awmsa le a pheisate sia keima tungah letsong tuam khat in nong aap tu a, thiampite atu in kikoituam tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Hi thu a kikheal ngawl ka thukhenna hi a, ka mite in kipawlkhop biakpiakna a nei ciang, nganno awmsa le a pheisate thiampite neisa hi tu hi. Tua ante an thiangtho ahikom thiampite bek in ne tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Sa ahizong, anluum ahizong zingsang dongin neakmong a om lai le kihal tu hi; tuate sia an thiangtho ahikom kine ngawl tu hi."},"35":{"text":"“Aaron le a tapate atu in thupha piak kipsakna ngeinate kong thupiak bang linlian in ni sali sung vawt in."},"36":{"text":"Mawna a kimaisak thei natu in ni simin khuital khat biakpiakna in pia nanak tu ni hi. Tua in biaknatau thiansua tu hi. Tua zawkciang a thiantho natu in olive thau noai in."},"37":{"text":"Tuabangin ni sali sung ni simin vawt in. Tuasia ciang biaknatau sia thiangtho sitset tu a, tuasia a thutha mihing khat ahibuale na khat peuma biaknatau ii thianthona vaang in ngim ngasak tu hi."},"38":{"text":"“Hong pai tu hun theampo ah ni simin biaknatau ah kum khat a pha tuuno nii biakpiakna in pia in.","title":"Ni sim Biakpiaknate (Ngamsung vakna 28:1-8)"},"39":{"text":"Zingsang in khat, nitakin khat biakpiakna in pia in."},"40":{"text":"A masa tuu sia taw in olive thau thiang litre khat taw kihel anvui kilogramme khat pia khawm in. Biakpiakna in sapittui litre khat buak in."},"41":{"text":"A niina tuu sia nitak biakpiakna in nei in, zingsang a bangma in anvui, olive thau le sapittui biakpiakna in pia in. Hi sia keima Topa an biakpiakna hi a, tua ii ngimnam in keima hong lungkimsak hi."},"42":{"text":"Hong pai tu hun theampo ah hi meihal biakpiakna sia ka ompuina Puanbuk tumna kongbiang, keima mai ah hong kipia tu hi. Tua munah ka mite kong mu tu a, kong paupui tu hi."},"43":{"text":"Tualai ah Israel mite ka mu tu a, kong ompuina khuavak taang velvol sia in tua mun thiangthosak tu hi."},"44":{"text":"Puanbuk le biaknatau ka thiangthosak tu a, Aaron le a tapate in thiampi na seam tu in ka tuam koi tu hi."},"45":{"text":"Israel mite sungah ka teang tu a, amate ii Pathian ka hi tu hi."},"46":{"text":"Israel mite sungah ka teen thei natu in keima in Egypt pan amate a pusuapui Topa a Pathian ka hina amate in he tu uh hi. Keima in amate ii Pathian Topa ka hi hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Paaknamtui hal natu in biaknatau khat acacia thing taw vawt in.","title":"Paaknamtui Hal natu Biaknatau (Pusuana 37:25-28)"},"2":{"text":"A sau centimetre 45, a zai centimetre 45, le a saang centimetre 90 hi tu a, a pangh kikim in kiing li nei tu hi. Keima Topa tungah hong ki aap hi biaknatau sia thiangtho sitset tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Ompuina Puanbuk atu Phiangshia"},"12":{"text":"“Israel mite ii mihing simna a nei ciang, a mi phaza a kisim laitak amate tungah tuasiatna a thet ngawl natu in mi theampo in a nuntakna ii man kei tungah hong pia tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Mihing simna ah a kihel peuma in, a kizangh ngei khaikhin taw tee in a kinget za sum pia tu hi. Olive thau litre 4 belap in,"},"25":{"text":"paaknamtui hel bangin noi sathau thiangtho vawt in."},"26":{"text":"Hi sathau sia ka ompuina Puanbuk, Thuciamna Thingkuang,"},"27":{"text":"sabuai le a na theampo, meikhuam le a na theampo, paaknamtui halna biaknatau,"},"28":{"text":"meihal biakpiakna biaknatau le a na theampo le kisilna kuang le a ngakna teng noai in."},"29":{"text":"Hi nate hi bangin na aap tu uh a, tua hile thiangtho sitset tu hi. Hi teng a vawt ciang, na tungah kong thupiak bang tatakin amate in vawt tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah","title":"Sabbath, Tawlngakna Ni"},"13":{"text":"Israel mite tungah a son tu in, “Ka tawlngak ni ahi Sabbath na tang vun, banghang ziam cile tua ni sia hong pai tu hun theampo sung Keima, Topa in note keima mi in kong vawt hunlam a kilangh natu in keima le note kilaklaw ah lim khat ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tawlngakna ni sia na tan kul tu hi, banghang ziam cile tua ni sia thiangtho hi. Amate in hisia Egypt pan a pusua pui amate ii pathian hi ci uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi mihingte thinpuizia ka he hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu in, kei hong tho tu hanciam heak in. Amate tungah ka thin uuk a, ka mongsak tu hi. Tua zawkciang nangma le na suan na paalte minam lian khatin kong vawt tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahizong Moses in Topa a Pathian tungah hesuak ngenin, “ Topa awng, na thahatna le na vaangletna taw Egypt pan na suatak, na mite tungah banghangin na thin uuksak mama thong ni ziam?","ref":"Mi 14:13-19"},"12":{"text":"A mite mual tungah that in a mot nop manin, nangma in Egypt pan pusua pui hi banghang Egypt te in ci theisak tu ni ziam? Na thin uuk thaisak in; na ngaisutna kheal in a, na mite tungah tuasiatna tungsak heak in."},"13":{"text":"Na naseamte ahi, Abraham, Isaac le Jacob phawk in. Amate tungah ciliap huai takin na kamciam ahi, a suan a paalte van ah aksi za in tam tu a, a suan a paalte in na khapsa ngam theampo a tawntungin amate ii neisa hi tu hi, na ci thute phawk in,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 22:16-17; Pian 17:8"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Topa in a ngaisutna khealin, a mite tungah a tawn bangin tuasiatna tungsak ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Mualtung pan Moses tuaksuk a, thupiakte a mai lang le lang ah a ki at suangpheakte nii toai hi."},"16":{"text":"Hi suangpheakte Pathian vawt hi a, a tungah thupiakte ama mama ii khet sa ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Mipite auna Joshua in za a, Moses tungah, “Ngiaphual sungah ngal kisimna aw ka za hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Moses in, “Tua aw sia ngalzawna aw le hi ngawl, ngallelna aw zongh hi ngawl a; tua sia lasakna aw hi,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Moses ngiaphual nai ah hong pai in khuital milim le mihingte lap a mu ciang a thinso hi. Tualai mualpeang ah, a toai suangpheakte nii lei denna nei in tamhthamsak hi."},"20":{"text":"Moses in amate vawt khuital no la in, tuisak a, ngoaivui in tui taw hel hi. Tua zawkciang ama in tua tui Israel mite nesak hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in Aaron munah, “Amate in tuabang a cizathuai mawna na vawtsak natu in nang bang hong law ziam?” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Aaron in, “Kei tungah hong thin uuk heak in; hi mihingte ii siatna a vawt nop hamtang sia he ni hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in kei tungah, ‘Egypt pan hong pusuapui hi mipa Moses bang tat ziam, ih he bua hi; tua ahiciang kote hong lampui tu in pathian khat hong vawtsak ta'n, hong ci uh hi.’"},"24":{"text":"Amate ii kizepna manpha khamhte hong paipui natu in ka sawl a, a nei peuma in suutin kei hong pia uh hi. Tua a manpha kizepnate mei sungah ka vawk a, khuitalno milim suak hi,” ci in zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Aaron in a mite uk zawk pang ngawl a omsak sia le, a ngalte mai ah a mawmaw bangin a omsakna thu Moses in mu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Moses in ngiaphual kongpi ah dingin au a, “ Topa sangah a pang peuma hi lai ah hong pai tavun!” ci hi. Tuasia ciang Levi mite theampo ama kungah kikhawm uh a,"},"27":{"text":"Moses in amate tungah, “Israel te Topa Pathian in na namsau tek taw hi ngiaphual kongpi pan a langkhat dong pai in, na suapuite, na ngualtamhte le na innpaamte thatlum tu in note theampo hong sawl hi,” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Levi mite in a thu ni a, tua ni in mihing tulthum bang thatlum uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in Levi te tungah, “ Topa ii nasepna sungah thiampite a seam tu in na tapate, na suapuite na thalupna uh taw in noma tek tuni in kipumpiak zo na hi uh kom, Topa in note a thupha hong pia zo hi,” ci hi."},"30":{"text":"A zing ciang Moses in mipite tungah, “A cizathuai mawna khat vawt zo nu hi. Ahizong tu in mualtung Topa kungah ka na paito kik tu a; note mawmai natu nga thei tha tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa kungah Moses heakkik in, “Hi mite in a cizathuai mawna vawt zo hi. Amate in khamh taw pathian khat vawt in bia uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Nong hesuakna in a mawna maisak in; ahizong na maisak zo buatu le, na mite min na khumna laibu sung pan ka min hong phiat ta'n,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 69:28; Tpl 3:5"},"33":{"text":"Topa in, “Ka tungah mawna a neite bek ka laibu sung pan a min ka phiat tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Tu in pai in kong sonna munah mihingte paipui in. Ka vantunglalang in lam hong lak tu phawkin a, ahizong a hun a cin ciang hi mihingte a mawna daan ka pia tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Topa in mite tungah natna tungsak hi, banghang ziam cile amate in Aaron khamh khuitalno milim a vawtsak hang ahi hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Nangma le Egypt pan na pusuapui mite in hi mun nusia in, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob le a suan a paalte tungah piak tu a, ka kamciamna munah pai tavun.","title":"in Sinai Mual Nusia tu in Israel Thu pia","ref":"Pian 12:7; Pian 26:3; Pian 28:13"},"2":{"text":"Vantunglalang khat note lam hong lak tu in kong puak tu a, Canaan te, Amor te, Hit te, Periz te, Hiv te le Jebus te ka notkeak tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Note ngampha le ngamnuam ah pai tu nu hi. Ahizong kei note taw kong pai buatu hi, banghang ziam cile mihing thinpuite na hi uh a, lampi ah kong mon tha tu hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Hi thu mite in a zaak uh ciang amate khuangai in, suangmanpha kizepna te bun nawn ngawl uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate tungah Moses ii a son natu in Topa in, “Note sia mihing thinpuite hi nu hi. Note taw tawmveino sung ih kithawl bek zong kong mon tha tu hi. Tu in na suangmanpha kizepnate suut vun, tuaciang note tungah ka sep tu sia ka khensat tu hi,” ci in a thupiak hang hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Sinai Mual a nusiat zawkciang, Israel mite in suangmanpha kizepnate bun nawn ngawl uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel mihingte ii ngiaphual a saat simin Moses in a Puanbuk thiangtho la in ngiaphual pan a khuala thithim na munah koi hi. Tua in Topa ii ompuina Puanbuk kici a, Topa thu a dongh nuamte in tua munah pai uh hi.","title":"ii Ompuina Puanbuk"},"8":{"text":"Tualai ah Moses a pai simin, mipite a Puanbuk kongbiang ah ding tek a, Moses a sungtan dong en uh hi."},"9":{"text":"A sungah Moses a tum zawkciang, meeikhuam tuaksuk in Puanbuk kongbiang ah tawlnga a, Topa in meei sung pan Moses paupui hi."},"10":{"text":"Mipite in Puanbuk kongbiang ah meeikhuam a mu po ciang kun uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ngualtamh khat thuson tu bang keakin maitang kisi a Topa in Moses paupui hi. Tuaciang Moses ngiaphual ah heak kik hi. Ahizong Nun ii tapa, ama a hu, tangvalpa Joshua sia Puanbuk sungah om lai hi."},"12":{"text":"Moses in Topa tungah, “Tua ngam ah hi mihingte lampui tu in nong sawlna thu thumaan ahi hi, ahizong kei taw a paikhawm tu sia nong son bua hi. Nangma in kei, nong telthiang a, dik kong sa hi nong ci zo hi.","title":"A Mite Ompui tu in in Kamciam"},"13":{"text":"Tu in tuabang na hile, na tupnate hong son ta'n, tua hile nangma na seamin, kong lungkimsak tawntung tu hi. Hi minam nangma atu in na tealsa a hina thu zongh phawk in,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in, “Nang taw ka paikhawm tu a, zawna kong pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Moses in, “Kote taw nong paikhawm bua ahile, hi mun hong nusiasak heak in."},"16":{"text":"Kote nong tonpui bua ahile, keima le na mite tungah na lungkimna thu akua in bangbangin hong he tu ziam? Kote nong ompuina in leitung midangte sung pan kote hong kilamdangsak tu hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Nong nget sa bangin kong seam tu hi, banghang ziam cile nang kong tel sitset a, na tungah ka lungkim hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Moses in, “Hesuakna taw nong ompuina khuavak taang velvol sia hong musak ta'n,” ci in ngen hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in, “Note mai ah, ka phatna teng kong paipui tu a, noma omna ah ka min thiangtho kong thangsak tu hi. Keima in Topa ka hi a, mulkimna le hesuakna ka teal mite tungah ka lak hi.","ref":"Rom 9:15"},"20":{"text":"Ka maitang kong musak buatu hi, banghang ziam cile ka maitang a mu peuma, nungta ngawl tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahizong suang khat tungah na din thei natu in, ka kungah mun khat om hi."},"22":{"text":"Kong ompuina khuavak taang velvol sia in nang hong kaantan ciang, suanghawng sungah nang kong koi tu a, kong kaantan zawk mateng ka khut taw nang kong hum tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ka khut ka dok tu a, ka nung teng na mu tu hi, ahizong ka mai na mu buatu hi,” ci in zo hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “A masate taw kibangin suangpheak nii vawt in a, na tapsak suangpheak masate tungah kammal teng tuate nii tungah ka at tu hi.","title":"A Nii Veina Suangpheakte (Thuhil kikna 10:1-5)"},"2":{"text":"Kithoai in a, Sinai Mualdawn ah kei taw kimu tu in zingsang ciang hong paito ta'n."},"3":{"text":"Khat zongh kaato pui heak in a; mual tung koima ah kuama omsak heak in; tuu ahizong, khui ahizong, mualpeang ah tha heak in,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaciang Moses in suangpheak nii vawt a, Topa thupiak bang tatakin a zing ciang zingtuung in Sinai Mual tungah puato hi."},"5":{"text":"Meeilom khat sungah Topa hong tuaksuk a, tualai ah ama taw ding khawmin, Topa ci in a min thiangtho thangsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in Moses mai kaantan a, tuaciang ama samin, “Keima in mulkimna le hesuakna taw a kidim Topa Pathian khat ka hi hi, ka thin uuk hakin, itna lian le thumaanna a lakpa ka hi hi.","ref":"Pu 20:5-6; Mi 14:18; Thkna 5:9-10; 7:9-10"},"7":{"text":"Ka kamciamte khang tul tam mama te tungah ka len a, siatna le mawna ka maisak hi; ahizong a pate a nute mawnate hangin tate le tute tungah, khang thum khang li dongin daan ka pia tu hi,” ci in pualaak hi."},"8":{"text":"Moses in lei ah manlang tak kunsuk in bia hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “ Topa awng, kei tungah nong lungkim takpi ahile kote taw hong paikhawm ta'n. Hi mihingte thinpui hi, ahizong kote siatna le mawna hong maisak ta'n a, nangma aituam mihing in hong saang ta'n,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Tu in Israel mite taw thuciamna khat ka vawt hi. Hi leitung minamte sungah a kivawt ngeingawl na thupite amate mai ah ka vawt tu hi. Keima, Topa ii na thupi ka vawt theinate mihing theampo in hong mu tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile note atu in nalamdang khat ka vawt tu hi.","title":"Thuciamna Kithaksua (Pusuana 23:14-19, Thuhil kikna 7:1-5,16:1-17)"},"11":{"text":"Tuni in kong piak thukhamte zui vun. Note maisang na manaw uh ciangin Amor te, Canaan te, Hit te, Periz te, Hiv te le Jebus te ka notkeak tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Na thetna ngam ah a teang mihingte taw thukimna khote vawt heak vun, banghang ziam cile tuasia in note atu in thi theina thaang suak tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua luangin a biaknataute baltham in, a khuam thiangthote lalcipsakin numeipathian Asherah milimte saattan vun.","ref":"Thkna 16:21"},"14":{"text":"“Pathian dang bia heak vun, banghang ziam cile Keima, Topa in kidempui dang ka dei bua hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ngammite taw thukimna khote bangma vawt heak vun, banghang ziam cile doai biate ii pathiante tungah sangaw biakpiakna a nei ciang, pathian biakpiakna an ne tu in hong sam tu a, note hong ze et tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Na tapate in tua ngamdang numeite teenpui tha tu a, amate in kei tungah a thumaan ngawl natu le a doai pathiante a biak natu in na tapate lam khialpui tha tu hi."},"17":{"text":"“Thik taw kivawt pathiante vawtin bia heak vun.","ref":"Pu 20:4; Thiam 19:4; Thkna 5:8; 27:15"},"18":{"text":"Tol saw ngawl Anluum Poaipi vawt suak vun. Kong thupiak bangin, Abib tha ni sali sung tol saw ngawl anluum ne vun, banghang ziam cile tua tha in Egypt pan pusuak nu hi.","ref":"Pu 12:14-20; Thiam 23:6-8; Mi 28:16-25"},"19":{"text":"Tapa suakciil le inn nganhing no suakciil a pa theampo keima aa ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 13:2"},"20":{"text":"Ahizong laa a suakciil pawpo sia a taangin tuu khat pia in lei kik tu nu hi. Na lei kik bua uh ahile a ngawng thiaktan vun. Tapaciil peuma lei kik vun. Biakpiakna khat a keng ngawl peuma ka mai ah hong kilaak heak hen.","ref":"Pu 13:13"},"21":{"text":"Ni luk sung noma na sep tu hun na nei uh a, ahizong lothaw hun le anlaak hun ngawngawn in ni sali ni in naseam heak vun.","ref":"Pu 20:9-10; 23:12; 31:15; 35:2; Thiam 23:3; Thkna 5:13-14"},"22":{"text":"Na mangtaang anpal na laak kipat ciang Anlaak Poaipi khaamin, tangngam sung thingnga na kaikhop ciang Buk Poaipi khaam vun.","ref":"Thiam 23:15-21; Mi 28:26-31; Thiam 23:39-43"},"23":{"text":"Kum khatin thumvei, Keima Topa Israel te ii Pathian bia tu in na mi, pasal a minpiang nong pai tu uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Note mai ah minamte notkeak in, na ngam kong keaksak zawkciang, poai khaam thumvei hun sung teng kuama in na ngam hong zaw tu hanciam ngawl tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Nganhing taw biakpiakna nong nei uh ciang tol saw anluum hong pia heak vun. Paisan Poaipi hunsung na ngaw uh nganhing sa peuma a zingsang ciang dong koi heak vun.","ref":"Pu 12:10"},"26":{"text":"Kum simin na laak anpal sia Topa inn sungah hong paipui tavun. Tuuno ahizong kealno ahizong a pui noaitui sungah huan heak vun.","ref":"Thkna 26:2; Thkna 14:21"},"27":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Hi kammalte at in, banghang ziam cile nangma le Israel mite tungah thuciamna ka vawt sia, hi kammalte kibulphu hi,” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tualai ah Moses an le tui ne ngawlin, sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung Topa taw omkhawm hi. Moses in Thupiak Sawmte ahi- thuciamna kammalte suangpheak tungah at hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in Thupiak Sawmte toai in, Sinai Mual pan hong tuaksuk ciang Topa taw kipaupui ahikom a maitang taang hi; ahihang ama in a taan hunlam he ngawl hi.","title":"Sinai Mual pan Moses Tuaksuk","ref":"2 Cor 3:7-16"},"30":{"text":"Aaron le mihingte theampo in Moses maitang taang a mu ciang lau in neak ngam ngawl uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahizong Moses in amate sam a, Aaron le taangpi lampuite theampo ama kungah pai in Moses in paupui hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Israel mite theampo ama kungah kikhawm in, Topa ii Sinai Mual ah a piak thukham theampo Moses in amate tungah pia hi."},"33":{"text":"Moses in thuson a man zawkciang dial khat taw a mai seal hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa paupui tu in Topa ompuina Puanbuk sungah Moses a pai simin, a dial hawk hi. Hong pusua ciang son tu in, a thupiak theampo Israel mite tungah son a,"},"35":{"text":"amate in a maitang taang sia mu uh hi. Tuaciang Topa paupui tu in a pai kik dong dial taw a mai seal hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in Israel taangpi taangta bup kaikhawm in amate tungah, “Hi thu sia na ngamtat natu uh Topa thupiak ahi hi:","title":"Sabbath Ngeinate"},"2":{"text":"ni luk sung noma na, na seam tu uh a, ahizong ni sali ni sia ni thiangtho hi tu a, keima, na Topa atu a kikoituam, a ciliaphuai tawlngak ni hi tu hi. Tua ni in na a seam peuma kithatlum tu hi.","ref":"Pu 20:8-11; 23:12; 31:15; 34:21; Thiam 23:3; Thkna 5:12-14"},"3":{"text":"Sabbath ni in na inn uh ah mei ngawngawn thut ngawl tu nu hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in Israel mite theampo tungah, “Hisia Topa thupiak ahi hi:","title":"Puanbuk Thiangtho atu Biakpiaknate (Pusuana 25:1-9)"},"5":{"text":"Topa tungah piakkhiat khat nei vun. A pia nuam peuma in, khamh, ngunn, taau;"},"6":{"text":"puan neal; vancii, a sandup le a san samul puan; kealmul taw a kivawt puan;"},"7":{"text":"a san kinimh tuutal vun; savun neal; acacia thing;"},"8":{"text":"meidet sathau; noi sathau atu le ngimnamtui atu hel namtuite;"},"9":{"text":"ephod le Thiampi Lianbel ii awmdal ah bul tu suangmanpha san le a dang suangmanphate paipui tu nu hi."},"10":{"text":"“Note sung pan thiamna nei naseam mi theampo hong pai in Topa thupiak theampo vawt hen:","title":"ii Ompuina Puanbuk atu Vanhzakte (Pusuana 39:32-43)"},"11":{"text":"Puanbuk, a sitna le a puasang sitna, a vanh khaina koaite le a kalte, a zawlte, a khuamte le a tawdapte;"},"12":{"text":"Thuciamna Thingkuang, a puakna thingpumte, a sitna le a dalna puankhai;"},"13":{"text":"sabuai, a puakna thingpumte le a vanh theampo; Pathian a piak anluum;"},"14":{"text":"meidet natu meikhuam le a vanhte, meiinnte le meidet sathau,"},"15":{"text":"ngimnamtui halna tu biaknatau le a puakna thingpumte; noi sathau; ngimnamtui; Puanbuk kongbiang puankhai;"},"16":{"text":"meihal biakpiak natu biaknatau le a saaksai, a zawnna thingpumte le a vanh teng; kisilna kuang le a ngakna;"},"17":{"text":"a doituam atu puankhaite, a khuamte le a tawdapte; a doituam tumna kongbiang puankhai;"},"18":{"text":"Puanbuk le doituam atu khetphinte le khaute;"},"19":{"text":"Tuaciang Thiangtho Mun ah thiampite in na a sep ciang a silh tu a tuanngen, a et hoi puante — thiampi Aaron le a tapate atu puan thiangthote a vawt tu ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Israel mite theampo cia siat a,","title":"Mipite in Amate Biakpiaknate Hong Paipui"},"21":{"text":"tuaciang Topa ii ompuina Puanbuk a vawt nuam peuma in Topa tungah piakkhiatna khat keng tek hi. Amate in biakna tu in a kisamh le thiampi puante vawt natu in a kisamh vanhte theampo hong paipui uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Piak nopna thin a nei numei le pasal te in kizepna phinte, bilbaate, khutzungbute, khite le khamh suang manpha namcinte paipui in, Topa tungah aap uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Puan neal; vancii, a sandup, a san samul puan; kealmul puan; a san a kinimh tuutal ii vun; ahibuale savun neal paipui uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ngunn ahizong, taau ahizong a pia theite in Topa atu in pia tek a, nasep natu khat pawpo ah a kizangh thei tu acacia thing a nei peuma in hong paipui tek uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Thiamneal vawt thei numei theampo in amate vawtsa puan neal, khau le samul khau vancii, a sandup le a sante hong paipui uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in kealmul taw khauzam zongh vawt uh hi."},"27":{"text":"A lampuite in ephod le awmdal ah a bul tu in suangmanpha san le a dang suangmanpha te,"},"28":{"text":"tuaciang meidet sathau, noi sathau le a ngimnamtuite atu in hel namtuite le sathau hong paipui uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah nasep tu a thupiak bangin, a pia nuam Israel mite theampo in Topa tungah a piakkhiatna tek hong paipui uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Moses in Israel te tungah, “Judah minam sung pan Hur ii tupa ahi, Uri ii tapa Bezalel Topa in teal zo hi.","title":"ii Ompuina Puanbuk atu Khutthiam mite (Pusuana 31:1-11)"},"31":{"text":"Topa in Bezalel sia ama ii vaangletna taw kidimsakin, khutthiamna, hi theina, le thiamneal nasep tuatuamte heaktheina,"},"32":{"text":"pungsaan ngeal thiamna tuatuamte le tua teng khamh, ngunn, le taaute taw vawt theina;"},"33":{"text":"kizepna suangmanpha tat thiamna; thingngel thiamna le thiamneal nasep tuatuamte pia hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa in ama, Bezalel le Dan minam sung pan Ahisamach ii tapa Oholiab tungah midangte khutthiamna a hil tu in pilna pia zo hi."},"35":{"text":"Topa in amate tungah khutthiamte, a ngeal thiamte, le thiamtak thiamte, vancii, a dup au le a san tuumul le a dang puante theampo sep thiamna pia zo hi. Amate in nasep namkim seam thei in, a ngeal thiamte ahi uh hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Bezalel, Oholiab, le Puanbuk thianthosak natu a kisamh theampo vawt tu zia a he te, Topa ii thiamna le heaktheina a piak khutthiam dangte theampo in Topa thupiak bang linlianin na theampo seam tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Moses in Bazalel, Oholiab le Topa ii hi theina a piak khutthiamna a nei midangte le nasep a hu nuamte sam a, nasep kipan tu in sawl hi.","title":"Mipite in Letsong Tam mama hong Paipui"},"3":{"text":"Amate in Israel te ii Puanbuk thianthosak natu in a paipui piakkhiatna theampo Moses tung pan nga siat hi. Ahihang Israel mite in a piaksate zing simin Moses tungah pia tawntung lai hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zawkciang khutthiamna nei tua nasep a seam mite pai in,"},"5":{"text":"Moses tungah, “ Topa ii hong thupiak nasepna atu in a kisamh za sang a tamzaw vanh, mihingte in hong paipui uh hi,” ci in zasak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, Moses in ngiaphual tengah Puanbuk thiangtho atu in kuama ii a piak thua ngawl natu thupia hi; tuasia ciang, mihingte in pia nawn ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Hong paipui sa teng, nasep theampo zaw natu in kicing vaal liang hi."},"8":{"text":"Naseamte sung pan khutthiambel teng in Topa ii ompuina Puanbuk vawt uh hi. Amate in tua puanbuk sia vancii, a sandup, le a san samul taw a kitak cherub limte taw thiamngel puanneal bek 10 taw vawt uh hi.","title":"ii Ompuina Puanbuk Vawt (Pusuana 26:1-37)"},"9":{"text":"Tua puante a letna kibangin, metre 12 sau in, metre 2 beak hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in puandal nga teng khuikhawmin, a dang nga teng zongh a kibangin khuikhawm uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in tua puante nii puasang mong tengah vanci puan taw bilvangte vawt uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Puan khat tungah bilvang sawmnga vawtin, a khat sia tung zongh ah sawmnga ma vawt uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in tua puante nii a pe natu in khamh kual sawmnga vawt uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang amate in Puanbuk sitna tu in kealmul taw kivawt puan sawm le khat vawt uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua puante kikimsak siatin, metre 13 sau in, metre 2 beak hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in tua puante nga ciang khatin khuikhawmin, a dang luk teng khatin khuikhawm uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in tua puante a khakbel sia mong ah bilvang sawmnga vawt uh a, a dang khat sia tungah bilvang sawmnga ma vawt uh hi."},"18":{"text":"A sitna sa khat a suak tu in tua puante nii a pe natu in amate in taaukual sawmnga vawt uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Puanbuk sitna tu in amate in a san taw a kinimh tuutal ii vun taw a kivawt khat le savun neal taw a kivawt a puasang sitna khat, a sitna nii vawt thua uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in Puanbuk a kalpheak tu in acacia thing zangh uh hi."},"21":{"text":"A mungte metre li saangin, centimetre 66 beak hi,"},"22":{"text":"a kalte khat le khat a kipee natu in a meang nii neisak hi. A kalpheakte tuabangin kivawt siat hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in thang sang atu a kalpheak kul,"},"24":{"text":"a meangte khat le khat a kipee natu in khat ii nuai ah ngunn tawdap nii veu, ngunn tawdap sawmli vawt uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Puanbuk saksang atu a kalpheak kul,"},"26":{"text":"a mung khat ii nuai ah ngunn tawdap nii veu, ngunn tawdap 40 vawt uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Puanbuk nitumna nungsang atu in a kalpheak luk"},"28":{"text":"a kingte ah a kalpheak nii vawt uh hi."},"29":{"text":"A king ah a kalpheakte a bul pan pee in a dawn dongin kizomsak hi. Tua king nii a piangsak a kalpheakte nii sia tuabang ma in kivawt hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuabangin a kalpheak liat om in, mung khat ciang tawdap nii tek ngunn tawdap sawm le luk om hi."},"31":{"text":"Amate in acacia thingzawl sawm le nga, puanbuk a kalpheakte atu in pangh khat ah zawl nga veu,"},"32":{"text":"a langkhat ah a kalpheak nga le a nungsang nitumna sangah a kalpheak nga vawt uh hi."},"33":{"text":"A kalpheakte ii lang khenna san pan a kithung zawlsau sia puanbuk mong khat pan mong khat dong a tuantung hi."},"34":{"text":"Amate in a kalpheakte khamh taw tuamin, khamh taw ma a kituam a zawlte a len tu in khamh kualte thua uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Amate in vancii, a sandup le samul san taw a kitak cherubim lim taw thiamngel puanneal puankhai khat vawt uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Amate in puankhai khat khak natu in khamh taw a kizut, khamh koai taw a kithua acacia thing khuam li vawt uh hi. Tuaciang khuamte a len tu in ngunn tawdap li vawt uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Amate in Puanbuk tumna kongbiang tu in vancii puan neal, a sandup le a san samul taw a kitak, thiamngel taw a zep puankhai khat vawt uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua puankhai atu amate in a koaite taw a kithua, a dawn teng le a ciangte khamh taw a kituam khuam nga vawtin, tua khuamte atu in taau tawdap nga vawt uh hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bezalel in a sau centimetre 110, a zai centimetre 66 le a saang centimetre 66 a pha Thuciamna Thingkuang sia acacia thing taw vawt hi.","title":"Thuciamna Thingkuang Vawt (Pusuana 25:10-22)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in khamh ciitak taw a sung a pua tuamin, a kiil kiimkot teng khamh taw zial hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua thingkuang puak natu in ama in khamh kual li vawtin, a lang ah kual nii veve khuam peang li tungah bul hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in a puak natu in acacia thingpumte vawt a, khamh taw tuamin,"},"5":{"text":"kuang pangh ah a kibul a kualte sungah thun hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a sitna sia a sau centimetre 110, a zai centimetre 66 in khamh ciitak taw vawt hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in sek taw a kiseak khamh taw cherub niite lim vawtin,"},"8":{"text":"a sitna mong ah khat veu koi hi. Ama in a sitna taw sakhat suak tu in vawt hi."},"9":{"text":"Cherub te thingkuang sitna tungah khat le khat kimai ngatin a tha phalh a, kuang sitna liap siat hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in a sauna centimetre 88, a zaina centimetre 44, le a saanna centimetre 66 a pha sabuai sia acacia thing taw vawt hi.","title":"Pathian A kipia Anluum atu Sabuai Vawtna (Pusuana 25:23-30)"},"11":{"text":"Ama in tuasia khamh ciitak taw tuamin, a king kiimkot teng khamh taw zial hi."},"12":{"text":"A kiimkot millimetre 75 zai a mong tuamna vawt a, khamh taw zuut hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in tua sabuai zawnna tu in khamh kual li vawtin, a peang omna king li teng ah bul hi."},"14":{"text":"A kualte sabuai zawnna thingpumte thun natu ahikom a mong tuamna taw a kinaina ah koi hi."},"15":{"text":"A zawnna thingpumte acacia thing hi a, khamh taw tuam hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in sabuai atu a vawt khamh taw kivawt kuangte: pakante, haite, haitungte, le bealte sia sapittui taw biakpiakna in zak tu ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in khamh ciitak taw meikhuam vawt hi. A bul le a khuam sia a kiseak khamh taw vawtin, a zepna paakte, a mom le a paakpalhte zongh a khuam taw kisakhat siat hi.","title":"Meikhuam Vawt (Pusuana 25:31-40)"},"18":{"text":"A pangh pan baak luk zaamsakin, a lang le a lang ah baak thum veve om hi."},"19":{"text":"Baak luk te khat simin almond paakmom le a paakpalhte taw a kibang a zepna paakte thum tek nei hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua meikhuam in almond paakmom le a paakpalh taw a kibang a zepna paakte li nei hi."},"21":{"text":"A baak kop thum sim ii nuai ah a mom khat tek om hi."},"22":{"text":"Paakmomte, a baakte le meikhuam sia a kiseak khamh bekno khat bekma taw a kivawt sakhat ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in meikhuam atu in meiinn sali vawtin, khamh ciitak taw taitee le kuangdaite vawt hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in meikhuam le a vanh teng khamh ciitak kilogramme 35 taw vawt hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in ngimnamtui hal natu in acacia thing taw biaknatau khat vawt hi. Tua in a dung a vai a kikim hi a, a sauna centimetre 45, a zaina centimetre 45 le a saanna centimetre 90 ahi hi. A kingdok li teng kipee siatin, sakhat suak hi.","title":"Ngimnamtui Hal natu Biaknatau Vawt (Pusuana 30:1-5)"},"26":{"text":"Ama in a tung, a pangh li teng, le a kingdok teng khamh ciitak taw tuamin, a kiil kiimkot teng khamh taw zial hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in a zawnna thingpumte thun natu in khamh kual nii vawt a, a pangh nii ii kiil nuai ah bul hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in acacia thingpumte vawtin, khamh taw tuam hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in paaknamtui bangin a kihel a thiangtho noi sathau le ngimnamtui ciitak zongh vawt hi.","title":"Noi Sathau le Ngimnamtui Vawt (Pusuana 30:22-38)","ref":"Pu 30:22-38"}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama in meihal biakpiak natu in acacia thing taw biaknatau khat vawt hi. Ama in tua a dokte taau taw tuam hi."},"3":{"text":"Biaknatau ah vanh zak tu in bealte, keaute, kuangte, a koaite le vut luana kuangte zongh vawt hi. Hi vanh teng theampo taau taw vawt hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in taau saaksai khat vawtin biaknatau saanna a lang bansuk in biaknatau ii ngong nuai ah koi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in zawn natu kual li vawtin a kingte li ah koi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in acacia thing taw zawnna thingpumte vawtin, taau taw tuam a,"},"7":{"text":"biaknatau lang le lang ah a om kualte sungah thun hi. Biaknatau sia thingpheak taw vawtin a sung hawmsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in Topa ii ompuina Puanbuk tumna kongbiang ah naseam numeite neisa limlanghte taw taau kuang le taau tawdap vawt hi.","title":"Taaukuang Vawt (Pusuana 30:18)","ref":"Pu 30:18; 38:25-26; Pu 30:11-16"},"9":{"text":"Ama in puanneal puankhaite taw Topa ompuina puanbuk atu doituam vawt hi.
