Puan khaina koaite, a dawn tuamnate le a ciangzawlte ngunn taw kivawt hi."},"20":{"text":"Puanbuk le doituam kiimkot letna khetphin theampo taau taw kivawt hi."},"21":{"text":"Thupiak sawmte a ki atna suangpheak niite koina ahi, Topa ii ompuina Puanbuk sungah na zakte a nuai a bang ahi hi. Tua tepteena lai vawt tu Moses in sawl a, thiampi Aaron ii tapa Ithamar khutnuai a naseam Levi mite in vawt hi.","title":"ii Ompuina Puanbuk sung Na zakte"},"22":{"text":"Judah minam sung pan Hur ii tupa, Uri ii tapa Bezalel in Topa ii thupiak bangin seam siat hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama a hupa Dan minam sung pan Ahisamach ii tapa Oholiab sia suang tung laikhen thiam, a ngeal thiam, le vancii, a sandup, a san samul puan le puanneal pha a tak thiam khat ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"A thiangtho puanbuk atu Topa tungah a ki aap khamh teng a kizangh ngei khaikhin taw a kitee ciang kilogramme tul khat ngit hi."},"25":{"text":"Misimna bangin a kipia ngunn teng a kizangh ngei khaikhin taw a kitee ciang kilogramme 3,430 ngit hi.","ref":"Pu 30:11-16; Mt 17:24"},"26":{"text":"Hite sia mihing kisim lai in mi sim ii 22 a piak teng kingawm in biakinn khaikhin taw a kitee ahi hi. Kum kul pan a tungsia teng a kisim ciang a vekpi mi 603,550 pha hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ngunnte sung pan kilogramme 3,400 teng a thiangtho Puanbuk le puankhai atu tawdap zakhat te vawt natu in kizangh a, tawdap khat ciang kilogramme 34 veu kizangh hi."},"28":{"text":"Bezalel in, a taanglai ngunn kilogramme 30 taw a ciangzawlte, a khuamte tungah vanh khaina koaite le a dawn tuamnate vawt hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa tungah a ki aap taau theampo kilogramme 2,425 ngit hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in tua taaute taw Topa ompuina Puanbuk tumna kongbiang tawdapte, taau saaksai a nei biaknatau, biaknatau atu vanh theampo vawt hi."},"31":{"text":"Doituam kiim le a tumna kongbiang tawdapte le Puanbuk le doituam kiimkot letna in a kizangh khetphin theampo ama in taau taw vawt hi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A Thiangtho Mun ah thiampite na a sep ciang a silh tu in vancii, a sandup le samul san taw a tuanngen puansilhte vawt uh hi. Moses tungah a thupiak bangin amate in Aaron atu in thiampi puante vawt uh hi.","title":"Thiampite atu Puante Vawt (Pusuana 28:1-14)"},"2":{"text":"Ephod sia puanneal; vancii, a sandup le a san samulpuan le khamh khauzam taw vawt uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in khamh dalte seakin, a paa in zen a, puanneal phate le vancii, a sandup le a san samulpuante taw khui khawm uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in a sawm natu liangkhai nii vawt a, ephod a kho thei natu in a pangh ah khii hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah a thupiak bangin a vanhzak kibang, pha takin a kitak kawngkhau sia ephod taw sakhat tu in, a tungah khii hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in carnelian suangsante taatin khamh dapphate tungah suang hi; tuate tungah Jacob tapa sawm le niite min teng suanglai khen thiamte in khensak hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah a thupiak bang tatakin Israel minam sawm le niite taang tu in, amate in tua suangsante ephod liangkhai puan tungah suang uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in thiamngelna le ephod vawtna in a kizangh vanhte taw ma in awmdal vawt uh hi.","title":"Awmdal Vawt (Pusuana 28:15-30)"},"9":{"text":"Tua in a kikim king li nei in thuap nii in kithep a, centimetre 22 sau, centimetre 22 zai hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in tua awmdal tungah suangmanpha ngual li in suang a, ngual khatna ah ruby, topaz le garnet;"},"11":{"text":"ngual niina ah emerald, sapphire le diamond;"},"12":{"text":"ngual thumna ah turquoise, agate, le amethyst;"},"13":{"text":"le ngual lina ah beryl, carnelian le jasper te ahi hi. Tua suangte khamh dapphate tungah suang uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel minam sawm le niite taang tu in, suang sawm le niite tungah Jacob tapa sawm le niite khat tek ii min khen hi."},"15":{"text":"Awmdal atu in khauhualte bangin a kipheak khamh ciitak khi nguite vawt hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in khamh dappha nii le khamh kual nii vawtin, khamh kual niite awmdal a tungsang king veve ah belh uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in khamh khau niite sia kual niite tungah khit a,"},"18":{"text":"a dappha niite tungah a mong niite khit hi, tuabangin ephod liangkhai puan mai sangah tuate belh uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in khamh kual nii vawtin, ephod zawkciang sungsang awmdal ii nuaisang mongte nii ah belh uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in khamh kual nii vawt thua in, ephod kawm ngawl natu in amate in awmdal kualte ephod kualte tungah vancii khau taw sawm uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in ephod nuai ah a kisilh puantual sia vancii samul khau ngitnget taw tak uh hi.","title":"A Dang Thiampi Puante Vawt (Pusuana 28:31-43)"},"23":{"text":"Lu thun natu in a vang sia a ek ngawl natu in puan kitak sa taw kikhui thua hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah a thupiak bang tatakin puantual mong nuai sang kiim tengah amate in puanneal pha taw a kivawt le vancii, a sandup le a san samul puan taw kivawt talee ngate, khamh ciitak taw a kivawt tengeng te taw kithatheak in koi hi.","merge":"25"},"27":{"text":"Topa ii Moses tungah a thupiak bang tatakin amate in Aaron le a tapate atu in laktong,"},"28":{"text":"dial, lukhu, puanneal ngoaipuan tom le"},"29":{"text":"puanneal, vancii, a sandup le a san samul taw a kivawt thiamngel in a kizeam kawngkhau vawtsak hi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in khamh ciitak taw Topa tungah ki aapna lim lakna thiangtho a hi, kizepna vawtin tua tungah, “ Topa atu Kitavaw” ci in khen uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa ii Moses tungah a thupiak bang tatakin amate in tua kizepna sia dial mai sangah vancii khau khat taw khii uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Topa ompuina Puanbuk nasep theampo kizo siat zo hi. Topa ii Moses tungah a thupiak bang tatakin Israel mite in na theampo seam uh hi.","title":"Nasep Zawna (Pusuana 35:10-19)"},"33":{"text":"Amate in Moses kungah Puanbuk le a vanh theampo, a vanh khaina koaite, a kalte, a zawlliang a tuukpite, a khuamte le a tawdapte;"},"34":{"text":"a sanin a kinimh tuuvun taw a kivawt a sitna; savun ciitak taw a kivawt a sitna; puankhai;"},"35":{"text":"suangpheakte a kikoina Thuciamna Thingkuang, a thingpumte le a sitna;"},"36":{"text":"sabuai le a vanhte theampo, Pathian a piak anluum;"},"37":{"text":"khamh ciitak meikhuam, a meiinnte, a vanhzak theampo le meidet sathau;"},"38":{"text":"khamh biaknatau; noi sathau; ngimnamtui; Puanbuk kongbiang puankhai;"},"39":{"text":"taau saaksai taw kithua biaknatau, a thingpumte, a vanhzak theampo; khut silna kuang le a ngakna;"},"40":{"text":"doituam atu puankhaite, a khuamte le a tawdapte; kongbiang puankhai le a khaute; Puanbuk khetphinte; puanbuk sungah a kizangh tu vanhzak theampo;"},"41":{"text":"tuaciang a Thiangtho Mun ah thiampite silh tu puansilh tuanngente — thiampi Aaron le a tapate atu in puan thiangthote hong paipui uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Topa ii Moses tungah a thupiak bang tatakin Israel mite in nasep theampo seam siat uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Moses in a nasepna teng sit siat a, Topa thupiak bangin a sep siatna thu mu hi. Tua ahiciang Moses in amate thupha pia hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"ii Ompuina Puanbuk Lepna le Aapna"},"2":{"text":"“Tha masa, a ni khat ni in Topa ii ompuina Puanbuk sia lemh in."},"3":{"text":"Thupiak Sawmte koina Thuciamna Thingkuang tua buk sungah koi in, a mai ah puankhai khai in."},"4":{"text":"A sungah sabuai tumpui in a tungah vanhte koi in. Meikhuam zongh la in a, meivakte bul in."},"5":{"text":"Thuciamna Thingkuang mai ah ngimnamtui hal natu in khamh biaknatau koi in a, Puanbuk kongbiang ah puankhai khai in."},"6":{"text":"Puanbuk mai ah meihal biakpiak natu in biaknatau koi in."},"7":{"text":"Puanbuk le biaknatau kilaklaw ah khut silna kuang koi in a, tui dim in."},"8":{"text":"A doituam kiimkot puan taw uumin a kongbiang ah puankhai khai in."},"9":{"text":"“Tuaciang Puanbuk le a vanhzak theampo a thiangtho sathau noina taw aap in, tua hile thiangtho tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zawkciang biaknatau le a vanhte theampo a thiangtho sathau noina taw aap in, tua hile thiangtho sinsen tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ta bangma in khut silna kuang le a ngakna zongh aap in."},"12":{"text":"“Aaron le a tapate puanbuk kongbiang ah paipui in a, a zeksa kibualna neisak in."},"13":{"text":"Aaron in keima na a seam thiampi a sep thei natu in thiampi puante silhsak in, sathau buakin, hi bangin ama aap in."},"14":{"text":"A tapate paipui in, laktong silhsak in."},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang thiampite bangin keima na hong sepsak thei natu in, a pa sathau na buak bangma, a tate zongh sathau buak in. Hi bang sathau buakna in amate maisang hun theampo ah thiampi suaksak tu hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin Moses in na theampo seam hi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt pan a pusua zawk a kum niina, a tha masa, a ni khat ni in, Topa ii ompuina Puanbuk kilemh hi."},"18":{"text":"Moses in a tawdapte pha sukin, a kalpheakte thua a, zawlliang le tuukpite thungin, a khuamte phut hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in Topa thupiak bangin puanbuk tungah a sitna phalhin, a puasang tuipuan sia a tung pan khu hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in suangpheakte nii la in Thuciamna Thingkuang sungah koi hi. Ama in a zawnna thingpumte a bilvang sungah thun in, Thuciamna Thingkuang sitna khak hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in Puanbuk sungah Thuciamna Thingkuang koi a, puankhai khak hi. Topa thupiak bangin, Moses in Thuciamna Thingkuang hi bangin seal hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in Puanbuk sung saksang, puankhai pua sangah sabuai koi a,"},"23":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin Topa a kipia anluumte, tua sabuai tungah lui hi,"},"24":{"text":"ama in Puanbuk sung thangsang king, sabuai taw kingalsai in meivak khuam koi hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin tualai Topa ii ompuina ah ama in mei de hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in Puanbuk sung puankhai mai ah khamh biaknatau koi a,"},"27":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin ngimnamtui hal hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in Puanbuk kongbiang ah puankhai khak a,"},"29":{"text":"tua mun puankhai mai ah meihal biakpiak natu in biaknatau koi hi. Topa thupiak bangin tua biaknatau tungah ama in sangawna taw meihal biakpiakna le antang taw biakpiakna te seam hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in Puanbuk le biaknatau kilaklaw ah kisilna kuang koi in tui dim hi."},"31":{"text":"Moses, Aaron, le a tapate in tualai ah"},"32":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin, Puanbuk sung le biaknatau ah a pai simin a khut le a peangte sil uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Moses in Puanbuk le biaknatau kiimkot teng uumin a doituam kongbiang ah puankhai khai hi. Tuabangin ama in nasep theampo man zo hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuasia ciang meei in Puanbuk tuam a Topa ii ompuina khuavak taang velvol sia in tua puanbuk dim hi.","title":"ii Ompuina Puanbuk tungah Meei (Mi Simna 9:15-23)","ref":"1 Kum 8:10-11; Is 6:4; Eze 43:4-5; Tpl 15:8"},"35":{"text":"Hi bang ahi hu in Puanbuk sungah Moses tum thei ngawl hi."},"36":{"text":"Puanbuk pan meei a kilapto ciang bekin Israel te in a ngiaphual mun dangah khiin uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Tualai ah meei a kaai laiteng a ngiaphual khiin ngawl uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Duisung ah a vathap sung tawntungin amate in Topa ii ompuina ahi, Puanbuk tungah sunin meei le zanin meikuang mu thei uh hi."}}}}},"3":{"info":{"name":"Thiampi Laibu","shortname":"Lev","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa ompuina Puanbuk sung pan Topa in Moses sam a,","title":"Pum bup Meihal Biakpiaknate"},"2":{"text":"Israel te ii biakpiakna a nei ciang a zui tu in a nuai a ngeinate pia hi. Mihing khat pawpo in nganhing taw biakpiakna a nei ciang, a khuihon ahibuale, a tuuhon ahibuale a kealhonte sung pan khat pia tu hi."},"3":{"text":"A khuihonte sung pan khat taw meihal biakpiakna a pia ahile, a mealhem ngawl khuital khat hi tu hi. Topa ii a saan natu in Topa ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang ah pia tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in khuital lu tungah a khut nga tu a, tuasia ama mawphel natu biakpiakna in kisaang tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualai ah ama in tua khuital ngo tu a, Aaron suan thiampite in khuital chi sia Topa tungah a piak zawkciang Puanbuk kongbiang ah a om biaknatau pangh li ah a chi the tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in a vun hoai in a sa sem tu a,"},"7":{"text":"thiampite in biaknatau tungah thing seng in mei taw tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in a kisemsa sabak teng, a lu le a thau taw mei tungah koi tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in a sungkua le a nungpeangte nii, sil tu a vaipuak nei thiampipa in sa teng biaknatau ah hal tu hi. Tua an taw biakpiakna ii ngimnam sia in Topa lungkimsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing khat in a tuu ahibuale a kealte sung pan khat taw biakpiakna a nei le, a mealhem ngawl a tal khat hi tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in biaknatau saksang ah tuasia ngo tu a, biaknatau pangh li ah thiampite in a chi the tu hi."},"12":{"text":"A sa a sem zawkciang thiampipa in a sa teng mei tungah koi tu a, a lu le a thau zongh kihel tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in a sungkua le a nungpeangte nii sil tu a, thiampipa in Topa tungah biakpiaknate pia in biaknatau tungah hal tu hi. Tua an taw biakpiakna ngimnam in Topa lungkimsak hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi khat in vacim khat taw meihal biakpiakna a pia le, ngam vakhu khat ahi buale, inn vakhu khat hi tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Thiampipa in tua biakpiakna sia biaknatau ah paipui tu a, a ngawng meaktan in, biaknatau tungah a lu hal tu hi. Biaknatau pangh ah a chi taaksak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"A longtawl le a tawl sungah a om teng la tu a, vut koina, biaknatau ii nisuana sangah vawk tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a thate nii pan len tu a, a thate tatsak ngawlin a pum balkeak tu a, biaknatau tungah a pum bup hal tu hi. Tua an taw biakpiakna ii ngimnam in Topa lungkimsak hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in antang taw Topa biakpiakna a nei ciang, antang ngoaivui masa nanak tu hi. Ama in olive thau le ngimnamtui buak tu a,","title":"Antang taw Biakpiaknate"},"2":{"text":"Aaron suan thiampite kungah paipui tu hi. Thiampipa in anvui khutdim khat, sathau le ngimnamtui theampo la in, Topa tungah kipia siat zo hi ci in a kiheak thei natu in biaknatau ah hal tu hi. Tua an biakpiakna ii ngimnam in Topa lungkimsak hi."},"3":{"text":"A taanglai antang teng thiampite neisa hi a, Topa a kipia an sung pan a laak ahikom, thiangtho mama hi."},"4":{"text":"A kipia anluum sia, anluum emna bealpeu sungah em ahile, tol saw ngawl hi nanak tu hi. Tuasia olive thau taw a kihel a anluum liante ahibuale olive thau taw a kizut a muhpaate hi thei tu hi."},"5":{"text":"A kipia anluum sia moh emna taw minsak ahile, olive thau le anvui a kihel hi tu a, ahizong tol saw ngawl hi tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Biakpiakna in na nei ciang, tuasia balneen in a tungah sathau na buak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Beal baannei taw a kihuan anluum a kipia ahile, olive thau le anvui taw huan hi tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Hi an sia Topa tungah biakpiakna khat in paipui a, thiampipa tungah pia in, biaknatau ah paipui tu hi."},"9":{"text":"A vekpi in Topa tungah a kipia a hina thu limlakna in thiampipa in tawm la a, biaknatau tungah hal tu hi. Tua an biakpiakna ii ngimnam in Topa lungkimsak hi."},"10":{"text":"A taanglai biakpiaknate thiampite neisa hi a; Topa a kipia an sung pan a kila ahikom, thiangtho mama hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa a kipia antang taw biakpiaknate tol kisaw ngawl tu a; Topa tungah na piak an sungah khuaitui ahibuale tol na zangh ngei buatu hi."},"12":{"text":"Anpal taw biakpiakna khat kum simin na paipui tu uh a, ahizong biaknatau ah na hal buatu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Antang taw biakpiakna theampo ah ci saw vun, banghang ziam cile ci sia noma le Pathian kilaklaw ah thuciamna lim ahi hi. (Biakpiakna theampo ah ci saw nanak vun.)"},"14":{"text":"Anpal taw Topa tungah biakpiakna na nei uh ciang, kan sa antang ahibuale ngoaivui sa an hi tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua tungah olive thau helin ngimnamtui na buak tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa tungah an taw biakpiakna a hina, limlakna in antawm, sathau le ngimnamtui theampo zongh thiampipa in hal tu hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in kipawlkhop biakpiakna in a khuite khat a piak ciang a mealhem ngawl a tal ahibuale a nu hi tu hi.","title":"Kipawlkhop Biakpiaknate"},"2":{"text":"Ama in tua nganhing lu tungah a khut nga tu a, Topa ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang ah ngo tu hi. Aaron suan thiampite in biaknatau pangh li ah a chi the tu a,"},"3":{"text":"a nuai a sa teng Topa tungah an taw biakpiakna in pia tu hi: a sungthau theampo,"},"4":{"text":"a nautate le a nauta tuam a thau teng le a thinsa phabel teng pia tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Thiampite in hi teng theampo meihal biakpiaknate taw biaknatau tungah hal khawm tu hi. Hi an taw biakpiakna ii ngimnam in Topa lungkimsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Kipawlkhop biakpiakna khat ah tuu ahibuale keal a kizangh le; anu zongh apa zongh hi thei a, ahizong a mealhem ngawl het hi tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing khat in tuu taw a bia le,"},"8":{"text":"tuu lu tungah a khut nga tu a, Puanbuk mai ah ngo tu hi. Thiampite in biaknatau pangh li ah a chi the tu a,"},"9":{"text":"a nuai a, nganhing sanam teng Topa tungah an taw biakpiakna in pia tu hi: a thau, a cingpingu dongin a kitan a meici thau buppi, a sungkua a tuam a thau theampo,"},"10":{"text":"a nauta le a nauta tuam a thau teng le a thinsa phabel teng pia tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa tungah an taw biakpiakna khat ahi bangma vaipuak nei thiampipa in biaknatau tungah hal siat tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing khat in keal a pia le,"},"13":{"text":"a keal lu tungah a khut nga tu a, Puanbuk mai ah ngo tu hi. Thiampite in biaknatau pangh li ah a chi the tu a,"},"14":{"text":"a nuai a sa teng Topa tungah an taw biakpiakna in pia tu hi: a sungthau theampo,"},"15":{"text":"a nauta le a nauta tuam a thau teng, a thinsa phabel teng ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa a lungkimsak an taw biakpiakna ahi bangma, thiampipa in biaknatau tungah hal siat tu hi. A thau teng Topa neisa ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel te in a thau ahizong, a chi ahizong, ne thei ngawl tu hi; hi thu in Israel te theampo ii a teenna mun pawpo ah a tawntung a zui tu ngeina khat ahi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Vawtthaak Mawna Khialnate atu Biakpiaknate"},"2":{"text":"a maw a khial mihing khat in tupkhol ngawlin Topa thupiakte khat pawpo a paltan ciang, a zui tu a nuai a ngeinate Israel mite tungah a son natu in thupia hi."},"3":{"text":"A maw a khial sia Thiampi Lianbelpa hi a, mipite tungah mawna khialna hong then ahile, ama mawna khialna hangin a mealhem ngawl khuital no khat Topa tungah sangaw biakpiakna in pia tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in Puanbuk kongbiang ah khuital paipui tu a, a lu tungah a khut nga in Topa mai ah ngo tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaciang Thiampi Lianbelpa in khuital chi pawlkhat la in, Puanbuk sungah tumpui tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a khutme, chi sungah pap tu a, a thiangtho puankhai mai ah salivei the tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in chi pawlkhat, Puanbuk sung ngimnamtui biaknatau kingte ii a dokna teng noai tu hi, a taanglai chi teng Puanbuk kongbiang ah a om, meihal biakpiakna in a kizangh biaknatau bul ah sung tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Hi khuital tung pan a thau teng theampo, a sungthaute,"},"9":{"text":"a nauta le a nauta tuam a thaute, le a thinsa phabel la tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Thiampipa in tua a thau teng la tu a, kipawlkhop biakpiakna in a kingo nganhingte tung pan a thaute a hal bangin meihal biakpiak natu in a kizangh biaknatau tungah hal tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahizong ama in a vun, a tak teng, a lu, a peang teng, a ngil le a ngilzangte a kihel a sungkua teng la tu a,"},"12":{"text":"ngiaphual puasang ah paipui in vut buakna, biakna a zeksa taw kisai a thiangthona munah thingthut in hal tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tupkhol ngawlin Israel taangpi bup in Topa thupiakte khat paltan in a maw a khial in ahile,"},"14":{"text":"a maw a khial a kiheak po ciang taangpi taangta in khuital khat taw mawphel biakpiakna nei tu hi. Amate in Topa ompuina Puanbuk ah paipui tu a,"},"15":{"text":"taangpi lampuite in a khui lu tungah a khutte nga in, tualai ah ngo tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Thiampi Lianbelpa in khuital chi tawm Puanbuk sungah paipui tu a tua ii sungah"},"17":{"text":"a khutme papin puankhai mai ah salivei the tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in Puanbuk sung ngimnamtui biaknatau king, a dokna tengah chi tawm noai tu a, a taanglai teng Puanbuk kongbiang ah a om, meihal biakpiakna in a kizangh biaknatau bul ah sung tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in a thau teng la in biaknatau tungah hal tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in mawphel biakpiakna in a kizangh khuital sia taw a vawt bangma in hi khuital zongh taw a kibangin vawt tu a, mipite ii mawna hu in hi bangin sangaw biakpiakna vawt tu hi, tuaciang amate mawna kimaisak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in tua khuital ngiaphual pua sangah paipui in, ama mawmai natu biakpiakna khuital a hal bangin hal tu hi. Hisia in taangpite mawna maisak natu biakpiakna khat ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ngam uk khat in tupkhol ngawlin Topa thupiakte paltan in mawna a vawt le,"},"23":{"text":"a mawna a heak po ciang, a mealhem ngawl kealtal khat taw biakpiakna nei tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in kealtal lu tungah a khut nga tu a, meihal biakpiakna in nganhing a kingawna mun biaknatau saksang ah ngo tu hi. Hisia in mawphel biakpiakna khat ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Thiampipa in a chi sungah a khutme pap tu a, biaknatau king a kidokna tengah noai in, a taanglai teng biaknatau bul ah sung tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in kipawlkhop biakpiakna in a kingo nganhing thaute kihal bangma in, biaknatau ah a thau teng hal tu hi. Ngam uk khat ii mawmai natu in hi bangin thiampipa in sangaw biakpiakna nei tu a, ngamukpa mawna kimaisak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Tupkhol ngawlin nautaang mi khat in Topa thupiakte paltan in, mawna a vawt le,","ref":"Mi 15:27-28"},"28":{"text":"a mawna a heak po ciang a mealhem ngawl kealnu khat taw biakpiakna nei tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in keallu tungah a khut nga tu a, meihal biakpiak natu nganhing kingawna mun, biaknatau saksang ah ngo tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Nganhing chi sungah thiampipa in a khutme pap tu a, biaknatau king a dokna teng noai in, a taanglai teng biaknatau bul ah sung tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in kipawlkhop biakpiak natu in a kingo nganthaute laak bangin a thau teng la tu a, Topa a lungkimsak ngimnam ahi natu in biaknatau tungah hal tu hi. Hi bangin thiampipa in tua pa ii mawmai natu in, sangaw biakpiakna neisak tu a, a mawna kimaisak tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Mihing khat in mawphel biakpiakna in tuu khat hong paipui le, a mealhem ngawl a nu khat hi tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in tuu lu tungah a khut nga tu a, meihal biakpiak natu in ngan kingawna mun biaknatau ii saksang ah ngo tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Thiampipa in a chi sungah a khutme pap tu a, biaknatau king ah a om a dokna teng chi noai in, a taanglai teng biaknatau bul ah sung tu hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in kipawlkhop biakpiak natu in a kingo tuu thau laak bangin a thau teng la tu a, Topa tungah a kipia an taw biakpiaknate taw biaknatau tungah hal khawm tu hi. Hi bangin thiampipa in tua pa mawmai natu in sangaw biakpiakna nei tu a, ama mawna kimaisak tu hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A nuai a thute ah mawphel biakpiaknate kisamh hi. Mihing khat sia thukhenzum ah tetti pang tu in kisam a, ama muna bang le a zaakna bangin a son buale ama in a piang bang a thuak kul tu hi.","title":"Mawphel Biakpiaknate Vawt tu A kul Thute"},"2":{"text":"Tup khol ngawlin, mihing khat in sathaang thi ci bang, biakna zeksa sang panin a thiang ngawl khat po a thamtha le, a vawt hunlam a phaw po ciang ama sia a thiang ngawl, a maw a khial ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tup khol ngawlin mihing khat in mihing sung pan a piang a thiang ngawl na khat pawpo a thamtha ahile bang po ahizong ama in a vawt hunlam a heak po ciang a maw a khial hi tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Kidawm ngawlin, mihing khat in thu khat po ah a kiciam tha le zong a vawt hunlam a phaw po ciang ama a maw a khial ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing khat in a khial ciang a khialna pualaak nanak tu a,"},"6":{"text":"mawna daan tu in Topa tungah tuu anu khat ahibuale keal anu khat pia tu hi. Tua pa mawmai natu in thiampipa in sangaw biakpiakna neisak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Mi khat in tuu ahibuale keal a pia zo buale, a mawmai natu in ngam vakhu nii ahibuale inn vakhu niite Topa tungah paipui tu a, a khat sia mawphel biakpiakna hi tu a, a dangkhat sia meihal biakpiakna hi tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in tuate thiampipa kungah paipui tu a, thiampipa in tua vacim taw mawphel biakpiakna nei masa tu hi. Ama in a lu tatsak ngawlin a ngawng meak tu a,"},"9":{"text":"a chi pawlkhat biaknatau pangh the tu hi. A taanglai chi teng biaknatau bul ah sung tu hi. Hisia in mawphel biakpiakna khat ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a niina vacim taw ngeina om bangin meihal biakpiakna pia tu hi. Hi bangin thiampipa in tua pa mawmai natu sangaw biakpiakna vawtsak tu a, tua pa mawna kimaisak tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Mi khat in ngam vakhu nii le inn vakhu nii a pia zo buale mawphel biakpiak natu in anvui kilogramme khat paipui tu hi. Antang taw biakpiakna hi ngawl a, mawphel biakpiakna ahikom, ama in olive thau ahibuale ngimnamtui a tungah buak ngawl tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in thiampipa kungah paipui tu a, Topa tungah a vekpi a piak a lakna in thiampipa in khutdim khat la tu a, an taw biakpiakna in biaknatau tungah hal tu hi. Tua in mawphel biakpiakna ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hi bangin thiampipa in tua pa mawmai natu biakpiakna neisak tu a, ama mawna kimaisak tu hi. Antang taw biakpiakna bangma in a taanglai anvui teng thiampipa aa ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah a nuai a zui tu ngeinate pia hi.","title":"Khialphel natu Biakpiakna"},"15":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in tup khol ngawlin Topa tungah biakna taw kisai a thiangtho nate pia ngawlin a khial le ama in khialphel biakpiakna in a mealhem ngawl tuutal ahibuale kealtal khat Topa tungah pia tu hi. A man sia a khensat ngeina om bang kikhensat tu hi."},"16":{"text":"A piak ngawl vanh teng ama in pia kik tu a, zakhat ciang kul taw in belap nanak tu hi. Ama in thiampipa tungah pia tu a, tua pa mawmai natu in nganhing taw biakpiakna khat thiampipa in neisak tu a, ama mawna kimaisak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in tup khol ngawlin Topa thupiakte a paltan le, ama a khial hi a, a khialna daan thuak tu hi."},"18":{"text":"A khialphel natu in a mealhem ngawl tuutal khat ahibuale kealtal khat thiampipa tungah paipui tu hi. A man sia a ngeina om bangin kikhensat tu hi. Thiampipa in tupkhol ngawlin a khialpa khialphel natu in sangaw biakpiakna neisak tu a, ama khialna kimaisak tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Hisia ama ii Topa tungah a khialna hu a, khialphel biakpiakna ahi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah a nuai a ngeinate pia hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihing khat tungah Israel a mipui khat in sum koi a, a koina pa in pia kik nuam ngawl ahizong, ama na nguksak ahizong, a theam ahizong,"},"3":{"text":"a bo vanh khat mu napi leilot a mu bong ci in a kiciam ahile zong, Topa tungah maw ahikom biakpiakna khat a vawt kul hi."},"4":{"text":"Hi bang khat pawpo taw mihing khat in a maw a khial ciang thumaan ngawlin a nga vanh pawpo pia kik hamtang tu hi. A khialna a kimu ni in, a neipa tungah a cingin pia kik tu a, zakhat ciang kul taw belap tu hi.","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Ama in Topa tungah ama ii khialphel biakpiak natu in a mealhem ngawl tuutal ahibuale kealtal khat thiampipa kungah paipui tu hi. A man sia khensat ngeina om bang hi tu hi.","ref":"Mi 5:5-8"},"7":{"text":"Tua pa mawmai natu in, thiampipa in biakpiakna piaksak tu a, ama khialna kimaisak tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Sangaw taw Pum bup Meihal Biakpiaknate"},"9":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate ii meihal biakpiaknate a piak ciang a nuai a ngeinate a zui tu in thupia hi. Meihal biakpiakna sia zankhuateak biaknatau tungah kinusia tu a, tuaciang tua mei sia kuang tansak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaciang thiampipa in puanneal ngoaipuan tom le puanneal puantual sil a, biaknatau ah vut teng luakin, biaknatau pangh ah sung tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in a puan laih tu a, ngiaphual puasang biakna taw kisai a thiangthona munah vutte bua tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Biaknatau ah mei kuang topsak tu a, mitsak ngeingawl tu hi. Zing simin thiampipa in thing thut thua tu a, meihal biakpiakna vawtin, kipawlkhop biakpiakna sathaute hal tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Biaknatau ah mei kuang topsak tu a, mitsak ngeingawl tu hi."},"14":{"text":"A nuai a te sia antang biakpiakna ah zui tu ngeinate ahi hi. Aaron suan thiampipa in biaknatau mai Topa tungah antang biakpiakna pia tu hi.","title":"Antang Biakpiaknate"},"15":{"text":"A vekpi in Topa tungah a kipia a hina thu heaksakna in ama in khutdim khat anvui le sathau, a tungah ngimnamtuite buakin, biaknatau ah hal tu hi. Hi biakpiakna ii ngim in Topa lungkimsak hi."},"16":{"text":"A taanglai teng thiampite in ne tu hi. Tuate tol kisaw ngawl anluum in ki em tu a, Topa ompuina Puanbuk suumsung a thiangtho munah kine tu hi. Tua sia an taw biakpiaknate a khensak bangin Topa ii thiampite a piaksa hi. Tua in mawphel biakpiakna le khialphel biakpiaknate bangin thiangtho mama hi.","merge":"17"},"18":{"text":"Maisang hun theampo atu in Aaron suan le paal peuma in Topa tungah a kipia ante amate nga bangin ne tan thei tu uh hi. Midang khat pawpo tua biakpiakna an a thutha sia, a thianthona vaang in ngim ngasak tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,"},"20":{"text":"Aaron suan thiampi khat thupha piak kipsak natu taw kisai ngeinate pia hi. Thupha piak kipsakna a nga ni in Topa tungah anvui kilogramme khat (ni sim antang biakpiakna za taw a kikim) zingsangin a lang, nitakin a lang pia tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuate sathau taw hel tu a, moh emna taw minsak in, balneen tu a, Topa tungah antang biakpiakna in pia tu hi, a ngim in Topa lungkimsak hi."},"22":{"text":"Maisang hun theampo ah Aaron suan peuma Thiampi Lianbel a sep ciang hi biakpiakna vawt tu hi. Tua antang sia Topa tungah sangaw biakpiakna bangin kihal tum tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Thiampipa ii a piak antang biakpiaknate tawm zongh kine thei ngawl hi; tua teng a kihal siat kul tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah Aaron le a tapate in","title":"Mawphel Biakpiaknate"},"25":{"text":"a nuai a ngeinate mawphel biakpiakna a piak ciang a zui tu in thupia hi. Meihal biakpiak natu in sa a kingawna mun, biaknatau saksang ah mawphel biakpiak natu in nganhing kingo tu hi. Tua in a thiangtho mama biakpiakna ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Sangaw biakpiakna a pia thiampipa in a piak nganhing sate, Topa ompuina Puanbuk suumsung mun thiangthona ah ne tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo ahibuale na khat pawpo in tua nganhing sa a thutha le tuasia ii thianthona vaang in ngim ngasak tu hi. Tua sachi puan khat po tungah a baang tha le tuasia mun thiangtho na ah sawp kul tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Sa huanna leibeal khat pawpo sia kisutham tu a, thikbeal a kizangh le nawt thiang in, tui taw silthiang tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Thiampi innkuanpui pa pawpo in hi biakpiakna sa ne thei tu hi; tua biakpiakna sia thiangtho mama hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahizong Puanbuk sungah sachi kipaipui in, mawmai natu in a zeksa vawtna ah a kizangh le tua sa kine ngawl het tu a; tuasia a kihal kul tu hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A nuai a te sia khialphel biakpiaknate atu zui tu ngeinate hi a, thiangtho mama hi.","title":"Khialphel natu Biakpiaknate"},"2":{"text":"Meihal biakpiak natu in nganhing kingawna mun, biaknatau saksang ah hi biakpiakna ngan kingo tu a, biaknatau pangh li tengah a chi kithe tu hi."},"3":{"text":"A thau theampo la in biaknatau tungah kipia tu a, tuate a meithau, a sungthau,"},"4":{"text":"a nauta le a tuam thau teng, le a thinsa phabel teng hi tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa tungah an taw biakpiakna bangin thiampipa in a thau theampo biaknatau tungah hal tu hi. Tua in khialphel biakpiakna khat ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Thiampi innkuanpui, pa peuma in tua sa ne thei tu a, ahizong tua sa thiangtho mama ahikom mun thiangthona ah kine tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Mawphel biakpiakna le khialphel biakpiakna ah a kibangin zak tu ngeina khat om a, tua in a sa sia sangaw biakpiakna a pia thiampipa ii neisa hi, cina ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Meihal biakpiakna in a kipia nganhing vun sia biakpiakna a pia thiampipa ii neisa ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Thik bealpeu sungah a ki em, ahibuale beal baannei le moh emna sungah a kivawt antang biakpiakna peuma, Pathian tungah a pia thiampipa ii neisa hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahizong a kihuan ngawl antang a kipia theampo, sathau taw a kihel ahizong a kihel ngawl ahizong, Aaron suan thiampite neisa hi a, a kikim in a hawm tek tu ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"A nuai a te Topa tungah a kipia kipawlkhop biakpiakna ah zui tu ngeinate ahi hi.","title":"Kipawlkhop Biakpiaknate"},"12":{"text":"Mihing khat in Pathian tungah lungdamko biakpiakna in hi biakpiakna a vawt le biakpiakna ah a zak tu nganhing taw in, tol saw ngawl anluum piakhawm tu hi, tuate anvui le olive thau a kihel a saa anluumte ahibuale olive thau taw a kizut muhte, ahibuale olive thau taw kihel muhte ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua dom ngawlin tol kisaw anluumte zongh pia tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in anluum nam simin khen khat tek a tuam vilvel in Topa tungah pia tu a; tuate nganhing chi la a, biaknatau tungah a the thiampipa ii neisa ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Biakpiakna nganhing sa sia biakpiakna vawt ni in kine tu a; a zingsang ciang dong koi ngawl tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihing khat in kamciam taangtut natu ahizong ama thinzaw biakpiakna taw ahizong a piak pawlkhop biakpiakna hong paipui le biakpiak ni in ne siat ngawl tu a, a taanglai pawpo a zing ciang ne thei tu hi."},"17":{"text":"A ni thum ni in sa taanglai pawpo kihal tu hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni thum ni in a taanglai sa a kine le tua pa biakpiakna Pathian in saang ngawl tu hi. Tua biakpiakna sia ama atu in phattuamna om ngawl tu a, a thiangtho ngawlin kingaisun in, tua sa a ne pawpo in a piang babang thuak tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua biakpiakna sa sia biakna taw kisai a thiang ngawl khat pawpo taw a kithutha le kine ngawlin a kihal kul tu hi. Biakna zeksa taw kisai in a thiang khat pawpo in tua sa ne thei tu hi,"},"20":{"text":"ahizong a thiang ngawl khat pawpo in tua sa a ne le Pathian mi in kingaisun nawn ngawl tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in mihing ahibuale nganhing tung pan biakna taw kisai in a thiang ngawl khat pawpo a tham zawkciang hi biakpiakna sa a ne le, ama sia Pathian mi in kingaisun nawn ngawl tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,"},"23":{"text":"a nuai a, zui tu ngeina teng Israel mite atu in pia hi. Khuithau, tuuthau le kealthau kine ngawl tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama thu in a thi thawthong nganhing ahibuale ngamsa ii a mat nganhing sia ii thaute kine ngawl tu a, ahizong na dangin kizangh thei tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in Topa tungah an taw biakpiakna in a kizangh thei nganhing thau a ne le, ama sia Pathian mi in kingaisun nawn ngawl tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Koisung po ah a teang zong Israel te in vacim chi le nganhing chi ne ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Pian 9:4; Thiam 17:10-14; 19:26; Thkna 12:16,23; 15:23"},"27":{"text":"Hi thukham a paltan pawpo Pathian ii mi khat in kingaisun nawn ngawl tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah"},"29":{"text":"a nuai a, zui tu ngeina teng Israel mite atu in pia hi. A kuama po in kipawlkhop biakpiakna a piak ciang tua ii sung pan pawlkhat sia Topa tungah a tuam vilvel letsong in puak hamtang tu a,"},"30":{"text":"tua letsong sia an taw biakpiakna bangin ama khut vateak taw paipui tu hi. Ama in nganhing thau sia a awmsa taw paipui tu a, Topa tungah a tuam vilvel letsong in pia tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Thiampipa in a thaute biaknatau ah hal tu a, ahizong a awmsa sia thiampite in tang tu hi."},"32":{"text":"A ziatsang phei bup sia a tuam vilvel letsong in,"},"33":{"text":"a chi le a thau taw in kipawlkhop biakpiakna a pia thiampipa tungah pia tu hi."},"34":{"text":"A awmsa sia a tuam vilvel letsong hi a, a ziatsang phei sia Israel mite tung pan Topa ii a laak, thiampite tungah a piak a tuam vilvel letsong ahi hi. Hisia maisang hun theampo ah Israel mite ii thiampite tungah a piak tu ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Hisia in Aaron le a tapate thiampi in a kikipsak ni a, Topa tungah a kipia an sung pan amate a kipia an khen khat ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ni in hi biakpiakna sung pan khen khat thiampite tungah piak tu in Israel mite tungah Topa in thupia hi. Hi sia in Israel mite ii mai sang hun theampo ah a zui tu ngeina khat ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, hite in meihal biakpiakna, antang biakpiakna, mawphel biakpiakna, khialphel biakpiakna, kipsakna biakpiaknate, le pawlkhop biakpiakna atu in ngeinate ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Hite sia sennealngam Sinai Mual ah, Israel mite ii zui tu biakpiaknate a vawt natu a son ni in Topa ii Moses tungah a thupiakte ahi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Aaron le A Tapate Thiampi Kipsakna (Pusuana 29:1-37)"},"2":{"text":"“Aaron le a tapate ka ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang ah paipui in, tuaciang thiampi puante, noi sathau, mawphel biakpiak natu in khuital moi sia, tuutal niite le tol saw ngawl anluum khum sia hong paipui ta'n."},"3":{"text":"Tua zawkciang tualai ah taangpi bup khawm in,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin Moses in seam a, taangpi a kikhop uh ciang,"},"5":{"text":"amate tungah Moses in, “Tu in ka sep tu sia, Topa hong thupiak ahi hi,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Moses in Aaron le a tapate mai sangah paipui a biakna zeksa om bangin, kibualsak hi."},"7":{"text":"Moses in Aaron laktong le puantual silhsak a, a kawng ah kawngsawmna sawm hi. Ama in ephod silhsak a, a pha mama a kitak kawngkhau taw a kawng sawmsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in awmdal thuasakin, a tungah Urim le Thummim koi hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin ama in a lu ah dial khimsak a, a dial mai sangah a thiangtho ki aapna lim, kizepna khamh sia belh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Moses in noi sathau la in Topa ompuina Puanbuk tung le a sungah a om nazak theampo noai siat a, hi bangin Topa tungah aap siat hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa tungah tua teng aap natu in ama in sathau pawlkhat la in biaknatau tung, a vanh zakte tung, kuang tung le a ngaknate tungah salivei the hi."},"12":{"text":"Moses in Aaron lu tung sathau buakna taw Aaron sia thiampi a hina kipsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Moses in Topa thupiak bangin Aaron tapate mai sangah paipui a, laktongte silsakin a kawng uh ah kawngsawmte sawmsakin a lu uh ah lukhute khusak hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Moses in mawphel biakpiak natu in khuital moi sia paipui a, Aaron le a tapate in khui lu tungah a khutte nga uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua biaknatau aap natu in Moses in tuasia ngo a, a khut taw a chi tawm la in biaknatau kingdokte noai hi. Tuaciang a taanglai chite biaknatau bul ah sung hi. Hi bangin ama in biaknatau aapin thiansua hi."},"16":{"text":"Moses in a sungthau theampo, a thinsa a phabel teng le a nauta le a tuam a thau teng la in biaknatau tungah hal siat hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a taanglai khuital sa teng, a vun, a tak le a ngilpi a ngilzangte la in Topa thupiak bangin ngiaphual pua sangah hal hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciang Moses in meihal biakpiak natu in tuutal paipui a, Aaron le a tapate in a lu tungah a khutte nga uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Moses in tua tuu ngo a, biaknatau pangh li tengah a chi the hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in Topa thupiak bangin tuusa sem a, a sungkua le a nung peangte tui taw silin, a lu, a thau, le a taanglai tuusa teng biaknatau tungah hal hi. Hi meihal biakpiakna sia an taw biakpiakna hi a, a ngimnam in Topa lungkimsak hi.","merge":"21"},"22":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Moses in thiampite a kipsak natu in tuutal a niina sia paipui a, Aaron le a tapate in a lu tungah a khutte nga uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Moses in tuutal ngo a, a chi tawm la in Aaron ziatsang bil tung, a ziatsang khutpi tung le a ziatsang peangpi tungah noai hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in Aaron ii tapate mai ah paipui a, tuutal chi pawlkhat a ziatsang bil tung, a ziatsang khutpi tung le a ziatsang peangpi tung tek ah noai hi. A taanglai chi te Moses in biaknatau pangh li tengah the hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in a thau, a meithau, a sungthau theampo, a thinsa phabel teng, a nauta le a tuam a thau teng le a nung peang ziatsang la hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in Topa tungah a ki aap khum sung pan tol saw ngawl anluum khat, sathau taw kivawt anluum khat, le moh phang khat la in a thau tung le a nung peang ziatsang tungah koi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in Aaron le a tapate khut tungah hi an teng koi a, amate in Topa tungah a tuam vilvel letsong in pia uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaciang Moses in amate tung pan tua an teng la in kipsakna biakpiakna in nei a, meihal biakpiakna ii tungbel biaknatau tungah hal hi. Hisia in an taw biakpiakna hi a, a ngimnam in Topa lungkimsak hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaciang Moses in a awmsa la in Topa tungah a tuam vilvel letsong in pia hi. Tua in kipsakna biakpiakna tuutal sa sung pan Moses ii satel ahi hi. Topa thupiak bangin Moses in seam siat hi."},"30":{"text":"Moses in noi sathau tawm le biaknatau tungah a om sachi tawm la in, Aaron le a tapate le a puante tungah the hi. Hi bangin amate le a puante Topa tungah aap hi."},"31":{"text":"Moses in Aaron le a tapate tungah, “ Topa thupiak bangin Topa ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang ah sate paipui in huan vun a, tuaciang khum sungah a om kipsakna biakpiakna anluum taw tualai ah ne vun."},"32":{"text":"A sa le anluum neakmongte hal vun."},"33":{"text":"Kipsakna biakpiakna a zeksa teng a cin mateng ni sali sung Puanbuk kongbiang pan puapial ngawl tu nu hi."},"34":{"text":"Na mawna uh a mai natu in Topa thupiak bangin tuni in ih vawt zo hi."},"35":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin seamin, sun taw zan taw ni sali sung Puanbuk kongbiang ah om hamtang tu nu hi. Na om bua uh le thi tu nu hi. Hi thu in kei tungah Topa hong thupiak ahi hi,” ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Topa ii Moses tungtawnin a thupiakte Aaron le a tapate in tuabangin vawt siat uh hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thiampi kipsakna a zeksa teng a man khuavak ni in Moses in Aaron le a tapate le Israel lampuite sam hi.","title":"Aaron in Sangaw Biakpiaknate Pia"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Aaron tungah, “A mealhem ngawl khuital khat le tuutal khat paipui in, Topa tungah pia in a, mawphel biakpiak natu in khuital le meihal biakpiak natu in tuutal hi tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Israel mite tungah mawphel biakpiak natu in kealtal khat, meihal biakpiak natu in a mealhem ngawl kum khat a pha khuino khat le kum khat a pha tuuno khat,"},"4":{"text":"pawlkhop biakpiakna khat atu in khuital khat le tuutal khat a ken natu son in. Sathau taw a kihel antang taw biakpiakna taw in amate in Topa tungah sangaw biakpiakna pia tu uh hi. Amate in hi teng vawt nanak tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile tuni in amate kungah Topa kilangh tu hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Moses thupiak bangin amate in Puanbuk mai ah na theampo paipui a, Topa a bia tu in taangpi bup tua munah kikhawm uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Moses in, “ Topa ompuina khuavak taang velvol sia no tungah a kilangh thei natu in hi sep tu theampo Topa in note thu hong pia zo hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahiciang ama in Aaron tungah, “Biaknatau ah pai in na mawnate le na mite mawnate a mai natu in, mawphel biakpiakna le meihal biakpiakna pia in. Topa thupiak bangin, mite mawnate a mai natu in hi biakpiakna pia in” ci hi.","ref":"Heb 7:27"},"8":{"text":"Aaron in biaknatau ah pai a, a ma mawphel biakpiakna in khuital moi khat ngo hi."},"9":{"text":"A tapate in sachi puak a, ama in sachi sungah a khutme papin biaknatau king a dok teng sachi pawlkhat noai in, biaknatau bul ah a taanglai teng sung hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Moses tungah Topa thupiak bangin Aaron in a thau, a nautate le a thinsa a phabel teng biaknatau tungah hal hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahizong ama in a satak le a vun sia ngiaphual pua sangah hal hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama ii aituam meihal biakpiakna in ama in ngan ngo hi. A tapate in sachi puakin tuasia biaknatau pangh li tengah the hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in a lu le a sabek dangte a khut sungah pia a, ama in tua sate biaknatau tungah hal hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in a sungkua teng le a nung peangte nii silin biaknatau tung, a om lai meihal biakpiaknate ii tungbel ah hal hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in mipite atu biakpiaknate pia hi. Ama in ama mawphel biakpiakna a vawt bangin mipite mawmai natu in a kipia keal sia kai in ngo a, biakpiakna in pia hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in meihal biakpiak natu in nganno zongh paipui a, ngeina om bangin biakpiakna in pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in antang biakpiakna pia a, anvui khutdim khat la in biaknatau tungah hal hi. (Hisia ni sim meihal biakpiakna belapna ahi hi.)"},"18":{"text":"Ama in mipite atu kipawlkhop biakpiakna in khuital le tuutal ngo hi. A tapate in sachi puak a, ama in biaknatau pangh li tengah the hi.","ref":"Thiam 3:1-11"},"19":{"text":"Aaron in khuithau le tuutal thaute,"},"20":{"text":"nganhingte ii awmsa tungah koi in biaknatau ah paipui siat hi. Ama in biaknatau tungah a thaute halin"},"21":{"text":"Moses thupiak bangin a awmsate le a nung peang ziatsangte thiampite atu in Topa tungah a tuam vilvel letsong in pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Aaron in sangaw biakpiakna teng a man ciang mipite tungah a khutte laamin thupha pia a, tua zawkciang tuaksuk hi.","ref":"Mi 6:22-26"},"23":{"text":"Topa ompuina Puanbuk sungah Moses le Aaron tum in, hong pusua ciang amate in mipite thupha pia a, Topa ompuina khuavak taang velvol sia mipite tungah kilangh hi."},"24":{"text":"Thakhat thu in Topa in meikuang puak a, biaknatau tungah a om meihal biakpiakna le a thau teng haltum hi. Mipite sia tua meikuang a mu uh ciang au siat a lei maingat in kunsuk uh hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aaron ii tapate Nadab le Abibu in amate mei lakna kuang tek la in a sungah meikam koi a, ngimnamtui helin Topa tungah pia hi. Ahizong tua mei thiangtho ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in tuasia a piak tu in amate thupia ngawl hi.","title":"Nadab le Abihu Mawna"},"2":{"text":"Thakhat thu in Topa in mei puak a, Topa ompuina munah tua mei in amate kaanghlum hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Moses in Aaron tungah, “ Topa in ‘Ka na a seamte theampo in ka thianthona zakta tu hi; ka mite tungah ka vaangletna ka pualaak tu hi’ a ci ciang a deina sia, tubang ahi hi,” ci hi. Ahizong Aaron bangma pau ngawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in Aaron pano, Uzziel tapate ahi, Mishael le Elzaphan sam a, amate tungah, “Hi sungah hong pai tavun a, a thiangtho Puanbuk sung pan ngiaphual pua sangah na suapuisealte ii luang pusuapui tavun,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Moses thupiak bangin amate in a luangte puan taw tunin ngiaphual pua sangah pusuapui uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Moses in Aaron le a tapate Eleazar le Ithamar tungah, “Na khuangaina na lakna in sam pot ngawl ahibuale puan balkeak in om heak vun. Tuabang na om uh le, na thi tu uh a taangpi bup tungah Topa thin uuk tu hi. Ahizong Topa ii puak mei taw a kaanghlumte hu in na Israel mipuite theampo in a khuangaina lak thei tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Puanbuk kongbiang nusia heak vun, na nusia uh le na thi tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile Topa ii noi sathau taw a ki aap sate na hi uh hi,” ci hi. Tua ahiciang amate in Moses ci bangin seam uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Aaron tungah,","title":"Thiampite Zui tu Ngeinate"},"9":{"text":"“Nangma le na tapate sapittui ahibuale beer na neak zawk uh ciang kong ompuina Puanbuk sungah tum ngawl tu nu hi; na tum uh le thi tu nu hi. Hi thukham na suan na paalte theampo ii zui tu ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Note in Topa neisa le zak ngengei vanhte sia, biakna taw kisai in a thiangtho le a thiangtho ngawl khentel tu nu hi."},"11":{"text":"Moses tungtawn a kong piak thukham theampo note in Israel mite tungah hil nanak tu nu hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Moses in Aaron le a taanglai a tapa niite Eleazar le Ithamar tungah, “ Topa tungah a kipia ante sung pan a taanglai antang biakpiakna teng la vun a, tol saw ngawl anluum vawtin, biaknatau pangh ah ne vun, banghang ziam cile biakpiakna sia thiangtho mama hi."},"13":{"text":"A thiangtho munah ne vun; tua in Topa tungah a kipia an sung pan hong khensak nangma le na tapate ii tan tu ahi hi. Tua in Topa ii kei tungah hong thupiak ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 6:14-18"},"14":{"text":"Ahizong nangma le na innkuanpuite in thiampite atu a Topa tungah a kituam piak letsong le a sa tel, a awmsa le a pheisate ne thei tu nu hi. Biakna taw kisai a thiangthona mun pawpo ah tua sate ne thei tu nu hi. Tuate Israel mite ii pawlkhop biakpiakna te sung pan hong khensak nangma le na tate tan tu in hong kipia biakpiaknate ahi hi,","ref":"Thiam 7:30-34"},"15":{"text":"Topa tungah an biakpiakna in a thau a kipiak hun ciang amate in a pheisa le a awmsa paipui tu uh hi. Topa thupiak bangin hi sanamte nangma le na tate neisa hi tawntung tu hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Mawphel biakpiak natu ahi keal sia ii thu Moses in a dok ciang tua keal, kihal tum zo ci sia he hi. Hi thu hangin Eleazar le Ithamar tungah thin uuk a, ama in,"},"17":{"text":"“Banghangin mawphel biakpiakna sa a thiangtho munah ne ngawl nu ziam? Tuasia in a thiangtho mama an hi a, taangpi taangta mawmai natu in Topa ii no hong piaksa ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 6:24-26"},"18":{"text":"A chi sia Puanbuk thiang sungah a kipaipui ngawl hu in, kong thupiak bangin biakpiakna sate tua munah na neak tu uh ahi hi,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Aaron in, “Mawphel biakpiakna sa sia tuni in ne hi leng Topa in hong saang tu ziam? Tuni in Topa tungah mipite in mawphel biakpiakna le meihal biakpiakna pia zo napi, kei tungah hi bang a lauhuai nate hong tung lalai hi,” ci in zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Moses sia hi thu a zaak ciang lungkim hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah,","title":"Neak thei Nganhingte (Thuhil kikna 14:3-21)"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite atu a nuai a ngeinate pia hi. Leitung nganhing,"},"3":{"text":"peangcin kaa a, eakkha zongh a thai pawpo ii sa na ne thei tu uh a,"},"4":{"text":"ahizong kalaohte, sakihte, ahibuale bilpite sa na ne bua het tu uh hi. Tuate a thiang ngawlin ngaisut tu ahi hi; hite eakkha a thai hangin a peangcin kaa ngawl hi.","merge":"5"},"7":{"text":"Voksa ne heak vun. Tuate a thiang ngawlin ngaisut tu ahi hi; Vok sia a peangcin kaa hikale eakkha thai ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua nganhingte ii sa ne heak vun, a thite zongh tham heak vun; tuate thiangtho ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tha le hawlip a nei ngasa nam peuma ne thei tu nu hi,"},"10":{"text":"ahizong tuisung nganhing, tha le hawlip a nei ngawlte na ne buahet tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Hi nganhingte a thiang ngawlin ngaisut tu ahi hi. Na ne buahet tu uh a, a thite zongh na tham buatu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuisung a nungta, tha le hawlip a nei ngawl peuma na ne bua het tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A nuai a vacimte: muvanlai, simbu, muthi, mupui; mumeikaa, vaciik, va-ak; kalaoh vacim; tuipiva, hilniang vacimlian, vakaang, tuingumpai, vanungak; vasuangui le bak sate na ne buahet tu uh hi.","merge":"14"},"20":{"text":"Peang luk a nei tha nei lungnote,"},"21":{"text":"a leang vakeu theite simngawl po thiang ngawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Khaumaw, khuangbai le sim khaumawte na ne thei tu uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahizong tha nei a, a bokvak nganhing no dang theampo a thiang ngawl het in ngaisut tu ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"A kuama po in a nuai a nganhing thite a tham peuma nitak dongin nin tu hi: tuate peangcin nei ahihang a kaa ngawl, eakkha a thai ngawl nganhing theampo le, a peangbom a, peang li nei nganhing theampo ahi hi. Tua nganhing a thite a pua peuma in a puan sawp nanak tu a, ahizong nitak dongin a thiang ngawl hi lai tu hi.","merge":"25"},"29":{"text":"Savokphualte, ngam zunamte, sanchiimte le, thankhik namte a nin in kingaisun hi.","merge":"30"},"31":{"text":"Hi nganhingte ahibuale a thiluangte a tham pawpo nitak dongin a thiang ngawl hi tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Hi sa a thite na khat pawpo tungah a taak le, a tukna tua vanhte a thiang ngawl hi tu hi. A kizakna taw kisai ngawlin thing, puan, savun, ip cite hisia in huam siat tu hi. Tuasia tui sungah dia tu a, ahizong nitak dongin a thiang ngawl hi tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua sathi luangte leibeal khat sungah a taak le, tua ii sungah a om na theampo a thiang ngawl hi tu a, a beal sutham hamtang tu nu hi."},"34":{"text":"A kine thei an pawpo tungah tuabang beal sung pan tui a kisung le a nin hi tu a, tuabang beal sungah a om a kidawn thei pawpo nin tu hi."},"35":{"text":"Sa thiluangte ii taakna khat pawpo sia thiang ngawl a, lei taw kivawt meibung ahibuale bealpeu sia kiseaktham tu hi."},"36":{"text":"Hi sathi luangte ii a thuthaak dang pawpo a thiang ngawl hi tu a, ahizong tuinaak ahibuale tuibeam sia thiang veve hi."},"37":{"text":"A kiciing tu thaicii tungah sathi luang khat a taak le, tua thaicii thiang veve hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahizong thaicii sia tui sungah kidia in tua tungah sathi luang khat a taak le tua thaicii thiang ngawl hi."},"39":{"text":"A kine thei nganhing khat a thi le, tuasia a tham pawpo nitak dongin thiang ngawl tu hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua nganhing sate a ne a om le, a puan sawp hamtang tu a, ahizong nitak dongin a thiang ngawl hi lai tu hi; tua sathi luang a pua pawpo in a puan sawp hamtang tu hi, ahizong ama sia nitak dongin a thiang ngawl hi lai tu hi."},"41":{"text":"Lei ah a vak nganhing note,"},"42":{"text":"a awmtaal ahizong, peang li taw a vak ahizong, peang tam mama a neite ahizong ne ngawl het tu nu hi."},"43":{"text":"Hi sate ne in noma le noma a thiang ngawl kisua heak vun."},"44":{"text":"Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi a, keima thiangtho ka hikom note zongh na thiangtho uh kul hi.","ref":"Thiam 19:2; 1 Pe 1:16"},"45":{"text":"Na Pathian ka hi thei natu in Egypt pan hong pusuapui Topa ka hi hi. Keima thiangtho ka hikom note na thiangtho uh kul hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua ahiciang hisia in nganhingte, vacimte, tuisung a nungtate theampo le leitung a vakte theampo taw a kisai thukham ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Note in biakna taw kisai a thiang le a thiang ngawl, neak thei le neak thei ngawl nganhingte na khentel thei tu na kidop uh kul hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah Israel mite atu in,","title":"Naunei Zawkciang Numeite Thiansuana"},"2":{"text":"zui tu a nuai a ngeinate pia hi. Numei khat in tha sim nin a nei hunsung bangma in tapa khat a nei zawk ni sali sung sia biakna taw kisai in thiangtho ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Ni liat ni in a tapa vunteap ki at tu hi.","ref":"Pian 17:12; Lk 2:21"},"4":{"text":"Tuaciang numei in a chi luanna pan biakna taw kisai in a thiantho dong ni sawmthum le ni thum sung ngak tu hi. Ama in a kithiansuana hun a cin mateng a thiangtho na khat zongh tham thei ngawl tu a, a thiangtho Puanbuk sungah tum ngawl het tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Numei khat in tha sim nin a nei hunsung bangma in tanu khat a nei zawk ni sawm le ni li sung biakna taw kisai in thiangtho ngawl hi. Tuaciang a chi luanna pan biakna taw kisai in a thian natu in ni sawmluk le ni luk ngei lai tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tapa ahizong tanu ahizong nei in a thiansua na hun a cin zawkciang, ama in Topa ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang ah a om thiampipa tungah meihal biakpiak natu in kum khat a pha tuuno khat le mawphel biakpiak natu in inn vakhu ahibuale ngam vakhu khat paipui tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Thiampipa in Topa tungah tua nu ii a zeksa biakpiakna piaksak tu a, ama thiantho ngawlna teng thiansuana in a zeksa teng vawtsak a, tuaciang ama biakna taw kisai in thiangtho tu hi. Hi thu in numei khat ii a naunei zawkciang a zui hamtang tu ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Numeinu in tuuno khat a nei zo bua ahile inn vakhu nii ahibuale ngam vakhu nii, meihal biakpiak natu in khat, mawphel biakpiak natu in a dang khat paipui tu a, tuaciang thiampipa in tua nu a thiantho ngawlna pan a thiansua tu in a zeksa teng vawtsak tu a, tuaciang ama biakna taw kisai in thiangtho tu hi.","ref":"Lk 2:24"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah hi thukhamte pia hi.","title":"Vun natnate taw Kisai Thukhamte"},"2":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in a vun tungah, a lauhuai vun natna dong a suak thei tu meima khat ahibuale uilut khat ahibuale a tum thei meima khat a nei le, ama sia Aaron suan thiampite kungah kipaipui tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Thiampipa in a meima etsak tu a, a meima sung multe kaangin a meima kiimkot sangin a sa a dum zaw le tua meima sia a lauhuai vun natna hi a, thiampipa in tua pa a nin in thangsak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahizong tua meima kaangin, a kiimkot zongh dum zaw ngawl a, a multe zongh a kaang buale thiampipa in tua pa ni sali sung koituam tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Thiampipa in ni sali ni in en kik tu a, a meimate beak ngawlin, kibang lai in, a ngaisun le a dang ni sali sung ma koituam lai tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Thiampipa in ni sali ni in en kik tu a, a meima thipin tuasia a beak buale ama sia biakna taw kisai in thiangtho hi ci in thangsak tu hi; tuasia meima thawthong bek hi. Tua pa in a puante sawp tu a, biakna taw kisai in a thiang hi tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahizong thiampipa in en a, thiang hi ci in a thansak zawkciang a meima a beak le thiampipa kungah kilak kik hamtang tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Thiampipa in en kik tu a, a meima a beak le ama sia a thiang ngawlin thangsak tu hi. Tua in a lauhuai vun natna ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in a lauhuai vun natna a nei le tua pa thiampipa kungah kipaipui tu a,"},"10":{"text":"thiampipa in en tu hi. A vun tungah meima kaang khat om in, a multe kaang a, a nai a dim le,"},"11":{"text":"tua meima sia a dam thei ngawl vun natna ahi hi. Thiampipa in tua pa a thiangtho ngawlin thangsak tu a, a thiang ngawl a kimusa hi zo ahikom koituam kul ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua vun natna beakin a lu pan a peang dong a theng le,"},"13":{"text":"thiampipa in en kik tu hi. A pumpi tung bup beak zo in a mu le thiampipa in biakna taw kisai in a thiang in thangsak tu hi. A vun theampo hong kaang ahile ama sia biakna taw kisai in a thiang ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahizong a meima balh a kimu po ciang ama sia a thiang ngawl ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Thiampipa in en kik tu a, a meima a balhin a mu le a thiang ngawlin thangsak tu hi. A meima balh sia vun natna cinopna hi a, tua pa sia a thiang ngawl ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahizong a meima damin a kaan kik ciang, thiampipa kungah tua pa pai tu a,"},"17":{"text":"thiampipa in en kik tu hi, tua meima a kaang zo le, a ma biakna taw kisai in a thiang hi a, thiampipa in a thiangin thangsak tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Uilut vei khat a dam zawkciang,"},"19":{"text":"a ma santak kang in ahibuale a san le a kang kithua in, hong tum le thiampipa tungah kilak tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Thiampipa in en tu a, tua a tum sia, a kiim a vunte sang dum zaw in a sungah a multe a kaang le, thiampipa in ama sia a thiang ngawlin thangsak tu hi. Tuasia in uilut pan a kipan a lauhuai vun natna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahizong thiampipa in en in a sung a, a multe kaang ngawlin, a kiim a vunte sangin a dum zaw tuan bua a, ahizong daang pian in a mu le thiampipa in ama ni sali sung koituam tu hi."},"22":{"text":"A meima a beak le thiampipa in ama a thiang ngawlin thangsak tu a; ama sia vun natna vei ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahizong a meima a ngei bangma hi in a beak tuan buale uilut mapawn hi lel a, thiampipa in ama biakna taw kisai a thiangin thangsak tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo mei in kaanghin, a sa kaang in ahibuale a san le a kaang a kithua le,"},"25":{"text":"thiampipa in en tu hi. A meima sung multe kaangin, a kiim a vunte sangin a dum zaw le, mei kakna pan a kipan a lauhuai vun natna hi a, thiampipa in tua pa a thiang ngawlin thangsak tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahizong a meima santak multe kaang ngawlin, a kiim vunte sangin dumzaw tuan ngawl a, ahizong a daang pian le thiampipa in ama ni sali sung koituam tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Ni sali ni in thiampipa in ama en kik tu a, a meima a beak le vun natna ahikom thiampipa in a thiang ngawlin thangsak tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahizong a meima beak ngawlin, kilamdang tuan ngawl a, a daang pian bek ahile a lauhuai vun natna hi ngawl hi. Mei kakna mapawn khat bek ahikom thiampipa in biakna taw kisai in a thiangin thangsak tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Pa ahizong numei ahizong a lu tung ahibuale a kha ah meima a nei ciang,"},"30":{"text":"thiampipa in en tu hi. A kiim a, a vunte sangin dum zaw in, a sung a multe engin a mal a no le, tua in a lauhuai vun natna hi a, thiampipa in a thiang ngawlin thangsak tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Thiampipa in a et ciang a kiim a, a vunte sangin a meima dum zaw tuan ngawlin, ahizong ama sung a multe mul dang taw a kibang buale, thiampipa in ama ni sali sung koituam tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Thiampipa in ni sali ni in a meima en kik tu a, beak zaw ngawl, a sungah mul eng om ngawlin, a kiim a vunte sangin a dum zaw tuan buale,"},"33":{"text":"tua pa in a meima kiim simngawl teng, a sam le a mul meet tu hi. Thiampipa in ama ni sali sung koituam tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Ni sali ni in thiampipa in a meima en kik tu a, a meima beak ngawlin a kiim a vunte sang a dum zaw tuan buale thiampipa in ama biakna taw kisai a thiangin thangsak hi tu hi. Tua pa in a puante sawp tu a, ama a thiangtho tu hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahizong a thiang in a thansak zawkciang a meima a beak le,"},"36":{"text":"thiampipa in en kik tu hi. A meima a beak le, a mul engte et kul nawn ngawl a; tua pa a thiang ngawl ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahizong thiampipa in a meima beak ngawlin, a sung a multe ciidam in po a, a meima a damin a ngaisun le thiampipa in ama biakna taw kisai a thiangin thangsak tu hi."},"38":{"text":"Pa ahizong numei ahizong a vun tungah a kaangpawlte a om le,"},"39":{"text":"thiampipa in en tu hi. Tua munte a kaang philphel ahile, vun mealhem natu bekin a piang hi a; tua pa biakna taw kisai in a thiang ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"Mihing khat a nung sam ahizong, a maisam ahizong a pul hangin tua in ninsak ngawl hi.","merge":"41"},"42":{"text":"Ahizong a lu kolhna ah a san le a kaang a kithua meima a piang le, tua in a lauhuai vun natna ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"Thiampipa in en tu a, a san le a kaang kithua meima a om le,"},"44":{"text":"a lu tungah a lauhuai vun natna vei ahikom thiampipa in ama a thiang ngawlin thangsak tu hi."},"45":{"text":"A lauhuai vun natna a veipa in puan ek silh tu a, a sam pot ngawlin, a mai nuaisang teng seal a, “A thiang ngawl, a thiang ngawl ka hi hi!” ci in au tu hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua natna a vei hun sung a thiang ngawl hi a, midangte taw a kikhualana ngiaphual pua sangah teang tu hi."},"47":{"text":"Samul ahibuale puanneal puansilh tungah,","title":"Cipawl Natna taw kisai Thukhamte"},"48":{"text":"puanneal puanbek, ahibuale samul puan, ahibuale savun, ahibuale savun taw kivawt khat pawpo tungah a pawl a om ciang,"},"49":{"text":"a hing ahibuale a sanin a beak le thiampipa tung lak tu hi."},"50":{"text":"Thiampipa in en tu a, tua puan ni sali sung koituam tu hi."},"51":{"text":"Thiampipa in ni sali ni ciang en kik tu a, tua a pawl sia a beak le, tua puan a nin ahi hi."},"52":{"text":"Thiampipa in hal tu hi, banghang ziam cile a beak thei ahikom mei taw haltum tu ahi hi."},"53":{"text":"Ahizong ama in a ettel ciang, a pawl sia puan tungah kizel ngawlin a mu le,"},"54":{"text":"ama in tua puan a sawp natu le a dang ni sali sung a koituam natu in thupia tu hi."},"55":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in en tu a, tua a pawl na ii a pianzia a kilaih buale a kizel bua zong nin veve hi; a pawl te omna mun a nung ahizong a mai ahizong mei taw hal tu hi."},"56":{"text":"Ahizong thiampipa in a et ciang a pawl teng a bo zo le, tua puan ahibuale savun sia tua san tak teng eaukeak tu hi."},"57":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a pawl te hong piangkik in a kizel kik le a neipa in tua sia hal tu hi."},"58":{"text":"Ama in tua na sia silthiang in a pawlte a bo le, ama in tuasia silthiang kik tu a, biakna taw kisai in a thiang hi tu hi."},"59":{"text":"Hisia in samul ahibuale puanneal ahibuale samul puan, savun taw kivawt na khat pawpo tungah a om a pawlte taw kisai zui tu thukham ahi hi; hisia in biakna taw kisai a thiang le a thiang ngawl khensatna daan ahi hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in a lauhuai vun natna pan a dam mihing khat a zeksa thiansua natu in,","title":"Vun natnate Nei Zawkciang Thiansuana"},"2":{"text":"a nuai a zui tu ngeinate Moses tungah pia hi. Ama a thiang hi ci in a kithansak tu ni in, thiampipa kungah kipaipui tu a,","ref":"Mt 8:4; Mk 1:44; Lk 5:14; 17:14"},"3":{"text":"thiampipa in ngiaphual pua sangah ama paipui in en tu hi."},"4":{"text":"A natna a dam le, thiampipa in biakna taw kisai a thiang vacim nii sia cedar thing, khausan, hyssop meangte taw a kipaipui khop natu in thupia tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaciang thiampipa in vacimte khat ciktui thiang a kidim leibeal khat tungah a thalup natu in thupia tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in vacim dang khat sia la in a kithat vacim ii chi sungah cedar thing, khausan le hyssop taw, pap khawm tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in vun natna vei a kithiansua tu pa ii tungah salivei a chi the tu a, tua zawkciang ama thiang hi ci in thiampipa in thangsak tu hi. A nungta vacim sia dui sungah leangsak tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua pa in a puan sawp tu a, a multe theampo meetin kibual tu a, tua zawkciang ama biakna taw kisai in a thiang hi tu hi. Ama ngiaphual sung tum thei tu ahihang, buk pua sangah ama ni sali sung a teen kul tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ni sali ni in ama in a sam, a khamul, a mitmul le a taanglai a pum tung mul teng theampo meet kik siat tu a; a puante silthiang in kibual tu a, tuaciang ama biakna taw kisai in a thiang hi tu hi."},"10":{"text":"A ni liat ni in kum khat a pha, a mealhem ngawl tuutalno nii le tuu anu khat olive thau taw kihel anvui kilogramme thum le olive thau litre khat ii khenthum sua khenkhat, ama in paipui tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Thiampipa in tua pa le biakpiaknate Topa ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang ah paipui tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaciang thiampipa in sathau litre khat ii khenthum sua khenkhat taw tuutal note khat khialphel biakpiakna in pia tu hi. Ama in thiampipa atu in tua te Topa tungah a tuam vilvel letsong in pia tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in mawphel biakpiak natu le meihal biakpiak natu in nganhing kingawna mun, a thiangthona munah tuuno ngo tu hi. Ama in hi bangin vawt tu hi, banghang ziam cile khialphel biakpiakna sia mawphel biakpiakna taw kibangin thiampipa ii neisa hi a, thiangtho mama hi."},"14":{"text":"Thiampipa in tuuno chi tawm la in, biakna taw kisai a kithiansua pa ii a ziatsang bildawn, a ziatsang khutpi dawn le a ziatsang peangpi dawn noisak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Thiampipa in olive thau tawm la in a veisang khutpheak sungah sung tu a,"},"16":{"text":"a ziatsang khutme khat a sungah papin, Topa ompuina tualai ah tua sathau pawlkhat salivei the tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a khutpheak sung a om sathau tawm le tuuno chi tawm la in biakna taw kisai thiang hi, ci in a kithangsak tu pa ii a ziatsang bildawn, a ziatsang khutpi, a ziatsang peangpi tungah noai tu hi."},"18":{"text":"A khutpheak sungah a taanglai sathaute tua pa lu tungah thisak tu hi. Tuabangin thiampipa in a zeksa thiansuana vawt tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaciang thiampipa in mawphel biakpiakna pia in a zeksa thiansuana vawt tu hi. Tuasia zawkciang ama in meihal biakpiak natu in ngan ngo tu a,"},"20":{"text":"antang biakpiakna taw biaknatau tungah pia tu hi. Hi bangin thiampipa in a zeksa thiansuana vawt tu a, tua pa biakna taw kisai in thiang tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua pa zawngin a dang bangma a pia zo buale a kithiansua natu bekin, tuutal khat khialphel biakpiak natu, thiampipa atu in Topa tungah a tuam vilvel letsongin pia tu hi. Ama in antang biakpiak natu in olive thau taw a kihel anvui kilogramme khat le olive thau litre khat ii khenthum sua khenkhat paipui tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in inn vakhu nii ahibuale ngam vakhu nii zongh keng tu a, mawmai biakpiak natu in khat, le meihal biakpiak natu in khat hi tu hi."},"23":{"text":"A kithiansua zawk ni liat ni in, Puanbuk kongbiang ah a om thiampipa kungah tuate paipui tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Thiampipa in tuu le olive thau keng tu a, thiampipa atu in Topa tungah a tuam vilvel letsongin pia tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in tuu ngo tu a, a chisan tawm la in tua pa ii ziatsang bildawn, a ziatsang khutpi tung le ziatsang peangpi tungah noai tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Thiampipa in a veisang khutpheak tungah sathau tawm sung tu a,"},"27":{"text":"a ziatsang khutme taw Topa ompuina tualai ah tua sathau pawlkhat salivei the tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in chisan a noina mun tengma ahi, a ziatsang bildawn, a ziatsang khutpi tung le a ziatsang peangpi tungah sathau tawm noai tu hi."},"29":{"text":"A khutpheak sungah a taanglai sathau teng sia tua pa lu tungah thisak tu a, hi bangin a zeksa thiansuana vawt tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in inn vakhu khat ahibuale ngam vakhu khat sia,"},"31":{"text":"mawphel biakpiakna in pia tu a, a dang khat sia meihal biakpiakna in antang biakpiakna taw pia tu hi. Hi bangin thiampipa in a zeksa thiansuana vawt tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Hisia in a kiitakhuai vun natna vei a ahihang ama kithiansua natu in a kisamh biakpiaknate a pia zo ngawl sia ii zui tu thukham ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah,","title":"Innsung Cipawl natna"},"34":{"text":"inn sungah cipawl natna kizel in a om ciang a nuai a zui tu ngeinate pia hi. (Hite sia Israel mite ii lua tu in Topa ii a piak tu Canaan ngamsung a tum zawkciang a zak tu ngeinate ahi hi.) Topa in a inn sungah cipawl natna puak hi ci in mihing khat pawpo in a mu le pai in thiampipa tungah son nanak tu hi.","merge":"35"},"36":{"text":"Thiampipa in cipawlnatna en tu a pai ma in inn sung vanh theampo a pusua natu in thupia tu a; tua ahibuale inn sung vanh teng thiang ngawl hi, ci tu hi. Tuaciang ama sia inn ah pai tu a,"},"37":{"text":"cipawl natna sittel tu hi. Tuate in ahingpian ahibuale a sanpawl hi a, innpang a nesuk tu bang ahile,"},"38":{"text":"tua inn sia ni sali sung tawkalh cip in ama in nusia tu hi."},"39":{"text":"Ni sali ni ciang ama heak kikin sittel kik tu hi. Tua cipawl natna a beak le,"},"40":{"text":"tua cipawl natna a baanna suangte la in khuapi puasang a ninna munah a vawk natu in thiampipa in thupia tu hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in pang sungsang belna teng kiatsak tu a, a kiatna vuite khuapi pua sang a ninna ah vawksak tu hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuaciang tua suangte a kilaakna munah suang dangte koi kik tu a, a zutna thak taw zut kik tu hi."},"43":{"text":"Suangte la in pangte kiat a, za a zut kik zawkciang cipawl natna tua inn sungah hong om kik veve le,"},"44":{"text":"thiampipa in pai in en tu hi. Tua cipawl natna a kizel ahile tua inn a thiang ngawl ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua inn phel tu a, a suangte, a thingte le a zutnate khua puasang a ninna munah vawk tu hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua inn sia taw a kikalh laitakin a sungah a tum khat pawpo sia nitak dong a thiang ngawl hi tu hi."},"47":{"text":"Hi inn sungah a lum ahibuale an a ne sia in ama puante sawpthiang tu hi."},"48":{"text":"Thiampipa in inn sia za a kizut zawk in a et ciang cipawl natna a om kik nawn buale, cipawl natna bo thiang zo ahikom ama in biakna taw kisai a thiang inn ci in thangsak tu hi."},"49":{"text":"Inn thiansua natu in ama in vacim nii, cedar thing tawm, khausan le hyssop baakno meang khat paipui tu hi."},"50":{"text":"Ama in cik tuithiang koina leibeal tungah vacimte khat ngo tu hi."},"51":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in cedar thing, hyssop, khausan le a nungta vacim paipui in, a kithat vacim chi sung le tuithiang sungah pap tu hi. Tuaciang ama in tua inn salivei the tu hi."},"52":{"text":"Hi bangin vacim chi, tuithiang, a nungta vacim, cedar thing, hyssop le khausante taw ama in inn thiansua tu hi."},"53":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in a nungta vacim sia khuapi puasang dui sungah leangsak tu hi. Hi bangin ama in a zeksa inn thiansuana vawt tu a, biakna taw kisai in inn thiang hi tu hi."},"54":{"text":"Hiteng sia a kiitakhuai vun natnate;"},"55":{"text":"meimate, uilutte ahibuale a tum meimate, le puan tung ahibuale inn sungah cipawl natnate taw kisai zui tu thukhamte ahi hi.","merge":"56"},"57":{"text":"Hi thukhamte in na khat sia thiang ziam thiang ngawl ziam khensat hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah,","title":"Pum tung pan A tui Pusuakte"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite atu in a nuai a zui tu ngeinate pia hi. Pasal khat pawpo a zang pan a tui a naai a pusuak le,"},"3":{"text":"tawlnga ngawlin a luang ahizong, a kikhak ahizong tua sia thiang ngawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Lupna tungah a to ahibuale a lum le tua lupna thiang ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua pa lupna a tham pawpo,"},"6":{"text":"ahibuale a tona tungah a to pawpo in a puante sawp in kibual nanak tu a, ahizong ama nitak dongin thiang ngawl veve hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua naai a neipa a tham pawpo in a puante sawp in kibual nanak tu a, ahizong ama nitak dongin thiang ngawl veve hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua naai a neipa in biakna taw kisai in a thiang khat pawpo cil a phii le tua pa sia ama puan teng sawp in, kibual nanak tu a, ahizong ama nitak dongin thiang ngawl veve hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua naai a neipa tona siphukungh ahibuale tokhum sia thiang ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Hi sia pa tona a tham pawpo nitak dongin thiang ngawl hi. Hi sia pa tona a pua pawpo in ama puante sawp in, kibual nanak tu a, ahizong ama nitak dongin thiang ngawl veve hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua naai a neipa in a khut sil masa ngawlin mihing khat po a tham le ama puan teng sawp in kibual nanak tu a, ahizong ama nitak dongin thiang ngawl veve hi."},"12":{"text":"Hi sia pa ii a tham leibeal pawpo kisutham tu a, ama thamsa thing taw kivawt kuang pawpo kisilthiang hamtang tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua naai a neipa a dam zawkciang ni sali sung ngak tu a, tuaciang a puante sawp in cik tuithiang sungah kibual nanak tu a, tuaciang ama biakna taw kisai in thiang tu hi."},"14":{"text":"A ni liat ni in ama in inn vakhu nii ahibuale ngam vakhu nii Topa ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang ah paipui in thiampipa pia tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Thiampipa in mawphel biakpiakna in khat, meihal biakpiakna in a dang khat pia tu hi. Hi bangin tua pa atu a zeksa thiansuana ama in vawt tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihing khat sia a bawtui a pusuak le a pum bupin kibual tu a, ahizong ama nitak dongin nin veve hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua bawtui a taakna puan taw ahibuale savun taw kivawt na khat pawpo sia silthiang tu a, ahizong nitak dongin tua na sia nin veve hi."},"18":{"text":"Numei le pa omkhopna a nei zawkciang a nii in kibual nanak tu a, ahizong amate nitak dongin thiang ngawl veve hi."},"19":{"text":"Numei khat tha sim nin a nei ciang ama ni sali sung thiang ngawl hi. Tua nu a tham pawpo nitak dongin thiang ngawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua numei ii a nin nei sung a tona ahibuale a lupna sia thiang ngawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama lupna ahizong a tona ahizong a tham pawpo in ama puante silthiang in kibual tu a, ahizong nitak dongin ama nin veve hi.","merge":"22"},"24":{"text":"Pa khat in numei khat a nin nei sungin a omkhoppui le tua pa niinsak a, ni sali sung thiang ngawl hi, tua ciang a lupna pawpo zongh thiang ngawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Numei khat tha sim a nin nei zawkciang ni tam mama sung a chi a luang le, ahibuale numei nin nei ngei hun sangin a chi luan hun a tamzaw le, nin a nei hunsung teng bangma in a chi luan laiteng tua nu sia nin hi."},"26":{"text":"A nin nei hun sungin a lupna le a tona pawpo sia nin hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuate a tham pawpo nin a, a puante sawp in kibual nanak tu a; ahizong ama nitak dongin thiang ngawl veve hi."},"28":{"text":"A chi luan a kan zawkciang ama in ni sali ngak tu a, tuaciang ama biakna taw kisai in thiang tu hi."},"29":{"text":"A ni liat ni in ama in inn vakhu nii ahibuale ngam vakhu nii Topa ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang ah a om thiampipa kungah paipui tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Thiampipa in mawphel biakpiakna in khat le meihal biakpiakna in a dang khat pia tu a, hi bangin ama in tua nu a zeksa kithiansuana vawtsak tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Ngiaphual laizang ah a om Topa ompuina Puanbuk a nitsak ngawl natu in Israel mite tungah a thiantho ngawlna taw kisai in, a kidopna tu thu a son tu in Topa in Moses thupia hi. A ninsak ahile amate kithatlum tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Hiteng sia, a zang pan naai a pusuak pa khat ahibuale a bawtui a luang pa khat,"},"33":{"text":"numei khat tha sim a nin nei hunsung ahibuale, biakna taw kisai in a thiang ngawl numei khat taw a khialpa ii zui tu ngeinate ahi hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa tungah a thiangtho ngawl mei taw biakpiakna a piak ciang a kithat Aaron tapate nii thi zawkciang Topa in Moses paupui hi.","title":"Mawsuutna Ni"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “Thiangtho Bel Mun sung puankhai ii nungah a hun lian ciang a tum natu in na suapuipa Aaron son in, banghang ziam cile tua mun sia Thuciamna Thingkuang sitna tung meei sungah ka kilaakna mun ahi hi. Tua thu a ni buale ama kithatlum tu hi.","ref":"Heb 6:19"},"3":{"text":"Ama mawphel biakpiakna in khuitalno khat le meihal biakpiakna in tuutal khat a paipui zawkciang bek in Thiangtho Bel Mun ah tum thei tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Heb 9:7"},"4":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in a nuai a zui tu ngeinate pia hi. Aaron, Thiangtho Bel Mun ah a pai ma in kibual nanak tu a, thiampi puante: puanneal puantual silhin, ngoaipuan tom teang tu a, kawngkhau sawm in dial khim tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel taangpite in mawphel biakpiak natu in kealtal nii le meihal biakpiak natu in tuutal khat Aaron tungah pia tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Aaron in ama mawna le a innkuanpuite mawna a mai natu in khuital khat sangaw biakpiakna in pia tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in Topa ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang ah keal nii paipui tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tualai ah, “ Topa atu” ci a, a kiciamtee suang khat le “Azazel atu” ci in a kiciamtee suang dang khat, suang nii zanghin ama in lai meetang sawk tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa atu in meetang taw a teal kealtal khat sia Aaron in mawphel biakpiakna in pia tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Azazel atu a kiteal keal sia a nungta in Topa tungah pia tu a, mipite mawmai natu in sennealngamsung Azazel kungah paisak tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Aaron in ama le a innkuanpuite atu mawphel biakpiakna in khuital a piak ciang,"},"12":{"text":"ama in biaknatau pan meikam kuang khat dim le ngimnamtui phate khutdim nii la tu a, Mun Thiangtho Bel ah paipui tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tualai Topa ompuina munah ama in ngimnamtui sia mei tungah koi tu a, a khu in Thuciamna Thingkuang sitna sia seal tu hi, tua hile ama in tuasia mu ngawl tu a, thi ngawl tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in khuital chi tawm la tu a, a khutme taw a sitna mai teng the in, tuaciang Thuciamna Thingkuang mai teng salivei the tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, ama in mipite mawphel biakpiakna in kealtal ngo tu a, Thiangtho Bel Mun ah a chi paipui in khuital chi a the bangma, a sitna tung le Thuciamna Thingkuang mai teng the tu hi.","ref":"Heb 9:12"},"16":{"text":"Tuabangin Israel mite ii thiantho ngawlna le mawna theampo ii nitsakna panin Thiang Bel Mun sia a zeksa thiansuana vawt tu hi. Biakna taw kisai in a thiang ngawl ngiaphual laizang ah tua Puanbuk om ahikom Aaron in Puanbuk sia tuabangin a thiansua kul tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Thiangtho Bel Mun ah a zeksa thiansuana vawt tu in Aaron a tum pan kipan a pusua kik dong, Puanbuk sungah kuama om ngawl tu hi. Ama atu, a innkuanpuite atu le Israel taangpi bup atu a zeksa teng a vawt zawkciang,"},"18":{"text":"meihal biakpiakna pia tu le biaknatau thiansua tu in biaknatau ah ama pai tu hi. Ama in khuital chi tawm le keal chi tawm la in biaknatau king a dokna teng noai tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in a khutme taw sachi pawlkhat biaknatau tung salivei the tu hi. Hi bangin ama in tua biaknatau Israel mite mawna pan thiansua in, thiangthosak tu ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Aaron in Thiangtho Bel Mun le Topa ompuina Puanbuk sung mundang teng le biaknatau atu in a zeksa thiansuana a vawt zawkciang, Azazel atu in a kiteal keal nungta lai sia Topa tungah pia tu hi.","title":"Mawna A Pua Keal"},"21":{"text":"Ama in tua keal lu tungah a khutte nii nga tu a, Israel mite siatna, mawna le leedona teng theampo pualaak in, tuabangin keal lu tungah suan siat tu hi.
