Tua zawkciang tua keal sia tuabang a seam tu, a kisep pa in sennealngam sungah beng tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua keal in kuama teen ngawlna ngam sungah amate mawna theampo pua in paipui tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaciang Puanbuk sungah Aaron tum tu a, Thiangtho Bel Mun sung a tum ma in a silh thiampi puan teng suutin tua munah nusia tu hi.","ref":"Eze 44:19"},"24":{"text":"Ama in mun thiangtho ah kibual tu a, ama puante silh tu hi. Tua zawkciang pusuak in ama mawna le mite mawna teng a mai natu in meihal biakpiakna pia tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in mawphel biakpiak natu in nganthau sia biaknatau tungah hal tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Sennealngam sung Azazel kungah keal a beng pa in ngiaphual ah hong cia kik ma in a puante sawp in kibual nanak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Mawphel biakpiak natu in a kizangh khuital le keal ii chi, mawmai natu in Thiangtho Bel Munah a kipaipui sia ngiaphual pua sangah paipui in kihal tu hi. A vun, a sa le a ngilzangte theampo kihal tu hi.","ref":"Heb 13:11"},"28":{"text":"A hal pa ngiaphual hong heak kik ma in a puante sawp in kibual nanak tu hi."},"29":{"text":"A nuai a ngeinate maisang hun theampo ah zui tu ahi hi. A tha salina, ni sawm ni in Israel te le a teen khoppui ngamdangmite in an tang tu a, na seam ngawl het tu hi.","title":"Mawsuutna Ni Tan tu Zia"},"30":{"text":"Tua ni in biakna taw kisai in a thian natu in amate mawna theampo a thiansua tu in a zeksa teng vawt tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ni sia a thiangtho mama ni khat hi tu a, tua ni in an tang tu a, na seam ngawl tu hi. Hi ngeinate maisang hun theampo ah zui tu ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"A pa za a laih tu in thupha piak kipsakna a vawtsak sa le a ki aap sa, Thiampi Lianbelpa in a zeksa thiansuana vawt tu hi. Ama in thiampi puante silh tu a,"},"33":{"text":"Thiangthobel Mun Topa ii ompuina Puanbuk a taanglai teng, biaknatau, thiampite le taangpi taangta theampo, thiansua natu in a zeksa teng vawt tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 23:26-32; Mi 29:7-11"},"34":{"text":"Hi ngeinate maisang hun theampo ah zui tu ahi hi. Israel mite mawna theampo thiansua natu in hi zeksa ngeina sia kum khat in khatvei kivawt hamtang tu hi. Tuabangin Moses in Topa thupiak bangin seam hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah Aaron le a tapate,","title":"Chisan ii Thianthona"},"2":{"text":"le Israel mite theampo tungah a nuai a zui tu ngeinate a piak tu in thupia hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel te khat in khui khat ahibuale tuu khat ahibuale keal khat Topa tungah biakpiakna khat bangin Topa ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang simngawl mundang ah a ngo le, Thukham paltan zo hi. Ama in chisan luangsak zo ahikom Pathian mi khat in kingaisun nawn ngawl tu hi.","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Hi thupiak ii a khiakna sia tu in Israel mite ii ngam sungah a ngaw bul ngannote Topa kungah paipui tu cinopna ahi hi. Amate in tu in tua ngannote Puanbuk kongbiang ah a om thiampipa kungah paipui tu a, pawlkhop biakpiakna in ngo tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Thiampipa in Puanbuk kongbiang ah a om biaknatau pangh tengah a chi the tu a, a thau sia Topa ii a lungkim ngimnamtui a piangsak tu in hal tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel mite in Topa tungah hong thumaan in, lo sung keal doaite biakna in sa ngo nawn ngawl tu hi. Israel mite in maisang hun theampo ah hi ngeina zui tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel khat ahibuale a teen khoppui ngamdangmi khat pawpo in meihal biakpiakna ahizong a dang biakpiakna ahizong,"},"9":{"text":"Topa tungah biakpiakna a piak ciang Puanbuk kongbiang simngawl mundang ah a pia le, Pathian mi khat in kituat nawn ngawl tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel te khat pawpo ahibuale a teen khoppui ngamdangmi khat pawpo in a sungah chi om lai sa a ne le, Topa in ama nungngat tu a, ama mi in sim nawn ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Pian 9:4; Thiam 7:26-27; 19:26; Thkna 12:16,23; 15:23"},"11":{"text":"A nungta theampo ii nuntakna sia chi sungah om hi, tua ahikom mihingte mawmai natu in chi theampo biaknatau tungah a kisun natu Topa thupiak ahi hi. Nuntakna a hi chisan in mawna teng lakeak hi.","ref":"Heb 9:22"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi hu in, amate ahizong a teen khoppui ngamdangmite khat pawpo ahizong, a sungah chi om lai sa pawpo a neak ngawl natu in Topa in Israel mite tungah son zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel te khat pawpo ahibuale a teen khoppui ngamdangmi khat pawpo in biakna taw kisai a thiang nganhing khat ahibuale vacim khat a man le ama in a chi lei ah sung nanak tu a lei huk tu hi."},"14":{"text":"A nungta theampo ii nuntakna sia chi sungah om ahi hu in a sungah chi om lai sa pawpo a neak ngawl natu in, Israel mite tungah Topa in son zo a, a ne pawpo ama mi khat in kingaisun nawn ngawl tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Israel te ahibuale ngamdangte khat pawpo in ama thu in a thi thawthong nganhing khat ahibuale ngamsa ii a mat khat ii sa a ne le, a puante sawp in kibual nanak tu a, biakna taw kisai in a thian mateng nitak dong ngak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuabang a vawt buale thupiangte a thuak kul tu hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in,","title":"A Kikhaam Numei le Pa Omkhopnate"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite a sonsawn tu in Moses tungah, “Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi,"},"3":{"text":"Na om ngeina uh Egypt mite omziate ahizong ahibuale tu in note kong paipuina Canaan ngamsung a teang mihingte ii omziate ahizong zui heak vun."},"4":{"text":"Ka thukhamte zui in kong thupiakte seam vun. Keima in Topa noma Pathian ka hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Sep tu kong sawl te seam vun a, kong piak thukhamte zui vun; tuabang na hina uh taw na nuntakna na hu tu uh hi. Keima in Topa ka hi hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Neh 9:29; Eze 18:9; 20:11-13; Lk 10:28; Rom 10:5; Gal 3:12"},"6":{"text":"Topa in a nuai a zui tu ngeinate pia hi. Na mealheakte khat pawpo taw omkhop khialna vawt heak vun."},"7":{"text":"Na nu taw numei le pa khialna vawtin na pa maizum pia heak in. Na nu maimawlsak heak in."},"8":{"text":"Na pa zino dangte khat pawpo taw numei le pa khialna vawtin na pa maizum pia heak in.","ref":"Thiam 20:11; Thkna 22:30; 27:20"},"9":{"text":"Inn khat sungah khangkhawm na hi uh zong, na hi bua uh zong, na suapuinu ahibuale na suapuisealnu taw numei le pa khialna vawt heak in.","ref":"Thiam 20:17; Thkna 27:22"},"10":{"text":"Na tunu taw numei le pa khialna vawt heak in; na maizum natu hi tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Na suapuisealnu taw numei le pa khialna vawt heak vun, ama zongh na suapuinu ma ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Na pa suapuinu ahibuale na nu suapuinu taw omkhop khialna vawt heak in.","ref":"Thiam 20:19-20","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Na pa suapuipa ii zi khialpui heak in; ama zongh na nu khat ma ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Na tapa zi khialpui heak in.","ref":"Thiam 20:12"},"16":{"text":"Na suapuipa zi khialpui heak in.","ref":"Thiam 20:21"},"17":{"text":"Na khialpui nu ii tanu ahibuale a tunu khialpui heak in; na mealheakte ma hi a, chi kinai omkhop khialna ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 20:14; Thkna 27:23"},"18":{"text":"Na zi nuntak laiteng na zi tu in na nuphal nu la heak in."},"19":{"text":"Numei khat nin a nei laitak omkhoppui heak in, banghang ziam cile ama biakna taw kisai in thiang ngawl hi.","ref":"Thiam 20:18"},"20":{"text":"Ngual zi khialpui heak in; na khialpui le biakna taw kisai in hong ninsak tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 20:10"},"21":{"text":"Molech pathian biakna ah zak tu in na tate khat zongh pia heak in, banghang ziam cile tua in Topa ahi Pathian ii min daisak tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 20:1-5"},"22":{"text":"Pa le pa omkhop khialna vawt heak in; Pathian in ngaimaw hi.","ref":"Thiam 20:13"},"23":{"text":"Pa ahizong numei ahizong kuama in nganhing taw omkhop khialna vawt heak hen; tuabang khialna in biakna taw kisai in no hong ninsak hi.","ref":"Pu 22:19; Thiam 20:15-16; Thkna 27:21"},"24":{"text":"Hi ngamtatnate taw a thiang ngawl kisua tawm heak vun, hi ngam na thet ma a, a teangsa doai biate in hi bangin amate kininsak ahikom noma tum thei natu in Topa in bengkeak hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate ngamtatna in ngam le lei ninsak ahikom Topa in leitang daan pia in tualai ah a teang mite leitang in nialsak hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate in hi bang a kiihuainate taw a leitang ninsak uh a, ahizong note tuabang na hi bua het tu uh hi. Note theampo, Israel te ahibuale no taw teang khawm ngamdangmite in Topa thukhamte le thupiakte zui hamtang tu nu hi,","merge":"27"},"28":{"text":"tua hile note mai ah a teang doai biate leitang ii a nial bangin, no hong nial ngawl tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Hi bangza in a thasiathuai in a ngamta peuma sia Pathian mi khat in kingaisun nawn ngawl tu a hina thu na he uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in, “Kong thupiakte zui in hi ngam le lei ah note mai a teang masate ii ngamtat luheaknate na zui heak vun a, hi bang khat pawpo vawtna taw na kininsak heak vun. Keima in Topa note ii Pathian ka hi hi,” ci hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in,","title":"Thianthona le Thutang Khenna Thukhamte"},"2":{"text":"Israel taangpite tungah a sonsawn tu in Moses tungah, “Thiangtho vun, banghang ziam cile Keima Topa na Pathian thiangtho khi hi.","ref":"Thiam 11:44-45; 1 Pe 1:16"},"3":{"text":"Kong thupiak bangin note in na nu le na pa zakta vun a, Sabbath tang vun. Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi.","ref":"Pu 20:12; Thkna 5:16; Pu 20:8; Thkna 5:12"},"4":{"text":"“Kei hong taisan in milim bia heak vun; pathiante thik taw vawt tawm in bia heak vun. Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi.","ref":"Thiam 26:1; Pu 20:23; 34:17; Thkna 17:2-5"},"5":{"text":"“Kipawlkhop biakpiak natu in nganhing na ngaw uh ciang kong piaksa ngeinate zui vun, tua hile tua biakpiakna kong saang tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Sa na ngaw uh sia na ngaw ni ahibuale a zing ciang na neak nanak kul hi. Ni thum ni in a taanglai sa pawpo kihal tu hi,"},"7":{"text":"banghang ziam cile tua sa in biakna taw kisai in nin a, a ne a om le tua biakpiakna kong saang buatu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuasia a ne pawpo sia in ka tungah hong ki aap ante nadang thawthong bang suaksak ahikom mawnei suak a, keima mihing khat in kingaisun nawn ngawl tu hi."},"9":{"text":"“Na lo ante na laak uh ciang lo kiil ah ante la heak vun, na nusiatsa ante a la tu in pai kik heak vun.","ref":"Thiam 17:15; Thkna 24:19-22"},"10":{"text":"Na makngil uh sapit bom ahibuale lei ah a taak sapitngate tawm kik tu in, pai kik heak vun; tuate mizawngte le ngamdangmite atu in nusiat vun. Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Nguta heak vun a, ngualtheam ahibuale leilot thu son heak vun.","ref":"Pu 20:15; Thkna 5:19; Pu 20:16; Thkna 5:20"},"12":{"text":"Na zui ngawl tu po ka min taw kamciam pia heak vun; tua in ka min daisak hi. Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi.","ref":"Pu 20:7; Thkna 5:11; Mt 5:33"},"13":{"text":"“Noma meet natu in midangte vanh suttol heak vun. Noma cial sa mihing khat ii thamante, zan khat bek zongh khak heak vun.","ref":"Thkna 24:14-15"},"14":{"text":"Nangongte haamsiat heak vun a, mittawte lutu natu in a mai ah na khat zongh koi heak vun. Kei hong kiita tavun; keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi.","ref":"Thkna 27:18"},"15":{"text":"Zum tung thusonnate na khen uh ciang “Thumaan le thutang taw thu khen vun; mizawngte ngum tuan heak vun, ahibuale sumhaute kiita heak vun.","ref":"Pu 23:6-8; Thkna 16:19"},"16":{"text":"Khat pawpo taw kisai in leilot thu sonsawn heak vun a, mihing khat ii nuntakna le thina thu a kison ciang na tetti panna in ama a hu thei tu a ahile, son khe in. Keima in Topa ka hi hi."},"17":{"text":"“Mihing khat pawpo ngimhuat heak vun, ahizong ama hangin na maw na khial ngawl natu in na kithukim ngawl nate ama taw maitang kisi in pha tak son zaw vun.","ref":"Mt 18:15"},"18":{"text":"Kuama tungah phula heak vun a, kuama ngaimaw top heak vun. Noma le noma na ki it uh bangin na innpaamte it vun. Keima in Topa ka hi hi.","ref":"Mt 5:43; 19:19; 22:39; Mk 12:31; Lk 10:27; Rom 13:9; Gal 5:14; Jas 2:8"},"19":{"text":"“Kong thupiakte zui vun. Inn ah khoai ngannote nam dang taw ta neisak heak vun. Lo khat sungah thaicii nam nii ciing heak vun. Puan nam nii taw a kivawt puan silh heak vun.","ref":"Thkna 22:9-11"},"20":{"text":"“Mi khat ii a zino ahi ama sila nu sia a kitan sa a suakta sa hi ngawl lai in, midang khat in a khialpui le a nii in daan pia tu a, ahihang a thu kikan ngawl tu a, tua nusia a sila khat ahi hu in amate kithatlum ngawl tu hi,"},"21":{"text":"Tua pa in ama khialphel biakpiak natu in ka ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang ah tuutal khat hong paipui tu a,"},"22":{"text":"thiampipa in a khialphel natu in tua tuutal taw a zeksa thiansuana vawt tu a, Pathian in ama khialna maisak tu hi."},"23":{"text":"“Canaan ngam sungah tumin thingno kung nam khat pawpo na suan uh ciang a masa kum thum sung tua thingngate biakna taw kisai in a thiang ngawlin ngaisun vun. Tua hun sung teng tua thingnga ne heak vun."},"24":{"text":"A kum lina ciang thingnga theampo, Keima na Topa tungah na lungdamna a lak biakpiakna in nong aap tu uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahizong a kum ngana ciang tua thingnga ne thei tu nu hi. Tuabang na hi uh le na thingno te in nga tamzaw nga tu hi. Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi."},"26":{"text":"“Chisan a om lai sa ne heak vun. Mitbum aisaanna tuatuamte zangh heak vun.","ref":"Pian 9:4; Thiam 7:26-27; 17:10-14; Thkna 12:16,23; 15:23; Thkna 18:10"},"27":{"text":"Mithite atu khuangai in na pangh samte meet heak vun, ahibuale na khamul meet heak vun,","ref":"Thiam 21:5; Thkna 14:1"},"28":{"text":"ahibuale noma le noma thulkawng sun ahibuale na taksa kiliamsua heak vun. Keima in Topa ka hi hi."},"29":{"text":"“Na tanute biakinn ah pumpi kizuakna taw a min daisak heak vun; tuabang na hisak uh le pathian dangte sang ah a pial na hi tu uh a, ngamsung teng numei le pa paktatna taw kidim tu hi.","ref":"Thkna 23:17"},"30":{"text":"Sabbath tang vun a, keima nong biakna mun zakta vun. Keima in Topa ka hi hi.","ref":"Thiam 26:2"},"31":{"text":"“Mithisate ii thaate thu a dongh thei te kungah thu dongh tu in pai heak vun. Na pai uh le, note biakna taw kisai in a thiang ngawl na hi tu uh hi. Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:11; 1 Sa 28:3; 2 Kum 23:4; Is 8:19"},"32":{"text":"“Khanghaamte zatakna lak vun a, upat vun. Keima hong thasia in ka thu ni vun; keima in Topa ka hi hi."},"33":{"text":"“Noma ngam sungah hong teang ngamdangmite vawtsia heak vun."},"34":{"text":"Na lawm Israel te na vawt uh bangin vawt vun a, noma na ki it uh bangin amate it vun. Khatvei lai in Egypt ngam ah ngamdangmi na hina thu phawk vun. Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi.","ref":"Pu 22:21; Thkna 24:17-18; 27:19"},"35":{"text":"“A man ngawl a sauna, a ngitna ahibuale a phakza teena taw khat pawpo theam heak vun."},"36":{"text":"A man pikhau, toaisuang le khaikhin zangh vun. Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi a, Egypt pan kong pusua pui hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:13-16; Pau 20:10; Eze 45:10"},"37":{"text":"Ka thukhamte le kong thupiakte theampo zui vun. Keima in Topa ka hi hi,” ci hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in,","title":"Thu ni Ngawlte Daan piaknate"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite tungah hi bang a sonsawn tu in Moses tungah, “Note khat pawpo ahibuale note taw a teang khawm ngamdangmi khat pawpo, Molech pathian biakna in a zak tu in a ta a pia pawpo sia, taangpi in suang taw deanglum tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo a tate khat Molech tungah pia in, ka Puanbuk thiangtho ninsak a, ka min thiangtho a daisak le ka nungngat tu a, ka mi khat in ka ngaisun nawn buatu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahizong tua pa ngamtatna taangpite in awlmawk ngawlin a thatlum bua le,"},"5":{"text":"tua pa, a innkuan bup le Molech bia in ka tungah hong thumaan ngawl theampo ka nungngat tu hi. Amate ka mi in ka ngaisun nawn buatu hi."},"6":{"text":"“Mithite ii thaate tungah thu a dongh thei mihingte kungah mi khat pawpo pai in thu a dongh le ama ka nungngat tu a, ka mi khatin ka ngaisun nawn buatu hi."},"7":{"text":"Note thiangtho tavun, banghang ziam cile keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka thukhamte hong zui tavun, banghang ziam cile Keima in Topa hi a, kong thiangthosak hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in a nuai a zui tu ngeinate pia hi. A nu le a pa a haamsiat peuma kithatlum tu hi; ama ii thina sia ama kivawt ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 21:17; Mt 15:4; Mk 7:10"},"10":{"text":"Mi khat in Israel mipui khat ii zi a khialpui le a nii in kithatlum tu hi.","ref":"Pu 20:14; Thiam 18:20; Thkna 5:18"},"11":{"text":"Mi khat in a pa zite khat a khialpui le a pa maimawlsak hi a, a nii in kithatlum tu hi. Amate thina in amate kivawt ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:8; Thkna 22:30; 27:20"},"12":{"text":"Mihing khat in a tapa zi a khialpui le a nii in kithatlum tu hi. Mealheak kuung sung numei le pa omkhop khialna vawt ahiciang amate thina in amate kivawt ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:15"},"13":{"text":"Pa khat in a dang pa khat taw a khial le a kiihuai ngamtatna hi a, a nii in kithatlum tu hi. Amate thina in amate kivawt ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:22"},"14":{"text":"Mi khat in numei khat le tua nu ii nu a teenpui le a thum in kihallum tu hi, banghang ziam cile amate in a min daihuai ngamtatnate vawt uh hi; note sungah hi bang ngamtatnate omsak ngawl het tu nu hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:17; Thkna 27:23"},"15":{"text":"Mi khat in nganhing taw a khial le, a nii in kithatlum tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Numei khat in nganhing khat taw khial nuamin a hanciam le a nii in kithatlum tu hi. Amate thina in amate kivawt ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 22:19; Thiam 18:23; Thkna 27:21"},"17":{"text":"Mi khat in a suapuinu ahibuale a suapuisealnu a teenpui le, amate mipite mai ah a maizumhuai le a thasiathuai in kivawt tu a, a mihuam sung pan kihawlkhia tu hi. A suapuinu khialpui ahikom a piang bang a thuak kul hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:9; Thkna 27:22"},"18":{"text":"Mi khat in numei khat a nin nei laitak a khialpui le a nii in a mihuam sung pan kihawlkhia tu hi, banghang ziam cile biakna sang pan a thiang ngawl thu taw kisai ngeinate paltan ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:19"},"19":{"text":"Mi khat in a ni taw a khial le, mealheak kuung ahi hu in a piang bang a nii in a thuak kul tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:12-14"},"20":{"text":"Mi khat in a pa suapuipa zi taw a khial le, a pa suapuipa maimawlsak hi a, a nii in daan thuak tu a; tasel tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi khat in a suapuipa zi a teenpui le, tasel in amate thi tu hi. Ama in biakna taw kisai a thiang ngawl na seam hi a, a suapuipa maimawlsak ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:16"},"22":{"text":"Topa in, “Kong paipuina Canaan leitang ii note hong nial ngawl natu in ka thukham le ka thupiakte theampo zui vun."},"23":{"text":"Tualai ah a teang mite ii ngeinate zui heak vun; hi ngamsung na tum thei natu in hi ngam pan tua doai bia te not keak tu khi hi. A ngamtat siatnate in hong thasiasak hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahizong hi ngamhoi ngampha lua tu in, hong ciam zo ka hi ciang kong pia tu hi. Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi a, minam dangte sung pan kong tuamkoi zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua hi a, nganhing le vacimte biakna taw kisai in a thiang le a thiang ngawl na khentel tu uh hi. A nin ahi nganhing le vacimte ne heak vun. Nin hi ka ci sa hi a, na ne uh le a nin hong suaksak tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Note na thiangtho tu uh a, keima neisa bek na hi tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile keima in Topa ka hi a, ka thiangtho hi. Keima neisa bek na hi thei natu in minam dangte sung pan kong tuamkoi hi."},"27":{"text":"“Pa ahizong nu ahizong mithisate thaa tung thu a dongh peuma suang taw kideanglum tu hi; hi bang a ngamta pawpo ama ii thina in ama kivawt ahi hi,” ci hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aaron suan thiampite tungah a son tu in Topa in Moses thupia a, “Thiampi peuma sia a nu, a pa, a tapa, a tanu, a suapuinu, a suapuipa le inn ah a om pasal nei ngawl a suapuinu a thi ciang simngawl a dang mealheak khat mithi vuina ah a kihelna hu in, biakna taw kisai in a nin kisua heak hen.","title":"Thiampite ii Thianthona","merge":"2"},"4":{"text":"Kiteenna hu in a kinai pui a mealheak te a thi ciang mithi sungah a kihel hu in ama le ama kininsak ngawl tu hi."},"5":{"text":"“Thiampi peuma khuangaina lakna in a sam mun khat zongh meet ngawl tu a, a khamul zongh tan ngawlin, a ci tung kiliamsua ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 19:27-28; Thkna 14:1"},"6":{"text":"Ama thiangtho tu a, ka min daisak ngawl het tu hi. Ama in an taw biakpiaknate hong pia ahiciang ama a thiangtho kul hi."},"7":{"text":"Thiampi khat in pumpi kizuak ngei numei khat, ngaknu thiangtho ngawl, ahibuale pasal ii khul numei khat teenpui ngawl tu hi; ama thiangtho hi."},"8":{"text":"Mite in thiampipa a thiangtho in ngaisun tu hi, banghang ziam cile an taw biakpiaknate kei tungah hong pia hi. Keima in Topa ka hi hi; keima ka thiangtho a, ka mite ka thiangthosak hi."},"9":{"text":"Thiampipa tanu khat pumpi kizuak numei a suak le, a pa maimawlsak hi; ama kihallum tu hi."},"10":{"text":"“A lu tung sathau buak sa le thiampi puan silh tu in a ki aapsa Thiampi Lianbel khat in khuangaina lakna in a sam pot ngawlin, a puante balkeak in om ngawl het tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama kei tungah hong ki aapsa ahiciang biakna taw kisai a thiangtho ngawl kisuaksak heak hen a, a nu a pa tatak thi le zong ka Puanbuk nusia in mithi koina inn ah a tum hu in a thiangtho ka Puanbuk ninsak heak hen.","merge":"12"},"13":{"text":"Ama in ngaknu thiangtho khat teenpui tu a,"},"14":{"text":"meingong ahibuale pasal taw kikhen sa numei, ahibuale pumpi kizuak ngei numei teenpui ngawl tu hi. Ama suante sung pan ngaknu thiangtho bekma teenpui tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuabang ahibuale a thiangtho tu a tate sia biakna taw kisai in a thiang ngawl suak tu hi. Keima in Topa hi a, ama sia Thiampi Lianbel in ka koituam zo hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in Moses ii"},"17":{"text":"Aaron tungah a son tu in a thupiakna pan, “Na suan na paal sung pan pumpi mealhemna khat pawpo a neite in ka tungah an taw biakpiakna hong pia heak hen. Hi thu in maisang hun theampo ah zui tu ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Pumpi mealhem peuma in biakpiakna pia thei ngawl tu hi, tuate in mittaw, peangbai, mealhem ahibuale pumpi sitbaang;"},"19":{"text":"khutkon peangkon te;"},"20":{"text":"cingkuul ahibuale mihing khansamh te; mit natna nei ahibuale vun natna nei; cil kingette ahi uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Thiampi Aaron suan pumpi mealhemte in kei tungah an taw biakpiakna hong pia thei ngawl tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuabang mihing khat in ka tungah hong kipia biakpiakna, a thiangtho biakpiakna le a thiangtho mama biakpiakna ante ne thei tu a,"},"23":{"text":"ahizong ama pumpi sitbaang ahikom a thiangtho puankhai kungah pai ngawl tu a, ahibuale biaknatau neak ngawl tu hi. Ama in hi a thiangtho nate ninsak ngawl het tu hi, banghang ziam cile Keima in Topa ka hi a, amate ka thiangthosak hi,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Hi thu Moses ii Aaron, Aaron ii tapate le Israel mite theampo tungah a son thu ahi hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses ii Aaron le a tapate a son tu in","title":"Biakpiakna ah Piakte ii Thianthona"},"2":{"text":"thupia a, “Ka min thiangtho na daisak ngawl het natu in Israel mite ii ka tungah hong aaptuam a thiangtho biakpiaknate ciliap tavun. Keima in Topa ka hi hi."},"3":{"text":"Na suan na paal khat po in biakna taw kisai a thian ngawl laitak, Israel mite ii ka tungah hong aaptuam a thiangtho biakpiaknate nai ah hong pai in ahile biaknatau ah naseam kik thei ngeingawl tu hi. Hisia maisang hun theampo ah a kizangh tu ahi hi. Keima in Topa ka hi hi."},"4":{"text":"“Aaron suan le paalte sung pan a kiitakhuai vun natna veite, ahibuale meima naai neite in biakna taw kisai in a thiantho mateng a thiangtho biakpiakna ante ne ngawl tu hi. Thiampi khat pawpo in mithiluang taw a kithutha a nin khat pawpo, ahibuale bawtui a tee pa khat,"},"5":{"text":"ahibuale a thiang ngawl nganhing, ahibuale mihing khat a tham le ama thiang ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Thiampi khat pawpo a thiang buale nitak dongin a nin hi tu a, a kibual mateng a thiangtho biakpiakna ante ne thei ngawl tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Nitum zawkciang ama thiang a, tuaciang ama an ahi a thiangtho biakpiakna ante ne thei tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in, ama thu in a thi thawthong nganhing ii sa ahibuale ngamsa ii thalup sate ne ngawl tu hi; tua in ama ninsak tu hi. Keima in Topa ka hi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Thiampi theampo in kong piaksa ngeinate zui tu hi. Tuabang a zui bua uh le amate a maw hi tu a thi tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate in a thiangtho ngeinate a zui ngawl hang ahi hi. Keima in Topa ka hi a, amate ka thiangthosak hi."},"10":{"text":"“Thiampi innkuanpuite bek in a thiangtho biakpiakna an pawpo ne thei tu a; kuama dang — thiampi taw a omkhawm khat, ahibuale a thacial khat zongh in ne thei ngawl tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahizong ama ii sum taw a lei silate ahibuale tualsuak silate in thiampi ii a nga ante ne thei tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Thiampi khat ii tanu in thiampi ahi ngawl khat a teenpui le a thiangtho biakpiakna an khat pawpo ne thei ngawl tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahizong thiampi khat ii tanu sia a pasal thi in meingong, ahibuale ta nei ngawlin a pasal in khul a, a pa inn ah bealhin a cia kik le a pa ii nga thiampi ante ne thei tu hi. Thiampi innkuanpuite bek in hi ante ne thei tu hi."},"14":{"text":"“Thiampi innkuanpui ahi ngawl khat in a thiangtho biakpiakna ante a heak ngawlin a ne tha le ama in thiampipa tungah a man a cingin liau kik tu a, zakhat ciang kul taw belap tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Thiampite in tua ante a ne thei ngawl tu midang khat pawpo a neaksakna taw,"},"16":{"text":"a thiangtho biakpiakna ante ninsak ngawl tu hi; a ninsakte a maw hi tu a, daan thuak tu hi. Keima in Topa ka hi a, biakpiaknate ka thiangthosak hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,"},"18":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate le Israel mite theampo ii zui tu in a nuai a ngeinate a piak tu in thupia hi. Israel mite khat pawpo in ahibuale Israel sung a teang ngamdangmi khat pawpo in meihal biakpiakna a piak ciang, kamciam taangtutna in a piak ahizong, thinzaw biakpiakna taw a piak ahizong, a mealhem ngawl nganhing zangh tu hi."},"19":{"text":"A kisaang thei tu in, a mealhem ngawl a tal hi nanak tu hi."},"20":{"text":"A mealhem nganno khat po na pia le Topa in saang ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:1"},"21":{"text":"Mi khat pawpo in kipawlkhop biakpiakna Topa tungah a piak ciang, kamciam taangtutna, ahibuale thinzaw biakpiakna a piak ciang, Topa ii saan thei tu in a mealhem ngawl nganhing hi tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa tungah a mittaw, a peangbai, a mealhem, meima vei, vun meima balh, a khiik nei meima vei nganhing khat pawpo pia heak vun. Hi bang nganhingte biaknatau ah an biakpiakna in pia heak vun."},"23":{"text":"Thinzaw biakpiakna ah a khansamh ahibuale a limci tatak ngawl nganhingte pia thei tu nu hi, ahizong kamciam taangtut natu in tuate kisaang ngawl hi."},"24":{"text":"A ciltang a tamhsa, a kingetsa, a kisuthamsa, a kilakeaksa nganhing khat pawpo Topa tungah pia heak vun. Hite sia na ngam sungah zak tu ki oai ngawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Ngamdangmite tung pan a kinga nganhing taw an biakpiakna pia heak vun. Hi bang nganhingte a sitbaang in kingaisun a, kisaang thei ngawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Khui, tuu, kealte a no a sua ciang ni sali sung a pui taw na khen buatu uh hi, ahizong tua zawkciang an biakpiakna in kisaang thei hi.","merge":"27"},"28":{"text":"Ni khat sungin khuipui le a no, tuupui le a no, kealpui le a no, sangaw biakpiakna in piakhawm heak vun."},"29":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamko biakpiakna na piak uh ciang hong san thei tu in ngeinate zui vun;"},"30":{"text":"tua ni in a sa ne in, a khuavak ni zingsang dong bangma khe heak vun."},"31":{"text":"Topa in, “Ka thupiakte zui vun; Keima in Topa ka hi hi."},"32":{"text":"Ka min thiangtho daisak heak vun; Israel mite theampo in thiangtho ka hina hong saan kul hi. Keima in Topa ka hi a, note kong thiangthosak hi;"},"33":{"text":"na Pathian ka hi natu in Egypt pan note kong pusuapui hi. Keima in Topa ka hi hi,” ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah","title":"Biakna Poaite"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite ii a biak kikhop ciang, biakna poaite atu in a zui tu a nuai a ngeinate pia hi."},"3":{"text":"Note in na nasep natu in ni luk sung nei nu hi, ahizong ni sali ni, Sabbath sia tawlngakna ni ahi phawk vun. Tua ni in naseam heak vun, ahizong biakpiakna vawt tu in kikhawm vun. Koisung po na teang uh zong Sabbath sia Topa neisa ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 20:8-10; 23:12; 31:15; 34:21; 35:2; Thkna 5:12-14"},"4":{"text":"A kisee hun a tun simin a nuai a poaite thangsak vun."},"5":{"text":"Topa patoaina in a kivawt Paisan Poai sia tha masabel ni sawm le ni li ni, nitum ciang kipan hi.","title":"Paisan Poai le Tol saw ngawl Anluum Poai (Mi Simna 28:16-25)","ref":"Pu 12:1-13; Thkna 16:1-2"},"6":{"text":"Ni sawm le ni nga ni in Tol saw ngawl Anluum Poai kipan a, ni sali sung tol kisaw anluum peuma na ne buatu uh hi.","ref":"Pu 12:14-20; 23:15; 34:18; Thkna 16:3-8"},"7":{"text":"Poai sung ni masabel ni in biakna vawt tu in na kikhawm tu uh a, kuama in noma ii ni sim nasep bangma seam ngawl het tu nu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ni sali sung Topa tungah an taw biakpiaknate pia vun. A ni sali ni in biakna vawt tu in kikhawm kik vun, ahizong kuama in noma ni sim nasep bangma seam heak vun."},"9":{"text":"Topa hong piakna ngam thengin an na laak uh ciang anpal taangvawng sia thiampipa pia vun.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"No hong kisaan thei natu in thiampipa in Topa tungah tuasia a tuam vilvel biakpiakna in pia tu hi. Tuasia Sabbath khuavak ni in thiampipa in pia tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Antang biakpiakna na piak ni in meihal biakpiakna in a mealhem ngawl kum khat a pha tuutal khat zongh na pia tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua taw an biakpiakna in olive thau taw a kihel anvui kilogramme nii na pia tu uh hi. Hi biakpiakna ii ngimnam in Topa lungkimsak hi. Biakpiakna in sapittui litre khat zongh pia tu nu hi."},"14":{"text":"Pathian tungah hi biakpiakna na piak uh mateng anthak peuma, a sial, a kan ahibuale anluum em ne heak vun. Hi ngeina sia na suan le na paalte theampo ii maisang hun theampo ah a zui tu ngeina ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa tungah anpal na piak ni, Sabbath khuavak ni pan nipi sali a cin dong simto vun.","title":"Anlaak Poai (Mi Simna 28:26-31)","ref":"Pu 23:16; 34:22; Thkna 16:9-12"},"16":{"text":"Sabbath salivei a cin zawk ni sawmnga ni in Topa tungah a dang antang biakpiakna thak pia vun."},"17":{"text":"Innkuan simin anluum lum nii tek keng tu a, a tuam vilvel letsong in Topa tungah pia tu hi. Anluum khat sia anvui kilogramme nii tol kisaw in a ki em hi tu a, laak pheang tu anpal biakpiakna in Topa tungah pia tu nu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua anluum taw taangpite in a mealhem ngawl kum khat a pha, tuuno sali, khuital khat le tuutal nii pia tu uh hi. Tuate Topa tungah meihal biakpiakna in antang biakpiakna le sapittui biakpiakna taw kipiakhawm tu hi. Hi biakpiakna ii ngimnam in Topa lungkimsak hi."},"19":{"text":"Mawphel biakpiakna in kealtal khat le kipawlkhop biakpiakna in kum khat a pha tuutalno nii zongh pia vun."},"20":{"text":"Thiampipa in thiampite atu in Topa tungah a tuam vilvel letsong in anluum sia tuunote nii taw pia tu hi. Hi biakpiaknate thiangtho hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ni in kuama in noma ii ni sim nasep bangma seam heak vun, ahizong biak kikhopna nei vun. Koisung po ah na teang uh zong na suan na paalte in hi ngeina sia maisang hun theampo ah zui tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Na lo ante na laak uh ciang lomong a om ante la heak vun a, na nusiat sa ante at kik tu in pai kik heak vun; tuate sia mizawngte le ngamdangmite atu in nusia vun. Topa sia na Pathian ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 19:9-10; Thkna 24:19-22"},"23":{"text":"A tha salina ni masabel ni sia a tuam vilvel tawlngakna ni in tang vun a, lemle hong kitum ciang biakna vawt tu in kikhawm vun.","title":"Kumthak Poai (Mi Simna 29:1-6)","merge":"24"},"25":{"text":"Topa tungah an taw biakpiakna pia vun a, noma ii ni sim nasep bangma seam heak vun."},"26":{"text":"Tha salina ni sawm ni sia mite mawmai natu in kumcin biakna a zeksa sep ni tu ahi hi. Tua ni in bangma ne heak vun a; biak kikhopna ah pai tekin Topa tungah an taw biakpiakna pia vun.","title":"Mawsuutna Ni (Mi Simna 29:7-11)","ref":"Thiam 16:29-34","merge":"27"},"28":{"text":"Tua ni in naseam heak vun, banghang ziam cile tua ni sia mawna a mai natu a zeksa sep ni ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ni in an khat pawpo a ne sia, Pathian mi khatin kingaisun nawn ngawl tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ni in na seam a om le Topa ama mama in thisak tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Koisung po ah a teang zong hi ngeina sia na suan na paalte theampo atu ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua tha ni kua ni nitum pan kipan ni sawm ni nitum dong sia a tuam vilvel tawlngakna ni in na tan tu uh hi a, tua hun sungin bangma kine thei ngawl tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Buk poai sia tha salina, ni sawm le ni nga ni pan kipan ni sali sung hi tu hi.","title":"Buk Poai (Mi Simna 29:12-40)","ref":"Thkna 16:13-15","merge":"34"},"35":{"text":"Ni masabel ni in biakna vawt khawm vun a, kuama in noma ii ni sim nasep bangma seam heak vun."},"36":{"text":"Ni sali sung ni simin an taw biakpiakna na vawt tu uh hi. A ni liat ni in a bia tu le an taw biakpiakna pia tu in na kikhawm kik tu uh hi. Tua ni sia biak kikhop ni hi a, kuama naseam ngawl tu nu hi."},"37":{"text":"(Hi biakna poaite sia a kisamh bangin biakna vawt khopna nei a, ni khat zawk ni khat an taw biakpiakna, meihal biakpiakna, antang biakpiakna, sangaw biakpiakna, le sapittui biakpiakna te taw Topa patoaina poaite ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Hi poaite in Sabbath tan ngeina sia belapna hi a, hi biakpiaknate sia Topa tungah na piak ngengei letsongte le kamciam taangtut biakpiaknate le thinzaw biakpiaknate belapna ahi hi.)"},"39":{"text":"Lo an na laak zawk uh ciang, tha salina ni sawm le ni nga ni pan kipan ni sali sung hi poai khaam tu nu hi. Ni masabel ni sia a tuam vilvel tawlngakna ni hi tu hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ni in na thingnote ii nga phabelte, palm baakte, thingtee baakboaite pawlkhat la in Topa na Pathian patoaina in biakna poai kipan tu nu hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua poai ni sali sung vawt tu nu hi. Hi ngeina sia na suan na paalte ii maisang hun theampo ah a zui tu ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Israel mite theampo ni sali sung bukte sungah teang tu a,"},"43":{"text":"tua hile Topa in Egypt pan hong pusuapui lai in Israel mite ii buk sak tawmte sungah hong teensakna thu na suan na paalte in hong he thei tu hi. Ama in Topa na Pathian ahi hi."},"44":{"text":"Hi bangin Topa patoaina in biakna poaite a khaam ciang Israel mite zui tu ngeinate Moses in pia hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Meivakte Kepcingna (Pusuana 27:20-21)"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite in Puanbuk sungah meiinnte a kidet ngei bangin a taan suak thei natu in olive thau phabelte hong paipui natu thupia in sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa ompuina Thiangthobel Mun sungah a om Thuciamna Thingkuang mai puankhai pua sangah meite, nitak sim Aaron in de a, zingsang dong kuangtopsak tu hi. Hi ngeina sia maisang hun theampo ah zui tu ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Khamh ciitak taw kivawt meikhuamte tungah meite Aaron in keamcing tu a, Topa ompuina ah a ngeina bangin taangsak nanak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Anvui kilogramme sawm le nii la in, anluum sawm le ni vawt in.","title":"Pathian tungah A kipia Anluum","ref":"Pu 25:30"},"6":{"text":"Topa ompuina mun khamh ciitak taw a kituam sabuai tungah luk veu ngual nii in koi hi."},"7":{"text":"Anluum taangin Topa tungah a kipia an taw biakpiakna a kilakna in, tua a ngualte tungah ngimnamtui a thiang tawm koi in."},"8":{"text":"Sabbath ni sim, maisang hun theampo ah tua anluumte Topa ompuina ah kikoi tu hi. Hisia a tawntungin Israel te sep tu ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi anluumte Aaron le a suan a paalte neisa hi a, amate in mun thiangthona ah ne tu hi, banghang ziam cile thiampite atu in Topa tungah a kipia a thiangtho mama ante ahi hi.","ref":"Mt 12:4; Mk 2:26; Lk 6:4"},"10":{"text":"Pasal khat om a, a pa sia Egypt te, a nu sia Israel te Dan minam sung pan Dibri tanu Shelomith a kici sia ahi hi. Tua ngiaphual sungah tua pa sia Israel te khat taw kihau hi. A kihau sungin tua pa in Pathian haamsiat ahikom, Moses kungah paipui uh hi,","title":"A Maan Daan Piaknazia","merge":"11"},"12":{"text":"tua pa kikhumcip a, bangbang hi tu ci sia Topa ii amate a son tu ngakin om uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,"},"14":{"text":"“Tua pa ngiaphual pua sangah paipui vun. Pathian a haamsiat lai in a za theampo in maw hi ci tetti lakna in tua pa lu tungah a khut uh nga tek tu a, tuaciang taangpi bup in suang taw deanglum tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang Pathian a haamsiat peuma in a piang bangin thuak tu a,"},"16":{"text":"kithatlum tu hi, ci in Israel mite tungah na son tu hi. Israel te khat pawpo ahibuale Israel te sungah a teang ngamdangmi khat pawpo Topa a haamsiat sia taangpi bup in suang taw deanglum tu hi."},"17":{"text":"“Mihing a that sia peuma kithat tu hi,","ref":"Pu 21:12"},"18":{"text":"ngual nganno khat a that sia peuma in liau kik tu hi. Nuntakna khat sia nuntakna khat taw lo tu ci thu ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"“Mihing khat in midang khat a liamsua le, ama vawt babangin a tungah kivawt tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in ngu khat a talsak le ama ngu khat kitalsak tu hi; ngual mittang khat a tawsak le ama mittang khat kitawsak tu hi. Ha tang khat a tongsak le ama hatang khat kithoksak tu hi. Midang khat a liamsua babangin ama tungah kithuk kik tu hi.","ref":"Pu 21:23-25; Thkna 19:21; Mt 5:38"},"21":{"text":"Nganno khat a that sia in liau tu a, ahizong mihing a that sia peuma kithatlum tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Hi thukham sia no Israel te le note sungah hong teang ngamdangmite theampo ii zui tu ahi hi, banghang ziam cile Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mi 15:16"},"23":{"text":"Hi thu Moses in Israel mite tungah a son zawkciang, tua pa ngiaphual pua sangah paipui in suang taw deanglum uh hi. Topa ii Moses tungah a thupiak bangin Israel mite in vawt uh hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Sinai Mual tungah Moses paupui a,","title":"A Kum Salina (Thuhil kikna 15:1-11)"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite tungah a nuai a zui tu ngeinate a piak tu in thupia hi. Topa hong piak tu ngam ah na tum uh ciang a kum sali kum simin lothaw ngawlna taw Topa na upat tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Kum luk sung lo na poai tu uh a, na sapitbaakte tan a puuapha in, lo ante na kaikhawm tu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahizong a kum salina sia na leitang ii tawlngak kum hi tu a, Topa tungah a ki aap kum hi tu hi. Tua kumin lo an ciing heak vun a, sapitkung zongh pua heak vun."},"5":{"text":"Na lo sungah a lipo ante zongh la ngawlin na pua ngawl sapitngate zongh lo heak vun. Tua kum sia na leitang ii tawlngak hiithiat kum ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua kumin lo a kithaw ngawl hang tua lo in note, na silate, na naseamte, no taw a teang khawm ngamdangmite,","ref":"Pu 23:10-11"},"7":{"text":"na ngannote le ngamsate zongh hong vak tu hi. Tua lo pan a piang theampo kine thei tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Kum sali mun salivei simna a kingawm ciang kum 49 ci in sim vun.","title":"Piakkikna Jubilee Kum"},"9":{"text":"Tua zawk tha salina, ni sawm ni, Mawsuutna Ni in ngamsung tengah lemle tum tu in mi khat na paisak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Hi bangin kum sawmngana kum sia na koituam tu a, ngam sungah a teang theampo tungah suatakna thu na thangsak tu uh hi. Tua kum in na zuak sa uh vanhte theampo, a nei sia kungah, ahibuale a suan a paalte kungah kipia kik tu hi, sila in a kizuaksa te zongh a innkuanpuite kungah cia kik tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Lo na tho buatu uh a, a lipo ante zongh na la buatu uh hi, na ho ngawl sapitngate zongh na lo buatu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua kum bup note atu in kum thiangtho hi tu a; lote pan a piang tawm teng bek na ne tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Hi kum sungin a kizuaksa na theampo a neite kungah kilee kiksak siat tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua hi a, Israel na mipuite tungah na lo na zuak ciang, ahibuale ama tung pan lo na lei ciang a kilawm ngawlin kison heak vun."},"15":{"text":"A man sia Piakkikna Jubilee Kum kik dong hi lo pan kum bangza sung, an bangza piang tu cisia tuatin a man kitan tu hi."},"16":{"text":"A kum a tam le a man tam tu a, ahizong a kum a tawm le a man tawm zaw tu hi, banghang ziam cile a kizuak lo sia pan a piang thei an phaza tungah kibulphu zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel na mipuite theam heak in a, Topa na Pathian ii thu ni in."},"18":{"text":"Hi ngam sungah ngammuang tak na nuntak thei natu in Topa thukhamte le thupiakte theampo zui in.","title":"A Kum Sali Kum ii Haksatna"},"19":{"text":"Leitang pan an hong piang tu a, na du theampo nei in, ngammuang takin na nungta tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahizong mihing khat po in tuabang lothaw ngawl, anlaak ngawl bulin, a kum sali kumin bang ne tu hi ziam, hong ci om thei tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Kum nii sung an na khom thei natu uh in Topa in a kum luk kumin leitang thupha pia tu hi."},"22":{"text":"A kum liat kumin lo na thaw ciang a kum lukna kumin na laak ante na ne lai tu a, tua kumin na thaw ante na laak dong neakkhom tu na nei tu uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Na leitang sia a tawntung atu in kizuak thei ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile nang neisa hi ngawl hi; Pathian neisa hi a, no sia thaw khuan a nga ngamdangmite taw na kibang uh hi.","title":"Neisate Piakkikna"},"24":{"text":"Leitang a kizuak ciang a neipa ii tat kik thei natu a thuneina sia heak tek kul hi."},"25":{"text":"Israel te khat zawng a, a leitang zuak tu a kul le a mealheak kinaibel sia in tan kik tu hi."},"26":{"text":"A tan kik tu mealheak a nei ngawl khat sia hong hau kikin a tan kik zo zongh suak thei tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua thu ah a lei kik thei ni in Piakkikna Jubilee kum dong a leitang pan a nga kik tu za taw tuatin a zuakna pa tungah a man pia in tuasia tan kik tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahizong a tat kik natu sum a cin zo buale Piakkikna Jubilee kum kik dong a leipa khut sungah om lai tu hi. Tua kum ciang tuasia a neipa tungah kipia kik tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Mihing khat in kulh taw ki uum khuapi sungah a om inn khat a zuak le, a zuak hun pan kum khat sung teng tan kik thei tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahizong tua kum sungin a tan kik zo buale tan kik thei nawn ngawl tu a, a inn sia a leipa le a suan le a paalte neisa hi suak tu hi; Piakkikna Jubilee kum ciang zongh in kipia kik tuan ngawl tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahizong uumna a nei ngawl khuanote sungah innte sia lote bangin kingaisun tu a, a neipa in tan kik thei tu hi, Jubilee kum ciang kipia kik tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahizong Levi suante in a nasepna khuapite sungah a neisate bang hun po in tat kik thei natu thu nei hi."},"33":{"text":"Hi khuapite khat sung pan inn khat sia Levi khat in zuak a, a tan kik buale Piakkikna Jubilee kum ciang kipia kik nanak tu hi, banghang ziam cile a khuapi sungah Levi te ii innte sia Israel mite sungah a kip a kho in amate ii neisa ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Levi khuapite kiimkot ah nganthana leitang ahile kizuak ngeingawl tu hi; tuasia a tawntung amate ii neisa ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Na nai a, a teang Israel mipui khat zawngin ama le ama a kivaak zo buale na nai ah hong teen suak thei natu in na cial naseampa khat bangin sum na puk tu hi.","title":"Mizawngte tung Sumpukna","ref":"Thkna 15:7-8"},"36":{"text":"Ama tung pan a meet la heak in a, ahihang Pathian thu ni in na Israel mipuipa na nai ah teangsak in."},"37":{"text":"Ama, sum na pukna tung pan summeet la heak in a, na anzuakte tung pan a meet la heak in.","ref":"Pu 22:25; Thkna 23:19-20"},"38":{"text":"Hi thu sia Canaan ngam hong piak natu le noma Pathian ahi natu in Egypt ngam pan hong pusuapuipa Topa na Pathian uh ii thu piak ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Na nai a, a teang Israel na mipui khat a zawn mama hu in sila khat bangin ama le ama hong kizuak le sila nasepte na seamsak buatu hi.","title":"Silate Suatakna","ref":"Pu 21:2-6; Thkna 15:12-18"},"40":{"text":"Ama in kuli khat bangin na kungah om tu a, Piakkikna Jubilee kum dong nangma ii na seam tu hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuasia hun ciang ama le a tate in nangma hong nusia tu a, a innkuanpuite le a taanghpupite neisa omna ah cia kik tu uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Israel mite sia Topa ii silate hi a, ama in Egypt pan pusuapui hi; amate sila in kizuak ngawl het tu hi."},"43":{"text":"Na Pathian kiita vun a, amate vawtsia heak vun."},"44":{"text":"Sila na kisamh le na kiim a om minamte tung pan lei vun."},"45":{"text":"Note taw teang khawm ngamdangmite ii tate zongh lei thei tu nu hi. Na ngamsung pan piang tuabang patangte noma neisa suak thei a,"},"46":{"text":"amate na tapate ii lua tu in na nusiat thei tu a, na tapate ii a nuntak laiteng a na sepsak tu hi. Ahizong Israel na mipuite peuma na vawtsia buatu uh hi."},"47":{"text":"Sonteena in note taw teang khawm ngamdangmite khat hong hau a, ahihang na Israel mipui khat zawngin tua pa tung ahibuale a innkuanpuite khat tungah sila in ama le ama hong kizuak hi."},"48":{"text":"Ama a kizuak zawk hang kitan kik thei lai hi. A suapuite khat,"},"49":{"text":"ahibuale a pano, a suapuiseal, a kinaipui a beete khat pawpo in tan kik thei tu hi; tua ahibuale ama mama in sum a khom a thalaw le kitan in suakta thei tu hi."},"50":{"text":"Ama in a leipa taw kikum tu a, a lei hun a kipan Piakkikna Jubilee kum kik dong a kum simto tu a, naseampa khat a kipia nitha za taw ama suatak natu a man tan tu hi."},"51":{"text":"Kum sim kuli naseam khat bangin ngaisun in, a taanglai kumte taw tuatin a lei man baang teng pia kik tu hi.","merge":"52"},"53":{"text":"A topa in vawtsia ngawl het tu hi."},"54":{"text":"Hi bang lam khat pawpo taw a kisuaktasak buale ama le a tate sia Piakkikna Jubilee kum kik ciang kisuaktasak nanak tu hi."},"55":{"text":"Israel mi khat sia sila hi top thei ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile Israel mite sia Topa silate ahi uh hi. Ama in amate Egypt pan pusuapui hi; ama sia Topa, amate ii Pathian ahi hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in, “Biak tu in milimte vawt heak vun, ahibuale suangkhuamte, ahibuale a kizeam suangte phut heak vun. Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi.","title":"Thunit hu in Thuphate (Thuhil kikna 7:12-24 ; 12:1-14 .)","ref":"Thiam 19:4; Pu 20:4; Thkna 5:8; 16:21-22; 27:1"},"2":{"text":"Biakna poaite vawt vun a keima nong biakna mun ciliap vun. Keima in Topa ka hi hi."},"3":{"text":"“Ka thukham bang nungta in ka thupiakte na zui uh le,","ref":"Thkna 11:13-15; 28:1-14"},"4":{"text":"Keima in nguatui hun maanin kong pia tu a, tua hile leitang in an piangsak tu a, thingkungte a nga nga tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Na lo ante tam mama tu a, sapitngate law hun dongin lo ante na la lai tu a, thaicii tuu kik hun dongin sapitnga na lo lai tu uh hi. Na du theampo na nei tu a, na ngam sungah ngammuang takin na teang thei tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"“Na ngam sungah kilemna kong pia tu a, kuama kiita ngawlin na mu thei tu uh hi. Na ngamsung pan ngamsa ngilote ka hawlkeak tu a, tua munah ngal le sa om ngawl tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Na ngalte na zo tu uh hi;"},"8":{"text":"note mi nga in mi zakhat na zo thei tu uh a, zakhat in tulsawm na zo thei tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Thupha kong pia tu a, ta tam mama kong pia tu hi; note taw ka vawt thuciam sia keima sang pan ka len tu hi."},"10":{"text":"An tam mama na la tu uh a, kum khat na khom tu uh hi, tua zawkciang zong saal sungah a taanglai an kumlui teng anthakte koi natu in na heam tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A thiangtho ka Puanbuk sungah note taw ka teang tu a, note kong nungngat ngei buatu hi."},"12":{"text":"Noma taw kong om tu a, na Pathian hi in, note keima mi na hi tu uh hi.","ref":"2 Cor 6:16"},"13":{"text":"Keima Topa na Pathian in sila na hi nawn ngawl natu in Egypt pan kong pusuapui hi. Keima in no hong neng suk vaangletna sia ka sumai zo a, vandak sa in hi vaviau in kong kalsuansak zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in, “Ka thu piakte na zui bua uh le daan kong pia tu hi.","title":"Thunit ngawl hu in Daan piakna (Thuhil kikna 28:15-68)","ref":"Thkna 28:15-68"},"15":{"text":"Note taw ka vawt ka thuciam paltan in, ka thukham le ka thupiakte na nial uh le,"},"16":{"text":"note daan kong pia tu hi. Na mit hong tawsak tu le na nuntakna a bo tu in note tungah tuasiatna — a dam thei ngawl natnate le cisa natnate kong tungsak tu hi. Lo na thaw ancii na poai hangin na phattuamna om ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile na ngalte in hong zo in na ciin po hong neaksak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Ngal na lel natu in kong nungngat tu a, hong ngaimaw te in hong uk tu hi; na patau mama tu uh a, hong del om ngawl napi na tatai tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"“Hi bang teng zawkciang ka thu nong ni bua veve uh le, na thuak tu uh daan a zaa sali in ka khangsak tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Na thinpui kiphatsakna ka sumai tu hi; nguatui hang a, na leitangte ko in thik bangin sak tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Hanciam in na nasepna theampo a luithawthong hi tu hi, banghang ziam cile na leitang pan an piang ngawl tu a, thingnote a nga nga ngawl tu hi."},"21":{"text":"“Nong nalh veve lai a, ka thu nong ni bualai uh le, na thuak daan a zaa sali in ka khangsak kik tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Note sungah a kiitakhuai ngamsate kong puak tu a, na tate, na ngannote hong thalupsakin, note tawm bek taanglai in na lampite uh kinusia tu hi."},"23":{"text":"“Hi bang teng daan na thuak zawk uh ciang ka thu nangai ngawlin nong nial veve lai uh le,"},"24":{"text":"kong nungngat tu a, a masa lai sangin salivei a nasia zaw daan kong pia tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Ih thuciamna na palsat manin daan hong pia tu in no tungah ngalpi kong thengsak tu hi. Na ngammuan natu in khuapi sung na zuan zonghin a dam maw natnate kong tungsak tu a, na ngalte na lel hamtang uh kul tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Nupi sawm ii a nei anluum theampo a em natu sia anluum emna khat bek a kisap natu zaa dongin na anneak nga natu kong khaktan tu hi. Amate in hong hawmsak tu uh a, na neak zawk uh ciang ngawngawn in na ngilkial lai tu uh hi."},"27":{"text":"“Hi bang teng zawkciang ka thu ni ngawlin nong nial veve lai uh le,"},"28":{"text":"no tungah ka thin uukin a masa na daan thuak uh sangin, a salivei a nasia zawin daan kong pia tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Na ngil uh kial leilam in, na tate sa na ne tu uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Mual tungah om noma biakna munte ka lalsak tu a, ngimnamtui biaknataute baltham in milim a lalte tungah na mithiluangte ka lawn tu hi. A thasiathuai tatakin,"},"31":{"text":"na khuapite ka lalcipsak tu a, na biakna munte siasak in, na sangaw biakpiaknate kong saang buatu hi."},"32":{"text":"Na leitang ka lalcipsak tu a, tuasia a lua na ngalte inghsak tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ngal kong thengsak tu a, ngamdang ah kong thethaang tu hi. Na leitang kitaisan tu a, na khuapite lalcip in kinusia tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuasia ciang tawlngak hun na piak ngawl, na leitang ii nuamsa in a tawlngak hunnuam kumte hi tu hi. Tuasia kinusia in ngam thimtham hong suak tu a, na ngalte ngam ah sal na tan hun sung teng na leitang tawlnga tu hi.","merge":"35"},"36":{"text":"“Saltaangin a om note kong patausak mama tu a, vui ii seam thingtee nging sia in note hong taisak tu hi. Ngal kisimna ah ngalte ii del bangin na tai tu uh a, na kiim ah ngal om ngawl napi na liik tu uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Kuama hong del om ngawl napi kipaltha in na liik tu uh a, ngalte khat zongh na sim zo buatu uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Na saltanna ah na thi tu uh a, na ngalte ii leitang in hong valhlum tu hi."},"39":{"text":"Na ngalte ngam le lei ah a taanglai sun tawmte zongh noma mawna le na taanghpupite mawna hangin na mangthang veve tu uh hi."},"40":{"text":"“Ahizong na suan na paalte in amate mawnate le hong nalh a hong leedo hu in amate mawnate le a taanghpupite mawnate pualaak tu uh hi,"},"41":{"text":"amate sia keima ii ka nungngat, a ngalte ngam ah salin hong puaksakte ahi uh hi. A khakbel in na suan na paalte a mawna hangin kiniamkhiak a, daan zong thuak zo ahiciang,"},"42":{"text":"Jacob, Isaac, le Abraham taw ka thuciamna ka phawk kik tu a, ka mite Canaan ngam piak tu in ka kamciamna ka thaksua kik tu hi.","ref":"Pian 28:13-14; Pian 26:3-4; Pian 17:7-8"},"43":{"text":"Ahizong hi leitang, a tawlngak hithet thei natu in a ngammite in a masabel in ngam le lei a taisat kul hi, ka thukham le ka thupiakte nial ahikom amate daan ka piak kul hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuabang ahitazong a ngalte ngam sungah a om hun sung zonghin ka nusia bup buatu a, ka mon buatu hi. Tuabangin vawt leng amate taw ka thuciamna bo tu hi, keima in Topa, amate ii Pathian ka hi hi."},"45":{"text":"Keima in Topa amate ii Pathian ka hi natu in Egypt ngam pan ka mite ka pusuapui na taw minam theampo tungah ka vaangletna ka lak ciang a taanghpupite taw ka vawt thuciamna ka thaksua tu hi,” ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Hi thukhamte le thupiakte theampo sia Israel mite atu in Sinai Mual tungah Topa ii Moses tungah a piakte ahi hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"tungah Letsongte Piakzia Thukhamte"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite atu a nuai a zui tu ngeinate pia hi. A tuam vilvel kiciamna khat taangtutna in Topa tungah a kipiasa mihing khat sia, a nuai a bangin sumpiakna taw tua pa kisuaktasak thei tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua sumte Biakinn zak ngei khaikhin taw kitee hi: — pasal khanthin kum kul pan kum sawmluk dong: ngunntang 50 — numei khanthin: ngunntang 30 — pa a khangmoi, kum nga pan kum kul dong: ngunntang 20 — numei a khangmoi: ngunntang 10 — patangno kum nga nuaisia : ngunntang 5 — numeino: ngunntang 3 — Pasal kum sawmluk tungsia: ngunntang 15 — Nupi kum sawmluk tungsia: ngunntang 10","merge":"4"},"8":{"text":"Kamciamna a vawtpa sia zawng leih in a ngeina bangin a pia zo buale ama sia thiampipa kungah kipaipui tu a, thiampipa in a piak zawkza dong khepsak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Kamciamna a vawt sia Topa biakpiakna in a saan thamman nganno khat ahile Topa tungah a kipia letsong theampo biakna taw kisai in a thiangtho hi a,"},"10":{"text":"kamciamna a vawtpa in nganno dang taw laih thei ngawl tu hi. Nganno dang taw a laih le ngannote nii sia Topa neisa hi tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahizong kamciamna in a piak tu nganno sia biakna taw kisai in a thiang ngawl hi a, Topa biakpiakna in saan thei ngawl tu ahile, tua pa in tua nganno sia thiampipa kungah paipui tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Thiampipa in nganno phatna le siatna taw kizui in a man tan tu a, a tan babangin kip tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua pa in a lei kik nuam le, a man za le tua man tungah zakhat ciang kul veu belapin lei tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi khat in a inn Topa tungah a aap ciang, thiampipa in a phatna le a siatna zui in a man tan tu a, a tan babang kip tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua pa in a inn a lei kik nuam le a man za le tua man tungah zakhat ciang kul veu belapin pia tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihing khat in a leitang khen khat Topa tungah a aap le, a thai ciin thei tu za tungtawnin a man kitan tu a, mangtaang kilogramme kul ciang ngunntang sawm in kituat tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Piakkikna Jubilee kum zawk po ciang a leitang a aap le, a man a cingin tan tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Piakkikna Jubilee kum zawk pek ciang a aap le, thiampipa in Jubilee kum kik dong a om lai kumte taw kizui in a man za see tu a, a man khiam tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi khat in a aapsa lo a lei kik nuam ahile a lo man za le tua man tungah zakhat ciang kul veu belap thua in pia tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa tung pan tuasia lei kik masa ngawlin mi dang khat tungah a zuak le lei kik theina thu sia a bo hi tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Piakkikna Jubilee kum a cin kik ciang tua lo a tawntungin Topa neisa suak tu a; thiampite in tang tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Mihing khat in ama leisa lo Topa tungah a aap le,"},"23":{"text":"thiampipa in mai Piakkikna Jubilee kum dong a kum tuatin a man see tu a, a see zaza tua pa in tua ni in pia nanak tu hi; tua sum teng Topa aa ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Piakkikna Jubilee kum a cin ciang tua lo a neiphitpa tungah ahibuale a suan a paalte tungah ki aap kik tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Biakinn zak ngei khaikhin taw kizui in na man theampo a man kitan tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Nganhing no suakciil peuma Topa neisa hi zo ahiciang, kuama in thinzaw biakpiakna in Topa tungah aap thei ngawl tu hi. Khuino, tuuno, ahibuale kealno khat Topa neisa hi a,"},"27":{"text":"ahizong a thiang ngawl nganhing no suakciil ahile, a man a kitan za le tua a man tung zakhat ciang kul veu belapin lei kik thei tu hi. A kilei kik buale tua nganhing sia a man a kitan za taw midang khat pawpo tungah kizuak thei hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa tungah thudang om ngawl tu in a aap thiang sitsetsa, mihing, nganhing, ahibuale leitang khat sia kuama in zuak kik, lei kik thei ngawl tu hi. A tawntungin Topa neisa ahi hi.","ref":"Mi 18:14"},"29":{"text":"Mihing ngawngawn tuabang a ki aap thiang sitset sa te tat kik thei tu hi ngawl hi; ama sia kithatlum nanak tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Na leitang pan a piang theampo, an le thingngate sawm a khat Topa ii neisa ahi hi.","ref":"Mi 18:21; Thkna 14:22-29"},"31":{"text":"Mi khat in tuate a tan kik nuam le, a man za le a man tungah zakhat ciang kul veu belapin tan tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Na khoai sa ngannote sawm a khat Topa ii neisa ahi hi. Na nganno na sim ciang a sawmna nganno sia veu Topa ii neisa ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"A neipa in a sim ciang a sawmna nganno sia a tha zawmbel a teal thei natu in vawt kaltang ngawl tu a, a kitealsa khat theak kik thei ngawl tu hi. A theak kik ahile tua nganhingte nii sia Topa ii neisa hi tu a, kilei kik thei ngawl tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Hite Israel mite atu in Sinai Mual tungah Topa ii Moses tungah a thupiakte ahi hi."}}}}},"4":{"info":{"name":"Ngamsung Vakna","shortname":"Num","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite Egypt pan a pusua zawk a kum niina, a tha niina ni masabel ni in, Sinai Sennealngam sung tua mun Pathian ompuina Puanbuk sungah Topa in Moses paupui hi. Topa in,","title":"Israel te ii A masabel Mihing simna"},"2":{"text":"“Nangma le Aaron in Israel mite ii bee le phungte le a innkuante zui in mihing simna nei tu nu hi. Pa a minpiang,"},"3":{"text":"kum kul le a tungsia ngalkap seam thei tu peuma a min sazian la vun."},"4":{"text":"Hong hu tu in bee le phung khat sung pan ukpi khat veu ngen tavun,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi mihingte sia hi na seam tu in taangpite sung pan a kiteal minam lampuite ahi uh hi:","merge":"6"},"17":{"text":"Hi pasal sawm le niite ii huna taw Moses le Aaron in,"},"18":{"text":"a tha niina, ni masabel ni in, taangpi bup sam a, bee le phungte le innkuante zui in mihing theampo tepteena lai vawt hi,"},"19":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin, kum kul le a tungsia pa peuma, kisimin a min kiciamtee hi. Sinai Sennealngam ah Moses in mihingte min tepteena lai vawt hi."},"20":{"text":"Ngalkap na a seam thei tu kum kul pan a tungsia pa peuma bee le phungte le innkuante zui in min kikhum a, Jacob tapa lianbel Reuben minam taw kipan hi. A vekpi in a nuai a bang ahi hi.","merge":"21"},"47":{"text":"Levi te sia nam dangte min kikhumna ah kihel ngawl hi,"},"48":{"text":"banghang ziam cile Topa in Moses tungah,"},"49":{"text":"“Ngalkap na a seam thei tu mihingte na sim ciang, Levi namte kihelsak heak in."},"50":{"text":"Ahizong Levi te ka ompui na Puanbuk le a vanhzak nate theampo a uk tu in koi in. Amate in Puanbuk le a vanhte pua tu uh a, a sungah naseam in tua Puanbuk kiim ah ngiaphual saat tu uh hi."},"51":{"text":"Na ngiaphual na khiin simin Levi te in Puanbuk phel tu a, ngiaphual thak ah thua kik tu uh hi. Midang khat pawpo Puanbuk nai ah a pai le kithatlum tu hi."},"52":{"text":"A taanglai Israel te in amate tek ii, laandial nuai ah a hon a hon in ngiaphual saat tu uh hi."},"53":{"text":"Khat po in puanbuk nai ah pai in a neak le ka thin uuk tu a, Israel taangpite daan ka pia tu hi, tua ahikom Levi te in Puanbuk kiim ah ngiaphual saatin cing tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"54":{"text":"Tuabangin Topa ii Moses a thupiakte theampo Israel mite in seam siat uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah a nuai a bangin thupia hi.","title":"Ngiaphual sungah Minamte Omzia"},"2":{"text":"Israel te in ngiaphual a saat uh ciang a pawlkhenna sung tek le a bee le phung ii laandial nuai tek ah om tu uh hi. Puanbuk kiimkot ah a ngiaphual kisaat tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Nisuana sang, Judah pawlkhen ii laandial nuai ah a omte in a lampuite khutnuai ah a nuai a bangin, a pawl a pawl in ngiaphual saat tu uh hi. Judah pawlkhen ah a omte pai masa tu uh hi.","merge":"4"},"10":{"text":"Thangsang Reuben ii laandial nuai ah a omte in a lampuite khutnuai ah a nuai a bangin, a pawl a pawl in ngiaphual saat tu uh hi:","merge":"11"},"17":{"text":"Tuaciang a masa pawl niite le a nungsang pawl niite kilaklaw ah Levi mite in Puanbuk pua in pai tu uh hi. A pawl a pawlin amate laandial nuai tek ah ngiaphual saat in a om bangma in a pai ciang zong tuabang ma in pai tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Nitumna sang, Ephraim pawlkhen ii laandial nuai ah a omte in a lampuite khutnuai ah a nuai a bangin, a hon a hon in ngiaphual saat tu uh hi: Ephraim pawlkhen ah a omte a thumna in pai tu uh hi.","merge":"19"},"25":{"text":"Saksang Dan pawlkhen ii laandial nuai ah a omte in a lampuite khutnuai ah a nuai a bangin, a hon a honin ngiaphual saat tu uh hi. Dan ii pawlkhen ah a omte a khak belin pai tu uh hi.","merge":"26"},"32":{"text":"Pawlkhen te sungah a pawl a pawl zui in, Israel mite kisim a, a vekpi 603,550 pha hi."},"33":{"text":"Moses tungah Topa thupiak sa bangma in Levi te sia Israel dangte taw kisim khawm ngawl hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuabangin Moses tungah Topa thupiak sa theampo Israel mite in vawt siat uh hi. Amate sia a laandial nuai tek ah ngiakin, tuaciang amate bee le phung zui in pai uh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiteng sia, Topa ii Sinai Mual tungah Moses a paupui hun lai a, Aaron le Moses ii innkuanpuite ahi hi.","title":"Aaron ii Tapate"},"2":{"text":"Aaron in tapa li nei a: a tapa lianbel Nadab hi a, Abihu, Eleazar le Ithamar te ahi hi.","ref":"Mi 26:60"},"3":{"text":"Amate thiampi suak tu in sathau kinoai a, thupha piak kipsakna a ngate ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahizong, Nadab le Abihu te sia Sinai Sennealngam ah a thiangtho ngawl meihal biakpiakna Topa tungah a piak ciang, kithatlum hi. Amate in ta nei ngawl ahikom Aaron nuntak hunsung teng Eleazar le Ithamar in thiampi na seam uh hi.","ref":"Thiam 10:1-2; Mi 26:61"},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Thiampite Na Sepsak tu in Levi te Panmun Kipia"},"6":{"text":"“Levi minamte paipui in a, thiampi Aaron ii naseam tu in panmun pia in."},"7":{"text":"Amate in keima ompuina Puanbuk atu in a kisamh bang le thiampite atu le taangpite atu a kisamh bang seam tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in Puanbuk sungah a om vanh theampo keamcing tu uh a, a taanglai Israel te atu in naseam tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Levi mite ii vaipuak sia Aaron le a tapate ii na a sepsak tu bek ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Thiampi na a seam tu in Aaron le a tapate nasep na pia tu a; midang khat pawpo hi na a seam nuam sia kithatlum tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,"},"12":{"text":"“Tu in Levi mite keima aa hi tu hi. Egypt te ii taciil theampo ka thalup lai in Israel te innkuan tek pan tapa upabel le a ngannote sung pan a suakciil theampo keima atu in ka thiangthosak hi. Tu in Israel mite tapaciilte taangin Levi mite keima aa ahi hi; amate keima neisa hi tu hi. Keima in Topa ka hi hi.” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 13:2","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Sinai Sennealngam ah Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Levi mite Misimna"},"15":{"text":"Levi mite ii bee le phungte le innkuante zui in, tha khat pan a tungsia a pha pa peuma a min la in tepteena vawt tu in sawl a,"},"16":{"text":"a thupiak bangin Moses in seam hi."},"17":{"text":"Levi in tapa thum nei a: Gershon, Kohath le Merari ahi hi. Tuate amate min a kivaw bee le phungte ii taanghpupite ahi hi. Gershon in tapa nii nei a: Libni le Shimei ahi hi; Kohath in tapa li nei a: Amram, Izhar, Hebron le Uzziel ahi hi; Merari in tapa nii nei a; Mahli le Mushi ahi hi. Amate sia amate min a kivaw innkuante ii taanghpupite ahi uh hi.","merge":"18"},"21":{"text":"Gershon ii bee le phung sia Libni innkuante le Shimei innkuante ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tha khat pan a tungsia a pha pa peuma kisim a, a vekpi in 7,500 pha hi."},"23":{"text":"Hi bee le phung sia nitumna sang Puanbuk nungsangah ngiaphual saat tu a,"},"24":{"text":"Lael tapa Eliasaph in bee le phung ii ukpi seam tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate in Puanbuk, a sungsang sitna, a puasang sitna, a sung tumna kongbiang puankhai,"},"26":{"text":"biaknatau le Puanbuk kiim kikhop na munah a om puankhakte le tuasia sung tumna kongkha puankhaite vaipuak la tu hi. Amate in hi nate taw a kipee-aw nasep theampo vaipuak la tu uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Kohath bee le phungte sia Amram innkuante, Izhar innkuante, Hebron innkuante le Uzziel innkuante ahi uh hi,"},"28":{"text":"Tha khat pan a tungsia pa peuma sazian kila a, a vekpi in 8,600 pha hi."},"29":{"text":"Hi bee le phung te sia Puanbuk thang sangah ngiaphual saat tu a,"},"30":{"text":"Uzziel ii tapa Elizaphan in bee le phung ukpi seam tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Amate in Thuciamna Thingkuang, Sabuai, meidetna khuam, biaknataute, Mun Thiangtho ah thiampite ii zak vanhte le Thiangthobel Mun sung tumna ah puankhai vaipuak la tu uh hi. Amate in hi nate taw a kipee-aw nasep theampo vaipuak la tu uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Levi mite ii ukpi sia thiampi Aaron tapa Eleazar hi. Ama sia Mun Thiangtho ah naseamte a ukpa ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Merari bee le phung sia Mahli le Mushi innkuante a kingawm ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Kum khat pan a tungsia pa peuma sazian kila a, a vekpi in 6,200 pha hi."},"35":{"text":"Hi bee le phung sia Puanbuk saksang ah ngiaphual saat tu a, Abihail tapa Zuriel in bee le phung ii ukpi seam tu hi."},"36":{"text":"Amate in Puanbuk sakna thingpheakte, a zawlte, a khuamte, a tawdapte le a kipeepui theampo vaipuak la tu uh hi. Ama te in hi nate taw a kipee-aw nasep theampo vaipuak la tu uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Amate in khuamte, tawdapte, khetphinte le a puasang kikhopna mun atu khaute zongh vaipuak la tu uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Moses le Aaron le Aaron tapate in nisuana sang Puanbuk mai ah ngiaphual saat tu uh hi. Amate in Israel mite atu in Mun Thiangtho ah sep tu nasep theampo vaipuak la tu uh hi. Mihing khat pawpo tua nasep sep tu a sawm sia kithatlum tu hi."},"39":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin Moses in Levi te bee le phung zui in tha khat pan a tungsia a pha pa peuma sazian la a, a vekpi in 22,000 pha hi."},"40":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah, “Israel te tapa a suakciil theampo keima aa hi. Tua ahiciang tha khat pan a tungsia Israel te tapa a suakciil theampo min tepteena lai vawt in. Ahizong amate tapa suakciil theampo taangin Levi te theampo keima aa ka suaksak hi! Keima in Topa ka hi hi! Tua banah nganno suakciil theampo taangin Levi te ngannote keima aa ka suaksak hi.” ci hi.","title":"Levi te in Tapaciilte ii Dinmun La","merge":"41"},"42":{"text":"Moses in a thu ni a, tapa suakciil tha khat pan a tungsia theampo sazian la in,"},"43":{"text":"a vekpi kingawm in 22,273 pha hi."},"44":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,"},"45":{"text":"“Tu in Israel te tapa suakciil theampo taangin Levi te keima atu in hong aap ta'n a, Israel te nganno suakciil theampo taangin Levi te ii ngannote zongh hong aap ta'n."},"46":{"text":"Israel te tapa a suakciilte sia Levi te sangin 273 in tamzaw ahikom a vaal tapate lei kik nanak tu ni hi."},"47":{"text":"Biakbuk ah a kizangh ngeina om bangin tapa khat ciang ngunntang nga pia in a,"},"48":{"text":"hi sumte Aaron le a tapate tungah pia in” ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Moses in a thu ni a,"},"50":{"text":"ngunntang 1,365 la in,"},"51":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate tungah pia hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Levi nam Kohath Bee le Phung Nasepte"},"2":{"text":"Levi nam Kohath bee le phung ii a bawng le a innkuante zui in mi simna vawt tu le,"},"3":{"text":"Topa ompui na Puanbuk sungah naseam thei tu kum sawmthum le kum sawmnga kilaklaw pa theampo sazian la tu in sawl hi."},"4":{"text":"A nasep sia a thiangthobel nate kihel hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in a nuai a bangin thuhilnate Moses tungah pia hi. Ngiaphual na phel tu uh hun a tun ciang Aaron le a tapate Puanbuk sungah tum tu a, Thuciamna Thingkuang mai ah a om puankhai la in tuasia taw tua Thingkuang siin tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in tuasia savun pha khat taw siin tu a, a tungbel ah vancii puan khat taw siinin, tua zawkciang a zawn natu thingpumte thun tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa tung anluum piakna sabuai tungah amate in vancii puan pha tu a tua tungah pakante, ngimnamtui bungte, biakpiakna kuangte le sapittui biakpiakna thawlte koi tu uh hi. Sabuai tungah anluum om tawntung tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in tuate theampo puansan khat taw siin tu a, savun pha khat taw tuate siin thua in, a zawn natu thingpumte thun tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in vancii puan khat la in, meiinnte taw meidetna khuam, taitee, kuangte le olive thau koina bung theampo siin tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in tuasia le a vanhte theampo savun pha khat sungah tunin puak natu thingzawl tungah koi tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate in vancii puan khat taw khamh biaknatau siin tu a tua tungah savun pha khat koi in, tuaciang zawn natu thingpumte thun tu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in Mun Thiangtho ah a kizangh vanh theampo la tu a vancii puan khat taw tunin savun pha khat a tungah koi in tuaciang puakna tu thingzawl sia tungah tuate koi tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in sathau a nel vutte biaknatau pan luak tu a, a tungah puan sandup khat pha tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in biaknatau nasepna ah a kizangh vanhte: meihalna kuangte, thikkoaite, kawkeaute le kisilna kuangte theampo tua tungah koi tu uh hi. Tuaciang amate in savun pha khat tua tungah koi tu uh hi, tuaciang a zawnna thingpumte thun tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ngiaphual kiphel tu hun a cin ciang a thiangtho nate le vanhzakte theampo Aaron le a tapate in a sit zawkciang a pua tu in Kohath bee le phung pan hong pai tu uh hi. Kohath bee le phung in a thiangtho nate thutha ngawl tu a, a thutha le amate thi tu uh hi. Puanbuk a kikhiin simin hite sia Kohath bee le phung ii vaipuak ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Puanbuk bup le meidet tu sathau, ngimnamtui, antang biakpiakna, noi sathaute le Topa tungah a ki aapsa puanbuk sungah a om theampo thiampi Aaron tapa Eleazar ii vaipuak hi tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah,"},"18":{"text":"“Kohath ii bee le phung sia"},"19":{"text":"hi biakna taw kisai a thiangthobel nate nai ah a paina hu in thalup thuaksak heak in. Hisia a pian ngawl natu in Aaron le a tapate a sungah tumin, mi simin a sep tu te pia in, a vawt tu te son tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahizong Kohath mite puanbuk sungah tumin biakna taw kisai a thiangtho nate tua tu in a kithoai thiampite a mu le amate thi tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Levi nam Gershon Bee le phung ii Sep tute"},"22":{"text":"Levi nam Gershon bee le phungte a innkuan le a beete taw kizui in mihing simna vawt tu le,"},"23":{"text":"Topa ompui na Puanbuk sungah na a seam thei tu kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga kilaklaw pa peuma sazian la in sawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in a nuai a vanhte puak tu vaipuak nei uh hi:"},"25":{"text":"Puanbuk, a sung sitna, a pua sitna, a tung sitna a kipha savun, a sung tumna puankhai,"},"26":{"text":"biaknatau le puanbuk kiimkot ah a om kikhopna mun puankhakte le khauhualte, tuasia sung tumna puankhakte le tua nate thua natu vanhzakte theampo ahi hi. Amate in hi nate atu a kisamh theampo vawt tu uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate ii Gershon suante tungah puak tu le sep tu vaipuak a piak theampo a sep siat natu in Moses le Aaron in pha takin en tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Hite sia Puanbuk sungah a sep tu Gershon bee le phungte ii vaipuak ahi hi; amate in tua nasepte thiampi Aaron tapa Ithamar ii thupiakna bangin seam tu uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah Levi nam Merari bee le phung ii bawngte le innkuante zui in mihing simna nei tu le,","title":"Levi nam Merari Bee le Phung ii Sep tute"},"30":{"text":"Topa ompui na Puanbuk sungah na a seam thei tu kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga kilaklaw, pa peuma sazian la in sawl hi."},"31":{"text":"Amate in puanbuk ii thingpheakte, zawlte, khuamte, le tawdapte,"},"32":{"text":"tuaciang khuamte, tawdapte, khetphinte le puanbuk kiim kikhop na munah khaute, tuate taw a kizom nate theampo puak tu vaipuak nei uh hi. A puak tu vanhte mi simin vaipuak tekin nei tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Hite sia Puanbuk sungah Merari bee le phungte ii vaipuak hi a: amate in thiampi Aaron tapa Ithamar thupiakna bangin seam tu uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa thupiakna taw kizui in, Moses, Aaron, le taangpi lampuite in Levi mi nam thumte ahi, Kohath, Gershon, le Merari suan teng a mihing simna nei hi, amate in Topa ompui na Puanbuk sungah na a seam thei tu kum sawmthum le kum sawmnga kilaklaw, pa peuma a bawngte le innkuante zui in sazian la a, a nuai a bang ahi hi.","title":"Levi te Mihing simna","merge":"35"},"49":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah a thupiak bangin mi simin min sazian kila hi; Topa in Moses tungtawnin a thupiak bangin, a nasep tu le a puak tu vaipuakte mihing sim tungah kipia hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"A Thiang ngawl Mihingte"},"2":{"text":"“A kiitakhuai vun natna veite ahibuale pumtung meima naai neite le mithi luang thamna taw a thiang ngawl peuma, ngiaphual pan a hawlkhiat natu in Israel mite thupia in."},"3":{"text":"Amate sungah ka teenna hi ngiaphual, a nitsak ngawl natu in biakna taw kisai a thiang ngawl hi mihingte theampo hawlkhia in,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel te in thu ni a, tua mihingte ngiaphual pan hawlkhia uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Sepkhial Vawtkhial Liau kiPiakna"},"6":{"text":"Israel te atu in a nuai a kihilnate pia hi. Mihing khat pawpo in Topa tungah thumaan ngawlin khat pawpo tungah khialna a vawt ciang"},"7":{"text":"a thuak pa tungah a mawna pualaak hamtang in, a maw a khial man a cingin a liau zawkciang zakhat tungah kul veu belapin pia thua tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahizong tua pa thi zo a, a liausum piak natu in mealheak nai a nei bua ahile, tua liausum sia thiampipa atu in Topa tungah kipia tu hi. Hi liausum sia, a maw a khialpa biakna taw kisai in thiansua natu a kizangh tuutal belapna ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 6:1-7"},"9":{"text":"Israel te ii Topa tungah a tuam vilvel in a piak letsongte zongh tua letsong a saang thiampipa ii neisa ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Thiampi khat simin ama tungah a kipia biakpiaknate keam tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Pasalte ii Muanlaak a Zite Thute"},"12":{"text":"Israel te tungah a nuai a kihilna teng a piak tu in sawl hi. Tua thu sia pasal khat in ama tungah a zi thumaan ngawl a, pasal dang khat taw khialin ama pumpi ninsak ci a, muang la hi. Ahizong a khial laitak a kiman hi ngawl, tetti om ngawl a — a zi zongh in iim thei ahikom a pasal in thiang takin tel ngawl hi. Tua ahibuale hi thu sia a zi in thumaan ngawlna nei ngeingawl napi, a pasal in muang la thawthong zongh hi thei hi.","merge":"13"},"15":{"text":"Hi bang thu khat sasang a piang le, a pasal in a zi sia thiampipa kungah paipui tu hi. A pasal in biakpiak natu in a kisamh mangtaang vui kilogramme khat keng tu a, ahizong olive thau ahibuale ngimnamtui khat pawpo a tungah buak ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile hi biakpiakna sia a muang la pasal in thumaan thutak a heak nop manin a piak biakpiakna ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Thiampipa in tua numei, mai ah paipui in biaknatau mai ah dingsak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Thiampipa in leibeal sungah tui thiangtho tawm sung tu a, Topa ompui na Puanbuk sung suat tungah a om leivui tawm la in, tua tui a kha a sua natu a sungah tha tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaciang thiampipa in numei ii sam phelsak tu a, tua numei khut sungah biakpiakna anvui koi tu hi. Thiampipa in a khut sungah haamsiatna tuikhaa a om beal sia toai tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaciang thiampipa in tua numei ii thukimna la in, “Na pasal na palngul bua ahile hi haamsiatna tui neakna taw ngim na thuak buatu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahizong na pasal na palngul ahile,"},"21":{"text":"Topa in na min sia na mite sungah haamsiatna khat suaksak tahen. Topa in na numei thilte kinsakin, na ngil puaksak tahen."},"22":{"text":"Hi tui na ngil sungah tum a, na ngil khangin, na numei thilte kinsak hen” ci in kiciamna vawtsak tu hi. Tua numei in, “Ka thukim hi; Topa in tuabang vawt tahen,” ci kik tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaciang thiampipa in hi haamsiatna teng lai taw at tu a, tua tuikhaa beal sungah sil tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua tui sia numeinu ngil sungah a bot mama natna a piangsak thei tu in a neaksak ma in,"},"25":{"text":"thiampipa in numei nu khut sungah a om biakpiakna anvui sia la tu a, Topa tungah aapin, biaknatau tungah koi tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaciang biakpiakna khat hi a cina in thiampipa in anvui khutdim khat la tu a, biaknatau tungah hal tu hi. A khakbel in tua tui sia numei in nesak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua numei in a pasal a palngul le tua tui in a bot mama natna piangsak tu a; a ngil khangin, a numei thilte kin tu hi. A min sia a mite sungah haamsiatna suak tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahizong tua nu a khial buale bangma tat ngawl tu a, nau nei thei tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Hi thu sia a zi in hong palngul hi ci in thuum a, a muang la pasal khat ii thute ah zui tu thukham ahi hi. Tua numei sia biaknatau mai ah kidingsak tu a, thiampipa in hi a zeksa teng seam tu hi.","merge":"30"},"31":{"text":"Hi khialna pan a pasal suakta tu a, ahizong tua numei a khial le a piang babang a thuak kul tu hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Moses tungah,","title":"Nazirite te atu Ngeina"},"2":{"text":"a nuai a kihilnate Israel mite a piak tu in thupia hi. Pa ahizong numei ahizong Nazirite mi suak tu khi hi, ci in kiciamna nei a, Topa tungah a ki aap sia in"},"3":{"text":"sapittui le kham thei ngui theite ten tu hi. Ama in sapitnga taw dawn tu a kivawt bangma dawn ngawl tu a, sapitnga sia a hingin ahizong a ko in ahizong ne ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Lk 1:15"},"4":{"text":"Ama in Nazirite te ahi hun sungin sapitkung pan a piang peuma, sapit mu le a haw dong ciangin ne ngawl tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Nazirite kiciamna nuai ah a om hun sung theampo a sam meet ngawl tu a, a mul meet ngawl tu hi. Tua ni ma in, ama in a sam pum aap kik tu a,"},"12":{"text":"Nazirite ahi na bangin Topa tungah amate hun sia aap kik tu hi. A masa hun teng kisimsak ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile a aapsa ama ii sam sia ninsak hi. Ama in khialphel biakpiakna in kum khat a pha tuu khat keng tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Nazirite khat a kiciam hun a cin ciang ama in a zeksa teng vawt tu hi.
