Banghang ziam cile ko sia nasia takin lau khu hi; ka nuntakna atu mama in patau khu hi."},"25":{"text":"Tu in ko sia nangma thuneina nuai ah om khu hi; Tang na sak bangin ko tungah hong vawt ta'n,” ci in zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom Joshua in hi bangin vawt hi: ama in amate hung a, Israel te ii thalup tu a oai bua hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahihang tua hunin amate sia sal suaksak hi, Topa biaknatau atu le Israel mite atu thing tomsakin tui toaisak hi. Tu ni dongin Topa ii ama ih biak natu a tealsa mun pawpo ah amate in hi nasep seam tan uh hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem kumpipa Adonizedek in Joshua ii Ai khua la zo a, Jericho khua le a kumpipa a vawt bangma in, a zaancip sakna, a kumpipa a thalupna thu teng za hi. Ama in Gibeon mite sia Israel mite taw kilemna vawt a, amate taw teang khawm hi ci in za si hi.","title":"Amor te Ngallel"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem mite sia nasia takin patau uh hi, banghang ziam ci le Gibeon sia kumpi a nei khuapi lian khat pawpo cia ma pha hi; Ai sangin zongh lian zaw a, a mite zongh ngalsim thiam vive hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom Adonizedek in Hebron kumpipa Hoham, Jarmuth kumpipa Piram, Lachish kumpipa Japhia, Eglon kumpipa Debir te tungah thu puak a:"},"4":{"text":"“Hong pai tavun, Gibeon hong sim pui tavun, banghang ziam cile amate in Joshua le Israel te taw kilemna vawt hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi Amor kumpi nga ahi Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish le Eglon te kumpipa te ii ngalkap teng kingawmtua a, Gibeon khua kiim uum in sim uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Gibeon mite in Gilgal ngiaphual ah Joshua atu kam thaak a: “Topa awng, ko hong nusia heak in! A manlang in hong pai tavun a hong hu tavun! Hong hun tavun! Mualtung ngam a teang Amor kumpite theampo in a ngalkap teng ngawmtua in ko hong sim uh hi!” cisak hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom Joshua le a ngalkaphonpi bup, ngalkap phabel te kihel a, Gilgal panin kuan uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Joshua munah, “Amate kiita heak in. Keima in nang zawna hong pia zo khi hi. Amate khat zongh in nang hong nang zo ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Zankhuateakin Joshua le a ngalkaphonpi sia Gilgal pan Gibeon khua sang zuanin kuan uh a, Amor te heakkhol ngawlin sim uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Amor te sia Israel ngalkaphonpi a mu po ciang patau keaksak hi. Israel te in amate Gibeon ah a thatlup kawmin, Beth Horon mualciangh ah delsuk a, thang sangah Azekah le Makkeda dong simsuk lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Amor te mualciangh zui in Israel ngalkaphonpi mai ah a taisuk laitak, Topa in ngialtang puite Azekah lampi tawntung kiasak hi. Israel te ii thalup sangin ngialtang ii denlup tamzaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Amor te tungah Israel te zawna a piak ni in, Joshua in Topa paupui hi. Israel mai ah ama in “Ni awng, Gibeon tung san ah ding zii in; Tha awng, Aijalon Kuam tungah tawlnga in,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ni zongh tawlnga a, tha zongh Israel te ii a ngalte a zaw thal dong a kiin bua hi. Hisia sia Jashar Thubu sungah ki at hi. Ni sia van laizang ah ding zii a, ni khat bup a tum suk bua hi.","ref":"2 Sa 1:18"},"14":{"text":"Tua masia hikale a zawkciang hikale Topa in mihing khat ii thu a nit hun, tuabang ni khat om ngeingawl hi. Topa sia Israel sangah pangin ngalsim hi."},"15":{"text":"Hi sia zawkciang Joshua le a ngalkaphonpi Gilgal ngiaphual zuan kik uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Amor kumpi nga teng ahile suakta in Makkedah suanghawng sungah buu uh hi.","title":"Joshua in Amor Kumpi Nga teng Man"},"17":{"text":"Pawlkhat in amate mu a, a bukna mun Joshua hil uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in, “Suang hawng mai ah suangtum pawlkhat lumliik vun. A cing tu pawlkhat koi vun,"},"19":{"text":"ahihang noma tatak tua munah om heak vun; ngalte zuizen vun a, a nungsang pan sim vun; a khuapite ah thengsak kik heak vun! Topa na Pathian in amate tungah noma zawna hong pia zo hi,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Joshua le Israel mite in amate thatlum hi, ahihang pawlkhatte sia a khuapi luphung pangte sung sang theng thei a, kithatlum ngawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Joshua ii mite a vekpi in bangma tat ngawlin Makkedah ngiaphual, ama kungah hong cia kik uh hi. Ngam sungah a om mite kuama in Israel te sia sonsia ngam ngawl liang hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joshua in, “Suanghawng tumna sia hong keak vun a, tua kumpi nga teng ka kungah hong paipui tavun,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom suanghawng sia hong keakin, Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish le Eglon kumpipa nga teng pusua a,"},"24":{"text":"Joshua kungah paipui uh hi. Joshua in Israel mi theampo sam a, ama taw a kuankhawm ngalkap bute munah, tua kumpite ngawng ah a peang uh nga in sawl hi. Tuabangin ngamta uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaciang Joshua in a ngalkap bute munah, “Kiita heak vun a, thinkiam heak vun. Na thin khosak vun a kimuang vun, banghang ziam cile hisia in na ngalte theampo tungah Topa sep tu sia ahi hi,” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joshua in kumpi nga teng thatlum in thingkung nga tungah a luangte nitak sang dong khai uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Nitum ciangin Joshua in thupia a, amate buk maksakna suanghawng sungah a luangte lawnsak hi. Suangtum puite suanghawng tumna ah koi uh a, tuate tua munah om lai hi."},"28":{"text":"Joshua in Makkedah khua sim a, a zaw ni in a kumpipa man hi. A khua mi theampo khat zongh hingkhoai ngawlin that siat hi. Jericho kumpipa a vawt bangma in Makkedah kumpipa tungah vawt hi.","title":"Joshua in Amor Ngam La thua"},"29":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joshua le a ngalkaphonpi Makkedah panin Libnah ah pai in sim hi."},"30":{"text":"Topa in Israel te hi khuapi le a kumpipa zosak leleau hi. Amate in kuama khoaikhe ngawlin a sungah a om mi theampo thatlum siat uh hi. A kumpipa tungah Jericho kumpipa a vawt bangin amate in vawt uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joshua le a ngalkaphonpi Libnah panin Lachish ah paitanin tuasia kiim uum in sim uh hi."},"32":{"text":"A kido zawk ni nii ni ciang Topa in Israel te Lachish khua zosak hi. Libnah ah a vawt uh bangma in kuama khoaikhe ngawlin khuapi sungah a om mi theampo thatlum uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Gezer kumpipa Horam in Lachish hu tu hong pai ahihang Joshua in a ngalkaphonpi zothal in, amate kuama hingkhoai ngawl hi."},"34":{"text":"A kizomin Joshua le a ngalkaphonpi sia Lachish panin Eglon ah pai suak a, tua khua kiim uum in sim uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ni ma in a khuapi la in, tuasung ah a om theampo Lachish ah a vawt bang keak ma in thatlum uh hi,"},"36":{"text":"Hisia zawkciang Joshua le a ngalkaphonpi Eglon panin mual tungah kaato in Hebron sim uh a,"},"37":{"text":"tua khua la uh hi. A kumpipa le a dang khuapi sungah a om theampo ahi zong khua nai nate sungah a om theampo ahi zong thatlum uh hi. Joshua in tua khuapi sia Eglon a vawt lai bangma in zaancipsak hi. Kuama a hingkhoai bua hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joshua le a ngalkaphonpi sia Debir ah heak kik in, tua khua sim uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Ama in tua khua le a kumpipa, tuaciang a naina khua theampo la hi. Tua mun a om theampo thatlum siat uh hi. Hebron, tuaciang Libnah a kumpipa tungah a vawt bangin Joshua in Debir le a kumpipa tungah vawt hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ngam le lei buppi sia Joshua in zothal hi. Mualtung ngam, nisuana sang mualpanghte le nitumna sang mualpeangte ii kumpite ahizong, thangsang mun kona ngam kumpite ahizong zo siat hi. Kuama khoaikhet nei ngawlin thatlum siat hi. Hisia sia Topa Israel te ii Pathian thupiak ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Joshua ii ngalsimna sia thangsang Kadesh Barnea pan tuipi hui Gaza, Goshen ngamkhen teng kihel in, saksang pan Gibeon dong ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Joshua in hi kumpite le a ngam a lei teng theampo nawk khat in zo siat hi, banghang ziam cile Topa Israel te ii Pathian sia Israel atu in ngal sim hi."},"43":{"text":"Hisia zawkciang, Joshua le a ngalkaphonpi Gilgal ngiaphual zuan kik uh hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hazor kumpipa Jabin in Israel te ii ngalzawna thuthang a zaak ciang, ama in Madon kumpipa Jobab, Shimron kumpipa le Achshaph kumpipa,","title":"Joshua in Jabin le A Pawlpuite Zo"},"2":{"text":"saksang mualtung ngam kumpite, Galilee Tuili thangsang Jordan Kuam, mualpeangte le tuipi hui Dor nai a kumpite munah kam taw thu zasak hi."},"3":{"text":"Jordan ngun lang le lang a teang Canaan te tung le Amor te, Hit te, Periz te, mual tungah a teang Jebus te, Mizpah ngam Hermon Mual nuai a teang Hiv te munah zongh thu zasak hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in a ngalkap nei theampo — tuipivaal a, sen vui za in mihing a tam ngalkaphonpi taw kuan uh hi. Amate in ngal siphu leangte le siphute zongh tam ma nei hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi kumpi teng in a ngalkap teng ngawmtua a, Israel te sim tu in hong kuan khawm tek in, Merom Lui ah ngiaphual saat uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in Joshua munah, “Amate kiita heak in. Zing ciang tubang hunin Israel atu in amate thatlum siat tu khi hi. Noma in a siphute a peang baisak in, a siphu ngalleangte haltham tu nu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom Joshua le a mi theampo in a ngalte sia Merom Lui ah a muanmawk ngawl laitakin sim uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Israel te zawna pia hi; Israel te in ngalte sia saksang ah Misrephoth Maim le Sidon dong nisuana sang pan Mizpah kuam dong simin del uh hi. A ngalte khat zongh a nungta a om nawn ngawl dong kido tan uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Joshua in Topa thupiak bangin a siphu uhte a peang baisakin, a siphu ngalleang uhte halthapsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joshua heak kik a Hazor la in, a kumpipa thatlum hi. (Tua hun lai in Hazor sia kumpi nei ngam teng pan a hatbel ahi hi)."},"11":{"text":"Tua munah a om theampo thisak uh hi; kuama kihingkhoai ngawl a, a khuapi kihaltum hi."},"12":{"text":"Joshua in hi khuapi teng la a, kumpipate manin, Topa naseam Moses ii thupiakna bangin, mi theampo thisak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang Israel te in Joshua ii halthap Hazor khua simngawl leivumte tungah a kisa khuapite khat zongh hal ngawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel mite in hi khuapite sung pan vanh manphate le ngannote theampo amate atu in la uh hi. Ahihang amate in mihing theampo thatlum uh a, khat zongh khoaikhe ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in a naseampa Moses tungah thupia in, Moses in Joshua tungah tua thupiaknate sonsawn a, Joshua in ni hi. Ama in Topa ii Moses thu a piak theampo vawt hi."},"16":{"text":"Joshua in ngam le lei theampo — la hi, mualtung ngam le mualpeangte ii sak le thang, Goshen ngam theampo le a thangsang kongaw ngam teng le Jordan ngun kuam teng la hi.","title":"Ngam le Lei Joshua ii Laakte"},"17":{"text":"A ngam sia thangsang Edom hui Halak Mual panin kithungsuk a, saksangah Baalgad, Lebanon leikuam sung Hermon Mual thangsang dong zai hi. Joshua sia hi ngam a kumpite taw khuangeipi ma kisim ahihang tuate la in amate thatlum siat hi.","merge":"18"},"19":{"text":"Israel te taw kilemna a vawt khuapi khat bek sia Gibeon hi a, tua munah Hiv te teang hi. A dang khuapite theampo sia kidona sungah kizo thal hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in amate sia Israel te a do natu a thin khosak mama a, tua in a lalcip natu le hesuak ngawlin a kithalup siat natu ahi hi. Hi sia in Topa ii Moses tungah thu a piaksa ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 7:16"},"21":{"text":"Hisia hun in Joshua pai a, Judah le Israel mualtung ngam theampo — Hebron, Debir, Anab le tua mualtung ngam theampo sungah a teang thatang lian mama Anakim a cite minam sia mongsak siat hi. Joshua in amate le a khuapi te a lalcip dipdeap dong susia hi."},"22":{"text":"Anakim te khat zongh Israel ngam sungah om nawn ngawl hi; ahihang tawm khawng sia Gaza, Gath le Ashdod ah taanglai hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa ii Moses a thu piaksa bangma in Joshua in ngam le lei bup la hi. Joshua in tua ngam sia Israel mite neisa tu in pia a, amate in nam sim khat tek khen in hawm hi. Tuabangin a mite sia ngal simna panin tawlnga uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite in ngal teng zo thal zo in Jordan nisuana Arnon Kuam pan Jordan Kuam le saksang Hermon Mual dong ngam le lei la hi. Amate in hi kumpipate nii zo hi.","title":"Moses ii A zaw Kumpite"},"2":{"text":"Khat sia Amor te kumpipa Sihon hi a Heshbon ah maang hi. Ama ii kumpi ngam sia Gilead ii a ngam lang kihel hi: Aroer (Arnon kuam ii kiil a om) le a kuam laizang a om khuapi pan Amon ngamngi Jabbok ngun dong ahi hi;"},"3":{"text":"tua ii sungah Jordan Kuam, Galilee tuili ii thang pan Beth Jeshimoth (Tuipi Thi ii nisuana sang) dong, tuaciang Pisgah Mual ii mualpeang sang teng kihel hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in Rephaim nam pan a khakbel ahi Bashan kumpipa Og zongh zo uh hi; ama sia Ashtaroth le Edrei ah maang hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama ii kumpi ngam ah Hermon Mual, Salecah, tuaciang Bashan ngam theampo Geshur le Maacah ngamngite dong le Gilead ngam lang khen, Heshbon kumpipa Sihon ii ngam dong kihel hi.","ref":"Mi 21:21-35; Thkna 2:26—3:11"},"6":{"text":"Hi kumpite nii sia Moses le Israel te in zo hi. Topa naseampa Moses in amate ngam sia Reuben nam, Gad nam le Manasseh nam a langte tungah amate ngam le lei tu in pia hi.","ref":"Mi 32:33; Thkna 3:12"},"7":{"text":"Joshua le Israel mite in Jordan nitumna ngam, Lebanon kuam sung Baalgad pan thangsang Edom hui Halak Mual dong a kumpipate theampo zo siat hi. Joshua in hi ngam le lei sia a minamte atu in hawmsak in a kip a kho neisa tu in pia hi.","title":"Joshua ii A zaw Kumpite"},"8":{"text":"Hi ngamkhenna sungah mualtung ngam, nitumna sang mualpeangte, nisuana susuk le thangsang kongaw ngam teng kihel hi. Hi ngam le lei sia Hit te, Amor te, Canaan te, Periz te, Hiv te, Jebus te ii teenna hi ngei hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel mite in hi kumpite ii khuapi hi teng zo siat uh hi: Ai (Bethel khua hui),"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem, Hebron,"},"11":{"text":"Jarmuth, Lachish,"},"12":{"text":"Eglon, Gezer,"},"13":{"text":"Debir, Geder,"},"14":{"text":"Hormah, Arad,"},"15":{"text":"Libnah, Adullam,"},"16":{"text":"Makkedah, Bethel,"},"17":{"text":"Tappuah, Hepher,"},"18":{"text":"Aphek, Lasharon,"},"19":{"text":"Madon, Hazor,"},"20":{"text":"Shimron Meron, Achshaph,"},"21":{"text":"Taanach, Megiddo,"},"22":{"text":"Kedesh, Jokneam (Carmel ngam sungah)"},"23":{"text":"Dor (Tuipi hui ah), Goiim (Galilee ngam sungah)"},"24":{"text":"le Tirzah — a vekpi kingawm kumpi 31 ahi hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joshua sia tu in huai mama zo hi. Topa in ama munah, “Nang huai mama zo ni hi, ahihang ngam le lei tam mama laak tu om lai hi:","title":"A Kila lai tu Ngamte"},"2":{"text":"Philistia le Geshur te ngam theampo,"},"3":{"text":"thang sangah Avvim te ngam theampo zongh ahi hi. (Shihor lui pan Egypt te ngamngi dong, saksang pan Ekron te ngamngi dong leitang teng sia Canaan te ngam in kingaisun hi; Philistine kumpite sia Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, le Ekron ah teang hi.)"},"4":{"text":"Canaan te ngam theampo le Mearah (Sidon te neisa hi) om lai a, Amor te ngamngi a om Aphek dong hi a;"},"5":{"text":"Gebal te ii ngam; nisuana ah Lebanon bup, Hermon Mual ii thangsang Baalgad pan Hamaath Mualciangh dong ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hisia Lebanon Mualte le Misrephoth Maim kilaklaw mualtung ngam a teang Sidon te ngam theampo kihel hi. Israel mite a mai sang a nawk kawmin hi mite theampo ka notkhia tu hi. Kong sawl sa bangma in ngam le lei te sia Israel mite sungah na hawmsak tu uh hi.","ref":"Mi 33:54"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahiciang tu in, Israel nam kua le Manasseh ii nam a lang teng ii tan tu in hawmsak in” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Reuben le Gad nam te le Manasseh ii nam a lang teng in Topa naseampa Moses ii piaksa ngam le lei tek nga zo a; tuasia Jordan ngun ii nisuana sangah om hi.","title":"Jordan Nisuana sang Ngamte A Hawmna","ref":"Mi 32:33; Thkna 3:12"},"9":{"text":"Amate ii ngam sia Aroer (Arnon Kuam ii kiil ah a om) le tua kuam ii laizang a om khuapi dong zai a, Medeba pan Dibon dong mual zaangtam theampo kihel hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuasia Ammon te ngamngi dong hi a, Heshbon pan a uk Amor te kumpipa Sihon ii khuapi theampo zongh kihel siat hi."},"11":{"text":"Gilead, Geshur le Maacah ngamte, Hermon Mual bup le, Bashan bup Salecah dong kihel hi."},"12":{"text":"Ashtaroth le Edrei panin a uk Rephaim kumpi nam a khakbel ahi Og ii kumpi ngam kihel hi. Moses in hi mite sia zo in notkeak hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang Israel te in Geshur le Maacah mite not ngawl uh a; amate Israel ngam ah teang lai uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Moses in Levi nam sia ngam le lei a pia bua hi. Topa ii Moses tungah a sonsa bangma in Israel ii Topa Pathian biakpiakna tau tungah a hal sangaw biakpiaknate sung pan tel khat sia amate in tang tu hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:1"},"15":{"text":"Moses in ngam khen khat sia Reuben ii nam innkuante tan tu in pia hi.","title":"Reuben Suante atu A kipia Ngam"},"16":{"text":"Amate ngam sia Aroer (Arnon Kuam kiil a om) le tua kuam laizang a om khuapi dong hi a Medeba mual zaangtam kiim teng kihel hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuasia sungah Heshbon le mual zaangtam tung a om khuapite: Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baalmeon,"},"18":{"text":"Zahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,"},"19":{"text":"Kiriathaim, Sibmah, tua kuam sung mual tung a om Zereth Shahar,"},"20":{"text":"Bethpeor, Pisgah Mual pangh suk teng le Beth Jeshimoth kihel hi."},"21":{"text":"Heshbon pan a uk Amor te kumpipa Sihon kumpi ngam bup le mual zaangtam a om khuapite kihel hi. Moses in ama zo a, Midian a ukte: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur le Reba te zongh zo hi. Amate theampo in Kumpipa Sihon atu in ngam uk uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Israel te ii thalupte sungah Beor tapa Balaam, aisaan thei pa kihel hi."},"23":{"text":"Jordan sia Reuben nam ii nitumna ngamngi ahi hi. Hi khuapite le khuate sia Reuben nam innkuante tan tu in kipia hi."},"24":{"text":"Moses in zongh ngam khen khat sia Gad nam innkuante tan tu in a piaksa hi.","title":"Gad Nam atu A kipia Ngam"},"25":{"text":"Amate ii ngam sia, Jazer le Gilead khuapi theampo, Ammon ngam a lang, Rabbah ii nisuana sang Aroer dong ahi hi;"},"26":{"text":"amate ngam sia Heshbon panin Ramath Mizpeh le Betonim dong, Mahanaim pan Lodebar ngamngi dongin kithung hi."},"27":{"text":"Jordan Kuam sungah Beth Haram, Bethnimrah, Sukkoth, le Zaphon, Heshbon kumpipa Sihon ii kumpi ngam a om lai teng ahi hi. Amate ii nitumna sang ngamngi sia Jordan ngun hi a, saksang ah Galilee Tuili dong hi to hi."},"28":{"text":"Hite sia Gad nam innkuante tan tu a kipia khuapite le khuate ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in Manasseh nam a lang ii innkuante tan tu in ngamkhen khat a piaksa hi.","title":"Nisuana Manasseh atu A kipia Ngam"},"30":{"text":"Amate ngam sia Mahanaim dong kithung a, Bashan theampo huam hi — Bashan kumpipa Og ii kumpi ngam bup le Bashan sungah Jair khuano 60 teng ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Bashan kumpipa Og ii kumpi ngamsung khuapi thupibel te Astaroth le Edrei, le Gilead ngam khenlang zongh tua ii sungah kihel hi. Hite theampo sia Manasseh tapa Machir ii suan innkuan te ii lang atu a kipia ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuasia Jericho le Jordan nisuana sang ngam le lei teng Moses ii Moab zaangtam ah a om lai in a khensakna bang ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahihang Moses in Levi nam sia leitang a pia bua hi. Israel ii Topa Pathian tungah a piak biakpiaknate sung pan tel khat amate ii neisa ahi sia ama sonsa hi.","ref":"Mi 18:20; Thkna 18:2"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jordan nitumna sang Canaan ngam le lei, Israel mite sungah a kihawmna thu a nuai a bangin kizom hi. Thiampi Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua le Israel nam innkuante ii lampuite in tuasia a mite teng tungah hawmsak hi.","title":"Jordan Nitumna sang Ngam Hawmna"},"2":{"text":"Topa ii Moses tungah a thupiak bangma in nam kua le nam lang te ii nga tu ngamte sia laimee sawkin khensat uh hi.","ref":"Mi 26:52-56; 34:13"},"3":{"text":"Moses in Jordan nisuana ngam sia nam nii le namlangte atu a seesak sa hi. (Joseph ii suante sia Manasseh nam le Ephraim nam ci in nam nii in kikhen hi.) Ahihang Moses in Levi te sia ngam bangma a pia bua hi. Tua taangin a teen natu khuapite, a khui le a tuu honte tat natu lote nga hi.","ref":"Mi 32:33; 34:14-15; Thkna 3:12-17","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Israel mite in Topa ii Moses tung a thupiak bangin ngam khen uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Judah nam pan mihing pawlkhat sia Gilgal, Joshua kungah hong pai hi. Amate sung pan khat Keniz mi Jephunneh tapa Caleb in, “Kadesh Barnea ah Topa in nang le kei huvau Pathian mihing ahi Moses tungah a ci teng na heak hi.","title":"Hebron sia Caleb atu Kipia","ref":"Mi 14:30"},"7":{"text":"Topa naseampa Moses ii hi ngam a vil ku tu hong paisak lai in kei sia kum sawmli ka pha zo hi. Ahi bang tatak teng ama tungah thu ka puak kik hi.","ref":"Mi 13:1-30"},"8":{"text":"Kei taw a paikhawm pasal dangte in ahile ih mite lauthawn hi. Ahihang keima in Topa ka Pathian thu ka mang hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuabang ka ngamtat hu in, Moses in kamciam hong piakna pan, ka paina sa ngam le lei sia kei le ka tate neisa in hong kipia tu ci hi.","ref":"Mi 14:24"},"10":{"text":"Ahihang tu in en in! Topa in Moses tungah a ci sia tu in kum sawmli le kum nga pha zo hi. Tuasia Israel te ii sennealngam kaantan in a pai hun hi a, tuaciang Topa in ama kamciam bangma hong nungtasak lai hi. Hong en ta'n! Kum sawmliat le kum nga pha khi hi,"},"11":{"text":"Moses ii hong paisak lai bangma in thahat ngawp lai khi hi, ngal sim tu ahizong bangdang khat po seam tu ahizong naap lai khi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka ngalvilpui pasalte taw thu ka puak ni in, Topa kei hong kamciamsa mualtung ngam teng, tu in hong pia ta'n. Tuasia lai in Anakim a kici thatang lian mama minamte sia luphung taw a ki uum khuapite sungah teang hi ci in kong son uh hi. Topa sia kei taw hong omkhawm po tahen, Topa ci bangma in amate ka hawlkhia tu hi,” ka ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Joshua in Jephunneh tapa, Caleb thupha pia in Hebron khuapi sia ama tan tu in pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Hebron khuapi sia Keniz mi Jephunneh tapa Caleb suante ii neisa in om lai hi, banghang ziam cile ama in Topa, Israel ii Pathian tung thumaan in a thu ni hi."},"15":{"text":"A masa in Hebron sia Arba khuapi kici hi (Arba sia Anakim te sung pan a lianbel ahi hi). Ngam sungah tu in kilemna om hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah nam innkuante in a nuai a, a kison bangin ngam le lei khen khat nga hi: Tua leitang sia Zin duisung thangsang khakbel mun Edom te ngamngi dong kithungsuk hi.","title":"Judah Minamte A kipia Ngam"},"2":{"text":"Hi thangsang ngamngi sia Tuipi Thi thangsang mong panin,"},"3":{"text":"Akrabbin Mualciangh zui suk a, Zin ah sun hi. Tuasia Kadesh Barnea thang sangah paisuk a, Hezron kaantan in Addar dong, Karka sangah kiheak a,"},"4":{"text":"Azmon sangah paitanin, Egypt ngamngi ah a luang lui sia zui a, Mediterranean Tuipi ah a ngamngi tawp hi. Tuasia Judah thangsang ngamngi hi."},"5":{"text":"Nisuana sang ngamngi sia Tuipi Thi hi a, Jordan ngun ii tumna dong tuipi hui to teng ahi hi. A saksang ngamngi sia tua mun panin kipan a,"},"6":{"text":"Beth Hoglah dong kithungin Jordan Kuam etsuk theina mualbawk saksang ah pai hi. Tua zawkciang Bohan ii Suangphuna ah (Bohan sia Reuben ii tapa hi) paito hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngimna Kuam panin Debir ah, tua zawkciang saksang ah kiheak a, tua kuam ii thangsang a om Adummim Mualciangh sia a maingat Gilgal sang sun hi. Tua zawkciang Enshemesh ciktuite ah paitanin, tua mun pan Enrogel ah paisuak hi,"},"8":{"text":"tuaciang Jebus te khuapi Jerusalem omna mual ii thang Hinnom Kuam kaantan to hi. Tua zawkciang ngamngi sia Rephaim Kuam saksang mong, Hinnom Kuam ii nitumna a om mual dawn dong paito suak hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua mun pan Nephtoah Ciktui te ah pai in, Ephron mual nai a om khuapite ah paitan hi. Tua mun panin Baalah (ahibuale Kiriath Jearim) sangah kiheak a,"},"10":{"text":"tua mun Baalah mual saksang ah paisuak in, nitumna sang teng kiimveal a, Edom mualtung ngam sangah, Jearim mual (ahibuale Chesalon) saksang ah paisuak in, tua mun pan Beth Shemesh ah paisuk a, Timnah kaantan hi."},"11":{"text":"Ngamngi sia Ekron saksang mual ah paisuak a, Shikkeron sangah kiheak in, Baalah Mual kaantan hi, tuaciang Jamnia ah paitan hi. Tuasia Mediterranean Tuipi ah tawp a,"},"12":{"text":"tua in a nitumna sang ngamngi ahi hi. Hi ngamngite ii huam sung sangah Judah innkuante ii mi teng teang hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in Joshua a thupiak bangma in Judah nam Jephunneh tapa Caleb tungah Judah ngamkhen khat kipia hi. Ama in Anak ii pa Arba ii khuapi Hebron nga hi.","title":"Caleb in Hebron le Debir Zothal (Thukhente 1:11-15)","ref":"Thkte 1:20"},"14":{"text":"Caleb in Anak ii suan le paal te khuapi panin hawlkhia hi — tuate sia Shesai, Ahiman le Talmai bee le phungte hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua mun pan ama in Debir a teang mite sim hi. (Hi khuapi sia Kiriath Sepher kici ngei hi)."},"16":{"text":"Caleb in, “Kiriath Sepher a la zo pa sia a zi tu in ka tanu Achsah ka pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Caleb suapuipa Kenaz ii tapa Othniel in tua khuapi la zo ahikom Caleb in a tanu Achsah sia a zi tu in pia hi."},"18":{"text":"A kiteen ni in Othniel in a zi tungah a pa tung pan lo khat ngen in ci in sawl hi. A tanu sia a laa tung pan tuaksuk a, tuaciang Celeb in bang dei ni ziam ci in dongh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in, “Tuicing pawlkhat omna mun dei khi hi, leitang nong piakte sia munko hi thong hi,” ci in zo hi. Tua ahikom Caleb in ciktui omna a thunghsang le a dopsang teng pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Judah nam innkuante ii nga, ngam le lei sia hi teng ahi hi.","title":"Judah te ii Khuapite"},"21":{"text":"Amate ii neisa a thangsang khakbel khuapite, Edom ngamngi taw a kinai teng sia Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,"},"22":{"text":"Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,"},"23":{"text":"Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,"},"24":{"text":"Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,"},"25":{"text":"Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (ahibuale Hazor),"},"26":{"text":"Amam, Shema, Moladah,"},"27":{"text":"Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Bethpelet,"},"28":{"text":"Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,"},"29":{"text":"Baalah, Iim, Ezem,"},"30":{"text":"Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,"},"31":{"text":"Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,"},"32":{"text":"Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain le Rimmon hi a: a kiim a om khuate taw a vekpi in khuapi 29 pha hi."},"33":{"text":"Mualpeang ah a om khuapite sia, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,"},"34":{"text":"Zanoah, Engannim, Tappuah, Enam,"},"35":{"text":"Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,"},"36":{"text":"Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah le Gederothaim hi a: a kiim a om khuate taw khuapi sawm le li pha hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuasung zongh ah, Zenan, Hadashah, Migdalgad,"},"38":{"text":"Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,"},"39":{"text":"Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,"},"40":{"text":"Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,"},"41":{"text":"Gederoth, Bethdagon, Naamah le Makkedah hi a: a kiim a om khuate taw a vekpi khuapi sawm le luk pha hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuasung ah a om a dang pan Libnah, Ether, Ashan,"},"43":{"text":"Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,"},"44":{"text":"Keilah, Achzib le Mareshah hi a: a kiim a om khuate taw khuapi kua pha hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuasung ah Ekron sia a khuate le a khuanote taw om hi,"},"46":{"text":"tuaciang Ashdod nai, Ekron pan Mediterranean Tuipi dong a, a om khuapite le khuate theampo ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Tualai ah Ashdod le Gaza om a, tuate ii khuate le khuanote taw om a, Egypt ngamngi ahi lui le Mediterranean Tuipi vaalbo dong ahi hi."},"48":{"text":"Mualtung ngam ah Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,"},"49":{"text":"Dannah, Kiriath Sepher (ahibuale Debir)"},"50":{"text":"Anab, Eshtemoa, Anim,"},"51":{"text":"Goshen, Holon le Giloh om a: a kiim a om khuate taw khuapi sawm le khat pha hi."},"52":{"text":"Tuate sungah Arab, Dumah, Eshan,"},"53":{"text":"Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,"},"54":{"text":"Humtah, Hebron le Zior om a: a kiim a om khuate taw khuapi kua ahi hi."},"55":{"text":"Tuate sungah Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,"},"56":{"text":"Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,"},"57":{"text":"Kain, Gibeah le Timnah om a: a kiim a om khuate taw khuapi sawm ahi hi."},"58":{"text":"Tualai ah Halhul, Bethzur, Gedor,"},"59":{"text":"Maarath, Bethanoth le Eltekon om a: a kiim a om khuate taw khuapi luk ahi hi."},"60":{"text":"Kiriath Baal (ahibuale Kiriath Jearim) le Rabbah om a: a kiim a om khuate taw khuapi nii ahi hi."},"61":{"text":"Sennealngam sungah Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,"},"62":{"text":"Ci khuapi Nibshan le Engedi om a: a kiim a om khuate taw khuapi luk ahi hi."},"63":{"text":"Ahihang Judah mite in Jerusalem a teang Jebus te notkeak zo ngawl hi. Tualai ah Jebus te sia Judah mite taw teang lai uh hi.","ref":"Thkte 1:21; 2 Sa 5:6; 1 Khang 11:4"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joseph suan le paalte a kipia ngam le lei ii thangsang ngamngi sia Jericho hui Jordan panin kipan a, Jericho cikte ii nisuana sangah pai in sennealngam sung sun hi. Jericho pan Bethel dong mualtung ngam ah paito hi.","title":"Ephraim le Nitumna sang Manassehte atu A kipia Ngam"},"2":{"text":"Bethel pan a ngamngi sia Luz ah pai a, Ataroth Addar, Archit te teenna kaantan hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua zawkciang nitumna Japhlet te ii ngam ah pai a, Beth Horon Nuainung ngam dong pai hi. Tua mun panin Gezer ah paisuakin tuaciang Mediterranean Tuipi ah tawp hi."},"4":{"text":"Joseph ii suan le paalte Ephraim nam le nitumna Manasseh namte in hi ngam sia amate ii neisa in saang uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ephraim innkuante ii ngam sia hisia ahi hi: a ngamngi paizia sia, Ataroth Addar pan nisuana sangah Beth Horon Tungnung ah,","title":"Ephraim"},"6":{"text":"tua mun panin Mediterranean Tuipi dong ahi hi. Michmethath sia a saksang ah om hi. Tua ii nisuana sangah ngamngi sia Taanath Shiloh sangah koai a, tuasia kaantan in nisuana sang Janoah dong paitan hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zawkciang paisuk a Janoah pan Ataroth le Naarah ah, Jericho pha in Jordan ah tawp hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngamngi sia Tappuah pan nitumna sang Kanah lui ah pai in Mediterranean Tuipi ah tawp hi. Hi leitang sia Ephraim nam innkuante tan tu in kipia a,"},"9":{"text":"Manasseh ngamngite ii sungsang a om khuate le khuano pawlkhat taw kopin Ephraim te kipia khawm hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang amate in Canaan mi Gezer a teangte sia notkeak ngawl ahikom Canaan mite sia Ephraim mite sungah tu ni dong teang khawm uh hi, ahihang amate sia salte bangin na kiseamsak hi.","ref":"Thkte 1:29"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jordan ii nitumna sang leitang khen khat sia Joseph ii tapa lianzaw Manasseh suan innkuan pawlkhat tan tu in kipia hi. Gilead ii pa Machir sia Manasseh tapa lianbel hi a, ngalhang khat ahi hi, tua ahikom Jordan nisuana sang Gilead le Bashan sia ama kipia hi.","title":"Nitumna sang Manasseh"},"2":{"text":"Jordan nitumna sang leitang sia Manasseh innkuan dang teng: Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher le Shemida te kipia hi. Hite sia Joseph tapa Manasseh suan pasalte hi a, a innkuan tek ii pabel veu ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Zelophehad sia Hepher tapa hi a, a pu Gilead, Machir, Manasseh te ii suan hi, ahizong ama in tapa nei ngawlin tanu bebek nei hi. Amate min sia Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, le Tirzah ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate sia thiampi Eleazar le Nun ii tapa Joshua le lampuite kungah pai in, “ Topa in Moses tungah, koma le ka mealheak pate zongh ii ka tan tu uh leitang khen khat hong kipiak natu thupia hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom, Topa sawl bangma in, amate sia a mealheakte taw leitang kipia khawm hi.","ref":"Mi 27:1-7"},"5":{"text":"Tua hu in Manasseh in Jordan Ngun ii nisuana sangah Gilead le Bashan belapna in leitang tel sawm nga hi,"},"6":{"text":"ama suan le paal numeite le pate tel a kipiak khop hang ahi hi. Gilead ngam le lei sia Manasseh suan a taang laite kipia hi."},"7":{"text":"Manasseh ngam sia Shechem nisuana sang Asher pan Michmethath dong ban hi. Tua zawkciang ngamngi sia Entappuah mite sungsuam tu in thangsang ah pai hi."},"8":{"text":"Tappuah ii kiim a leitangte sia Manasseh neisa hi, ahizong Tappuah khua, ngamngi tung a om sia Ephraim suante neisa ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngamngi sia tua mun pan Kanah lui dong paisuk hi. A ngam sia Manasseh ngamsung ahisaap hang lui ii thangsang a om khuapite sia Ephraim te neisa ahi hi. Manasseh ngamngi sia lui ii saksang ah paitan a, Mediterranean Tuipi ah tawp hi."},"10":{"text":"Ephraim sia thang sangah, Manasseh sia saksang ah om a, Mediterranean Tuipi sia amate ii nitumna sang ngamngi hi."},"11":{"text":"Issachar le Asher ngamte ii sungsang ah Manasseh in Beth Shan le Ibleam, a kiim a om khuate taw, tuaciang Dor (tuipi hui a om sia), Endor, Taanach, Megiddo le a kiim a khuate taw zongh nei hi."},"12":{"text":"Manasseh mite in tua khuapite ah a teang mite not zo ngawl ahikom Canaan mite sia tuasung ah teang suak uh hi.","ref":"Thkte 1:27-28"},"13":{"text":"Israel te a hat zawk hun ciang ngawngawn in Canaan mi theampo notkeak ngawl uh hi, ahizong amate atu in zawthawk thu taw naseamsak uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Joseph suan le paalte in Joshua munah, “Banghangin ko neisa tu leitang khen khat bek hong pia ni ziam? Topa in thupha hong pia a, ko mihing tam mama pha khu hi,” ci uh hi.","title":"Ephraim le Nitumna sang Manasseh te in Ngam Ngen thua"},"15":{"text":"Joshua in, “No mihing tam mama a Ephraim mualtung ngam sia no atu no leih ahile Periz te le Rephaim te ngam a thingtang sungah pai in noma atu in vaat tavun,” ci in zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in, “Mualtung ngam sia ko atu lian ngawlin kicing zo ngawl hi, ahihang zaanglei a teang Beth Shan le a kiim khuate le, Jazreel Kuam sungah teangte Canaan te in thik siphu ngalleang nei tek uh hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"17":{"text":"Joshua in Ephraim nam le nitumna Manasseh nam tungah, “No sia tam mama takpi a, hat zongh hat mama nu hi. Tel khat sangin a tamzaw nga tu nu hi."},"18":{"text":"Mualtung ngam sia no neisa hi tu hi. Duithuk hikale na vaat tham tu uh a mong khat pan mong langkhat dong la in tang tu nu hi. Canaan mite ahile thik siphu ngalleang te nei in a hat mite ahitazong hawlkhia tu nu hi,” ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngam a zawthal zawk uh ciang Israel taangpi bup sia Shiloh ah kikhawm in, Topa ompuina Puanbuk sa uh hi.","title":"Ngam le lei A taanglai teng Hawmna"},"2":{"text":"Amate tel saan tu leitang a piak ngawl lai Israel mite nam sali om lai hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom Joshua in Israel te mun ah, “ Topa, na taanghpupite ii Pathian ii hong piaksa ngam le lei sia va pai in na laak uh ma in bang tanvei ngak tu nu ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Noma nam sim panin mihing thum veu hong pia tavun. Ngam bup sungah ka vaksak kawkoai tu a, amate ii neisa tu in a dei uh ngam le lei ii ngamlim ka suaisak tu hi. Tua zawkciang amate kei kungah hong heak kik tu hi."},"5":{"text":"A ngam sia khen sali kisua tu hi; Judah sia thangsang a ngam sungah om tu a, Joseph sia saksang a ngam sungah om tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Hi ngam khen salite ii thu hong at tavun a, ka kungah hong paipui tavun. Tuasia ciang laimee sawkin Topa ih Pathian tungah no atu in thu ka dongh tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Levi te ahile no a dangte bangin leitang tel a saang buatu hi, banghang ziam cile amate tel sia Topa ii thiampi a sepna ahi hi. Tuaciang Gad, Reuben le Nisuana Manasseh namte in, Topa naseampa Moses ii Jordan nisuana ngam a piaksa sia nga zo hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Tua pasalte ngamlim suai tu in a pai ciang, Joshua in hi bangin thupia hi: “Ngamsung theampo ah va pai tavun a, ngamlim na suai zawk uh ciang ka kungah hong cia kik tavun. Tuaciang hi lai Shiloh ah Topa kong dongh tu a, no atu in laimee ka sawk tu hi.”"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom pasalte sia ngamsung mun theampo ah vak a, khen sali in a khenna lai taw at in, khua om teng min zong ngual uh hi. Tua zawkciang amate sia Shiloh ngiaphual, Joshua kungah heak kik uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Joshua in amate atu laimee sawk in Topa dongh hi, a taanglai Israel namte khat sim tungah leitang khen khat tek pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Benjamin nam sung innkuan te ii neisa ngam sia a khatna in kipia hi. Amate ngam sia Judah le Joseph namte ii kilaklaw ah om hi.","title":"Benjamin A kipia Ngam"},"12":{"text":"Saksang ah a ngamngi sia Jordan panin kipan a Jericho saksang munkhamna ah paito a, mualtung ngam nitumna sang kaantan in Bethaven sennealngam dong ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ngamngi sia tua mun pan thangsang munkhamna ah paisuk a, Luz (Bethel zongh kici) pangh ah, tua zawkciang Beth Horon Nuainung ii thangsang mual tungah a om Ataroth Addar dong paisuk hi."},"14":{"text":"Ngamngi sia tua mun pan mundang khat ah pai a, hi mual ii nitumna pangh panin thang sangah kiheak in, Judah nam ii neisa Kiriath Baal (ahibuale Kiriath Jearim) dong ahi hi. Hi sia nitumna sang ngamngi hi."},"15":{"text":"Thangsang ngamngi sia Kiriath Jearim ngammong panin kipan a Nephtoah ciktui sun hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua mun pan paisuk a, Rephaim Kuam saksang mong Hinnom Kuam etsuk theina mualpeang ah paisuk hi. Tua mun pan Hinnom Kuam kaantan in thangsang ah paisuk a, Jebus mualbawk ii thangsang Enrogel sang sun hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua mun panin saksang ah kiheak in Enshemesh sangah, tuaciang Adumim Mualciangh ii langkhat Geliloth ah paitan hi. Ngamngi sia Bohan Suangphu (Bohan sia Reuben ii tapa khat hi) ah paisuk hi,"},"18":{"text":"tuaciang Jordan Kuam a kimu suk thei mualbawk saksia ah kaantan hi. Tua mun pan mualkuam sungah paisuk in,"},"19":{"text":"Beth Hoglah mualbawk saksang kaantan in pai a, Jordan Ngun ii tumna mun Tuipi Thi saksang ah tawp hi. Hisia sia a thangsang ngamngi hi."},"20":{"text":"Jordan sia nisuana ngamngi hi. Hiteng sia Benjamin nam innkuante nga tu ngam ii ngamngite ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Benjamin nam innkuante ii a nga khuapite sia Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,"},"22":{"text":"Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,"},"23":{"text":"Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,"},"24":{"text":"Chepharammoni, Ophni, le Geba hi a; khuapi sawm le nii le a kiim a khuate zongh ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"A dang khuapite sia Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,"},"26":{"text":"Mizpah, Chephirah, Mozah,"},"27":{"text":"Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,"},"28":{"text":"Zela, Haeleph, Jebus (ahibuale Jerusalem) Gibeah le Kiriath Jearim hi a: khuapi sawm le li le a kiim a om khuate taw ahi hi. Hi ngam sia Benjamin nam innkuante ii nga ngam ahi hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A niina a kipia sia Simeon nam innkuante atu hi. A ngam sia Judah nam atu a kipia ngam sungah kithungsuk hi.","title":"Simeon atu A kipia Ngam"},"2":{"text":"Tuasung ah Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah,"},"3":{"text":"Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,"},"4":{"text":"Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,"},"5":{"text":"Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,"},"6":{"text":"Beth Lebaoth le Sharuhen kihel a: a kiim a khuate taw khuapi sawm le thum ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaban ah, Ain, Rimmon, Ether le Ashan om a: khuapi li le a kiim a khuate taw ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hi khuapite kiim ah a om khuate theampo kihel a thang sangah Baalath Beer (ahibuale Ramah) dong ahi hi. Hi ngam sia Simeon nam innkuante ii nga ngam ahi hi.","ref":"1 Khang 4:28-33"},"9":{"text":"Judah a kipia sia amate kisapna sangin lianzaw ahikom a ngam khen khat Simeon nam kipia hi."},"10":{"text":"A thumna a kipia sia Zebulun nam innkuante atu hi. Amate nga leitang sia Sarid dong ban hi.","title":"Zebulun atu a kipia Ngam"},"11":{"text":"Tua mun panin ngamngi sia nitumna sang Mareal ah pai in, Dabbesheth le Jokneam nisuana ah a om lui sia ban hi."},"12":{"text":"Sarid ii langkhat panin nisuana Chisloth Tabor te ngamngi ah, tua zawkciang Daberath le Japhia dong pai hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua mun pan nisuana sangah paisuak a, Gath Hepher le Ethkazin ah, tuaciang Neah sangah kiheak in, Rimmon paina sang zuan hi."},"14":{"text":"Saksang ngamngi sia Hannathon sangah kiheak, Iphtahel Kuam ah tawp hi."},"15":{"text":"A ngam sungah Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah le Bethlehem kihel a: a kiim a khuate taw kopin khuapi sawm le nii ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Hi khuapite le a khuate sia Zebulun nam innkuante ii a nga ngam sia sungah om hi."},"17":{"text":"A lina ah a kipia sia Issachar nam innkuante atu ahi hi.","title":"Issachar atu A kipia Ngam"},"18":{"text":"A ngam sungah Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,"},"19":{"text":"Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,"},"20":{"text":"Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,"},"21":{"text":"Remeth, Engannim, Enhaddah le Bethpazzez te kihel hi."},"22":{"text":"Ngamngi sia zong Tabor, Shahazumah le Beth Shemesh ban a, Jordan ah tawp hi. A kiim a om khuate taw khuapi sawm le luk ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Hi khuapi te le a khuate sia Issachar nam sung a innkuante neisa tu in a nga ngam sungah om hi."},"24":{"text":"A ngana a kipia sia Asher nam innkuante atu ahi hi.","title":"Asher atu a kipia Ngam"},"25":{"text":"Tua ngam ah Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,"},"26":{"text":"Allam Melech, Amad le Mishal kihel hi. Nitumna sangah a ngamngi in Carmel le Shihor Libnath baan hi."},"27":{"text":"Nisuana sang a zot ciang, ngamngi sia Bethdagon ah pai in, Zebulun le Iphtahel Kuam baan in saksang Bethemek le Neiel ah pai hi. Tuasia a saksang Cabul,"},"28":{"text":"Ebron, Rehob, Hammon le Kanah, Sidon dong paisuak hi."},"29":{"text":"Ngamngi sia Ramah ah kiheak a, a khua kulhpi taw a ki uum Tyre dong theng hi; tua mun pan Hosah ah kiheak a, Mediterranean Tuipi ah tawp hi. A ngam sia Mahalab, Achzib,"},"30":{"text":"Ummah, Aphek le Rehob kihel a: khuapi kulh le nii le a kiim khuate taw ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Hi khuapite le a khuate sia Asher nam innkuante neisa tu in a nga ngam sungah om hi."},"32":{"text":"A lukna a kipia ngam sia Naphtali nam innkuante atu ahi hi.","title":"Naphtali Minamte atu A kipia Ngam"},"33":{"text":"A ngamngi sia Heleph pan pai a, Zaanannim ah a po oak thingkung ah, Adaminekeb le Jamnia ah, tuaciang Lakkum dong paitanin Jordan ngun ah tawp hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua mun pan ngamngi sia nitumna sangah kiheak a, Aznoth Tabor ah, tua mun pan Hukkok ah, tuaciang thang sangah Zebulun, nitumna sangah Asher, nisuana sangah Jordan taw kipha hi."},"35":{"text":"Kulhpi taw ki uum a khuapite sia Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,"},"36":{"text":"Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,"},"37":{"text":"Kedesh, Edrei, Enhazor,"},"38":{"text":"Yiron, Migdalel, Horem, Bethanath le Beth Shemesh hi a: a kiim khuate taw kopin khuapi sawm le kua ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Hi khuapite le a khuate sia Naphtali nam innkuante neisa tu in a kipia ngam sungah om hi."},"40":{"text":"A sali na a kipia ngam sia Dan nam innkuante atu ahi hi.","title":"Dan atu A kipia Ngam"},"41":{"text":"A ngam sia Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,"},"42":{"text":"Shaalbim, Aijalon, Ithlah,"},"43":{"text":"Elon, Timnah, Ekron,"},"44":{"text":"Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,"},"45":{"text":"Jehud, Beneberak, Gathrimmon,"},"46":{"text":"Mejarkon le Rakkon, tuaciang Joppa kiim a ngam zongh kihel hi."},"47":{"text":"Dan mite in a ngam a taan uh ciang, amate Laish ah pai in sim uh hi. Amate in a khua la in, a mite that a, tuaciang amate ii neisa suaksak hi. Amate sia tua munah teang in, a khuapi min sia Laish pan a taanghpupi Dan min taw laih uh hi.","ref":"Thkte 18:27-29"},"48":{"text":"Hi khuapite le a kiim a khuate sia Dan nam innkuan te neisa tu in a nga ngam le lei ah om hi."},"49":{"text":"Israel mite in ngam le lei a hawmna teng a man uh ciang Nun tapa Joshua ii neisa tu in ngam khen khat pia uh hi.","title":"A khakbel A kipia Ngam"},"50":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin, ama ii nget khuapi: Timnath Serah kipia a, Ephraim mualtung ngam sungah om hi. Ama in khuapi puua kik in tua munah teang hi."},"51":{"text":"Thiampi Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua le Israel nam teng ii innkuan lampuite in hi ngam le lei sia a hawm uh ciang, Topa ii ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang Shiloh ah, Topa a dokna in laimee sawk uh hi. Hi bangin amate in a ngam hawmna teng man uh hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa in Joshua munah,","title":"Bukna Khuapite"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite a son tu in, “Moses ii hong sonsawn tu ka sawl bukna khuapite teal vun."},"3":{"text":"Mihing khat in ngual dang khat a thalup thaak ciang, a phulam tu in a zong pa khut pan a suatak natu in tua munah pai thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in hi khuapi te khat pawpo ah tai thei a, hi khuapi tumna kongbiang thukhenna munah a om lampuite tungah thupiang babang son thei tu hi. Amate in khuapi sungah a om thei natu in ama tumsak a, a teen natu mun khat pia tu hi."},"5":{"text":"A phulam nuam pa in tua mun dongah a zuizen le khuapi mipite in ama ii khut sungah a tai pa sia aap ngawl het tu hi. Amate in ama hung nanak tu hi, banghang ziam cile ama thin uukna hang hi ngawlin a thalup thaak ahi man hi."},"6":{"text":"Taangpi mai ah thu a kikhen dong le tua laitak Thiampi Lianbel a seam sia ii thi dong ama sia tua munah om thei tu hi. Tua zawkciangin tua pa hong taina a khua a inn ah cia kik thei tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in Jordan nitumna sang Naphtali mualtung ngamsung Galilee ngam ah Kedesh; Ephraim mualtung ngam ah Shechem; Judah mualtung ngam ah Hebron tuamkoi hi;"},"8":{"text":"Jordan nisuana, Jericho nisuana sang sennealngam mualtung, Reuben ngam sungah Bezer; Gad ngamsung Gilead ah Ramoth; Manasseh ngamsung Bashan ah Golan teal uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi teng sia bukna khuapi tu in Israel te theampo le ngamdangmi amate sungah a teangte atu a kiteal teng ahi hi. Khat po in midang khat a thatlum tha le phulam tu in ama a zong sia ii khut pan dalna nga thei tu hi; taangpi mai ah thukhenna a thuak phot buale ama kithatlum thei ngawl hi.","ref":"Mi 35:9-34; Thkna 4:41-43; 19:1-13"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Levi innkuan lampuite sia thiampi Eleazar, Nun ii tapa Joshua le Israel nam theampo te ii innkuan lutangte kungah pai uh hi.","title":"Levi te ii Khuapite"},"2":{"text":"Tualai Canaan ngam Shiloh ah hi bangin kison hi, “ Topa ii Moses tungtawnin a thupiakna pan, ko sia khuapite hong kipia tu a, ngan tat natu tua khuate ii kiim le paam lozaute zongh hong kipia tu ci hi.”","ref":"Mi 35:1-8"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa ii thupiakna taw kizui in Israel te in Levi te sia amate ngamsung pan khuapi pawlkhat le ngan tat natu leitang pia uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kohath bee le phung pan Levi innkuante sia a masabel in khuapite kipia hi. Thiampi Aaron suan le paal innkuante sia Judah ngam, Simeon ngam, le Benjamin ngamsung panin khuapi sawm le thum kipia hi."},"5":{"text":"Kohath beete sung a om lai teng sia Ephraim, Dan le Nitumna Manasseh ngam teng sung pan khuapi sawm kipia hi."},"6":{"text":"Gershon bee le phung sia Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, Nisuana Manasseh ngam teng sung pan khuapi sawm le thum kipia hi."},"7":{"text":"Merari phung sung pan innkuante sia, Reuben, Gad, le Zebulun ngam teng sung pan khuapi sawm le nii kipia hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa ii Moses tung thu a piak bangin Levi te sia khuapite le ngan tha natu lozaute Israel mite in laimee sawkin pia uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Levi suan, Kohath ii bee le phung pan Aaron suan le paal te atu in Judah ngam le Simeon ngamsung pan a kipia khuapite min teng hi teng ahi hi. Amate a kipiakna sia a masabel ahi hi.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Amate tungah Arba khuapi (Arba sia Anak ii pa hi), tu in Hebron kici, Judah mualtung ngam a om khuapi le a kiim nganthana leitang taw kop in kipia hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahihang khuapi ii lote le a kiim a khuate sia Jephunneh tapa Caleb a kipiasa ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hebron (bukna khuapite sung pan khat) taw kikop in a nuai a khuapi teng sia thiampi Aaron suante kipia hi: Libnah,"},"14":{"text":"Jattir, Eshtemoa,"},"15":{"text":"Holon, Debir,"},"16":{"text":"Ain, Juttah le Beth Shemesh a ngan tatna leitangte taw: Judah le Simeon namte pan khuapi kua ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Benjamin ngam panin amate sia khuapi li: Gibeon, Geba,"},"18":{"text":"Anathoth le Almon, nganthana mun teng taw kipia hi."},"19":{"text":"A vekpi in khuapi sawm le thum, a ngan tat natu leitangte taw Aaron ii suan thiampi te kipia hi."},"20":{"text":"Kohath ii phung sung Levi innkuan dangte atu Ephraim ngamsung pan khuapi pawlkhat kipia hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate tungah khuapi li: Shechem le a nganthana Ephraim (bukna khuapi khat hi), mualtung ngam Gezer,"},"22":{"text":"Kibzaim le Beth Horon, a nganthana leitangte kipia hi."},"23":{"text":"Dan ngamsung pan amate tungah khuapi li: Eltekeh, Gibbethon,"},"24":{"text":"Aijalon le Gathrimmon, a nganthana leitangte taw kipia hi."},"25":{"text":"Nitumna Manasseh ngam pan amate tungah khuapi nii: Taanach le Gathrimmon, nganthana leitangte taw kipia khawm hi."},"26":{"text":"Hi Kohath bee le phung innkuante in a kingawmin khuapi sawm le a nganthana teng nga hi."},"27":{"text":"Levi mi pawl dangkhat Gershon ii bee le phungte in Nisuana Manasseh ngam pan khuapi nii: Bashan ah Golan (bukna khuapi khat) le Beeshterah, a nganthana leitangte taw nga khawm uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Issachar ngam panin amate in khuapi li: Kishion, Daberath,"},"29":{"text":"Jarmuth le Engannim, a nganthana leitangte taw kopin nga khawm uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Asher ngam panin amate in khuapi li: Mishal, Abdon,"},"31":{"text":"Helkath le Rehob, a nganthana leitangte taw nga khawm uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Naphtali ngam pan amate in khuapi thum: Galilee ah Kedesh, a nganthana leitangte taw (bukna khuapi khat), Hammoth Dor, le Karta'n, a nganthana leitang taw nga khawm uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Gershon bee le phung pan innkuante in a vekpi a kingawm khuapi sawm le thum le a nganthana leitang teng taw nga khawm uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Merari bee le phung pan Levi mi a taanglaite in Zebulun ngam panin khuapi li: Jokneam, Kartah,"},"35":{"text":"Dimnah le Nahalal, a nganthana leitang taw nga khawm uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Reuben ngam panin amate in khuapi li: Bezer, Jahaz,"},"37":{"text":"Kedemoth le Mephaath, a nganthana leitang taw nga khawm uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Gad nam tung pan amate in khuapi li: Gilead pan Ramoth, a nganthana leitang taw (bukna khuapi khat) Mahanaim,"},"39":{"text":"Heshbon le Jazer, a nganthana leitang taw kopin nga khawm uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ahikom Merari bee le phung a kipia khuapi sia sawm le nii ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Israel te neisa ngam le lei panin a kingawm khuapi sawmli le liat le a kiim nganthana leitang teng sia Levi te kipia hi.","merge":"42"},"43":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Topa in Israel te sia a taanghpupite tungah a ciliap huai kamciam a piaksa ngam le lei theampo pia hi. Amate in tuasia a nga zawk uh ciang, tua munah teang uh hi.","title":"Israel te in Ngam a Neisa tu in La"},"44":{"text":"Topa in a taanghpupite tungah kamciam a piaksa bangma in, ngamsung bup ah kilemna pia hi. A ngalte theampo sung pan khat zongh in amate nalh zo ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in a ngalte theampo zaw zawkna Israel te pia hi."},"45":{"text":"Topa in Israel mite tungah kamciam a piak theampo kholet hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joshua in Reuben, Gad, le nisuana Manasseh nam teng pan mipite sam khawm hi.","title":"Joshua in Nisuana sang Minamte Ciasak"},"2":{"text":"Amate tungah, “ Topa naseampa Moses thupiak theampo vawt siat zo nu hi, tuaciang keima thupiak theampo hong ni zo nu hi.","ref":"Mi 32:20-32; Jos 1:12-15"},"3":{"text":"Hi hun bup sungah na Israel mipuite khatvei zongh na taisan ngei bua uh hi. Topa na Pathian ii thupiakna pha takin na ni uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu in ama kamciam bangma in, Topa na Pathian in na Israel mipuite kilemna hong pia zo hi. Tua ahikom Topa naseampa Moses ii hong piak Jordan nisuana sangah noma atu na laak na inn na lo uh ah cia kik tavun."},"5":{"text":"Moses ii hong thupiak bangin thukham na zui natu khuangaisun hamtang tavun: Topa na Pathian it vun, ama deina bang ngamta vun, a thupiakte ni vun, ama tungah thumaan vun, tuaciang ama atu na thin theampo le na thaa theampo taw seam vun,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Joshua in thupha pia in hi kammalte taw amate ciasak hi: “No sia a hau mama in nganno, ngunn, khamh, taau, thik, silh le teen tam mama taw cia kik nu hi. Na ngalte tung pan na laak uh vanhte sia na nam pui mite hawm tavun,” ci hi. Tua zawkciang amate inn ah cia uh hi. Moses in Manasseh nam a khenlang sia Jordan nisuana sangah ngam pia zo hi, ahihang a dang khenlang sia Joshua in nam dangte taw Jordan nitumna sangah ngam pia hi.","merge":"7"},"9":{"text":"Tua hi a, Reuben, Gad, le Nisuana Manasseh nam teng sia inn ah cia kik uh hi. Amate in Israel mi a taanglai teng sia Canaan ngam Shiloh ah nusia uh hi, tuaciang amate in Topa ii Moses tungah a thupiakna tungtawnin a laak sa Gilead ngam le lei zuan uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Reuben, Gad, le Nisuana Manasseh te nitumna sang ma ahi lai Geliloth a thet uh ciang, tuasung ngun hui ah a lian a munophuai biaknatau khat sa uh hi.","title":"Jordan hui ah Biaknatau"},"11":{"text":"Israel mi a taang lai teng munah, “Ngai vun! Reuben, Gad, le Nisuana Manasseh namte in Geliloth, Jordan ii ei sangah biaknatau sa uh hi!” ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Israel mite in hi thu a zaak uh ciang, a taangpi bup sia, nisuana sang minamte sim tu in Shiloh ah kikaikhawm uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Israel mite in thiampi Eleazar ii tapa Phinehas sia Reuben, Gad, le Nisuana Manasseh te kung Gilead ah paisak uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Lampui pasal sawm sia Phinehas taw paikhawm uh hi, nitumna sang a minamte khat ciang khat veu le bee le phung sungah a innkuan papi khat tek kihel uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in Gilead ngam ah Reuben, Gad, le Nisuana Manasseh namte kungah a pai uh hi, Topa ii huam taangpi bup taangin amate tungah hong pau hi."},"16":{"text":"“Banghangin Israel te ii Pathian tungah hi bang ngamtatna siatna vawt nu ziam? Noma atu hi bang biaknatau na sak uh ciang Topa a langpan na hi uh hi. No in ama nung zui nawn ngawl nu hi!","ref":"Thkna 12:13-14"},"17":{"text":"Peor ah ih mawna te phawk kik vun, Topa in ama mite sia tua munah pul natna taw daan hong pia hi kana ngawl ziam? Tua hu in eite in tu dong ma in ih thuak lai hi. Tua mawna sia pha zo sa ngawl lai nu ziam?","ref":"Mi 25:1-9"},"18":{"text":"Tu in ama nung na zui tu uh nial lai nu ziam? Tu ni in Topa na langpan uh le ama in zing ciang Israel mi khat sim tungah hong thin uuk tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu in, na ngam na lei uh sia biakpiak natu in citaak sa ngawl na hi uh le ama Puanbuk omna Topa ii leitang tungah hong pai tavun. Ko sungah leitang pawlkhat sia ko aa hi hong ci tavun. Ahizong Topa ih Pathian biaknatau sia belapna in biaknatau khat a kisakna taw in Topa langpanin leedo heak vun, ahibuale ko zongh a leedote hong suaksak heak vun."},"20":{"text":"Zerah tapa Achan phawk vun, ama in a kiningkhiin nate taw kisai thupiakna sia ni nuam ngawl hi; Israel taangpi bup sia tua huvau in daan hong kipia hi. Achan mawna hu in a thi sia ama bek hi ngawl hi.”","ref":"Jos 7:1-26"},"21":{"text":"Nitumna sang minamte ii innkuan papi te munah Reuben, Gad, le Nisuana Manasseh te in:"},"22":{"text":"“A Thahatpipa sia Pathian hi! Ama sia Topa hi! A Thahatpipa sia Pathian hi! Ama sia Topa hi! Ama in hisia banghangin vawt khu ziam ci in hong he hi, tuaciang no zongh in he le uhte kong oai hi. Topa ka upna keamcing ngawlin, ka langpan uh le hong nungtasak heak vun!"},"23":{"text":"Topa thu ni ngawlin koma aituam atu hi biaknatau sia sa in, meihal biakpiakna ahibuale antang biakpiakna, pawlkhop biakpiakna tu in sa ka hi uh le Topa ama mama in daan hong pia tahen."},"24":{"text":"Hi ngawl hi! Biaknatau ka sak uh ahang sia mai sangah noma suan le paalte in koma suan le paalte tungah, ‘Israel te ii Pathian Topa taw no bang kisai nu ziam?"},"25":{"text":"Ama in Jordan ngun sia no Reuben le Gad te taw ih kilaklaw ah ngamngi hong khen sa hi. No le Topa sia na kisaina uh om ngawl hi,’ hong ci thaak tu ka lau uh hang hi. Tuaciang noma suan le paalte in koma suan le paalte sia Topa biak tu hong khaam tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom biaknatau khat sa khu hi, meihal biakpiaknate ahibuale piakkhiatnate atu hi ngawl hi,"},"27":{"text":"tua sangin, koma mite le noma mite atu, tuaciang khangkikte atu in ama ii a thiangtho Puanbuk mai ah koma in Topa sia meihal biakpiaknate, sangaw biakpiaknate le pawlkhop biakpiakna te taw bia tatak khu hi ci heaksakna lim khat hi tu hi. Hi sia in noma suan le paalte in koma suan le paalte tungah Topa sia no taw bang kisai ziam hong ci ngawl natu ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Ko ngaisutna pan hi bang thu hong piang zezen le, koma suan le paalte in, ‘En vun! ka taanghpupite in Topa biaknatau taw a kibang biaknatau khat vawt hi. Tua biaknatau sia meihal biakpiakna ahibuale sangaw biakpiakna vawt natu kici ngawl hi, koma mite le noma mite kilaklaw ah lim khat in kivawt hi,’ ci thei tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Kote in Topa langpan ngawl het tu khu hi, tua ahibuale meihal biakpiaknate, antang biakpiaknate ahibuale sangaw biakpiaknate vawt natu in biaknatau khat a kisakna taw tu in ama nungzui tu a tawp hi ngawl khu hi. Ama hong ompuina Puanbuk mai ah Topa ih Pathian biaknatau sia ngawl a dang biaknatau khat pawpo vawt ngawl tu khu hi,” ci uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Reuben, Gad, le Nisuana Manasseh nam pan mite ii pauna teng sia thiampi Phinehas le ama taw a paikhawm taangpi lampuite sawm le nitumna sang a teang namte ii innkuan papite in za a, a lung uh kim hi."},"31":{"text":"Eleazar thiampipa ii tapa Phinehas in amate tungah, “Tu in ka heak uh thu pan Topa sia ei taw hong omkhawm hi, tua ahikom noma in Topa ii daan hong piak natu panin Israel mite hong suatak nu hi,” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Phinehas le lampuite in Reuben, le Gad mite Gilead ngam ah nusia uh a, Canaan ngam ah cia kikin Israel mipuite tungah thu a puak uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Israel te lungkim in, Pathian pok uh hi. Reuben, le Gad mite teenna ngamte lalcipsak tu in ngalsim tu thu, a son nawn bua uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Reuben le Gad mite in, “ Topa sia Pathian hi ci in hi biaknatau in eite theampo atu tetti hi ci uh hi. Tua ahikom amate in a min sia “Tetti” a phuak uh hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khuangei mama zawkciang Topa in Israel te sia a kiim a paam ngal launa panin ngammuanna pia hi. Tua hun in Joshua sia huai mama zo hi,","title":"Joshua ii Kikhenna Kam vaithak"},"2":{"text":"tua ahikom Israel theampo, upate, lampuite, thukhente, mipite sung pan a uliante sam a, ama in, “Tu in kei sia huai mama zo khi hi."},"3":{"text":"Noma hu in hi minam teng tungah Topa na Pathian ii a sep a vawt theampo na mu zo uh hi. Topa na Pathian sia no atu in ngal do hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngamsung minam a taanglai te ii leitang sia noma namte atu kong pia zo a, nisuana Jordan ngun pan nitumna Mediterranean Tuipi dong ka zawthal sa minam teng ii ngam zongh kong khensak zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa na Pathian in no kung pan amate nungkinsak tu a, tuaciang mai sang na manaw uh ciang amate hawlkeak tu hi. Topa na Pathian ii hong kamciamsa bangin amate ngam sia na tang tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom Moses Thukham laibu sung a ki at theampo na zui natu na kikhuangkho tavun. Tuasung thute khat zongh na ngaingon heak vun,"},"7":{"text":"tuasia ciang note kawm ah a taanglai mite taw na kipawl buatu uh hi, amate ii pathian minte thuson in na nei buatu uh hi, ahibuale tuate ii min lo in thuciamte na vawt buatu uh a, tua pathiante bia in na kun suk buatu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua taangin tu dong ciang na thumaan sa uh bangma Topa tungah thumaan tu nu hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in a thahat minam liante sia na mai sang na manaw uh ciang hong nawkeaksak zo a, kuama no hong nalh zo om ngeingawl hi."},"10":{"text":"No sung pan pasal khat pawpo in pasal tulkhat taikeaksak zo tu nu hi, banghang ziam cile Topa na Pathian sia, hong kamciamsa bangma in, no atu ngal hong simsak hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:30; Thkna 3:22"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Topa na Pathian na it tu uh kingaisun vun."},"12":{"text":"Na thumaan bua uh a, no sungah a taanglai minamte taw kipawlkhawm in na kiteang uh le,"},"13":{"text":"Topa na Pathian in hi minamte sia maisang na manaw uh ciang hong nawkeaksak nawn ngawl het tu ahi sia na he thei hi. Amate sia no atu in thaang bang, vuum bangin hong lauhuai zaw tu a, thibin pan kivel bang, mittang sung ling do bangin hong na zaw tu hi. Topa na Pathian ii hong piaksa hi leitang hoi tungah note kuama na om nawn ngawl uh dong hisia kipee tan tu hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tu in ka thi tu hun theng zo hi. Topa na Pathian in na pha theampo hong kamciamsa bangin hong pia zo ci sia na thinmuu na lungmuu le na thaa sungah a kuama po in na he uh hi. A kamciam khat simin kikeamcing a; khat zongh vaalthongsak ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang, no tung a kamciam hong kipia theampo a kepcing bangma in, hong tawnnate theampo zongh tungsak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa na Pathian ii na kepcing tu in hong thupiak thuciam sia keam ngawlin pathian dangte na seamin na bia uh le ama in a thin uuk tutna in note daan hong pia tu a, ama hong piaksa hi ngam hoi ngam phana ah hai ngawlin kuama na om nawn buatu uh hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joshua in Israel nam teng theampo Shechem ah khawmtua hi. -Ama in upate, lampuite, thukhente, Israel uliante sam a, Pathian ompuina munah hong pai tek uh hi.","title":"Shechem ah Joshua in Mipite tungah Thuson"},"2":{"text":"Joshua in mipite theampo tungah, “ Topa Israel te ii Pathian ii a ci sia hi teng hi: ‘Khuangeipi hun lai in noma taanghpupite sia Euphrates ngun langkhat ah teang a, pathian dang bia uh hi. Tua taanghpupite sung pan khat sia Terah hi a, Abraham le Nahor ii pa ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 11:27"},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang noma ii taanghpupi Abraham ka la a, Euphrates ngunngal ngam pan Canaan ngam buppi kaantan in ka paipui hi. Suan le paal tam mama ka pia hi. Ama Isaac ka pia a,","ref":"Pian 12:1-9; Pian 21:1-3"},"4":{"text":"tuaciang Isaac tungah Jacob le Esau ka pia hi. Esau tungah a neisa tu in Edom mualtung ngam ka pia a, ahihang na taanghpupi uh Jacob le a tate ahile Egypt ah paisuk hi.","ref":"Pian 25:24-26; Pian 36:8; Thkna 2:5; Pian 46:1-7"},"5":{"text":"A zawkciang Moses le Aaron ka paisak a, Egypt tungah ngimna lianpi ka pia hi. Tuasia ciang amate a vekpi pusuak hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, kumpipa sia innkhum tung a votna, ama inndoi sungah ama nguak a to laitak Ehud pai in, “Pathian kung pan nang atu thupuak khat kong nei hi,” ci hi. Kumpipa dingto hi."},"21":{"text":"Ehud in a khut veisang taw a ziatsang pangh pan namsau la a, kumpipa ngil hol hi."},"22":{"text":"Namsau bup a kuung taw cipin tum hi, tuaciang a thau in a namsau tuam hi. A ngalkaphonpi ukpa sia Gentile te ii Harosheth ah a teang Sisera ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Jabin in thik siphu ngalleang 900 nei a, ama in Israel te sia ngitlona le ngoltolna taw kum kul uk hi. Tuasia ciang Israel mite in Topa tungah hu ngen in au uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu in, Lappidoth ii zi Deborah sia kamsaang khat hi a, tua hun laitakin ama in Israel te ii thukhen seam hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama sia Ephraim mualtung ngamsung Ramah le Bethel kilaklaw palm thingkung khat nuai ah to bul hi, tuaciang ama kungah Israel mite in ama ii khensatnate la tu in pai bul uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ni khat ni ciang ama in Naphtali ngam Kadesh khuapi pan Abinoam ii tapa Barak sam sakin ama tungah, “ Topa , Israel te ii Pathian in nang sia hi thu hong pia hi, ‘Naphtali le Zebulun namte panin pasal tulsawm la in a, Tabor Mual zot pui in."},"7":{"text":"Keima in Jabin ii ngalkaphonpi ukpa Sisera sia Kishon ngun ah nang taw kido tu in kong paipui tu hi. Ama in a siphu ngalleangte le ngalkapte nei hi, ahihang zawna nang kong pia tu hi,’ ci in son hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Barak in, “Nangma in kei nong paipui le ka pai tu a, nong paipui buale ka pai buatu hi,” ci zo kik hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Pha hi, nang hong paipui tu khi hi, ahihang nangma in zawna tungah bangma min na nga buatu hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in Sisera sia nupi khat aap tu hi,” ci in zo hi. Tuabangin Deborah sia Barak taw Kedesh ah pai hi."},"10":{"text":"Barak in Zebulun le Naphtali namte Kedesh ah sam a, pasal 10,000 samin ama zuisak hi. Deborah sia ama taw paikhawm hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hun sungin Ken mi Heber in Kedesh khua hui Zanannim a om oak thingkung nai ah a puanbuk sa hi. Moses sunghno Hobab ii suan le paalte a dang Ken mite kung pan ama kikhiin zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Barak sia Tabor Mual ah paito zo hi ci in a zaak ciang"},"13":{"text":"Sisera in a thik siphu ngalleang 900 teng le a mite theampo sam a, Gentile-te-ii-Harosheth pan Kishon ngun ah paisak hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Deborah in Barak munah, “Pai in! Topa in nang hong lampui hi! Tu ni in ama in Sisera tungah zawna nang hong pia zo hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom Barak sia ama mi 10,000 teng taw Tabor Mual panin paisuk uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Barak in a ngalkaphonpi taw a sim tak ciang Topa in Sisera sia a siphu ngalleangte le a mite theampo taw kinuaisak a, a nokkhak bialbual tu in vawt hi. Sisera sia a siphu ngalleang tung panin tuaksuk a, a peangin tai hi."},"16":{"text":"Barak in tua siphu ngalleang le ngalkaphonpi sia Gentile-te-ii-Harosheth dong del a, tuaciang Sisera ngalkaphonpi bup thatlum hi. Mihing khat zongh a kikhe bua hi."},"17":{"text":"Ken mi Heber ii zi, Jael ii puanbuk dong Sisera tai hi, banghang ziam cile Hazor kumpipa Jabin sia Heber bangkua taw kilem hi."},"18":{"text":"Jael pusuak in Sisera hong muak hi, “Hong pai ta'n, topa, ka tuipuan buk sungah hong tum ta'n. Lau heak in!” ci hi. Tuabangin ama tum hi, tuaciang innteaknu in puankhakna lia ah phual hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama munah, “Nong hesuakna tuidam dawn tu hong pia ta'n; ka dangko hi,” ci hi. Ama in noai koina savun ip khat hongin a dawn tu in pia hi, tuaciang seal kik hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama mun ah, “Puanbuk kongbiang ah ding in a, khat po hong pai in hi sungah a om, om ziam ci in hong dongh le om bo na ci in,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Sisera sia toi mama ahikom mutthip paih hi. Tuasia ciang Jael in sek khat le puanbuk khetphin khat la in, ama kungah pai vadeen a, tuasia a thaideap pan khenin leisung dong pailetsak a, thatlum hi."},"22":{"text":"Barak in Sisera zongin hong pai ciang Jael in ama muak a, “Hi sungah hong pai ta'n! Na zon sia pa hong lak tu khi hi,” ci hi. Tuabangin ama a sungtan pui le Sisera sia lei ah a thisa in om a, puanbuk khetphin khat taw a lutang na kikhenlet hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ni in, Pathian in Israel te in Canaan kumpipa Jabin zosak hi."},"24":{"text":"Canaan kumpipa a suksiat diipdeap dong amate in a nasia vaial, a nasia vaial in phul a, sim uh hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni in Deborah le Abinoam ii tapa Barak in la hisia sa uh hi:","title":"Deborah le Barak ii La"},"2":{"text":"Topa pok vun! Israel te sia ngal do tu in a thin khensat zo uh hi; mipite sia lungdam takin hong kipia uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ngai vun, no kumpipate awng! No ngamukte awng, hong nadon tavun! La ka sa tu a, tum thei te ka tum tu hi Israel ii Pathian, Topa tungah."},"4":{"text":"Topa awng, Seir mualpite na nusiat ciang, Edom ngam panin nong pusua ciang, lei liingin van pan nguatui hong taak suk hi. Hi hi, meei sung panin tui hong bua hi."},"5":{"text":"Sinai ii Topa mai, Topa Israel ii Pathian mai ah mualpite liing hi.","ref":"Pu 19:18"},"6":{"text":"Anath ii tapa Shamgar khan sung, Jael ii khan sung, kalaoh hon vanh puate sia ngam kaanin pai nawn ngawl hi, tuaciang khualhaw te in lamzinte tawn uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel khuate kinusia hi, Deborah awng; nang nong pai mateng amate sia a hawmpi in ding hi, Israel atu in nu bangin nong pai hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang ngam sungah ngal hong om hi Israel te in pathian thakte hong teal uh ciang ahi hi. Israel ngam a om pasal tul sawmli sungah, lum ahibuale tei toai akua om ziam?"},"9":{"text":"Ka thin sia Israel a ukte taw omkhawm hi, lungdam takin a kipia mite taw om hi. Topa pok vun!"},"10":{"text":"Laa kaang tungah a to note awng, a kunghte tungah a tote awng, na pai natu mun theampo ah peang taw a paite awng, hi thu son tek vun."},"11":{"text":"Ngai vun! Tuikhuk kiim ah a ngamlum mihonte in Topa ii ngalzawnate Israel mite ii ngalzawnate a son uh hi! Tuaciang Topa ii mite in a khuapite uh pan, hong kuan suk hi."},"12":{"text":"Lampui in, Deborah awng, lampui in! Lampui in! La khat sa in! Lampui in! Abinoam ii tapa Barak awng, mai sangah na ngalmatte paipui in!"},"13":{"text":"Tuasia ciang a thumaan te sia a lampuite kungah hong pai a; Topa ii mite ama kungah ngal sim tu kithoai sa in hong pai uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate sia Ephraim panin a kuam sungah, Benjamin nam le a mite ii nungsang pan hong pai hi. A ukte Machir pan hong pai suk hi, a uliante Zebulun pan hong kuan suk hi."},"15":{"text":"Issachar ii lampuite Deborah taw hong pai uh hi; hi hi, Issachar hong pai a, Barak zongh hong pai hi, tuaciang amate in a kuam sungah ama a zui uh hi. Ahihang Reuben nam sia kikhen a; amate in hong pai tu uh sia a khensat thei bua uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Banghangin amate nungsang ah tuute taw taang khawm ziam? Hi hi, Reuben nam kikhen hi; amate in hong pai tu uh sia a khensat thei bua uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Gad nam sia Jordan ii nisuana sangah om hi, tuaciang Dan nam sia teambawte kungah om suak uh hi. Asher nam sia tuipi hui ah om hi; amate tuipi vaalbo teng ah om suak uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahihang Zebulun le Naphtali mite in, ngal kisimna phual ah a nuntakna aitaa uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Megiddo luihui Taanach khua ah, kumpite hong pai in kido hi; Canaan kumpite in ngalsim uh a; ahihang amate in ngunn bangma ciapui ngawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Aksite in, van pan ngaldo uh hi; van kaantan in a pai uh ciang, tuate in Sisera sim hi."},"21":{"text":"Kishon ah namthuam a — Kishon ngun pawm sia in amate taaikeak hi. Mai ka nawt tu, ka nawt tu, thahatna taw ka paitan tu hi!"},"22":{"text":"Tua zawkciang siphute hong kinuntaw uh a, a peangcinte taw lei tuan uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa ii vantunglalang in, “Meroz tomlaw in” ci hi, “Tomlaw vun, tua munah a teangte tomlaw vun. Amate sia Topa hu tu in hong pai bua a, ama atu ngalkapte bangin ngal sim tu hong pai ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Numei a hamphabel sia Jael hi, Ken mi Heber ii zi — puanbuk sung a teang numei teng po pan, a kaamphabel hi."},"25":{"text":"Sisera in tui ngen a, ahihang ama in khuinoai pia hi; ama in kuang hoi khat taw noaidiat puak hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in a khut lang taw puanbuk khetphin toai in, a langkhat taw naseampa ii sekpui toai hi; Ama in Sisera lutang seakin a lu sutham hi; ama in a lutang vutlet hi."},"27":{"text":"A khupte top suk in, puksuk a, ama peang kungah tung ngawlin lum hi. Ama ii peang ah a khupte top sukin puk hi; lei ah pukin thi hi."},"28":{"text":"Sisera ii nu in khelki pan khua en a; puankhak sia nung panin salh hi. “Banghangin a siphu ngalleang hong cia kik tu haisaang mama ziam?” Banghangin a siphute a heak kik tu vai hai leih thong ziam?” ci in ama in dongh hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama ii numei ciimbel te in zo a, ama le ama zongh a kison kikik na ah,"},"30":{"text":"“Amate in a mat tu le a hawm tu nate bek a mu dong zong hi, ngalkap khat sim atu ngaknu khat ahibuale nii, Sisera atu puan manham kumpinu ngawng aw tu a kingelh puan hi tu hi,” ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa awng, na ngalte theampo tuabang veu in thi tahen, ahihang na lawmte sia nisuak bangin taang tahen! Tuaciang ngam sungah kum 40 kilemna om hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatvei ma Israel mite in Topa tungah mawna vawt hi, tua ahikom Midian mite in amate kum sali uk hi.","title":"Gideon"},"2":{"text":"Midian te sia Israel te sangin hat zaw ahikom Israel te suanghawng te le mualtung a dang ngammuanna munte ah buu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel te in thaicii a poai uh ciang, Midian te, Amalek te le sennealngam minamte taw paikhawm in sim uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate sia ngam sungah ngiaphual saat in, Gaza kiim thangsang ngam dong ankungte susia hi. Amate in khuite, tuute, laate la in, Israel te nuntak natu bangma kheet ngawl uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in a puanbukte le a ngannote taw hong pai uh ciang khaumaw za in tam uh hi. Amate le a kalaoh te tam leih a, sim zawk hi ngawl hi. Amate hong pai in,"},"6":{"text":"ngamsung susia ngawp a, tuaciang Israel te in amate nalh zo ngawl uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Israel mite sia Midian te a nalh zawk natu in Topa tungah hu ngen in au uh hi,"},"8":{"text":"tuaciang ama in kamsaang khat paisak a, Topa Israel te ii Pathian ii thupuak hisia kengsak hi: “Egypt ngam na saltanna uh panin kong pusua pui hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt te le hi lai ngam sungah hong sim mite kung pan kong suatak hi. Maisang na manaw uh ciang amate sia ka notkeak hi, tuaciang amate ii ngam, no kong pia hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in Topa na Pathian khi hi, tuaciang tu in amate ngam ah na teen uh laitakin Amor te ii pathiante na bia buatu uh hi, kong ci hi. Ahihang kei nong nadon bua uh hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa ii vantunglalang sia Ophrah khua ah hong pai a, Abiezer phung sungah a pasal khat ahi Joash ii neisa oak thingkung nuai ah hong to hi. A tapa Gideon sia Midian te mu ngawl natu in sapittui suukna munah zungtaang tawm hong cil ku hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa ii vantunglalang sia tua mun ama mai ah hong kilaak a, “ Topa sia nang taw omkhawm hi, ngalhang, a thahat pa awng!” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Gideon in ama munah,” Kong dongh thei tu ahile, topa awng, Topa in hong ompui ahile hite theampo banghangin piang ziam? Ka pate ii hong son Topa sep ngei nalamdang te — amate Egypt ngam pan a pusua puina thu theampo bang suak ziam? Topa in ko, hong taisan zo a, Midian te khut sungah hong nusia zo hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in ama thupia a, “Na thahatna theampo taw kuan in a, Israel te Midian te khut sung pan suatakin. Keima tatak ma in nang kong paisak hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Gideon in, “ Topa awng, bangbangin Israel suatak thei tu khi ziam? Ka bee ka phung sia Manasseh nam sung pan a zawngkhalbel hi a, keima zongh ka bangkua sung pan a thupi ngawlbel ka hi hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in, “Suatak thei tu ni hi, banghang ziam cile keima in hong hu tu khi hi. Midian te sia mihing khat vawt tu bang bekin ol takin na sucip tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Gideon in, “Kei dik nong sa le nang sia Topa na hi takpina tawm hong lak ta'n."},"18":{"text":"Nong hesuakna in an taw biakpiakna kong paipui dong hong nusia heak in,” ci hi. Ama in, “Nong pai kik dong om tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom Gideon inn sungah tumin, kealmoi khat huan a, mangtaang vui kilogramme 10 taw tol saw ngawlin anluum vawt hi. Ama in a sa sia khum sungah koi in, a satui sia beal sungah a koi zawkciang Topa vantunglalang kung oak thingkung nuai ah paipui a, tua ante ama pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Vantunglalang in, “A sa le anluum teng hi suang sia tungah koi in a, a tungah satui buak in,” ci in sawl hi. Gideon in tuabangin vawt hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa vantunglalang in ama ii toai ciangkang ii dawn taw sa le anluumte kithuthasak hi, tuaciang suang sung panin meikuang pusuak a, sa le anluum kaanghtum hi. Tuasia ciang vantunglalang bo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Gideon in Topa vantunglalang mu ahi hunlam phawk in, launa lianpi taw, “Vaanglianpipa Topa! Na vantunglalang taw maitang kisii in mu zo khi hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang Topa in, ama munah, “Na thinnuamsak in. Lau heak in. Thi ngawl tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Gideon in tua munah biaknatau khat sa in,” Topa sia thinnopna hi,” (“Jehovah Shalom”) ci hi. (Tuasia tu dong ma in Ophrah ah ding lai a, Abiezer ii bee le phung neisa ahi hi.)"},"25":{"text":"Tua zanin Topa in Gideon munah, “Na pa khuital le khuital dang khat la in a, na pa ii Baal biaknatau sia baltham in, tuaciang a kung a om Asherah numeipathian ii lim sia zongh phuktan in."},"26":{"text":"Topa na Pathian atu in biaknatau khat leivum tungah a pha takin sa in. Tuaciang khuital a niina sia la in, biakpiak na in a bup in hal in, Asherah thingngel na phuktan sia thing in thut in,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahikom Gideon in a naseamte sawm taw Topa sawl teng seam hi. Ama in a innkuanpuite le khua mite kiita lei ahikom sunin seam ngam ngawlin zanin seam hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua khua mite a zing ciang zingtuungin hong thaw uh ciang, Baal biaknatau le Asherah lim a kiphuktan teng le, tuaciang khuital a niina sia a saksa biaknatau tungah biakpiakna in a kihal mu uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Amate khat le khat kidongh a, “Akua in hisia vawt ziam?” ci hi. Amate in a kat uh ciangin Joash tapa Gideon vawt ahi sia he uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuasia ciang amate in Joash mun ah, “Na tapa hi sungah a kithalup thei natu in hong paisak ta'n! Ama in Baal biaknatau sia baltham a, a kungah a om Asherah lim sia phuktan hi,” ci uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahihang Joash in ama a nalhte theampo tungah, “Baal panpui in ding tek nu ziam? Ama hung nu ziam? Ama a panpui khat pawpo sia zingsang khuavak ma in thalup thuak tu hi. Baal sia pathian ahile ama le ama kihung tahen. A kibaltham biaknatau sia ama aa hi,” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua hun pan kipan Gideon sia Jerubbaal kina hi, banghang ziam cile Joash in, “Baal sia ama le ama kihung tahen; biaknatau a kibaltham sia ama aa hi,” a ci hu hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Midian mite theampo, Amalek te, le sennealngam sung teang minamte hong kikhawmtua a, Jordan ngun kaantan in, Jezreel Kuam ah ngiaphual saat uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa ii thaa in Gideon uk a, tuaciang ama in Abiezer bee le phungte sung pan pasalte ama zui tu a samna lemle tum hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama in kamtaite Manasseh ngam khente ngeal ah paisak a, ama a zui tu in samsak hi. Ama in kamtaite sia Asher, Zebulun, le Naphtali namte kungah paisak a, amate zongh Gideon taw kipawl tu in hong pai uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Gideon in Pathian munah, “Israel te a suatak tu in kei nong zak tu in khensat zo khi hi, ci ni hi."},"37":{"text":"Pha hi, tuumul pawlkhat ka zungtaang cilna ah koi tu khi hi. Zingsang ciangin daaitui kia sia tuumul tung bek ah om in, lei ah a om buale, Israel suatak tu in hong zangh takpi tu na hina ka tel tu hi,” ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuabang tatak ma in hong piang hi. A zing ciang khuavak tuungin Gideon hong thaw ciang, ama in tuumul hong meak a, kuang khat dim tu za daaitui om hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuaciang Gideon in Pathian munah, “Kei tungah na thin uuksak heak in; khatvei lian bekma pau lai tong. Nong hesuak na in tuumul taw khatvei hong sinsak lai ta'n. Tusia hun ciang tuumul kosak in a, a lei kawtsak in,” ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua zanin Pathian in tuabang tatak ma in vawt hi. A zingsang ciang tuumul sia ko a, lei ahile daaitui kawt hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Gideon le a mite tho pal in Harod Cik paam ah ngiaphual saat uh hi. Midian te ii ngiaphual sia Moreh Mual nai amate ii saksang kuam sung ahi hi.","title":"Gideon In Midian te Zo"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Gideon munah, “Midian te kong zawsak natu in na mihing nei teng sia kei atu tam lei hi. Tuate in amate ii zaw zawk khawng ma sa in kei min hong pusak ngawl tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihingte tungah, ‘A lau khat pawpo sia inn ah cia kik thei tu hi, tuaciang ko sia hi lai Gilead Mual ah ka na om tu uh hi,’ ci in taangko vun” ci hi. Tuabang ahiciang 22,000 cia kik a, ahihang 10,000 taanglai hi.","ref":"Thkna 20:8"},"4":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa in Gideon munah, “Na mite tam lei lai hi, tui omna ah paipui in a, tua munah nang atu amate kong khen tu hi. Nangma munah pai ngawl tu hi ka ci le pai ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Gideon in tui omna ah paipui suk a, tuaciang Topa in ama munah ‘Ui bangin a leei uh taw tui a liak theampo sia khupdin a tui a ne suk teng sung panin khen tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"A khutpheak uh taw tui suakin a leei uh taw a liakte zathum pha hi; a dang teng sia tui ne tu in khupdin a boksuk uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in Gideon munah, “Midian te khut sung pan nang kong suatak tu a, a leei uh taw tui a liak mihing zathum teng taw zawna kong pia tu hi. A dangte theampo ciasak in” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom nguai an le lemle theampo a keam mihing zathum simngawl po Israel mi teng Gideon in inn ah ciasak hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua zanin Topa in Gideon thupia a, “Tho in a ngiaphual sim in; tuasia zawna nang hong pia khi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang na sim ngam buale, na naseampa Purah taw ngiaphual ah paisuk tavun."},"11":{"text":"Amate ci teng na za tu a, tuasia ciang sim natu na thin hong lian tu hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom Gideon le a naseampa Purah sia ngalte ngiaphual mong dong hong pai uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Midian te, Amalek te le sennealngamsung a minamte sia tua kuam sungah khaumaw hon bangin kizel uh hi, tuaciang a kalaoh te zong tuipivaal a senvui za in tam hi."},"13":{"text":"Mihing khat in a lawmpa tungah a mang a son teng Gideon hong thet ciangin za hi. Puanbuk sia cimh in lei ah kipheangpha hi,” ci in a mang son hi."},"14":{"text":"A lawmpa in, “Tuasia Israel te Joash ii tapa Gideon ii namsau hi! Khiakna dang mama nei thei buan te! Pathian in Midian le a ngalkap bup tungah zawna sia ama pia zo hi!” ci in zo kik hi."},"15":{"text":"Gideon in tua pa ii mang le a khiakna a son teng a zaak ciang khupdin in Pathian bia hi.
