Midian ngalkaphonpi tungah no sia Topa in zawna hong pia zo hi!” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in mihing zathum teng sia pawl thum in khen a, lemle khat le meisip a kikoi tungbeal khat tek pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate tungah, “Ngalte ngiaphual mong ka thet ciang, hong en nginge tavun a, keima hi babang hi vun."},"18":{"text":"Ka pawlte le keima in lemle kong tum uh ciang, no zongh ngiaphual kiimkot panin lemle tum in, ‘ Topa atu le Gideon atu’ ci in hong au tavun,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Zankim mahiat, a cingte kilaih zawk bek ciangin Gideon le a mi zakhat teng sia ngiaphual mong hong theng hi. Amate in lemle tumin, a beal toai te sutham uh a,"},"20":{"text":"tuaciang pawl dang nii te zongh in tuabang ma in hong ngamta uh hi. Amate a vekpi in meisipte a veisang khut taw len in, a ziatsang ah lemle toai in, “ Topa atu le Gideon atu namsau khat!” ci in a au uh hi."},"21":{"text":"mi simin ngiaphual kiim ah ama din natu san tek ah hong ding tek in, ngalte ii ngalkaphonpi sia au in a taikeak uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Gideon mite ii a lemle tum sungin, Topa in ngalte sia amate le amate khat le khat namsau taw kisimsak uh hi. Ama sepsa te taw kilawm in Gideon sia zatakna taw na phawk uh ziam, a innkuanpuite tungah pha takin na vawt uh ziam?"},"17":{"text":"Ka pa ii no atu ngal hong dosak sia phawk vun. Jephthah in Mizpah khua Topa mai ah a deina teng son hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaciang Jephthah in Ammon kumpipa kungah kamtaite paisak a, “Ko nong kihau puina sia bang thu ziam? Banghangin ka ngam uh hong sim ni ziam?” cisak hi."},"13":{"text":"Jephthah ii kamtaite tungah Ammon kumpi pa in, “Egypt panin Israel te hong pusua lai in, amate in ka ngam sia Arnon ngun pan Jabbok ngun le Jordan ngun dong hong laaksak hi. Tu in tuasia kam tam ngawlin nong piak kik uh kul tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Jephthah in Ammon kumpipa kungah kamtaite paisak kik a,"},"15":{"text":"hi bangin zo kik hi: “Israel in Moab ahibuale Ammon te leitang laaksak ci thu sia maan ngawl hi."},"16":{"text":"A thupiang tatak sia hi bang hi: Israel te in Egypt a nusiat uh ciang, sennealngam kaantan in pai a, Aqaba Tuidok ah, tua mun pan Kadesh hong theng uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Edom kumpipa tungah kamtaite paisak a, a ngam kaantan thei natu ngen hi. Ahihang Edom kumpipa in amate a kaantansak bua hi. Amate in Moab kumpipa tungah zongh ngen uh hi, ahihang kuama in a ngam kaantan tu a oai bua uh hi. Tua ahikom Israel te sia Kadesh ah taam uh hi.","ref":"Mi 20:14-21"},"18":{"text":"Tuaciang amate sia sennealngam kaantan in, Edom le Moab ngamte kiimkot a, Moab ii nisuana sang Arnon ngun langkhat a thet dong paitan uh hi. Amate in tua munah ngiaphual saat ahihang Arnon a kaantan bua hi, banghang ziam cile tuasia Moab ngamngi ahihang hi.","ref":"Mi 21:4"},"19":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Israel te in Heshbon a om Amor kumpipa Sihon tungah kamtaite paisak a, a ngam kaantan in amate ngamsung a tot natu ngen uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahihang Sihon in Israel te tuabangin a paisak bua hi. Ama in a ngalkap buppi khawmtua in kuan a, Jahaz ah ngiaphual saat in, Israel te sim hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang Topa, Israel te ii Pathian in Sihon ngalkaphonpi sia Israel te in zosak hi. Tua ahikom Israel te in tua ngam a teang Amor te ii ngam nei theampo la uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in Amor te ii ngam theampo, thangsang Arnon pan saksang ah Jabbok dong, tuaciang nisuana sang sennealngam pan nitumna Jordan dong la uh hi.","ref":"Mi 21:21-24"},"23":{"text":"Tua hi a, Israel a mite atu Amor te a notkeak sia Topa Israel te ii Pathian ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuasia la kik tu in hanciam tu ni ziam? Na pathian Chemosh ii hong piak teng keam thei ni hi. Ahihang ko ka hi uh le Topa ka Pathian hong piaksa teng keam tu khu hi."},"25":{"text":"Zippor ii tapa Moab kumpipa Balak sangin nangma phazaw kisa ni ziam? Ama in Israel sia thato ngeingawl hi, ahi ziam? Ama in ko hong sim tu in hong kuan ngei na ziam?","ref":"Mi 22:1-6"},"26":{"text":"Kum zathum tawntung Israel te in Heshbon le Aroer, tuaciang a kiim a paam khuate le Arnon ngun vaal a khuapi teng la hi. Hi hunte theampo sungah banghangin la kik ngawl ni ziam?"},"27":{"text":"Kei sia no tungah bangma tat khial hong nei ngawl khi hi. Kei tungah ngal nong phot uh sia noma khial zaw nu hi. Topa sia thukhenpa hi. Ama in tuni in Israel te le Ammon te kilaklaw ah thu khensat tu hi.”"},"28":{"text":"Ahihang Jephthah ii kam thaak huvau Ammon kumpipa in awlmawk ngawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa ii thaa sia Jephthah tungah hong theng hi. Ama in Gilead le Manasseh kaantan in pai a, Gilead ngam Mizpah ah hong heak kikin, Ammon ah paitan hi."},"30":{"text":"Jephthah in Topa tungah kamciam pia a: “Ammon te nong zosak le,"},"31":{"text":"zawna taw ka cia ciang, ka inn panin kei hong muak tu in hong pusuak phit mihing sia meihal biakpiakna in kong pia tu hi. Ama sia sangaw biakpiakna in nang kong pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuabangin Jephthah in Ammon te sim tu in ngun kaantan a, Topa in zawna pia hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in amate sia Aroer pan Minnith kiim ngamte, a vekpi in khuapi kul teng Abel Keramim dong vaat pheang hi. Tua kithalupna nasia mama a, Ammon te sia Israel te in zo hi."},"34":{"text":"Jephthah sia Mizpah ah hong cia kik ciangin ama muak tu in a tanu sia daalkual khuangno tum kawmin laam a hong pusuak hi. Ama sia Jephthah ii khat bek a hin ta ahi hi.","title":"Jephthah ii Tanu"},"35":{"text":"Ama in a tanu a mu ciang heena taw a puansilh eautham a, “Aw, ka tanu! nang in ka thin hong tamhthamsak ni hi! Kei hong thinnasak tu sia banghang nang keak hi luilam ni ziam? Topa tungah a ciliap huai kamciam ka piaksa hi a, tuasia dawk kik thei nawn ngawl khi hi!” ci hi.","ref":"Mi 30:2"},"36":{"text":"A tanu in, “ Topa tungah kamciam pia zo na hi le Ammon na ngalte tungah Topa in phulamna hong pia zo ahiciang kei tungah vawt tu na ci bangin vawt in,” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahihang ama in a pa mun ah, “Hi na khat kei atu hong hisak lai ta'n. Ngaknu thiangtho in ka thi tu sia, ka lawmte taw mual tungah vak kawkoai a, khuangai in ka om thei natu, keima a tuamin tha nii hun hong pia ta'n” ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama in a tanu sia tha nii sung, a paisak hi. Ama le a ngualtamhte sia mual tungah kaato uh a, khuangai in om uh hi, banghang ziam cile ama sia pasal nei ngawl le ta nei ngawlin thi tu ahihang hi."},"39":{"text":"Tha nii zawkciang ama a pa kungah hong cia kik hi. A pa in Topa tungah a kamciam bangin vawt a, ama sia ngaknu thiangtho in thi hi. Hi sia in Israel ngam ah ngeina khat hong pianna hi a,"},"40":{"text":"kum simin Israel ngaknute sia ni li sung veu Gilead khua mi Jephthah ii tanu atu a khuangaina lakna in pusuak uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephraim pasalte sia ngal kido natu kinging hi; amate in Jordan ngun kaantan in, Zaphon sangah zuan a, Jephthah mun ah, “Ammon te sim tu ngamngi kaantan in pai napi, banghangin ko hong paa ngawl ni ziam? Na inn taw hong halcip tu khu hi!” ci hi.","title":"Jephthah le Ephraim mite"},"2":{"text":"Ahihang Jephthah in amate munah, “Ka mite le kei sia Ammon te taw nasia takin kihauna nei khu hi. Hong sam khi hi, ahihang kei hong suatak ngawl nu hi."},"3":{"text":"Hong suatak ngawl tu ci in ka mu ciang ka nuntakna aitaa in amate do tu in ngamngi kaantan khu hi, tuaciang Topa in amate hong zosak hi. Tua ahikom tu in kei hong sim tu in banghangin hong pai nu ziam?” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jephthah in Gilead mite theampo khawmtua a, Ephraim mite simin zo uh hi. (Ephraim te in, ‘Ephraim le Manasseh a om no Gilead te sia Ephraim te a taisante nu hi’ ci uh hi.)"},"5":{"text":"Ephraim te a suatak ngawl natu in, Gilead te ii Jordan a kaantan thei natu mun teng la uh hi. Ephraim mite khat pawpo suakta nuamin kaantan tu a ngen le, Gilead te in, “Nang Ephraim te na hi ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ama in, “Hi ngawl khi hi” a ci le,"},"6":{"text":"tuasia ciang, “Shibboleth ci in” ci in sawl hi. Ahihang ama in “Sibboleth” ci hi, banghang ziam cile ama in tua kammal sia a maan in a lo thei bua hi. Tuasia ciang ama manin Jordan kaantanna teng mun khat ah thatlum uh hi. Tua hun sungin Ephraim mite 42,000 that uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Jephthah in Israel te kum luk sung lampui hi. Tua zawkciang ama thi a, Gilead ngam a khua sungah phum uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Jephthah zawkciang Bethlehem pan Ibzan in Israel te lampui hi.","title":"Ibzan, Elon le Abdon"},"9":{"text":"Ama in tapa 30 le tanu 30 nei hi. Ama in a tanute sia phung dangte taw teangsak hi, a tapate atu phung dang panin mo 30 pui hi. Ibzan in Israel te kum sali lampui hi,"},"10":{"text":"tua zawkciang ama thi a Bethlehem ah kiphum hi."},"11":{"text":"Ibzan zawkciang Zebulun pan Elon in Israel te kum sawm sung lampui hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama thi a, Zebulun ngam Aijalon ah kiphum hi."},"13":{"text":"Elon zawkciang, Pirathon pan Hillel tapa Abdon in Israel te lampui hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in tapa 40 le tupa 30 nei a, tuate in laa 70 tungah to uh hi. Abdon in kum liat sung Israel te lampui hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang ama thi a, Amalek te mualtung ngam, Ephraim ngamsung Pirathon khua ah kiphum hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel te in Topa tungah maw kik a, tuaciang Topa in amate sia Philistine te in kum 40 sung uksak hi.","title":"Samson ii Suana"},"2":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Zorah khua ah Manoah a ci pasal khat om hi. Ama sia Dan nam sung pan ahi hi. A zi in ta nei thei ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa vantunglalang khat ama kungah kilangh a, “Nang sia ta nei thei ngawl ni hi, ahihang hai ngawlin na ngai tu a, tapa khat na nei tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Sapittui, beer ahibuale a kikhaam an khat pawpo na neak ngawl het natu kidawm in;"},"5":{"text":"na tapa a pian zawkciang, a sam meetsak ngeingawl het tu ni hi, banghang ziam cile a pian ni pan kipan ama sia Pathian atu a kituam koi nazirite khat in ki aap tu hi. Ama in Philistine te khut sung pan Israel te suataksak natu nasep kipan tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mi 6:1-5"},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang tua nu a pasal kungah pai in, “Pathian mi khat hong pai a, ama sia Pathian vantunglalang bangin kiitakhuai mama hi. Ama hong paina mun ka dongh bua a, a min hong son bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahizong ama in kei sia naupaai in tapa khat nei tu hong ci hi. Ama in sapittui le beer, ahibuale a kikhaam an peuma ka neak ngawl natu in thu hong pia hi, banghang ziam cile patang sia a nuntak lai teng Pathian tungah nazirite khat bangin ki aaptuam tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang Manoah in Topa tungah thungen a, “ Topa awng nong hesuakna in, ko nong puak Pathian mipa ma hong paisak kik ta'n a, pano sia a sua ciang bangbang ngamta tu khu ziam ci in hong sonsak ta'n,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Pathian in Manoah nget bangin, vantunglalang sia tua nu lo sungah a to laitakin pai kiksak hi. A pasal Manoah sia ama taw a om bua hi,"},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama thakhatin tai a, a pasal mun ah, “En in! Khatvei ni a, hong pai pa ma kei kungah hong kilangh kik hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Manoah hong dingin a zi nung zui hi. Tua pa kungah pai in, “Ka zi kungah thuson sia nangma na hi ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Hi khi hi” ci in zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaciang Manoah in, “Na paunate hong taangtun tak ciang patang sia in bang teng a vawt kul tu ziam? Bangbang nuntak zia taw nungta tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"13":{"text":"Vantunglalang in, “Na zi in ka sonsa theampo a vawt hamtang kul tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in sapitkung pan a piang peuma ne ngawl het tu hi; sapittui, beer ahibuale a kikhaam an ne ngawl het tu hi. Ama tungah ka sonsa theampo cing takin a sep kul tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Manoah in tua pa sia Pathian ii vantunglalang ahi hunlam he ngawl ahikom, ama mun ah, “Hesuakna taw na pai heak lai in. Nangma atu kealmoi khat huan phot tawng,” ci hi. Ahihang vantunglalang in, “Ka tawlnga zii zonghin, na an ne ngawl tu khi hi. Ahizong na vawt veve nuam le tuasia Topa atu meihal biakpiakna in nei in,” ci hi.","merge":"16"},"17":{"text":"Manoah in, “Na min hong son ta'n, tua hile na pauna teng a tun tak ciang, kong patoai thei tu uh hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"18":{"text":"Vantunglalang in zo a, “Banghangin ka min he nuam ni ziam? Ka min sia a lamdang min hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 32:29"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom Manoah in kealmoi khat la a, antang pawlkhat taw kopin nalamdang te a seam Topa atu biakna suangtau tungah biakpiakna in pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Biaknatau tung panin meikuang a paito laitakin, Manoah le a zi in Topa ii vantunglalang sia meikuang sung panin vantung a zotto mu hi. Manoah in tua pa sia Topa ii vantunglalang hi ci in phawk a, a zi taw amate nii sia lei ah a bok lamin kisepsuk uh hi. Amate in tua vantunglalang sia a mu kik nawn bua uh hi.","merge":"21"},"22":{"text":"Manoah in a zi munah, “Eima ih thi kul tu hi, banghang ziam cile eima in Pathian ih mu zo hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang a zi in, “ Topa in ei hong thatlum nuam hi thong le ih biakpiakna te hong saang ngawl tu hi; ama in hite theampo hong lak ngawl tu a, tu in hi bang thute hong son ngawl tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua nu in tapa khat hong hing a, a min sia Samson phuak hi. Tapano sia hong khang a, Topa in thupha pia hi."},"25":{"text":"Zorah le Eshtaol kilaklaw Dan ii Ngiaphual sungah a om laitakin, Topa vaangletna in ama thahatsak tu in kipan hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Samson sia Timnah khua a pai le tua munah Philistine ngaknu khat mu in hoaikhol hi.","title":"Samson le Timnah pan Ngaknu khat"},"2":{"text":"Ama a inn ah cia kikin a pa le a nu tungah, “Timnah khua ah ka thin hong la Philistine ngaknu khat om hi. Hong puisak tavun; ama teenpui nuam khi hi.” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang a pa le a nu in “Zi khat nga natu in tua Pathian he ngawl Philistine te kungah pai kul na ziam? Eima mi sung teng, ih bee ih phung sungah ngaknu khat mu zo ngawl ni ziam?” ci in dong hi. Ahihang Samson in a pa munah, “Kei atu nong puisak tu ka dei sia ama bekma hi. Ama diksa khi hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Samson ii hi bang a hina sia Pathian lamlakna ahi hunlam a pa le a nu in he ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in Philistine te a sim natu hunpha khat a zonna ahi hi. Hi hun sia Philistine te ii Israel a uk hun sung ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom Samson sia a pa le a nu taw Timnah ah pai suk hi. Amate sapithuan sung kaantan in a pai laitak tawpi moi khat a hawk za hi."},"6":{"text":"Thakhat thu in Topa vaangletna in Samson hatsak a, tuaciang a khutnguak taw tawpi sia kealmoi khat bangin baltham hi. Ahihang a ngamtatna teng a pa le a nu a hil bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaciang ama pai in tua ngaknu paupui a, diksa hi."},"8":{"text":"Ni tawmvei zawkciang ama teenpui tu in Samson pai kik hi. A cia lamin tawpi a thalup sia en tu in lampialin a pai le tua tawpi ii luanghawm sungah khuai honkhat le khuaitui mu a lamdang sa hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in khuaitui sia a khut taw la in a lampai kawmin ne hi. Tuaciang a pa le a nu kungah pai in pawlkhat pia hi. Amate in ne ahihang Samson in tua khuaitui sia tawpi thisa pum sung pan a laak hunlam a son bua hi."},"10":{"text":"A pa sia ngaknu nu ii inn ah pai a, tuaciang Samson in anneakpoai khat tua munah vawt hi. Tuasia in tangvalte ngeina khat ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Philistine te in ama a mu uh ciangin ama a ompui tu tangval 30 puak uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Samson in amate munah, “Thukheldokna khat hong dong tong. Mopoai ni sali a bo ma in, a khiakna na son thei uh le khat sim, puanneal hoi khat tek le puansilh laihna khat tek kong khaam ngam hi, nong son thei bua uh le puanneal hoi khat tek hong pia tu nu hi” a ci ciang, “Na thukheldokna sia hong son ta'n, ko za nuam ung,” ci uh hi.","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Ama in, “A ne sia ii sung pan neak tu khat hong piang; A hat sia ii sung pan a thum khat hong piang,” ci hi. Ni thum zawkciang zong amate in khel dokna a tel zo bua lai uh hi."},"15":{"text":"A ni li ni ciangin amate in Samson zi munah, “Na pasal ii thukheldok ii a khiakna hong son natu in theambawl in. Tuabang na hi buale na pa inn mei taw ka hal tu uh a, nangma taw cipin kong hal tu uh hi. No nii in ko teng nong sutol nopna in hong sam na hi bua uh ziam?” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom Samson zi zongh thitui taw a kungah pai in, “Kei hong it ngawl ni hi! Hong ensan hi bek ni hi! Ka ngualtamhte thukhel khat dongh a ciang, kei munah a khiakna hong son ngawl ni hi!” ci hi. Ama in, “En in! Ka pa le ka nu zongh son ngawl khi hi. Banghangin nang hong son tu khi ziam?” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Mopoai sung ni sali tawntung a zi kap hi. Ahihang a ni sali ni ciang a nakheng cimh manin ama in thukheldokna ii khiakna son hi, Tuasia ciang a zi in Philistine te tungah son hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahiciang a ni sali ni in Samson ii lupna a zot ma in, khuapi sung mite in ama munah, “Khuaitui sangin a thum zaw bang om thei ziam? Tawpi sangin a hatzaw bang om thei ziam?” ci uh hi. Samson in, “Ka khuipui taw lo tho khawm ngawl hi le uhte tu in a khiakna, na he buatu uh hi.” ci in zo kik hi."},"19":{"text":"Thakhat thu in Topa vaangletna in Samson hatsak a, tuaciang ama Ashkelon ah paisuk hi, tua munah pasal 30 thatlum in, a puansilh uh suusak a, thukheldokna a zo thei teng tua puan hoite pia hi. Tuasia zawkciang thupiang teng hu in a thinso ahikom, ama inn ah cia kik a,"},"20":{"text":"tuaciang a zi sia a kiteen lai in ama a dinpuipa kipia hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hun tawmvei zawkciang Samson sia, zungtaang laak hun laitakin, kealmoi khat kai in a zi kungah haw hi. A sunghpa munah, “Ka zi omna inndoi sungah pai nuam khi hi,” ci hi. Ahihang ama in a tum tu a oai bua hi."},"2":{"text":"Samson munah, “Ensan takpi hi vak teh ci in kong um a, tua ahikom na lawmpa hong piaksak khi hi. Ahihang a nau nu sia ama sangin a mealpha zawsap hi. A taangin ama la thei ni hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Samson in, “Tu in, Philistine mite tungah ka vawt po kei hong kimawsiat thei ngawl tu hi!” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama pai in, ngia zathum man hi. A meite nii veu nii veu in sawm khawm a, a sawmna khaubawk ah meisip thiat hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciang meisipte halin Philistine te ii zungtaang lo sungah tha hi. Hi bangin ama in zungtaang a kila sa te bek hi ngawlin, laak ngawl laite le olive ciinna huante zongh haltham hi."},"6":{"text":"Philistine te in akua in vawt ziam ci in a kat uh ciang Samson ii vawt hi a, banghang tuabangin vawt ziam cile Timnah khua ah a sunghpa in Samson ii zi sia Samson ii lawmte khat a piaksak hang ahi hunlam tel uh hi. Tua ahikom Philistine te va pai a tua nu a hal lup zawk uh ciang a pa inn zongh haltumsak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Samson in amate munah, “Tua ahile no hi bangin ngamta nu hi! Hite kong thuk kik mateng tawp ngawl tu in kiciam khi hi!” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in amate sim ngawp a, tam ma thatlum hi. Tua zawkciang ama pai in Etam lianghawng sungah om hi."},"9":{"text":"Philistine te hong pai in Judah ah ngiaphual saat a, Lehi khua sim uh hi.","title":"Samson in Philistine te Zo"},"10":{"text":"Tuaciang, Judah mite in “Banghangin ko hong sim nu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Amate in “Samson man tu le ama ii ko hong vawt bangin ama tungah vawt tu in hong pai khu hi,” ci in zo uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom Judah te mihing 3000 sia Etam liang hawng ah pai in Samson munah, “Philistine te sia ei hong ukte ahi hunlam he ngawl ni ziam? Ko bang hong law thong ni ziam?” ci uh hi. Ama in, “Kei tungah hong vawt bangin amate tungah vawt khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in, “Hi sungah kong paina uh sia nangma letheen tu le amate tungah nangma aap tu in hong pai khu hi,” ci uh hi. Samson in, “Noma tatak ma ii nong thalup ngawl natu kamciam hong pia tavun,” ci in ngen hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in, “Pha hi, hong letheen bek tu a, amate tungah hong aap tu khu hi. Ko nang hong that ngawl tu khu hi,” ci uh hi. Tuabangin amate in khauzeen thak nii taw heen cip in lianghawng pan cia pui uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Lehi a thet ciang, Philistine te in ama ausan in hong del uh hi. Thakhat thu in Topa vaangletna in ama hatsak hi, tuaciang ama in a khut le a baan a heenna khauzeente sia khauzam kaanghdeau sa bang phetin saantat hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in a thi tuung laa khat ii khangu mu hi. Ama kunsuk in tawm a, tua taw pasal tulkhat thatlum hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom Samson in, “Laa khangu taw miza a tul that ing nge, Laa khangu taw a luang uh kangthing bang siah ing,” ci in lasa hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciang, a laa khangu vawk hi. Hi bang a pianna mun sia Ramath Lehi kici hi."},"18":{"text":"Samson sia a dangko mama a, Topa tungah hi bangin ko hi, “Zawna lianpi hong pia zo ni hi; tu in dangko in thi tu khi ziam, hi Pathian he ngawl Philistine te in hong man tu ziam?” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Pathian in tua mun Lehi ah leivang khat honsak a, tua ii sung pan tui hong pusuak hi. Samson in tua tui dawn a, ama a om nuamtuam zawhiat hi. Tua ahikom tua ciktui sia Hakkore kici a, Lehi ah om nginge lai hi."},"20":{"text":"Philistine te ii uk hun sung ma ah Samson in Israel kum kul sung lampui hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat Samson sia Philistine te khuapi Gaza ah pai in, tua munah pumpi kizuak numei khat mu a, tua nu lup pui hi.","title":"Gaza ah Samson"},"2":{"text":"Gaza mite in Samson sia tua munah om ci in he ahikom amate in tua mun kiim uum a, zankhuateakin khuapi kongpi ah ama ngakin om uh hi. Zankhuateak in amate thim khipkhep in om a, “Khua hong vak dongin ih ngak tu a, tuasia ciang ama ih thatlum tu hi,” ci in ngaisun uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang Samson sia lupna tungah zankim dong bek om hi. Tua zawkciang ama tho a khuapi kongpi hong zamh a — kongkhate, khuamte le kongkalnate theampo phai keak hi. Ama in tuate a liang ah kisuanh siat in, mualtung Hebron a kimu suk theina mun dong pua to hi."},"4":{"text":"Hisia zawkciang Samson in Sorek Kuam sungah a teang Delilah kici numei khat taw ki it hi.","title":"Samson le Delilah"},"5":{"text":"Philistine kumpi ngate sia tua nu kungah pai in, “Ama sia banghangin tuza in hat a, bangbang hi leang ama kizo thei tu a, letheen in a cimaw in kikoi thei tu ziam ci in nangma tung hong son thei natu in, Samson theam vawt in. Ko khat simin ngunntang tul le zakhat tek hong pia tu khu hi,” ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom Delilah in Samson mun ah, “Nong hesuakna in hong son ta'n, nang sia bang in hong hatsak mama ziam? Tuabangin amate in Samson ii thahat theina thuku sia he zo ngawl lai hi."},"10":{"text":"Delilah in Samson munah, “En in, nang kei sia a mawmaw bangin hong vawt ni hi, thumaan hong son ngawl ni hi. Ahihang Samson in a khut heen na khauzeente khauzam bang phetin saantat hi."},"13":{"text":"Delilah in Samson munah, “Kei sia a mawmaw khat vawtin hong vawt lai ni hi, thumaan hong son ngawl ni hi. Ama in, “Ka sampheak lom sali teng hong pheaksakin, thiamtana sungah taanelh in tuk kilhna khat taw hong ngatsak le ngualdang khat bangin ka tha zawm tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Delilah in ama a mut natu in oai a, a samlom sali teng thiamtana khat sungah taanelh hi. Ahihang ama hong khanglo a, a sam sia thiamtana pan hong nuk keak hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Delilah in ama tungah, “Nong it tak ngawl po bangbangin kong it ci thei ni ziam? Ama in tua nu ii a kut tawntung sia cimtak pi in cimtak a,"},"17":{"text":"a khakbel ciang a thu maan son hi. Ka sam hong kimeetsak hi le, ka thahatna ka taan tu a, ngualdang khat pawpo bangma in ka tha zawm tu hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Delilah in Samson ii thumaan a son hunlam a phaw ciangin, Philistine kumpipa te tungah thupuak in, “Khatvei ma hong pai kik tavun. A mihonte in ama a mu uh ciang, amate ii pathian tungah pokna lasa uh hi: “Ih pathian in ih ngalpa, ih ngam lalcipsak a eite tam mama hong that pa hong zosak hi.”","merge":"25"},"26":{"text":"Ama khut pan len in a paipui tangvalpa munah Samson in, “Innpi a dingsak khuampite hong thamsak ta'n, tuate neal nuam khi hi,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"A inn sia numei le pasal a dimteak in om hi. Philistine kumpi nga te zongh tua munah om a, tuaciang innkhum tungah numei le pasal kingawm mihing tulthum khawng zongh Samson ii poai lak en in om uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Samson in thu ngen a, “Vaanglianpipa Topa awng, kei hong phawk ta'n; nong hesuakna in Pathian awng, ka mittang te ngeal hong khelsak Philistine te tungah hi ka hatna khatvei zangh in phu ka lam zawk natu in ka thahatna khatvei bekma hong pia lai ta'n,” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahikom Samson in innpi a dingsak a laizang a po suut khuampite nii zamh hi. Samson in a nuntak lai a thalup sangin a thi ciangin a tamzaw thatlum hi."},"31":{"text":"A suapuipate le a innkuanpui dangte hong paisuk a, a luang phaam hi. Ama sia Israel lampui kum kul seam hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatvei lai in, Ephraim mualtung ngam a teang Micah a kici pasal khat om hi.","title":"Micah ii Milimte"},"2":{"text":"Ama in a nu munah, “Tua ngunntang tul le zakhat nang tung pan khat ii hong nguksak lai in, nguta pa na tomlaw hi. A nu in, “ Topa in nang thupha hong pia tahen, ka tapa awng!” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in a sum teng a nu piakik a, a nu in, “Haamsiatna ka tapa tung hong tun ngawl natu in, keima mama in tua ngunntang Topa tungah ciliap huai takin aaptuam khi hi. Amate Ephraim mualtung ngam hong thet uh ciang Micah ii inn ah tung uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate tua munah a taam sung Levi te khangmoi pa khat ii pau za uh hi, tua ahikom tua pa kungah amate pai in, “Hi sungah bang hi ni ziam? Amate in tua mite sia Sidon mite bangma in ngammuang takin a teang mu uh hi. Amate sia a kilem, dai khipkhep a om mite hi a, kuama taw bangma kituu ngeingawl hi; a kitaangsap uh theampo nei uh hi. Amate sia Sidon mite kung pan a khuala mama na ah teang in, midang taw bangma kizopna a nei bua uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Pasal nga teng Zorah le Eshtaol ah hong cia kik ciang, a ngammipuite in bang teng mu ni ziam ci in dongh uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in, “Hong pai tavun, Laish te sim tawng. Tua hu in a mun sia Dan Ngiaphual kici top lai hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate tua mun pan paisuak in Ephraim mualtung ngam Micah ii inn theng uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang Laish khua kiim ngam vil tu in a pai pasal nga teng in a kitholpuite mun ah, “Hi sung innte khat sungah thingngel milim ngunn taw a kituam khat a om sia na he uh ziam? Hi thu huvau bangbangin ngamta tu hi ziam?” ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihing theampo hong ding khawm tek in, “Ei a kuama po puanbuk ah ih teang zong, inn sung ih teang zong, cia ngawl tu hi hing."},"9":{"text":"Ih sep tu sia hisia hi: laimee ih sawk tu a, Gibeah a sim tu pasal pawlkhat ih teal tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel mi teng sung pan sawm ciang khat veu in ngalkaphonpi atu an sik tu a, a dang teng sia kuan in, hi paktat tatsiatna Israel ah hong vawt hu in Gibeah te daan ih pia tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom Israel mite theampo Gibeah khua sim natu vaihawm tu in kikhawm uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Israel namte in Benjamin nam ii ngamsung tangciing kamtai paisak in, “Hi khialna lian na vawt uh sia bang hi thong ziam?"},"13":{"text":"Gibeah ah a ngottatte, tu in hong aap tavun, tua hile amate thatlum thei in, hi tatsiatna sia Israel panin ka heam thei tu uh hi,” cisak hi. Ahihang Benjamin mite in Israel dangte a awlmawk bua uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate Benjamin ngamsung khuapite theampo panin Israel dang teng a do tu in Gibeah zuan uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in tua ni in a khuapite uh pan ngalkap 26,000 sam uh hi. Ahihang tua ngaknute amate atu in a kicing zo bua hi."},"15":{"text":"Benjamin te atu in mipite khuangai hi, banghang ziam cile, Topa in Israel namte ii kilomtangh na sia sutham hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom a kikhawmte ii lampuite in, “Benjamin nam sungah numei om nawn ngawl hi. Noma khat simin tua ngaknute sung pan zi khat tek zawthawk thu taw la vun a, Benjamin ngam ah cia pui vun."},"22":{"text":"Amate ii pate, suapuite in no kungah hong pai in lungkim ngawlna hong pau le, ‘Nong hesuakna in hong keamsak po tavun, banghang ziam cile amate sia ka zi tu a ngal kidona pan ka laak uh hi ngawl hi. Tuaciang no zongh in ko nong piak uh hi ngawl ahiciang, na kamciam uh a paltan suak ngawl nu hi,’ ci thei tu nu hi,” ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Benjamin te in tuabang ma in ngamta uh hi; Shiloh ah a laam ngaknute sung pan amate atu tek tealin a ngam ah ciapui in, khua saat kikin tua munah teang uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuasia hun laitak ma in a taanglai Israel te zongh tua mun nusia in, mi simin ama ii nam, a innkuanpuite kung, a neisa omna ah cia uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Israel ngam ah kumpi a om bua hi. Mi theampo in amate uuk bangin ngamta uh hi.","ref":"Thkte 17:6"}}}}},"8":{"info":{"name":"Ruth","shortname":"Ruth","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khua ngeipi hun lai, Israel te ii kumpi a nei ma in, a ngam sungah kialpi hong tung hi. Tua ahikom Ephrath bee le phung sung pan, Judah ngam Bethlehem khua a teang Elimelech a kici pasal khat sia a zi Naomi le a tapate nii, Mahlon le Chilion taw Moab ngam ah tawmvei sung teang tu in pai hi. Tua munah a teen lai in,","title":"Elimelech le A Innkuanpuite Moab ngam Theng","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Elimelech hong thi hi, tuaciang Naomi sia Moab numeite Orpah le Ruth"},"4":{"text":"a teenpui a tapate nii taw bek taang hi. Kum sawm bang zawkciang"},"5":{"text":"Mahlon le Chilion zongh thi uh hi, tuaciang Naomi sia pasal ngawl ta ngawl taw taang hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawk tawmvei ciangin, Topa in ama ii mite sia thupha pia a, an tam mama la hi ci in Naomi in za hi; tua ahikom a mote nii taw Moab ngam nusia tu in kithoai hi.","title":"Naomi le Ruth Bethlehem khua ah Heak kik"},"7":{"text":"Judah ngam zuan kik tu in amate kipan khawm tek hi, ahihang lam a pai kawmin"},"8":{"text":"Naomi in amate mun ah, “Cia kik tavun a, na nute uh taw om tavun. Kei tung le a thisate tungah nong thuthiam uh bangma in Topa in no tungah hong thuthiam tahen."},"9":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in no ngeal sia pasal nei kikin innkuan khat veve nei kik tu in hong siam tahen,” ci hi. Nangma taw na mipuite kungah hong zui tu khu hi,” ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Ka tanute awng, na heak kik uh kul tu hi,” ci in Naomi in zo hi. “Kei taw banghangin paikhawm nuam nu ziam? Na teenpui tu in tapate vei hing kik thei lai tu hong um nu ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Cia kik tavun, banghang ziam cile kei sia pasal nei kik tu in huai lei zo khi hi. Lam et om lai hi ci ngaisunin tu nitak mama, pasal nei in tapate nei hial leng zong,"},"13":{"text":"a khan ngak zo tu nu ziam? Hi bang taw ngualdang na teenpui tu uh kikhaksak nuam nu ziam? Topa in kei hong nungngat zo hi, tuaciang no atu in khuangai mama khi hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate kap tu in hong kipan leleau hi. Ahihang Ruth in a thasua nuam bua hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom Naomi in ama tungah, “Ruth awng, na unu sia a mite le a pathian kung zuan kik zo hi. Ama taw cia khawm ta'n,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang Ruth in, “Nang hong nusiasak heak in. Nangma taw hong paikhawmsak po ta'n. Na paina theampo ah ka pai tu a; na teenna po ah ka teang tu hi. Na mite sia keima mite hi tu a, na Pathian sia ka Pathian hi tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Na thina po ah ka thi tu a, tua mun sia hong kiphumna mun hi tu hi. Thina ngawl buang, kei sia nang taw ka kikhen ta le Topa in daan nasiabel kei tungah hong tungsak tahen,” ci in zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Naomi in Ruth sia ama taw paikhawm tu in a thin khensat zo ci in a mu ciang a pau nawn bua hi."},"19":{"text":"Bethlehem a thet dong amate paitan uh hi. Amate tua khua a thet uh ciang a khuathing bup liinglawng a, numei te in, “Hi sia Naomi hi takpi ziam?” ci in au uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in, “Kei Naomi hong ci heak vun, Marah hong ci tavun, banghang ziam cile Vaanglianbelpa Pathian in ka nuntakna hong haksasak hi."},"21":{"text":"Hi sung ka nusiat lai in na tam mama ka nei hi, ahihang Topa in bangma ngawl taw hong ciasak kik hi. Topa Vaanglianbelpa in hong puanil zo a, ngimna hong pia zo ahiciang banghangin Naomi hong cici lai nu ziam?” ci in zo hi."},"22":{"text":"Moab mi a monu Ruth taw Naomi ii hong ciana sia tu a bang ahi hi. Bethlehem hong thet hun lai in mangtaang at hun a kipat laitak ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Naomi in a pasal Elimelech ii bangkua sung pan a hau le a thudok khat ahi Boaz a kici mealheak khat nei hi.","title":"Boaz ii Lo sungah Ruth Naseam"},"2":{"text":"Ni khat ni in, Ruth in Naomi munah “Lo sungah hong paisak ta'n a, naseamte kheet ansangh te va khon tong. Naomi in, “Ka tanu awng, va pai ta'n,” ci in zo hi.","ref":"Thiam 19:9-10; Thkna 24:19"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom Ruth pai a, naseamte ii nung pan zui in, an a kheet te la hi. Ama ii sepna lo sia Boaz ii lo na hi luilam hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zawk tawm vei ciang Bethlehem panin Boaz hong theng a, naseamte paupui in, “ Topa in hong ompui tahen!” ci hi. Amate in, “ Topa in thupha hong pia tahen!” ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Boaz in, naseam uk pa munah “Zia sungah numei khangmoi sia akua ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua pa in, “Ama sia Moab pan Naomi ii hong ciapui numei sia hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in keima munah, naseamte nung pan zui in ansanghte a laak natu in hong ngen hi. Ama in zingsang tuung panin seam zo a, tu mahiat ma in thinglim ah tawmvei tawlnga hi,” ci in zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Boaz in Ruth munah, “Ngaisutna khat hong piasak ta'n. Hi lo sung simngawl koima dang ah ansangh tawm heak in. Hi sungah numeite taw naseam khawm in;"},"9":{"text":"amate koisungah la ci in en in, amate taw kithua in. Nang hong vawtsiat ngawl natu in ka mite thupia zo khi hi. Na dangko simin amate dipsa tuibealte sung pan tui dawn in,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ruth in a maitang lei pha dong kunsuk a Boaz tungah, “Nang a banghang kei huvau hong thinnuammaw mama ni ziam? Banghangin ngamdangmi khat tungah hong dik mama ni ziam?” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Boaz in, “Na pasal thi pan kipan na tonupi atu na sep na vawt theampo hong za siat khi hi. Na pa na nu le na ngam nusia in, na heak ngeingawl mite kawm ah teang tu in hong pai na hi sia ka he hi."},"12":{"text":"Na sepsa na vawtsa tungtaang Topa in thaman hong pia tahen. Ama ii hong pao hong dal tu in Israel te Topa Pathian na belh hu in ama in thaman kicing hong pia tahen!” ci in zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Ruth in, “Topa awng, nang kei tungah hong dik mama ni hi; Kei na naseamte khat taw zong kikim zo ngawl kasap kamthiam taw nong paupui ciang ka om nuam zaw paih hi,” ci in zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Anneak hun ciang Boaz in Ruth mun ah, “Hong pai ta'n a, anluum bek khat la in meetui sungah pap in,” ci hi. Tua ahikom ama naseamte taw hong tokhawm a, tuaciang Boaz in an em pawlkhat pia hi. Ama in a kham dong a neak zawkciang a neak vaal pawlkhat nei lai hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama ansangh tawm lai tu in a pai zawkciang Boaz in naseamte thupia a, “Taangvawngte a kikoina phual dong ma an lasak vun a, anlaak a tawp natu in bangma ci heak vun. Tua bek dom ngawlin taangvawngte pan pawlkhat dok vun a ama top tu in nusiat vun,” ci hi.","merge":"16"},"17":{"text":"Tua hi a Ruth in lo sungah nitak dong ansangh tawm a, tuaciang a cil ciangin kilogramme 10 dektak pha hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in a anlaakte khua sungah cia pui in a tonupi a nga za lak hi. A anneak vaal teng zongh a tonupi pia hi."},"19":{"text":"Naomi in ama munah, “Hiteng theampo koisung pan kaikhawm ni ziam? Akua lo sungah naseam ni ziam? Nang hong kin pa tungah Topa in thupha pia tahen!” ci hi. Tua ahikom Ruth in Naomi munah ama sia Boaz a kici pasal khat ii lo sungah na a sep son hi."},"20":{"text":"Naomi in, “ Topa in Boaz thupha pia tahen!” ci in au hi. “ Topa in a kamciam sia a nungta lai te le a thisate tung dong ah kholet tawntung hi.” A kampau zom lai a, “Tua pasal sia eima mealheak kuung khat hi a, ei hong kep tu vaipuak a nei khat ahi hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Thiam 25:25"},"21":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Ruth in, “A phabel hile, ama in an laak man dong a naseamte taw ansangh tawmin hong sawl sia ahi hi,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Naomi in Ruth mun ah, “Ahi ma hi, ka tanu awng, Boaz lo sungah tua numeite taw nasep khop tu ma phabel tu hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua hi a, Ruth in mangtaang le zungtaang laak teng a man dong amate taw seam khawmin an kaikhawm hi. Tuaciang ama sia a tonupi taw ma in teang khawm top hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tawmvei zawkciang Naomi in Ruth munah, “Inn tuam taw na om thei natu in pasal khat kong zonsak kul tu hi.","title":"Ruth in Pasal Mu"},"2":{"text":"Nangma nasep pui numeite ii Topa Boaz sia ih mealheak ahi hunlam ciamtee in. Tu in hong ngai ta'n. Nitak ciang ama in mangtaang na cil tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom kibualin a, paaknamtui tawm kinoai in, tuaciang na puan phabel teng silh in. Tua zawkciang ama taang cilna ah va pai ta'n a, ahizong a neak a dawn zawk mateng tua munah na om hunlam hesak heak in."},"4":{"text":"Ama koi sungah lum ziam pha tak ciamtee in, tuaciang a mut zawkciang a puanvan hawk in a, a khuadop ah lum in. Ama in na ngamtat natu teng hong son tu hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ruth in, “Na ci theampo ka vawt tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom Ruth sia ancilna munah pai in, a tonupi sawl bangin ngamta hi."},"7":{"text":"Boaz sia a neak a dawn zawkciang a om nuam hi. Ama taangvawng lomte omna ah pai in mu nuam in lum hi. Ruth hong pai vadeen a, a puanvan hawkin ama khuadop ah lum hi."},"8":{"text":"Zan lai in Boaz thakhatin hong khanglo in, kilumheak a, numei khat a khuadop ah a lum mu in lamdang sa hi."},"9":{"text":"“Nang akua ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Ruth khi hi, Topa awng. Nang sia mealheak kuung khat na hi ciang kei nong et tu vaipuak nei ni hi. Nong hesuakna in hong teenpui ta'n,” ci in zo hi."},"10":{"text":"“ Topa in nang thupha hong pia tahen. Na tonupi atu na sepna sa te sangin, tu in na ngamtatna taw ih bangkua sungah na thumaanna lian zaw lai hi. A hau a zawng tangval khat po zong thei na hi hang tuabangin zong ngawl ni hi."},"11":{"text":"Ruth awng tu in, na thinngim heak in. Nong nget theampo vawt tu khi hi; khua sungah a om a kuama theampo in nang sia numei pha khat na hi sia hong he hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei sia na mealheak kuung khat hi a, nang tungah vaipuak kong nei na in a maan thu hi, ahihang kei sangin a kuung zaw mealheak pasal khat om hi.","ref":"Ruth 2:20"},"13":{"text":"Hi sungah zankhuateakin om vet in a, zingsang ciangin tua pa in nang vaipuak hong la tu ziam, hong la ngawl tu ziam ih en tu hi. Vaipuak hong la tu ahile a dik a pha hi, hong la bua ahile a nungta Topa tungah kiciamna vawt hi tong, keima in vaipuak la tu khi hi. Tu in hi sungah zingsang ciang dong lum po in,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in Boaz ii khuadop ah lum top hi, ahizong ama a kimu ngawl natu in khuavak mahiat in tho hi, banghang ziam cile Boaz in ama tualai ah a om sia kuama in a hesak nuam bua hi."},"15":{"text":"Boaz in ama munah, “Na puantual suut in a, hi sungah pha in,” ci hi. Ama in tuabangin pha a, Boaz in mangtaang kilogramme 20 dektak sun hi, tuaciang a liang ah a puak tu in suanh hi. Tua zawkciang khua sungah a vanh taw ama heak kik hi."},"16":{"text":"Inn a thet ciang a tonupi in, “Bangbang nong hi ziam? ka tanu awng,” ci in dongh hi. Ruth in Boaz ii ama atu in, a sep a vawtsak theampo son hi."},"17":{"text":"A son lai na pan, “Nangma kungah khut hawm nguakin kong cia ngawl natu in hi mangtaang teng zongh hong pia hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Naomi in ama mun ah, “Tu in na thin sausak in, Ruth awng, hi thu teng koibang ciang hong theng tu ziam na mu dong ngak in. Boaz sia tuni in hi thu a thian mateng om thong ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Boaz sia a khua kongpi ah pai in tua kikhopna munah to hi. Tua zawkciang Elimelech ii mealheak naihuaibel, Boaz ii son sia pa hong pai hi, Boaz in ama sam in, “Hi sungah hong pai ta'n, ka lawm pa awng, hong to ta'n,” ci hi. Tuasia ciang ama pai in to hi.","title":"Boaz in Ruth Teenpui"},"2":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Boaz in a khua lampuite sawm zongh samin tua mun ma ah to a sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate a tosak zawkciang a mealheak pa munah, “Tu in Naomi sia Moab panin hong ciakik a, ih beepa Elimelech neisa a lo sia ama in zuak nuam hi,"},"4":{"text":"tuaciang hi thu na heak uh kul ka sa hi. Na dei le hi sungah a to mite mai ah lei in. Ahi hang na dei buale lei nuam bong ci in, banghang ziam cile lei thei natu thu a nei masabel sia nang hi a, tua zawkciang kei hi pheang khi hi,” ci hi. Tua pa in, “Tuasia lei tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Boaz in, “Pha mama hi, ahizong Naomi kung panin lo na lei le, Moab meingong nu Ruth zongh a lei suak tu ni hi, tuasia ciang bekin a lo sia mithi pa ii bangkua sungah om tu hi,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua pasal pa in, “Tuabang thu ahile lo lei theina ka thuneina sia thasua tong, banghang ziam cile ka tate in tua lo lua thei ngawl tu uh hi. Nangma lei in, tuasia kei lei bua zaw tong,” ci in zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hunlai in, sum kizuak kilei na ahizong, vanh kithena ahizong, kipsak na tu in a zuak pa in peangdap suut in a lei pa tungah a piak sia a ngeina hi. Israel te in hi bangin thukip thukho suaksak hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:9"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom pasal pa in Boaz mun ah, “Tuasia nangma lei in,” a ci ciang, a peangdap suutin Boaz pia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Boaz in lampuite le a om dangte mun ah, “No sia tu ni in Elimelech le a tapate Chilion le Mahlon ii neisa theampo Naomi tung pan ka leina tetti hi siat nu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua bek dom ngawlin Mahlon zi meingong nu Moab mi Ruth sia keima zi suak hi. Hi sia in mithi pa bangkua sungah a neisa teng kip tu hi, ama ii innkuan khang zongh a mite sung le a khua sungah kizom tan tu hi. No teng sia hi thu huvau in tetti hi siat nu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:5-6"},"11":{"text":"Lampuite le a dangte in, “Hi hi, tetti te hi khu hi. Topa in na zi sia Jacob atu ta tam mama a piangsak Rachel le Leah bang hong hisak tahen. Ephrath bee le ngui sungah hau in Bethlehem khua sungah na minthang tahen.","ref":"Pian 29:31"},"12":{"text":"Topa ii hi nupi khangmoi tung pan hong piak tu tate sia Judah le Tamar tapa Perez bangkua bang hong hisak tahen,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 38:27-30"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom Boaz in Ruth sia a zi tu in ciapui hi. Topa in Ruth thupha pia a, nau hong paai in, tapa khat hong hing hi.","title":"Boaz le A suan A paalte"},"14":{"text":"Numei te in Naomi tung ah, “ Topa pok in! Ama in nang hong en kik tu tupa khat tuni hong pia hi. Hi patang sia Israel ah minthang tahen!"},"15":{"text":"Na monu in nang hong it hi, tuaciang ama in tapa sali sang zongin nang atu tam hong sepsak zo zaw hi. Tuaciang tu in ama in tupa khat hong pia a, tua pa in nang atu nuntakna thak le na huai ciang ngam muanna hong pia tu hi,” ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Naomi in nau sia la in toai bikbek a, pha takin omh hi."},"17":{"text":"Innpaam nupi te in tua pano min sia Obed phuak uh hi. Amate in ngual mun theampo ah, “Naomi in tapa khat hong nei hi!,” ci uh hi. Obed sia Jesse ii pa suak a, Jesse sia David ii pa hi."},"18":{"text":"Hiteng sia Perez pan David dong khangsimna ahi hi: Perez, Hezron, Ram, Amminadab, Nahshon, Salmon, Boaz, Obed, Jesse, David ahi hi.","merge":"19"}}}}},"9":{"info":{"name":"Samuel Khatna","shortname":"1Sam","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephraim mualtung ngam Ramah khua ah Ephraim nam ahi Elkanah a kici pasal khat om hi. Ama sia Jeroham ii ta, Elihu ii tupa hi a, Tohu baangkua, Zuph bee le phung sung pan ahi hi.","title":"Shiloh ah Elkanah le A Innkuante"},"2":{"text":"Elkanah in zi nii nei a, Hannah le Peninnah ahi hi. Peninnah in ta nei ahihang Hannah in nei ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Kum simin Elkanah sia Topa Vaanglianbelpa bia tu le sangaw biakpiakna vawt tu in Ramah pan Shiloh ah pai hi, tua munah Eli ii tapa nii te Hophni le Phinehas sia Topa ii thiampi seam uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Elkanah in sangaw biakpiakna a vawt simin, tel khat Peninnah pia a, tel khat tek sia a tate pia hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in Hannah it mama hi napi tel khat bek pia thei hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in ta neisak ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"A kidem pui Peninnah in ama sia nunau zazaan in, a maizum thethei tu in vawt sia hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in Hannah sia ta selsak hi."},"7":{"text":"Kum khat zawk kum khat hi bangin papai a; Topa ii inn ah a pai uh simin Peninnah in Hannah a thin lalsak mama ahikom Hannah sia kap a, bangma a ne nuam bua hi."},"8":{"text":"A pasal Elkanah in, “Hannah awng, banghangin kap ni ziam? Banghangin an ne nuam ngawl ni ziam? Banghangin hee tawntung ni ziam? Tapa sawm sangin kei sia nang atu manpha zaw hi ngawl khi ziam?” ci in dong hi."},"9":{"text":"Ni khat, amate Shiloh khua, Topa inn sungah an a neak zawk uh ciang, Hannah hong dingto hi. Ama sia a thin na sa mama a, kap ngawpin Topa tungah thungen hi. Tua hun sung tengin Eli thiampipa sia ama omna kongkha hui ah to nginge hi.","title":"Hannah le Eli","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Hannah in a ciliap huai kamciam khat pia hi: Vaanglianbelpa “ Topa awng, na naseamnu hong en ta'n! Ka ngimna hong en ta'n a, hong phawk ta'n! Hong mangil heak in! Tapa khat nong pia le, ama nuntakna buppi nang tungah tuam aap tu in kong kamciam hi, ama in a sam meet ngeingawl tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mi 6:5"},"12":{"text":"Hannah in Topa tungah hun saupi sung thungen top a, tuaciang Eli in ama ii muk en hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama sia a thimthamin thungen hi; a muk phun ahihang a aw suaksak ngawl hi. Tua ahikom Eli in ama sapittui kham hi tu in um hi,"},"14":{"text":"tuaciang ama munah, “Na zukham ngamtatna teng tawp in! Zu ne nawn heak in a, na zu neak tawp in!” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in, “Hi ngawl khi hi, kei zu kham hi ngawl khi hi, topa awng, zu ne sa in om ngawl khi hi! A cimaw ka hi hi, thu ngengen in ka ngimna teng Topa tungah sung khi hi."},"16":{"text":"Nupi mannung ngawl hong sa heak in. Lungmang mama ka hikom hi bangin thu ngengen khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"17":{"text":"“Thinnuam in va pai ta'n, Israel te ii Pathian in na nget teng hong pia tahen,” Eli in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"“A tawntungin cikna thiamna taw kei hong phawk ta'n,” ama in ci hi. Tuasia zawkciang an tawm ne in paikhia a, a khuangai nawn bua hi."},"19":{"text":"A zingsang kik ciang Elkanah le a innkuanpuite tho pal in, Topa a biak zawk uh ciang Ramah khua ah ciakik uh hi. Elkanah in a zi Hannah ompui a, Topa in a zi thungetna zo hi.","title":"Samuel ii Pianna le a Ki aapna"},"20":{"text":"Tuabangin ama naungil om a, tapa khat hing hi. Ama in a min Samuel phuak a, “Ama sia Topa tung pan ka nget hi” a cina ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Elkanah le a innkuanpuite Shiloh ah pai in Topa tungah kum sim sangaw biakpiakna le a kamciam tuam sangaw biakpiakna a piak tu hun hong cing kik hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang tusia hunin Hannah hong pai bua hi. Ama in a pasal munah, “Nau in noai a ten po ciang a nuntak sung teng a om natu in Topa inn ah ka paipui tu hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Elkanah in zo kik a, “Pha hi, phabel na sak bangin vawt in; nau noai na tensak dong inn ah om in. Tuaciang Topa in na kamciam hong taangtungsak hen,” ci hi. Tua ahikom Hannah sia inn ah om a, a nau keam hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in nau noai a tensak zawkciang Shiloh ah paipui a, kum thum a pha khuital khat, anvui kilogramme 10 le savun ip sungah sapittui a dim keng hi. Ama in Samuel sia moi mama ahihang Topa inn Shiloh ah paipui hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate in khuital a ngaw zawkciang nauno sia Eli kungah paipui uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Hannah in ama munah, “Topa awng hong ngai zii ta'n. Kei nong ciamtee lai ziam? Kei sia hi munah dingin Topa tungah thu a ngengen nong mu numei sia khi hi."},"27":{"text":"Hi patang sia ama munah ka ngen a, ka nget bangin hong pia hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa tungah ama aaptuam khi hi. A nuntak lai theampo ama sia Topa neisa suak tu hi,” ci hi. Tua zawkciang amate in tua munah Topa bia uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hannah in hi bangin thungen hi: “ Topa in ka lungtang sia lungdamna taw hong dimh hi; Ama ii sepna sate hu in bangza in ka lungdam ziam! Ka ngalte ka nuisan hi; Pathian in hong hu ahikom bangza in ka thinnuam ziam!","title":"Hannah ii Thungetna","ref":"Lk 1:46-55"},"2":{"text":"“ Topa bangin a thiangtho kuama om ngawl hi; Ama taw a kibang kuama om ngawl hi, Ih Pathian bangin hong dal kuama om ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Na kisuantaak vazakna uh teng kheal vun; Na kiphatsak kampaute thimsak vun. Banghang ziam cile Topa sia a he a tel Pathian hi a, mihingte sepna vawtna theampo tungah thu khen hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngalkap thahat te ii thalte taltan a, ahihang a thazawmte thahat tawto hi."},"5":{"text":"Khatvei lai in pha takin a kivaakte, tu in an thalaw bek a, ngual cial sa in om hi, ahihang a ngilkialte sia kial nawn ngawl hi. Tasel zi sia ta sali hong nei hi, ahihang ta tam mama te ii nu kungah kuama a taang nawn bua hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in thatlum a, tuaciang nungtasak kik hi; ama in mihingte sia mithi khua ah puak hi, tuaciangin heakpui kik hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in mihing pawlkhat zawngkhalsak a, pawlkhat hausak hi; pawlkhat sia ama in kiniamkhiaksak a, pawlkhat liansak hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in mizawngte leivui panin laamto a, a kitasamhte a lungmanna panin phongto hi. Amate sia kumpipa tapate taw kithawlsakin, ki upat vawtna munah koi hi. Simlei ii phungkawng sia Topa aa hi; tuate ii tungah ama in leitung sato hi.","ref":"Ps 113:7"},"9":{"text":"“Ama in a thumaan a mite ii nuntakna dal hi, ahihang a seksolte sia khuazing sungah mang hi; mihing khat in ama hantang tha ngum hatna taw mualsuak zo ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa ii ngalte sia kisusia cip tu hi; Topa in amate vantung panin vanto bangin langpan tu hi. Topa in leitung buppi thu hong khen tu hi; ama in a kumpipa tungah vaangletna pia tu hi, ama ii teal kumpipa in zosak tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Elkanah sia Ramah ah cia kik hi, ahihang Samuel patangno sia Shiloh ah taang a, thiampi Eli khutnuai ah Topa naseam hi."},"12":{"text":"Eli ii tapate sia mihing phelphol vive hi. Amate in Topa a awlmaw bua uh hi,","title":"Eli ii Tapate"},"13":{"text":"tua bek dom ngawlin thiampite ii mipite tung pan a nget thei tu te a nadon bua uh hi. Tua taangin mihing khat ii sangaw biakpiakna a om ciangin thiampi pa ii naseampa in kaa thum nei thiktung zum khat taw hong pai uh hi. A sa a kihuan saan laitakin"},"14":{"text":"ama in beal sungah a thiktung kaa taw sun a, a laak po sia thiampipa ii neisa ahi hi. Shiloh ah sangaw biakpiakna pia tu in hong pai Israel mite theampo sia hi bangin kivawt hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua banah ngan thau hoai in a kihal ma in, thiampipa ii naseampa hong pai a, sangaw biakpiakna a pia pa munah, “Sa pawlkhat thiampipa em tu hong pia ta'n; ama in na sa huansa hong saang ngawl tu hi, sasial bek dei hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua pa in, “A maan bangin ngamta tawng, a thau hal phot tawng; tua zawkciang na dei po la in,” ci in a zo ciang, “Hi ngawl hi! tu ma in hong pia ta'n! Nong pia buale zawthawk thu taw la tu khi hi!” thiampipa ii naseampa in ci tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Hi bangin Eli ii tapate mawna sia Topa muna ah nasia leih hi, banghang ziam cile amate in Topa tungah biakpiaknate tuabangin simmawk vawt uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hun sungin patang Samuel sia puanneal kawngsawm thiangtho khat taw Topa na seam hi.","title":"Shiloh ah Samuel"},"19":{"text":"A nu in a pasal ii kum sim sangaw biakpiakna a vawt simin a pai khop uh ciangin, puantual khat veu ama atu in khuisak a, puak hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua hun ciang Eli in Elkanah le a zi thupha pia a, Elkanah munah, “ Topa atu na piaktuam na tapa taangin hi numei nu tung panin ta dangte zongh hong pia tahen,” ci hi. Tua zawkciang amate inn ah cia kik uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in Hannah sia thupha pia takpi a, tapa thum le tanu nii nei thua hi. Patang Samuel sia Topa na a sepna sungah khangto hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu in Eli sia huai mama zo hi. Ama in a tate ii Israel mite tungah a ngamtatna theampo zaza a, Topa ompuina Puanbuk kongbiang a na a seam numeite ngawngawn luppui uh hi, ci in za hi.","title":"Eli le A tapate"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate munah, “Banghangin hi bangte vawt nu ziam? Mihing theampo in siatna na vawt uhte hong son hi."},"24":{"text":"Kheal vun, ka tate awng! Hi thu sia a lipkhaphuai mama in Topa mite ii son ahi hi!"},"25":{"text":"Mihing khat in midang khat tungah a maw le Pathian in sungsia thei hi, ahihang Topa tungah a mawte sia akua in sungsia thei tu ziam?” ci hi. Ahihang amate in a pa thu a ni bua uh hi, tua ahikom Topa in amate thalup tu in khensat zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Patang Samuel sia hong khang tawto a, Topa le mihingte mai ah maipha nga hi.","ref":"Lk 2:52"},"27":{"text":"Topa kung pan hi thu puak in kamsaang khat Eli kungah hong pai hi: “Na taanghpupi Aaron le innkuanpuite Egypt kumpipa salin a om lai in, Aaron tungah keima ka kilaak hi.","title":"Eli ii Bangkua atu Sonkholna"},"28":{"text":"Israel minam theampo ii sung pan keima thiampi tu, biaknatau ah a seam tu, ngimnamtui hal tu, ephod silh a, keima thu hong dongh tu in amate innkuan ka teal hi. Tuaciangin biaknatau tungah a kihal sangaw biakpiakna te tel khat sia amate tan thei natu thu ka pia hi.","ref":"Pu 28:1-4; Thiam 7:35-36"},"29":{"text":"Tua hikasap ka mite tung pan, ka nget biakpiaknate le sangaw biakpiaknate banghang duhopna thin taw en ni ziam? Eli awng, ka mite ii kei tungah hong piak sangaw biakpiakna theampo pan sabak phabel teng taw na tate a thau dong amate le amate na kivaaksakna taw banghangin kei sangin na tate upat vawt zaw ni ziam?"},"30":{"text":"Keima, Israel te ii Topa Pathian in na innkuan le na phung sia keima thiampi seam tawntung tu hi, ci in a bosa hun sungah kamciam ka pia hi. Ahihang tu ahile kong cina pan, tuasia len nawn ngawl khi hi! Tua sangin kei hong patoai te ka patoai tu a, kei hong simmaw te ka ngaimawk vawt tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Ngai in, na bangkua sungah kuama a khanhaam in a nuntak ngawl natu, na bee na ngui sungah tangval khangmoi teng ka thalup siat tu hun hong theng tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Nangma in ngim na nga tu a, Israel midangte thupha ka piakte na eang tu hi, ahihang na bangkua sungah kuama a khanhaam dong a nungta buatu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahitazong na suan na paalte khat sia keamin ka nungtasak tu a, thiampi in ka na seam tu hi. Ahihang ama sia a mittaw in, a lam etna theampo bo tu hi, tuaciang na suan na paal theampo sia thi ngamh in thi tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Na tapate nii Hophni le Phinehas, ni khat thu in hong thi khop ciang kong son teng tung hi ci in hong lak tu hi.","ref":"1 Sa 4:11"},"35":{"text":"Vawt le ka oai theampo vawt a, kei tungah hong thumaan tu thiampi dang khat ka teal tu hi. Ama sia suan le paal ka pia tu a, amate in ka teal kumpipa omna ah seam tawntung tu uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Na suan na paal sung pan a luhai lai te in tua thiampipa kungah pai in sum le anneak tu ngen tu a, tuaciang a neak tawm tu a zonna in thiampite nasep a hu thei natu in ngen tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun lai, patang Samuel in Eli ii lamlakna bang a Topa atu a sep lai in, Topa tung pan thu hong pai sia tawm mama hi, tuaciang mang muna te tam ngawl hi.","title":"Samuel tungah Kilaak"},"2":{"text":"Tu in a mit a taw cip dektak Eli sia, zan khat, ama inndoi sungah mu in om hi;"},"3":{"text":"Samuel sia Thuciamna Thingkuang thiangtho omna biakpiakna munah mu in om hi. Khuavak ma, meiinn a taan laitak ma in,"},"4":{"text":"Topa in Samuel sam hi. Ama in “Hi sungah om ing, topa!” ci in zo hi,"},"5":{"text":"tuaciang Eli kungah tai a, “Kei nong sap sia, hi sung ma ah om khi hi,” ci hi. Ahihang Eli in zo a, “Nang hong sam ngawl khi hi; lum kik ta'n,” ci hi. Tua ahikom Samuel sia a lupna zuan kik hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in Samuel sam kik hi. Patangpa in Topa ahi hunlam a he bua hi, banghang ziam cile tua masia in Topa in ama a paupui ngei bua hi. Tua ahikom ama tho in Eli kungah pai a, “Nong sap sia hi sungah om khi hi,” ci hi. Ahihang Eli in, “Ka tapa awng, hong sam ngawl khi hi; lum kik ta'n,” ci hi.","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Topa in Samuel sia a thum veina sam hi; ama tho a, Eli kungah pai in, “Nong sap sia, hi sungah om khi hi,” ci hi. Tuasia ciang Eli in patang a sam sia Topa ahi hunlam phawk hi."},"9":{"text":"tua ahikom ama munah, “Lupna zuan kik ta'n; tuaciang ama in hong sam kik le hi bangin ci in, ‘ Topa awng pau in, na naseampa in hong ngai khi hi,’ ci ta'n,” ci hi. Tua ahikom Samuel sia lupna zuan kik hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa hong pai a tua munah dingin, a masa bangma in sam kik a, “Samuel! Samuel!” ci hi. Samuel in zo a, “Hong paupui ta'n; na naseampa in hong ngai khi hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in ama munah, “Ni khat ni ciang Israel mite tungah a lauhuai mama khat ka vawt tu a, a za peuma lau ngawp tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ni in Eli innkuante ka tawnna theampo a kipat pan a tawp dong ka tungsak tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama munah a bangkua sia a tawntung daan ka piak tu son zo khi hi, banghang ziam cile a tapate kei hong langpanin kamsia pau uh hi. Eli in hite sia he nginge ahihang tho ngawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom Eli ii bangkua tungah sangaw biakpiakna ahizong, piakkhiatna ahizong bangma in, hi a lipkhaphuai mama mawna taw a kizui a piang tu te pengsak zo ngawl tu hi ci in ciliap huai takin ka taangko hi."},"15":{"text":"Samuel sia zingsang dong lupna tungah om hi; tua zawkciang tho in, Topa inn kongkha hong hi. A mangmuna huvau Eli tungah a son tu sia lau hi."},"16":{"text":"Eli in, “Samuel, ka patangpa awng!” ci in sam hi. “Om khi hi, topa” ci in Samuel in zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Eli in, “ Topa in bang hong son ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Kei tungah bangma hong iim heak in. Hong son theampo nong son buale Pathian in nasia takin daan hong pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom Samuel in ama tungah na theampo son a, bangma kheet a nei bua hi. Eli in, “Ama sia Topa hi; phabel a sak bangin ama in seam tu hi,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Samuel hong khan ciang Topa sia ama taw omkhawm a, Samuel ii son teng a vekpi in taangtungsak hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahikom Israel mi theampo, a ngam mong pan a mong khat dongin, Samuel sia Topa kamsaang takpi hi ci in he uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in ama le ama sia Shiloh ah a kizomin Samuel tungah hong kilaak a, paupui hi. Tuaciang Samuel ii a pau ciang, Israel theampo in ngai uh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Philistine te in Israel sim tu in kikaikhawm ahikom Israel te sia amate do tu in kuan uh hi. Ama in ka mite uk tu hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Saul sia kongkha hui ah a om Samuel kungah pai in, “A mukhol thei pa koi sungah teang ziam, hong son ta'n,” ci in dongh hi."},"19":{"text":"Samuel in, “Keima a mukhol theipa khi hi. Biakna mun ka mai ah pai vun. No nii sia tuni in kei taw an nekhawm tu nu hi. Zing ciang zingsang in nong dok teng theampo hong son tu khi hi, tua zawkciang na pai natu po ah hong paisak tu khi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tu nung ni thum lai in a bo laate ahile thinngim heak in; tuate kimu zo hi. Ahizong, Israel mite ii a dei a lungngul mama sia akua ziam? Nangma ni hi — nang le na pa ii innkuan ahi hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul in zo a, “Kei sia Israel sungah nam nobel Benjamin nam pan khi hi, tuaciang ka bangkua sia tua nam sung pan a thupi ngawlbel hi. Tua ahiciang banghangin tubangin thu hong son ni ziam?” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Samuel in Saul le a naseampa inndoi lian khat sungah tumpui a, leangna 30 khawng ii tona sabuai lu ah tosak hi."},"23":{"text":"Samuel in an huan pa munah, sabak khat tuamkoi in ci a kong piak sia hong la ta'n,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahikom anhuanpa in a deiteal a pheisa bak khat hong la in, Saul mai ah hong lui hi. Samuel in, “En in, hi sungah sabak nang atu a kikoituam sia om hi. Hisia ne in. Mihing ka samte taw tu laitak na neak tu in kong khealsiasak hi,” ci hi. Tuabangin tua ni in Saul sia Samuel taw an nekhawm hi."},"25":{"text":"Biakna mun panin khua sungah a tuaksuk zawk uh ciang, amate in innkhum tungah Saul atu lupna vawtsak uh hi,"},"26":{"text":"tuaciang ama tua munah lum hi. Khuavak ciang Samuel in innkhum tungah Saul sam to a, “Tho in, na pai natu munah hong paisak tu khi hi,” ci hi. Saul tho in Samuel taw lampi zui in paikhawm hi."},"27":{"text":"Khua mong a thet uh ciang, Samuel in Saul munah, “Naseampa ei mai ah paisak in,” ci hi. Naseampa in amate nusia a, Samuel in, “Tawmvei no sung hi sungah na om zii in, Pathian ii hong cina teng hong son tu khi hi,” ci hi.","title":"Samuel in Ngam Ukpa tu in Saul Sathau noai"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Samuel in olive thau thawl khat la a, Saul lu tungah buakin ama a nap zawkciang, “ Topa in a Israel mite uk tu in nang sathau hong noai hi. Ama mite nangma uk in, a ngalte theampo kung panin amate na hung tu hi. Tuaciang Topa ii a mite a uk tu nang hong teal takpina sia hi bangin kilak tu hi:"},"2":{"text":"Tuni kei nong nusiat ciang Benjamin ngam Zelzah khua Rachel ii thaan ah mihing nii taw na kisi tu hi. Amate in laa na zonte kimu kik zo a, na pa sia tuate atu thinngim nawn ngawl hi, nangma atu thinngim a, hi bangin dok sasaan hi, “Ka tapa vai bang law tu khi ziam?” hong ci tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tabor ah biakna thingkung omna san na thet dong na papai tu a, tua munah mihing thum, Bethel ah Pathian tung sangaw biakpiakna pia tu in a paite taw na kisi tu hi. Tuate khat in kealngual thum kai tu a, a dang khat in anluum luum thum, a thumna sia in savun thawl a dim sapittui pua tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in nang hong muak in, anluum luum nii hong pia tu a, tuate na saang tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, Philistine te ngiaphual saatna khat a omna, Gibeah ngamsung Pathian Mual ah na pai tu hi. Khua sung tumna ah kamsaang pawlkhat, mualtung biaknatau pan tengtongh, khuang, tamngai le liamlo te tumin hong tuaksuk te taw na kisi tu uh hi. Amate laam in a au tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Thakhat thu in Topa thaa in nang hong uk in, amate biakna taw kisai a lapna le a auna te na pawm tu a, mihing tuamdang khat na suak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Hite hong pian ciangin Pathian ii na vawt tu a hong lampui pawpo sia vawt in."},"8":{"text":"Keima mai Gilgal ah na paikhol tu a, tua munah ih kimu tu hi, tuaciang meihal sangaw biakpiaknate le pawlkhop sangaw biakpiaknate ka pia tu hi. Keima hong pai in, na sep na vawt tu teng kong son dong ni sali hong ngak tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Samuel nusia tu in Saul a kiheak ciang, Pathian in Saul sia pianzia thak khat pia hi. Tuaciang Samuel son theampo tua ni in piang hi."},"10":{"text":"Saul le a naseampa Gibeah hong thet uh ciang, kamsaang pawlkhat taw kisi hi. Thakhat thu in Pathian thaa in ama uk a, tua ciang amate ii lawp ngawpin a ngualnop lapna le a auna pawm hi."},"11":{"text":"Nidang in ama a he ngeite in hi bangin a om a mu uh ciang amate khat le khat kidongh a, “Kish ii tapa bang tawk ziam? Saul sia kamsaang khat suak zo ziam?” ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua munah a teang pasal khat in, “Hi kamsaang dangte thu bangbangziam? — a pate sia akua bangte hi tu na um uh ziam?” Hisia sia, “Saul ngawngawn kamsaang khat suak zo ziam?” ci paunak ii kipatna ahi hi.","ref":"1 Sa 19:23-24"},"13":{"text":"Saul zongh lawp ngawpin a lap le a au teng a man zawkciang mualtung biaknatau ah paito hi."},"14":{"text":"Saul ii pano in ama le a naseampa mu a, “Koisung theng man nu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Laa zong khu hi,” ci in Saul in zo hi. “Ka mu zawk ngawl uh ciang Samuel taw kimu tu in pai khu hi,” ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tuaciang ama in bang hong ci ziam?” ci in Saul pano in dongh hi."},"16":{"text":"Saul in, “Ama in ngannote kimu zo hi ci in hong son hi,” ci in zo hi — ahihang ama ii kumpipa a suana tu huvau Samuel ii ci teng a pano tungah a son bua hi."},"17":{"text":"Samuel in Mizpah ah mipite biakkikhop khat sam a,","title":"Saul sia Kumpipa in, Kithangsak"},"18":{"text":"tuaciang amate tungah, “ Topa Israel te ii Pathian in, ‘Egypt ngam panin kong pusua pui a, Egypt te le no hong nengniam midang te kung panin kong suatak hi."},"19":{"text":"Keima sia na Pathian ka hi a, noma ngimna theampo le haksatna theampo panin hong suatak pa khi hi, ahihang tuni in hong nial in, kumpipa khat piak tu in nong ngen uh hi. Pha mama hi, tua ahile, Topa mai ah a nam le a bee a phung zui in hong kikhawm tavun,’ ” ci in son hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Samuel in a nam simin mai ah paisak a, Topa in Benjamin nam tangkal hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaciang Samuel in Benjamin namte sung pan a innkuan tek sia mai ah a paisak ciang Matri ii innkuan kiteal hi. Matri ii innkuan pan pasalte a mai ah hong pai a, tuaciang Kish ii tapa Saul kiteal hi. Amate in ama zongin a mu zawk ngawl ciang,"},"22":{"text":"amate in Topa dongh a, “A dang khat ma a om lai ziam?” ci uh hi. Topa in zo a, “Saul sia zia sungah om hi, vanh honte nungah buu hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate va tai in Saul sia mipite kungah hong paipui uh hi, tuaciang ama sia midang khat pawpo sangin lu tun khat saangzaw in mu thei uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Samuel in mipite munah, “Hi munah Topa ii teal sia pa om hi! Ei sungah ama taw a kibang kuama dang om ngawl hi,” ci hi. Mipite au siat in, “Kumpipa a khansau tahen!” ci uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Samuel in kumpipa khat ii sep thei te le a vaipuakte mipite tungah sonthiangin, laibu sungah a at zawkciang a thiangtho mun khat ah koi hi. Tua zawkciang ama in a kuama theampo inn tek ah ciasak hi."},"26":{"text":"Saul zongh Gibeah a inn ah cia hi. Pathian ii a lungtang a thuthaak pasal thahat pawlkhat in ama tonpui hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahihang mihing mannung ngawl pawlkhat in, “Hi sia pa in ei tungah a pha khat po bangbangin hong vawt thei thong tu ziam?” ci uh hi. Saul sia simmaw in letsong bangma a puak bua uh hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tha khat bang zawkciang Ammon kumpipa Nahash in Gilead ngam sung, Jabesh khua sia a ngalkaphonpi kuanpui in uumci hi. Jabesh mite in Nahash munah, “Ko taw thukimna kho khat vawt in, tuaciang hong ukpa tu in kong saang tu uh hi,” ci uh hi.","title":"Saul in Ammon mite Zothal"},"2":{"text":"Nahash ii zo kikna pan, “Thu khat na lungkim uh le no taw thukimna kho khat vawt ma tawng: Israel mi bup mindai natu in khat sim ii mittang ziatsang khelsak tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Jabesh lampuite in, “Israel ngam bup ah kamtaite ka paisak natu in ni sali hun hong pia ta'n. Kuama in hong hu tuak buale kong tum tu uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kamtaite Saul ii teenna Gibeah hong thengin, a thu teng a kison ciang mihingte sia thinkiamin kap uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Saul sia a khuitalte taw lo panin hong cia zawk hiat bek hi a, “Bang tat nu ziam? Banghang mihing theampo kap ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Amate in Jabesh pan kamtaite ii thupuak teng son uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Saul in hi thu a zaak ciang, Pathian thaa in ama uk a, a thinso hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in khuital nii ngoin, a bak a bak in a sem zawkciang, Israel ngam bup ah kamtaite sabak kengin paisak a, a kidop natu thu puaksak hi: “Ngal kisimna sungah Saul le Samuel nung a zui ngawl peuma a khuital tek uh tuabang ma in kivawtsak tu hi,” ci hi. Israel mite sia Topa in bang khat po a law thak tu lau in, khat zongh kikhe ngawlin hong paikhawm tek uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Saul in amate Bezak ah khawmtua a: Israel pan 300,000 le Judah pan 30,000 pha uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in Jabesh pan kamtai te munah, “Na mipuite munah son vun, zing ciang nisun ma in amate kisuatak tu hi.” Jabesh a mite in tua thupuak a nga ciangin lungdam leilam uh a,"},"10":{"text":"tuaciang Nahash munah, “Zing ciangin hong tum tu khu hi, nong law nop po hong law ta'n,” ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zanin Saul in a mite pawl thum in khen a, khuavak ciang ngalte ngiaphual sungah tum ngawpin Ammon te sim uh hi. Ni sun hun in amate thatlum ngawp uh hi. A suakta sun te khakhat in tai thaap uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Israel mite in Samuel munah, “Saul sia ih kumpi seamsak ngawl tu hi a ci te koi sungah om siat ziam? Ko tungah hong aap tavun, thatlum siat tu khu hi!” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang Saul in, “Tuni in kuama kithisak ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in Israel a suatak ni hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang Samuel in amate munah, “Ih vekpi Gilgal ah pai in, Saul sia ih kumpipa hi ci in khatvei taangko lai tawng,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate Gilgal ah pai siat a, tuasung mun thiangthona ah Saul sia kumpipa hi ci in thangsak uh hi. Amate in pawlkhop sangaw biakpiaknate pia in, Saul le Israel mite theampo tua thu huvau in poai khaam uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang Samuel in Israel mite munah, “Nong nget uh theampo hong vawtsak zo khi hi. Kumpipa khat no hong uk tu in hong pia zo khi hi,","title":"Samuel in Mipite tung Thuson"},"2":{"text":"tu in no lam hong pui tu ama nei zo nu hi. Kei ka hi le huai in ka puakkaang zo hi, tuaciang ka tate sia no taw omkhawm nu hi. Ka khangno lai pan kipan tu dong noma lampui seam zo khi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi sungah om khi hi. Ka sep ka vawt khat po ahi ngawl a om le tu in Topa le a tealsa kumpipa mai ah maw hong suan tavun. Mihing khat po ii khui ahizong, laa ahizong kong laaksak ngei ziam? Akua khat po kong theam ngei, kong nengniam ngei ziam? Khat po tung pan sumnguk kong saang ngei ziam? Hi bang khat pawpo ka ngamta ngei le ka laak babang pia kik tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Mipite in zo a, “Hong theamin hong nengniam ngeingawl ni hi; kuama tung pan bangma la ngeingawl ni hi,” ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Samuel ii a zo kikna pan, “Kei a maw ngawl het in nong mu uh sia Topa le ama ii tealsa kumpipa sia tuni in tetti ahi hi,” ci hi. “Hi ma hi, Topa sia kote ii tetti hi,” amate in ci in zo uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Samuel in zom suak a, “ Topa sia Moses le Aaron a teal, Egypt pan na taanghpupite hong pusuapui sia hi.","ref":"Pu 6:26"},"7":{"text":"Tu in na omna tek ah ding vun, Topa ii noma le na taanghpupite a hut natu a nasep lianpite theampo no kong phawksak tu a, Topa mai ah note maw kong suan tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Jacob le a innkuanpuite Egypt ah a pai lai in, Egypt te in nengniam ahiciang, na taanghpupite in Topa munah hu ngenin au uh hi, tuaciang ama in Moses le Aaron paisak in, Egypt ngam pan amate pusua pui a, hi ngam ah teangsak hi.","ref":"Pu 2:23"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang mite in Topa a Pathian mangil a, tuasia ciang ama in Philistine te, Moab kumpipa le Hazor khuapi ii ngalkaphonpi ukpa Sisera te in na taanghpupite simsak a, zothal hi.","ref":"Thkte 4:2; Thkte 13:1; Thkte 3:12"},"10":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate in Topa tungah hu ngenin, ‘Ko sia maw zo khu hi, banghang ziam cile nang kung panin kiheak khu hi, Topa awng, tuaciang Baal le Astarte milimte bia khu hi. Ka ngalte kung pan hong suatak ta'n, tuaciang nangma hong bia tu khu hi!’ ci in au uh hi.","ref":"Thkte 10:10-15"},"11":{"text":"Tuaciang, Topa in Gideon, Barak, Jephthah, a khakbel in kei hong paisak hi. Kote khat simin na ngalte khut sung pan no kong suatak uh hi, tuaciangin ngammuang takin na teang uh hi.","ref":"Thkte 7:1; Thkte 4:6; Thkte 11:29; 1 Sa 3:20"},"12":{"text":"Ahihang Ammon te kumpipa Nahash in no hong sim tu in a kithoai laitak, Topa sia na kumpipa a hina na nial uh hi, tuaciang kei munah, ‘Ko hong uk tu kumpipa khat dei khu hi,’ nong ci uh hi.","ref":"1 Sa 8:19"},"13":{"text":"“Tu in hi sungah noma teal kumpipa om hi; na nget uh sia ama hi a, tuaciang Topa in no hong pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa na Pathian zatak vawtin a na seam in, tuaciang a thu ni in, a thupiakte na ni uh a, noma le na kumpipa in ama nung na zui uh le na theampo a dik a pha in hong piang tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang Topa ii pau ngai ngawlin, a thupiakte na ni bua uh le ama in no le na kumpipa hong langpan tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom na dinmun uh kholet vun, tua hile Topa hong sep tu na lianpite na mu tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu hun sia khuakhaal laitak hi kana ngawl ziam? Ahihang thu kong ngen tu a, Topa in vanto sakin nguatui hong puak tu hi. Hi bangin hong pian ciang kumpipa khat na nget uh sia Topa tungah nasia takin maw na hi uh hunlam na kiphawk tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom Samuel in thungen a, tua ni ma in Topa in vanto sakin nguazusak hi. Tuasia ciang mi theampo in Topa le Samuel kiita uh hi,"},"19":{"text":"tuaciang Samuel munah, “Topa awng, nong hesuakna in, ka thi ngawl natu Topa na Pathian tungah thu hong ngetsak ta'n. Tu in koma mawna dangte tungsia ah kumpipa khat ka ngetna ah maw zo ka hi uh hunlam ka phawk uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Samuel in, “Lau heak vun, siatna khaatna tuaza in vawt na hi uh hangin, Topa nusia heak vun, ahihang na thin theampo taw ama na na seam vun."},"21":{"text":"A maan ngawl pathian te zuan heak vun; amate in hong hu thei ngawl, hong ngum thei ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile amate sia a tatak hi ngawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in a ciliap huai kamciamna vawt zo a, ama in no hong nusia ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile no sia ama mite hong hisak tu in khensat zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei ka hile note atu thunget nawn ngawlna taw ama tungah mawna ka vawt ngawl natu Topa in thu hong pia hi. No vawt tu a pha le a maan thute kong hil zaw tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa thu ni vun a, thumaan takin na thin theampo taw ama ii na seam vun. Na lianpi no atu hong sepsak te ciamtee vun."},"25":{"text":"Ahihang mawna na vawvawt lai uh le no le na kumpipa uh hong kisusia tu hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"2":{"text":"Saul in pasal tulthum teal a, ama in tulnii sia Michmash le Bethel mualtung ngam ah ama taw a om tu in koi a, tulkhat sia a tapa Jonathan taw Benjamin namte ii ngam Gibeah ah puak hi. Tua ngawl teng Saul in a inn tek ah ciasak hi.","title":"Philistine te taw Ngal kisimna"},"3":{"text":"Jonathan in Philistine ngalkap ukpa sia Geba ah that hi, tuaciang Philistine mi theampo in tua thu za uh hi. Tuasia ciang Saul in kamtaite paisak a, ngam bup sungah Hebrew mite ngal sim tu a samna in lemle tumsak kawkoai hi."},"4":{"text":"Saul in Philistine ngalkap ukpa a thalupna thu, Israel mite theampo kizasak a, tuaciang Philistine te in amate ensan hi; tua ahikom mite in Gilgal ah Saul koppui tu in a sap bangin pai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Philistine te sia Israel te sim tu in kikhawmtua uh hi; amate in siphu ngalleang 30,000, siphu ngalkap 6,000 nei a, ngalkapte sia tuipivaal a sen za in tam hi. Amate Bethaven nisuana sang Michmash ah kuanin, tuasung ah ngiaphual saat uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate in Israel te nasia takin sim a, Israel te a cimaw dinmun ah koi hi. Israel mi pawlkhatte sia suanghawng, leihawng le suangpi kawm ahibuale leidum le tuikhuk sungah buu uh a;"},"7":{"text":"a dangte Jordan ngun kan in, Gad le Gilead te ngamsung zuan uh hi. Saul sia Gilgal ma ah om lai a, ama taw a om mite lau in liing uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in ni sali sung Samuel ii sawl bangin Samuel ngak hi. Ahihang Samuel sia Gilgal ah hong pai peang bua hi. Mipite in Saul taisan tu kipan uh hi,","ref":"1 Sa 10:8"},"9":{"text":"tua ahikom ama in amate munah, “Meihal biakpiakna le pawlkhop sangaw biakpiakna ka kungah hong paipui tavun,” ci hi. Ama in meihal sangaw biakpiakna khat vawt a,"},"10":{"text":"a man lian laitakin Samuel hong theng hi. Saul in pai in muak a,"},"11":{"text":"ahizong Samuel in, “Bang vawt thong ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Saul in zo a, “Mipite in hong taisan a, kong pai tu na ci bangin hong pai ngawl ni hi; tua banah Philistine te sia Michmash ah kikhawmtua hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom, ‘Philistine te in hi sung Gilgal ah kei hong sim tu in om a, tuaciangin Topa maipha ka nga natu sep ka nei bua hi. Tua ahikom sangaw biakpiakna khat ka piak kul vak,’ ci in ka ngaisun hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"“Tuasia mawmawt nasep hi,” ci in Samuel in zo hi. “Nang in na Topa Pathian ii thupiak bangin ngamta ngawl ni hi. A thu ni hi lete nang le na suan na paalte in a tawntungin Israel hong uksak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahizong na ukna sia kizom suak ngawl tu hi. Nangma in a thu ni ngawl na hikom ama ii dei bang mihing zong tu a, a mite uk tu in vawt tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:22"},"15":{"text":"Samuel in Gilgal nusia a, ama pai natu ah pai hi. A dangte in Saul sia a ngalkapte kungah a pai ciang zui uh hi. Amate sia Gilgal pan Benjamin te ngamsung Gibeah ah pai uh hi. Saul in a ngalkap 600 khawng teng sit hi."},"16":{"text":"Saul, a tapa Jonathan le a mite sia Benjamin te ngam Geba ah ngiaphual saat uh hi; Philistine te ngiaphual sia Michmash ah om hi."},"17":{"text":"Philistine te in pawl thum kisua in a ngiaphual tek pan veu in sim uh hi: pawlkhen khat in Shual te ngamkhen Ophrah ah pai uh a,"},"18":{"text":"a dang pawlkhat in Beth Horon zuanin, tuaciang a dangkhat te in Zeboim Kuam le duisung a kingalmu theina ngamngi ah pai uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Israel te sungah thikseak kuama a om bua hi, banghang ziam cile Hebrew te ii namsau le tei a nei ngawl natu in Philistine te in nasia takin khak uh hi."},"20":{"text":"(Israel te in a hei, a tu, a phiau uh a hiamsak nop ciangin Philistine te kung veu ah pai uh hi."},"21":{"text":"A hiamsak man sia hei le ngan hawlna ciang dawn ah a kisuan thik ahile ngunn dangkatang khat, lo thawna le tumanh ahile ngunntang tang nii piasak uh hi.)"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom ngal kido ni in Saul le a tapa Jonathan simngawl ngalkap dangte in namsau le tei a nei bua uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Philistine te in ngalkap pawlkhat Michmash mualciangh cing tu in paisak hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Jonathan in ngalhiamte a pua pa munah, “Philistine te ngiaphual kaantan in pai tawng,” ci hi. Ahihang Jonathan in a pa Saul munah a son bua hi,","title":"Jonathan ii Ngalhan Nasepna"},"2":{"text":"a pa sia Gibeah pan a khuala ngawl Migron khua, talee kung nuai khat ah ngiaphual saat hi; ama in a kithuapui mihing 600 bang nei hi."},"3":{"text":"(Ephod a silh thiampi sia Ichabod ii suapuipa Ahitub ii tapa Ahijah hi a, tua pa sia Phinehas ii tapa, Eli ii tupa hi a, Shiloh ah Topa ii thiampi ahi hi.) Jonathan ii paisat hunlam sia a mite in he ngawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Philistine te ngiaphual a thet thei natu in a kaantan tu a kul Michmash mualciangh ah suangpi dok nii a lang le a lang ah om a: tuate khat sia Bozez kici a, a dang khat sia Seneh kici hi."},"5":{"text":"Khat zaw sia Michmash maingat a, mualciangh saksang ah om in, a khat sia a thang sangah Geba sang nga in om hi."},"6":{"text":"Jonathan in tangvalpa munah, “Pathian he ngawl Philistine te ngiaphual kaantan tawng. Topa in hong hu thei tu hi; hong hu a ahile bangza in ih tawmbel hang, zawna hong piak natu sia bangma in khak ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tangvalpa in, “Na vawt nop babang hi hen, kei sia nangma taw pang khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Jonathan in, “Pha hi. Ei ih paitan tu a Philistine te in ih musak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama te ei kungah hong pai nuam a, ngakin hong sawl le ih omna mun san ah ih om nginge tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang amate kungah pai in hong sawl le ih pai tu hi, banghang ziam ci le tuasia sia Topa ii ngal zaw natu lim hong piakna hi tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabangin amate sia Philistine te in mu in, “En vun! Hebrew mite pawlkhat leihawng sung a bukna pan hong pusuak hi!” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate in Jonathan le tangvalpa oksan in, “Hi sungah hong paito tavun! Kong son nop khat om hi!” ci in sam hi. Jonathan in tangvalpa munah, “Hong zui ta'n. Topa in amate tungah Israel te zawna hong pia zo hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Jonathan sia mualciangh pan a khut le a khup taw bokvak in kaato a, tangvalpa in zui hi.
