Tu in David sangah pang na hi sia hong tel khi hi, tuaciang nangma le tua na nu min daisak ni hi!"},"31":{"text":"David nuntak lai teng nang sia bangma hun hi ngam ii kumpipa suak ngeingawl tu na hi hunlam na he ziam? Tu in va pai ta'n a, hi sungah ama hong paipui ta'n — ama a thi kul hi!” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Jonathan in, “Banghang thi liang tu ziam? Ama in bang seam na ziam?” ci in zo kik hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuasia ciang, Saul in Jonathan that nuamin tei taw khaw hi, tuaciang Jonathan in a pa ii David a thalup nop takpi hunlam tel hi."},"34":{"text":"Jonathan thin uuk mama in sabuai pan dingto a, tua ni bup bangma ne ngawl hi — tuasia Tha Thak Poai a ni nii ni ahi hi. David huvau in ama nasia takin a thinnuam ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Saul in ama zawnsak vawt hi."},"35":{"text":"A zingsang ciangin a thukim sa om bangma Jonathan sia David taw kisi tu in lo sungah pai hi. Ama in patang khat pai pui a,"},"36":{"text":"tuaciang ama munah, “Thaltang ka kaa tu sia tai in va zong ta'n,” ci hi. Patang sia tai a, Jonathan in a thaltang khat patang ii mai a kalh tu in kap hi."},"37":{"text":"Patang pa in a thaltang tukna a thet ciang Jonathan in oksan a, “Thaltang sia a khuala zawna ah tu hi!"},"38":{"text":"Tua munah ding top heak in! Manlang in!” ci hi. Patang no sia thaltang tawmin a topa kungah heak kik hi,"},"39":{"text":"a topa cinopna theampo a tel bua hi; Jonathan le David bek in he uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Jonathan in patang sia a ngalhiam pia a, khua sungah ciapui in sawl hi."},"41":{"text":"Patang ii a nusiat zawkciang, David sia suangkholna nung panin dingto a, hong khupdin in a maitang lei pha in thumvei hong kun hi. Jonathan le ama kinamh in kap khawm uh hi; David ii khuangaina sia Jonathan aa sangin nasia zaw lai hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jonathan in David munah, “Pathian nang taw hong om tahen. Topa in nang le kei, nang ii suan le paalte le kei aa te khat le khat tungah a thiangtho kamciam ih vawt sa te hong keamcingsak thei tahen,” ci hi. Tua zawkciang David in nusia a, Jonathan sia khua sung zuan kik hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nob khua ah a om thiampi Ahimelech kungah David pai hi. Ahimelech a liing sa in ama muak tu in pai a, “Nangma nguakin hi sungah banghang hong pai ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi.","title":"Saul kung pan David Tai"},"2":{"text":"“Kumpipa vai taw kei hi sungah kong pai hi,” ci in David in zo hi. “Ama in ka sep tu te kuama ka heaksak ngawl tu in hong paisak hi. Ka mite ahile mun khat ah kisiktua tu in ka sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua hi a, tu in nguai an bang teng nei ni ziam? Anluum nga ahibuale zong a dang na nei khat po hong pia ta'n!” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Thiampipa in, “Anluum thawthong nei ngawl khi hi, a kithiansua sa anluum bek nei khi hi; na mite in tu nai sungin numei taw a omkhawm bua na uh le tuate nga thei ni hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"David in, “Tuabang omkhawm ngawl hi, ka mite sia a kisawl thawthong khat ah seam tu a pai bek zong, a zeksa in amate le amate kithiangsak tawntung hi, tua ahile tu a ko hong kisawl tuamna ah ka pai uh ciang thiang seseam ngawl tu khu ziam?,” ci in zo hi.","ref":"Mt 12:3-4; Mk 2:25-26; Lk 6:3"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom thiampipa in David sia a thiangtho anluumte pia hi, banghang ziam cile anluum a nei sun teng Pathian a kipia hi a, sabuai thiang panin a kisot sa hi a, anluum thak taw a kilaih sa hi.","ref":"Thiam 24:5-9"},"7":{"text":"(Saul ii Edom pan a tuucing ukpa Doeg sia tua ni in tua munah biakna vai sepna khat a khuangkhimsak tu in na om luilam hi.)"},"8":{"text":"David in Ahimelech munah, “Tei ahizong namsau ahizong khat kei nong piak tu na nei ziam? Kumpipa thupiakte in tuabang manlang tatakin hong paisak ahikom ka namsau ahizong ngalhiam dang khat po ahizong laak tu hun ka nei nawn bua hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahimelech in, “Elah Kuam sungah na thalup Philistine te Goliath ii namsau nei khi hi; tuasia ephod ii nungah puan taw kituun in om hi. Na dei le la in — hi sungah a om ngalhiam sia tuasia bekma hi,” ci in zo hi. David in, “Hong pia ta'n, tuasia sangin a phazaw namsau dang koima ah om ngawl hi!” ci hi.","ref":"1 Sa 17:51"},"10":{"text":"Tuabangin David in Saul kung pan tai in, tua mun zongh nusia in, Gath ah kumpipa Achish kung zuan hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa ii uliante in, “Hisia David hi kana ngawl ziam? Ama ii ngam sungah kumpipa hi ngawl ziam? Numeite a lap kawmin la a sak uh, ‘Saul in a tul in that a, David in a tulsawm in that hi’ a ci sia hi ngawl ziam?” ci uh hi.","ref":"1 Sa 18:7; 29:5"},"12":{"text":"Amate ii kammalte in David thinsung nasia takin patausak hi, tuaciang ama in Kumpipa Achish sia kiita mama hi.","ref":"Ps 56 (Thulu)"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate a kiim le a paam ah hong om uh ciang David sia a thin kiamhsak in, a letcip nop uh ciang, mihing mawmaw te bangin kithoai hi; khuapi kongpite tung ngelh zazaan in, a khamul tungah a cil kaaisak dimdum hi.","ref":"Ps 34 (Thulu)"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom Achish in uliante munah, “En vun! Hisia pa mawmaw hi! Banghang kei kungah hong paipui nu ziam?"},"15":{"text":"Mihing mawmaw a kicing khomkhat nei zo hi ngawl khi ziam? Hi lai ka bangkua sungah ama ii mawmawt ngamtatna te taw ka thin hong nawngkaisak tu in banghang midang khat hong paipui nu ziam?” ci hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David sia Gath khuapi panin tai in Adullam khua nai suanghawng khat zuan hi. A suapuipate le a innkuanpui dangte in tua thu a zaak ciang ama pawm uh hi.","title":"Thiampite Kithalupna","ref":"Ps 57 (Thulu); Ps 142 (Thulu)"},"2":{"text":"Mihing a kinengniamte, leiba neite ahibuale lungkim ngawlna a nei pawpo in ama kungah zuanin, a vekpi a kingawm in pasal 400 bang pha a, ama sia amate lampui suak hi."},"3":{"text":"David in tua mun panin Moab ngam Mizpah ah paitan a, Moab kumpipa munah, “Pathian in kei atu bang hong vawtsak tu ci ka heak dong, ka pa le ka nu sia nang kungah na omsak natu in hesuak kong ngen hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuabangin David in a pa le a nu sia Moab kumpipa kungah nusia a, David ii suanghawng sung a buk lai teng amate tua munah om uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin kamsaang Gad sia David kungah pai a, “Hi sungah om heak in; Judah ngam ah tu mama in pai in,” ci hi. Tua ahikom David in tua mun nusia in Hereth duisung zuan hi."},"6":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Saul sia Gibeah ngamsung mualtung makeang kung khat nuai ah tei toai in om a, a ulian teng ama kiim ah dingin om hi. David le a mite sia kimu zo hi ci in ama tungah thu kiko a,"},"7":{"text":"tuaciang ama in a uliante munah, “Benjamin mite awng, ngai vun! David in note theampo lote le sapithuante hong pia in, ama ngalkaphonpi sungah ngalkap ulian hong pia tu in muangmaw nu ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Tuasia hu in kei suam tu hong sawm na hi uh ziam? Ka tapa tilteal in David taw a kipawl hunlam no sung pan khat zongh in hong son ngawl nu hi. Kuama in kei hong thinnuam maw ngawlin, keima mi khat ahi David in tu hun tatak ma in kei hong thalup natu hunpha khat zon saan a, ka tapa in ama hanthawn ahi hunlam hong son ngawl nu hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Doeg sia Saul ii uliante taw tua munah a dinkhop laitak ama in, “Nob khua ah Ahitub ii tapa Ahimelech thiampipa kungah David a pai mu khi hi."},"10":{"text":"David in bang teng vawt kul tu ziam ci in Ahimelech in Topa dongh a, tua zawkciang David an tawm pia in, Philistine mi Goliath ii namsau sia pia hi,” ci in son hi.","ref":"1 Sa 21:7-9; Ps 52 (Thulu)"},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa Saul in thiampi Ahimelech le Nob ah thiampite ma ahi a mealheak teng samsak a, hong pai tek hi."},"12":{"text":"Saul in Ahimelech munah, “Ahimelech awng, hong ngai ta'n,” ci hi. Ama in, “Nong sawl po seam tu khi hi, topa,” ci in zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Saul in thu dongh a, “Nang le David in banghangin kei hong thasawm nu ziam? Banghangin ama an tawm le namsau pia in, Pathian munah ama atu thu doksak ni ziam? Tu in ama in kei hong langpan a, hong thalup natu hunpha khat ngakin a om laitak hi!” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahimelech in, “David sia nangma nei a thumaanbel ulian hi! Ama sia na maakpa, nangma hong cingte ii ngalkap mang pa, tuaciang kumpipa inn sungah a om theampo ii a zatak mama pa hi."},"15":{"text":"Hi hi, ama atu Pathian tungah thu dongh peu khi hi, ahizong hisia a masa phitbel hi ngawl hi. Nang hong kithasawm na taw kisai in, kumpipa awng, kei ka hizong, ka innkuan sungah a dang khat pawpo ahizong maw hong suan thei ngawl tu ni hi. Hi thu huvau bangma he ngawl khi hi!” ci in zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Ahimelech awng, nang le na mealheak theampo na thi uh kul hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama a cing, a kungah a dingte munah, “ Topa ii thiampite that vun! Amate in David taw kikum ku in, ama a taimang zongh he napi hong son ngawl hi,” ci hi. Ahihang amate in Topa ii thiampite thalup natu a khut tungsak nuam ngawl uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom Saul in Doeg munah, “Amate nangma that in!” ci a — tuasia ciang Doeg in thatlum siat hi. Tua ni in ephod a silh thei sa thiampi 85 that hi."},"19":{"text":"Saul in thiampite khuapi Nob khua sungah a teang dangte theampo zongh thalup natu thupia a: pasal, numei, patang le nausen, khuite, laate le tuute — tuate theampo kithat hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahihang Abiathar a kici Ahimelech ii tapa khat suakta a, ama in David zuanin pawm hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul ii Topa thiampite a thalupna vai ama in son hi."},"22":{"text":"David in ama tungah, “Tua ni in Doeg tua munah ka mu ciang, ama in Saul tungah a son vangiat tu ka heak ma hi. Tua ahikom, na mealheakte theampo ii thina sia keima hang ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Keima kungah hong om ta'n a, lau heak in. Saul in nang le kei hong thatlum khawm nuam hi, ahihang nang sia kei taw ngammuangin om tu ni hi,” ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Philistine te in Keilah khua sim a, a anthak laak sa te a nguksak uh sia David in za hi.","title":"David in Keilah Khua Suatak"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in Topa dongh a, “Philistine te sim tu in ka kuan tu ziam?” ci hi. “Hi hi, amate sim in a, Keilah hun in,” ci in Topa in zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang a mite in David munah, “Hi lai Judah ah ih kiitak tu a khom om hi; Keilah ah pai in Philistine ngalkapte sim leang pha ngawl seseam tu hi,” ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom David in Topa dongh kik a, tuaciang Topa in, “Pai in a, Keilah sim tavun, banghang ziam cile Philistine te kong zosak tu hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom David le a mite Keilah ah kuanin, Philistine te sim uh hi; amate in tam ma thatin, a ngannote laaksak uh hi. Tuabangin David in tua khuapi hun hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahimelech ii tapa Abiathar suakta in Keilah khua ah David a pop ciang ephod keng hi."},"7":{"text":"David ii Keilah a zotna thu Saul tungah a kison ciang, “Pathian in ama sia ka khut sungah hong pia zo hi. David in ngalnanna luphung kongpite a nei khuapi sung sangah a tumna taw ama le ama thaang kisia zo hi,” Saul in ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom Saul in a ngalkapte samin, Keilah khua ah David le a mite uumci sawm hi."},"9":{"text":"Saul ii amate sim tu in a ngealna thu David in a zaak ciang, thiampi Abiathar munah, “Hi sungah Ephod hong paipui ta'n,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David in, “ Topa Israel ii Pathian awng, kei na naseampa hu in Saul sia Keilah khua ah pai in suksiat sawm hi ci in za khi hi."},"11":{"text":"Keilah khua mite in kei Saul khut sungah hong aap tu ziam? Ka zaak bangin Saul hong pai takpi tu ziam? Topa Israel ii Pathian awng, nong zo natu hesuak kong ngen hi!” ci hi. Topa in, “Saul hong pai tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tua ahile Keilah khua mite in kei le ka mite Saul khut sungah hong aap tu ziam?” ci in David in dongh kik hi. “Amate in no hong aap tu hi,” ci in Topa in zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom David le a mite — a vekpi 600 khawng — Keilah khua thakhat ma in nusia a, paisuak uh hi. Saul in Keilah khua pan David a suatak hunlam a zaak ciang a ngealna kheal hi."},"14":{"text":"Ziph khuapi naina duisung, mualtung ngam ah David buu in om hi. Saul in zong tawntung a, ahihang Pathian in David sia ama ii khut sungah a aap bua hi.","title":"David Mualtung Ngam ah Om"},"15":{"text":"David in Saul ii ama a thalup nopna sia phawk hi. David sia Ziph khua paam duisung, Horesh ah om hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua mun ama kungah Jonathan pai a, Pathian ii sungsiatna a muan natu in hanthotna pia hi,"},"17":{"text":"tuaciang ama munah, “Lau heak in, ka pa Saul in nang bangma hong law zo ngawl tu hi. Ama in nang Israel kumpipa tu hi a, kei sia nangma zom a zalian kik bel ka hi tu sia tel mama hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate nii khat le khat kilawmtatna in a thiangtho kamciam kipia hi. David sia Horesh ah taamin, Jonathan inn ah cia hi.","ref":"1 Sa 18:3"},"19":{"text":"Ziph khuapi panin mihing pawlkhat Gibeah, Saul kungah hong pai in, “David sia Judah thangsang duisung, koma ngam Horesh a om Hachilah Mualtung ah buu hi.","ref":"Ps 54 (Thulu)"},"20":{"text":"Kumpipa awng, ama bangza in man nuam na hi sia hong he khu hi; tua ahikom koma ngam sungah hong pai ta'n, na mat thei natu koma in vawt hamtang tu khu hi,” ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul in, “Kei tungah hong dik mama na hi uh ciang, Topa in thupha hong pia tahen!"},"22":{"text":"Pai tavun a, khatvei ma hong telthiang tavun; ama koisung tatak ah om ziam, tua munah akua in mu ziam, a man in hong kan tavun. Ama sia kukal mama hi ci in za khi hi."},"23":{"text":"A bukna mun tatak hong zong tavun a, kei kungah thu hong puaksak paih nanak tavun. Tua zawkciang noma kong zui tu a, ama tua ngam sungah a om lai le Judah ngam buppi vai a kul zong ka zong tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate Saul mai ah pai a, Ziph ah heak kik uh hi. David le a mite Judah ngam thangsang duisung ngamtongta kuam, Maon duisung ah om uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Saul le a mite in David zong tu in pusuak uh hi, ahizong ama in a thu za in, Maon ngampa sung mual khat zuan in tuak ah taam hi. Saul in hi thu a zaak ciang David zuizen hi."},"26":{"text":"Saul le a mite sia mualpangh langkhat ah om in, a lang pangh a om David le a mite taw mual in daa hi. Saul le a mite in amate hong neak a, man dektak ahiciang, amate zong manlang takin tai uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua zawk bek lianin kamtai khat hong theng a, Saul munah, “Philistine te in ih ngam hong sim hi! Thakhat ma in hong heak kik ta'n!” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom Saul sia David a zuizenna tawlnga in, Philistine te do tu in kuan hi. Tua hu in tua mun sia Kikhenna Mual kici hi."},"29":{"text":"David in tua mun nusia in Engedi ngam sungah buu hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Philistine te a simna pan Saul hong cia kik ciang, David sia Engedi nai dui sungah om hi ci in Saul munah kison hi.","title":"David in Saul ii Nuntakna Khoaikhe"},"2":{"text":"Saul in Israel ngamsung ngalkap phabel 3,000 la in David le a mite zong tu in Ngam Keal Suangpi ii nisuana sangah hong pai uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in tuukhawk pawlkhat taw a kinai lampi hui suanghawng khat ah awnghaw tu in tum hi. Tua sia David le a mite ii a sung tawngh ah a bukna suanghawng na hi luilam hi.","ref":"Ps 57 (Thulu); Ps 142 (Thulu)"},"4":{"text":"Amate in ama munah, “Tusia nangma ii hunpha hi! Topa in na ngalte nangma khut sungah kong koi tu hi hong ci sa hi, ama tungah na law nop po law thei tu ni hi,” ci uh hi. David bokvak in pai a, Saul heak ngawl lan in a puantual mong bek khat at tansak hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang tuasia hun laitakin David thinnuam ngawl a,"},"6":{"text":"ama in a mite tungah, “ Topa ii kumpipa in a teal ka topa tungah siatna ka vawt ngawl natu Topa in hong keamcing tahen! Ama tawm zongh ka suksiat thaak ngawl tu kisam hi, banghang ziam cile Topa ii tealsa kumpipa ahi hi!” ci hi.","ref":"1 Sa 26:11"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom David in a mite sia Saul a sim ngawl natu in a thinzosak hi. Saul dingto a, suanghawng nusia in ama pai natu ah pai tu in kipan hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David pusuakin a nung panin zui a, “Kumpipa awng!” ci in ama biakpui hi. Saul hong kiheak a, tuaciang David lei ah bok suk in zatak a piak zawkciang,"},"9":{"text":"ama in, “Banghangin keima nang vawtsiat tu hanciam hi ci a, thu hong son mihingte thu ngai ni ziam?"},"10":{"text":"Tu ma hiat ma in Topa in nang sia suanghawng sung keima khut sungah hong piak sia nangma tatak ma in mu thei ni, hi. Ka mite pawlkhat in nang thatlum in hong sawl hi, ahihang khuangai huai kong sa a, tawm zongh nasak ngawl tu khi hi ka ci hi, banghang ziam cile nang sia Topa ii kumpipa tu in hong teal na hi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka pa awng hong en ta'n, na puantual mong bek ka khut sungah ka toai sia en in! Hong thatlum thei khi hi, tuabang hi ngawlin hisia bek at keak zaw khi hi. Hisia in nang langpanin kong leedo nop ngawlna le nang bangma kong law nop ngawlna thu hong telsak tu hi. Nang tungah bangma hong khial ngawl napi kei hong that nuam in hong vaizui ni hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in ei nii akua maw hi ziam thu hong khen tahen! Kei tungah nong ngamtatna hu in Topa in nang daan hong pia tahen, banghang ziam cile nang sia bangma hong law ngawl tu khi hi."},"13":{"text":"Taanghkam teptee khat, ‘Siatna sia misiate bek in vawt hi’ a ci sia he ni hi. Tua ahikom nang sia bangma hong law ngawl tu khi hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel kumpipa ii a thalup nop sia en vun! A del thapaai sia bang ziam en vun! Ui thisa khat, uili khat hi lel ziam!","ref":"1 Sa 26:20"},"15":{"text":"Ei ngeal akua maw hi ziam Topa in thu hong khen tu hi. Hi thu ama in hong en cian tahen, kei hong hung in, nang khut sung pan hong hun tahen,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"David ii thuson zawkciang, Saul in, “Ka ta David awng, nangma tatak ma ni ziam?” ci hi. Tuaciang ama hong kap hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David munah, “Nangma maan a, kei khial khi hi. Kei ii nang tungah khialna ta za kong nei kawmsung panin, hong dik mama ni hi!"},"18":{"text":"Tu ni in nang sia kei tungah bangza in hong dik ni ziam ci in hong lak zo ni hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in na khut sungah kei hong aap hi napi nong thatlum bua hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing khat in a ngalpa man zo kasap vawtsia ngawlin bang tanvei suaktasak kik ngei ziam? Tuni in kei tungah nong vawt teng hu in Topa in nang thupha hong pia tahen!"},"20":{"text":"Tu in ka tel thu in nang sia Israel te kumpipa suak tu a, kumpi ngam sia nangma ukna nuai ah kizom suak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang ka min le ka innkuan ii min a kimakngil bit ngawl natu in, ka suan ka paalte nong khoaikhetsak natu Topa min taw kamciam hong pia ta'n,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"David in tuabang ka hi tu hi ci in kamciam pia hi. Tuaciang Saul a inn ah cia kikin, David le a mite sia a bukna mun zuan kik uh hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel thi a, Israel mi bup hong pai in, ama nusiat hu in khuangai tek hi. Tua zawkciang ama ii teenna Ramah ah phum uh hi. Tua zawkciang Paran duisung ah David pai hi.","title":"Samuel ii Thina"},"2":{"text":"Tua munah Caleb ii phung sung pan Nabal a ci pasal khat om hi, ama sia Maon khua pan hi a, Carmel khua hui ah leitang nei hi. Ama sia a hau mama pa khat hi a, tuu 3,000 le keal 1,000 nei hi. A zi Abigail sia a mealhoi in pil hi, ahihang a pasal sia a iiciil a thin tom khat hi. Carmel khua ah Nabal in a tuute mul meet in om a,","title":"David le Abigail","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"tuaciang duisung ah a om David in ama ii thu za hi,"},"5":{"text":"tua ahikom ama in tangval sawm paisak a, Carmel ah Nabal zongsak in, nuksetna kam thaak hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Nabal tungah amate pau natu teng hil a: “David in hong nukset hi, ka lawmpa awng, nangma atu, na innkuan bup atu le na neisa theampo atu in, a phabel deisakna hong zasak hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in nang sia tuumul meetin om ci hong za a, na tuucingte zongh ko taw omkhawmin, bangma kong law ngawl uh sia na heak tu ka dei hi. Carmel ah a om sung tawntung amate ii neisa na khat zongh kinguksak ngeingawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate dongh lete ahi bangin hong son tu hi. Poai khaam ni in ko hong pai khu hi, David in pha takin zin nong do natu hong ngen hi. Nong hesuakna in nong piak thei po ko, na naseamte le na it na lawmpa David hong pia ta'n,” cisak hi."},"9":{"text":"David mihingte in hi kam vaithak teng David min suangin Nabal tungah son uh hi. Tua zawkciang amate in tua munah ngak uh a,"},"10":{"text":"tuaciang Nabal in a khakbel ciangin, “David sia akua ziam? Za zongh za ngei bong! Ih ngamsung sia sila tai khawng taw tu laitak kidim hi!"},"11":{"text":"Ka an le ka tui, ka tuumul meette atu ngan ka ngawte ii sa la in hong paina mun zongh ka heak ngawl mite pia ngawl tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"12":{"text":"David ii mite heak kikin Nabal ii ci teng David tungah son kik uh hi."},"13":{"text":"David in, “Na namsau uh kua vun!” ci in thupia a, amate in tuabang ma in vawt uh hi. David zongh ama namsau kua in, tuaciang a mite 400 khawng taw kuan in, nungsang ah vanhte taw 200 nusia hi."},"14":{"text":"Nabal ii naseamte khat in Nabal zi Abigail munah, “Na za zo ziam? David in duisung pan kamtaite paisak a, ih topa munah, nuksetna kam puaksak kasap ama in ci zazaan hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuabang hi nave, amate ei tungah hong dik mama uh hi; ko hong nawngkaisak ngeingawl hi, tuaciang lo sungah amate taw ka om sung tawntung, ka neisa uh bangma hong kinguksak ngeingawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuu honte cingin ka om uh laitakin amate in sun taw zan taw ko hong hung hi."},"17":{"text":"Nong hesuakna in hi thu a pha tak ngaisun in, na vawt tu sia khensat in. Hi sia in ih topa le a innkuanpuite atu lalna piangsak thei tu hi. Ama sia mawmaw thinpui khat hi a, kuama nadon ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Abigail in manlang takin anluum 200, savun tuithawl nii dim sapittui, tuu pum em nga, an puakkan kilogramme 17, sapitko bom zakhat, theiko moh luum 200 khawmtua in laa tungah suanh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a naseamte munah, “No, mai ah pai vun, kei, nung pan kong zui tu hi,” ci hi. Ahihang a pasal munah bangma son ngawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama a laa tung to in a pai le muallimvei khat ah thakhatin David le a mite hong pai taw kikealsik uh hi."},"21":{"text":"David in, “Banghangin hisia pa ii neisate hilai duisung ah hun sasak ka na khi ziam? Ama ii neisa khat zongh kinguksak ngeingawl hi, tu in ka huna sa teng hi bangin hong thukkikna ahi ve!"},"22":{"text":"Zingsang khuavak ma in tua pasalte khat zongh kikhe ngawlin ka that siat buale Pathian in keima hong vaat tahen!” ci in ngaisun hi,"},"23":{"text":"Abigail in David a mu ciang manlang takin a laa tung pan tuakin,"},"24":{"text":"David peang kung lei ah kisepin, “Topa awng, nong hesuakna in hong ngai ta'n! Keima a mawpu hi tong."},"25":{"text":"Bangma kimanna a nei ngawl Nabal sia awlmaw heak in! Ama sia a min ii khiakna — ‘A Mawmaw’ ci sia ma hi takpi hi! Na naseamte hong thet lai in tua munah keima om ngawl luilam khi hi, topa awng."},"26":{"text":"Phulam in na ngalte na thalup ngawl natu pan hong keamcing sia Topa hi. Tuaciang tu in a nungta Topa taw ka kiciamna pan, na ngalte le nang hong susia nuamte theampo sia Nabal bangin daan thuak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Nong hesuakna in topa awng, kong paipui hi letsong sia hong saang ta'n, na mite pia in."},"28":{"text":"Ka khialna a om le nong hesuakna in hong maisak ta'n. Topa in nangma le na suan na paalte zongh kumpi hong suaksak tu hi, banghang ziam cile ama ii ngalte nangma in na simsak hi; tuaciang na nuntak sung tawntung na tatkha ngei buatu hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaciang mihing khat po in nang hong simin that tu in hong hanciam le Topa na Pathian in sumngum manphate a kep bangin nang hong keamcing tu hi. Na ngalte ahile, mihing khat ii saili taw suangtang a kaa bangin ama in lawnthal tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaciangin Topa in nang atu hong kamciamsa napha theampo hong tungsak a, Israel kumpipa hong suasak ciangin,"},"31":{"text":"topa awng a thu om ngawl bulin ngual na thalupna ahibuale nangma thu in, phu na lamnate hu in kisii na, thin nop ngawlna na nei buatu hi. Tuaciang Topa in thupha hong piak zawkciangin, topa, kei hong mangil heak in,” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"David in ama munah, “Tuni in kei taw kisi tu a nang hong puak Israel te ii Pathian Topa pok tawng!"},"33":{"text":"Na khua ngaisut thiamna, tuaciang mihing thalupna khialna lian ka vawt tu le keima thu in phu ka lam natu pan tuni nong kep natu in, na sep na vawt teng hu in Pathian ka pok hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa in nang kong suksiat ngawl natu in kei hong keam zo hi. Ahihang a nungta Israel te ii Pathian taw kiciam in kong sonna pan, keima taw kisi tu in a manlang tatak hong pai buathong le te tu zingsang in, Nabal ii mite theampo thi siat tu hi,” ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David in ama kungah hong puak letsong teng saang a, “Va cia kik ta'n a, thinngim heak in. Na dei bangin vawt tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Abigail sia kumpipa khat atu a kilawm poai khat, a inn ah a khaam Nabal kungah ciakik hi. Zu khamin maimua nuamin om a, tua ahikom a zingsang ciang mateng ama ii munah bangma son ngawl hi."},"37":{"text":"A zukham hong thai ciang ama in thu theampo son hi. Thakhatin ama sia pumzaw natna hong nga a, a tung thei nawn bua hi."},"38":{"text":"Ni sawm khawng zawkciang Topa in Nabal sia vaatin thi hi."},"39":{"text":"Nabal ii thina David in a zaak ciang, “ Topa pok vun! Nabal tungah ama in kei hong nunau hu in phu hong lamsak a, kei a naseampa ii ka khial ngawl natu hong keamcing hi. Topa in Nabal sia a khansiat hu in daan tat hi,” ci hi. Tua zawkciang David in kiteen natu mo dokna Abigail tungah thaak hi."},"40":{"text":"A naseamte Carmel ah pai in, “David in a zi tu, nang hong pui tu in ko hong sawl hi,” ci uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Abigail lei ah kun sukin, hi bangin ci hi, “Keima a naseamnu hi a, a naseamte ii peang a silsak tu naseam ka hi hi.”"},"42":{"text":"Ama manlang tak tho in a laa tungah to hi. A lalang numei nga teng taw David ii naseamte taw ton in, a zi suak hi."},"43":{"text":"David in Jezreel mi Ahinoam teenpui zo a, tu in Abigail zongh a zi hong suak hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua lanin Saul in David ii zi ahi a tanu Michal sia Gallim khua Laish ii tapa Palti a piaksak hi.","ref":"2 Sa 3:14-16"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ziph khua panin pasal pawlkhat Saul omna Gibeah ah hong pai in David sia Hachilah Mual Judah ngampa ii mong ah buu hi ci in son uh hi.","title":"David in Saul ii Nuntakna Khoaikhe kik","ref":"Ps 54 (Thulu)"},"2":{"text":"Thakhat ma in Saul in Israel ngalkap phabel 3,000 tonpui in Ziph duisung ah David zong tu in pai a,"},"3":{"text":"tuaciang Hachilah Mualtung lampi hui ah ngiaphual saat uh hi. David sia duisung ah om lai a, ama zong tu in Saul hong pai ci in a heak ciang,"},"4":{"text":"ngalvilte a paisak le, Saul sia tua munah na om takpi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama thakhatin pai a, Saul le Ner ii tapa Abner, Saul ii ngalkap hon ukpipa lupna mun tatak ma mu hi. Saul sia ngiaphual sung sangah lum a, a mite sia ama ii kiim ah ngiaphual saat uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuasia ciang David in Hit mi Ahimelech le Joab ii suapuipa Abishai (A nu uh sia Zeruiah hi), te munah, “No nii akua zaw in Saul ii ngiaphual ah hong zui tu nu ziam?” a ci ciang, Abishai in, “Keima hong zui tong,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zanin, David le Abishai te Saul ii ngiaphual sung sangah tum in, Saul sia ngiaphual laizang ah mutchip in a om mu a, a luthung ah a tei phut hi. Abner le ngalkapte a kiim ah mu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Abishai in David munah, “Pathian in na ngalpa na khut sungah tu zanin hong pia hi. Tu in ama ii tei taw ma in keima in ama lei taw cip in hong sunletsak ta'n, khatvei sut taw kiman tu hi — niivei ka sut kul ngawl tu hi!” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang David in, “Ama susia ngawl het tu ni hi! Topa in ama ii tealsa kumpipa a susia peuma daan pia nanak tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"David in a pau zomto lai in, “Thi kum tungin, thi ngei a thi tu ahizong, ngalphual ah thi tu ahizong, Topa ama mama in Saul sia thatlum tu ci in a nungta Topa tungtawnin he khi hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in ama ii koisa kumpipa sia ka suksiat tu oai ngawl hi! A tei le a tuithawl la in, pai ka tawng,” ci hi.","ref":"1 Sa 24:6"},"12":{"text":"Tuabangin David in Saul ii tei le a tuithawl Saul ii luthung pan la a, ama le Abishai in nusia uh hi. Kuama a mu om ngawl, bang thu piang ci in a he zongh om ngawlin, a khanglo beak zongh a om bua uh hi — amate a vekpi in mutchip dipdeap uh hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in a mutciiksak hi."},"13":{"text":"David in a kuam langkhat kaantan in mualdawn, a khuala khopna mun khat panin,"},"14":{"text":"Saul ii ngalkapte le Abner ama in oksan a, “Abner awng! Nong za thei ziam?” ci hi. Abner in, “Kumpipa phawng tu in a au sia akua ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"15":{"text":"David in “Abner, nang sia Israel ngam ah mi lianbel hi ka na ngawl ni ziam? Banghangin na topa kumpipa hung zo ngawl ni ziam? Tu ma hiat in na topa thatlum tu in mihing khat ngiaphual sungah hong tum hi."},"16":{"text":"Na vaipuak lel ni hi, Abner awng! A nungta Topa taw kiciamin kong cina pan, no theampo a thi tu kilawm nu hi, banghang ziam cile Topa ii kumpipa a suasak na topa uh hung ngawl nu hi. En in! Kumpipa ii tei koisungah om ziam? A lu hui a tuithawl sia koisung om ziam?” ci in zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Saul in David ii aw tel a, “David ka tapa awng, nangma ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Hi khi hi, kumpipa awng,” ci in David in zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in, “Topa awng, kei na naseampa banghangin hong delkot lai ni ziam? Bang vawt na khi ziam? Bang khialna lian vawt khi ziam?"},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa awng, kong son tu sia na ngai in. Kei nong langpan natu hong vawt pa sia Topa ahile ama tung a biakpiakna khat vawt leang a thin khealsak tu hi; ahihang mihingte ii vawt ahile Topa haamsiatna amate tungah tung tahen. Banghang ziam cile Topa ii ngam le lei panin ngamdang pathiante bek ka biak thei natu ngam ah kei hong kinotkeak hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa taw a kikhuala ngamdang leitang tungah thalup hong thuaksak heak in. Banghangin Israel ii kumpipa in kei uili khat bang ahi sia that tu in hong pai ziam? Ngam sungah vacimte khat vai bangin ama in banghang hong vai zui hi tu ziam?” ci lai hi."},"21":{"text":"Saul in, “Keima khial zo khi hi. Hong heak kik ta'n, David ka tapa awng. Bangma hong law kik ngawl tu khi hi, banghang ziam cile tu zanin ka nuntakna hong khoaikhe ni hi. Kei sia mawmaw khi hi! A lipkhaphuai mama na khat vawt zo thong khi hi!” ci in zo hi."},"22":{"text":"David in, “Kumpipa awng, hi sungah na tei om hi. Na mihingte khat hong paisak in hong lasak ta'n."},"23":{"text":"Topa in a thumaante le a thutangte tel pia hi. Tuni in ama in nang, keima khut sungah hong pia hi, ahihang Topa ii kumpipa in hong koisa nang sia kong susia bua hi."},"24":{"text":"Na nuntakna tuni in kong khoaikhet bangma in, Topa in kei tungah hong vawt in ngim ngana theampo pan hong suaktasak tahen!” ci in zo kik hi."},"25":{"text":"Saul in David munah, “Pathian in thupha hong pia tahen, ka tapa awng! Na sep na vawt theampo zo tu ni hi!” ci hi. Tuabangin David, ama ii pai natu ah pai a, Saul sia inn ah ciakik hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in ama le ama hi bangin kici hi, “Ni khat teteei ciang Saul in kei hong thatlum tu hi. Kei ngamtat natu a phabel sia Philistia ah tai in ka suatak tu ahi hi. Tuasia ciang Saul in kei Israel ngam sungah hong zon sia kheal tu a, ka ngammuang tu hi.”","title":"Philistine te sungah David"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom David le a mite 600 sia thakhat ma in Gath kumpipa Maoch ii tapa Achish kung zuan uh hi."},"3":{"text":"David le a mite sia a innkuanpuite taw Gath ah peam uh hi. David taw a kop a zite nii sia Jezreel pan Ahinoam le Carmel pan Nabal ii zi meingongnu Abigail ahi uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Saul in David Gath ah a tai a zaak ciang David a zon tawntung kheal hi."},"5":{"text":"David in Achish munah, “Nang ka lawm na hile ka teen natu khuano khat hong ngasak ta'n. Topa awng khuapi sungah nang taw ka teenkhop tu sia kisam ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Achish in Ziklag khua pia a, tua hu in Ziklag sia Judah kumpite neisa hi top hi."},"7":{"text":"David in Philistia ah tha sawm le tha luk teang hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hun sung tengin David le a mite in tua Geshur, Girzi, le Amalek ngamkhente sungah khuangeipi a teang sa mite sim uh hi. Ama in amate ii ngam sia Shur dong, Egypt paina lamdung theampo simsuk hi,"},"9":{"text":"a pasalte le a nupite that in, a tuu, a khui, a laa le a kalaoh te le puan ngawngawn laaksak uh hi. Tua zawkciang Achish kung veu ah cia kik hi,"},"10":{"text":"tua pa in, “Tutung koisungah ngal sim ni ziam?” ci in dongh bul a, tuaciang David in, Judah thangsang ngam, ahibuale Jerahmeel bee le phungte ngam, ahibuale zong Ken te ii teenna ngamte ka sim hi ci hi."},"11":{"text":"David in, ama le a mite ii ngamtatna sa teng kuama ii Gath ah cia in a son thei ngawl natu in, pasal le numei theampo thatlum siat hi. Hisia in Philistia ah a teen sung tawntung David ngamtatna ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahihang Achish in David muang a, ama le ama hi bang kici hi, “Ama sia a mipui Israel te in ensan mama ahiciang a nuntak tawntung keima na hong sepsak tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawk tawmvei ciangin Philistine te in Israel sim tu in a ngalkapte uh khawmtua hi, tuaciang Achish in David munah, “Nang le na mite in kei sang pan ngal sim tu ci sia na tel sa hi,” ci hi."},"2":{"text":"David in, “Hi mama hi. Kei na naseampa khi hi, tuaciang bang ciang vawt thei khi ziam ci sia nangma mama in nong mu tu hi,” ci in zo hi. Achish in, “Pha hi! A tawntungin keima hong cing pa kong suaksak tu hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu in Samuel thi zo a, Israel theampo ama ii a nusiat hangin khuangai in, ama ii khua Ramah ah phum uh hi. Saul in aisaan theite le thaa sam theite theampo zawthawk thu taw Israel panin hawlkhia zo hi.","title":"Saul in Thaa sam thei khat Thu dongh","ref":"1 Sa 25:1; Thiam 20:27; Thkna 18:10-11"},"4":{"text":"Philistine ngalkapte kikhawmtua a, Shunem khua hui ah ngiaphual saat uh hi; Saul in Israel te khawmtua in Gilboa Mual ah ngiaphual saat hi."},"5":{"text":"Saul in Philistine ngalkapte a mu ciang lau mama hi,"},"6":{"text":"tua ahikom ama in Topa munah bang law tu khi ziam ci in dongh hi. Ahihang Topa in mang sung pan ahizong, Urim le Thummim tung pan ahizong, kamsaangte tung pan ahizong, a zo mama bua hi.","ref":"Mi 27:21"},"7":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Saul in a uliante thupia a, “Thaa sam thei nupi khat va zong tavun, keima pai in thu dongh tu khi hi,” ci hi. Amate in, “Endor ah khat om hi,” ci in zo uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom Saul kimealseal a, puan dang silh in, khuazin zawkciang a mite nii taw tua nupi nu taw kisi tu in pai hi. Ama in, “Thaate tungah dongh in a, bang thu piang tu ziam hong son ta'n. A min kong law pasal khat ii thaa sam in,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Nupi nu in zo a, “Kumpipa Saul ngamtatna teng na heak siat sa hi a, Israel ngamsung panin aisaan theite le thaa sam theite theampo hawlkeak hi. Tua ahiciang, banghangin kei thaang hong sia in hong kithatlumsak tu ni ziam?” ci in zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Saul in kiciamna thiangtho khat vawt hi. Ama in, “A nungta Topa min taw kamciam hong pia khi hi, hisia na sep hu in daan hong kipia ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"“Akua thaa hong samsak tu khi ziam?” nupi nu in ci hi. Ama in, “Samuel” ci in zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua nu in Samuel a mu ciang ciik au in Saul munah, “Banghang hong theam ni ziam? Nang Saul kumpipa ni hi!” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"“Lau heak in! Bang na mu ziam?” Kumpipa in ci hi. Nupi nu in, “Thaa khat sia lei panin hong pai to ka mu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in, “Tuasia bang taw kibang ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Pasal huai khat hong pai to hi. Ama in puantual tungsilh silh hi,” ci in nupi nu in zo hi. Tuasia ciang Saul in Samuel hi ci in he a, ama a zatakna in lei ah bok hi."},"15":{"text":"Samuel in Saul munah, “Banghangin kei hong nawngkaisak ni ziam? Banghangin hong pai kiksak ni ziam?” ci hi. Saul in, “Ngimna lianpi sungah om khi hi! Philistine te sia kei ngalin hong pang hi, tuaciang Pathian in kei hong nusia hi. Ama in kamsaangte tungtawn ahizong, mang tungtawn ahizong ka thudok hong zo nawn ngawl hi. Tua ahikom bang vawt tu khi ziam nong son natu nang hong sam khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Samuel in, “ Topa in nang hong nusia zo a, na ngal a sua zawk nungsang, banghangin kei hong sam ni ziam?"},"17":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah hong sonsa bangma in ama in nang tungah hong seam zo hi: ama in kumpi ngam sia na khut sung pan la keakin David hong piaksak zo hi.","ref":"1 Sa 15:28"},"18":{"text":"Nangma in Topa thupiak ni ngawlin, Amalek te le a neisa theampo a vaikhua in susia cip ngawl ni hi. Tua hu in Topa in hisia tu in nang tungah hong vawt hi.","ref":"1 Sa 15:3-9"},"19":{"text":"Topa in nang le Israel sia Philistine te khut sungah hong aap tu hi. Zing ciangin nang le na tapate in kei kung nong theng tu uh a, Topa in Israel ngalkaphonpi zongh Philistine te aap tu hi,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Samuel ii pau teng hu in thakhat ma in Saul puksuk a, lau leilam in lei ah kithuang hi. Ama sia ni bup le zan tawntung bangma neak nei ngawl ahikom in a tha zawm hi."},"21":{"text":"Nupinu in ama kungah hong pai in lau ngawpin om a mu ciang, “Topa awng, nong hesuakna in ka luang aitaa in, nong sawl teng hong vawtsak khi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu in nong hesuakna in kong nget bangin hong ngamta ta'n. Nang atu an tawm kong vawtsak tu hi. Na khualhaw thei khom natu na thahat natu in an na neak kul tu hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Saul in bangma ne ngawl tu khi hi ci in nial hi. Ahihang a uliante zongh in ama an ne in sawl uh hi. A khakbel ciang ama in zawp in lei pan tho to a, lupna tungah hong to hi."},"24":{"text":"Nupinu in a thau tu in a vaak top khuino sia ngo hi. Tuaciang ama in anvui pawlkhat la a, tol saw ngawl anluum in hong em hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in Saul le a uliante mai ah a an lui a, amate in ne uh hi. Amate tua zan ma in ding kik uh hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Philistine te in a ngalkap theampo Aphek ah hong paipui uh hi, tua laitakin Israel te sia Jezreel Kuam sungah a om cik ah ngiaphual saat uh hi.","title":"Philistine te in David Nial"},"2":{"text":"Philistine kumpi nga teng in amate mi tek a za pawl, a tul pawl taw kuan uh hi; David le a mite, Achish kumpipa taw a nungsang pan kuan uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Philistine ngalkap maangte in amate mu in, “Hi Hebrew te, hi sungah bang hong hi ziam?” ci uh hi. Achish in, “Hi sia David hi, Israel kumpipa Saul ii ulian khat hi. Tu in ama sia kei taw khuangeipi ma omkhawm zo khu hi. Ama kei kung hong zot pan kipan ka mawsak natu a ngamtatna bangma mu ngawl khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang Philistine ngalkap maangte in Achish tungah thin uuk in, ama munah, “Tuasia pa na piaksa khua ah puak kik in. Ngal kidona phual ah ei taw kuansak heak in; ngal kido sungin ama in ei hong langpan kik thei tha tu hi. A topa ii maipha a nga kik natu in ih mite thina sangin ama atu a phazaw dang bang om ziam?"},"5":{"text":"A tatakin ci leang, ama sia David hi a, numeite laamin lasa a, ‘Saul in a tul a tul in that a, David in a tulsawm, a tulsawm in that hi,’ a ci sia pa hi ngawl ziam?” ci uh hi.","ref":"1 Sa 18:7; 21:11"},"6":{"text":"Achish in David sam a, “Israel ii a nungta Pathian taw kiciam hi tong, nang sia kei tungah hong thumaan ni hi; hi kidona sungah kei taw kikop in ngal hong simsak leng lungkim tu khi hi. Kei kung nong zot ni pan kipan nang tungah mawna kong sot tu bangma om ngawl hi. Ahihang kumpi dangte in hong thukimpui ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom inn ah thinnuam takin cia kik ta'n a, amate lungkim ngawl tu bangma vawt heak in,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"David in, “Bang ka sep khial om ziam, topa awng. Na ci bangin nang kung kong zot a kipan na na ka sepna sungah sep khial vawt khial nei ngawl ka hile, nang ka topa le ka kumpipa taw kuankhawm in na ngalte hong dosak ngawl tu khi ziam,” ci in zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Achish in, “Na ci teng thukim khi hi, nang sia Pathian vantung mi khat za in hong thumaan hi ci in kong ngaisun hi. Ahihang kumpi dangte in nang sia ngal sungah ko taw kuan khawm thei ngawl tu hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom David awng, Saul nusia in, kei kungah hong pai note theampo sia zing ciang, thopal in khuavak po ciang nong nusiat uh kul tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabangin David le a mite, a zing ciang zing tuungin Philistia zuan kik a, Philistine te sia Jezreel ah paitan uh hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni nii zawkciang David le a mite Ziklag theng kik uh hi. Amalek te in Judah thangsang sim zo a, Ziklag sim uh hi. Amate in a khua haltham a,","title":"Amalek te taw Kidona"},"2":{"text":"numei teng man hi; kuama that ngawl ahihang a nusiat uh ciang a kuama theampo paipui uh hi."},"3":{"text":"David le a mite hong thet uh ciang, a khua kihal tham sa in mu a, a zite, a tapate, a tanute kipaipui siat zo hi."},"4":{"text":"David le a mite kakap in, a tha bo vanek dong tawp ngawl uh hi."},"5":{"text":"David zite nii, Ahinoam le Abigail ngawngawn laaksak uh hi.","ref":"1 Sa 25:42-43"},"6":{"text":"David sia tu in a thinngim mama hi, banghang ziam cile a mite a vekpi in a tate a bosua hu in a thin uh na mama a, amate in David suang taw denlup tu in tawng hi; ahihang Topa a Pathian in ama thinletna pia hi."},"7":{"text":"David in Ahimelech ii tapa thiampi Abiathar munah, “Ephod hong paipui tavun,” ci a, Abiathar in ama kungah paipui hi.","ref":"1 Sa 22:20-23"},"8":{"text":"David in Topa tungah, “Tua hong simthamte ka del tu ziam? Amate ka man zo tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ama in, “Del in; amate man zo lai tu ni hi, tuaciang a matte zongh suatak tu ni hi,” ci in zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom David le ama mi 600 teng hong kipan a, Besor Lui a thet uh ciangin amate pawlkhat tua munah taam hi."},"10":{"text":"David in mihing 400 taw paisuak a; a dang 200 teng lui kaan tu in toi lei ahikom nungah taam uh hi."},"11":{"text":"David taw a kithua mite in Egypt te patangno khat ngam sungah mu in, David kungah paipui uh hi. Amate in an le tui tawm,"},"12":{"text":"theinga ngawm tawm le sapit ko ngawm bom nii pia uh hi. An a neak zawkciang a tha hong hat kik hi; ama in an ahizong tui ahizong a neak ngawl zawk ni thum hi zo hi."},"13":{"text":"David in, “Na topa akua hi a, koisung pan hong pai ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ama in, “Kei Egypt te khat hi a, Amalek te khat ii sila ka hi hi. Ka topa in tu nung ni thum lai in ka ciina ahikom hong nusia hi."},"14":{"text":"Judah ngam thangsang ah a om Chereth te ngam le Caleb bee le phung te ii ngam teng simtham in, Ziklag sia ka hal tum uh hi,” ci in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"David in, “Tua hong simthamte kungah nong paipui tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ama in, “Kei nong thalup ngawl natu le ka topa kungah nong aap ngawl natu Pathian min taw kamciam hong pia po lete, hong paipui tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in David sia amate kungah paipui hi. Tua a simthamte sia Philistia le Judah ngam pan a laak uh vanh tam mama te ai in poai khaam uh a, an ne, zu dawn in, mun theampo ah kithethaang uh hi."},"17":{"text":"A khuavak ni zing tuungin David in sim a, nitak dong kido uh hi. Kalaoh tung to in a tai khangno 400 simngawl kuama a suakta om ngawl hi."},"18":{"text":"David in Amalek te ii laak sa na theampo le a mat teng ama zite nii dongin suatak a;"},"19":{"text":"bangma a sumsi om ngawl hi. David in a mite ii tapate, tanute le Amalek te ii laak sa na theampo nga kik hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in tuu hon le khui hon te zongh nga kik a; a mite in amate mai ah nganno theampo hawl a, tuaciang, “Hi teng David ii neisa hi!” ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David in Besor Lui ah tha zawm leih in nungsang ah a taam 200 te kungah pai kik hi. Amate sia David le a mite muak tu in hong pai a, tuaciang David in pha takin amate nukset hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang mihing mannung ngawl thusel pawlkhat in, “Amate ei taw hong kuan khawm ngawl ahiciang, ih vanh ngate hawm ngawl tu hi. Amate in a zite le a tate la in cia thei tu hi,” ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang David in, “Ka suapuite awng, Topa ii hong piak vanhte tungtaang ah tuabangin ngamta thei ngawl tu nu hi! Ama in ei hong keamcing a, hong simthamte tungah zawna hong ngasak hi."},"24":{"text":"No ii ci bang sia kuama in hong thukim pui thei ngawl tu hi! Ih vekpi a kibangin ih hawm kul tu hi: a kuama po nungsang ah vanhcing te zongh, ngalphual ah a kuante nga za ma nga tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"25":{"text":"David in hi thuthun vawt a, tuate Israel ngam ah tua hun pan kipan kizui tan hi."},"26":{"text":"David in Ziklag ah hong heak kik ciangin, vanh a laakte pawlkhat sia a lawmte ahi Judah lampuite munah, “Hi sungah Topa ii ngalte vanh ka laaksak uh sung pan no atu letsong hi,” cisak in puak hi.”"},"27":{"text":"Ama in tua letsong sia Bethel khua mite, Judah thangsang ngam a om Ramah khua mite, tuaciang Jattir,"},"28":{"text":"Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa,"},"29":{"text":"le Racal khua mite; Jerahmeel bee le phung, Ken mite,"},"30":{"text":"tuaciang Hormah, Borashan le Athach,"},"31":{"text":"le Hebron khua mite teng tungah puak hi. Ama in ama le a mite vaa kotna mun theampo ah tua letsong puak siat hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gilboa Mual ngal kidona ah Philistine te in Israel te do uh hi. Israel te tam mama tua munah thi in, a taang laiteng, Kumpipa Saul le a tapate zongh tai uh hi.","title":"Saul le A tapate ii Thina (1 Khangtaanghthu 10:1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Ahihang Philistine te in amate pha in Saul ii tapate thum, Jonathan, Abinadab le Malchishua te that uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Saul ii kiim ah nasia tak ngal kidona om a, Saul ama mama ngalte thaltangte in kha in, nasia liam mama hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in a ngalhiam pua tangvalpa munah, “Pathian sel Philistine te ii selno a hong thalup ngawl natu in, na namsau dokin hong that ta'n,” ci hi. Ahihang tangvalpa in tuabang a ngamtat tu lau mama hi. Tua ahikom Saul in ama namsau ma la in tua dawnah ama le ama kisep hi."},"5":{"text":"Tangvalpa in Saul thi zo ci in a mu ciang, ama zongh ama ii namsau dawn ma ah kisepin Saul taw thi khawm hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuabangin Saul, a tapate thum le tangvalpa thi uh hi; Saul ii mite theampo tua ni in thi siat uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Jezreel Kuam ii langkhat Jordan ngun nisuana sang a om Israel te in, Israel ngalkaphonpi taikeak zo a, Saul le a tapate kithat zo ci a zaak uh ciang amate a khua uh nusia in tai uh hi. Philistine te pai in tua khuate la uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngal kido khuavak ni in Philistine te a thite vanh laaksak tu in hong pai uh ciang Saul le a tapate thum ii luang Gilboa Mualvum ah a kisial mu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in Saul ii ngawng tan in, a ngal dalna teng suut a, tuate taw kamtaite Philistia ngamsung tangciing amate ii milimte le a mite tungah a lungdamna thu taangko tu in paisak hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate in Saul ii ngalhiamte a Astarte numeipathian biakinn sungah koi in, a luang sia Beth Shan khuapi luphung tungah kilh uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Gilead ngam Jabesh mite in Saul tungah Philistine te ngamtatna a zaak uh ciang,"},"12":{"text":"pasal hangbel teng hong kipanin Beth Shan ah zankhuateak a pai uh hi. Amate in Saul le a tapate ii luang teng luphung tung pan la in, Jabesh ah ciapui kik a, tua munah hal uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaciang a ngu teng la a, khua sung makeang thingkung nuai ah phum in ni sali sung an tang uh hi."}}}}},"10":{"info":{"name":"Samuel Niina","shortname":"2Sam","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul ii thi zawkciang, David sia Amalek te a zawna pan hong cia a, Ziklag ah ni nii taam hi.","title":"David in Saul ii Thina thu za"},"2":{"text":"A zing ciangin khangno khat Saul ii ngiaphual panin hong theng hi. Ama khuangaina a lak natu in a puante eaukeak in a lu tungah leivui kipoai hi. Ama in David kungah pai in, zatak piakna in lei ah bok hi."},"3":{"text":"David in, “Koisung pan hong pai ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ama in, “Israel te ngiaphual panin hong suakta khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"4":{"text":"“Bang thu teng piang ziam hong son ta'n,” David in ci hi. “Ih ngalkaphonpi ngalphual panin taikeak hi, tuaciang ih mite tam ma kithatlum hi. Saul le a tapa Jonathan zongh kithat hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"5":{"text":"“Bangbangin Saul le Jonathan thi hunlam he ni ziam?” ci in David in dongh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in, “Kei Gilboa Mualvum tungah ka om luilam a, Saul sia a tei neal in om hi, tuaciang siphu ngalleang le siphu ngalkapte in ama a neak vaial ka mu hi.","ref":"1 Sa 31:1-6; 1 Khang 10:1-6"},"7":{"text":"Tuasia ciang ama hong kiheak a, kei hong mu in hong sam hi. ‘Topa!’ ci in ka zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in akua ni ziam ci in hong dongh a, Amalek te ka hi hi, ci in ka son hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuasia ciang ama in, ‘Hong pai ta'n a, hong that ta'n! Kei ka liamna nasia a, a thi tu hi zo khi hi,’ hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama kung ka zuan a, ka that hi, banghang ziam cile ama puksuk pole a thi tu veve ahi sia ka he hi. Tua zawkciang, ama lu pan a kumpilukhu le a baan pan a haak la in, nangma hong puak khi hi, topa awng,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"David khuangai in a puan eaukeak a, a mite theampo tuabang ma in ngamta uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Saul le Jonathan, tuaciang Israel te Topa ii mite ngalphual ah tam mama kithat ahikom, amate hee in mau in, nitak dong an tang uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A thu hong puak khangno pa munah, “Nang koisung pan ni ziam?” ci in David in dongh hi. Ama in, “Kei Amalek te ka hi a, ahizong nangma ngam sungah ka teang hi,” ci in zo hi."},"14":{"text":"David in, “Banghangin Topa ii tealsa kumpipa that ngam ni ziam?” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang, David in a mite khat sam a, “Hi sia pa that in!” ci in sawl hi. Tua pa in Amalek pa vaat vawk a, nasia liam mama hi,"},"16":{"text":"tuaciang David in Amalek pa tungah, “Hi sia nangma kivawt hi. Topa ii a teal kumpipa khat ka thatlum na ci hu in nangma le nangma kipuavawk ni hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"David in Saul le a tapa Jonathan atu hi kaa la sa a,","title":"Saul le Jonathan atu David ii Kaa la"},"18":{"text":"tuasia Judah mite tungah hil sawn tu in thupia hi. (Tuasia Jashar Thubu sungah kikhum hi.)","ref":"Jos 10:13"},"19":{"text":"“Israel mualte tungah ih lampuite thi hi! Ih ngalkap hangbel teng thi zo hi!"},"20":{"text":"Tuasia Gath ah taangko heak vun, Ashkelon lampite ah zongh taangko heak vun. Philistia numeite lungdamsak bua tawng; doai biate ii tanute lungdamsak bua tawng!"},"21":{"text":"“Gilboa mualte tungah nguatui le daaitui kia heak hen; a lote kolh tawntung tahen! Banghang ziam cile tua munah a hangsan te ii lum teng mindaina taw liik a; Saul ii lum sia sathau taw kizut nawn ngawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Jonathan ii thal sia thi theina hi a, Saul ii namsau in hesuakna selin, a thahat te vaat vawk a, ngalte thatlum hi."},"23":{"text":"“Saul le Jonathan, lamdangin ithuai a, a nunna ah nungta khawm, a thina ah thi khawm hi; muvanlaite sangin zuan ngang zaw, tawpi te sangin hat zaw hi."},"24":{"text":"“Israel numeite awng, Saul atu khuangai vun! ama in puansan hoite nang hong silhsak a, suang manphate le khamh taw hong zeam hi."},"25":{"text":"“Ngalkap hangte puk zo a, amate ngalphual ah kithatlum uh hi. Jonathan sia mual tungah thi in lum hi."},"26":{"text":"“Nang atu in hee khi hi, ka suapui Jonathan awng; bangza in kei atu in ithuai ni ziam! Kei nong itna bangza in lamdang ziam, Numeite ii itna sang zongin nasia zaw hi."},"27":{"text":"“Ngalkap hangte puk siat zo a, a ngalhiamte kimanna selin kinusia hi.”"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia zawkciang David in Topa dongh a, “Keima pai in Judah khuate khat ka uk tu ziam?” ci hi. “Uk in,” ci in Topa in zo hi. David in “Koisia ziam?” ci in, dongh hi. Topa in, “Hebron” ci hi.","title":"David Judah Kumpipa in Kikoi"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom David in Hebron ah a zite nii ahi Jezreel pan Ahinoam le Carmel pan Nabal ii zi meingongnu Abigail te kengin pai hi.","ref":"1 Sa 25:42-43"},"3":{"text":"Ama in a mite le tuate ii innkuanpuite zongh paipui a, Hebron kiim a khuate ah teang uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Judah pan a mite Hebron ah hong pai in David sia Judah kumpipa tu in sathau noai uh hi. Gilead ngamsung Jabesh mite in Saul luang a phum sia David in a zaak ciangin,","ref":"1 Sa 31:11-13"},"5":{"text":"tualai ah mihing pawlkhat paisak a, kam vaitha hi: “Na kumpipa tungah a luang na vuina taw thumaanna na lak uh a, na lak uh hu in Topa in thupha hong pia tahen."},"6":{"text":"Tu in Topa dikna, a thumaanna no tungah hong tung tahen. Noma nasepna sa te hangin kei zongh no hong phatvawt tu khi hi."},"7":{"text":"Hat vun a, hang vun! Noma kumpipa Saul thi zo a, Judah mite in kei sia a kumpipa ci in sathau hong noai zo hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Saul ii ngalkaphonpi ukpa Ner ii tapa Abner sia Saul ii tapa Ishbosheth taw Jordan ngun kaantan in Mahanaim ah tai khawm hi.","title":"Ishbosheth sia Israel Kumpipa in Kikoi"},"9":{"text":"Tua sungah Abner in Ishbosheth sia Gilead, Asher, Jezreel, Ephraim le Benjamin ngam teng ii kumpipa in koi a, a tatakin Israel ngam buppi uk hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in a kikoi hun in, ama sia kum 40 pha a, kum nii sung uk hi. Ahihang Judah nam in David tungah thumaan ahiciang,"},"11":{"text":"ama in Hebron panin Judah te kum sali le kum lang sung uk hi."},"12":{"text":"Abner le Ishbosheth ii uliante Mahanaim pan Gibeon khuapi ah pai uh hi.","title":"Israel te le Judah te Ngal Kidona"},"13":{"text":"Zeruiah ii tapa Joab le David ii ulian dangte sia amate taw tuicing khat hui ah kisii uh hi, tua munah amate teng, pawlkhat sia tuicing ii langkhat ah, pawldang khat sia tuicing ii a langkhat ah to hi."},"14":{"text":"Abner in Joab munah, “Eima sang tek panin khangnote pawlkhat veve sawlin kido kidemsak tawng,” ci hi. Joab in, “Hi hen,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom Ishbosheth le Benjamin namte taangin mihing sawm le nii, le David mihing sawm le nii te kidosak hi."},"16":{"text":"Misim in a kido pui tek sia a lu pan kizamh in, namsau taw a pangh tek kihol uh ahiciang mihing 24 sia pukin thi siat uh hi. Tua ahikom Gibeon ah tua mun sia, “Namsaute Lo” kici hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kidona nasia mama khat hong nei in, David mite in Abner le Israel te zo uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Zeruiah ii tapate thum tua sungah kihel hi: Joab, Abishai, le Asahel ahi uh hi. Asahel sia ngamsa, sangai bangin a tai ngang a,"},"19":{"text":"Abner del tan pai hi."},"20":{"text":"Abner in nung lee et kik a, “Nangma Asahel ni ziam?” ci hi. Ama in, “Hi khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"21":{"text":"Abner in, “Kei hong del heak in! Ngalkapte khat del in a, a nei po laaksak in,” ci hi. Ahihang Asahel in ama del tan lai hi."},"22":{"text":"Khatvei ma Abner in, “Hong del heak in! Banghang nang hong thatlumsak hamtang tu ni ziam? Tuabang hi leng bangbangin na suapui pa Joab mai mu ngam tu khi ziam?” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang Asahel a tawlnga nuam bua hi; tua ahikom Abner in a tei taw a nungsang a khaw le Asahel ngil kha in a nungah pailet hi. Asahel lei ah topsuk in thi hi, tuaciang tuak a luang sialna munah hong pai peuma in tawlnga in en uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahihang Joab le Abishai in Abner ii nung zuizenin, nitum ciangin Giah ngam nisuana sang, Gibeon duisung paina lampi tung, Ammah mual theng hi."},"25":{"text":"Benjamin nam pan pasalte Abner ii kiim ah kikhawmtua kikin mualdawn khat tungah ngalnanna mun la uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Abner in Joab oksan a, “Tawp hun nei ngawlin kido tan tu hi ziam? A khakbel ciang thin lalna simngawl bangma dang taang nawn ngawl tu ci in mu thei ngawl nu ziam? Ko sia na ngammipuite khu hi. Na mite munah ko hong del a tawp natu thu na piak tu, bang tanvei hai tu ziam?” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Joab in, “Pau ngawl hi thong lete ka mite in zingsang khuavak dong hong del tu hi, ci in a nungta Pathian taw kiciam ngam khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joab in Israel te a del a mi teng a tawlngak natu in lemle tum hi; tuabangin kidona tawp uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Abner le a mite sia Jordan Kuam dungah zankhua in pai uh hi; amate Jordan ngun kaantan in, a zingsang kik hunsung bup a pai suak zawkciang, Mahanaim theng kik uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Joab in ngal del a tawp zawkciang a mi teng a khoptua le, Asahel kihel in a kingawm mihing sawm le kua kisamh hi."},"31":{"text":"David ii mite in Benjamin nam Abner ii mite 360 that uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Joab le a mite in Asahel luang phaam in, Bethlehem khua a innkuan ii thaan ah phum uh hi. Tua zawkciang zankhua in pai a, zingsang khuavak bek in Hebron theng kik uh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul ii bangkua sang a pangte le David ii bangkua sang a pangte ii kidona sia khuangei hi. David hong hat vaial ciang, ama a langpante hong thazawm vaial hi."},"2":{"text":"David ii tapa luk Hebron ah a suak teng sia a piankum zui in: Amnon, a nu sia Jezreel panin Ahinoam;","title":"David ii Tapate"},"3":{"text":"Chileab, a nu sia Carmel panin Nabal ii zi meingong nu Abigail; Absalom, a nu sia Geshur kumpipa Talmai ii tanu Maacah;"},"4":{"text":"Adonijah, a nu sia Haggith; Shephatiah, a nu sia Abital;"},"5":{"text":"Ithream, a nu sia Eglah hi. Hi tapate theampo sia Hebron ah piang siat uh hi."},"6":{"text":"David ii ngalkapte le Saul ii bangkua tung a thumaan ngalkapte a kido tawto uh ciang, Saul ii nungzuite sung pan Abner hong thahat vaial hi.","title":"Abner in David Pawm"},"7":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Saul ii tapa Ishbosheth in Abner sia Saul ii zino Aiah ii tanu Rizpah taw lumkhawm hi ci in mawsuanh hi."},"8":{"text":"Hisia in Abner thinsosak hi. “Saul leeheak tu in hong um ni ziam? Judah te atu na a seseam hong sa takpi ni ziam?” ci ngawp hi. “A kipat peuma pan na pa Saul, a suapuite le a ngualtamhte tungah thumaan khi hi, tuaciang David ii hong zaw natu pan hong hun khi hi; ahitazong tuni in numei khat huvau in maw hong zong ni hi!"},"9":{"text":"Topa in David munah kamciam pia a, ama in kumpi ngam sia Saul le a suan a paalte tung pan la in, David sia ngam mong khat pan mong khat dong a uk Israel le Judah kumpipa suaksak tu hi. Tu in hi thu ka taangtungsak buale Pathian in hong saatlum tahen!” ci hi.","ref":"1 Sa 15:28","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Ishbosheth in Abner kiita mama ahikom kam khat zongh pau ngam ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Abner in tua laitak Hebron ah a om David kungah kamtaite paisak a, “Akua in hi ngam hi lei uk tu ziam? Keima taw thukimna khat hong vawt ta'n, tuaciang Israel ngam bup nangma sangah na nga natu kong hu tu hi,” cisak hi."},"13":{"text":"David in, “Pha hi! nang taw thukimna vawt tu khi hi, ahihang nong hisak tu khat sia: kei taw kimu tu nong pai ciang Saul ii tanu Michal hong keng nanak tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"David in Ishbosheth tung zongh ah kam thaak a, “Ka zi Michal hong pia kik ta'n, ama ka teenpui natu in Philistine te ii vunteap zakhat taw ka tat sa hi,” ci hi.","ref":"1 Sa 18:27"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom Ishboseth in Michal sia Laish ii tapa, a pasal Paltiel kung panin la khe hi."},"16":{"text":"Paltiel in lam tawntung ma in kap kawmin Bahurim khua dong zui hi. Ahihang Abner in, “Inn ah ciakik ta'n,” a ci ciang ama cia hi."},"17":{"text":"Abner sia Israel lampuite kungah pai in, “Khua ngeipi ma David sia na kumpipa tu in dei nu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu in hisia no atu hunpha hi. Topa in hi bang a ci sia ciamtee vun, ‘Ka naseampa David in, Israel ka mite sia Philistine te le ngal a dangte theampo panin a suatak natu in zangh tu khi hi,’ ” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Abner in Benjamin nam pan mite tung zongh ah a son zawkciang Benjamin mite le Israel te ii a vawt tu thukimna teng David munah a son tu in Hebron ah pai hi."},"20":{"text":"Hebron khua David kungah mihing kul taw Abner hong pai ciangin David in amate atu poai vawtsak hi."},"21":{"text":"Abner in David munah, “Tu in ka na pai tu a, Israel buppi kumpipa nangma sangah kong pangsak tu hi. Amate in nang sia kumpipa in hong saang tu hi, tuaciangin nangma in na dei teng na nga siat tu a, ngam buppi na uk tu hi” ci hi. David in Abner sia ngammuan natu thukho khat pia in paisak hi."},"22":{"text":"A zawkciang, Joab le David ii ulian dangte ngalsimna panin a sutol uh vanh tam mama taw hong cia hi. Abner ahile tua mun Hebron ah David taw a om nawn bua hi, banghang ziam cile David in ama sia ngammuanna thukho taw thaa hi.","title":"Abner Kithatlum"},"23":{"text":"Joab le a mite hong thet uh ciangin ama tungah Abner sia David kumpipa kungah haw zo a, ngammuan natu kamciam pia in a kipaisakna thu kison hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahikom Joab sia kumpipa kungah pai in, “Bang vawt thong ni ziam? Abner nang kungah hong pai ci leang — banghangin thaa thong ni ziam?"},"25":{"text":"Ama hi sungah hong pai sia nang hong theam tu, na sep na vawt theampo le na paina theampo a kan tu in hong pai hi. Tuasia na heak ma hi ngawl ziam!” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Joab in David a nusiat zawkciang Abner sam tu in kamtaite paisak a, tuaciang amate in Sirah tuikhuk panin ama hong ciapui kik hi; ahihang David in bangma heak pui ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Hebron ah Abner hong thet ciangin, Joab in ama nguak taw thu son tubangin kongpi ah a tuamin paipui a, tua munah a ngil pan naam taw hol hi. Tuabangin Abner sia kisuamlum hi, banghang ziam cile ama in Joab ii suapuipa Asahel thalupsak hi."},"28":{"text":"David in tua thu a zaak ciang, “ Topa in kei le ka uk sung mite Abner kisuamlupna tungtaang ah bekcik zongh maw ngawl hi ci in hong he hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua atu in daan piakna Joab le a innkuan bup in thuak tahen! Khangsimin a bangkua sungah numei le pa omkhopna pan a piang natna a vei khat, ahibuale a lauhuai vun natna khat, ahibuale numei nasep teng a seam thei bek khat, tua ahibuale ngal sungah a thi khat, ahibuale an neak tu nei ngawl khat veu om vaciat tahen!” ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuabangin Joab le a suapuipa Abishai in Gibeon kidona ah amate ii suapuipa Asahel a thatlum pa Abner tungah phulam uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David in Joab le a mite a puan uh eaukeak in, khau-ip puan silh a, Abner thina hangin a khuangai natu in thupia hi. Tuaciang thi vuina ah Kumpipa David mama mithi kuang nung pan zui in pai hi.","title":"Abner Kivui"},"32":{"text":"Abner sia Hebron ah kiphumin, kumpipa sia a thaan ah a ngingin kap a, mite theampo zongh kap tek hi."},"33":{"text":"David in hi kaa la Abner sak hi: “Banghangin Abner sia a mawmaw pa bangin thi ziam?"},"34":{"text":"A khut te kiletheen ngawl hi, a peangte kisawm ngawl hi; Ama sia khialna lian vawtte ii thalup mi khat bangin thi hi!” Tuaciang mipite in ama kaa kik leleau uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Mipite nitangtum hanciamin David in bang khat po nesak nuam ahihang ama in a ciliap huai kamciam vawt a, “Nitum ma in neak khat po ka nei le Pathian in hong vaatlum tahen!” ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Amate in hisia ciamtee a, lungkim mama uh hi. A tatakin, David ii vawt theampo in mipite lungkimsak hi."},"37":{"text":"David ii a mi teng le Israel mi theampo in Abner kisuamlupna ah kumpipa a kihel ngawlna thu tel uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Kumpipa in a uliante munah, “Tuni in Israel ngam sungah lampui lian khat thi ahi hunlam phawk ngawl nu ziam?"},"39":{"text":"Keima sia Pathian ii teal kumpipa ka hisaap hang, tuni in ka tha zawm hi. Hi Zeruiah ii tapate sia kei atu in ngoltol lei hi. Hi khialna lian vawtte a kilawm bangin Topa in daan pia tahen,” ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hebron khua ah Abner kisuamlupna thu, Saul ii tapa Ishbosheth in a zaak ciang lau mama a, Israel mite theampo patau uh hi.","title":"Ishbosheth Kisuamlum"},"2":{"text":"Ishbosheth in ulian nii nei a, ngalsim lampuite veu ahi hi, amate Benjamin nam, Beeroth khua pan Rimmon ii tapate hi a, Baanah le Rechab ahi uh hi. (Beeroth sia Benjamin ngam in kiciamtee hi."},"3":{"text":"A teangciil te sia Gittaim ah a tai pan kipan tua munah teang uh hi.)"},"4":{"text":"Saul ii suan le paal dang khat sia Jonathan ii tapa Mephibosheth hi a, kum nga a phak laitakin Saul le Jonathan ngal sungah kithat hi. Jezreel khuapi panin amate ii thina a kizaak ciang, ama a omh nu in zamh a taipui hi; ahihang ama manlang nuam mama ahikom a nau taaksua tha a, a peangbai khat suak hi.","ref":"2 Sa 9:3"},"5":{"text":"Rechab le Baanah te Ishbosheth inn ah a haw tu in hong pai in, sun hun ama ii tawlngak laitakin tualai ah theng uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Numei kongkhacing sia zungtaang kheapin a omna ah lusu in mu zo hi, tua ahikom Rechab le Baanah te tum ku uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate inn sung hong thet poma ciang Ishbosheth ii lupna inndoi sungah tum in, ama mutthip in om sia thatlum hi. Tua zawkciang a lu tansak a, Jordan Kuam zui in zankhua paipui uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in a lutang sia Hebron ah David pia a, “Nang hong that tu a hanciam na ngalpa Saul ii tapa Ishbosheth lutang hi sungah om hi. Ama man in thatsak khi hi. Ama hong puak lungdamhuai thu hu a, tel ka piak sia tuabang hi!","ref":"2 Sa 1:1-16"},"11":{"text":"Mawnei ngawl, ama inn sungah a mu mihing khat a suamlum mi ngilote atu in bangza in sia zaw lai tu ziam! Amate in Ishbosheth lutang la in Hebron khua Abner ii thaankuul ah phum uh hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Israel namte theampo Hebron khua David kungah hong pai in ama munah, “Ko sia nangma ii chi le sa hi khu hi.","title":"David sia Israel te le Judah te ii Kumpipa Suak (1 Khangtaanghthu 11:1-9 ; 14:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"A bosa hun sung Saul sia ih kumpipa ahi lai ngawngawn in, nangma in Israel mite ngal kidona sungah na lampui a, tuaciang Topa in na mite na lampui natu le a ukpa na sua natu kamciam hong pia hi,” ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuabangin Israel lampui theampo David Kumpipa kung Hebron ah hong pai uh hi. Ama in amate taw a thiangtho kipawlpuina vawt a, amate in ama sathau noai in, Israel kumpipa suak hi."},"4":{"text":"David sia kumpipa a sua hunin kum 30 pha a, kum 40 sung uk hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Hebron panin Judah te kum sali le lang sung uk a, Jerusalem panin Israel le Judah te theampo kum 33 sung uk hi.","ref":"1 Kum 2:11; 1 Khang 3:4; 29:27"},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa David le a mite ii Jerusalem sim tu in a kuan tu hun hong theng hi. Tua munah a teang Jebus te in tua khuapi sia David in zothal zo tu in um ngawl ahikom ama tung ah, “Hi lai ah nang hong tum ngeingawl tu ni hi; mittawte le peangbaite ngawngawn in hong nolh keak zo tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Jos 15:63; Thkte 1:21"},"7":{"text":"(Ahihang David in amate Zion kulhpi suan takpi in tua hun pan kipan “David Khuapi” kici hi.)"},"8":{"text":"Tua ni in David in, a mite tungah, “Jebus mite kei ii ngaimawk za in a ngaimaw hi sungah na om uh ziam? Thalup nop dongin a ensan na om uh ziam? Tua ahile tui laakna lei tawlet sia zui in pai tavun a, tua a khuangai huai mittaw peangbaite sim tavun,” ci hi. (Tua hu in, “Mittawte le a peangbaite sia Topa inn sungah tum thei ngawl tu hi kici hi.)"},"9":{"text":"Kulhpi a suan zawkciang a sungah David teang a, “David khuapi” ci in minvaw hi. Hi thu David in a zaak ciangin ngalnanna kulh khat sungah tuaksuk hi.","title":"Philistine te A Zawna (1 Khangtaanghthu 14:8-17)"},"18":{"text":"Philistine te Rephaim Kuam sung hong theng a tua mun laa uh hi."},"19":{"text":"David in Topa dongh a, “Philistine te ka sim tu ziam? Zawna kei nong pia tu ziam?” ci hi. Topa in, “Hi hi, sim in! Zawna kong pia tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahikom David sia Baal Perazim ah kuan a Phillistine te zo hi. Ama in, “ Topa in ka ngalte khuanawl tuipawm bangin nawk keak hi,” ci hi. Aminadab ii tapate Uzzah le Ahio in khuileang lampui in,","ref":"1 Sa 7:1-2"},"4":{"text":"leang mai ah Ahio pai hi."},"5":{"text":"David le Israel buppi sia a tha nei za uh taw Topa patoaina in lasa in laam uh hi. Tengtongh, liamlo, khuang, nguasemh le daalkopsai te tum uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate Nacon ii ancilna mun hong thet uh ciangin a khuitalte hong lutu a, Uzzah in Thuciamna Thingkuang hong zamh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua Thuciamna Thingkuang sia a thasia vawt ngawl hu in thakhat thu in Uzzah tungah Topa Pathian thin uuk a, thatlum hi. David sia a thinso hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in Uzzah sia thin uukna taw daan a piak hang ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David in Topa kiita a, “Bangbangin Thuciamna Thingkuang sia tu in keima in tonpui ngam nawn tu khi ziam?” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in Jerusalem khua ah ciapui ngawl tu in khensat hi; tuasia taangin lampialpui a, Gath khua mi Obed Edom inn ah tun hi."},"11":{"text":"Thuciamna Thingkuang sia tua munah tha thum kitaamsak a, Topa in Obed Edom le a bangkua thupha pia hi.","ref":"1 Khang 26:4-5"},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa David in Thuciamna Thingkuang hu in, Topa in Obed Edom bangkua le a neisa theampo thupha pia hi ci in za a; tua ahikom ama in Thuciamna Thingkuang sia Obed inn panin la in, poai khaamna lianpi taw Jerusalem ah ciapui hi."},"13":{"text":"Thuciamna Thingkuang a pua mihingte kal luk hong suan zawkciang David in tawlngasak a, khuital khat le khuino thau khat sangaw biakpiakna in pia hi."},"14":{"text":"David sia a kawngah dial khat teang bekin, Topa a patoaina in a tha neiza taw laam hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuabangin ama le Israel mite theampo in Thuciamna Thingkuang Jerusalem ah lawpin auna le lemle aw te taw paipui uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua thingkuang khuapi sung a kithetpui laitakin Saul ii tanu Michal in khelki panin khua a et le David kumpipa Pathian mai ah laamin tawnin a om a mu ciang, hoi maw sa hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in tua Thingkuang sia David ii tua atu a saksak Puanbuk sungah koi uh hi. Tua zawkciang ama in Topa tungah sangaw biakpiakna le kipawlkhop biakpiaknate pia hi."},"18":{"text":"Sangaw biakpiakna a man zawkciang David in Vaanglianbelpa Topa min taw mipite thupha pia in,"},"19":{"text":"amate an hawmsak hi. Ama in Israel pasal le numei khat simin anluum khat tek, sa em bak khat tek le sapitko tawm tek pia hi. Tua zawkciang a kuama po inn ah cia uh hi.","ref":"1 Khang 16:43"},"20":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David in a innkuanpuite nukset tu in hong cia ciang, Michal sia ama taw kisi tu in hong pusuak hi. “Tuni in Israel kumpipa in ama min let natu khat vawt hi! Ama uliante ii naseam numeite mu na ah a mawmaw bangin kipholaak hi!” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"David in, “Na pa le ama ii bangkua taangin Israel lampui tu in kei hong teal, ka Topa ka patoaina in laam khi hi,"},"22":{"text":"tuaciang tu a sang zongin a nasia zaw lai in keima le keima kisimmawk vawt zaw lai tu khi hi. Nang na hile kei, bangma in hong heang ngawl tha tu ni hi, ahihang tua numeite in kei, hong thupi sim mama tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Saul ii tanu Michal sia a khan sung ta nei ngawl hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa David sia a kumpi inn sungah om a, tuaciang Topa in a ngalte theampo kung panin keamcing hi.","title":"Nathan ii David A Thupuak (1 Khangtaanghthu 17:1-15)"},"2":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kumpipa in kamsaang pa Nathan munah, “Kei hi sungah cedar thing taw a kisa inn sungah teang khi hi, ahihang Pathian ii Thuciamna Thingkuang sia puanbuk sungah kikeam hi!” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Nathan in, “Na thinsung a om babangin vawt in, banghang ziam cile nangma taw Topa hong omkhawm hi,” ci in zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang tua zanin Topa in Nathan munah,"},"5":{"text":"“Va pai ta'n a, ka naseampa David munah hi bangin ka ci teng va son ta'n, ‘Kei teen natu biakinn a sa tu sia nang hi ngawl ni hi."},"6":{"text":"Egypt ngam panin ka mite ka suatak hun pan kipan tu hun dong biakinn sungah teang ngeingawl khi hi; puanbuk sungah teangin khualhaw kot khi hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel mite taw ka khualhawna theampo ah a lampui in ka koite khat po tung zongh ah banghangin cedar thing taw a kisa biakinn hong saksak ngawl nu ziam, ci ngeingawl khi hi.’"},"8":{"text":"“Tua ahikom ka naseampa David munah na son in a, Kei, Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, ‘Lo sungah tuu cingin na omna panin nang kong la a, Israel ka mite a uk pa kong suaksak hi."},"9":{"text":"Na paina po ah nang taw kong omkhawm a, maisang na manaw ciang na ngalte theampo ka zo siat hi. Leitung ah lampui lianbel te bangin kong minthangsak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka mi Israel te ten natu mun khat ka teal zo a, tua munah amate kinengniam nawn ngawlin nungta tu uh hi. Ngam hisia sungah amate hong tum pan kipan mihing ngoltolte in sim tawntung ahihang hi bangte piang kik nawn ngawl tu hi. Na ngalte kung pan kong kepcing natu le suan le paal na nei natu in kamciam kong pia zo hi.","merge":"11"},"12":{"text":"Nang thi in na taanghpupite taw na kiphum khop zawkciang zong na tapate sung pan khat kumpipa ka suaksak tu a, a kumpi ngam ka thahatsak tu hi.","ref":"Ps 89:3-4; 132:11; Jn 7:42; Sawl 2:30"},"13":{"text":"Ama sia biakinn khat kei atu a sa tu pa hi tu a, a kumpi khangngui a tawntungin ka kizomsak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima in ama ii pa ka hi tu a, ama ka tapa hi tu hi. Na kumpi khangngui sia a mong ngei buatu hi,’ ” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 89:36-37"},"17":{"text":"Pathian ii a pualaak teng a vekpi in Nathan in David munah son hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David kumpipa sia Topa ompuina Puanbuk sung zuan a, to in hi bangin thungen hi: “Vaanglianpipa Topa awng, kei tung ahizong ka innkuanpuite tung ahizong nong septe ka kiphu ka kilawmna uh om ngawl hi.","title":"David ii Lungdamkona Thungetna (1 Khangtaanghthu 17:16-27)"},"19":{"text":"Tua hi napi tu in a nasia zaw lai in hong seam ni hi, Vaanglianpipa Topa awng; maisang hong pai lai tu kumte ah ka suan ka paalte atu dongin kamciam nong pia zo hi. Tuaciang hisia mihing khat in musak ni hi, Vaanglianpipa awng!"},"20":{"text":"Nang tungah bang kong ci lalai thei tu ziam! Kei na naseampa hong he ni hi."},"21":{"text":"Hi bang nong vawt tu sia nangma deina le tupna hi; nangma in hi na lianpite kei nong hil natu in na vawt ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Bangza in lian ni ziam, Vaanglianpipa Topa awng! Nang taw a kibang khat zongh om ngawl hi; nangma bekma Pathian na hi sia kong he tawntung uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Nangma mi tatak a suak tu in na suatak Israel bang peuma leitung ah a dang minam om ngawl hi. Egypt ngam pan nangma mi tu in na suataksak na mite maisang a nawk ciangin minam dangte le a pathian te na notkeak hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:34"},"24":{"text":"Nangma in Israel te a tawntungin nangma mi na suaksak a, Topa awng, tuaciang nangma sia amate ii Pathian suak zo ni hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tuaciang tu in, Topa Pathian awng, kei le ka suan ka paalte atu kamciam na vawt sia a tawntung atu in hong taangtungsak ta'n, ka seam tu na ci te hong seam ta'n."},"26":{"text":"Na minthanna nasia tu a, tuaciang mite in a tawntungin, ‘ Topa Vaanglianbelpa sia Israel ii Pathian hi,’ hong ci tu uh hi. Tuaciang nangma in ka kumpi khangngui sia a tawntung nong kepsak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa Vaanglianpipa, Israel ii Pathian awng! Hi thungetna nang tungah hang takin kong ngen ngam hi, banghang ziam cile, nangma in kei na naseampa tungah hi teng nong lak zo a, tuaciang ka suan ka paalte kumpi na suasak tu sia nong son zo hi."},"28":{"text":"“Tuaciang tu in, Vaanglianpipa Topa , nangma in Pathian na hi hi; na kamciamte na len tawntung a, hi a lamdang kamciam sia kei tungah nong pia zo hi."},"29":{"text":"Nangma piak hamphat nate taw a nopsak tan natu in ka suan ka paalte thupha nong piaksak natu kong ngen hi. Nang, Vaanglianpipa Topa in, hisia nong kamciam zo a, na thupha sia ka suan ka paalte tungah a tawntungin kip tu hi.”"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hun tawmvei zawkciang Kumpipa David in Philistine te sim kik in zo ahiciang, amate in a ngam uh uk nawn ngawl hi.","title":"David ii Ngalzawnate (1 Khangtaanghthu 18:1-17)"},"2":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Moab te zo hi. A ngal matte lei ah lumsakin thum sung pan nii veu thatlum hi. Tua ahikom Moab te sia a khutnuai mi hong suakin, ama tungah shia pia uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang, ama in Syria ngamsung Zobah ngamuk kumpipa Rehob ii tapa Hadadezer sia Euphrates ngun naak sangah ngamukna la kik tu in a paina lampi ah ama in zo hi."},"4":{"text":"David in siphu ngalkap 1,700 le, lei ngalkap 20,000 matsak hi. Ama in siphu ngalleang zakhat atu a kicing khom siphu la in, a dang teng theampo a peangbaisak siat hi."},"5":{"text":"Damascus a om Syria te in Kumpipa Hadadezer hu tu in ngalkaphonpi khat a paisak le David in tuate simin 22,000 that hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in amate ngam sungah ngal ngiaphualte saat a, amate sia a khutnuai mite hong suakin, shia pia uh hi. Topa in David sia mun theampo ah ngal zosak hi."},"7":{"text":"Hadadezer ii a uliante ii toai khamh lumte David in sut a, Jerusalem ah cia pui hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in Hadadezer ii uk khuapite ahi Betah le Berothai pan taau zongh tam mama la hi."},"9":{"text":"David in Kumpipa Hadadezer ii ngalkaphonpi zo zo hi ci in Hamath kumpipa Toi in za hi."},"10":{"text":"Toi taw tamvei ma a kido ngei Hadadezer sia David in zo ahikom a tapa Joram in muaksak a, tuabangin a lungdampuina ko hi. Joram in David kungah khamh, ngunn le taau taw a kivawt letsongte puak hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa David in tuate sia a zawthal sa ngamte ahi"},"12":{"text":"Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, le Amalek te tung pan a laaksak ngunn le khamh te le Hadadezer kung pan a laaksak vanh pawlkhatte taw zong kopin biakna ah a zak tu in koituam hi."},"13":{"text":"Ci Kuam sungah Edom mite 18,000 a thalupna pan a cia kik ciang David minthang zawkan hi.","ref":"Ps 60 (Thulu)"},"14":{"text":"Ama in Edom ngamsung theampo ah ngalkap phualte saat a, tuaciang tua munah a om mite ama ii khutnuai mi suak uh hi. Topa in David mun theampo ah ngal zosak hi."},"15":{"text":"David in Israel buppi uk a, a mite thumaan tak le a pha takin a kivawt tawntung natu in uk hi."},"16":{"text":"A nu Zeruiah ahi Joab sia ngalkaphonpi a ukpa hi; Ahilud ii tapa Jehoshaphat sia thu tepteena teng a lenpa hi;"},"17":{"text":"Ahitub ii tapa Zadok le Abiathar ii tapa Ahimelech te sia thiampite ahi hi; Seraiah sia kumpipa zum sung thuzeakpi ahi hi;"},"18":{"text":"Jehoiada ii tapa Benaiah sia David a cingte a ukpa hi a, David ii tapate sia thiampite ahi uh hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat ni in David in, “Saul ii bangkua sung pan a nungta lai om ziam? Tuabang a om le Jonathan hu in dikna lak nuam khi hi,” ci hi.","title":"David le Mephibosheth","ref":"1 Sa 20:15-17"},"2":{"text":"Saul ii innkuan naseampa Ziba a kici khat om a, David kungah ama kipaisak hi. “Nang Ziba ni ziam?” ci in kumpipa in dongh hi. “Na naseampa hi khi hi, topa,” ci in ama in zo hi."},"3":{"text":"“Pathian tungah kamciamna ka piak bangma, Saul ii bangkua tungah thumaanna le dikna ka lak natu in Saul ii bangkua sungah khat po a kikhe a om ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ziba in, “Jonathan ii tapa khat om lai hi; Ama a peangbai hi,” ci in zo hi.","ref":"2 Sa 4:4"},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Koi sungah ama om ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ziba in “Lodebar khua, Ammiel ii tapa Machir inn ah om hi,” ci in zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom David kumpipa in ama samsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Saul ii tupa, Jonathan ii tapa, Mephibosheth a thet ciang David mai ah zatak pia in kun hi. David in, “Mephibosheth awng,” ci in sam a, ama in “Na naseampa hi khi hi, topa,” ci in zo hi."},"7":{"text":"David in, “Lau heak in. Na pa Jonathan hu in nang tungah hong dik tu khi hi. Na pu Saul ii leitang theampo nang kong pia kik tu a, tuaciang nang sia ka sabuai ah an na ne tawntung tu hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Mephibosheth kun kik a, “Kei sia ui thisa khat bang bek hi khi hi, topa awng! Banghangin kei tungah tuaza in hong dik tu ni ziam?” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kumpipa in Saul ii naseampa Ziba sam a, “Na topa ii tupa Mephibosheth tungah Saul le a bangkua ii neisa theampo pia khi hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang, na tapate le na naseamte in na topa Saul ii innkuanpuite atu tua leitang tho in, lo an tun ciang amate na puak tu uh hi. Ahihang Mephibosheth ahile keima sabuai ah leangna thupi khat hi tawntung tu hi,” ci hi. (Ziba in tapa sawm le nga le naseam kul nei hi.)"},"11":{"text":"Ziba in, “Kumpipa ii nong thupiak babang ka seam tu hi,” ci in zo hi. Tuabangin Mephibosheth in kumpipa ii tapate khat bangin kumpi sabuai ah an ne hi."},"12":{"text":"Mephibosheth in tapano Mica a kici khat nei hi. Ziba ii innkuanpuite theampo Mephibosheth ii naseamte suak siat uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom, a peangte ngeal a zaw Mephibosheth sia Jerusalem khua ah teangin, a an neak theampo kumpi sabuai ah ne hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawk tawm vei ciangin Ammon kumpipa Nahash thi a, a tapa Hanun sia kumpi suak hi.","title":"David in Ammon te le Syria te Zo (1 Khangtaanghthu 19:1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa David in, “A pa Nahash ii kei tungah hong vawt bangin Hanun tungah thumaan kilawmtatna ka lak nanak tu hi,” ci hi. Tua hi a, David in a khuangai puina a ko tu in kamtaite paisak hi.
