Amate Ammon a thet uh ciang,"},"3":{"text":"Ammon lampuite in kumpipa tungah, “David in na pa a upatna taw, khuangai puina a lakna in hi mite hong paisak, hi tu in um ni ziam? Hi peuma ngawl hi! Ama in hi sungah amate hong puakna sia ei hong zawthal thei natu in ih khuapi thu a dawp tu ngalvilin hong paisak hi!” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Hanun in David ii kamtaite mansak a, a khamul a lang meetkol sakin, a puansilhte a kawng ciangin tansak a, tha kik uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate inn lam a zot kik tu uh sia maizum leih hi. David in bang thu piang ci a zaak ciang amate tungah kam thaak a, na khamul uh a po kik mateng hong heak kik heak vun a, Jericho khua ah na taam vun ci in zasak hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in David sia a ngal uh suaksak ci in Ammon te in tel zo ahiciang Bethrehob le Zobah pan Syria ngalkap 20,000, Tob pan 12,000, tuaciang Maacah kumpipa le a mite tulkhat teng ngalcial uh hi."},"7":{"text":"David in hi thu za a, tuaciang amate do tu in Joab le a ngalkaphonpi bup kuansak hi."},"8":{"text":"Ammon te kuanin amate khuapi Rabbah tumna ah mun la uh a, tua laitak a dangte, Syria te le Tob le Maacah pan mite in ngam taanzauna ah mun la uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngalte in mai pan le nung panin a sim tu hunlam Joab in mu ahikom Israel ngalkap phabel teng tealin Syria te maingat in mun lasak hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngalkap a om lai teng sia a suapui pa Abishai in uksak a, Ammon te maingat in koi hi."},"11":{"text":"Joab in ama munah, “Syria te in kei hong zo tu bangin na mu le hong pai ta'n a hong hu ta'n, tuaciang Ammon te in nang hong zo tu bang ahile keima hong pai in kong hu tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Hat in a, na thinliansak in! Ih Pathian khuapite le ih mite atu in nasia takin do tawng. Tuaciang Topa ii deina babangin piang tahen!” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Joab le a mite in a sim tu mai a nawk ciang, Syria te tai keak uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ammon te in Syria te tai a mu uh ciang amate zongh Abishai kung panin tai a, a khuapi sung tu uh hi. Tuasia ciang Joab sia Ammon te a simna pan hong heak kikin Jerusalem khua zuan hi."},"15":{"text":"Syria te in Israel te a lel hunlam phawk ahikom a ngalkap theampo khawmtua uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpipa Hadadezer in Euphrates ngun ii nisuana sangah a om Syria te sam a, tuaciang Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer ii ngalkaphonpi ukpa Shobach ukna nuai Helam khua ah amate hong pai uh hi."},"17":{"text":"David in tua thu a zaak ciang Israel ngalkap theampo khawmtua a, Jordan ngun kaantan in Helam ah kuan hi, tua munah Syria te in ama maingat in mun la uh hi. Kidona hong kipan a,"},"18":{"text":"tuaciang Israel te in Syria ngalkaphonpi notkeak kik uh hi. David le a mite in Syria siphu ngalleang ukte 700, siphu ngalkap 40,000 thatin, ngalte ngalkap ukpa Shobach liamsak a, ngalphual ah thi uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Hadadezer khutnuai a om kumpite in Israel te a lel hunlam a kiphaw uh ciangin ngal kilemna vawtin, amate khutnuai ah om uh hi. Tuaciangin Syria te in Ammon te hu ngam nawn ngawl uh hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipate in ngalsim veu in a kuan hun khaal kipat kik ciangin David in Joab sia a ngalkap bute le ngalkaphonpite taw kuansak hi; amate in Ammon te zo in, Rabbah khuapi uumci uh hi. Ahihang David ama sia Jerusalem ah om hi.","title":"David le Bathsheba","ref":"1 Khang 20:1"},"2":{"text":"Nikhat, ni kai zawkciang David sia a mutna pan hong tho a, kumpi innkhum tungah kaato hi. Ama tualai ah a vavaa ciang numei khat kibual in a om mu hi. Ama a mealpha mama hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in kamtaite paisak in, tua nu sia akua ziam ci in a katsak ciang, Hit mi Eliam ii tanu, Uriah ii zi Bathsheba hi ci in he hi."},"4":{"text":"David in ama a sam tu in kamtaite paisak hi; amate in tua nu ama kung then hi, tuaciang ama in luppui hi. (Ama sia tha simin a zeksa kithiansuana a man zawk hiat bek ahi hi.) Tua zawkciang ama cia kik hi."},"5":{"text":"A zawkciang ama ngai ahi hunlam kiphawk a, David munah a son tu in kamtai paisak hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuasia ciang David in Joab tungah kam thaak a: “Hit mi Uriah hong puak ta'n,” cisak hi. Tua ahikom Joab in David kungah ama paisak hi."},"7":{"text":"Uriah hong thet ciang David in Joab le a ngalkapte a ciidam ziam, ngal kidona bangbang hi ziam ci in dongh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang, ama in Uriah munah, “Cia in a, tawm vei tawlngak hun la ta'n,” ci hi. Uriah in nusia a, tuaciang David in a inn ah letsong puaksak hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang Uriah cia ngawl a; kumpi inn kongpi ah kumpipa a cingte taw lum hi."},"10":{"text":"Uriah sia inn ah a cia ngawl hunlam David in a zaak ciang ama dongh a, “Hun saupi inn taw kikhen a, nong heak kik zawk bek hi ngawl ziam; banghangin cia ngawl ni ziam?” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Uriah in, “Israel te le Judah te ngal sungah om a, tuaciang Thuciamna Thingkuang zongh amate taw om hi; kei hong ukpa Joab le a bute zongh mun taanzauna ah ngiaphual saat hi. Bangbangin kei inn zuan a, ne in dawn in ka zi taw lum thei thong tu khi ziam? Tuabang peuma in ngamta ngeingawl tu khi hi ci in biakna taw kisai a thiangtho theampo taw ka kiciam hi,” ci in zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom David in, “Tua ahile tuni in hi sungah taam lai in, zing ciangin kong puak kik tu hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom Uriah sia tua ni le a zing ciang dong Jerusalem ah taam hi."},"13":{"text":"David in nitak an ne tu in Uriah sam a, zu khamsak hi. Ahihang tua zan zongh Uriah a inn ah cia peang ngawl hi; kumpi inn a cingte inndoi sungah ama puanvan tungah mu zaw hi."},"14":{"text":"A zingsang ciang David in Joab lai thaak a, Uriah in a lai puaksak hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in a lai sungah: “Uriah sia ngal kisim a nasia belna, ngal mai ah koi in, tuaciang nungkin vun a, ama thalup thuaksak vun,” ci in at hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom Joab in khuapi a uumci laitakin ngalte thahatna munah Uriah puak hi."},"17":{"text":"Ngalte ngalkapte khuapi panin hong pusuak in, Joab ngalkapte sim uh hi; David ii ngalkapmang pawlkhat kithat a, Uriah zongh thi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Joab in David munah ngal kidona thu zasak hi,"},"19":{"text":"tuaciang ama in kamtai pa pau natu hil a, “Kumpipa tungah ngal kidona thu teng na son siat zawkciang,"},"20":{"text":"ama thin uukin, hi bangin hong dongh thei tu hi. ‘Banghangin amate sim tu in khuapi taw a kinai lei na dong pai nu ziam? Khuapi luphungte tung panin thaltangte hong kap tu ci in he ngawl nu ziam?"},"21":{"text":"Gideon ii tapa Abimelech a kithalupna ciamtee nawn ngawl nu ziam? A mun sia Thebez hi a, numei khat ii anngoaina suang khat taw luphung tung pan a densuk sia in ama khalum hi. Tua ahile banghangin luphung neak leih in pai nu ziam?’ Kumpipa in tu a bangin hong dongh le ama munah, ‘Na ngalkap mangpa Uriah zongh kithat hi,’ ci vun,” ci hi.","ref":"Thkte 9:53"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom kamtai pa, David kungah hong pai in Joab ii a thupiak bangin son hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in, “Ih ngalte sia ei sangin hat zaw a, mun taanzauna ah ei hong sim tu khuapi sung pan hong pusuak hi, ahihang amate sia khuapi kongpi dong ka nawt kik uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuasia ciang amate in luphung tung pan thaltang taw hong kap in, na kumpi ngalkapmang pawlkhat hong thalupsak a, Uriah zongh thi hi,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Kamtaipa munah David in, “Joab na hanthawn in a, ngal kidona sung sia akua teng thi tu ci in kison thei ngeingawl ahi nungsang a thin lal ngawl natu son in. Khuapi sia nasia seseam in sim a, a laak natu son in,” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Bathsheba in a pasal kithat ci in a zaak ciang khuangai in tau hi."},"27":{"text":"A khuangai tu hun teng a bo ciangin David in ama sia kumpi inn ah sam hi; ama ii zi hong suak a, tapa khat hing hi. Ahihang David ii ngamtatna huvau Topa lungkim ngawl hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kamsaang pa Nathan sia David kungah paisak hi. Ama kungah Nathan pai in, “Pasal nii khuapi khat sungah teang khawm hi; khat sia hau a, a khat sia zawng hi.","title":"Nathan ii Thupuak le David ii Kisiikikna","ref":"Ps 51 (Thulu)"},"2":{"text":"A hau pa in khui le tuu tam mama nei hi,"},"3":{"text":"a zawng pa ahile a leisa tuuno khat bek nei hi. Ama in tuasia pha takin khoai a, a inn ah a tate taw khang khawmsak hi. Ama ii neak lai an pawlkhat taw vaakin, a hai taw tui dawnsak a, a kaang sungah toai hi. Tuuno sia ama atu in tanu khat taw kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"Ni khat ni in leangna khat a hau pa inn ah zin hong tung hi. Tua pa neak tu in mihaupa in a nganno khat zongh ngaw nuam ngawl hi; ama in mizawngpa ii tuuno laaksak in a zinpa neak tu in huan hi,” ci in son hi."},"5":{"text":"David sia tua mihau pa tungah thin uuk mama a, “A nungta Topa taw kiciam hi tong, hi bangin a ngamta pa a thi tu kilawm hi!"},"6":{"text":"Hi bangin a tatsiat hu in a laak za tungah a zaa li in a lo kik kul tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"“Nangma tuasia pa ni hi,” Nathan in David munah ci hi. “Tuaciang hisia Israel ii Topa Pathian in ci hi: ‘Saul khut sung pan kong suatak a, Israel kumpipa kong suaksak hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama ii kumpi ngam le a zite nang kong pia hi; Israel le Judah kumpipa kong suaksak hi. Hi sia kicing ngawl lai ahile a zaa nii in a tamzaw hong pia zo tu khi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahile banghangin kong thupiakte ni ngawl ni ziam? Banghangin hi tatsiatna ngamtat in nei ni ziam? Nang in Uriah sia ngal sungah na thisak hi: Ammon te in na thatlumsak hi, tua zawkciang a zi na la hi!"},"10":{"text":"Tu in na khang simin na suan na paalte pawlkhat sia thisia thi ngamh in thi tu hi, banghang ziam cile nang in ka thu nong ni bua a, tuaciang Uriah ii zi na la hi."},"11":{"text":"Nangma innkuan sung pan ma in khat ma in nangma ngim hong piak natu in ka kiciam hi. Na zite nangma kung pan la in midang khat ka piak ciangin hi thu na mu tu hi; ama in suntangin amate luppui tu hi."},"12":{"text":"A thimtham in mawna vawt ku ni hi, ahihang Israel theampo ii a mu tu in suntangin tuabang ka piangsak tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"2 Sa 16:22"},"13":{"text":"David in, “ Topa tungah maw zo khi hi,” ci hi. Nathan in, “ Topa in hong maisak hi; thi ngawl tu ni hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang hi bangin na ngamtatna panin Topa simmawkna lak zo na hikom na ta sia thi tu hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Nathan inn ah cia hi. Uriah zi taw a hin David ii ta sia Topa in a ciinasak mama hi."},"16":{"text":"David in a ta dam natu Pathian tungah thu ngen hi. Ama in bangma ne nuam ngawl a, zan simin ama ii inndoi sungah pai in suat tungah lum hi.","title":"David ii Tapa Thi"},"17":{"text":"A kumpi inn uliante in thosak nuamin hanciam hikale tho nuam ngawl a, amate taw bangma nekhawm nuam ngawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Nipi khat zawkciang a ta hong thi a, tuaciang David ii uliante in tua thu ama tungah son ngam ngawl uh hi. Amate in, “A ta nuntak lai zongin ih paupui ciang David in hong zo nuam ngawl hi. Na ta thi zo hi ci in bangbangin son thei tu hi ziam? Ama le ama bang khat po kilaw tha tu hi!” ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"David in amate kihuau a mu ciang a tano thi zo hi, ci in phawk thei hi. Tua ahikom ama in amate munah, “Tano thi zo ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Hi hi, thi zo hi,” ci in amate in zo uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Suat tung pan David thoto a, kibualin, a sam pot a, a puan laih hi. Tua zawkciang ama Topa ii inn sungah pai in biakna vawt hi. Kumpi inn ah a heak kik ciangin an ngen a, a kilui po ciangin ne paih hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama uliante in ama munah, “Hi thu sia tel zo ngawl khu hi. Tano luhai lai in ama na kaa a, an na ne bua hi; ahihang a thi po ciang thoto in an na ne hi!” ci uh hi."},"22":{"text":"“Hi hi, a nuntak hunsung teng kapin an tang peu khi hi. Topa in kei hong hesuak tha tu a tano thisak ngawl tu hi ci in ka ngaisun hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang tu in thi zo ahiciang banghangin an tatang lai tu khi ziam? Tano nungtasak kik thei tu khi ziam? Ni khat ni ciang ama omna ah kei pai tu khi hi, ahihang ama kei kungah hong pai kik thei ngeingawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David in a zi Bathsheba heeneam hi. Ama in luppui in, tapa khat nei kik a, David in Solomon ci in a min phuak hi. Topa in patangno sia it hi,","title":"Solomon hong Piang"},"25":{"text":"tuaciang Topa in kamsaangpa Nathan thupia a, patangno min Jedidiah phuaksak hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in ama it hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua lanin Joab in Ammon te khuapi Rabbah a simna zom suak a, la zo dektak hi.","title":"David in Rabbah Khuapi La (1 Khangtaanghthu 20:1-3)"},"27":{"text":"Ama in kamtaite paisak a, David tungah, “Rabbah sim zo khi hi, tuaciang a tui laakna zongh suan zo khi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tu in na ngalkap om lai teng hong khawmtua ta'n a, a khuapi simin, nangma tatak ma in la in. Tua khuapi la hi ci in min nga nuam ngawl khi hi,” ci in kosak hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahikom David in a ngalkapte khawmtua a, Rabbah ah kuanin sim a, zothal hi."},"30":{"text":"Ammon te ii biak milim pathian Molech ii lu tung pan David in kilogramme 35 bang a ngit suangmanpha khat a kisuan khamh kumpilukhu sia la hi. David in tua suangmanpha la in ama lukhu tungah suang hi. Ama ii khuapi sung pan a laaksak vanh zongh tam mama a,"},"31":{"text":"a khua mite sia thing at naam, thik tumanh, thik heite taw naseamsakin, zawthawk thu taw uksuang seaksak hi. Ammon khua dangte sung a om mite zongh tuabang ma in seamsak hi. Tua zawkciang ama le a mite Jerusalem ah heak kik uh hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David ii tapa Absalom in a mealpha pasal nei ngawl lai suapuinumei Tamar a kici khat nei hi. Amnon a kici David ii tapa dang khat in ama dei hi.","title":"Amnon le Tamar"},"2":{"text":"Ama in tua nu dei mama ahikom nat law liang hi, banghang ziam cile a teenpui tu suak thei tuak ngawl hi; ngaknu thiangtho a hina taw kizui in ama sia pate taw kimu ngawlin kikoi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang ama in a pilvang mama, David ii suapuipa Shammah ii tapa Jonadab kici ngualtamh khat nei hi."},"4":{"text":"Jonadab in Amnon munah, “Nang sia kumpipa ii tapa hi napi, ni khat zawkciang ni khat hee mai taw om ni hi. Bang tat ni ziam?” ci hi. Ama in, “Ka suapui sealh Absalom ii suapuinu Tamar dei khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Jonadab in, “Na ci kinasak in lupna zuan in. Na pa in nang ve tu in hong pai ciang, ama munah hi bangin ci in, ‘Nong hesuakna in ka suapuinu Tamar hong paisak in an hong piasak ta'n. Hi sungah ka mu tangin an hong huansak hen a, ama mama in an hong piasak ta'n ci in,’ ” ci in sawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom Amnon sia kizawmsakin lupna tung zuan hi. Kumpipa David in ama ve tu in pai a, tuaciang Amnon in, “Nong hesuakna in Tamar hi sungah hong paisak ta'n a, ama ka mu thei natu munah anluum nip pawlkhat hong vawtsak tahen, tuaciang ama mama in hong pia tahen,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom Kumpipa David in kumpi inn sungah Tamar kam thaak a; “Amnon ii inn ah va pai ta'n a, an tawm vawtsak ta'n,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama pai in lupna tungah a lup mu hi. Tua nu in anvui thauh sa pawlkhat la in, ama ii mu thei natu munah moh pawlkhat vawt hi. Tua zawkciang muhte em a,"},"9":{"text":"ama ii neak tu in beal sung pan sua hi, ahihang ama in ne nuam ngawl hi. Ama in, “A om theampo pusuaksak in,” ci a — tua ciang amate a vekpi ma in pusuak uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, ama munah “Muhte hi sung ka lupna ah hong paipui ta'n a nangma hong lui ta'n,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in muhte la in paipui hi. Tuate a piak ciangin, Amnon in zamh a, “Hong pai ta'n, lumkhawm tawng!” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tuabangin zawthawk thu taw ka minsiat natu hong ngamtasak heak in! Mu thadahuai mama hi!"},"13":{"text":"Bangbangin mipi kawm ah khuadak ngam nawn tu khi ziam? Tuaciang, nangma Israel ngam sungah min siacip tu ni hi. Nong hesuakna in kumpipa paupui po lete ama in kei, nang atu hong pia leilam tu um khi hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang ama in a nangai bua hi; tuaciang ama sia tha hatzaw ahikom buanin khialpui hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Amnon in tua nu nasia takin ngaimaw hi; a masa lai a itna sangin tu in a ngaimawkna nasia zaw kan hi. Ama in, “Tai in!” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in, “Tai ngawl tu khi hi. Tu bang a nong betkeak sia, na vawt sa khialna sangin zongh a lianzaw khialna ahi hi!” ci in zo hi. Ahihang Amnon in ama ii pau a ngai nuam bua hi;"},"17":{"text":"ama in a aituam naseamte samin, “Hi numei ka muna ah omsak heak vun! Doipua ah notkeak vun a, kong kalh vun!” ci in sawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Naseampa in ama doipua ah koi in kongkha kalh san uh hi. Tamar sia tua hun lai in kumpipa tanu, pasal nei ngawl lai te kizepna ahi puantual baan sau silh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in a lu tungah vut kipoai a, a puantual eaukeak in, a khut sungah a mai phumin kap kawmin paisan hi."},"20":{"text":"A suapuipa Absalom in ama a mu ciang, “Amnon in hong vawtsia ahi bua ziam? Suapui nu awng, tuaza in na thin lalsak heak in. Ama na suapui sealh hi, tua ahikom kuama munah son heak in!” ci hi. Tuabangin Tamar sia Absalom ii inn ah hee in lungzuangin om hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpipa David in thupiang teng a zaak ciang a thinso hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaciang Absalom in Amnon sia a suapuinu a buansak hu in huatsa mama a, pau zongh paupui nawn ngawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Kum nii zawkciang Ephraim khua hui, Baal Hazor ah Absalom in a tuumul meetsak a, ama in kumpipa tapate theampo tua munah sam hi.","title":"Absalom ii Phu laakna"},"24":{"text":"Ama in Kumpipa David kungah pai in, “Kumpipa awng, ka tuute mul meetsak khi hi. Nang le na uliante hong pai in tua poai ah nong kihel tu uh ziam?” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"“Hong kihel thei ngawl tu khu hi, ka tapa awng, ka vekpi in hong pai thong le ung, nang atu ngim huai lei tu hi,” kumpipa in ci hi. Absalom in sam hamtang ahihang kumpipa uuk ngawlin, Absalom cia a sawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahihang Absalom in, “Tua ahile pha hi, ka suapuipa Amnon beak nong paisak buatu ziam?” ci hi. “Banghangin ama hong pai kul tu ziam?” ci in kumpipa in dongh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahihang a khakbel ciang David in Amnon le a tapa dangte theampo Absalom taw a paisak dong ngen hamtang hi. Absalom in kumpipa taw a kiphu an neak poaipi khat vawt hi,"},"28":{"text":"tuaciang a naseamte thupia a: “Amnon ii zu a kham mama hun hong he tavun a, thu kong piak ciangin ama that vun. Lau heak vun. Keima in vaipuak la khi hi. Hang vun a, haisaang heak vun,” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuabangin naseamte in Absalom thupiak bangin Amnon that uh hi. David ii tapa dang teng sia a laate tung to in taikeak uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Amate inn lam a zawzot laitakin, David munah thu kiko a: “Absalom in na tapate theampo thatlum zo hi — khat zongh kikhe ngawl hi!”"},"31":{"text":"Kumpipa hong ding a, a puansilh lai sia heena taw eaukeak in, leiliik hi. Ama taw a omkhawm naseamte zongh a puante eaukeak uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahihang David ii suapuipa Shammah ii tapa Jonadab in, “Kumpipa awng, amate in na tapa theampo that siat ngawl hi. Amnon bek thi hi. Amnon in Absalom suapuinu Tamar a buan pan kipan hi bangin a ngamtat tu sia a khensat sa ahi hunlam Absalom na et ciang son thei ni hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahikom na tapate theampo thi hi ci thuthang sia um heak in; Amnon bekma kithat hi,” ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua lanin Absalom tai zo hi. Tua zawk bekin ngal encik ngalkappa in Horonaim sang pan mualtung lampi hong tawnsuk mihonpi khat mu hi. Ama in kumpipa kungah pai in a mu teng ko hi."},"35":{"text":"Jonadab in David munah, “Tuate sia kong sonsa bangin na tapate hong cia hi,” ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Hi teng a son zawk po ciang, David ii tapate hong tum a: amate kap a, David le a uliante zongh nasia takin kap uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Absalom sia tai in, Ammihud ii tapa Talmai, Geshur kumpipa kung zuan a, tuaciang tua munah kum thum sung om hi. David in a tapa Amnon atu khuangei pi ma khuangai hi;","ref":"2 Sa 3:3","merge":"38"},"39":{"text":"ahihang Amnon thina huvau a khuangaina a theau zawkciang a tapa Absalom bebek thangai in hong om hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa David in Absalom ngai mama hi ci in Joab in he hi,","title":"Absalom hong heakkik natu Joab in Vaihawmsak"},"2":{"text":"tua ahikom ama in nupi pilvang khat Tekoa ah a teang sia samsak hi. Ama hong thet ciang Joab in ama munah, “Kikhuangaisak in; na khuangai puante silh in a, na sam pot heak in. Khuangei mama khuangai in a omsa nupi khat bangin kithoai in."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang nupi nu sia kumpipa kungah va pai ta'n a, ci a kong sawl teng va ci ta'n,” ci hi. Tua zawkciang Joab in a pau natu teng hil hi."},"4":{"text":"Numei nu kumpipa kungah pai in, zatak piakna in lei ah bok hi, tuaciang hi bangin ci hi, “Hong hu ta'n, Kumpipa awng!”"},"5":{"text":"“Bang dei ni ziam?” ci in ama in dongh hi. Tua nu in, “Kei sia a zawng meingong nu khi hi, topa awng. Ka pasal sia thi zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa awng, keima in tapa nii ka nei a, ni khat ni ciang kuama a khen tu a om ngawlna lo sungah kihau in, khat in a dang khat sia thatlum hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaciang tu in, topa awng, ka mealheakte theampo in hong langpan hi, a suapuipa a thalup hu in ama zongh a thalup thei natu in ka tapa sia amate khut sungah aapin hong sawl hi. Hi bangin amate hong ngamta le tapa nei nawn ngawl tu khi hi. Amate in ka lam etna a khakbel sia hong suk siatsak tu a, ka pasal min kilaw natu zongh tapa om nawn ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Inn ah cia kik ta'n, keima in hi thu kong thintoisak tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"9":{"text":"“Kumpipa awng, bang po na vawt zong, hi thu tungtaang ah kei le ka bangkua in mawsiat thuak taw ung; nang le kumpi innkuan sia maw ngawl tu nu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Khat po in hong tawng le keima kungah ama hong paipui ta'n, tua hile ngim hong pia kik ngeingawl tu hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Kumpipa awng, nong hesuakna in, Topa na Pathian tungah ka mealheakte ka tapa thi huvau phulam natu vaipuak nei sia in ka tapa a om lai sia a thalupna taw khialna lianzaw lai a vawt ngawl natu in thu hong ngetsak ta'n,” ci hi. “A nungta Topa min taw kamciam hong pia khi hi, na tapa sia tawmno zongh bangma tat ngawl tu hi,” David in ci hi."},"12":{"text":"“Kumpipa awng, nong hesuakna in, kam khat hong pausak lai ta'n,” nupi nu in ci hi. Ama in, “Son in,” ci in zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Nupi nu in ama munah, “Banghangin Pathian mite tungah tuabang khialna vawt ni ziam? Nangma zongh na tapa sia lei dangah a peamna pan cia kiksak ngawl ni hi, tua ahikom tu mahiat a na pau teng taw nangma le nangma mawpu kisua ni hi."},"14":{"text":"Ei ih vekpi in thi tu hi hing; ei sia lei ah tuibua taw kibangin, kiluak kik thei ngawl hi. Pathian ngawngawn in a thisate nungtasak kik ngawl hi, ahihang kumpipa in peamta in a om mihing khat sia a nobel in a cia kik natu lam zonsak thei ni hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu in, kumpipa awng, nang kungah hong pai a hi bangin thu kong sonna sia, tua mite in kei hong tawn hang hi, tua ahikom nangma tungah hong son leng kong nget sia hong vawtsak tu ci in keima le keima lametna nei kisa khi hi."},"16":{"text":"Pathian ii a mite a piak ngam le lei pan kei le ka tapa hong heam nuamin ko thalup hong sawm sia kung pan zong nangma in kong son teng hong ngai a, hong hun tu um khi hi."},"17":{"text":"Keima le keima tungah ka kicina pan, topa, na kamciamna in keima hong ngammuangsak tu hi, banghang ziam cile kumpipa sia Pathian ii vantung mi taw kibangin a pha le a sia khentel thei hi. Topa na Pathian nang taw omkhawm tahen!” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Thu khat hong dongh tu khi hi, tuaciang ahi babangin hong son nanak tu ni hi,” ci in zo hi. Tua nu in, “Kumpipa awng, nong dok nop po hong dongh ta'n,” ci in zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in, “Tu a bang teng nong sep sia Joab ii hong sawl ahi ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Tua nu in “A thiangtho nate theampo taw kiciam khi hi, Kumpipa awng nong thudok sia ka pial thei natu mama a lam om ngawl hi. Na ulianpa Joab in ka sep tu le ka pau tu teng hong son takpi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahihang ama in hi vai teng thiangsak nuam ahi hu in a vawt ahi hi. Kumpipa nang sia Pathian ii vantunglalang bangin ciim a thupiang theampo he ni hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"A zawkciang kumpipa in Joab munah, “Na dei bangin sep tu ka khensat zo hi. Va pai ta'n a tua khangno Absalom sia hi sungah hong ciapui ta'n,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Joab in David ii mai ah zatakna taw kileisee sukin, “Pathian in thupha hong pia tahen, Kumpipa awng! Tu in kei tungah nong lungkim hunlam sia kong nget teng nong piak ciangin ka he hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama thoto in Geshur ah pai a, Absalom sia Jerusalem ah ciapui hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahihang kumpipa in Absalom sia kumpi inn sungah a teen ngawl natu in thupia hi. Kumpipa in, “Ama mu nuam ngawl khi hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom Absalom sia ama inn ah teangin kumpipa mai ah kilaak ngawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Israel ngam sungah mealphatna lam sang Absalom bangin a minthang kuama om ngawl hi; a lu pan a peang dong sit baanna nei ngawl hi.","title":"Absalom le David Kilem kik"},"26":{"text":"A sam saa mama a, sau leih in a ngit leih ciang kum sim khatvei veu tan hi. A sam ngitna sia kumpi khaiteena taw tee ciang, kilogramme 2 vaal pha hi,"},"27":{"text":"Absalom in tapa thum le Tamar kici tanu khat nei a, a mealpha mama numei khat ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Absalom sia kumpipa taw kimu ngawlin kum nii sung Jerusalem ah teang hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama vai in Joab sia kumpipa kung paisak nuam a, samsak hi; ahihang Joab hong pai ngawl hi. Khatvei ma Absalom in Joab samsak kik ahihang Joab pai nuam peang ngawl hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahikom Absalom in a naseamte munah, “En vun, Joab ii lo sia keima taw kingizawng hi, tuaciang a sungah mangtaang kiciing hi. Pai tavun a va hal tavun,” ci hi. Tua ahiciang amate pai in tua lo hal uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Absalom inn ah Joab pai in, “Banghangin na naseamte in ka lo hong halsak ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"32":{"text":"Absalom in, “Banghang ziam cile kong sam sasak hang nang hong pai ngawl ni hi. Kumpipa kungah pai in, kei taangin thu hong doksak lete oai khi hi: ‘Banghangin Geshur nusia in hi sungah hong pai kana khi ziam? Tua munah om po leng phazaw tu hi ve,’ ci hi. Absalom in zom to a, “Kumpipa taw ka kimu natu hong vaihawm ta'n, tuaciang kei maw ka hi le hong thatlum tahen,” ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahikom Joab sia Kumpipa David kungah pai a, Absalom ii ci teng son hi. Kumpipa in Absalom samsak a, ama pai in kumpipa mai lei ah hong kun suk hi. Kumpipa in ama muakin namh hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia zawkciang Absalom in ama atu siphu ngalleang khat le siphu pawlkhat heang a, ama a cing mihing 50 koi hi.","title":"Absalom in Tualngal tho tu Ngeal"},"2":{"text":"Ama zing tuungin tho a, khuapi kongpi hui lampi ah ding hi. Mihing khat po sia ngual taw thu kinei a, kumpipa khensak nuam in hong pai a om simin, Absalom in sam a, koisung pan hong pai ni ziam ci in dongh bul hi. Tuaciang ama tungah a nam min sia a son zawkciang,"},"3":{"text":"Absalom in, “En in, thukham in nang hong panpui hi, ahihang kumpipa luangin nang thu hong sitin thu hong khen tu kuama om ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaciang hi bang veu belap a, “Keima thukhenmang hi leng uuk meak ing! Tua hile ngual taw thu kinei, ahibuale ama ii neisa a nga kik nuam khat pawpo kei kungah hong pai thei tu a, thu khaikimin ka khensak tu hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuabangin mihing khat Absalom mai ah kun in hong neak ciangin Absalom in a khut thaakin koai a, namh hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa tung pan thu khaikim khenna thangai a hong pai Israel mi theampo Absalom in hi bang veu in vawt ahikom amate ii panpuina maan nga hi."},"7":{"text":"Kum li zawkciang Absalom in David kumpipa munah, “Topa awng, Hebron ah hong paisak ta'n, Topa tungah ka piak kamciam teng seam nuam khi hi."},"8":{"text":"Syria ngam Geshur ah ka teen lai in, Topa tungah kamciam ka piakna pan, ama in kei, Jerusalem ah hong la kik le Hebron ah ama bia tu khi hi, ka ci hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"“Thin nuam takin va pai ta'n,” kumpipa in ci hi. Tua ahikom Absalom sia Hebron ah pai hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang ama in Israel namte theampo kungah kamtai paisak in, “Lemle aw na zaak uh ciang, ‘Hebron ah Absalom sia kumpi suak zo hi!’ ci in a au natu in sonsak hi.”"},"11":{"text":"Absalom ii sapna taw Jerusalem ah ama taw a paikhawm mihing 200 pha hi; amate in a sawmna thu bangma he ngawlin, thinpha lungpha taw pai uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaciang Absalom in Kumpipa David ii thudokte khat ahi Gilo khua ah Ahithophel zongh sangaw biakpiakna a vawt laitakin samsak hi. Kumpipa langpan tu a sawmna sia hong thahatin, Absalom ii nungzuite tam vaial hi."},"13":{"text":"Kamtai khat in David munah, “Israel te in Absalom tungah a thumaan natu in kamciam pia hi,” ci hi.","title":"Jerusalem pan David Tai"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom David in Jerusalem ah ama taw a om a uliante theampo munah, “Absalom khut panin ih suakta nuam le thakhat ma ih tai kul tu hi! Manlang vun! Tua ahibuale ama hai ngawlin hi mun hong theng tu a, hong zo in khuapi sungah a om theampo hong that tu hi!” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in, “Hi hi, Kumpipa awng, na ci babangin ngamta tu in kinging khu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom kumpipa sia kumpi inn en tu a nusiat a zino sawm teng simngawl, a innkuanpui dang teng le a uliante taw tai uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa le a mite theampo khuapi a nusiat tu ciangin. inn mong khakbel sia ah tawlnga uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpi a cing teng sia ama mai kaantan in a pai suak laitak a uliante theampo zongh ama hui ah ding tek hi. Gath pan a zui ngalkap 600 te zongh hong kaantan uh a,"},"19":{"text":"tuaciang kumpipa in amate lampuipa Ittai munah, “Banghangin ko taw hong paikhawm tu ni ziam? Heak kik in a, kumpi thak sia taw om ta'n. Nang sia ngamdangmi ni hi, na ngam panin ngaltai khat hi ni hi."},"20":{"text":"Hi sungah tawmvei sung bekma hong teang na hi ciang, banghangin nang, kei taw hong vakthap kawkoaisak tu khi ziam? Koisung zuan tu khi ziam ci in keima zongh in he ngawl khi hi. Heak kik in a, na ngammipuite zongh tonpui ta'n — Topa in no tungah hong dik tahen a hong thumaan tahen,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang Ittai in, “Kumpipa awng, Topa min taw kiciam khi hi, thi tu keak a kul zong na paina po ah pai tawntung tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"22":{"text":"David in, “Pha hi! Pai suak in!” ci in zo hi. Tua ahikom Ittai sia a mi teng le ama a bealhte theampo taw pai suak uh hi."},"23":{"text":"David nungzuite in a nusiat tak ciang mipite a ngingin hong kap uh hi. Kumpipa in Kidron lui kaantan a, a mite in zui in amate duisung manaw in paikhawm hon uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Thiampi Zadok, tuaciang ama taw Thuciamna Thingkuang thiangtho a pua Levi mite zongh tualai ah kihel in om uh hi. Amate in Thuciamna Thingkuang lei ah koisukin, mi theampo ii khuapi a nusiat dong kisuanh kik ngawl uh hi. Thiampi Abiathar zongh tua munah om hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuasia ciang kumpipa in Zadok munah, “Thuciamna Thingkuang khuapi sungah heak pui kik ta'n. Topa in kei tungah hong lungkim ahile ni khat ni ciangin kei hong heak kiksak tu a, tuasia le a omna mun hong musak tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahihang Topa in kei tungah hong lungkim buale — tuasia ciang ama uuk bang po hong vawt tahen,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in Zadok munah a ci lai na pan, “En in, na tapa Ahimaaz le Abiathar ii tapa Jonathan tonpui in khuapi sung ma ah thinnuam takin zuan kik tavun."},"28":{"text":"Tua lanin nang tung pan thuthak ka zaak dong ngun kanna pan kong ngak tu hi,” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahikom Zadok le Abiathar in Jerusalem ah Thuciamna Thingkuang puak kik in tua khua ah om uh hi."},"30":{"text":"David in Olive Mual ah a kapsa in kaato a; khuangaina lim lak in a peangnguakin om a, a lu siin hi. Ama a zuite theampo in zongh a lu uh puan taw siinin kap uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahithophel in Absalom ii leedona ah pawm hi ci in David tungah a kison ciangin, “ Topa awng, nong hesuakna in Ahithophel ii ngaisut piakna sia a lui thawthong suaksak in!” ci in thu ngen hi."},"32":{"text":"Biakna mun khat sia ii a omna mual tungah David hong thet ciangin, Arch mi ahi a lawm muan Hushai taw kimu a, ama sia a puan ki eaukeak in a lu tungah leivui kibuak hi."},"33":{"text":"David in ama munah, “Kei taw nong tonkhop hang kei nong hu theina bangma om ngawl hi,"},"34":{"text":"ahihang khuapi ah heak kik in Absalom munah na pa atu na ka sep bangma, tu in nangma atu thumaan takin hong sepsak tu khi hi, va ci lete kei hong hu thei zaw tu ni hi. Tuaciang Ahithophel ii ngaisut piakna peuma na hi thei za in nalh in."},"35":{"text":"Thiampi Zadok le thiampi Abiathar te tua munah om tu hi; kumpi inn sungah na zaak theampo amate tungah son in."},"36":{"text":"Amate ii a tapate Ahimaaz le Jonathan amate kungah om hi, tuaciang thu na kaikhop theampo amate in kei hong puaksak thei tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ahikom David lawmpa Hushai sia Absalom hong thet bek laitakin khuapi sungah heak kik hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in mualdawn a kan zawkciang thakhat thu in Mephibosheth ii naseampa Ziba taw kisi hi, ama in laa nii hong keng a, a laate in anluum luum 200, sapitko bom zakhat, thingnga hing bom zakhat le savun ip khat dim sapittui hong pua hi.","title":"David le Ziba","ref":"2 Sa 9:9-10"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa David in, “Tuate theampo bang tu ci ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ziba in, “Laate sia kumpipa innkuanpuite to natu hi a, anluum le thingngate sia mihingte neak tu, tuaciang sapittui sia dui sungah amate a toi ciang a dawn tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Na topa Saul ii tupa Mephibosheth koisung a om ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ziba in, “Ama Jerusalem ah om hi, banghang ziam cile tu in a pu Saul ii neisa theampo, Israel te in ama tungah pia tu in um tatak hi,” ci in zo hi.","ref":"2 Sa 19:25-27"},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in Ziba munah, “Mephibosheth ii neisa theampo nangma tang tu ni hi,” ci hi. Ziba in “Kei na naseampa khi hi. Kumpipa nang hong lungkimsak tawntung tu pa hong suaksak ta'n,” ci in zo kik hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa David sia Bahurim a thet ciangin Saul mealheak khat, Gera ii tapa Shimei sia ama taw kisi tu in hong pai in ama haamsiat hi.","title":"David le Shimei"},"6":{"text":"David sia ama uliante le a cingte in kiim uum napi Shimei in suang taw deang hi."},"7":{"text":"Shimei in haamsiat a, “Tai in! Tai in! Mi that pa! Mimaw mikhial pa!"},"8":{"text":"Nang in Saul ii kumpi ngam na suan a, tu in Topa in Saul ii innkuanpuite na suamlup hu in daan hong pia hi. Topa in kumpi ngam sia na tapa Absalom hong piaksak hi, tu in lalcip zo ni hi, nang mi that pa!” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"A nu Zeruiah ahi Abishai in, “Kumpipa awng, banghangin ui hisia in nang haamsiatsak ni ziam? Ama ii kungah hong paisak ta'n a, a lu hong tansak ta'n!” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa in Abishai le a suapuipa Joab munah, “Hisia no taw bangma kisai bo. Topa ii sawl hu in hong haamsiat ahile akua in khaam thei tu ziam?” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaciang David in Abishai le a uliante theampo munah, “Keima tapa in kei hong thatlum nuam a hanciam hi; tua ahiciang Benjamin mi khat ii ngamtatna banghangin lamdang sa nu ziam? Topa in a haamsiat natu in sawl hi; tua ahiciang ama nguak koi po vun a, tuabang hisak vun."},"12":{"text":"Topa in ka lungmanna hong heaksak tha tu a, ama ii hong haamsiatna sia taangin kei atu thupha pawlkhat hong pia nuam hi tu hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom David le a mite a lampai zom suak hi. Mualpangh a paina ah Shimei in amate pha valep a; a pai kawkawm in amate haamsiat a, suang le lei taw deang hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa le a mite theampo Jordan ngun a thet ciangin, amate a tha uh zawm mama zo ahikom tua munah tawlnga uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Absalom le ama taw kikop Israel te theampo Jerusalem khua ah tum a, Ahithophel zongh amate taw om hi.","title":"Absalom Jerusalem Khua sungah om"},"16":{"text":"David ii muan a lawmpa Hushai in Absalom taw a kisik ciang, “Kumpipa a khansau tahen! Kumpipa a khansau tahen!” ci in au hi."},"17":{"text":"Absalom in, “Na lawmpa David tungah na thumaanna teng bang suak ziam? Banghangin ama taw ton ngawl ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"18":{"text":"Hushai in, “Banghangin ton thei tu khi ziam? Topa ii tealpa, mipite ii teal pa, le Israel mi bup ii teal pa sangah pang khi hi. Kei nang taw om tu khi hi."},"19":{"text":"A khakbel in ci leang, ka topa ii tapa atu ka seam buale akua dang atu seam tu khi ziam? Na pa atu ka sepsak bangma in tu in nang atu hong sepsak tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Absalom in Ahithophel sang nga in, “Tu in hi sungah ei teng om ci leang ih ngamtat natu ngaisutna bang hong pia tu ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahithophel in, “Va pai ta'n a, na pa ii kumpi inn a cing tu in a nusiat a zinote luppui in. Tua hile Israel a om theampo in nang sia na pa in a ngalin hong nei hi, ci in he tu uh hi, tuaciang na nungzuite nasia takin kihansua tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in kumpi inn khuvum tungah Absalom atu puanbuk khat khaksak a, Absalom tumin ngual theampo mu tangin, a pa ii zinote luppui hi.","ref":"2 Sa 12:11-12"},"23":{"text":"Tua hunin Ahithophel ii ngaisut piak pawpo sia Pathian kammal bang keak ma in kisaang a; David le Absalom in zui khawm uh hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawk a ngeingawlin, Ahithophel in Absalom munah, “Pasal tulsawm le tulnii hong tealsak ta'n a, tu nitakin David ka na del tu hi.","title":"Hushai in Absalom Lamlak khial"},"2":{"text":"Ama a toi laitak le a thinkiam laitakin ka na sim tu hi. Ama lau tu a, a mite theampo taikeak tu hi. Keima in kumpipa bekma ka that tu a,"},"3":{"text":"tuaciang mo khat a pasal kung a zot kik bangin nangma kungah a mite kong paipui tu hi. Na thalup nop sia mihing khat bekma hi a; a dang teng bangma tat ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Hi ngaisutna sia Absalom le Israel lampuite atu in ngaisutna pha hi tuak sa uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Absalom in “Tu in Hushai sam vun, ama in bang ci nop a nei ziam ngai sin tawng,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Hushai a thet ciang, Absalom in ama munah son a, “Ahithophel ii ngaisut hong piak hi bang teng hi; tuasia ih zui tu ziam? Ih zui buatu le, ih ngamtat natu nangma hong son ta'n,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Hushai in, “Tu tungin Ahithophel ii ngaisutna hong piak sia pha ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Na pa David le a mite sia ngalsim a hatte hi a, a note a kilaaksak vompui a kiitakhuai za in kiitakhuai hi. Na pa sia ngalsim zia a he sa khat hi a, zanin a mite taw mun khat ah omkhawm ngawl tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu laitak lian bangin ama sia suanghawng sung khat ziam a dang mun khat ziam ah om tu hi. David ii na mite a sim po ciang tua thu a za pawpo in na mite ngallel sa hi ci tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tawpite bangin kiitak a nei ngawl a hangsan belte ngawngawn lau tu hi, banghang ziam cile Israel ngam a om a kuama po in na pa sia ngalkap lian khat hi a, a mite zongh ngalsim a hatte vive hi ci in he uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Kei ii ngaisut kong piak nopna pan, tuipivaal a senneal za bangin a tam Israel te, ngam mong khat pan mong khat dong khawmtua in a, tuaciangin ngalsimna ah nangma mama in lampui in."},"12":{"text":"David sia a omna po ah ih mu tu a, tuaciang ama in bang piang ziam ci a heak ma in ih sim tu hi. Ama ahizong a mite ahizong a suakta om ngawl tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in khuapi sung tuu in a nungkin le zong, ih mite in khauzeente keng tek tu a, a khuapi mama a nuaisang kuam sungah ih kaisuk tu hi. Tua mual tungah suangtum khat dongin kikhe ngawl tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Absalom le Israel te theampo in, “Hushai ii ngaisut piakna sia Ahithophel aa sangin phazaw hi,” ci uh hi. Absalom ii tuasiatna hong tun natu in Ahithophel ii ngaisut pha a piak sia a kizui ngawl natu in Topa in khensat zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Hushai in thiampite Zadok le Abiathar te munah, Absalom le Israel lampuite tungah ama in bang ngaisutna teng pia a, Ahithophel in bang ngaisutna teng pia ziam ci in son hi.","title":"David Kidop natu Thu Kipuak a, Suakta"},"16":{"text":"Hushai in belap a, “Tu in manlang vun! Ama le a mite kiman in a kithalup ngawl natu in, ngun kaantanna dui sungah zanin om heak hen a, Jordan ngun thakhat a kaantan paih natu David tungah thu puak vun,” cisak hi."},"17":{"text":"Abiathar ii tapa Jonathan le Zadok ii tapa Ahimaaz te in Jerusalem khua puasia a om Enrogel cik panin ngak uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate in khuapi sung a tum sia kimusak ngam ngawl hi. Naseam numei khat hun maanmaan in pai a, bang thu veu om ziam ci in amate tungah son hi, amate in Kumpipa David kungah pai in tua thute sonsawn uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahihang ni khat ni ciangin patang khat in amate mu luilam hi, tuaciang ama in Absalom munah son hi; tua ahikom amate in manlang takin tai a Bahurim khua sung pasal khat ii inn ah buu uh hi. Ama in a inn hui ah tuikhuk khat nei a, tua ii sungah tuaksuk uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasal pa ii zi in a sit natu khat la in tuikhuk vang tungah zalh a, antang pawlkhat a tungah poai hi, tua ahiciang kuama in bangma a lamdang a mu bua uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Absalom ii uliante hong pai a, tuaciang numeinu munah, “Ahimaaz le Jonathan koi sungah om ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Tua nu in, “Amate ngun kaanin pai zo hi,” ci hi. Pasalte in tuate ngeal zong ahihang mu zo ngawl ahiciang, Jerusalem ah heak kik uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate ii pai zawkciang Ahimaaz le Jonathan te tuikhuk sung pan pusuakin, David kumpipa kungah pai a tua thu ko hi. Ahithophel ii ama langpanin a ngealna teng ko a, tuaciang, “Manlang vun a, ngun kaantan vun,” ci uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahiciang David le a mite Jordan ngun kaantan a, khuavak bek in amate theampo a ngalkhat theng siat zo uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahithophel in ama ii ngaisut piakna kizui ngawl hi ci in a mu ciang, a laa tung to in ama ii khuapi ah cia kik hi. Ama vai tuatuamte ahi tu bangin a vawt siat zawkciang ama le ama awklum hi. Ama sia a innkuan ii thaan ah kiphum hi."},"24":{"text":"Absalom le Israel te ii Jordan ngun a kaantan hunin, David sia Mahanaim khua theng zo hi."},"25":{"text":"(Absalom in Joab taangin Amasa sia ngalkaphonpi ukpa in koi hi. Amasa sia Ishmael mi Jether ii tapa hi a; ama ii nu sia Nahash ii tanu, Joab ii nu Zaruiah ii suapuinu Abigail ahi hi.)"},"26":{"text":"Absalom le a mite in Gilead ngam ah ngiaphual saat uh hi."},"27":{"text":"David sia Mahanaim hong thet ciang Ammon ngam Rabbah khuapi pan Nahash ii tapa Shobi, Lodebar pan Ammiel ii tapa Machir le Gilead ngam Rogelim pan Barzillai te in muak uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in meekuangte, tungbealte, zanpuan, tuaciang an zongh David le a mite atu in hong puak hi; zungtaang, mangtaang, anvui, antang kan, benaang, be, khuaitui, noaikhal, noaidiat le tuu pawlkhat hong puak uh hi. Amate in David le a mite dui sungah a toi tu, ngilkial dangtaak in a om tu hunlam he uh hi.","merge":"29"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa David in a mite theampo khawmtua in, tulkhat pawl, zakhat pawl ci in khen a, a uk tu uliante koi hi.","title":"Absalom sia Ngallel in Kithatlum"},"2":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in tuate pawl thum in kuansak a, Joab le a suapuipa Abishai, Gath pan Ittai te thum in tua pawlte khat tek uksak hi. Tuaciang kumpipa in, “Keima zongh no taw kuankhawm tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in, “Ko taw hong kuankhawm ngawl tu ni hi. Ei a taanglai teng kiheak in ih tai ahizong, ei a lang ma hong kithat ahizong ih ngalte atu bangma kilamdanna om ngawl tu hi; ahihang nang na hile ko tulsawm taw na man neina kikim hi. Hi lai khuapi sungah om in huna hong puak lete phazaw tu hi,” ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Pha na sakbel uh bangin ngamta tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi. Tuasia zawkciang a ngalkapte tulkhat pawl, zakhat pawl, a pawl a pawl in a kuan ciangin, David sia kongpi hui ah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Joab, Abishai le Ittai te munah thupia a, “Keima nong ngaisutna in, tangvalpa Absalom bangma na law heak vun,” ci hi. Ngalkap mite theampo in David ii a uliante tungah hi a thupiakna sia za kim uh hi."},"6":{"text":"David ii ngalkaphonpi sia ngamsung theampo ah hong kuanin, Ephraim duisung ah Israel te sim uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel te in David ii mite lel uh hi; tua ni in nasia lel mama uh a, tulkul kithatlum uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngamsung bup ah kidona hong kilaw a, duisung ah a thi sia ngalphual ah a kithat sangin tamzaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Thakhat thu in Absalom in David ii mite taw kisi uh hi. Absalom sia laa tungah to in, a laa sia oak thingkung lian nuai khat ah a pai laitak thingbaak kawm ah, Absalom ii lutang awk hi."},"10":{"text":"David ii mite khat in ama mu a, Joab tungah, “Topa awng, Absalom sia oak thingkung tungah a kaai ka mu hi,” ci in ko hi."},"11":{"text":"Joab in, “Mu na hi le banghangin a munah thatlum paih ngawl ni ziam? Keima mama in ngunn tang sawm le kawngkhau khat hong pia zawsap tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahihang tua pa in, “Ngunn tang tulkhat keak nong pia hial zong kumpi pa tapa tungah ka khutme khat zongh laamto ngawl tu khi hi. Kumpipa in nang le Abishai, Ittai tungah, ‘Keima nong ngaisutna in khangno pa Absalom sia bangma na law heak vun’ ci in thu hong piak sia za tek khu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang kumpipa thupiak mang ngawlin Absalom that hi leng, kumpipa in za nanak tu hi — ama in thu theampo za hi — tuaciang nangma in kei hong hung ngawl tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Joab in “Nang taw hun sauzaw bosak thawthong nawn bua tong,” ci hi. Joab in tei thum la in, oak thing tung a kikhai a nungta lai Absalom ii awm hol hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang Joab ngalkap sawm in Absalom hong neak in, thatlum vet uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ngal kido tawlngak natu in Joab in lemle tum natu thupia a, a ngalkapte Israel te a delna uh pan heak kik uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in Absalom ii luang la in duisung dum thuk khat sungah a lotsuk zawk uh ciang suangtum honpui khat taw siin uh hi. Israel te theampo taimang in a inn tek zuan uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Absalom in a nuntak lai in, a min kilaw natu tapa nei ngawl ahikom, Kumpipa Kuam a kicina munah ama atu in khansuang vawt in phut hi. Tua bangin ama min ma kivaw a, tuni dong ciang Absalom ii Khan kici lai hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Zadok ii tapa Ahimaaz in Joab munah, “ Topa in a ngalte khut sung pan ama a hutna thupha kumpipa tungah son tu in hong taisak ta'n,” ci hi.","title":"Absalom ii Thina David munah Kison"},"20":{"text":"Joab in, “Hi ngawl hi, tuni in thupha bangma puak ngawl tu ni hi. Nidang khat pawpo ciang na uuk le hi thei hi, ahihang tuni in puak ngawl tu ni hi, banghang ziam ci le kumpipa ii tapa thi hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Ethiopia a sila pa tungah, “Pai in, na mu teng kumpipa tungah son ta'n,” ci hi. Sila pa sia kun a tai paih hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahimaaz in, “Bang thu po piang kale awlmaw bong; nong hesuakna in tua thu zong keima hong puaksak po ta'n,” ci veve hi. Joab in, “Ka tapa awng, bang tu ci kenkon ni ziam? Tua atu in letsong bangma nga beak ngawl tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"“Bangpo a piang zong pai nuam khi hi,” Ahimaaz in ci kik hi. Joab in, “Tua ahile va pai ta'n,” ci hi. Ahimaaz zongh lam ah hong taisuk in, Jordan Kuam kaantan a, hai ngawlin silapa suangkhial hi."},"24":{"text":"David sia khuapi kongpi puanung le sungnung kilaklaw mun awngna ah to hi. Ngal vilpa sia khuapi uumna luphung vuum tungah kaato a, kongpi ii tung innkhum tungah ding hi; ama in khua a et le pasal khat ama nguakin hong tai mu hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in oksan suk a kumpipa munah son hi, tuaciang kumpipa in, “Ama nguak ahile thupha hong puak hi tu hi,” ci hi. A tai pa sia hong nai vaial hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaciang ngalvil pa in pasal dang khat ma ama nguakin hong tai mu leleau a, kongkhapi cing pa oksan suk hi. “En in! Zia sungah pasal dang khat ma hong tai hi!” ci hi. Kumpipa in, “Hisia zongh in thupha hong puak hi” ci in zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Ngalvil pa in, “A masa a hong tai sia Ahimaaz ii tai bangin tai hi,” ci hi. Kumpipa in, “Ama mihing pha khat hi a, thupha hong puak hi,” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahimaaz in kumpipa nuksetna kam pau in ama mai lei ah kisepsuk hi, tuaciang, “Kumpipa awng Topa na Pathian pok in, ama in na lang pan hong leedo mite hong zosak hi!” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tangvalpa Absalom a suakta ziam?” ci in kumpipa in dongh hi. Ahimaaz in, “Topa awng, na ulianpa Joab in kei hong paisak lai in a buai lialua khat ka mu a, bang ziam ci in ka son thei bua hi,” ci in zo hi."},"30":{"text":"“Zia lai ah ding in,” kumpipa in ci a; tuaciang ama tua munah ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Ethiopia silapa hong theng a, kumpipa munah, “Kumpipa awng, nang atu thupha khat hong puak khi hi! Tuni in Topa in nang hong leedo te theampo hong zosak hi,” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"“Tangvalpa Absalom a suak ta na ziam?” ci in kumpipa in dongh hi. Sila pa in, “Ama thuak sia na ngalte theampo le, tuaciang nang hong leedo theampo in thuak le ka oai hi,” ci in zo hi."},"33":{"text":"Kumpipa khuangai mama hi. Kongpi suazoai tung inndoi sungah kaato in kap hi. A pai kawkawmin, “Aw, ka tapa! Ka tapa Absalom! Absalom ka ta awng! Nang ka tapa ii thi luangin kei thi zaw leng maw! Absalom ka tapa!” ci in au hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa David sia Absalom hu in khuangai a, kakap hi ci in Joab tungah kison hi.","title":"Joab in David Teih"},"2":{"text":"Tuabangin ngalzawna lungdamna sia tua ni in David ii a ngalkapte atu in heena hong suak hi, banghang ziam cile a tapa thi hu in kumpipa a tauna teng amate in za hi."},"3":{"text":"Ngal kisimna phual panin a tai a maizum ngalkapte bangin, amate sia khuapi sungah thim takin hong tum kik uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in a mai hum in nging takin, “Aw ka tapa! Ka tapa Absalom! Absalom ka tapa!” ci in kap hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa ii inn ah Joab pai in ama munah, “Tuni in na mite — nang le na tapate na tanute, na zite le na zinote nuntakna hong huu mite maimawlsak ni hi."},"6":{"text":"Nang hong it teng na langpan a, nang hong ensan teng na panpui hi. Na uliante le na mite sia bangma in hong heang ngawl na hi sia kitelthiangsak zo ni hi. Tuni in Absalom nungta hen a, ko teng theampo thi zaw le ung na lungdam zaw phial tu in hong mu khi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu in va pai ta'n a, na mite lungmuangsak kik ta'n. Topa min lo in ka kiciamna pan, tuabangin nong vawt buale zingsang ciangin amate sung pan khat zongh in nang hong koppui nawn ngawl tu hi. Tuasia in na khan tawntung tuasiatna nasia belh na thuak hi tu hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuasia ciang kumpipa kikhuangkho a, hong pai in khuapi kongpi hui ah to hi. A mite in ama sia tualai ah a om hunlam a zaak uh ciangin ama kiim ah hong kikaikhawm uh hi. Tua hun sungin Israel te theampo tai in amate inn tek zuan uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngam buppi sungah amate le amate hong kihau uh hi. “Kumpipa David in ih ngalte khut sung panin hong suatak hi,” khat le khat kici uh hi. “Ama in Philistine te khut sung panin hong suatak a, ahihang ama sia tu in Absalom kung pan tai in ngam nusia zo hi.","title":"David Jerusalem zuan kik"},"10":{"text":"Absalom sia ih kumpipa tu in sathau ih noai hi, ahihang ama ngalphual ah kithat hi. Tua ahiciang banghangin khat po in Kumpipa David ciapui kik tu hanciam ngawl ziam?” ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel te ii pauna teng David kungah kison hi. Tua ahikom thiampi Zadok le Abiathar te Judah lampuite a dongh tu in samsak hi. Ama in, “A kumpi inn sungah kumpipa a cia kik natu a hute sung pan banghangin note a hu khakbel hi tu nu ziam?"},"12":{"text":"No sia ka mealheakte nu hi, ka chi le ka sa nu hi; banghangin ka cia kik natu hong hu khakbel te hi nu ziam?” ci in donghsak hi."},"13":{"text":"David in Amasa tungah hi bangin cisak si hi, “Nang ka mealheak ni hi. Tu pan kipan Joab taangin ka ngalkaphonpi ukpa in hong koi khi hi. Tuabangin ka vawt buale Pathian in hong vaatlum tahen!” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"David kammalte in Judah mite theampo ii thumaan takin a panpuina a cingin piangsak a, amate in ama le a uliante hong heak kik natu kam thaak hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa hong cia kik lamin Judah mite in Jordan ngun ah muak in, a ngun kan na ah a cing tu in Gilgal ah amate hong pai ahi uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hun ma in, Bahurim pan Gera ii tapa, Benjaminte Shimei zongh Jordan ah Kumpipa David taw kisi tu in manlang in hong pai hi.","ref":"2 Sa 16:5-13"},"17":{"text":"Ama in Benjamin namte tulkhat tonpui hi. Tuaciang Saul ii innkuan naseampa Ziba zongh a tapa sawm le nga le a naseam kul taw hong pai in, kumpipa thet ma in Jordan theng hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa le a pawlte ngun a kan laitak a cing tu le kumpipa ii dei babangin a seam tu in amate ngun hong kan uh hi. Kumpipa ii ngun kaantan tu a kithoai laitak Shimei hong pai in ama mai ah hong kilei see suk a,"},"19":{"text":"“Kumpipa awng, nong hesuakna in Jerusalem na nusiat ni in nang tungah ka ngamtat khialna teng hong makngilsak ta'n. Tuasia taw kei hong langpan heak in a, thinngil laingil ah na paai heak in.","title":"Shimei tungah David in Cikna Thiamna lak"},"20":{"text":"Topa awng mawna vawt zo ka hi hunlam kihe khi hi, tuaciang tua hu ma in saksang namte sung pan tuni in kumpipa taw kisi tu in hong pai phitbel pa khi hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Zeruiah ii tapa Abishai hong pau a: “Shimei sia thalup tu hi, banghang ziam cile Topa ii kumpi tu in a teal pa haamsiat hi,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahizong David in Abishai le a suapuipa Joab munah, “A kua in no ngaisutna hong ngen ziam? Ngim hong pia tu nu ziam? Tu in kei Israel ii kumpipa hi zo khi hi, tuaciang tu ni in Israel te kuama kithatlum ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaciang Shimei munah, “Nang hong kithatlum ngawl tu hi ci in kamciam hong pia khi hi,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Saul ii tupa Mephibosheth sia David taw kisi tu in hong pai hi. Ama in kumpipa ii Jerusalem a nusiat hun pan ngalzo a hong cia kik dong, a peang le sil ngawl, a khamul le meet ngawl, a puan le sawp ngawlin omcip hi.","title":"Mephibosheth tungah David in Cikna Lak","ref":"2 Sa 9:1-13; 16:1-4"},"25":{"text":"Kumpipa taw kimu tu in Jerusalem ah Mephibosheth hong thet ciangin, kumpipa in, “Mephibosheth awng, nang kei taw hong paikhawm ngawl ni hi. Banghang ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in, “Kumpipa awng, na heaksa bangma, kei sia ka peang zaw hi. Ka naseampa munah ka laa a kungh hong thuasak ta'n, kumpipa taw tonkhawm nuam khi hi, ka ci hang ama in kei hong leeheak hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in kei huvau Kumpipa nangma tungah leilot hi, ahihang nang sia Pathian ii vantunglalang taw na kibang hi, tua ahikom maan na sak bangin ngamta in."},"28":{"text":"Ka pa ii innkuanpuite theampo kumpipa ii na thisak sia ahi tu ma hi, ahihang nangma in na sabuai ah an ka neak thei natu thu hong pia ni hi. Kumpipa tung pan hamphatna dang kong nget thuathua lai natu thu om ngawl hi,” ci in zo hi."},"29":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Bangma son thua kul nawn bo. Nang le Ziba in Saul ii ngamh teng na hawm natu khensat zo khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"30":{"text":"“Ziba in tang siat tahen. Kumpipa nangma ciidam in inn nong cia kik sia kei atu pha zo hi,” ci in Mephibosheth in zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Gilead pan Barzillai zongh kumpipa ii Jordan a kan ciang a cing tu in Rogelim pan hong paisuk hi.","title":"David in Barzillai tungah Cikna Thiamna Lak","ref":"2 Sa 17:27-29"},"32":{"text":"Barzillai sia kum sawmliat a pha pasal huai mama khat ahi hi. Ama hau mama a, Mahanaim ah a taam sung kumpipa anvaak hi."},"33":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama tungah, “Kei taw Jerusalem ah ih paikhawm tu a, nang kong en tu hi,” ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahihang Barzillai in, “Kei sia ngei nungta nawn ngawl tu khi hi, banghangin kumpipa taw Jerusalem ah pai tu khi ziam?"},"35":{"text":"Kei kum sawmliat pha zo a, bangma in nopsak hong pia nawn ngawl hi. Ka neak ka dawnte ii limna le he nawn ngawl, lasa te ii aw le za thei nawn ngawl khi hi. Kumpipa nang atu vanh ngitpi khat suak bek tu khi hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuabang tel lian a saang tu in kiphu nawn ngawl khi hi. Tua ahikom Jordan ngal khat tawm khawng dong hong pai lai bek tu khi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua zawkciang hong ciasak ta'n a, ka nute ka pate ii thaan hui ka inn ah thi ka tong. Hi munah ka tapa Chimham om hi, ama in nangma na hong sepsak tu hi; ama nangma paipui in, kumpipa awng, nangma ii pha na sakbel bangin ama atu vawtsak ta'n,” ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Ama paipui tu khi hi, tuaciang vawt a na oai babangin ama tungah ka vawt tu hi. Tuaciang nong nget pawpo nang atu in hong vawtsak tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David le a mite theampo in Jordan ngun kan uh hi. Ama in Barzillai namh in, thupha pia a, tuaciang inn ah Barzillai cia kik hi."},"40":{"text":"Judah mi theampo le Israel mi teng ii a lang in kumpipa cing in ngun a kan zawkciang, ama Gilgal ah paitan a. Chimham sia ama taw paikhawm hi.","title":"Judah le Israel in Kumpipa vai Kam kinial"},"41":{"text":"Tuaciang Israel te a om theampo kumpipa kungah pai in, ama munah, “Kumpipa awng, koma suapui Judah mite in nang hong la khe a, nangma, na innkuanpuite le na mite ii Jordan na kan uh ciang hong cin natu banghangin thu nei kisa ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Judah mite in, “Banghangin tuabang ngamta khu ziam cile kumpipa sia koma mi khat hi. Tua ahikom banghangin hisia hu in thin uuk thei nu ziam? Ama in ka an neak tu uh la hong leisak bo, a dang zongh bangma piak hong nei ngawl hi,” ci in zo uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Israel te in, “Ama sia noma mi khat hikale David kumpipa tungtaang ah no sangin koma in see sawm bang a tamzaw in thu nei khu hi. Banghangin hong no mu nu ziam? Kumpipa ciapui kik natu kam a nging phitsak sia koma khu hi, mangil heak vun,” ci in zo kik hi. Ahihang Judah mite ii a cite sia Israel mite kampauna sangin nasia zaw in khalh zaw hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gilgal ah Benjamin mi Bikri ii tapa Sheba a kici mihing mannung ngawl khat om hi. Ama in lemle tumin au a, “David taak hen! Ei ama zui ngawl tu hi hing! Israel pasalte awng inn ah cia tawng!” ci hi.","title":"Sheba ii Leedona","ref":"1 Kum 12:16; 2 Khang 10:16"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom Israel te in David nusia in Sheba zui ahihang Judah mite sia thumaan top in, Jordan pan Jerusalem ah David zui uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem khua a kumpi inn ah David a thet ciangin kumpi inn cing tu in ama nusiat zino sawm teng la in, a cingte ii khutnuai ah koi hi. Amate ii taangsapna babangin sik hi, ahihang amate taw nupa vai in omkhawm ngawl hi. A nuntak lai teng kikhumcip in meingong bangin nungta hi.","ref":"2 Sa 16:22"},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in Amasa munah, “Judah mite khawmtua in, thai ciangin amate taw hi lai ah hong heak kik tavun,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Amasa in amate khawmtua tu in pai hi, ahihang kumpipa hunciam lapin a theng kik bua hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom kumpipa in Abishai munah, “Absalom sangin Sheba in ngim hong pia zaw tu hi. Ka mite la in a, ama del in, tua ahibuale kulh taw a ki uum khua pawlkhat hong la tha tu a, ei kung pan suakta tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom Joab ii mite, kumpi cingte le ngalkap dang teng in Abishai taw Jerusalem nusia in Sheba del uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate suangpi khat sia omna Gibeon a thet uh ciang Amasa taw kisi uh hi. Joab sia ngalsim natu puansilh in, a namsau sia a paai taw a kawngkhau tungah khit hi. Ama mai sangah a pai laitak a namsau taaksua hi."},"9":{"text":"Joab in Amasa munah, “Bang na ci ziam, ka lawmpa awng,” ci in, ama namh tu bangin a khut ziatsang taw a khamul len hi."},"10":{"text":"Amasa sia Joab ii a khut langkhat ah a toai namsau sia pan kidal ngawl ahikom Joab in a ngil panin sun a, a ngilzang teng lei ah keekeak hi. Ama thakhatin thi paih a, Joab ii a sat kik kul ngawl hi. Tuaciang Joab le a suapui pa Abishai in Sheba del uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Joab ii mi khat Amasa ii luang hui ah ding a, “Joab le David mi ahi theampo in Joab nung zui vun!” ci in au hi."},"12":{"text":"Chi taw a kidim Amasa ii luang sia lampi laizang ah liik hi. Joab ii mihing pa in, a kuama theampo in tawlnga in a et thong uh bek a mu ciang, ama in a luang sia lampi pan lo sungah kai in, puanvan taw siin hi."},"13":{"text":"A luang lampi pan a khiin zawkciang a kuama po in Joab zui in Sheba del uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Sheba in Israel nam theampo ii ngam kaantan in, Abel Beth Maacah khuapi ah pai hi, tuaciang Bikri ii bee le phungte hong kikhawm a, khuapi sungah ama nung zui uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Joab ii mite in Sheba sia tua munah a om hunlam za uh ahikom amate pai in khuapi uumci uh hi. Luphung puanung pangh panin lei vum tosak a, a luphung cip thei natu in a nuai pan zong lei to hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua khuapi sungah nupi ciim khat om a, tua nu in luphung panin au a, “Na ngai vun! Na ngai vun! Joab hi sungah hong pai natu in na son vun; ama taw thu son nuam khi hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Joab pai a, tuaciang tua nu in, “Nang Joab na hi ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ama in, “Hi hi, keima khi hi,” ci in zo hi. Tua nu in “Topa awng hong ngai ta'n,” ci hi. Ama in, “Hong ngai tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua nu in, “Nidang tawngh lai in, ‘Abel khuapi ah pai in a, hong zo kikna ngai in’ — kici a, tuabang ma in kingamta hi."},"19":{"text":"Ko khuapi sia lian a, Israel ngam ah kilemna a om bel, a thumaanbel khuapi khat ahi hi. Banghangin tuasia suksiat tu hanciam ni ziam? Pathian ii neisa sia zaanciimsak nuam ni ziam?” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Joab in, “Hi ngei ngawl tu khi hi! Na khuapi sia bangma hunin zaanciimsak, ahibuale hong suksiatsak ngeingawl tu khi hi!"},"21":{"text":"Tuabang sia ko ngealna hi ngawl hi. Ephraim mualtung ngam pan Bikri ii tapa Sheba a ci sia in Kumpipa David langpanin leedo hi. Hi sia pa hong aap lete, khuapi pan nungkin tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi. “Ama lutang sia luphung tung kan in no kungah kong lawn tu hi,” tua nu in ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama tua khua mite kungah ama ii ngealna taw pai hi, amate in Sheba ii lu tan in, luphung kaantan in Joab kungah lawn uh hi. Ama in a mite khuapi a nusiat natu in lemle tum a, amate inn ah ciakik uh hi. Taciang Jerusalem kumpipa kungah Joab heak kik hi."},"23":{"text":"Joab sia Israel ngalkaphonpi ukpa hi; Jehoiada ii tapa Benaiah sia David a cingte a ukpa hi;","title":"David ii Uliante"},"24":{"text":"Adoniram in zawthawk thu taw kisawlin na a sepsakna teng uk a; Ahilud ii tapa Jehoshaphat in tepteena lai teng sai hi;"},"25":{"text":"Sheva sia kumpi zum thuzeakpa ahi hi; Zadok le Abiathar te sia thiampi te ahi uh hi,"},"26":{"text":"Tuaciang Jair khua pan Ira zongh David ii thiampi khat ahi hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David ii kumpi in a maan hunsungin kum thum sitset kialpi nasia khat tung hi. Tua hi a, David in Topa munah tuasia thu a dok ciang, Topa in, “Saul le a bangkua in mihing that mawna vawt hi; ama in Gibeon mite thatlum hi,” ci hi.","title":"Saul ii Suan le Paalte Kithatlum"},"2":{"text":"(Gibeon mite sia Israel mi hi ngawl a; amate sia, Israel te in hut tu dal tu in kamciam a piaksa Amor mi pawlkhat hi napi, Israel mite in Judah mite atu a deisak leilam manin Saul in tuate mot tu in hanciam hi.)","ref":"Jos 9:3-15"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom David in Gibeon mite samsak a, “No atu bang hong vawtsak thei tu khi ziam? Topa ii mite tungah thupha na piak natu in no tungah hong tatkhialna te hong lul kik nuam khi hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in, “Saul le a bangkua taw ka kihauna uh sia ngunn le khamh taw thu kisaatsat thei ngawl bek dom ngawlin Israel mite khat zongh thatlum nuam ngawl khu hi,” ci in zo hi. David in, “Tua ahile no atu in kei bang hong vawtsak tu ci in na ngaisun uh ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in, “Saul in ko sia hong maaimot nuam hi, tuaciang Israel ngamsung koima ah khat zongh a nungta in hong koi nuam ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom Saul ii suan le paal pasal sali hong aap tavun, Topa ii kumpi tu a teal Saul ii khua Gibeah ah amate sia Topa mai ah ka awksak tu uh hi,” ci in zo uh hi. Kumpipa in, “Amate hong aap tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahihang Jonathan taw a thiangtho kamciamna a piak hu in, David in Saul ii tupa, Jonathan ii tapa, Mephibosheth khoaikhe hi.","ref":"1 Sa 20:15-17; 2 Sa 9:1-7"},"8":{"text":"Ahihang ama in Aiah ii tanu Rizpah ii Saul taw a hin tapate nii, Armoni le Mephibosheth la hi; ama in Saul ii tanu Merab le Meholah pan Barzillai ii tapa Adriel taw a hin tapa nga teng zongh la hi.","ref":"1 Sa 18:19"},"9":{"text":"David in amate teng Gibeon mite tungah aap a, tuate in Topa mai mual tungah awklumsak uh hi — tuaciang a sali ma in thi khawm uh hi. Tua a thi hun sia phalbi bo kuan hi a, mangtaang at a kipatsawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaciangin Saul ii zino, Aiah tanu Rizpah sia mithiluangte kisialna suangpi tungah khau-ip buk vawtin anlaak kipat pan kipan tangngam ngua a zuk dong om hi. Ama in sun in mithiluangte a ne tu vacimte hung a, zanin ngamsate neak tu pan dal hi."},"11":{"text":"David in Rizpah ii ngamtatna a zaak ciangin,"},"12":{"text":"ama pai a, Gilead ngam Jabesh mite kung panin Saul le a tapa Jonathan ii ngu la hi. (Amate in Gilboa mualvum tung a Saul a kithalup ni in Philistine te ii a luang a khaina Beth Shan taangpi khawlmun panin ngu uh hi.)","ref":"1 Sa 31:8-13"},"13":{"text":"David in Saul le Jonathan ii ngute le a ki awklumsak pasal sali teng ii ngute zongh khawmtua hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate in kumpipa sawl babangin, Saul le Jonathan ii ngute Benjamin ngamsung Zela khua, Saul ii pa Kish ii thaan sungah phum uh hi. Tuasia zawkciang amate ngam atu a thungetna teng Pathian in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Philistine te le Israel te ngal kisimna khat om kik a, David le a mite pai in Philistine te do uh hi. Kido hun sung khat ah David toi zo ta hi.","title":"Philistine Thatanglian mamate taw Ngal kisimna (1 Khangtaanghthu 20:4-8)"},"16":{"text":"Thatang lian mama Ishbibenob a kici khat sia taau taw a kivawt kilogramme thum le lang a ngit teipi khat toai in, namsau thak khat kua a, David that thei tu in ki um hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahihang Zeruiah ii tapa Abishai in David hu a, thatang lianpa simin thatlum hi. Tua zawkciang David ii mite in David peuma amate taw ngalsim khawm tu in a kuan kik nawn ngawl natu in kamciam piasak hi. Amate in, “Nang sia Israel te ii lam etna ni hi, nang hong taan nuam ngawl khu hi,” ci uh hi.","ref":"1 Kum 11:36; Ps 132:17"},"18":{"text":"Hisia zawkciang Gob ah Philistine te taw kidona khat om kik a, Hushah pan Sibbecai in Saph a kici thatang lian mama khat thatlum hi."},"19":{"text":"Gob ma ah Philistine te taw kidona khat om a, Bethlehem pan Jair ii tapa Elhanan in Gath mi Goliath that hi, ama ii teibul sia thiamtakte ii thiambanna pumlawng cia pha hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaciang Gath ah ngal kidona dang khat om a, tua munah thatang lian mama ngal sim uuk mama khat om hi. Ama in a khutte ah khutme luk veve le a peangte ah peangme luk veve nei hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in Israel te nalh hi, tuaciang David ii suapuipa Shammah ii tapa Jonathan in ama thatlum hi."},"22":{"text":"Hi mihing li teng sia Gath mi thatang lian te suan vive hi a, David le a mite in thatlum uh hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in David sia Saul le a ngal dangte kung panin a hutkhiat ciangin David in Topa tungah hi la a sak hi.","title":"David ii Ngalzawna La (Psalm 18)"},"2":{"text":"Topa in kei hong dal pa hi; ama sia ka kulh kho ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka Pathian sia ka kidalna hi a, tuaciangin ama hangin kei ka ngammuang hi. Ama in lum bangin kei hong sung hi; ama in kei hong hung a, kei hong keamcing hi. Ama in ka ngumpa hi; Ama in a ngoltolte kung panin kei hong dalin hong hun hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa ka biakpui a, ama in ka ngalte kung panin hong hun hi. Topa pok vun!"},"5":{"text":"Thina tuihualte ka kiim theampo ah om a; lalna tuihualte kei tungah hong kihual hi."},"6":{"text":"Thina ii lau huaina ka kiim ah hong om a, tuaciang thaankuul in kei thaang hong sia hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngim ka nga ciangin Topa ka biakpui a; ka Pathian munah hu ka ngen hi. A biakinn sung pan ka aw hong za a; hu ngen in ka auna aw ama in hong ngai hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua zawkciang leitung sia liingin ngawk a; van ii a bul a zungte kivei in liing hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian a thin uuk hi!"},"9":{"text":"A naak hawng panin meikhu hong pusuak a, a kam sung pan a kaanghtumsak thei meikuang le meikam leang hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in vantung balkeakin hong pai suk a, a peang nuai ah meeivom kaai hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in cherub tha tungah to in manlang takin leang a; vui ii thakhui te tungah khualhaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama le ama khuazing taw kituam a; tui taw kidim meeikaai saate in ama kiim uum hi;"},"13":{"text":"khualeng in meikamte ama mai ah kuangsak hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in van pan vanto nging bang hisak a, Vaanglianbelpa Pathian ii aw kiza hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in a thaltangte kap a, a ngalte kithethaangsak hi; khualeng kuang taw amate taisak hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in a ngalte a teih ciang le a thin uukin a hawksan ciangin, Tuipi ii tawdap kihawk a, leitung ii tawdap kilawt hi"},"17":{"text":"Topa in tungsang panin hong baan suk a, kei hong len hi; ama in tuithukna panin kei hong kaito hi."},"18":{"text":"A thahat ka ngalte kung pan ahizong kei hong ensan theampo te kung pan ahizong hong suatak hi — kei atu in amate hat leih uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ngim ka nga ciang, amate in kei hong sim a, ahizong Topa in kei hong dal hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in launa pan hong hu a; kei tungah hong lungkim hu in kei hong hun hi."},"21":{"text":"A maan bang ngamta ka hikom Topa in kei, tel hong pia hi; paubaang ngawl ka hikom ama in thupha hong pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa thukham ka ni a; ka Pathian kung pan ka puapial bua hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama ii thukham theampo ka tang a; a thupiakte ni ngawlin ka om bua hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in ka maw ngawl hunlam hong he a, a maan ngawl ngamtatnate pan ka kikep hong he hi."},"25":{"text":"A maan bang ngamta ka hikom ama in tel hong pia hi, banghang ziam cile paubaang ngawl ka hi hong he hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa awng, nang tungah hong thumaante tungah na thumaan a, a cialcingte tungah na phatna kicing hi."},"27":{"text":"Nangma in a thiangtho te ii tungah na thiangtho a, ahizong a seksolte na ngal vawt hi."},"28":{"text":"A kiniamkhiakte na ngum a, ahizong a kiphasakte na kiniamkhiaksak hi."},"29":{"text":"Nangma, Topa , ka khuavak na hi hi; ka khuazing na nilkeak hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka ngalte ka sim natu in thahatna nong pia a, amate kihuuknate ka zaw zawk natu in vaangletna nong pia hi."},"31":{"text":"Hi Pathian — bangza in ama nasepnate cialcing a, ama kammalte suan taak ziam! Ama hong dalna a zong theampo atu in ama in lum khat taw kibang hi."},"32":{"text":"Topa bekma Pathian hi a; Pathian bekma ih kihuukna ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Hi Pathian in a kip a kho ka bukna hi; Ama in ka lampi ngammuangsak hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in ka peangte sangai bangin kho takin hong khuasuansak a; mualte tungah kei hong keamcing hi.","ref":"Hab 3:19"},"35":{"text":"Ama in ngal kisim hong sinsak a, tuasia ciang thalkawng a khobel zongh ka zangh thei hi."},"36":{"text":"Oh, Topa, nangma in nong dal a, nong hun hi; nong huna in keima hong thupisak hi."},"37":{"text":"Hong kimat natu panin nong keam a, bangma hunin ka puk ngei bua hi."},"38":{"text":"Ka ngalte ka del a ka zo hi; amate ka mot mateng ka tawp bua hi."},"39":{"text":"Amate ka vaat vawk a, a thoto zo bua uh hi; amate ka mai ah ngallel in puk uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Ngal do natu in thahatna nong pia a; ka ngalte nong zosak hi."},"41":{"text":"Ka ngalte ka kung panin na taisak a; kei hong ensan te ka mon hi."},"42":{"text":"Amate in huna zong ka le kuama in hun ngawl hi; amate in Topa biakpui hikale ama in zo ngawl hi."},"43":{"text":"Amate ka sucip a, leivui bang suak uh hi; lampi ah a om buan bangin amate ka tuanhcil hi."},"44":{"text":"Hong leedo ka mite kung pan nong hun a minamte ka ukna nong kipsak hi; tu in ka heak ngeingawl mihingte ka khutnuai mi suak uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Ngamdangmite ka mai ah hong kun a; amate in ka kammal a zaak ciang hong ni hi."},"46":{"text":"Amate a thin letna uh bosua in, a kulhte sung pan liing vadil in hong pai uh hi."},"47":{"text":"Topa nungta hi! Kei hong hunpa pok vun! Kei hong hun a thahat Pathian ii letna thangsak vun."},"48":{"text":"Ama in ka ngalte hong zosak hi! minamte ka khutnuai ah ama in huthe ngam ngawlin koi a;"},"49":{"text":"ka ngalte kung pan kei hong hun hi. Oh Topa , ka ngalte nong zosak a, a ngoltol mite kung panin nong dal hi."},"50":{"text":"Tua ahiciang minamte sungah nang kong pok a; na tungah pokna late kong sak hi.","ref":"Rom 15:9"},"51":{"text":"Pathian in a kumpipa tungah zawna liante pia hi; ama in a tealsa khat ii tungah itna kip lak a, David le a suan a paalte tungah itna kip a tawntungin lak hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesse ii tapa, David sia Pathian ii mi thupi tu in a vawt, Jacob te ii Pathian in kumpipa tu in a teal hi a, Israel atu in la hoite a phuakpa ahi hi. Hi teng sia David ii a khakbel a pau kammalte ahi hi:","title":"David ii Kammal Khakbelte"},"2":{"text":"Topa ii thaa in kei tungtawnin pau hi; ama ii thu puak sia ka muk tungah om hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel ii Pathian pau zo hi; Israel a dal pa in kei tungah hong ci hi: “Thutang khenna taw a uk kumpipa, Pathian thu ni in a uk pa sia,"},"4":{"text":"meeikaai om ngawl zing khuavak tuung nitaang taw kibang hi, ngua theau zawkciang lopate a teesak vasip ni taw kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian ii ka suan ka paalte thupha a piak tu zia sia tuabang ahi hi, banghang ziam cile ama in kei taw tawntung thuciamna khat hong vawt hi, a kipaltan ngawl tu thukimna khat, a kikheal ngeingawl tu kamciam piakna khat ahi hi. Kei dei sia tua teng lian ahi hi; tua in ka zawna hi tu a, Pathian in taangtungsak nanak tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian a selte sia, a kivawk lingte taw kibang hi; Kuama in khutnguak taw amate tham thei ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Thik vanhzak ahibuale tei khat na zak kul tu a; amate kaanghtum tu hi."},"8":{"text":"David ii a minthang ngalkapte sia hite ahi hi: a masa phitbel sia Tachemon pan Josheb Basshebeth hi a, ama sia “Thum teng” ii lampui pa ahi hi; ama in ngal kisimna khat sungah a teipi taw ngalte 800 do in thatlum siat hi.","title":"David ii Ngalkap Minthangte (1 Khangtaanghthu 11:10-41)"},"9":{"text":"A minthang thum sung pan a niina sia Ahoh phung sung pan Dodo ii tapa Eleazar hi. Ni khat ni in ama le David in ngaldo tu a kikhawmtua Philistine te thato uh hi. Israel te nungkin a,"},"10":{"text":"ahihang ama ding topin do in, a khut khikcip ahikom namsau tha thei nawn ngawl hi. Topa in tua ni in zawna lianpi nga hi. Ngal a zaw zawkciang Israel te Eleazar kungah heak kikin a thite ii ngaldalna teng suut uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A minthang thum sungah a thumna sia Harar pan Agee ii tapa Shammah hi. Philistine te sia be ciinna lo khat omna Lehi ah kikhawmtua uh hi. Israel te Philistine te mai panin tai keak uh a,"},"12":{"text":"ahizong Shammah ahile lo sungah a dinmun nusia ngawlin ngalnang a, Philistine te that hi. Topa in tua ni in zawna lianpi nga hi."},"13":{"text":"Anlaak hun kipat nai ciang, “Sawmthumte” sung pan thum sia David omna Adullam suanghawng sungah pai in, Philistine te ahile Rephaim Kuam ah ngiaphual saat uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin David sia ngalnanna tu in a ki uum mualtung khat ah om a, Philistine te pawlkhat in Bethlehem khua la uh hi."},"15":{"text":"David in inn sang ngai mama in, “Bethlehem kongpi hui tuikhuk panin ka dawn tu tui, mi khat po in hong paipui le paw uuk na peu ing!” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ngalkap minthang thumte in a pai natu Philistine te phual nawkkeak in, tuikhuk pan tui tawm a laak zawkciang David kungah paipui uh hi. Ahihang David in a dawn nuam bua hi; tua sangin Topa tungah piakkhiatna in lei ah sung zaw a,"},"17":{"text":"tuaciang, “ Topa awng, hi tui ka ne thei ngei buatu hi! A nuntakna a khaam mite ii chi a ne taw ka kibang tu hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom ama in tui a neak tu nial hi. Ngalkap minthang thumte ii ngalhan nasepnate tuabang ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Joab ii suapuipa Abishai (a nu sia Zeruiah hi) sia “A minthang Sawmthumte” ii lampui ahi hi. Ama in tei taw a ngalte zathum do a, that siat hi, tuabangin ama “Sawmthumte” sungah minthang hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama sia “Sawmthumte” sungah a minthangbel hi a, amate ii lampui hong suak hi, ahihang tua “Thumte” za in minthang ngawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Kabzeel pan Jehoiada ii tapa Benaiah sia ngalkap minthang dang khat hi; ama in ngalhang nasep lian tam mama a seamsa hi a, tuasung pan Moab ngalhang kiciante nii a thalup kihel hi. Vuuk taak ni khat in, dum khat sungah ama tuaksuk in tawpi khat thatlum hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in a thatang lian mama Egypt te tei toai khat that hi. Benaiah in a molpum taw Egypt pa sim a, a tei sutin tua taw that hi."},"22":{"text":"“Sawmthumte” sungah khat ahi Benaiah ii ngalhan nasepnate tuabang ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama sia “Sawmthumte” sung panin kician a, ahihang “Thum teng” za in minthang zo ngawl hi. David in ama a cingte ukpa in koi hi."},"24":{"text":"“Sawmthumte” sungah a kihel dang teng sia: Joab ii suapui Asahel, Bethlehem pan Dodo ii tapa Elhanan, Harod pan Shammah le Elika Pelet pan Helez Tekoa pan Ikkesh ii tapa Ira Anathoth pan Abiezer Hushah pan Mebunnai Ahoh pan Zalmon Netophah pan Maharai Netophah pan Baanah ii tapa Heleb Benjamin ngam Gibeah pan Ribai ii tapa Ittai Pirathon pan Benaiah Gaash ngamnai kuamte sung pan Hiddai Arabah pan Abialbon Bahurim pan Azmaveth Shaalbon pan Eliahba Jashen ii tapate Jonathan Harar pan Shammah Harar pan Sharar ii tapa Ahiam Maacah pan Ahasbai ii tapa Eliphelet Gilo pan Ahithophel ii tapa Eliam Carmel pan Hezro Arab pan Paarai Zobah pan Nathan ii tapa Igal Gad pan Bani Ammon pan Zelek Beeroth pan Naharai Joab ii ngaldalna puapa Jattir pan Ira le Gareb Hit mi Uriah, ahi uh hi. A vekpi in ngalkap minthang sawmthum le sali pha hi.","merge":"25"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa sia Israel te ii tungah khatvei ma thin uuk kik a, amate tungah David in ngim piasak hi. Topa in ama mun ah, “Va pai ta'n a, Israel te le Judah te mi phaza sim ta'n,” ci hi.","title":"David in Misimna Vawt (1 Khangtaanghthu 21:1-27)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom David in ngalkaphonpi ukpa Joab munah thupia hi: “Na uliante taw Israel nam theampo sung, ngam mong khat pan mong khat dong paitan a, mi phaza sim tavun. Bangza pha ziam he nuam khi hi.”"},"3":{"text":"Ahihang Joab in kumpipa munah, “Kumpipa awng, Topa na Pathian in Israel mite, tu a zaa sangin a zaa zakhat a tamzaw in hong pungsak tahen a, tuaciang tuabang a punsakna sia a mu tu in nangma hong nungtasak tahen. Ahihang, kumpipa awng banghang hisia vawt nuam ni ziam?” ci in zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang kumpipa in Joab le a uliante in a thu nisak a; amate in kumpipa omna nusia a, Israel mite a phakza sim tu in pai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in Jordan ngun kaantan a, Gad ngamkuam laizang a Aroer khuapi ii thang sangah ngiaphual saat uh hi. Tua mun panin amate in saksang Jazer ah,"},"6":{"text":"tua mun pan Hit te ngamsung Gilead le Kadesh ah pai uh hi. Tua zawkciang amate in Dan ah pai in, Dan pan nitumna sangah Sidon zuan uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua mun pan amate thangsang zuan a, kulh taw a ki uum Tyre khuapi, Hiv le Canaan te khuapi theampo, a khakbel in Judah ngam thangsang Beersheba ah pai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuabangin amate ngamsung buppi ah khualhaw uh a, tha kua le ni kul zawkciang Jerusalem ah heak kik uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in kumpipa tungah, ngalkap seam thei pasal sia: Israel ngam ah 800,000 om in, Judah ngam ah 500,000 om hi, ci in son uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang David in mi simna sazian a laaksak zawkciang ama kithasungin a thin hong ngim a, Topa munah, “Hi nasep ka sep sia maw mama khi hi! Nong hesuakna in hong maisak ta'n. Mawmawt nasep a seam hi thong khi hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in David ii kamsaang Gad munah, “David kungah pai in son ta'n, ama ii teal tu thu nam thum pia khi hi. Ama teal po vawt tu khi hi,” ci hi. A zing ciang zingsang, David ii thaw zawkciang,","merge":"12"},"13":{"text":"ama kungah Gad pai a, Topa ii sawl teng son hi, tuaciang ama in, “Koisia teal tu ni ziam? Na ngam sungah kum thum kialpi tungsak tu ni ziam, ahibuale na ngalte mai pan tha thum sung tai zaw tu ni ziam, tua ahibuale ni thum sung na ngam sungah natsia tungsak nuam zaw ni ziam? Tu in ngaisun ta'n a, Topa munah ka puak kik tu na zona hong son ta'n,” ci in dongh hi."},"14":{"text":"David in, “A heehuai mama dinmun ah om khi hi! Ahihang mihingte ii daan hong piak tu uuk ngawl khi hi.
