Topa khat bek ma ko daan hong pia tu pa hi hen, banghang ziam cile ama sia ngual hesuakna thin nei hi,” ci in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom tua ni zing pan kipan ama ii tealna hun a cin dong Topa in Israel tungah natsia tungsak hi. Ngam mong khat pan mong khat dong Israel mi tul sawmsali thi uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa ii vantunglalang in Jerusalem lalcipsak tu in a kipat ciangin Topa in mihingte daan a piak huvau a thin kheal kik a, amate a that vantunglalang munah, “Tawp in! Pha zo!” ci hi. Vantunglalang sia Jebus mi Araunah ii ancilna nai theng hi."},"17":{"text":"David in mite a that vantunglalang sia mu a, Topa munah, “A maw sia keima khi hi, a seam khialpa sia keima khi hi. Hi a khuangai huai mihingte in bang seam thong na ziam? Keima le ko innkuan daan nong piak tu hi zaw khu hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ma in Gad sia David kungah hong pai a, “Araunah ii ancilna munah va pai ta'n a, tua munah biaknatau khat Topa atu sa ta'n,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"David in Topa ii thupiak ni in Gad ii sawl bangin pai hi."},"20":{"text":"Araunah in a etsuk le kumpipa le a uliante ama kungah hong paito mu hi. Ama in David ii mai lei ah kisepsuk in,"},"21":{"text":"“Kumpipa awng, banghangin hi sungah hong om ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi. David in, “Na ancilna mun a lei tu le, natsiatna a thai natu in. Topa atu biaknatau khat sa tu hong pai khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tuasia la in, kumpipa awng, tuaciang Topa tungah na uuk babangin biakpiakna pia in. Hi sung biaknatau tungah na biakpiak natu in khuital te om hi, tuaciang hi munah khuite ii kanhakte le ancilna thingpheakte om hi, mei thu natu in zangh in,” Araunah in ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Araunah in kumpipa tungah a vekpi in pia siat hi, tuaciang ama munah, “ Topa na Pathian in na biakpiakna hong saang tahen,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahihang kumpipa in zo a, “Hi ngawl hi. Tuate ii man hong pia tu khi hi. Topa ka Pathian tungah keima ii man piak ngawlin ka nga sangaw biakpiaknate pia ngawl tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi. Ama in ancilna mun le khuitalte ngunntang 50 taw lei hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in Topa tungah biaknatau sa in, meihal biakpiakna le kipawlkhop biakpiakna pia hi. Topa in a thungetna saang a, Israel ngam sungah tua natna kamh hi."}}}}},"11":{"info":{"name":"Kumpite Khatna","shortname":"1Kgs","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa David sia tu in pasal huai mama khat hi a, a naseamte in puanvante thuapin silhsak hikale a khualum thei ngawl hi.","title":"Kumpipa David a Huai a teak Hun"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom a uliante in ama munah, “Kumpipa awng, nang taw om in hong ou tu numei khangmoi khat hong zonsak tu khu hi. Ama in nangma kungah lum tu a, na khua hong lumsak tu hi,” ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel ngam bup ah ngaknu mealpha khat kizong a, tuabang a mealpha Abishag a kici khat Shunem ah mu a, kumpipa kungah kipaipui hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama sia a mealpha mama a, kumpipa zongh ou hi, ahihang ama in nupa vai a nei pui bua hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu in Absalom a thi tak ciang David ii Haggith taw a tapa Adonijah sia a nungta lai te sung pan a tapa lianbel ahi hi. Ama sia a mealhoi mama mihing khat ahi hi. David in ama sia bangma hunin teih ngeingawl a, tuaciang ama zongh kumpipa suak nuam mama hi. Ama atu in siphu ngalleangte, siphu te le ama a cing mihing 50 koi hi.","title":"Adonijah in Kumpi tokhum Lua nuam","ref":"2 Sa 3:4","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Ama in Joab (A nu Zeruiah) le thiampi Abiathar taw thu kikum uh hi, tuaciang amate in ama panpui tu in lungkim uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang thiampi Zadok, Jehoiada ii tapa Benaiah, kamsaangpa Nathan, Shimei, Rei le David a cing te sia Adonijah sangah a pang bua uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Adonijah in Enrogel cik hui Ngul Suangpi a kicina munah tuute, khuitalte, khuino thaute taw sangaw biakpiakna khat nei hi. Ama in David kumpipa ii tapa dangte le Judah pan kumpipa ii uliante tua sangaw biakpiakna anneakpoai sungah sam hi,"},"10":{"text":"ahihang ama in a suapui sealh Solomon, kamsaangpa Nathan, Benaiah le kumpipa a cingpa sam ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Nathan in Solomon ii nu Bathsheba kungah pai in ama munah, “Haggith ii tapa Adonijah in ama le ama kumpipa a kisuasak hunlam za ngawl ni ziam? Tuaciang Kumpipa David in hi thu bangma he ngawl hi!","title":"Solomon Kumpipa in Kikoi","ref":"2 Sa 12:24"},"12":{"text":"Nangma le na tapa Solomon ii nuntakna na hu nuam le, ngaisutna hong pia khi hi,"},"13":{"text":"tu mama in Kumpipa David kungah pai in a, ‘Kumpipa awng, ciliap huai takin kei tungah kamciam nong piakna ah ka tapa Solomon in na kumpi za hong laih tu ci ka na ngawl ni ziam? Tua ahile Adonijah sia bangbangin kumpi suak thei ziam?’ ci in va dongh ta'n,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang Nathan in, “Tuasia ciang Kumpipa David taw na papau laitakin kei kong tum tu a, na thuson teng maan hi kong ci tu hi,” ci lai hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom Bathsheba in kumpipa lupna inndoi sungah ama taw kimu tu in pai hi. Ama huai mama zo a, Shunem panin Abishag in ou hi."},"16":{"text":"Bathsheba sia kumpipa mai ah a niamin hong kun a, tuaciang ama in, “Bang uuk ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in, “Kumpipa awng, Topa na Pathian ii min taw kei tungah ciliap huai takin kamciam nong piakna ah, nang zawkciang kumpi a suak tu sia ka tapa Solomon hi tu hi ci ni hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahihang Adonijah sia kumpipa suak zo a, tuaciang hi thu huvau nang bangma he ngawl ni hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in khuital tam ma, tuute, khuino thaute sangaw biakpiakna in pia a, ama in biakpiakna poai ah na tapate, thiampipa Abiathar, na ngalkaphonpi ukpa Joab sam hi, ahihang ama in na tapa Solomon sam ngawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Kumpipa awng, Israel mite theampo in na kumpi za hong laih tu sia na son tu hong ngak tek hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuabang na hi buale na thi pawpo ciang ka tapa Solomon le kei sia thumaan ngawlte a vawt bangin hong kivawt tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"22":{"text":"Bathsheba a papau laitakin, kumpipa inn sungah Nathan tum hi."},"23":{"text":"Nathan a om hunlam kumpipa tungah kison a, kamsaangpa Nathan sungtangin kumpipa mai ah kun hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in, “Kumpipa awng, Adonijah sia nang hong laih tu kumpipa ci in taangko zo ni ziam?"},"25":{"text":"Tu ni mama in ama pai a, khuital tam ma, tuu le khuino thaute sangaw biakpiakna in pia hi. Ama in na tapate theampo, na ngalkaphonpi ukpa Joab, tuaciang thiampipa Abiathar te sam a, tu in amate poai khaam in, ‘Kumpipa Adonijah a khansau tahen!” ci in au uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahihang ama in kei hong sam ngawl hi, topa awng, thiampipa Zadok ahizong, Benaiah ahizong, Solomon ahizong sam ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Hiteng sia kumpipa ii na thukim ma ziam, nang hong laih tu sia na uliante ngawngawn zongh na son ngawl ma ahi ziam?” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpipa David in, “Bathsheba hong tumsak kik tavun,” a ci ciang ama hong pai a, ama mai ah ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaciang ama munah, “Ka ngim nga na theampo pan hong suatakpa, a nungta Topa min taw nang tungah kamciam hong pia khi hi,"},"30":{"text":"tu ni in Topa Israel te ii Pathian min taw kamciam kong piak sia kholet tu khi hi, na tapa Solomon in keima kumpi za hong laih tu hi,” ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Bathsheba kunsuk in, “Ka topa kumpipa nungta tawntung tahen!” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua zawkciang David kumpipa in Zadok, Nathan le Benaiah samsak hi. Amate hong pai ciangin,"},"33":{"text":"ama in, “Ka zum uliante keng vun a; ka tapa Solomon sia ka laa tungah tosak in, Gihon cik ah tha suk tavun,"},"34":{"text":"tua munah Zadok le Nathan in Israel kumpipa tu in sathau noai tahen. Tua zawkciang lemle tum vun a, ‘Solomon kumpipa a khansau tahen!’ ci in au vun."},"35":{"text":"Ka kumpi tokhum tungah to tu in hi munah hong heak kik ciangin, a nung zui vun. Ama in ka kumpi za hong laih tu hi banghang ziam cile ama sia Israel le Judah uk tu in ka tealsa ahi hi,” ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Benaiah in, “Na dei bangin ka seam tu hi, tuaciangin Topa in hong kipsak tahen."},"37":{"text":"Topa in nang kumpipa hong ompui bangin Solomon taw zong hong omkhawm tahen, tuaciang ama ii kumpi maanna zongh nang sangin mainawt zaw lai tahen,” ci in zo hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ahikom Zadok, Nathan, Benaiah le kumpipa a cingte in Solomon sia Kumpipa David ii laa tungah suan in, Gihon cik ah tha uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Zadok in Topa ompuina puanbuk pan a paipui olive thau bung la in, Solomon sathau noai hi. Amate in lemle tum a, mipite theampo au in, “Kumpipa Solomon a khansau tahen!” ci uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate theampo in ama nungzui kik a, lungdam in a auna le tamngai a tumna hu in, lei liing khop dongin a aw uh nging hi."},"41":{"text":"Adonijah le a leangnate theampo a poai a man kuan ciang, tua awnging za uh hi. Tuaciang Joab in lemle aw a zaak ciang, “Khuapi sungah awnging sia bang khiakna nei ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"42":{"text":"A pau a man ma in thiampi Abiathar ii tapa Jonathan hong theng hi. Adonijah in, “Hong pai ta'n, nang pasal pha khat ni hi, thupha khat hong puak hi nanak tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Jonathan in, “Thupha hong puak ngawl khi hi,” ci in zo hi. “Kumpi ahi David kumpipa in Solomon sia kumpipa suaksak hi."},"44":{"text":"Ama in Zadok, Nathan, Benaiah le kumpipa cingte in thasak hi. Amate in kumpipa laa tungah Solomon tosak uh hi,"},"45":{"text":"tuaciang Zadok le Nathan in Gihon cik ah sathau noai in kumpi suaksak hi. Tua zawkciang amate lungdamna taw au kawmin khuapi sungah tum uh a, tuasia ciang tu in mipite ngamlum lialua uh hi. Tuasia, tu a na zaak uh awnging sia ahi hi."},"46":{"text":"Solomon sia tu in kumpipa suak zo hi."},"47":{"text":"Tua teng bek dom ngawlin kumpipa ii uliante pai a, Kumpipa David zatakna pia in, ‘Na Pathian in Solomon sia nang sang zongh in minthangsak zaw lai tahen, tuaciang Solomon kumpi maanna sia nang aa sangin nopci zaw lai tahen,’ ci uh hi. Tua zawkciang Kumpipa David in a lupna tungah kun in biakpiakna vawt a,"},"48":{"text":"tuaciang in thungen hi, ‘Ka suan ka paalte khat tuni in kei hong laih in kumpi a suasak sia a mu tu in hong nungtasak Israel ii Pathian Topa pok tek tawng,’ ” ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Adonijah ii leangnate lau in, a vekpi ding a, amate a sansak tek ah pai uh hi."},"50":{"text":"Adonijah in Solomon kiita mama ahikom Topa ii ompuina puanbuk sungah pai a, biaknatau kiil lenin om hi."},"51":{"text":"Adonijah in ama kiita ahikom biaknatau king lenin om a, ama in, “A masa phitbel in Kumpi Solomon in kei hong thalup ngawl natu kamciam hong pia le dei khi hi,” a ci teng Solomon tungah kison hi."},"52":{"text":"Solomon in, “Ama kei tungah hong thumaan po le a luzang samzam khat zongh kithutha ngawl tu hi; ahihang hong thumaan bua ahile thi tu hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"53":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, Solomon kumpipa in Adonijah sia biaknatau panin samsak hi. Adonijah hong pai in kumpipa ii mai ah kun suk a, tuaciang kumpipa in ama munah, “Nang cia thei ni hi,” ci hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in a thi tu nai ciang a tapa Solomon sam a, a khakbel hilna teng son hi:","title":"David ii Solomon tungah A khakbel A hilna"},"2":{"text":"“Ka thi tu hun hong theng zo hi. Kimuang in a, takkha in;"},"3":{"text":"tuaciang Topa na Pathian ii vawt a hong sawl teng vawt in. A thukhamte le a thupiakna te a vekpi in Moses ii thukham sungah a ki at babang zui in, tua hile na paina po, na sepna pawpo ah na nuamsa thei tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama thu na ni le, Topa ii kei tungah hong piak ka suan ka paalte in thumaan tak le thintak lungtak taw ama ii thupiakte a nit tu a kidop uh laiteng in, Israel ngam uk tu hi ci in kamciam sia ama in kholet tu hi."},"5":{"text":"“Thudang khat om lai hi. Joab in kei tungah hong ngamtatna ciamtee tu ni hi, ama in Israel te ngalkaphonpite a uk, Ner ii tapa Abner le Jether ii tapa Amasa te nii hong thalupsak hi. Ngal sungah thina hangin ngal kilem hun sungah phulam in tualthat ahi sia na phawk tu hi. Ama in mihing mawnei ngawlte that ahikom tu in ama ngamtatna teng keima pu khi hi, tuasia taw kizui in a piang babang thuak khi hi.","ref":"2 Sa 3:27; 2 Sa 20:10"},"6":{"text":"Na vawt tu bangziam ci in he ni hi; ama sia thi ngei bang thawthongin thisak ngawl tu ni hi."},"7":{"text":"“Ahihang Gilead pan Barzillai tapate tungah hesuakna lak ta'n a, a pha takin ou ta'n, banghang ziam cile na suapuipa Absalom kung pan ka tai lai in amate in kei hong hesuak hi.","ref":"2 Sa 17:27-29"},"8":{"text":"“Benjamin ngam Bahurim khua panin Gera ii tapa Shimei a ci khat zongh om hi. Mahanaim ka zot lai in nasia takin hong haamsiat hi, ahihang Jordan ngun ah ka kisik ciangin ama a kithalup ngawl natu in Topa min taw a ciliap huai kamciam ka pia hi.","ref":"2 Sa 16:5-13; 19:16-23"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang ama daan piak ngawlin thaa thong ngawl het tu ni hi. Bang vawt tu ci in nangma he ni hi, ama a kithisak natu na vaihawm kul tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"David thi a David khuapi ah kiphum hi.","title":"David ii Thina"},"11":{"text":"Ama in kum 40 sung Israel kumpi seam a, Hebron ah kum sali, Jerusalem ah kum 33 sung maang hi.","ref":"2 Sa 5:4-5; 1 Khang 3:4"},"12":{"text":"Solomon in a pa David ii kumpi za lua a, ama ii kumpi vaangletna kip hi.","ref":"1 Khang 29:23"},"13":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Haggith ii tapa, Adonijah sia Solomon ii nu Bathsheba kungah haw hi. “Kilem vai in hong vak na hi ziam?” ci in Bathsheba in dongh hi. Adonijah in, “Hi hi,” ci in zo hi,","title":"Adonijah ii Thina"},"14":{"text":"tuaciang, “Kong nget nop khat om hi,” ci lai hi. Ama in, “Tua sia bang ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in, “Na heaksa bangin kei sia kumpi ka sua natu hi, Israel ngam ah mi theampo in tuabangin muangmaw hi. Ahihang a tuam dang khat in hong piang a, ka suapuipa sia kumpipa suak hi, banghang ziam cile tuasia Topa deina hi."},"16":{"text":"Tu in nget nop khat hong nei khi hi; nong hesuakna in hong nial heak in,” ci in zo hi. Bathsheba in, “A bang ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in, “Nong hesuakna in Kumpipa Solomon tungah Shunem panin numei Abishag sia ka zi tu in hong ngetsak ta'n — nang sia ama in hong nial ngawl tu ci in he khi hi,” ci in zo hi.","ref":"1 Kum 1:3-4"},"18":{"text":"Tua nu in, “Pha mama hi nang atu Kumpipa tungah kong sonsak tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom Bathsheba sia kumpipa kungah Adonijah taangin a paupui tu in pai hi. Kumpipa sia a nu muak tu in dingto a, a nu kun hi. Tuasia zawkciang ama kumpi tokhum tungah to a, a nu atu tokhum dang khat lasak in a ziatsang ah tosak hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in, “Hamphatna no khat hong ngen nuam khi hi; nong hesuakna in hong nial heak in,” ci hi; Ama in, “Bang ziam nu awng?Hong nial bong,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"A nu in, “Na suapuipa Adonijah ii zi tu in Abishag pia in,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Banghangin ama piak tu in Abishag hong ngen ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Kumpi tokhum zongh ngetsak vet in. Adonijah sia ka u ahikom, thiampi Abiathar le Joab zongh ama ii sangah pang hi!” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Solomon in Topa min taw kiciam a, “Adonijah in hi bang hong nget hu in ama nuntakna taw ka lulsak bua ngawngaw le Pathian in kei hong vualum tahen!"},"24":{"text":"Topa in ka pa David ii kumpi tokhum tungah kip takin kei hong koi zo hi; ama in a kamciam kholet in kumpi ngam sia ka suan ka paalte dongin hong pia zo hi. Adonijah sia tu ni mama in thi tu hi ci in a nungta Topa taw kiciam khi hi!” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahikom Solomon kumpipa in Benaiah thupia a, tua pa va pai in Adonijah that hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Kumpipa Solomon in Abiathar thiampipa tungah, “Na teenna ngam Anathoth ah cia ta'n. A thi tu kilawm ni hi, ahizong ka pa David taw na om lai in Topa Thuciamna Thingkuang a keam pa na hi hu le ama ii ngim ngana theampo a thuakpui pa zongh na hi hu in, tu in hong thisak ngawl tu khi hi,” ci hi.","title":"Abiathar Kihawlkhiakna le Joab ii Thina","ref":"1 Sa 22:20-23; 2 Sa 15:24b"},"27":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Solomon in thiampi Abiathar sia Topa ii thiampi a sepna pan tawpsak hi, tuabangin Topa ii Shiloh ah thiampi Eli le a suan a paalte huvau a pauna taangtungsak hi.","ref":"1 Sa 2:27-36"},"28":{"text":"Joab in thupiang teng za hi. (Ama in Absalom panpui ngawl ahihang Adonijah panpui hi.) Tua ahikom ama tai in Topa ii ompuina puanbuk sungah biaknatau ii kingte lenin om hi."},"29":{"text":"Kumpipa Solomon in Joab sia puanbuk bealh tu in tai a, biaknatau hui ah a om hunlam a zaak ciang, Kumpipa Solomon in kamtai khat sawlin Joab munah banghangin biaknatau a bealh tu in tai ni ziam ci in donghsak hi. Joab in Topa kungah ka tai sia Solomon ka kiitak hang hi ci in zo hi. Tua ahikom Kumpipa Solomon in Joab a that tu in Benaiah paisak hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama Topa ii ompuina Puanbuk ah pai in Joab munah, “Kumpipa in pusuak a hong sawl hi,” ci hi. Joab in, “Hong pusuak ngawl tu khi hi. Hi sungah thi zaw tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi. Benaiah heak kikin kumpipa munah Joab pauna teng son hi."},"31":{"text":"“Joab ii ci bangin vawt in. Ama that in a, phum in. Tuasia ciangin kei ka hi zong, David ii suan le paal dangte ahizong Joab ii mawnei ngawl a thalupte huvau ah vaipuak ka nei nawn buatu hi."},"32":{"text":"Ka pa David ii heak ngawl laanin, mihing a thana hu in Topa in Joab daan pia tu hi. Joab in ama sangin mi pha ahizaw, a maw ngawl mihing nii thatlum a: Israel te ngalkaphonpi ukpa Abner le Judah te ngalkaphonpi ukpa Amasa te ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Amate ii mihing thanate hu in daan piakna sia Joab le a suan a paalte tungah a tawntungin tung tu hi. Ahihang Topa in David suan le paal te ama ii kumpi tokhum tungah a to peuma zawna pia tawntung tu hi,” Solomon in ci in zo hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ahikom Benaiah in Topa ompuina Puanbuk ah pai in Joab that hi, tuaciang ama sia ama ii inn, ngam taanzauna ah kiphum hi."},"35":{"text":"Kumpipa in Benaiah sia Joab taangin ngalkaphonpi ukpa suaksak a, thiampipa Zadok in Abiathar za laihsak hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kumpipa in Shimei samsak a, “Hi sung Jerusalem ah nangma atu in inn khat sa in. A sungah teang in a, khuapi nusia heak in.","title":"Shimei ii Thina"},"37":{"text":"Inn nusia in Kidron lui na kaantan le thi tatak tu ni hi — tuaciang nangma mawna hi tu hi,” ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Shimei in, “Pha mama hi, Kumpipa awng, na ci babangin ngamta tu khi hi,” ci in zo kik hi. Tuabangin ama Jerusalem ah ngei ma teang hi."},"39":{"text":"Ahizong kum thum zawkciang, Shimei ii silate nii sia, Maacah ii tapa Achish, Gath kumpipa tuu in tai uh hi. Shimei in amate sia Gath ah om hi ci in a zaak ciangin,"},"40":{"text":"a laa tung to in Gath khua Achish kumpipa kungah pai a tua silate zong hi. Amate mu in inn ah hong cia pui kik hi."},"41":{"text":"Solomon in Shimei ngamtatna teng a zaak ciangin,"},"42":{"text":"ama samsak a, “Jerusalem na nusiat ngawl natu in Topa min taw kamciam kong piasak hi. Tuaciang na nusia napo le thi tatak tu ni hi ci in na kidop natu thu kong piaksa hi. Tuabang thukim in na thu kong ni tu hi nong cisa hi ngawl ziam?"},"43":{"text":"Tua ahile banghangin ciampeal in kong thupiakna hong mang ngawl ni ziam?"},"44":{"text":"Ka pa David tungah na tatkhialnate theampo he nginge ni hi. Topa in nang tua hu in daan hong pia tu hi."},"45":{"text":"Ahihang ama in kei thupha hong pia tu a, David ii kumpi ngam sia ngammuangsak tawntung tu hi,” ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kumpipa thupiak bangin Benaiah pusuak a, Shimei that hi. Tu in Solomon in uk siat hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in Egypt kumpipa tanu a teenpuina taw ngal vai a kipawlna khat nei hi. Ama in tua nu sia a kumpi inn, Biakinnpi le Jerusalem khua uumna luphungte a sak man dong David khuapi ah a teang tu in ciapui hi.","title":"Solomon in Ciim natu Thungen (2 Khangtaanghthu 1:3-12)"},"2":{"text":"Topa atu in biakinn kisa ngawl lai hi, tua ahikom mipite in sangaw biakpiaknate mun tuatuam ah vawt uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Solomon in Topa it a, a pa David ii hil bangin ngamta hi, ahihang ama in ngannote ngo a, biaknatau tuatuamte ah sangaw biakpiaknate zongh nei hi."},"4":{"text":"Khatvei, ama sia Gibeon ah sangaw biakpiakna vawt tu in pai hi, banghang ziam cile tua munah biaknatau a minthangbel sia om hi. Ama in hun bosa sungah tua munah meihal biakpiaknate a za simin pia zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zanin Topa sia a mang sungah hong kilaak a, “Bang kong piak tu na uukbel ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"6":{"text":"Solomon in, “Nangma in ka pa David, na naseampa sia itna lianpi na lak tawntung hi, tuaciang ama pha a, thutakin nang taw a kizopna sungah thumaan hi. Tuaciangin ama panmun ah tu ni in ngam a uk nangma in a kizom paisuakin tapa khat na piakna taw a lian na itna kip na lak hi."},"7":{"text":"Oh Topa Pathian, keima sia ka khanmoi mama in ngam ukzia he ngawl ka hihang, nangma in ka pa ii kumpi za nong laihsak zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Hi sungah nangma atu na tealsa mite tam leihin a kisim zo ngawlte sungah om khi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom na mite thutang khenna taw ka uk thei natu le a pha le a sia ka khentel thei natu in ciimna hong pia ta'n. Tua ahibuale bangbangin hi na mihonpite uk thei tu khi ziam?” ci hi"},"10":{"text":"Solomon ii hisia a nget sia Topa lungkim hi,"},"11":{"text":"tua ahikom ama munah, “Nangma atu in khansauna ahizong, hau natu ahibuale na ngalte thi natu ahizong, hong ngen ngawlin thutang takin uk thei natu ciimna hong ngenzaw na hikom,"},"12":{"text":"nong nget bangin kong pia tu hi. Ciimna le tel theina sia tu masia le maisang zong kuama peuma ii a tamzaw in a nei ngeingawl tu za kong pia tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Nong nget ngawlte zongh hong pia si tu khi hi: na khan tawntung hauna le minphatna zongh kumpipa dang khat pawpo sangin tamzaw nga tu ni hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang na pa David bangin kei thu nong ni a ka thukhamte le ka thupiakte na keamcing le khansauna hong pia tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Solomon khanglo a, Pathian in a mang sungah a paupui hunlam phawk hi. Tua zawkciang ama Jerusalem ah pai in Thuciamna Thingkuang mai ah dingin Topa tungah meihal biakpiakna le kipawlkhop biakpiakna vawt hi. Tua zawkciangin a uliante theampo atu anneak poai khat vawt hi."},"16":{"text":"Ni khat ni in pumpi kizuak numei nii hong pai a, Kumpipa Solomon mai ah amate ii thu teng son uh hi.","title":"Solomon in Thu Haksa khat khensat"},"17":{"text":"Khat sia in, “Kumpipa awng, hi numei le keima sia inn khat sungah teang khawm khu hi, tuaciang keima in ama om sung ma in inn ah nausen pano khat ka nei hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka nau a sua zawk ni nii ciang ama zongh in nau pano khat nei hi. Koma nii bekma tua inn sungah teang a — kuama dang om ngawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua zawk zan khat ciangin ama in a nau tungah kilumliik tha in, a nau dellum hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama zan lai in tho a, ka mut lanin ka tapa sia ka pangh pan hong la a, ama ii lupna ah paipui hi; tua zawkciang ama in nausen thisa sia keima ii lupna ah koi hi."},"21":{"text":"A zing ciang zingsang ka khanlaw ciangin ka nau noai pia tu ka hile a thisa ahi sia ka mu hi. Nausen pha takin ka etcian ciang ka ta ahi ngawl sia ka mu hi,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang nupi dang khat sia in, “Hi ngawl hi! Nau thisa sia nang aa hi a, a nungta sia kei aa hi!” ci hi. Nupi a pau masa sia in, “Hi ngawl hi! Nau a thi sia nang aa hi a, a nungta sia keima aa hi!” ci kik hi. Tuabangin kumpipa mai ah kinial uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Kumpipa Solomon in, “Na nii uh ma in, nau a nungta sia kei aa hi ci in a thisa sia ahile ama aa hi ci nu hi,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in namsau khat lasak a, hong thet ciang,"},"25":{"text":"ama in, “Nau a nungta sia phalbat in a, nupite a lang veve hawmsak in,” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"A nu tatak sia in a tapa a itna taw kidim ahikom kumpipa munah, “Kumpipa awng, nong hesuakna in nau sia that heak in! Ama pia in!” ci hi. Ahihang nupi dang khat sia in, “Koma khat zongh hong pia heak in; khen nii ma hong suasak po ta'n,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Solomon in, “Nau sia that heak in! Nupi a pau masa sia pia in — ama sia a nu tatak hi,” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Israel mipite in Solomon ii thu khenna a zaak uh ciang ama ii tungah zatakna nasia tak nei uh hi, banghang ziam cile tuasia tak ciang ama sia thu kituu te tang takin a khen thei natu Pathian in ciimna pia hi, ci in he uh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon sia Israel ngam bup ii kumpipa hi a,","title":"Solomon ii Uliante"},"2":{"text":"tuaciang hite sia a uliante ahi uh hi: Thiampi: Zadok ii tapa Azariah"},"3":{"text":"Zum thuzeakpite: Shisha tapate Elihoreph le Ahijah Thu ciamtee pipa: Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat"},"4":{"text":"Ngalkaphonpi ukpa: Jehoiada tapa Benaiah Thiampite: Zadok le Abiathar"},"5":{"text":"Ngamkhen uk mangte a ukpipa: Nathan tapa Azariah Kumpi thudokpa: Nathan tapa thiampi Zabud"},"6":{"text":"Kumpi inn sung naseamte a ukpa: Ahishar Zawthawk thu taw na a kiseam sakte a ukpa: Abda ii tapa Adoniram ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Solomon in Israel ngam sungah ngamkhen uk mangte sawm le nii koi hi. Kumpipa le a bangkua ii kum khat bup a neak tu sia tua mangte khat simin a uk sung ngamkhen tek panin tha sim a banin piasak hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ulian sawm le niite le amate ii ukna ngamkhente sia hi bang ahi hi: Benhur: Ephraim mualtung ngam teng"},"9":{"text":"Bendeker: Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, Elon le Beth Hanan khuapite"},"10":{"text":"Benhesed: Arubboth le Socoh khuapite le Hepher ngam theampo"},"11":{"text":"Solomon tanu Taphath ii pasal Benabinadab: Dor ngamkhen buppi"},"12":{"text":"Ahilud tapa Baana: Taanach le Megiddo khuapite le Jezreel khua thangsang, Beth Shan le Zarethan nai khuate ah a om ngamkhen theampo, Abel Meholah khuapi le Jokmeam khuapi dong"},"13":{"text":"Bengeber: Gilead ngam Ramoth khuapi, tuaciang Manasseh ii suan ahi Jair ii bee le phung neisa Gilead ah khuanote le Bashan ngamsung Argob ngamkhen, a vekpi in khua lian sawmluk hi a, luphung taw a ki uum le kongpite taau taw a kikalh te"},"14":{"text":"Iddo tapa Ahinadab: Mahanaim ngamkhen"},"15":{"text":"Solomon ii tanu dang khat Basemath ii pasal Ahimaaz: Naphtali ngam"},"16":{"text":"Hushai tapa Baana: Asher ngamkhen le Bealoth khua"},"17":{"text":"Paruah tapa Jehoshaphat: Issachar ngam"},"18":{"text":"Ela tapa Shimei: Benjamin ngam"},"19":{"text":"Uri tapa Geber: Amor kumpipa Sihon le Bashan kumpipa Og ii a ukna sa Gilead ngamkhen Hi ngam uk sawm le niite ii tungsia ah ngam bup a uk mang khat om hi."},"20":{"text":"Judah le Israel mite sia tuipivaal a senmal za in tam hi; amate in ne in, dawnin, lungdam uh hi.","title":"Solomon ii kumpi maan sung Khantona"},"21":{"text":"Solomon ii kumpi ngam sia Euphrates ngun pan Philistia le Egypt te ngamngi dong ngam theampo kihel hi. Amate in shia pia in, ama nuntak sung tawntung a khutnuai ah om uh hi.","ref":"Pian 15:18; 2 Khang 9:26"},"22":{"text":"Solomon ii ni sim a tulmawk ante sia, zungtaang vui neal litre 5,000, an litre 10,000,"},"23":{"text":"sangai, saza, sanang le akte bek dom ngawlin, inn ah a kivaak khui sawm, ngam sungah a kitha khui kul le tuu zakhat te ahi uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Solomon in Euphrates Ngun ii nitumna sang ngam theampo, Tiphsah khua omna Euphrates pan nitumna sang Gaza khuapi dong uk hi. Tuaciang Euphrates ii nitumna sang kumpipate theampo sia ama khutnuai hi a, ngamngi kizawng ngamte theampo taw kilem hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama nuntak lai tengin Judah le Israel ngamsung a teang mite ngammuangin, innkuan simin a sapitkungte le a thei kungte taw nuamsa uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Solomon in ngalleang kai siphute atu siphu buk 40,000 le siphu ngalkap 12,000 nei hi.","ref":"1 Kum 10:26; 2 Khang 1:14; 9:25"},"27":{"text":"Ngamuk mang sawm le niite in Solomon le a kumpi inn sungah an ne theampo atu an sia tha simin a piak tu za tek pia uh hi; amate in a kisamh theampo a tawntungin pia uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Ngamkhen uk mang khat simin a kisamh babang taangpi le taangphawte zongh, ngalsimna siphute le naseam nganhingte an tu sik uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Pathian in Solomon sia a tuampian ciimna le thuthuk mu theina, a kitee thei ngawl heakna lianpi pia hi."},"30":{"text":"Solomon sia Nisuana sang a miciimte ahibuale Egypt miciimte sangin ciim zaw hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama sia mihing a minpiang a ciimbel ahi hi: Ezrah mi Ethan, tuaciang, Mahol ii tate ahi Heman, Calcol le Darda, sangin ciimzaw a, ama ii minthanna sia kiim le paam ngam theampo dongin kizel hi.","ref":"Ps 89 (Thulu)"},"32":{"text":"Ama in paunak 3,000 le la ngui tul vaal phuak hi.","ref":"Pau 1:1; 10:1; 25:1"},"33":{"text":"Ama in thingkung le lopate thu thusonin nei a, Lebanon a cedar te pan pang tung a po hyssop te thu dong son thei hi; ama in ngamsate, vacimte, awmtaal nganhingte le ngasate ii thu son hi."},"34":{"text":"Leitung bup a kumpite in a ciimna za a, a thuson ngai tu in thataak mite paisak uh hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tyre kumpipa Hiram sia David ii lawm khat hi tawntung a, tuaciang Solomon in a pa David ii kumpiza laih zo hi ci in a zaak ciang tongciinte ama kungah paisak hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Sa tu in Solomon Kinging (2 Khangtaanghthu 2:1-18)"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in Hiram tungah hi kamte thaak kik hi:"},"3":{"text":"“Na heak bangma ka pa David in a kiim a om ngam theampo taw ngal kisim tawntung ahi hu in Topa in a ngalte theampo tungah zawna a piak mateng ama in Topa a Pathian a biak natu biakinn a sa thei bua hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang tu in Topa ka Pathian in ka ngamngi dung theampo ah kilemna hong pia zo hi. Ngal nei nawn ngawl khi hi, tuaciang hong kisim tu zongh lau om ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in ka pa David munah, ‘Nang zawkciang kumpi ka suasak tu na tapa in kei atu biakinn hong saksak tu hi,’ ci in kamciam pia hi. Tuaciang tu in Topa ka Pathian a kibiak natu tua biakinn khat sak tu ka khensat zo hi.","ref":"2 Sa 7:12-13; 1 Khang 17:11-12"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom kei atu Lebanon ah cedar kungte phuk tu in na mite na paisak in. Keima mite zongh amate taw diangkhawm tu a, tuaciang nangma ii khensat babang thaman pia tu khi hi. Na heak bangma, ka mite in thingphuzia sia na mite thiam bangin thiam ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Solomon ii kam thaakte a saan ciang Hiram lungkim mama a, “Ngamlian tuasia uk tu in David a laih tu kumpi tapa ciim khat a piak hu in Topa tu ni in pok vun!” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Hiram in Solomon munah hi bangin kam thaak hi: “Na kam hong thaak nga khi hi, tuaciang nong nget bangin seam tu kithoai zo khi hi. Cedar thing le taakthing teng hong sik tu khi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka mite in thingluangte Lebanon panin tuipi dong hong paipui tu a, tuate sawmkhawm in phong ka vawtsak zawkciang nangma tealna tuipi vaal mun khat ah hong taaisuksak tu khi hi. Tua munah ka mite in phel in, tuaciang na mite in vaipuak la tu hi. Nangma in ka mite nguai an nong piaksak tu ka dei hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom Hiram in Solomon sia cedar luang le taak luang a dei za sik hi,"},"11":{"text":"tuaciang, Solomon in Hiram sia kum simin a mite a vaak natu zungtaang taan 2,000 le olive thau thiang litre 400,000 sik hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in a kamciam lenin Solomon sia ciimna pia hi. Hiram le Solomon kilaklaw ah kilemna om hi, tuaciang amate ngeal sia khat le khat kihu natu thukimna lai kho khat vawt hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa Solomon in Israel ngam bup panin zawthawk thu taw a kisawl naseam tu 30,000 khon hi,"},"14":{"text":"tuaciang Adoniram sia tuate uk tu in koi hi. Ama in tua mi teng sia pawlkhat ciang mihing 10,000 veu pawl thum in khen a, Lebanon ah thakhat veu diangsakin, tha nii veu ciasak hi.","ref":"1 Kum 12:18"},"15":{"text":"Solomon in mualtung ngam ah suang to tu mihing 80,000, tua suangte a pua tu mihing 70,000 nei a,"},"16":{"text":"ama in tuate ii nasep a encik tu in a uk 3300 koi hi."},"17":{"text":"Solomon ii thupiakna taw Biakinnpi tawdap atu a hoi suangtum liante tosak hi."},"18":{"text":"Solomon le Hiram ii naseamte le Byblos khuapi pan pasalte in suangtum le thingte Biakinnpi sak natu in pua pha hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite ii Egypt a nusiat zawk kum zali le kum sawmliat zawk, Solomon ii maan zawk kum lina, a tha niina, Ziv tha sungah Solomon in Biakinnpi sak kipan hi.","title":"Solomon in Biakinnpi Sa"},"2":{"text":"A sungsang a sauna metre 27 pha a, metre 9 zai in, metre 13.5 saang hi."},"3":{"text":"A tumna inndoi sia metre 4.5 saangin, a zaina metre 9 hi a, biakinnpi cia ma zai hi."},"4":{"text":"Biakinnpi ii pangte ah a om a hawngvang te sia a sungsang sangin a puasang ciakzaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Biakinnpi ii panghte le a nungsangah inn pepna inndawl thum khat sia a pang puasang nealin sa a, dawl khat simin metre 2.2 veu saang hi."},"6":{"text":"A dawl nuainungbel ii a inndoi khat sim metre 2.2 veu zai a, a dawl laizang sia metre 2.7 zai in, a dawl tungnungbel sia metre 3.1 zai hi. Suatte tungah om biakinn pang sia a nuai suat ah omte sangin pazaw ahiciang a inndoite sia pang sungah suatthal phum kul ngawl a, pang tungah kinga thei hi."},"7":{"text":"Biakinnpi a sak tatak ciang sek, hei, le thik vanhzakte ii ngin a kizaak ngawl tu in, Biakinnpi sak natu suangtumte sia suangkhuk sungah kivawt khol hi."},"8":{"text":"Innpi pepna ii a dawl nuainungbel tumna sia Biakinnpi ii thang sangah om a, tua mun panin a dawl niina le a thumna pai natu kealleite kithung hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuabangin Solomon kumpipa in Biakinnpi a sak man hi. Ama in innciingdap sia cedar thingpheakte le innsunhte taw vawt hi."},"10":{"text":"Dawl thum a pha inn pepna sia metre 2.2 saang a, inndoi simin Biakinnpi pang pua nung sia neal in kisa a, cedar innsunhte taw kipee-awsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in Solomon munah,"},"12":{"text":"“Ka thukhamte le ka thupiak te na zui le na pa David tungah sep tu a ka kamciam teng nang atu seam tu khi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu a na sak hi Biakinnpi sung, Israel ka mite sungah kong teang tu a, tuaciangin amate ka nusia ngei buatu hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuabangin Solomon in Biakinnpi a sak man hi."},"15":{"text":"Biakinnpi sung sang pangte sia suat tung pan innciingdap dong cedar thing pheakte taw kituam a, tuaciang a suat teng taakthing kizangh hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Sungsang Zepna (2 Khangtaanghthu 3:8-14)"},"16":{"text":"A sung sang inndoi khat, Thiangtho belh Mun a kici sia Biakinnpi ii nungsangah kisa hi. Tua sia metre 9 sau in, cedar thingpheak a kilhkhopte taw kidoi a, suat tung panin innciingdap dong phato hi.","ref":"Pu 26:33-34"},"17":{"text":"Thiangthobel Mun ii mai ah a om inndoi sia metre 18 sau hi."},"18":{"text":"Cedar thingpheakte sia uum ngate le paak a kikhuak limte taw kizeam hi; a sungsang bup sia cedar thingpheak taw kituam a, tua hu in pangin a kiciang suangte kimu thei ngawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Biakinnpi nungsangah Topa ii Thuciamna Thingkuang koi natu in inn sungnung inndoi khat kisa hi."},"20":{"text":"Hi inn sungsang inndoi sia metre 9 sau a, metre 9 zai in, metre 9 saang hi, a buppi in khamh ciitak taw kituam hi. Biaknatau sia cedar thingpheakte taw kituam hi."},"21":{"text":"Biakinnpi sungsang sia khamh taw kituam a, khamh taw ma a kituam a inndoi sungnung tumna sia khaamtan in khamh kual kipeete kithung hi."},"22":{"text":"Biakinnpi sungsang buppi khamh taw kituam a, Thiangthobel Mun aa biaknatau sia zongh khamh taw kituam hi.","ref":"Pu 30:1-3"},"23":{"text":"Meter 4.4 veve a saang Cherub lim nii sia olive thing taw kivawt a, Thiangthobel Mun ah kikoi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuate ngeal a letna le a lim a meal kibang hi. Khatsimin tha nii tek nei hi. Tuaciang a thate khat ciang metre 2.2 sau hi, tua ahikom a kiphal a tha dawn khat pan dawn khat dong metre 4.4 pha hi.","merge":"25"},"27":{"text":"Tuate ngeal sia Thiangthobel Mun ah a kicial in kikoi in, a tha kiphalte dawn veve a inndoi laizang santak ah kiphasak a, tuaciang a tha dangte nii in pangte pha uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Cherub te a nii in khamh taw kituam hi.","ref":"Pu 25:18-20"},"29":{"text":"A inndoipi pangte le a sungnung inndoi pangte sia a khetkuak cherub te ii limte, palm thingkung limte le paak limte taw kizeam siat hi."},"30":{"text":"A suat ngawngawn khamh taw kituam hi."},"31":{"text":"Olive thing taw a kivawt bangkua a kipee nii te sia Thiangthobel Mun tumna ah kikoi hi; a kongbiang tung santak sia a tung zumin a kawn khat hi."},"32":{"text":"Kongkhate sia cherub lim te, palm thingkung limte le paak limte taw kizeam a, khamh taw kituam hi."},"33":{"text":"Inndoipi sung tumna kongkhamung sia siik li nei in olive thing taw kivawt hi."},"34":{"text":"Kongkha kithep thei nii sia taakthing taw kivawt a,"},"35":{"text":"cherub limte, palm thingkung lim le paak lim te taw kizeam hi, tuate sia a kibang kim in khamh taw kituam hi."},"36":{"text":"Zum sungnung sia Biakinnpi ii mai ah kisa a, pangte taw ki uum in, tuate atu in suang ngual thuap thum simin cedar thingpim ngual khat veu kician nelh hi."},"37":{"text":"Biakinnpi ii tawdap sia Solomon kumpi maan zawk a kum lina a tha niina Ziv tha sungah kiciang hi."},"38":{"text":"Solomon ii maan zawk a kum sawm le kum khat a tha liatna Bul tha sung ah, a kingeal bang lianin kiman thiang hi. Solomon atu tuasia a sak na in kum sali hai hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in ama atu zong kumpi inn khat sa si a, kum sawm le kum thum hai hi.","title":"Solomon ii Kumpi Inn"},"2":{"text":"Lebanon Thingtaam Inndoipi sia metre 44 sau a, metre 22 zai in, metre 13.5 saang hi. Cedar khuam sawm le nga veu ngual thum om a, tuate khat sim tungah a kinga zawlliang kithung hi. Innciingdap sia cedar hi a, vanh kholna inndoite tung liap hi, tuate sia khuamte taw kinang hi.","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"A pangte ngeal ah khelki ngual thum veu om hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua kongbiangte le a khelkite sia a pangh kikim king li nei veu hi a, tuaciang pang khat sim tungah khelki ngual thumte in a langkhat ngualte maingat hi."},"6":{"text":"Khuamngual te ii Inndoipi sia metre 22 sau a, metre 13.5 zai hi. A tung siin nei a, khuamte in nang hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpi Tokhum omna Inndoi sia Thukhenna Inndoi zongh kici a, Solomon ii a thukhenna mun ahi hi, tuasia suat tung panin tuukpite dong cedar thingpheakte taw kivawt hi."},"8":{"text":"Solomon teenna inn sia Thukhenna Inndoi ii nungsangah inn dangte sak bangma in kisa hi. A zi, Egypt kumpipa ii tanu atu zongh tua taw kibangin inn saksak hi.","ref":"1 Kum 3:1"},"9":{"text":"Hi innte theampo le a suum lianpi sia a tawdap pan kipan bitha dong suangphate taw kivawt hi. A suangte sia a suangkhuk ah a pha tu cia kivawt khol a, a sungsang le a puasang panghte sia thingatnam taw kingiamh hi."},"10":{"text":"A tawdap tu sia suangtum liante taw suangkhuk ah kivawt a, pawlkhat sia metre 3:5, pawlkhat sia metre 4 sau hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuate ii tungah a phabek tu a at sa suang dangte le cedar thingpim te taw kisa hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpi inn suum, Biakinnpi suum sungnung le Biakinnpi tumna inndoite ii pangte sia suang tansa ngual thum simin cedar thingpim ngual khat veu thekin kisa hi."},"13":{"text":"Solomon kumpipa in taau taw nasep a thiam Tyre khuapi ah a teang, khutthiamna a nei Huram a kici pasal khat sam hi.","title":"Huram ii Nasep"},"14":{"text":"A thi zo a pa sia Tyre pan hi a, ama zongh taau taw nasep a thiam khat ma hi; a nu sia Naphtali nam pan ahi hi. Huram sia a pil, khutthiam nasep a seam ngeisa ahi hi. Ama in taau taw nasepna theampo a uk tu in Solomon kumpipa ii sapna a saang hi."},"15":{"text":"Huram in taau khuampi nii vawt hi, khat simin metre 8 saang a, a kiimkot sia metre 5.3 pha hi, tuate sia Biakinnpi tumna munah koi hi.","title":"Taau Khuam Ngual Niite (2 Khangtaanghthu 3:15-17)"},"16":{"text":"Ama in tua khuampite ii tungkhu tu in taau metre 2.2 veve a sau zongh vawt si hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuampite ii a dawn veve sia thikkhau kipheakte ii lim la in"},"18":{"text":"taau taw a kivawt talee nga lim ngual nii veve taw zongh zeam hi."},"19":{"text":"A tung khu sia unok paak bangin kivawt in, metre 1.8 sau a,"},"20":{"text":"tuate sia a kawnin a kivawt a tungkhu thikkhau pheak bang ahi sia ii tungah kikoi hi. A tungkhu khat sim ii kiim ah talee nga ngual nii in a kingual pum 200 om hi."},"21":{"text":"Huram in hi taau khuampite nii sia Biakinnpi tumna mai ah koi hi: a thangsang a sia Jachin ci a, a saksang a sia Boaz kici hi."},"22":{"text":"Unok paak taw kibang taau tungkhute sia tua khuampite dawn ah kinga hi. Tuabangin khuampite taw kisai nasepna kiman hi."},"23":{"text":"Huram in tuikuang khat sia a beamin vawt hi, metre 2.2 thuk a, a khuangmai sia metre 4.4 ahi hi, a kiimkot sia metre 13.2 ahi hi.","title":"Taau Tuikuang (2 Khangtaanghthu 4:2-5)"},"24":{"text":"Tuikuang ii a ngong puasang kiil kiim theampo taau uum nga lim ngual nii om a tuikuang taw sakhat suak in taau kisung hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuikuang sia a puasang a ngaa, khuital lim sawm le nii te ii nungzaang ah tosak hi, thum veu khen in mun khat sang tek ngaa sak hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuikuang ii pangh sia millimetre 75 saa hi. A ngong sia hai ngong taw kibang a, a pua sangah paal in, unok paakpalh bang ahi hi. Tua tuikuang sungah litre 40,000 bang taa hi."},"27":{"text":"Huram in taau taw leang sawm vawt si hi; khat simin metre 1.8 sau a, metre 1.8 zai in, metre 1.3 saang hi.","title":"Taau Leangte"},"28":{"text":"Tuate sia a paona nei kiing li kikim taau a pheakte taw kivawt a,"},"29":{"text":"tawpi lim, khuital lim le cherub limte tua taaupheakte tungah kingelh hi; a paona mungte tungah a om tawpi le khuital limte ii tung le, a kivial limte om hi."},"30":{"text":"Leang khat simin taau mui li veu, taau zawlte tungah kibul hi. A leang ii king li simin kuangpui nanna, taau taw a kivawt khuam note om a; tuate sia a kivial limte taw kizeam hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua tungah kuangpui ngak natu valh kawn khat om hi. Tuasia in leang tungah centimetre 45 dok to a, tuasia sungah centimetre 18 tum suk hi. Tuasia ii kiim ah thing ngelhte kivawt hi."},"32":{"text":"Leangmuite sia centimetre 66 saang hi; Tuate sia taaupheakte nuai ah om a, a leang zawlte sia a leangte taw sakhat in kivawt hi."},"33":{"text":"Leangmuite sia siphu ngalleangmuite taw kibang hi; leangzawlte, a mui kiil te le a mui letna ciangte le a mui kamhnate sia taau vive ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Leang khat ii a king sim ah a nuai pan a nannate zongh leang taw sa khat ma ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Centimetre 22 a beak taau kual khat veu leang khat sim tungah om hi; tua ii nannate le taaupheakte sia leang taw sa khat ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"A nannate le taaupheakte sia cherubim, tawpite le palm thingkung limte taw a awng napo ah kizeamin, lim a kivialte taw a kiimkot theampo ah kizeam hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua hi a, hi bangin leangte kivawt hi; tuate khat le khat kibang hi, a phakcia le a pianzia kibang kim hi."},"38":{"text":"Huram in leang khat atu khat veu kuangpui sawm vawt si hi. Kuangpuite khat sim ii a khuangmai metre 1.8 veu zai a, tuaciang kuang simin litre 800 taa hi.","ref":"Pu 30:17-21"},"39":{"text":"Ama in leang nga sia Biakinnpi thang sangah koi a, a om lai nga teng saksang ah koi hi; tuikuang sia nisuana thang sang king ah koi hi."},"40":{"text":"Huram in bealte, leiluana kawkeaute le kuangte zongh vawt hi. Ama in Solomon kumpipa atu in Topa Biakinnpi atu a nasep theampo khuangkhim zo hi. Hi sia ama ii vawt teng ahi hi; Khuampi niite Khuampi dawn ah kuangno taw a kibang khuam tungkhu nii, Khuam tungkhu khat sim tungah a kipheak thikkhau Khuam tungkhu kiimkot ah 100 veu ngual nii in a kisuai, talee nga lim 400 Leang sawmte, Kuangpui sawmte Tuikuang Tuikuang ngakna khuital sawm le nii Bealte, kawkeaute le kuangte Hi Biakinnpi vanh zak tu in Huram ii Solomon kumpipa atu a vawtte sia a kinawt sa taau taw kivawt hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Nazak Tepteena A Tom (2 Khangtaanghthu 4:11 ; 5:1)","merge":"41"},"46":{"text":"Kumpipa in tuate theampo sia Jordan Kuam sung Sukkoth le Zarethan kilaklaw ah a om thikseakna munah vawtsak hi."},"47":{"text":"Solomon in hi taau vanh te khaitee sak ngawl hi, banghang ziam ci le tam lei ahikom a ngitna kituat ngeingawl hi."},"48":{"text":"Solomon in Biakinnpi atu khamh vanhzakte zongh vawtsak hi: biaknatau, Pathian tung anluum piakna sabuai,","ref":"Pu 30:1-3; 25:23-30"},"49":{"text":"Thiangthobel Mun ii mai ah a ding meivak khuam sawm, a saksang ah nga, a thang sangah nga a koite; paakte, meiinnte le taiteete;","ref":"Pu 25:31-40"},"50":{"text":"haite, taitee, kuangte, meikam toaina bealte; Thiangthobel Mun kongkhate le Biakinnpi puasang kongkhate ii pattaate ahi hi. Hi na zakte theampo sia khamh taw kivawt hi."},"51":{"text":"Kumpipa Solomon in Biakinnpi tungtaang ah nasep tu teng a man ciangin a pa David ii Topa tungah a aap tuamsa na teng — ngunn, khamh le a dang nate sia biakinn vanh kholna inndoite sungah koi hi.","ref":"2 Sa 8:11; 1 Khang 18:11"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Kumpipa Solomon in Topa ii Thuciamna Thingkuang sia David ii khuapi Zion panin Biakinnpi ah a tua tu in Israel ngamsung namte le, bee le phungte ii lampui theampo Jerusalem ama kungah hong pai tu in sam hi.","title":"Thuciamna Thingkuang sia Biakinnpi ah Kipaipui (2 Khangtaanghthu 5:2—6:2)","ref":"2 Sa 6:12-16; 1 Khang 15:25-29"},"2":{"text":"Amate teng in Ethanim tha, a tha sali tha Buk Poai hun sungin kikhawmtua uh hi.","ref":"Thiam 23:34"},"3":{"text":"A lampuite theampo a kikaikhop zawkciang, thiampite in Thuciamna Thingkuang laamto uh a,"},"4":{"text":"tuaciang Biakinnpi ah hong pua uh hi. Levi te le thiampite in Topa ii ompuina Puanbuk le tua taw kisai vanh teng zongh Biakinnpi ah khiin uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa Solomon le Israel mite theampo Thuciamna Thingkuang ii mai ah hong kikhawmtua in, khui le tuu tam mama sangaw biakpiakna in nei uh hi — tam lei ahikom kisim zo ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang thiampite in Thuciamna Thingkuang sia Biakinnpi sungah hong tum pui in, cherub te ii nuai Thiangthobel Mun sungah koi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"A thakhui kizalhte in thingkuang le a puakna molte siin uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Thiangthobel Mun ii mai san tak ah a dingte bek in tua molte ii mongte mu thei a, koima dang pan kimu thei ngawl hi. (Molpumte sia tu ni in tua munah om lai hi.)"},"9":{"text":"Thuciamna Thingkuang sungah, Egypt ngam panin Israel mite a pusua lai in Sinai mual tungah Topa in amate taw thuciamna a vawt ciangin Moses ii koi tua suangpheak nii te simngawl, nadang bangma om ngawl hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:5"},"10":{"text":"Thiampite in Biakinnpi a nusiat laitak thakhat thu in tuasia meeikaai taw kidim in,"},"11":{"text":"Topa ii ompuina hu in khuavak taang velvol sia taw kidim a, amate sia a vaipuakte seam tu in pai kik thei nawn ngawl hi.","ref":"Pu 40:34-35"},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Solomon in thungen hi: “Nang, Topa in van ah ni na koi hi, tua hi napi nang in meeikaai sung le khuazing sungah om tu na teal zo hi.","ref":"Ps 18:11; 97:2"},"13":{"text":"Tu in a tuanngen biakinn khat nang atu kong saksak zo hi, a tawntungin na ten natu mun ahi hi.”"},"14":{"text":"Mipite tua munah a din uh ciangin Kumpipa Solomon in amate maingat tu in kihei a, tuaciang ama in mipite atu in Pathian thupha ngetsak hi.","title":"Solomon ii Mihonpi tungah A Thusonna (2 Khangtaanghthu 6:3-11)"},"15":{"text":"Ama in, “Israel ii Topa Pathian pok vun! Ama in ka pa David tungah hi bangin a ci, a kamciam kholet a,"},"16":{"text":"‘Egypt ngam panin ka mite ka paipui hun pan kipan, Israel ngam bup sungah kei hong kibiak natu in biakinnpi sak natu khuapi khat zongh ka teal bua hi. Ahihang, ka mite uk tu in David nang kong teal hi,’ ” a ci hi.","ref":"2 Sa 7:4-11; 1 Khang 17:3-10"},"17":{"text":"Tuaciang Solomon in a thuson zom a, “Ka pa David in Israel ii Topa Pathian a biak natu biakinn khat sak tu ngeal hi,","ref":"2 Sa 7:1-3; 1 Khang 17:1-2"},"18":{"text":"ahihang Topa in ama munah, ‘Kei atu biakinn na sak nop sia maan ni hi,"},"19":{"text":"ahihang nang in na sa ngei buatu hi. Na tapa, nangma ii tapa tilteal in ka biakinn sa tu hi,’ a ci hi.","ref":"2 Sa 7:12-13; 1 Khang 17:11-12"},"20":{"text":"“Tu in Topa in a kamciam kholet hi. Israel kumpi suak in ka pa za ka laih zo hi, tuaciang Israel ii Topa Pathian biak natu in Biakinnpi ka sa zo hi."},"21":{"text":"Egypt ngam panin ih taanghpupite a pusua pui lai in Topa in amate taw thuciamna suangpheak nii a om Thuciamna Thingkuang koi natu mun khat zongh Biakinnpi sungah ka vawtsak hi,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaciang mipite omna biaknatau mai ah Solomon ding a, a khut laamin,","title":"Solomon ii Thungetna (2 Khangtaanghthu 6:12-42)"},"23":{"text":"thu ngen hi, “Israel ii Topa Pathian awng, a tungsang vantung ah ahizong, a nuaisang lei tungah ahizong nang taw a kibang pathian om ngawl hi! Na mite taw na thuciamna na kholet a, amate in thin theampo taw na thu hong ni in a nuntak ciangin na itna na lak hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka pa David tungah na kamciam sia na kholet hi; tu ni in na kammalte theampo taangtung zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaciang tu in Israel ii Topa Pathian awng, ka pa tungah kamciam na vawt dang khat ahi, ama ii na thu hong nit bangin amate in kidopna taw thuni pole, ama suan le paalte sung pan khat in Israel kumpi in maang tawntung tu hi, na ci sia zongh nong taangtunsak natu thu kong ngen hi.","ref":"1 Kum 2:4"},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom tu in Israel ii Pathian awng, na naseampa ka pa David tungah kamciam na piakte theampo zongh taangtungsak in."},"27":{"text":"“Ahihang, Oh Pathian awng, nang leitung ah teang thei takpi tu ni ziam? Vantung theampo zongh nang hong huam tu in lian tham ngawl hi, tua ahikom hi Biakinnpi kei ii sak sia lian khom thong tu ziam?","ref":"2 Khang 2:6"},"28":{"text":"Topa ka Pathian awng, kei sia na naseampa khi hi. Ka thungetna hong za ta'n a, tu ni a kong ngetnate hong pia ta'n."},"29":{"text":"Hi Biakinnpi, nang hong kibiak natu in na tealsa hi mun sia a sun a zanin na cing in. Hi mun maingat in thu kong nget ciangin hong za ta'n.","ref":"Thkna 12:11"},"30":{"text":"Kei ii thungetna le na mite ii hi mun maingat in thu hong nget ciang hong za ta'n. Vantung na inn sung panin hong za ta'n a, kote hong maisak ta'n."},"31":{"text":"“Mihing khat sia midang khat tungah khial hi ci in a kimawsiat ciangin, a khial ngawlna thu a kilangh natu in kiciamna nei tu in hi Biakinnpi sung na biaknatau ah a kipaipui ciang,"},"32":{"text":"Oh Topa , vantung pan na ngai in a, na naseamte tungah thu hong khen ta'n. A maw sia tungah a kiphu bangin daan na pia in, a maw ngawl sia na tha in."},"33":{"text":"“Na Israel mite sia nangma tungah hong maw hu in a ngalte in zo hi, tuaciang amate in nang sang hong heak a, kiniamkhiakin maw maisak natu in thu hong ngen le,"},"34":{"text":"vantung panin na ngai in. Na mite ii mawna khialnate maisak in a, tuaciang a taanghpupite tungah na piak ngam le lei ah na ciapui kik in."},"35":{"text":"Na mite in nang tungah hong maw zo ahi hu in nguatuite na hansak ciang le, amate kisiik in hi Biakinnpi sang nga in kiniamkhiakin thu hong nget ciang,"},"36":{"text":"vantung pan na ngai in. Kumpipa le Israel mite ii mawna khialna te, na maisak in. A maan bang a ngamtat natu amate na hil in. Tuaciang, Oh Topa , na mite ii a tawntung a neisa tu in na piak hi na leitang tungah nguatui na puak in."},"37":{"text":"“Ngam sungah kialpi, ahibuale natsia tungin, ahibuale ankungte vuisa, ahibuale khaumaw hon in a lalsak ciang, tua ahibuale na mite a ngalte in a sim ciang, tua ahibualaile amate sungah natna satna a om ciang,"},"38":{"text":"amate ii thungetna na ngai in. Israel na mite khat pawpo in thin heena tatak lakin, hi Biakinnpi sangah a khut uh zan in thu hong ngen le,"},"39":{"text":"ama te thungetna za in. Vantung na inn sung panin amate ngetna na ngai in a, a mawna maisak in, na hu in. Nangma bekma in mihing thinsung ngaisutna te he ni hi. Mi simin ama taw a kiphu bangin a tungah na vawt in,"},"40":{"text":"tua hile koma a taanghpupite tungah na piak ngam le lei tungah amate ii teen sung tawntung na thu hong ni tu hi."},"41":{"text":"“A khuala a om ngamdang mi khat in na minthanna le, na mite atu na lianpi na sepna te za in, hi Biakinnpi ah nangma bia tu hong pai in thu hong ngen le,","merge":"42"},"43":{"text":"a thungetna na ngai in. Vantung na teenna pan za in a, vawtsak tu in hong nget teng vawtsak in, tua hile leitung mite theampo in Israel na mite ii hong heak bangma hong he thei in, na thu hong ni tu uh hi. Tuasia ciang amate in hi Biakinnpi ka sak sia nangma biak natu mun ahi hunlam he tu uh hi."},"44":{"text":"“A ngalte uh taw kido tu in kuan a, na sawl ciang na mite in nang tungah thu hong ngen a, koisung po ah a om zong na tealsa hi khuapi le nang atu ka sak Biakinnpi te maingat in thu hong nget ciangin"},"45":{"text":"amate ii thungetna na ngai in. Vantung panin na za in a, zawna na pia in."},"46":{"text":"“Na mite in khialna vawtin nang hong langpan ciang — a maw ngawl khat zongh om ngawl ahiciang — na thin uukin a, a ngalte in zosak in ngamdang ah thongtaak tu in amate a paipui ciang bangza po in tua ngam sia a khuala ta zong,"},"47":{"text":"na mite ii thungetna ngai in. Tua ngam pan amate kisik kikin na tungah a seksolna le a mawna pualaak in thu hong ngen le, amate thungetna na ngai in, Oh Topa awng."},"48":{"text":"Tua ngam ah amate in thin tak le thu maan takin kisiik a, ka taanghpupite tungah na piak sa, hi ngam, na tealsa hi khuapi le nang atu ka sak hi Biakinnpi sia maingat in thu hong ngen le,"},"49":{"text":"tuasia ciang amate ii thungetna na ngai in. Vantung na inn sung panin tuate za in a, amate tungah hesuakna na nei in."},"50":{"text":"Amate ii mawna khialna le hong le do na sia maisak in a, tuaciang a ngalte sia amate tungah dikna na laksak in."},"51":{"text":"Amate sia na mihingte hi a, tua meiphual lingh na Egypt pan na pusuasakte ahi hi."},"52":{"text":"“Vaanglianpipa Topa, na Israel mite le a kumpipa tungah maipha na pia tawntung in a, amate in hu ngen in hong sap simin a thungetna uh na za in."},"53":{"text":"Koma taanghpupite Egypt pan na pusuapui lai in na naseampa Moses tungah na sonsa bangma in mihing theampo sung pan amate sia nangma mi tu in na teal hi,” ci hi."},"54":{"text":"Solomon in Topa tungah a thunget a man zawkciang khut laamin khupdin a, a om na biaknatau mai pan dingto hi.","title":"A khakbel Thungetna"},"55":{"text":"Ama in tua munah a kikhawm mite theampo tungah Pathian ii thuphate a tun natu in awnging tak taw ngen hi. Ama in,"},"56":{"text":"Ama mite munah ngal kilemna a piak tu in, a kamciam bangma ngal kilemna hong pia “ Topa pok vun. A naseampa Moses tungtawnin ngo takin a piak kamciam theampo len hi.","ref":"Thkna 12:10; Jos 21:44-45"},"57":{"text":"Topa ih Pathian in ih taanghpupite taw a omkhop bangin ei taw hong omkhawm tahen; hong nusia ngei heak hen a, hong taisan heak hen;"},"58":{"text":"ama dei bangin ih nuntak tawntung thei natu le ih taanghpupite tungah a piak thukhamte le thupiakna te theampo ih kepcing thei natu, ama ii thu a ni thei tu in hong vawt tahen."},"59":{"text":"Topa ih Pathian in ama tungah hi thu ngetna le thuumna ka vawtte a tawntungin hong tepteesak tahen. Israel mite le a kumpipa tungah ni simin a kitaangsap uh bangin ama in hong hesuak tawntung tahen."},"60":{"text":"Tuabangin leitung minamte theampo in Topa ama bek Pathian hi a — a dang Pathian om ngawl hi ci in he tu uh hi."},"61":{"text":"No, ama mite in Topa ih Pathian tungah thumaan tawntung vun a, a thukhamte le a thupiakte tu ni a na zui uh bangin zui thei tawntung tavun.”"},"62":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Kumpipa Solomon le mite theampo in Topa tungah sangaw biakpiakna vawt uh hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Aapna (2 Khangtaanghthu 7:4-10)"},"63":{"text":"Ama in khui 22,000 le tuu 120,000 sia kipawlkhop biakpiakna in pia hi. Tuabangin kumpipa le a mite theampo in Biakinnpi aaptuam uh hi."},"64":{"text":"Tua ni ma in ama in Biakinnpi mai leitual laizang sia, thiangthosak hi, tua munah ama in pum bup a kihal sangaw biakpiaknate, antang biakpiaknate le nganno ii thau te taw kipawlkhop biakpiaknate vawt hi. Ama ii hi bangin a vawtna sia hi biakpiakna theampo atu, taau biaknatau teng sia biakpiak natu in no leih ahihang hi."},"65":{"text":"Tua mun Biakinnpi ah Solomon le mite theampo in a Buk Poai sia ni sali sung vawt uh hi. Tua munah saksang Hamath Mualciangh pek pan le thangsang Egypt ngamngi pan hong pai mihon tam mama om hi."},"66":{"text":"A ni liat ni ciang Solomon in mipite ciasak hi. Amate theampo in ama pok a, lungdam in cia uh hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in a naseampa David le a mi Israel te thuphate a piak hu ahi hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon kumpipa in Biakinnpi, kumpi inn le a dang a sak nop teng a sak zawkciang,","title":"Pathian, Solomon tungah Kilaak kik (2 Khangtaanghthu 7:11-22)"},"2":{"text":"Gibeon ah Topa a kilaak bangin ama tungah kilaak kik hi.","ref":"1 Kum 3:5; 2 Khang 1:7"},"3":{"text":"Topa in ama munah, “Na thungetna hong za zo khi hi. A tawntungin kei hong kibiak natu in na sak, hi Biakinnpi koituam khi hi. Ka encik tu a ka keamcing tawntung tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Thumaanna le phinciingna taw na pa David ii sep bangin keima ii na seamin, ka thukhamte na zui a, kong thupiak theampo na vawt le,"},"5":{"text":"na pa David tungah kamciam ka piak, Israel sia ama ii suan le paalte in uk tawntung tu hi, ka ci sia ka kholet tu hi.","ref":"1 Kum 2:4"},"6":{"text":"Ahihang nangma ahibuale na suan na paalte in kei nong zui nawn bua uh a, ka thukhamte le kong thupiakte zui ngawlin pathian dangte na bia uh le,"},"7":{"text":"tuasia ciang ka Israel mite sia ka piaksa ngam panin ka heam tu hi. Kei hong kibiak natu in ka koituam sa, hi Biakinnpi zongh ka nusia tu hi. Mun theampo pan mihingte in Israel sia nunau tu a, simmaw tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Hi Biakinnpi sia zaanciim in kisengneng tu a, a kaantan in a pai theampo liinglawng tu uh a lamdang sa in, ‘Banghangin Topa in hi ngam le hi Biakinnpi tungah hi bangin ngamta ziam?’ ci in kidongh tu uh hi.","ref":"2 Kum 25:9; 2 Khang 36:19"},"9":{"text":"Mihingte in ‘Banghang ziam cile Egypt ngam panin a taanghpupite a pusua, a Pathian a nusiat uh hu hi. Pathian dangte tungah kinga a, a biak hu in Topa in hi tuasiatna amate tungah tungsak hi,’ ci in kizo tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Biakinnpi le ama kumpi innte a sak hun kum kul ngei hi.","title":"Solomon ii Hiram taw a Thukimna (2 Khangtaanghthu 8:1-2)"},"11":{"text":"Tyre kumpipa Hiram in hi nasepna atu a kisamh cedar thing le taakthing teng ahizong, khamh theampo ahizong sik siat hi. Tuasia a kiman zawkciang Solomon kumpipa in Hiram sia Galilee ngamkhen sungah khua kul pia hi."},"12":{"text":"Hiram pai in a mu ciangin tua khuate dei ngawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in Solomon munah, “Tua ahile, suapui awng, kei nong piak khuate hi teng ahi ziam!” ci hi. Hi sia hu in tua mun le ngam teng Cabul kici lai hi."},"14":{"text":"Hiram in Solomon khamh kilogramme tul li vaal pia hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa Solomon in Biakinnpi sak natu, kumpi inn sak natu le khuapi ii nisuana sang teng lei vuk natu le khuapi luphung cian natu in, zawthawk thu taw a kisawl naseamte zangh hi. Amate in khuapite ahi Hazor, Megiddo, le Gezer khuate saat natu in tuate ma zangh hi.","title":"Solomon ii A Zaw Nasep dangte (2 Khangtaanghthu 8:3-18)"},"16":{"text":"(Egypt kumpipa in Gezer simin la zo a, a teang khua mite thatin, a khuapi haltum hi. Tua zawkciang tua khuapi sia a tanu le Solomon hong kiteen uh ciang mo thaakna letsong in pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaciang Solomon in sa kik hi.) Zawthawk thu taw a kisawl naseamte ma zangh a, Solomon in Beth Horon khua Nuainung zongh saat kik hi."},"18":{"text":"Baalath, Judah duisung ah a om Tamar,"},"19":{"text":"a anneak a vanh zakte kholna khuapite, a siphute le a siphu ngalleangte kholna khuapite, inn a sak nopna dang theampo ah Jerusalem, Lebanon le a uk sung mun dangte sung zongh ah tua naseamte zangh hi."},"20":{"text":"Solomon in zawthawk thu taw a kisawl nasep seam tu in Israel mite ii a ngam a suan lai in a thalup mong Canaan mite ii suan le paalte zangh uh hi. Hite sungah Amor te, Hit te, Periz te, Hiv te le Jebus te kihel in, tuate ii suan le paalte sia tu ni dong sila ahi uh hi.","merge":"21"},"22":{"text":"Solomon in Israel te sila in a khoai bua hi; amate in a ngalkap no, ngalkap bu, ngalkap uk, siphu ngalleang uk le siphu ngalkap veu seamsak uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Solomon ii inn sak natu nasep tuatuamte sungah ulian 550 in zawthawk thu taw a kisawl naseamte uk uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Solomon in a zi, Egypt kumpipa tanu atu a saksak kumpi inn ah David khuapi pan a khiin zawkciang, khuapi ii nisuana sang teng lei vuksak hi."},"25":{"text":"Kum khat sung thumvei veu Solomon in meihal biakpiakna le kipawlkhop biakpiaknate Topa atu a sak sa biaknatau tungah pia hi. Ama in Topa atu ngimnamtuite zongh hal hi. Tuabangin ama in Biakinnpi sakna man hi.","ref":"Pu 23:17; 34:23; Thkna 16:16"},"26":{"text":"Solomon in Edom ngam Aqaba Tuidok vaal ah a om Elath taw kinai, Eziongeber ah teambaw honkhat vawt hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa Hiram in a teambaw naseam thiam sa pawlkhat Solomon mite taw seam khawm tu in puak hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in Ophir ngam ah teambaw taw pai in khamh kilogramme 14,000 bang Solomon kungah cia pui uh hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sheba kumpinu in Solomon minthanna za a, tuaciang thudokna haksa pawlkhat taw ama ze et tu in Jerusalem ah haw hi.","title":"Sheba Kumpinu ii a Hawna (2 Khangtaanghthu 9:1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in a lalangte honpui khat, hel namtuite, suangmanpha le khamh tam ma a pua kalaoh te hong paipui hi. Ama le Solomon a kisik ciangin a ngaisut thei za taw thu doknate nei hi."},"3":{"text":"Solomon in tua teng zo thei siat hi; ama a tu zo mawk tu a haksa leih bangma om ngawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Sheba kumpinu in Solomon ii ciimna za a, kumpi inn a sak sia mu hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpinu in kumpipa sabuai ah a kilui ante, a uliante ii teenna innte, kumpi inn sung naseamte ii nasep hawm zia le a puansilhte, poaipi khaam ciang a sabuai ngak naseamte le Biakinnpi sungah a sangaw biakpiaknate mu hi. Ama in husamh liangin lamdang sa hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Kumpipa Solomon munah, “Ka ngam panin na ciimna le nangma thu kong zaakte maan siat hi!"},"7":{"text":"Ahihang hong pai a keima tatak ma in ka mu mateng ka um thei bua hi. Ahihang a lang zongh za ngawl lai hi nginge khi hi; na ciimna le na hauna te kei tungah hong kiko za sangin nasia zaw lai hi."},"8":{"text":"Na zite bangza in hampha uh ziam! Na ciimna kammalte hong za tawntung, na kung a om, na naseamte zongh hampha mama hi!"},"9":{"text":"Topa na Pathian pok in! Ama in nang Israel kumpipa hong suasak ciang nang tungah a lungkimzia ama in lak zo hi. Ama ii Israel te hong itna kip tawntung ahikom, nang sia thukham le thutang khenna na kepcing thei natu in, amate kumpi hong suaksak zo hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in Solomon kumpipa tungah letsong hong paipui teng: khamh kilogramme 4,000 vaal, hel namtuite le suangmanpha tam mama pia hi. Tua hel namtui teng sia ama ii vanh saan ngei theampo sung pan a nasiabel ahi hi.","ref":"Mt 12:42; Lk 11:31"},"11":{"text":"(Ophir panin khamh hong ciapui Hiram ii teambaw te in juniper thing le suangmanpha zongh hong ciapui hi."},"12":{"text":"Solomon in tua thingte taw Biakinnpi le kumpi inn dalna te, tuaciang music thiamte atu tengtongh le liamlo vawtna in nei hi. Tuate sia Israel ngam sungah a kiciapui ngei juniper thing phabel teng po pan a phabel hi; hi bangte bangma hunin kimu kik ngei nawn ngawl hi.)"},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa Solomon in Sheba kumpinu sia ngo takin a kipiak ngei letsongte vaalin a nget theampo pia hi. Tua zawkciang ama le a lalangte Sheba ngam ah cia uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Kum simin Solomon Kumpipa in khamh kilogramme 23,000 dektak nga hi,","title":"Solomon Kumpipa ii Hauna (2 Khangtaanghthu 9:13-29)"},"15":{"text":"tua banah sumvawtte ii shia piakte, sumzuak sumleina tung pan a meet, le Arab kumpite le Israel ngamkhen uk mangte ii piak shia te zongh nga hi."},"16":{"text":"Solomon in lum a lian 200 vawtsak a, khat simin khamh kilogramme 7 dektak taw veu zeamsak hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in lum a no zaw 300 zongh vawtsak a, khamh kilogramme 2 dektak taw veu zeamsak hi. Ama in hi lumte teng Lebanon Thingtaam Inndoipi sungah koisak hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in kumpipa tokhum lian khat zongh vawtsak hi. Tuasia ii khen khat sia saiha taw tuam a, a taanglai teng khamh phabel taw tuam hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpi tokhum kung thet to natu keallei dawl luk om in, a dawl khat ii mong sim ah tawpi lim khat veu taw a vekpi tawpi lim sawm le nii om hi. Kumpi tokhum ii nungsangah khuital lu ii lim suang a, a khut ngakna baan te nii pangh ah tawpi lim khat veve kivawt hi. Kumpi ngam koima dang ah hi bang kumpi tokhum om ngeingawl hi.","merge":"20"},"21":{"text":"Solomon ii hai theampo khamh taw kivawt hi, tuaciang Lebanon Thingtaam Inndoipi sung a, ankuang ankeau theampo khamh ciitak taw kivawt hi. Solomon hun lai in ngunn sia a manpha in kingaisun ngawl ahikom ngunn kizangh ngawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in tuipi teambaw hon nei a, Hiram ii teambaw hon taw paikhawmsak hi. Kum thum simin ama teambaw hon sia heak kik in, khamh, ngunn, saiha, zawng te le mei nei ngawl zawngku puite ciapui hi."},"23":{"text":"Solomon kumpipa sia kumpi dang khat pawpo sangin hau zawin ciim zaw hi,"},"24":{"text":"tuaciang, leitung bup in Pathian ii piaksa ama ii ciim kam pauna te ngai tu in hong pai nuam uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Hong pai peuma in ama letsong khat veu — ngunn le khamh taw a kivawt nate, puantualte, ngalhiam te, hel namtuite, siphute le laate puak hi. Kum khat zawk kum khat tuabangin kipia tan hi."},"26":{"text":"Solomon in siphu ngalleang 1,400, ngalsim siphu 12,000 nei hi. Tuate pawlkhat Jerusalem ah koi a, a dang teng khuapi dang ah koi kawkoai hi.","ref":"1 Kum 4:26"},"27":{"text":"Ama ii uk hun sungin ngunn sia suang bangma in Jerusalem khua sungah om a, cedar sia sycomore thing thawthong za in Judah mualpeangte ah tam hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:17"},"28":{"text":"Kumpipa ii taang mite in Musri le Cilicia pan ngamdang a puak tu siphute,","ref":"Thkna 17:16"},"29":{"text":"tuaciang Egypt pan ngamdang a puak tu siphu ngalleangte saisak uh hi. Amate in Hit mite le Syria kumpipate atu, siphu le siphu ngalleangte vaihawmsak in, siphu ngalleang khat ciang ngunntang 600, siphu khat ngunntang 150 taw zuak uh hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in ngamdang numeite tam ma it hi. Egypt kumpipa ii tanu bek hi ngawl, Hit, Moab, Ammon, Edom le Sidon pan numeite teenpui hi.","title":"Solomon in Pathian Nungngat","ref":"Thkna 17:17"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Israel te sia hi mite taw a kiteen ngawl natu thupia hi, banghang ziam cile tua mite in Israel mite sia pathian dangte tungah thumaan zaw tu ahi hang hi, tua hi napi ama in amate teenpui hi.","ref":"Pu 34:16; Thkna 7:3-4"},"3":{"text":"Solomon in kumpi tanute 700 teenpui a, zino 300 nei si hi. Amate in Solomon sia Pathian nung ngat in omsak hi,"},"4":{"text":"tuaciang a khanhaam hun ciangin amate in ngamdang pathiante biakna sungah tumpui hi. Ama in Topa a Pathian tungah a pa David ii thumaan bangza in thumaan ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in Sidon te ii numeipathian Astarte, tuaciang Ammon te ii a thasiathuai pathian Molech bia hi."},"6":{"text":"A pa David bang hi ngawl a, ama in Topa tungah khialin a tungah thumaan ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem nisuana sang mual tungah Moab te ii a thasiathuai pathian Chemosh biak natu mun khat, tuaciang Ammon te ii a thasiathuai pathian Molech biak natu mun vawt hi."},"8":{"text":"A ngamdang zite ii ngimnamtui a hal natu le sangaw biakpiaknate amate tek ii pathiante tungah a nei thei natu in biakna munte zongh vawtsak hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa, Israel te ii Pathian in niivei tak Solomon tungah kilaak a, ngamdang pathiante a biak ngawl natu thupia hikale Topa thu ni ngawlin nungngat hi. Tua ahikom Topa sia Solomon tungah thin uuk a,","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"ama tungah, “Nang sia kei taw na thuciamna palsat kaltang in, ka thupiakte zui ngawl na hikom na kumpi ngam kong laaksak tu a, na uliante khat pia tu in ka kamciam om hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahihang na pa David ka khualna in hisia na nuntak sungin ka vawt buatu a, na tapa ii uk hun sungin piang tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaciang ama ii kumpi ngam bup ka la buatu hi; ama atu sia ka naseampa David le keima atu ka vawtsa Jerusalem khuapi ka khualna in minam khat ka nusiat zaw tu hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa in Edom kumpi bangkua pan Hadad sia Solomon langpansak hi.","title":"Solomon ii Ngalte"},"15":{"text":"Hi hun ma pek in, David in Edom a zawthal lai in, a ngalkaphonpi ukpa Joab sia tua munah a thite ii luang phum tu in pai zo hi. Ama le a mite Edom ah tha luk a taam hun sungin Edom mite pa a minpiang,","merge":"16"},"17":{"text":"Hadad le a pa ii naseam Edom mi pawlkhat Egypt ngam zuan in a suakta teng simngawl thatlum siat hi. (Tua hun lai in Hadad sia patangno khat hi pheang hi.)"},"18":{"text":"Amate in Midian nusia in Paran ah pai a, tua munah mi pawlkhat in amate pawm hi. Tua zawkciang amate Egypt ngam ah khualhaw in, kumpipa kung a pai ciang Hadad sia leitang pawlkhat le inn khat pia hi, tuaciang anvaak hi."},"19":{"text":"Hadad sia kumpipa in pawl vawt a, kumpipa in a nuphal nu, Kumpinu Tahpenes ii suapuinu sia Hadad ii zi tu in pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua nu in Hadad taw tapa khat hing in, a min Genubath hi a, ama sia kumpinu in kumpi inn sungah khangsak a, kumpipa tapate taw teang khawm hi."},"21":{"text":"David ii thina le ngalkaphonpi ukpa Joab ii thina thu Egypt ah Hadad in a zaak ciang Hadad in kumpipa munah, “Ka ngam ah hong cia kiksak ta'n,” ci in ngen hi."},"22":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Banghangin maw? Kong piak tu khat po kong piak ngawl om ziam? Tua hu in cia kik nuam ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Hadad in, “Hong ciasak lel po ta'n,” ci in kumpipa tungah zo hi. Tuaciang a ngam ah ama ciakik hi. Edom kumpipa a hina taw ama sia Israel te atu a ngilo a ngal cipha khat ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Pathian in Eliada ii tapa Rezon zongh Solomon a langpan tu in vawt hi. Rezon sia a topa Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer kung pan tai a,"},"24":{"text":"tuaciang ama sia thukham nei ngawl mihing tatsia pawlkhat ii lampui suak hi. (Hisia David ii Hadadezer a zaw zawk, a kipawlpui Syria te a thalup zawkciang ahi hi.) Rezon le a mite Damascus ah pai in tua munah teang uh hi, tua munah a mite in ama Syria kumpi suaksak uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama sia Solomon khan sung Israel te ii ngal ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Solomon kumpi a langpan midang khat sia a uliante khat ahi Jeroboam hi a, Ephraim ngam Zeredah pan Nebat ii tapa hi. A nu sia meingong khat hi a Zeruah hi.","title":"Jeroboam tungah Pathian ii Kamciam"},"27":{"text":"Hisia tualngal thawna taanghthu hi. Solomon sia Jerusalem ii nisuana sangah lei dimh in, khuapi luphungte pua hi."},"28":{"text":"Solomon in Jeroboam sia a kiveakseak nasep hanciam khangno khat hi ci in a mu ciang Manasseh le Ephraim ngamsung om zawthawk thu taw a kisawl naseam theampo uksak hi."},"29":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Jeroboam sia Jerusalem pan khualhaw in a pai laitak ama nguak hong pai Shiloh pan kamsaang pa Ahijah taw, ngam taanzauna khat lampi tungah kisi uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahijah in a puantual thak silh lai sia suutin, khen sawm le khen nii sua in eautham hi,"},"31":{"text":"tuaciang, Jeroboam munah, “Puanbek sawm nangma la in, banghang ziam cile Topa , Israel ii Pathian in nangma tungah, ‘Keima in Solomon khut sung pan kumpi ngam ka la tu a, nang sia mi nam sawm hong pia tu khi hi."},"32":{"text":"Ka naseampa David le Israel ngam bup sung pan ka khuapi tu ka tealsa Jerusalem ka khualna in, Solomon in nam khat keam lai tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Hi bangin seam tu khi hi, banghang ziam cile Solomon in kei hong nial in ngamdang pathiante: Sidon te ii numeipathian Astarte;, Moab te ii pathian Chemosh; Ammon te ii pathian Molech te bia hi. Solomon in ka thu hong ni ngawl hi; ama in khialna vawt zo hi, a pa David ii a zui bangin ka thukhamte le ka thupiakte zui ngawl hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahihang Solomon tung pan kumpi ngam bup la ngawl tu khi hi, a nuntak lai teng vaang nei in ka koi tu hi. Ka teal pa, ka thukhamte le ka thupiakte hong zui ka naseampa David ii hu in hi bangin vawt tu khi hi."},"35":{"text":"Solomon ii tapa tung pan kumpi ngam laaksak in no minam sawmte hong pia tu khi hi,"},"36":{"text":"ahihang Solomon ii tapa in nam khat ka keamsak tu hi, tuasia ciang ka naseampa David ii suan khat in kei hong kibiakna munin ka tealsa khuapi, Jerusalem panin a uk tawntung tu hi."},"37":{"text":"Jeroboam awng, nang sia Israel kumpipa hong suaksak tu khi hi, tuaciang ngam na dei zaza na uk tu hi."},"38":{"text":"ka thu a cing takin nong ni a, ka thukhamte taw nungta in, ka thupiak sia David ii hong nit bangin nong ni le nang taw kong omkhawm tawntung tu hi. Israel kumpipa kong suaksak tu a na suan le na paalte in nang zawkciang, David a tu ka vawt bangma in, ka uksak tu hi."},"39":{"text":"Solomon ii mawna hu in David ii suan le paalte daan ka pia tu hi, ahihang a tawntung hi ngawl tu hi, hong ci hi,” ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ahikom Solomon in Jeroboam thalup tu in hanciam ahihang Egypt kumpipa Shishak bealh in tua munah Solomon ii thi dong om hi."},"41":{"text":"Solomon ii sep le vawt dang teng theampo, a nuntak sung a sepna le a ciimna teng Solomon ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum siat hi.","title":"Solomon ii Thina (2 Khangtaanghthu 9:29-31)"},"42":{"text":"Ama in Jerusalem ah Israel bup uk in kum 40 kumpi seam hi."},"43":{"text":"Ama thi a, David Khuapi sungah kiphum hi, tuaciang a tapa Rehoboam in ama ii kumpi za laih hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rehoboam sia Shechem ah pai a, tua munah Israel saksang mite theampo in ama kumpi suaksak tu in kikhawm uh hi.","title":"Saksang Namte Tualngal Tho (2 Khangtaanghthu 10:1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Solomon kumpipa khut sung pan suakta tu in Egypt ngam ah a tai Nebat ii tapa Jeroboam in hi thu za a, Egypt ngam panin ama cia kik hi."},"3":{"text":"Saksang namte sung pan mite in ama samsak hi, tua zawkciang amate theampo Rehoboam kungah pai in ama tungah,"},"4":{"text":"“Na pa Solomon in ko hong siat vawt a, vanhngit pi hong suan hi. Hi vanhngitte nong zaangsak a, nuntakna a ol zawhiat tu in nong vawt le ko sia a thumaan na uk sung mite hi tu khu hi,” ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"“Ni thum zawkciang hong pai kik tavun, hong zo kik tu khi hi,” ci in ama in zo hi. Tua ahikom amate in nusia hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa Rehoboam in a pa Solomon ii thudok uhaamzawte dongh hi. Ama in, “Hi mite tungah bangbangin zo tu khi ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in, “Hi mite atu a pha in a na na sepsak nuam le amate ii hong ngetnate tungtaang ah zawp in, tua hile amate in thumaan takin nang na hong sepsak tawntung tu hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang ama in uhaamzawte ii ngaisut piakna sia melsia a, ama taw a khangkhawm, tu in a thudokin a koi khangmoite kungah pai zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka ngamtat natu in bangbangin ngaisutna hong pia tu nu ziam? A vanhngit uh zaangsak zaw tu in hong ngen mite tungah bangbangin ci tu khi ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in, “Amate tungah hi bangin ci in: ‘Ka khutme nobel sia ka pa kawng sangin lian zaw hi!’"},"11":{"text":"Amate tungah, ‘Ka pa in no, vanhngit hong suan hi; keima in tua sangin ngitsak zaw lai tu khi hi. Ama in khauhual kibul ciang taw hong saat hi; kei ka hi le siphu saatna taw hong vel tu khi hi va ci ta'n!’ ” ci in zo kik hi."},"12":{"text":"Ni thum zawkciang Jeroboam le mipite theampo Kumpipa Rehoboam kungah ama ii sawl bangin hong heak kik uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa in uhaamzawte ii ngaisutna piakte melsia in tua mite tungah,"},"14":{"text":"khangmoite ii ngaisut piak bangin aw ham taw pau hi. Ama in, “Ka pa in no vanhngit hong suan hi; tuate sangin a ngit zaw lai in ka vawt tu hi. Ama in khauhual kibul ciang taw hong saat hi; kei ka hile siphu velna taw kong vel tu hi!” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Shiloh panin kamsaang Ahijah tungtawn a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam tungah a sonsa, Topa ii deina sia a taangtun natu in a pau ahi hi. Hisia hu in kumpipa in mipite bangma thudon ngawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Mipite in kumpipa ii a thudon ngawl a mu uh ciang in amate au hi. David le a innkuante kiamsuk tahen! Ei atu amate in bang hong vawtsak ngei na ziam? Israel mite awng, cia lel tawng! Rehoboam sia ama le ama kikeam tahen!” ci uh hi. Tua ahikom Israel mite tualngal tho a,","ref":"2 Sa 20:1"},"17":{"text":"Rehoboam sia Judah ngam khen sungah a teang mite bek ii kumpipa tu in nusia uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Kumpipa Rehoboam in zawthawk thu taw a kisawl naseamte a uk Adoniram samin Israel te kungah paisak hi, ahihang amate in Adoniram suang taw deanglum uh hi. Tuasia ciang Rehoboam sia a siphu ngalleang tungah manlang takin kaato a, Jerusalem khua ah suakta hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua hun pan kipan Israel saksang kumpi ngammite in David ii kumpi nam sia leedo tan uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Israel mite in Jeroboam sia Egypt pan hong ciakik zo ci in a zaak uh ciang, amate in mipite kikhopna khat ah sam in, Israel kumpipa suaksak hi. Judah nam bek David ii suan le paalte tungah thumaan lai uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Rehoboam sia Jerusalem khua a thet ciangin ama in Judah nam le Benjamin namte sung pan ngalkap phabel 180,000 sam hi. Ama in saksang Israel namte simin uk kik sawm hi.","title":"Shemaiah ii Kamsaanna (2 Khangtaanghthu 11:1-4)"},"22":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in kamsaang pa Shemaiah kungah,"},"23":{"text":"Rehoboam, Judah le Benjamin namte theampo tungah hi thu puakin sawl hi:"},"24":{"text":"“Na suapui tilteal ahi Israel mite sim heak vun. Na vekpi inn ah cia kik vun. Thu piang sa sia keima ii deina hi,” cisak hi. Amate in Topa ii thupiakna mang siat in inn ah cia kik uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Jeroboam in Ephraim mualtung ngam ah Shechem khua kulh taw uumin tua munah tawmvei teang hi. Tua zawkciang ama in tua mun nusia in Penuel khua ah kulh vawt hi.","title":"Jeroboam in Topa Nungngat"},"26":{"text":"Ama le ama hi bangin kici hi, “Tu a thu omzia bangin ka mite Jerusalem khua ah pai in Topa atu sangaw biakpiaknate tua mun Biakinnpi sungah vawt thong le amate in Judah kumpipa Rehoboam panpui leleau tu a, kei hong that tu hi.”","merge":"27"},"28":{"text":"Khua a ngai susut zawkciang ama in khamh khuital no nii ii lim vawtin a mite tungah, “Biakna vawt tu in Jerusalem ah na pai zawk uh ngei zo hi. Israel mite awng, hi sungah Egypt pan hong pusuasak na pathiante om hi!” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 32:4"},"29":{"text":"Ama in a khamh khuital note khat Bethel ah koi a, khat sia Dan ah koi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuabangin mipite in biakpiakna pia tu in Bethel le Dan ah a pai hu in maw uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Jeroboam in mualdawnte ah biak natu munte zongh vawtin, Levi nam ahi ngawl innkuante sung panin thiampite teal hi."},"32":{"text":"Judah poaipi taw kibangin Jeroboam in biakna poaipi khat zongh tha liat tha, ni sawm le ni nga ni in phuan hi. Ama in Bethel biaknatau tungah a khamh khuitalno a vawtte a tu in biakpiaknate pia a, ama saksa Bethel biakna tu munte ah a seam tu in thiampite koi hi.","title":"Bethel ah Biakpiakna Kipuavawk"},"33":{"text":"Tuaciang tha liatna ni sawm le ni nga ni, ama ii see ni in, ama Bethel ah pai a. Israel te atu ama ii phot tawm poai khaamsak in biaknatau tungah sangaw biakpiakna khat pia hi.","ref":"Thiam 23:33-34"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa ii sawlna taw Judah panin kamsaang khat Bethel ah hong pai a, sangaw biakpiakna pia tu in Jeroboam biaknatau mai ah hong din laitak hong theng hi."},"2":{"text":"Topa ii sawlna zui in kamsaangpa in biaknatau sia siat son hi: “Oh biaknatau, biaknatau awng, hisia Topa ii pauna hi: David ii bangkua sungah Josiah a kici nausen khat hong piang tu hi. Ama in doai biaknataute tungah seam in nang tungah sangaw biakpiakna a vawt thiampite nangma tungah that tu a, mihing ngute nang tungah hal tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"2 Kum 23:15-16"},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang kamsaang pa in a ci lai na pan, “Hi biaknatau sia cimhtham tu a, a tungah vutte kithezau tu hi. Tuasia ciang Pathian in kei tungtawn a hong pau zo hi ci in na he tu hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa Jeroboam in hi thu a zaak ciang ama kawkin thupia hi: “Pasal ziasia man vun!” Thakhat thu in kumpipa ii baan zaw a, dok kik thei nawn ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Thakhat thu in biaknatau sia cimhtham a, Topa min taw kamsaang pa ii sonkhol bangma in vutte lei ah kithezau hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa Jeroboam in kamsaangpa munah, “Ka khut hong damsak natu in Topa na Pathian tungah nong hesuak na in thu hong ngetsak ta'n!” ci hi.
