Kamsaang pa in Topa tungah thu a nget le kumpipa baan dam hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuasia ciang kumpipa in kamsaangpa munah, “Kei taw cia khawm in bang khat po ne tawng. Na sepsa te hu in thaman hong pia tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Kamsaangpa in, “Na hauna a lang keak nong pia hial tu ahizong nang taw paikhawm ngawl tu khi hi, ahibuale zong nang taw bangma ne ngawl dawn ngawl tu khi hi,"},"9":{"text":"Topa in bangma ne ngawl dawn ngawl tu in thu hong pia a, kong paina lampi tawnin a ciakik ngawl tu in hong sawl hi,” ci in zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in a paina lampi pan ciakik ngawlin lampi dang khat tawn hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Bethel ah a teang kamsaang pasal huai khat om hi. A tapate hong pai a Judah pan a kamsaang khat ii Bethel ah a ngamtatna teng le Jeroboam kumpipa tungah a pauna teng ama munah son hi.","title":"Bethel pan Kamsaang Huaipa"},"12":{"text":"“A heakkik ciangin koisung tawn ziam” ci in kamsaang huaipa in amate dongh hi. Amate in a lampi lak a,"},"13":{"text":"tuaciang amate in a laa kungh thuasak in sawl hi. Amate in a sawl bang a vawt zawk uh ciang ama sia laa tungah to in pai a,"},"14":{"text":"Judah panin kamsaang pa ii nung pan a zui le oak thingkung nuai khat ah a to mu hi. “Nang Judah pan a kamsaangpa na hi ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Hi khi hi,” ci in pasalpa in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in, “Inn ah cia in, kei taw an nekhawm tawng,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang Judah panin kamsaangpa in “Nang taw cia khawmin nong zindo nopna hong saang zo ngawl tu khi hi, tuaciang hilai ah nang taw bangma nekhawm ngawl tu khi hi,"},"17":{"text":"banghang ziam cile Topa in bangma ka neak ka dawn ngawl natu le ka paina lam tawnin ka cia kik ngawl natu thu hong pia hi,” ci in zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Bethel pan kamsaang huai pa in ama munah, “Kei zongh nangma bangma kamsaang khat khi hi, tuaciang Topa ii sawlna taw vantunglalang khat in nang sia inn ah ciapui in zindo in hong sawl hi,” ci hi. Ahihang kamsaang huai pa sia leilot thu son ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom Judah pan kamsaangpa sia kamsaang huaipa taw ciakhawm in ama taw an nekhawm hi."},"20":{"text":"Sabuai ah an ne in a to laitak Topa kammal sia kamsaang huai pa tungah hong theng hi,"},"21":{"text":"tuaciang ama in tua Judah kamsaang pa tungah, “ Topa in ama ii thu ni ngawlin, a thupiak bang seam ngawl hi hong ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua taangin na heakkik a, an ne ngawl a hong sawlna munah tumin an na ne hi. Hi sia hangin nang sia thalup na thuak tu a, na luang sia na innkuan thaan ah kivui ngawl tu hi,” ci in au hi."},"23":{"text":"Anneak zawkciang kamsaang huai pa in Judah pan kamsaangpa atu a laa kungh thuasak a,"},"24":{"text":"ama sia laa tungah tosak hi. Lampi ah tawpi khat taw kisi a, tawpi in ama thatlum hi. A luang sia lampi tungah kisial a, a laa le tawpi te sia a luang hui ah ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhat in tua mun hong kaantan a, lampi tungah a luang mu uh hi, tawpi sia a kungah dingin om hi. Amate sia Bethel ah paisuak in, amate ii mu teng son hi."},"26":{"text":"Kamsaang huai pa in tua thu a zaak ciang, ama in, “Tuasia Topa ii thupiakna a ni ngawl kamsaang pa hi! Tua ahikom Topa in ama a that tu in tawpi paisak hi, Topa ii ka vawt tu a ci bangma in kivawt hi,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciang a tapate munah, “Ka laa kungh hong thuasak tavun,” ci hi. Amate in tuabangin seam uh a,"},"28":{"text":"tuaciang ama laa tungah to in a pai le kamsaang pa ii luang lampi ah kisial in mu hi, laa le tawpi zongh a kungah dingkhawm nginge lai hi. Tawpi in mithi luang le ne ngawl a, laa zongh bangma law ngawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua tungtangin a khuangai natu le a phum natu in kamsaang huai pa in a luang phaam a, laa tungah suanin Bethel ah ciapui hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama in a innkuan thaan ah phum a, tuaciang ama le a tapate khuangai in, “Oh, ka suapui, ka suapui awng!” ci hi."},"31":{"text":"A phum zawk uh ciang, kamsaangpa in a tapate munah, “Ka thi ciangin hi thaan sungah ama ii luang hui ah hong phum tavun."},"32":{"text":"Topa ii thupiakna taw Bethel ah biaknatau le Samaria khuate sungah a biakna munte langpanin a pau teng sia tung takpi tu hi,” ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Jeroboam in ama tatsiatnate kheal tuan ngawl a, ama saksa biaknataute ah thiampi seam tute sia bangkua thawthongte panin teal lai hi. Ama in thiampi a uuk pawpo thiampi in koi hi.","title":"Jeroboam ii Lalna piangsak Mawna"},"34":{"text":"Hi mawna in siatna le ama ii kinguizui kumpi ukna a bo cimitna suak hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Kumpipa Jeroboam ii tapa Abijah a ciina hi.","title":"Jeroboam ii Tapa Thina"},"2":{"text":"Jeroboam in a zi munah, “Nangma le nangma, kuama ii hong tel ngawl natu in kimealseal in a, kei sia Israel kumpipa suak tu hong ci, Shiloh a teang kamsaangpa Ahijah kungah va pai ta'n."},"3":{"text":"Anluum luum sawm, moh pawlkhat le khuaitui thawl khat va puak ta'n. Ih tapa bang suak tu ziam ama munah dongh ta'n, hong son tu hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama Shiloh khua Ahijah inn ah pai hi. Khanghaam zo ahikom Ahijah sia a mittaw hi."},"5":{"text":"A tapa ciina sia huvau dongh tu in Jeroboam ii zi sia ama kungah a pai tu hunlam Topa in son zo hi. Tuaciang Topa in Ahijah ii pau natu teng hil zo hi. Jeroboam ii zi hong thet ciangin, ama sia ngualdang khat bangin hong kivawt tawm hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang Ahijah in ama ii bangkua sung sangah hong tum a zaak ciang, “Hong tum ta'n, Jeroboam ii zi na hi sia hong he khi hi. Midang khat bangin banghangin kithoai ni ziam? Nang atu thupha ngawl kong son tu nei khi hi."},"7":{"text":"Pai in a Jeroboam munah va son ta'n, Israel ii Pathian Topa in ama tungah hi bangin ci hi: ‘Mite sung pan nang kong teal a, ka Israel mite uk pa in kong koi hi."},"8":{"text":"David suan le paalte khut sung panin kumpi ngam ka lakeak a, nang kong pia hi. Ahihang nang sia ka naseampa David bang na hi bua hi, ama sia kei tungah hong thumaan tinten a, ka thupiakte ni in, ka thukim teng bek seam hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang in na mai a ngamukte sangin mawna lianzawte na vawt hi. Nang in kei nong nial a, tuaciang ka thin uuk natu in milimte vawtin thik milimte na biak tu in na vawt hi."},"10":{"text":"Hi sia hu in na kumpi khang zui in tuasiatna kong tungsak tu a, tuaciang na suan na paal sung panin pa a minpiang a moi a haam a kibangin ka thatlum siat tu hi. Na bangkua kong heam tu a; eak bangin kiphiat keak tu hi.","ref":"1 Kum 15:29"},"11":{"text":"Khuapi sungah a thi na innkuanpuite sa sia ui in ne tu a, ngam taanzauna a thite sa sia vaciik in ne tu hi. Keima, Topa in pau zo khi hi,’ ” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaciang Ahijah in Jeroboam ii zi tungah a ci lai na pan, “Tu in inn ah cia ta'n. Khua sung na tum po ciangin na tapa thi tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel mi bup in ama atu khuangaina lakin phum tu hi. Jeroboam bangkua sung pan ama bekma pha takin kivui tu hi, banghang ziam cile ama ii tung bekma ah Israel ii Pathian Topa lungkim hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in Israel te tungah kumpi khat koi tu a, ama in Jeroboam ii kumpi khangngui sia bosak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in Israel daan pia tu a, tuaciang lui sungah pumpate bangin ngawk tu hi. A taanghpupite tungah a piaksa hi leitang phate tung panin ama in Israel mite zunglok tu a, Euphrates ngun kalhin thethaang tu hi, banghang ziam cile amate in Asherah numeipathian sia ii limte a vawt hu in ama a thin uuksak hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in Israel taisan tu hi banghang ziam cile Jeroboam in mawna vawt a, Israel mite mawna sungah lampui hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Jeroboam ii zi sia Tirzah ah ciakik hi. A inn sung a tum bek lian ciangin a tapa thi hi."},"18":{"text":"A naseam pa, kamsaangpa Ahijah tungah Topa ii sonkhol bangma in Israel mite ama atu khuangai in phum hi."},"19":{"text":"Jeroboam ii sep le vawt a dang theampo, a ngal dona ahizong a uk zia ahizong Israel kumpite ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi.","title":"Jeroboam ii Thina"},"20":{"text":"Jeroboam in kum 22 sung kumpi in maang hi. Ama thi in kiphum a, a tapa Nadab in a kumpi za laih hi."},"21":{"text":"Solomon ii tapa Rehoboam sia Judah kumpipa a sua lai in, kum 41 pha hi, tuaciang Israel ngam bup sungah Topa a kibiak natu mun Topa ii tealsa Jerusalem khuapi pan kum sawm le kum sali uk hi. Rehoboam ii nu sia Ammon panin Naamah ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Rehoboam (2 Khangtaanghthu 11:5—12:15)"},"22":{"text":"Judah mite in Topa tungah maw a, ama thin uuk natu in a taanghpupite theampo ii vawt sangin a tamzaw in vawt uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in pathian theamte biak natu in biakna munte vawt a, mualtung le thinglim nuaite ah biak tu in Asherah limte le suangkhuamte phut uh hi.","ref":"2 Kum 17:9-10"},"24":{"text":"A siatbelna sia, tua doai biakna munte ah numeite le pasalte sia pumpi zuakin om uh hi. Israel mite ii tua ngamsung a zot uh lai in Topa ii a nawkeak mite ii a maizumhuai ngamtatnate ma Judah mite in ngamtatna in nei uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 23:17"},"25":{"text":"Rehoboam ii uk zawk a kum ngana ciangin Egypt kumpipa Shishak in Jerusalem sim hi.","ref":"2 Khang 12:2-8"},"26":{"text":"Ama in Biakinnpi sung le kumpi inn sung a sumngum theampo la siat hi, tuate sungah Solomon ii vawt sa khamh lumte zongh kihel hi.","ref":"1 Kum 10:16-17; 2 Khang 9:15-16"},"27":{"text":"Tuate taangin Kumpipa Rehoboam in taau lumte vawt a, kumpi inn kongkhacing uliante tungah a kepcing tu in aap hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpipa Biakinnpi ah a pai simin a cingte in tua lumte paipui in, tua zawkciang a cingte omna inndoi ah ciapui kik uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Kumpipa Rehoboam ii sep le vawt dangte theampo sia Judah Kumpite Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"30":{"text":"Hi hunte theampo sungah Rehoboam le Jeroboam sia a tawntungin khat le khat kido uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Rehoboam thi a, David Khuapi sung kumpi thaan ah kiphumin, a tapa Abijah in a kumpi za laih hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Jeroboam ii maan zawk a kum sawm le liatna ciangin Abijah sia Judah kumpipa suak a,","title":"Judah Kumpipa Abijah (2 Khangtaanghthu 13:1—14:1)"},"2":{"text":"tuaciang, ama in Jerusalem panin kum thum sung uk hi. Ama ii nu sia Absalom ii tanu Maacah ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in a pa ii a vawt mawnate ma vawtin, a pu selawn David bangin Topa a Pathian tungah thumaan siat zo ngawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang David hangin Topa a Pathian in ama zawkciang Jerusalem a uk tu le Jerusalem ngammuangsak tu in Abijah sia tapa khat pia hi.","ref":"1 Kum 11:36"},"5":{"text":"Topa in hi bangin a vawt sia banghang ziam cile David in ama ii lungkimte bek seam a, Hit mi Uriah taw a vai khat simngawl po, a thukham peuma zui ngawl nei ngeingawl hi.","ref":"2 Sa 11:1-27"},"6":{"text":"Abijah ii khan hunsung theampo ma Rehoboam le Jeroboam ii hun pan a kipan kidona sia kizom suak lai hi.","ref":"2 Khang 13:3-21"},"7":{"text":"Tuaciangin Abijah ii sep le vawt dangte theampo sia Judah Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum siat hi."},"8":{"text":"Abijah thi in David Khuapi sungah kiphum hi, tuaciang a tapa Asa in ama kumpi za laih hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Jeroboam ii maan zawk a kum kul na ciangin Asa sia Judah kumpipa suak hi,","title":"Judah Kumpipa Asa (2 Khangtaanghthu 15:16—16:6)"},"10":{"text":"tuaciangin ama in Jerusalem ah kum 41 sung uk hi. A pi sia Absalom ii tanu Maacah ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"A taanghpupi David ii ngamtat bangin Asa in Topa lungkim tu in ngamta hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in ngamsung panin numei le pasal pumpi zuak a, doai biakna munte ah a om theampo hawlkhia hi, tuaciang ama ii mai ah a seamte ii vawt milim theampo heam hi.","ref":"2 Khang 15:8-15"},"13":{"text":"Ama in a pi Maacah sia, kumpinu ii nu a hina panin heam hi, banghang ziam cile ama in ta tam nei natu a siam Asherah numeipathian ii a kiihuai milim khat vawt hi. Asa in tua milim sia sattan in Kidron kuam ah hal hi."},"14":{"text":"Asa in doai biakna mun theampo susia ngawl ahihang Topa tungah a nuntak tawntung thumaan top hi."},"15":{"text":"Biakinnpi sungah a pa ii Pathian atu a piaktuam na teng le khamh le ngunn taw a kivawt ama ii piaktuam nate zongh koi hi."},"16":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Asa le Israel kumpipa Baasha sia vaang a nei uh lai teng in kido tawntung hi."},"17":{"text":"Baasha in Judah sim a, Judah ngam pan a pusuak a sungtang thei te theampo a khatan natu in Ramah sia kulh taw uum hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom Kumpipa Asa in Biakinnpi le kumpi inn sung a khamh le ngunn a om laiteng la in Damascus ah, Tabrimmon ii tapa, Hezion tupa, Syria kumpipa Benhadad kungah a uliante pawl khat in puaksak a, hi bang kam teng taw thaak hi:"},"19":{"text":"“Ih pate sia ngal a kipawl ahi bangma ei zongh kipawl khawm tawng. Hi ngunn le khamhte sia nangma atu letsong kong piak hi. Tu in ka ngamsung pan a ngalkapte a laak kik nanak natu in, Israel kumpipa Baasha taw na kipawl na sia na pheltan in,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Benhadad kumpipa in Asa ii ci teng thukim a, Israel khuapite sim tu in ngalkap ukte le ngalkaphonpite kuansak hi. Amate in Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maacah, Galilee Tuili hui ngam teng, Naphtali ngam bup la hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpipa Baasha in thupiang teng a zaak ciang Ramah khua ah a kulhpi vawt teng tawpin Tirzah zuan hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Kumpipa Asa in Judah ngam bup ah khat zongh kikhe ngawlin, Baasha ii kulh vawtna a zak suang le thingte Ramah panin puasiat tu in thupia hi. Asa in Mizpah le Benjamin ngam ah Geba khuapi sia hi vanhte taw ngalnanna kulh in vawt hi."},"23":{"text":"Asa ii a sep a vawt dang theampo, a hanna le kulh a vawt khuate ii thu teng Judah Kumpipate ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi. Ahihang a khanhaam ciangin ama sia peang natna taw zawcip hi."},"24":{"text":"Asa thi a, David Khuapi sung kumpi thaan ah kiphum hi, tuaciang a tapa Jehoshaphat in a kumpi za laih hi."},"25":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Asa ii maan zawk a kum niina hun sungah Kumpipa Jeroboam ii tapa Nadab sia Israel kumpipa hong suak a kum nii sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Nadab"},"26":{"text":"Ama ii mai ah a pa bangma in Topa tungah ama maw a, Israel te mawna sungah lampui hi."},"27":{"text":"Issachar nam Ahijah ii tapa Baasha in Nadab thasawm in, Nadab le a ngalkaphonpi in Philistia ngam Gibbethon khuapi a uumci laitakin ama thatlum hi."},"28":{"text":"Hi thu sia Kumpipa Asa ii Judah ah a maan zawk a kum thumna sungah piang hi. Tua bangin, Baasha in Nadab ii Israel kumpi za laih hi."},"29":{"text":"Thakhat thu in ama in Jeroboam ii innkuanpuite that siat hi, Shiloh pan kamsaang pa Ahijah ii Topa kammal a sonsa bang tatakin Jeroboam ii innkuanpui teng that siat a; khat zongh khe ngawl hi.","ref":"1 Kum 14:10"},"30":{"text":"Hi bang a pian sia banghang ziam cile Jeroboam in Israel ii Pathian Topa sia ama mawna hang le Israel mite mawna a vawtsak hu in thin uuksak ahi hang hi."},"31":{"text":"Nadab ii a sep a vawt dang theampo sia Israel Kumpite ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"32":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Asa le Israel kumpipa Baasha te ngeal sia a vaang nei uh lai teng khat le khat kido tan uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Asa ii maan zawk a kum thumna ah Ahijah ii tapa Baasha sia Israel kumpipa suak a, Tirzah panin kum 24 sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Baasha"},"34":{"text":"Ama ii mai ah Kumpipa Jeroboam bangma in Topa tungah ama maw a, Israel te mawna sungah lampui hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hanani ii tapa kamsaang pa Jehu tungah Baasha atu kam hi teng Topa in pau hi:"},"2":{"text":"“Nang sia bangma ahi ngawl khat hi napi ka Israel mite lampui in hong koi khi hi. Tuaciang tu in nang zongh Jeroboam bangma in mawna na vawt a, ka mite mawna sungah lampui zo ni hi. Amate ii mawnate in kei hong thin uuksak hi,"},"3":{"text":"tua ahikom Jeroboam ka vawt bangma in nang le na bangkua kong heam tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Na innkuanpuite khuapi sungah a thi peuma ui in ne tu a, ngam taanzauna sungah a thi peuma vaciik in ne tu hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Baasha ii a sep a vawt dang theampo Israel Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"6":{"text":"Baasha thi a Tirzah ah kiphum hi, tuaciang a tapa Elah in a kumpi za laih hi."},"7":{"text":"Baasha le a bangkua langpanna, tua Topa kammalte sia kamsaangpa Jehu in pia hi, banghang ziam cile Baasha in Topa tungah mawna vawt hi. Ama in Topa thin uuksak hi, banghang ziam cile ama in tatkhakna sia ama mai a, Jeroboam vawt bangin a vawt dom ngawlin, Jeroboam ii innkuanpuite theampo zongh that siat hi."},"8":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Asa ii maan zawk a kum 26 na in, Baasha ii tapa Elah sia Israel kumpipa suakin Tirzah pan kum nii sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Elah"},"9":{"text":"A uliante khat, kumpipa siphu ngalleangte ii kimkhen khat a ukpa Zimri in ama suam sawm hi. Ni khat ni in Tirzah ah Elah sia kumpi inn ukpa Arza ii inn ah zu kham hi."},"10":{"text":"Zimri sia inn sungah tum a, Elah suamlum in kumpi za laih hi. Hi bang a pian hun sia Judah kumpipa Asa a maan zawk kum 27 na kum ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Zimri kumpi a sua po ciangin Baasha ii innkuanpuite theampo thatlum siat hi. A mealheak le a lawm ahi theampo pasal a minpiang thatlumsak siat hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuabangin kamsaangpa Jehu tungtawnin Topa ii Baasha huvau a son bang tatakin Zimri in Baasha innkuanpui theampo thatlum siat hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate ii milim a biak hu le Israel mite mawna sung a thet pui hu in Baasha le a tapa Elah in Israel ii Pathian, Topa a thin uuksak hi."},"14":{"text":"Elah ii sep le vawt a dangte theampo Israel Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum siat hi."},"15":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Asa maan zawk kum 27 na ciang Zimri in Tirzah pan Israel sia ni sali sung uk hi. Israel ngalkapte in Philistia ngam Gibbethon khuapi uumci uh hi,","title":"Israel Kumpipa Zimri"},"16":{"text":"tuaciang amate in Zimri ii kumpipa a suamlup a zaak uh ciang, tua hun tua munah amate ngalkap ukpa Omri sia Israel kumpipa in thangsak uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Omri le a ngalkapte in Gibbethon nusia in Tirzah ah pai a uumci uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Zimri in khuapi sia kila zo ci in a mu ciang kumpi inn ii a sungsang kulh ah tumin kumpi inn hal a, ama zongh meikuang sungah thi hi."},"19":{"text":"Hi bangin a pian sia ama in Topa tungah a maw hang hi. Ama mai ah a maang Jeroboam bangma in ama mawna hu le Israel mite mawna sungah a lampui hu in, Topa lungkim ngawlna piang hi."},"20":{"text":"Zimri ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo a sawmna thu zongh Israel Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum siat hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel mite sia kikhen hi: pawlkhat te in Ginath ii tapa Tibni kumpi suaksak nuam a, a dangte in Omri dei uh hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Omri"},"22":{"text":"A khakbel ciang Omri deite in zo zaw hi; Tibri thi a, Omri sia kumpi suak hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuabangin Judah kumpipa Asa maan zawk a kum 31 na kumin Omri sia Israel kumpipa suak hi, tuaciang ama in kum sawm le kum nii sung uk hi. A masa kum luk teng sia ama in Tirzah pan uk a,"},"24":{"text":"tua zawkciang Samaria ngam mual khat sia Shemer a kici pasal khat ii tung pan ngunntang 6,000 taw lei hi. Omri in tua mual sia kulh vawt in tua munah khua khat saat a, a min sia mual nei lui pa min Shemer la in Samaria phuak hi."},"25":{"text":"Omri in ama mai a te sangin Topa tungah a nasia zawin maw hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama ii mai ah Jeroboam bangma in ama mawna te hu le a mite sia mawna le milim biakna sungah a thet pui hu in Israel ii Pathian Topa thin uukna piangsak hi."},"27":{"text":"Omri ii a sep a vawt dangte le ama zawnate sia Israel Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"28":{"text":"Omri thi a, Samaria ah kiphumin, a tapa Ahab in a kumpi za laih hi."},"29":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Asa ii maan zawk a kum 38 na kumin Omri ii tapa Ahab sia Israel kumpipa suak a, Samaria ah kum 22 sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Ahab"},"30":{"text":"Ama in ama ii mai a kumpi dangte sangin Topa tungah mawna tam vawtzaw hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama atu in Kumpipa Jeroboam bangin a maw tu sia pha zo sa ngawl hi; ama in tua kaanin ngamta a, Jezebel a kici Sidon kumpipa Ethbaal ii tanu teenpui in Baal pathian bia hi."},"32":{"text":"Ama in Samaria ah Baal atu biakinn saksakin, biaknatau khat vawtin biakinn sungah koi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in numeipathian Asherah milim khat zongh vawt hi. Israel ii Pathian Topa thin uuk natu in ama ii masia a, Israel kumpi theampo sangin ama in vawt zaw lai hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama ii maan sungin Bethel panin Hiel in Jericho sa kik hi. Nun ii tapa Joshua tungah Topa ii sonkhol bangma in Hiel in a tapa lianbel Abiram sia Jericho khua ii tawdap a vawt laitakin thi sua a, tuaciang a tapa a nobel Segub zong kongpite a vawt ciang thisua hi.","ref":"Jos 6:26"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gilead ngam Tishbe panin Elijah a kici kamsaangpa in Ahab kumpipa munah, “A na ka sepsak Israel te ii a nungta Pathian, Topa min taw keima in nang tungah kong sonna pan keima ii kong son kik mateng kum nii ahibuale kum thum sung daaitui ahizong, nguatui ahizong hang tu hi,” ci hi.","title":"Elijah le Nguatui Han hun","ref":"Jas 5:17"},"2":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa in Elijah munah,"},"3":{"text":"“Hi mun nusia in a, nisuana sangah pai in Cherith luino hui ah buu ta'n."},"4":{"text":"Tua luino in na zak tu tui hong sik tu a, tuaciang va-akte in nangma tua munah an hong puak tu in thupia zo khi hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Elijah in Topa ii thupiakna zui in, Cherith luino ah pai in tua munah taam hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Luitui dawnin, va-akte in zing sim nitak simin anluum le sa puak hi."},"7":{"text":"Tawm vei zawkciang nguatui kisap hu in lui sia kang hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa in Elijah munah,","title":"Zarephath a Meingong nu le Elijah"},"9":{"text":"“Tu in Sidon nai ah a om Zarephath khua ah pai in a, tua munah om ta'n. Tua munah meingong nupi khat nang an hong vaak tu in thupia zo khi hi” ci hi.","ref":"Lk 4:25-26"},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom Elijah sia Zarephath ah pai a, khua kongpi a thet ciang, meingongnu khat thingtom in om mu hi. Ama in, “Tui neak khat hong puak ta'n,” tua nu tungah ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tui laksak tu in a pai ciang, “Nong hesuakna in anluum zongh hong paipui ta'n,” ci thua hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in, “Anluum nei ngawl het khi hi ci in a nungta Topa na Pathian min taw ka kiciam ngam hi. Ka nei theampo sia kuang sungah anvui khut hum khat le thawl sungah olive thau tawmcik bek hi. Hi sungah kong pai sia thing tawm tom a ciapui in, ka nei sun teng ka tapa le keima neak tu in vawt tu khi hi. Tuasia koma an neak khakbel hi tu a, tua zawkciang pukthi tu khu hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Elijah in, “Thintoi heak in, va pai ta'n a, an na vawt ta'n. Ahihang a masa phitin na nei sung pan kei atu anluumno khat hong vawtsak ta'n a, kei hong puak ta'n, tua zawkciang nang le na tapa atu a om lai teng vawt in."},"14":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile hisia sia Topa, Israel te ii Pathian ii pauna hi: ‘Kuang sungah anvui thot ngeingawl tu a, thawl sungah sathau sia, keima Topa ii nguatui ka puak ni mateng kang ngeingawl tu hi,’ ” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Meingong nu in Elijah sawl bangin pai in ngamta a, tuaciang amate in ni tam mama sung a khom tu an nei uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa ii Elijah tungtawn a kamciam a piak bangin, kuang sungah anvuite thot ngawlin, thawl sungah sathau a kang bua hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua zawk tawmvei ciangin meingong nu ii tapa a ci na hi; ama zawm vaial in a khakbel ciang thi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in Elijah munah, “Pathian mipa awng, banghangin hi bangin kei hong vawt ni ziam? Hi sungah nong pai sia ka mawna teng Pathian in phawksak a, ka tapa thi natu in hong vawt ni ziam?” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Elijah in, “Patang sia keima hong pia ta'n,” ci hi. Ama in patang sia a khut sung pan la a, ama ii omna inn tung inndoi ah toai to in, lupna tungah sial hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua zawkciang nging takin thungen a, “Oh, Topa ka Pathian awng, banghangin hi bang meingongnu tungah a lauhuai mama in vawt ni ziam? Ama dik a kei hong vaak kasap tu in a tapa thalupsak ni hi!” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Elijah in patang sia tungah thumvei bokin kizalh a, “Oh, Topa ka Pathian awng, hi patang a nuntakna pia kik in!” ci in thungen hi.","ref":"2 Kum 4:34-35"},"22":{"text":"Topa in Elijah ii thungetna zo a; patang sia a hu hong sang kikin hong nungta kik hi."},"23":{"text":"Elijah in patangpa sia inn nuaidawl a nu kungah paipui suk kikin a nu munah, “En in, na tapa nungta hi!” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in, “Tu ahile nang sia Pathian ii mi khat hi a, tuaciang Topa in nang tungtawnin hong pau takpi hi, ci in hong he khi hi,” ci in zo hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nguatui a hanh zawk kum thum a phak zawk hiat ciangin Topa in Elijah munah, “Va pai ta'n a, Kumpipa Ahab mai ah kilak ta'n, tuaciang ngua kong zusak tu hi,” ci hi.","title":"Elijah le Baal Kamsaangte"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom Elijah hong kipan hi. Samaria a kialpi tung sia a nasia bel laitak ahi hi,"},"3":{"text":"tua ahikom Ahab in kumpi inn a uk pa Obadiah sam hi. (Obadiah sia Topa a bia thu um khat hi a,"},"4":{"text":"Jezebel in Topa ii kamsaangte a thalup lai in, Obadiah in tua kamsaangte zakhat la in, suanghawng sungah pawl khat ciang 50 veu khen in pawl nii in seal a, an le tui sik hi.)"},"5":{"text":"Ahab in Obadiah munah, “Ih siphute le laate a nungta in ih kep thei natu in lopa a kicing ih mu zo ziam maw, ngamsung tuinaak theampo le ngun omna theampo ah pai in zong sin tawng. Ih ngannote khat zongh ih thalup kul ngawl tha tu hi,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate ngamsung koisungsan ah akua pai in zong tu ziam ci in thukimna vawt a, mun tuatuam ah vaiding tek uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Obadiah in a paina lam tungah thakhat thu in Elijah taw kisi hi. Ama in tel a, ama ii mai ah a niamin kunsuk a, “Topa awng, nangma tatak ma ni ziam,” ci in dongh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in, “Hi khi hi, keima Elijah khi hi” ci in zo hi. “Pai in a, na topa, kumpipa munah hi sungah ka om hunlam va son ta'n,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Obadiah in, “Kumpipa Ahab ii hong thalup tu launa sungah nong koi natu in bang khialna nei khi ziam?"},"10":{"text":"A nungta Topa, na Pathian taw kiciam ngam khi hi, leitung ngam theampo ah kumpipa in nang hong zongsak zo hi. Ngam khat a ukpa in nang sia ama ii ngam sungah om ngawl hi ci in thu a puak le Ahab in tua ngam ah nang hong kimu zawk ngawlna thu sia tua ngamukpa kiciamsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaciang tu in nang hi sungah na om sia son tu in ama kungah pai le hong oai ni ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Ka pai po ciang Pathian ii thaa in nang sia heak ngeingawlna mundang khat pawpo ah hong tua luilam le bang law tu khi ziam? Tuasia ciang Ahab munah nang hi sungah om hi ka ci ciang, ama in hong mu zo buale kei hong thatlum tu hi. Ka no ciang a thu um, Topa a biapa ka hi hunlam sia ciamtee in."},"13":{"text":"Jezebel in Topa kamsaangte a thalup lai in amate suanghawng sungah 50 veu pawl nii sua in, zakhat ka seal a, an le tui ka vaakna thu za ngeingawl ni ziam?"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom bangbangin nang hi sungah na omna thu kumpipa kungah son tu in hong sawl thei ni ziam! Ama in kei hong that tu hi!” ci in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Elijah in, “A na a seam keima in a nungta Topa taw kiciam khi hi, kumpipa mai ah tu ni kilak tu in kiciam khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom Obadiah in Ahab kumpipa kungah pai in a son ciang, Ahab sia Elijah taw kimu tu in vaiding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahab in a mu ciangin ama munah, “Zialai ah nang — Israel ngam sungah ngimna a nasiabel a piangsak pa om na hi ziam!” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"“Kei ngimna a piangsak pa hi ngawl khi hi,” ci in Elijah in zo hi. “Nangma ni hi — nangma le na pa na hi uh hi. Nangma in Topa ii thupiakte zui ngawlin Baal milimte bia ni hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu in Israel mite theampo kei taw Carmel mual ah kisi tu in thupia in. Baal kamsaang 450 le numeipathian Asherah kamsaang 400, kumpinu Jezebel ii a vaak teng hong paipui tavun,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahikom Ahab in Israel mite theampo le Baal kamsaangte sia Carmel Mual ah sam hi."},"21":{"text":"Elijah in mite kungah paito in, “Na thin uh na khensat natu in bang tanvei hai lai tu nu ziam? Topa sia Pathian ahile ama bia vun; ahihang Baal sia Pathian ahile bia vun!” ci hi. Ahihang mite in kam khat zongh pau ngawl uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Elijah in, “ Topa kamsaang sia kei bekma taanglai khi hi, ahihang Baal kamsaangte sia 450 om hi."},"23":{"text":"Khuital nii hong paipui tavun; Baal kamsaangte in khat lasak vun a, tua sia ngoin, semneen in thingkangte tungah koisak vun — ahihang meitaw heak vun. Keima in khuital dang khat sia tuabang ma in ka vawt tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Baal kamsaangte in amate ii pathian tungah thu ngen hen, tuaciang keima in Topa tungah thu ka ngen tu a, tuaciang meikuang hong puakna taw thunget hong zo pa — ama sia Pathian hi,” ci hi. Mipite lungkim in au uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaciang Elijah in Baal kamsaangte munah, “No tam mama na hi uh ciang, noma khuital khat la in kinging khol masa vun. Noma pathian tungah thungen vun, ahizong thingkang te tungah meitaw heak vun,” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate kungah a kipaipui khuital sia amate in la a, a vawt tu bang vawtin nisun dong Baal tungah thu ngen uh hi. Amate in, “Hong zo ta'n, Baal awng!” ci in au a, amate ii a sak biaknatau sia ii kiimkot ah laam top uh hi. Ahihang zona hong pai bua hi."},"27":{"text":"Sun hun ciang Elijah in amate nunau tu hong kipan hi: “A nging zaw in thungen ve vun! Ama sia pathian khat hi! Ama mangngai in om ziam, awnghaw ziam, tua ahibuale khualhaw ziam khat hi thei tu hi! Tua ahibuale zong a mut laitak hi thei tu hi, na phok uh kul tu hi!” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom kamsaangte in nging zaw lai in thu hong ngen in, amate ii zeksa ngeina om bangin naamte, naamzumte taw amate le amate chisan a luan dongin ki at uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Sun ni kaai dongin amate au lialua in om top lai uh hi; ahihang zona hong pai ngawl a, aw khat zongh kiza ngawl hi."},"30":{"text":"Elijah in mipite munah, “Ka kung nai hong neak zaw tavun,” a ci ciang amate in ama kiimkot ah kikhawm uh hi. Topa biaknatau a kibaltham sia hong pua kik hi."},"31":{"text":"Israel ci in Topa ii Israel min a piakpa Jacob tate min a kivaw nam sawm le nam nii sim atu in suangtum sawm le nii la hi.","ref":"Pian 32:28; 35:10"},"32":{"text":"Hi suangte taw ama in Topa biak natu biaknatau sa kik hi. Ama in tua kiimkot ah tui litre 14 dektak a ta thei tu dum to hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in thingkangte biaknatau tungah koi in, khuital sia semneen a, thingkangte tungah koi hi. Ama in, “Tui pheal li hong dim tavun, a biakpiakna tung le thing tungah hong sung tavun,” ci hi. Amate in tuabang ma in vawt a,"},"34":{"text":"tuaciang ama in, “Hi kik vun,” ci hi — amate in sung kik hi. Ama in, “Khatvei ma hi lai vun,” ci hi — tuaciang amate in tuabang ma seam uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tui sia biaknatau kiim ah hong luang a, dum sung hong dim hi."},"36":{"text":"Nikai sang sangaw biakpiakna hun tak ciang Elijah in biaknatau neak in thungen hi. “Oh Topa , Abraham, Isaac le Jacob te ii Pathian awng, tu in nang Israel ii Pathian hi a, tuaciang kei sia na naseampa ka hina taw nong sawl bangin hi bang teng ngamta ka hina thu sia hong lak ta'n."},"37":{"text":"Hong zo ta'n Topa , kei hong zo ta'n, tua hile hi mite in nang Topa Pathian hi a, tuaciang amate nang kungah heak kiksak tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Topa in meikuang hong puaksuk a, sangaw biakpiakna, thingkangte, suangtumte kaanghtham in, lei zongh kaangh upsak a, dum sungah tuite kosak hi."},"39":{"text":"Mipite in hisia a mu uh ciang amate le amate lei ah hong bok suk a, “ Topa sia Pathian hi; Topa bekma Pathian hi!” ci in au uh hi"},"40":{"text":"Elijah in thupia a, “Baal kamsaangte man vun; kuama suaktasak heak vun!” ci hi. Mipite in amate man siat a, tuaciang Elijah in Kishon Ngun ah paipui sukin amate thatlum hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Elijah in Kumpipa Ahab kungah, “Tu in va pai ta'n a, an va ne ta'n. Nguazu nuam kisa in a hawk bangza khi hi,” ci hi.","title":"Nguatui Kanna Veng"},"42":{"text":"Ahab an ne tu a pai laitakin Elijah sia Carmel Mualdawn ah kaato a, lei ah kun sukin, a khup sungah a lu phum hi.","ref":"Jas 5:18"},"43":{"text":"A naseampa munah, “Va pai ta'n a, tuipi sang va en ta'n,” ci hi. A naseampa pai a hong heak kik in, “Bangma mu bong,” ci hi. Salivei vaset Elijah in a naseampa pai in en a sawl hi."},"44":{"text":"A sali veina ciangin ama hong heakkik a, “Meeikaai no khat mihing khut saang a lianzaw ngawl khat tuipi panin hong paito ka mu hi,” ci hi. Elijah in a naseampa thupia a, “Kumpipa Ahab kungah va pai ta'n a, ama siphu ngalleang sungah to in, ngua ii khaktan ma inn ah a ciakik natu va son ta'n,” ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Hun tawm no sungin van sia meeivom dim in, vui va a, ngua nasia takin zuk tu kipan hi. Ahab zongh siphu ngalleang sungah to in, Jezreel ah cia kik hi."},"46":{"text":"Topa ii thahatna Elijah tungah hong theng a; ama in a puante a kawng ah ngat takin sawmin, Jezreel a thet dong Ahab ii mai ah tai hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Ahab in a zi Jezebel munah, Elijah ii ngamtatna theampo son a, Baal kamsaang theampo a thalup na thu teng son siat hi.","title":"Sinai Mual ah Elijah"},"2":{"text":"Tua nu in Elijah kam khat thaak hi: “Kamsaangte tungah na vawt bang keak in zing ciang tu hunin nang tungah kong vawt bua tale pathiante in kei hong vaatlum tahen,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Elijah lau a, a nuntakna kihuk natu in, a naseampa taw Judah ngam Beersheba zuan in tai hi. A naseampa tua munah nusia a,"},"4":{"text":"Elijah sia nitangtum duisung ah a peangin pai hi. Ama in thinglim nuai khat ah tawlnga in to a, tuaciang thithei le uuk hi. “Nasia leih hi, Topa awng, ka nuntakna hong laaksak ta'n; thi leng zong phazaw tu hi,” ci in thungen hi.","ref":"Jon 4:3"},"5":{"text":"Ama in thingkung nuai ah lumin mu hi. Thakhat thu in vantunglalang khat in tham a, tuaciang, “Tho in a ne in,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"A kiimkot a et ciang a luthung ah anluum khat le tuidam thawl khat mu hi. Ama in tuate ne a, tua zawkciang lum kik hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa ii vantunglalang heakkik in a nii veina in phong a, “Tho in a, an ne in, tua ahibuale na khualhaw natu sia nang atu haksa lei tu hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Elijah tho in a neak ciang tua an in ni 40 sung mual thiangtho Sinai dong a pai khom natu thangui thatang nguan hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua munah zan ngiak tu in suanghawng khat ii sungah tum hi. Thakhat thu in Topa in, “Elijah, hi sungah bang vawt ni ziam?” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in, “ Topa Pathian Vaanglianbelpa awng, nangma ii na — nangma bekma ii na hong sepsak tawntung khi hi. Ahihang Israel mite in nang taw a thuciamna paltan in, na biaknataute baltham a, na kamsaangte thatlum siat hi. Keima bekma taanglai khi hi — tuaciang amate in kei hong that nuam in hanciam uh hi!” ci in zo hi.","ref":"Rom 11:3"},"11":{"text":"Topa in ama tungah “Pusuak in a, mualdawn keima mai ah hong ding ta'n,” ci hi. Tua zawkciang Topa in kaantan a, vuipi nasia mama khat vasak in, mualnote kikhenthamsak a, suangtumpuite neenthamsak hi — ahihang tua vui sungah Topa om ngawl hi. Vui vak thim a, tua zawkciang zinliing hi — ahihang zinliing na sungah Topa om ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Zinliin zawkciang meikuang khat om a, — ahihang tua meikuang sungah Topa om ngawl hi. Tua meikuang sia zawkciangin kihuauna awneal no khat za hi."},"13":{"text":"Elijah in tua a zaak ciang a maitang a puantual taw sealin pusuak a suanghawngkua mai ah ding hi. Aw khat in ama tungah, “Elijah, hi sungah bang hi ni ziam?” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in, “ Topa Pathian Vaanglianbelpa nangma ii na — nangma bekma ii na hong sepsak tawntung khi hi. Ahihang Israel mite in nang taw a thuciamna paltan in, na biaknataute baltham a, na kamsaangte thatlum siat hi, Keima bekma taanglai khi hi — tuaciang amate in kei hong that nuam in hanciam hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in ama munah, “Damascus naina duisung ah heak kik ta'n a, khuapi sungah tumin, Hazael sia Syria kumpipa tu in sathau noai ta'n;","ref":"2 Kum 8:7-13"},"16":{"text":"Nimshi ii tapa Jehu sia Israel kumpipa tu in sathau noai ta'n, tuaciang Abel Meholah pan a, Shaphat ii tapa Elisha sia nang hong laih kamsaang tu in sathau noai ta'n.","ref":"2 Kum 9:16"},"17":{"text":"Hazael ii thalup natu pan a suakta a om le Jehu in thatlum tu a, Jehu ii thalup tu pan a suakta a om le Elisha in thatlum tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahihang Israel ngam ah a nungta in mihing tulsali khe lai tu khi hi — tuate sia kei tungah hong thumaan theampo le Baal mai ah a kun ngawl, a milim a namh ngawlte ahi uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Rom 11:4"},"19":{"text":"Elijah in tua mun nusia in a pai le Elisha sia khui kap taw lotho in a om mu hi; ama mai ah kap sawm le kap khat om a ama sia a khakbel kap sia taw lotho hi. Elijah in a puantual suut a Elisha silhsak hi.","title":"Elisha a Sapna"},"20":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Elisha in a khuitalte nusia in Elijah del a, “Ka pa le ka nu ka vaithakna in va namh phot tong, tua zawkciang nangma taw tonkhawm tu khi hi,” ci hi. Elijah in, “Pha hi, cia kik ta'n. Hong khaam ngawl khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Elisha sia ama ii khuikaapte ngoin, a khui hakkolte mei thuna thingin zangh in a sa huan hi. Ama in a sa sia mipite hawmsak a, ne uh hi. Tua zawkciang ama in Elijah ii hupa in a nungzui hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Syria kumpipa Benhadad in a ngalkap theampo khawm a, ngam uk 32 te ii huna siphu le siphu ngalleang te taw kuanto in Samaria khuapi uumci in sim hi.","title":"Syria te taw Kidona"},"2":{"text":"Ama in khuapi sungah kamtaite paisak in Israel kumpipa Ahab munah, “Kumpipa Benhadad in"},"3":{"text":"ama tungah na ngunn, na khamh, na numeite le na tate a hatbel teng taw na lut tu hong tangkal hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahab in “Kumpipa Benhadad ka topa munah ka lungkimna thu son tavun; ama in kei le ka neisa theampo tang thei hi,” ci in zo hi."},"5":{"text":"A zawkciang kamtaite in, Benhadad tung pan ngetna dang khat taw Ahab kungah hong heak kik uh hi. “Na ngunn, na khamh, na numeite le na tate nong aap natu kam hong thaak khi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahizong tu in, ka uliante kong paisak tu a, na kumpi inn le na uliante ii innte tok in, manpha a sak theampo la tu hi. Amate zing ciang tubang hun khawngin hong theng tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa Ahab in ngamsung a lampui theampo samin, “Na mu uh hi a, hisia pa in ei hong susia nuam hi. Ama in kam hong thaak a, ka zite ka tate le ka ngunn ka khamh teng hong ngen hi, tuaciang kei lungkim khi hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Lampuite le mipite in, “Ama bangma awlmaw heak in; lut heak in!” ci in zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom Ahab in Benhadad ii kamtaite munah, “Hong nget masak teng thukim khi hi, ahihang a niina sia thukim zo ngawl khi hi, ka topa kumpipa munah va ci tavun,” ci in zo kik hi. Kamtaite va pai a, tua zawkciang hong heak kikin"},"10":{"text":"Benhadad tung pan kamthaak dang khat hong keng hi: “Na khuapi hisia a susia zo tu le amate khut tek taw suangbek teng a vawk siat zo tu mihing a khom kong paipui tu hi. Tuabangin ka ngamta bua ta le pathiante in hong vaatlum tahen!” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa Ahab in, “Kumpipa Benhadad munah son tavun a, ngalkap citak khat in ngal kido zawkciang kisuangtaak pheang a, kido ma in kisuangtaak ngawl hi,” ci in zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Benhadad in Ahab ii zona kam sia ama le a kipawlpui ngamuk dangte taw a puanbukte sungah zu a neak laitakin kison hi. Ama in a mite, khuapi sim tu kinging in sawl a, tua ahikom amate sia dinmun la tu in kuan uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua laitakin kamsaang khat Kumpipa Ahab kungah hong pai a, “ Topa in, ‘Tua ngalkap hon lian sia kiita heak hen! Tuni in tuasia nangma in kong zosak tu hi, tuasia ciang keima Topa ka hi hunlam nong he tu hi,’ ” ci in son hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahab in, “Akua in kidona lampui tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ngamkhen uk mangte ii nuai ah a seam khangmoi ngalkapte in lampui tu hi “ Topa in ci hi,” ci in kamsaangpa in zo hi. Kumpipa in, “Ngalkaphonpi sia akua in uk tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Nangma,” ci in kamsaangpa in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom kumpipa in ngamkhen uk mangte ii nuai a ngalkap khangmoi te sam a, a vekpi sia 232 pha hi. Tua zawkciang ama in Israel ngalkaphonpi sam a, a vekpi in 7,000 pha hi."},"16":{"text":"Kisimna sia sun laitakin kipan a Benhadad le a pawlpui 32 te a puanbukte sungah zu khamin a om laitak ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ngalkap khangmoite kuan masa uh hi. Benhadad ii paisak ngalvilte in Samaria pan ngalkap pawlkhat hong pai hi ci in ama tungah ko uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in thupia a, “Hong sim tu in hong kuan ahizong, kilemna ngen nuam in hong pai ahizong, amate a nungta in pummat siat vun,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ngalkap khangmoite in kisimna lampui in, Israel ngalkaphonpi in zuisak a,"},"20":{"text":"tuaciang mi simin ama ii kido pui tek that hi. Syria te tai in, Israel te in del ngawp paih ahihang Benhadad sia siphu tung to in tai a suakta hi, ama sia siphu ngalkap pawlkhat in tonpui hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpipa Ahab sia ngalphual ah hong kuan a, siphute le siphu ngalleang te manin, Syria te in nasia takin lel hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kamsaangpa zongh kumpipa Ahab kungah pai a, “Cia kik in a, na ngalkapte puuapha in, tuaciang a pha takin ngealkhol in, banghang ziam cile Syria kumpipa in mai khaal kipat ciang hong sim kik tu hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Kumpipa Benhadad ii uliante in, “Israel ii pathiante sia mualpi pathiante hi a, tua hu in Israel te in ei hong zo hi. Ahizong, zaangtam ah simin hi leang zo nanak tu hi hing ci uh hi.","title":"Syria ii Niivei A simna"},"24":{"text":"Tu in ngamukmang sawmthum le nii te tawpsak in a, ngal a sim ngalkap maangte taw theak in."},"25":{"text":"Tuaciang nang hong taisan sa ngalkapte za in a tam ngalkaphonpi sam in, siphute le siphu ngalleangte zongh tua za ma sam in. Israel te zaangtamna ah ih sim tu a, tu sia ciangin amate ih zo tu hi,” ci hi Kumpipa Benhadad in amate ii ngaisut piakna sia thukim a, tuabangin ngamta hi."},"26":{"text":"Khaal kipat hun hong thet kik ciangin ama in ngalkapte sam a, Aphek khuapi ah Israel te sim tu in kuan uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Israel te sia kisam a, ngalvanh a cing in a kinguan sa hi; amate a kuan ciang pawl nii in kikhen a. Syria te taw kimaingat in ngiaphual saat uh hi. Israel ngalkapte sia Syria te ngamsung theampo ah a kizel te taw teengat ciang keal hon tawmno nii bang ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Kamsaang khat Kumpipa Ahab kungah hong pai a, “ Topa in hi bangin ci hi: ‘Syria te in kei sia mualte pathian khat hi a, zaangtam te ii pathian hi ngawl hi hong ci hu in, hi ngalkap hon lian sia kong zosak tu a, tuasia ciang nang le na mite in keima Topa ka hi hunlam nong he tu uh hi, ci hi,’ ” ci in son hi."},"29":{"text":"Ni sali sung Syria te le Israel te sia kimaitua in a ngiaphual tek ah om uh hi. A ni sali ni ciang amate a kido kipan a, Israel te in Syria te tul zakhat thatlum hi."},"30":{"text":"A suakta lai teng sia Aphek khuapi sungah tai a, a khuapi luphung cimh in, tua 27,000 te tung san ah taak suk hi. Benhadad zongh khuapi sungah suakta a, inn nung inndoi khat sungah om hi."},"31":{"text":"Uliante ama kungah pai in, “Israel kumpipate sia ngual hesuak thei hi ci in za khu hi, Koma kawng ah khau-ip puan teangin ka ngawng uh ah khauhual te aw in, Israel kumpipa kungah ko hong paisak ta'n, tua hi le ama in na nuntakna hong khoaikhe tha tu hi,” ci uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in a kawngah khau-ip puan teang uh a, a ngawng ah khauhualte vial in Ahab kungah, “Na naseampa Benhadad in a nungta in a suatak natu hong maangkaa hi,” ci uh hi. Ahab in, “Ama nungta lai ziam? Pha hi! ama sia ka suapui khat bangma hi!” ci in zo hi."},"33":{"text":"Benhadad ii uliante in limpha khat ngaingam in a om laitak Ahab in “suapuipa” a ci poma ciang, amate in thakhatin zawp in, “Na ci bangma in Benhadad sia na suapui pa hi!” ci uh hi. “Ama keima kungah hong paipui tavun,” ci in Ahab in thupia hi. Benhadad hong thet ciang Ahab in siphu ngalleang sungah a tokhawm tu in sam hi."},"34":{"text":"Benhadad in ama munah, “Ka pa ii na pa tung pan khua a laak teng hong pia kik tu khi hi, tuaciang Damascus khua ah nangma atu sumzuak sum leina phual khat zongh ka pa ii Samaria ah a koi bangin koi thei tu ni hi,” ci hi. Ahab in, “Hi thukimna tungtawnin nang hong suatak tu khi hi,” ci in zo kik hi. Ama in kiciamna khat vawtin, Benhadad paisak hi."},"35":{"text":"Topa ii sawlna bangin kamsaang pawlkhat sung pan khat in a kamsaang pui khat mun ma ah, ama vua in sawl hi. Ahihang tua pa in nial hi,","title":"Kamsaang khat in Ahab Puanil"},"36":{"text":"tua ahikom ama in tua pa tungah, “ Topa ii thupiakna nial na hikom kei nong nusiat po ciang tawpi khat in nang hong thatlum tu hi,” ci hi. Tuaciangin a nusiat po ciang tawpi khat in zui paih a, ama that hi.","ref":"1 Kum 13:24"},"37":{"text":"Tua zawkciang tua kamsaangpa ma in a dang khat ii munah, “Hong vua ta'n!” ci hi. Hi sia pa in vua hi; ama in nasia takin vua a liamsua hi."},"38":{"text":"A kimealseal natu in kamsaangpa in a maitang puan taw tuamin pai a, lampi hui ah Israel kumpipa hong kaantan tu ngakin ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Kumpipa hong kaantan ciang kamsaang pa in biakpui a, “Kumpipa awng, ngal ka do laitakin ngalkap khat in a ngal mat khat kei kungah hong paipui a, ‘Hi sia pa cing in; a suakta napo le na nuntakna taw lul tu ni hi, tua ahibuale zong ngunntang tulthum liau tu ni hi,’ hong ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Ahihang vai dang taw komla ka hikom tua pa suakta hi” ci hi. Kumpipa in, “Nangma le nangma thu kikhen ni hi, daan na thuak kul tu hi,’ ci in zo hi."},"41":{"text":"Kamsaangpa in a maituamna puan eaukeak a, thakhat thu in kumpipa in kamsaang khat ahi hunlam tel paih hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuasia ciang kamsaangpa in kumpipa munah, “Hi sia Topa ii kammal hi: ‘Thalup tu in kong thupiak pa suaktasak na hikom nangma in na nuntakna taw lul tu ni hi, tuaciang ama ii ngalkaphonpi na suataksak hu in nangma ngalkaphonpi kisusia tu hi,’ ” ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Kumpipa sia Samaria a inn ah cia kikin thinngim in a thin kiam hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jezreel khua sung Kumpipa Ahab ii kumpi inn hui ah Naboth a kici pasal khat ii sapithuan om hi.","title":"Naboth ii Sapit Huan"},"2":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Ahab in Naboth munah, “Na sapithuan kei hong pia ta'n; ka kumpi inn taw kinai a, tua leitang sia antee lamsang ciin na huan tu dei khi hi. Sapit huan a phazaw khat hong pia tu khi hi, ahibuale na deizaw le a man kilawm khat hong pia tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Naboth in, “Hi sapithuan sia ka taanghpupite tung pan ka luasuk hi a, Topa in nang kong piak tu hong khaam hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahab inn ah cia a, Naboth ii kampau teng hu in thin uukin a thinnuam ngawlin om hi. A lupna tungah lum a, pang sang nga in an ne nuam ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"A zi Jezebel sia ama kungah pai in, “Banghangin tuaza in na thinnuam ngawl ziam? Banghang an ne ngawl tu ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in, “Naboth ii kei tungah hong ci teng hang hi. A sapithuan lei tu in ka paupui a, a uuk le zong huan dang khat piak tu in ka ci hi, ahihang ama in tua huan sia na neisa suak thei ngawl tu hong ci hi!” ci in zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Jezebel in, “Tua le, nang kumpipa ni ziam maw hi ngawl ni ziam? Na lupna pan tho in, na maitaisakin a, an ne in. Naboth ii sapithuan keima hong ngasak tu khi hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in laithak pawlkhat at in, Ahab min bul a, tazeik tuum in, Jezreel khua a uliante le lampuite thaak hi."},"9":{"text":"A laithakte sungah: “An tan ni khat taangko vun, mipite sam vun, tuaciang Naboth sia upat vawt vun."},"10":{"text":"Mihing pha ngawl nii in a maitang panin Pathian le kumpipa a haamsiatna huvau mawsuansak vun. Tua zawkciang khuapi puasia ah paipui in suangtum taw deanglum vun,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Jezreel khua uliante le khua mi lampuite in Jezebel ii thupiak bangin ngamta uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in antan ni khat taangko in mipi sam a, Naboth sia upat vawt uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Misia te nii in ama sia mipi mai ah Pathian le kumpipa haamsiat hi ci in mawsuanh hi, tua ahikom ama sia khuapi puasia ah kipaipui in suangtum taw kideanglum hi."},"14":{"text":"Jezebel tungah kam kithaak a: “Naboth kithatlum zo hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Jezebel in kam kithaak sia a nga po ciang, Ahab munah, “Naboth sia thi zo hi. Tu in a sapithuan nang hong zuak nop ngawl sia la in tang in,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Thakhatin Ahab pai in sapithuan sia a neisa tu in la hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in Tishbe panin kamsaangpa Elijah munah,"},"18":{"text":"“Samaria ah Kumpipa Ahab kungah va pai ta'n. Ama sia Naboth ii sapithuan sungah tua huan sia a neisa sua tu in kithoai na mu tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama munah son in, keima Topa in ama munah, ‘Pasalpa na suamlup zawkciang a neisa la tu in kithoai lalai ni ziam,’ ci khi hi. Ama tungah hi teng son in: ‘Naboth ii chisan uite ii a lia na mun ma ah nangma chisan zongh tua uite in liak tu hi!’ ci in son ta'n,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahab in Elijah a mu ciang, “Ka ngal pa awng, kei hong pha zo ngawngaw ni ziam?” ci hi. Elijah in “Hi hi, hong pha zo khi hi,” ci in zo hi. “ Topa muna ah khialna hi teng na vawt natu in nangma le nangma kipumpiak ni hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa in, ‘Tuasiatna nang tungah kong piangsak tu hi. Nangma le na innkuan sungah pa a minpiang a haam a moi theampo kong heam siat tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Na bangkua sia Nebat ii tapa Kumpipa Jeroboam bangkua bang hi tu a, Ahijah ii tapa Kumpipa Baasha ii bangkua bang hi tu hi, banghang ziam cile nangma in ka thin uuk natu in nong sau a, Israel te sia mawna sungah lam na pui hi,’ hong ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in Jezebel taw kisai in, a luang Jezreel khuapi sungah ui in ne tu hi, ci hi.","ref":"2 Kum 9:36"},"24":{"text":"Na mealheakte khuapi sungah a thite ui in ne tu a, ngam taanzauna munah a thite vaciik in ne tu hi,” ci hi,"},"25":{"text":"( Topa muna ah Ahab bangin khialna vawt natu a kipumpiak kuama dang om ngawl hi — tua theampo a zi Jezebel ii hanthotna panin piang ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Israel mite maisang a nawk lai in ngamsung pan Topa ii nawkeak Amor te ii biak bangma in ama in milim biakna taw maizumhuaibel mawnate vawt hi.)"},"27":{"text":"Elijah ii a pau tu teng a man ciang Ahab in a puansilh lai te baltham in, suut a, khau-ip puan silh hi. Ama in an ne ngawlin khau-ippuan te taw lum a, mainuu in thin lalin vavak hi."},"28":{"text":"Topa in kamsaangpa Elijah munah,"},"29":{"text":"“Ahab in keima mai ah bangzata kiniamkhiak in a om sia na mu ziam? Hi bangin ngamta ahiciang ama khan sungah tuasiatna piangsak ngawl tu khi hi; a tapa ii khan sung in Ahab bangkua sungah tuasiatna piangsak tu khi hi,” ci hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel te le Syria te kilaklaw ah tua zawk kum nii sung ngal kilemna om hi,","title":"Kamsaangpa Micaiah in Ahab Kidop natu Son (2 Khangtaanghthu 18:2-27)"},"2":{"text":"ahihang a kum thumna ciang Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa Ahab taw kisi tu in hong pai hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahab in a uliante munah, “Banghangin Syria kumpipa tung pan Gilead ngam Ramoth khua laak kik natu bangma seam ngawl hi ziam? Tuasia eima neisa hi!” ci in dongh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaciang Ahab in Jehoshaphat munah, “Ramoth sim tu in kei taw nong paikhawm tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Jehoshaphat in, “Nangma ii kingin hunin, kei zongh kinging sa in om khi hi,” ci in zo hi, “Ka ngalkapte le ka siphu ngalkapte zongh tuabang ma hi,"},"5":{"text":"ahizong Topa dongh phot tawng,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom Ahab in kamsaangte 400 bang samin, “Kei pai in Ramoth sim tu khi ziam maw, sim ngawl tu khi ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Amate in, “Sim in, Topa in zawna hong pia tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahihang Jehoshaphat in, “ Topa ih dok thei natu in kamsaang dang om nawn ngawl ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahab in, “Khat om lai hi, Imlah ii tapa Micaiah hi. Ahihang ama ensan khi hi, banghang ziam cile ama in kei atu a pha bangma sonkhol ngeingawl hi; a pha ngawl khat veu hi tawntung hi,” ci in zo hi. Jehoshaphat in “Tuabangin ci heak in!” ci in zo kik hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuasia ciang, Ahab in zum uliante khat sam a, Micaiah thakhatin hong paipui ta'n, ci in sawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipate nii sia kumpi puantualte silh a, Samaria kongpi pua sang ancilna ah kumpi tokhumte tungah a to laitakin, kamsaang theampo in amate mai ah thusuakte son uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate sung pan khat, Chenaanah ii tapa Zedekiah in thik kiite vawt a, Ahab munah, “Hisia Topa ii pauna hi: ‘Hite taw Syria te na sim tu a, na zocip tu hi,’ ” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Kamsaang dang theampo in tuabang vive ma in ci uh hi. “Ramoth a sim tu kuan tavun, zo tu nu hi,” ci uh hi. “ Topa in zawna hong pia tu hi.”"},"13":{"text":"Tua laitakin Micaiah sam tu in a pai ulian pa in, “Kamsaang dangte theampo in kumpipa zawna tu bebek son zo hi, nang zongh tuabang ma son hamtang lete pha tu hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang Micaiah in, “A nungta Topa min lo in kamciam ka piakna pan ama ii son a hong sawl teng son tu khi hi!” ci in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama Kumpipa Ahab mai ah hong kipaipui ciang, kumpipa in, “Micaiah awng, Kumpipa Jehoshaphat le kei Ramoth ah kuanin sim tu khu ziam maw, sim ngawl tu khu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Micaiah in, “Sim vun! Noma zo tu nu hi. Topa in zawna hong pia tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang Ahab in, “ Topa min taw kei tungah nong pau ciangin thumaan thutak son in! Bang tanvei tuabangin hong ci tu khi ziam?” ci in zo kik hi."},"17":{"text":"Micaiah in, “Israel ngalkapte sia mualtung tengah tuu cing pa om ngawl a tuute kithezau bangin ka mu hi. Tuaciang Topa in, ‘Hi mite in lampui nei ngawl hi; inn ah thinnuam takin cia hen,’ ” ci hi.","ref":"Mi 27:17; Mt 9:36; Mk 6:34"},"18":{"text":"Ahab in Jehoshaphat munah, “Ama in kei huvau peuma a pha khat zongh hong sonkholsak ngeingawl hi, kong ci sa hi ka na ngawl ziam; a sia khat veu hi tawntung hi!” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Micaiah in zomto a, “Tu in Topa pauna teng ngai vun! Topa sia vantung a kumpi tokhum tungah to a, ama ii vantunglalangte a kiim ah a ding ka mu hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Topa in, ‘Ramoth ah Ahab pai in a kithalup natu in akua in ama theam tu nu ziam?’ ci in dongh hi. Vantunglalang pawlkhat in son khat nei a, a dangte in thudang khat a son uh hi,"},"21":{"text":"a khakbelin thaa khat sia mai ah hong pai a, Topa kung zuanin, ‘Keima in ama theam tu khi hi,’ a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in ‘Bangbangin maw?’ ci in dongh hi. Tua thaa in, ‘Keima pai in Ahab ii kamsaangte theampo leilot thu ka sonsak tu hi!’ ci in zo kik hi. Topa in, ‘Va pai ta'n a, va theam ta'n, theam zo tu ni hi,’ ” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaciang Micaiah in thu khup a, “A piang thu in hisia hi. Topa in na kamsaang hite nang tungah leilot thu hong sonsak hi. Ahihang ama mama in nang tuasiatna nga tu in a thutan sa hi!” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaciangin kamsaangpa Zedekiah in Micaiah kungah paito in, a maitang beang hi, tuaciang, “Bang hun pan kipan Topa thaa in kei hong nusia a, nang tungah hong pau ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"25":{"text":"Micaiah in, “Inn nungsang inndoi sung khat ah a buu tu in na pai ciangin mu tu ni hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Kumpipa Ahab in a uliante khat munah, “Micaiah man in a, khuapi ukpa Amon le Kumpipa tapa Joash tungah paipui vun."},"27":{"text":"Amate in ama thong sungah koi hen a, bangma tat ngawlin kong heak kik dong anluum le tui bek taw na vaak hen, ci in son in,” ci in thupia hi."},"28":{"text":"“Bangma tat ngawlin nong heak kik le Topa in kei tungtawn a hong pau ngawl hi tu hi,” ci in Micaiah in ci ngaw hi. Tuaciang ama in, “Ka ci sa teng kuama po in hong ngai tavun!” ci lai hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Israel kumpipa Ahab le Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat te in Gilead ah Ramoth khuapi sim tu in pai uh hi.","title":"Ahab ii Thina (2 Khangtaanghthu 18:28-34)"},"30":{"text":"Ahab in Jehoshaphat munah, “Ngal kisim ciangin kei kong kimealseal tu a, nang na hile kumpi puan teng ma nong silh tu hi,” ci hi. Tuabangin Israel kumpipa kidona phual ah kimealseal in pai hi."},"31":{"text":"Syria kumpipa in a siphu ngalleang uk 32 te munah, Israel kumpipa ngawlpo a dang khat zong sim ngawl tu nu hi ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in Kumpipa Jehoshaphat a mu uh ciangin a vekpi ma in Israel kumpipa sa ahiciang ama sim tu in kiheak uh hi. Ahihang ama hong au keak ciangin"},"33":{"text":"ama sia Israel kumpipa ahi ngawl hunlam phawk uh hi, tuaciang amate in sim nawn ngawl uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahizong Syria ngalkapte khat ii kap thaltang khat in Kumpipa Ahab ii thikpuan kipeena pan kha luilam hi, “Kei liam khi hi! Ngalphual panin kiheam in!” ci in a siphu ngalleang hawlpa oksan hi."},"35":{"text":"A kido saan lai tengin Kumpipa Ahab sia a siphu ngalleang sungah kikhuangkho in to a, Syria te maingat hi. A liamna ma pan chi luang in siphu ngalleang nuai tawdap teng tuam a, a nitak sang ciangin ama thi hi."},"36":{"text":"Nitum kuan ciangin Israel ngalkapte a lian a no tungah thupiakna hong pai a: “Mi simin a ngam le a khuapi tek ah cia hen!,” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuabangin Kumpipa Ahab thi hi. A luang Samaria ah kiciapui a, kiphum hi."},"38":{"text":"Topa ii piang tu hi a ci bangma in, a siphu ngalleang sia Samaria tuili no ah kisil a, tua munah a chi ui in liak a, pumpi kizuak numeite kisil hi."},"39":{"text":"Saiha taw a zep a kumpi inn le ama ii a sak khuapite thu a kihel Kumpipa Ahab ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo sia Israel Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"40":{"text":"Ama ii thi ciangin a tapa Ahazia in a kumpi za laih hi."},"41":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Ahab ii maan zawk a kum lina ciang, Asa ii tapa Jehoshaphat sia Judah kumpipa suak hi,","title":"Judah Kumpipa Jehoshaphat (2 Khangtaanghthu 20:31—21:1)"},"42":{"text":"ama kum 35 pha a, Jerusalem panin kum 25 sung uk hi. A nu sia Azubah hi a, Shilhi ii tanu ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"Ama mai ah a pa Asa bangma in ama in Topa muna ah a maanin ngamta hi; ahihang doai biakna munte sia kisusia ngawl a, mipite in tua munah sangaw biakpiaknate le ngimnamtui halna in zangh suak uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa taw kilemna vawt hi."},"45":{"text":"Jehoshaphat ii a sep a vawt na dangte theampo, a hanna, a ngal donate theampo Judah Kumpipate ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"46":{"text":"Ama in doai biate ii biaknataute ah a pa Asa hun panin a taanglai numei ahizong, pasal ahizong pumpizuakte heam siat hi."},"47":{"text":"Edom ngam in kumpi nei ngawl a; Judah kumpipa ii koi a khutdawn khat in uk hi."},"48":{"text":"Kumpipa Jehoshaphat in Ophir ngam pan khamh pua in a pai natu tuipi teambawte vawt hi; ahihang tua teambawte Eziongeber ah lal a, tuipi sungah hong pai ngeingawl hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Israel kumpipa Ahaziah in ama mite le Jehoshaphat ii mite tuipi sungah khualhaw khawm tu in paisak hi, ahihang Jehoshaphat in saang ngawl hi."},"50":{"text":"Jehoshaphat thi a, David Khuapi sung kumpite thaan ah kiphum hi, tuaciang a tapa Jehoram in a kumpi za laih hi."},"51":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat ii maan zawk kum sawm le kum sali kumin Ahab ii tapa Ahaziah sia Israel kumpi suak hi, tuaciang ama in Samaria panin kum nii sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpi Ahaziah"},"52":{"text":"Israel te sia mawna sungah a then, a pa Ahab ii seksol ngamtatna bang le, a nu Jezebel le Kumpipa Jeroboam bangma in ama in Topa tungah maw hi."},"53":{"text":"Ama in a mai a, a pa bangma in Baal bia in, a na sepsak hi, ama in Israel ii Pathian Topa a thin uuksak hi."}}}}},"12":{"info":{"name":"Kumpite Niina","shortname":"2Kgs","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Ahab thi zawkciang Moab ngam in Israel langpanin leedo hi.","title":"Elijah le Kumpipa Ahaziah"},"2":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Ahaziah sia ama ii Samaria kumpi inn tung dawl thaam tung panin taak a, nasia takin liam hi. Tua ahikom ama in Philistine khuapi Ekron ah kamtai paisak a, a dam kik tu le a dam nawn ngawl tu Philistine te pathian Baalzebub donghsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang Topa ii vantunglalang khat in Tishbe pan kamsaang Elijah sia Kumpipa Ahaziah ii kamtaite taw kisi tu in paisak a, “Banghangin Ekron pathian Baalzebub tungah thu dongh tu nu ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Israel ngam ah pathian om ngawl hi ci in na ngaisut uh hang ziam ci in amate donghsak hi. Topa in, ‘Na liamna pan dam kik ngawl tu ni hi; thi tu ni hi hong ci hi!’ ci in kumpipa tungah son in,” ci hi. Elijah in Topa thupiak bangin ngamta a,"},"5":{"text":"tuaciang kamtaite kumpipa kungah heak kik uh hi. “Banghangin hong heak kik nu ziam?” ci in ama in dongh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in, “Pasal khat taw ka kisik uh ciang, ama in heak kik in hong sawl a, Topa ii nang tungah, ‘Banghangin Ekron pathian Baalzebub kungah thu dongh tu in kamtaite paisak ni ziam? Israel ngam ah pathian om ngawl hi, ci in ngaisun ni ziam? Na liamna pan dam kik ngawl tu ni hi, thi tu ni hi!’ ” hong ci teng sonin hong sawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Pasal pa ii pianzia bangbang ahi ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Ama in nganhing phaw taw a kivawt puantual khat silh a, tuaciang savun kawngkhau taw sawm hi,” ci in amate in zo hi. “Ama Elijah hi!” kumpi pa in ci hi.","ref":"Mt 3:4; Mk 1:6"},"9":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in ulian khat le pasal 50 sia Elijah sam tu in paisak hi. A ulian pa in ama mualtung khat ah to in mu a, ama munah, “Pathian ii mipa awng, kumpipa in nong paisuk natu thu hong pia hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Elijah in, “Kei Pathian ii mi ka hi le van panin meikuang hong paisuk tahen a, nang le na mite hong thatlum tahen!” ci in zo hi. Thakhat thu in meikuang hong pai suk a, ulian pa le a mite thatlum siat hi.","ref":"Lk 9:54"},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa in ulian dang khat le pasal sawmnga sawl kik a, amate paito in, Elijah munah, “Pathian ii mipa awng, kumpipa in thakhatin nong paisuk natu thu hong pia hi!” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"“Kei, Pathian ii mi ka hile, vantung panin meikuang hong paisuk tahen a, nang le na mite hong thatlum tahen,” ci in Elijah in zo hi. Ka nuntakna uh hong khoaikhe ta'n!"},"14":{"text":"Ulian dangte nii le a mite sia vantung pan meikuang in thatlum siat hi; ahizong kei ka hile hong hesuak ta'n!” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa ii vantunglalang in Elijah munah, “Ama taw paisuk ta'n a, lau heak in,” ci hi. Elijah le Elisha te ngun hui ah tawlnga in, a kamsaang 50 teng sia tawm a kikhuala na ah ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang Elijah in a puantual suutin, a zial zawkciang tui saatna in nei hi; tui hong kikhen a, ama le Elisha in a langkhat ah leiko tung tawnin kaantan uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaciang, Elijah in Elisha munah, “Kei hong kilaak ma in nang atu bang kong vawtsak tu dei ni ziam hong son ta'n,” ci hi. Elisha in, “Na zaa kong laih thei natu in na vaangletna tel ka saan tu za (a zaa nii ) hong ngasak ta'n,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Elijah in, “Tuasia piak tu a haksa mama ngetna hi,” ci in zo kik hi. “Ahihang nang kung panin kei hong kilaak nong mu le, tua ngetna sia na nga tu hi; nong mu buale na nga buatu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate lam a pai kawmin thu son uh hi; tuaciang thakhat thu in meikuang siphute ii kai meikuang siphu ngalleang khat amate nii kilaklaw ah hong pai a, Elijah sia vantung ah suumpei in kaato pui hi."},"12":{"text":"Elisha in mu in, Elijah oksan a, “Ka pa, ka pa! Elisha khuangai in a puantual eau a khen nii sua hi.","ref":"2 Kum 13:14"},"13":{"text":"Tuaciang hong taaksuk Elijah ii puantual sia tawm in hong heak kik a, Jordan ngun vaal ah ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in nguntui sia Elijah ii puantual taw vaat a, “Elijah ii Pathian Topa a koi sungah om ziam?” ci hi. Tuaciang ama in tui vaat kik in, tui hong kikhen a, ngun langkhat ah pai hi."},"15":{"text":"Jericho pan kamsaang 50 teng in ama mu a, “Elijah ii vaangletna Elisha tungah om hi!” ci uh hi. Amate pai a, ama taw kisi in, a mai ah kun uh hi,"},"16":{"text":"tuaciang, “Hi sungah a thahat tingtengh pasal sawmnga om khu hi. Na topa zong tu in pai tek tawng. Tua zawkciang vompui nii duisung pan hong pai in, patangte sung pan 42 laaitham uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Elisha Carmel Mual ah kaato a, tua zawkciang Samaria ah heak kik hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat a maan zawk a kum sawm le liat laitakin, Ahab ii tapa Joram sia Israel kumpipa suak a, tuaciang ama in Samaria panin kum sawm le kum nii sung uk hi.","title":"Israel te le Moab te Ngal kidona"},"2":{"text":"Ama sia Topa tungah mawna vawt a, ahizong a pa ahibuale a nu Jezebel za in sia ngawl hi; ama in a pa ii vawt Baal biak natu milim sia kaivawk hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahizong, ama mai ah a maang Nebat ii tapa, Kumpipa Jeroboam bangma in mawna sungah Israel lampui a, kheal nuam ngawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Moab Kumpipa Mesha in tuu khoai a, kum simin Israel kumpipa tungah tuuno 100,000 le tuu 100,000 ii mul teng shia in pia hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang Israel kumpipa Ahab a thi ciang Kumpipa Mesha in Israel te langpanin leedo hi."},"6":{"text":"Thakhat thu in Kumpipa Joram in Samaria nusia in a ngalkapte khawmtua hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat tungah kam thaak a: “Moab kumpipa in kei langpanin hong leedo hi; ama sim tu in kei nong pawm tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Kumpipa Jehoshaphat in, “Hong pawm tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi. “Keima, ka mite le ka siphute, na dei babangin zeak in."},"8":{"text":"Ama ih sim natu koisung lampi tawn tu hi ziam?” ci hi. “Edom duisung kaantan in a pai lam sau sia ih tawn tu hi,” ci in Joram in zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom Kumpipa Joram, Judah le Edom kumpipate ngamkuan uh hi. Ni sali a pai zawk uh ciang a tui neak tu uh bo a, mihingte atu ahizong, vanh pua ngannote atu ahizong bangma om nawn ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa Jehoshaphat in, “Man sa hi hing!” ci hi. “ Topa in ei teng thum sia Moab kumpipa ii a uuk po hong vawt tu in hong koi hi!” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa Jehoshaphat in, “Ama tungtawnin Topa ih dok thei tu hi sungah kamsaang khat om hi ngawl ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Ama sia Elijah ii khutdawn pa ahi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa Jehoshaphat in, “Ama sia kamsaang maan khat hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom kumpipate thum sia Elisha kungah pai uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Elisha in Israel kumpipa munah, “Banghangin nang hong hu tu khi ziam?” ci hi. “Na pa le na nu ii thudok tua kamsaangte dongh tu in va pai ta'n,” ci hi. Joram in, “Hi ngawl hi, Topa in ko kumpi thum teng sia Moab kumpipa ii a uuk po hong law tu in hong koi sa hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"14":{"text":"Elisha in, “A na ka sepsak a nungta Topa taw kiciam khi hi, na kipawl puipa Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat ka zatak hang hi buale nang taw bangma kipee-aw nuam ngawl khi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu in music thiam khat hong sam tavun,” ci in zo hi. Music thiampa in a tengtongh hong tum tak ciang Topa ii vaangletna Elisha tungah hong pai a,"},"16":{"text":"tuaciang, ama in, “Hi sia Topa pauna hi: ‘Hi luamko dung theampo ah dum to vun."},"17":{"text":"Vui ahizong ngua ahizong na mu mun uh a om ngawl hang, hi luam sia tui taw kidim tu a, noma, na ngannote uh le na vanh pua ngannote ii dawn tu kicing piikpeak tu hi,’ ” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaciang Elisha in zomto a, “Ahihang hisia in Topa sep tu in a ol mama nasep khat hi; Moab te zongh hong zosak lai tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Noma in amate ii a hoi mama a kip a kho in a vawt khuapi theampo na zothal tu uh hi; amate ii thingnga kung theampo phuktan in, a tuinaak teng kangsak tu nu hi, tuaciang, leipha a lo teng theampo suang dimsak in, na siasak tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"A zing ciang zingsangin, sangaw biakpiakna vawt ngei hun laitakin, Edom sang pan tui hong luang a, lei khuum hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua kumpi thum teng amate sim tu in hong pai hunlam Moab te in a zaak uh ciang pa a minpiang ngalhiam toai thei theampo a moibel pan a haambel dong kiko in, ngamngi ah amate panmun la sak uh hi."},"22":{"text":"A zing ciang zingsang a thaw uh ciang, tui tungah ni hong taang a, tui sia chi bang a sanin kimusak hi."},"23":{"text":"“Chisan hi!” ci in amate in au uh hi. “Ngalte ngalkaphonpi thum sia amate le amate kido in kithat hi tu hi! A ngiaphual ah pai in phuul tawng,” ci uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahihang amate tua ngiaphual a thet uh ciang, Israel te in simin, not kik uh hi. Israel te in del tan in, Moab te that uh a,"},"25":{"text":"a khuapite lalthamsak uh hi. Leipha lo khat pawpo a kaantan uh ciangin Israel mi simin tua lo sung teng theampo suang a dim dongin suang khat tek lawn uh hi; amate in ciktui naakte zongh kangsak in, thingnga kungte phuk uh hi. A khakbel ciangin Kir Heres khuapi bek taanglai a, tuaciang saili kapte in uumci in sim uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Moab kumpipa in a ngallelna a phaw tak ciang ama in namsau zangh thiam mihing 700 taw a ngalte kawm panin Syria kumpipa kungah suatak tu hanciam ahihang, suak zo ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in ama za laih tu a tapa lianbel sia la in, khuapi luphung tung pan Moab pathian tungah sangaw biakpiakna in pia hi. Israel te sia lau ngawp ahikom tua khuapi pan nungkin in amate ngam ah heak kik uh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kamsaang honkhat sung a kihel khat ii zi meingong nu sia Elisha kungah pai in, “Topa awng, ka pasal thi zo hi! Na heak bangma in ama sia Pathian kiita pasal khat hi, ahihang tu in a leibatna pasal khat in, ka pasal ii leiba taangin ka tate nii sila in a la tu hong pai zo hi,” ci in son hi.","title":"Elisha in a Zawng Meingong Nu khat Hu"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “Nang atu bang hong vawtsak tu khi ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Inn ah bang nei ni ziam, hong son ta'n,” ci hi. Ama in, “Olive thau thawl khat simngawl a dang nei mama ngawl khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Elisha in, “Na innpaamte kungah va pai ta'n a, bealhawm a tam thei zaza zawng in,” ci in sawl hi."},"4":{"text":"“Tua zawkciang nangma le na tapate inn sungah tum in, kongkha khak vun a, bealte ii sungah sathau sung tavun.
