A tapate khat in, “Tuasia a khakbel hi,” ci in zo hi. Tuasia ciang olive thau luang nawn ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama kamsaangpa Elisha kungah pai kik a, kamsaang pa in ama munah, “Olive thaute zuak tavun a, na leiba theampo lo tavun, tuaciang nang le na tapate kivaak khom natu in sum a khomkhat ma hong vaal lai tu hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ni khat ni in nupi hau khat ii a teenna Shunem khua ah Elisha haw hi. Ama in kamsaang pa an ne tu in sam a, tuasia pan kipan Shunem ah a pai simin ama inn ah an ne hi.","title":"Elisha le Shunem pan Nupi Hau Khat"},"9":{"text":"Ama in a pasal munah, “Hi sungah hong pai tawntung pasal sia mi thiangtho khat hi vangiat tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Innkhum tungah inndoino khat vawtsak in, lupna khat, sabuai khat, tokhum khat le meiinn khat tua inndoi sungah koisak tawng, ama hong haw simin tua munah om thei tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ni khat ni ciang Elisha sia Shunem ah hong zuan kik a, toitang tu in a inndoi ah kaato hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in a naseampa Gehazi sawl in, nupinu samsak hi. Tua nu hong pai ciang,"},"13":{"text":"ama in Gehazi munah, “Ei ii ih kitaangsap teng hong sik natu hong ngim law hu in ama atu bang ka vawtsak thei tu ziam ci in dongh in. Kumpipa tungah ahizong ngalkaphonpi ukpa tungah ahizong ama atu kampha khat po sonsak le hong oai hi tha tu hi,” ci hi. Tua nu in, “Hi sungah ka mite kawmah ka kisap theampo nei khi zam,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Elisha in Gehazi munah, “Tua ahile ama atu bang vawtsak thei tu khi ziam?” ci dongh hi. Ama in, “Pha hi, tua nu in tapa nei ngawl a, a pasal le huai zo hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Elisha in, “Ama hi sungah hong pai natu son in,” ci in thupia hi. Ama hong pai a, bangkua ah hong ding hi,"},"16":{"text":"tuaciang Elisha in ama munah, “Mai ciang tubang hun in tapa khat na khut sungah toai tu ni hi,” ci hi. Ama in, “Oh! Topa awng nong hesuakna in leilot thu hong son heak in. Nang sia Pathian mihing khat na hi hi!” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 18:4"},"17":{"text":"Ahihang Elisha ii ci bangin a mai kum tua hun khawng ciangin ama in tapa khat hing hi."},"18":{"text":"Kum tawmvei zawkciang anlaak hun laitakin, patangno sia zing khat, a pa kung zuan tu in pusuak hi, a pa sia lo sungah an late taw diang hi."},"19":{"text":"Thakhatin patangno sia in a pa tung ah, “Ka lutang na hi! Ka lutang na hi!” ci hi. A pa in, “Patangno sia a nu kungah na puak ta'n,” ci in naseam khat sawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Naseam pa in patangno sia a nu kungah puak kik a, a nu in ni sun dong a kaang sungah toai hi, tua hunsung in a ta thi hi."},"21":{"text":"A nu in patangno sia Elisha ii inndoi ah toai to in lupna tungah sial a nusia hi, tuaciang kongkha khak hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in a pasal samin, ama munah, “Naseamte khat hi sungah laa taw hong paisak ta'n. Kamsaang pa Elisha kungah ka pai kul tu hi. A manlang thei belin hong heak kik tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"“Banghang tu ni na pai kul tu ziam? Tu ni sia Sabbath le hi ngawl Thathak Poai ni le hi ngawl hi,” a pasal in ci hi. Tua nu in, “Pha maw bo,” ci in zo hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in laa kungh thuasakin, naseampa tung ah, “Laa sia a manlang thei za in paisak in, keima kong sawl ngawl po haisak heak in,” ci in thupia hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuabangin ama vaiding in Elisha ii omna Carmel Mual ah pai hi. Ama ii hong pai sia Elisha in a khuala thithim na pan mu a, a naseampa Gehazi munah, “En in — zia sungah Shunem pan nupinu hong pai hi!"},"26":{"text":"Manlang in va pai ta'n a, ama ahizong a pasal ahizong a tapa ahizong a dam tek ziam, va dawp ta'n,” ci hi. Nupinu in Gehazi munah na theampo pha hi ci hi,"},"27":{"text":"ahihang Elisha kung a thet ciang a mai ah kun sukin a peangte pom hi. Gehazi in ama sawn tu in kithoai ahihang Elisha in, “Koi po in. Ama nasia takin a thin hee ahi hunlam mu thei ngawl ni ziam? Tuaciang Topa in a thu khat zong kei hong son ngawl het hi,” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Nupi nu in ama tungah, “Topa awng, tapa khat nang tungah hong ngen kana khi ziam? Lametna saangpi ka nei thaak tu in hong hi heak in hong ci hi ka na ngawl khi ziam?” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Elisha sia Gehazi sangah kiheakin, ama munah, “Manlang in! Ka ciangkhut la in va pai ta'n. Lampi ah na kisik pui pawpo paupui tu in tawlnga heak in, tuaciang khat po in hong paupui le zong ama na zo kik natu hun bosak heak in. A inn ah tangtan in va pai ta'n a, patangno sia tungah ka ciangkhut va nga ta'n,” ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Nupi nu in Elisha munah, “A nungta Topa tung le nang tungah ka thumaanna taw kiciam khi hi, nang hong nusia ngawl tu khi hi!” ci hi. Tua bangin amate nii hong heak kik khawm uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Gehazi sia mai ah paikhol a, Elisha ciangkhut sia patangno ii tungah nga ahihang bangma a nging le om ngawl, nuntakna lim a dang le a om bua hi. Tua ahikom ama Elisha taw kimu tu in hong pai kik a, tuaciang, “Patangno sia khanglo ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Elisha hong thet ciangin, ama nguak inndoi sungah hong tum a, patangno a lupna tungah a thisa in mu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in kongkha khak in Topa tungah thu ngen hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in patangno tungah boksuk a, a kam le a kam, a mit le a mit, a khut le a khut kisisak hi. Tuabangin patangno ii tungah kizanin a om ciang patangno ii ci lum tu in hong kipan hi.","ref":"1 Kum 17:21"},"35":{"text":"Elisha tho a, inndoi sung tengah vakin, tua zawkciang hong pai kik a, patangno ii tungah khatvei ma kizan kik hi. Patangno sia salivei hetchia lo a, tua sia zawkciang a mit hak hi."},"36":{"text":"Elisha in Gehazi sam in, patangno ii nu sam a sawl hi. A nu hong sungtan ciang ama in, “Hi sungah, na tapa om hi!” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama in Elisha peang ah boksuk a, a mai lei phasak hi; tua zawkciang a tapa la in paisan hi."},"38":{"text":"Khatvei lai, ngam bup sungah kialpi khat a tun lai in Elisha sia Gilgal ah heak kik hi. Ama in kamsaangte honkhat a hil laitakin, a naseampa munah amate atu bealpui khat taw mei tungah sa tuihuan in sawl hi.","title":"Nalamdang Lakna A dang Niite"},"39":{"text":"A naseamte khat lo sungah ngamh an pawlkhat la in pai hi. Ama in uum ngui khat mu a, uum nga a puak zawk za lo hi. Ama in tuate ciapui in bang ziam ci in he ngawl bul ma in, a sem zawkciang satui sungah tha hi."},"40":{"text":"Pasalte neak tu in satui thuuk hi, ahihang amate in a tep po uh ciang, Elisha munah “Hisia ngu kisaw hi!” ci in a ne bua uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Elisha in, an tawm ngenin beal sungah tha hi, tuaciangin ama in, “Amate ii neak tu satui tawm thuuk thua lai vun,” ci hi. Tua zawkciang satui sia bangma siat huai nawn ngawl hi."},"42":{"text":"Hun dang khat ciang, Baal Shalishah panin pasal khat hong pai a, tua kum in a lak anpal mangtaang taw a vawt anluum luum kul le a balh tawm vaimim ngap pawlkhat hong paipui hi. Elisha in a naseampa munah tua kamsaangte, tuate taw vaakin sawl hi,"},"43":{"text":"ahihang naseampa in, “Mihing zakhat atu hi teng kikhom tu in um ni ziam?” ci in zo hi. Elisha in, “A neak tu in amate pia in, banghang ziam cile amate in ne tu a, a neak vaal zongh om tu hi, Topa in ci hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua ahikom a naseampa in an lui a, tuaciang Topa ii ci bangma in, amate theampo in ne a, pawlkhat vaal lai hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Syria ngalkaphonpi ukpa Naaman sia Syria kumpipa in nasia takin zakta in upat vawt hi, banghang ziam cile Naaman tungtawnin Topa in Syria ngalkapte zawna pia hi. Ama sia ngalkap mang lian khat hi, ahihang ama in a kiitakhuai mama vun natna khat thuak hi.","title":"Naaman Kidamsak","ref":"Lk 4:27"},"2":{"text":"Amate ii Israel a sim hunlai khat ah Syria te in Israel numeino khat ciapui in, tua nu sia Naaman zi ii naseamnu suak hi."},"3":{"text":"Ni khat ni in ama in a tonu tungah, “Samaria a teang kamsaangpa kungah ka topa pai thei le ka oai hi! Ama in a natna teng damsak tu hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Naaman in hi thu a zaak ciang kumpipa kungah pai in, numeino ii pauna teng son hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Israel kumpipa kungah va pai ta'n a, hi ka laithak sia na puak ta'n,” ci hi. Tua ahikom Naaman vai ding in, ngunntang 30,000, khamh tang 6,000, puan laih natu puan hoi sawm keng hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama ii puak laithak sungah hi bang ki at hi: “Hi laithak in ka ngalkap bu Naaman kong heaksakna hi. A natna pan na damsak natu ka dei hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in tua laithak a sim ciangin, thinkiamna taw a puante eaukeak in, “Bangbangin Syria kumpipa in hisia pa damsak thei tu in kei hong um ziam? Nuntakna le thina tungah vaang a nei Pathian vei hong sa ziam? Ama kei taw kihau nuam in hanciam ahi hunlam kician hi!” ci in au hi."},"8":{"text":"Kamsaangpa Elisha in bang thu piang ci in a zaak ciangin ama in kumpipa tungah kam thaak hi: “Banghang tuaza in na thinngim ziam? Tua pa keima kungah hong puak ta'n, Israel ngam sungah kamsaang khat a om nginge hunlam lak tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom Naaman in a siphu te le a siphu ngalleang taw pai in Elisha ii kongbiang ah tawlnga hi."},"10":{"text":"Elisha in a naseam khat paisak in, ama munah Jordan ngun sungah salivei kisil tahen, tua hile a natna pan dam thiang tu hi cisak hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang Naaman a thinso in tua mun nusia a, “Kei ngaisutna pan a nobel in ama kei kungah hong pusuak in, Topa a Pathian munah thu hong ngetsak tu a, ka natna mun santak teng tungah a khut hong vaan le, hong damsak tu in ka um hi!"},"12":{"text":"Tua banah Damascus ah Abana ngun le Pharpar ngun te Israel ngam sungah ngun khat pawpo sangin phazaw hi ngawl ziam? Tuate sungah kibual in dam thei tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"A naseamte ama kungah pai in, “Topa awng, kamsaangpa in a haksa vawt tu in hong sawl le zong vawt tu ni hi. Tu in ama ci bangin banghangin na dam natu in ngun sungah kibual paih lel ngawl tu ni ziam?” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jordan ngun ah Naaman paisuk in, Elisha ii ci bangin ngun tui sungah ama le ama salivei kipap a, tuaciang ama dam thiang sitset hi. Ama ii sa sia hong ciip in a ciidam a, nauno khat ii cii le sa bang ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in a mite theampo taw Elisha kungah hong heak kik a, “Tu in Israel ii Pathian ngawl pathian dang om ngawl hi ci in ka he hi; tua ahiciang topa awng, nong hesuakna in, kong piak letsong khat hong saang ta'n,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Elisha in, “A na ka sepsak a nungta Topa taw kiciam khi hi, letsong khat zongh saang ngawl tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi. Naaman in a saan natu in kunh top ahihang ama in saang nuam ngawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom Naaman in, “Ka letsong hong saang ngawl tu na hile laa nii ii puakkhop leitang hong ciapuisak ta'n, banghang ziam cile tu pan kipan Topa tung simngawl pathian dang peuma tungah sangaw biakpiakna ahibuale meihal biakpiakna te pia nawn ngawl tu khi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuabangin hi leng, Rimmon biakinn ah Syria pathian a biak tu in ka kumpipa ka zui ciang Topa in kei hong maisak tu in ka lamen hi. Topa in hong maisak tatak tu hi,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Elisha in, “Thinnuamin va pai ta'n,” ci hi. Tuaciang Naaman in paisan hi. Ama lam khuala a thet ma in,"},"20":{"text":"Elisha naseampa Gehazi in, ama le ama hi bangin, “Ka topa in Naaman sia bangma piasak ngawlin paithongsak hi. Tua Syria pa ii piak teng sia a saan tatak tu ahi hi. A nungta Topa min taw ama nung pan del in, na khat pawpo ama tung pan nga tong,” kici hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in Naaman ii nung panin del hi. Naaman in ama nung pan mihing khat ii a del a mu ciangin a leang tung pan tuak a, ama taw kisi in, “A phamaw khat po om ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"22":{"text":"Gehazi in “Om ngawl hi,” ci in zo hi. “Ahihang ka topa in nangma tungah sonin hong sawlna pan, tu ma hiat in Ephraim mualtung ngam panin kamsaangte pawl sung pan nii hong theng a, amate ngunntang tulthum le puan laih natu kop nii pia le hong oai hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Naaman in, “Nong hesuakna taw ngunntang tulluk la in,” ci in zo hi. Ama in lasak hamtang hi, ngunntangte ip nii sungah sawm in, puansilh laihna kop nii pia a, a naseamte nii aap in, Gehazi mai ah tua vanhte taw pai masa sak hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate sia Elisha teenna mualtung a thet ciang Gehazi in ipte nii saangin inn sungah sungtan pui hi. Tua zawkciang ama in Naaman ii naseamte ciasak hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama inn sungah tum kik a, tuaciang Elisha in ama munah, “Koisung pai ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Topa awng, koima pai bong,” ci in ama in zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahihang Elisha in, “A mihingpa in nang taw kisi tu in leang tung pan hong tuak lai in, kei zongh ka thaa taw hong om ngawl ka na khi ziam? Hi bang sum ahizong, puan le olive huante ahizong, sapithuante ahizong, tuu le khuite ahizong, letsong saan tu hun hi ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Tu in Naaman ii natna teng nang tungah hong theng tu a, nang le na suan na paal theampo in tua natna a tawntungin vei tu nu hi!” ci hi. Gehazi a pusua ciang ama in tua natna nga in — a vun sia vuuk bangin kaang hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat ni in, Elisha ii uk kamsaang pawlkhat te in Elisha tungah amate lungkim ngawlna zasak uh hi, “Ka teenna mun uh no leih hi!","title":"Heitang Nga kikna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom, ka teen natu uh inn ka sak natu Jordan ngun ah pai a, thing pawlkhat hong phuksak thei ta'n,” ci uh hi. Elisha in, “Pha hi,” ci in zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate sung pan khat in amate taw ton tu in Elisha paa a, ama lungkim in paikhawm uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Jordan a thet uh ciangin amate sia naseam tu in hong kipan uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate sung pan khat in thing khat a phu ciangin thakhat thu in a heitang zuukin tui sungah taak hi. Ama in Elisha munah, “Bang law tu khi ziam, Topa awng? Hei sia a kikawm hi!” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Elisha in, “Koisung santak ah taak ziam?” ci in dongh hi. A taakna san a lak ciang Elisha in ciangkang khat saattan in, tui tungah a lot le a heitang tui tungah hong kilaamto hi."},"7":{"text":"“La in,” ci in a sawl ciang tua pa kun sukin heitang tawm hi."},"8":{"text":"Syria kumpipa sia Israel taw kido hi. Ama in uliante taw kikum a, ngiaphual saat natu mun khat teal hi.","title":"Syria Ngalkaphonpite Kizo"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang Elisha in Israel kumpipa tungah tua mun ii nai ah pai ngawlin a kidop natu kam thaak hi, banghang ziam cile Syria te in tua mun pan a suam tu in pang hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom Israel kumpipa in tua mun nai ah a om mihingte munah kidop natu thu puak hi, tuaciang amate sia ngal nang tu kithoai sa in om uh hi. Hi bangin tamvei ma hong piang hi."},"11":{"text":"Syria kumpipa sia hisia huvau in nasia takin a thin buai hi; ama in a uliante sam in, “No sung pan akua sia Israel kumpipa sangah pang nu ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"12":{"text":"Khat in, “Kumpipa awng, kuama a pang om ngawl hi. Kamsaangpa Elisha in Israel kumpipa tungah na inndoi sungah thuku na son theampo zong son siat hi,” ci in zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Ama koisungah om ziam? Zong vun! Ama man tu khi hi,” ci hi. Elisha sia Dathan ah om hi ci in a kison ciangin ama in,"},"14":{"text":"tua munah ngalkap le siphu ngalleang tam ma puak hi. Amate sia tua khua ah zan in theng a, uumci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"A khuavak ni zing tuungin Elisha ii naseampa hong tho a, inn pua ah pusuakin khua a et ciang, khua kiimkot ah ngalkapte, siphu ngalleangte le siphute mu hi. Ama in inn sungah tum kikin, Elisha munah, “A lal hi zo hing, topa awng, bang ih law tu ziam?” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Elisha in, “Lau heak in, amate sangah a pangte sangin ei sangah hong pangte tamzaw hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama thungen a, “Oh, Topa , ama mittangte khua a mu thei natu honsak in,” ci hi. Topa in Elisha thungetna zo a, tuaciang Elisha ii naseampa in a et to le Elisha ii kiimkot mual pangh te sia siphu le meikuang siphu ngalleangte taw kidim in mu hi."},"18":{"text":"Syria te ii sim ciang Elisha in thungen a, “Oh Topa , hi mite a mit uh tawcipsak in!” ci hi. Topa in a thungetna zo a, a ngalte a mittaw cipsak hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaciang Elisha in amate kungah pai in, “No sia lam khial nu hi, khua na zon uh sia hi sung hi ngawl hi. Mihing na zon uh sia kungah keima hong paipui tu khi hi,” ci hi. Tuaciang ama in amate sia Samaria zotpui hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate khuapi sung a tum po ciang Elisha in thu ngen a, “A mittang uh honsak in, Topa awng, amate khuamusak thei in,” ci hi. Topa in a thungetna saang in, amate khuamusak kik a, tuaciang khua a et uh ciang amate sia Samaria sungsang ah om ahi hunlam kimu uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Syria te a mu ciang Elisha mun ah, “Ka thatlum tu ziam, topa ka thatlum tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"22":{"text":"“Thatlum heak in, kidona phual ah na matsa ngalkapte zongh thisak ngawl tu ni hi. Amate neak tu dawn tu khat po pia in a, amate ii kumpipa kungah cia kiksak in,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom Israel kumpipa in amate atu anneakpoai lian khat vawtsak a, amate ii a neak a dawn zawkciang Syria kumpipa kungah ciasak hi. Tua hun pan kipan Syria te in Israel ngam a sim tawntung teng kheal uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawk tawm vei ciang Syria kumpipa Benhadad in ama ii ngalkaphonpi bup lampui in Samaria uumci hi.","title":"Samaria a ki Uumci na"},"25":{"text":"Tuabang a ki uumci hu in khuapi sungah anneak tu haksa mama a, laa khat ii lutang sia ngunntang 80 man a, inn vakhu eak gram 200 ciang ngunntang nga man hi."},"26":{"text":"Israel kumpipa, khuapi luphungte tungah a vak laitak, numei khat au in, “Hong hu ta'n, Kumpipa awng!” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in zo a, “ Topa in nang hong hu buale kei in nang bang hong pia zo tu khi ziam? Zungtaang ahibuale sapittui nei na khi ziam?"},"28":{"text":"Na haksatna sia bang tatak ziam?” ci hi. Tua nu in, “Ning zeini in hi lai a numei sia in ngaisutna hong pia a, kei nauno sia tua ni in ne tu, a zing ciang ama ii nau sia ne tu ci in ka thukim uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka nauno sia ka huan uh a ka ne uh hi. A khuavak ni ciang ama nau sia ne tu ka ci le ama in phual hi,’ ci in zo hi.","ref":"Thkna 28:57; Kaa 4:10"},"30":{"text":"Kumpipa in hi thu a zaak ciang a khuangai in a puansilh lai eautham hi, tuaciang ama kung nai ah a pai mite in a puansilhte ii sungsang ah khau-ip puan a silh sia mu uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama au in, “Nitum ma in Elisha ii lu a kitan buale Pathian in hong vaat lum tahen!” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in Elisha man tu in kamtai paisak hi. Tua laitakin Elisha sia a inn ah a haw upa pawlkhat taw om uh hi. Kumpipa ii kamtaite hong thet ma in, Elisha in upate munah, “Mithatpa in kei that tu in khat hong paisak hi! Tu in ama hi sung hong thet ciang kongkha khak vun a, tumsak heak vun. Kumpipa ama mama zongh a nung hiat pan hong pai tu hi,” ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Hi teng a pau zongh man tak ngawl lai in kumpipa hong pai a, “Hi ngimna ei tungah hong puak sia Topa hi. Ama ii na khat pawpo a vawt tu ngakin banghangin om top tu khi ziam?” ci hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Elisha in, “ Topa pauna ngai in! Zing ciang tu hunin Samaria ngam sungah zungtaang phabel kilogramme thum ahibuale mangtaang kilogramme luk ciang ngunntang khat taw lei thei tu nu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa a cing tuam pa in Elisha mun ah, “Tuabang piang thei ngawl tu hi — Topa in thakhat thu in antang hong puak hial zong piang thei ngawl tu hi!” ci hi. Elisha in, “Tuabang a pian sia mu tu ni hi, ahihang nang in tua an peuma na ne ngei buatu hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"3":{"text":"A lauhuai vun natna a vei pasal li sia Samaria kongpi pua sangah om in, amate khat le khat a kipaupuina ah, “Banghangin hi sungah ih thi dong ngak tu hi ziam?","title":"Syria Ngalkapte Dingkhia"},"4":{"text":"Khuapi sungah ih tum tu le lui thawthong hi, banghang ziam cile, tua munah ih pukthi tu hi; ahihang hi sungah om leang zong ih thi veve tu hi. Tua ahikom Syria te ii ngiaphual sungah tum ka tawng; a siabel amate ii hong vawt thei sia hong thatlum tu hi, ahizong ih nuntakna hong khoaikhe tha tu hi,” ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom khuazing tu a kithoai ciang, amate in Syria te ngiaphual ah pai uh hi, ahihang tua mun a thet uh ciangin, kuama a na om bua hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in Syria te ii zaakna ah siphu te le siphu ngalleangte taw ngalkap honpui kuan in a nging bang khat zasak a, tuaciang Israel kumpipa in Hit le Egypt kumpite ngalcialin, amate simsak hi ci in Syria te in ngaisun uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom tua nitakin Syria te in amate nuntakna kihuk natu in taikeak in, a puanbukte, siphute, laate le a ngiaphual uh sia a om babangin nusia uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua pasal li teng in ngiaphual kiing a thet uh ciang, puanbuk khat sungah tum in, tua munah a mu po ne in dawn uh hi, ngunn, khamh le puansilh a mu po zongh zamh a, pusua pui in phual uh hi; tua zawkciang amate hong heak kik a, puanbuk dang khat ah tum in tuabang ma in ngamta uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang amate khat le khat ii tung ah, “Hi bangin ih ngamtat tu hi ngawl hi! Eima in thupha nga kasap, eima bek ii ih kep tu hi ngawl hi. Tua thu ih son natu in zingsang dong ih ngak le daan hong kipia nanak tu hi. Thakhatin pai in, kumpipa ii uliante munah ko tawng!” ci uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate sia Syria te ngiaphual nusia in Samaria ah heak kik a, kongpi cingte oksan in, “Ko teng Syria te ngiaphual ah ka pai uh le kuama mu ngawlin, a pau a haam zongh za ngawl khu hi; a siphute le a laate zongh a khau uh kisuut ngawl hi; tuaciang puanbukte zongh Syria te ii nusiat bang linlian in om hi,” ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Kongpi cingte in tua thu taangko in, kumpi inn sungah tua thu hong kiko hi."},"12":{"text":"Zan lai ma hi napi kumpipa hong tho a, a uliante munah, “Syria te ii ngealna teng hong son tu khi hi! Amate in hi sungah kialpi a tun sia he hi, tua ahikom amate in ngiaphual nusia a, ngam sungah a bu tu in pai hi. Amate in ei sia an zong a khuapi nusia tu in hong um hi, tuaciang amate in ei hong hing mat tu a, khuapi hong suan tu hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama uliante khat in, “Hilai khuapi sung a mite sia bangbang po ahizong a thisate taw kibangin a lal hi zo hi hing. Tua ahikom thupiang teng ih mu thei natu in, a thi mong siphu nga teng taw pasal pawlkhat paisak tawng,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in pasal pawlkhat teal in, kumpipa in siphu ngalleang nii taw paisak a, Syria ngalkaphonpi bang tat ziam ci in dawpsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Pasalte Jordan ngun dong pai in, lamdung ah Syria ngalkapte ii a tai kawmin a nusiat puan le vanh te mu uh hi. Tua zawkciang amate hong heak kik in, kumpipa tungah thu ko uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Samaria mite manlang tak hong pusuak in Syria te ngiaphual phuul uh hi. Tuaciangin Topa ii ci sa bangma in a zungtaang phabel kilogramme 3 ahibuale mangtaang kilogramme 6 ciangin ngunntang khat taw kizuak hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in ama a cing tuam ulian pa sia khuapi kongpi uk tu in na koi luilam hi. Tua ulian pa sia tualai ah mipite in siiklum hi, kumpipa in ama taw kimu tu in a pai laitak Elisha ii sonkhol bangin thi hi."},"18":{"text":"Elisha in kumpipa munah a zing ciang tua hunin zungtaang a phabel kilogramme 3 ahibuale mangtaang kilogramme 6 ciang ngunntang khat taw kizuak tu hi a ci lai in,"},"19":{"text":"tua ulian pa in, “Tuabang piang thei ngawl tu hi — Topa mama in thakhat thu in antang hong puak hial zong piang thei ngawl tu hi!” ci in zo hi. Tuaciang Elisha in, “Tuasia a pian mu tu ni hi, ahihang nang in na ne ngei buatu hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuasia bang tatakin ama ii tungah piang a, ama thi hi — khuapi kongpi ah mite in ama tuanhlum hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in Elisha in Shunem ah a teang, a tapa a nuntak kiksak nupinu munah, Topa in kum sali sung a ngei tu kialpi khat a ngam sungah a tunsak natu le ama sia leidang khat ah a innkuanpuite taw pai in a teen tu a kulna thu son hi.","title":"Shunem pan Nupi nu Heak kik","ref":"2 Kum 4:8-37"},"2":{"text":"Ama in a sawlna mangin a innkuanpuite taw Philistia ah kum sali sung teang hi."},"3":{"text":"Kum sali bo zawkciang ama Israel ngam ah hong heak kik a, kumpipa ii munah a inn le a leitangte ama tungah a kipiak kik natu ngen hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in kumpipa sia Elisha ii naseampa Gehazi taw kipaupui in om mu hi; kumpipa in Elisha ii a lamdang nasepte he nuam hi."},"5":{"text":"Gehazi in Elisha ii a thisa mi khat a thawsak kikna thu kumpipa tungah a sawson laitakin tua nu in kumpipa tungah thuumna nei hi. Gehazi in, “Kumpipa awng, tua nupi sia le Elisha ii a nuntak kiksak a tapa sia hi sungah om hi,” ci in son hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa ii dokna te a zona in Gehazi ii son teng sia maan hi ci in nupi nu in son hi, tuasia ciang kumpipa in a uliante khat samin, ama ii neisa teng theampo a piak kik natu le kum sali a om ngawl sung theampo a, a lo sung pan a piang ante theampo ii man taw ama ii a neisa teng theampo a piak kik tu in thupia hi."},"7":{"text":"Syria te ii Kumpipa Benhadad ii ciinat hun khat laitakin Elisha sia Damascus khua ah pai hi. Elisha tua munah om ci in kumpipa tungah a kison ciang,","title":"Elisha le Syria te Kumpipa Benhadad"},"8":{"text":"ama in a uliante khat ahi Hazael munah, “Kamsaangpa letsong khat na puak ta'n a, kei ka ciidam tu ziam, dam ngawl tu khi ziam Topa hong doksak tahen,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom Hazael in Damascus pan a piang vanh phabel teng kalaoh 40 tungah suanhin Elisha kungah pai hi. Hazael in ama taw a kimu ciang ama in, “Na naseampa Kumpipa Benhadad in nang kungah pai in ama ii natna sia dam tu ziam dam nawn ngawl tu ziam ci sia nang kungah pai in dongh tu in hong sawl hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Elisha in zo a, “ Topa in ama thi tu hi ci in hong lak hi; ahihang ama ii kungah va pai ta'n a, ama dam kik tu hi na ci ta'n,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciang Elisha in a lauhuai mama mai puak taw Hazael ii om nuam ngawl a sak dong a maitang salh hi. Thakhat thu in Elisha a thitui luang hi."},"12":{"text":"Hazael in, “Banghangin kap ni ziam, topa awng,” ci in dongh hi. “Israel mite tungah a lipkhaphuai mama na ngamtat tu teng ka heak hu hi,” ci in zo kik hi. Nangma in a kulhpite na haltum tu a, a khangmoi tangval a phabel teng na thatlum tu a, patangnote na vaatlum tu hi, naungil omte ii ngil na khuakeak tu hi,” Elisha in ci hi."},"13":{"text":"“Banghangin tua zata in vaanglian thei tu khi ziam kei sia bangma ka hi bua hi,” Hazael in ci hi. “ Topa in hong son zo hi, nang sia Syria te ii kumpipa na suak tu hi,” ci in Elisha in zo hi.","ref":"1 Kum 19:15"},"14":{"text":"Hazael sia Benhadad kungah heak kikin, ama in, “Elisha in bang hong ci ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Ama in nang sia dam kik tatak tu hi, hong ci hi,” Hazael in ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang a khuavak ni ciang Hazael in puanvan khat tui sungah pap a, tuasia taw kumpipa ii nuntakna sumit hi. Tuaciang Hazael in Syria Kumpipa Benhadad ii za laih hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel te Kumpipa Ahab ii tapa Joram ii maan zawk a kum ngana ciang Judah te Kumpipa Jehoshaphat ii tapa Jehoram sia kumpipa suak hi,","title":"Judah Kumpipa Jehoram (2 Khangtaanghthu 21:1-20)"},"17":{"text":"ama ii kum, kum 32 pha a, tuaciang ama in Jerusalem panin kum liat sung uk hi."},"18":{"text":"A zi sia Ahab ii tanu hi a, tuaciang Ahab ii innkuante bangma in ama in Israel kumpipa ii ngamtat siat teng ma zui hi. Ama in Topa tungah maw hi,"},"19":{"text":"ahihang Topa in Judah sia a susia nuam bua hi, banghang ziam cile ama in a naseampa David munah, a suan a paalte in a kizom suakin uk tu hi ci in kamciam pia zo hi.","ref":"1 Kum 11:36"},"20":{"text":"Jehoram ii maan sungin Edom te in Judah te langpanin leedo uh a, amate le amate a ki uk kumpi ngam hong suak hi.","ref":"Pian 27:40"},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jehoram in ama ii siphu ngalleang theampo taw Zair ah kuan a, tua munah Edom ngalkap honte in amate uumci uh hi. Zan lai in ama le a siphu ngalleang ukte in a kikiim uumna phultham thei in, suakta uh a, a ngalkapte sia amate inn tek ah kithethaang uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Edom sia tua hun pan kipan Judah te khutnuai pan amate le amate a ki uk suak hi. Hi hun sung ma in Libnah khuapi zongh in leedo hi."},"23":{"text":"Jehoram ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo Judah Kumpite ii Taanghthu sungah kiciamtee hi."},"24":{"text":"Jehoram thi a, David khuapi sung kumpite thaan ah kiphumin, a tapa Ahaziah in a kumpi za lua hi."},"25":{"text":"Israel te ii kumpipa Ahab ii tapa Joram a maan zawk kum sawm le kum nii na ciang Jehoram ii tapa Ahaziah sia Judah te ii kumpipa suak hi,","title":"Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah (2 Khangtaanghthu 22:1-6)"},"26":{"text":"ama kum 22 pha a, ama in Jerusalem panin kum khat sung uk hi. A nu sia Athalia hi a, kumpipa Ahab ii tanu, Israel kumpipa Omri ii tunu hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahaziah sia a zi hangin Ahab ii mealheak khat a sua bangin, Ahab ii innkuanpuite bangma in ama in Topa tungah maw hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpipa Ahaziah in Israel te kumpipa Joram taw kipawl khawm in Syria te ii kumpipa Hazael do uh hi. Ngalkap honte sia Gilead ngam Ramoth ah hong kisii uh a, Joram sia ngal kisimna sungah liam hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in Jezreel khuapi ah heak kikin, a liamna pan a dam kik tu ngak hi, tuaciang Ahaziah in tua munah pai in ve hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun sungin kamsaangpa Elisha in kamsaang khangmoi khat munah, “Kithoai in a, Gilead ah a om Ramoth ah va pai ta'n. A lawmte kung pan samkhia in inndoi tuam khat sungah paipui in a,"},"3":{"text":"hi olive thau sia a lu tungah buakin, ‘ Topa in nang sia Israel te ii kumpipa tu in taangko hi,’ ci ta'n. Tua zawkciang tua mun sia a manlang thei zaza in nusia in,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom kamsaang khangmoi pa Ramoth ah pai in,"},"5":{"text":"tua munah ngalkap maangte thu kikum mu hi. Ama in, “Topa awng, nang atu kamthaak khat hong keng khi hi,” ci hi. Jehu in, “Ko teng sungah akua hong paupui ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Topa awng, nangma ni hi,” ci in ama in zo kik hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate nii sia inn doituam sungah tum a, tuaciang kamsaang khangmoipa in Jehu ii lu tungah olive thau buakin ama munah, “ Topa Israel te ii Pathian in taangko hi: ‘Keima in nang sia Israel te ii kumpipa tu in sathau hong noai khi hi.","ref":"1 Kum 19:16"},"7":{"text":"Jezebel ii ka kamsaangte le a dang ka naseamte a thalup hu in daan ka piak natu in, nangma in na topa, kumpipa Ahab ii tapa sia thatlum tu ni hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahab ii innkuanpuite le a suan a paalte a thi siat kul tu hi; a moi a haam a kibangin a bangkua sungah pa a minpiang heamkhia tu khi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama ii bangkua tungah Israel te ii Kumpipa Jeroboam tung ahizong, Israel te kumpipa Baasha ii tungah ahizong, ka vawt bangin vawt tu khi hi."},"10":{"text":"Jezebel sia kiphum ngawl tu hi; a luang sia Jezreel ngamkhen sungah ui in ne tu hi,’ ” ci hi. Hi teng a ci zawkciang kamsaang moi pa pusuakin tai hi.","ref":"1 Kum 21:23"},"11":{"text":"Jehu sia a ngalkap maang puite kungah pai kik a, amate in, “Na theampo a pha na'am? Tua a mawmawt tuak pa sia in nang tung pan bang dei ziam?” ci uh hi. Jehu in, “Ama ii dei sia he nu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in, “Ko he ngawl khu hi, hong son ta'n,” ci in zo uh hi. Ama in keima munah, Topa in hi bangin taangko hi: “Nangma sia Israel te ii kumpipa tu in sathau hong noai khi hi,” ci in hong son hi."},"13":{"text":"Thakhat thu in Jehu ii ngalkap maang puite in a puantual uh keallei tungah Jehu ii dinpha tu in pha uh a, lemle tumin, “Jehu sia Kumpipa hi!” ci in au uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jehu in Kumpipa Joram suamlup tu sawm hi, ama sia Syria Kumpipa Hazael taw Ramoth ah a kidona a liamna pan a dam kik natu in Jezreel ah om hi. Tua ahikom Jehu in ama ii ngalkap maang puite munah kei sangah nong pang uh ahile Jezreel ah mipite kidop natu son tu in Ramoth pan kuama pai ku heak vun,” ci hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Joram Kithatlum","merge":"15"},"16":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama a siphu ngalleang tungah hong kaa in Jezreel zuan tu in vaiding hi. Joram sia dam kik ngawl lai hi, Judah te kumpipa Ahaziah zongh ama ve in om lai hi."},"17":{"text":"Jezreel tausaang tung pan ngalvil vaipuak a nei sia in, Jehu le a mite hong neak sia mu hi. “Mihing pawlkhat siphu tung to in hong pai ka mu hi,” ci in au hi. Joram in, “Tual ziam maw ngal ziam siphu ngalkap khat pai in kansak vun,” ci in zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Kamtai pa Jehu kungah pai in, ama munah, “Kumpipa in nang sia lawm khat bangin nong pai ziam ci in he nuam hi,” ci hi. Jehu in, “Tuasia nang taw bangma kisai bo, ka nung panin hong zui ta'n,” ci in zo hi. Tausaang tung a ngalvil pa in, kamtai pa sia hong paite taw kisii napi hong heak kik ngawl hi ci in thu ko hi."},"19":{"text":"Kamtai dang khat ma paisak uh a, ama in Jehu sia a mai a pa ii dok teng ma dongh hi. Tuaciang Jehu in “Tuasia nang taw bangma kisai bo, ka nung uh pan hong zui ta'n,” ci in zo leleau hi."},"20":{"text":"Khatvei ma khuapi cing pa in, kamtaipa le hong papai pawlte kimu napi ama hong heak kik nawn ngawl hi, ci hi. Ama ii belapna ah, “Hong pai pawlte ii lampui pa in a siphu ngalleang sia mihing thin amh bang phet in nasia takin hawl hi, Jehu taw kibang hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"“Ka siphu ngalleang a pai tu kithoaisak vun,” ci in kumpipa Joram in thupia hi. Tuabang ma in, ama le kumpipa Ahaziah sia amate siphu ngalleang tek tung to in Jehu taw kisi tu in hong pai uh hi. Amate in Naboth ii lo sungah ama taw kisi uh hi."},"22":{"text":"“Lem thu taw hong pai nu ziam?” ci in Joram in dongh hi. Jehu in, “Bangbangin lem thu om thei tu ziam, Na nu Jezebel ii patsa bum le ai toaite ahizong, milim biakna ahizong, ih nei lai teng lem thu om thei ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"“Ahaziah awng, hisia kilee heakna hi,” ci in Joram au a, a siphu ngalleang heak in, tai hi."},"24":{"text":"Jehu in a thal eal in a tha nei za taw a kap le Joram ii cingzaang pan kha in a lungtang sunlet a, Joram sia ama siphu ngalleang sungah pukin thi hi,"},"25":{"text":"tuaciang, Jehu in ama a hu pa Bidkar munah, “A luang la in a, Naboth ii lo sungah vawk in. Nang le kei kumpipa Ahab ii nung pan siphu tung to in ih pai lai in, Topa in Ahab huvau,"},"26":{"text":"‘Zeini in Naboth le a tate a kisuamlupna ka mu hi. Tuaciang kamciam kong piakna pan, lo hisia sung mama ah nang daan hong pia tu khi hi’ ci in a pau sia na ciamtee lai ziam? Tua ahikom Joram ii luang la in, Topa ii kamciam sia a taangtun natu in, Naboth ii lo sungah vawk in,” Jehu in ci hi.","ref":"1 Kum 21:19"},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa Ahaziah in bang teng piang ci in mu a, a siphu ngalleang taw Beth Haggan khua sangah tai a, Jehu in del hi. “Ama zongh that vun,” ci in Jehu in a mite sawl hi, tuaciangin ama a siphu ngalleang Ibleam khua hui Gur sang lam tungah hawlto a, amate in liamsua hi. Ahihang Megiddo khuapi a thet dong a leang hawl thei a, tua mun a thet ciang thi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah Kithat"},"28":{"text":"Ama ii uliante in a luang siphu ngalleang khat taw pua in, David Khuapi sung kumpi thaan ah phum hi."},"29":{"text":"Israel te Kumpipa Ahab ii tapa Joram a maan zawk a kum sawm le khat kum in Ahaziah sia Judah te kumpipa suak hi."},"30":{"text":"Jehu sia Jezreel khua ah theng hi. Jezebel in bang thu teng piang ci in za zo a, a ma in mitkhu vom za kinoai in, a sam pot in, kumpi inn tung khelki panin lampi ensuk hi.","title":"Kumpinu Jezebel Kithat"},"31":{"text":"Jehu sia khuapi kongpi sungah a tum ciangin ama in oksan a, “Nang Zimri! Nang tual that pa! Hi sungah bang hi ni ziam?” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Jehu in ento a, “Akua teng kei sangah hong pang nu ziam?” ci hi. Kumpi inn sung uliante nii khawng thum khawng in khelki pan en suk hi,"},"33":{"text":"tuaciang Jehu in, “Ama hong vawk suk tavun,” ci hi. Amate in a vawksuk uh le pangte tungah a chi kithe a, siphute tung zongh ah kithe hi. Jehu in a siphu le a leang ama ii luang tungah hawl a,"},"34":{"text":"kumpi inn sungah tum hi, tuaciangin an ne hi. Tua zawkciang bekma in hi bang ci hi. “Tua a kitomlaw sa numei sia la vun a phum vun; a tatakin ci leang ama zongh kumpipa tanu khat hi,” ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahihang ama phum tu a pai te in a lungu le a khut ngu, a peang ngu simngawl bangma mu nawn ngawl uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Hi thu amate in Jehu munah a ko uh ciangin Jehu in, “Hi sia Topa ii naseampa Elijah tungah a sonsa bangin a piang hi: ‘Jezreel ii ngamkhen sungah uite in Jezebel luang ne tu hi.","ref":"1 Kum 21:23"},"37":{"text":"Ama ii pumpi sia eak bangin kithethaang tu hi, tuasia ciang kuama in ama pumpi ahi hunlam son thei ngawl tu hi,’ ci hi,” ci in son hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samaria khuapi ah Ahab ii suan le paalte mihing 70 om uh hi. Jehu in khuapi ukte, khuapi sungah lampuite le Ahab ii suan le paalte a keamte munah lai at a thaak hi. A laithak sungah:","title":"Ahab ii Suan le paalte Kithat"},"2":{"text":"“No sia kumpipa ii suan le paalte a keam te nu hi, tuaciang na uuk po na zak tu uh siphu ngalleang te, siphute, ngalhiamte le kulh taw a ki uum khuapite nei nu hi. Tua ahikom hi laithak na nga uh po ciang"},"3":{"text":"kumpipa ii suan le paal sung pan a kilawmbel khat teal in, kumpipa suaksak vun a, tuaciang ama hung tu in ngal do vun,” ci in at hi."},"4":{"text":"Samaria ukpite sia lau mama uh hi. “Kumpipa Joram le kumpipa Ahaziah ii zaw ngawl Jehu sia ei in bangbangin nalh zo tu hi ziam?” ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom kumpi inn ah vaipuak neite, khuapi tungah vaipuak neite kikopin, ngammite lampuite le kumpipa bangkua a keamte in hi kamthaak sia Jehu tungah puak uh hi; “Ko sia na naseamte khu hi, nangma ii ci po a seam tu in kinging khu hi. Ahihang kuama kumpipa in koi ngawl tu khu hi; phabel na sak bangin hong seam ta'n,” ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Jehu in laithak dang khat puak hi: “Kei sangah nong pang uh a, tuaciang ka thupiak babang zui tu na hi uh le, zing ciang tu hunin Kumpipa Ahab ii suan le paal teng ii lutang hong puak tavun,” ci hi. Kumpipa Ahab ii suan le paal 70 teng sia Samaria ngammi lampuite ii kep le ou ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Jehu laithak a kinga ciangin, Samaria lampuite in Ahab ii suan le paal 70 teng thatlum in a lutang uh bawm sungah heangin Jehu omna Jezreel ah puak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahab ii suan le paalte ii lutang teng hong kipaipui zo hi ci in Jehu tungah a kison ciang ama in tua lutangte khuapi kongpi hui ah kholh nii in sengin a zingsang kik dong tua munah a kinusiat tu in thupia hi."},"9":{"text":"A zingsang ciangin ama khuapi kongpi ah pai in, tua munah a om mite munah, “Kumpipa Joram suam tu a sawm sia keima khi hi; no sia tua tungtaang ah bangma vaipuak nei ngawl nu hi. Ahihang hite sia akua in thatlum ziam?"},"10":{"text":"Hi sia in Ahab ii suan le paalte huvau Topa ii kamsaang Elijah ii tungtawnin a pau teng taangtung hi,” ci in lak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jehu in Ahab ii bee le phung dangte, Jezreel a om theampo le a uliante, a ngualtamhte, a thiampite, khat zongh a nungta in kikhoaikhe ngawl hi.","ref":"Hos 1:4; 1 Kum 12:28"},"12":{"text":"Jehu in Samaria khua ah pai tu in Jezreel khua nusia hi. Lampi tung mun khat, “Tuucingte Ngiaphual” a kicina munah,","title":"Kumpipa Ahaziah ii Mealheakte Kithat"},"13":{"text":"A thisa Judah kumpipa Ahaziah ii mealheakte pawlkhat taw kisi in amate tungah, “A kuate nu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Amate in, “Ahaziah ii mealheakte khu hi! Kumpinu Jezebel tate le kumpi innkuanpui a taanglaite zatakna pia tu in Jezreel ah pai tu khu hi,” ci in zo uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Jehu in, “Hing mat siat vun!” ci in a ngalkapte thupia hi. A ngalkapte in amate manin Jehu in dum khat ii hui ah that siat hi. A vekpi in mihing 42 pha a, khat zongh khoaikhe ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Jehu vaiding kik a, lampi ah Rechab ii tapa Jonadab taw kisi uh hi. Jehu in paupui a, “Nang le kei ih khua ngaisutna kibang hi, Kei nong panpui tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Jonadab in, “Hong panpui tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi. “Na khut hong thaak ta'n,” Jehu in ci hi. Amate kilen uh hi, tuaciang Jehu in ama sia siphu ngalleang tungah a kaato zawk natu kaito in,","title":"A taanglai Ahab Mealheakte theampo Kithat"},"16":{"text":"“Keima taw paikhawm tawng, Topa tungah bangza in kipia khi ziam nangma ma in hong mu ta'n,” ci in son kawm hi. Tuaciang amate Samaria ah leang taw paikhawm uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua mun a thet ciang Jehu in Ahab ii mealheak theampo khat zongh khoaikhe ngawlin thatlum siat hi. Hi sia in Topa ii Elijah munah piang tu hi ci in a sonsa teng ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Jehu in Samaria ngammite kaikhawm in hi bang ci hi, “Kumpipa Ahab in Baal pathian sia tawmno bia hi, ahihang keima in tua sangin a nasia zaw in ka bia tu hi.","title":"Baal A biate Kithatlum"},"19":{"text":"Baal ii kamsaangte theampo le ama a biate theampo, ama thiampite theampo a vekpi hong sam siat tavun. Kuama kamzong thei ngawl tu hi; Baal tungah sangaw biakpiakna nasia takin vawt tu khi hi, tuaciang hi sungah hong kihel ngawl peuma kithisak tu hi,” ci hi. (Hi sia in Jehu ii a theamna hi a, Baal a biate theampo a thalup nopna hi.)"},"20":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jehu in thupia a, “Baal zatak piak natu biakna ni khat thangsak vun,” ci hi. Thu thansakna kivawt a,"},"21":{"text":"tuaciang Jehu in Israel ngam bup ah kam zasak hi. Baal a bia theampo hong pai uh hi, hong pai ngawl khat zongh om ngawl hi. Amate theampo Baal biakinn sungah tum uh a, biakinn monglang pan monglang dong dim uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaciang Jehu in puantual thiangtho a keam thiampipa munah puantualte pusua in biakpiakna a vawtte pia in sawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jehu ama mama zongh biakinn sungah, Rechab ii tapa Jonadab taw tum a, tuaciang tuasung ah om mihingte munah, “Baal biate bek a sungah om tu a, tuaciang Topa a biate kuama a kihel ngawl natu in a pha takin en vun,” ci in sawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama le Jonadab in pai in sangaw biakpiakna, meihal biakpiakna Baal tungah pia hi. Ama in pasal 80 biakinn pua sangah koi a, hi bangin thupia hi. “Hi mihingte a vekpi in thatlum siat tu nu hi, khat po in amate a suaktasak a om le ama ii nuntakna taw lul tu hi!” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Jehu in biakpiakna a vawt zawkciang a cingte munah, “Tum vun a, a vekpi in thatlum siat vun; khat zongh suaktasak heak vun,” ci hi. Amate namsau daw sa in tum a, a vekpi in thatlum siat in, amate luang sia doipua ah kaikeak uh hi. Tua zawkciang amate a sungnung biakna munah tumin,"},"26":{"text":"a thiangtho khuam sia pusua uh a, haltum uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuabangin amate in a thiangtho khuam sia susia in biakinn zongh susia uh a, a biakinn sia eakbuk suaksak uh hi, tu ni dong ma in tuabangin om lai hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuabangin Jehu in Israel ngam ah Baal biakna phiat siat hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahihang khamh khuital limte Bethel le Dan ah koi in Israel te in biasak a, mawna sungah a lampui kumpipa Jeroboam ii ngamtatna teng ama in zui hi."},"30":{"text":"Topa in Jehu tungah, “Ahab le a suan a paalte tungah vawt a kong oai theampo vawt zo ni hi. Tua ahikom na suante khang li dong Israel te kumpipa in koi tu khi hi ci in kamciam hong pia khi hi,” ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahihang Jehu in a thin theampo taw Topa Israel te ii Pathian thukhamte ni ngawl a, ama in Israel te mawna sungah a then Jeroboam ngamtatna zuizaw hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Topa in Israel ngam ii a zaina khiam tu in hong kipan hi. Syria Kumpipa Hazael in Israel te ii ngam theampo zo hi,","title":"Jehu ii Thina"},"33":{"text":"Jordan ii nisuana Aroer khuapi thangsang Arnon Ngun hui dong zo hi — tuasung ah Gilead le Bashan ngamkhen te, Gad, Reuben le Nisuana Manasseh te ii teenna teng kihel hi."},"34":{"text":"Jehu ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo ama ii hanna nasepte dong Israel Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama thi a Samaria ah kiphum hi, tuaciang ama ii tapa Jehoahaz in a kumpi za laih hi."},"36":{"text":"Jehu in Israel kumpipa khat a hina taw Samaria panin kum 28 sung uk hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Ahaziah ii nu Athaliah in a tapa ii kisuamlupna a zaak po ciang kumpipa innkuan pui theampo thalup natu thupia hi.","title":"Judah te ii Kumpinu Athaliah (2 Khangtaanghthu 22:10—23:15)"},"2":{"text":"Ahaziah ii tapa Joash bekma suakta hi. Ama sia a dangte taw kithatlum dektak a, ahihang a ni Jehosheba in suatak hi, tua nu sia Kumpi Jehoram ii tanu hi a, Ahaziah ii suapui sealh ahi hi. Ama in Joash sia a keam nu taw la in Biakinnpi sung lupna inndoi khat sungah koi a, kithalup ngawl natu in Athaliah ii mu natu pan seal hi."},"3":{"text":"Kum luk sung Jehosheba in patangno sia biakinn sungah Athaliah ii Kumpinu a sep sung theampo phual hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang a kum sali na ciangin thiampi Jehoiada in kumpipa a cingte le kumpi inn a cingte a uk uliante Biakinn ah samin, ama ii ngealna bang a ngamtat nop natu kiciamna taw thukimna vawtsak hi. Ama in Kumpipa Ahaziah ii tapa Joash amate lak hi,"},"5":{"text":"tuaciang hi thupiakna teng pia hi: “Sabbath ni in vaipuak la tu in nong pai uh ciang, no sung pan see thum sua see khat in kumpi inn cing tu nu hi;"},"6":{"text":"a dang see thum sua see khat sia Sur Kongpi cingin om tu nu hi, tuaciang a om lai see thum sua see khat te inn kongpi ah kong cingte nung pan cing sawn tu nu hi."},"7":{"text":"Sabbath ni a vaipuak nei ngawl a om pawl nii te sia kumpipa hung tu in Biakinnpi ah a cingin om tu nu hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa Joash sia noma in namsau daw sa in cing tu a, ama ii paina theampo ah ama ompui tu nu hi. No ii nai ah hong pai khat po a om le thatlum tu nu hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Uliante in Jehoiada ii hil bangin ni a, a mite ama kungah paipui hi — Sabbath ni a vaipuak nei ngawlte le vaipuak neite paipui uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in uliante sia David ii neisa, Biakinnpi sungah a kikeam tei le lum te pia a,"},"11":{"text":"tuaciang ama in kumpipa cing tu in ngalkapte sia a namsau daw sa in Biakinn mai kiimkot ah koi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jehoiada in Joash pusua pui in, kumpilukhu a lu tungah koi a, kumpite ii zak tu thukham laibu bu khat Joash pia hi. Tua zawkciang Joash sia sathau noai in kumpipa hi ci in taangko uh hi. Mipite in a khut uh beang uh a, “Kumpipa a khansau tahen!” ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpinu Athaliah in a cing ngalkapte le mipite ii awsa za ahikom, mihonpi kikhawm in a omna Biakinnpi ah manlang in pai hi."},"14":{"text":"Ngeina om bangin kumpipa thak sia Biakinnpi tumna khuampi kungah dingin a om sia kumpinu in mu hi. Ama sia uliante le lemle tumte in kiim uum uh a, mipite a vekpi in lungnuam takin au in, lemle tum uh hi. Athaliah in a puansilh baltham in, “Hong leeheak hi! Hong leeheak hi!” ci in au hi.","ref":"2 Kum 23:3"},"15":{"text":"Jehoiada in Athaliah sia biakinnpi huang sungah a kithalup tu oai ngawl ahikom ama in ngalkap uliante munah: “A ngual a ngualin a cingte kilaklaw panin ama la in paipui vun, ama suatak a sawm pawpo that vun,” ci in thupia hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in Athaliah manin, kumpi inn ah paipui uh a, tua mun Siphu Kongpi ah ama thatlum uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Thiampi Jehoiada in Kumpipa Joash le mipite, Topa ii mite a sua natu in Topa taw thuciamna vawtsak hi; ama in kumpipa le mipite kilaklaw ah zongh thuciamna vawtsak hi.","title":"Jehoiada ii Ngam puua kikna (2 Khangtaanghthu 23:16-21)"},"18":{"text":"Tua zawkciang mipite in Baal ii biakinn ah pai uh a, biakinn baltham uh hi; amate in biaknataute le milimte saat tham uh a, tuaciang Baal ii thiampi Mattan sia biaknatau ii mai ah thatlum hi. Jehoiada in Biakinn ah a cingte koi in,"},"19":{"text":"tua zawkciang ama sia ngalkap uliante, kumpipa a cing ngalkapte, le kumpi inn a cingte in kumpipa sia Biakinnpi pan kumpi inn ah paipui uh a, mihonpite in zui uh hi. Joash in Cinna Kongpi panin tumin, kumpi tokhum tungah ama ii mun hong la hi."},"20":{"text":"Mipi theampo sia lungdam uh a, kumpi inn sungah Athaliah zongh kithat zo ahikom khuapi sung sia ngamdai in om uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Joash sia kum sali a phak laitakin Judah te kumpipa suak hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel ah Jehu Kumpipa a maan zawk a kum salina ciang Joash sia Judah te ii kumpipa suakin, ama in Jerusalem panin kum sawmli sung uk hi. A nu sia Beersheba khua panin Zibiah ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Joash (2 Khangtaanghthu 24:1-16)"},"2":{"text":"A khan tawntung ama in Topa ii diksak tu bebekin ngamta hi, banghang ziam cile Jehoiada thiampipa in ama hil hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahitazong doai biakna munte kisusia ngawl a, tuaciang mihingte in sangaw biakpiakna le ngimnamtui halna te tua munah vawt tan lai uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Joash in thiampite sam a, Biakinnpi sungah sangaw biakpiakna tungtaang sum a kipiate, hun maan a sangaw biakpiakna tung pan sumte ahizong amate tungah a thin zawna taw piakte ahizong, tua sumte a top natu in thupia hi.","ref":"Pu 30:11-16"},"5":{"text":"Thiampi sim in ama ii sepsak mite tung pan a nga uh sumte vaipuak in a laak natu le a kisamh bangin Biakinnpi puua natu a kizak natu in thupia hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang Joash ii maan zawk a kum 23 dong sia thiampite in Biakinnpi puuana khat zongh nei ngawl uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in Jehoiada le a dang thiampite samin, “Banghangin Biakinnpi puua ngawl nu ziam? Tu pan kipan sum na saan uhte noma keam nawn ngawl tu nu hi; Biakinnpi puua natu in aap tu nu hi,” ci in sawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Thiampite lungkim uh a, Biakinnpi amate ii puua kul ngawl tu sia zongh thukim uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jehoiada in thingkuang khat la in, a sitna tungah a hawng khat vut hi, tuaciang a thingkuang sia biaknatau ii kung, Biakinnpi sung tumna ii ziatsang ah koi hi. Tumna munah vaipuak a nei thiampi sia in biakpiakna a piate ii sum theampo thingkuang sungah khia hi."},"10":{"text":"Thingkuang sungah sum tam a om simin kumpipa ii thuzeakpa le Thiampi Lianbelpa hong pai in, ngunn teng a tui thapsak zawkciang khai tee uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A pha za tatak a kiteptee zawkciang Biakinnpi sung nasepte a ukpa tungah a ngunnte aap in, tua pa in lettamate, inn sate,"},"12":{"text":"uksuang ciangte, suang at te pia in, inn puua natu in a kisamh thing le suangte theampo lei a, a dang zak tu a kisam theampo pia uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahizong a sumte sung panin ngunn haite, kuangte, lemle te, meiinn taw kisai vanhzakte, ngunn le khamh taw a kivawt vanh te ii manh tu in kizangh ngawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua sumte sia naseamte thaman le biakinn puuana sung a kizangh vanhte leina bekin kizangh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua nasep taw kisai in a ukte sia thumaan takpi ahikom tua sumte tungtaang ah sazian koi kul ngawl hi.","ref":"2 Kum 22:7"},"16":{"text":"Khialphel biakpiakna le mawphel biakpiakna atu a kipia sumte sia thingkuang sungah kikoi ngawl hi; tuate sia thiampite neisa ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 7:7"},"17":{"text":"Tua hunin, Syria te ii Kumpipa Hazael in Gath khuapi simin zo hi; tua zawkciang ama in Jerusalem sim tu sawm hi."},"18":{"text":"Judah te Kumpipa Joash in ama ii mai ah a maang Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, le Ahaziah te ii Topa tungah a aapsa uh piakkhiatnate la in ama ii piakkhiatna taw ngawm a, Biakinnpi sung le kumpi inn sungah khamh theampo taw kop in Kumpipa Hazael letsongin a piak ciang, tua kumpipa in a ngalkapte Jerusalem panin leidang zot pui hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa Joash ii a sep a vawt a dang theampo sia Judah Kumpite Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"20":{"text":"Kumpipa Joash ii uliante in ama thalup sawm uh a, tuate sung pan nii, Shimeath ii tapa Jozacar le Shomer ii tapa Jehozabad in Jerusalem nisuana sangah lei kihukna mun Silla paisukna lampi tungah a kisa inn sia sungah thatlum uh hi. Joash sia David ii Khuapi sung kumpi thaan ah kiphum a, a tapa Amaziah in a kumpipa za laih hi.","merge":"21"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah te Kumpipa Ahaziah ii tapa Joash maan zawk a kum 23 kumin, Jehu ii tapa Jehoahaz sia Israel te ii kumpipa suak a, ama in Samaria panin kum sawm le kum sali uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Jehoahaz"},"2":{"text":"Ama mai ah kumpipa Jeroboam bangma in ama in Topa tungah maw a, Israel mite mawna sungah thetpui hi; ama in a ngilo ngamtatnate kheal ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa sia Israel tungah thin uuk hi, tuaciang ama in Syria te kumpipa Hazael le a tapa Benhadad in Israel sia hun khat zawk hun khat zosak hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jehoahaz in Topa tungah thungen a, tuaciang Topa in Syria te ii kumpipa in Israel mite nasia takin a kinengcip a mu ciang a thungetna zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Israel te lampui khat puak a, Syria te khut sung pan ama in suatak hi, tuaciang nidang bangma in, Israel sia ngammuangin om uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang amate in Kumpipa Jeroboam ii Israel mite mawna sungah a lampuina te nusia ngawl uh a, tua mawnate ma vawt suak lai uh hi, tuaciang numeipathian Asherah ii lim sia Samaria ah taanglai hi."},"7":{"text":"Jehoahaz in siphu ngalkap 50, siphu ngalleang sawm le ngalkap 10000 simngawl ngalkap nei ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Syria kumpipa in a dang teng susia in leivui bangin amate tuanhcil hi."},"8":{"text":"Jehoahaz ii a sep a vawt le a hanna dang teng sia Israel Kumpite Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama thi a, Samaria ah kiphum hi, tuaciang a tapa Jehoash in a kumpi za lua hi."},"10":{"text":"Judah te Kumpipa Joash ii maan zawk a kum 37 kumin Jehoahaz ii tapa Jehoash sia Israel te ii kumpipa suak hi, tuaciang ama in Samaria pan kum sawm le kum luk sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Jehoash"},"11":{"text":"Ama in zongh Israel te mawna sungah a lampui, Kumpipa Jeroboam ii siatna teng zui in Topa tungah maw hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama ii sep le vawt dangte, Judah te kumpipa Amaziah taw a kidona sungah a hanna theampo a kihel in Israel Kumpipate ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"13":{"text":"Jehoash thi a Samaria khua kumpi thaan ah kiphum a, a tapa Jeroboam II in a kumpi za laih hi."},"14":{"text":"Kamsaangpa Elisha sia thithei natna taw na a, ama thi tu in a lupna ah Israel te Kumpipa Jehoash in ve hi. “Ka pa awng, ka pa awng!” ci in au in kap hi. “Nang sia Israel a hung a thahat pa ni hi!” ci hi.","title":"Elisha Thina","ref":"2 Kum 2:12"},"15":{"text":"Elisha in, Jehoash tungah, “Thal khat le thaltang pawlkhat hong la ta'n,” ci in thupia hi. Jehoash in tuate la a,"},"16":{"text":"Elisha in tua thal kaap tu in kinging in sawl hi. Kumpipa in a sawl bangin mang a, tuaciang Elisha in a khut sia kumpipa khut tungah koi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kamsaangpa ii sawl bangin Syria ngam sang a nga khelki sia kumpipa in hong hi. “Thaltang kap in!” ci in Elisha in thupia hi. Kumpipa ii thaltang a kaa zawk po ciang kamsaangpa pau a, “Nang sia Topa ii thaltang ni hi, tua taw Topa in Syria te zo tu hi. Nangma in Aphek ah Syria te na zaw dong na do tu hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Elisha in kumpipa munah thaltang dang teng zongh la in lei saatna nei in ci in sawl hi. Kumpipa in lei thumvei saat a, tua zawkciang tawp hi."},"19":{"text":"Hi sia in Elisha thin uuksak a, ama in kumpipa munah, “Nga vei lukvei bang na saat tu hi ve, tua hile Syria te zo siat tu ve teh, tu in amate thumvei bekma zo tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Elisha thi in ama kiphum hi. Kum simin Moab te in a hon veu in Israel ngam sim uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Khatvei mithi khat a kivui laitakin tua ngalte honkhat kingal mu a, tuaciang mithi puate in a thiluang sia Elisha ii thaan sungah lawnsuk uh a, amate taikeak uh hi. Elisha ii ngu taw a kiphak po ciang mithi sia nungta kik a, ding to hi."},"22":{"text":"Syria Kumpipa Hazael in Jehoahaz ii maan sung theampo Israel nengcip ngawp a,","title":"Israel te le Syria te Kilaklaw ah Ngal"},"23":{"text":"ahizong Topa in amate tungah thuthiamin hesuak hi. Amate a kimaimot mang tu oai ngawlin, hu zaw hi, banghang ziam cile Abraham, Isaac le Jacob te tungah thuciamna a vawt hang ahi hi. Ama in a mite mangil ngeingawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Syria Kumpipa Hazael a thi ciang a tapa Benhadad kumpi suak hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Israel Kumpipa Jehoash in Benhadad sia thumvei zo zo a, tuaciang a pa Jehoahaz ii khan lai a Benhadad ii suan sa khuapite ama in la kik hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel te Kumpipa Jehoahaz ii tapa Jehoash ii maan zawk a kum nii na ciang, Joash ii tapa Amaziah sia Judah te kumpipa suak hi,","title":"Judah Kumpi Amaziah (2 Khangtaanghthu 25:1-24)"},"2":{"text":"ama kum 25 pha a, ama in Jerusalem panin kum 29 sung uk hi. A nu sia Jerusalem pan a Jehoaddin hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in Topa ii diksak bangin ngamta a, ahihang ama sia a taanghpupi David bang hi ngawlin, a pa Joash ii ngamtat bangin ngamta zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in doai biakna munte baltham ngawl a, tuaciang mihingte in sangaw biakpiakna le ngimnamtui halna te tua munah zom to suak uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaziah in a thuneina a kip po ciang, a pa kumpipa a that uliante thatsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang ama in tuate ii tate thatlum ngawl a, Moses Thukham sungah Topa ii thupiak ahi: “A tate ii a vawt khialnate hu in nute pate kithisak ngawl tu a, pate nute ii a vawt khialnate hu in tate kithisak ngawl tu hi; mihing khat sia ama ii khialna hang bekin kithisak tu hi,” a cite zui hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:16"},"7":{"text":"Amaziah in Edom ngalkapte 10,000 sia Ci Kuam sungah that hi; ama in Sela khuapi sia kidona sungah suan a, Joktheel ci in a min phuak a, tu dong ma tua min pua lai hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang Amaziah in Israel te Kumpipa Jehoash tungah kamtaite paisakin kido natu thato hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang Kumpipa Jehoash in hi bang zo kikna thaak kik hi: “Khatvei lai in lingkung khat Lebanon Mual tungah a om sia in cedar kung khat ii munah: ‘Na tanu sia ka tapa ii zi tu hong pia ta'n,’ ci hi. Ngamsa khat hong pai in lingkung sia tuanhcil hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu in Amaziah awng, nang in Edom te na zaw hu in kisathei ni hi. Na minthanna taw lungkim in a, inn ah om po in. Nang le na mite lalna bek hong pia tu ngimna banghangin piangsak nuam ni ziam?” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang Amaziah in ngai nuam ngawl hi, tua ahikom Kumpipa Jehoash in a mite taw kuanin Judah ngam Beth Shemesh ah kido uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaziah ii ngalkap honte in lel a, a ngalkap te theampo amate inn tek ah tai uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Jehoash in Amaziah sia manin thongtaaksak hi, Jerusalem ah paisuak in a khuapi ii luphung sia Ephraim Kongpi pan A Kiing Kongpi dong metre 200 dektak kikaal sung teng baltham hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in ngunn le khamh a mu theampo, biakinn vanh theampo le kumpi inn sungah sumngum te la in Samaria ah ciapui hi. Ama in mihing pawlkhat zongh a kitan kik tu in ciapui hi."},"15":{"text":"Jehoash ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo, kumpipa Amaziah taw a kidona sungah a hannate huamin, Israel te ii Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"16":{"text":"Jehoash thi a, ama sia Samaria khua kumpi thaan ah kiphum hi, tuaciang a tapa Jeroboam II in ama ii kumpi za laih hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel Kumpipa Jehoash ii thi zawk kum sawm le kum nga dong Judah te kumpipa Amaziah nungta hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Amaziah Thina (2 Khangtaanghthu 25:25-28)"},"18":{"text":"Amaziah ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo sia Judah te Kumpipate ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaziah suamlup natu in Jerusalem ah sawmna khat om hi, tua ahikom ama sia Laschish khuapi ah tai hi, ahihang a ngalte in tua munah zuizen in thatlum uh hi."},"20":{"text":"A luang sia siphu khat tungah suanh in Jerusalem ah ciapui uh hi, David khuapi kumpi thaan ah ama kiphum hi."},"21":{"text":"Judah mite in a tapa kum sawm le kum luk a pha Uzziah sia kumpilukhu khusakin kumpi suaksak hi."},"22":{"text":"A pa thi zawkciang Uzziah in Elath khua suan kikin sa kik hi."},"23":{"text":"Judah te kumpipa Joash ii tapa Amaziah maan zawk a kum sawm le kum nga kum in Jehoash ii tapa Jeroboam sia Israel te ii kumpipa suak hi, tuaciang ama in Samaria pan kum 41 sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Jeroboam II"},"24":{"text":"Ama in, Israel sia mawna sungah a then, ama mai ah a seam masa Nebat ii tapa Kumpipa Jeroboam ii a ngitlo ngamtatna teng zui in Topa tungah maw hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in Israel te ii neisa ngamkhen theampo, saksang pan Hammath Mualciangh, thangsang pan Tuipi Thi dong zo kik hi. Hisia in Jonah Gath Hepher khua pan a kamsaangpa Amittai ii tapa Oonah tungah Topa, Israel te ii Pathian ii a kamciamsa sia ahi hi.","ref":"Jon 1:1"},"26":{"text":"Topa in Israel te ii a cizathuai mama thuakna sia mu hi; tuaciang amate a hu tu kuama om ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahihang Israel te a bo cimit tu sia Topa ii tupna hi ngawl hi. Tua ahikom ama in amate sia Kumpipa Jeroboam II tungtawnin suatak hi."},"28":{"text":"Jeroboam II ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo, ngal sung a hanna le Damascus le Hamath khuate, Israel te atu a laak kikna theampo sia Israel Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"29":{"text":"Jeroboam thi a, kumpi thaan ah kiphumin, tuaciang a tapa Zechariah in a kumpi za lua hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Jeroboam II kumpi a sep zawk a kum 27 kumin Amaziah tapa Uzziah sia Judah te kumpipa suak a,","title":"Judah Kumpipa Uzziah (2 Khangtaanghthu 26:1-23)"},"2":{"text":"ama kum sia kum sawm le kum luk pha in, Jerusalem pan kum 52 sung uk hi. A nu sia Jerusalem pan a Jecoliah ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A pa ii ngamtatna zui in ama in Topa ii diksak bangin ngamta hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang doai biate ii biakna munte kisusia ngawl a, mihingte in sangaw biakpiakna le ngimnamtui halnate tua munah vawt suak lai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Uzziah sia a kiitakhuai vun natna taw vaat a, a thi dong tua natna vei hi. Ama in ama ii aituam inn khat ah teang a, a vaipuak theampo kipengsakin, a tapa Jotham in ngam uk hi."},"6":{"text":"Uzziah ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo sia Judah Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"7":{"text":"Uzziah thi a, David ii khuapi sung kumpi thaan ah kivui a, a tapa Jotham in a kumpi za laih hi.","ref":"Is 6:1"},"8":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Uzziah maan zawk a kum 38 kumin Israel te ii kumpipa Jeroboam II ii tapa Zechariah sia Israel te ii kumpipa suak a, tuaciang ama in Samaria pan tha luk sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Zechariah"},"9":{"text":"Ama in, ama mai ah a seam masa te bangma in Topa tungah maw hi. Ama in Nebat ii tapa kumpipa Jeroboam ngitlo ngamtat sia teng zui in, Israel te mawna sungah lampui hi."},"10":{"text":"Jabesh ii tapa Shallum in Kumpipa Zechariah suam tu a sawm bangin Ibleam ah thatlum hi, tuaciang a kumpi za ama in lua hi."},"11":{"text":"Zechariah ii sep le vawt a dangte theampo sia Israel Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa ii Kumpipa Jehu tungah kamciam a piak, “Na suan na paalte khang li dong Israel kumpipate suak tu hi,” a ci sia taangtung hi.","ref":"2 Kum 10:30"},"13":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Uzziah a maan zawk a kum 39 kumin, Jabesh ii tapa Shallum sia Israel te ii kumpipa suak hi, tuaciang ama in Samaria pan tha khat sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Shallum"},"14":{"text":"Gadi ii tapa Menahem in Tirzah pan Samaria ah pai a, Shallum suamlum in a kumpi za lua hi."},"15":{"text":"Shallum ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo, a ngual suamna thute a kihel in Israel Kumpipate ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"16":{"text":"Menahem in Tirzah panin a pai ciangin Tappuah khuapi, a sungah a teangte le a kiim a paam ngamkhen teng susia cip hi, banghang ziam cile ama tungah ki aap ngawl hi. Nau ngai numeite theampo ii ngilpi ngawngawn khuakeak hi."},"17":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Uzziah ii maan zawk a kum 39 kum in Gadi ii tapa Menahem sia Israel te ii Kumpipa suak hi, tuaciang ama in Samaria pan kum sawm sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Menahem"},"18":{"text":"Ama in, a thi dong Israel te mawna sungah a lampui Nebat ii tapa kumpipa Jeroboam tatsiatna teng zui in, Topa tungah maw hi."},"19":{"text":"Assyria te ii kumpilianpa Tiglath Pileser in Israel sim a, tuaciang Menahem in, ngam sungah ama ii vaangletna a kip natu tua kumpipa ii panpui natu in ngunn kilogramme 34,000 pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Menahem in tua dangka te sia Israel ngam ah mihaute khat sim tung pan ngunntang 50 tek zawthawk thu taw khonin a nga ahi hi. Tua ahikom Tiglath Pileser sia ama ngam ah cia kik hi."},"21":{"text":"Menahem ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo sia Israel Kumpite ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama thi in kiphum a, a tapa Pekahiah in ama kumpi za laih hi."},"23":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Uzziah ii maan zawk a kum 50 kumin Menahem ii tapa Pekahiah sia Israel te ii kumpipa suak hi, tuaciang ama in Samaria panin kum nii sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Pekahiah"},"24":{"text":"Ama in, Israel sia mawna sungah a lampui Nebat ii tapa Kumpipa Jeroboam ii ngitlo ngamtat teng zui in, Topa tungah maw hi."},"25":{"text":"Pekahiah ii ngalkap ulian khat ahi Remaliah ii tapa Pekah in Gilead khua pan mihing 50 taw ama thasawmin, Samaria kumpi inn a sungnung kulh sungah Pekahiah sia suamlum a, ama in a kumpi za lua hi."},"26":{"text":"Pekahiah ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo Israel Kumpipate ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"27":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Uzziah ii a maan zawk a kum 52 kumin Remaliah ii tapa Pekah sia Israel te kumpipa suak a, ama in Samaria ah kum kul sung maang hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Pekah"},"28":{"text":"Ama in Israel te mawna sungah a lampui Nebat ii tapa Kumpipa Jeroboam ii ngitlo ngamtatna teng zui in, Topa tungah maw hi."},"29":{"text":"Pekah kumpipa ahi hun laitakin Assyria te ii kumpilianpa Tiglath Pileser in, Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh le Hazor khuapi teng le Gilead ii ngamkhen, Galilee le Naphtali teng suan hi, tuaciang a mihingte sia Assyria ah thongtaak tu in ciapui hi."},"30":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Uzziah ii tapa Jotham ii maan zawk a kum kul lai in Elah ii tapa Hoshea in kumpipa Pekah sia thasawmin, suamlup zawkciang a kumpi za sia ama in lua hi."},"31":{"text":"Pekah ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo sia Israel Kumpipate ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"32":{"text":"Remaliah ii tapa Pekah ii Israel kumpi in a maan zawk a kum nii kumin Uzziah ii tapa Jotham sia Judah te kumpipa suak hi,","title":"Judah Kumpipa Jotham (2 Khangtaanghthu 27:1-9)"},"33":{"text":"ama ii kum sia kum 25 pha a, Jerusalem panin kum sawm le kum luk sung uk hi. A nu sia Zadok ii tanu Jerusha hi."},"34":{"text":"A pa Uzziah ii ngamtatna zui in Jotham in Topa ii diksak te ngamtatna in nei hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahihang doai biate ii biakna munte kisusia ngawl hi, tuaciang mihingte in sangaw biakpiakna le ngimnamtui halna te tua munah vawt suak lai uh hi. Biakinnpi ii Saksang Kongpi a sa sia Jotham ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Jotham ii sep le vawt a dangte theampo sia Judah Kumpipate ii Taanghthu sungah kikhum siat hi."},"37":{"text":"Ama kumpipa ahi laitakin Topa in Judah te sim tu in Syria te kumpipa Rezin puak masa a, tuaciang Israel te kumpipa Pekah puak hi."},"38":{"text":"Jotham thi a David ii Khuapi sung kumpi thaan ah kiphumin a tapa Ahaz in a kumpi za laih hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Remaliah ii tapa Israel te ii kumpipa Pekah ii maan zawk kum sawm le kum sali kum in Jotham ii tapa Ahaz sia Judah te kumpipa suak hi,","title":"Judah Kumpipa Ahaz (2 Khangtaanghthu 28:1-27)"},"2":{"text":"ama kum kul pha a, Jerusalem panin kum sawm le kum luk sung uk hi. Ama in a taanghpupi David ii ngamtatna phate zui ngawl a; Topa Pathian ii diksak ngawlte vawt zaw hi,"},"3":{"text":"tuaciang ama in Israel kumpipate ii ngamtatna te veu zui hi. Ama in, Israel mite hong mainawt uh lai in, Topa ii a ngamsung pan a nawkeakte ii a thasiathuai ngamtatnate zui a, a tapa ngawngawn milim biakna meihal biakpiakna in nei hi.","ref":"Thkna 12:31"},"4":{"text":"Doai biate ii biakna mun, mualte ii tung, le thinglim nuai sim ah, Ahaz in sangaw biakpiakna le ngimnamtui halnate piakhia hi."},"5":{"text":"Syria te kumpipa Rezin le Israel kumpipa Pekah in Jerusalem sim a, uumci ahihang Ahaz sia zo zo ngawl uh hi.","ref":"Is 7:1"},"6":{"text":"(Tua hun sung ma in Edom te kumpipa in Elath khuapi la kik a, Judah mi tua munah a teangte notkeak hi. Edom te Elath a teang a, teang top lai uh hi.)"},"7":{"text":"Ahaz in Assyria te ii kumpilianpa Tiglath Pileser munah kamtaite paisak a: “Keima in a thumaan na naseampa khi hi. Hong pai ta'n a, Syria le Israel kumpipate khut sung pan hong hun khia ta'n, amate in kei hong sim hi.” cisak hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahaz in ngunn le khamhte Biakinn pan le kumpi inn sung sum kholna pan la in, kumpilianpa tungah letsong in thaak hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahaz ii maangkaa na a zona in Tiglath Pileser in a ngalkap hon taw Damascus ah kuan in, tua khuapi suan a, kumpipa Rezin thatlum in a mite sia thongtaak tu in Kir khua ah paipui hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa Ahaz in Damascus ah Kumpilianpa Tiglath Pileser taw kimu tu in a pai ciang, tua munah a om biaknatau sia mu hi, ama in tua biaknatau ii lim sia kheet nei ngawlin a kicing tatakin suai a, Uriah thiampipa thaak kik hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom Uriah in biaknatau tuasia taw a kibang linlian khat vawtsak a, Ahaz hong heak kik ma in man hi."},"12":{"text":"Damascus pan hong cia kik ciang Ahaz in biaknatau sia a kiman sa in mu hi,"},"13":{"text":"tua ahikom ama in nganhingte taw sangaw biakpiakna le antang biakpiakna tua biaknatau tungah vawt a, tuaciang sapittui biakna le kipawlkhop biakpiakna chi te bungh suk hi."},"14":{"text":"Taau taw kivawt biaknatau Topa tungah a ki aapsa sia biaknatau thak le Biakinnpi kilaklaw ah koi uh a, tua ahikom Ahaz in biaknatau thak sia ii saksang ah khiin hi.","ref":"Pu 27:1-2; 2 Khang 4:1"},"15":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in Uriah munah, “Hi keima aa ahi biaknatau lian sia zingsang meihal biakpiakna le nitak antang biakpiakna, kumpipa le a mipite meihal biakpiakna le antang biakpiak natu le mipite ii sapittui biakpiak natu in zangh in. Nganhing sangaw biakpiakna a kizangh theampo ii chi sia a tungah sung in. Ahihang taau biaknatau sia keima ii aisaanna ah ka zak tu in na koi in,” ci in thupia hi."},"16":{"text":"Uriah in kumpipa thupiak bangin seam hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa Ahaz in Biakinnpi sungah a kizangh taau leang sia a tuamin la a, tua tungah a om kuangpuite heam hi; ama in taau khuital sawm le nii te nungzaang pan taau tuikuangte zongh la in suangtum doppha tungah koi hi.","ref":"1 Kum 7:23-39; 2 Khang 4:2-6"},"18":{"text":"Assyria te kumpilianpa a lungkimsak natu in Ahaz in Biakinnpi sung pan kumpi tokhum koina dawtuam sia heamkhia in, kumpipa ii Biakinnpi sung aituam tumna bangkua zongh khakbil hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahaz Kumpipa ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo sia Judah Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum siat hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahaz thi a, David Khuapi sung kumpi thaan ah kiphumin, a tapa Hezekiah in a kumpi za laih hi.","ref":"Is 14:28"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah ah kumpipa Ahaz a maan zawk a kum sawm le kum nii kumin Elah ii tapa Hoshea sia Israel te kumpipa suak a, ama in Samaria pan kum kua sung uk hi.","title":"Israel Kumpipa Hoshea"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Topa tungah maw a, ahizong ama mai ah Israel a uk kumpipa dangte za in maw ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Assyria kumpilianpa Shalmaneser in ama tungah ngal phuang hi; Hoshea in Shalmaneser tungah tum in, kum simin shia pia hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang Hoshea in kum khat ciang, Egypt kumpipa So tungah hu ngen tu in kamtai paisak hi, tuaciang Assyria te tungah shia a piak sia tawp hi. Shalmaneser in hi thu a heak ciang Hoshea mansak in thong sungah khum hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Shalmaneser in Israel simin Samaria uumci hi. A uumci zawk a kum thum kum,","title":"Samaria khua Bona"},"6":{"text":"Hoshea ii maan zawk a kum kua a phak kumin Assyria te ii kumpilianpa in Samaria suan hi, Israel te thongtaak tu in ciapui a, tuate sung pan pawlkhat sia Halah khuapi ah, pawlkhat sia Gozan ngamkhen sung Habor Ngun hui ah, tuaciang pawlkhat sia Media te khuapite ah teangsak hi."},"7":{"text":"Samaria khua bona sia Egypt ngam panin amate a pusua pui, Egypt kumpipa khut sung pan a hunkhia Topa a Pathian tungah a maw uh hang ahi hi. Amate in pathian dangte bia uh a,"},"8":{"text":"a mite ii a mainawt ciang Topa ii a nawkeak mite ii ngeina te zui pui in, Israel kumpipate ii a piansak tawm ngeinate zuisak uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel te in Topa a Pathian ii thukimpui ngawl nate seam uh hi. Amate in doai biate ii biakna munte khua theampo, khuanobel pan khuapi lianbel dongah sa uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Mualtung theampo le thinglim nuai sim ah, Asherah numeipathian ii milim le suangkhuamte phut uh hi,","ref":"1 Kum 14:23"},"11":{"text":"tuaciang, Topa ii a ngam pan a betkeak mihingte ii ngamtatna zui in amate in ngimnamtuite doai biate tau tungah hal uh hi. Amate in Topa thin uuk natu in amate ii ngitlo ngamtatna te taw piangsak a,"},"12":{"text":"milim biak ngawl natu Topa ii thupiakte ni ngawl uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in a kamtai te le a kamsaangte paisakin Israel le Judah te a kidop natu in sawl a: “Na ngamtat siatna uhte nusia vun a, na taanghpupite uh ka piak Thukhamte sungah a om, ka naseam ka kamsaangte tungtawnin no tungah kong piak kong sawlna te ni vun,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang amate in a thu ni ngawl uh hi; Topa a muang ngawl a taanghpupite uh bangma in thinpui uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama ii hilnate nit tu nial hi, a taanghpupite taw thuciamna a vawtte zongh keam ngawl uh a, kidop natu a piakte zongh thu in sim ngawl uh hi. Amate in a mannung ngawl milimte bia uh a, amate mama zongh a mannung ngawl suak uh hi, amate in a kiim a paam ah mite ii ngeinate zui uh a, Topa ii zui heak vun ci in a thupiakna sia ni ngawl uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa a Pathian ii thukham theampo amate in paltan uh a, amate in thik taw a kivawt khuital nii ii lim a biak tu in vawt uh hi; amate in Asherah numeipathian ii milim zongh vawt a, aksite bia in, Baal pathian ii naseam uh hi.","ref":"1 Kum 12:28"},"17":{"text":"Amate in a tapa a tanute doai biate ii pathiante tungah meihal biakpiakna in pia uh hi; amate in thaa sam theite le aisaan theite thu dongh uh hi, tuaciang amate in Topa ii muna ah a maan ngawlte vawt tu in kipum aap uh a, Topa thin uukna piangsak hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:10"},"18":{"text":"Topa sia Israel tungah thin uuk ahikom ama ii mu na pan bengkeak a, Judah kumpi ngam bek khe hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahihang Judah mite ngawngawn in zongh Topa a Pathian ii thukhamte ni ngawl uh a; Israel te ii ngeina a zak uhte zui uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in Israel te nial in, daan pia a, a ngilo ngalte khut sungah aap hi, a khakbel ciang ama ii muna pan bengkeak hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in Israel le Judah a khen zawkciang Israel te in Nebat ii tapa Jeroboam sia kumpi suaksak uh hi. Jeroboam in Israel te a Topa taisansak in a kiitakhuai mama mawna sungah then hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in Jeroboam zui in ama ii mawna a vawt theampo vawt paisuak uh a,"},"23":{"text":"a naseam kamsaangte tungah Topa ii ka vawt tu hi ci in a kidop natu a sonkhol bangin a khakbel ciang ama ii mu na pan betkeakna a thuak uh dong amate in mawna vawt uh hi. Tua ahikom Israel mite sia Assyria ah sal in kiciapui a, tu ni dong tua munah teang lai uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Assyria kumpilianpa in Babylon, Cuth, Ivvah, Hamath le Sepharvaim khuapite pan mihingte paipui in, saltaang Israel te ii teenna mun Samaria te khuapite ah teangsak hi. Hi khuapite, amate ii neisa sua in tua munah teang uh hi.","title":"Assyria te Israel Ngam sungah Teang"},"25":{"text":"Amate tua munah a ten phit sawngin Topa bia ngawl uh ahikom Topa in tawpi te puakin, amate pawlkhat thatlumsak hi."},"26":{"text":"Assyria te ii kumpilianpa munah, Samaria khuapite ah mihing a teensakte in tua ngam ii pathian thukhamte he ngawl ahikom a pathian in tawpi puakin thatsak hi, ci in son hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahikom kumpilianpa in: “Thiampi ih ciapui thongtaak te sung pan khat puak kik vun a; a ngam ii pathianzia a mite tungah a hil tu in tua munah cia kik in teangsak vun,” ci in thupia hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom Samaria pan a kihawlkhia Israel thiampi khat sia pai in, Bethel ah teang a, tua mun pan Topa bangbangin bia tu ci in a mihingte hil hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahihang Samaria ah a teang mite in amate ii milim tek ma vawt suak uh a, Israel te ii vawt sa biakpiakna buk sungah koi uh hi. A kibang ngawl pawl tuatuam sim in amate ii teenna khuapite ah a milimte vawt tek uh hi;"},"30":{"text":"Babylon mite in Succoth Benoth pathian ii milimte vawt a; Cuth mite in Nergal pathian milimte; Hamath mite in Ashima milimte;"},"31":{"text":"Ivvah mite in Nibhaz le Tartak milimte; tuaciang Sepharvaim mite in a pathian uh Adrammelech le Anammelech tungah meihal biakpiakna in a tate pia uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Hi mite in Topa zongh bia uh hi, tuaciang doai biate ii biakna munte sangaw biakpiakna munte ah thiampi seam tu le amate taangin sangaw biakpiakna a pia tu in amate sung pan mi tuatuamte teal uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuabangin amate in Topa bia uh a, ahihang amate hong paina a ngamte ii ngeinate bangma in amate tek ii pathiante zongh bia uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Amate in a ngeina luite tu ni dongin zom suak lai uh hi. Amate in Topa bia ngawl a, Israel ci in min a piak Jacob ii suan le paalte tung a piak thukham le thupiaknate zongh ni ngawl uh hi.","ref":"Pian 32:28; 35:10"},"35":{"text":"Topa in amate taw thuciamna vawt in, “A dang pathiante bia ngawl tu nu hi; tuate mai ah kun ngawl tu nu hi tuaciang a na seam ngawl tu nu hi, tua ahibuale zong sangaw biakpiakna pia ngawl tu nu hi.","ref":"Pu 20:5; Thkna 5:9"},"36":{"text":"No te Egypt ngam pan vaangletna le thahatna taw hong pusuapui keima Topa ii thu hong ni tu nu hi, note kei mai ah hong kun tu nu hi, tuaciang sangaw biakna zongh hong pia tu nu hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:13"},"37":{"text":"Note a tu ka at thukhamte le thupiakte a tawntungin ni tu nu hi. A dang pathiante bia ngawl tu nu hi,"},"38":{"text":"tuaciang no taw thuciam ka vawtte mangil ngawl tu nu hi."},"39":{"text":"Keima Topa , na Pathian ii thu nong ni tu uh a, tuasia ciang, na ngalte kung pan kong suatak tu hi,” ci in thupia hi,"},"40":{"text":"Ahihang tua mite in ngai ngawl uh a, amate ii ngeina luite ma zui veve uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua hi a, tua mite in Topa bia uh hi, ahihang amate ii a milimte zongh bia uh hi; tuni dong ma in a suan a paalte in tuabangin ngamta lai uh hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel ah Elah ii tapa Hoshea ii maan zawk a kum thum kum Ahaz ii tapa Hezekiah sia","title":"Judah Kumpipa Hezekiah (2 Khangtaanghthu 29:1-2;31:1)"},"2":{"text":"ama kum 25 a phak laitakin Judah te ii Kumpipa suak a, Jerusalem panin kum 29 sung uk hi. A nu sia Zechariah tanu Abijah hi."},"3":{"text":"A taanghpupi David ii ngamtatna zui in ama in Topa ii diksak tu in ngamta hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in doai biate ii biakpiakna munte sutham hi, suangkhuamte sutan in, tuaciang numeipathian Asherah limte zongh sattan siat hi. Moses ii vawt taau ngul, Nehushtan a kici sia zongh sutham hi. Tua hun dong sia Israel mite in tua taaungul upat vawtna in ngimnamtui hal uh hi.","ref":"Mi 21:9"},"5":{"text":"Hezekiah in Topa Israel te ii Pathian muang hi; Judah mite in ama ii hun ma hikale ama ii hun zawkciang hikale ama taw a kibang kumpipa nei ngeingawl uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Topa tungah thumaan in, bangma hunin a thu ni ngawlin a om ngei bua hi, Topa ii Moses tungah a piak thupiakna te phinciing takin keamcing hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa sia ama taw omkhawm a, tuaciangin ama sia a sep a vawt theampo ah zawna nga hi. Ama in Assyria te ii kumpilianpa langpanin leedo a ama khutnuai ah tum nuam ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in Philistine te zo in, Gaza le a kiim a paam ngamte kihel amate ii teenna khuanobel te pan kipan khuapi lianbel te dong kuanin sim hi."},"9":{"text":"Hezekiah ii a maan zawk a kum li kum ciang — tuasia Israel te tungah kumpipa Hoshea ii maan zawk a kum sali kum hi a — Assyria te ii Kumpilianpa Shalmaneser in Israel simin Samaria uumci hi."},"10":{"text":"A uumci zawk a kum thum kum ciangin Samaria khua bo a; Hezekiah ii maan zawk a kum lukna hi a, Hoshea ii maan zawk a kum kua kum ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Assyria te ii kumpilianpa in Israel te thongtaak tu in paipui a, pawlkhat sia Halah khuapi sungah, pawlkhat Gozan ngamkhen sung Habor Ngun hui ah, pawlkhat sia Media te khuapite ah teangsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Samaria khua bo hi, banghang ziam cile Israel in Topa a Pathian ii thu ni ngawl hi, tua banah amate taw thuciam a vawt te zongh paltan uh a, Topa naseampa Moses ii thukham a piakte theampo zongh ni ngawl uh hi.
