Amate in za nuam ngawl a, ni nuam ngawl uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa Hezekiah ii a maan zawk a kum sawm le kum li ciangin, Assyria te ii kumpilianpa Sennacherib in Judah te ii kulh taw a ki uum khuapite simin zo hi.","title":"Assyria te in Jerusalem Tawng (2 Khangtaanghthu 32:1-19 ; Isaiah 36:1-22)"},"14":{"text":"Hezekiah in Lachish a om Sennacherib tungah, “Keima in seam khial zo khi hi; nong hesuakna in hong sim nawn heak in, nong nget pawpo kong pia tu hi,” ci in kamthaak hi. Kumpilianpa in zo kik a, Hezekiah in ngunn kilogramme 10,000 le khamh kilogramme tulkhat ama a puak tu in sawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Hezekiah in Biakinnpi sung le kumpi inn sumkholna sungah ngunn teng thaak hi,"},"16":{"text":"ama in Biakinnpi kongbiang khuamte tung pan khamhte zongh khokin, tuaciang ama mama ii kongbiang khuamte a tuamna khamhte la in Sennacherib thaak siat hi."},"17":{"text":"Assyria kumpilianpa in ngalkaphon lian khat Jerusalem ah Hezekiah sim tu in paisak hi; tua ngalkaphonpi sia ama ii uliante a za lianbel thum teng in uksak hi. Amate Jerusalem a thet uh ciangin, amate in tuili tungnung sia pan tui hong luanna hawkluam sia ii hui ah a om puantak naseamte ii omna lampi sia lua uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaciang amate in Hezekiah samsak uh hi, tuaciang ama ii uliante thum in amate taw kisi tu in pai uh hi: tuate sia kumpi inn a keam pa Hilkiah ii tapa Eliakim, zum lai atpa Shebna; le thu tepteena teng a uk Asaph ii tapa Joah ahi uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Assyria uliante khat in, kumpipa Hezekiah sia a bang teng in hi zata in ngammuangsak thei ziam ci sia kumpilianpa in he nuam hi, ci in son hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in, “Ngalkap lam sang thiamna le hatna te sia kam le muk taw kizo thei hi ci in um nu ziam? Assyria te nong leedo uh sia akua in hong hu tu in um nu ziam?"},"21":{"text":"Egypt te in no hong hu tu in um nu hi, ahihang tua ngaisutna sia pumpa kung ciangkhut in zak taw kibang tu hi — hong tal tu a, na khut uh hong sun tu hi. Egypt kumpipa sia ama a suang pawpo atu tuasia taw kibang hi,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Assyria ulianpa in, “Tua ahibuale zong noma in na Topa Pathian uh suang nu ziam? Topa ii biakpiakna bukte le biaknataute a sutham sia Hezekiah hi, ama in Judah mite tungah Jerusalem biaknatau bekma ah biakpiakna vawt thei tu nu hi, ci in thupia hi."},"23":{"text":"Kumpilianpa min taw thukimna khat no taw ka vawt tu hi. A tungah a to tu mihing tuaza in a tam na mu zo uh le siphu tulnii hong pia tu khi hi."},"24":{"text":"No sia Assyria te sung pan a za nobel sia taw zong kitee ngat thei ngawl lai nu hi, hi napi Egypt te in siphu ngalleang le siphu ngalkapte puak tu in na muangmaw uh hi!"},"25":{"text":"Topa ii hong huna kihel ngawlin na ngam uh sim tu in hong um nu ziam? Topa ama mama in simin susia in ci in kei hong sawl hi,” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Eliakim, Shebna le Joah in ulian pa munah, “Aramaic kam in hong pau ta'n, topa awng, tua kam tel khu hi. Hebrew kam in hong pau heak vun, luphung tungah a to mite theampo in hong ngai hi,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in zo kik a, “Kumpilianpa in hite theampo sia no le na kumpipa zaak tu bek in son a hong sawl sa nu ziam? Hi ngawl hi, noma bang keakin, a eak uh ne a, a zun uh a dawn tu, luphung tungah a to te ii zaak tu in ka pau ahi hi,” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ulian pa hong dingto in Hebrew kam in hong au hi, “Assyria kumpilianpa ii hong son teng ngai vun!"},"29":{"text":"Ama in Hezekiah ii hong theam ngawl natu kidopna hong pia hi. Hezekiah in no hong hun zo ngawl tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa a suang tu in ama in zolsak zo heak vun. Topa in no hong hun tu in um heak vun, tuaciang Assyrian ngalkapte ii na khuapi hong lak tu hong khak zo tu um nu ziam?"},"31":{"text":"Hezekiah ii thu son ngai heak vun. Assyria te kumpilianpa in, khuapi panin hong pusuak tavun a hong tum tavun ci in thu hong pia hi. Noma sapitkungte panin sapitte hong kinesak tu a, na thingkung uhte panin thei ngate hong kinesak tu hi, tuaciang na tuikhuk uh pan tui hong kidawnsak tu hi —"},"32":{"text":"tua teng sia kumpilianpa ii note teen kik natu ngam hong piak dong hi tu a, tua ngam sia noma ngam taw ma kibang tu hi, sapittui na neak natu uh sapithuan om a, anluum vawt natu antang om tu hi: tua ngam sia olive kung le olive thau, le khuaitui omna ngam hi. Ama ii hong thupiak bangin na ngamta uh le na thi buatu uh a, na nungta tu uh hi. Topa in note hong suatak tu hi ci in Hezekiah in theamsak heak vun."},"33":{"text":"Ngamdangte ii pathiante in zongh a ngam uh sia Assyria kumpilianpa ii khut sung pan hunkhia ngei na ziam?"},"34":{"text":"Amate tu in koisungah om ziam? Hamath le Arpad ii pathiante, koisungah om ziam? Sepharvaim, Hena, le Ivvah te ii pathiante koisungah om ziam? Samaria akua in hun ngei ziam?"},"35":{"text":"Ko ii kumpilianpa khut sung pan hi pathiante khat pawpo in hi ngamte hun ngei ka na ziam? Tua ahile Topa in Jerusalem hun thei tu hi ci in bang in hong ngaisunsak ziam?” ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Mihingte sia kumpipa Hezekiah ii sawl bangma in dai khipkhep in om uh a; amate in kam khat zongh pau ngawl uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuaciangin Eliakim Shebna le Joah te in heena taw a puansilh uh baltham uh a, tuaciangin Assyria ulian pa ii pauna teng kumpipa munah son uh hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Hezekiah in amate ii a puak thu a zaak po ciang he mama in a puansilh eaukeak in, khau-ip puan silhin Topa Biakinnpi sungah tum hi.","title":"Kumpipa in Isaiah Thu dongh (Isaiah 37:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in kumpi inn a keam pa Eliakim, zum lai at pa Shebna le thiampi uhaam pa sia Amoz ii tapa kamsaangpa Isaiah kungah paisak hi. Amate theampo zongh khau-ip puan silh uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate ii Isaiah tungah kammal thaak tu a piak sia hi teng hi. “Tuni sia haksatna ih thuak ni hi; ei hong kidaantat a, hong kimaimawlsak hi. Ei sia numei khat nausuak tu kipan ahihang tha mama nei ngawl khat taw ih kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"Assyria kumpilianpa in ama ii ulianbel pa a nungta Pathian a selno tu in hong paisak hi. Na Topa Pathian in hi a selnonate za hen a, tuabang a paute daan pia tahen. Tua ahikom Pathian tungah ih mihingte a nungta lai teng atu thu ngen in,” ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Isaiah in kumpipa Hezekiah ii kamthaak teng a nga ciang,"},"6":{"text":"ama in, “ Topa in nang hong hun thei bo a ci, Assyria te ii pauna te in pautausak heak in."},"7":{"text":"Topa in kumpilianpa sia a ngam ah a ciakik natu kamleang khat zasak tu hi, ama tua munah kithat lumsak tu hi, ci in Topa in nang hong son hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"8":{"text":"Assyria ulian pa in kumpilianpa sia Lachish khua nusia in a nai na Libnah khuapi ah ngaldo hi ci in za hi; tua ahikom ama in ama taw kamkum tu in pai hi.","title":"Assyria te in Tawnna Dangkhat Puak (Isaiah 37:8-20)"},"9":{"text":"Egypt te ngalkap honte Ethiopia kumpipa Tirhakah in lampui in amate sim tu hi ci in Assyria te in thu za uh hi. Kumpilianpa in hi thu a zaak ciang ama in Judah te kumpipa Hezekiah tung ah,"},"10":{"text":"“Na muanna Pathian in nang sia kei khut sungah taak ngawl tu ni hi hong ci hi, ahihang tua in nang theamsak heak in."},"11":{"text":"Assyria kumpilianpa khat in ama ii siatsak nop ngam khat pawpo sia bang law ziam na zaaksa hi. Nang suakta thei tu ki um ni ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Ka taanghpupite in khuapite ahi Gozan, Haran le Rezeph te susia a, Telasar a teang Bethedan mite zongh mon hi, amate ii pathiante in hun thei ngawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena le Ivvah khuapi te ii a kumpipate koi sungah om ziam?” ci in lai khat thak hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang Hezekiah in kamtaipa tung pan a laithak sia la in sim hi. Tua zawkciang ama Biakinnpi sungah tumin Topa ii ompuina ah laithak sia koi hi,"},"15":{"text":"tuaciang, “Cherubim te ii tungsia na tokhum tungah a to, Topa Israel te ii Pathian awng, nang bekma Pathian na hi hi, leitung kumpi ngam theampo a uk pa na hi hi. Nangma in lei le van na bitphua hi.","ref":"Pu 25:22"},"16":{"text":"Tu in Topa awng, ko tungah thu hong piangte en in. Nang a nungta Pathian hong selnona Sennacherib ii pau teng ngai in."},"17":{"text":"Topa awng, Assyria te kumpilianpa in ngam tam mama susia a, a leitangte ngamkhing in omsak hi,"},"18":{"text":"tuaciang pathian hi ngawl het a, mihing khut bek taw a kivawt thing le suang milim ahi, a pathian uhte haltham ahi hunlam kote theampo in he khu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu in, Topa ka Pathian awng, Assyria te kung panin hong hun ta'n, tuasia ciang leitung ngamte theampo in nang, Topa bek Pathian na hi hunlam hong he tu hi,” ci in thungen uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Isaiah in Kumpipa Hezekiah tungah kumpipa ii thungetna a zo kikna teng sia","title":"Kumpipa tungah Isaiah ii Kamthaak (Isaiah 37:21-38)"},"21":{"text":"Topa in, “Sennacherib awng, Jerusalem khuapi in nang hong nuisan hi, hong thusim ngawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Nang in akua thusim ngawl a, akua selno in kingaisun ni ziam? Nang in kei, Israel ii a thiangtho Pathian nong zatak vawt bua hi."},"23":{"text":"Na siphu ngalleangte taw Lebanon mualsaangbel te na zawthalna thu kisuangtaak tu in kei kungah na kamtai te nong paisak hi. Nangma in cedar thingkung saangbelte le cypress thing phabelte ka phuktan a, dui thuk belna mun ka theng hi ci in na kisuangtaak hi."},"24":{"text":"Ngamdang ah tuikhuk to in tui ka dawn hi na ci a, na ngalkapte in Nile ngun tuanh in kosak hi ci in na kisuangtaak hi."},"25":{"text":"“Hi teng sia khuangeipi lai in ka ngeal sa ahi hunlam za ngeingawl ni ziam? Tuciangin tuasia taaksua zo khi hi. Kulh taw a ki uum khuapite niinthuk kikholte suaksak tu in thahatna kong pia hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua munah a teang mihingte sia thahatna nei ngawl hi; amate lau in khing liang uh hi. Amate sia lo sungah lopate ahibuale nisuana pan vuisa ii seam keak innkhum tungah a po lopate taw kibang hi."},"27":{"text":"“Ahihang nang huvau theampo, bang vawt a koi sungah pai, ci in kong he hi. Kei hong langpanin na kitom ngawp kong he hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua na kitomna thu le na kiphatsakna hong kikona te ka za hi, tu in na naak pailet in thikkoai kong thaak tu a, na kam sungah kamkhau kong khii tu hi, nong paina lampi sia ma tawnin kong leekai kik tu hi,” a ci teng sonsak hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Isaiah in Kumpipa Hezekiah munah, “Hong piang tu thu ii lim sia hisia hi. Tu kum le mai ciangin ngamh ante bek na ne tu uh hi, ahizong a kum kik ciang na ciin sa uh ante na at tu a, na suan sa uh sapitngate na ne tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Judah ngam ah a luhai lai teng sia thingno bangin khang tu a, lei ah zung thuk tha in, a nga bangin nopci tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Jerusalem ah mite om tu a, Zion Mual ah a luhai in om tu hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in hisia a pian natu khensat hi."},"32":{"text":"“Assyria kumpilianpa huvau Topa ii ci sia hisia hi: ‘Ama in hi khuapi sungah tum ngawl tu a, thaltang khat zongh hi khuapi ngatin kap ngawl tu hi. Lum toai ngalkap khat zongh in hi khuapi hong neak ngawl tu a, tuaciang a uumci natu in a kiim ah leivum khat zongh kivawt ngawl tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama hi khuapi sungah tum ngawlin hong paina lampi ma tawnin heak kik tu hi, Keima, Topa pau zo khi hi."},"34":{"text":"Keima vaang atu le ka naseampa David tungah ka kamciamna hangin hi khuapi sia dal in hung tu khi hi’ ” ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua zanin Topa vantunglalang khat Assyria te ngiaphual ah pai in ngalkap 185,000 thatlum hi. A zingsang khuavak ciang amate a thisa in tua munah liik siat hi!"},"36":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Assyria kumpilianpa Sennacherib nungkin in Nineveh khua ah heak kik hi."},"37":{"text":"Ni khat ni in ama in a pathian Nisroch ii biakinn sungah ama bia in a om laitak a tapate nii, Adrammelech le Sharezer te in a namsau uh taw thatlum hi, tuaciang amate Ararat ngam ah tai in suakta uh hi. A tapa dangkhat Esarhaddon in a za laih a kumpilianpa suak hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi hun sung khawngin Kumpipa Hezekiah sia a ciina in thi dektak hi. Amoz ii tapa, kamsaangpa Isaiah in ama taw kimu tu in pai a, ama munah, “ Topa in nang tungah na theampo a kilawm bangin hong koi tahen, banghang ziam cile dam kik ngawl tu ni hi. A thi tu kinging hen hong ci hi,” ci in son hi.","title":"Hezekiah Kumpipa ii Natna le Dam kikna (Isaiah 38:1-8 ; 21-22; 2 Khangtaanghthu 32:24-26)"},"2":{"text":"Hezekiah in a maitang pang sang nga in,"},"3":{"text":"“ Topa awng, nang tungah thumaanna le citakna taw in nong oai theampo hanciam in ka sep tawntung sia hong phawk ta'n,” ci in thungen hi. Tuaciang ama nasia takin kap hi."},"4":{"text":"Isaiah in kumpipa paisan ahihang kumpi inn leitual laita sia a kaantan ma in"},"5":{"text":"Topa in mite a ukpa Hezekiah kungah Isaiah pai kik in sawl a, ama munah, “Kei, Topa, na taanghpupi David ii Pathian in na thungetna kong za zo a, na thitui luan ka mu zo hi. Nang hong damsak tu khi hi, tuaciang tu zo ni thum ciangin Biakinnpi ah pai tu ni hi."},"6":{"text":"Kum sawm le kum nga hong nungtasak lai tu khi hi. Assyria kumpilianpa khut sung pan nang le hi Jerusalem khuapi sia hong suatak tu khi hi. Keima vaang tu le ka naseampa David tungah kamciam ka piak hu in hi khuapi hung tu khi hi,” ci in sonsak hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Isaiah in kumpipa a ou te munah theinga panin a kivawt noi thei khat a uilut noai le uhte ama dam tu hi, ci in sawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa Hezekiah in, “ Topa in hong damsak tu a, ni thum ciangin Biakinnpi ah ka pai thei tu sia bang lim taw tel tu khi ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"9":{"text":"Isaiah in, “ Topa in a kamciam bang len tu hi ci in hong lakna in lim khat hong pia tu hi. Tu in keallei tungah a limh sia a mai sangah kal sawm paisak tu deizaw ni ziam ahibuale a nungsangah kal sawm nungkinsak nuam zaw ni ziam?” ci kik hi."},"10":{"text":"Hezekiah in, “A limh liap sia a mai ah kal sawm paisak tu ol hi! Kal sawm nungkinsak in,” ci in zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Isaiah in Topa tungah thungen a, Kumpipa Ahaz ii vawt keallei tungah a limh sia kal sawm Topa in nungkinsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua hun khawngma in Babylon kumpi ahi Baladan ii tapa Merodach Baladan in Hezekiah kumpipa ciinat za ahikom ama in lai thaak khat le letsong khat thaak hi.","title":"Babylon pan Kamtaite (Isaiah 39:1-8)"},"13":{"text":"Hezekiah in tua kamtaite pha takin vaidawn a, tuaciang a hauna teng amate lak hi — ama ii ngunn le khamhte, hel namtuite le paaknamtuite tuaciang a ngal vanh teng lak hi. Ama ii vanh kholna inndoi sung ahizong ama ii kumpi ngam sungah ahizong a lak ngawl vanh khat beak zongh a om bua hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kamsaangpa Isaiah sia Hezekiah kumpipa kungah pai in, “Mihing hite koisung pan hong pai a, amate in nang tungah bang hong ci ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Hezekiah in, “Amate ngam khuala mama na Babylon panin hong pai hi,” ci in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"“Kumpi inn sungah amate in bang teng mu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. “Amate in na theampo mu siat hi. Vanh kholna inndoite sungah ka lak ngawl bangma om ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuasia ciang, Isaiah in kumpipa tungah, “ Topa Vaanglianbelpa in,"},"17":{"text":"na kumpi inn sungah vanh om theampo, na taanghpupite ii tuni dong a kholsa theampo Babylon ah a kipuak tu hun khat hong theng tu hi. Bangma kikhe ngawl tu hi.","ref":"2 Kum 24:13; 2 Khang 36:10"},"18":{"text":"Nangma ii suan le paal tatak te pawlkhat kipaipui tu a, a cil uh kinget in Babylon kumpi inn sungah numei uk kiseamsak tu hi ci hi,” ci in son hi.","ref":"2 Kum 24:14-15; Dan 1:1-7"},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa Hezekiah in hi teng sia ama ii nuntak sungah ngal kilemna le ngam muanna om tu hi cinopna in saang ahiciangin, “ Topa tung pan nong thu piak teng sia thupha hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"20":{"text":"Hezekiah kumpipa ii a sep a vawt dang teng, a ngal hanna, tuikholna khat a vawtna le khuapi sungah tui a luan natu lei a tawletna thute theampo sia Judah Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum siat hi.","title":"Hezekiah ii Maanna Bo (2 Khangtaanghthu 32:32-33)"},"21":{"text":"Hezekiah thi a, a tapa Manasseh in a kumpi za laih hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh sia Judah kumpipa a sua hunin ama kum sawm le kum nii pha hi, tuaciang ama in Jerusalem panin kum 55 sung uk hi. A nu sia Hephzibah hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Manasseh (2 Khangtaanghthu 33:1-20)"},"2":{"text":"Topa ii mite mai sang hong nawk ciang a kinotkeak minamte ii a thasiathuai ngamtatna te zui in Manasseh in Topa tungah maw hi.","ref":"Jer 15:4"},"3":{"text":"A pa Hezekiah ii a suksiatcip sa doai biate ii biakpiakna munte ama in sa kik hi; Israel kumpipa Ahab ii vawt bang keak ma in ama in Baal biak natu biaknataute sa in, Asherah numeipathian ii milim vawt hi. Manasseh in aksite zongh bia hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in Topa ii ama a kibiak natu mun hi a ci Biakinnpi sungah doai sepna taute sa hi.","ref":"2 Sa 7:13"},"5":{"text":"Biakinnpi ii leitualte nii sungah aksite a biak natu biaknatau te vawt hi."},"6":{"text":"A tapa sia meihal biakpiakna in pia hi. Ama in aisaan le mitbumna zangh in, tuaciang aisaan theite le thaa sam theite kungah thu veu dongh hi. Ama in Topa tungah nasia takin maw a, a thin uukna piangsak hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in numeipathian Asherah ii lim sia Biakinnpi sungah koi hi, tua mun sia Topa ii David le a tapa Solomon tungah: “Hi Jerusalem khua ah hi Biakinnpi sung sia kei hong kibiak natu in minam sawm le niite ii ngamsung bup pan ka teal ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang Israel mite theampo in ka thupiakna te theampo ni in, ka naseampa Moses ii amate a piak thukham buppi te a keamcing le amate ii taanghpupite tungah ka piak ngam le lei panin a kinawkeak tu ka oai buatu hi,” a cina mun ahi hi.","ref":"1 Kum 9:3-5; 2 Khang 7:12-18"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang Judah mite in Topa thu ni ngawl a, Manasseh in a mite mai sang a nawk hun lai a, Topa ii a nawkeak mite sangin mawna nasia zaw a vawt natu ngawngawn in lampui hi."},"10":{"text":"A naseam kamsaangte tungtawnin Topa in,"},"11":{"text":"“Kumpipa Manasseh in hi a thasiathuai mama nate Canaan mite vawt bang sangin a nasia zaw lai in vawt hi; tuaciang ama ii milimte taw Judah mite mawna sungah lampui hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom kei, Israel te Topa , Pathian in Jerusalem le Judah tungah tuasiatna ka piangsak tu a, a za theampo khing liang tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Samaria daan ka piak bang le Israel kumpipa Ahab le a suan a paalte ka vawt bangin Jerusalem daan ka pia tu hi. Jerusalem sia a mite bo dongin ka nawt siat tu a, a kinawt thiang a khup lam a kikoi pakan khat bangin ka vawt tu hi."},"14":{"text":"A nungta lai teng ka nusia tu a, a ngalte khut sungah ka aap tu hi, tuate in amate zothal tu a, a leitang nopzak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Hi bangin ka vawt tu sia banghang ziam cile ka mite in kei tungah hong maw a, Egypt ngam pan a taanghpupite ii a pusua pan kipan tuni dong ma ka thin hong uuksak tawntung hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Manasseh in mawna nei ngawl mihing tam mama thatlum a, Jerusalem lampite chisan luang hi; hi teng banah ama in a mite milim biakna ah lampui a, Topa tungah mawsak hi."},"17":{"text":"Manasseh ii sep le vawt a dangte theampo mawna a vawtte theampo kihel in, Judah Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"18":{"text":"Manasseh thi a, kumpi inn huang sung Uzza huan ah kiphum hi, tuaciang a tapa Amon in a kumpi za laih hi."},"19":{"text":"Amon sia Judah te kumpipa a sua hunin kum 22 pha a, Jerusalem panin kum nii sung uk hi. A nu sia Meshullemeth hi a, Jotbah khua pan Haruz ii tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Amon (2 Khangtaanghthu 33;21-25)"},"20":{"text":"A pa Manasseh bangma in ama in Topa tungah maw hi;"},"21":{"text":"ama in a pa ii ngamtatna teng zui in a pa ii biak milimte bia hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in a taanghpupite ii Pathian, Topa nial a, Topa ii thupiak ni ngawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Amon ii uliante in ama thasawm in, kumpi inn sungah ama thatlum uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Judah mite in Amon a that teng thatlumin, a tapa Josiah kumpi suaksak hi."},"25":{"text":"Amon ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo Judah Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"26":{"text":"Amon sia Uzza huan sung thaan ah kiphum a, a tapa Josiah in a kumpi za laih hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah sia Judah kumpipa a sua hunin kum liat pha hi, tuaciang ama in Jerusalem pan kum 31 sung uk hi. A nu sia Bozkath khua pan Adaiah ii tanu Jedidah hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Josiah (2 Khangtaanghthu 34:1-2)","ref":"Jer 3:6"},"2":{"text":"Josiah in Topa ii diksak te vawt hi; ama in a taanghpupi David ii lamlak bangin ngamta a, Pathian thukhamte theampo belcing takin zui hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa Josiah in a maan zawk kum sawm le kum liat laitakin, Meshullam ii tupa, Azaliah ii tapa zum thuzeakpi Shaphan sia Biakinnpi ah samsak a:","title":"Thukham Laibu Kimu (2 Khangtaanghthu 34:8-28)"},"4":{"text":"“Thiampi Lianbelpa Hilkiah kungah pai in a, Biakinnpi tumna a vaipuak nei thiampite ii mipite tung pan a khon sumte bangza pha ziam sazian hong la ta'n."},"5":{"text":"A sum sia Biakinnpi puate a ukte tungah a piak tu in son in. Amate in"},"6":{"text":"lettamate, inn sate, uksuang ciangte thaman pia in, thing le suang biakinn pua natu a kizangh teng leina in nei tahen."},"7":{"text":"Nasepnate a ukte sia thumaan mama ahikom a sum zakna uh sazian vawtsak kul ngawl hi,” ci in thupia hi.","ref":"2 Kum 12:15"},"8":{"text":"Shaphan in kumpipa thupiakna teng Hilkiah tungah son a, tuaciang Hilkiah in Biakinnpi sungah Thukham laibu ka mu hi ci in son hi. Hilkiah in tua laibu sia pia a Shaphan in sim hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama kumpipa kungah pai kik a: “Na naseamte in Biakinnpi sung a om sum teng la in, innpuuate a ukte tungah aap siat zo hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in, “Hi sungah Hilkiah ii hong piak laibu khat nei khi hi,” ci hi. Tuaciang ama in kumpipa tungah a nging in sim hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa in laibu a kisim sia thu a zaak ciang, thinnop ngawlna taw a puan eaukeak a,"},"12":{"text":"tuaciang Hilkiah thiampipa, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Micaiah tapa Achbor, zum thuzeakpi Shaphan te tung le kumpipa koppui pa Asaiah te tungah:"},"13":{"text":"“Pai tavun a, hi laibu ii hong hilna thute Topa tungah keima le Judah mi teng a tu in hong dongh tavun. Topa sia ei tungah thin uuk hi, banghang ziam cile ih taanghpupite in hi laibu ii vawt hamtang tu a ci bangin seam ngawl uh hi,” ci in thupia hi."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ii a khenthak sungah a teang Huldah a kici numei kamsaang khat munah thu dongh tu in, Hilkiah, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan le Asaiah te pai uh hi. (A pasal Shallum sia, Tikvah ii tapa, Harhas ii tupa hi a, ama in biakinn sungah a zak puantualte a keampa ahi hi.) Amate in thupiang teng ama munah son uh hi,"},"15":{"text":"tuaciang ama in amate sia kumpipa kungah cia kikin sawl a,"},"16":{"text":"Topa ii thupiak hi teng kumpipa puakin sawl hi: “Keima in Jerusalem le a mite theampo kumpipa ii sim laibu sia sungah a ki at bangin daan ka pia tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in kei hong nial a, tuaciang pathian dangte tungah sangaw biakpiakna pia zo hi, tua ahikom amate ii sep le vawt theampo in ka thin uukna piangsak hi. Ka thin uukna sia Jerusalem tungah tu hi, tuaciang tua ka thin uukna sia veng ngawl tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa ama a tu in hi bangin kei, Topa Israel ii Pathian in ci khi hi: nangma in laibu sung a ki at teng nadon zo ni hi,"},"19":{"text":"tuaciang Jerusalem le a mite daan piak tu ka tawn na te na zaak ciang kisiik kikin kiniamkhiakna taw ka mai ah na puansilh eaukeak in kap ni hi. Mit mu bek zongin a lauhuai mama na mun ka suaksak tu a, mihingte in tua mun ii min sia haamsiatna kammal in a zangh tu hi. Ahihang na thungetna hong za zo khi hi,"},"20":{"text":"tuaciang Jerusalem khua daan ka piak tu sia zongh na thi zawk mateng in tung ngawl tu hi, thinnuam in kong thisak tu hi.” Tua pasalte in hi a thupuak teng taw kumpipa Josiah kungah heak kik uh hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Josiah in Judah ngam le Jerusalem khua ii lampuite theampo khawmtua hi,","title":"Josiah in Doai biate Biakna Vawk (2 Khangtaanghthu 34:3-7 , 29-33)"},"2":{"text":"tuaciang amate sia Biakinnpi ah thiampite le kamsaangte, tuaciang a taanglai mite theampo taw a hau a zawng kibangin paikhawm uh hi. Kumpipa in amate mai ah Biakinnpi sungah a kimu tua thuciamna laibu buppi a ngingin sim hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in kumpi khuam sia kungah dingin ama ii thu a ni tu, a thupiakte le a thukhamte thin theampo ngaisutna theampo taw a keamcing tu le thuciamna taw hong tangkal ngetnate zongh laibu sungah a ki at bangin a seam a vawt tu in Topa taw thuciamna khat vawt uh hi. Tuaciang mite theampo in thuciamna keamcing tu in kamciam pia uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Josiah in Thiampi Lianbel Hilkiah, a khutdawn thiampite, Biakinnpi tumna kongkhacingte munah, Biakinnpi sungah Baal biakna, numeipathian Asherah biakna le aksite biakna vanh theampo pusua siat tu in thupia hi. Kumpipa in hi vanh teng khuapi puasang Kidron kuam hui ah haltum in, a vaam teng sia Bethel ah paipuisak hi.","ref":"2 Kum 21:3; 2 Khang 33:3"},"5":{"text":"Ama in Judah khuapite le Jerusalem nai ah a om sangaw biakpiakna le doai sepna taute tungah a seam Judah kumpi masa te ii kipsak thiampite — Baal tung a sangaw biakpiakna a pia, ni, tha, solh le aksi te biakna ah a seam thiampi theampo heamkhia hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Biakinnpi sung pan Asherah numeipathian ii lim sia la keakin khuapi pua sang Kidron kuam ah a haltum zawkciang a vaamte a zaancip dong sucip in nautaangte kiphumna munah poai hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in pumpi zuakte teenna Biakinnpi sung inndoite baltham hi. (Numeite in tua munah Asherah biak natu a kizangh puantualte tak uh hi.)"},"8":{"text":"Ama in Judah khuapite a om thiampite Jerusalem ah paipui hi, tuaciang ngam bup sungah sangaw biakpiakna vawtna biaknataute phiat hi. Khuapi kongpi sung tum ciang veisang ah a om khuapi uk Joshua ii vawt keal-doai biakna biaknataute zongh baltham hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua thiampite sia Biakinnpi sungah a sep tu ki oai ngawl hi, ahihang amate in a thiampi seppuite a kipia tol saw ngawl anluumte ne thei uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Kuama in a tapa ahibuale a tanu, Molech pathian tungah meihal biakpiakna in a nei thei ngawl natu in, Josiah kumpipa in Hinnom Kuam a om Topheth a kici doaibiakna mun sia zongh lalthamsak hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:21; Jer 7:31; 19:1-6; 32:35"},"11":{"text":"Ama in Judah kumpite ii ni biakna in a zak siphute heam a, hi biakpiakna sungah a kizangh leangte haltum hi. (Hite sia ulian mama khat ahi Nathan Melech ii teenna innte ii nai, biakinn leitual sung, kongpi hui ah kikoi hi.)"},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa Josiah in Ahaz kumpipa teenna inndoite ii tung kumpi innkhum tungah Judah kumpipate ii saksa biaknataute le Manasseh kumpipa ii Biakinnpi leitualte nii sungah a koi biaknataute vaattham hi; ama in biaknataute saatneen in a bek a bek in Kidron kuam ah vawk hi.","ref":"2 Kum 21:5; 2 Khang 33:5"},"13":{"text":"Josiah in Kumpipa Solomon ii saksa Jerusalem nisuana sang Olive Mual thang sangah a om a thasiathuai milim biaknataute — Sidon numeipathian Astarte, Moab pathian Chemosh, Ammon pathian Molech milim biaknate lalsak hi.","ref":"1 Kum 11:7"},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa Josiah in suangkhuamte vaattan in, Asherah numeipathian tepteena limte zongh sattan a, tuaciang tuate ii dinna mun sia mithi ngute taw siin hi."},"15":{"text":"Josiah in Israel te mawna sungah a lampui Nebat ii tapa Kumpipa Jeroboam ii saksa Bethel a om biakpiakna mun sia zongh baltham hi. Josiah in biaknatau kaivawk a, a suangte a bekin sutham in leivui suak tu in seakcip hi; ama in Asherah ii lim zongh haltum hi.","ref":"1 Kum 12:33"},"16":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Josiah in a kiimkot a et le mual tungah thaankuul pawlkhat mu hi; ama in mithi ngute la in biaknatau tungah halsak hi. Kumpipa Jeroboam sia poaikhaam sungin biaknatau hui ah a din laitak kamsaang khat ii nidang pek lai in a sonkhol sa bangin ama in vawt a, hi bangin biaknataute lalsak hi. Kumpipa Josiah in a kiimkot a et le tua bang a sonkhol kamsaangpa ii thaankuul mu hi.","ref":"1 Kum 13:2"},"17":{"text":"Ama in “Zia sia akua thaan ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Bethel mite in, “Tuasia Judah panin hong pai kamsaang khat ii thaan hi a, hi biaknatau tungah na vawt tu teng a sonkhol sia hi,” ci uh hi.","ref":"1 Kum 13:30-32"},"18":{"text":"Josiah in, “A om bangin omsak po vun,” ci in thupia hi. “Ama ii ngute sia khiin tu hi ngawl hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom a ngute sia kikhiin ngawl a, Samaria pan hong pai kamsaangte ii ngu zongh kikhiin ngawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa Josiah in Israel khuapi theampo ah Topa thin uukna piangsak Israel kumpite ii vawt doai biakna munte susia siat hi. Tua biaknataute Bethel a te a vawt bangin vawt hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in doai bia thiampi theampo sia amate ii doai sepna biaknatau tungah thatlum a, tuaciang ama in biaknatau sim tungah mithi ngute hal hi. Tua zawkciang ama Jerusalem ah heak kik hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpipa Josiah in mipite munah thuciam laibu sungah a ki at bangin Topa amate ii Pathian zatakna Paisan Poai vawtin sawl hi.","title":"Josiah in Paisan Poai Vawt (2 Khangtaanghthu 35:1-19)"},"22":{"text":"Hi bang Paisan Poai khat Israel kumpipate ahibuale Judah kumpipate peuma in Thukhenmangte ii ngam a uk zawk nungsang in vawt ngeingawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Tu in a khakbel ciang Josiah ii kumpi maan zawk a kum sawm le liat na hun ciang Jerusalem khua sungah Paisan Poai kivawt hi."},"24":{"text":"Thiampi Lianbel Hilkiah ii Biakinnpi sung pan a mu Thukham laibu sungah a ki at te bang ngamtatsak natu in Kumpipa Josiah in Jerusalem pan le Judah ngam lei dang panin, thaa sam thei te theampo, aisaan theite, bangkua pathiante, milimte, a dang doai sepna in a zak nate a vekpi in heam siat hi.","title":"Josiah ii Kikhealna A Vawt Dangte"},"25":{"text":"Ama ii Topa atu a thin theampo, a ngaisutna theampo le a thatang theampo taw seam a, Moses ii thukham theampo a zui bangin ama ii masia ah kumpi khat zongh om ngeingawl hi; ama zawkciang zong tuabang kumpi khat zongh om ngawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahihang Topa ii a nasia mama a thin uukna sia Kumpipa Manasseh ii ngamtatna hangin Judah te tungah hong tung a, tu dong ma in thai ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel tungah ka vawt sa bangma Judah tungah vawt tu khi hi: Judah mite sia ka muna pan hawlkhia tu khi hi, tuaciang ka tealsa Jerusalem khuapi le keima hong kibiakna mun tu hi ka ci Biakinnpi te zongh, ka nil tu hi,” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpipa Josiah ii a sep a vawt dangte theampo sia Judah Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi.","title":"Josiah ii a Kumpi Maan A tawpna (2 Khangtaanghthu 35:20—36:1)"},"29":{"text":"Josiah sia kumpi ahi laitakin, Egypt kumpipa Neco in Assyria kumpilianpa a hu tu in ngalkaphonpi taw Euphrates ngun ah kuan hi. Kumpipa Josiah in Megiddo ah Egypt ngalkaphonpi khak tu in hanciam a, ama ngal kisimna ah kithat hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama ii uliante in a luang sia siphu leang tungah suan a Jerusalem ah ciapui in, kumpite thaan ah kiphum hi. Judah mite in Josiah ii tapa Joahaz tealin kumpi suaksak hi."},"31":{"text":"Joahaz sia Judah kumpi a sua hunin kum 23 pha hi, tuaciang ama in Jerusalem pan tha thum sung uk hi. A nu sia Hamutal hi a, Libnah khuapi pan Jeremiah ii tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Joahaz (2 Khangtaanghthu 36:2-4)"},"32":{"text":"A taanghpupite ii ngamtat zui in ama in Topa tungah maw hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama ii kumpi maan hun sia Egypt kumpipa Neco in Hamath ngam Riblah ah thong a taaksak ciang bo a, Judah in ngunn kilogramme 3,400 le khamh kilogramme 34 shia in piasak hi."},"34":{"text":"Kumpipa Neco in Josiah ii tapa Eliakim sia Josiah laih tu Judah kumpipa in koi a, a min Jehoiakim ci in khealsak hi. Joahaz sia Kumpipa Neco in Egypt ah ciapui a, tuasung ah thi hi.","ref":"Jer 22:11-12"},"35":{"text":"Kumpipa Jehoiakim in a mipite tung pan amate hauna taw kizui in shia sia, Egypt kumpipa ii nget za a cingin a piak zawk natu in a kisamh bangin khon hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim (2 Khangtaanghthu 36:5-8)"},"36":{"text":"Jehoiakim sia Judah kumpipa a sua hunin ama kum 25 pha hi, tuaciang ama in Jerusalem panin kum sawm le kum khat sung uk hi. A nu sia Zebidah hi a, Rumah khua panin Pedaiah ii tanu hi.","ref":"Jer 22:18-19; 26:1-6; 35:1-19"},"37":{"text":"A taanghpupite ii ngamtat zui in ama in Topa tungah maw hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehoiakim sia kumpipa ahi laitakin Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in Judah sim hi, tuaciang kum thum sung Jehoiakim sia ama ii ukna nuai ah lutsak hi; tua zawkciang ama in leedo hi.","ref":"Jer 25:1-38; Dan 1:1-2"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Babylon te, Syria te, Moab te le Ammon te ii ngalkapte ngalsim tu in Judah ah paisak a, Jehoiakim langpanin Topa in a naseam a kamsaangte tungtawnin ka vawt tu hi a ci bangin Judah lalsak tu in kuan uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Hisia Topa ii thupiakna taw a piang hi a, Kumpipa Manasseh ii mawna teng hu in Judah mite sia ama muna pan a betkeak thei natu a piang ahi hi,"},"4":{"text":"tuaciang, a tuan in mawnei ngawlte theampo zongh a thalup hu ahi hi. Topa in Manasseh ii tuabang ahikom in maisak zo ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Jehoiakim ii sep le vawt theampo sia Judah Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kikhum hi."},"6":{"text":"Jehoiakim thi a, a tapa Jehoiachin in a kumpi za laih hi."},"7":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa le a ngalkaphonpi in Egypt pua sia ah kuan kik nawn ngawl uh hi, banghang ziam cile Babylon kumpipa in tu in Egypt te ii ngam theampo, Euphrates ngun pan Egypt saksang ngamngi dong uk hi."},"8":{"text":"Jehoiachin sia Judah kumpipa a sua hunin kum sawm le kum liat pha a, ama in Jerusalem pan tha thum sung uk hi. A nu sia Nehushta hi a, Jerusalem khua pan Elnathan ii tanu hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Jehoiachin (2 Khangtaanghthu 36:9-10)"},"9":{"text":"A pa ii ngamtat teng zui in Jehoiachin in Topa tungah maw hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama ii kumpi maan hun sungah Nebuchadnezzar uliante ii a uk Babylon ngalkaphonpi sia Jerusalem sim tu in kuan pui in, tua khuapi uumci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabang a uumci sungin Nebuchadnezzar ama mama Jerusalem ah pai hi,"},"12":{"text":"tuaciang Kumpipa Jehoiachin sia a nu, a tapate, a uliante, le kumpi inn uliante taw Babylon te tungah tum uh hi. Nebuchadnezzar in a kumpi maan a kum liatna hun sungin Jehoiachin sia thong taak tu in","ref":"Jer 22:24-30; 24:1-10; 29:1-2"},"13":{"text":"Babylon ah paipui a, Biakinnpi sung le kumpi inn sungah sum le vanh manpha theampo pua siat hi. Topa ii sonkhol bangma in Nebuchadnezzar in Biakinnpi sungah zak tu Solomon kumpipa ii vawt khamh ankuang ankeaute sutham siat hi."},"14":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in Jerusalem mite, kumpipa tapate le lampuite theampo thongtaak tu in ciapui hi, a vekpi kingawm 10,000 pha hi. Ama in khutthiamna nei theampo, thikseakte zongh ciapui hi, Judah ah mizawngbel teng bek nusia hi."},"15":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in Jehoiachin sia Babylon ah thongtaak tu in ciapui a, Jehoiachin ii nu, a zite, a uliante le Judah mi lampuite theampo taw zong ciapui hi.","ref":"Eze 17:12"},"16":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in mihing thupi theampo Babylon ah puak hi, a vekpi in 7,000 pha uh hi, tuaciang a ciapui thikseakte kihel, nasep thiamte 1,000 sia ngalkap seam thei tu cinghtengh vive ahi uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in Jehoiachin ii pano, Mattaniah sia Judah kumpipa suaksak a, a min Zedekiah ci in khealsak hi.","ref":"Jer 37:1; Eze 17:13"},"18":{"text":"Judah kumpipa ii kumpipa a sua hunin Zedekiah sia kum 21 pha hi, tuaciang ama in Jerusalem pan kum sawm le kum khat sung uk hi. A nu sia Hamutal hi a, Libnah khua mi Jeremiah ii tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah (2 Khangtaanghthu 36:11-12 ; Jeremiah 52:1-3 a)","ref":"Jer 27:1-22; 28:1-17"},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa Zedekiah in Topa tungah Kumpipa Jehoiakim maw bang tatakin maw hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa sia Jerusalem le Judah mite tungah thin uuk mama ahikom ama muna pan bengkeak hi.","ref":"Eze 17:15"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah in Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar leedo ahikom Nebuchadnezzar in a ngalkap hon theampo taw Jerusalem sia Zedekiah ii kumpi maan a kum kua kum, a tha sawm, ni sawm ni in sim hi. Amate in khuapi pua sangah ngiaphual saat a, a uumci natu in pangte vawtin,","title":"Jerusalem khuapi Bona (2 Khangtaanghthu 36:13-21 ; Jeremiah 52:3b-11)","ref":"Jer 21:1-10; 34:1-5; Eze 24:2"},"2":{"text":"Zedekiah ii a ngam ukna, kum sawm le kum khat a cin dong uumci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua kum a tha lina, a ni sawm ni in, kialpi nasia mama a, mite neak tu bangma om nawn ngawl ahikom"},"4":{"text":"a mite in a khuapi luphung sulet hi. Babylon te in khuapi kiim uum ahihang ngalkap theampo sia zanin suakta uh hi. Amate in kumpi huan pan luphungte nii kipeena kongpi lam tawn in Jordan Kuam sangah tai uh hi.","ref":"Eze 33:21"},"5":{"text":"Ahihang Babylon ngalkaphonpi in Zedekiah kumpipa zuizen a, Jericho khuahui zaangtamna munah man hi, ama sia a ngalkapte theampo in taisan hi."},"6":{"text":"Zedekiah sia Riblah ah a om Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar kungah kipaipui a, tua mun ah Nebuchadnezzar in Zedekiah tungah thukhen hi."},"7":{"text":"Zedekiah ii mu tangin a tapate kithatlum hi; 2 Khang 4:16"},"15":{"text":"Amate in khamh le ngunn taw a kivawt peuma, meikam toaina kuangtung kuangdal te dongin la uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpipa Solomon ii Biakinnpi atu a vawt taau vanhte, — khuam niite, leangte, tuikuangpui — hite sia ngit leih ahikom khai kitee ngawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuampi nii a kiphutte sia kikim in metre 8 veu saang hi, a dawn a tungkhuna sia taau ma hi a, metre 1.3 saang hi. Ama taw tualai ah a om Israel mite le Babylon te zongh that hi.","ref":"Jer 41:1-3"},"26":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Israel te theampo a hau a zawng, a kibangin ngalkap uliante taw tua mun nusia in Egypt ah tai uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate in Babylon te kiita uh hi.","ref":"Jer 43:5-7"},"27":{"text":"Evilmerodach sia Babylon kumpipa a sua kumin, ama in Judah kumpipa Jehoiachin tungah hesuakna a lakna in thong panin pusuaksak hi.
