(","title":"Solomon ii Thungetna (1 Kumpite 8:22-53)"},"13":{"text":"Solomon in dawtuam khat taau taw vawtin leitual laizang ah koi hi. Ka thungetna hong ngai ta'n. Kong ngetnate hong pia ta'n."},"20":{"text":"Hi Biakinnpi a sun a zanin na cing in. Hisia nang hong kibiak natu mun hi ci in nong kamciamsa hi, tua ahiciang hi Biakinnpi sang nga in thu kong nget ciangin hong za ta'n.","ref":"Thkna 12:11"},"21":{"text":"Kei ii thungetnate le na Israel mite ii hi mun maingat in a thungetnate hong za ta'n. A maw sia tungah a kiphu bangin daan pia in, a maw ngawl sia suaktasak in."},"24":{"text":"“Na Israel mite sia nangma tungah hong khial hu in a ngalte in zo a, tuasia ciang nang sang hong heak in, hi Biakinnpi ah pai a, amate kiniamkhiakin maw maisak natu in thu hong ngen le,"},"25":{"text":"vantung panin na ngai in. Na mite ii mawna khialnate maisak in a, tuaciang amate le a taanghpupite tungah na piaksa ngam le lei ah na paipui kik in."},"26":{"text":"Na mite nang tungah hong maw hu in nguatui na hansak ciang le, amate kisiik in hi Biakinnpi sang nga in kiniamkhiakin thu hong nget ciang,"},"27":{"text":"Oh, Topa awng, vantung panin ngai in a, na naseamte le Israel mite ii mawna khialnate na maisak in, tuaciang a maan a sep natu amate na hil in. Israel na mite khat pawpo in a thin hee lawlawm man po in, hi Biakinnpi sangah a khut uh zan in thu hong ngen le,"},"30":{"text":"amate ii thungetna na za in. Vantung na inn sung panin amate na ngai in a, na maisak in. Nangma bekma in mihingte thinsung ngaisutnate he ni hi. mi simin ama taw a kiphu bangin a tungah na vawt in,"},"31":{"text":"tuasia ciangin koma taanghpupite tungah na piaksa ngam sungah a teen hun sung theampo amate in nangma hong zakta in na thu hong ni tu hi."},"32":{"text":"“A khuala a teang ngamdangmite in na letna, na vaang neina le a seam tu a tawntung na kinginnate za a, hi Biakinnpi ah hong pai in thu hong nget ciang,"},"33":{"text":"amate thungetnate na ngai in. Vantung na teenna mun pan na za in a, vawtsak tu in hong nget teng na vawtsak in, tua hile leitung mite theampo te in Israel na mite ii hong heak bangin hong he thei in, na thu hong ni tu uh hi. Vantung panin na za in a, amate zawna na pia in."},"36":{"text":"“Na mite in mawna hong vawt ciang — a maw ngawl kuama om ngawl ahiciang — na thin uukin a ngalte in zosak a, ngamdang ah thongtaak tu in a paipui ciangin tua ngam sia a khuala ta zong,"},"37":{"text":"na mite ii thungetnate ngai in. Pathian mi David ii thupiak bangin biakinn cingte in a vaipuak neina kongpi tek ah ni sim a nasep natu in pawl khensak hi."},"15":{"text":"David ii thiampite le Levi mite tungah vanh kholna innte le a dangte taw kisai in a thupiakte kheet nei ngawlin kivawtsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Hi hun in Solomon ii nasepna theampo kizo thiang hi. Solomon taw a kimu uh ciang ama in a thu ngaisut thei theampo dongh hi.","title":"Sheba Kumpinu Khualhawna (1 Kumpite 10:1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in tuate zo thei siat hi; ama ii a zo kik tu in thu haksa leih bangma om ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Sheba kumpinu in Solomon ii ciimna he a, a sak sa kumpi inn zongh mu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in kumpi sabuai tungah a kilui ante, a uliante teenna innte, kumpi inn sung a naseamte omzia le a kibang a puansilhte, poai vawt ni in ama a cing a naseamte ii puansilhte le Biakinnpi ah a piak biakpiaknate mu hi. Tuate ama in lamdang sa in ingh liang hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in kumpipa tungah, “Ka ngam panin na ciimna le na thu ka zaakte maan hi!"},"6":{"text":"Keima mama hong pai in ka mu matengin ngual ii hong sonte ka um bua hi. Ama in a Israel mite it a, a tawntungin a kep nopna hu in, thukham le thutang khenna na kipsak thei natu in nangma sia amate ii kumpi hong suaksak zo hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in Solomon kumpipa tungah a ken letsongte: khamh kilogramme 4,000 vaal le hel namtuite le suangmanpha tam mama pia hi. Arabia kumpite le Israel ngamkhen ukte zongh in ngunn le khamh puak uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Solomon in ngaldalna lumlian 200 vawtin lum khat ciangin a kiseak khamh kilogramme 7 bang taw tuam hi,"},"16":{"text":"tuaciang ngaldalna lum a no zaw 300 vawt a, khat ciangin a kiseak khamh kilogramme 3 bang taw tuam hi. Ama in tuate a vekpi in Lebanon Thingtaam Khaanpui sungah koi hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa in kumpi tokhum lian mama khat zongh vawt hi. Hi bang kumpi tokhum sia kumpi ngam mundang peuma ah om ngeingawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Solomon kumpipa ii zak haite theampo khamh taw kivawt a, Lebanon Thingtaam Khaanpui sungah a kikoi vanhzak kuang le keau te theampo sia khamh ciitak veu hi. Solomon hun lai in ngunn sia a man nei in kingaisun ngawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Solomon in Hiram kumpipa ii teambawte taw a paikhawm tuipi teambaw honkhat nei hi. Asa in tua milim phuktanin ektham a, Kidron kuam sungah a bek teng haltum hi."},"17":{"text":"Asa in Israel ngamsung doai sepna mun theampo susia siat ngawl ahihang a nuntak sung teng Topa tungah thumaan hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in Pathian tungah a pa Abijah ii a aap vanhte theampo le ama mama ii a aapsa ngunn le khamh taw a kivawt nate zongh Biakinnpi sungah koi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama ii kumpi maan sung kum 35 kum ciang dong ngal om nawn ngawl hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Asa ii kumpi maanna kum 36 kumin Israel kumpipa Baasha in Judah ngam sim a, Judah ngam ah a tum a pusuak leang theampo a khaam nop manin Ramah sia kulh taw a uum kipan hi.","title":"Israel taw Buainate (1 Kumpite 15:17-22)"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Asa in Biakinnpi sumkholnate le kumpi inn pan khamh le ngunn la in Damascus ah Syria kumpipa Benhadad tungah thaak a, hi kam teng vaitha hi:"},"3":{"text":"“Ih pate a kipawl bangma in ei zongh kipawl tawng. Hi khamh le ngunnte sia letsong in kong puak hi. Tu in Israel kumpipa Baasha taw na kipawlna sia tatsak vun, tua hile ka ngam pan ama ii ngalkapte ciasak kik tu hi.”"},"4":{"text":"Asa ii kam vaithak sia Benhadad lungkimin, a ngalkapmangte le a ngalkaphonpite Israel khuapite sim tu in paisak hi. Amate in Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maacah le ankholna Naphtali khuapite theampo la hi."},"5":{"text":"Baasha kumpipa in tua thu a zaak ciang Ramah khua a kulh vawt tawlnga in a nasep nusia hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Asa kumpipa in Judah ngamsung theampo pan mihing khawmtua in Baasha ii Ramah ah a zak suang le thingte puasakin Geba le Mizpah khuapi kulhte vawtna in zangh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hunin kamsaang Hanani sia Kumpipa Asa kungah pai a, “ Topa na Pathian suang ngawlin Syria kumpipa na suan zawk hu in Israel kumpipa ii ngalkaphonpi sia nangma khut sung pan suakta zo hi.","title":"Kamsaangpa Hanani"},"8":{"text":"Ethiopia le Libyan te in siphu ngalleang tam mama le siphu ngalkap tam mama taw ngalkaphonpite nei hi ngawl ka na ziam? Ahihang Topa muangin suang na hikom ama in amate hong zosak hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in ama tungah thumaanna a neite tungah thahatna pia nuam in leitung buppi encik nginge hi. Na mawmawt ngamtatna hu in tu pan kipan ngal do tawntung tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Hi thu in kamsaangpa tungah Asa thin uuksak mama ahikom ama in kamsaangpa thikkol bulsak hi. Hi hunsung teng mama in Asa in a mite pawlkhat a vawtsiat kipan hi."},"11":{"text":"Asa ii kumpi maan sungin a piang thute theampo a kipat pan a tawpna dong Judah le Israel Kumpite Taanghthu sungah kiciamtee hi.","title":"Asa ii Kumpi Maanna a Bona (1 Kumpite 15:23-24)"},"12":{"text":"Asa ii kumpi a sep a kum 39 kumin a peang ah meima ngilo khatvei in a peang bai hi; ahihang tuasia hun ngawngawn in ama in Topa tungah hu ngen ngawlin syavuante in bawlsak zaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua zawk a kum nii ciang ama thi a,"},"14":{"text":"David Khuapi sungah ama mama ii khuaksa suangkuul sungah kiphum hi. Amate in a luang phum natu a puuana in a tungah hel namtuite le paaknamtui thau te zut in ama ii thi a khuangaina in a lian mama meimang khat sep uh hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in a pa Asa ii kumpi za laih a Israel te sim tu in ama dinmun khosak hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat Kumpi Suak"},"2":{"text":"Ama in kulh taw a ki uum Judah khuapite sung, Judah ngam nawl sung le a pa ii a laak Ephraim ngamsung khuapite ah a ngalkapte koi hi."},"3":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in a pa ii kumpi a sua sawng lai bangma in ngamta a, Baal bia ngawl ahikom Topa in thupha pia hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in a pa ii Pathian na seamin Pathian thupiakte zui a, Israel kumpite ngamtat bangin ngamta ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Jehoshaphat sia Judah kumpi ngam kho takin uksak a, a ngammite theampo in letsong a puak tek uh ciang ama hau in nasia takin ki upat hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Topa na a sep sia ki angtang in Judah ngam sungah doai sepna munte theampo le Asherah numeipathian limte zongh sumai hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama ii kumpi maan zawk a kum thum kumin ama in Judah khuapite ah thuhil tu in a nuai a ulian teng paisak hi: Benhail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel le Micaiah te ahi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate sia Levi te kua le thiampi nii in zui hi. Levi te sia Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah le Tobadonijah hi a; thiampite sia Elishama le Jehoram te ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in Topa Thukham laibu kengin Judah khuate theampo ah pai in mihonpite hil kawkoai hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Jehoshaphat kumpipa sia tua a kiim a paam kumpi ngam theampo in simsak ngam ngawl hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat ii Letna"},"11":{"text":"Philistine te pawlkhat in Jehoshaphat tungah ngunn tam mama le letsong dangte puak in, Arab te pawlkhat in tuu 7,700 le keal 7,700 puak uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuabangin Jehoshaphat sia a vaanglian vaial hi. Judah ngamsung theampo ah ama in kulhte vawt in khuapite saat a,"},"13":{"text":"an te a vuum a saal kholna in nei hi. Ama in Jerusalem khua sungah a mindok tuam ngalkapbute sia,"},"14":{"text":"a bee le a phung zui in koi hi. Adnah sia Judah bee le phungte sung pan ngalkapmang hi a, a khutnuai ah ngalkap 300,000 nei hi."},"15":{"text":"A zom a niina sia Jehohanan hi a, ngalkap 280,000 nei hi,"},"16":{"text":"a zom a thumna sia Zichri tapa Amasiah hi a, ngalkap 200,000 nei hi. (Amasiah sia Topa naseam tu in ama le ama kipia hi.)"},"17":{"text":"Benjamin bee le phungte sung panin ngalkap maangpa sia a mindok tuam ngalkap Eliada hi a, lum le thal toai ngalkap 200,000 uk hi."},"18":{"text":"A zom a niina pa sia Jehozabad hi a, ngalhiam toai cinghteng pasal 180,000 uk hi."},"19":{"text":"Hi mite in Jerusalem ah kumpipa na a seamte hi a, tua ban ah kulh taw a ki uum Judah khuapi dangte sung zongh ah ngalkap dangte koi thua lai hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat hau in a minthan ciang a innkuanpui khat le Israel kumpipa Ahab ii innkuanpui khat a kiteen natu in vaihawm hi.","title":"Kamsaang Micaiah in Ahab Kidop natu Sonkhol (1 Kumpite 22:1-28)"},"2":{"text":"Kum tawmvei zawkciang Jehoshaphat sia Ahab kung haw tu in Samaria khuapi ah pai hi. Jehoshaphat le a kithol puite a patoaina in Ahab in anneakpoai atu in khui le tuu tam mama ngo hi. Ahab in Gilead ngam Ramoth khuapi a simpui tu in Jehoshaphat paa hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahab in Jehoshaphat tungah, “Ramoth khua a sim khawm tu in nong kuan tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Jehoshaphat in, “Na kithoai man ciang hong son ta'n, keima le ka ngalkaphonpi a kinging sa in om khu hi. Hong pawm tu khu hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuasia ciang, “Ahihang Topa dongh phot tawng,” ci lai hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom Ahab in kamsaangte 400 bang samin, “Kei pai in Ramoth sim tu khi ziam maw, sim ngawl tu khi ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Amate in, “Sim in, Pathian in zawna hong pia tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang Jehoshaphat in, “ Topa ih dok thei natu in kamsaang dang om nawn ngawl ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahab in, “Khat om lai hi, Imlah ii tapa Micaiah hi. Ahihang ama ensan khi hi, banghang ziam cile ama in kei atu a pha bangma sonkhol ngeingawl hi; a pha ngawl khat veu hi tawntung hi,” ci in zo hi. Jehoshaphat in “Tuabangin ci heak in!” ci in zo kik hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, Ahab kumpipa in zum uliante khat sam a, Micaiah thakhatin hong paipui ta'n, ci in sawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumpipate nii sia kumpi puantualte silh a, Samaria kongpi pua sang ancilna ah kumpi tokhumte tungah a to laitakin, kamsaang theampo in amate mai ah thusuakte son uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate sung pan khat, Chenaanah ii tapa Zedekiah in thik kiite vawt a, Ahab munah, “Hisia Topa ii pauna hi: ‘Hite taw Syria te na sim tu a, na zocip tu hi,’ ” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Kamsaang dang theampo in tuabang vive ma in ci uh hi. “Ramoth a sim tu kuan tavun, zo tu nu hi,” ci uh hi. Topa in zawna hong pia tu hi.”"},"12":{"text":"Tua lanin Micaiah sam tu in a pai ulian pa in, “Kamsaang dangte theampo in kumpipa zawna tu bebek son zo hi, nang zongh tuabang ma son hamtang lete pha tu hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang Micaiah in, “A nungta Topa min lo in ka Pathian ii son a hong sawl teng son tu khi hi!” ci in zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama Kumpipa Ahab mai ah hong kipaipui ciang, kumpipa in, “Micaiah awng, Kumpipa Jehoshaphat le kei Ramoth ah kuanin sim tu khu ziam maw, sim ngawl tu khu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Micaiah in, “Sim vun! Na zo tu uh hi. Topa in zawna hong pia tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang Ahab in, “ Topa min taw kei tungah nong pau ciangin thumaan thutak son in! Bang tanvei tuabangin hong ci tu khi ziam?” ci in zo kik hi."},"16":{"text":"Micaiah in, “Israel ngalkapte sia mualtung tengah tuu cing pa om ngawl a tuute kithezau bangin ka mu hi. Tuaciang Topa in, ‘Hi mite in lampui nei ngawl hi; inn ah thinnuam takin cia hen,’ ” ci hi.","ref":"Mi 27:17; Eze 34:5; Mt 9:36; Mk 6:34"},"17":{"text":"Ahab in Jehoshaphat munah, “Ama in kei huvau peuma a pha khat zongh hong sonkholsak ngeingawl hi, kong ci sa hi ka na ngawl ziam; a sia khat veu hi tawntung hi!” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Micaiah in zomto a, “Tu in Topa pauna teng ngai vun! Topa sia vantung a kumpi tokhum tungah to a, ama ii vantunglalangte a kiim ah a ding ka mu hi.”"},"19":{"text":"Topa in, ‘Ramoth ah Ahab pai in a kithalup natu in akua in ama theam tu nu ziam?’ ci in dongh hi. Vantunglalang pawlkhat in son khat nei a, a dangte in thudang khat a son uh hi,"},"20":{"text":"a khakbelin thaa khat sia mai ah hong pai a, Topa kung zuanin, ‘Keima in ama theam tu khi hi,’ a ci hi. Topa in ‘Bangbangin maw?’ ci in dongh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua thaa in, ‘Keima pai in Ahab ii kamsaangte theampo leilot thu ka sonsak tu hi!’ ci in zo kik hi. Topa in, ‘Va pai ta'n a, va theam ta'n, theam zo tu ni hi,’ ” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaciang Micaiah in thu khup a, “A piang thu in hisia hi. Topa in na kamsaang hite nang tungah leilot thu hong sonsak hi. Ahihang ama mama in nang tuasiatna nga tu in a thutan sa hi!” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaciangin kamsaangpa Zedekiah in Micaiah kungah paito in, a maitang beang hi, tuaciang, “Bang hun pan kipan Topa thaa in kei hong nusia a, nang tungah hong pau ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"24":{"text":"Micaiah in, “Inn nungsang inndoi sung khat ah a buu tu in na pai ciangin mu tu ni hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Kumpipa Ahab in a uliante khat munah, “Micaiah man in a, khuapi ukpa Amon le Kumpipa tapa Joash tungah paipui vun."},"26":{"text":"Amate in ama thong sungah koi hen a, bangma tat ngawlin kong heak kik dong anluum le tui bek taw na vaak hen, ci in son in,” ci in thupia hi."},"27":{"text":"“Bangma tat ngawlin nong heak kik le Topa in kei tungtawn a hong pau ngawl hi tu hi,” ci in Micaiah in ci ngaw hi. Tuaciang ama in, “Ka ci sa teng kuama po in hong ngai tavun!” ci lai hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Israel kumpipa Ahab le Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat te in Gilead ah Ramoth khuapi sim tu in pai uh hi.","title":"Ahab ii Thina (1 Kumpite 22:29-35)"},"29":{"text":"Ahab in Jehoshaphat munah, “Ngal kisim ciangin kei kong kimealseal tu a, nang na hile kumpi puan teng ma nong silh tu hi,” ci hi. Tuabangin Israel kumpipa kidona phual ah kimealseal in pai hi."},"30":{"text":"Syria kumpipa in a siphu ngalleang ukte munah, Israel kumpipa ngawl buang a dang khat zongh sim ngawl tu nu hi ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in Kumpipa Jehoshaphat a mu uh ciangin a vekpi ma in Israel kumpipa sa ahiciang ama sim tu in kiheak uh hi. Ahihang ama hong au keak ahiciang Topa Pathian in suatak a, ama kung pan a simte kileesak kik hi."},"32":{"text":"Siphu ngalleang ukte in ama sia Israel kumpipa ahi ngawl hunlam mu ahiciang amate in del nawn ngawl uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahizong Syria ngalkapte khat ii kap thaltang khat in Kumpipa Ahab ii thikpuan kipeena pan kha luilam hi, “Kei liam khi hi! Ngalphual panin kiheam in!” ci in a siphu ngalleang hawlpa oksan hi."},"34":{"text":"A kido saan lai tengin Kumpipa Ahab sia a siphu ngalleang sungah kikhuangkho in to a, Syria te maingat hi. Nitum laitakin ama thi hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat sia Jerusalem a kumpi inn ah ciidamin heak kik hi.","title":"Kamsaangpa khat in Jehoshaphat Teih"},"2":{"text":"Hanani ii tapa kamsaang Jehu sia kumpipa taw kisi tu in pai a, ama tungah, “Mihing seksolte hu tu le Topa a huatsa mite panpui tu sia maan sa ni ziam? Hi bangin na ngamtatna hangin Topa thin uukna na tungah thengsak ni hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuabang ahitazong nang sungah phatna pawlkhat om veve hi. Nangma in mite biak Asherah numeipathian milim teng na vawk siat a, Pathian ii deina zui tu na hanciam hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Jehoshaphat kumpipa sia Jerusalem khuapi ah teang hi napi a taanghpupite ii Pathian, Topa kungah mite sam kik tu in thangsang Beersheba pan saksang Ephraim mualtung ngammong dong a huhunin mite sungah khualhaw hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat ii A Puua kiknate"},"5":{"text":"Ama in kulh taw a ki uum Judah khuapi theampo ah thukhenmangte khanin,"},"6":{"text":"amate hi bangin thuhil hi: “Thu na khen uh ciang kidawm vun; mihing thuneina taw ngamtat tu hi ngawl a, Topa thuneina bang hizaw hi, tuaciang thu na khen uh ciang noma taw Topa hong omkhawm hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa zakta vun a, ngamtatna kidawm vun, banghang ziam cile Topa ih Pathian in thumaan ngawl thimthelna, mi doidan kingupna le sumnguk neaknate dei ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem khua sungah Jehoshaphat in Levi mi, thiampite le khua sung lampuite pawlkhat sia Topa Thukham a paltan ciang ahibuale khua mite kihau in thu a nei uh ciang thu a khen tu in thukhenmang panmun pia hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in amate tungah hi bangin hil hi: “ Topa thasia vun a, na nasepna theampo ah ama thu ni in, thumaan in a muanhuai in seam tavun."},"10":{"text":"Khuapite khat pawpo pan na mipuite in mihing thisakna ahizong, a dang thukham khat ahibuale thupiakna khat pawpo palsatna ahizong note kungah thu hong thetpui uh ciang amate Topa tungah a khial a maw a sua ngawl natu in thu a kisit laitakin bangbang ngamta tu ci sia pha takin hil hamtang tavun. Tuabang na seam bua uh le noma le na mipuite in Topa thin uukna na thuak tu uh hi. Ahitazong tuabang na na seam uh le mawpu ngawl tu nu hi."},"11":{"text":"Biakna paaina taw kisai thu theampo ah Thiampi Lianbel Amariah in thu neibel tu a, Judah ngamuk mangpa Ishmael ii tapa Zebadiah sia khua mite taw kisai thu theampo ah thuneibel tu hi. Levi te in thukhenzum pan a thukhennate bangin kiseam suak ziam ci a etcik tu vaipuak nei hi. Kihansua vun a, hi hilnate bangin seam suak vun, Topa in a maanna sangah hong pang tahen!” ci hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tawmvei zawkciangin Moab le Ammon ngalkaphonpite in amate pawlpui Meun te taw Judah ngam sim uh hi.","title":"Edom Ngal Dona"},"2":{"text":"Kamtai pawlkhat hong pai in Jehoshaphat kumpipa tungah hi bangin ko hi: “Edom ngalkap honpui khat Tuipi Thi langkhat panin hong sim tu hong kuan hi. Amate in Hazazon Tamar khua la zo hi.” (Hi sia Engedi ii a min dang khat hi.)"},"3":{"text":"Jehoshaphat patau a, lam a lak natu in Topa tungah thungen hi. Tua zawkciang ama in ngamsung theampo ah an tanna khat nei natu in thupia hi."},"4":{"text":"Khuapi sim pan Judah mite Topa lamlakna ngen tu in Jerusalem ah manlang tak hong pai in,"},"5":{"text":"amate le Jerusalem khua mite Biakinnpi leitual thak ah kikhawm uh hi. Jehoshaphat kumpipa hong pai in amate mai ah ding a,"},"6":{"text":"a ngingin, “Oh Topa ka taanghpupite ii Pathian awng, vantung le leitung ngam theampo na uk siat hi. Nangma sia a vaanglian a thahat na hi a, kuama in hong nalh zo ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma in koma Pathian na hi hi. Israel na mite hi ngam sungah hong kikhiin ciang, hi sungah a teang mite na nawtkeak a, ngam le lei teng sia na lawm Abraham suan le paal te tungah a tawntung a tu in na pia hi.","ref":"Is 41:8; Jas 2:23"},"8":{"text":"Amate hi ngam sungah teangin nangma hong patoaina in biakinn khat sa zo a,"},"9":{"text":"amate daan na piakna in tuasiatna khat pawpo — ngal kidona, a kilaw thei natna ahibuale kialpi — na tunsak ciang amate hong pai in nangma hong biakna hi Biakinnpi mai ah a din thei hunlam he uh hi. Amate in a ngim ngana huvau na tungah thu hong ngen thei a, tuaciang nangma in za in na suatak hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tu in Ammon mi, Moab mi le Edom mite in ko hong sim zo hi. Ka taanghpupite Egypt ngam pan a pusua lai in tua ngamte sung a tum tu oai ngawl na hi komin ka taanghpupite in hi ngamte kiimvealin susia ngawl uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 2:4-19"},"11":{"text":"Ko tungah amate hong lo kikna sia hi bang hi — nong piaksa ngam pan hong notkeak tu in amate hong pai uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Nangma in koma Pathian na hi hi! Amate daan pia in. Banghang ziam cile ko hong sim, hi ngalkaphonpite mai ah ka ci ka law uh he ngawl khu hi. Bang vawt tu ci sia ka heak ngawl uh hangin nangma ii nong hu tu lam en khu hi,” ci in thungen hi."},"13":{"text":"Judah mi theampo a zite a tate taw tualai Biakinnpi ah ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihonpi sungah a om Levi te khat ii tungah Topa thaa hong theng hi. Ama min Jahaziel hi a Zechariah ii tapa ahi hi. Ama sia Asaph bee le phung pan hi a, Mattaniah, Jeiel le Benaiah te ii sungsuak, Asaph suan ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Jahaziel in, “Nangma kumpipa le no Judah le Jerusalem mite theampo awng, na ngalte a tam hangin thinkiamin lau ngawl het tu nu hi, Topa in hong ci hi. Ngal kisimna sia Pathian ii sep tu hi a, no taw kisai ngawl hi.","ref":"Thkna 20:1-4"},"16":{"text":"Zing ciang amate Ziz mualciangh lam hong totto laitakin sim vun. Jeruel nai ngam tawnghtol sang paina leikuam tawpna ah na kisi tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Note in hi ngal do kul ngawl tu hi. Panmunte la po vun a, ngak vun; Topa ii zawna hong piak na mu tu uh hi. Judah mite le Jerusalem mite awng, haisaang heak vun a lau heak vun. Ngalsim tu in kuan vun, Topa in note hong ompui tu hi!” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 14:13-14"},"18":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Jehoshaphat kumpipa sia a mai lei pha dongin kun a, mipi teng zongh kunin Topa bia uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Levi te ahi Kohath le Korah ii bee le phungte dingto in a nging tatakin au a, Israel te ii Pathian, Topa pok uh hi."},"20":{"text":"A zing ciang zingtuungin mihonte Tekoa hui ngamsung zuan uh hi. A vaidin uh ciang Jehoshaphat in amate tungah kam vaitha hi: “Judah mite le Jerusalem mite awng! Topa na Pathian muang vun, tua hile kip takin na ding thei tu uh hi. Ama kamsaangte ii hong sonte um vun, tua hile na ma na tun tu uh hi.”"},"21":{"text":"Mipite thu a kikuppui zawkciang kumpipa in music thiam pawlkhat sia biakna poai vawt ciang amate silh bul puantualte silhsak a, ngalkaphonpi mai ah paisak a: “ Topa pok vun! Ama hong itna kip tawntung hi!” ci in lasa sak hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuabangin lasak a kipat po uh ciang Topa in ngal a sim ngalkaphonpite tungah patauna tungsak hi."},"23":{"text":"Ammon te le Moab te in Edom ngalkaphonpite simin a suksiat cip zawkciang amate le amate nasia takin kisim uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Judah ngalkaphonpi in sennealngamsung tausaang khat a thet uh ciang a ngalte sang a et le amate a vekpi in lei ah thi peakpuk sia mu uh hi. Khat zongh suakta ngawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Jehoshaphat le a ngalkapte sia a ngalte vanh laksak tu in pai a, khui, neak le dawn, puansilhte le vanh manpha dangte mu uh hi. Amate in ni thum sung vanhte khawmtua napi tamleih ahikom a vekpi in la siat zo ngawl uh hi."},"26":{"text":"A ni li ni in amate sia Beracah Kuam ah kikhawm a, ama ii vawtsa theampo atu in Topa pok uh hi. Tua ahikom tua kuam sia “Beracah” kici hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in a ngalte zawsak zo ahikom Jehoshaphat lampui in, a ngalkapte Jerusalem ah zawna le lungdamna taw cia kik uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate khuapi a thet ciang tengtongh le lemlete tumin Biakinnpi zuan uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa in Israel ii ngalte a zawsakna thu a za ngam theampo lau mama uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuabangin Pathian in a kiim a paam pan ngammuangsak ahikom Jehoshaphat in dai takin ngam uk hi."},"31":{"text":"Jehoshaphat sia kum 35 a phakin Judah kumpi suak a, Jerusalem panin kum 25 sung uk hi. A nu sia Shilhi ii tanu Azubah ahi hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat ii Kumpi Maanna A bona (1 Kumpite 22:41-50)"},"32":{"text":"Ama mai ah a pa Asa bangma in Topa muna ah a maan in seam hi;"},"33":{"text":"ahihang doai sepna munte susia ngawl hi. Tuaciang a teambawte siatham a, tuipi tungah paisak ngei nawn ngawl hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehoshaphat thi a, David Khuapi sung kumpi thaan ah kiphumin a tapa Jehoram in a kumpi za laih hi."},"2":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat ii tapa Jehoram in suapui pasal luk nei a: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariahu, Michael le Shephatiah ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Jehoram (2 Kumpite 8:17-24)"},"3":{"text":"A pa in amate khamh, ngunn le a neisa na manpha tam ma pia a, Judah ngamsung kulh taw a ki uum khuapite khat tek uksak hi. Ama in Topa tungah mawna khialna vawt hi,"},"7":{"text":"ahihang Topa in David taw thuciamna khat vawt zo a, David suan le paalte in ngam uk tawntung tu hi ci in kamciam ahikom Topa in David ii kumpi khangngui susia nuam ngawl hi.","ref":"1 Kum 11:36"},"8":{"text":"Jehoram ii kumpi maan sungin Edom ngam in Judah ngam leedo in, a suakta kumpi ngam khat suak hi.","ref":"Pian 27:40"},"9":{"text":"Tuabangin Jehoram le a ngalkap bute in siphu ngalleang taw kuanin Edom ngamsung tumin sim uh hi. Tua munah Edom te ngalkaphonpi in amate kiim uum a, ahihang zanin amate pusuak thei in suakta uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua hun pan kipan Edom sia Judah khut sung pan suatakna nga hi. Jehoram in a taanghpupite ii Pathian, Topa a nusiat hu in hi hun sung mama in Libnah khuapi zongh in leedo hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in Judah ngam mualsaangte tungah doai sepna munte ngawngawn vawtin, Judah le Jerusalem mite Topa langpanin mawna sung then hi."},"12":{"text":"Kamsaangpa Elijah in Jehoram laithak a, a lai sungah: “Na pa Jehoshaphat kumpipa ahibuale na pu Asa kumpite ii lamlakna bangin na zui ngawl hu in na taanghpupi David ii Pathian, Topa in nang hong puavawk hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel kumpite lamlakna zuizaw in Ahab le ama za a laih te ii Israel te sia thumaanna panin a pialpui bangma Judah le Jerusalem mite Pathian tungah thumaan ngawl tu in lam na pui hi. Nangma sangin mi phazaw na suapuite ngawngawn na suamlum hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa in na mite, na tate le na zite nasia takin daan pia tu a, na neisate susia tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Nangma mama in ngilzang natna khat na nga tu a, ni khat sangin ni khat nasia vaial tu hi,” ci in at hi."},"16":{"text":"Philistine te le Arab te pawlkhat sia Ethiopia te pawlkhat teenna tuipi dung teng ah teang uh hi. Tua mite sia Jehoram a sim tu in Topa in thawn hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in Judah ngam simin kumpipa inn phuul a, a tapa nobel Ahaziah simngawl a zite le a tapate theampo paipui in thongtaaksak hi."},"18":{"text":"Hiteng theampo a pian zawkciang Topa in kumpipa sia a bot mama ngilsung natna khat veisak hi."},"19":{"text":"A natna nasia vaial in kum nii dektak zawkciang thuak zo ngawlin thi hi. A khutnuai ngammite ii a taanghpupite atu a vawtsak ngei bangin thina huvau khuangaina lakna in meimang sep ngawl uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Jehoram kum 32 a phak ciang kumpi suak a, Jerusalem khua pan kum liat sung uk hi. A thi ciang kuama khuangai ngawl hi. Amate in ama sia David Khuapi sungah phum ahihang kumpi thaan ah phum ngawl uh hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Arab te pawlkhat in Jerusalem simin Jehoram kumpipa ii tapa teng a nobel Ahaziah simngawl thatlum siat hi. Tua ahikom tu in Jerusalem khua mite in Ahaziah sia a pa ii kumpiza laihsak hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah (2 Kumpite 8:25-29 ; 9:21-28)"},"2":{"text":"Ahaziah kum 22 a phakin kumpi suak a, Jerusalem khua pan kum khat sung uk hi. Jehu in amate that siat hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahaziah a kizon ciang a bukna Samaria khua sungah mu hi. Amate in ama sia Jehu kungah paipui in thatsak hi. Ahihang amate in Topa atu a sep thei za a seam a pu Jehoshaphat kumpipa a zatakna uh taw Ahaziah ii luang sia phum hi. Ahaziah innkuan sungah kumpi ngam uk thei tu khat zongh taang ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahaziah kumpipa ii nu Athaliah in a tapa a kithalupsak sia a heak po ciang Judah kumpi innkuanpui theampo a kithalup natu in thupia hi.","title":"Judah Kumpinu Athaliah (2 Kumpite 11:1-3)"},"11":{"text":"Ahaziah in thiampi Jehoiada taw a kiteang Jehosheba a kici suapui sealh numei khat nei hi. Tua nu in Ahaziah ii tapate khat a hi Joash a kici pa suatak ku in, a kithat tu kumpi tapa dangte kung panin la a, nau omh khat taw Biakinnpi sung lupna inndoi khat sungah phual hi. Tuabangin a seal hu in Jehosheba in Joash sia Athaliah khut sungah a thi natu panin suatak hi."},"12":{"text":"Athaliah ii kumpinu a sep kum luk sung theampo tua munah ama buu top hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum luk sung a ngak zawkciang thiampi Jehoiada in a sep tu hun hong theng zo hi ci in khensat hi. Ama in ngalkapbu ngate: Jeroham ii tapa Azariah, Jehohanan ii tapa Ishmael, Obed ii tapa Azariah, Adaiah ii tapa Maaseiah le Zichri ii tapa Elishaphat te taw thukimna khat vawt uh hi.","title":"Athaliah langpanin Ngal Thawna (2 Kumpite 11:4-16)"},"2":{"text":"Amate Judah khuapi theampo ah khualhaw in Levi te le, bee le phung lutangte a vekpi in Jerusalem ah paipui kik uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate a vekpi in Biakinnpi sungah kikhawmtua in kumpipa ii tapa Joash taw thuciamna khat vawt uh hi. Jehoiada in amate tungah, “Hong thi san sa kumpipa ii a tapa sia hi lai ah om hi! David suan le paalte kumpi seam tu hi ci a, Topa ii kamciamsa thu om bangin ama zongh tu in kumpi suak tu hi.","ref":"2 Sa 7:12"},"4":{"text":"Ih vawt tu sia hisia hi. Thiampite le Levi te, Sabbath ni in vaipuak nei tu in hong pai uh ciangin khen thum sua khen khat in biakinn kongpite cing tu a,"},"5":{"text":"a dang khen thum sua khen khat in kumpi inn cing tu hi, a taanglai teng in Kongpi Bulpi ah om tu uh hi. Mite theampo biakinn leitual ah kikhawm tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"A vaipuak a seam thiampite le Levi te simngawl kuama biakna innte sungah tumsak ngawl hi. Amate sia a ki aap sate ahikom tum thei hi, a dangte ahile Topa thupiak bang peal ngawlin zui in, a pua sangah a om tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Levi te in namsau doksa in kumpipa cingin, a paina pawpo ah om tu uh hi. Biakinnpi sung tum a sawm pawpo sia kithatlum tu hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Levi te le Judah mipite in Jehoiada thupiak bangin seam suak uh hi. Sabbath ni in vaipuak a pengte ciasak ngawl ahikom nasep ukte in naseam tu hong kuante le nasep a mansa a cia tute zongh na seamsak thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Jehoiada in Biakinnpi sungah a kep David kumpipa ii neisa lumte le teite uliante pia hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in kumpipa cing tu in pasalte namsau dok sa in Biakinnpi mai kiimkot ah koi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jehoiada in Joash pusuapui a, kumpilukhu khusakin kumpi ki ukna thukham laibu khat pia hi. Tuabangin ama kumpi kisuaksak hi. Thiampi Jehoaiada le a tapate in Joash sathau noai a, a om theampo in, “Kumpipa a khansau tahen,” ci in au uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihonpite ii kumpipa a pokna aw Athaliah in a zaak ciang mihon kikhopna Biakinnpi ah manlang takin pai hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in tua munah kumpi thak pa zongh kumpipa atu in a kituam koi Khuam sia kung, biakinn tumna ah ngalkap bute le lemle tumte in kiim uum in a ding mu hi. A om theampo lungdamin au a lemle tum hi, biakinn music thiamte in tumtheite taw tua poai lampui uh hi. Athaliah khuangai a, a puante baltham in “Hong leeheak hi! Hong leeheak hi!” ci in au hi."},"14":{"text":"Jehoiada in Athaliah sia biakinn huang sungah a kithalup tu dei ngawl ahikom a ngalkap bute pawlkhat sam a, “Ama la in, a ngualin a om a cingte kilaklaw panin paipui vun, ama suatak tu a sawm pawpo that vun,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in ama zamh in kumpi inn ah paipui a tua mun Siphu Kongpi ah thatlum uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Thiampi Jehoiada in Joash kumpipa le mipite ama taw kingawm in Topa mi ahi natu in thuciamna khat vawt hi.","title":"Jehoiada ii Puuaphat kiknate (2 Kumpite 11:17-20)"},"17":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate Baal biakinn ah pai siatin biakinn susia hi. Amate in tua munah biaknataute le milimte saattham siatin biaknatau mai ah Baal thiampi Mattan thatlum hi."},"18":{"text":"Jehoiada in thiampite le Levi te Biakinnpi ah nasep a uk tu in koi hi. Amate in David kumpipa ii a see sa nasep om bangin a sep suak tu le Moses Thukham om bangin Topa tungah a kipia sangaw biakpiaknate a hal tu ahi hi. Amate in tumthei te le poai vawtna te zongh uk uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Jehoiada in biakpiakna ah a thiang ngawlte peuma a khaam tu in biakinn kongcingte zongh koi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ngalkap bute, khua mi lampuite, ulian te le mipite theampo in Jehoiada pawm a, a kingual sa in Biakinnpi pan kumpi inn ah kumpipa paipui uh hi. Amate kongpi lianbel panin tumin tuaciang kumpi tokhum tungah kumpipa hong to hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu in Athaliah kithatlum zo ahikom khuapi thimdide in mi theampo lungdamna taw kidim uh hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joash sia kum sali a phak kumin Judah kumpi suak a, Jerusalem pan kum 40 sung uk hi. A nu sia Beersheba khua mi Zibiah ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Joash (2 Kumpite 12:1-16)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in thiampi Jehoiada nuntak laitengin a sep a vawtna ah Topa lungdamsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Jehoiada in Joash kumpipa atu in zi nii tealsak a, a zite taw tanute tapate toai hi."},"4":{"text":"Tawmvei kumpi a sep zawkciang Joash in Biakinnpi puuaphat tu in khensat hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in thiampite le Levi te Judah ngamsung khuapi theampo ah paisak in kum sim Biakinnpi puua natu a kisam za sum khon tu in sawl hi. Ama in manlang a vawt paih natu in sawl ahihang Levi te haisaang ahiciang,"},"6":{"text":"ama in amate lampui Jehoiada samin, “ Topa ompuina Puanbuk atu in mipite in panpuina phiangshia pia tahen ci a Topa naseampa Moses ii tangkal bangin, banghangin Levi te in Judah mite le Jerusalem mite tung pan shia khonsak ngawl ni ziam?” ci in thu dongh hi.","ref":"Pu 30:11-16"},"7":{"text":"(Nupi thimthel Athaliah ii nungzuite in Biakinnpi susia in biakinn vanh thiangtho tam mamate Baal biakna in zangh zo hi.)"},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in Levi te tungah sum khiakte khol natu thingkuang khat vawtin biakinn kongpi ah a koi natu in thupia hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in Pathian naseampa Moses ii a masabel in duisung ngampa ah a khon phiangshia sia kuama po in Topa tungah a piak natu in Jerusalem le Judah ngamsung theampo ah zasak kawkoai uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Hi thu in mipite le a lampuite lungdamsak a, amate in a shia sumte hong paipui tekin thingkuang dim hi."},"11":{"text":"Ni simin Levi te in tua vaipuak nei kumpi ulian khat tungah tua thingkuang puak uh hi. Thingkuang a dim simin kumpi thuzeakpa le Thiampi Lianpa ii taangmipa in a sumte la in a thingkuang sia a omna ngei ah koi kik uh hi. Tuabangin amate in sum tam ma khon uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa le Jehoiada in tua sumte sia Biakinnpi puuana a saite tungah pia uh hi, amate in a puua tu in suang ciangte, lettamate le thik vawt te cial uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Naseamte theampo in nasep hanciam tekin Biakinnpi sia a sakciil bang linlian in a kho mama in puuapha kik uh hi."},"14":{"text":"A puuanate a man zawkciang khamh le ngunn a taanglaite sia kumpipa le Jehoiada pia a, amate in Biakinnpi atu a kisamh kuangnote le nazak dangte vawtna in zangh uh hi. Jehoiada nuntak lai tengin Biakinnpi ah sangaw biakpiakna te a hun maan in kipia hi."},"15":{"text":"Huai mama in kum 130 a phak zawkciang ama thi hi.","title":"Jehoiada ii Thupaizia Kilumlet"},"16":{"text":"Israel mipi atu, Pathian atu le Biakinnpi atu a nasep kiheaksak na in amate in David Khuapi, kumpi thaan ah phum uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahihang Jehoiada thi zawk po ciang Judah lampuite in Joash kumpipa sia amate thu ngai tu in zol zaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom, mipite in a taanghpupite ii Pathian, Topa Biakinnpi sungah biakna vawt nawn ngawlin milimte le Asherah numeipathian limte bia tu kipan uh hi. Hi mawna khialna a vawt nate taw Judah le Jerusalem tungah Topa thin uuksak hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in ama a zot kik natu a phawksak tu in amate kungah kamsaangte a puak hang mite in nangai ngawl uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Pathian thaa in thiampi Jehoiada ii tapa Zechariah tungah theng hi. Ama mipite mu theina ah dingin, “ Topa Pathian in banghangin a thupiakte zui ngawlin noma le noma tungah tuasiatna tungsak nu ziam! Note in ama nusia nu hi, tua hu in ama in note hong nusia hi!” ci in aukeak hi.","ref":"Mt 23:35; Lk 11:51"},"21":{"text":"Joash kumpipa in Zechariah a kithasawmna ah pawmin, kumpipa thupiakna taw mipite in biakinn tual ah Zechariah suang taw deanglum uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Kumpipa in Zechariah ii pa Jehoiada ii ama tungah a thumaan nasepnate mangil a, Zechariah thatsak hi. Zechariah in a thi dektak ciang, “Na vawt uh sia Topa in hong mu in note daan hong pia tahen!” ci in au san hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua kum tangngam phalbi kipat hun ciang Syria ngalkaphonpi in Judah le Jerusalem simin a lampui theampo that a, vanh tam mama laksak in Damascus ah ciapui hi.","title":"Joash ii Kumpi Maanna a Bona"},"24":{"text":"Syria ngalkapte tawm ahihang, Judah mite in a taanghpupite ii Pathian, Topa a taisat hu in Topa in a tamzaw pek Judah ngalkaphonpite zosak hi. Ama David Khuapi sungah kiphum ahihang kumpi thaan ah kiphum ngawl hi."},"26":{"text":"(Joash a suamte sia Ammon numei Shimeath ii tapa Zabad le Moab numei Shimrith ii tapa Jehozabad ahi hi.)"},"27":{"text":"Kumpite ii Thubu Sontelna sungah Joash tapate taanghthu, ama atu a pha ngawl kamsaanna te le Biakinnpi a sak kikna thu tepteenate kihel hi. A tapa Amaziah in a kumpiza laih hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amaziah sia kum 25 a phakin kumpi suak a, Jerusalem pan kum 29 sung uk hi. A nu sia Jerusalem khua mi Jehoaddin hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Amaziah (2 Kumpite 14:2-6)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Topa diksak bang seam ahihang a sepna ah thalawp ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama thuneina a kip po ciang, a pa a that ulian teng that hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang ama in Moses Thukham sungah Topa thupiak bang zui in tua ulian te ii tate that ngawl hi, Moses Thukham sungah: “A tate ii khialna liante hangin a nu le a pa kithat ngawl tu a, a nu le a pa khialna liante hangin a tate kithat ngawl tu hi; mihing khat sia ama mama ii vawt khialna lian hang bekin kithisak tu hi,” ci in om hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:16"},"5":{"text":"Amaziah kumpipa in Judah le Benjamin namte sung pan pasal theampo ngalkap tumsak a, a bee a phung zui in khen hi, tuaciang tulkhat uk le zakhat uk tu in ngalkapbute koi hi. Hi sungah kum kul le a tungsia theampo kihel a, a vekpi in 300,000 pha hi. Amate sia ngalkap a khop tuamte hi a, ngalsim thei paih tu lum le tei toai thiam sa te vive hi.","title":"Edom Ngam A simna (2 Kumpite 14:7)"},"6":{"text":"Tua bek dom ngawlin ama in ngunn kilogramme 3,400 bang thaman pia in, Israel ngalkap 100,000 cial hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahihang kamsaang khat kumpipa kungah pai in, “Hi Israel ngalkapte la heak in. Hi saksang kumpi ngam pan mite Topa in ompui ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in ngal kisimna ah nang hong thahatsak zaw tu hi, ci in um tha tu ni hi, ahihang zawna le lelna a pia vaang a nei sia Pathian hi a, ama in na ngalte hong lelsak tu hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaziah kumpipa in kamsaangpa tungah, “Tua ahile ka piaksa ngunnte theampo a thawthong suak tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Kamsaangpa in, “Tuasia sangin a tamzaw Topa in nang hong pia kik thei hi!” ci in zo kik hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Amaziah in a cial ngalkapte ciasak kik hi. Tuabangin amate cia a, Judah mite tungah thin uuk mama uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaziah ama le ama kihansua in Ci Kuam ah a ngalkaphonpi paipui hi. Tua munah amate in Edom ngalkapte simin 10,000 thatin"},"12":{"text":"a dang 10,000 man uh hi. Amate in thongtaakte Sela khuapi liangbo sia tungah paipui a, a nuai suang tungah a kiseplum tu in lawnsuk hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:16"},"13":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Amaziah ii a ngalsim khoppui tu in a oai ngawl Israel ngalkapte in Samaria le Beth Horon kilaklaw a om Judah khuapite sim a, pasal 3,000 thatin, vanh tam mama laaksak uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaziah sia Edom ngalkapte zo in a cia kik ciang, amate ii biak milimte ciapui a, omna pia a, tuaciang ngimnamtui halin bia hi."},"15":{"text":"Hisia in Topa thin uuksak ahiciang, Amaziah kungah kamsaang khat paisak hi. Kamsaangpa in, “Nangma khut sung pan ngawngawn in a mipuite a hun zo ngawl ngamdang pathiante banghangin bia ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"16":{"text":"A kampau suan a, Amaziah in, “Bang hun pan kipanin kumpipa ngaisutna pia tu in hong koi khu ziam? Pau nawn heak in, tua ahibuale hong thatsak tu khi hi!” ci hi. Kamsaangpa in, “Hi bang teng ngamta zo a, ngaisutna kong piak sia awlmawk ngawl na hi hu in Pathian in nangma hong susia tu in khensat zo ahi sia tu in ka he hi,” a ci zawkciang a pau tawp pheang hi."},"17":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Amaziah le ama thu dokte in Israel ngam sim sawm uh hi. Tuaciang ama in Jehoahaz ii tapa, Jehu ii tupa Israel kumpipa Jehoash tungah thu puakin a do natu in thato hi.","title":"Israel te A simna (2 Kumpite 14:8-20)"},"18":{"text":"Jehoash in Amaziah tungah hi bangin zo kik hi: “Khatvei lai in Lebanon Mualte tung pan lingkung khat in cedar thing kung tungah thu khat puak hi: ‘Ka tapa zi tu in na tanu hong pia ta'n,’ ci hi. Ngamsa khat pai in tua lingkung siikcil hi"},"19":{"text":"Tu in Amaziah awng Edom te na zaw hu in kiphasak ni hi, ahihang na inn ah om hithiat lete hong oai zaw khi hi. Banghangin nangma le na mite tuasiat natu bekin ngim zong vealvul ni ziam?”"},"20":{"text":"Ahihang Amaziah in tua thu nadon ngawl hi. Hi bang a Amaziah ii a ngallel tu sia Pathian ii deina hi a, ama ii Edom milimte a biak hang ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuabangin Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Judah kumpipa Amaziah sim tu in kuan hi. Amate Judah ngam Beth Shemesh ah kisii a,"},"22":{"text":"Judah ngalkaphonpite ngallel in, a inn tek ah tai siat uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Jehoash in Amaziah manin Jerusalem ah paipui hi. Topa note Pathian in no tungah a thin uuk nawn ngawl natu in a tawntungin a thianthosak sa Jerusalem Biakinnpi ah hong pai in ama bia vun."},"9":{"text":"Topa na zuan kik uh le na mealheakte, thong a taaksakte in amate khuangai huai sa in inn ah hong ciasak kik tu hi. Topa note Pathian dikin, ngual hesuak thei a, ama na zuan kik uh le ama in hong saang tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Kamtaite sia Ephraim le Manasseh namte ii ngamsung khuapi theampo ah pai a, saksang khakbel Zebulun namte teenna dong theng hi, ahihang mite in amate nuisan in selno uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua kawm pan Asher, Manasseh le Zebulun namte sung pan Jerusalem khua ah a pai nuam veve pawlkhat om lai hi."},"12":{"text":"Judah mite sung zongh ah Pathian in naseam a, kumpipa le a uliante thupiakte a thunitna taw ama deina a zui tu in mipite a kibangin thin khensatna neisak hi."},"13":{"text":"A tha nii tha in Tol Kisaw Ngawl Anluum Poai vawt tu in mi honpui khat Jerusalem ah kikhawmtua uh hi.","title":"Paisan Poai Kivawt"},"14":{"text":"Amate in Jerusalem khua sungah sangaw biakpiakna le ngimnamtui halna in a kizangh biaknataute theampo la in Kidron kuam ah vawk uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang tua tha a ni sawm le ni li ni in amate in Paisan Poai sangaw biakpiakna atu tuute ngo uh hi. A zeksa om bangin a thiang ngawl lai thiampite le Levi te sia a maizum mama in Topa mai ah amate le amate ki aaptuam hi; tuasia ciang tu in amate in Biakinnpi sungah meihal biakpiakna pia thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Pathian mi Moses ii Thukham sungah a thupiak bangin amate in Biakinnpi sungah omna mun la tek hi. Levi te in sangaw biakpiaknate ii a chite thiampite pia a, thiampite in biaknatau tungah the uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Mipite tam mama sia a zeksa om bangin thiang ngawl ahi hu in Paisan Poai tuute ngo thei ngawl ahikom amate taangin Levi te in ngoin Topa tungah tuuno te aap uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaban ah, Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar le Zebulun namte sung panin hong pai mihing tam mama te in a zeksa thiansuana vawt ngawl ahikom amate in Paisan Poai sia a ngeina zui ngawlin tang uh hi. Hezekiah kumpipa in amate atu in hi bangin thungetsak hi:"},"19":{"text":"“Ka taanghpupite ii Pathian, Topa awng, a zeksa om bangin thiang ngawl ahitazong a thinsung theampo taw nang hong bia amate tungah na thin phatna taw maisak in,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in Hezekiah thungetna saang a; tua mite mawna maisak in, ngim ngasak ngawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ah a kikhawmtua mite theampo in Tol Kisaw Ngawl Anluum Poai sia lungdamna lianpi taw ni sali sung vawt hi; ni khat zawkciang ni khat thiampite le Levi te in a tha neiza taw Topa pok uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Hezekiah in Topa biakna vawt a thiam Levi te pok hi. A taanghpupite ii Pathian, Topa a pokna in ni sali sung sangaw biakpiaknate a nei zawkciang"},"23":{"text":"amate teng in a dang ni sali sung ma poai vawt natu in khensat hi. Tuabangin amate lungdam takin poai vawt uh hi.","title":"Paisan Poai Vawt a Niina"},"24":{"text":"Hezekiah kumpipa in tua poai ah mipite neak tu in khuital 1,000 le tuu 7,000 pia in a uliante in a dang khuital 1,000 le tuu 10,000 pia uh hi. Thiampi tam mama in a zeksa kithiansuana vawt uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahikom mite theampo — Judah mi, thiampite, Levi te, saksang ngam pan hong pai mite le Israel le Judah ngam sungah a teang suak ngamdangmite, a kuama po lungdam uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi sia lungdamna taw kidim hi, banghang ziam cile tuabang lungdamnate David ii tapa Solomon kumpipa hunlai pan kipan om ngeingawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Thiampite le Levi te in mipite atu in Topa tungah thupha ngetsak hi. Vantung a inn pan Pathian in amate thungetna za in saang hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua poai a man zawkciang Israel mite theampo Judah khuapi teng ah pai a, suangkhuamte sutan in Asherah numeipathian ii limte phuktan in biaknatau te le doai sepna munte sutham hi. Amate in a taanglai Judah ngam theampo, tuaciang Ephraim, Benjamin le Manasseh ngamte ah tuabang ma in vawt hi; tua zawkciang amate inn zuan kik siat uh hi.","title":"Hezekiah in Biakna Ngeinate Puua kik"},"2":{"text":"Hezekiah kumpipa in thiampite le Levi te ii nasep kipawlna puuapha kik a, tuabangin mi simin vaipuak nei tek hi. Tuate in meihal biakpiaknate, kipawlkhop biakpiaknate, biakinn biakpiakna sungah kihelna, Biakinnpi sung mun tuatuam ah Pathian min pokna le Pathian tungah lungdamkonate ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Zing le nitak veu in a kiseam meihal biakpiaknate le Sabbath ni le Tha Thak Poai atu ahizong, Topa Thukham om bangin vawt a kul Poai dangte atu ahizong Hezekiah in ama ii khuihon le a tuu honte sung pan nganno te pia hi.","ref":"Mi 28:1—29:39"},"4":{"text":"Tua banah Topa Pathian Thukham om bangin thiampite le Levi te in a hun nei zaza a piak thei natu in amate nga tu a hi piakkhiatnate a piak tek natu in kumpipa in Jerusalem khua mite thupia hi.","ref":"Mi 18:12-13,21"},"5":{"text":"Tuabangin thu a piak zawk po ciang Israel mite in a antang, sapittui, olive thau, khuaitui te le a dang lo an sung pan a phabel teng letsong in pia hi, tuaciang a neisa theampo sung pan sawm a khat zongh paipui hi."},"6":{"text":"Judah khuapite ah a teang mite theampo in a khui le a tuute sawm a khat puakin, amate ii Pathian, Topa tungah a aapsa letsongte tam mama zongh puak si uh hi."},"7":{"text":"A tha thumna tha sungin letsongte hong puak a, tha li sung a kipee in hong thengin kiciangto hi."},"8":{"text":"Hezekiah kumpipa le a uliante in tuabangza a tam letsong a kipiak a mu uh ciang, amate in Topa le Israel a mite pok hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi letsongte thu kumpipa in thiampite le Levi te tungah a son ciang,"},"10":{"text":"Zadok ii suan Thiampi Lianbel Azariah in Ama tungah, “Mihonpite in a letsongte Biakinnpi ah hong paipui pan kipan, neak tu kicingin tam mama zongh vaal lai hi. Tu bangza theampo ih nei na sia Topa in a mite thupha hong piak hang hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa thupiak bangin amate in Biakinnpi suum sungah vanh kholna inndoite vawt a,"},"12":{"text":"tua inndoite sungah letsongte le sawm a khat te theampo kikeamcing hi. Amate in tua sia Levi te Conaniah in uksak a, a suapuipa Shimei in husak hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate khutnuai ah na seam tu in Levi te sawm kisee a: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath le Benaiah te ahi hi. Hite theampo sia Hezekiah kumpipa le Thiampi Lianbel Azariah thu taw a kiseam ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Biakinnpi Nisuana sang Kongpi a cingpipa Levi mi Imnah ii tapa Kore sia Topa tungah a kipia letsongte a sang tu le tuate a hawmna ah a ukpa ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Thiampite teenna khuapi dangte ah hi Levi dangte in thumaan takin ama nasep a hu te sia: Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah le Shecaniah te ahi hi. Ante sia amate sepna bang zui in Levi mipui te tungah kim hawm a,"},"16":{"text":"bee le phung zui in hawm ngawl hi. Amate Biakinnpi ah ni sim vaipuak nei pasal kum 30 ahibuale a tungsia theampo a nasep na mun zui in hawmsak uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Thiampite sia bee le phung zui in nasep kiseesak a, Levi te pasal kum kul le a tungsiate sia a pawl nasepna zui in kisee hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate ii a thiangtho nasep thupite bang hun pawpo in sep na tu kingin kul ahikom amate, a zi a tate le a bealh dangte taw a min theampo kiciamtee hi."},"19":{"text":"Thiampi bangkua sungah a om pa a minpiang le Levi bee le phung min tepteena sungah min om theampote, an a hawmsak tu in vaipuak nei pasal teng sia Aaron suan le paalte atu a kisee khuapite ahibuale hi khuapite ii neisa nganthana munte sungah a teang thiampite sung pan veu a hi hi."},"20":{"text":"Judah ngamsung theampo ah Hezekiah kumpipa in a maan sia le Topa a Pathian ii diksak teng seam hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama ii Biakinnpi a tu a sep theampo ahibuale Thukham zuina thu ah thutakin a thin takpi taw a Pathian a biak hu in a maa tun hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekiah kumpipa in thumaan takin Topa na seam a, hi bang thupiang teng zawkciang Assyria kumpilianpa Sennacherib in Judah ngam sim hi. Ama in kulh taw a ki uum khuapite uumci in a ngalkaphonpite tungah luphungte sulet in a kaantan natu thupia hi.","title":"Assyria te in Jerusalem Sim sawm (2 Kumpite 18:13-37 ; 19:14-19 , 35-37 ; Is 36:1-22; 37:8-38)"},"2":{"text":"Sennacherib in Jerusalem khuapi zongh sim a sawm hunlam Hezekiah in a phaw ciang,"},"3":{"text":"Assyria te Jerusalem khua hong nai ciang tui a nga ngawl natu in ama le a uliante in khuapi pua sang pan tuinaakte khakcip tu in khensat uh hi. Uliante lampui in khua mite tam mama kuan tek a, tui a suak nawn ngawl natu in tuinaak theampo khakcip uh hi.","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa in khuapi uumna luphungte puuapha in, a tungah ngal vilna tausaangte sa in khuapi uumna pua sangah luphung cian thuana taw ngal nannate khosak hi. Tuaban ah, ama in Jerusalem khua lui mun khen khat ii nisuana sang lei kidipna tungah ngalnanna a sakte zongh puua kik hi. Ama in lum le tei tam mama zongh vawtsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in khuapi sung pasal om theampo ngalkap bute khutnuai ah koi in khuapi kongpi leitual ah a kikhoptua natu thupia hi. Ama in amate tungah,"},"7":{"text":"“Citakin kimuang vun, Assyria kumpilianpa ahibuale a lampui ngalkaphonpi sia kiita heak vun. Ama sangah a nei thahatna sangin ei sangah a om thahatna nasia zaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in mihing thahatna nei ahihang eite in hong hu tu le ih ngalte hong simsak tu in Topa ih Pathian kinei hi,” ci hi. A kumpipa ii hi kammalte in mite hanthawn hi."},"9":{"text":"Tawmvei zawkciang Sennacherib le a ngalkaphonpite Lachish ah a om hun laitakin, Sennacherib in Jerusalem khua ah a om Hezekiah kumpipa le ama taw a omkhawm Judah mite tungah hi thu teng puak hi:"},"10":{"text":"“Keima Assyria kumpilianpa Sennacherib in kong dok nopna pan, a ki uumci Jerusalem khua sungah na om ngam lai natu sia bang in kimuanna hong pia ziam?"},"11":{"text":"Ko khut sung panin Topa na Pathian in no hong hun tu hi ci in Hezekiah in hong son hi, ahihang Hezekiah in note hong theam a, ngilkial dangtaak in hong thisak tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa biakna munte le biaknataute a sutham sia ama hi a, Judah le Jerusalem mite tungah biaknatau khat bek ah biakna vawt in ngimnamtui a halsak sia zongh ama ma hi."},"13":{"text":"Ngamdangmite tungah ka taanghpupite le keima ngamtatna he ngawl nu ziam? Ngamdang khat pawpo ii pathiante in a mite Assyria kumpilianpa khut sung panin a hun ngei ziam?"},"14":{"text":"Bang hunin tua ngam teng ii pathiante khat pawpo in a ngam sia ko khut sung pan hun ngei na ziam? Tua ahile na pathian in nang hong hun thei hi ci sia, bang in hong ngaisunsak ziam?"},"15":{"text":"Tu in Hezekiah in tuabangin theamsak heak vun a, tuabangin lamkhial puisak heak vun. Ama um heak vun! Ngam khat pawpo ii pathian in a mite sia Assyria kumpilianpa khat pawpo khut sung pan hun zo ngeingawl hi. Tua ahiciang hi note pathian in note hong hun takpi zo ngawl tu hi!” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Assyria uliante in Topa Pathian le Topa naseampa Hezekiah te siat son zaw lai uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpilianpa in Israel te ii Pathian Topa a dona lai thaak a tuasung ah, “Tua ngamte ii pathiante in keima khut sung panin a mite hun ngawl hi, Hezekiah ii pathian in ka khut sung pan a mite hun ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua uliante in tua khuapi a ol zaw in a laak thei natu in luphung tungah a om Jerusalem mite a lau natu le a thinkiam natu in Hebrew kam taw, a tung a teng ci in au hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in mihing khut taw a kivawt tawm milimte, midangte ii pathiante a sonna taw ma kibangin Jerusalem Pathian zongh sonsak lel uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Hezekiah kumpipa le Amoz ii tapa, kamsaang Isaiah te in Pathian tungah thungen a, au in huna ngen uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in vantunglalang khat paisakin Assyria ngalkap te le a ngalkapbute thatsak hi. Tua ahikom a kumpilianpa sia maimawlin Assyria ngam ah heak kik hi. Ni khat ni in ama sia a pathian biakinn sungah a om laitakin a tapate pawlkhat in a namsau uh taw ama thatlum hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuabangin Topa in Hezekiah kumpipa le Jerusalem mi teng Assyria kumpilianpa Sennacherib le a ngal dangte khut sung pan zongh suatak hi. Ama in a mite sia a kiim le a paam ngam theampo taw kilemin teangsak hi."},"23":{"text":"Mihing tam mama in Topa tungah a piak tu biakpiakna te le Hezekiah tungah a piak tu letsongte kengin Jerusalem ah hong pai uh hi, tuabangin tua hun pan kipan minam theampo mai ah Hezekiah sia kizakta in kithasia mama hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua hun khawngin Kumpipa Hezekiah a ciina in thi dek tak hi. Ama in thungen a, Topa in a dam natu lim khat lak hi.","title":"Hezekiah ii Ciinatna le Kiphatsakna (2 Kumpite 20:1-3 , 12-19 ; Is 38:1-3; 39:1-8)"},"25":{"text":"Ahihang Hezekiah kiphasak leih in Topa ii ama atu a vawtsak nate hangin lungdamko ngawl hi, tuaciang Judah le Jerusalem mite in ngim nga law uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahizong a khakbel ciang Hezekiah le Jerusalem mite kiniamkhiak kik ahikom Topa in Hezekiah ii thi dong tua mite daan pia ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Hezekiah kumpipa hau mama a, kuama po in vaang pia hi. Ama in a neisa ngunn, khamh, suangmanpha te, hel namtuite, lumte le vanh manpha dangte khol natu in vanh kholna inndoite sa hi.","title":"Hezekiah ii Nei le Lam le a Vaang neina"},"28":{"text":"Tuaban ah ante, sapittui le olive thau kholna tu inndoite; a khuite atu in khuibukte; tuaciang a tuute atu tuu khawk te sasak hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaban ah Pathian in tuu le khui te pia in a dang nei le lamh tam mama pia ahikom ama in khuapi tam ma saat hi."},"30":{"text":"Gihon Ciktui ii pusuana vang khaktan in Jerusalem luphung sungsang mun khat dongin leinuai ah tui kheetna luam a vawt sia Hezekiah kumpipa ahi hi. A sep a vawt theampo Hezekiah in taangtun a,"},"31":{"text":"a ngam sungah a lamdang a piang thu kan tu in Babylon tongciinte a pai laitak ngawngawnin a ngamtatna a heak ku nopna in Pathian in Hezekiah sia ama uuk thu in ngamtasak hi."},"32":{"text":"Hezekiah kumpipa ii a nasep dang teng le Topa tungah a kipiaknate theampo sia Amoz Tapa Kamsaang Isaiah ii Mukholna sung le Judah le Israel Kumpipate ii Taanghthu sungah kiciamtee hi.","title":"Hezekiah ii Kumpi Maanna a Bona (2 Kumpite 20:20-21)"},"33":{"text":"Hezekiah thi a, kumpite thaan tungnung ah kiphum hi. A thi ciang, Judah le Jerusalem mite theampo in zatakna lianpi pia uh hi. A tapa Manasseh in a kumpiza laih hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh sia kum sawm le kum nii a phak ciangin Judah kumpi suak a, ama in Jerusalem pan kum 55 sung uk hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Manasseh (2 Kumpite 21:1-9)"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite maisang a manaw lai in tua ngamsung pan Topa ii a nawkeak minamte ii a kiihuai ngamtatna te zui in Manasseh sia Topa tungah maw hi.","ref":"Jer 15:4"},"3":{"text":"Ama in a pa Hezekiah ii suksiat sa doai biakna munte sa kik hi. Ama in Baal biakna tu in biaknataute sa a, Asherah numeipathian limte vawtin aksite bia hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa ii ama a tawntungin a kibiak natu mun a cina Biakinnpi sungah ama in doai biaknataute vawt hi.","ref":"2 Khang 6:6"},"5":{"text":"Ama in Biakinnpi leitual nii te ah aksite biakna tu in biaknataute vawt hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a tapate Hinnom Kuam ah meihal biakpiakna in nei hi. Ama in mitbum le aisaanna zangh a, maisang thu a sontheite le thaa sam theite thu dongh hi. Ama in Topa tungah maw mama in a thin uuksak hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in Topa Biakinnpi sungah milim khat koi a, tua mun in Pathian ii David le a tapa Solomon tungah, “Hi lai Jerusalem khua sung, hi Biakinnpi sung sia keima hong kibiak natu in, Israel minam sawm le niite ii ngamsung theampo panin ka tealna mun ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel mite in ka thukham theampo zui in ka naseampa Moses ii amate a piak Thukham buppi a zui uh le a taanghpupite tungah ka piak ngam panin a kinawkeak tu ka oai buatu hi,” a ci sa hi.","ref":"1 Kum 9:3-5; 2 Khang 7:12-18"},"9":{"text":"Topa mihing Israel mite maisang a manaw lai in, tua ngamsung pan Topa ii nawkeak minamte ii mawna sang zong a lianzaw te ngawngawn a vawt tu in Manasseh in Judah mite lampui hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Manasseh le a mite a kidop natu in son hi napi amate in nangai ngawl uh hi.","title":"Manasseh Kisiik kik"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa in Assyria ngalkapmangte in Judah ngam simsak hi. Amate in Manasseh manin thikkawn le kol bulin Babylon ah paipui uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Hi bangin a thuakna hu in ama kiniamkhiak in Topa a Pathian zuanin huna ngen hi."},"13":{"text":"Manasseh ii thungetna sia Pathian in saang a, Jerusalem ah heak kiksakin a ngam uksak kik hi. Hisia in Topa ma Pathian a hina thu Manasseh in telsak hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciang Manasseh in David Khuapi nisuana sangah a om luphung puanung sia Gihon Cik hui Kuam sung panin saksang ah Ngasa Kongpi le Ophel kici khuapi huam ciang dong saangsak vaial hi. Judah ngam sungah kulh taw a ki uum khuapi sim ah ngalkap honkhat le a uk ngalkapbu khat veu koi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in Biakinnpi sung panin ngamdang pathiante le tua munah ama koi milim sia ahizong, Biakinnpi omna mualtung le Jerusalem khua sung mun dangte ah a om doai sepna biaknataute ahizong khiin hi; ama in hite theampo Jerusalem khua pua sangah paipui in vawk siat hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in Topa a kibiakna biaknatau zongh puua kikin tua tungah kipawlkhop biakpiaknate le lungdamko biakpiaknate pia hi. Ama in Israel te ii Pathian, Topa a biak natu in Judah mite theampo thupia hi."},"17":{"text":"Mite in biakna mun dangte ah sangaw biakpiaknate pia suak ahitazong amate in Topa tung bekma ah pia uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Manasseh ii a nasep dangte theampo a Pathian tungah a thungetna le Topa Israel ii Pathian min taw kamsaangte ii ama tungah a thupuakte theampo Israel Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kiciamtee hi.","title":"Manasseh ii Kumpi Maanna a Bona (2 Kumpite 21:17-18)"},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa ii thungetna le Pathian zo kikna, a kisiik kik ma in a vawt mawna khialna — a sia a vawtte, doai sepna munte le numeipathian Asherah lim, tuaciang a biak milimte — theampo sia Kamsaangte Taanghthu sungah kiciamtee hi."},"20":{"text":"Manasseh thi a, kumpi inn ah kiphumin, a tapa Amon in a kumpiza laih hi."},"21":{"text":"Amon in Judah kumpi a sua lai in kum 22 pha a, Jerusalem panin kum nii sung uk hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Amon (2 Kumpite 21:19-26)"},"22":{"text":"A pa Manasseh bangma in ama in Topa tungah maw in a pa ii biak milimte bia hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang ama ahile a pa bang hi ngawl a, kiniamkhiak ngawlin Topa kung zuan ngawl hi; a pa sang zong mawzaw lai hi."},"24":{"text":"Amon sia a uliante ma in thasawm a, kumpi inn sungah thatlum hi."},"25":{"text":"Amon a suamte sia Judah mite in thatin, a tapa Josiah kumpi suaksak uh hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah in kum liat a phak ciang Judah kumpi suak a, Jerusalem panin kum 31 sung uk hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Josiah (2 Kumpite 22:1-2)","ref":"Jer 3:6"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Topa diksak nate vawt a; a taanghpupi David ngamtatna zui in Pathian ii thukham theampo pha takin zui hi."},"3":{"text":"Josiah a kumpi sua zawk kum liat a phak kumin khangmoi mama lai ahihang ama in a taanghpupi David kumpipa ii Pathian a biak kipan hi. Kum li zawkciang ama in doai sepna munte, Asherah numeipathian limte le a dang milimte theampo a suksiat kipan hi.","title":"Josiah in Doai Biakna Do"},"4":{"text":"Ama ii thupiak bangin a mite in Baal biakna biaknataute sutham in a kungah ngimnamtui halna biaknataute pheltham hi. Amate in Asherah milimte le a dang milimte theampo suuvui in, a vui teng sia tua milimte sangaw biakpiakna a pia mite ii thaan tungah the uh hi.","ref":"2 Kum 21:3; 2 Khang 33:3"},"5":{"text":"Ama in doai seam thiampite ii ngu teng amate ii biaknataute tungah hal hi. Hi bang teng taw Josiah in Judah le Jerusalem sia a zeksa ngeina om bangin thiansua kik hi.","ref":"1 Kum 13:2"},"6":{"text":"Ama in khuapite sung le Manasseh ngam, Ephraim ngam le Simeon ngamsung a zawna mun theampo, tuaciang saksang ah Naphtali dongin tuabang ma in vawt siat hi."},"7":{"text":"Saksang kumpi ngam theampo ah ama in biaknataute le Asherah limte sutham in milimte suuvui a, ngimnamtui halna biaknataute theampo sem tham hi. Tua zawkciang ama Jerusalem ah heak kik hi."},"8":{"text":"Josiah kumpipa in a kumpi maan zawk kum sawm le kum liat kumin, a ngam le Biakinnpi sia doai biakna a bosakna taw a thiansua zawkciang ama in Topa Pathian Biakinnpi puua kik tu in pasal thum paisak a: Azaliah tapa Shaphan, Jerusalem a uk mangpa Maaseiah le ulian khat ahi Joahaz ii tapa Joah ahi hi.","title":"Thukham Laibu Kimu (2 Kumpite 22:3-20)"},"9":{"text":"Levi biakinn cingte ii Biakinnpi sung pan a khon sum teng Thiampi Lianbel Hilkiah tungah ki aap hi. (Tua sumte sia Ephraim mi, Manasseh mi le a taanglai Saksang kumpingam mite, Judah mi, Benjamin mi, Jerusalem mite tung pan a kikhonte hi.)"},"10":{"text":"Tua sum teng biakinn puua kikna a ukte thum tungah ki aap a, amate in"},"11":{"text":"Judah kumpite ii a muatsak innte puua natu a kizangh suang le thing lei natu in lettamate le inn sate a piak tu ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua na a seamte thumaan tatak hi. Amate sia Levi mite li ahi Merari bee le phung pan Jahath le Obadiah, Kohath bee le phung pan Zechariah le Meshullam te in uk uh hi. (Tua Levi te sia a vekpi in music thiam uh hi.)"},"13":{"text":"A dang Levi te in vanh nawn na le nasep dang tuatuam a seamte uk in, a dangte sia thu tepteena a keamte ahibuale a cingte ahi uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Vanh kholna inndoi sung pan sum a laak laitakin Hilkiah in Moses tungah Pathian piak Thukham, Topa Thukham laibu sia mu hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in Shaphan munah, “Hi Biakinnpi sungah Thukham laibu mu khi hi,” ci hi. Ama in tua laibu Shaphan pia a,"},"16":{"text":"Shaphan in kumpipa kungah paipui hi. Ama in, “Nong sawl theampo ka seam siat zo uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Biakinnpi sungah a kep sum teng ka la zo uh hi, tuasia naseamte le a ukte tungah ka pia zo uh hi,” ci in son hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in, “Hi sungah Hilkiah ii hong piak laibu khat om hi,” ci lai hi. Tuaciang ama in tuasia kumpipa tungah nging vazak in sim hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa in laibu a kisim na bang a zaak ciang, thin nop ngawlna taw a puansilh lai eaukeak a,"},"20":{"text":"tuaciang Hilkiah, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Micaiah tapa Abdon, zum thuzeakpipa Shaphan le kumpipa cing pa Asaiah te tungah hi bang thupia hi:"},"21":{"text":"“Pai tavun a, kei taang le Israel le Judah ah a om lai mite taangin Topa ii thu dongh tavun. Biakinn kongpi cingte in a cinna mun tek nusiat kul ngawl hi; banghang ziam cile amate atu in Levi dangte in Paisan Poai kingingsak uh hi.","ref":"1 Khang 25:1"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom Josiah kumpipa thupiak bangin Topa biakna Paisan Poai vawtna a tu le biaknatau tungah meihal biakpiaknate a tu teng tua ni in a vekpi kivawt siat hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua munah a om Israel mite a vekpi in Paisan Poai le Tol Kisaw ngawl Anluum Poai ni sali sung vawt uh hi.","ref":"Pu 12:1-20"},"18":{"text":"Kamsaangpa Samuel hun lai pan kipan Paisan Poai hi bangin kivawt ngeingawl hi. Ama in a naseamte tungah, “Hong taipui tavun; nasia liam khi hi!” ci in thupia hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in a siphu ngalleang tung panin toai in tua munah a om ama siphu ngalleang niina sia tungah suanh in Jerusalem ah paipui uh hi. Tua late sia khuangai late khoptuana sungah kimu hi."},"26":{"text":"Josiah ii a sep theampo — Topa tungah a kipiakna, Thukham a zuina,"},"27":{"text":"le ama taanghthu a kipatna pan a tawpna dong — Israel le Judah Kumpipate Taanghthu sungah kiciamtee siat hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah mite in Josiah ii tapa Joahaz teal a Jerusalem khua ah ama sathau noai in kumpi suaksak hi.","title":"Judah Kumpipa Joahaz (2 Kumpite 23:30-35)"},"2":{"text":"Judah kumpi a sua lai in Joahaz kum 23 pha a, Jerusalem pan tha thum sung uk hi."},"3":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa Neco in ama thongtaaksak a, Judah panin Neco tungah ngunn kilogramme 3,400 le khamh kilogramme 34 phiangshia in piasak hi."},"4":{"text":"Neco in Joahaz ii suapuipa Eliakim Judah kumpi suaksak a, a min Jehoiakim ci in laihsak hi. Kumpipa in Judah tangvalte Biakinnpi sung ngawngawn ah thatlum hi. Kumpipa in a moi a haam, numei pasal, a ciina a ciidam ci doi ngawlin kuama hesuak ngawl hi. Pathian in amate a vekpi ma ama tungah aap hi.","ref":"Jer 21:1-10; 34:1-5"},"18":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa in Biakinnpi sung, biakinn sum le vanh manpha, kumpipa le a uliante nei le lam teng theampo laksak a Babylon ah pua kik hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in Biakinnpi le khuapi sia a kumpi innte le a nei a lam theampo taw haltum in khuapi uumna luphungte sutham hi.","ref":"1 Kum 9:8"},"20":{"text":"Ama in a nungta lai theampo Babylon ah ciapui a, tua munah amate in sila bangin Persia kumpilianpa hong khan dong ama le a suan a paalte ii na seam uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuabangin kamsaang Jeremiah tungtawn a, Topa ii hi bang a sonkhol sa sia taangtung hi: “Sabbath tawlngakna a kitang ngawl teng lo kik natu in a ngam sia kum sawmsali sung ngamtongta hi tu hi.”"},"22":{"text":"Persia mi Cyrus, kumpilianpa a sep, a kum khat na kumin Topa in kamsaang Jeremiah tungtawn a, a thusonte taangtungsak hi. A nuai a, a thupiaknate a suasak tu le ama ii ukna ngam theampo ah a nging a sim tu in lai at in a thaak natu Topa in Cyrus thawn hi:","title":"Cyrus in Jew te Ciakiksak (Ezra 1:1-4)"},"23":{"text":"“Hisia in Persia kumpilianpa Cyrus ii thupiakna ahi hi. Vantung Pathian, Topa in leitung buppi uk pa in keima hong koi zo a, Judah ngam Jerusalem ah ama atu biakinn khat sa tu in vaipuak hong pia zo hi. Tu in no, Pathian mite theampo awng, tualai ah va pai tavun a, Topa na Pathian note taw hong omkhawm tahen.”","ref":"Is 44:28"}}}}},"15":{"info":{"name":"Ezra","shortname":"Ezra","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Persia mi Cyrus in kumpilianpa a sep, a kum khat kumin Topa in kamsaang Jeremiah tungtawn a, a thusonte taangtungsak hi. Vantung Pathian, Topa in leitung bup uk tu in keima hong koi zo a, Judah ngam Jerusalem ah ama atu biakinn khat sa tu in vaipuak hong pia zo hi.","ref":"Is 44:28"},"3":{"text":"Ama mi ahi note theampo taw Pathian hong omkhawm tahen.
