(Barzillai thiampi bee le phung pianna taanghpupi in Gilead ngam Barzillai bee le phung pan numei khat teenpui a, a sunghpa ii bee le phung min la hi). A taanghpupite sia a kuate ci lak thei ngawl ahikom amate sia thiampi tu in kisaang ngawl hi.","merge":"62"},"63":{"text":"Jew ngamukmangpa in amate tungah Urim le Thummim a zangh thei thiampi khat a om mateng in Pathian a kipia ante ne thei ngawl tu nu hi ci hi.","ref":"Mi 27:21"},"64":{"text":"Saltanna pan a cia kik theampo 42,360 Amate ii naseampa le numei - 7,337 Music thiam, pa le numei - 200 Siphu - 736 Laa - 245 Kalaoh - 435 Laano - 6720 pha uh hi.","merge":"65"},"68":{"text":"Jerusalem ah om Topa ii Biakinnpi ah saltaangte a thet uh ciang, bee le phungte lampui pawlkhat in a mun lui ma ah Biakinnpi a kisak kik natu panpui in thinzaw piakkhiatnate pia uh hi."},"69":{"text":"Amate in hi nasep a sep natu in a piak zawk za tek pia in, a vekpi kingawm khamh kilogramme 500, ngunn kilogramme 2,800 le thiampite atu in puantual silh 100 ahi hi."},"70":{"text":"Thiampite, Levi te, le mi pawlkhatte Jerusalem ahibuale tua khua nai ah teang uh hi. Music thiamte, biakinn cingte le biakinn naseamte sia a naina khuate ah teang uh hi; tuaciang a taanglai Israel te sia a taanghpupite teenna khuate ah teang uh hi.","ref":"1 Khang 9:2; Neh 11:3"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tha sali tha in Israel mite a khua tek ah teang siat hi. Tua zawkciang amate a vekpi in Jerusalem ah kikhawm uh a,","title":"Pathian Biakna Kipan kik"},"2":{"text":"Jehozadak ii tapa Joshua, a thiampi puite le Shealtiel ii tapa Zerubbabel le a beete teng in Pathian ii mihing Moses ii Thukham sungah a ki at hilnate bangin sangaw biakpiaknate a hal thei natu in Israel ii Pathian biaknatau sa kik uh hi.","ref":"Pu 27:1"},"3":{"text":"Saltanna pan a cia kikte in tua ngam ah a teang mite kiita ahitazong, amate in biaknatau sia a om maksakna mun ma ah sa kik uh hi. Tua zawkciang amate ii a vawt ngei zing le nitak sangaw biakpiaknate tua tungah hal tu in khatvei ma kipan kik uh hi.","ref":"Mi 28:1-8"},"4":{"text":"Amate in zui tu ngeina om bangin Buk Poai khaam a; ni khat sim atu a kisamh babang tua ni in biakpiakna pia uh hi;","ref":"Mi 29:12-38"},"5":{"text":"tuaban ah amate in a piak tawntung pum bup meihal sangaw biakpiakna, Tha Thak Poai biakpiakna le a vawt ngengei Topa biak kikhopna dang teng theampo le Topa tungah amate thin zawna taw a piak biakpiaknate theampo zongh pia uh hi.","ref":"Mi 28:11—29:39"},"6":{"text":"Mipite in Biakinnpi sakkik tu kipan ngawl lai hikale, amate in a tha salina ni khat ni in Topa tungah meihal sangaw biakpiaknate kipan uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Mipite in suangciangte le lettamate a piak tu sum khia in, tuipi lam tawnin Joppa khua ah a kipua tu Lebanon pan Cedar thingte the natu in, Tyre le Sidon khuapite ah an le tui, olive thaute pia si uh hi. Hite theampo Persia kumpilianpa Cyrus ii thukimna la in kivawt hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Sakkik tu Kipan"},"8":{"text":"Tuabangin Jerusalem Biakinnpi sak natu munah amate a ciakik kum, a tha nii tha in nasep kipan uh hi. Zerubbabel, Joshua le a taanglai ngamsung a mipuite, thiampite le Levi mite, a tatakin saltanna pan Jerusalem ah a cia kikte theampo in sep pui tek hi. Kum kul le a tungsia Levi te theampo Biakinnpi sak kikna ah nasep ki uksak hi."},"9":{"text":"Levi mi Jeshua le a tapate le a mealheakte, tuaciang Kadmiel le a tapate (Hodaviah ii bee le phung) in Biakinnpi a sak kikna uk khawm uh hi. (Amate sia Henadad bee le phung pan Levi te in hu uh hi.)"},"10":{"text":"Inn sate ii Biakinn tawdap a vawt kipat ciang puantual silh Thiampite in a khut ah lemle toai in dinmun la uh a, Asaph bee le phung Levi te in daalkopsai taw tua munah ding uh hi. Amate in David kumpipa hun pan a kihilnate bangin Topa pok uh hi.","ref":"1 Khang 25:1"},"11":{"text":"Amate in hi Topa pokna la sa kikik hi: “ Topa pha hi, Israel a itna kip tawntung hi.” A kuama po in a tha neiza tek taw au in Topa pok uh hi, banghang ziam cile Biakinnpi tawdap a vawt kipan zo hi.","ref":"1 Khang 16:34; 2 Khang 5:13; 7:3; Ps 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"12":{"text":"Khanghaam thiampite, Levi te le bee le phung lutangte tam ma in a masa Biakinnpi mu ngei zo a, hi Biakinnpi tawdap a kipha a mu uh ciang amate au in kap uh hi. Ahizong tua munah a om dangte lungdamin au uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate aw sa taw ngamlum mama in a khuala na pan kiza thei ahiciang kuama in kaa na aw maw lungdamna aw maw khen thei ngawl uh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah le Benjamin mite ii ngalte in saltaang a cia kikte ii Israel te ii Pathian, Topa Biakinnpi a sak kikna thu za uh hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Sak kikna Kilangpan"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahiciang amate pai a Zerubbabel le a bee a phung lutangte taw a kimu uh ciang, “Ko zongh Biakinnpi sakna ah hong kihelsak tavun. Noma biak Pathian ma kote in bia khu hi, Assyria kumpilianpa Esarhaddon in hi lai ah teang tu in hong paisak pan kipan ama tungah sangaw biakpiakna pia khu hi,” ci uh hi.","ref":"2 Kum 17:24-41"},"3":{"text":"Zerubbabel, Joshua le a bee a phung lutangte in amate tungah, “ Topa kote Pathian biakinn sak natu in nong hu tu ka kisamh bua uh hi. Persia kumpilianpa Cyrus ii hong thupiakna bangin koma teng ma in ka sa tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaciang tua ngam sungah a teang mite in a sak ngawl natu in Jew te thinkiam sakin lauthawn tu hanciam uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate a langpan natu in Persia kumpi uliante zongh sumnguk pia uh hi. Amate in Cyrus kumpi maan hun sung theampo le Darius kumpi maan hun dongin tubangin langpan tan uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Xerxes kumpilianpa maan hun a kipat ciang Judah le Jerusalem ah a teangte ii ngalte in amate a langpanna lai pia uh hi.","title":"Jerusalem Sak kikna Kilangpan","ref":"Est 1:1"},"7":{"text":"Persia kumpilianpa Artaxerxes maan hun ciangin Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel le a pawlpuite in kumpilianpa tungah laithak at kik uh hi. Tua laithak sia Aramaic lai taw in ki at a, a kisim ciang pheen kik kul hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngamukmangpa Rehum le ngamsung thuzeakpi Shimshai te zongh in Jerusalem khua thu taw kisai kumpilianpa Artaxerxes tungah a nuai a bangin laithak at uh hi:"},"9":{"text":"“Ngamukmangpa Rehum le ngamsung thuzeakpi Shimshai, a pawlpuite, thukhente le Elam ngam sungah a om Erech, Babylon le Susa khuate ah a teang ulian dang theampote tung pan"},"10":{"text":"tuaciang a lian le a thahat Ashurbanipal ii amate inn pan a khiin Samaria khuapi sung le Euphrates nitumna ngamsung mundang ah a teensak midangte theampo tung panin kong thaak khop uh lai ahi hi.”"},"11":{"text":"A laithak sia a nuai a bang hi: “Euphrates nitumna sangah a teang na naseamte in kumpilianpa Artaxerxes tungah lai kong thaak uh hi."},"12":{"text":"“Nangma vaanglian kumpipa in, na ngam tuatuam panin hi mun ah hong pai Jew te ii Jerusalem khua ah teang a, a ngilo khuapi le kumpi leedo thei, tua khuapi a saat kikna thu he le te kong oai uh hi. Amate in luphung cian tu kipan zo a, hai ngawlin zo tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Vaanglian kumpipa awng, hi khuapi kisa kikin a luphungte kimanthiang le a mite in phiangshia piak tawlnga in, na kumpi sum tum kiam tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu in kote sia nangma a vaanglian kumpipa khutnuai ah a seamte ka hi uh ciang, hi bangin a pian tu sia mu nuam ngawl khu hi, tua hi a,"},"15":{"text":"na taanghpupite nusiat thu tepteena laibu sungah na kat kik tu in ngaisutna kong pia uh hi. Tuabangin kan kik le te hi khuapi sia kumpi leedo tawntung khuapi a hina le taanghlai hun a kipan kumpite le ngam ukte a buaisakna thu na mu tu hi. A mite sia uk hak tawntung hi. Tua hangin a khua kilalsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Hi khua kisaat kikin a luphungte kizo thiang thong le vaanglian kumpipa nangma in Euphrates nitumna ngam teng uk zo nawn ngawl tu ci thu telthiang khu hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Kumpilianpa in hi bangin lai thuk hi: “Ngam uk mangpa Rehum, ngamsung thuzeakpi Shimshai le Samaria le Euphrates nitumna sangah a teang pawl le lawmte awng kong paupui hi."},"18":{"text":"“Nong laithak kipheen kik in keima hong kisim hi."},"19":{"text":"A thu kan tu in ka sawl a, thu a kat ciang nidang tawngh hun pan Jerusalem sia kumpi a langpan tawntung a, a leedote le thu nawngkai vawtte taw a kidimna kimu takpi hi."},"20":{"text":"A thahat kumpite maang in Euphrates nitumna sang theampo uk in shia le phiangshia khon uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom thu kong piak kik mateng tua mite in khuapi a sakkik nawn ngawl natu in thupia tu nu hi."},"22":{"text":"Ka ngam phattuam nate a kilalsak ngawl natu in thakhat thu in tuasia seam paih vun,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Hi Artaxerxes ii laithak sia Rehum, Shimshai le a pawlpuite tungah a kisim po ciang amate Jerusalem ah manlang takin pai in Jew te khuapi a sakkik sia zawthawk thu taw tawlngasak uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Biakinnpi sakkik sia kitawlngasak a, Persia kumpilianpa Darius ii kumpi maan a kum nii kum dong bangma seam ngawlin omcip hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Sak Nasep Kipan kik","ref":"Hag 1:1; Zec 1:1"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun lai in kamsaang niite ahi Haggai le Iddo ii tapa Zechariah in Judah le Jerusalem ah a teang Jew te tungah Israel ii Pathian min suangin thu son kipan uh hi.","ref":"Hag 1:1; Zec 1:1"},"2":{"text":"Shealtiel ii tapa Zerubbabel le Jehozadak ii tapa Joshua te in a thusonte a zaak uh ciang Jerusalem Biakinnpi sakkik kipan a, kamsaangte nii in hu uh hi.","ref":"Hag 1:12; Zec 4:6-9"},"3":{"text":"Thakhat thu phialma in Euphrates nitumna sang ngamukmangpa Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai le a seppui uliante Jerusalem ah pai in, “Hi Biakinnpi sak tu le a sungah vanh teng a nguan tu in akua in thu hong pia ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in Biakinnpi sakna ah a hu teng ii min zongh dongh uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahizong Pathian in Jew lampuite mitsuan nginge a, Persia uliante in kumpilianpa Darius tungah laithak in a zo kik mateng bangma law ngawl tu in khensat uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in hi bangin kumpilianpa tungah thu zasak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"“Darius kumpilianpa awng, thinnopna taw ngam uk thei ta in."},"8":{"text":"“Nangma Kumpipa awng, kote Judah ngam sungah ka pai uh a, a lian Pathian ii Biakinnpi sia suangtum lian mamate taw kisa in, a pang zongh thing pangluaite a kithung in ka mu uh a, tua thu he lete kong oai uh hi. A nasep belcing mama a, ngaih vahuut uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuasia ciang akua ii thu taw hi Biakinnpi kisa kik a, a vanhte kinguan ziam, hong son natu in a lampuite ka dongh uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Hi nasep a lampuite akua teng ziam kong son thei natu in amate min zongh ka dongh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Amate in, ‘Kote vantung le leitung Pathian ii naseamte hi in, a vaanglian Israel kumpipa khat ii kum tam mama lai in a sak phit le vanh a kinguan Biakinnpi sia a sa kik ka hi uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahizong ka taanghpupite in vantung Pathian thin uuksak ahiciang, Chaldean kumpi ngui sung pan Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in amate zosak hi. Biakinnpi sia kisia sakin tua mipite Babylon ah sal in kila hi.","ref":"2 Kum 25:8-12; 2 Khang 36:17-20; Jer 52:12-15"},"13":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Cyrus kumpilianpa in Babylon kumpilianpa ahi zawk a kum khat kumin Biakinnpi a kisak kik natu thupia hi.","ref":"Ezra 1:2-11"},"14":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar ii Jerusalem Biakinnpi pan a laak Babylon biakinn ah a koi biakinn a zak khamh le ngunn, Biakinn vanh zakte puuapha kik hi. Cyrus in tua teng Judah ngamukmang tu in a koi Sheshbazzar tungah pia hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua kumpilianpa in tua vanhte la a, Jerusalem Biakinnpi ah koi kikin nidang a sakna ngei mun ma ah Biakinnpi a sakkik natu in ama sawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Sheshbazzar hong pai in a tawdap phaasak hi; tua hun pan kipan tu dong Biakinnpi kisa zom a, ahizong kiman ngawl lai hi,’ ci in zo hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tu in, Nang Vaanglianpa, na lung a kim le Babylon kumpi thu tepteenate sungah Cyrus in hi Jerusalem Biakinnpi sakkik natu in thu a piak le a piak ngawl kansak in a, hi thu taw kisai nangma deina bang hong zasak ta'n,” ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang Darius kumpilianpa in Babylon khua ah a kikeam kumpite thu tepteena laibu sungah tua thute kan tu in thupia hi.","title":"Cyrus Kumpilianpa ii Thupiakna Kimu kik"},"2":{"text":"Ahizong Media ngamsung Ecbatana khua sungah a nuai a bang thu tepteena a om laizial khat kimu hi:"},"3":{"text":"“Ama ii kumpi maan zawk a kum khat kum in Cyrus kumpilianpa in sangaw biakpiakna le meihal biakpiakna mun tu in Jerusalem Biakinnpi a kisak kik natu thupia hi. Biakinnpi sia metre 27 saangin metre 27 zai tu hi."},"4":{"text":"A pangte suangtum dawl thum a cian simin thing dawl khat taw kisa tu hi. A sum bo theampo kumpi sum sung pan kipia tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar kumpipa ii Jerusalem Biakinnpi pan Babylon ah a paipui khamh le ngunn, vanh zakte zongh Jerusalem Biakinnpi sung a omna ngei tek ah kikoi kik tu hi,” ci in a kitepteena mu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Darius in a nuai a bangin zasak kik hi: “Euphrates nitumna ngamuk mangpa Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai le Euphrates nitumna ngam ah a om a nasep pui uliante awng, “Biakinnpi pan kiheam vun a,","title":"Darius in Nasep A Zop natu Thupia"},"7":{"text":"Biakinn sakna nawngkaisak heak vun. Judah ngamukmangpa le Jew lampuite in Pathian Biakinnpi sia a om na ngei ma ah sa kiksak vun."},"8":{"text":"Amate ii a sak kikna na hu natu uh in hi lai sungah thu kong pia hi. Hi nasep a kisuangsamh ngawl natu in Euphrates nitumna sang pan phiangshia a kinga kumpi sum sung pan a bona teng theampo manlang takin kipiaksak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Jerusalem ah a om thiampite ii ni simin kisamh hi hong ci pawpo peal ngawlin pia tu nu hi: vantung Pathian tungah meihal biakpiak natu in khuitalnote, tuute ahibuale tuunote ahibuale zungtaang, ci, sapittui ahibuale olive thau ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Vantung Pathian ii a saan thei tu in sangaw biakpiakna a piak thei natu le keima le ka tapate atu in thupha nong nget thei natu in hisia sep tu ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua banah hi thupiakna a zui ngawl a om le a inn zawlliang khat kidawkeaksak tu a, a mong khat kizumin tuaciang ama pumpi kisunlet tu hi. A inn sia ninthuk kisua tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama a kibiak natu mun Jerusalem khuapi a teal Pathian in hi thupiakna nial a, tua Biakinnpi a lalsak nuam kumpi ahibuale minam peuma susia tahen. Keima Darius in hi thu kong pia zo hi. Ka thupiak sia na zui siat tu uh ahi hi.”"},"13":{"text":"Tuasia ciang ngamukmang Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai le a naseppui uliante in kumpilianpa thupiak bang linlian in vawt siat uh hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Ki aap"},"14":{"text":"Jew lampuite in kamsaang Haggai le Zechariah te ii hanthotna taw a Biakinnpi sak ngai tawto uh hi. Amate in Biakinnpi sia Israel te ii Pathian le Persia kumpiliante ahi Cyrus, Darius le Artaxerxes te ii thupiak bangin zo thiang uh hi.","ref":"Hag 1:1; Zec 1:1"},"15":{"text":"Amate in Darius ii kumpilian a sep zawk a kum luk kum Adar tha, ni thum ni in Biakinnpi zo uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Israel mite — thiampite, Levi te le saltanna pan a cia kik midang theampote in lungdam takin Biakinnpi aap uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Biakinnpi aapna in amate in khuital 100, tuu 200, le tuuno 400 te sangaw biakpiakna in pia a, Israel nam sim atu mawphel biakpiakna in keal khat tek, keal 12 pia uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in Moses laibu sungah kihilna om bangin Jerusalem biakinn naseam tu in thiampite le Levi te zongh kaikhawm uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Saltanna pan hong cia kik mite in a kum kik, a tha masa, ni sawm le ni li ni in Paisan Poai khaam uh hi.","title":"Paisan Poai","ref":"Pu 12:1-20"},"20":{"text":"Thiampite le Levi te theampo in amate le amate kithiansua in a zeksa om bangin thiangtho uh hi. Levi te in hong cia kik mite theampo atu le thiampite le amate mama atu in Paisan Poai sangaw biakpiakna in ngannote ngo uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua biakpiakna sate saltanna pan hong cia kik Israel te theampo le tua ngam ah a teang doai biate ii biakna nusia a Israel ii Topa Pathian bia tu in hong paite in ne uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ni sali sung lungdam takin Tol saw ngawl Anluum Poai khaam uh hi. Israel te ii Pathian ii Biakinnpi a sakkikna ah a hu natu Topa in Assyria kumpilianpa sia Jew te ngup nopna thin neisak ahikom amate lungdamna taw kidim hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum tam mama a ngei zawk, Artaxerxes sia Persia kumpilianpa a sua ciang Ezra kici mihing khat om hi. Ama in a taanghpupite Thiampi Lianbel Aaron dong a kat kik ciang a nuai a bang hi: Ezra sia Seriah ii tapa, Seriah sia Azariah ii tapa, Azariah sia Hilkiah ii tapa,","title":"Jerusalem ah Ezra Theng"},"2":{"text":"Hilkiah sia Shallum ii tapa, Shallum sia Zadok ii tapa, Zadok sia Ahitub ii tapa,"},"3":{"text":"Ahitub sia Amariah ii tapa, Amariah sia Azariah ii tapa, Azariah sia Meraioth ii tapa,"},"4":{"text":"Meraioth sia Zerahiah ii tapa, Zerahiah sia Uzzi ii tapa, Uzzi sia Bukki ii tapa,"},"5":{"text":"Bukki sia Abishua ii tapa, Abishua sia Phinehas ii tapa, Phinehas sia Eleazar ii tapa, Eleazar sia Aaron ii tapa ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ezra sia lai thiam mipil khat hi a, Topa, Israel te ii Pathian ii Moses tungah a piak Thukham teng he sitset hi. Ezra in Topa a Pathian thupha nga ahikom, a nget theampo kumpilianpa in pia hi. Artaxerxes ii kumpi maan hun a kum sali kumin Ezra sia thiampite, Levi te, biakinn music thiamte, biakinn cingte le naseamte a kihel Israel te honkhat taw Babylon pan Jerusalem zuan hi.","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Amate in a tha masabel tha, a ni khat ni in Babylon nusia in, Pathian ii huna taw in a tha nga tha, ni khat ni in Jerusalem theng uh hi.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Ezra in a nuntakna sia Topa Thukham sinna, a sinsate zuina, le Israel mite tungah thukham le ngeina theampo hilna in zangh hi."},"11":{"text":"Artaxerxes in a nuai a lai sia Topa ii Israel tungah a piak thukhamte le thupiakte a he sitset, thiampi le lai thiam mipil, Ezra tungah pia hi:","title":"Artaxerxes ii Ezra tungah A lai piakna"},"12":{"text":"“Kumpilianpa Artaxerxes tung pan Vantung Pathian Thukham a he mipil thiampi Ezra tungah:"},"13":{"text":"“Ka kumpi ukna ngamsung theampo ah a om Israel mite theampo, thiampite le Levi te Jerusalem ah a cia nuam peuma nangma taw a pai thei natu in thu ka pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima le ka thudok salite in nangma muangin hong ki aap, na Pathian Thukham teng Judah le Jerusalem ah bangza ciang pha takin kizui ci thu kan tu in kong sawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Israel te ii Pathian, Jerusalem Biakinnpi a nei pa tungah keima le ka thudokte ii ka piak nop uh khamh le ngunn biakpiakna teng na keng tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel mite le a thiampite ii Jerusalem Pathian Biakinnpi atu in a piak piakkhiatnate le noma ii Babylon ngamsung pan na kaikhop uh ngunn le khamh theampo zongh paipui tu ni hi."},"17":{"text":"“Hi dangka teng khuital, tuutal, tuuno, antang le sapittui leina in pha takpi na zangh tu a, tua vanhte Jerusalem Biakinnpi biaknatau tungah na pia tu hi."},"18":{"text":"A taanglai ngunn le khamhte na Pathian ii deina taw kizui in nangma le na ngamsung mite deina po ah zangh thei tu ni hi."},"19":{"text":"Biakinn sung nasepna ah zak tu in nangma hong kipia vanhzakte theampo Jerusalem khua Pathian tungah pia tu ni hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaciang Biakinnpi atu in na kisap dangte sia kumpi sum le vanh manpha sung panin nga thei tu ni hi."},"21":{"text":"“Keima in thiampi le Vantung Pathian ii Thukham a he, mipil Ezra ii hong nget theampo thakhat thu piak tu in Euphrates Nitumna Ngam sungah a om sum lamsang a len uliante theampo thu ka pia hi,"},"22":{"text":"piak tu a kiciangtan za sia, ngunn kilogramme 3,400, zungtaang kilogramme 10,000, sapittui litre 2,000, olive thau litre 2,000, le ci al a kisamh zaza hi tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Vantung Pathian in a Biakinnpi atu in a tulmawk theampo pha takin pia nanak tu nu hi; tuasia in keima tung le kei zawkciang ngamukte tungah a thin a uuk ngei nawn ngawl natu ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Nangma in thiampite, Levi te, music thiamte, a cingte, naseamte ahibuale Biakinnpi taw a kizom midang khat pawpo tung pan shia na khon thei buatu hi."},"25":{"text":"“Nangma Ezra in na Pathian hong piaksa ciimna zanghin, na Pathian Thukham bangin a nungta Euphrates Nitumna sang mite theampo a uk tu ngamukte le Thukhente panmun na pia tu hi. A he ngawl laite theampo tungah tua Thukham na hil hamtang tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in na Pathian thukhamte, ahibuale kumpi ngamsung upadi te a zui buale ama sia thidaan ahizong, hawlkhiatna taw ahibuale a na theampo laaksakna ahibuale, thongtaaksakna taw thakhat thu in daan kipia tu hi,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ezra in, “Ih taanghpupite ii Pathian, Topa pok vun! Ama in kumpilianpa sia Topa ii Jerusalem Biakinnpi, hi bangin patoai nopna thin neisak hi.","title":"Ezra in Pathian Pok"},"28":{"text":"Pathian ii thuthiamna taw kumpilianpa, a thudokte le a thahat ulian theampote ii maipha ka nga zo hi; Topa ka Pathian in thinletna hong pia zo a, keima taw cia khawm tu in Israel bee le phung lampui tam mama ka zol thei hi,” ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hiteng sia Artaxerxes ii kumpilian a sep ciangin Babylon saltanna pan Jerusalem ah Ezra taw a ciakik bee le phung lutangte hi:","title":"Saltanna pan A Ciakik Mite"},"2":{"text":"Phinehas bee le phung pan Gershom Ithamar bee le phung pan Daniel David bee le phung pan Shecaniah ii tapa Hattush, Parosh bee le phung pan Zechariah le a bee a phung pan pasal 150 (a pianna innkuan tepteena lai om hi) Pahath Moab bee le phung pan Zerahiah ii tapa Eliehoenai taw pasal 200 Zattu bee le phung pan Jahaziel ii tapa Shecaniah taw pasal 300 Adin bee le phung pan Jonathan ii tapa Ebed taw pasal 50 Elam bee le phung pan Athaliah ii tapa Jeshaiah taw pasal 70 Shephatiah bee le phung pan Michael ii tapa Zebadiah taw pasal 80 Joab bee le phung pan Jehiel ii tapa Obadiah taw pasal 218 Bani bee le phung pan Josiphiah ii tapa Shelomith taw pasal 160 Bebai bee le phung pan Bebai ii tapa Zechariah taw pasal 28 Azgad bee le phung pan Hakkatan ii tapa Johanan taw pasal 110 Adonikam bee le phung pan Eliphelet, Jeuel le Shemaiah taw pasal 60 (A khak sang a ciate hi) Bigvai bee le phung pan Uthai le Zaccur taw pasal 70","merge":"3"},"15":{"text":"Ahava a kitotawm Tuiluam hui ah mihon bup ka kaikhawm a, tua munah ni thum sung ngiaphual ka saat uh hi. Tua mihon sungah thiampite om a, ahizong Levi te ka mu bua hi.","title":"Biakinn naseam tu in Ezra in Levi te Zong"},"16":{"text":"Tuaciang lampui kuate: Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah le Meshullam le sya niite ahi Joiarib le Elnathan te ka sam hi."},"17":{"text":"Casiphia khua taangpi lutang ahi Iddo kungah amate ka paisak a, ama le a pawlte, biakinn naseamte in Biakinnpi sungah Pathian naseam tu mihing hong puak natu ka ngensak hi."},"18":{"text":"Pathian ii thuthiamna tungtawnin amate in Mahli bee le phung sung pan Levi te a pilvang Sherebiah hong puak a, a tapate le a suapuipate sawm le liat taw hong pai uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in Merari bee le phung sung pan Hashabiah le Jeshaiah te zongh a mealheakte kul taw hong puak hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua banah Levi te a hu tu in David kumpipa le a uliante ii a taanghpupite pan nasep a piaksa biakinn naseam 220 om hi. Amate min teng zongh kikhum siat hi."},"21":{"text":"A kitotawm Ahava Tuiluam hui ah ka vekpi uh in antang in kote ii Pathian mai ah kiniamkhiak a, ka khualhawna uh ah hong lampui in, koma, ka tate uh le ka neisa theampo taw hong kep natu ama tungah hesuak ngen tu in ka sawl hi.","title":"Ezra in Mipite An tangin Thungetna ah Lampui"},"22":{"text":"Ih khualhaw sungin ngalte khut sung pan hong keam tu in kumpilianpa tungah ngalkapte ka nget tu sia maizum naap khi hi, banghang ziam cile ama munah koma Pathian in ama a muang pawpo thupha pia a, ahizong ama a nungngat pawpo tungah lungkim ngawlin daan a piakna thu ka son zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua bangin kote in Pathian hong dal natu an tangin thu ka ngen uh a, kote ii thungetnate ama in hong zo hi."},"24":{"text":"Thiampi lampuite sung panin Sherebiah, Hashabiah le a dang sawm ka teal hi.","title":"Biakinnpi atu Letsongte"},"25":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kumpilianpa, ama ngaisutna a piate le, uliante, tuaciang Israel mite ii Biakinnpi sungah zak tu in a piak ngunn, khamh le vanhzakte toai ka tee a, tua teng thiampite tungah ka pia hi."},"26":{"text":"Hi teng sia amate ka piakte hi: Ngunn - tann 22 Ngunn vanh zakte 100 - kilogramme 70 Khamh - kilogramme 3,400 Khamh khawbeam 20 - kilogramme 8.4 Taau ciitak kuangte 2, kham khawbeam taw a man kibang hi.","merge":"27"},"28":{"text":"Keima in amate tungah, “Note in na taanghpupite ii Pathian, Topa tungah biakna taw kisai na thiangtho uh bangma in ama kungah thinzaw biakpiakna in na paipui ngunn le khamh vanhzakte zongh thiangtho hi."},"29":{"text":"Biakinnpi na thet uh dong tua teng pha takin keamcing tavun. Tua teng thiampite inndoi ah toaitee in Jerusalem ah a om thiampi lampuite, Levi lampuite le Israel te lampuite tungah aap vun,” ka ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahiciang thiampite le Levi te in ngunn, khamh le vanh zakte Jerusalem Biakinnpi ah paipui tu in vaipuak la uh hi."},"31":{"text":"A tha khat tha, ni sawm le ni nii ni in Jerusalem zuan tu in Ahava a kitotawm Tuiluam ka nusia uh hi. Khualhawna ah kote ii Pathian in hong ompui a, ngalte hong simna le hong suam natu panin hong dal hi.","title":"Jerusalem ah Cia kik"},"32":{"text":"Jerusalem ka thet uh ciang, ni thum sung ka tawlnga uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua zawk ni li ni in Biakinnpi ah pai in tua ngunn, khamh le vanh zakte toai ka tee zawkciang in Uriah ii tapa thiampi Meremoth tungah ka aap uh hi. Ama taw in Phinehas ii tapa Eleazar le Levi te nii ahi, Jeshua ii tapa Jozabad le Binnui ii tapa Noadiah zong om uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Na theampo kisimin toai kitee a, tepteena cing takin kivawt paih hi."},"35":{"text":"Saltanna pan hong cia kikte theampo in Israel te ii Pathian tungah sangaw biakpiakna a hal tu in biakpiaknate hong paipui uh hi. Amate in Israel mite theampo atu in khuital 12, tuutal 96, le tuuno 77 pia in mawna pan amate le amate a kithiansua natu in keal 12 zongh pia uh hi. Hi ngannote theampo Topa tungah sangaw biakpiakna in hal uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Amate in kumpilianpa ii a piak lai sia zongh kengin Euphrates nitumna ngamukmangte le uliante tungah pia a, tuate in mipite le biakinn sung biakpiakna ah huna pia hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi teng a kisep zawkciang Israel mite lampui pawlkhat hong pai in, mipite, thiampite le Levi te sia a innpaamte ahi Ammon, Moab le Egypt ngammite sung pan ahizong, Canaan te, Hit te, Periz te, Jebus te le Amor te sung pan ahizong a tuamin a om ngawlna thu ka tungah hong son uh hi. Amate in hi mite ii a vawt a kiihuai nate ma vawt uh hi.","title":"Jew ahi ngawlte taw Kiteenthaangna Ezra in He"},"2":{"text":"Jew pate in ngamdang numeite teenpui ahikom Pathian ii mi thiangthote mi thiangtho ngawl suaksak uh hi. A khial belte sia lampuite le uliante veu ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi thu ka zaak ciang thinkiam in ka puan ka eaukeak a, ka sam le ka khamul bot in khuangai in ka to cip hi."},"4":{"text":"Khuangai in tualai ah nitak sangaw biakpiak hun dong ka to a, ka kiim ah mipite — a vekpi ka kungah hong kikhawm uh hi, tuate sia saltanna pan a cia kikte ii mawna khialna thu Israel te ii Pathian ii a son hu in a laute ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Nitak sangaw biakpiak hun hong thet ciang khuangai in ka omna mun pan thoto in ka puan ek sil lai teng ma taw khupdin in ka khutte laamin Topa ka Pathian tungah thu ka ngen hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in, “Pathian awng, na mai ah vandak in ka om tu ka maizum lei hi. Ka mawna uh sia ka lu sang in a saang zawin kiciang a; vantungte a dong tu za in saang hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka taanghpupite hun pan tu hun dongin koma, na mite nasia takin maw zo khu hi. Kote mawna hangin koma, ka kumpite le ka thiampite sia ngamdang kumpite khutnuai theng in, hong kisuamin, hong kisuttol a, thongtaak tu in hong kipaipui hi. Tuni ciang dongin maimawl minsiatna ka thuak dikdek lai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu in hun tomno sung teng kote Pathian, Topa awng, ko tungah nong thuthiam a, mi pawlkhat sila pan nong suatak a, hi mun thiangthona ah thin muang takin nong teangsak hi. Saltanna pan nong suaktasak a, nuntakna thak nong pia hi."},"9":{"text":"Kote sila ka hi uh hang saltaangin nong nusia bua hi. Persia kumpiliante in nong ngumsak a, hi lai Judah le Jerusalem ah ngammuanna ka nei thei natu uh le a lalsa na Biakinnpi sa kik tu in nong nungtasak hi."},"10":{"text":"“Ahizong tu in Pathian awng, tuabang teng a sua zawkciang bang son thei nawn tu khu ziam?"},"11":{"text":"Kamsaang na naseamte tungtawn a nong thupiakte ka zui bua leleau uh hi. Amate in ka laak tu uh ngam sia thiangtho ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile tualai ah a teang mite in tua ngam mong khat pan mong khat a kiihuai, a thasiathuai ngamtatnate taw kidimsak hi hong ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate hong cina pan, tua ngam sungah nuamsa in na suan na paalte in a tawntung na luasak nuam uh le tua mite taw na kiteangthaang ngei buatu uh a, a khanto natu le a matut natu in hu ngeingawl tu nu hi, hong ci hi.","ref":"Pu 34:11-16; Thkna 7:1-5"},"13":{"text":"Ka mawnate le ka khialnate hangin hiza daan ka thuak zawk uh ciang zong in nangma, kote Pathian in kote thuak tu a kilawm za sangin a tawm zaw nong thuaksak a, nong nuntaksak lai sia he khu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahiciang nong thupiakte thu sim ngawl kikin hi mihing seksolte taw kiteang kik thei tu khu ziam? Tuabang ka ngamta uh le na thin uuk mama in khat zongh hong hing khoai ngawlin nong mon siat tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Israel ii Topa Pathian awng, nang thutang ni hi, ahihang kote nong nungtasak hi. Ka mawnate na tungah kong pualaak uh hi; na mai ah kong pai natu thu a om bua hi,” ka ci hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biakinnpi mai ah Ezra kapin hi mawna khialnate pualaakin kunin a thunget laitak a kiim ah Israel te — pasalte, nupite le patangte — kikhawm a, nasia takin kap uh hi.","title":"Ngamdangte taw Kiteenthaangna Bosak natu Ngealna"},"2":{"text":"Tuaciang Elam bee le phung sung pan Jehiel ii tapa Shecaniah in Ezra tungah, “Ngamdang numeite teenpuina hangin Pathian taw ciampeal khu hi, ahitazong Israel atu in lam et om lai hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu in hi numeite le a tate puak kik natu in ih Pathian tungah a ciliap huai kamciamna khat vawt hamtang tu khu hi. Kote in nangma le Pathian thupiak a zakta dangte ii vawt tu hong ci bangin ka vawt tu uh hi. Pathian Thukham ii ci bangin ka vawt tu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuasia in sep tu na vaipuak ahi hi. Kote na nungah om khu hi, tua hi a pai in a, seam suak vet in,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Ezra in Shecaniah ii a ci bangin thiampi lampuite, Levi lampuite le a taanglai mihon lampuite sep tu in kiciamsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama sia Biakinnpi mai pan pai in Eliashib ii tapa Jehohanan inn sungah tumin zan taam hi, tua munah saltaangte thumaan ngawlnate hangin khuangai in om hi. Ama in bang mama ne ngawl dawn ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Saltanna pan a cia kik theampo Jerusalem khua ah a kikhop natu thu Jerusalem le Judah ngam mun theampo ah"},"8":{"text":"mipi lampuite ii thupiak bangin kizasak hi. Ni thum sungin a pai ngawl a om le, a neisa theampo kimatsak tu a, taangpite sungah pawlmi suak thei nawn ngawl tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni thum sung, a tha kuana, ni kul ni in Judah le Benjamin ngam sungah a teang pasal theampo, Jerusalem khua ah pai in biakinn leitual ah kikhawm uh hi. Tua hun sung ngua tam mama zu ahikom khua hun phat ngawl hang le kikhopna a thupina hangin mipi theampo ling vakil uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Thiampi Ezra dingto in amate tungah, “Note in upna na nei bua uh a, ngamdang zi na nei uh manin, Israel tungah khialna na tungsak uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahiciang tu in na taanghpupite ii Pathian, Topa tungah na mawnate pualaak vun a, ama diksak bangin ngamta vun. Ih ngam sungah a teang ngamdangmite kung pan a tuamin om vun a, na ngamdang zite taw kikhen vun,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Mipite au in, “Na ci babangin vawt tu khu hi,” ci in zo uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahizong amate in, “Mihonpi tam leih a, ngua zongh tam mama hi. Hi bangin sepna taw Pathian ii thin uukna sia thai thei tu hi,” ci thua uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Hi ngealna sia Asahel ii tapa Jonathan le Tikvah ii tapa Jahzeiah te sim ngawlin nial ngawl a, amate sia Melshullam le Levi mi Shabbethai te in panpui uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Saltanna pan a cia kikte in tua ngealna sia thukim ahikom thiampi Ezra in bee le phung lutang teng tung pan pasal upate panmun pia in, a min teng khum hi. Amate in a tha sawmna, ni khat ni in a thu kat kipan in,"},"17":{"text":"tua zawk tha thum sungin amate in ngamdang zi neite taw kisai thu theampo kan siat uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Hi sia in ngamdang Amate in Jerusalem luphungte a cimhtham in om lai a, kongpite a kihaltum pan kipan a kivawt kik ngawl laina thute zongh hong son uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Hi thu teng ka zaak ciang to suk in ka kap hi. Ni tam mama khuangai in ka mau a an ka ne bua hi. Pathian tungah thu ka ngen a,"},"5":{"text":"“Vantung ah a mang Topa Pathian awng! Nang na lian a, nangma kiita in ka om uh hi. Nangma hong itte le na thupiak a zuite tungah na thuciamna thumaan takin na len hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa awng, hong en ta'n a, Israel mi na naseamte atu a sun a zanin ka thungetna hong ngai ta'n. Koma Israel mite mawna khialna teng hong pualaak khi hi. Ka taanghpupite le keima ka maw zo uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Seksol ngamtatna taw nang kong langpan zo uh a, nong thupiakte ka zui bua uh hi. Na naseampa Moses tungtawnin nong piak thukhamte ka zui bua uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Nangma ii Moses tungah: ‘No Israel mite ka tungah nong thumaan bua uh le minam dangte sungah kong thethaang tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 26:33"},"9":{"text":"Ahizong ka kungah hong zuan kikin kong thupiakte na zui uh le, leimong dongin kithethaang zo na hi uh hangin keima nong biak natu in ka tealsa munah kong paipui kik tu hi,’ na ci thute tu in phawk kik ta'n.","ref":"Thkna 30:1-5"},"10":{"text":"“ Topa awng, hite in nangma mi, na naseamte ahi uh hi. Na vaangletna le na thahatna taw amate na suatak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu in ka thungetna le nangma hong patoai nuam na naseam dangte theampo ii thungetnate hong ngai ta'n. Tuni in taangtutna hong pia ta'n a, kumpilianpa in hong hesuaksak ta'n.” Tua hun lai in keima in kumpilianpa sapittui a pia pa ka hi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tha li zawk ni khat ni in Artaxerxes kumpilianpa ii an a neak laitakin sapittui ka pia hi. Ama in nidang in ka hee maipuak hong mu ngeingawl ahiciang,","title":"Jerusalem ah Nehemiah Pai"},"2":{"text":"ama in, “Banghangin hee tuak mama ni ziam? Na ci le na ngawl ahiciang na thin nop ngawlna om hi tu hi,” ci in hong dongh hi. Ka patau a,"},"3":{"text":"“Kumpipa awng, na khansau tahen! Ka taanghpupite a kiphumna khuapi laltham a, a kongpite kaanghtum siatin a om laitak bangbangin khuangai ngawlin om thei tu khi ziam?,” ci in ka zo hi.","ref":"2 Kum 25:8-10; 2 Khang 36:19; Jer 52:12-14"},"4":{"text":"Kumpilianpa in, “Na dei sia bang ziam?” ci in hong dongh hi. Vantung Pathian tungah thu ka nget zawkciang,"},"5":{"text":"kumpilianpa tungah, “Kumpipa awng kei tungah nong lungkim a, kong ngetna nong pia nuam le ka taanghpupite kiphumna khuapi ka pua kik thei natu in Judah ngam ah hong paisak ta'n,” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpilianpa in kumpiliannu taw tokhawm a, ka ngetna hong saang hi. Ama in bang tanvei ngei tu a, bang hun ciang hong heak kik tu ni ziam ci in hong dongh a, ka son hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, nong hesuak zo le Judah ngam dong hong paisak thei natu in Euphrates Nitumna sang ngamukmangte tungah lai hong thaaksak ta'n, ci in ka ngen hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpi thingtaamte a keam pa Asaph tungah Biakinnpi cinna kulh kongpite, khuapi luphungte le ka teen natu ka innthingte atu in thing hong piak natu zongh lai hong thaaksak natu ka ngen hi. Pathian in kei hong ompui ahikom ka nget theampo kumpilianpa in hong pia hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumpilianpa in keima taw ngalkapbu pawlkhat le siphu ngalkap pawlkhat hong paisak a, Euphrates Nitumna ngam ah khual ka haw uh hi. Keima tona laa sia ngawl buang nganhing dang ka keng bua uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Zan lai ma in khuapi nusia in nitumna sang Kuam Kongpi tawnin thangsang Ngulpui Tuinaak kaantan in Ninthuk Kongpi ah ka pai hi. Ka pai kawmin khuapi luphung cimhthamte le mei ii kak kongpite ka en kawkoai hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang khuapi nisuana sang pan saksang Tuinaak Kongpi le Kumpipa Tuili ah ka pai hi. Tuaciang ka paina lampi tawnin ka heak kik a, Kuam Kongpi kaantan in khuapi sungah ka tum kik hi."},"16":{"text":"Tualsung uliante khat zongh in ka omna mun ahibuale ka nasepte he ngawl hi. A taanghpupite sungah Mattaniah le Mica kihel a, ama sia biakinn biak kikhopna ah music vaipuak a nei Asaph bee le phung pan hi."},"23":{"text":"Bee le phung tuatuamte kilaih in ni simin biakinn music lampuina ah a sep zia taw kisai in a zui tu kumpi ngeinate om hi."},"24":{"text":"Judah nam, Zerah bee le phung. Meshezabel ii tapa Pethahiah in Persia te ii thukhenzum ah Israel mite taang in ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Mihing tam mama sia a lo thawna paam khuate ah teang uh hi. Judah namte sia Kiriath Arba, Dibon le Jekabzeel le hi khuapite ii nai khuanote ah teang uh hi.","title":"A dang Khuate le Khuapite ah A teang Mite"},"26":{"text":"Amate Jeshua, Moladah, Bethpelet,"},"27":{"text":"le Hazarshual khuapi te tuaciang Beersheba khuapi le a kiim a om khuanote zongh ah teang uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate sia Ziklag khuapi, Meconah le a khuanote sungah,"},"29":{"text":"Enrimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth,"},"30":{"text":"Zanoah, Adullam khua te sung le hi khua te ii a kiim a paam khuanote ah teang uh hi. Amate Lachish le a naina lote sungah le Azekah khua le a khuanote ah teang uh hi. Judah mite teenna ngam sia thangsang ah Beersheba le saksangah Hinnom Kuam kilaklaw teng kici thei hi."},"31":{"text":"Benjamin nam pan mite Geba, Michmash, Ai, Bethel le a nai na khuano te,"},"32":{"text":"Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,"},"33":{"text":"Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,"},"34":{"text":"Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,"},"35":{"text":"Lod le Ono le Khutthiamte Kual sungah teang uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Judah ngamsung a teang Levi mi pawlkhatte sia Benjamin mite taw teang khawmsak hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Shealtiel ii tapa Zerubbabel le Thiampi Lianbel Joshua taw saltanna pan a cia kik, thiampite le Levi te min tepteena a nuai a bang ahi hi:","title":"Thiampite le Levi te Min Tepteena"},"2":{"text":"Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra, Amariah, Malluch, Hattush, Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth, Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah, Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah, Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah, Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah le Jedaiah ahi uh hi. Hite sia Joshua hunlai in a thiampipuite theampo sungah lampuite ahi hi.","merge":"3","title":"Thiampite:"},"8":{"text":"A nuai a teng sia lungdamko biakna lasakna ah lampuite veu hi: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah le Mattaniah.","title":"Levi te:"},"9":{"text":"A kizo choir lasate a nuai a bang hi: Bakbukiah, Unno le a Levi puite."},"10":{"text":"Joshua sia Joiakim ii pa hi a; Joiakim sia Eliashib ii pa hi; Eliashib sia Joiada ii pa hi;","title":"Thiampi Lianbel Joshua ii Suan le paalte"},"11":{"text":"Joiada sia Jonathan ii pa hi a; Jonathan sia Jaddua ii pa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Joiakim ii Thiampi Lianbel a sep lai in thiampi bee lutangte sia a nuai a thiampite veu hi:","title":"Thiampi Bee le phungte ii Lutangte","merge":"13"},"22":{"text":"Thiampi Lianbel te: Eliashib, Joiada, Jonathan le Jaddua te nuntak hun sungin Levi innkuan lutangte le thiampi innkuan lutangte tepteena khat kikoi hi. Hi tepteena sia Darius ii Persia kumpilianpa a sep lai in kizo siat hi.","title":"Thiampi le Levi Innkuante Tepteena"},"23":{"text":"Levi innkuan lutangte tepteena lai ahile Eliashib ii tupa Jonathan hun dong bekma zumlai tepteena sungah kikhum hi."},"24":{"text":"Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua, Binnui le Kadmiel te sawlna taw Levi te a pawl a pawl veu sua hi. Pathian mi David kumpipa thupiakna taw kizui in, pawl nii veu in kilaih in Pathian pok a, lungdamko uh hi.","title":"Biakinnpi sung Nasep Hawmna"},"25":{"text":"Biakinnpi kongpite hui ah vanh kholna inndoi a cingte a uk biakinn cingte sia a nuai a teng hi: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon le Akkub."},"26":{"text":"Hi mite sia Joshua ii tapa, Jehozadak ii tupa ahi Joiakim hun, le ngamukmang Nehemiah le Thukham a he, thiampi mipil Ezra te hun lai in a omte veu hi."},"27":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi luphung a ki aap ciang, daakbute le tengtonghte tumin lungdamkona late taw a ki aapna poai ah a kihel thei natu in Levi te sia a teenna tek pan kikaikhawm hi.","title":"Nehemiah in Khuapi Luphung Aap"},"28":{"text":"Levi innkuan la sate sia Jerusalem khua kiim a teenna tek pan le Netophah kiim khuate pan,"},"29":{"text":"tuaciang Bethgilgal, Geba le Azmaveth panin kikhawmtua uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Thiampite le Levi te in amate, mipite, kongpite le khuapi luphung atu in a zeksa thiansuana seam hi."},"31":{"text":"Luphung tungah Judah lampuite ka khawmtua a, Pathian tungah lungdamko in, khuapi a kiimkot tu pawl lian niite ka uksak hi. A masa pawl sia luphung tung ziatsang Ninthuk Kongpi sang manaw in pai uh hi."},"32":{"text":"La sate nung pan Hoshaiah pai a, Judah lampuite a lang in zui uh hi."},"33":{"text":"A zom kik a nuai a thiampi teng in lemle tumin pai uh hi: Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam, Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah le Jeremiah. Tua zawkciang Jonathan ii tapa Shemaiah ii tupa ahi, Zechariah in zui hi. (A taanghpupite sungah Asaph bee le phungte ahi Mattaniah, Micaiah le Zaccur te zongh kihel hi.)","merge":"34"},"36":{"text":"Zechariah sia a bee le phung sung pan a dangte — Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah le Hanani — a vekpi in Pathian mi David kumpipa ii a tum thei music vanh namte keng uh hi. Hi pawl sia a pai ciang laithiam mipil Ezra in lampui hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuinaak Kongpi pan David Khuapi sangah kaato in, David kumpi inn kaantan a, khuapi nisuana sang Tui Kongpi luphung ah heak kik uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Lungdam a ko pawldang khat sia luphung tung a veisang tawnin pai a, keima le mipite a lang in ka zui uh hi. Meikhukte Tausaang kaantan in Luphung Zai sia ah pai in,"},"39":{"text":"tua mun pan Ephraim Kongpi, Jeshanah Kongpi, Ngasa Kongpi, Hananel Tausaang le Zakhat Tausaang te kaantan in Tuu Kongpi ah ka pai uh a, Biakinnpi kongpi hui ah ka tawp uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuabangin Pathian tung lungdam a ko tua pawl niite biakinn suumsung theng uh hi. Keima taw a omkhawm lampuite ban ah"},"41":{"text":"ka pawl sungah lemle tum a nuai a thiampite: Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah le Hananiah te kihel a;"},"42":{"text":"tuaciang amate nung pan Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam le Ezer te in zui uh hi. Jezrahiah ii lampui lasate in a aw neiza taw lasa uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ni in sangaw biakpiakna tam mama kipia a, mipite lungdamna taw kidim uh hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian in amate lungdamsak mama hi. Numeite le patangte tua poai ah kihel in, amate ii awngingte a khualana pan kiza kawkoai thei hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua hunlai in sawm a khat sumpite, kum sim anpalte le a minciil thingngate a kihel Biakinnpi atu a kipiate kikepna vanh kholna inndoite a uk tu in pasalte kikoi hi. Hi mite in Thukham sungah a om bangin khuapi tuatuam naina ah a om lote pan thiampite le Levi te atu a kipiate, kaikhop tu vaipuak nei uh hi. Judah mi theampo thiampite le Levi te tungah lungkim uh hi,","title":"Biakinnpi ah Biak natu A piakna"},"45":{"text":"banghang ziam cile amate in Pathian thupiakna bangin kithiansuana poaite le a zeksa dangte vawtsak hi. David kumpipa le a tapa Solomon ii zui tu ngeina a piakte bangin biakinn music thiamte le biakinn cingte zongh in pha takin a sep tute seam uh hi.","ref":"1 Khang 25:1-8; 1 Khang 26:12"},"46":{"text":"Nidang lai, David kumpipa le music thiam Asaph hun pan kipan lasate in Pathian pokna late le lungdamkona lasaknate lampui uh hi."},"47":{"text":"Zerubbabel le Nehemiah hun ciang zonghin biakinn music thiamte le biakinn cingte kivaak natu in Israel mi theampo in ni simin letsong pia uh hi. Mipite in Levi te tungah a thiangtho biakpiaknate pia a, Levi te in a kisamh za thiampite pia uh hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mipite tungah nging takin Moses ii Thukham a kisim ciang Ammon te le Moab te sia Pathian mite sungah kihel thei ngawl tu hi a cina laingual mu uh hi.","title":"Ngamdang Mite taw Kikhenna","ref":"Thkna 23:3-5"},"2":{"text":"Tuasia banghang ziam cile Israel mite Egypt pan a pusua lai in, lampi ah Ammon le Moab mite in an le tui a piak ngawl hang hi. Amate in Israel a haamsiat tu in Balaam sum pia ahihang ih Pathian in tua haamsiatna sia thupha khat suaksak zaw pum hi.","ref":"Mi 22:1-6"},"3":{"text":"Israel mite in hi thukham a kisim a zaak ciang amate mi sungah ngamdangmi theampo kihelsak ngawl uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Biakinn vanh kholna inndoite a uk thiampi Eliashib sia Tobiah taw khuangei hialma a thu kisi in om uh hi.","title":"Nehemiah ii Puuaphatnate"},"5":{"text":"Ama in Tobiah sia antang le ngimnamtui biakpiaknate, Biakinnpi sungah a kizangh vanhte, thiampite atu biakpiaknate le, tuaciang Levi te, biakinn music thiamte le biakinn cingte a kipia antang, sapittui le olive thau, sawm a khat te bek khol natu a, a kingaisun inndoi lian sia zong zanghsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Hi bang teng ahi hunlai in Jerusalem ah ka om bua hi, banghang ziam cile Artaxerxes ii Babylon kumpi a sep zawk kum 32 kum in, ama kungah thupuak tu in ka pai kik hi. Hun tawmvei zawkciang ama oaina taw"},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem ah ka heak kik hi. Tualai ah Eliashib in Biakinnpi inndoi khat Tobiah a zaksak ka mu ciang ka patau hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka thinso a, Tobiah neisa vanh theampo ka lotkeaksak hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua inndoite a zeksa om bangin a kithianthosak natu le biakinn vanhte, biakpiakna ante le ngimnamtuite a kikoi kik natu in thu ka pia hi."},"10":{"text":"Mipite in a khamkhop tu an pia zo ngawl ahikom biakinn music thiamte le a dang Levi te in Jerusalem nusia in a lo tek a zot kik zongh ka za hi.","ref":"Thkna 12:19"},"11":{"text":"Biakinnpi a kingaingonsak hu in tua uliante ka teih zazaan hi. Tuaciang Levi te le music thiamte Biakinnpi ah ka kaikhawm kik a, a nasep ka seamsak kik hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Israel mite theampo in biakinn vanh kholna inndoite ah sawm a khat a piak antang, sapittui le olive thaute a puak kipan kik uh hi.","ref":"Mal 3:10"},"13":{"text":"Vanh kholna inndoite uk tu in, a nuai a teng: thiampi Shelemiah; thukham a he mipil Zadok; le Levi mi Pedaiah ka koi hi. Mattaniah ii tupa, Zaccur ii tapa ahi Hanan in amate hu tu hi. Hi mite in a naseppuite tungah thumaanna taw an hawm tu in a muanhuai mite ahi sia ka he hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka Pathian awng, na Biakinnpi atu le a biakpiak natu in hi ka nasepnate theampo hong phawsak ta'n."},"15":{"text":"Tua hunlai Judah ngam ah mite in Sabbath ni in sapittui a suuk uh ka mu hi. Midangte in an, sapittui, sapitngate, thei ngate le, nadang teng a laate tungah suanhin Jerusalem ah a tumpui ka mu a; Sabbath ni in bangma a zuak ngawl natu in a kidop natu thu ka pia hi.","ref":"Pu 20:8-10; Thkna 5:12-14; Jer 17:21-22"},"16":{"text":"Tyre khuapi mite pawlkhat Jerusalem ah teang a, tuate in Sabbath ni in ka mite tungah a zuak tu ngasate le vanh tuatuamte khuapi sungah hong paipui uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Jew lampuite ka teih a, amate tungah, “A sia na vawt uhte en ve vun! Sabbath ni ninsak nu hi."},"18":{"text":"Hi bang linlian in na taanghpupite ngamta ahikom Pathian in daan pia a, hi khuapi lalcipsak hi. Tua hi napi Sabbath ni nitsakna taw Israel tungah Pathian thin uuk seseam natu in vawt veve nu hi,” ka ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom Sabbath a kipat sim, nitak kipat po ciang khuapi kongpite a kikha natu le Sabbath hun a bo mateng a kihon kik ngawl natu in thu ka pia hi. Sabbath ni in khuapi sungah bangma a kitumpui ngawl het natu in ka mihingte pawlkhat in kongpite ka cingsak hi."},"20":{"text":"Vanh namcin a zuakte khatvei niivei khawng khuapi luphung pua sangah nipi zawk Ni nga ni zanin ngiak uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua mite tungah, “Zingsang ciang dong na ngak uh hang a kimanna om bo. Hi bang na om kik uh le, zawthawk thu kong zak kul tu hi,” ci in a kidop natu in thu ka pia hi. Tua hun a kipan Sabbath ni in amate hong pai kik ngawl uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Levi te amate le amate kithiansua natu le Sabbath a thianthosak nanak natu in, kongpite pha tak a cin natu thu ka pia hi. Pathian awng, hi thu zongh ah hong phawk ta'n a, itna lian nei na hikom kei hong suaktasak ta'n."},"23":{"text":"Tua hun in Judah pasal tam mama in Ashdod, Ammon le Moab numeite a teenpui uh zongh ka mu hi.","ref":"Pu 34:11-16; Thkna 7:1-5"},"24":{"text":"A tate a lang in Ashdod kam ahibuale kamdang khat pau in om a, amate in koma kam pau thei ngawl uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua pasalte teih in ka haamsiat ngawp a, saatin, a sam ka nuk zazaan hi. Tua zawkciang amate ahizong a tate ahizong ngamdangmite taw a ten kik ngei nawn ngawl natu in Pathian min taw ka kiciamsak hi."},"26":{"text":"Keima in, “Solomon kumpipa a mawsak a khialsak sia ngamdang numeite hi. Ama in minam dangte ii kumpite sangin a lianzaw pa hi. Pathian in ama it a, Israel theampo ii kumpi suaksak napi, hi mawna khialna sungah puk hi.","ref":"2 Sa 12:24-25; 1 Kum 11:1-8"},"27":{"text":"Kote in na ngamtatna hong zui in ngamdang numeite teenpuina taw ih Pathian thu nial tu khu ziam?” ka ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Joiada sia Thiampi Lianbel Eliashib ii tapa hi a, ahizong Joiada ii tapate khat in Beth Horon khua pan Sanballat ii tanu teenpui ahikom Jerusalem pan Joiada ka hawlkhia hi.","ref":"Neh 4:1"},"29":{"text":"Pathian awng, hi mite in thiampi nasepna mun le thiampite le Levi te taw na vawt thuciamna te a nitsakna thu phawk in."},"30":{"text":"Ngamdang taw a kipee-awna theampo pan mipite ka thiansua a, amate nasep tu tek a heak natu in thiampite le Levi te zui tu ngeinate ka vawtsak hi."},"31":{"text":"A hun ciang biakpiaknate halna ah a kizangh thingte a kipaipui natu le mipite ii a anpalte le thingnga minciilte taw biakpiaknate a paipui natu in ka vaihawmsak hi. Pathian awng, hite theampo phawk in a, tuaciang keima hong kiphaw natu hong hisak ta'n."}}}}},"17":{"info":{"name":"Esther","shortname":"Esth","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Persia ngam khuapi Susa khua kumpi tokhum tung panin Xerxes kumpipa in India pan Ethiopia dong ngamke 127 uk hi.","title":"Vashti Kumpinu in Xerxes Kumpipa Thu nial","ref":"Ezra 4:6","merge":"2"},"3":{"text":"Kumpi a sep a kum thum kumin a uliante theampo le zum ukte atu in anneakpoai khat vawt hi. Tualai ah, Persia le Media ngalkaphonpite, ngamuk mangte le kumpi uliante om hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in a ngam haunate le kumpi zum ii vaang neina, nasiatna taw a thupiziate tha luk sung bup lak hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kumpipa in Susa khuapi sungah a om pasal theampo a hau, a zawng a kibangin anneakpoai khat vawtsak hi. Tua poai nipi khat sung bup kumpi inn huante sungah kivawt hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua mun a suumsung sia patpuankhai vancii le a kaangte taw kizeam a, tua puankhakte a ci pha puanneal sandup khaute taw marble suangkaang khuamte tungah ngunnkualte taw kikhii hi. Tua suumsung teng marble suang a kaang, a san, a tee keptang le vancii meal suangmanpha bangte kipha in, a tungah khamh le ngunn taw a kivawt tokhumte kikoi hi."},"7":{"text":"Sapittui te khat le khat a kibang ngawl khamh hai taw kihawm vazia a, kumpipa in a kumpi sapittui te ciil vawt ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Sapittui neak tu za ciangtan om ngawl a; a kuama po in a du za a neak natu in kumpipa in kumpi inn sung naseamte thupia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua poai hun sungin Vashti kumpinu in kumpi inn sungah numeite atu in anneakpoai khat vawtsak hi."},"10":{"text":"A poaikhaam ni sali ni in kumpipa sapittui ne in nuamsa ahikom ama aituam naseam, numei uk cilnge sa pasal sali Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar le Carkas te sam hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa in amate tungah Vashti kumpinu a kumpilukhu khu in ama kungah a paipui natu in thupia hi. Kumpinu sia numei mealpha khat hi a, kumpipa in uliante le a leangnate theampo tungah kumpinu mealhoina lak nuam hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahizong a naseamte in kumpipa thupiakna Vashti kumpinu tungah a son uh ciang kumpinu in nialin pai nuam ngawl hi. Tua hu in kumpipa thinso hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu in upadi zui natu ngeina huvau thudokna a pian ciang, ama in a pil a thiamte ngaisutna a dok tu sia kumpi ngeina ahikom ama in bang vawt tu ci a he, ngaisutna a piate sam hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama ii ngaisutna a dok tawntung belte sia Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena le Memucan — Persia le Media ngam ulian salite hi a, kumpi ngam sungah zum lianbelte uk uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in hi uliante tungah, “Keima Xerxes kumpipa in ka naseamte sawlin Vashti kumpinu ka samsak a, ahizong ama in ka thu hong nial hi! Ama tungah ih vawt tu sia upadi in bang ci ziam,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Memucan in kumpipa le a uliante tungah: “Vashti kumpinu in kumpipa bek hi ngawlin, a uliante — a tatakin ci leang kumpi uk sungah a om pasal theampo hong zawngsak hi!"},"17":{"text":"Kumpinu ngamtatna a zaak pawpo ciang, kumpi uk sungah a om numei theampo in amate ii pasal tek nomu paih tu hi. Amate in, ‘Xerxes kumpipa in Vashti kumpinu sia ama kungah a pai natu thupia napi a thu nial hi,’ ci tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Persia le Media ngamsung uliante ii zite in kumpinu ngamtatna teng a zaak po ciang nitum ma in tua thu a pasalte tungah son tu uh hi. Mun theampo ah zite in a pasalte zakta nawn ngawl tu a, a pasalte sia a zite tungah thin uuk tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa na lung a kim le, Vashti sia kumpipa mai ah a kilak kik ngei nawn ngawl natu in kumpi thu thansakna khat vawt in. Tuasia a kilaih kik thei nawn ngawl tu in Persia le Media te upadi sungah a ki at natu thupia in. Tua zawkciang ama kumpinu dinmun ah numei phazaw khat koi in."},"20":{"text":"Na thu thansakna sia a lian mama hi kumpi ukna ngam theampo ah a kiheak ciang numei theampo in amate ii pasalte hau kale zawng kale pha takin zatak vawt tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpipa le a uliante in hi ngaisutna pha sa a, Memucan ii ngaisutna a piak bangin kumpipa ngamta hi."},"22":{"text":"Zi neisa pasal theampo sia amate ii bangkua tek ii topa hi tu a, a thuneibel hi tu hi ci in, ama in tua kumpi ukna ngam sim ah a kampau tek le a lai tek taw thu zaaksakna khat puak hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua nungciang kumpipa ii thin uukna a thai zawkciang ngawngawnin ama in Vashti ngamtatna le a tungah a thu thansakna sia ngaisun top hi.","title":"Esther, Kumpinu Suak"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahiciang kumpipa kung a om a thudok pawlkhatte in, “Banghangin ngaknu thiangtho mealpha pawlkhat zongsak ngawl ni ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Na ukna ngamke theampo ah ngaknu mealpha teng hi lai Susa khuapi sung numeite teenna munah hong puak tu in uliante panmun pia thei ni hi. Na numeite a uk cilnge sa Hegai ii kep tu in koi in a, amate tualai ah a mealphat natu in kipuuasak in."},"4":{"text":"Tuasia ciang pha na sakbel numei sia la in a, Vashti taangin kumpinu suaksak in” ci in ngaisutna pia uh hi. Kumpipa in hi ngaisutna sia phasa in zui hi."},"5":{"text":"Tualai Susa khuapi ah Jew te Jair tapa Mordecai kici khat teang hi; ama sia Benjamin minam hi a, Kish le Shimei ii suan khat hi."},"6":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in Judah kumpipa Jehoiachin le a ngalmat honkhat Jerusalem pan saltaang tu in a paipui lai in Mordecai kihel hi.","ref":"2 Kum 24:10-16; 2 Khang 36:10"},"7":{"text":"Ama in suapuiseal khat nei in, Hebrew min, Hadassah kici Esther hi a; tua nu a mealpha in a khanhoi hi. A nute a pate a thi ciang Esther sia Mordecai in la a, ama tanu tatak bangin khoi in khangsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in tua thu thansakna thak a suasak ciang Susa ah ngaknu tam mama hong kipaipui a, Esther kihel hi. Ama zongh numeite teenna a uk Hegai khutnuai kumpi inn sungah kikoi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hegai in Esther diksa in maipha pia hi. Ama in Esther mealphat natu in kin vawt a, kimetsak in, an tuam taw vaak hi. Ama in tua nu numeite teenna munah omna phabel pia a, kumpi inn pan a kitealtuam numei salite in khoisak hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu in Mordecai ii ngaisutna a piak bangin Esther in Jew te a hina thu iimcip hi."},"11":{"text":"Ni simin Mordecai in Esther bang bang in om a, bang suak lai tu ci in a heak natu in numeite teenna leitual mai ah kilee nithi hi."},"12":{"text":"Numeite mealphat natu a kipua hun kum khat sung hi a — myrrh sathau namtui taw tha luk sung le balsam sathau taw tha luk sung kimet hi. Tua zawkciang numeite khat zawkciang khat kumpi Xerxes kungah kipaipui tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Numeite teenna pan kumpi inn sungah ama a pai ciang puan a silh nop po silh thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Tualai ah ama nitak sang in pai a, a zingsang ciang numeite teenna mundang ah kipaipui kikin kumpipa zinote a uk cil kingetpa Shaashgaz tungah ki aap tu hi. Kumpipa in diksa a, a min taw a sam kik buanale ama sia kumpipa kung pai kik ngawl tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa kungah Esther a pai tu hun hong theng hi. Esther sia Abihail ii tanu hi a, a tanu tu in a la Mordecai ii suapui sealh hi; Esther sia a mu pawpo in hoisa hi. Ama pai hun a thet ciang numeite teenna a uk, cil kingetpa Hegai ii a sawl bang linlian in puansilh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuabangin Xerxes ii kumpi a sep a kum sali kum, a tha sawmna, Tebeth tha in Esther sia kumpi inn sung Kumpi Xerxes kungah kipaipui hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa in ngaknu dangte sangin ama hoi sa zaw a, a dangte sangin maipha pia zaw in, it zaw hi. Ama in a lu tungah kumpilukhu khusak a, Vashti dinmun ah kumpinu suaksak hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kumpipa in Esther patoaina in anneakpoai lian khat vawt a, a uliante le zum nasep uk theampo sam siat hi. Ama in kumpi ukna ngamsung bup zum kha ni khat tu in thangsak a, kumpipa taw a kiphu, a kilawm letsongte hawm hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua hun sungin kumpipa in Mordecai sia nasep uk dinmun khat pia hi.","title":"Mordecai in Kumpipa Nuntakna Hun"},"20":{"text":"Esther in ahile Jew te a hina kihesak ngawl lai hi. Mordecai in kuama tung a son ngawl natu sawl a, a no lai a thu a nit bangma in hi thu huvau zong ah a thu ni hi."},"21":{"text":"Mordecai in kumpi inn ah zum na a sep hun sungin, kumpipa inndoi sung tumna a cing numei uk cil kinget niite ahi, Bigthana le Teresh in Xerxes kumpipa ngalvawtin, thalup sawm ku uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Mordecai in tua thu a heak ciang Esther kumpinu tungah son a, Mordecai ii a heak thute ama in kumpipa tungah son hi."},"23":{"text":"Hi thute a kat ciang thumaan a hina mu ahikom tuate ngeal sia ngui ki awklumsak hi. Hi thu teng theampo kumpi ukna ngamsung zum thu tepteena te sungah a kikhum natu in kumpipa in thupia hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tawmvei zawkciang Xerxes kumpipa in Haman a kici khat sia vuanzi lianbel in a za khanto hi. Haman sia Agag suan Hammedatha tapa ahi hi.","title":"Haman in Jew te Thalup Sawm"},"2":{"text":"Zatakna piakna in Haman mai ah khupdin in a kun natu Kumpipa in a khutnuai ulian theampo tungah thupia hi. A dang teng in tuabangin zatakna pia napi Mordecai in nial hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpi ulian dangte in kumpipa thupiakna sia banghangin zui nuam ngawl ni ziam, ci in dongh uh hi;"},"4":{"text":"amate in ni khat zawk ni khat a zui natu sawsawl napi Mordecai in thudon nuam tuan ngawl hi. Ama in, “Keima in Jew mi hi a, Haman mai ah ka kun thei buatu hi,” ci in thiang son hi. Tua ahiciang amate in Mordecai ii ngamtatna a thuak zo ka tawm ci in ngaisun kawm ma in Haman tungah hi thu son uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Mordecai ii khupdin in a kun ngawlna thu Haman in a heak ciang a thinso hi,"},"6":{"text":"tuaciang, Mordecai sia Jew mi a hina thu ama in a heak ciang Mordecai khat bek daan piak ngawl tu in, khensat hi. Ama in Persia kumpi ukna ngam bup ah a teang Jew mi theampo mot siat tu in ngeal hi."},"7":{"text":"Xerxes kumpipa ii kumpi a sep a kum sawm le kum nii kum, tha masa, Nisan tha in, a sawmna bang a vawt natu in bang ni bang tha phabel ziam he nuam ahikom (“purim” a kici) lai mee vawt tu in Haman in thupia hi. Adar tha, tha sawm le tha niina, ni sawm le ni thum ni in vawt tu khensat hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Haman in kumpipa tungah, “Na kumpi ukna ngamsung theampo ah a kithethaang le ngamke theampo ah a kimu minam khat om hi. Amate ii zui a ngeinate sia midangte a taw kibang ngawl hi. Tua banah na kumpi ukna ngamsung upadi te zui nuam ngawl ahikom tuate na koithong tu sia nang atu in pha ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumpipa awng, na lung a kim le, amate a kithalup natu in thutan in. Tuabangin thu na tan le kumpi ukna ngam vaihawmna sungah zak tu in kumpi sum le vanh manpha sungah keima ngunntang kilogramme 340,000 vaal kong piak tu in kong kamciam hi,” ci in son hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa in tua thuthansakna sia zum thu a sua thei natu laitupna in a kizangh a khutzungbu suut a, Jew mite ngal Agag suan Hammedatha tapa Haman tungah pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama tungah, “Tua mite le a dangkate nangma aa hi; na uk bang po vawt in,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahiciang tha masabel ni sawm le ni thum ni in, Haman in kumpipa ii thuzeakte sam a, kumpi ukna sungah a om kampau nam theampo le amate ii zak lai taw pheen in at tu in thuthansakna khat sonin atsak hi. Tua lai sia ngamukte, ngamukmangte le uliante theampo tungah puak tu ahi hi. Tua lai sia Xerxes kumpipa min taw a kisuaksak hi a, a khutzungbu kituum hi."},"13":{"text":"Laitaite in hi thuthansakna sia kumpi ukna ngamsung a om ngamke theampo ah puak uh hi. Tuasia sungah Adar tha, ni sawm le ni thum ni, ni khat sungin Jew te theampo — a moi le a haam, numeite le patangte — a kimot natu thupiakna teng om hi. Amate kihesuak ngawlin kithat tu a, a neisa teng kilaaksak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ni hong thet ciang a kuama po a kingin thei natu in tua thuthansakna teng ngamke theampo ah ngammite heak tu in kizasak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa ii thupiakna taw Susa khuapi ah tua thutanna a heak kim natu in kizasak a, laitaite in tua thuthak sia ngamkete ah puak uh hi. Susa khuapi sungah a buaisak laitakin kumpipa le Haman tokhawm in zu ne uh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mordecai in hi thu vawtna teng a heak ciang a thinna sa in a puan balkeak hi. Tua zawkciang khau-ip puan silhin a lu tungah vut poai a, nasia tak kapin tau in,","title":"Mordecai in Esther ii Huna Ngen"},"2":{"text":"khuapi kaantan a, kumpi inn kongbiang a thet dong pai hi. A sungah ama tum ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile khau-ip puan silhte a sungah kuama kitumsak ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa thuthansakna a kiheaksakna ngamke theampo ah Jew te nasia tak khuangai in om hi. Amate an tang a, kapin tau in, a tamzaw khau-ip puan silhin vut sungah lum uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Esther naseam numeite le numei uk cil kingette in Mordecai ngamtatna teng ama tungah a son uh ciang nasia takin Esther thinngim hi. Esther in Mordecai sia khau-ip puan a silh taangin a silh tu puan pawlkhat piasak ahihang ama in saang nuam ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Esther in kumpipa ii ama naseam tu a koi numei uk cil kingetpa Hathach samin, Mordecai kungah paisak a, thupiang teng a pian theina thu kan in sawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Hathach sia Mordecai omna ahi kumpi inn tumna khuapi leitual ah pai hi."},"7":{"text":"Mordecai in thupiang theampo son siat a, Jew te theampo a kimon le, kumpi sum le vanh manpha tungah dangka a piak tu za Haman in kamciam a piakna dongin son siat hi."},"8":{"text":"Jew te a suksiat natu thu Susa khuapi pan a laihawm dal khat sia ama in Hathach pia hi. Mordecai in Esther tungah tua lai a piak natu, thupiang teng a son siat natu le kumpipa kungah Esther pai in ama mipuite atu hesuak a nget natu in vaitha hi."},"9":{"text":"Mordecai vaithak bangin Hathach in seam a,"},"10":{"text":"tuaciang Esther in Mordecai tungah hi thu teng ama ma in puaksak kik hi;"},"11":{"text":"“Mihing khat pawpo, pa ahizong numei ahizong sapna nga ngawlin kumpipa taw kimu nuam in suum sungnung ah a tum le ama a thi kul hi. Tua in upadi hi a; kumpipa thudokte a kipan ngamsung mi theampo ii heak ahi hi. Hi upadi pial thei natu lampi khat bek om hi: kumpipa in mihing khat tungah a khamh ciangkhut a lapto le, tuasia ciang ama nuntakna kikhoaikhe hi. Keima zongh kumpipa ii hong sap ngawl zawk tha khat pha zo hi,” ci in sonsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Esther ii kam vaithak teng Mordecai in a nga ciang,"},"13":{"text":"ama in hi bangin a kidop natu thupuak hi: “Kumpi inn sungah na om hu in Jew dangte sangin ngammuang zaw tu in kingaisun heak in."},"14":{"text":"Hi bang hun sungah thimthu in na om le, vantung pan Jew te atu huna hong pai in, Jew te kihun tu a, ahizong nangma na thi tu a, na pa ii bangkua mong tu hi. Ahitazong, akua in he tu ziam? — nangma kumpinu hong kisuasak zongh hi bang hun atu in a suak na hina meal kihe ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Esther in Mordecai tungah hi bang zo kik hi:"},"16":{"text":"“Pai in a, Susa khuapi sungah a om Jew mi theampo khawm in; antang in kei atu thu hong ngetsak tavun. Sun thum le zan thum sung an ahizong tui ahizong bangma ne heak vun. Ka khangmoi numeite le keima zongh tuabang ma in ka na vawt tu uh hi. Tua zawkciang, upadi bang ahibuatazong kumpipa kungah ka pai tu hi. Tuabang ka pai hu in ka thi a kul le zong a thi ka hi tu hi” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Mordecai in tua mun nusia in, Esther ii vawt tu a sawl theampo vawt hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A antan ni thum ni ciang Esther in a kumpinu puantual silh a, kumpi inn suum sungnung ah pai in, kumpi tokhum omna inndoi sang maingat in ding hi. Kumpipa sia a sungsang tokhum tungah to in kongbiang maingat hi.","title":"Esther in Kumpipa le Haman Anneakpoai ah Sam"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa in Esther kumpinu doipua sangah ding a mu ciang maipha pia in ama sangah a khamh ciangkhut laamto hi. Tuasia ciang Esther hong paito in, tua ciangkhut dawn len hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in dongh a, “Esther kumpinu awng, bang ziam? Na dei sia hong son tan — ka ukna ngam a lang keak ahizong nga tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Esther in, “Kumpipa awng na lung a kim nale, noma atu in ka vawt anneakpoai ah ka leangna in nangma le Haman tu nitak hong haw le uhte uuk khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Esther ii leangna tu in kumpipa in Haman manlang tak a pai natu in samsak hi. Tuabangin kumpipa le Haman sia Esther ii anneakpoai ah pai uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Sapittui a neak kawmin kumpipa in Esther tungah, “Na dei sia hong son ta'n, kong pia tu hi. Ka ngam phellang keak ahizong nong ngen le kong pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Esther in,"},"8":{"text":"“Kumpipa awng, na dik a kong nget sia nong pia zo tu ahile, zing nitak ciangin noma kong ngintaakna anneakpoai dang khat ah nangma le Haman ka leangna tu in kong dei hi. Tua hun ciang ka dei sia kong son tu hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua anneakpoai pan Haman lungdam thinnuam in cia hi. Ahizong ama in kumpi inn kongbiang ah Mordecai mu a, ama mai a kaan ciang Mordecai in din ngawl, bangma zatakna lak ngawl ahikom Haman sia ama tungah thin uuk mama hi.","title":"Haman in Mordecai Thalup Sawm"},"10":{"text":"Ahizong ama in vei kenkon in a inn ah cia hi. Tuaciang a inn ah a lawmte sam a, a zi Zeresh zongh kihelsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in a hauna teng, a tapa nei teng, kumpipa ii a za a laptona thu, le kumpi ulian dangte sangin a thupi zawkna thu teng amate tungah kisuangtaak hi."},"12":{"text":"Haman in, “Hi teng bek hi ngawl lai hi. Esther kumpinu in kuama dang anvaak ngeingawl a, ahizong kumpipa le keima an hong vaak a, zing ciang zong hong sam kik hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahizong kumpi inn kongbiang ah a to Jew mi Mordecai ka mu lai teng hi thute theampo kei atu in khiakna nei ngawl hi,” ci lai hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahiciang a zi le a lawmte theampo in, “Banghangin mihing a ki awklupsak natu in metre kul le nii a saang khuam khat vawt ngawl tu ni ziam? Zingsang ciang tuasia tungah Mordecai awklup natu in kumpipa tungah na ngen tu a, tua zawkciang lungdam takin an neakna poai ah na pai thei tu hi,” ci in ngaisutna pia uh hi. Haman in hi ngaisutna phasa ahikom a awklupsak natu in khuam phut hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zan ma in kumpipa mu thei ngawl ahikom a kumpi ukna ngamsung thu tepteena zum laite lasakin ama tungah simsak hi.","title":"Kumpipa in Mordecai Patoai"},"2":{"text":"Tua lai sungah kumpipa a kisuam nopna — a inndoite a cing cil kinget kumpi inn sung numei uk niite ahi Bigthana le Teresh in kumpipa a thalup nopna a phawk Mordecai ii pualaakna thu kihel hi.","ref":"Est 2:21-22"},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Hi thu hangin Mordecai tungah patoaina le tel piakna bangbang om kana ziam?” ci in dongh hi. A naseamte in, “Ama atu bangma kivawtsak ngawl hi,” ci in zo uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in, “Kumpi inn sungah ka uliante akua om ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Tu in Haman sia zum suumsung hong tum zawk bek hi; ama in Mordecai awklup natu khuam taw kinging zo a, a awklupsak thei natu in kumpipa tungah a ngen tu hong pai zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahiciang a naseamte in, “Hi lai ah Haman om a, nangma taw kimu tu in hong ngak hi,” ci in zo uh hi. Kumpipa in, “Sungtangsak vun,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuabangin Haman tum a, kumpipa in ama tungah, “Ka patoai nop mama mi khat om hi. Tua pa atu bang vawt tu khi ziam?” ci hi. Haman in, “Tu in kumpipa in hi zata a, a patoai nop sia akua hi thei tu ziam? Keima hi nak vak ing!” ci in ngaisun hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in kumpipa tungah, “Tua pa atu kumpi puan — nangma mama ii na silh puantual sia tuasia pa atu in lasak in. Kumpi kizepna teng na siphu tungah koisak in.","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"Tua zawkciang na kumpi ulian sung pan ulianbel khat in tua pa hi puantualte silhsak in a, siphu tungah tosakin khuapi khawlmun kaantan in paisak in. Amate a pai kawmin tua pa in: ‘Kumpipa in a patoai nop pa bangbangin tel pia ci sia, en vun!’ ci in taangko tahen” ci in zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuasia ciang kumpipa in Haman tungah, “Manlangin pai in a, kumpi puantual le ka siphu la in, tua patoai natu teng Jew mi Mordecai atu vawt ta'n. Ama kumpi inn kongbiang ah a to na mu tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Haman in puantualte le siphu la in, puantualte Mordecai in silhsak hi. Mordecai siphu tung to in khuapi khawlmun kaantan a, a paipui kawmin mipite tungah Haman in: “Kumpipa in a patoai nop pa bangbangin tel pia ci sia en vun!” ci in taangko hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Mordecai kumpi inn kongbiang ah heak kik a, Haman ahile maizumin a mai sealsa in inn ah manlang tak cia hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama tungah thupiang teng a zi le a lawmte theampo tungah son siat hi. Tuasia ciang a zi le a lawm mipilte in, “Na vaang teng Mordecai tungah a theng tu hi zo hi. Ama Jew mi hi a, zo thei ngawl tu ni hi. Ama in nang hong zo nanak tu hi,” ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate hi thu teng a son laitak Esther ii vawt anneakpoai ah Haman paipui tu in kumpi inn pan numei uk cil kingette manlang tak hong theng uh hi.","title":"Haman Kithatlum"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Esther taw an nekhawm tu in kumpipa le Haman sia,"},"2":{"text":"a nii veina pai uh hi. Sapittui a neak kawmin kumpipa in Esther thu dongh kik a, “Tu in Esther kumpinu awng, bang dei ni ziam? Hong son po ta'n, kong pia tu hi. Kumpi ukna ngam phellang keak ahizong hong pia tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Esther kumpinu in, “Kumpipa na lung a kim a, kiniamkhiakna taw kong ngetna nong pia zo tu le, keima le ka mite hong nungtasak thei lete uuk khi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka mite le keima, thalup tu in hong kizuak zo hi. Saltaang tu in hong kizuak hi zaw le, pau ngawlin ka om lel tu a, kong nawngkaisak buatu hi, ahizong kote hong kithatlum — hong kimon tu hi zo hi!” ci in zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Xerxes kumpipa in Esther kumpinu awng, “Tua bangte akua in vawt ngam tu ziam? Hisia pa koisungah om ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"6":{"text":"Esther in, “Kote ii ngal le kote hong vawtsia pa sia, hi mihing tatsia Haman hi!” ci in zo hi. Kumpipa in hi thu hangin daan a piak hunlam Haman in mu thei ahikom Esther kumpinu tungah a nuntak natu hesuak ngen nuam in nungsang ah taanglai hi."},"8":{"text":"Haman in hesuak ngen tu in Esther tona ah a to suk bek laitakin huan sung pan kumpipa inndoi sungah hong sungtang kik hi. Hi bang a mu ciang kumpipa au in, “Hisia pa in ka kumpi inn sung hi lai, keima mai tatak ah kumpinu buanin khialpui nuam ziam?” ci hi. Kumpipa ii a kampau a man ma in numei uk cil kingette in Haman lutang puan khu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Harbonah a kici te sung pan khat in, “Kumpipa nangma nuntakna a hu Mordecai a awklupsak thei natu in, a khuam ngawngawn Haman in a inn ah phut zo hi, tuasia metre kul le nii saang hi,” ci hi. Kumpipa in, “Tuasia tungah Haman awklumsak tavun,” ci in thupia hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuabangin Mordecai atu ama ii phusa khuam sia tungah Haman ki awklumsak hi. Tua zawkciang kumpipa thin uukna thai hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni ma in Xerxes kumpipa in Esther kumpinu tungah Jew te ngalpa Haman neisa theampo pia hi. Esther in Mordecai taw mealheak khat a hina thu kumpipa tungah son a, tua hun a kipan Mordecai sia kumpipa omna ah kitumsak thei hi.","title":"A do Kik tu in Jew te Kisawl"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa in a min tupna a om a khutzungbu suutin, (Haman tung pan a laak kik sia ahi hi.) Ama in kumpipa tungah Agag suan Haman ii Jew te tungah thusia vawt in a thasawm nopna thu a tawlngaksak natu in ngen hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in a khamh ciangkhut Esther sangah laamto ahikom ama dingto in,"},"5":{"text":"“Kumpipa awng, na lung a kim na le kei nong khualna in, hi thu maan tuak na sa le, nong hesuakna in Haman thupiak nate bangin a kisep suak ngawl natu — Agag suan Hammedatha tapa ii na kumpi ngamsung tengah Jew te theampo suksiat natu in tua thupiaknate khaktan natu thu thansakna hong suaksak ta'n."},"6":{"text":"Ka mite tungah hi tuasiatna tungin, ka mealheakte kithat le, bangbangin thuak zo thong tu khi ziam?” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Xerxes kumpipa in Esther kumpinu le Jew mi Mordecai tungah, “En vun, keima in Jew te a thasawm hu in Haman ka awklumsak zo a, a neisa teng Esther tungah ka pia zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahizong kumpipa min taw kumpi tazeik kituum in a suaksa thu thansakna sia kidawk kik thei ngawl tu hi. Ahizong Jew te tungah na dei bang po in lai at thei tu nu hi; tuaciang ka min taw lai at vun a, tua lai tungah kumpipa tazeik tuum thei tu nu hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Sivan tha, a tha thumna, ni 23 ni in hi thu piang hi. Mordecai in kumpipa ii thuzeakte samin India pan Ethiopia dong ngamke 127 teng ah Jew te, ngamukmangte, zum vaihawmte le uliante tungah a laithak tu teng khaw hi. Tua laithakte sia ngamke sim ah a zak kampau tek le a lai tek taw ki at a, Jew te tungah amate kam le a lai taw in ki at hi."},"10":{"text":"Mordecai in tua laithakte Xerxes kumpipa min taw atsak a, ama in tua laite kumpi tazeik tuum hi. Tua laite kumpi siphu buk pan siphu tai ngaangte tung a tote in hawmsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua laithakte sungah kumpipa in khuapi theampo ah Jew te kipawl in amate le amate a kihuuk thei natu thu a omsakna thiang son hi. Ngamke khat pawpo ah ngam minam khat pawpo in ngalhiamte taw Jew pasalte, a patangte, a numeite a sim le Jew te in a simte do kik thei a; tuate khat zongh khoaikhe ngawlin thatlum thei tu a, a neisa teng laaksak thei tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Hi thutanna sia Persia ngamsung theampo ah Jew te a kithalup tu ni, tha sawm le tha niina, Adar tha ni sawm le ni thum ni pan kisimin, taangtunsak natu ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hi thu sia upadi in kithangsak tu a, tua ni a thet ciang Jew te in a ngalte tungah phulam tu in a kingin khol thei natu in ngamke theampo ah mi theampo ii heak tu in kizasak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa thupiak bangin kumpi siphu tungto laitaite a manlang thei tawpin kipaisak hi. Tua thutanna sia Susa khuapi sung zongh ah kithangsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Mordecai sia vancii le a kaang ngelh kumpi puantual le a sa pha puanneal sandup te silh in, a etlawm mama khamh lukhu khu in kumpi inn pan pusuak hi. Tuasia ciang Susa khuapi lamdung teng ah patoaina aw te le lungdam in aunate hong nging hi."},"16":{"text":"Jew te atu in thinnopna le suatakna, lungdamna le ngualzawna hong om hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa ii thu thansakna lai a kisimna mun theampo, khuapi sim le ngamke sim ah Jew te in lungdam anneakpoai vawtin, lungdam poaikham ni nei kawkoai uh hi. A tatakin ci leang tu in midang tam mama in Jew te a kiitak hu in, Jew te suak uh hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Adar tha ni sawm le ni thum ni theng a, tua ni sia kumpi thu thansakna, a kisim tu ni, Jew te tung a ngalte ii ngalzo tu in a kilamet ni ahi hi. Ahizong Jew te in amate zo pumsai uh hi.","title":"Jew te in A Ngalte Thatlum"},"2":{"text":"Kumpi ukna ngamsung khuapi sim, Jew te omna khawk teng ah Jew te a ngal vawt nuam khat pawpo a sim kik tu in amate sia a kipawl sa in om hi. Koima po ah a om mite in Jew te kiita in, khat zongh in langpan ngam ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"A tatakin ci leang ngamke kumpi ulian theampo — ngamukmangte, zum vaihawmte le kumpi palaite — in Jew te panpui zaw uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate theampo in Mordecai kiita uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mordecai sia tu in kumpi inn sungah a vaang nei pa hi ci in, kumpi ukna ngam theampo ah a minthang a, tuaciang a vaangletna khang vaial hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jew te in a ngalte tungah a uuk bang po in vawt thei uh hi. Amate in a ngalte namsau taw simin thatlum uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Susa khuapi sung mama ah Jew te in pasal 500 thatlum uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuate sungah Jew te ii a ngalpa, Hammedatha tapa Haman ii tapate sawm — Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha, Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha, Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai le Vaizatha te kihel uh hi. Ahizong a neisa bangma kilaaksak ngawl hi.","merge":"8"},"11":{"text":"Tua ni ma in Susa khuapi sungah mihing a kithat za kumpipa tungah thu kizasak hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaciang kumpipa in Esther kumpinu tungah, “Susa bebek ah Jew te in pasal za nga thatlum zo a, Haman tapate sawm kihel hi. Ngamke te sungah bang teng suaksak zo tu ziam! Tu in bang dei ni ziam? Na nga tu hi. Bang dang dei lai ni ziam hong son ta'n, na nga tu hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Esther in, “Kumpipa awng, na lung a kim le Jew te ii tu ni Susa ah a kingamtatsak thei bangma in zing ciangin ngamta kik tahen. Tuaciang Haman tapate sawm ii luanghawmte sia ngui awkna khuam tungah khaisak in,” ci in zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa in Esther kumpinu ci bangin sep tu thupia a, Susa khuapi sungah thangsak hi. Haman tapate sawm ii luanghawm sia ngual muna ah kikhai hi."},"15":{"text":"Adar tha, ni sawm le ni li ni in Susa a om Jew te kikaikhawm kikin, khuapi sungah pasal 300 that thua uh hi. Ahizong a neisa bangma laaksak tuan ngawl uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ngamke tuatuam sungah a om Jew te zongh kipawl in amate le amate kihuu uh hi. Amate a ngaimaw, a ngalte75,000 a thalup na taw amate le amate kihuu uh hi. Ahizong a neisa bangma laaksak ngawl uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ni sia Adar tha, ni sawm le ni thum ni hi. A zing ciang, ni sawm le ni li ni sia, kithalupna om nawn ngawl a, lungnop anneakpoai vawt ni in zangh uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahizong Susa a om Jew te in sawm le thum ni le sawm le li ni in a ngalte that a, tuaciang sawm le nga ni in tawlnga ahikom ni sawm le ni nga ni sia tawlngak ni suaksak hi."},"19":{"text":"Hi thu hangin khuanote sungah a teang Jew te in Adar tha, ni sawm le li ni sia lungdam tawlngak ni, anneakpoai vawt hun le khat le khat an letsong a kipiak hun in zangh uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Mordecai in hi thupiangte lai taw at in, Persia te ii kumpi ukna ngamsung theampo, a nai le a khuala a om Jew te tungah laithak kawkoai hi,","title":"Purim Poai"},"21":{"text":"kum simin Adar tha, sawm le li ni le sawm le nga nite sia tawlngak ni in a zak natu in son hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua nite sia Jew te ii a ngalte a bosak ni hi a; tua tha sia heena le thinkiamna hun pan thinnopna le lungdamna hunin a kilaih tha ahi hi.
