Ka nuntakna theampo awng, ama min thiangtho pok in!","title":"Pathian ii Itna"},"2":{"text":"Ka thaa awng, Topa pok in a, ama bangza dik ziam ci sia mangil heak in."},"3":{"text":"Ka mawna theampo ama in hong maisak a, ka natna theampo hong damsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in thaankuul thet natu panin hong keam a, itna le hesuakna taw thupha hong pia hi."},"5":{"text":"Muvanlai bangin hatin ka moisua kik natu in ka nuntakna sia naphate taw ama in hong dimh hi."},"6":{"text":"A kinengcipte panpuina taw Topa in thukhen a, amate ii nga tuakte pia hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama ii ngealnate Moses tungah ama in pualaak a, ama ii sepna liante Israel mite musak hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in hong hesuak a hong it in, thin uuk hak a, itna kip taw kidim hi.","ref":"Jas 5:11"},"9":{"text":"Ama in hong teih thapaai ngawl hi; a tawntungin a thin uuk ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in eite taw a kiphu bangin daan hong pia ngawl a, ih mawnate le ih tat khialnate bangin hong thuk ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Van sia lei panin a saan za in ama a zaktate a itna sia lian mama hi."},"12":{"text":"Nisuana sia nitumna pan a kikhualat za in ih mawnate sia eite sung pan tuabangza ma kikhuala in hong khiinsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Pa khat in a tate tungah dik ahi bangma Topa sia ama a zaktate tungah dik hi."},"14":{"text":"Eite sia bang taw kivawt ci sia ama in he hi; ama in eite leivui ih hi sia phawk nginge hi."},"15":{"text":"Eite ih hile ih nuntakna sia lopa bang ahi hi. Ngam paak khat bangin ih khang a ih palh hi;"},"16":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a tungah vui hong va a, tua paak bo in- kuama in mu kik ngawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahihang Topa a zaktate atu in ama ii itna in a tawntungin kikhomsuan a, ama phatna sia khang tawntungin kikhom hi,"},"18":{"text":"Ama thuciamna sungah a thumaante le ama thupiakte citakna taw a zuite atu in ama phatna sia khang tawntungin kikhom hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in a kumpi tokhum sia vantung ah koi hi; ama in mun theampo a uk kumpipa ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama thupiakte zui a, ama ci bang a ni, no, a thahat vantunglalangte awng Topa pok vun."},"21":{"text":"Ama deina bangin a ngamta no, ama naseam, vantung a om vaang nei theampo awng, Topa pok vun!"},"22":{"text":"Topa pok vun, ama ukna sung mun theampo ah ama ii bitphua sate awng. Topa pok in, ka tha awng!"}}},"104":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka thaa awng, Topa pok in! Topa ka Pathian awng, nang bangza in na lian ziam! Kumpi zaletna le minthanna,","title":"A Bitphuapa Pokna"},"2":{"text":"nangma in puan bangin na silh hi; Nangma le nangma khuavak taw na kituam hi. Vantungte tuipuan buk khat bangin na phalh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciangin na inn sia tungsang a om tuite tungah na sa hi. Meeite sia siphu ngalleang bangin na zangh a, vui ii thate tungah na to hi."},"4":{"text":"Vui sia kamtaite bangin na zangh a, khualeng sia na naseamte bangin na zangh hi.","ref":"Heb 1:7"},"5":{"text":"Simlei sia a tawdapte ii tungah kho takin na phut a, a kikhiin ngei buatu hi."},"6":{"text":"A tungah tuipi sia puantual khat bangin na koi a, tui in mualte a khum hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuite na teih ciangin amate tai uh hi; na thupiakna aw hong zaak ciangin nawtai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua tuite sia mualte tung le leikuamte sungah luang a, na see sa mun zuan uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Leitung a khuum kik nawn ngawl tu, a kaantan thei ngeingawl natu in ngamngi na omsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Ciktuite munkuam sungah na luangsak a, ngunte mualte kilaklaw ah na luangsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuate in ngamsate atu tui ngasak hi; tua munah ngam laate a dangcim uh hi."},"12":{"text":"A hui ah a om thingkungte tungah vacimte bu vawtin lasa uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Mualte tungah van panin nguatui na puaksuk a, leitung sia na thuphate taw kidim hi."},"14":{"text":"Khuite atu in lopa na posak a, mihingte zak tu in thingnote na posak hi, tua ahikom amate in lo ante ciing thei a,"},"15":{"text":"a lungdam natu in sapittui, a maitai natu in olive thau, a thahat natu in anluumte piangsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Lebanon mual tungah Topa ii a suan a neisa Cedar thingkungte in nguatui tam mama a nga uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua munah vacimte in a bu vawt uh hi; hilniang vacimliante in mang taakthing tungah a bu vawt uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Sathakte in mualdawn saangte tungah teang a, ngalhvangte in suangliangte ah buu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"A ni a thate teptee natu in tha na bitphua hi; ni in a tum tu hun he hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangma in zan na vawt a, khuazing sungah ngamsa theampo pusuak hi."},"21":{"text":"Tawpi moite in sa a vai ciang hawk uh a, Pathian ii piak an zong uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ni a sua ciangin amate akua zuanin lum uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin mihingte in naseam tu in kuan a nitak dongin na seam suak uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa awng, nangma in na tam mama na vawt zo hi! Ciimna taw tuate theampo na vawt hi! Simlei sia na bitphua nuntakna neite taw kidim hi."},"25":{"text":"A kisim zo ngawl nganhingte a lian, a no a teen khopna tuipi sia lianin zai hi."},"26":{"text":"A tungah teambawte khualhaw a, a sungah na vawtsa tuipi nganhingpui Leviathan kimai hi.","ref":"Job 41:1; Ps 74:14; Is 27:1"},"27":{"text":"Tuate theampo in an a taangsap hun ciang a pia tu in nang hong suang hi."},"28":{"text":"Nangma in amate an na pia a, a ne uh hi; an na piak ciang amate a lungkim uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Na nungngat ciangin amate lau uh hi; a husan na laak ciangin amate thi in, amate pianna leivui ah cia kik uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahihang amate hu na mop ciang a kibitphua uh hi; Nangma in leitung ah nuntakna thak na pia hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa minthanna kikhomsuan tahen! Ama vawt sate tungtaang ah Topa lungdam tahen!"},"32":{"text":"Ama in simlei en a, leitung a liing hi; ama in mualte tham a, tuate sung pan meikhu pusuak hi."},"33":{"text":"Ka nuntak lai tawntung Topa tungah la ka sa tu hi; ka nuntak laiteng ka Pathian tungah pokna la ka sa tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Ka la in ama lungkimsak tahen, banghang ziam cile ka lungdamna sia ama kung pan hong pai ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Mawneite leitung panin kilalcipsak tahen; mihing seksolte om nawn heak hen. Ka thaa awng, Topa pok in! Topa pok in!"}}},"105":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamkona pia vun a, ama ii letna thangsak vun; ama ii sep sate minam tuatuamte tungah son vun.","title":"Pathian le Ama Mite (1 Khangtaanghthu 16:8-22)"},"2":{"text":"Topa tungah pokna lasa vun; a lamdang a sep sa nate thu son vun."},"3":{"text":"Ama ii neisa ih hi hu in lungdam vun; ama a bia theampo lawp tahen."},"4":{"text":"Hu ngen tu in Topa zuan vun; a kizom suakin ama bia vun."},"5":{"text":"A naseampa Abraham ii suante, a teal pa Jacob ii suante awng: Pathian ii a sep nalamdang laknate le a thukhennate phawk vun.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Topa in ih Pathian hi; ama thupiakte in leitung bup atu ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in a thuciam sia a tawntung kholet tu a, ama kamciamte khang tul dongin kipsak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Abraham taw a vawt thukimna sia le Isaac tungah a kamciam sia ama in kipsak tu hi.","ref":"Pian 12:7; 17:8; 26:3"},"10":{"text":"A tawntungin a kikhom tu thuciamna khat Topa in Jacob taw vawt hi.","ref":"Pian 28:13"},"11":{"text":"“Canaan ngam nang kong pia tu a, nangma ii neisa hi tu hi,” ama in ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Pathian mite sia citawm a, Canaan ngam ah zin tang uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate sia ngam khat pan ngam khat ah, kumpi ngam khat pan ngam khat ah vak kawkoai uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in amate kuama in a zothawsak bua hi; amate a dal natu in kumpipate tungah hi bangin kidop natu thupia hi:","ref":"Pian 20:3-7"},"15":{"text":"“Ka tealsa ka naseamte susia heak vun; ka kamsaangte thutha heak vun,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in amate ngam ah kialpi tungsak a, a an uh a vekpi in laaksak hi.","ref":"Pian 41:53-57"},"17":{"text":"Ahihang ama in sal bangin a kizuak Joseph a kici mihing khat amate mai ah paikholsak hi.","ref":"Pian 37:28; 45:5"},"18":{"text":"Ama sonkhol thu a taangtun mateng in Joseph ii peangte thikkhau kibul a, thikkol sia a ngawng ah kibul hi."},"19":{"text":"Pathian kammal in ama sia maan hi ci in lak hi.","ref":"Pian 39:20—40:23"},"20":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin Egypt ngam kumpipa in ama suaktasak hi; minamte a ukpa in ama suaktasak hi.","ref":"Pian 41:14"},"21":{"text":"Ama in Joseph sia a ngamukna teng lampui tu le, a ngam bup ukpa tu in koi a,","ref":"Pian 41:39-41"},"22":{"text":"kumpipa ii uliante tungsia ah vaangneina le kumpipa ngaisutna a piate lamlak tu in thuneina pia hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jacob sia Egypt ngam ah pai a, tua ngam ah teang hi.","ref":"Pian 46:6; 47:11"},"24":{"text":"Topa in a mite tungah ta tam mama pia a, a ngalte sangin hatsak zaw hi.","ref":"Pu 1:7-14"},"25":{"text":"Ama in a mite Egypt te ii a ngaimawk natu in vawt a, ama in a naseamte theambawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in a naseampa Moses le a teal pa Aaron paisak hi.","ref":"Pu 3:1—4:17"},"27":{"text":"Amate in Pathian ii a nasia mama sepnate seam a Egypt ngam ah a lamdang laknate vawt hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ngam sungah Pathian in khuazing puak hi, ahihang Egypt te in ama thupiakna a ni bua uh hi.","ref":"Pu 10:21-23"},"29":{"text":"Ama in nguntuite chisan suaksak a, a ngasate theampo thisak hi.","ref":"Pu 7:17-21"},"30":{"text":"A ngam bup sia ulolte dimteak a, kumpipa inn ngawngawn ulol taw kidim hi.","ref":"Pu 8:1-6"},"31":{"text":"Pathian in thupia a, tho le thataa sia a ngam sung bup ah a hataak in om hi.","ref":"Pu 8:16-17,20-24"},"32":{"text":"Nguatui taangin ngialtang le khualeng te amate ngam sungah puak hi;","ref":"Pu 9:22-25"},"33":{"text":"amate ii sapitkungte le theikungte lalsak a, thingkungte theampo nuaitan hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in thupia a khaumawte hong pai in, sim zawk ngawl awn tampi pha uh hi:","ref":"Pu 10:12-15"},"35":{"text":"tuate in a ngam sungah thingno lopa theampo netum uh a, lo ante theampo khawng siat uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama in Egypt ngam ah innkuante theampo sung pan tapaciil teng thatlum hi.","ref":"Pu 12:29"},"37":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in Israel te pusua pui hi; amate in ngunn le khamh pua uh a, amate a vekpi in ciidam in thahat uh hi.","ref":"Pu 12:33-36"},"38":{"text":"Egypt te in amate kiita ahikom amate ii a nusiat ciangin a lungdam uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Pathian in a mite tungah meeilom khat koi a, zan in khuavak pia tu in mei khat koi hi.","ref":"Pu 13:21-22"},"40":{"text":"Amate in ngen a, ama in vamimte puak hi; ama in amate lungkim natu in vantung pan an khiak hi.","ref":"Pu 16:2-15"},"41":{"text":"Ama in suangpi khat hong a, tui hong phulkeak hi, tua tui in sennealngam sungah ngun bangin luang hi.","ref":"Pu 17:1-7; Mi 20:2-13"},"42":{"text":"A naseampa Abraham tungah a kamciam thiangtho a piak teng ama in ciamtee hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in a tealsa a mite pusuapui a, amate in lawpna taw lasa in au uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Ama in midangte ii leitangte amate tungah pia a, tuaciang a lo teng a tansak sia,","ref":"Jos 11:16-23"},"45":{"text":"a mihingte in ama thukhamte a zui natu le a thupiak theampo a zui natu in a vawt ahi hi. Topa pok vun!"}}},"106":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pok vun! Topa tungah lungdamko vun, banghang ziam cile ama pha hi; ama ii itna in a tawntungin kip hi.","title":"A mite tungah ii phatna","ref":"1 Khang 16:34; 2 Khang 5:13; 7:3; Ezra 3:11; Ps 100:5; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"2":{"text":"A sep sa na liante theampo akua in son zo tu ziam? Akua in a kicingin pok thei tu ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Ama thupiakte ni a, a tawntungin a maan in a seamte sia mihing lungdamte ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa awng, na mite na hu ciangin kei hong phawk ta'n; amate na ngup ciang kei zongh hong hel ta'n."},"5":{"text":"Na mihingte nopsakna hong musak ta'n a, na minam ii lungdamna, na mihingte ii lungdam angtannate hong siimsak ta'n."},"6":{"text":"Ka taanghpupite ii maw bangma in ko zongh ka maw zo uh hi; kote in seksolin ka ngilo uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Egypt ngam ah ka taanghpupite in Pathian ii a lamdang a sepnate tel ngawl hi; tamvei tak, a itna a lak hunte amate in mangil hi, tuaciangin San Tuipi ah amate in Vaanglianbelpa langpan uh hi.","ref":"Pu 14:10-12"},"8":{"text":"Ahihang ama in a kamciamsa bangin a vaangletna lian a lakna in amate hun hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in San Tuipi thupia a, tua tuipi kang hi; ama in a mite leiko tung tawnsak in lampui hi.","ref":"Pu 14:21-31"},"10":{"text":"A ensante khut sung panin amate hun hi; a ngalte khut sung panin amate suatak hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang a ngalte ahile tuitaa siat hi; khat zongh a taang bua hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuasia ciang a mite in ama kamciamte um in pokna la a sak uh hi.","ref":"Pu 15:1-21"},"13":{"text":"Ahihang amate in ama sep sa teng mangil pai uh a, ama ii ngaisut piakna ngak ngawlin ngamta uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Senneal sungah amate duhopna taw kidim a, Pathian ze et uh hi;"},"15":{"text":"tua ahikom amate nget teng ama in pia a, a kiitakhuai mama natna khat zongh amate sungah puak hi.","ref":"Mi 11:4-34"},"16":{"text":"Tua sennealngam sungah amate in Moses le Topa ii a thiangtho naseampa Aaron a eang uh hi.","ref":"Mi 16:1-35"},"17":{"text":"Tuasia ciang lei kihong in, Dathan sia lei in valh a, Abiram le a innkuanpuite lei in hukcip hi;"},"18":{"text":"a nungzuite tungah meikuang paisuk a, tua mihing seksolte kaanghtum hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in Sinai ah khamh taw khuitalno lim khat vawtin tua milim bia uh hi;"},"20":{"text":"amate in Pathian minthanna sia lopa a ne nganhing khat ii lim taw theak uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Egypt ngam sungah ama ii a nasia mama sepnate taw amate a hun Pathian, amate in mangil uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua munah ama in bang a lamdang nate vawt ziam! San Tuipi ah ama in bang a lamdangsak huaite vawt ziam!","ref":"Pu 32:1-14"},"23":{"text":"Pathian in a mite ka lalsak tu a ci ciangin ama ii teal a naseampa, Moses in Pathian mai ah dingin a thin uukna taw amate a lalsak ngawl natu in khaam hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate in tua ngamnuam a nolh uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate in Pathian kamciam a um bua uh hi.","ref":"Mi 14:1-35"},"25":{"text":"Amate in a tuipuan buk sungah om in phun a, Topa aw a nangai nuam bua uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate sia sennealngam sungah a thisak natu ahizong"},"27":{"text":"a suan a paalte Pathian he ngawlte kawm ah a kithethaangsak natu ahizong, ngamdang ah a thisak natu ahizong ama in a ciliap huai kidop thei natu thupia hi.","ref":"Thiam 26:33"},"28":{"text":"Tuaciang Peor ah Pathian ii mihingte in Baal biakna pawm uh a, nuntakna nei ngawl pathiante tungah a kipia sangaw biak piaknate ne uh hi.","ref":"Mi 25:1-13"},"29":{"text":"Amate in a ngamtatna taw Topa thin uukna toklosak uh a, a kiitakhuai natna khat amate sungah hong tung hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahihang Phinehas dingto in a mawte daan a piak ciang, tua pul natna thai hi."},"31":{"text":"Hi thu sia ama maipha nga natu in tua hun pan kipan kiciamtee a, hong pai lai tu hun theampo sungah kiphawk tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Meribah ciktui ah tua mite in Topa thin uuksak uh a, amate hu in Moses ngim nga hi.","ref":"Mi 20:2-13"},"33":{"text":"Amate in Moses ii thin siasak ahikom ngaisun phot ngawlin ama pau hi."},"34":{"text":"Amate in Topa thupiak bangin Pathian he ngawlte a that bua uh hi,","ref":"Thkte 2:1-3; 3:5-6"},"35":{"text":"tuabang ci thada amate taw nupa in kiteang uh a, doaibiate ii ziate zui uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Pathian mite in milim bia uh a, tua in amate lalna piangsak hi."},"37":{"text":"Amate in a tapate a tanute sia Canaan milimte tungah sangaw biakpiakna in nei uh hi.","ref":"2 Kum 17:17"},"38":{"text":"Amate in tua mawnei ngawl patangno numeinote thatlum uh a, tua kithalupnate in ngam ninsak hi.","ref":"Mi 35:33"},"39":{"text":"A ngamtatna uh taw amate le amate kininsak in Pathian tungah a thumaan bua uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa sia ama mite tungah thin uuk hi; ama in thasiathuai sa hi.","ref":"Thkte 2:14-18"},"41":{"text":"Pathian in amate sia Pathian he ngawlte ii khut sungah nusia a, a ngalte in amate uk uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Amate sia a ngalte in zothaw a, amate khutnuai theng siat uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tamvei ma Topa in a mite suatak ahihang, amate in Topa langpan tu teal zaw ahikom amate sia mawna sungah a thuk zaw in taaksuk uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Ahizong amate ii au in a biapui ciang Topa in za a, amate ii dongtawnate phawsak hi."},"45":{"text":"Amate atu in a thuciamna phawk a, ama ii itna lianpi hu in amate maisak hi."},"46":{"text":"Pathian in amate a vawtsia mihing theampo sungah, hesuakna thin neisak hi."},"47":{"text":"Topa kote Pathian awng, hong hun ta'n, nang tungah lungdam kong ko thei natu le na min thiangtho kong pok thei natu in, minam tuatuamte sung panin, hong kaikhawm kik ta'n.","ref":"1 Khang 16:35-36"},"48":{"text":"Israel te ii Pathian, Topa pok vun; tu le a tawntungin ama pok vun! A kuama theampo in “Amen!” ci tahen. Topa pok vun!"}}},"107":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“ Topa tungah lungdamko vun, banghang ziam cile ama pha hi; ama ii hong itna in kikhomsuan hi!”","title":"LAIBU A NGANA Psalm Late 107 — 150 Pathian ii Phatna Pokna","ref":"1 Khang 16:34; 2 Khang 5:13; 7:3; Ezra 3:11; Ps 100:5; 106:1; 118:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"2":{"text":"Ama hong ngup sa note theampo in hi kammalte lo kikikin Topa pok vun. Ama in na ngalte kung panin hong suatak a,"},"3":{"text":"ngamdang pan le nisuana, nitumna, sak le thang panin no hong ciapui kik hi."},"4":{"text":"Pawlkhatte in senneal ngamsung lampi om ngawlna ah vakthap a, a teen natu khuapi paina lampi a mu zo bua uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate a ngilkialin a dangtaak a, lametna bangma a nei nawn bua uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuasia ciang a ngim ngana sung pan amate in Topa biakpui uh a, ama in a cimawkna uh sung pan hun hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in lampi tang khat tawnin amate lampui a, a teen thei natu khuapi khat ah then hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate atu nalamdang a septe hang le ama ii itna kip hu in amate in Topa tungah lungdamko tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in a dangkote dangcimsak a, a ngilkialte an phate taw ngilvasak hi."},"10":{"text":"Pawlkhatte khuangaina le khuazing sungah teang a, luangta in thikkol kibul uh hi,"},"11":{"text":"banghang ziam cile amate in Vaanglianbelpa Pathian thupiakte nalh a, ama hilnate nial uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in na ham sepna taw a tha uh tul hi; amate puk tu a, kuama in a hu buatu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A ngim nga uh ciang amate in Topa biakpui a, ama in a cimawkna uh panin hun hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in amate sia khuangaina le khuazing sung pan pusua a, a thikkolte sukthapsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate atu a lamdang na a septe hang le a itna kip hu in amate in Topa tungah lungdamko hamtang tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Taau taw kivawt kongkhate ama in saattham a, a ki uumna thikzawlte sutan hi."},"17":{"text":"Pawlkhatte mawmaw a, a mawna hu le a ngitlo hu in thuak uh hi;"},"18":{"text":"amate in an kii a, thi dedek in om uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaciang a ngim nga uh ciangin amate in Topa sam a, amate cimawkna sung pan Topa in hun hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in a thupiakna taw amate damsak a, thaankuul panin hun hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate atu a lamdang na a septe hang le a itna kip hu in amate in Topa tungah lungdamko hamtang tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama tungah sangaw biakpiakna taw lungdamko hamtang tu a, lungdam lasakna taw ama sep sa theampo son hamtang tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Pawlkhatte in tuipite tungah teambawte taw khualhaw in tuipi tung panin a nuntak natu zong uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in Topa vawt thei nate mu uh a, tuipi tungah a lamdang a vawtte mu uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in thupia a, vuipi nasia mama khat hong va a, tua in tuihualte thawn hi."},"26":{"text":"Teambawte vui sung a saangna ah kilawnto in, a thukna ah tumsuk hi. Tuabang lauhuaina sungah teambaw naseamte a thinkiam uh hi;"},"27":{"text":"amate sia zukhamte bangin lutu in hoi vatut uh a, amate thiamna theampo sia a kizangh thei bua hi."},"28":{"text":"A ngim nga uh ciang amate in Topa biakpui a, a cimawkna uh panin ama in hun hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in a kinuai vuipi suangvalte thimsak a, tuihualte dai hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua tuihualte a thim hu in amate lungdam a, amate thet nopna teambaw tawlngakna mun ngammuanna taw ama in then hi."},"31":{"text":"Amate atu nalamdang a septe hang le a itna kip hu in amate in Topa tungah lungdamko hamtang tu uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Mihingte kikhopna sungah amate in ama ii letna thangsak hamtang tu a, upate thu kikupna mai ah ama pok tu uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Topa in ngunte kangcipsak a, ciktuite luangsak nawn ngawl hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua munah a teangte ii seksolna hangin, ama in leiphate ci al lei ngamtul suaksak hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama in sennealngam sia tuicingna mun suaksak a, lei kona mun sia ciktui luanna in kheal hi."},"36":{"text":"Ama in a ngilkialte tua munah teangsak a, amate in a teen natu in khuapi khat saat uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Amate in lote ah thaicii tu in sapitkung suan uh a, anlaak hun ciangin an tam mama la uh hi."},"38":{"text":"A mite ama in thupha pia a, ta tam mama hing uh hi; Khui honte zongh a kiam ngawl natu in ama in kepsak hi."},"39":{"text":"Ngitlo zawthawkna le ngim nganate hangin, Pathian mite ngallel in zawnsak a thuak uh ciang,"},"40":{"text":"amate a zothawte ama in ngaimawkna lak a, lampi om ngawlna sennealngam sungah vakthapsak hi."},"41":{"text":"Ahihang taangsapna a neite sia amate lungmanna panin ama in suatak a, a innkuanpuite tuu hon bangin pungsak hi."},"42":{"text":"Thutang mite in hi thu mu in lungdam uh a, ahihang a seksol theampo thimsak hi."},"43":{"text":"A ciimte in hi thute ngaisun thei tahen; Topa ii itna kip ngaisun thei tahen."}}},"108":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungmuanna a cingin ka nei hi, Pathian awng! La ka sa tu a, kong pok tu hi! Khanglo in, ka thaa awng!","title":"Ngalte Zaw natu Hu nget Thungetna (Psalm Late 57:7-11 ; 60:5-12)"},"2":{"text":"Ka tengtongh le liamlo te awng, khanglo vun! Tung sunni zongh ka phong tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa awng, minamte sung nangma tungah lungdam kong ko tu hi. Mihingte kawm panin nang kong pok tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Na itna kip in vantungte kalh hi; na thumaanna in vante ban hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian awng, van ah na letna le leitung bup ah na minthanna lak in."},"6":{"text":"Na thahatna taw kote hong hun ta'n; na it, na mite a suatak thei natu in ka thungetna hong zo ta'n."},"7":{"text":"A inn thiangtho pan Pathian in, “Zawna mualsuana taw Shechem ka khentham tu a, Sukkoth ngamkuam sia ka mihingte ka hawmsak tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Gilead sia kei aa hi a, Manasseh zongh kei aa, ahi hi; Ephraim sia ka thik lukhu hi a, Judah sia ka kumpi ciangkhut hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang Moab sia ka kisilna kuangin ka zangh tu a, ka neisa hi ci in a kitel natu in Edom tungah ka peangdap ka lawn tu hi. Philistine te tungah zawna mualsua in ka au tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Pathian awng, ngalnan natu in a ki uumcip khuapi sungah akua in kei hong tumpui tu ziam? Edom ah akua in kei lam hong pui tu ziam?"},"11":{"text":"Hong nial takpi zo ni ziam? Ka ngalkap honte taw mainawt in hong kuanpui ngawl tu ni ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Ngalte langpanin ko hong hu ta'n; Mihingte kihuna in mannung ngawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Pathian ei sang hong pang le eite in ih zo tu hi; ama in ih ngalte a zothal tu hi."}}},"109":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian awng, nang kong pok hi; thim om top heak in!","title":"A Ngim nga Pasal khat ii Phunna"},"2":{"text":"Mihing seksolte le leilot theite in kei hong sim hi. Amate in kei huvau leilot thu son hi,"},"3":{"text":"Kei hong siatson hi, a thu om ngawl bulin kei hong sim hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate it in amate atu thungetsak ka hi hangin amate in kei hong ngalvawt hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in kei tungah phatna sia siatna taw, itna sia etsatna taw hong thuk kik hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka ngalpa tungah thusit tu in a maan ngawl thukhenpa khat teal in a, ama ngalte khat ma in ama mawsiatsak in."},"7":{"text":"Ama sia thu kisit in, a maw hunlam kilangh tahen; ama ii thungetna ngawngawn khialna lian khat bangin kituat tahen!"},"8":{"text":"A nuntakna hai ngawlin bo tahen; midang khat in a nasep lua tahen!","ref":"Sawl 1:20"},"9":{"text":"A tate sia tanga suak tahen a, a zi meingong tahen!"},"10":{"text":"A tate inn nei ngawl khutdaw ngente suak tahen; a siacip sa a teenna pan amate kinot tahen!"},"11":{"text":"A leibatnate in a neisa theampo laaksak tahen a, ama sep thaman theampo khualmite in nga tahen."},"12":{"text":"Kuama in ama tungah dik ngei heak hen a, ama ii nusiat tangate sia kuama in khoi a keam heak hen."},"13":{"text":"A suan a paal theampo mong tahen a, khang kik sungah a min kimangil tahen."},"14":{"text":"A taanghpupite ngitlona sia Topa in ciamtee hen a, a nu mawnate maisak ngei heak hen."},"15":{"text":"Amate mawna sia Topa in a tawntungin ciamtee tahen a, ahizong amate sia kimangil biing tahen."},"16":{"text":"Tua pa in cikna thiamna ngaisun ngeingawl hi; ama in a zawng, taangsapna a neite le a hu tu a nei ngawlte vawtsia in thatlum hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in ngual tomlaw thanuam ahikom, ama kitomlaw tahen! Ama in thupha pia nuam ngawlhet ahikom, kuama in ama thupha pia heak hen!"},"18":{"text":"Ama in haamsiatna sia a puansilh bangin ngeina see hi; haamsiatnate in ama ii pumpi tui bangin tuamh tahen a, a ngu a taang sungah sathau bangin zenh tahen!"},"19":{"text":"Tua haamsiatnate in ama sia puan bangin tuam tahen a, kawngkhau bangin ama vial top tahen!"},"20":{"text":"Topa awng, kei hong langpanin kamsia a pau ka ngalte tungah tuabangin daan pia in."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang Vaanglianpipa ka Topa awng, nong kamciamsa bangin kei hong hu ta'n a, a pha na itna hangin kei hong suatak ta'n."},"22":{"text":"Keima in zawngin ka kitaangsamh hi; ka thinsung tawngh dongin na hi."},"23":{"text":"Nitak niliap bangin ka bo dektak hi; lungno khat bangin hong kiseamkeak zo hi."},"24":{"text":"Anneak kisap hu in ka khupte huang hi; keima in vun le ngu bek taw ka om hi."},"25":{"text":"Mihingte in kei hong mu ciangin hong nuisan uh hi; selnona taw a lu uh hong pei san hi.","ref":"Mt 27:39; Mk 15:29"},"26":{"text":"Topa ka Pathian awng, kei hong hu ta'n; na itna kip hu in hong hun ta'n!"},"27":{"text":"Kei hong hunpa sia nangma na hi hunlam ka ngalte in hesak in."},"28":{"text":"Amate in kei hong tomlaw thei tu ahihang nangma in thupha nong pia tu hi. Kei hong vawtsiate in lelna thuak tahen a, keima, na naseampa hong lungdamsak ta'n."},"29":{"text":"Ka ngalte sia mindaina taw kituam tahen; amate in a maizumna sia puantual bangin silh tahen."},"30":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamkona nging takin ka pia tu hi; mihingte kikhopna sungah ama ka pok tu hi,"},"31":{"text":"banghang ziam cile ama in mizawng pa hung a, a thi natu in a puavawkte kung panin amate suatak hi."}}},"110":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka topa tungah Topa in, “Na ngalte na peang nuai ah ka koi dong hi sung ka ziatsang ah to in” ci hi.","title":"le A teal Kumpipa","ref":"Mt 22:44; Mk 12:36; Lk 20:42-43; Sawl 2:34-35; 1 Cor 15:25; Eph 1:20-22; Col 3:1; Heb 1:13; 8:1; 10:12-13"},"2":{"text":"Zion panin Topa in na kumpi vaangletna hong khang tu hi. Ama in, “Na ngalte uk in” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Na ngalte na sim ni ciangin na mite in amate uuk thu in nang hong pawm tu hi. Zingsang tuung daaitui bangin na khangnote in nang kung mual thiangthote tungah hong pai tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in ciliap huai kamciam khat vawt a dok kik ngawl tu hi: “Nangma in Melchizedek pan a kinguizui thiampi nam sungah a tawntungin thiampi khat na hi tu hi,” ci in kamciam pia hi.","ref":"Heb 5:6; 6:20; 7:17-21"},"5":{"text":"Topa sia na ziatsang ah om hi; ama a thin a uuk ciangin kumpite zothal siat tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Minam tuatuamte tungah ama in thutan tu a, ngal kisimna phual sia mithiluang taw kidimsak tu hi; leitung kumpite theampo zo siat tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa in lamhui ah a luang luitui ne tu a, tuasia ciang kithakho sua in, zawna taw a ding tu hi."}}},"111":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pok vun! Ama ii mite kikhopna ah ka thin theampo taw Topa ka pok tu hi.","title":"Pokna"},"2":{"text":"Topa ii septe bangza in lamdang ziam! Tuate hu in a lungpilte in tuate thu a tel nuam uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama ii sep theampo sia patoaina le vaangneina taw kidim hi; ama ii thutang in kip tawntung hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in ama ii a lamdang a septe eite makngil tu a dei bua hi; ama dik a hesuak thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama a zaktate atu in ama in an pia hi; ama ii thuciam a mangil ngei bua hi."},"6":{"text":"Ngamdang mite ii leitangte amate a piakna taw in a mite tungah ama in a vaang lak hi."},"7":{"text":"A sep a vawt theampo sungah ama thumaanin thutang hi; ama ii thupiakna theampo in muan thamman hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuate in a tawntungin kikhomsuan hi; thumaan thutak le thutang taw a kipia ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in a mite suaktasak a, amate taw a kip tawntung thuciamna khat vawt hi. Ama thiangtho in vaanglian hi!"},"10":{"text":"Topa zatakna in ciim natu lampi ahi hi; ama thupiakte a zui theampo tungah thu khentel thiamna pia hi. Ama sia a tawntungin pok tu ahi hi.","ref":"Job 28:28; Pau 1:7; 9:10"}}},"112":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pok vun! Topa zakta a, a thupiakte zui tu nuam a sa sia in mihing lungdam ahi hi.","title":"Mipha khat ii Lungdamna"},"2":{"text":"Mihing pha khat ii tate sia a ngam sungah thahat tu uh hi; ama ii suan le paalte thupha kipia tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama ii bangkua sia nei le lamh taw kicing tu a, ama a tawntungin nuamsa tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihing phate, ngual a hesuak theite, a dikte le thutangte atu in khuazing sungah khuavak a taang hi."},"5":{"text":"Ngual tungah ngo takin sum pukthaak a, a nasepna thumaanna taw a seam sia in mihing lungdam ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Mipha khat in lelna thuak ngeingawl tu hi; ama sia kiphawk tawntung tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in thusia zaak tu a patau bua hi; ama ii upna kho a, ama in Topa muang hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama sia thinngim ngawlin a lau bua hi; a ngalte ii a lel tu uh sia ama in mu nanak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"A kitaangsamhte tungah ama in ngo takin pia a, ama ii cikna thiamna sia bo ngeingawl hi; ama thahat tu a, kizakta tu hi.","ref":"2 Cor 9:9"},"10":{"text":"Mihing seksolte in hi thu mu in a thin uh uuk hi; amate in etsatna taw salh in tua teng taw amate a bo uh hi; amate lametnate a tawntungin mangthang hi."}}},"113":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pok vun! Topa naseamte awng, ama min pok vun!","title":"Phatna Pokna"},"2":{"text":"Tu le a tawntungin ama min kipok tahen."},"3":{"text":"Nisuana pan nitumna ah Topa min pok vun!"},"4":{"text":"Topa in minam theampo uk hi; Ama ii minthanna sia vantungte sangin saang zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa ih Pathian taw a kibang kuama dang om ngawl hi. Ama sia tungsang a saangna ah teang a,"},"6":{"text":"ahihang ama in vantungte le leitung en tu in kunsuk hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in leivui sung panin mizawngte phongto hi; a kitasamhte a lungmanna panin laamto hi,","ref":"1 Sa 2:8"},"8":{"text":"tuaciang a mite ii kumpipa tapate ahi, kumpipa tapate taw kithawlsak hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in tasel nupi sia a inn sungah patoai a; ama in tanu tapa piakna taw ama lungdamsak hi. Topa pok vun!"}}},"114":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel te in Egypt ngam pan pusuak a, Jacob suante in tua ngamdang sia a nusiat ciang,","title":"Paisan Poai La khat","ref":"Pu 12:51"},"2":{"text":"Judah sia Topa ii minam thiangtho suak a, Israel te sia ama ii neisa suak hi."},"3":{"text":"San Tuipi in en a, taisan hi; Jordan Ngun a luan tawlnga hi.","ref":"Pu 14:21; Jos 3:16"},"4":{"text":"Mualpite sia keal bangin leang valet uh hi; mualnote sia tuunote bangin kilawn kawkoai hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi awng, nang tuabangin na taikeak natu bang thu piang ziam? Tuaciang, Jordan awng, banghangin na luan tawlnga ni ziam?"},"6":{"text":"No, mualpite awng, banghangin kealte bangin leang valet nu ziam? No, mualnote awng, banghang tuunote bangin kilawn kawkoai nu ziam?"},"7":{"text":"Topa hong pai ciang, Jacob ii Pathian mai ah leitung awng, liing in;"},"8":{"text":"suangpite sia tuicingte, suangliang kipte sia ciktui luangte in a kheal sia ama ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 17:1-7; Mi 20:2-13"}}},"115":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa awng, na itna kip le na thumaanna hangin na minthanna sia kote tungah hi ngawlin, nang tung bek ah om tahen.","title":"A maan Pathian khat"},"2":{"text":"Banghangin minam tuatuamte in, “Na Pathian uh koisungah om ziam?” ci in hong dongh tu ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Ih Pathian in vantung ah om hi; ama in a uuk pawpo seam hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate ii pathiante sia ngunn le khamh taw kivawt a, mihing khutte taw kivawt hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua pathiante in kamte nei ahihang pau thei ngawl a, mittangte nei ahihang, khuamu thei ngawl hi.","ref":"Ps 135:15-18; Tpl 9:20"},"6":{"text":"Amate in bilte nei ahihang khua za thei ngawl a, naakte nei ahihang a ngim za thei ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in khutte nei ahihang tham thei ngawl a, peangte nei ahihang lampai thei ngawl hi; amate in aw ngingsak thei ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuabangte vawt a tuate ma a muangte in amate vawt milimte bang suak siat tahen."},"9":{"text":"No, Israel te awng, Topa muang vun. Ama in no hong hu a hong dal hi."},"10":{"text":"No, Pathian thiampite awng Topa muang vun. Ama in no hong hu a hong dal hi."},"11":{"text":"No, ama a biate theampo awng, Topa muang vun. Ama in no hong hu a hong dal hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in eite hong phawk a thupha hong pia tu hi; ama in Israel te le Pathian thiampite theampo thupha pia tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama a zaktate theampo a lian, a no a kibangin ama in thupha pia tu hi.","ref":"Tpl 11:18; 19:5"},"14":{"text":"Topa in no le na suan na paalte uh tungah hin le toai hong pia tahen!"},"15":{"text":"Van le lei a vawt Topa in note thupha hong pia tahen."},"16":{"text":"Vantung sia, Topa bek ii neisa hi a, ahihang simlei sia mihingte atu in pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa sia, ngam thimna a zuansuk mithite peuma in pok ngawl uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahihang ei a nungtate in tu le a tawntungin ama tungah lungdam ih ko tu hi. Topa pok vun!"}}},"116":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa ka it hi, banghang ziam cile ama in ka aw hong za hi; ama in ka thungetnate hong ngai hi.","title":"Thina pan A kingum khat ii Pathian Pokna"},"2":{"text":"Ka biapui simin ama in hong ngai hi."},"3":{"text":"Thi tu lau huaina sia ka kiimkot ah om hi; thaankuul kiitakhuaina in kei hong neak hi; kei sia launa le thintoina taw ka kidim hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa sia hi bangin ka sam a, “Hong thuum khi hi, Topa awng, kei hong hun ta'n!” ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa sia hesuak thei a, pha hi; ih Pathian in khuangai huai hong sa thei hi."},"6":{"text":"A hun tu a nei ngawlte Topa in sungsia a; a lau huaina sungah ka om ciangin ama in kei hong hun hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka lungtang awng, kimuang in, banghang ziam cile Topa in kei tungah pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in thina panin kei hong suatak hi; ama in ka thitui hong khaamsak a, hong lelsak ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa ii mai, a nungtate teenna leitung ah ka vak hi."},"10":{"text":"“Hong kisucip hi,” ka ci ciang ngawngawn ahizong,","ref":"2 Cor 4:13"},"11":{"text":"kei lau in, “Kuama muan thei tu om bo” ka ci ciang ngawngawn zongin ka upna ka thasua bua hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa ii kei tungah a phatna theampo hu in ama bang pia thei tu khi ziam?"},"13":{"text":"Kei hong hutna lungdamkona in Topa tungah sapittui biakpiakna ka pia tu hi."},"14":{"text":"A mite theampo kikhopna ah ka kamciamsa sia ama ka pia tu hi."},"15":{"text":"A mite khat a thi ciangin Topa in bangza in na sa ziam!"},"16":{"text":"Kei sia na naseampa khi hi, Topa awng; ka nu ii nang atu hong sepsak bangma in kei zongh in nang atu ka seam hi. Thina panin nong hun zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Lungdamko biakpiakna kong pia tu a, nang tungah thungetna kong nei tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Na mite theampo kikhopna mun, Jerusalem na Biakinnpi thiangtho sungah, ka kamciamsa sia kong pia tu hi. Topa pok vun!","merge":"19"}}},"117":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pok vun, minamte theampo awng! Ama pok vun, mite theampo awng!","title":"Pokna","ref":"Rom 15:11"},"2":{"text":"Ama ii eite hong itna in lian a, a thumaanna sia a tawntung atu ahi hi. Topa pok vun!"}}},"118":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamko vun, banghang ziam cile ama pha hi, tuaciang ama hong itna in a tawntung kip hi.","title":"Zawna hu a Lungdamko Thungetna","ref":"1 Khang 16:34; 2 Khang 5:13; 7:3; Ezra 3:11; Ps 100:5; 106:1; Ps 107:1; 136:1; Jer 33:11"},"2":{"text":"Israel te in: “Ama ii itna kip tawntung hi” ci tahen."},"3":{"text":"Pathian thiampite in “Ama ii itna kip tawntung hi” ci tahen."},"4":{"text":"Ama a bia theampo in “Ama ii itna kip tawntung hi” ci tahen."},"5":{"text":"Ka ngim ngana sungah Topa ka biakpui hi; ama in hong zo a hong suaktasak hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in keima taw hong omkhawm a, kei ka lau buatu hi; akua in kei bang hong law thei tu ziam?","ref":"Heb 13:6"},"7":{"text":"Topa sia kei hong hu pa hi a, ka ngalte ii lelna a thuak sia ka mu tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa muanna in mihing suan tu sangin phazaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa muanna in mihing lampuite suan tu sangin phazaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngal tam mamate ka kiim ah om hi; ahihang Topa vaang taw amate ka susia hi!"},"11":{"text":"Amate ka kiimkot mun theampo ah a om uh hi; ahihang Topa vaang taw amate ka susia hi!"},"12":{"text":"Ka kiimkot panin amate in khuai bangin hong uumci hi, ahihang lingkung kawm kaanghmei bangin amate kaanghtum paih hi; Topa vaang taw amate ka susia hi."},"13":{"text":"Kei sia nasia takin hong kisim a hong zo uh hi, ahihang Topa in kei hong hu hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in vaang hong pia a hong hatsak hi; ama in kei hong hun zo hi.","ref":"Pu 15:2; Is 12:2"},"15":{"text":"Pathian mite tuipuan bukte sungah zawna lungdamna taw a auna ngai vun: “ Topa vaanglet thahatna in tu a bang a suaksak hi!"},"16":{"text":"Kidona sungah ama vaanglet thahatna in eite zawna ah hong then zo hi!” ci uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Kei ka thi buatu hi; ka nungta zaw tu a, Topa sepsate ka thangsak tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in nasia takin kei daan hong pia zo hi, ahihang ama in kei hong thisak bua hi."},"19":{"text":"Biakinn kongpite kei hong hon tavun; a sungah tumin, Topa tungah lungdam ka ko tu hi!"},"20":{"text":"Hisia in Topa kongpi hi; thutangte bek tum thei hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa awng, nang kong pok hi, banghang ziam cile nangma in ka aw nong za a, zawna nong pia zo hi."},"22":{"text":"Inn sate in mannung sa ngawl a, a nil suangtum sia a thupibel hong suak hi.","ref":"Mt 21:42; Mk 12:10-11; Lk 20:17; Sawl 4:11; 1 Pe 2:7"},"23":{"text":"Hisia in Topa ii sepsa ahi hi; tua in bangza mu nop huai ziam!"},"24":{"text":"Hisia in Topa zawna ni ahi hi; lungdam in poai vawt tawng!"},"25":{"text":"Hong hun ta'n, Topa awng, hong hun ta'n! Kote zawna hong pia ta'n, Topa awng!","ref":"Mt 21:9; Mk 11:9; Jn 12:13"},"26":{"text":"Topa min taw hong pai pa, Pathian in thupha pia tahen! Topa Biakinn panin nang thupha kong pia uh hi.","ref":"Mt 21:9; 23:39; Mk 11:9; Lk 13:35; 19:38; Jn 12:13"},"27":{"text":"Topa sia Pathian hi; ama in ei tungah hong pha hi. Na khut sung uh ah thingsawlte toai in poai khaamna kipan vun a, biaknatau kiimkot in pai vun."},"28":{"text":"Nangma in ka Pathian na hi a, lungdam kong ko hi; na letna ka thangsak tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamko vun, banghang ziam cile ama pha hi, tuaciang ama ii itna a tawntungin kip hi."}}},"119":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa thukham bangin nungta a, a nuntakna a sit baang ngawlte in mihing lungdamte ahi hi.","title":"Thukham"},"2":{"text":"Ama thupiakna a zuite, a thin theampo taw ama thu a nite in mihing lungdamte ahi uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in ngamtat khial a nei ngei bua uh hi; Topa lampi a tawn uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa awng, na thukhamte ko nong pia zo a, thumaan takin ka zui natu nong sawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Nong hilnate thumaan tak a, ka kepcing natu sia bangza in lametna nei khi ziam!"},"6":{"text":"Na thupiakte theampo ka nadon le, ka mai hong zumsak buatu hi."},"7":{"text":"Thutang taw na thu khennate ka heheak ciangin, thinsung thiangtho taw nang kong pok tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Na thukhamte ka zui tu hi; Kei hong nusia ngei heak in!"},"9":{"text":"Khangno khat in ama nuntakna bangbangin a thiangtho in a keam thei tu ziam? Na thupiakte zuina taw keam thei tu hi.","title":"Thukham Zuina"},"10":{"text":"Ka thin theampo taw nang atu sep tu ka hanciam hi; na thupiakte a zui ngawlin hong koi heak in."},"11":{"text":"Nang tungah kong maw ngawl natu in na thukham ka thinsung ah ka keam hi."},"12":{"text":"Nang kong pok hi, Topa awng; nangma paiziate hong hil ta'n."},"13":{"text":"Nong piaksa thukhamte theampo nging takin ka lo kik tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Hau mama tu sangin na thupiakte zuina sungah lungpilna ka nei zaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Nong lamlaknate ka kantel hi; nong hilnate ka mitsuan hi."},"16":{"text":"Na thukhamte sungah nuam ka sa hi; nong thupiaknate ka mangil buatu hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka nuntak thei natu le nong hilnate kong nit thei natu in, kei na naseampa tungah hong dik ta'n.","title":"Thukham sungah Lungdamna"},"18":{"text":"Na thukham sungah a lamdang thumaante ka mu thei natu in ka mit hong honsak ta'n."},"19":{"text":"Hi sung leitung ah tawm vei bek ka om tu hi; na thupiakte kei kung pan seal heak in."},"20":{"text":"Na thu khennate a tawntungin ka he nuam a, thangai in ka thin na hi."},"21":{"text":"A kiphasakte na mawsak hi; na thupiakte a ni ngawlte haamsiatna thuak tahen."},"22":{"text":"Na thukhamte ka kepcing hu in kei hong selno a, hong nomute taw hong kipealsak ta'n."},"23":{"text":"Ngam ukte kisitua in kei hong thasawm uh hi, ahihang nangma hilnate ka kantel tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Na lamlaknate in kei thinnopna hong pia hi; tuate in ngaisutna hong piate ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Leivui sungah lelna taw ka lum hi; nong kamciamsa bangma in hong hingsak ta'n.","title":"Thukham Zui natu Thin Khensatna"},"26":{"text":"Ka sepsa theampo nang tungah kong pualaak a, nangma in nong zo hi; nangma ii paiziate hong hil ta'n."},"27":{"text":"Na thukhamte ka tel thei natu in hong hu ta'n, tua ciangin a lamdang nong hilnate ka ngaisusun tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Heena in keima hong khucip hi; nong kamciamsa bangin hong hatsak ta'n."},"29":{"text":"A maan ngawl lampi ka zui ngawl natu in hong keam ta'n a, na phatna zui in na thukham hong hil ta'n."},"30":{"text":"Thu nit tu ka teal zo hi; na thu khennate ka nadon zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Na lamlakna ka zui zo hi, Topa awng; maizum hong ngasak heak in."},"32":{"text":"Na thupiakte thalawp takin ka zui tu hi, banghang ziam cile nangma in tel theina a tamzaw nong pia tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Topa awng, na thukhamte ii khiakna hong hil ta'n, tua hile a tawntungin ka zui tu hi.","title":"Tel thei natu Thungetna khat"},"34":{"text":"Na thukham kei tungah hong thiangson ta'n, tua hile ka zui tu hi; ka thin theampo taw ka keam tu hi."},"35":{"text":"Na thupiakte hong zuisak ta'n, banghang ziam cile tuate sungah lungdamna ka mu hi."},"36":{"text":"Hau natu sangin na thukhamte zui nopna thin hong pia zaw ta'n."},"37":{"text":"A man nei ngawl nate nadon na panin hong keamcing ta'n a, nong ciamsa bangma kei tungah hong dik ta'n."},"38":{"text":"Na thu hong nite tungah na piak kamciam sia na naseampa kei tungah hong tungsak ta'n."},"39":{"text":"Selnona thuak tu ka launa panin hong hun ta'n; na thu khennate bangza in lamdang ziam!"},"40":{"text":"Na thupiakte ka zui nuam hi; nuntakna thak hong pia ta'n, banghang ziam cile nangma in thumaan thutang na hi hi."},"41":{"text":"Topa awng, kei bangza hong it ni ziam hong lak ta'n a, na kamciamsa taw kizui in, kei hong ngum ta'n.","title":"Thukham Muanna"},"42":{"text":"Tuasia ciang kei hong selnote pauna ka zo thei tu hi banghang ziam cile na kammal ka muang hi."},"43":{"text":"A tawntungin thumaan hong pausak thei ta'n, banghang ziam cile ka lametna sia nangma thukhen nate sungah om hi."},"44":{"text":"Na thukham sia a tawntung a tawntungin ka zui tu hi."},"45":{"text":"A cialcing suatakna sungah ka nungta tu hi, banghang ziam cile na hilnate zui tu ka hanciam hi."},"46":{"text":"Kumpipate munah na thupiaknate ka son tu a, ka mai a zum buatu hi."},"47":{"text":"Na thupiakte zuina sungah thinnopna ka nga hi, banghang ziam cile tuate ka it hi."},"48":{"text":"Na thupiakte thasia in ka it hi; na lamlaknate thuk takin ka ngaisusun tu hi."},"49":{"text":"Na naseampa kei tung a, nong kamciam sia phawk in; tuasia in lametna hong pia hi.","title":"Thukham tungah Kimuanna"},"50":{"text":"Ka ngimna sung ngawngawn ah keima hong kiheneam hi, banghang ziam cile na kamciamna in kei nuntakna hong pia hi."},"51":{"text":"A kiphasakte in kei hong zawnsak tawntung hang, na thukham panin ka pial ngei bua hi."},"52":{"text":"Topa awng, taanghlai a na thukhennate ka ciamtee a, tuate in heenepna hong pia hi."},"53":{"text":"Mihing seksolte ii na thukham a paltan ka mu ciangin thin uukna taw ka kidim hi."},"54":{"text":"Leitung ka nuntak hun tom no sungah na thupiakte huvau la in ka phuak hi."},"55":{"text":"Topa awng, zanin nang kong phawk a, na thukham ka ngaisun hi."},"56":{"text":"Na thupiakte zuina in ka lungdamna ahi hi."},"57":{"text":"Topa awng, ka dei theampo sia nangma na hi hi; na thukhamte zui tu in kong kamciam hi.","title":"Thukham tungah Kipiakna"},"58":{"text":"Nong kamciamsa bangma kei tungah hesuakna nong nei natu in ka thin theampo taw kong ngen hi!"},"59":{"text":"Ka ngamtat nate ka ngaisun zo a, nong lamlaknate zui natu kamciam kong pia hi."},"60":{"text":"Na thupiakte zui natu ka haisaang bua a, ka manlang hi."},"61":{"text":"Mihing seksolte in kei thaang hong sia zo hi, ahihang na thukham ka mangil bua hi."},"62":{"text":"Thutang taw na thu khennate hangin nangma pok tu in zan kimlai in ka khanglo hi."},"63":{"text":"Keima in nang atu hong sepsakte theampo le, na thukhamte a zuite theampo ii lawm ka hi hi."},"64":{"text":"Topa awng, leitung in na itna kip taw kidim hi; na thupiakte hong hil ta'n."},"65":{"text":"Topa awng, na kamciam, na kholet zo a, na naseampa keima ii tungah nong dik hi.","title":"Thukham ii Manphatna"},"66":{"text":"Ciimna le heakna hong pia ta'n, banghang ziam cile na thupiaknate ka muang hi."},"67":{"text":"Daan nong piak ma in ka pai khial bul hi, ahihang tu in na pau kong ni hi."},"68":{"text":"Nang sia na pha a, na thuthiam hi! Na thupiakte hong hil ta'n."},"69":{"text":"Mihing kiphasakte in kei huvau leilot thu son zo uh hi, ahihang na lamlaknate ka thinsung theampo taw ka zui hi."},"70":{"text":"Hi mihingte in tel theina bangma nei ngawl hi, ahihang kei in na thukham sungah nuam ka sa hi."},"71":{"text":"Daan ka thuakna in kei atu in pha hi, banghang ziam cile na thupiakte hong hesak hi."},"72":{"text":"Leitung ah a om sum le vanh manpha theampo sangin nong piak na thukham in kei atu in khiakna nei zaw hi."},"73":{"text":"Nangma in kei nong bitphua a, nong keamcing hi; tel theina hong pia ta'n, tua hile na thukhamte ka he tu hi.","title":"Thukham sungah Thutang khenna"},"74":{"text":"Nang hong upatte in kei hong mu ciangin a lung uh dam tu hi, banghang ziam cile na kamciam ka muang hi."},"75":{"text":"Topa awng, na thukhennate tang hi ci in ka he hi, tuaciang daan nong piak zongh nangma thumaan hang ahi hi."},"76":{"text":"Na naseampa kei tungah nong kamciamsa bangma in na itna kip in kei hong heeneam tahen."},"77":{"text":"Kei hong hesuak ta'n, tua hile ka nungta tu hi, banghang ziam cile na thukham sungah thinnopna ka nei hi."},"78":{"text":"A kiphasakte in a maan ngawl bulin kei hong suanhkhial ahikom maizumna nga tahen; kei ka hile nangma lamlaknate thuk takin ka ngaisusun tu hi."},"79":{"text":"Nang hong zaktate na thupiakte a hete theampo kei kungah hong pai tahen."},"80":{"text":"Lelna maizumna taw ka kipeal natu in na thupiakte a cing takin hong zuisak thei ta'n."},"81":{"text":"Topa awng, nong ngup tu kong ngakna in, ka tha tul zo hi; na kammal sungah muanna ka nei hi.","title":"Suatak natu Thungetna"},"82":{"text":"“Bang hun ciang hong hu tu ni ziam?” ci in kong dok kawmin nong kamciamte muangmaw a ka e etna in ka mit taak zo hi."},"83":{"text":"A kivawk sa savun tuithawl bangin kei sia kimanna ka nei nawn bua hi; ahihang na thupiakte ka mangil bua hi."},"84":{"text":"Bang tanvei hong ngak lai tu khi ziam? Kei hong vawtsiate bang hun ciangin daan pia tu ni ziam?"},"85":{"text":"Na thukham a zui ngawl mihing kiphasakte in kei thaang hong sia natu in vuum a to zo uh hi."},"86":{"text":"Na thupiak theampo muan thamman hi; mihingte in leilot thu taw kei ngim hong pia hi — kei hong hu ta'n!"},"87":{"text":"Amate in kei hong thatlum dektak zo hi, ahihang na thupiakte ka ngaingon ngei bua hi."},"88":{"text":"Na itna kip hu in kei tungah hong dik ta'n, tua hile na thukhamte ka zui thei tu hi."},"89":{"text":"Topa awng, na kammal in kikhomsuan tu hi; tua in vantung ah kip tawntung hi.","title":"Thukham Upna"},"90":{"text":"Na thumaanna sia khang theampo dong kikhomsuan hi; nangma in simlei sia a om natu munah na nga a, tuabang ma in om top hi."},"91":{"text":"Tuni dong na theampo amate om babang tekin om hi, banghang ziam cile nangma thupiak hang le amate theampo sia na naseamte a hi siat uh hang ahi hi."},"92":{"text":"Na thukham in ka lungdamna ii naak hi buathong le ka thuaknate taw ka thi zo tu hi."},"93":{"text":"Na lamlaknate ka ngaingon ngei buatu hi, banghang ziam cile tuate taw keima a nungta in nong keam hi."},"94":{"text":"Kei sia nangma aa ka hi hi — kei hong hun ta'n! Na thupiakte zui tu ka hanciam zo hi."},"95":{"text":"Mihing seksolte in kei hong thatlum tu in hong ngak hi, ahihang na thukhamte a thukin ka ngaisusun hi."},"96":{"text":"Na theampo sia a kiciangtan in om hi ci in ka he hi; ahihang na thupiakna sia sitbaang ngawl hi."},"97":{"text":"Na thukham bangza in it khi ziam! Tua thu nitangtumin ka ngaisun hi.","title":"Thukham Itna"},"98":{"text":"Na thupiak sia kei taw a tawntungin omkhawm a, kei sia ka ngalte sangin hong ciimsak zaw hi."},"99":{"text":"Ka syate theampo sangin ka tel zaw hi, banghang ziam cile keima in nong lamlaknate thuk takin ka ngaisusun hi."},"100":{"text":"Pasal haamte sangin ciimna lianzaw ka nei hi, banghang ziam cile na thupiakte ka zui hi."},"101":{"text":"Ngamtat sia theampo ka pial hi; banghang ziam cile na thu ka ni nuam hi."},"102":{"text":"Na lamlaknate ka ngaingon bua hi; banghang ziam cile nangma in ka syapa na hi hi."},"103":{"text":"Na lamlaknate thum mama a, khuaitui sang ngawngawn in thum zaw hi!"},"104":{"text":"Na thukhamte panin ciimna ka nga hi; tua ahikom a sia ngamtatna theampo ka ensan hi."},"105":{"text":"Na kammal in kei lam hong lak tu meiinn hi a ka lampi atu khuavak ahi hi.","title":"Thukham pan Khuavak"},"106":{"text":"Na lamlakna maante zui natu in, a ciliaphuai ka kamciam sia ka len tu hi."},"107":{"text":"Topa awng, ka thuaknate sia lauhuai takpi hi; nong kamciamsa bangma in hong nungtasak ta'n."},"108":{"text":"Topa awng, lungdamko ka thungetna hong saang ta'n a, na thupiakte hong hil ta'n."},"109":{"text":"Ka nuntakna khaamh tu in ka kinging tawntung hi; na thukham ka mangil bua hi."},"110":{"text":"Mihing seksolte in thaang taw kei hong sia hi; ahihang na thupiakte zui ngawlin ka om bua hi."},"111":{"text":"Na thupiakte sia a tawntungin keima neisa ahi hi; tuate in ka lungdamna ahi hi."},"112":{"text":"Ka thi ni matengin na thukhamte zui tu in ka khensat zo hi."},"113":{"text":"Nang tungah a pha tak hong thumaan ngawlte ka ensan hi, ahihang na thukham ka it hi.","title":"Thukham sungah Ngammuanna"},"114":{"text":"Nangma in kei hong hungpa le hong dalpa na hi a; na kamciam sungah lametna ka nei hi."},"115":{"text":"No, mawnei mite awng, kei kung panin tai vun. Ka Pathian thupiakte ka zui tu hi."},"116":{"text":"Nong ciamsa bangma in thahatna hong pia ta'n, tua hile ka nungta tu hi; ka lametna sungah hong thinkiamsak heak in!"},"117":{"text":"Ka ngammuan natu in hong len ta'n, tuaciang na thupiakte a tawntungin ka nadon tu hi."},"118":{"text":"Na thukhamte a zui ngawl peuma na nial hi; amate thimthel ngiimnate sia a mannung bua hi."},"119":{"text":"A seksol theampo sia ninteak bangin na ngaisun hi, tua ahikom na lamlaknate ka it hi."},"120":{"text":"Nangma hu in ka lau hi; na thukhennate hu in launa taw ka kidim hi."},"121":{"text":"A phate le a maante ka seam zo hi; ka ngalte khut sungah hong nusia heak in!","title":"Thukham Zuina"},"122":{"text":"Na naseampa na hu tu sia kamciam pia in; a kiphasakte in hong zothawsak heak in."},"123":{"text":"Nong hut natu kong etna, nong kamciamsa ngupna ka etna in ka mit taak zo hi."},"124":{"text":"Nong itna kip taw kizui in kei tungah hong vawt ta'n a, na thupiakte hong hil ta'n."},"125":{"text":"Keima in na naseampa ka hi hi; na hilnate ka heak thei tu in, tel theina hong pia ta'n."},"126":{"text":"Topa awng, na sep tu hun zo hi, banghang ziam cile, mihingte in na thukham hong zui ngawl hi."},"127":{"text":"Khamh le, khamh ciitak sangin na thupiakte ka itzaw hi."},"128":{"text":"Tua ahiciang na lamlaknate theampo ka zui a, lam khialna theampo ka ngaimaw hi."},"129":{"text":"Na hilnate lamdang hi; ka thin theampo taw ka zui hi.","title":"Thukham Zui nopna"},"130":{"text":"Na hilnate na thiang sonna in khuavak pia a, a he ngawlte ciimna pia hi."},"131":{"text":"Na thupiakte ka deina hangin kamkaa in ka haihaw liang hi."},"132":{"text":"Kei sang hong nga ta'n a, nang hong itte theampo tungah na ngamtat bangmain kei hong hesuak ta'n."},"133":{"text":"Nong kamciamsa bangin liik natu pan hong keam ta'n; siatna in hong zosak heak in."},"134":{"text":"Na thupiakte ka zui thei natu in kei hong zothawte kung panin hong hun ta'n."},"135":{"text":"Nong ompuina taw thupha hong pia ta'n a, na thukhamte hong hil ta'n."},"136":{"text":"Mihingte in na thukham hong zui ngawl hu in ka thitui ngun bangin luang hi."},"137":{"text":"Topa awng, nangma in thumaan thutang na hi a, na thukhamte maan hi;","title":"Thukham ii Thukhaikimkhenna"},"138":{"text":"zui tu ngeina na piakte sia pha tatak a, maan hi."},"139":{"text":"Ka ngalte in, na thupiakte thusim ngawl ahikom ka thin uukna sia, ka sungah mei bangin kuang hi."},"140":{"text":"Na kamciam sia bangza in maan ziam! Tuasia bangza in diksa khi ziam!"},"141":{"text":"Kei sia a thupi ngawl ka hi a, zawnsak ka thuak hi, ahihang na hilnate ka ngaingon bua hi."},"142":{"text":"Na thutang sia a tawntungin kikhomsuan tu a, na thukham sia maan tawntung hi."},"143":{"text":"Ngimna le thintoina taw ka kidim hi, ahihang na thupiakte in lungdamna hong puak hi."},"144":{"text":"Na lamlaknate a tawntungin thutang ahi hi; telthiamna hong pia ta'n, tua hile ka nungta tu hi."},"145":{"text":"Ka thin theampo taw nang kong sam hi; Topa awng, hong zo ta'n, tuaciang na thupiakte ka zui tu hi!","title":"Suatak natu Thungetna khat"},"146":{"text":"Nang kong sam hi; hong hun ta'n, na thukhamte ka tang tu hi."},"147":{"text":"Nisua ma in hu ngenin nang kong sam hi; na kamciam sungah ka lametna om hi."},"148":{"text":"Na lamlaknate ka thuk ngaisusutna in zankhuateakin khangciim in ka lum hi,"},"149":{"text":"Topa awng, nong itna in kip ahikom hong za ta'n; nong hesuakna hong lak ta'n a, ka nuntakna hong keamcing ta'n."},"150":{"text":"A ngilo kei hong vawtsiate in hong neak vaial hi; amate sia na thukham a tang ngeingawlte ahi hi."},"151":{"text":"Ahihang Topa awng, nangma in keima nai ah nong om a, na thupiakte theampo kho top hi."},"152":{"text":"Na lamlaknate ka heak zawk ngei zo hi; tuate sia a kikhomsuan tu in na vawt ahi hi."},"153":{"text":"Ka thuakna hong en ta'n a, hong ngum ta'n, banghang ziam cile na thukham ka ngaingon bua hi.","title":"Hu nget Maangkaana"},"154":{"text":"Ka vai hong panpui ta'n a, hong suaktasak ta'n; nong kamciamsa bangin hong hun ta'n."},"155":{"text":"A seksolte kingum ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile amate in na thukhamte a ni bua uh hi."},"156":{"text":"Ahihang, Topa awng, na mulkimna in lian hi; na hesuakna hong lak ta'n a hong hun ta'n!"},"157":{"text":"Keima in ngalte le hong zothaw theite tam mama ka nei hi, ahihang na thukhamte ka zui khial ngei bua hi."},"158":{"text":"Tua ngual leeheak theite ka et ciangin kiihuai ka sa hi, banghang ziam cile amate in na thupiakte a len bua uh hi."},"159":{"text":"Topa awng, na lamlaknate bangza in it khi ziam cisia, hong mu ta'n. Na itna in kikheal ngeingawl ahiciang hong hun ta'n!"},"160":{"text":"Na thukham laingil in thumaanna hi a, a tangin na thukhennate theampo sia kip tawntung hi."},"161":{"text":"Mihing vaang neite in a maan ngawlin kei hong do hi, ahihang na thukham ka thasia hi.","title":"Thukham sungah Ki aapna"},"162":{"text":"Na kamciamte hu in bangza ka lungdam ziam — Sumngum kikholna a mu khat bangin ka lungdam hi."},"163":{"text":"Leilot thu theampo ngaimaw in ka huatsa hi, ahihang na thukham ka it hi."},"164":{"text":"A tang na thukhennate hu in ni simin salivei nang tungah lungdam kong ko hi."},"165":{"text":"Na thukham a itte in ngammuanna tatak nei a, amate a puksak thei bangma a om bua hi."},"166":{"text":"Topa awng, nong ngup tu ngakin ka om a, nong sawl po ka seam hi."},"167":{"text":"Na hilnate ka ni hi; ka thinsung theampo taw tuate ka it hi."},"168":{"text":"Na thupiakte le nong lamlaknate ka zui hi; ka sep ka vawt theampo na mu hi."},"169":{"text":"Hu ngen a kong auna nang kung hong theng tahen, Topa awng! Nong kamciamsa bangin tel theina hong pia ta'n!","title":"Hu natu Thungetna"},"170":{"text":"Kong thungetna hong ngai ta'n a, na kamciamsa om bangin hong hun ta'n!"},"171":{"text":"A tawntungin nang kong pok tu hi, banghang ziam cile nangma in na thukhamte nong hil hi."},"172":{"text":"Na thukham tungtaang ah la ka sa tu hi, banghang ziam cile na thupiaknate maan hi."},"173":{"text":"Kei hong hu tu in a tawntungin hong kinging ta'n, banghang ziam cile na thupiakte ka zui hi."},"174":{"text":"Topa awng, hong ngum tu nong huna sia bangza in thangai khi ziam! na thukham sungah lungdamna ka mu hi."},"175":{"text":"Nang kong pok thei natu in nuntakna hong pia ta'n; na lamlaknate in kei hong hu tahen."},"176":{"text":"Ngam amh tuuno khat bangin ka vakthap hi; Tua ahikom hong pai in, na naseampa keima hong zong ta'n, banghang ziam cile na thukhamte ka ngaingon bua hi."}}},"120":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngim ka nga ciangin Topa ka sam a, ama in hong zo hi.","title":"Hu natu Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Topa awng, leilot theite le ngualtheam theite kung pan hong hun ta'n."},"3":{"text":"No a leilot theite awng, Pathian in bang hong law tu ziam? Bangbangin daan hong pia tu ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Ngalkapte thaltang hiamte le meikam sa taw daan hong pia tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Note kawm ah teen sia Meshech ah teen bang, Kedar mite kawm sungah teen bangin sia hi."},"6":{"text":"Kilemna a ngaimawte taw ka teen khop zawk ngei lei zo hi!"},"7":{"text":"Kilemna vai ka son ciangin amate in ngalvai vaihawm uh hi."}}},"121":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei hong kihuna koisung pan hong pai tu ziam ci in mualtung ka ento hi.","title":"Ei Hong dal"},"2":{"text":"Kei hong kihu natu sia van le lei a vawt Topa kung panin hong pai hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in nang hong puksak ngawl tu hi; nang hong dalpa in a tawntungin khangciim hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel te a dalpa in lusu ngeingawlin mu ngeingawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in nang hong cing tu hi; ama sia na kungah nang hong dal tu in om hi."},"6":{"text":"Sunin ni in nang hong liamsua ngawl tu a, zanin tha in zongh nang hong nasak ngawl tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in nang sia launa theampo panin hong dal tu hi; ama in nang hong keamcing tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in na sungtanna le, na pusuana ah tu le a tawntungin nang hong dal tu hi."}}},"122":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“ Topa inn ah pai tek tawng” hong ci a om ciangin ka lungdam hi.","title":"Jerusalem Pokna La"},"2":{"text":"Tu in eite sia hi sung Jerusalem kongpite sung sangah ih ding hi!"},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem sia a etlawm, a hoi in a kipua kik khuapi khat ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa thupiak bangin ama tungah lungdamko tu in, Israel minamte hong paina mun ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel kumpipate in a mite tungah thukhen tu in hi sungah to uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi ah kilemna a om thei natu thungen vun: “Nang hong itte khangto tahen."},"7":{"text":"Na suumsung sangah kilemna om tahen a, na kumpi innte ah ngal muanna om tahen,” ci vun."},"8":{"text":"Ka mealheakte le ka ngualtamhte ka ngaisutna in Jerusalem tungah, “Kilemna om tahen!” ka ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa ih Pathian inn atu in na nopsak natu thu ka ngen hi."}}},"123":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa awng, na ukna vantung le, nangma kong ento hi.","title":"Hesuak Nga natu Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Topa kote Pathian awng, naseampa khat in a topa suang a, naseamnu khat in a tonu a suan bangma, kote tungah hesuakna nong nei mateng in nang kong ento tawntung tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Kote hong hesuak ta'n, Topa awng, hong hesuak ta'n; kote hong kizawnsak vawt mama zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Kote sia sumhaute in hong nunau zawk ngei lei zo a, tuaciang a kiphasak hong zothawte in hong zawngsak uh hi."}}},"124":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in ei sangah hong pang ngawl hile bang suak tu hi ziam? Hong zo tavun, Israel te awng!","title":"A mite A Sungsia Pathian"},"2":{"text":"“ Topa ei sangah hong pang ngawl hi thong le,"},"3":{"text":"ih ngalte ii hong sim ciang, thinsona taw eite a hingtang in hong valhlum zo tu hi;"},"4":{"text":"tuaciang namthuam in hong taikeak zo tu a, tui in hong khum zo tu hi,"},"5":{"text":"a lauhuai khuanawl in tui hong tasak zo tu hi.”"},"6":{"text":"Ih ngalte ii hong lalthapsak tu, a oai ngawl Topa tungah lungdamko tawng."},"7":{"text":"Savaipa thaang sung pan a suakta vacim khat bangin ei zongh ih suakta zo hi; a thaang taltham zo a, eite suakta hi hing!"},"8":{"text":"Simlei vantung a vawt Topa kung panin eite hong huna hong pai ahi hi."}}},"125":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa a muangte in a ngawk thei ngeingawl, a kikhiin thei ngeingawl Zion Mual bang ahi hi.","title":"Pathian Mite Ngammuanna"},"2":{"text":"Mualpite in Jerusalem kiim uum in a om bangma Topa in a mite kiim ah tu le a tawntungin om hi."},"3":{"text":"Thutangte ii ngam le lei sia mihing seksolte in a tawntungin a uk buatu hi; uk tawntung thong le a thutangte mama in zongh siatna vawt thei tha tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa awng, mihing phate tungah dik in a, na thupiakna a zuite phat vawt ta'n."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang mihing seksolte daan na piak ciangin nangma ii thu le la a taisante zongh daan na pia in. Israel te tungah kilemna om tahen!"}}},"126":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Jerusalem ah hong ciapui kik ciangin mang bang phet ma ahi hi!","title":"Suatak natu Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Bangza in ih nui a, lungdam in la ih sa ziam! Tuasia ciang minam dangte in ei huvau sia, “ Topa in amate atu in na lianpi seam zo hi” a ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Na lianpite ei atu hong seam takpi zo hi; bangza in ih lungdam ziam!"},"4":{"text":"Nguntui kang a, a kona munah ngua in tui a puak kik bangin, Topa awng, ko hong nuamsasak kik ta'n."},"5":{"text":"Thitui taak a, thaicii a tute sia lungdamna taw an lasak in!"},"6":{"text":"Thitui taak a thaicii pua in a kuante sia anla a hong cia kik uh ciangin lungdam in la a sa tu uh hi."}}},"127":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in inn a sa buale inn sate ii dianna in a luithawthong ahi hi; Topa in khuapi a dal buale ngalvilte ii cinna sia a luithawthong ahi hi.","title":"Pathian ii Phatna Pokna"},"2":{"text":"Zingsang thopal a, nitak lum hakin kivaak kitaa natu nasia takin nasep sia, a luithawthong ahi hi. Banghang ziam cile Topa in ama ii itte a mutthip lanin hu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tanu tapate sia Topa hong piak letsong hi; amate sia thupha tatak khat ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihing khat ii a khanmoi lai a hin tapate sia ngalkap khat ii khut sungah a om thaltangte bang ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuabang thaltang tam a neipa sia mihing lungdam ahi hi. Thukhenna munah a ngalte taw a kisik ciangin ama in a lel ngei buatu hi."}}},"128":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa thu ni a, a thupiakte babangin a nungtate in mihing lungdamte ahi uh hi.","title":"Thunitna Thaman"},"2":{"text":"Na nasepna in na kisap tu teng hong sik tu hi; nangma in na lungdam tu a, na nuamsa tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Na zi in na inn sungah a ngathiam sapitkung taw kibang tu a, na sabuai kiim ah na tate in olive kung moite taw kibang tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa thu a ni mihing khat sia, tu a bang keakin thupha kipia takpi tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in Zion panin nangma thupha hong pia tahen! Na khan tawntung Jerusalem nopsakna hong musak tahen!"},"6":{"text":"Tunu tupa mealmu tu in hong nungtasak tahen! Israel te tungah kilemna om tahen!"}}},"129":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel te awng, na khangmoi lai pan ma kipan na ngalte in bangza in hong vawtsia zo ziam ko tungah hong son ta'n.","title":"Israel ii Ngalte Langpan Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"“Khangmoi ka hi lai pan ma kipan ka ngalte in hong vawtsia zazaan hi, ahihang amate in hong zo zo ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in ka nungzaang nasia takin hong liamsak a, lo kitho vuungsa khat bangin hong vawt hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang a thutang pa Topa in saltanna panin hong suatak zo hi.”"},"5":{"text":"Zion a ensante theampo in lelna le nawkeakna thuak tahen."},"6":{"text":"Amate sia innkhum tungah a po, a khan ma a kocip lopate bang hi tahen;"},"7":{"text":"tuate sia kuama in khawmtua ngawl a, a lom in zongh kipua ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuate kaantan in a pai a kuama po in, “ Topa in thupha hong pia tahen! Topa min taw thupha hong pia khu hi” ci ngawl tu hi."}}},"130":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa awng, ka thinkiam dikdekna panin nang kong biakpui hi.","title":"Hu natu Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Topa awng, ka auna hong za ta'n; hu ngen a kong sapna hong ngai ta'n!"},"3":{"text":"Nangma in ko mawnate hong tepteesak hi thong lete akua peuma puavawkna pan suakta thei tu ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Ahihang nangma hong thasia in kong din thei natu uh in, nangma in tua mawnate nong maisak hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa hong hu natu lawpin ka ngakla a, ama kammal ka muang hi."},"6":{"text":"Ngalvilte in zingsang khuavak tu kaal a ngalaak mama sangin, Topa ka ngakla zaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel te awng, Topa muang vun, banghang ziam cile ama ii itna in kip a, ama in hong hunnuam tawntung hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in Israel a mite sia amate mawna theampo panin ngum tu hi.","ref":"Mt 1:21; Tit 2:14"}}},"131":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa awng, ka kiphatsaknate ka kheal zo a, ka kisaktheinate ka nungngat zo hi. Thu liante ahizong, kei atu a haksa leilam thute ahizong patau in ka nei bua hi.","title":"Kiniamkhiak in Muanna taw Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Tua taangin lungkim thinnuamin ka om zaw hi. Nute kaang sungah nauno khat ommuangin a lup bangin ka sungah lungmuanna om hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel te awng, Topa sia, tu le a tawntungin muang tavun."}}},"132":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa awng, David le ama ii thuak haksatnate mangil heak in.","title":"Biakinnpi Pokna"},"2":{"text":"Topa awng, a vaanglian Jacob ii Pathian, nangma tungah hong kamciamna, hong kiciamnate phawk in:"},"3":{"text":"“Inn ah ka cia buatu a, lupna ka zuan buatu hi;"},"4":{"text":"Topa atu mun khat, a vaanglian Jacob ii Pathian teenna tu inn khat, ka piak mateng,"},"5":{"text":"ka tawlnga buatu a, ka mu buatu hi,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Bethlehem khua ah Thuciamna Thingkuang huvau ka za uh a, Jearim lote sungah tua thingkuang ka mu uh hi.","ref":"2 Khang 6:41-42"},"7":{"text":"“ Topa inn ah pai tawng; a kumpi tokhum mai pan bia tawng” ka ci uh hi.","ref":"1 Kum 11:36"},"8":{"text":"Topa awng, na vaangletna lim ahi, na Thuciamna Thingkuang taw na Biakinnpi sungah hong pai ta'n a, hi sungah a tawntungin hong om ta'n."},"9":{"text":"Na thiampite in a maan sepnate vawt tawntung tahen; na mihingte in lungdamna taw au tahen!"},"10":{"text":"Na naseampa David tungah kamciamna khat na pia hi; Topa awng, na tealsa kumpipa nial heak in."},"11":{"text":"David tungah ciliap huai takin kamciamna khat na pia hi; tua kamciam sia na dawk kik tu in na piak ahi bua hi; “Na tapate sung panin khat kumpi ka suaksak tu a, ama in nang zawkciang ngam a uk tu hi.","ref":"2 Sa 7:12-16; 1 Khang 17:11-14; Ps 89:3-4; Sawl 2:30"},"12":{"text":"Na tate in ka thuciamna sungah thumaan a, amate tungah ka piak thute a zui le, amate ii tate zongh in a tawntungin kumpi suakin na za hong lua tu hi,” na ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in Zion sia teal zo hi; ama teenna tu in vawt nuam hi."},"14":{"text":"“Hi sia in a tawntungin, ka teen natu mun ahi hi; hi mun in ka uk nopna mun ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Zion tungah ama kisap theampo kicing takin ka pia tu hi; a mizawngte an pia in ka lungkimsak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"A thiampite sia a sepna theampo ah thupha ka pia tu a, ama mihingte in lasa in lungdamna taw a au tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Hi sungah David ii suan khat sia kumpi lian khatin ka siam tu hi; hi sungah ka tealsa kumpipa ukna ka keamcing tu hi.","ref":"1 Kum 11:36"},"18":{"text":"A ngalte sia maizumna taw ka tuam tu a, ahizong ama ii kumpingam khangto in nuamsa tu hi,” na ci hi."}}},"133":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ii mihingte kituiton takin a teen khop uh ciang bangza in lamdang a, bangza in nuam ziam!","title":"Kilemin Nuntakna Pokna"},"2":{"text":"Tua in Aaron lu tungah a kibuak a luzang pan a khamul ah a puantual kithepna mong dong a luangsuk sathau manpha sia taw kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Hermon Mualvum tungah daaitui Zion mualte tungah a kia sia taw kibang hi. Tuasia in tawpna a nei ngawl nuntakna a kici Topa ii thupha piak tu a kamciamna mun ahi hi."}}},"134":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zan hun sung Biakinn sungah a naseam, ama ii naseamte theampo awng, hong pai tavun a, Topa pok vun!","title":"Pathian Pok natu Sapna"},"2":{"text":"Ama Biakinn sungah thungetna taw na khut uh laam vun a, Topa pok vun!"},"3":{"text":"Van le lei a vawt Topa in Zion panin, note thupha hong pia tahen!"}}},"135":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pok vun! No Topa naseamte awng, ama min pok vun.","title":"Pokna La"},"2":{"text":"Topa ii inn sung le, ih Pathian Biakinnpi sungah a dingte awng, Topa pok vun!"},"3":{"text":"Topa pok vun, banghang ziam cile ama pha hi; ama ii min pokna late sa vun, banghang ziam cile ama dik hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in ama atu in Jacob teal a, ama aituam tu in Israel mite teal hi."},"5":{"text":"Ih Topa lian hi ci in ka he a, pathian dang theampo sangin lianzaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Vantung le leitung ah ahizong, tuipi sung le a nuai a thuknate ah ahizong ama uuk pawpo a vawt hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in leitung mong panin vuipi meeite hong puak hi; ama in vuipi suangvalte atu in khualeng vawt a, tuaciangin vuite sia ama ii kholna sung panin pusua hi."},"8":{"text":"Egypt ngam ah ama in mihing le nganhingte ii taciil tek a kibangin thatlum hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua munah nalamdangte le a lamdadangte kumpipa le a upate daan piak natu in vawt hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in ngam tuatuam tam ma susia a, a thahat kumpite thatlum hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuate sungah Amor kumpipa Sihon, Bashan kumpipa Og, le Canaan kumpi theampo kihel hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate ii leitangte sia ama in a mite pia hi; ama in tuate Israel mite pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa awng, nangma sia Pathian hi ci in a tawntungin hong kithangsak tu hi; khang theampo in nang hong phawk tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in ama ii mihingte hung tu hi; ama in a naseamte hesuak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua minamte ii pathiante sia mihingte ii khut taw a vawt tawm khamh le ngunn taw a kivawtte ahi hi.","ref":"Ps 115:4-8; Tpl 9:20"},"16":{"text":"Amate in kam nei ahihang a pau thei bua hi, mit nei ahihang a mu thei bua uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in bil nei ahihang khua a za thei bua uh hi; amate sia hu ngawngawn a sang thei bua uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuate a vawtte le a muangte theampo sia amate vawt sa milimte bangma suak tahen!"},"19":{"text":"Israel mite awng, Topa pok vun; no Pathian thiampite awng, ama pok vun!"},"20":{"text":"No Levi mite awng, Topa pok vun; no ama a biate theampo awng, ama pok vun!"},"21":{"text":"Topa sia Zion ah pok vun, a inn ahi Jerusalem ah pok vun. Topa pok vun!"}}},"136":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa tungah lungdamko vun, banghang ziam cile ama pha hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi.","title":"Lungdamkona La","ref":"1 Khang 16:34; 2 Khang 5:13; 7:3; Ezra 3:11; Ps 100:5; 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; Jer 33:11"},"2":{"text":"Pathiante theampo sung pan a lianbel pa tungah lungdamko vun, ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"3":{"text":"To theampo sung pan a thahatbel pa tungah lungdamko vun, ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama bek in nalamdang lakna liante vawt hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama ciimna taw vantungte vawt hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pian 1:1"},"6":{"text":"Ama in simlei sia tuithukna tungah sa hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pian 1:2"},"7":{"text":"Ama in ni le tha vawt hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pian 1:16"},"8":{"text":"Ni in sun hun a uksak hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi;"},"9":{"text":"tha le aksi te in zan hun uksak hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in Egypt te ii tapaciil teng that hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pu 12:29"},"11":{"text":"Ama in Israel mite Egypt ngam panin pusuapui hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi;","ref":"Pu 12:51"},"12":{"text":"a khut tha khona, a vaanglian baan taw pusuapui hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in San Tuipi khen hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Pu 14:21-29"},"14":{"text":"tuasia kaantan in a mite lampui hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi;"},"15":{"text":"ahihang Egypt kumpipa le a ngalkap teng tuitaasak hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a mite sennealngam kaantan in lampui hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in a thahat kumpite that hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi;"},"18":{"text":"Ama in kumpi minthangte thatlum hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"19":{"text":"Amor mite kumpipa, Sihon thatlum hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Mi 21:21-30"},"20":{"text":"tuaciang Bashan kumpipa Og thatlum hi, ama ii itna kip tawntung hi.","ref":"Mi 21:31-35"},"21":{"text":"Amate ngam teng a mite piaksak hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"22":{"text":"A naseam Israel te tungah tua ngamte pia hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"23":{"text":"Ngal ih lel ciangin ama in hong mangil ngawl hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in ih ngalte khut sung panin hong suatak hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama in nuntakna nei theampo an pia hi; ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."},"26":{"text":"Vantung a om Pathian tungah lungdamko vun, ama ii itna kip tawntung hi."}}},"137":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon ngunte hui ah ka to uh hi; tua munah Zion ka phawk uh ciangin ka kap uh hi.","title":"Saltaang Israel te Kaana"},"2":{"text":"A nai a om pakngiam kungte tungah ka tengtonghte uh ka khai uh hi;"},"3":{"text":"Ko hong pummatte in lasa in hong sawl hi. Amate ngualnop natu in “Zion la hong sak tavun” hong ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngual ngam ngual lei ah bangbangin Topa tungah lasa thei tu khu ziam?"},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem awng, nang kong mangil le tengtongh zongh tum thei ngei nawn bua tong!"},"6":{"text":"Nang sia ka lungdamna lianbel na hi hunlam kong ngaisun bua a, nang kong mangil le, la zongh sa kik thei ngei nawn bua tong!"},"7":{"text":"Topa awng, Jerusalem a kilaak ni in Edom te ngamtatna na phawk in. “A bul dongin sutham vun” a ci kikik uh sia na phawk in."},"8":{"text":"Babylon awng, nang sia hong kilalsak tu hi. Kote tungah nong vawtna sa teng hong thuk kik te —","ref":"Tpl 18:6"},"9":{"text":"na nausente uh hong laaksak in suangpi tungah hong teaklupsak te sia mihing lungdamte ahi uh hi."}}},"138":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa awng, ka thin theampo taw lungdam kong ko hi; tua pathiante mai ah nangma pokna la kong sak hi.","title":"Lungdamko Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"A thiangtho na Biakinnpi sang maingatin, kunin na min kong pok hi, banghang ziam cile itna kip le na thumaanna hang ahi hi, na min le na thupiaknate sia a lianbel in nong lak hang hi."},"3":{"text":"Kong sam ciangin nong zo kik hi, na thahatna taw kei nong thakhosak hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa awng, leitung ah kumpi theampo in nang hong pok tu hi, banghang ziam cile na kamciamte amate in za zo uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in na sep na vawt sate le na minthanna liante huvau in la hong sak tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Nang sia tungsang ah, saang mama na hihang, a kiniamkhiakte na khoi a, a kiphasakte sia nang kung panin a buu thei bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngimnate in kei hong uumci ciangin nangma in nong keamcing hi. A thin uuk ka ngalte nong dosak a na vaangletna taw kei nong hun hi."},"8":{"text":"Na kamciamsa theampo na seam tu hi; Topa awng, na itna kip tawntung hi. Na patsa nasep sia a khuangkhim dongin hong seam ta'n."}}},"139":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa awng, nangma in nong sit ngiingeei zo a nong he hi.","title":"Pathian ii A kicing Heakna le Khoina"},"2":{"text":"Nangma in ka sep ka vawt theampo na he hi; ka ngaisutna theampo a khuala na panin na he hi."},"3":{"text":"Na ka sep laitak ahizong, ka tawlngak laitak ahizong, nong mu hi; ka ngamtatna theampo na he hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka pau ma ngawngawn in ka son tu teng na he zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangma in ka kiimkot mun theampo ah na om hi; na vaangletna taw kei nong dal hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei nong heakna sia thuk mama a; kei tel zawk ahi bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma pial in koisung zuan thei tu khi ziam? Nang omna pan koisungah ka tai thei tu ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Vantung ah paito kaleng zong tua munah na om hi; mithi khua ah lum kaleng zong tua munah na om hi."},"9":{"text":"Nisuana kalhin ka leang hial zong ahibuale nitumna sang a khuala belna ah teang kaleng zong"},"10":{"text":"kei hong lampui tu in tua mun ma ah na om tu hi, kei hong hu tu in tua mun ma ah na om tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Khuazing ii hong sealcip natu, tua ahibuale ka kiimkot khuavak sia zan a suak tu in ka ngen thei hi,"},"12":{"text":"ahihang khuazing ngawngawn nang atu zing tuan ngawl a, zan sia sun bangin a taang hi. Khuazing le khuavak sia nang atu in kibang hi."},"13":{"text":"Nangma in ka pumpi sungah a om na theampo na bitphua hi; Ka nu naubu sungah ka pumpi nong ngawmtua hi."},"14":{"text":"Nangma kong pok hi, banghang ziam cile nangma in kiitak tu na hi hi; na sep na vawt theampo tumdangin lamdang hi. Tuasia ka thinsung theampo taw ka he hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka ngute kipiangsak in, ka nu naubu sungah pha takin kingawmtua a, a thimtham in ka khanto hunin, tua munah ka om hunlam nong he hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka sua ma in kei nong mu zo hi. Kei atu hong kisee sa ni le hunte a kipat ma in na laibu sungah kiciamtee siat zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Pathian awng, na khua ngaisutnate sia kei tel tu bangza haksa ziam, bangzata tam ziam!"},"18":{"text":"Keima in tuate sim hi leng senvui za sangin tamzaw tu hi. Ka khanlaw ciang zong nangma taw ma ka omkhawm lai hi."},"19":{"text":"Pathian awng, mihing seksolte hong thalupsak le te ka uuk hi! mihing ngoltolte, kei hong nusia in tai le ka uuk hi!"},"20":{"text":"Amate in nangma taw kisai in seksol kamte hong zangh uh hi; na min siat thethei natu in pau uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa awng, nang hong ngaimawte bangza in ngaimaw khi ziam! Nang hong langpante bangza in ensan khi ziam!"},"22":{"text":"Amate sia ngaimawk tawpin ka ngaimaw hi; amate keima ngal bangin ka nei hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei hong sit ta'n, Pathian awng, ka thinsung hong he ta'n; hong sittel ta'n a, ka ngaisutnate a thakin na mu in."},"24":{"text":"Ka sungah siatna a om ziam hong mu ta'n a, tawntung lampi ah kei lam hong pui ta'n."}}},"140":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihing tatsiate kung panin hong hun ta'n, Topa awng, mihing ngoltolte kung panin hong keamcing ta'n.","title":"Kidal natu Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Amate in a tawntungin a sia vawt tu a sawm ku uh a, kihau thei natu in ngual a hol tawntung uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate ii leeite sia hong thisak thei ngulte taw kibang a; amate kammal in ngulsok ii nguu bang ahi hi.","ref":"Rom 3:13"},"4":{"text":"A seksolte thahatna panin hong dal tan Topa awng, ka puk natu hong sawm ku a ngoltol mite kung panin hong keamcing ta'n."},"5":{"text":"Mihing kiphasak te in thaang hong sia hi; amate in khau thaangte pha in lamdung ah kei hong mat natu in thaangte keaksa in koi uh hi."},"6":{"text":"“Nangma in ka Pathian na hi hi,” Topa tungah ka ci hi.
