Topa awng, hu ngen a kong auna hong za ta'n!"},"7":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa ka Topa awng, a tha kho kei hong hungpa, nangma in ngal kidona sungah nong dal zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa awng, a seksolte ii deite pia heak in; amate sawmku thute taangtungsak heak in."},"9":{"text":"Ka ngalte in hong zosak heak in; amate ii kei hong tawn nate amate tungah tusak kik in."},"10":{"text":"Meikam san vahem te amate tungah taak tahen; dum sungah amate kilawn suk tahen a, pusuak ngei nawn heak hen."},"11":{"text":"Midangte maw a suan khialte, zawna nga heak hen; mihing ngoltolte sia siatna in ban tahen a, lalsak tahen."},"12":{"text":"Topa awng, nangma in mizawngte vai le, a cimawte ii nga tu a kilawm thute ah na panpui sia ka he hi."},"13":{"text":"A thutangte in nang hong pok takpi tu hi; amate sia nangma ii omna munah teang tu uh hi."}}},"141":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nang kong sam hi, Topa; tu in hong hu ta'n! Kong sam ciangin hong ngai ta'n.","title":"Nitak Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Kong thungetna a namtui biakpiakna in hong saang ta'n a, ka khutte kong lapto sia nitak sangaw biakpiakna khat bangin hong saang ta'n.","ref":"Tpl 5:8"},"3":{"text":"Topa , ka kam ah a cing tu khat, ka muk kongkha ah a cing khat koi in."},"4":{"text":"A maan ngawl sep nopna le, mihing tatsiate seksolnate panpui nopna pan hong keam ta'n. Amate ii anneak poai sungah ka kihel ngei buatu hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing pha khat in deisakna taw hong teih in daan zongh hong pia thei hi, ahihang mihing ngilote ii upatna ka saang ngei buatu hi, banghang ziam cile amate ngamtat siatnate langpanin thu ka ngen tawntung hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate a ukte sia suangliang tung panin a kilotsuk tak ciang mihingte in ka kammalte sia maan sa tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"A bebek in a ki ektham thing bangin amate ii ngute sia thaan kiil ah kithethaang tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang nang kong muang tawntung hi, Vaanglianpipa ka Topa awng. Nong dalna ka zong hi; Hong thisak heak in!"},"9":{"text":"Amate ii kei hong siana thaangte panin hong dal ta'n a, thusia vawtte khauthaang panin hong hung ta'n."},"10":{"text":"Kei bangma tat ngawlin ka pai laitakin, a seksolte sia amate ii thaang sung ma ah awk tahen."}}},"142":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hu ngenin Topa ka sam hi; ama ka maangkaa hi,","title":"Hu natu Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Ka lungkim ngawlna theampo ama ka puak hi; ka ngim ngana theampo ama tungah ka son hi."},"3":{"text":"A cimaw hi zo ing ci tu in ka kithoai ciang, ama in ka ngamtat natu he hi. Ka lampi totna ah ka ngalte in kei thaang hong sia ku zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka kiim ka paam ka et ciangin kei hong hu tu kuama ka mu bua hi, kuama hong dal tu a om bua hi. Kuama in kei hong awlmawk bua hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa awng, nang tungah hu ngenin kong au hi; Topa , nangma in kei hong dalpa na hi hi; hi nuntakna sungah ka dei theampo kicinna in nangma na hi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hu ngen a, kong auna hong ngai ta'n, banghang ziam cile ka thin kiamcip zo hi. Ka ngalte kung panin hong hun ta'n; amate sia kei atu in hat lei hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka thinngimna pan suatakna hong pia ta'n, tuasia ciang kei tungah nong phatna hangin na mite kikhopna sungah nang kong pok tu hi."}}},"143":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa awng, ka thungetna hong za ta'n! Na thutang sungah kong maangkaana hong ngai ta'n; na thumaanna hangin kei hong zo ta'n!","title":"Hu natu Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Kei na naseampa thusitna hong thuaksak heak in; nang muna ah a maw ngawl kuama a om bua hi.","ref":"Rom 3:20; Gal 2:16"},"3":{"text":"Ka ngalpa in savai bangin hong vai a hong zothal hi. Ama in thongzing khat sungah hong khum zo a, ngei tawngh lai ah a thisate bang ka hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom, a cimaw hi zo ing ci tu in ka kithoai a, ka thinkiam dikdek hi."},"5":{"text":"A bosa nite ka phawk hi, na sepsa theampo ka ngaisun hi, na ngamtatna sa theampo ka thin sungah ka sut kikik hi."},"6":{"text":"Thungenin ka khutte nang kungah kong laamto hi; lei ko bangin ka thaa in nang hong dangtaak law hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu ma in hong zo ta'n, Topa ! lametna theampo ka bosua zo hi. Kei kung panin buu heak in, na buu le kei sia mithi khua a zuansukte taw ka omkhawm tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Zing simin na itna kip hong phawksak kik ta'n, banghang ziam cile nangma kong muang hi. Ka thungetnate nang kung hong theng hi, ka tot tu lampi hong lak ta'n."},"9":{"text":"Kidalna nga tu in nang kungah kong pai hi, Topa ; ka ngalte kung panin hong suatak ta'n."},"10":{"text":"Nangma in ka Pathian na hi hi; na deina bang ka vawt thei natu hong hil ta'n. Kei tungah hong dik ta'n a, a muanhuai lampi ah lam hong pui ta'n."},"11":{"text":"Topa awng, nong kamciamsa bangma in hong suatak ta'n; na phatna taw ka ngim ngana sung pan hong hun ta'n!"},"12":{"text":"Kei nong itna hu in ka ngalte that in a, kei hong zothaw theampo na susia in, banghang ziam cile kei sia na naseampa ka hi hi."}}},"144":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei hong sungsia pa Topa pok vun! Ama in ngal kidozia kei hong hil a, ngalsim tu in hong kingingtasak hi.","title":"Zawna nga Kumpipa ii Pathian tungah Lungdamkona"},"2":{"text":"Ama in kei hong dalpa le hong hungpa ahi hi, ka belhna le ka ngumpa, ngammuan natu in, ka muanpa ahi hi. Ama in minamte ka khutnuai ah om tu in hong zawsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa awng, nangma in na phaw tham tu in a thithei mihingte bang hi a; a thithei lelte po banghangin thusim ni ziam?","ref":"Job 7:17-18; Ps 8:4"},"4":{"text":"Amate sia vui muut khat taw kibang hi; amate ii khan sia a kaantan ziau limh khat bang ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa awng, van khentham in hong pai suk ta'n; mualte tham in, tua hile tuate in meikhu pusua tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Khualeng tee vazalte tha in a, na ngalte thethaang in; na thaltangte kap in a, amate taikeaksak in."},"7":{"text":"Tungsang panin hong baansuk ta'n. Tuithukna pan hong dokto ta'n a, hong suatak ta'n; ngamdang mite thahatna panin hong hun ta'n,"},"8":{"text":"amate in thumaan son ngeingawl a, kiciam napi leilot lai hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang tungah la thak khat kong sak tu hi, Pathian awng; tengtongh tumin la kong sak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipate tungah zawna na pia a, na naseampa David na suatak hi."},"11":{"text":"A ngilo ka ngalte kung panin hong hun ta'n; thumaan son ngeingawl a, kiciamna ngawngawn taw a leilot lai, ngamdangmite thahatna panin hong suatak ta'n."},"12":{"text":"Ka tapate uh a khanmoi lai in thahatin a khang thingkungte bang hi tahen. Ka tanute uh sia kumpi inn kingte a zeam khuam hoite taw kibang tahen."},"13":{"text":"Ka ansaal uhte an namcin taw kidim tahen a, ka lo sungah tuute in a tul a then in pung tahen."},"14":{"text":"Ka khuite uh zongh a no tol, a sumsi om ngawlin ta tam mama nei tahen. Khua sung ih lampite ah ngim nga kikona aw nging heak hen."},"15":{"text":"Hi thute bangin a piang minam sia mi nuamsa ahi hi; Pathian sia Topa in a nei mite in mihing lungdamte ahi uh hi."}}},"145":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na letna ka thangsak tu hi, ka Pathian le ka kumpipa awng; a tawntung a tawntungin lungdam kong ko tu hi.","title":"Pokna La"},"2":{"text":"Ni simin nang tungah lungdam kong ko tu hi; a tawntung a tawntungin nang kong pok tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa sia lian ahikom, nasia takin pok tu ahi hi; ama ii letna in tel zawk ahi bua hi."},"4":{"text":"Na sepsate hu in khang khat panin khang khat ah hong kipok tu hi; amate in a nasia mama na sepnate thangsak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in na minthanna le na letnazia son tu uh a, a lamdang na sepnate thuk takin ka ngaisusun tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihingte in a lianpi na sepnate son tu a, na letna ka thangsak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in na phatna theampo son tu a, na thuthiamna la in sa tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in itna le hesuakna nei a, thinsau in itna kip taw kidim hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama sia mihing sim tungah pha in, a vawt theampo tungah mulkimna nei hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa awng, na bitphua sa nuntakna nei theampo in nang hong pok tu a, na mite theampo in lungdam hong ko tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in na kumpi vaangletna ii minthanna sia thuson in nei tu a, na thakhona thu son tu uh hi,"},"12":{"text":"tuasia ciang mihing theampo in na sepna lianpite he tu a, na kumpingam sungah na minthanzia hong he tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Na ukna kip tawntung a, nang sia a tawntungin kumpipa na hi hi. Topa in a kamciamnate tungah thumaan a, a ngamtatna sung theampo ah hesuak thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in ngim a ngate theampo hu hi; a puksa theampo phongto hi."},"15":{"text":"Nuntakna a nei theampo in lametna taw nang hong mitsuan a, amate kisap ciangin an na pia hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate a kikhom in na pia a, kitaangsapna theampo ah a lung na kimsak hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in ama ii sepna theampo sungah thutang a, a ngamtatna sung theampo ah hesuak thei hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama a kote, thintak taw a samte nai ah ama om hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama a zaktate ii kitaangsapnate ama in sik hi; amate auna za in hun hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama a it theampo ama in sungsia hi, ahihang a seksolte susia tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa ka pok tawntung tu hi; ama bitphua sa nuntakna nei theampo in a min thiangtho a tawntungin pok tahen."}}},"146":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pok vun! Ka thaa awng, Topa pok in!","title":"Ngumpa Pathian Pokna"},"2":{"text":"Ka nuntak lai teng ama ka pok tu hi; ka khan tawntung ka Pathian tungah la ka sa tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Na muanna uh sia mihing lampuite tungah koi heak vun; mihing kuama in no hong hun thei ngawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate a thi ciangin leivui ah cia kik uh hi; tua ni in amate ngealna theampo bo hi."},"5":{"text":"Jacob ii Pathian sia ama ii hupa in a neipa le Topa sia amate ii Pathian in, a muangte sia mi nuamsate hi a,"},"6":{"text":"ama sia vantung, leitung le tuipi, tua teng sung a om theampo a Bitphuapa ahi hi. Ama in a kamciamte kholet tawntung hi;","ref":"Sawl 4:24; 14:15"},"7":{"text":"Zawthawk a thuakte sangah pangin thukhen a, a ngilkialte an pia hi. Topa in thongtaakte suaktasak hi,"},"8":{"text":"mittawte khua musak hi. Ama in a puk sate phongto hi; a thutang ama mite it hi."},"9":{"text":"Ih ngam sungah khualmi hong teangte ama in sungsia hi; ama in meingongte le tangate hu hi, ahihang a seksolte sia siatcip natu munah then hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa sia a tawntung kumpipa ahi hi. Zion awng, na Pathian sia hun theampo ah maang tu hi. Topa pok vun!"}}},"147":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pok vun! Ih Pathian tungah, pokna la sak tu pha hi; ama pok tu sia nuam a maan hi.","title":"Vaanglianbelpa Pathian Pokna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Jerusalem thaksua kik a, ngamdang ah saltaangte hong ciapui kik hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in thin kitamhte damsak a, a liammate tuamsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in aksite a phakza tu see a, khat sim a min taw sam hi."},"5":{"text":"A lian a thakho sia eite Topa hi; ama ciimna in kitee thei ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a kiniamkhiak te laamto a, ahihang a seksolte lei ah sucip hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa tungah pokna biakna late sak vun; Ih Pathian tungah tengtongh taw music tum vun!"},"8":{"text":"Ama in van ah meeite phalh hi; ama in leitung atu in nguatui pia a, mualte tungah lopa posak hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in nganhingte an pia a, va-ak note a au uh ciang anvaak hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama ii nuam a sak sia siphu thahatte hi ngawl a, ama ii dik a sak zongh ngalkap hangte ahi bua hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang ama in ama a zaktate le ama ii itna kip a muangte tungah lungkim hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa pok in, Jerusalem awng! Na Pathian pok in, Zion awng!"},"13":{"text":"Ama in na kongpite khosak a, na mite thupha pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Na ngamngi uhte bitsak a, zungtaang phabelte taw hong lungkimsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in simleitung ah thupia a, ama ci babang, a manlang in kiseam hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in vuuk sia puanvan khat taw kibangin phalh a, thuamluak sia leivui bangin thethaang hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in ngial sia suangpim bangin puak a, ama puak khuasik sia kuama in a thuak zo bua hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuasia ciang ama in thupia a, tuikhalte tuitham hi; ama in vui vasak a, tui luangsak hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in a mite tungah thupuak a, lamlaknate le thukhamte Israel te pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in minam dangte tungah hi bangin a seam bua hi; amate in ama thukhamte a he bua uh hi. Topa pok vun!"}}},"148":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pok vun! No, tungsang a saangna a teangte awng, vantung panin Topa pok vun.","title":"Vaannuai ii Pathian A pok natu Sapna"},"2":{"text":"Ama ii vantunglalang theampo, ama ii vantung ngalkaphonpi theampo awng, ama pok vun."},"3":{"text":"Ni le tha awng, ama pok vun; a taang aksite awng, ama pok vun."},"4":{"text":"A saangbel vantungte le van ii tungsia a om tuite awng, ama pok vun."},"5":{"text":"Amate theampo in Topa ii min pok tek tahen! Ama in thupia a, amate kibitphua hi;"},"6":{"text":"Ama thupiakna taw amate sia a om na sasan tek ah a tawntungin kikoi a, tuaciang amate in a thu ni ngawlin a om thei bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Leitung panin Topa pok vun, tuipi nganhingpuite le tuipi thukte;"},"8":{"text":"a thupiak a zui khualeng le ngialte, vuuk le meeite, vui thahatte awng."},"9":{"text":"Pok vun, mualniamte le mualsaangte, a nga thei thingkungte le taamthingte;"},"10":{"text":"innsa ngamsa nganhing theampo, a awmtaal nganhingte le vacimte awng."},"11":{"text":"Ama pok vun, kumpipate le mihing theampo, kumpi tate le a dang ngamukte;"},"12":{"text":"ngaknunote le tangvalnote, khanghaamte le patangnote zongh in pok vun."},"13":{"text":"Amate theampo in Topa ii min pok tek tahen! Ama ii min in a dang theampo sangin lianzaw hi; ama ii minthanna in van le lei ii tungsia ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama ii a it mama Israel mite ahi ama mite theampo in ama a pok natu in ama in ama ii minam thahatsak hi. Topa pok vun!"}}},"149":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pok vun! Topa tungah la thak khat sa vun; a thumaan a mite kikhopna sungah ama pok vun!","title":"Pokna La"},"2":{"text":"Israel te awng, nang hong Bitphuapa hangin lungdam vun; Zion mite awng, na kumpipa hangin lawp vun."},"3":{"text":"Ama min sia lapna taw pok vun; ama pokna in khuang le tengtonghte tum vun."},"4":{"text":"Topa in a mite tungtaang ah thinnopna nei hi; ama in a kiniamkhiak te zawna taw patoai hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian ii mihingte in zawna mualsuana tungah lawp in zankhuateak lungdam takin late sa tek tahen."},"6":{"text":"Pathian a pok ciang nasia takin au tahen,"},"7":{"text":"minam dangte zaw natu le, a mihingte daan piak natu;"},"8":{"text":"a kumpipate thikkhau a khii natu, a lampuite uh thikkol a bul natu le,"},"9":{"text":"Pathian thupiak bangin minam dangte daan a piak natu in a khut sungah namsau hiamte toai kawm tahen. Hisia in Pathian mite ii zawna ahi hi. Topa pok vun!"}}},"150":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa pok vun! Pathian sia ama Biakinnpi sungah pok vun! Vantung ah ama ii thahatna pok vun!","title":"Pok vun!"},"2":{"text":"A sep sa na lianpite hu in ama pok vun. Ama ii letna lianpi pok vun."},"3":{"text":"Lemlete taw ama pok vun! Tengtonghte le liamlo te taw ama pok vun."},"4":{"text":"Khuangte le lapna taw ama pok vun. Tengtonghte le tamngaite taw ama pok vun."},"5":{"text":"Daalkopsaite taw ama pok vun. Daalkopsai nging tatak taw ama pok vun."},"6":{"text":"Nuntakna a nei theampo in Topa pok vun! Topa pok vun!"}}}}},"20":{"info":{"name":"Paunak","shortname":"Prov","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon ii paunakte ahi hi.","title":"Paunakte Manneina","ref":"1 Kum 4:32"},"2":{"text":"Hisung a paunakte in ciimna le ngaisutpha khentel natu le a khiakna thuk kamtepteete tel natu in hong hu tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuate in pilvangna taw bangbangin nungta tu, bangbangin thumaan tu a, thutang tu, thukhual tu ci in nang hong hil thei tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuate in heakna a nei ngawl lai khat pilsak thei tu a, tuaciang in khangnote kicinna a nei thei natu dan hil hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi paunakte in a ciimte ii heakna ngawngawn belap thei a, pilna saang a neite lamlak hi,"},"6":{"text":"tuasia ciangin amate in paunakte ii a kiseal khiaknate he thei tu a, mihing ciimte dok thu telhakte zongh tel thei tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Heakna na nei natu in Topa thasiana na nei phot kul hi. Mihing mawmawte in ciimna awlmawk ngawlin kan nuam ngawl hi.","title":"Khangmoite Ngaisut Piakna","ref":"Job 28:28; Ps 111:10; Pau 9:10"},"8":{"text":"Na pa le na nu hong sonte pha takin nadon in, ka tapa awng."},"9":{"text":"Amate hong hilnate in a et hoi dial khat, khi khat ii na meal hong hoi tuamsak bangin na pianzia hong etlawmsak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, mimawte hong ze et ciangin zui heak in."},"11":{"text":"A zezen in, amate in “Hong pai ta'n; ih thalup tu khat zong ka tawng! Mawna nei ngawl khat cimthoina in ngalvawt sin ve tawng!"},"12":{"text":"Amate ih mu tangin nungta a, ciidam hikale amate tungah ih law nop teng ih man zawkciang thi siat tu hi!"},"13":{"text":"Hauna namcin le ih innte sia ih sutol vanhte taw a kidim in ih mu tu hi!"},"14":{"text":"Hong pai ta'n a hong pawm ta'n, ih nguk theampo ih hawm tek tu hi,” hong ci tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, mihing tuabangte taw kithawl heak in. Amate kung pan kiheam in."},"16":{"text":"Amate in a sia khat a vawt tu ngakla hi. Amate in thatlum tu in kinging tawntung hi."},"17":{"text":"Na mat nop vacim sia ii mu tangin thaang nasia hang, bangma phatuam ngawl hi,"},"18":{"text":"ahihang mihing tuabangte in amate le amate thaang kisia uh a, tua thaang sungah amate thi tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing suamna in a suamte nuntakna siik kik vaciat hi, ngoltolna taw a nungta khat pawpo tungah tuabang ma in tung hi."},"20":{"text":"Ngai in! Ciimna in khuapi lampi liante sung le vanhzuakna phual ah hong sam hi,","title":"Ciimna in hong Sam","ref":"Pau 8:1-3"},"21":{"text":"khuapi kongpite le mihingte kisiktuana munte ah a nging tatakin hong sam hi:"},"22":{"text":"“Mihing mawmawte awng! bang tanvei mawmaw nuam nu ziam? Heakna bang tanvei ciammui vawt tu nu ziam? Heak tu sawm nawn ngawl nu ziam?"},"23":{"text":"Kong teih ciangin hong ngai tavun; ngaisutna pha kong pia tu a, ka heaknate kong hawm tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Hong sasam khi hi, hong pai tavun ci in hong thaw khi hi, ahihang hong ngai nuam ngawl nu hi. Kei sia hong nadon nuam ngawl nu hi."},"25":{"text":"Ngaisutna kong piak theampo thusim ngawl nu hi, kong hil kong pau tu zongh nong oai ngei bua uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom ngim na nga ciang, kong nuisan tu hi. Launa lian tatakin nang hong nawk a,"},"27":{"text":"na tungah vuipi suangval bangin hong va a, ngimna vuipi hong puak hi, nang sia natna le cimawkna taw na om hun ciangin kong nunau tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuaciang ciimna nong kan tu a, ahihang kong zo buatu hi. Mun theampo ah hong zong ka lete zong nong mu buatu hi."},"29":{"text":"Heakna bangma hunin na thusim ngei bua a Topa thu nit tu zongh na nial tawntung hi."},"30":{"text":"Ngaisutna kong piakte na dei ngei bua a, kong hil kong pau ciangin nong nadon bua hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahikom, nangma taw a kiphu bangin na nga tu hi, tuaciang nangma ngamtatna ma in na ci hong nasak tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Heakna nei ngeingawlte thi hi, banghang ziam cile amate in ciimna nial uh hi. A mawmawte sia awlmawk a neithei ngawlna in amate lalsak hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahihang a kuama po kei thu hong ngaite in ngammuanna nei tu hi. Ama sia thinmuang in om tu a, a launa tu bangma thu a om buatu hi.”"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, kong hilte sin in a, vawt a kong sawlte bangma hunin mangil heak in.","title":"Ciimna ii Tel"},"2":{"text":"Ciimna thute ngai in a, tuate heak tu in hanciam in."},"3":{"text":"Hi hi, ciimna ngen in; a thuk mu theina nei natu maangkaa in."},"4":{"text":"Ngunn ahizong a kiseal sum manphate ahizong na zon tu bangin nasia takin zong in."},"5":{"text":"Tuabangin na ngamta le Topa kiitakna sia bang ziam ci in na he tu a, Pathian thu heakna in na nei tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ciimna a pia sia in Topa hi; ama kung pan heakna le tel theina hong pai hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in huna pia a, thutang, thumaante a sungsia hi."},"8":{"text":"Midangte tungah a kilawm tu bangin a ngamtate ama in sungsia a, ama tungah a kipiate ama in cing hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka pau nong ngai le, a maan, a tang le a kilawmte na he tu hi. Na vawt tute na he tu hi."},"10":{"text":"A ciim na suak tu a, na heakna in nopsakna hong pia tu hi."},"11":{"text":"A thuk na mu theina le na telna in nang hong sungsia tu hi,"},"12":{"text":"tuaciang a maan ngawlte na vawt ngawl natu in hong khaam tu hi. Amate pauna taw ngimna a piangsak mite kung panin tuate in hong keam tu hi,"},"13":{"text":"tuabang mite in thutang nuntakzia nusia in mawna khuazing sungah a teang uh hi,"},"14":{"text":"tuabang mite in a maan ngawl sepna sungah nuamsa a, tuaciang in khiakna nei ngawl siatnate ah thanuam uh hi,"},"15":{"text":"amate sia mihing suantaak ngawl a muan thamman ngawlte ahi uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma in numei paktat khat po ii kamthum taw hong zolnate na nalh zo tu hi,"},"17":{"text":"ama in a pasal tungah thumaan ngawlin kiciamna thiangthote a mangil nu ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama inn ah na haw le thina lampi ah khual a hawhaw na hi hi. Tua munah pai tu sia mithi khua a neak na hi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama kung a haw peuma hong heak kik ngeingawl hi. Tua pa in nuntakna lampi ah hong kilee kik ngei nawn ngawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahikom mihing phate lamlaknate zui in thutang nuntakna taw nungta hamtang in."},"21":{"text":"Thutang mi, thumaan takkhate, hisung eima ii leitang tungah a nungta tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in mihing seksolte leitung panin dokkhe tu a, hi mawneite leitung panin thingnote baw bangin bot tu hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, kong hilte mangil heak in. Vawt a, kong sawlte a tawntungin ciamtee in.","title":"Khangmoi Pasalte Ngaisut pha Piakna"},"2":{"text":"Kong hilnate in khansauna le nuntakna nuam hong pia tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Thuciipna le thumaanna thasua ngei heak in. Na ngawng kiimkot ah vet in a; na lungtang tungah at in."},"4":{"text":"Hi bangin na ngamta le Pathian le mihingte in nang dik hong sa tu hi.","ref":"Lk 2:52"},"5":{"text":"Na thin theampo taw Topa muang in. Nangma ii he na kisakte bangma hunin muang heak in."},"6":{"text":"Na sep na vawt theampo sungah Topa phawk in, tua hile ama in a maan lampi hong lak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Na hi bang sangin a ciim zaw in kituat heak in, Topa ii thu ni lel in a, a maan ngawlte vawt tu nial in.","ref":"Rom 12:16"},"8":{"text":"Tuabangin na hile zatui pha bang hong hi tu a, na liamnate hong damsak in, na natnate hong nuamtuamsak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Leitang tung pan a piang theampo sung pan a phabel sia piakna taw Topa patoai in."},"10":{"text":"Tuabangin na hile na ansaal sia antangte taw kidim tu a, na khol natu om ngawl liang dongin sapittui tam mama na nei tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, Topa in tekna, hilna hong nei ciangin pha takpi in nadon in a, kidop natu hong piak thu hi ci in saang in.","ref":"Job 5:17; Heb 12:5-6"},"12":{"text":"Nu le pate in a kiphatsak pui a ta khat, a tek a hil bangma Topa in ama ii itte tek hi.","ref":"Tpl 3:19"},"13":{"text":"A ciim a hong kikheal mihing — telthiamna a nei pa in mihing lungdam ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ii sungah ngunn sangin meetna tam om zaw hi; nang atu in khamh sangin man neizaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Ciimna sia suang manphate sangin manpha zaw hi; deihuai na sak na khat pawpo taw zong a kitee ngat thei bua hi."},"16":{"text":"Ciimna in khansauna hong pia a, hauna le minphatna zongh hong pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Ciimna in na nuntakna hong nuamsak tu a, thinmuang takin hong tonpui tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihing ciimte sia a lungdamte ahi uh hi; ciimna in nuntakna pia tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in simlei sia ama ciimna taw bitphua hi; ama heakna taw van sia a omna munah koi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama ciimna in ngunte luangsak hi, tuaciang leitang atu in meeikaaite in nguatui piasak hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, na ciimna le a thuk na muna sia keamcing in kholet in. Na kung panin taisua heak in."},"22":{"text":"Tuate in nangma nuntakna hong pia tu hi, a nuam le lungdam nuntakna hong pia tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Na paina lampi ah sumsina om ngawlin na pai tu a, zongh na lutu beak buatu hi."},"24":{"text":"Lupna na zot ciang zong na lau buatu a, zankhuateakin mut citakin na mu tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Mi seksolte tungah vuipi suangval bangin thakhatthu a tung thei lal theinate patau in na nei buatu hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in nang hong keamcing tu hi. Ama in thaang sungah nang hong awksak buatu hi."},"27":{"text":"Bang hun po ahizong, na hi thei lai teng a kitaangsamhte tungah phatna vawt in."},"28":{"text":"Tutawm in na hu thei tu ahi nale zing ciang dong na innpaamte in ngaksak heak in."},"29":{"text":"Na innpaamte tungah siatna a piangsak thei bangma sawmku heak in; amate in nang hong muangin na nai ah hong teang hi."},"30":{"text":"Nang tungah siatna hong vawt ngeingawl mihing khat taw bangbang po thu om kale kam kinial heak in."},"31":{"text":"Mihing ngoltolte eang heak in a, amate ngamtat bangin ngamta tu in khensat heak in,"},"32":{"text":"banghang ziam cile Topa in ngamtat pha ngawl a vawtte ngaimaw a, ahizong thutangte sia ama mimuan in koi hi."},"33":{"text":"Topa in mi seksolte inn ah haamsiatna koi a, ahihang a thutangte inn sia thupha pia hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama in a kisatheite zangh ngawlin, a kiniamkhiakte maipha pia hi.","ref":"Jas 4:6; 1 Pe 5:5"},"35":{"text":"Mihing ciimte in a pok huai minphatna nga tu a, ahizong mihing mawmawte in maimawlna bekma nga thua tu hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, na pa hong hilnate ngai in. Pha takin nadon lete telthiamna na nei tu hi.","title":"Ciimna ii Phattuamna"},"2":{"text":"Nang kong hil sia pha ahikom a vekpi in ciamtee in."},"3":{"text":"Ka nu le ka pa ii tapa khat bek ahi keima ka patangno lai in,"},"4":{"text":"ka pa in hong hil hi. Ama in, “Ka ci theampo ciamtee in a, mangil ngei heak in. Kong sawl bangin ngamta in, tua hile na nungta tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Ciimna le thuthuk mu theina kan in! Kong cite sia mangil heak in a, awlmawk ngawlin om heak in."},"6":{"text":"Ciimna taisan heak in; tua hile tuasia in nang hong hung tu hi; ama it in, tua in nang hong keamcing tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ciimna ngana sia na vawt thei sung pan a thupibel ahi hi. A dang theampo na nga tazong thuthuk muna ma kan in."},"8":{"text":"Ciimna thangai in, nang hong liansak tu hi. Ciimna pom in, minphatna hong pia tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ciimna in na minthanna lukhu ahi tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, hong ngai ta'n. Kong son tute thupi laak in, tua hile khansau in na nungta tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ciimna le a maan lampi taw nuntakzia hong hil zo khi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ciim takin kal na suan le bangma in na lampi hong khak ngawl tu a, na tai ciangin na lutu buatu hi."},"13":{"text":"Na sinsate a tawntungin ciamtee in. Na sin pilna sia na nuntakna ahi hi — pha takin keamcing in."},"14":{"text":"Mi ngilote paina ah pai heak in. Mi seksolte ngamtatna ettee in zui heak in."},"15":{"text":"Tuabangin vawt heak in! Siatna pan kikeam in! Nial in a, na pai ngei bangin pai in."},"16":{"text":"Mi seksolte sia a maan ngawl ngamtatna khat peuma a vawt bua uh le mutthip thei ngawl uh hi. Khat po a liamsua bua uh le amate mutthip thei ngawl uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Seksolna le ngoltolna sia amate atu in an le tui bang ahi uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Thutangte tot lampi sia sun dongin, a taang vaial nisuak taw kibang hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi seksolte lampi ahile zan bangin zing hi. Amate in liik ahihang bang tungah, lutu ziam ci in a mu thei bua uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, ka ci teng pha takin nadon in. Ka kammalte ngai in."},"21":{"text":"Tuate in nangma taisansak heak in. Tuate ciamtee in a, na thinsung ah keam in."},"22":{"text":"Tuate in a tel theite tungah nuntakna le ciidamna pia tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Na khua ngaisut dan kidawm in; na nuntakzia sia na khua ngaisutna in zeam hi."},"24":{"text":"A maan ngawl peuma bangma son ngei heak in. Ngual theamna le leilot thu peuma zangh heak in."},"25":{"text":"Citak kimuanna taw maisang mitsuan in; maizumna taw kun heak in."},"26":{"text":"Na sep po pha takin ngeal phot in, tua hile nasep theampo a maan suak tu hi.","ref":"Heb 12:13"},"27":{"text":"Siatnate pial in a, tang takin mai sangah kalsuan in. A maan lampi panin kal khat zongh pial heak in."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, hong nadon ta'n a, ka ciimna le thuthuk ka muna hong ngai ta'n.","title":"Palngulna huvau Kidop natu"},"2":{"text":"Tuaciang ngamtat luheakzia ahi tu bang na he tu a, na kammalte in heakna na nei hunlam hong lak tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasal dang khat ii a zi muk sia khuaitui bangin thum tha tu a, ama ii hong napna in olive thau bangin neal tu hi,"},"4":{"text":"ahihang a zawkciang tua nu in a sia a kha le natna bek hong nusiat hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in mithi khua hong zotpui tu hi; ama tot lampi in thina lampi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in nuntakna lampi tungah a om bua hi; vakthapin bang teng piang ziam ci zongh a tel bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu in hong ngai tavun, ka tapate awng, ka pau teng mangil ngei heak vun."},"8":{"text":"Tuabang numei sia ii kung panin kikeam vun! Ama ii bangkua nai ngawngawn zongh neak tha heak vun!"},"9":{"text":"Na neak uh le, nidang na nei ngei kizataknate sia midangte in lua tu a, hesuakna sel mite khutsa taw na khanthi tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Hi hi, khualmite in na hauna theampo la siat tu a, na thalaw sa theampo sia ngualdang khat atu hi tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Na thi natu lupmun tungah na tatau tu a, na sazang le na thangolte kine tum tu hi,"},"12":{"text":"tuasia ciang, “Banghangin he thei ngawl khi ziam? Banghangin khat po in teksak ngeingawl ka na khi ziam?"},"13":{"text":"Ka syate thu ka ngai bua a, amate ka thusim bua hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang thakhat thu in mipi mai ah maizum minsiat ka thuak sia keima le keima ka kihe hi,” na ci tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Na zi tungah thumaan in a, na itna sia ama bekma pia in."},"16":{"text":"Numei dang taw na nei na tate in bangma phattuamna hong pia ngawl tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Nangma tate nangma hong hu tu in hong khang tu a, ngualdang a hu tu ahi bua hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom na zi taw lungdam vun a, na teenpui nu taw thinnuamin om in —"},"19":{"text":"ama sia sangai bangin ngaibaang in thuzawk huai hi. Ama ngaibannate taw na lungdamsak in; ama hong itna in nangma tuamsak in."},"20":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, banghangin na itna sia numei dang khat pia tu ni ziam? Banghangin ngualdang khat zi ii ngaibannate lungngul zaw tu ni ziam?"},"21":{"text":"Topa in na ngamtatna theampo hong mu hi. Na paina theampo ama in hong encik hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi seksol khat ii mawnate sia thaang khat ahi hi. Amate mama ii mawna ngeen sungah amate awk uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in a pumpi ki uk zo ngawl ahikom thi uh hi. Amate mawmawt leilamna in a thaankuul uh ah amate puak tu hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, ngualdang khat ii leibatte vaipuak la tu in kamciam na vawt ngei ziam?","title":"A tamzaw lai Kidop natu"},"2":{"text":"Nangma kammal ma in hong man kik ngei a, nangma kamciam in thaang hong sia ngei ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahile ka tapa awng, nang sia tua mihing pa khut sungah om ni hi, ahihang hisia vai taw na kipeal natu a manlang in ama va zuan ta'n a, hong maap natu in hesuak ngen ta'n."},"4":{"text":"Nangma le nangma sia mut hun ahizong tawlngak hun ahizong kipia heak in."},"5":{"text":"Savaipa thaang panin vacim ahizong, sangai ahizong a suatak bangin tua thaang panin pusuak in."},"6":{"text":"Mihing dathamte in mitsate nuntakzia tung pan sin tahen."},"7":{"text":"Amate in lampui ahizong, hausa, ukpi ahizong nei ngawl hi,"},"8":{"text":"ahihang amate in phalbi sung atu a kinginna in khaal lai in an koikhol hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing datham pa in bang tanvei lupna tungah lum tu ziam? Bang hun ciang hong tho peetma tu ziam?"},"10":{"text":"Ama in, “Tawmvei mu zok tong, leekoai in tawmvei sung tawlnga sin tong” ci hi.","ref":"Pau 24:33-34"},"11":{"text":"Ahihang a mut lanin zawnna in hiamh toai ngualsuamte bangin ama sim tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing ngautaak ngawl, mi seksolte in leilot thu sonin vak kawkoai hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate nang hong theam natu in a mit suukin a khut uh vik hi,"},"14":{"text":"tuasung theampo ah siatna taw kidim in a khel thinsung taw mun theampo ah nawngkaina piangsak tu in hol kawkoai hi."},"15":{"text":"Hi thu hangin amate heakkhol ngawlin lalna in amate vaat tu a, tuaciangin amate sia thi theina ciang dongin liam tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa ii a etsat le a dual zawk ngawl thu nam sali om hi: Kiphatsakna maipuak, a theam thei leei, mawnei ngawlte a thatlum khut, seksol sawmin a ngaisun thinsung, siatna vawt tu a, a zuan ngang peangte, leilot thu khat zawkciang khat a son tetti, lawm le ngual sungah buaina pian natu a heltua pa cite ahi hi.","merge":"17"},"20":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, na pa hong sonte vawt in a, na nu hong hilte mangil ngei heak in.","title":"Palngulna huvau Kidop natu"},"21":{"text":"Amate ii kammalte phawk tawntungin a, na thinsung ah kip takin ciamtee in."},"22":{"text":"Amate hong hilnate in khual na haw ciangin hong hu tu hi, zanin hong hung tu hi, tuaciang sunin ngaisutna pha hong pia tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate hong hilnate sia a taang khuavak hi; amate hong teknate in nuntakzia hong hil thei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua hilnate in numei pha ngawlte kung panin hong keam tu hi; midangte zite ii zolna kammalte pan hong keam tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate mealphatna ip la heak in. Amate sikvil mit hana sungah awk heak in."},"26":{"text":"Pasal khat in anluum khat man za taw pumpi zuak numei khat nga thei hi, ahihang palngul mawna in a neisa theampo bosak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Na puan kaangh ngawl hetin na awm ah meikuang na toai thei tu ziam?"},"28":{"text":"Na peang kaangh ngawl hetin meikam tungah na pai thei tu ziam?"},"29":{"text":"Ngual zi a luppui sia tuabangza ma in lauhuai hi. Tuabang a ngamta theampo in ngimna thuak tu hi."},"30":{"text":"A ngilkial laitak a, an a ngu nguta khat sia mihingte in zawngsak ngawl hi;"},"31":{"text":"ahitazong ama a kiman le a see sali in liau tu hi — a neisa theampo a piak siat kul tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahihang palngul mawna a vawt mihing khat in ngaisut kaakna nei ngawl ahi hi. Ama le ama a kilalsua hi lel hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama a min kisiasak tu a, kivelpheang tu hi; a tawntungin maimawl tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Pasal khat in a zi a muan nawn ngawl ciang a thin uuk za sangin a thin uuk zawk hun om ngawl hi; ama ii thuk kikna in ciangtan nei ngawl hi."},"35":{"text":"Ama in liausum bangma a saang buatu hi; letsong bangza po in a tam ta zongin a thin uukna thai zo ngawl tu hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, ka paunate ciamtee in a, kong sawlte vawt tu mangil ngei heak in."},"2":{"text":"Kong sawlte seam lete na nungta tu hi. Na mittangte na huuk bangin kong hilnate kidawm in zui in."},"3":{"text":"Kong hilnate a tawntung keamcing in; na lungtang tungah at in."},"4":{"text":"Ciimna sia na suapuinu bangin ngaisun in a, thuthuk muna sia na ngualtamh phabel bangin ngaisun in."},"5":{"text":"Tuate in ngual zite kung panin nang hong keam tu hi, zolna kampau thei numeite kung panin hong keam tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Khatvei lai in ka khelki panin a pua sang khua ka et le","title":"A paktat Numei"},"7":{"text":"bangma a khua he seam ngawl lai tangval tam mama ka mu hi, tuate sungah a mawmaw khat a tuamin ka ciamtee hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in numei khat ii teenna nai, lampi sia tawnin pai hi,"},"9":{"text":"tua hun sia nitak khuazin zawk ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuasia ciang tua nu in ama taw kisi hi; tua nu sia pumpi zuak numeite bangin kizeam a, tuaciang ama in niimna khat nei hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama sia hangin a maizum maw numei khat hi a, lampi ah vak tawntungin tua ahibuale"},"12":{"text":"lamking pan ngakin ding hi, khat vevei sia lampi ah, khat vevei le vanhzuakna phual ah ngakin om hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in tangvalpa ngawngkoai in namh a, a mittang salhin,"},"14":{"text":"“Tuni in biakpiakna ka vawt a, sangaw biakpiakna pan sa zongh ka nei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom nangma zong tu in kong pusuak hi. Kong mu nop bangma in hi sungah na om hi!"},"16":{"text":"Ka lupna sia Egypt pan puanneal a pawlkhat taw ka siin zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua lupna sia myrrh, aloe le cinnamon thingnamtuite taw ka namtuisak zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Hong pai ta'n! Zankhuateakin lumkhawm tawng. Khat le khat kikoai in nuamsa tawng."},"19":{"text":"Ka pasal sia inn ah om ngawl hi. Khual khuala a haw laitak hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in sum tam ma keng a, nipi nii sung hong cia ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuabangin ama in tangvalpa sia ama thiamna taw zol a, numei ii kamthum kamzol in tangvalpa zo hi."},"22":{"text":"Thakhat thu in ama sia ngaw tu in a kipaipui khuital bangin numei nu taw pai a, thaang sungah a awk tu sangai bangin kilawn in tai hi;"},"23":{"text":"tua thaang sia thaltang ii a lungtang a vutlet natu mun hi. Ama sia ngeen sungah a tum vacim bang hi a — ama nuntakna lauhuai ahi hunlam a he bua hi."},"24":{"text":"Tu in, ka tapate awng, hong ngai tavun. Ka pauna hong nadon tavun."},"25":{"text":"Tuabang numei khat in na thinzosak heak vun: ama ii nung zuikot heak vun."},"26":{"text":"Ama in pasal tam mamate ii lalcipna hi a, a kisim zo ngawl mihing tam mamate ii thina piangsak hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama inn ah na haw le mithi khua a zuazuan na hi hi. Tua in thi natu lamban khat ahi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngai vun! Ciimna in hong sam hi. Thu tuatna in ama le ama hong kihiil hi.","title":"Ciimna kipok","ref":"Pau 1:20-21"},"2":{"text":"Lampi hui mualdawnte le lamkaate ah ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Khuapi sung tumna mun, kongpite hui ah ama in hi bangin au hi:"},"4":{"text":"“Mihingte awng, hong maangkaa khi hi; leitung ah a om theampo sam khi hi."},"5":{"text":"Puicing ngawl lai nu ziam? Puicin natu in kisin vun. Mawmaw nu ziam? Ngaisut theina na nei natu in sin vun."},"6":{"text":"Ka kammal pha mamate hong ngai tavun; kong son theampo maan hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka ci teng thumaan hi; leilot thu ngaimaw khi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka pau theampo thumaan hi; a maan ngawl ahibuale lampui khialna bangma om ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Thuthuk a mu thei mihing khat atu in thiang sitset hi; pha tak a, a kihil sa khat atu in tel ol hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngunn sangin kong lamlakna teal zaw vun; khamh phabel sangin heakna teal zaw vun."},"11":{"text":"“Keima in Ciimna ka hi hi, suangmanphate sangin ka phazaw hi; na dei theampo, kei taw a kitee ngat thei bangma om ngawl hi.","ref":"Tpl 3:14"},"12":{"text":"Keima in Ciimna ka hi hi, thuthuk mu theina ka nei hi; keima in heakna le thukhenna maan ka nei hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa zatakna in a sia ngaimawkna ahi hi; kiphatsakna le kisaktheina, siatna lampite le a maan ngawl kammalte ka ngaimaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Ngealnate ka nei a, tuabangin ka seam suak hi. Telthiamna ka nei a, ka thahat hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpite ngamukna le ngamukte ii upadi phate a vawtna ah ka hu hi."},"16":{"text":"Leitung ah ngam uk theampo in keima huna taw ngam uk hi, ngam uliante ahizong nam liante ahizong ka hu hi."},"17":{"text":"Kei hong itte ka it hi; kei hong zong po in hong mu thei hi."},"18":{"text":"Haunate le minphatna, nopsakna le matutna piak tu ka nei hi."},"19":{"text":"Kei tung pan na ngate in khamh phabel sangin phazaw a, ngunn ciitak sangin phazaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Thutang lampi ka tawn a; thukhaikim lampi ka zui hi,"},"21":{"text":"kei hong itte hauna ka pia hi, a innte uh sum le vanh manpha te taw ka dimsak hi."},"22":{"text":"“ Topa in a masa phitbel in kei hong bitphua a, khuangeipi lai in a nasep phitbel ka hi hi."},"23":{"text":"A kipatciil hun mama in kei hong kivawt hi, simlei a kipat ma in a masabel ka hi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuipite a pian ma, ciktui te a om ma in ka piang zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Mualpite pian ma, mualnote a om natu tek ah a kikoi ma in ka piang zo hi,"},"26":{"text":"Pathian in leitung le a lote a vawt ma, ahibuale leitang masabel sia khutdim a vawt ma ngawngawnin ka piang zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Van sia a om natu munah ama ii a koi hun lai, tuipi kaantan in vanmong a phalh lai,"},"28":{"text":"van ah meeikaaite a koi lai, tuipi tuinaakte a hon lai le,"},"29":{"text":"tuipi tuite ama ii ciza sangin a saangzawin a khanto ngawl natu thu a piak lai, leitung tawdapte a phaa lai in tua munah kei ka om zo hi."},"30":{"text":"Keima in ama kungah inn limsuaithiamte bangin ka om hi, kei sia ni simin ama ii lungdamna naak ka hi hi, tuaciang ama taw ka om sia nuam ka sa tawntung hi,"},"31":{"text":"simlei taw lungdam in mihing namte dik a sa pa ka hi hi."},"32":{"text":"“Tu in, khangmoite awng, hong ngai tavun. Ka ci bangin vawt vun, na lung uh dam tu hi."},"33":{"text":"No hong kihilte ngai vun. Ciim vun a; ngaingon heak vun."},"34":{"text":"Kei thu hong ngaipa in lungdam tu hi — Ni simin ka kongbiang ah om a, ka inn sung tumna pan hong ngak pa sia mihing lungdam ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Kei hong mu pa in nuntakna mu a, tuaciang Topa in ama diksa tu hi."},"36":{"text":"Kei hong mu ngawl pa in ama le ama kiliamsua hi; a kuama po kei hong ensan sia in thina dei ahi hi.”"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ciimna in a inn sa a, khuam sali phut hi.","title":"Ciimna le Mawmawtna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in poai vawt natu nganno khat ngosakin, sapittui sungah hel thei tuatuamte a hel zawkciang sabuai phaasak hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in a naseam numeite sam a, khua sung a saang belna mun pan hi bangin ausak hi;"},"4":{"text":"“Heakna nei ngawl mite awng, hong tum tavun!” Tuaciang mi mawmawte munah ama in;"},"5":{"text":"“Hong pai tavun a, ka an ne in, ka hel sa sapittui ne vun."},"6":{"text":"Heakna nei ngawl mihingte taw kitholna nusia vun a, nungta vun. Heakna lampi zui in” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing kisathei khat na hil na pau le hong lanna bek na thuak tu hi. Mihing tatsia khat na teih le thinnatna bekma na nga tu hi."},"8":{"text":"A kisathei khat bangma hunin hilin pau heak in; ama in tua hu in nang hong ensan tu hi. Ahihang mihing ciim khat hilin pau lete ama in nang hong zakta tu hi."},"9":{"text":"A ciimte khat ii tungah na ci pawpo in ama ciimsak seseam tu hi. A thutang khat ii tungah na son khat sia in ama ii heakna belap hi."},"10":{"text":"Ciim natu in Topa na thasia maksak kul hi. A Thiangtho Pa na he le telthiamna nei na hi hi.","ref":"Job 28:28; Ps 111:10; Pau 1:7"},"11":{"text":"Ciimna in kum tam mama na khan hong sausak tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Ciimna na nei le a hampha tu sia in nangma na hi a, ciimna na nial le a thuak tu sia nangma na hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Mawmawtna sia a au vazak, heakna nei ngawl, a maizum maw numei khat taw kibang hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in a kongbiang ah to a, ahibuale khua sung a saangbelna munah to in,"},"15":{"text":"amate nasep tek ngaisun a, hong papai mihingte tungah:"},"16":{"text":"“Hong tum tavun, heakna nei ngawl mihingte awng!” ci hi. A mawmawte mun ah:"},"17":{"text":"“A kingu tuidam in thum zaw hi. A kingu anluum in lim zaw hi” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama ii inn sungah a tumte thi a, a tum sate sia tu in mithi khua, a thukbelna ah a om hunlam tua numeinu ii a theam zawkte in a he bua uh hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hite sia Solomon ii paunakte ahi hi: Tapa ciim in a pa angtangsak a; a mawmaw sia in a nu khuangaisak hi.","title":"Solomon ii Paunakte"},"2":{"text":"Thumaan ngawlna taw na nga hauna in bangma phattuamna hong pia ngawl tu hi, ahihang thumaanna in na nuntakna hong ngum thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in mihing phate ngilkialsak ngawl tu hi; ahihang a seksolte sia amate ii deite a ngasak buatu hi."},"4":{"text":"Dathamna in zawnna piangsak tu a, ahizong nasep hatna in hong hausak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing khuangaisun thei khat in a hunlai in lo ante kaikhawm hi; anlaak hun sung teng mutna in mindaina hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing pha khat in thupha saang tu hi. Mihing seksol khat ii kammalte in a ngoltol pianzia phualseal hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing phate sia thupha saanna hi ci in kiciamtee tu hi, ahihang mihing seksolte sia kimangil pal tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihing khuangaisun theite in ngaisut pha piakna saang thei hi. Mawmawt kam a pau mite sia siatna sung theng tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Thumaan mihingte thinmuang hiithiat a, ahizong thumaan ngawlte mat thuak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Thumaan thutak a iim te in buaina piangsak a, ahizong phualseal ngawlin a son ngamte in kilem natu in naseam ahi uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihing pha khat ii kampaute in nuntakna tuinaak hi a, ahizong a seksol khat ii kammal in a ngoltol pianzia phualseal hi."},"12":{"text":"Ki etsatna in buaina thawn a, ahizong itna in tatkhialna theampo maisak hi.","ref":"Jas 5:20; 1 Pe 4:8"},"13":{"text":"Mihing a pilte in khiakna nei in pau a, ahizong a mawmawte daan piak kul hi."},"14":{"text":"A ciimte in heakna a nga thei za in la a, ahizong mihing mawmawte hong pau ciang buaina taw kinai hi."},"15":{"text":"Hauna in a haute hung a; zawnna in a zawngte susia hi."},"16":{"text":"Nasep pha sepna thaman in nuntakna hi a, ahizong mawna in mawna dang tamzaw lai sung hong then hi."},"17":{"text":"Kihil kipau ciangin a ngai mihingte nungta tu a, ahizong amate khialna a pualaak nuam ngawlte atu in lauhuai hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihing khat ama ii etsatna a phualseal sia in leilot pa ahi hi. Thu nawnsan a kizelsak sia in mihing mawmaw ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Kam tam pau vaial lete mawna vawt vaial hi thei tha tu ni hi. Mihing ciim na hile pau ngawlin om khipkhep tu ni hi."},"20":{"text":"Mihing pha khat ii kammalte in ngunn ciitak bang hi a, a seksol khat ii ngaisutnate in man nei ngawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihing pha khat ii kammalte in mihing tam mama phattuamna pia tu a, ahizong nangma le nangma sia mawmawtna taw na kithatlum thei tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Nang hong hausak sia in Topa ii thupha ahi hi. Nasep hanciamna in hong hauzawsak thei ngawl hi."},"23":{"text":"A maan ngawl sep diksakna sia mawmawtna hi. Mihing pilte in ciimna sungah nuamsa uh hi."},"24":{"text":"A thutangte in amate deite nga a, ahizong a seksolte in a kiitakbel teng nga tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Vuipi suangval hong pai in a seksolte seamkeak a, ahizong mihing thumaante a tawntung suakta hi."},"26":{"text":"Bangma hunin mihing datham pa khat in nang atu bangma seamsak ngei heak in; ama sia na ha le zuhau a kilem ngawl bang ahibuale na mittang sungah meikhu bangin hong nuammawsak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa thu ni lete na khansauzaw tu hi. Mihing seksolte sia thi hun ngawlin khanthi uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Mihing phate ii lametnate in thinnopna sung hong then a, ahizong mihing seksolte in mai sangah lamet tu bangma a nei thei bua uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Topa in thumaan mihingte sungsia hi; ahizong a ngamta khialte susia hi."},"30":{"text":"A thutang mite in ngammuanna nei tawntung tu a, ahizong mihing seksolte a ngam sungah a nungta buatu hi."},"31":{"text":"A thutang mihingte in ciimkam pau uh a, ahizong kamsia a pau leei sia kitawlngasak tu hi."},"32":{"text":"A thutang mihingte in a dik thute pau tu he a, ahihang a seksolte in ngual thin nat natu bek pau nithi uh hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in khaikhin maan ngawl a zanghte ensan hi. Toaisuang maante hangin ama lungdam hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihing kiphasak te hai ngawlin maimawl tu hi. Kiniamkhiakna sia ciimna hizaw hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihing pha na hile thumaanna in lam hong lak hi. Mihing a muanhuai ngawlte sia amate thumaan ngawlna in susia hi."},"4":{"text":"Na thi ni hong thet ciang haunate in bangma phattuamna hong pia zo ngawl tu hi, ahihang thumaanna in na nuntakna hong ngum thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Thumaanna in mihing pha khat ii nuntakna olsak zaw hi, ahihang mihing seksol khat in ama puk natu ama mama in piangsak tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Thutang hina in a thumaante suatak hi, ahihang a muanhuai ngawlte sia amate duhopna thaang sungah awk hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing seksol khat a thi ciangin ama lametna zongh ama taw thi khawm hi. Haunate sungah thinmuanna sia bangma ahi bua hi."},"8":{"text":"A thutangte sia ngimna pan kidal hi; a seksolte tungah ngimna tung zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Pathian sel mihingte thu sonna in nang hong lalsak thei a, ahizong thutangte ciimna in nang hong hun thei hi."},"10":{"text":"A thumaante in hamphatna a nei uh ciangin khuapi sungah lungdamna om a, a seksolte a thi uh ciang lungdamna aw nging hi."},"11":{"text":"A thutangte ii thupha a piak uh ciangin khuapi khat sia khua thupi suak hi; ahihang khuapi khat sia a seksolte kammalte taw kilalsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Ngual zawnsak kampauna in mawmawtna hi. Khuangaisun thei khat na hile na thim khipkhep tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Thu nawnsan son khat sia thuku huvau ah kimuang thei ngawl hi, ahihang a muan taak khat sia na muang thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Lampuina a nei ngawl minam khat sia puk tu hi. Ngaisutna a pia thei tam mama a om le ngammuanna om hi."},"15":{"text":"Khualmi khat ii leiba losak tu in kamciam na pia le na kisiik tu hi. Kamkumh bua lete nangma atu in phazaw hi."},"16":{"text":"A thuthiam numei khat kizakta a, ahizong ngamtat pha ngawl numei khat sia a maizum huai khat ahi hi. A datham mihing khat in sum a nei ngei buatu a, ahihang a hanciam mama khat sia hau tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Na dik le nangma le nangma kiphatvawt na hi hi. na ngilo le nangma le nangma kiliamsua na hi bek hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihing seksolte in a tatakin bangma meetna a nga bua hi, ahihang a maan in na ngamta le thaman hong kipia takpi tu hi."},"19":{"text":"A maan a, ngamta tu khensatna a nei sia nungta tu hi, ahihang akua po ahizong a maan ngawl ngamtatna a vawt hamtang sia thi tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in mihing thinsiate ngaimaw hi, ahizong a maan a ngamtate it hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihing ngilote daan kipia tu ci sia a pealmaw hi, ahihang thutang mite ahile suakta tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Thu khensatna pha a nei ngawl numei khat ii mealphatna in vok naak ah khamh naakba taw kibang hi."},"23":{"text":"Mihing phate ii deite sia phatna taw tawp tawntung hi; mihing seksolte ii a deite a nga uh ciang a kuama po thin uuk hi."},"24":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhat sia a sum uh zangh vapeak a hau vaial hi. A dangte sia kidawm in zangh hi napi zawng vaial hi."},"25":{"text":"Ngo vapeak vun, tua hile na nuamsa tu uh hi. Ngual hu vun, no zongh hong kihu tu hi."},"26":{"text":"A man khan tu ngak a, antang a kholte sia mihingte in haamsiat hi, ahihang tuabang khol ngawlin a zuak paihte sia ngual in pok hi."},"27":{"text":"Na mungtupnate a pha le nang hong kizakta tu hi, ahihang ngimna na zong le tuasia ma na nga tu hi."},"28":{"text":"A hauna uh a suangte in tangngam lai a, thingteete bangin a pul tu uh hi, ahihang thutangte in khaal lai a, thingteete bangin a khang tu uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Amate ii bangkuate sungah ngimna a piangsakte in a tawpna ah bangma a nei buatu uh hi. Mi mawmawte sia miciimte ii naseam a suak tawntung tu uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Thutang in nuntakna pia a, ahihang ngoltolna in nuntakna bosak hi."},"31":{"text":"Mihing phate hi leitung ah thaman kipia ahiciang mihing seksolte le mimawte daan kipia tu hi ci sia na he hamtang tu hi.","ref":"1 Pe 4:18"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kuama po heakna a deite in a khial ciangin hil tu uuk hi. Kihil kipau tu dei ngawlna in mawmawtna hi."},"2":{"text":"Topa in mihing phate tungah lungkim a, ahizong siatna a ngealte puavawk hi."},"3":{"text":"Seksol tatsiatna in thinmuanna pia ngawl a, ahizong mihing thutangte in dinmun kip nei hi."},"4":{"text":"Zi pha khat in a pasal ii angtanna le lungdamna ahi hi; ahihang a pasal a maizumsak zi khat in a pasal ii ngu sungah cancer natna khat taw kibang ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"A thumaan mihingte in a kilawm bangin hong vawt tu hi; mihing seksolte in theam tu bek hong sawm hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing seksolte ii kammalte in mihing thatlum thei a, ahihang a thutangte ii kammalte in tawnna a thuakte suatak hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing seksolte in kiamsukin suan le paal nei ngawl a, ahihang thutangte ii bangkuate sia nungta paisuak hi."},"8":{"text":"Na pil le, nang hong kipok tu hi; na mawmaw le nang hong kinomu tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Milian khat bang kiheang in ngilkial a ih om sangin nuntak natu a thalaw mihing thawthong khat hi leang phazaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing pha khat in a ngannote pha takin en a, ahihang mihing seksolte in nganno tungah tatkha hi."},"11":{"text":"Nasep hanciam lotho mi khat in neak tu tam mama nei hi, ahihang kimanna om ngawl nasepnate taw hun bosakna in mawmawtna hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing seksolte ii uuk theampo sia, a sia vawt tu zonna ahi hi, ahihang thutangte a dinmun kho hi."},"13":{"text":"Mihing seksolte khat in ama ii pauna taw thaang sungah awk hi, ahihang a thumaan khat in ama le ama ngimna pan kipusua hi."},"14":{"text":"Na thaman sia na pauna le na sepna tung pan kituat tu hi; nang taw a kiphu bang na nga tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihing mawmawte in amate le amate maan kisa tawntung hi. Mihing ciimte in ngaisut piakna ngai hi."},"16":{"text":"A mawmaw khat in diksak ngawlna a nei ciang manlang takin kilanghsak hi. Mihing khuangaisun theite in ngual ii lanna kam a awlmaw buatu hi."},"17":{"text":"Thumaan na son ciangin thutang khenna piang hi; ahihang leilotna in a kikhaikim ngawl thukhenna piangsak hi."},"18":{"text":"Ngaisun phot ngawl a, pauna in namsau taw saat bangin thuk bunin liamsak thei hi, ahihang ciim kampauna in damsak thei hi."},"19":{"text":"Leilot thu sia ngei kho ngawl a, thumaan thutak sia a tawntungin nungta hi."},"20":{"text":"Siatna a ngealte in muanmawk ngawl thusia khat tawk tu a, ahihang phatna a seamte in lungdamna nga tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Thutang mite tungah a sia na khat zongh tung ngawl hi, ahihang a seksolte in ngimna simngawl bangma a nei bua uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in leilot theite ensan hi, ahihang a kampau sa a kholette diksa hi."},"23":{"text":"Mihing khuangaisun theite in a heak uh thute son vazai ngawl hi, ahihang mihing mawmawte in a heak ngawlna uh teng ma thangsak hi."},"24":{"text":"Nasep hamciamna in thahatna hong pia tu hi; na dathamna in sal hong sua tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Thinngimna in lungdamna hong suttol thei hi, ahihang kamthiam in hong lungpilsak tu hi."},"26":{"text":"A thutang pa sia a lawm pa atu in lamhilpa hi tu a, ahihang a seksol khat ii lampi in amate lam pialpui hi."},"27":{"text":"Na da a tham le na zon sia na nga ngei buatu a, ahizong nasep na hanciam le hauna na nga tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Thutang hina in nuntakna lampi hi; seksolna sia thina lampi ahi hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tapa ciim khat in a pa ii a hil a pau ciangin nadon a, ahihang a kisathei mihing khat in khial khi hi a ci ngei bua hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihing phate sia amate pauna tung panin thaman kipia tu a, ahihang ngualtheam theite sia andu ngilkial bangin ngoltol ngamtatna dei hi."},"3":{"text":"Na pau po kidawm in a, na nuntakna huu in. Kidawm ngawlin a pau khat in ama le ama kisiatsua hi."},"4":{"text":"A datham khat in na khat pawpo bangza in a dei hang, a nga ngei buatu hi. Naseam hat khat in a dei po nga tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing thumaante in leilot thute ngaimaw hi, ahihang mihing seksolte ii kammal in maizumhuai a, minpaan huai hi."},"6":{"text":"Thutang hina in a maw ngawlte hung hi; seksolna in mawneite ii pukna hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhat sia a hau bangin kiheang ahihang, bangma a nei bua uh hi. A dang pawlkhat sia a zawng bangin kiheang ahihang, nei le lamh a nei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Sumhau khat in a nuntakna a huuk natu in a sum a zak kul a, ahihang a zawng khat sia ama a tawng tu kuama a om bua hi."},"9":{"text":"Thutangte sia khuavak taang kiukiau khat taw kibang hi; a seksolte sia meiinn a mit vangeu taw kibang hi."},"10":{"text":"Kisak theina in ngim ngana simngawl bangma dang a piangsak bua hi. Ngaisutna ngetna in ciim zawkna hi."},"11":{"text":"Ol takin hauna na nga le na bosak pal tu hi. A haksa zaw in na thalaw le a tamzaw na nei tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Lametna a bo ciang ngaisutna zongh lal a, ahihang na uukna khat a taangtun ciang thinnopna taw hong kidimsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Ngaisutna phate na nial le ngimna a zong na hi hi; tuasia zui lete na ngammuang tu hi."},"14":{"text":"A ciimte hong hilnate sia nuntakna ii tuinaak hi; tuate in launa sungah na om ciang hong suaktasak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Pilna in kithasiana piangsak a, ahihang a muanhuai ngawlte sia lalna lampi a tawn uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Khuangaisun thei mihingte in a ngamtat ma in ngaisun phot tawntung hi, ahihang mihing mawmawte in a heak ngawlna uh thangsak hi."},"17":{"text":"A muan thamman ngawl kamtaite in ngimna piangsak hi, ahihang a muanhuaite in kilemna hong then hi."},"18":{"text":"Kihilna a ni nuam ngawl po sia zawngin mindai tu hi. A kuama po kihil kipauna a ngai sia kizakta hi."},"19":{"text":"Na dei po na nga tu sia bangza in pha ziam! Mihing mawmawte in siatna nusia nuam ngawl hi."},"20":{"text":"A ciimte taw na kithawl le na ciim tu hi. Mihing mawmawte taw na kipawl le na lal tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Ngimna in mawneite mun theampo ah zuizen a, ahihang mihing thutangte sia a thaman in naphate kipia tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Mihing pha khat in a tute atu hauna nusiat tu hi, ahihang mawneite hauna sia thutangte kung zuan tu hi."},"23":{"text":"A kitho ngawl lote in mizawngte atu, an tam mama piangsak thei hi, ahihang a maanin a ngamta ngawlte in mizawngte thaw tu khaktan hi."},"24":{"text":"Na tapa na hilna in daan na pia buale ama a it ngawl na hi hi. Ama na it nale hil in."},"25":{"text":"Thutangte in a neak tu a kicing nei a, ahihang a seksolte sia a ngil uh kial tawntung hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Numeite ii ciimna taw inn sung nuntakzia kipuua a, ahihang mawmawtna in tuate susia hi."},"2":{"text":"Thumaan in, tua hile Topa thasiana a lak na hi hi; thumaan heak in, tua hile Topa na thasia ngawlna a lak na hi hi."},"3":{"text":"A mawmaw a kiphasakte kam tam pau hi; a ciimte ii kammal in amate huu hi."},"4":{"text":"Lotho tu khuital a om buale na ansaal hawm tu a, ahihang tua khuitalte a om hu in na ansaal sia antang taw kidim tu hi."},"5":{"text":"A muan taak tetti khat in thutak son tawntung a, ahihang a muan thamman ngawl khat in leilot thu simngawl a dang a son bua hi."},"6":{"text":"A kinasiasak mihingte bangma hun a ciim thei ngei buatu hi, ahihang mihing pilvangte in olno takin tel thei hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing mawmawte kung pan kikeam in; amate in nang hong hil tu bangma a nei bua uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Banghangin mihing pil khat sia ciim ziam? Banghang ziam cile ama in a sep tu he hi. A nangh khat sia banghangin mawmaw ziam? Banghang ziam cile ama in he siat kisa hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing mawmawte in mawna a vawt le zong phamaw sa ngawl hi, ahihang mihing phate in maw kimaisak tu dei hi."},"10":{"text":"Na thinnopna sia nangma ii aituam hi; na thin natna zongh nangma ii aituam hi. Kuama in tuate nang taw hawm thei ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihing pha khat ii inn sia mihing ngilo khat ii inn a kisuksiat zawkciang zong kip lai tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Lampi maan na sak khat in thina sung hong then thei hi.","ref":"Pau 16:25"},"13":{"text":"Nuina in heena seal thei hi. Lungdamna a bo zawkciang heena sia tua munah om tawntung hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihing pha ngawlte in amate taw a kiphu bangin nga tu hi. Mihing phate in amate sepnate tung pan thaman nga tu hi."},"15":{"text":"A mawmaw khat in na theampo um tu hi; khuangaisun theite in a kalsuan natu kidawm hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihing ciimte in ngim ngana pan a kikep thei natu kidawm hi, ahihang mihing mawmawte sia kidawm ngawlin ngamta memeang hi."},"17":{"text":"A thinngeam mihingte in a mawmawthuai nate seam hi; a ciimzawte in dai takin om hi."},"18":{"text":"Heakna nei ngawlte in a mawmawtna taw a kiphu bang nga uh hi, ahihang a pilte tungah heakna sia thaman in kipia hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing ngilote in thutangte mai ah kiniamkhiak in kun a, maipha a zong tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Mizawng khat sia kuama in a dei bua hi, a innpaamte ngawngawn in, a dei bua uh hi, ahihang a hau khat in lawm tam ma nei hi."},"21":{"text":"Na lungdam nuam le a zawngte tungah dik in; mi khat po zawnsakna sia mawna ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"A pha na vawt le ngualdang ii muanna le zatakna na thalaw tu hi; a sia na vawt le a ngamta khial na hi hi."},"23":{"text":"Na na seam le nuntak natu na thalaw tu hi; thuson in na to thawthong le na zawng tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Mihing ciimte in hauna thaman saang a, ahihang a mawmawte sia amate ciim ngawlna panin kihe hi."},"25":{"text":"Tetti khat in thumaan a son ciangin ngual nuntakna huu hi; ama in leilot thu a son ciangin ngual leeheak ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa thasiana in mihing khat le a innkuanpuite atu in kimuanna le ngammuanna pia hi."},"27":{"text":"Thina na pial nuam ziam? Topa thasiana in nuntakna tuinaak ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpipa khat ii letna sia mihing bangza uk ziam, ci thu taw kisai hi; a uk tu mihing a nei buale ama in bangma ahi bua hi."},"29":{"text":"Dai takin na om le nang sia a ciim na hi hi, ahihang na thin a ngeam le, bangza mawmaw ci a lak hi bek ni hi."},"30":{"text":"Thinnopna in pumpi ciidamsak hi, ahihang eenna thin in cancer natna taw kibang hi."},"31":{"text":"Mizawngte na nengcip le a vawt pa Pathian simmaw na hi hi; ahihang mizawngte tungah dikna in biakpiakna nam khat ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Mihing seksolte in amate tatsiatnate taw amate le amate ii a kiamsuk natu uh piangsak hi, ahihang mihing phate sia amate takkhana in huu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ciimna sia mihing pilvangte ii ngaisutna theampo sungah om hi; a mawmawte in ciimna huvau bangma a he bua hi."},"34":{"text":"Thutang hina in minam lian khat suaksak hi; mawna in minam khat ii min daisak hi."},"35":{"text":"Kumpipate in nasep thiam uliante diksa uh a, ahihang nasep thiam ngawlte daan pia uh hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Awneam taw kizona in thin uukna thaisak a, ahihang awtawlok in thinsosak hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihing ciimte a pau uh ciang heakna deihuaisak a, ahihang mihing mawmawte in nawnsan thu son nuam uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in mun theampo ah bang teng piang ci in mu hi; na pha ih seam a, a sia ih seam zong ama in hong en nginge hi."},"4":{"text":"Kamthiam in nuntakna piangsak a, ahihang ngitlo kampauna in na thin hong siasak hi."},"5":{"text":"Na pa hong hilnate na awlmawk ngawl tu sia mawmawthuai hi; ama ii hong hilna hong paunate saan theina in ciimna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"A thutang mihingte in a hauna uh keamcing hi, ahihang mihing seksolte in hun haksa hong thet ciang a neisate bosua uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Heakna sia mihing a ciimte in kizelsak a, mihing mawmawte ii kizelsak hi ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihing phate thunget ciang Topa lungkim hi; ahihang mihing seksolte hong paipui sa ngaw biakpiaknate ensan hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in mihing ngilote ngamtatziate ensan hi, ahihang a maan a seamte it hi."},"10":{"text":"A maan ngawl sep na nei le nasia takin daan hong kipia tu hi; kipuuaphat tu na uuk buale na thi tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Mithi khua ngawngawn in, tua munah bang om ziam ci in Topa ii heak tu sia khaam thei ngawl hi; tua ahile bangbangin mihingte in amate khua ngaisutna sia Pathian mai ah seal thei tu ziam?"},"12":{"text":"A kisathei mihingte in kipau kihil tu a uuk bua uh hi; a ciimzawte tung panin ngaisutna a ngen ngei bua hi."},"13":{"text":"Mihingte sia a lungdam uh ciangin maitui uh a, ahihang a hee uh ciangin thinkiamna maipuak nei uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihing pilvangte in he thua nuam hi, ahizong a nanghte in heak ngawlna taw lungkim uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Mizawng khat ii nuntakna sia a tawntung thasaalin dianna hi a, ahihang mihing lungdamte in a nuntak nuamsa tawntung uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Hau a ngim nga tu sangin, zawng a Topa kiitakna in phazaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Ki etsatna a omna munah sa a limbel neak sangin na it mihingte taw antee neak khop sia phazaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Thinngeamna in kam kinialna piangsak a, ahihang thinsauna in kilemna hong puak hi."},"19":{"text":"Na da a tham le mun theampo ah haksatna na thuak tu a, ahihang na thumaan le ngim na nga buatu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ta ciimte in a pate lungdamsak hi. A mawmawte bek in a nute maimawlsak hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihing ciim ngawlte in a mawmawtna taw lungdam uh hi, ahihang a ciimte in a maan sia bek seam tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Ngaisut piakna na nga thei theampo la lete zawna na nga tu hi; tua ngawl taw zawna na nga buatu hi."},"23":{"text":"A hun taw a kilawm a kiphu tu kammal zak thei sia bangza in thinnopna om ziam!"},"24":{"text":"Mihing ciimte in nuntakna lampi ah paito uh a, thina lampi a tawnsuk bua uh hi."},"25":{"text":"A kisathei mite ii bangkua sia Topa in susia tu a, ahihang ama in meingong khat ii neisa sia a huu tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in ngitlo ngaisutnate ngaimaw hi; ahihang ama in kamthiamte diksa hi."},"27":{"text":"Thumaan ngawlin meetna nga tu na sawm le na innkuan in ngimna sung na theng tu hi. Sumnguk ne heak in tua hile na khansauzaw tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Mihing phate in ngual kam a zo ma in ngaisun masa uh hi. Mihing ngilote in manlang takin zo kik a, ahihang buaina piangsak hi."},"29":{"text":"Mihing phate thu a nget ciang Topa in ngai hi, ahihang ama in a ngilote a awlmawk bua hi."},"30":{"text":"A maitaite in nang hong lungdamsak hi, tuaciang lungdamhuai thute in na thin hong nuamzawsak hi."},"31":{"text":"Nang hong kihil hong kipau ciangin na nadon le a ciim na hi hi."},"32":{"text":"Heak nopna na nei buale nangma le nangma kisiatvawt na hi hi. Kipau kitekna na saang thei le na ciim seseam tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Topa thasiana in pilna heakna khat ahi hi. Patoaina na saan thei ma in na kiniamkhiak masak kul tu hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Eite in tupna sawmna vawt ka leang Pathian ii deina bang bekin taangtung hi."},"2":{"text":"Na sep na vawt theampo maan hi ci in ngaisun tha tu ni hi, ahihang Topa in na tupna laingil tungah thu hong khen hi."},"3":{"text":"Na ngealnate Topa in thupha hong piak natu in ngen in, tua hile na sep tak ciang zawna taw, ma na tun tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa vawt sa khat simin a tawp natu khat tek om hi; a seksolte tawp natu sia lalna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"A kisathei pawpo Topa in ensan hi; ama in amate daan thuak natu panin a suaktasak buatu hi."},"6":{"text":"Thumaan vun a, citak vun, Pathian in na mawna hong maisak tu hi. Topa ii thu ni vun, thusia bangma na tungah hong tung ngawl tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa na lungkimsak ciangin na ngalte zongh lawm le ngual na suaksak thei tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Thumaan ngawlna taw sum tam mama nga sangin thumaan takin thalaw vateeina taw sum tawmno khat nei sia phazaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangma in ngealna vawt thei tu na hihang Pathian in na ngamtatnate hong zeak hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa in Pathian ii thuneisakna taw pau hi; ama thukhennate sia maan tawntung hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in toaisuangte le khaikhin a maan tu dei a, vanhzuak theampo a kilawm in zuak tu dei hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipate in ngitlona dual zo ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile a khaikim thukhenna in kumpi khat thahatsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa khat in thumaan thutak za nuam a, thumaan a sonte ama in maipha pia tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihing ciim khat in kumpipa lungdam in a om thei natu hanciam tu hi; kumpipa a thin a uuk le khat po in thi law thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa ii maipha a piakte sia khuakhaal kipat hun a, nguazusak meeikaaite bang ahi hi. Tuasung ah nuntakna om hi."},"16":{"text":"Khamh le ngunn sangin ciimna le heakna nei tu phazaw hi — phazaw pek hi."},"17":{"text":"Miphate in siatna a pial lampi tawn in khualhaw hi; tua ahikom na pai natu en in kidawm ta'n — tua in na nuntakna hong hun thei tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Kiphatsakna in siatna sungah hong then a, kisaktheina in kiamsukna sung hong then hi."},"19":{"text":"A kisatheite ii sungah kihel a, ih pawlte ii a sutol vanh hawmte ih nga sangin, kiniamkhiakin a zawngin om leang phazaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Nang hong kihilnate nadon in tua hile zawna na nga tu hi; Topa muang lete na lungdam tu hi."},"21":{"text":"A ciim a puicing mihing khat sia ama ii tel theina a neina pan kihe hi. Ama sia kamthum pau vaial a, ngual huai vaial hi."},"22":{"text":"A ciimte atu in ciimna sia nuntakna tuinaak ahi hi, ahihang mihing mawmawte pilsak tu hanciamna sia hun bo thawthong hi."},"23":{"text":"Mihing pilvangte in a pau ma in ngaisun khol uh hi; tuasia ciang amate pauna sia ngual zaak nop suak seseam hi."},"24":{"text":"Kamthiam paunate sia khuaitui bangin thum a, ciidam natu in pha hi."},"25":{"text":"A maan lampi hi ci in na up sia in thina sung hong then thei hi.","ref":"Pau 14:12"},"26":{"text":"Nasep haksa seam khat ii ankam limna in a nasep hatsak zaw hi, banghang ziam cile ama in a ngilvasak nuam hi."},"27":{"text":"Mihing ngilote in ngualdangte ngim nga natu in lam zong uh hi; amate kammalte mama ngitlona taw kuang hi."},"28":{"text":"Ngual ngensiatna sia mihing seksolte in kizelsak hi; amate in buaina piangsakin, ngualtamh hina zongh khentham hi."},"29":{"text":"A ngoltol mihingte in a lawmte theamin lalna sungah tumpui hi."},"30":{"text":"Nang hong maitui a hong mitsuk te kidawm in; amate in a sia pawlkhat ngaisun zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Khansauna sia a thutangte ii thaman ahi hi; puakkaanna in minthanna kumpilukhu ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Thahatna sangin thinsauna phazaw hi. Khuapite na uk siat sangin nangma le nangma na ki uk zawk tu sia phazaw hi."},"33":{"text":"Mihingte in Pathian ii deina a heak natu in aisaan uh a, ahizong a zo kikna sia Pathian ii khensatna bang bek ahi hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thinngimna taw kidim inn khat sung anneakpoai ah anneak sangin anluum ko bekkhat thinnuam a, neak sia phazaw hi."},"2":{"text":"A pil naseam khat in a mannung ngawl a topa ii tapa tungah thunei tu a, a ngamh sung pan khen khat lua tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Khamh le ngunn sia mei taw hal in kisit hi, Topa in mihing khat ii thinsung sit hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihing ngilote in ngitlo ngaisutnate diksa a, leilot theite in leilot thu diksa hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing zawngte na nuisan le, amate a vawt Pathian a selno na hi hi. Midang khat ii kaamsiatna tungtaang ah diksa in na om le daan na thuak tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Patangnote in a pate huvau in a angtan uh bangin pasal haamte in a tute huvau in angtang uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngual ii zatakte in leilot thu son ngawl hi, tuaciang mihing mawmawte in a mannei thuson tu bangma he ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhat in sumnguk piakna sia mitbum bang hi thei tu in ngaisun uh hi; amate in sumnguk piakna taw na theampo seam thei tu in um hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihingte ii hong it tu na nuam uh le no tungah hong khial ciangin maisak vun. Tatkhialnate teptee in nei leang ngualtamh hina khentham thei hi."},"10":{"text":"A mawmaw khat sia zakhatvei saatna taw a heak tu sangin, a pilvang khat in khatvei teihna taw tamzaw he thei hi."},"11":{"text":"Buaina a piangsak tawntung mihing seksolte kungah thina sia kamtai ngilo khat bangin hong pai tu hi."},"12":{"text":"A mawmawthuai tupna taw a komla mihing mawmaw pawlkhat taw kimu tu sangin, a note a kimatsak vompui khat taw kisi leang phazaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Thupha khat sia thusia taw na thuk le na bangkua sungah siatna a veng ngei buatu hi."},"14":{"text":"Kam kinial kipatna in tuicimna phung pan tuikee kipat bang hi; a nasiat ma in tawp vun."},"15":{"text":"A maw ngawl khat mawsakna ahizong mi seksol khat tha thongna ahizong Topa atu in ngaimawkhuai khawm hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihing mawmaw khat ii tungah pilna sin natu sum bosakna in phat tuamna om ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile ama in pianpui khentel theina nei ngawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Ngualtamhte in a ki itna kilak tawntung uh hi. Ngimna thuak khawm tek tu ih hi buale unau khat ih hi man bang om ziam?"},"18":{"text":"Khuangaisun ngawl te bekma in ngual leiba losak tu in kamciam tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Mawna a lamnai sia in ngimna vawt a lamnai ahi hi. A tawntungin na kisuangtaak le ngimna a zawzong na hi hi."},"20":{"text":"A sia vive ngaisun a, a paute in a pha mu tu lamet thei om ngawl a — siatna bek mu tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Mawmawthuai nasepte a seam tate ii nu le pa atu in heena le khuangaina simngawl a dang bangma a om bua hi."},"22":{"text":"Maituina in na ci hong damsak hi. A tawntung mainuu a omna in vuitat zok ngawl thina ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"A maan ngawl thukhenmangte in sumnguk ne ku hi, tuasia ciang a khaikim thukhenna kivawt nawn ngawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Mihing pil khat in ciim ngamtat tu tumh hi, ahihang a mawmaw khat in a tuatuam tumh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ta mawmawte in a pate atu in heena le a nute atu in thinnat khuangaina piangsak hi."},"26":{"text":"A maw ngawl khat liau piak tu sia maan ngawl hi; mihing phate daan a khak ciangin thukhaikim lam pan pialsak hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama le ama a kimuang khat sia pau tawntung ngawl hi. A om hithiat mihingte sia thuthuk tatak muna nei hi."},"28":{"text":"A tawpna ah, mihing mawmaw khat ngawngawn zongh pau bua hen a, a kam iim in om le a ciim a pilvang ma kisa thei hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngual taw a kituiton thei ngawl mihingte sia amate bek a kikinte ahi hi; midangte ii maan hi ci in a heakte a thukim pui buatu hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihing mawmaw khat in na khat a tel le a tel ngawl sia phamaw a sa bua hi; ama ii uuk sia ama bangza in pil khi ziam, ci in a lak nuam hi bek hi."},"3":{"text":"Mawna le maizumna tonkhawm hi; na zatakhuaina taan lete a luangin zawnsakna na nga tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihing khat ii kammalte in ciimna ii naak, tuipi bangin a thuk le a thiang luamtui luang bang hi thei hi."},"5":{"text":"A mawte angvan a, a maw ngawlte tungah a kikhaikim in thukhen ngawlna sia maan ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"A mawmaw khat po in kam kinialna a phuang le, ngual ii vel tu a zong ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"A mawmaw khat a pau ciangin ama le ama kilalsak hi a; ama kampaute taw thaang sungah awk hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngual ngensiatna sia lim mama a, bangza in kivalh suk nuam ziam!"},"9":{"text":"A datham mihing khat sia ngual a lalsak thei khat za in sia hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa sia, tausaang kho taw kibang a, thutangte in zuanin ngammuanna nga thei hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihaute ahile amate hauna in, a saang a kho khuapi luphungte bangin, amate dal hi ci in ngaisun hi."},"12":{"text":"A kiniamkhiak ngawlte kuama in a zakta bua hi; mihing a kisatheite sia lalna lampi zuan ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ngual kam na zo ma in ngai masa in. Tuabangin na hi buale nang sia mawmaw a, ngual a thusim ngawl na suak hi."},"14":{"text":"Na nat ciangin nuntak nopna thin in nang hong luhaisak thei hi, ahihang tuasia na bosua tha le na lamet khakbel sia bo hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihing pilvangte in lawp tawntung a, pilna sin tu kingingsa in om uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihing thupi khat taw na kisi nuam ziam? Letsong khat puak lete ol takin na kisi thei tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Thukhenzum sungah, a pau phitbel pa sia a langkhat pa ii thu a dok mateng a maan son bang hi tawntung hi."},"18":{"text":"Thukhenzum sungah a thahat mihing nii sia thu nei in a kilangpan tan le mee sawksak in thu saatsat thei hi."},"19":{"text":"Na mealheakte hu lete amate in khuapi luphung kho khat bangin nang hong dal tu hi, ahihang amate taw na kihau le a innkha uh hong khasan tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Na ci pawpo taw kizui in thupiangte na nuntakpui kul tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Na kampauna in nuntakna hong keam thei a, tua ahibuale zong hong lalsak thei hi; tua ahikom na kammal tung pan a piang thute lungkimin na thuak kul hi."},"22":{"text":"Zi khat na nei ciang na pha khat mu na hi hi; tuasia in nang tungah Topa pha hi ci in hong lak hi."},"23":{"text":"Mizawng khat in a pau ciangin kamthiam a zak kul hi, ahihang mihau khat in ngual kam a zo ciangin kamkhal zangh hi."},"24":{"text":"Kingualtamhna pawlkhat sia kho ngawl hi, ahihang ngualtamh pawlkhatte ahile suapui laipeete sangin thumaan zaw hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A leilot thei a mawmaw khat hi tu sangin, zawng napi a thumaan khat ih hi tu phazaw hi."},"2":{"text":"Heakna om ngawl thalawpna in pha ngawl hi; thin vei laakna in ngimna sungah hong then tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhatte in amate ii mawmawt ngamtatnate taw kilal sua a, tuasia ciang Topa mawsiat uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihaute in ngualtamh thakte mu tawntung hi, ahihang a zawngte in ngualtamh tawmno a nei sun teng keam zo ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Thukhenzum sungah leilot thu na son le daan na thuak tu hi — suatakna a om buatu hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing thupite tung pan maipha nga tu in a kuama po hanciam uh hi; a kuama po in phattuamna a pia theite sia ka ngualtamh hi ci tek uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Mizawng khat in a mealheakte ngawngawn konlaw thei ngawl hi, ama ii ngualtamh a nei ngawl sia lamdang ngawl hi. Bangza in hanciam kale kuama a nga zo bua hi."},"8":{"text":"Nangma le nangma kiphatvawt in a, na sin thei theampo sin in; tuaciang na sin sa teng ciamtee in, tua hile na khangto tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Thukhenzum sungah leilot thu a sonte peuma daan piakna pan suakta ngawl tu hi; ama a lal ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"A mawmawte a nuam leilam in nungta heak hen a, salte in lianzaw tate uk heak hen."},"11":{"text":"Khuangaisun thei khat na hile na thin tomna na uk zo tu hi. Nang tung hong taa khial khat a om ciang awlmawk ngawlin om theina in phatna lian khat ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa ii thin uukna in tawpi hawk bang ahi hi. Ahihang ama ii hong phatvawtna sia ih dei laitak a zu nguatui bang ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"A mawmaw tate in a nu le a pate lalna sung then thei hi. A nawnsan zi sia mal khakhat in a taak vakek tui taw kibang hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihing khat in a nu le a pa tung panin inn le sumte lua thei a, ahihang Topa bek in khuangaisun thei zi khat pia thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Na datham nuam le datham in; mumu lel in, ahihang ngilkial in na om tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Pathian thukhamte tang in, na khansauzaw tu hi; na thusim buale na thi tu hi."},"17":{"text":"A zawngte tungah na piak ciangin Topa tungah pukthaak bang hi a, Topa in hong lo kik tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Na tate heak thei natu in a khanmoi lai in tek in. Tuabangin na vawt buale amate le amate a kilalsua natu in a hu na hi tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing khat a thin a ngam le ama in a piang thute thuaksak in. Ngim nga natu panin khatvei na hun ngei le na hut kik kul tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ngaisut piakna ngai in heakna sin tu na lungngul le ni khat ni ciang na ciim tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihingte in na namcin ngeal thei hi, ahihang Topa deina bang bekin piang tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Duhopna in min paanna hi; mizawngte in a leilot theite sangin phazaw lai hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa thu ni in na om le khansau in na nungta tu hi, lungkim in siatna pan suakta in na om tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhatte a kam sungah an zongh kibak naap ngawl za dongin datham mama hi."},"25":{"text":"A phazaw ngamtatna a he ngawlte ii a heak thei natu in, kisaktheinate sia daan kipia tu hi. Na ciim le nang tungah hong kipau hong kihil ciangin na tel tu hi."},"26":{"text":"A maizumhuai, a minpaan pa bek in a pa vawtsia tu a, ahibuale a inn panin a nu not tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Tapa awng, pilna sinna na tawp le na heak sate zongh hai ngawlin na ngaingon tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Tetti khat in mihing khat pawpo supna baina pia nuamin a khensat zawkciang thumaan thukhenna om thei nawn ngawl hi. A seksol mihingte in a sia nate sin tu lamnai hi."},"29":{"text":"A kihisak a mawmaw khat in velna vuakna nga tatak tu hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zu tamlei neakna in aw saangsak a, hong mawmawsak hi. Zu khamna sia mawmawthuai hi."},"2":{"text":"Hong ngalh tawpi khat na kiitak tu bangin a thin uuk kumpipa khat kiita in; ama thin uuksakna in eima le eima kithalupna hi."},"3":{"text":"Kam kinialnate sia a mawmaw khat po in pan thei hi;
