tuate panin kikepna in a zatak huai ngamtatna ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"A hun lai in lothaw tu a datham mama lotho pa khat in anlaak tu a nei buatu hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing khat ii khua ngaisutnate sia, tuikhuk thuk sung a tui bang ahi hi, ahihang thuthuk mu thei khat in tua tui toai thei hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing theampo in bangza thumaanin citak khi ziam ci thei tek uh hi, ahihang tuabang ahi takpi mihing ih mu zo tu ziam!"},"7":{"text":"A pa uh thumaan a, a maan nasep a seam le, a tate sia hampha uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in thukhenna ah to a, a sia a mu ciang khentel hi."},"9":{"text":"Khat pawpo in ama thinsung thiangtho a, mawna taw kipeal zo ing a ci thei takpi tu ziam?"},"10":{"text":"Topa in a maan ngawl khaikhin toaisuangte le vanh teena a zangh mihingte ensan hi."},"11":{"text":"Patangnote zongh amate ii sep le vawt taw amate sia bang ziam ci in lak hi; amate thumaan ziam, pha ziam na son thei tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in khuamu thei natu mittangte le khua zaak thei natu bilte hong pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Na hunte mumutna in na zangh le na zawng tu hi; komla in, tua hile neak tu tam mama na nei tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Vanh lei thei khat in a manham lei hi ci in phun a, tua zawkciang a man a nee zawkna sia kiphatsak pui hi."},"15":{"text":"Na son sia bang ziam ci in na he le, khamh le suangmanpha te sangin a manpha zaw na khat a nei na hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Khualmi khat ii leiba teng losak tu in kamciam a pia mi mawmaw khat sia ama ii neisate laaksakin a lo dong vaukhamna in koisak khol kul hi."},"17":{"text":"Thumaan ngawlna taw na nga nate sia an limbel neak bangin diksa tha tu ni hi, ahihang hai ngawlin hun khat ciang, tuate in kamdim senvui baak bang hi tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Ngaisut piakna pha saang in, zawna na nga tu hi; ngealna om ngawlin ngalsim thawthong heak in."},"19":{"text":"Ngualngen khat in thuku a keam thei ngei buatu hi. Mihing a kam tamleite kung pan kikeam in."},"20":{"text":"Na nu le na pa na tomlaw le na nuntakna sia khuazing sungah meiinn mit bangin bo tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Hauna ol vaial in na nga le nang atu pha ngawl vaial tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Ngual ii nang tungah hong khialnate thuk kik tu in ngaisun heak in. Topa muang in, ama in a maanin seam tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in a maan ngawl khaikhin le toaisuang a zangh mihingte ensan hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa in ih tot tu lampi khensat zo hi; tua ahile bangbangin khat pawpo in ama nuntakna ii zotna sang a tel thei tu ziam?"},"25":{"text":"Pathian tungah piak tu kamciam na vawt ma in, pha tak ngaisun phot in. A zawkciang khuangai tha tu ni hi."},"26":{"text":"A ciim kumpipa khat in akua in a maan ngawl seam ziam ci in he tu a, tua pa hesuak ngawlin daan pia tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa in khua ngaisut theina le a pha a sia heak theina hong pia hi; eima le eima ih kiphualseal zo bua hi."},"28":{"text":"Kumpipa khat in thumaan, thukhaikim le a kilawm bangin a uk laiteng a vaangletna kip tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Khangnote ii thahatna thupi ih sa a, khanghaamte puakkaang ih zakta hi."},"30":{"text":"Khat vevei thuakna haksa khat in, ih nuntakzia hong khealsak hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in luitui luanna lam ol takin a heak bangin kumpipa khat ii ngaisutna uk hi."},"2":{"text":"Na sep na vawt theampo maan sa tha tu ni hi; ahihang Topa in na tupna laingilte tungah thukhen hi ci in ciamtee in."},"3":{"text":"A maan le ahi tu bangin seam in; tua in sangaw biakpiakna sangin Topa lungdamsak zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihing seksolte sia amate ii a kihisakna le a kisaktheina in uk hi, tuaciang hisia in mawna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Pha takpi ngeal in, tam mama na nei tu hi; na lawplai leih le a kicing na nei ngei buatu hi."},"6":{"text":"Thumaan ngawlna taw na nga hauna bo pal tu a, ahihang thina thaang sung hong tumpui ma in bo ngawl tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing seksolte sia amate ii ngoltolna taw lal uh a, amate in a maan sep tu nial uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Mimawte in lampi koai tawn uh hi; a maw ngawlte in a maan seam hi."},"9":{"text":"A nge hat zi khat taw inn khat sung teenkhop sangin innkhum tungah teang leang phazaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi seksolte in ngilkial andu bangin siatna vawt nuam hi; amate in kuama tungah hesuakna nei ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"A kihisak khat in daan a khak ciangin khuangaisun meal ngawl khat ngawngawn in pil law hi. A ciim khat in ama a kihilna tung panin pilna nga tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Thumaan thutang ahi Pathian in, mihing seksolte inn sungah bang piang ziam ci in he a, a seksolte siacipsak tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Mizawngte auna aw ngai tu na nial le, hu tu dei a, nangma ii hu ngetna aw hong kizaaksak ngawl tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihing khat po in nang tungah hong thin uuk le letsong khat piak ku na taw ama thim tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Thukhaikimin a kisep ciang, mihing phate lungdam uh hi. Ahihang mihing ngilote thinkiamsak hi."},"16":{"text":"A kilawm ngamtatna pan, a puapial pawpo thina in ngak nginge hi."},"17":{"text":"A nuam leilam nuntaknate, sapittui le anlim neak lei nate in nang hong hausak ngeingawl tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihing seksolte in mihing phate tungah thuaksak tu a hanciam ngimna teng, amate tung ma ah theng kik hi."},"19":{"text":"A ngenge, a phuphun zi khat taw teenkhop sangin sennealngam sungah teang leang phazaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Mihing ciimte in hauna le nopsakna taw nungta uh hi, ahihang mihing mawmawte in sum a nga pawpo a manlang thei zaza in zangh uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Dik in a, thumaan in, tua hile khansau in na nungta tu hi; ngual dangte in hong zakta tu a, ahi tu bangin hong phatvawt tu hi."},"22":{"text":"A pil a thiam ngalkapmang khat in mihing thahatte ii a cin khuapi khat sia la zo hi, tuaciangin amate ii muan khuapi luphungte susia hi."},"23":{"text":"Buaina taw na kipeal nuam le, na kampau kidawm in."},"24":{"text":"A kihisak mihing khat hong lak ta'n, tua hile a kisathei, a kiphasak le ngual atu a ngaisun ngawl mihing khat kong lak tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Nasep tu a nial mihing datham khat in ama le ama kithat hi bek hi;"},"26":{"text":"a dei teng a nga natu a ngaisut sia ama nasep hi bek hi. Thumaan thutang khat ahile ngual pia thei a, ngo takin pia hi."},"27":{"text":"Mihing seksolte ii sangaw biakna a piak ciang, a tuanin ngitlo thin taw a pia le Topa in huatsa hi."},"28":{"text":"A leilot khat ii tetti panna sia ki um ngawl hi, ahihang thu a ngaisun kaak mihing khat ii kammal sia kisaang hi."},"29":{"text":"Thumaan thutang mihingte in amate le amate kimuang uh hi; a seksol mihingte in a thiam thei za in a kivawttawm uh kul hi."},"30":{"text":"Mihingte ciimna pilna, kivakna le thuthuk muna cite sia — Topa in nang hong langpan le, kimanna nei ngawl hi."},"31":{"text":"Ngalsim natu in siphute na kinging kholsak thei hi. Ahihang ngalzawna hong pia pa in Topa ahi hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minphatna le hau mamana khat sasang teal tu hi le uhte minphatna teal vun."},"2":{"text":"A haute le a zawngte in hisia nei khawm hi: Amate nii sia Topa ii vawt khop ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihing khuangaisun theite in ngimna hong pai ciangin mu thei a pial uh hi, ahihang khuangaisun meal ngawl khat sia tua ii sungah tum vacin tu a, a zawkciang kisiik tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa ii thu ni vun a, kiniamkhiak vun, tua hile hauna, patoaina le khansauna na nga tu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Na nuntakna na it le, lamdung ah a kisia mihing seksolte matna thaangte na pial vun."},"6":{"text":"Patang khat ii a nuntakzia tu na hil vun, tua hile a khan tawntungin ciamtee tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Mizawngte in sumhaute ii sal ahi uh hi. Sum na pu le leeitopa ii sal na suak hi."},"8":{"text":"A maan ngawl thaicii na tu uh le siatna hong po to tu hi, tuaciang ngual na zawthawkna uh sia a tawpna hong hi tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Piakna sungah na ngo vun a, na an uh mizawngte na hawm vun. Tua hu in thupha na saang tu hi."},"10":{"text":"A kihisak mihing sia na pial vun, tua hile kam kinialna, kihauna le min kisiatsakna a om nawn buatu hi."},"11":{"text":"Thinsung thianthona le kamthiam paunate zak tu dik na sa le kumpipa ii lawm na hi tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Leilot theite ii kammalte maan ngawl hi ci in lakna taw Topa in thumaan thutak sia keamcing hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasal datham pa in inn veu ah om hi; pusuak leng tawpi in hong man thei tha tu hi ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Palngulna sia thaang hi a — Topa thin uukna a thuakte tua thaang sungah awk hi."},"15":{"text":"Patangte ii mawmawthuai ngamtatna le bawlpelnate a nei sia a ngeina hi lel hi, ahihang a kilawm bang a, ngoaibul bekna taw amate ngamtat zia tu kihil thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Na hau natu in mihaute tungah letsong na pia a, ahibuale mizawngte na zothaw le nangma zongh na zawng tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Ngai vun, mihing ciimte pauna kong hil tu hi. Amate ii hilciannate kan vun,","title":"Ciim Kamteptee Sawmthum"},"18":{"text":"tuaciang ciamtee in, na zangh kik thei le na lungdam tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa na pummuan tu ka dei hi; tua hu in tu in hong son tu khi hi."},"20":{"text":"Nang atu in paunak sawmthum kong at zo hi. Tuate sungah heakna le ngaisut pha piaknate om hi,"},"21":{"text":"tuaciang tuate in thumaan thutak sia bang tatak ziam ci in hong hil tu hi. Tua zawkciang tuate a zong tu in hong kipaisak ciang a maan thu nong ciapui tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Hi thei tang ci in mizawngte tung pan hamphatna la heak vun; thukhenzum ah cimaw in a dingte tung pan hamphatna la heak vun.","title":"-1-"},"23":{"text":"Topa in amate ii thu sia amate taangin nialsak tu a, amate nuntakna a lauthawn po ii nuntakna kilauthawn tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Mihing thinngam, thin ngeamte ngualtamh in na man heak vun.","title":"-2-"},"25":{"text":"Amate omziate na zui tha tu a, na kikheal kik zo buatu uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Mi dangkhat ii leibate losak tu in kamciam pia heak vun.","title":"-3-"},"27":{"text":"Lo zawk ngawlna khat nei lete na lupna dongin amate in hong laaksak tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Na taanghpupite ii ngisuang luite na khiin heak vun.","title":"-4-"},"29":{"text":"Nasep pha tak a, a seam mihing khat hong lak tavun, tuaciang mihing tam mamate sang a phazaw, kumpite kitholpui tu dong a, a kilawm khat kong lak tu hi.","title":"-5-"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihing thupi khat taw an nekhawm tu in na to uh ciang, ama sia akua ziam ci in phawk nginge tavun.","title":"-6-"},"2":{"text":"An na du mama uh zong na kidawm tavun."},"3":{"text":"Ama hong lui anlimte neak nopin nei leih heak vun; hong aitaana khat po zongh hi thei tha tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Hau tu na hanciamna ah nangma le nangma na tha a bo ngawl natu in ciimna a khom na nei in.","title":"-7-"},"5":{"text":"Na sumte sia muvanlai khat a tha hong po in a len bangma in thakhat thu in bo thei hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing a iiciilte sabuai ah an na ne heak vun, tua ahibuale zong anlim hong luite hu in duhop neak heak vun.","title":"-8-"},"7":{"text":"“Tawm beak ne lai in” hong ci kale hong ci takpi hi ngawl thei hi. Ama ii ngaisutna sia ama tatak ma ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Na neak sa teng na lua kik tu a, na sialpokna theampo a vaal thong hi tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing mawmaw khat sia a khua heak thei natu in na sonpui heak vun; ama in thupi sa thei meal ngawl hi.","title":"-9-"},"10":{"text":"Bangma hunin ngisuang luite na khiin ngei heak vun, ahibuale tangate neisa leitang na sut heak vun.","title":"-10-"},"11":{"text":"Topa sia amate ii a vaanglian a dal pa hi a, nang hong langpanin amate ii sang panin hong pau tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Na syapa ii hong hilna pha tak nadon in a, na sin thei theampo sin in.","title":"-11-"},"13":{"text":"Patangte tungah tek tu le pau tu haisaang heak in. A kilawm bang a, a ngoaibul bekna in ama thisak ngawl tu hi.","title":"-12-"},"14":{"text":"A tatakin ci leang ama ii nuntakna kihun zongh hi thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tapa awng, nong ciim le ka lungdam mama tu hi.","title":"-13-"},"16":{"text":"Ciim kamte na pau ka zaak ciang ka angtang tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Mimawte eang heak in; Topa thasiana sia na nuntak sung na thintoi thu hisak in.","title":"-14-"},"18":{"text":"Tuabang hi lete na maivang tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Ngai in ka tapa awng, ciim in a na nuntakzia thuk takin ngaisun in.","title":"-15-"},"20":{"text":"Sapittui tam lei a nete, ahibuale an a bebente taw na kithawl heak in."},"21":{"text":"Zukhamte le antuangte zawng vaial tu hi. Anneak le mut sia nasep in na nei le hai ngawlin puansia ngapkaai na silh tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Na pa thuson ngai in; ama ngawl taw piang thei ngawl tu ni hi. Na nu a khanhaam ciangin ama thupi na saknate lak in.","title":"-16-"},"23":{"text":"Thumaan thutak, ciimna, sintheina le khua ngaisut theina, hite sia a man piak taak a, ahizong na zuak tu in manpha lei hi."},"24":{"text":"Mihing thutang khat ii pa in a lungdam natu thu om hi. Tapa ciim khat tungtaang ah na angtang thei hi."},"25":{"text":"Na pa le na nu sia nang huvau in angtang tahen; tua lungdamna sia na nu pia in."},"26":{"text":"Tapa awng, hong nadon ta'n a, ka nuntakna sia nangma ettee tu hisak in.","title":"-17-"},"27":{"text":"Pumpi zuak numeite le a paktat numeite sia a lauhuai thi theina thaang ahi uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in ngualsuam phalakte bangin hong ngakin pasal tam mamate thumaan ngawl suaksak hi."},"29":{"text":"Zu tam ne leilam a, a nam thak a ne nuam lai khat kei hong lak ta'n, tuaciang a thinngim mama, khuangaihuai a kisa, ngual buaisak tawntung le lungkim ngawlin a phun tawntung khat kong lak tu hi. A mit san neinoi a, a pial thei tu hi napi liamnate nei hi.","title":"-18-","merge":"30"},"31":{"text":"Sapittui sia bangza po in san kilkel in, hai sungah tee vasip a, valhsuk ol hikale na ze etsak heak vun."},"32":{"text":"A khuavak ni zing ciang ngul nguu nei ii tuk bang hi na sa tu hi."},"33":{"text":"A kiitakhuai lului na mu tu a, na ngaisutna le na kampauna a thiangtho vaset buatu hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuipi tungah teambaw nguih bang, teambaw kilok tung to a, a saangna ah hong veito bang na hi tu hi."},"35":{"text":"“Hong kivua hi nak tu hi ve aw,” na ci tu a, “Vel zazaan thuak hi vak ing, ahihang ka phawk bua hi. Banghang khangciim thei ngawl khi ziam? Zu tawm ma kisamh lai ing,” na ci tu hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihing tatsiate na eang heak vun a, amate pawlpui tu in na hanciam heak vun.","title":"-19-"},"2":{"text":"Buaina piansak tu sia amate ngaisut pi hi lel hi; amate a pau simin mihing khat pawpo ii thin nasak tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Innkuante in ciimna le telthiamna doppha in kisa hi.","title":"-20-"},"4":{"text":"Heakna omna munah inn doituamte sia a manpha na hoite taw kizeam hi."},"5":{"text":"Ciimna in thahatna sangin phazaw hi. Hi hi, heakna sia thahatna sangin thupi zaw hi.","title":"-21-"},"6":{"text":"A tawpkhakna ah ngal na do ma in pha takpi na ngeal uh kul a, tuaciang ngaisut piakna pha tam na ngana zui in zawna zongh na nga zaw thei tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ciimkam tepteete sia mihing mawmaw khat ii tel tu in thuk lei hi. Amate in a thupi kikupnate sungah a son tu bangma he ngawl hi.","title":"-22-"},"8":{"text":"Thusia bebek na ngeal le, buaina piangsak pa ci in na minthang tu hi.","title":"-23-"},"9":{"text":"Mihing mawmaw khat ii ngaisut tupnate sia mawna taw kidim hi. Midangte siatson bebek a kinte ngual in ensan hi."},"10":{"text":"Phatmawk hun sungah, na thaneam le a thaneam takpi ma na hi hi.","title":"-24-"},"11":{"text":"Mihing khat sia thumaan ngawl thu taw a kithat tu na mu le ama na hut natu in haisaang heak in.","title":"-25-"},"12":{"text":"Kei taw bang kisai ziam ci tha tu ni hi, ahihang Pathian in na thinsung tawngh hong he a, tua tungah thu hong khen tu hi. Ama in nang hong en nginge hi; ama in he hi. Tuaciang na sep babangin ama in thaman hong pia tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tapa awng, khuaitui ne in; khuaitui pha hi. Khuai lu sung a, khuaitui sia na leei tungah thum ahi bangma","title":"-26-"},"14":{"text":"ciimna sia na thaa atu in pha hi ci in na telthiang tu hi. Ciimna nga in, tua hi le na mai vang tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihing thumaan khat suttol tu a tum, ahibuale a inn a laaksak nuam mihing seksol pa bang hi heak vun.","title":"-27-"},"16":{"text":"Mihing thumaan khat in bang tanvei po a puk hial zong tho kik tawntung tu hi; ahizong lalna in mihing seksolte siasak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Na ngal pa lalna a thuak ciangin lungdam heakin a, tuaciang a lutu ciangin lungdam heak vun.","title":"-28-"},"18":{"text":"Ngual tungtuan nopna na nei le Topa in hong he tu a, a dei buatu hi; tuasia ciang Topa in amate daan piak awl thei tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing ngilote hangin na thinngimsak heak in; amate eang heak in.","title":"-29-"},"20":{"text":"Mihing seksol khat sia a mai bing hi — lamet tu a nei bua hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, Topa thasiana nei in a, kumpipa zongh zakta in. Kumpipa langpanin a leedote taw bangma kipee-awna nei heak in;","title":"-30-"},"22":{"text":"tuabang mihingte tawmvei no sungin siacip thei hi. Pathian ahibuale kumpipa piansak thei lalna sia na he ziam?"},"23":{"text":"Mihing ciimte in hite zongh na ci lai hi: Thukhen pa khat atu in doidan nopna a nei sia maan ngawl hi.","title":"Ciimna Paunak A dangte"},"24":{"text":"Mikhial khat khial ngawl hi a cile ama sia mihing theampo in haamsiat in ensan tu hi."},"25":{"text":"A mawte daan a pia thukhenmangte ahile khangto tu a, ngual phat sonna nga tu hi."},"26":{"text":"A thumaan kam zo kikna in lawm tatak hina lim khat ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Na lo ante laak pha zo a, na nuntak natu thalaw thei tu in na kimuan mateng, na inn sa heak in a, innkuan phut heakin."},"28":{"text":"A thu om ngawlin ngualdang khat langpanin tetti pang heak in, ahibuale zong ama ii huvau telkhial thei thute phuang heak in."},"29":{"text":"“Ama ii kei hong vawt bangin ama tungah vawt tong! Ama thuk tong!” ci heak vun."},"30":{"text":"Pasal datham le a mawmaw khat ii lo sung le sapithuan sungah ka vak hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua munte sia lingkungte le lopate in khunel hi. A huang uumna phungte zongh cimh zo hi."},"32":{"text":"Hite ka en a, khua ka ngaisut ciang tua tung panin hi bang heakna khat ka nga hi:"},"33":{"text":"na uuk le tawmvei sung mu zok in. Leekoai in tawmvei tawlnga in,"},"34":{"text":"ahihang na mut lanin zawnna in hiamh toai phalak khat bangin hong sim tu hi.","ref":"Pau 6:10-11; 25:6-7; Lk 14:8-10"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah Kumpipa Hezekiah kumpi zum sung pan ettee in a ki at kik Solomon paunakte om thua lai hi.","title":"Solomon Paunak Dangte"},"2":{"text":"Pathian ii a seal thute hu in ama zatak ih pia hi; kumpipate sia tua thu a thiangin a sontel uh hu in zatak ih pia hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa khat ii ngaisut sia na he ngei bua uh hi; ama ngaisutnate in ei bat zawk ahi ngawl, van saang bang, tuipi thuk bang ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngunn sung panin a nin teng a laakkeak ciangin ngunn seakpa in na hoi mama khat piangsak thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa kung panin ngaisutna pia mihing siate heam le uhte a kumpi ukna sia thukhaikim thu om hi ci in thang tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa mai ah na din uh ciangin hong nasia ngaisut natu in hanciam heak vun a, mihing thupi bangin kiheang heak vun."},"7":{"text":"A thupi zaw ngualdang khat atu na dinmun awn a hong kisawl sangin dinmun saangzawna ah kaato a hong kisawl tu sia phazaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Na muna uh khat taw kisai in thukhenzum theng papaih heak vun. Tetti dang khat in nang muna sia maan ngawl hi ci in hong lak thei le bang law tu ni ziam?"},"9":{"text":"Na innpaamte taw ngaisut kisik ngawlna khat na nei uh le noma sungah kilemtua tavun a, thuku khat po pualaak se heak vun."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahibuale mihing theampo in thuku keamcing thei ngawlte ci in hong he tu a, tua maizumna na pu zo ngei buatu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ngaisutna khat pha tak a, pualaak theina in ngunn tung khamh taw zep bang ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Thuakna a nei ngeisa mihing khat ii kidop tu thupiakna a saang nuamte sia khamh khutzungbute ahibuale khamh pha belte taw a kivawt kizepnate sangin phazaw hi."},"13":{"text":"A muanhuai kamtaipa sia anlaak hun nisat laitak tuivot bangin, a sawlpa atu lungpilna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Piak tu kamciam napi a pia ngeingawlte sia nguatui paai ngawl meeikaai le vuite bang ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Thin sau takin zolna in a tha khobel kinanna sutham thei a, ngamukte thinsung ngawngawn zo thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Na kisap za sangin a tamzaw khuaitui ne heak vun; a tam lei le hong luasak tha tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Na innpaamte mun haw vazut leih heak vun; amate in hong cimtak tu a, hong ngaimaw thei tu hi."},"18":{"text":"A maan ngawl kimawsakna sia, namsau, moltawng, ahibuale thaltang hiam bangin kiitakhuai hi."},"19":{"text":"Phatmawk hun sungah a muanhuai ngawl khat muan thaakna sia ha ngawk sa taw an thai nop bang, ahibuale peangbai sa in lampai taw kibang hi."},"20":{"text":"A thin kiamcip khat kungah lasakna sia khuasik laitak a puan suusakna, ahibuale a liamma sung ci noisakna taw kibang hi."},"21":{"text":"Na ngalte a ngil a kial le an pia in; a dang a ko le amate ii dawn tu khat pia in.","ref":"Rom 12:20"},"22":{"text":"Maizumna taw ama na kaanghsak tu a, tuaciang Topa in thaman hong pia tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Saksang vui in ngua hong puak bangma ngual ngensiatna in thin uukna hong puak takpi hi."},"24":{"text":"A nge hat zi khat taw inn khat sungah teenkhop sangin innkhum tungah teang leang phazaw hi."},"25":{"text":"A khak belin, a khualana mun pan thupha zaakna in na dangko laitak tuivot neak bang ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Mihing pha khat in mihing ngilo khat ii thu a zawp ciang ciktui nin ahibuale nguu a kitha tuikhuk khat hong phawksak hi."},"27":{"text":"Khuaitui tam lei sia nang atu pha ngawl hi, tuasia bangma, pokna tam lei nga tu hanciam zongh pha ngawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Na thin uukna na khaam zo buale luphung taw a ki uum ngawl, a kisim thei khuapi dongdai bangin na cimaw tu hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A mawmaw khat pok natu sia khaal lai vuuk taak, ahibuale anlaak hunlai nguazu tu bang keakin suak thei ngawl hi."},"2":{"text":"A thuak tu ma in na kilawm bua nale haamsiatna in bangma hong law zo ngawl tu hi. Tuate in leleang a, tawlngak hun a nei ngawl vacimte taw kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Siphu khat sia saat kul a, laa khat sia kamkhau bul kul a, tuaciang a mawmaw khat sia vel kul hi."},"4":{"text":"A mawmawthuai dokna khat na zo le, a dongh pa bangma a mawmaw na hi hi."},"5":{"text":"A mawmawthuai dokna khat sia a mawmawthuai ma in zo kik lete, a dongh sia in ama kingaisut bangin a pil ngawl hunlam kiphawk tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing mawmaw khat kamtai in na sawl le, nangma peang a saattan bang na hi thei hi; buai natu a zong na hi hi."},"7":{"text":"A mawmaw khat in paunak khat a zak theina sia a koncip khat ii a peang a zak thei bang bek hi."},"8":{"text":"A mawmaw khat po pokna in saili kuung tungah suangtang kikhit bang bek ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"A mawmaw khat in ciimkam teptee a zak ciang zukham khat ii a khut sung pan ling tangciak a daw nop hong phawksak hi."},"10":{"text":"Thacialpa khat in, hong vak thawthong a mawmaw khat po tha a cial le, a kisai theampo nasak bek hi."},"11":{"text":"A mawmaw khat in mawmawt vai khat a nii veina in a vawt kik le a luak sa a ne kik ui khat taw kibang hi.","ref":"2 Pe 2:22"},"12":{"text":"A ciim ngawl khat ciim a kisa sia sangin, a mawmawbel khat phazaw lai hi."},"13":{"text":"Mihing dathamte banghangin a inn uh pan pusuak ngeingawl ziam? Amate in bang kiita ziam? Tawpite ziam?"},"14":{"text":"Mihing dathamte sia a lupna tungah kilum lelet uh hi. Innkha khat pattaa tungah a kihei za sangin, tua pa in a khuala zaw theng ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi pawlkhatte sia ama le ama a kam sungah an a kibak tu takpi zongh datham hi."},"16":{"text":"A datham mihing khat in, amate ii ngaisut thiamna a lak thei pasal sali sangin pilvangzaw in kingaisun tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Nang taw kisai ngawl thu khat taw kam kinialna sungah kihelna sia khua sung lampi tawnin ui khat a bil pan zap taw kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihing khat in ngualtheam a, a zawkciang ka ciammuina zam a cite sia, a lauhuai ngalhiam taw a kimai mihing thin amh khat taw kibang hi.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"Thing om buale mei mit hi; thu nawnsan om buale kihauna bo hi."},"21":{"text":"Meihol in meikamte linghsak a, thing in mei kuangsak hi, buaina a piangsakte in kam kinialna kipee suaksak hi."},"22":{"text":"Thu nawnsan sia lim mama hi! Bangza in valh thanuam hi ziam!"},"23":{"text":"Na ngaisut takpi teng seal a, thumaan son ngawlna in a man ol leibeal zutna in a kizangh cimbeng taw kibang hi."},"24":{"text":"A kihitheamsak mihing khat in ngual a etsatna sia kisialpokna kammalte taw seal hi."},"25":{"text":"A kampaunate ahile zaaknophuai tha tu hi, ahihang um heak vun, banghang ziam cile a thinsung ah ki etsatna a dim in om hi."},"26":{"text":"A ngual etsatna sia phualseal zo tha tu hikale, mihing theampo in a ngitlo ngamtatnate mu tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Ngual thaang a sia mihingte sia amate ma awk kik vacin hi. Min a cimhsak mihingte sia min in vuknelh hi."},"28":{"text":"Leilot thu taw ngual thinnat natu a vawt nuam khat sia na etsat kul hi. Thumaan ngawl sonna in siatna simngawl a dang a piangsak bua hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zing ciang thu taw kisai in kisuangtaak khol heak vun. Tua hun le tu kilaklaw bang piang tu ziam na he bua uh hi.","ref":"Jas 4:13-16"},"2":{"text":"Midangte in poksak vun — khualmite ngawngawn in poksak vun; bangma hunin noma le noma kipok heak vun."},"3":{"text":"Mawmawt ngamtatna pan a piang thei ngimnate sia suang le sen ii ngitna taw kisontee thei ngawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Thin uukna sia tatkha a, lalna piangsak thei hi, ahihang ki eenna sia bangma taw kiteengat thei ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing khat ii a khialna hu in a kilangh in hilna pauna sia kei bangma hong awlmawk ngawl hita a, hong ci saang phazaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Ngualtamh khat in hong nasak tha hial zong, a pha piang le a deina hi. Ahihang na ngal khat in a khut taw na liangko pan hong koai ciang — na kikeam vun!"},"7":{"text":"Na ngil a va laitakin khuaitui zongh na du buatu hi, ahihang na ngilkial laitakin, ankha khat zongh thum hi."},"8":{"text":"A inn pan a puapial khat pawpo sia, a bu sung pan a leang vacim taw kibang hi."},"9":{"text":"Paaknamtui le sathau namtuite in hong lungdamsak zaw a, ahihang ngimna in na thinnopna bosak hi."},"10":{"text":"Nangma ngualtamhte ahizong na pa ngualtamhte ahizong mangil heak in. Ngim na nga le na suapuipa kungah hu ngen heak in; na nai a om innpaam khat in a khuala a om na suapuipa sangin hong hu thei zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Ciim in, ka tapa awng, tua hile ka lungdam tu hi; kei tungah maw hong zong khat po munah ka zo kik natu om hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing khuangaisun theite in ngimna hong pai ciangin mu thei a pial uh hi, ahihang khuangaisun meal ngawl khat sia tua ii sungah tum vacin tu a, a zawkciang kisiik tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Khualmi khat ii leiba teng losak tu in kamciam a pia mi mawmaw khat sia ama ii neisate laaksakin a lo dong vaukhamna in koisak khol kul hi."},"14":{"text":"Zing tuungin na ngualtamh te awnging takin nuksetna kam taw na phong le a haamsiat taw zong na kibang thei hi."},"15":{"text":"A nge hat zi khat sia nguazuk ni a, mal khakhat veu a taak vakek tui taw kibang hi."},"16":{"text":"Bangbangin ama thimsak thei tu ni ziam? Vui vak thimsak tu, ahibuale na khut sungah sathau hum zawk tu na hanciam ngei ziam?"},"17":{"text":"Thik le thik kitaat a kihiamsak bangin mihingte in khat le khat tung panin heakna nga hi."},"18":{"text":"Theikung khat pha takin ou lete theinga na ne tu hi. A topa a ou naseam khat sia kipatoai tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tui sung pan hong leng kik na mu sia nangma maitang hi a, tuasia bangma na thinsung ah na mu sia nangma tatak na hi hi."},"20":{"text":"Mihingte ii deina sia mithi khua bang ahi hi — a tamzaw lai te atu mun awng om tawntung hi."},"21":{"text":"Meisa in khamh le ngunn a tak le a theam sit a; mihing khat ii minthanna zongh kisit thei hi."},"22":{"text":"A mawmawte a thi dektak dongin na vuak bel hang amate mawmawtna lakeak zo ngawl lai tu ni hi."},"23":{"text":"Na tuute le na khuite na hi theiza in pha tak vak in,"},"24":{"text":"banghang ziam cile hauna sia kip ngawl hi. Minamte ngawngawn a tawntungin kip ngawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Taangphawte na tan a, tua zawkciang lo sung pan a piang kik tu taangphawte a khan lan in mualpangh ah lopate na meet hi."},"26":{"text":"Na tuute pan a piang tuumulte taw puansilhte na vawt thei hi, tuaciang keal pawlkhat na zuak man sum taw leitang na lei thei hi."},"27":{"text":"A om lai kealte in nangma le na innkuanpuite, tuaciang na naseam numeite atu zongh noai hong pia tu hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihing seksolte sia kuama ii del ngawl bulin tai hi, ahihang a thumaan mihing khat in tawpi bangin hang hi."},"2":{"text":"Minam khat a maw ciang ngam uk khat zawkciang khat kilaih tu hi. Ahihang ngam khat sia a pilvang, khuangaisun thei lampuite a nei le, thahat tu a, kip tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Mizawngte a zawthawk vawt thunei mihing khat sia lo an a lalsak vui le ngua taw kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"Thukham na thusim buale mihing seksolte sangah pang na hi hi; ahizong thukham na ni le amate a langpan na hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing ngilote in thukhaikim sia bang ziam ci in a he bua uh hi, ahihang Topa a biate in pha takin tel uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Zawng a, thumaan tu sia, hau a thumaan ngawl sangin phazaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Thukham a zui khangno khat in mihing pilvang ahi hi. A mannung ngawl ngualtamh a nei pa sia a pa maimawlna ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihingte tungah summeet thaakna le ngual duupna taw na hau le na hauna teng mizawngte tungah a thudik khat ii khut sung theng tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Thukham na zui buale na thungetnate sia Pathian atu in a ngaimawk huai, a zaak thada suak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing thumaan khat a sia vawt tu in na theam le nangma thaang sung ma ah na taaksuk tu hi. Mawbaang ngawlte thaman a pha kipia tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihaute sia amate ciim kisa tawntung a, ahihang ngual ii ngamtatzia a thuk a mu thei mizawng khat sia ciimzaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing phate in ukna za hong nga ciang mihing theampo lungdamin poai khaam uh a, ahihang mihing siate in ngam a uk ciang mihingte buu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Na mawnate seal tu na hanciam le nuntak sungin zawna na nga ngei buatu hi. Mawna pualaak vun a, nusia vun; tuasia ciang Pathian in na tungah hesuakna hong lak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa thu ni tawntung in, tua hile na lungdam tu hi. Na thin na puisak le siatna sung na theng tu hi."},"15":{"text":"A seksol ngamuk khat ii lang ah, mizawngte a hu tu a om bua hi; ama sia tawpi hawk le an zongin a vakkot vompui bangin kiitakhuai hi."},"16":{"text":"Khua ngaisutna pha a nei ngawl ngamuk khat sia a ngilo zawthawk thu taw ngamuk khat ahi hi. Thumaan ngawlna a ngaimaw khat in khuangei mama ngam uk tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihing that pa khat sia ama atu thaankuul a manlang thei za in a to pa ahi hi. Na tho heak vun."},"18":{"text":"Thumaan le uhte ngammuangin na om tu uh hi. Na thumaan buale thakhat thu in na puk tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Nasia tak a diang lotho pa in neak tu tam mama nei hi. Hun a bosak thawthong mihingte sia, zawng tawntung tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Thumaan mihingte in nuntakna kicing taw lungdamin a nungta tu uh hi. Ahihang hau tu kaal na ngakla uh le daan na thuak tu uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi doidanna in khialna hi. Ahihang thukhenmang pawlkhat in sumnguk tawmno po deina ngawngawnin a maan ngawlin naseam tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Kaangsung bek a he mihing duhopte in hau tu ngakla in diang ahiciang, zawnna ii vaat tu hun a he bua uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Khat pawpo pau in hil vun, a zawkciangin ama in sialpokna sangin diksa zaw tu hi."},"24":{"text":"A nu a pate neisa ngukna in mawna in a ngaisun ngawlte sia nguta dangte taw kilamdang ngawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Duhopna in ngimna bek piangsak hi. Topa na muan tu sia phazaw pek hi."},"26":{"text":"Nangma bek ii ngaisutna teng zuina in mawmawtna hi. Ngammuangin om vun a, tuaciang a ciimzawte ii hong hilnate zui vun."},"27":{"text":"Mizawngte pia vun, tua hile bangma hun na kitaangsamh buatu uh hi. A zawngte na en bua uh le mihing tam mama in hong haamsiat tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Mihing pha ngawlte in ukna za a nga ciang mihingte buu uh hi. Ahihang amate a za a taak uh ciang a thutang mite in uk kik tu hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nang hong kipau hong kihil simin na thin na puisak vaial le ni khat ni ciang sukcipna na thuak tu a, na lu na phong kik zo nawn buatu hi."},"2":{"text":"A thutang ngamukpa khat hong lak tavun, a lungdam ngam mite kong lak tu hi. A seksol ngamukpa khat hong lak tavun, a thinngim ngammite kong lak tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ciimna thupi na sa le na pa in nang hangin angtang tu hi. Pumpi zuak numeite tungah, sumzakna sia a mawmawthuai maizakna hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in thukhaikim sia thinbot in a nei le a ngam thahat tu a, ahizong ama in sum bekma thinbot in a nei ciang a ngam lalsak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Na ngualtamhte na sialpok le, nangma le nangma thaang kisia na suak hi."},"6":{"text":"Mi ngilote amate mawna sungah awk hi, thumaan mihingte ahile lungdam in suakta hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing pha khat in mizawngte nga tuakte he a, ahihang mihing seksolte in tuabangte a tel thei bua uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngualdangte atu khualna a nei ngawl mihingte in khuapi bup buaisak thei hi. Mihing ciimte in thimsak khipkhep hi."},"9":{"text":"Mi pilvang khat in a mawmaw khat tungah thu a vawt ciang, mi mawmaw sia nui bekin, aw saang taw kam ngaldo pau hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngual thalup tu a ciza ngawl mihingte in a thumaan pawpo ngaimaw hi, ahihang thumaan mihingte in tuabang mihing khat ii nuntakna huu tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihing mawmawte in a thin uukna uh kilanghsak hi, ahihang khuangaisun theite in thinsau in a thin uukna iip hi."},"12":{"text":"Ngamuk khat in a maan ngawl thute a nadon le, a ulian theampo sia leilot theite ahi tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Mizawng pa le ama a zothaw pa in hisia nei khawm hi — Topa in amate ngeal sia mittangte neisak khawm hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa khat in mizawngte nga tu a kilawm thute a panpui le ama in kum saupi ngam uk tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Patangte atu in hilna le tekna sia pha hi. Patangte in amate uuk bang bekin a khang le a nute maizumsak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihing ngilote ngamukna za hong nga ciang khialna lian khang hi. Ahihang a thutangte in tuabang mihingte ii kiamsukna mu tu in a nungta tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Na tate tek vun, tua hile a tawntungin ama hu in na angtang tu hi. Amate in maizum natu ahang thu omsak ngeingawl tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Pathian ii lamlak ngawl minam khat sia thu kinitna om ngawl minam ahi hi. Pathian thukham a zui pa in mihing lungdam ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Naseamte sia thusonpuina bek taw na hil na pau thei buatu hi. Amate in hong tel thei tu ahihang hong thusim tuan buatu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ngaisun ngawlin a pau khat po atu sangin, a ngoai a mawmaw khat atu lametna om zaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Na naseam khat sia a no panin, a dei theampo na pia le ni khat ni ciang na neisa theampo ama in hong suanthal tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Mihing thinngamte in kihauna le buaina tam mama piangsak hi."},"23":{"text":"Kisaktheina in, kiamsukna sung hong then tu a, ahizong na kiniamkhiak le hong kizakta tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Nguta khat ii kipawl puipa sia a ngal ci phabel ahi hi. Thukhenzum sungah thumaan a son le nguta pa daan kipia tu a, tuabang a son buale Pathian in nguta pa haamsiat tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Midangte ii nang hong ngaisutnate thin nopmawkin na nei tu sia lauhuai hi, ahizong Topa na muang le ngammuangin na om tu hi."},"26":{"text":"A kuama po in ngamuk khat ii hong deisakna kithangai tek hi, ahihang Topa tung pan bekin thutang khenna na nga thei hi."},"27":{"text":"Thutangte in mi seksolte ensan a, mi seksolte in thutangte ensan hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hite in Jakeh tapa Agur ii a ciliap huai kammalte ahi hi: “Pathian in kei taw omkhawm ngawl hi, Pathian kei taw omkhawm ngawl hi, tuaciang keima cimaw khi hi.”","title":"Agur ii Kammalte"},"2":{"text":"Keima in mihing khat taw sangin nganhing khat taw ka kibang zaw hi. Mihing khat ii nei tu a kilawm khua ngaisut theina ka nei bua hi."},"3":{"text":"Ciimna ka sin ngei bua hi, tuaciang Pathian thu bangma heak ka nei bua hi."},"4":{"text":"Akua in vantung thu heaknate a cingin nei ngei ziam? A kua in vui sia, a khut sungah man ngei ziam? Tua ahibuale tui sia puanbek taw tun ngei ziam? Tua ahibuale leitung ngamngite phut ngei ziam? Na he le, ama akua ziam? Ama ii tapa sia akua ziam?"},"5":{"text":"Pathian in a kamciam theampo keamcing hi. Ama ii huuk tu a zong theampo atu in ama sia lum taw kibang hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama ii son ngeingawl khat pau hi na cile ama in hong teih tu hi, tuaciang a leilotpa na hi hunlam hong lak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Pathian awng, ka thi ma in thu nam nii kong ngen hi:","title":"Paunak Dangte"},"8":{"text":"leilot ngawl natu in hong keamcing ta'n, tuaciang hau le hong hausak heak in a, zawng le hong zawngsak heak in. Tua ahikom an ka taangsap za bek hong pia ka po in."},"9":{"text":"Ka kham vaalin an ka nei le, nang hong tulmaw bong kong ci tha tu hi. Ahihang ka zawng le, ka nguta tha tu a, ka Pathian ii min daina kong suaksak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Naseamte a topa tungah sonsia ngei heak vun. Tua hu in haamsiatna le ngimna na nga tu hi."},"11":{"text":"A pate haamsiatin a nute a thupi sim ngawl mihing om hi."},"12":{"text":"A nin thei za in, nin napi thiangtho a kisa mihing om hi."},"13":{"text":"Pha mama a kisa mihing om hi — Oh, bangza in amate le amate pha kisa ziam?"},"14":{"text":"A zawngte le a kitaangsamhte tung pan ngitlo vai taw a nga thei zaza uh a duup mihing om hi; tuabangin amate nuntakna a zong uh mihing om hi."},"15":{"text":"Liit khat in tanu nii nei a, a min sia “Hong pia ta'n!” hi khawm hi. A lungkim ngeingawl, na nam li om hi:"},"16":{"text":"Mithite khua, tasel numei, nguatui a kisamh leiko, le a kisumit zo ngawl meikuangte ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"A pa sia ngual nuizak tu in ciammuina in a nei, ahibuale a nuhuai a zawngsak mihing khat pawpo sia vaciikte in a sa ne le pha hi, tua ahibuale zong a mittangte ngam va-akte in khel le pha hi."},"18":{"text":"Kei atu a tel hak mama thu li om hi:"},"19":{"text":"van ah a leang muvanlai, suangpi tung a vak ngul, tuipi tungah lam khial ngawlin a pai teambaw, le pa khat le numei khat a kidei theina ci teng ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Zi thumaan ngawlte ngamtatna in hi bang ahi hi; ama in palngul mawna vawt a, tua zawkciang kibual a, “Ahihang, a maan ngawl bangma vawt nei bong!” ci lai hi."},"21":{"text":"Leitung ngawngawn ii dual zawk ngawl na nam li om hi:"},"22":{"text":"kumpipa a suak sal khat, a du theampo a nei mi mawmaw khat,"},"23":{"text":"pasal a nga a etsat huai numei khat, a tonu omna a suan naseam numei khat."},"24":{"text":"Leitung ah nganhing no mama napi pil citak a pil li om hi:"},"25":{"text":"Mitsate; tuate in thaneam mama ahihang a an neak tu uh khaal sungin khol hi."},"26":{"text":"Liang lai a, teang ngalhvang nam khat te: tuate in thahat ngawl hi, ahihang liang lai suangpite kawmah teang thei hi."},"27":{"text":"Khaumawte: tuate in kumpipa nei ngawl ahihang hi vadiam in vak hi."},"28":{"text":"Innhikte: na khut sungah khat kihum thei napi, kumpi teenna inn sungah kimu thei hi."},"29":{"text":"Lam a pai uh ciang a etlawm mama na nam li om hi:"},"30":{"text":"nganhing sung teng pan a thahatbel le kiitak mama a nei ngawl tawpi;"},"31":{"text":"kealtal, aklui pokngai le a mite mai ah a om kumpipate."},"32":{"text":"Kiphatsak natu le a sia ngeal natu za dongin na mawmaw le tawlnga phot in a, khuangaisun in!"},"33":{"text":"Noai na sasau le thawbat na nga tu hi. Midang khat ii naak na suu le, chi luang tu hi. Na thin na sosak le ngimna sungah na theng tu hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Lemuel tungah a nu ii a ciliaphuai kampaunate in hi teng hi;","title":"Kumpipa tungah ngaisut piakna"},"2":{"text":"“Nangma in ka thungetna hong kizo kikna ka it ka tapa na hi hi. Nang tungah bang kong son tu ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Na tha nei theampo numei le pa omkhopna huvau in zangh heak in a, na sum theampo numei tungah zangh heak in; tuate in kumpipate susia hi."},"4":{"text":"Hong ngai ta'n, Lemuel awng. Kumpipate in sapittui ne ngawl tu hi, ahibuale, zu thangai leilamna thin nei ngawl tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Zu a neak uh ciang amate in thukhamte mangil in, kitaangsapna a nei mihingte ii nga tuak thute ngaingon uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Zu sia a thi dektak mihingte, a thinngim mamate atu ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in a zawnna le a khuangaina a makngil thei natu in dawn tahen."},"8":{"text":"Amate atu, thu a son thei ngawl mihingte atu in sonsak in. A cimaw theampo ii nga tu a kilawmte sungsia in."},"9":{"text":"Amate taangin pau in a, thutang thukhenpa hi in. A zawngte le taangsapna a neite ii nga tuak thute sungsia in."},"10":{"text":"A zaktel mama zi khat mu natu bangza in haksa ziam! Ama in suangmanpha te sangin tam mama in manpha zaw hi.","title":"Zi Zaktel"},"11":{"text":"A pasal in ama tungah muanna nei a, tuaciang a pasal a zawng ngei buatu hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua nu in a nuntak lai tawntungin a pasal tungah phatna vawt a bangma hunin siatna a thuaksak bua hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in tuumul puante le puannealte takin komla tawntung hi."},"14":{"text":"Vanh pua teambawte bangin ama in a khuala munte panin inn ah an hong ciapui hi."},"15":{"text":"Zingsang khuavak ma in tho a, innkuan anneak tu vawtin, a naseam numeite sep tu teng zongh son hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in leitangte en in lei hi, ama thalaw sa sum taw sapitkungte ciing hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in naseam hat khat hi a, thahatin lawp hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in a sep a vawt theampo ii manphatna he a, khuazan dongin naseam hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in khauzomin ama puan tu tak hi."},"20":{"text":"A zawngte le a kitaangsamh te ngo takin pia hi."},"21":{"text":"Vuuk a kiak hangin a thin a ngim bua hi, banghang ziam cile a innkuanpuite in puan lum nei uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in luppha puanvante takin puanneal sandup phate silh hi."},"23":{"text":"A pasal sia mihing tam ii heak, ngammite ii lampui khat ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in puansilh le kawngkhaute vawtin vanhzuakte munah zuak hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama hat a, ngual in thasia in mailam atu a patau bua hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in a pau ciang kamneam le ciimkam taw pau hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in a tawntungin komla a, a innkuanpuite kisapte vah hi."},"28":{"text":"A tate in ama thupi a sakna uh lak a, a pasal in pok hi."},"29":{"text":"A pasal in: “Numei tam mamate in zipha vive hi a, ahihang tuate theampo sung pan nang sia a phabel na hi hi,” ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ngaibanna in hong theam thei a, mealhoina zongh bo thei hi, ahihang Topa a zakta numei khat sia kipok tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama sep le vawt theampo tungah minphatna pia vun. Ama in mihing theampo ii zatakna a nga tu in kilawm hi."}}}}},"21":{"info":{"name":"Thuhilsya","shortname":"Eccl","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hite sia David ii tapa Jerusalem kumpipa ahi Thuthuk ngaisunpa ii kammalte ahi hi.","title":"Nuntakna sia Luithawthong hi"},"2":{"text":"Thuthuk ngaisunpa in a luithawthong, a luithawthong hi, ci hi. Nuntakna sia luithawthong, a vekpi luithawthong hi."},"3":{"text":"Na nuntak sungah naseam in na diang uh a, ahihang bang teng na lak tu om na ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Khang khat piangin, khang khat bo hi, ahizong simlei sia a om ngei in om hi."},"5":{"text":"Ni suak kik lai in, tum kik lai a, a sua natu munah heak kikin suak kik leleau hi."},"6":{"text":"Vui zongh thang sangah vasuk, saksang ah vato, a kot a kotin va a, kipan kik nithi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngun theampo tuipi sungah luangsuk a, ahihang tuipi dimleet tuan ngawl hi. Ngunte kipatna ah tuite heak kik a, tuaciang kipan kik leleau hi."},"8":{"text":"Na theampo in hong thinngimsak a, thinngimna sia kam taw son zawk hi ngawl hi. Ih mittang in a mu cim thei ngawl a, bil in a zaak cim ngeingawl hi."},"9":{"text":"A piang ngeisa tengma piang kikik tu hi. A kiseam ngeisa tengma kiseam kikik tu hi. Simleitung bup ah a thak bangma om ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in, “En vun, hi sungah bang ziam maw a thak khat om hi!” ci uh hi. Hi ngawl hi, a piang ngeisa hi lel hi, ei sua ma pek a, a piang sa hi."},"11":{"text":"Hun bosa sung a thupiangte kuama in ciamtee ngawl a, tu le maisang kilaklaw hun sungah a piang thute kuama in ciamtee tuan ngawl tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei, Thuthuk ngaisunpa sia Jerusalem ah Israel te kumpipa ka hi ngei hi.","title":"Thuthuk ngaisunpa ii Sin sate"},"13":{"text":"Hi leitung ah a kiseam na theampo kantel in sin tong ci in tupna ka nei hi. Pathian in eite tungah a ngimhuai haksatna hong pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Hi leitung ah a kiseam theampo ka mu zo a, a luithawthong vive hi ci in kong son hi. Tuasia in vuiva delkot taw kibang hi."},"15":{"text":"A koaite na maam thei bua a, a om ngawl nate na sim thei bua hi."},"16":{"text":"Keima le keima, “Mihing thupi khat ka suak zo a, ka mai ah Jerusalem a ukte sangin ka ciim zaw pek hi. Ciimna le heakna tatak tel ing,” ka kici hi.","ref":"1 Kum 4:29-31"},"17":{"text":"Heakna le mawmawtna, ciimna le thin apnate a kilamdanna kan tu in ka khensat hi. Ahihang vuiva del taw ka kiban tu sia ka he hi."},"18":{"text":"Ciim vaial leang thinngimna tam vaial a, heak vaial na in hong ngimsak vaial zawkan hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungdamna zongin nuam ka sak babangin om tong ci in ka khensat hi. Ahizong, hisia zongh luithawthong hi veve hi."},"2":{"text":"Nuina in mawmawthuai a, nopsakna in bangma phattuamna hong pia ngawl ci sia ka mu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ciimna ka thangaina in kei hong tawsawn a, keima le keima thinnop ka kipiak natu in sapittui ne in hunnuam zak tu ka khensat hi. Hi leitung ah tawmvei a nuntak hunsung mihingte ngamtat zia tu sia hisia a phabel hi vak ci in ka ngaisun hi."},"4":{"text":"Na lianpite ka seam zo hi. Keima atu in innte ka sa a, sapithuante ka vawt hi.","ref":"1 Kum 10:23-27; 2 Khang 9:22-27"},"5":{"text":"Huan vawtin thingno ka ciing a, a sungah thingnga kung namcin om hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuate tuibuak natu in tuikhukte ka to hi."},"7":{"text":"Sila tam mama ka lei a, ka inn sungsuak sila tam mama om hi. Jerusalem khua ah a teang ngeite theampo sangin nganno tamzaw ka nei hi.","ref":"1 Kum 4:23"},"8":{"text":"Ka ukna ngam kumpi sumkholnate panin ngunn le khamhte ka la hi. Pasal le nupite in lasa in hong ngualnuamsak a, pasal khat ii dik a sak numeite ka dei zaza ka nei hi.","ref":"1 Kum 10:10,14-22"},"9":{"text":"Hi hi, kei ka lian a, Jerusalem khua ah a teang ngei khat po sangin ka lian zaw a, ka ciimna bo ngeingawl hi.","ref":"1 Khang 29:25"},"10":{"text":"Ka dei pawpo ka nga hi. Nopsakna a min piang, bangma ka kidan bua hi. Ka sep sa theampo tungah ka kisuangtaak a, hite theampo sia ka min phatna tel ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaciang ka sep sa theampo le haksa tak ka sepnate ka ngaisun a, bangma khiakna a nei ngawl hunlam ka phawk hi. Tuasia in vuiva del taw kibang a, kimanna om vet ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Bangbang po ahizong kumpi khat in ama mai a, a seam kumpite ii sep sa teng seam thei bek hi. Tua ahikom ciimna, ahibuale maitatna, ahibuale mawmawtnate bang ziam cisia ngaisut ka kipan hi."},"13":{"text":"Oh, he ing, “Khuavak sia khuazing sangin a phat zawk bangma, ciimna sia mawmawtna sangin phazaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihing ciimte in a pai natu mun mu thei a, a mawmawte in mu thei ngawl hi,”. Ahihang eite theampo atu in mai sangah a kibangin ih thuak tu thu in hong ngak nginge ci sia zongh ka he hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima in hi bang, “Mihing mawmawte tungah a tung thu sia kei tung zongh ah hong tung tu hi. Tua ahikom ka ciim mama na in bang meetna hong pia ziam?” ci in ka ngaisun hi. Bangma hong pia ngawl hi, na khat beak zongh hong pia ngawl hi,” ci in ka zo kik hi."},"16":{"text":"Kuama in mihing ciimte phawk ngawl a, kuama in a mawmawte phawk ngawl hi. Hong pai tu hunte sungah ih vekpi in hong kimangil siat tu hi. A ciim le a mawmaw a kibangin ih thi siat tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom nuntakna in kei atu bangma khiakna nei ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile nuntakna in ngimna simngawl bangma hong puak ngawl hi. Na theampo a luithawthong hi a, vuiva del bang ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Naseam a, ka thalawte khiakna nei ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile ka za hong laih tu sia atu in a nusiat tu ka hi hunlam ka he hi,"},"19":{"text":"tuaciang tua pa a ciim ahile, a mawmaw ahi akua in he ziam? Ahizong ka sep ka vawt theampo, ka ciimna ii hi leitung ah kei atu a thalaw theampo ama in lua tu hi. A vekpi a luithawthong ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahikom nasia tak na ka sep sia ka kisiik hi."},"21":{"text":"Na khat pawpo atu in na ciimna, na heakna le na thiamna theampo taw naseam a, a zawkciang tua na sia a seam ngawl het khat tungah na nusiat lel tu hi. A luithawthong hi a, maan zongh maan ngawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Na nuntak sungah thinngim tak ngimin na na sep hangin bang na lak tu om na ziam?"},"23":{"text":"Na nuntak laiteng na sep na vawt theampo in thinngimna le thin natna simngawl bangma dang hong puak ngawl hi. Zan ngawngawn in na mutmawklaw hi. A vekpi a luithawthong ahi hi.","ref":"Job 5:7; 14:1"},"24":{"text":"Mihing khat ii a phabel a sep thei sia neak tu dawn tu le a thalaw sa teng taw a lungkim tu ahi hi. Ahizong, hisia ngawngawn Pathian kung pan hong pai hi, cisia ka phawk hi.","ref":"Thsya 3:13; 5:18; 9:7; Is 56:12; Lk 12:19; 1 Cor 15:32"},"25":{"text":"Tua ngawlin bangbangin neak tu le lungkim natu koisung pan nga thei tu ni ziam?"},"26":{"text":"Pathian a lungdamsak te tungah Pathian in ciimna, heakna, le lungdamna pia hi, ahihang mimawte ii thalaw sate ama a lungkimsakte tungah a piak thei tu in ama in mawneite na seamsak, sum thalawsakin sum kholsak hi. A vekpi a luithawthong ahi hi. Tuasia in vuiva delkot bang ahi hi.","ref":"Job 32:8; Pau 2:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi leitung ah a piang na theampo Pathian see sa bangin piang hi.","title":"Na theampo in Hun nei tek"},"2":{"text":"Ama in pian natu le thi natu hun, suan tu hun le bawkeak tu hun,"},"3":{"text":"thalup tu hun le damsak tu hun, phelthap tu hun le sakto tu hun ciangtan hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in hee natu hun le lungdam natu hun, mau tu hun le lap tu hun,"},"5":{"text":"ki it tu hun le ki etsat tu hun, kinap tu hun le kinap ngawl tu hun, ciangtan hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in zon tu hun le bosua tu hun, top tu hun le vawk tu hun,"},"7":{"text":"balthap tu hun le khuikhop tu hun thim dide in om tu hun le pau tu hun ciangtan hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in it tu hun le etsat tu hun, ngal kisim tu hun le kilem tu hun ciangtan hi."},"9":{"text":"Ih sep ih vawtte theampo pan bang meetna nga hi ziam?"},"10":{"text":"Pathian in vanh ngitpi eite hong sot ka he hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in na theampo atu hun a lem tu in ciangtan hi. Ama in maisang hong pai tu thute heak nopna thin hong pia ahihang ama ii sep le vawtte a cingin hong telsak ngeingawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom ih nuntak laiteng ih lungdam tu le ih sep thei bang a phabel ih sep tu ahi hunlam ka he hi."},"13":{"text":"Ih sep thaman taw ne in dawnin, ih nopsak tu ahi hi. Tuasia in Pathian ii letsong ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Pathian ii sep theampo sia a tawntung atu ahi hunlam ka he hi. Bangma belap heak in a, bangma dawk kik heak in. Pathian ii na a sep khat sia ama ih zatak natu ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"A piang na khat ahibuale a piang tu na khat sia a piang ngeisa ahi hi. Pathian in na khat sia a kibangin piangsak kikik hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua bek dom ngawlin hi leitung ah thutang le thumaan om tu kilawm napi ngitlo khansiatnate na mu sia kei zongh ka mu hi.","title":"Leitung ah Thumaan ngawlna"},"17":{"text":"Keima le keima, “Pathian in mihing phate le mihing siate a kibangin thu khen tu hi, banghang ziam cile na a kiseam theampo sia a hun a kiciangtan bangin piang tu hi,” ka kici hi."},"18":{"text":"Eite nganhingte sangin ih phat zawk tuan ngawlna hong lak tu in Pathian in eite hong ze et ci in ka khensat hi."},"19":{"text":"A tawpna ah, mihing le nganhing ii a thuak tute in a kibangin ngak hi. Nganhing bangma in mihing zongh thi hi. Amate in bitphua nam hi khawm hi. Mihing khat sia nganhing khat sangin phazaw tuan ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile amate atu in nuntakna in khiakna nei ngawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate mun khat zuan khawm tu a, leivui suak tu uh hi. Amate leivui pan hong paikhawm uh a, leivui ah ciakhawm kik tu uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Banghangin khat po in mihingte ii thaa sia tungsang zuanto a, nganhingte ii thaa ahile leinuai zuansuk hi, ci in tel thei tu ziam?"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom ih sep thei a phabel sia ih sepsa tungah ih lungkim thei tu ahi sia ka phawk hi. Ih vawt thei dang bangma om ngawl hi. Ih thi zawkciang bang suak tu cisia ih heak thei natu lampi om ngawl hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang hi leitung ah a piang thumaan ngawlna theampo ka en kik hi. A kivawtsiate kakap a, kuama in hu ngawl hi. Kuama in amate hu ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile amate a vawtsiate in thahatna nei hi."},"2":{"text":"A thi le a bo sate ka eang hi, a nungta laite sangin amate nuamsa zaw pek hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang tuate sangin a hamphazaw laite sia hi leitung ah a piang thumaan ngawl a mu ngeingawl, a piang ngawl laite ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihingte in ngual a zaw natu in banghangin nasia tak na seam ziam ci zongh ka tel zo hi, banghang ziam cile a innpaamte a een hang ahi hi. Ahihang tuasia in a luithawthong ahi hi. Tuasia in vuiva del taw kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing khat pukthi liang dongin leekoai in a omcipna sia mawmawt vai hi, amate in ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zongh hi thei tha tu hi, ahihang vuiva man nuam a, khut nii taw komlaak tawntung sangin thinnopna taw, tawmno ih nei sia phazaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Nuntakna sungah luithawthong ahi, thudang khat zongh ka mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Hi sungah ama nguakin a teang khat om hi. Ama in tapa le nei ngawl, suapui le nei ngawl hikale ama sia na seam tawntung a, bangma hunin a hauna taw lungkim ngeingawl hi. Ama le ama nopsaknate nialin, akua atu in nasia takin na seam ziam? Tuasia zongh luithawthong hi a, tuaciang a ngim huai mama nuntakzia ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Khat sangin nii phazaw hi, banghang ziam cile amate ngeal in a kizen zaw in naseam khawm thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate khat a puk le a dang khat in phongto thei hi. Ahihang khat nguak a om khat sia puk le mansa hi lel hi, banghang ziam cile kuama a hu tu om ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Khua a sik le nii lumkhawm leang khualum thei hi, ahihang nang nguak bangbangin na khua lumsak thei tu ni ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Khat nguak ii lel tu kisimna sia nii in zo thei hi. Khauzam thum taw a kipheak khauzeen sia a tat tu haksa hi."},"13":{"text":"Mihing khat sia zawnna panin a ngam ii kumpi suak tu in khangto thei a, ahibuale thonginn pan kumpi tokhum dong kaato thei hi, ahizong a khan haam ciang ngual ii ngaisut pha piakte saan ngawl tu dongin a mawmaw le, tua pa sangin khangmoi a zawng a pil khat phazaw hi.","merge":"14"},"15":{"text":"Hi leitung ah a teang mihing theampo ka ngaisun a, amate sungah kumpipa ii dinmun a la tu khangmoi khat a om sia ka phawk hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpipa khat ii a uk mihingte sia kisim zo ngawl tha tu a, ama a thi zawkciang ama nasep sate hangin a lungdam khat beak om ngawl tu hi. Tuasia in luithawthong ahi hi. Tuasia in vuiva del bang ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biakinnpi ah na pai ciang kidawm in. Tua munah pai in thusin tu sia, a maan le a maan ngawl a he ngawl mihing mawmawte ii sangaw biakpiakna sangin phazaw hi.","title":"Kamciam Pia Memeang Heak in."},"2":{"text":"Na pau ma in ngaisun phot in a, Pathian tungah kamciam vawt memeang heak in. Ama sia vantung ah om in, nang sia leitung ah om a, tua ahikom na pau tu za sangin a tamzaw pau heak in."},"3":{"text":"Na thinngimna a tam zaza in na mang sia vaial tu hi. Kam tam na pau zaza in mawmawt kamte na pau tha tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom Pathian tungah kamciam na piak ciang, manlang takin taangtungsak in. Ama in mihing mawmawte diksa ngawl hi. Na kamciam bangin vawt in.","ref":"Ps 66:13-14"},"5":{"text":"Kamciam pia a, nasep ngawl sangin kamciam piak awl lete phazaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Khial tha ing ci in Pathian thiampipa mai ah na son kul tu ahikom, na kampauna in khialna sung thensak heak in. Banghang na tungah Pathian thin uuksak ni ziam? Nasep sa theampo ama in banghang laltham siatsak ni ziam?"},"7":{"text":"Bangza in mang na man a, bangza in a luithawthong nasep naseam zong, ahibuale bangza in na pau hial zong, Pathian na zatak veve kul lai tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpite in mizawngte vawtsia in amate hamphat natu te danh in thumaan ngawlin thu a khen na mu ciang lamdang sa heak in. Ulian khat pawpo, a tungsia a ulian sia in vuumsit a, amate ngeal sia a tung sawn a sia in vuumsit lalai hi.","title":"Nuntakna sia Luithawthong"},"9":{"text":"Kumpi khat ngawngawn in thaw an suang hi."},"10":{"text":"Sum na it le na lungkim ngeingawl tu a, hau tu na lungngul le na dei theampo na nga ngei buatu hi. Tuasia in a luithawthong ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Na hau vaial le na vaak tu tam vaial tu hi. Na meet belna sia na hau hunlam na heak sia bekma hi tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Naseam khat sia a neak khom tu zongh nei thei a, nei ngawl thei si hi, ahizong ama sia zanin a mut nuam lel hi. Sumhaupa sia, nei leilam ahikom thinngim a, zanin mutthip thei ngawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Hi leitung ah a lauhuai ka mu thu khat om hi: mihingte in a kitaangsap uh ciang a zak tu in a sum tawm uh hi,"},"14":{"text":"tuaciang nasep pha ngawl khat tungah sumhcip in a tate atu zongh bangma kheet ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Hi leitung ah pumnguak in ih sua bangma, pumnguak in ih nusia hi. Bangza po ih seam zong ih ken thei bangma om ngawl hi.","ref":"Job 1:21; Ps 49:17; 1 Tim 6:7"},"16":{"text":"Hi thu maan ngawl hi! Ih pai lai bang lianin ih cia kik hi. Na ih seam a, vui man tu in ih hanciam hi, ahihang bang nga na hi ziam?"},"17":{"text":"Eite sia khua zing sungah heena, thinngimna, thin uukna le ciinat thuakin ih nungta hi."},"18":{"text":"Hi sungah ka phaw thu om hi: Pathian ii hong piak nuntak tomno sungin ih sep thaman ne in dawnin, nuamsa in ih om tu sia a phabel ahi hi. Hisia in mihing ii thuak tu nuntakzia ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Pathian in mihing khat hauna le neisa lamhsa pia in tuate tungah a lung a damsak le ama sia lungkim in a sep a vawt tungah nuamsa tu hi. Hisia in Pathian letsong ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Pathian in ama lungdamsak ahikom, a nuntakna a tom hunlam thinngim leilam ngawl tu hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi leitung ah a nasia mama a maan ngawl het a kivawt khat om ci sia ka mu hi."},"2":{"text":"Pathian in mihing khat sia hauna, min phatna le neisa pia hi, hi hi, a dei theampo pia hi, ahihang tua vanhte tungah nopsakna pia ngawl hi. Khualmi khat po in nopsak law tu hi. Tuasia in a luithawthong ahi hi, maan ngawl het hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihing khat in ta zakhat nei in, a khansau kale, bang tanvei po a nungta zong, ama ii tel tu lungdam na a nga bua a, a thi ciang pha tak a kiphum buale, nausen a thisa in a suak sia phazaw lai hi, ka ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua nausen a sua hu in phattuamna om ngawl hi; ama sia khuazing sungah bo in kimangil hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua nausen in sun khuavak sia mu ngeingawl a, nuntak zongh bangbang hi ci in he ngawl hi, ahihang ama in a no belin tawlngakna a mu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in kum tulnii nungta kale, a nuntak sung thinnopna a nei ngei buale a thisa a suak tua nausen sia phazaw hi. A tatak ci leang amate ngeal in a zot natu mun kibang hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing khat in bang khat po a neak thei natu in naseam ahihang a kicing in nei ngeingawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Bangbangin mihing ciim khat sia a mawmaw khat sangin nuamsa zaw ziam? Mizawng khat in nuntak natu zia a heak hangin bang phatuam ziam?"},"9":{"text":"Tuasia in a luithawthong hi. Tuasia in vuiva delkot bang ahi hi. Na neisa taw na lungkim tu sia, nadang dei tawntung sangin phazaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Na a piang theampo sia taanghtawng lai pan a piang tu in a kiseesa hi a, mihing khat in ama sangin a hat zaw mihing khat ii kam nial thei ngawl ci sia ih he siat hi."},"11":{"text":"Na nial vaial le a luithawthong hi vaial a, nang sia phazaw tuan ngawl ni hi."},"12":{"text":"Limh khat bangin a papai nuntakna sia a luithawthong ama nuntakna hi a, a tom a nuntak sungah mihing atu a phabel sia akua in he thei tu ziam? Bangbangin mihing khat in a thi zawkciang leitung ah bang thu piang tu cisia he thei tu ziam?"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Min phatna sia a manham paaknamtui sangin phazaw a, na thi ni sia na sua ni sangin phazaw hi.","title":"Nuntakna huvau Ngaisutna","ref":"Pau 22:1"},"2":{"text":"Khuangaina inn ah pai sia poai vawtna inn ah pai sangin phazaw hi, banghang ziam cile a nungta lai eite theampo thina in hong ngak nginge hi cisia hong phawksak hi."},"3":{"text":"Heena in nuina sang phazaw a; na mai hong khingsak tha tu ahitazong, na heakna khangsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Lungdamna thu a ngaisun tawntung mihing sia mihing mawmaw ahi hi. Mihing ciim khat in thina thu ngaisun hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing mawmawte ii pokna la hong sak sangin mihing ciimte ii hong teih sia phazaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing mawmaw khat a nui ciang, mei sungah lingkung hal puak vazak bang ahi hi. Bangma khiakna nei ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"A ciim khat in mihing khat pawpo a theam ciang a mawmaw khat bangin ngamta na suak hi. Sumnguk na ne le na ngamtatzia lalsak, na hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Na khat pawpo ii a tawpna sia a kipatna sangin phazaw hi. Thin sauna sia kiphatsakna sangin phazaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Na thin tomna uk in; diksak ngawlna nei top tu sia mawmawthuai hi.","ref":"Jas 1:19"},"10":{"text":"“Oh! banghangin nidang in na theampo phazaw ziam?” ci in dongh peuma heak in. Tua in pil thudok hi ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihing nungta peuma sia a ciim tu kilawm a, tua in ngamhlua bangza in pha hi."},"12":{"text":"Sum in hong thin nopsak za in ciimna zongh in hong thinnuamsak hi. Ciimna in hong keamcing a, hisia in heakna ii phattuamna ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Pathian ii sep sate ngaisun in. Pathian ii a koaisak sate akua in bangbangin maamsak thei tu ziam?"},"14":{"text":"Nang atu in nate a dik a pha in a pian ciang lungdam in a, ngimna hong pai ciang phawk lel in: Pathian in lungdamna le ngimna pia khawm a; a zawkciang bang piang tu ci, na he ngei bua hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka nuntakna sia a luithawthong hi a, ahizong ka nuntak sungin thu theampo ka mu zo hi. Mihing khat sia pha napi thi a, a dang khat sia, sia napi nungta hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom pha lei heak in a, ciim lei heak in — banghangin nangma le nangma kithatlum tu ni ziam?"},"17":{"text":"Ahizong ngilo lei heak in a, mawmaw lei heak in — banghangin na hun a tun ma in thi tu ni ziam?"},"18":{"text":"Tua a leilam te ngeal pial in. Pathian na thasia le na ma vang tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Khuapi uk mihing sawmte ii khuapi khat atu a vawt thei sangin ciimna in mihing khat atu tam vawt zaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Leitung ah a maan bek seam tawntung in, khialna khat a vawt ngeingawl kuama om ngawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihingte ii thuson theampo ngai heak in — na naseampa ii hong sonsiatna za tha tu ni hi,"},"22":{"text":"Nangma zongh in midangte tamvei mama na sonsiat sia kihe nginge ni hi."},"23":{"text":"Hite theampo ahile ahi ngawl khentel tu in ka ciimna ka zangh hi. A ciim tu ma in khensatna ka nei hi, ahizong kei ii hi zawk hi ngawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Nuntakna ii a khiakna akua in mu thei tu ziam? Tuasia eite atu in thuk lei a, heak tu in haksa lei hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahihang keima in pilna, thiamna heak natu in ka ki aap a, pilna mu in, thupiangte ahang ka heak natu, pil ngawlna sia bangza in ngitlo huai a mawmawthuai ziam ci thu ka heak natu in nasia takin ka hanciam hi."},"26":{"text":"Thina sangin a khaa zaw khat ka mu hi — tua in thaang taw a kibang numei ahi hi. Ama ii hong itna in ngeen bangin nang hong man tu a, ama hong koaina in thikkhau khat bangin nang hong heencip tu hi. Pathian ii deina bangin a ngamta sia in tuabang numei pial thei a, ahizong a khial sia, a thaang sungah awk hi."},"27":{"text":"Hi hi, hi thute ii a khiakna ka zawzon ciang tawtawm in ka mu hi. Thuthuk ngaisunpa in ci hi."},"28":{"text":"A khiakna dang ka zon hangin ka mu bua hi. Tulkhat sung pan ka zatak tu pasal khat ka mu thei a, ahizong numei khat zongh ka mu bua hi."},"29":{"text":"Hisia in ka sin theampo ahi hi: Pathian in eite a thumaan tu in hong vawt hi napi paulap tuatuam zongin eima le eima ih kikai awksak hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nate ii khiakna tatak sia mihing ciim khat bek in he hi. Ciimna in ama maitaisak a, a mai siatna teng bosak hi."},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa ii ci bangin vawt in a, Pathian tungah kamciam pia memeang heak in.","title":"Kumpipa Thu ni in"},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in a uk po vawt thei a, tua ahikom ama omna pial in; tuabang a lauhuai munah om heak in."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in a thuneina taw ngamta a, ama ii sepna sia kuama in thato thei ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"A thupiakte na nit lai tengin ngimna na thuak buatu a, tuaciang mihing ciim khat in koibang le bang hun ciang vawt tu ci sia he hi."},"6":{"text":"Na theampo vawt natu a hun maan le sepzia maan om a, ahihang ih heak thu tawm lei hi!"},"7":{"text":"Bang hong piang tu cisia kuama in ih he bua a, ei hong son tu kuama om ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Kuama in thina pial thei ngawl a, a thi tu ni khangkhan thei ngawl hi. Tua in ih pial thei ngawl ngal kisimna khat hi a, ih ngelku thei bua hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi leitung ah a kivawt sate ka ngaisut ciang hite theampo ka mu a, hi leitung ah mihing pawlkhat in thahatna nei a, pawlkhat te in tuate khutnuai ah thuak uh hi.","title":"Khansiate le Thutangte"},"10":{"text":"Hi hi mi seksolte amate thaankuul sungah kiphum ka mu a, ahihang a phuum mihingte thaan pan a cia kik uh ciang, amate ii a sia a vawtna, khuapi sung mama ah a khua mite in amate pok uh hi. Tuasia in a luithawthong ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Banghangin mihingte in ol vazeang in khutkhial ziam? Banghang ziam cile khut khialna sia man lalang in daan a kipiak ngawl hang ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing khial khat in khut khialna zakhatvei vawt a, ahizong nungta veve hi. Oh, hi hi, amate kampau nate ka he a, “Pathian thu na ni uh le na theampo a pha in piang tu hi,"},"13":{"text":"ahizong mihing ngilote atu in phatna om ngawl tu hi. Amate ii nuntak hun sia limh khat taw kibang a, Pathian thu ni ngawl ahikom amate khanthi tu hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang hite nawnsan thu ahi hi. Leitung ah bang thu piang ziam ci sia en vun; khat vevei mihing thutangte in misiate ii thuak tu daante thuak a, misiate in thutangte min phatna tel nga hi. Hisia in a luithawthong hi, ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom mihing khat in a nuntak sungin nuam a sak tu ngawl a dang om ngawl ahikom anne tuidawn in, a lungkim tu bek a hina ka he hi. Pathian in hi leitung ah nuntakna a piak hun sung teng, ama in a sep thaman nga thei tu hi bek hi."},"16":{"text":"Ciim tu hanciam in hi leitung ah bang piang cisia ka tel ciangin sun zong zan zong mu ngawlin na om thei sia ka phawk hi,"},"17":{"text":"tuaciang Pathian in bang seam cisia ka tel zo bua hi. Bangza po na hanciambel hang na tel zo ngei buatu hi. Mihing ciimte in he kisa tha tu hi, ahihang amate he ngawl uh hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thute theampo khuangeipi le nasia takin ka ngaisun a, Pathian in mihing ciimte le mihing thutangte ngamtatna te, amate ki itna le kihuatna ngawngawn uk hi cisia ka phawk hi. A mai ah bang om ziam ci sia kuama in he ngawl hi."},"2":{"text":"A kilamdanna om tuan ngawl hi. Thutangte le a ngilo te, a phate le a siate, biakna hanciamte le a awlmaw ngawlte, sangaw biakpiakna a vawtte le a vawt ngawlte tungah a kibangin thina theng hi. Mihing pha khat sia mihing khial khat taw kitumdang ngawl a, tom lo in a kiciam khat le a kiciam ngawl khat kitumdang tuan ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Thina sia mihing theampo tungah a kibangin tung a, hi thu mama zongh, leitung ah a piang na dangte bangma in maan ngawl hi. Mihingte a nuntak laiteng a thinsung uh sia siatna le mawmawtna taw kidim a, amate thakhat thu in thi uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahizong leitung ah a nungta khat pawpo in lametna pawlkhat nei a, ui nungta khat sia tawpi thisa khat sangin phazaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi hi, a nungtate in a thi tu uh he a, ahizong a thite in bangma he ngawl hi. Amate in min phatna tel bangma nei tuan ngawl a, amate kimangil cip hi."},"6":{"text":"A ki itna, a kihuatna, cii le sa uukna te a vekpi in amate taw thi khawm hi. Hi leitung ah a piang nate khat pawpo sungah amate kihel kik nawn ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Pai in, na an ne in a, lungdam in; na sapittui ne in a, maitai in. Pathian in diksa hi."},"8":{"text":"A tawntung lungdam in, maitai in."},"9":{"text":"Pathian hong piak hi leitung ah a mannung ngawl na nuntak hunsung teng na it numei taw a nuamin nungta in. A mannung ngawl nite a nuamin zangh in, banghang ziam cile, tuasia bekma na ngim thaman na saan tu ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Na sep pawpo hanciam in seam in, banghang ziam cile mithite ngamah, tukna, dianna om ngawl, khua ngaisutna, heakna, ciimna om ngawl tu hi — tua mun sia na zotna tu mun ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Thudang khat zongh ka he lai hi, hi leitung ah tai ngang theampo in zawna nga tawntung ngawl a, ngalhang theampo in ngalzo tawntung ngawl hi. Mihing ciimte in nuntak natu thalaw tawntung zo ngawl a, mihing pilte zongh hau tawntung ngawl hi, hi theina a nei theampo dinmun sang theng tuan ngawl hi. Kaamsiatna sia mihing theampo tungah tung hi."},"12":{"text":"Na hun hong thet tu na he ngei bua hi. Thakhat thu in vacimte thaang sungah a kimat bang, ngasate ngeen taw a kimat bangin, eite zongh ih muanmawk ngawl het laitakin thaang sungah hong kiman hi."},"13":{"text":"Nadang khat ma ka mu a, ciimna sia hi leitung ah a thupi in a kingaisut zia ahi hi.","title":"Ciimna le Mawmawtna tungtaang Ngaisutna"},"14":{"text":"Khua khat om a tua ii sungah mihing tam teang ngawl hi. A thahat kumpipa khat in tua khua sim hi. Ama in uumci a, a luphungte sutham tu in kipan hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua khua ah mizawng ahihang khua khat a hu zo tu mihing pil mama khat teang hi. Ahizong kuama in ama phawk ngawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Ciimna sia hatna sangin phazaw hi ka ci tawntung hi, ahizong kuama in mizawngpa sia mihing ciim in ngaisun ngawl a, ama paunate kuama in nadon ngawl hi."},"17":{"text":"A kamneam mihing ciim khat ii pauna sia mihing mawmaw honkhat kikhopna sungah a lampuipa auna ngai tu sangin phazaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Ciimna in ngalhiamte sangin a pha seam thei zaw a, ahizong mihing khial khat in na pha tam mama lalsak thei hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tho thisate in paaknamtui bung bup khat uihsak thei a, mawmawtna tawmno khat in ciimna lianbel siasak thei hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihing ciim khat in a maan khat a sep tu le, a mawmaw khat in a maan ngawl a sep tu sia a ngeina ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama mawmawtna sia lampi ah a kisikpui khualmite ngawngawn in tel pai a; ama mihing mawmaw ahi hunlam mihing theampo in hesak hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang hong ukpa na tungah a thin a uuk le nasep tawp tu ngen heak in; thim dide in na om le khialna liante zongh hong kimaisak thei hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi leitung ah a dik ngawl thu khat ka mu a — ngamukte ii a kilawm ngawl ngamtatna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing mawmawte thuneina dinmun kipia a, mihaute kimel sia hi."},"7":{"text":"Silate siphu tungah to a, kumpinamte silate bangin peang taw vak ka mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Dum na to le a sungah na taak tu a; luphung khat na sulet le ngul khat in nang hong tu tu hi.","ref":"Ps 7:15; Pau 26:27"},"9":{"text":"Suangkhuk ah na na seam le suang taw na liam tu hi. Thing na ek le tua nasepna taw na liam tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Na hei a mawl a, na taat buale na zak ciang na nasep haksa zaw tu hi, maisang atu zeak khol sia pha hi."},"11":{"text":"Ngul zol thiam napi na tusak masa le ngul zol na thiam sia a phat tuamna om ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing ciim khat ii kampauna in ama min phasak a, ahizong mihing mawmaw khat sia ama kammal ma in siasak hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in a mawmawthuai kampau a, mawmawt kam taw khup hi."},"14":{"text":"A mawmaw khat sia papau in lului hi. Kuama in maisang thupiang tu he ngawl a, ih thi zawkciang bang suak tu cisia kuama in hong son thei ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Inn lam a zong kik thei ngawl, a mawmaw leilam khat sia a nasepna taw zawm law tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Ngam uk kumpipa khangmoi lai in, ngam lampuite in zan tha pai in poai a khaam uh le, tua ngam sia ngim nga hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahizong kumpipa in ama thu in thu a khensat thei a lampuite in a hun maanin an ne in, amate le amate zu khamcip ngawl natu, a ki uk zo le tua ngam sia a hampha ngam ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Pasal khat a datham lei in a innkhum a pua buale a inn kuai tu a, a inn cimh tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Poai khaamna in nang hong lungdamsakin, sapittui in hong maitaisak hi, ahizong khat zongh sum ngawl taw na nga thei bua hi."},"20":{"text":"A thimtham in kumpipa son sia heak in a, sumhaupa sia na aituam lupna inndoi sung zongh ah sonsia heak in. Vacim khat po in na pau teng amate thu puakin son tha tu hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na sumte ngamdang taw sum vawtna ah zangh in, tua hile ni khat ni ciang a meet nga tu ni hi.","title":"Miciim khat ii Sep"},"2":{"text":"Na sumte mun tuatuam ah koi in a — mun tam mama ah sum vawt in — banghang ziam cile hi leitung ah bang kaamsiatna thuak tu ci sia na he bua hi."},"3":{"text":"Thingkung khat sia, koisang po ah a puk zong poimaw ngawl hi, a puna munah om tu hi. Meeite a niim ciang nguazu hi."},"4":{"text":"Vuite le khuahunte a phat dong ngakin na om le bangma hunin an na ciing ngei buatu a, bangma hunin an na la ngei buatu hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian in na theampo vawt a, ama sep le vawtte numei naupaai khat ii sulh sungah nuntakna thak khat a kipat, na tel zawk ngawl bangin na tel zo bua hi."},"6":{"text":"Zing ahizong nitak ahizong an ciing in. A pha in po tu maw, ahibuale anciin hun khat sia hun khat sang phazaw tu maw, ci sia na he ngei bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Sun khuavak nuam na sak thei sia thupha ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Na nuntak kumte hu in lungdam in. Bang tanvei na nungta zong na thi tu khuangei zaw ahi sia phawk in. Mai sangah lamet tu bangma om ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Khangnote awng, na khangmoi hun nuamsa vun. Na khanmoi lai in lungdam vun. Na vawt nop po vawt vun a, na lungngulna bangin ngamta vun. Ahihang Pathian in na vawtna tungah thu hong khen tu cisia ciamtee tavun.","title":"Khangnote Ngaisut Piakna"},"10":{"text":"Bangma in thinngimsak heak vun a, bangma in nasak heak vun, khangmoi hun khuangeingawl tu nu hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na thinngim tu ni le a kum hong thet ma, “Nuntak paw nuamsa bong” na ci ma, na khangmoi lai in nang hong Bitphuapa phawk in."},"2":{"text":"Tua hun sia, ni le tha le aksite ii tanna nang atu in a dial hun le ngua meei a ven nawn ngawl hun ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuasia ciang nang hong dal na baante liing tu a, tu laitak a, a hat na peangte tha zawm tu hi. Na hate na an thai tu in tawm lei tu a, na mitte mangin khua pha tak na mu thei buatu hi."},"4":{"text":"Na bil in khuaza ngawl tu a, lampi ah awngingte na za buatu hi. An ngoaina sette a kingoai ciang ahizong, tumtheite a kitum ciang ahizong, nakheng phaksap vamial in na za tu a, ahizong vacim khat po haam in na mut hong phawng tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Mun saangna ah na kiinta tu a, na lampai ciang lauhuai tu hi. Na puakkaang tu a; nangma le nangma kikai vakiat in, na lungngul theampo bo tu hi. Eite in a khakbel ih tawlngak natu mun ih zuan tu a, lampite ah mauna om tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ngunnkhau tat tu a, khamh meiinn taaksuk in tamhtham tu hi; tuikhuk ah khauzeen sia tatin tuibeal zaantham tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ih pumpite leivui ah cia kik tu a, ih thaa ahile nuntakna hong pia pa Pathian kung zuan kik tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Luithawthong, luithawthong, Thuthuk Ngaisunpa in ci hi. A vekpi a luithawthong ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Thuthuk Ngaisunpa sia ciim ahikom ama in a heak thute mihingte tungah hil hi. Ama in paunakte encian a, tuate a maanna sittel hi.","title":"Thu Ngawmtuana"},"10":{"text":"Thuthuk Ngaisunpa in a henepna kammalte zong a, ahihang ama ii a at kammalte a maan tatak veu hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihing ciimte ii paunakte sia tuucingte ii tuute a cinna tu a, a zak ciangzumte bang hi a, a khoptua paunakte sia kho takin a kikhen thikpimte bang ahi hi. Tuate sia eite theampo hong cing ih tuucingpa Pathian ii hong piak ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, kidop tu thudang khat om lai hi. Laibute a ki at sia tawp hun ci om thei ngawl a, lai tam lei simna in pumpi thazawmsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Hite theampo zawkciang son tu thu khat bek om lai hi: Pathian thasia in a, a thupiakte ni in, banghang ziam cile hite theampo sia mihing a kibitphuana thu ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Pathian in ih sep ih vawtte theampo, a pha ahizong, a sia ahizong, ih vawt kute ngawngawn dongin thu hong khen tu hi."}}}}},"22":{"info":{"name":"Solomon Late","shortname":"Song","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon ii phua la a phabel teng","ref":"1 Kum 4:32"},"2":{"text":"Na muk taw nong tawp a, nong itna in sapittui sangin thum zaw hi.","title":"La A ngui Khatna Ngaknu ii sak"},"3":{"text":"Na pum tungah a namtui na khat om a, na min in tuasia ma phawlo hi. Nang hong it thei ngawl numei om ngawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Hong pui ta'n a, ih tai tu hi; ka kumpipa hong hi ta'n a, na inndoi sungah hong paipui ta'n. Ih lungdam khawm tu a, nasia tak dawn khawmin, ki itna sungah suakta takin ih omkhawm tu hi. Numei theampo ii nang hong it sia lamdang ngawl hi!"},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem numeite awng, kei ka ci vom hi, ahihang ka mealpha hi. Kedar ah sennealngam tuipuanbuk bangin vom kaleng Solomon ii kumpi inn sungah puankhaite bangin ka mealpha hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka ciivom hu in, hong nomu heak vun, banghang ziam cile nisa ka thuak hang ahi hi. Ka suapui pate in kei tungah hong thin uuk ahikom sapithuan sungah na hong seamsak hi. Keima le keima ka kipua tu hun ka nga bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka ngaino awng kei hong son ta'n, na ngannote koisungah na tha tu ziam? Sunkim nisa ciang koisungah tawlnga tu ni ziam? Tuucing dangte ii tuuhon kawm ah banghang kong zon kul tu ni ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Numei sung pan a ithuaibel awng, a mun he ngawl ni ziam? Pai in tuuhonte zui ta'n; na kealte atu in tuucingte ii buk hui ah lo hingna mun zong ta'n.","title":"Tangval ii sak"},"9":{"text":"Ka ngaino awng, Pharaoh ii siphu ngalleang a kai siphutalte a thin a thosak siphupui bangin pasalte thin na thosak hi."},"10":{"text":"Na sam sia na biangkho tungah hoi niingniang a na ngawng kiim ah suang manphate bangin kibaang hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang nang atu in khamh khi ngui khat ih vawt tu a ngunn kizepna taw ih zeam tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka kumpipa sia a lupna tungah lum a, ka paaknamtui ngim kizel hi.","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"},"13":{"text":"Ka ngaino ka awm tungah hong lup ciang myrrh ngimnamtui nam hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka ngaino sia Engedi sapithuante sungah a palh duisung paakte bang ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka ngaino awng bangza in na mealpha ziam; na mittangte bangza in ithuai vakil ziam?","title":"Tangval ii sak"},"16":{"text":"Kong itbel awng, na etlawm mama a, nong lungkimsak mama hi! Lopa hingte ih lupna hi tu a;","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"},"17":{"text":"Cedar thingte sia ih inn thulnuai hi a, cypress thingkungte ih innciing dap hi tu hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima in Sharon ah ngampaak khat ka hi lel a, mualkuam ah unok paak khat ka hi lel hi."},"2":{"text":"Ling kawm a unok paak khat bangin numeite sungah ka it ngaino om hi.","title":"Tangval ii sak"},"3":{"text":"Ka itbel ka lawmpa sia tangval dangte taw teengat ciang thingtang sungah apple kung khat taw kibang hi. Ama ii limh sungah ka to nuam a, a nga sia thum ka sa hi.","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"},"4":{"text":"Ama in a an neakna innpi sungah kei hong paipui a, itna mai taw hong en hi."},"5":{"text":"Lungzuang duangvul ka hikom sapitnga kote taw ka tha hong dimsak ta'n a, apple nga taw hong thak sua ta'n!"},"6":{"text":"A baan veisang hong khamhsak a a ziatsang khut taw hong koai hi."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem numeite awng, ka ki itna nong pheltan ngawl natu in a zuanngang sangaite le sazate min lo in kei hong kamciam tavun."},"8":{"text":"Ka ngaino ii aw ka za hi.
