Ama sia mualpi tungah tai kawmin hong pai a, mualnote kaantan in ka kung hong zuan hi.","title":"La A ngui Niina Ngaknu ii sak"},"9":{"text":"Ka ngaino sia saza khat bang, sangai moi khat bang ahi hi. Ama sia ka innpang kungah ding hi. Ama in kongkha pan puankhaite pailet in inn sung sang hong en hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka ngaino in kei hong paupui hi. Ka ngaino awng, hong pai ta'n, ka it ngaino awng hong pai ta'n.","title":"Tangval ii sak"},"11":{"text":"Phalbi bo zo a, nguatui kang zo hi;"},"12":{"text":"ngam sungah paakte palh hi. Hi hun sia lasak hun hi a, lo sungah vakhute kuul kiza hi."},"13":{"text":"Theite min tu kipan a, sapit paak ngimnamtui zongh kiza zo hi. Tua ahiciang hong pai ta'n, ka ngaino awng; Kong it ngaino awng hong pai ta'n."},"14":{"text":"Nang sia suanghawng kawmah a buu vakhu khat bang na hi hi. A ngaibaang na meal hong musak ta'n a, a lungzuanhuai na aw hong zasak ta'n."},"15":{"text":"Ih sapitkungte paak zo ahikom ngia honte ii a lalcipsak ma in ngiano honte man in."},"16":{"text":"Ka ngaino sia keima aa hi a, keima in ama aa ka hi hi. Ama in a nganhonte unok paak sungah,","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"},"17":{"text":"zingvui a vak vahiau ma le khuavak mahiat dong cing hi. Ka it ngaino awng, Bether mual lian tungah a om saza khat le sangai moi khat bangin hong heak kik ta'n."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lupna tungah ka lum a zan simin, ka it ka ngaino ka mang in ka man hi. Ama ka zong a, ahihang ka mu zo bua hi."},"2":{"text":"Khuapi sungah ka vavak a, a lamliante le a lamzinte kaantan in, ka it ka ngaino ka zong hi, ahizong ka mu zo bua hi."},"3":{"text":"Khuapi a cing ngalvilte in kei hong mu hi. Amate tungah “Ka ngaino na mu uh ziam?” ci in ka dongh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate ka nusiat po ciang ka ngaino ka mu hi. Ama ka lencip a, ka nu ii inn sung ka suana inndoi sung ka thet pui dong ama ka thasua bua hi."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem numeite awng, ko ii ki itna nong pheltan ngawl natu in, a zuanngang sangaite le sazate min lo in kei hong kamciam tavun."},"6":{"text":"Sennealngam pan meikhu khuam khat bang, ngimnamtui le sum vawtte ii zuak paaknamtui bang, myrrh thingnaai namtui taw hong pai sia a bang ziam?","title":"La A ngui Thumna Ngaknu ii sak"},"7":{"text":"Solomon kumpipa a kumpi tokhum tungah to in, kizawng in hong pai hi. Israel ngam a ngalkap phabel sawmlukte in cing uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate theampo namsau zak thiam tek hi. Amate sia ngalsim a thiam ngiingeei sa ngalkap luite ahi uh hi. Zanin a sim a om le a do tu in amate namsau khat tek toai uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Solomon Kumpipa sia a phabel thing taw a kivawt kumpi tokhum tungah to in, kizawng hi."},"10":{"text":"A khuamte sia ngunn taw kizeam a; a tungah khamh taw a kizeam puan kikoi hi. A tophate sia Jerusalem numeite ii itna takpi taw a taa puan sandup taw kituam hi."},"11":{"text":"Zion numeite awng hong pai tavun a Solomon Kumpipa en vun. Ama in a zi nei ni, a lungdam ni le a thinnop ni in a nu ii a lu tungah a khuksak kumpilukhu sia khu hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ngaino awng, na mealpha lawlawm hi! Na mai sealna dial ii nungah a ithuai na mittangte tee vakil hi. Na sam sia Gilead mualpangh suk a, keal hon tai bangin kithing hi.","title":"Tangval ii sak"},"2":{"text":"Na hate sia a mul a kimeet tawm, a kisilthiang tuute bangin paak hi. Khat beak zongh tongh ngawlin kikim diimdiam hi."},"3":{"text":"Na mukte puansan khaupheang khat bang hi a; na pau ciang bangza in etlawm ziam? Na biangte sia na kisealna dial nungah san sitset hi."},"4":{"text":"Na ngawng sia ngalhangte zak lum tulkhat a kikhai zeizoina ngil kilkel in a beam David ii tausaang taw kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"Na noaite sia unok paak kawm ah an ne a, a taa khawm saza, apeang sangaite bang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Keima in zingvui a vak vahiau mateng le khuavak mahiat dong myrrh thingnaai namtui mual, ngimnamtui mualtung ah ka om tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka ngaino awng, na mealpha lawlawm a; Paubanna na nei bua hi!"},"8":{"text":"Ka angkoai awng, Lebanon mual panin kei hong zui ta'n, Lebanon panin hong zui ta'n, Tawpite le pawlbeamte teenna, Amana Mualdawn, Senir Mualdawn le Hermon Mualdawn panin hong tuaksuk ta'n."},"9":{"text":"Ka ngaino le ka angkoai awng, na mit ha zia le na khi aw ziate in ka thin ka lung hong vut hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka ngaino le ka angkoai awng, nong itna in ka thin hong nuamsak hi. Nong itna sia sapittui sangin thum zaw a, na paaknamtui sia a dang hel namtuite sangin namtui zaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Kong it ngaino awng, na muk sia khuaitui bangin thum a, na leei sia kei atu in, khuinoai le khuaitui ahi hi. Na puansilhte sia Lebanon ii paaknamtui namcinte nam hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka ngaino, ka angkoai sia a kiseal huan, a ki uumcip huan, aituam tuinaak ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua munah thingkungte dawngin khang hi. Amate sia talee kung bangin po a, nga pha belte nga hi. Henna thingnamtui, nard thingnaai namtui, saffron, calamus le cinnamon pan kipan thing ngimnamtuite kamh ngeingawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua munah a namtuibel myrrh le aloe te po hi."},"15":{"text":"Lebanon Mualte panin luamtui a luangsukte le ciktui te in tua huan tui kawtsakin lei zenhsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Khanglo vun, Saksang vui awng. Thangsang vui awng, ka huan sungah va vun; ngimnamtui taw dimsak vun. Ka ngaino sia ama ii huang sungah hong pai in thingnga a limbel teng ne tahen.","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kong it ka ngaino, ka angkoai awng, Ka huan sungah ka tum zo hi. Ka hel namtuite le ka myrrh thingnamtuite khawmtua in; ka khuaitui le ka khuaiphaangte ka ne a; ka sapittui le ka noai ka ne hi. Lawmtate awng, itna taw na kham teakin ne in, dawn vun!","title":"Ngaknute ii sak"},"2":{"text":"Ka mut lanin ka thin ciim hi. Ka mang in ka ngaino in kongkha hong king hi. Kong it ngaino, ka vakhu awng, hong tumsak ta'n, ka lu sia daaitui taw kawt a ka sam sia meeizunh taw tuamh hi.","title":"Tangval ii sak"},"3":{"text":"Ka nik ka puante suut siat zo khi hi, banghangin silh kik teang kik tu khi ziam? Ka peangte sil zo khi hi, banghangin ninsak kik tu khi ziam?","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"},"4":{"text":"Ka ngaino in a khut taw kongkha len a, ama hong nai ahikom ka lungpeal ngam hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama tumsak tu in ka kingingta khol zo hi. Kong hon tu ka kipat ciang ka khutte myrrh thingnaai namtui taw, ka khutmete myrrh thingnaai tui taw kizut hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka ngaino kongkha ka hon hi, ahihang ama om nawn ngawl hi. Ama aw za nuam lawlawm ing! Ka zon hang ama ka mu zo bua a, ka biapui hang ama in hong zo ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Khuapi a cing, ngalvilte in hong mu a, amate in hong saatin, hong chidupsak hi. Khuapi luphung a cingte in ka lukhu hong eaukeaksak hi."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem numeite awng, ka ngaino na mu uh le kei sia ama ngai in vul khi hi, ci in nong sonsak natu uh in kamciam kei hong pia tavun."},"9":{"text":"Numei theampo sung pan a mealphabel nu awng, na lawmpa sia ngualdang khat po sangin lamdangin, tum pian zaw ziam? Tuabang liang a kamciam kong piak tu uh sia, ama huvau bang a lamdang vahut om na ziam?","title":"Ngaknute ii sak"},"10":{"text":"Ka ngaino sia etlawm in hat hi; ama sia tulsawm sung pan khat ahi hi.","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"},"11":{"text":"A maitang sia taau bang hi a neal hi; a sam kiil a, va-ak vom bangin vom hi."},"12":{"text":"A mittangte sia luamtui luang khat ii hui ah vakhute bang, noaitui taw kisil a, luihui ah a ding vakhute bangin pha kilkel hi."},"13":{"text":"A biangkhote sia paak le hel namtuite taw a kidim huan khat bangin etlawm hi. A mukte sia myrrh thingnamtui tui taw a kawt dikdek unok paakte taw kibang hi."},"14":{"text":"A khutte sia a et hoi a pha in piang a, ama in suangmanpha khutzungbute bun hi. A pumpi sia suangmanpha taw a kizeam saiha neal taw kibang hi."},"15":{"text":"A pheizangte sia khamh tungah a kingaa suangngo khuamte taw kibang hi. Ama sia kumpi mealpu a, Cedar kung saang pona Lebanon mualte bang ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"A kampaute thum a, zaak nop huai mama hi. A kampaute ih nial tu khat mama zongh om ngawl hi. Jerusalem numeite awng, ka ngaino sia hi bang teng ahi hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A mealphabel numei awng, na it na lawmpa koi sungah pai ziam? Na mu natu kong hu thei natu uh in bang lampi tawn ziam, hong son ta'n.","title":"Ngaknute ii sak"},"2":{"text":"Ka ngaino sia balsam thing pona mun a huan sungah pai zo hi, Ama in a tuu honte a huan sungah tha a, unok paakte lo hi.","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"},"3":{"text":"Ka ngaino sia keima aa hi a, keima in ama aa ka hi hi. Ama in a tuu honte unok paak sungah tha hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka ngaino awng, nang sia Tirzah bangin na mealpha a, Jerusalem khuapi bangin ithuai in, hi khuapi liante bangin na mealphatna in husan ngawngawn hong tawpsak tha liang hi.","title":"La A ngui ngana Tangval ii sak"},"5":{"text":"Na mittangte kei sang panin heam in, tuate in kei hong cimawsak hi. Na samte sia Gilead mual pangh suk ah keal honte tai valet bangin kithing hi."},"6":{"text":"Na hate sia a kisilthiang tuu honte bangin paak hi. Khat beak zongh a peuhe om ngawlin kikim diimdiam hi."},"7":{"text":"Na mai sealna dial nungah na biangkhote san sitset hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in zi sawmluk, zino sawmliat, a kisim zo ngawl ngaknu moi nei tahen!"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang keima in khat bek ka it a, ama sia vakhu khat bangin ithuai hi. Ama sia a nu ii tanu khat bek a nei hi a, a nu ii a it mama tanu ahi hi. Numei theampo in ama en in pok uh hi; a zi le a zinote in ama pokna lasa uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Zingsang khuavak taw a kibang hisia nu akua ziam? Ama a mealpha a, taang hiihee a, ni bang tha bangin tee hi."},"11":{"text":"Ngamkuam sungah thingnote en tu, sapitkung tungah a teeno suakte en tu le talee kung tungah a paakte en tu in Almond kungte sungah ka paisuk hi."},"12":{"text":"Siphu ngalleang hawlpa ii ngal sim tu lawpin a liin bangin nang kong it hu in ka liing hi."},"13":{"text":"Shulam ngaknu awng, laam in, laam in, Na lap kong en tu uh hi. A ngual a ngual a hong en te ii kilaklaw ah ka lap sia banghangin hong en nuam nu ziam?","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nang sia a tuanngen ngaknu khat na hi hi! Na peangdap sungah na peangte hoi lawlawm hi. Na pheizangte phatzia sia limsuai thiamte ii limsuai taw kibang hilhel hi.","title":"Tangval ii sak"},"2":{"text":"A kamh ngeingawl sapittui namtui kuang khat tua munah om hi. Mangtaang vawng khat tua munah om a, unok paakte in kiim uum hi."},"3":{"text":"Na noaite sia a taa khawm vahel apeang sangai, a omkhawm vahel saza nii taw kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"Na ngawng sia saiha tausaang khat taw kibang hi. Na mitte sia Heshbon khuapi kongpi hui ah a om tuicingte bang ahi hi. Na naak sia, Damascus khua a cing Lebanon tausaang bangin ithuai hi."},"5":{"text":"Na lutang sia Carmel Mual bangin saangto kiukiau hi. Na sam kipheakte sia naipuan cii phabelte bangin tee vasip a; ama ii phatna in kumpipa ii mit le thin suu hi."},"6":{"text":"Na mealpha mama a, hoi lawlawm nii hi; Nong itna in ka lung hong kimsak siat hi."},"7":{"text":"Palm thingkung khat bangin na ngaibaang a, na noaite sia date nga bom kaaite bang ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Palm kung khat tungah kaato in a nga ka lo tu hi. Kei atu in na noaite sia sapit bom bang hi a, na ngim sia apple min bang namtui in,"},"9":{"text":"Na muk sia sapittui phabel taw kibang hi. Tua ahile sapittui sia ka ngaino kungah luang tahen a, a muk le a ha khuum tahen.","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"},"10":{"text":"Ka ngaino neisa ka hi a, ama in dik hong sa hi."},"11":{"text":"Kong it ngaino awng, hong pai ta'n a, ngam sungah pai in khuanote ah zan ngiak tawng."},"12":{"text":"Zingtuung in ih tho tu a sapitkungte, a khang ziam, paakte a palh ziam, talee kungte a paak ziam ih en tu hi. Tua munah kong itna kong pia tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Mandrakes dei aikung ngim namtui na za tu a, tuaciang thingnga lim theampo sia ih kongbiang hui ah om tu hi. Kong it ngaino awng, thingnga a lui le a thak nang atu in kong khealsiasak hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nang sia ka nu ii a noai taw a vaak ka suapuipa hi lete kong oai hi. Tua hile lampi ah kisi in kong namh zong kuama in hong awlmawk ngawl tu hi."},"2":{"text":"Ka nu ii inn ah hong ciapui leng a ki itna zia hong hil lete uuk ing. Na neak tu in sapittui namtui le talee tui kong pia tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Na baan veisang nong khamhsak a, na ziatsang khut taw nong koai hi."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem numeite awng, ka ki itna uh nong pheltan ngawl natu uh in kei kamciam hong pia tavun."},"5":{"text":"Sennealngam panin a lawmpa taw a kikoai sa in hong pai sia akua ziam? Na suana mun ahi apple kung nuai pan, nang kong phong hi.","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"},"6":{"text":"Keima simngawl kuama dang it heak in a, keima simngawl kuama dang koai heak in. Ki itna sia thina bangza in vaanglian a, kingaina zongh thina za in kho hi. Ki itna sia mei bangin kuang a, kaanghmei bangin lengkeak hi."},"7":{"text":"Ki itna meikuang sia tui in tulmit zo ngawl a, namthuam in khuum zo ngawl hi. Ahizong khat po in a hauna taw ki itna lei a sawm le simmawkna bek nga tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Suapui numeino khat ka nei uh a, a noaite no lai hi. Tangvalno khat hong pai in ama a heal ciang ka suapuinu atu bang vawt tu khu ziam?","title":"Ngaknu ii suapuipate"},"9":{"text":"Ama luphung khat hile ngunn tausaang khat ka saksak tu uh hi. Ahizong ama kongpi khat hi le cedar thing pheakte taw ka dal tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima in luphung ka hi a, ka noaite sia a tausaangte ahi hi. Ka ngaino in ama taw lungkimna le thinnopna ka nei sia he hi.","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"},"11":{"text":"Baal Hamon a kicina munah Solomon in sapithuan khat nei hi. Ama tung pan lo a saap lotho pawlkhat om hi, amate khat simin ngunn dangka tulkhat tek pia hi.","title":"Tangval ii sak"},"12":{"text":"Solomon awng na ngunn dangkatang tulkhat la in a, lothote tungah amate tel tu a zaa nii pia in. Kei ka hi le keima aituam sapit huan khat ka nei hi!"},"13":{"text":"Ka ngaino awng, huan sung panin na aw hong zasak ta'n, ka kithol puite in na pauna aw za tu in hong ngak hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka ngaino awng, saza khat bangin, hel namtuite pona mualtung ah a om, sangaital moi khat bangin ka kungah hong pai ta'n.","title":"Ngaknu ii sak"}}}}},"23":{"info":{"name":"Isaiah","shortname":"Isa","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi laibu sungah, Amoz ii tapa Isaiah tungah Judah kumpite ahi Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz le Hezekiah te hun lai in Judah le Jerusalem huvau Pathian pualaak thute kihel hi.","ref":"2 Kum 15:1-7; 2 Khang 26:1-23; 2 Kum 15:32-38; 2 Khang 27:1-9; 2 Kum 16:1-20; 2 Khang 28:1-27; 2 Kum 18:1—20:21; 2 Khang 29:1—32:33"},"2":{"text":"Topa in, “Leitung le vantung awng, kong ci bang ngai vun! Ka vaak ka taa sa ka tate in kei hong langpan uh hi.","title":"Pathian in A Mihingte Hil"},"3":{"text":"Khuite in a topa he uh a, laate in a topa ii an piakna mun he hi. Ahihang ka mihing Israel te in tua za in he ngawl hi. Amate in tel vet ngawl uh hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"No a khial a maw minam, siatna vawtin a seksol mihingte a lal tu hi zo nu hi! Na mawnate in note hong kaisuk hi! Israel te ii a thiangtho Pathian, Topa nialin na nungngat zo uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Banghangin hong langpan lalai nu ziam? Daan thuak thua nuam lai nu ziam? Israel te awng, na lu tung theampo liamma dim zo a, na thin uh ngim mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Na lutang pan na peang dong, na pumpi tung a dam mun om ngawl hi. Liamna chinumte, meimate le liamma balhte taw kidim nu hi. Na liammate kisil ngawlin, kituam ngawl hi. Zatui zaha kinoai ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Na ngam uh lalcip zo a, na khuapite kihaltum zo hi. Na mu tangin ngamdangmite in na ngam uh hong laaksak a, na theampo susia uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem khuapi bek taanglai a, tua zongh ki uumci a — sapithuan sungah huan cingpa ii buk ahibuale, tangmai huan ah thaampheang bangin, a hung tu le a cing tu nei ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa, Topa in mi pawlkhat hong nungtasak lai buathong le, Sodom le Gomorrah bang keakma in Jerusalem kilalsak siat zo tu hi.","ref":"Pian 19:24; Rom 9:29"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem awng, no hong ukte le na mihingte sia Sodom le Gomorrah a te bang keakma na hi uh hi. Topa in no tungah hong cina ngai vun. Ih Pathian ii no hong hilna nadon vun."},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Kei tungah nong piak bul biakpiaknate theampo dei tu in hong um nu ziam? Nganhing a limci, a thaute le meihal biakpiakna a nong nei tuute zaa sangin a kicing vaal zaw ka nei hi. Khuitalte, tuute le kealte ii chi cimtak zo khi hi."},"12":{"text":"Kei bia tu in nong pai uh ciang, hite theampo keng tu in akua in hong sawl ziam? Ka Biakinnpi sung tuanhcil kawkoai tu in akua in hong sawl ziam?"},"13":{"text":"Nong paipui uh biakpiaknate kimanna nei ngawl hi. Na hal uh paaknamtui ngim ka kii hi. Thadet Poaite, Sabbath nite le biakna kikhopnate ka thuak zo bua hi; tuate a vekpi in na mawnate uh in ninsak siat hi."},"14":{"text":"Na Thadet Poaite le na ni thiangthote ka ngaimaw hi; tuate in vanhngit khat hi a, ka puakna in ka cimtak hi.","ref":"Amo 5:21-22"},"15":{"text":"“Thungen in na khutte na lapto ciang note kong en buatu hi. Bang zata thu na ngen ta uh zongin kong ngai buatu hi, banghang ziam cile na khutte chi taw kituam hi."},"16":{"text":"Noma le noma kithiangsak vun. Ka mu tangin a sia na vawt uh theampo vawt nawn heak vun. Hi hi, a sia ngamtatnate kheal vun a,"},"17":{"text":"tuaciang a maan sep tu kisin vun. Thukhaikim thu omsak vun — a kizawthawk vawtte hu vun, tangate ii nga tuakte pia vun a, meingongte panpui vun” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in, “Tu in, thukhensat tawng. Note in mawna chisan na baang uh a, ahihang vuuk bang a thiang tu in kong sil tu hi. Note tungah a sannum baang kale zong, tuu mul bangin na kaang tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Keima thu bek nong ni uh le lei pan a piang a pha nate na ne tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahihang kei nong langpan uh le note thi tu nu hi. Keima, Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Khatvei lai in a thumaan khuapi sia pumpi zuak numei khat bangin ngamta hi! Khatvei lai tua khuapi sia mihing thutangte taw kidim a, ahizong tu in mithatte bekma taang lai hi.","title":"Mawnei Khuapi"},"22":{"text":"Jerusalem awng, khatvei lai in ngunntang bang na hi a, ahizong tuciangin na mannung bua hi; sapittui pha taw na kibang ngei a, ahizong tuciangin tuidam bek na hi hi."},"23":{"text":"Na lampuite sia ngual leedote le ngutate ii lawmte veu hi a; amate in letsong le sumngukte saang tawntung uh hi. Amate in tangate, zumkong maangkong ah panpui ngeingawl a, meingongte ii a thusun ngai ngeingawl uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahiciang tu in, Vaanglianbelpa Topa , Israel te ii a vaanglian Pathian ii a ci bang ngai vun: “Ka ngalte ahi note tungah phu kong la tu a, note in kei ngim nong pia nawn buatu uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Note tungah thu kong vawt tu hi. Thik sia mei taw a kithiansua bangin note kong thiansua tu a, na thiantho ngawlna theampo kong hepsak tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Taanghlai in na nei uhte bangma in no hong uk tute le ngaisutna hong pia theite kong pia tu hi. Tua zawkciang Jerusalem sia a thutang, thumaan khuapi kici tu hi.”"},"27":{"text":"Topa thutang ahikom, Jerusalem le tualai ah a om a kisiik kik theampo, ama in ngum tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahihang mawna a vawtte le ama a langpante theampo, ama in sucip tu a; ama a taisan peuma thatlum tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Thingkungte na biak ngei hang le huan thiangthote na vawt ngei uh hu in na hee tu uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Note in a thi dek limkung khat le, kuama tui buak ngawl husuan khat taw kibangin na vulcip tu uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Mei eak leang khat hu a, taangvawng a kak bangma in, mihing thahatte sia a sia a vawtna uh taw ma amate kilalcipsak tu a, amate lalna sia kuama in phel zo ngawl tu hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia sia Judah le Jerusalem taw kisai, Amoz ii tapa Isaiah tungah Pathian thu piak ahi hi:","title":"Tawntung Kilemna (Micah 4:1-3)"},"2":{"text":"Maisang hunin Biakinnpi dinna mun ahi, hi mual in mual theampo sung pan a saangbel hi tu a, mualno theampo tungah dokto tu hi. Tua munah minam tam mama kikaikhawmin hong pai ngeingui tu a,"},"3":{"text":"tuaciang a mihingte in, “ Topa ii mual, Israel te ii Pathian Biakinnpi ah kaato tawng. Ama in ih sep tu a dei sia ih sep thei natu in hong hil tu hi; ama tealsa lampite ih tawn tu hi. Banghang ziam cile Jerusalem pan Topa ii hilcianna hong pai tu a; Zion panin ama in a mihingte tungah thu son tu hi,” a ci tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in minam liante sungah thu nawngkaite khensat tu hi. Amate in a namsaute lo thawna tumanh le a teite thingbaak heuna namte in seak tu uh hi. Ngam khat le ngam khat kido kik ngei nawn ngawl tu a, ngal sim tu in kithoai kik nawn ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Jol 3:10; Mic 4:3"},"5":{"text":"Tu in, Jacob suan le paalte awng, Topa hong piak khuavak sungah kalsuan tek tawng!"},"6":{"text":"Pathian awng, Jacob suan le paal, na mite na nusia zo hi! Ngam le lei sia nisuana sang pan le Philistia pan mitbum nasepnate taw kidim zo hi. Mihingte in ngamdang ngeinate zui hi.","title":"Kisaktheina Kilalcipsak tu"},"7":{"text":"Amate leitang sia ngunn le khamh taw kidim a, amate ii sum le vanh manphate bo hun nei nawn ngawl hi. Amate ngam sia siphu taw kidim a, a siphu ngalleangte sim zawk hi ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate ngam sia milimte taw kidim a, amate khut taw a vawt tawm uhte ma amate in bia uh hi."},"9":{"text":"A vekpi in kiniamsuksak tu a, kimaizumsak tu hi. Amate mawna maisak heak in Topa awng!"},"10":{"text":"Topa ii thin uukna pan le a vaangletna le a minthannate pan a suatak natu hanciam in, amate sia mualkawm suanghawng sung ahibuale leihawng tawna sungah buu tu uh hi!","ref":"Tpl 6:15; 2 Th 1:9"},"11":{"text":"Mihingte kiphatsakna le, mihingte kisaktheina a kilalsak tu ni khat hong theng tu hi. Tuasia ciang Topa bekma kipok tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ni ciang Vaanglianbelpa Topa in a vaanglian theampo le, a kiphasakte, a kiliansakte theampo niamsuksak tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in Lebanon Cedar kung saangte le Bashan ngamsung oak thingkung te theampo susia tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in mualpite le mualnote tamkimsak in,"},"15":{"text":"tausaang theampo le a muanhuai kulh pangte theampo kikimsak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in a lianbel le a hoibel teambawte ngawngawn tum suksak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihing kiphatsak nate bo tu a, mihing kisakthei nate kilalsak tu hi. Milimte mangthang siat tu a, tua ni in Topa bekma kipok tu hi.","merge":"18"},"19":{"text":"Topa in leitung lok tu in hong pai ciang, mihingte in Topa ii thin uukna pan le a vaangletna le a minthannate pan a suatak natu hanciam in, ahibuale leihawng tawna sungah buu tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ni hong thet ciang, khamh le ngunn taw a vawt sa milimte, amate ma in vawkkeak tu a, tuate sia buite le bakte nusiat tu uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in leitung lok tu in hong pai ciang, mihingte in Topa thin uukna, vaangletna le a minthannate pan, a suatak natu hanciamin leihawngte sung le mualkawm suanghawngte sungah buu tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"A thithei mihingte muanin nei nawn heak vun. Amate in bang kimanna nei uh ziam?"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in Topa , Vaanglianbelpa Topa in Jerusalem le Judah pan mihingte ii tulmawkna theampo, suan le muan mihing theampo laaksak tu in kithoai hi. Topa in amate ii an le tui,","title":"Jerusalem Khua sungah Buaina"},"2":{"text":"a ngalhangte le a ngalkapte, a thukhenmangte le a kamsaangte, aisaan theite le a ngam lampuite,"},"3":{"text":"a ngalkap sang lampuite le a mihon lampuite, a ngam vai thu kinte le thupiangte uk tu a zak mitbum thiamte theampo laaksak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in mihingte sia a khanthin ngawl lai patangte in uksak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing theampo khat le khat tungnut kituu in meetna la tu hi. Khangmoite in khanghaamte zakta ngawl tu a, a mannung ngawl mihingte in a tungsia te zakta ngawl tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate bee sung pan mihing khat a teal tu hun khat theng tu a, a teal sia pa tungah, “Nang na hile puansilh tawm tu nei buang na hi ciang, hi bang ngim le kham hun sungah kote lampui hong seam ka ven,” ci tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahizong ama in, “Kei hi ngawl khi hi! Hong hu zo ngawl tu khi hi. Ka anneak tu ka puansilh tu nei ngawl khi hi. Na lampui hong seamsak heak vun!” ci in zo kik tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Hi peu hi, Jerusalem sia a lal tu hi zo hi! Judah sia a lalal hi zo hi! Amate kampau theampo le a sep a vawt theampo in Topa langpan hi; amate in Pathian mama sia a langh takin selno hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngual ngaimaw khol a doidanna sia amate ii puk natu ahi hi. Sodom mite bangin amate in a langh takin mawna khialna vawt uh hi. Amate a lal tu hi zo a, a zon bangin tawk uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Thumaan thutang mihingte lungdam tu uh a, amate atu in a pha hong piang tu hi. Amate a sepna bang zui in nuamsa thei tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang mi seksolte a lal tu hi zo hi; amate in ngual tung a vawt bangin tu in, amate tungah kivawt tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Sum pukthaakte in ka mite zawthawk vawt a, a leiba tote in amate theam uh hi. Ka mite awng, na lampuite in lam hong pui khial ahikom, na kiheak natu lampi na he bua uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa sia ama ii thu sung tu in kinging hi; ama in a mite tung thukhen tu in kithoai zo hi.","title":"in A mite Thukhen"},"14":{"text":"Topa in ama mihingte ii upate le a lampuite thukhenna thuaksak tu hi. Ama in hi bangin: “Note in sapithuante na suttol uh a, na inn uh sia mizawngte tung pan na laak uh vanhte taw kidim teak hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka mite na sukcip natu le mizawngte tung pan meetna laak natu thu bangma na nei bua uh hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa, Vaanglianbelpa ka pau zo hi,” ci in mawsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in, “En vun Jerusalem numeite kiphasak mama hi! Amate vandak sa in lampai uh hi. Amate sikvil tawntung hi. Amate a kal tomsakin pai vakhiangh a, a siakmit tungah haakte ngingsak vasial hi.","title":"Jerusalem Numeite tung Kidop natu Thupiakna"},"17":{"text":"Ahihang amate daan ka pia tu hi — a sam uh ka meetsak tu a, lutol in ka nusia tu hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in Jerusalem numeite tung pan tuabang a, a kiphatsak pui nate theampo — a siakmit tungah a but, a lu tungah a tot, a ngawng ah a aw kizepnate,"},"19":{"text":"tuaciang a khut tung a but haakte theampo a laak tu hun ni khat hong theng tu hi. Ama in a maisitnate le"},"20":{"text":"a lukhute; a baan tung le a kawngah a vom mitbum aite;"},"21":{"text":"a khutmete tungah a but khutzungbute le a naakba te;"},"22":{"text":"puasil puantual te, puantualte, puanvante le a dangka ipte theampo;"},"23":{"text":"a vang silsial a puanzate, a puanneal dial note, ngawng aw puante le lu tung khuk maisitna puan a saute la siat tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Paaknamtuite a zak luangin amate namsia valut tu hi; kawngkhau phate luangin khauhual teang tu hi; a sam hoite taangin a lu uh tol tu hi; puansilh phate luangin, puansia ngapkaai kisilhsak tu hi; a mealhoina in maizumna suak tu hi!"},"25":{"text":"Hi hi, khuapi sung pasalte, a thahat belte ngawngawn ngal sungah kithatlum tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Khuapi kongpite mau in kap tu a, a khuapi mama sia a puan teng kisuutsak a, a pumnguak in lei ah a to numei khat taw kibang tu hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun hong thet ciang, numei sali in pasal khat lencip in; “Koma le koma kivaak zo in, puansilh nikteen ka heang thei tu uh a, ahitazong ko pasal taan ci ka maizum seal natu in, nong hesuakna in nang sia koma pasal hi hong cisak ka po in,” ci tu uh hi."},"2":{"text":"Topa in ngam sungah a om ankung le thingkung theampo a khantosak tu le, a limciitsak tu hun hong thetheng tu hi. A nungta lai Israel mihing theampo in a ngamsung pan a piang an kungte hu in lungpilna le kiphatsak puina nei tu uh hi.","title":"Jerusalem Kipua kik tu"},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem ah a taanglai, Pathian ii a nungta lai tu a tealsa theampo sia, a thiangtho kici tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in ama ii vaangletna taw minam tung thukhenin thiansua tu a, Jerusalem ii mawna le tua munah chi kibua sia silthiang tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Zion mualtung le tua munah a kikhawmte theampo tungah, sun hunin meeikaai khat, zan hunin meikhu le meikuang taang sitset khat, Topa in puak tu hi. Pathian ii minthanna in khuapi bup huamin dal tu hi.","ref":"Pu 13:21; 24:16"},"6":{"text":"Ama ii minthanna in tua khuapi sia sun ni satna pan lia tu a, vuipi le nguapi pan bukna le belhna muan mun khat hisak tu hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi la kong sak laitak hong ngai ta'n, ka lawmpa le ama sapithuan taw kisai la khat hi: Ka lawmpa in leipha mama mual khat ah sapithuan khat nei hi.","title":"Sapit huan La"},"2":{"text":"Ama in leito in suang teng vawk a; sapitkung pha belte suan hi. Ama in tuate a cin natu in tausaang khat sa in, sapitngate a cil natu in leidum khat to hi. Ama in sapit a min tu ngak a, ahihang sapitnga theampo thuk siat hi.","ref":"Mt 21:33; Mk 12:1; Lk 20:9"},"3":{"text":"Tuabang hi a, tu in ka lawmpa in, “Jerusalem le Judah ngam ah a teang no mite awng, kei le ka sapithuan kilaklaw ah thu hong khen tavun."},"4":{"text":"Hisia atu ka sep laak bang om ziam? Tuaciang ka muanmawk bang sapit phate piang ngawl a, banghang sapit thuk piang thong ziam?"},"5":{"text":"“Hi bangin ka sapithuan tungah ka vawt tu hi; a kiim uumna dalte ka lakeak tu a, a dalna ngawlte thiaktanin, ngamsate in ka nesak tu a, ka tuanhcilsak tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Lopa in ka khunelsak tu hi. Sapit baakte ka heu buatu a, a lei zongh ka tho buatu hi; tuasia luangin, lingte ling kungte in ka khunelsak tu hi. Ngua a zuksak ngawl natu in meeite ngawngawn ka khaam tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel sia Vaanglianbelpa Topa ii sapithuan hi; Judah mite sia ama suan sa sapitkungte ahi hi. Topa in amate a pha vawt tu in muangmaw a, ahihang amate in tual that zaw uh hi. Ama in amate sia a maan bang seam tu in muangmaw a, ahihang amate ii a vawtsiatte in thumaanna dei in kap uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Note a lal na hi uh hi! Na neisa inn le lote belap natu in na lei thawthua uh hi. Hai ngawlin midangte teen natu mun om ngawl tu a, tua leitang tungah noma bekma na teang tu uh hi.","title":"Mihingte ii Vawt Ngitlona"},"9":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, “Hi a lian a pha inn theampo a hawm suakin lal tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Sapitkung hectare sawm ciinna leitang in sapittui litre liat bekma piangsak tu hi. Anci litre za le sawm liat in vaimim litre sawm le liat bek piangsak tu hi,” a ci ka za zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Note a lal na hi uh hi. Zingsang zu ne tu in na thopal uh a, nitak ngei hial veu zu ne zu khamin na om uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Na poai sung uh ah tengtongh, daalkual khuangnote, tamngaite, na tum uh a — tuaciang sapittui na ne uh hi. Ahihang Topa in bang seam cisia na tel bua uh hi,"},"13":{"text":"tua ahikom thongtaakte bangin hong kipaipui tu hi. Na lampuite ngilkialin pukthi tu a, nautaang mite dangko in thi tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Mithi khua in amate ne tu in kamkat hi. Tua in Jerusalem mithupite sia a ngamlum nautaang mihonte taw valhtum khawm tu hi."},"15":{"text":"A kuama po kimaimawlsak tu a, a kiphasak theampo kiniamsuksak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang Vaanglianbelpa Topa in ama ii letna sia thutang sepna taw lak a, ama thianthona sia a mite tungah a thu khenna taw pualaak hi."},"17":{"text":"A sia sa khuapite sungah tuute in lopa ne tu a, kealnote in a tatna tu mun mu tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Note a lal na hi uh hi! Na mawnate uh pan suatak natu in na kisaan zo bua uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Note in, “ Topa in ka vawt tu hi a ci sia hi vabil in vawt tahen, tua hile ih mu thei tu hi. Israel ii a thiangtho Pathian in ama ngealnate vawt hen; a thinsung ah bang ngaisun ziam en tek tawng,” na ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Note a lal na hi uh hi! Note in a siate pha hi, a phate sia hi na ci uh hi. Note in khuazing sia khuavak ah, khuavak sia khuazing ah na heak uh hi. Note in a kha sia a thum, a thum sia a kha na sua uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Note a lal na hi uh hi! Noma sia ciim kisa, pilvang mama kisa si nu hi."},"22":{"text":"Note a lal na hi uh hi! Sapittui ne in a hangsan te awng! Zu helin na neak tu uh hangsan in launa nei ngawlte awng!"},"23":{"text":"Ahihang sumnguk khat po taw a maw mite na suaktasak zeang uh a, a maw ngawlte ii thukhaikim thu khenna a nga natu na khaam uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahiciang tu in, taangphaw le lopa ko ngimngeamte mei a kak bangma in, na zungte muatin na paakpalhte kongaw tu a, vui in lenkeak tu hi, banghang ziam cile, noma in Vaanglianbelpa Topa Israel te ii a thiangtho Pathian ii ei hong hilna thu na nial zo uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa sia a mite tungah thin uukin amate daan pia tu in a khut vaan zo hi. Mualte liing tu a, mithi luangte ninteak bangin lampi tungah kinusia tu hi. Tuasia ngawngawn zong Topa thin uukna thai zo ngawl lai tu a, daan pia tu in a khut vaan lai tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in, a khualana ah a om minam khat sapna tu in limlakna khat pia hi. Amate leimong pan hong pai natu in Topa in phit tum in sam hi. Tuasia ciang amate hi sungah manlang takin hong pai paih hi!"},"27":{"text":"Amate kuama toi ngawl a; lutu in a liik om ngawl hi. Amate mutsuak in lusu ngeingawl, mu ngeingawl hi. Kawngkhau khat zongh kawm ngawl hi; peangdap khau khat zongh tat ngawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate thaltangte hiam a, a thalte kaa tawm tu bekin eal pinpen uh hi. A siphu peangcinte thausuang bangin sak a, a muite suumpei bangin pei hi."},"29":{"text":"Ngalkapte sia, tawpite in ngam sa khat man a, amate kung pan kuama ii a laaksak thei ngawl natu munah tua in, a hawk bangin au uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ni a thet ciang, amate in tuipi nging bangin nging takin Israel mite hawksan tu uh hi. Ngam hisia en vun! Khuazinna le ngim thuakna! Khuavak sia khuazing in valhtum hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uzziah Kumpipa ii thi kumin, Topa ka mu hi. Ama sia a kisaangkhai kumpi tokhum tungah to a, a puantual sia Biakinnpi bup dim hi.","title":"Pathian in Kamsaang khat tu in Isaiah Sam","ref":"2 Kum 15:7; 2 Khang 26:23"},"2":{"text":"Ama kiimkot ah a ding, meikuang bang ahi Seraphim vantung mite khat simin tha luk tek nei hi. Tha nii taw a mai tek uh, tha nii taw a pumpi tek uh tuam a, a tha dangte nii tek taw leang uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate khat le khat ki oksan in: “Thiangtho, thiangtho, thiangtho! Vaanglianbelpa Topa sia thiangtho hi! Ama ii minthanna in leitung zel hi,” ci in au uh hi.","ref":"Tpl 4:8"},"4":{"text":"Amate awnging in Biakinnpi tawdappha liingsak a, tuaciang Biakinnpi mama meikhu taw kidim hi.","ref":"Tpl 15:8"},"5":{"text":"Keima in, “Kei atu bangma lam et om ngawl hi! Kei a lal hi ing, banghang ziam cile ka muk pan a pusuak kammal sim sia mawna veu hi a, a kampau sim mawna veu ahi mite sungah ka teang hi. Tuabang teng ahitazong, Kumpipa, Vaanglianbelpa Topa sia ka mittang vateak taw ma in ka mu zo hi,” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Seraphim vantunglalangte khat sia biaknatau pan taitee taw a laak meikam khat dep a, toai in ka kungah hong leang suk hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in meikam taw ka muk hong bitsak a, “Hisia in na muk hong bi zo hi, tu in na mawna bo siat zo a, na mawna teng kimaisak zo hi,” hong ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in, “Akua sawl tu khi ziam? Akua in eite kamtai hi tu ziam a ci ka za hi. “Keima pai tu khi hi! Hong sawl ta'n!” ci in keima in ka zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in nangma va pai ta'n a, hi thu mihingte tungah son ta'n ci in hong sawl hi: “Bang zata na ngai uh zong, na tel thei buatu uh hi. Bang zata na en uh zong bang piang cisia na he buatu uh hi”."},"10":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in keima tungah, “Hi mihingte lungmusakin, a na ngongsak in a, a mittawsak in, tua hile amate khuamu thei ngawl, khua za thei ngawl, tel thei ngawl tu hi. Tuabang hile ka kung hong zuan thei in, a ci ka damsak tu hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Mt 13:14-15; Mk 4:12; Lk 8:10; Jn 12:40; Sawl 28:26-27"},"11":{"text":"Keima in, “ Topa awng, hi bang ahi tu sia bang tanvei ngei tu ziam?” ci in ka dongh hi. (Tua thingbul sia Pathian ii mihingte kipat thakna lim a lak ahi hi.)"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jotham ii tapa, Uzziah ii tupa ahi, Ahaz kumpipa in Judah ngam a uk lai in ngal piang hi. Khuite in taangphaw a neak bangma in tawpite zongh in taangphaw ne tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Nauno khat nguu a nei ngul khat kungah kimai in a om hial zongh in bangma kilaw ngawl tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Pathian ii mual thiangtho Zion tungah liamna baina, a sia a kha bangma om ngawl tu hi. Tuipite sia tui taw a kidim bangma in leitung sia Topa thu heakna taw kidim tu hi.","ref":"Hab 2:14"},"10":{"text":"David kumpi suan pan kumpi thak khat sia minam tam mama te atu in lim khat ahi natu ni khat hong theng tu hi. Amate sia a kumpi khuapi sungah kikhawm in ama zatakna pia tu uh hi.","title":"Saltaang Mite Cia kik tu","ref":"Rom 15:12"},"11":{"text":"Tua ni a thet ciang, Topa in ama ii vaangletna khatvei zangh kik tu a, ama ii mite sung pan Assyria le Egypt ngamsung, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Babylon, Hamath ngamsung teng le tuipi tuikulhte tung, le tuipi dung ngamte ah a kinusia mite, a inn uh ah puak kik tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in a kithethaang Israel le Judah mite kaikhawm kikin, leitung kiing li panin a ciapui kik natu thute sia minamte a lak natu in lim lakna laandial khat phut tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel kumpi ngam in Judah ngam eang nawn ngawlin, Judah te sia Israel te ngal hi ngawl tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate in nitumna sangah a teang Philistine mite sim khawm tu a, nisuana sangah a teang mite do khawmin suttol tu uh hi. Amate in Edom le Moab mite zothal tu a, Ammon mite in amate thu ni tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in Suez Tuidok kangsak tu a, tuaciang Euphrates ngun tui a kan natu in vuisa vasak hi, mi theampo ii a kaantan zawk tu in luino sali bek khe lai tu hi.","ref":"Tpl 16:12"},"16":{"text":"A taanghpupite in Egypt ngam a nusiat lai in amate atu lampi lian khat a om bangma in, tua munah a nungta lai Israel a mite atu in Assyria ngam pan a suatak natu lampi lian khat om tu hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihingte in hi bang la a sak tu ni khat hong theng tu hi, “Nang kong pok hi, Topa awng! nang in kei tungah nong thin uuk hi, ahihang tu in nong heeneam a, na thin uuk nawn ngawl hi.","title":"Lungdam Kona Biakna La"},"2":{"text":"Pathian sia kei hong ngumpa hi; Ama muangin, ka lau buatu hi. Topa in vaangletna le thahatna kei hong pia a; ama sia kei hong ngumpa ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 15:2; Ps 118:14"},"3":{"text":"Tui thiang in a dangko te, a lungdamsak bangma in, Pathian ii mihingte zongh ama ii a ngup ciangin lungdam uh hi.”"},"4":{"text":"Mihingte in hi bang la a sak tu ni khat hong theng tu hi, “ Topa tungah lungdamko vun! Nang hong hu tu in ama sam vun! Ama sep teng minam theampo tungah son vun! Ama bang zata lian ziam cisia mihingte tungah son vun!"},"5":{"text":"Topa in na lianpite seam zo ahikom ama tungah lasa vun. Hi thuthang sia leitung buppi in za tahen."},"6":{"text":"Zion ah a teang mi theampo au in lasa tahen! Israel te ii a thiangtho Pathian sia lian a, ama in a mite sungah teang hi.”"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia sia Babylon taw kisai, Amoz ii tapa Isaiah ii Pathian tung pan a nga thupuak khat ahi hi.","title":"Pathian in Babylon Daan pia tu","ref":"Is 47:1-15; Jer 50:1—51:64"},"2":{"text":"Mual kolh khat tungah ngal simna laandial khaito vun! A kiphasak khuapi kongpite a sim natu limlakna in na ngalkapte oksan in a, na khut laamto in."},"3":{"text":"Topa in a thiangtho ngal khat sim tu le ama a thin a uuksakte daan pia tu in, a kiphasak le a muanhuai a ngalkapte sam zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Mualtung ngamlumna — mihonpite aw, a kikhawm tua minamte le kumpi ngamte ii ngamlumna awte ngai vun. Ngalkaphonpite ii Topa in a ngalkapte ngalsim tu in kithoaisak hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate sia leimong ah a om ngam khualate pan hong pai uh hi. Topa sia a thin uukna taw ngam bup lalthamsak tu in hong pai hi."},"6":{"text":"Na sa in kap keak vun! Vaanglianbelpa ii sukcip tu ni, Topa ni, hong nai hi.","ref":"Jol 1:15"},"7":{"text":"Mihing theampo ii khutte zaw vanek tu a, a thinhanna uh kiam tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate a vekpi in launa le nasak mamana thuak tu uh a, numei nausuak tun bangin na sa tu hi. Amate khat le khat launa taw ki en tu a, maizum in a mai uh san tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa ni — a kiitakhuai, a thin uuk, a thinso vilvel, ni ngilo ni hong theng tu hi. Leitung sia dui kisuaksakin, mawnei theampo kilalcipsak siat tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Aksi theampo le aksi honpite taang nawn ngawlin, ni a sua ciang mial tu a, tha zongh taang ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Eze 32:7; Mt 24:29; Mk 13:24-25; Lk 21:25; Tpl 6:12-13; 8:12"},"11":{"text":"Topa in, “Leitung ah ngimna siatna ka thengsak tu a, mi seksolte theampo a mawnate hu in daan ka pia tu hi. A kiphasak theampo ka niamsak tu a, a kisathei theampo le a ngilote theampo daan ka pia tu hi."},"12":{"text":"A nungta sunte khamh sangin ka tawmsak zaw tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa keima in, ka thin uukna ka lak ni in, vantungte ka liingsak tu a, leitung sia ama omna pan kithingkeak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"“Babylon ah a teang ngamdangmite sia savaite kung pan a suakta sangai bang le a cing om ngawl tuute bangin amate ngam tek ah tai in kithethaang tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Mat a thuak pawpo kihollum tu hi."},"16":{"text":"A nausente kivellupsak tu a, a innte kiphuul in, a zite a kibuansak tu sia cimaw in en thong tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in, “Babylon sim tu in Medeste ka hol tu hi. Amate in ngunn sia bangma thusim ngawlin, khamh zongh awlmawk ngawl uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in a thal le a thaltangte taw tangvalte thatlum tu uh hi. Amate in nausente hesuak ngawlin, patangte khuangai huai sa ngawl tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Babylon sia kumpi ngam theampo sung pan a et hoibel hi a; tuasia in a mite kiphatsakna ahi hi. Ahihang Topa ahi, keima in, Sodom le Gomorrah ka vawt bangin Babylon ka lawnthal tu hi!","ref":"Pian 19:24"},"20":{"text":"Tua munah kuama teang kik ngei nawn ngawl tu hi. A vak kawkoai Arab mite, kuama in tua munah puanbuk phut ngei nawn ngawl tu a, tuucingpa in tua munah a tuu honte tha ngeingawl tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua mun sia sennealngam ngamsate teenna le simbute bu tomna mun hi tu hi. Tua munah kalaoh vacimte teangin, sathakte a sia a lalte sungah kinuntaw tu uh hi.","ref":"Is 34:14; Zep 2:14; Tpl 18:2"},"22":{"text":"Tausaangte le kumpi innte sungah ngam ui le ngiate auna aw hawl tu hi. Babylon khuapi a siat tu hun theng zo hi! A nite cing dektak zo hi,” ci hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in ama ii mihing Israel te khatvei ma hesuak kik leleau tu a, ama aituam mi in teal tu hi. Topa in amate a leitang tungah teangsak kik tu a, ngamdangmite pai in tua munah amate taw teang khawm tu uh hi.","title":"Saltanna pan Heak kikna"},"2":{"text":"Topa ii Israel mite a piaksa ngam ah a cia kik natu in minam tam mama in hu tu a, tua munah minamte sia Israel ii sila suak tu uh hi. Khatvei lai in Israel te a mante sia tu in Israel te in man tu a, khatvei lai amate a zothawte sia Israel mite in uk tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in Israel mite natna ngimna a thuakna pan le nasep ham a kisepsakna panin damna le tawlngak toithaina pia tu hi.","title":"Mithi Khua ah Babylon Kumpipa"},"4":{"text":"Topa in hi bang a piak ciang, Israel mite in Babylon kumpipa sia: “A ngilo kumpipa pukvawk zo! Ama in kuama zawthawk vawt kik ngei nawn ngawl tu hi!"},"5":{"text":"Thin uukna taw a mite a zawthawk vawtte le, a zaw sa minamte a vawtsia tan tawntung a tatsia ngamukte ii thahatna Topa in bosak zo hi.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Tu tak ciang leitung bup ah tawlngakna le kilemna om a, kuama po thinnuam lungnuam in lasa uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A zataak kumpipa hu in Lebanon ngam a om cypress le cedar thingkungte lungdam uh hi, banghang ziam cile tu in ama thi zo a, amate a phuktan tu kuama om nawn ngawl hi!"},"9":{"text":"“Babylon kumpipa muak tu in mithi khua kinging hi. Leitung ah a thahat mite ii thaate vak hiithuut kawkoai hi. Kumpite ii thaate sia a kumpi tokhumte pan tho uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate a vekpi in ama ausan in, ‘Tu in nang sia koma bangma in thazawm zo ni hi! Nang sia koma khat bangma na hi hi!"},"11":{"text":"Tengtongh music te taw hong kipok bul hi, ahihang tuciang hi mun mithi khua theng ni hi. Thanhte na luppha hi a, lungte na puanvan ahi hi.’"},"12":{"text":"“Babylon kumpipa nikonghong aksi awng, vantung panin na taak suk zo hi! Nidangin minamte na zo a, ahizong tu in lei ah hong kikhiasuk zo ta hi.","ref":"Tpl 8:10; 9:1"},"13":{"text":"Nangma in, vantung ah kaato in, na kumpi tokhum sia a saangbel aksite ii tung pek ah koi tu in na khensat hi. Nangma in pathiante kikhopna tua saksang mual tungah kumpi khat bangin to tu in na kingaisun hi."},"14":{"text":"Nangma in meei dawnte ah ka kaato tu a, Vaanglianbelpa taw ka kibang tu hi, na ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahizong mithi khua a thuk belna munah nang hong kipuak suk zo zaw hi.","ref":"Mt 11:23; Lk 10:15"},"16":{"text":"“Mithite in nang hong salh tu a, lamdang sa in hong kamkat tu hi. Amate in, ‘Hisia pa in leitung lok a, kumpi ngamte a liingsak pa hi ngawl ziam?"},"17":{"text":"Hisia pa in khuapite lalcipsakin, leitung sennealngam a suaksak pa hi ngawl ziam? Hisia pa in a thongtaakte suatak ngeingawl, a inn uh ah a ciasak ngeingawl pa hi ngawl ziam?’ ci in dongh tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Leitung kumpi theampo sia amate ii a nasia mama thaankuul ah kiphum uh a,"},"19":{"text":"ahihang nangma in thaankuul nei ngawlin, na luang sia a muatcip tu in kivawk hi. Na luang sia ngal kisimna sungah a kithatlum ngalkapte ii luangte in khunel a, suanghawng sung khat ah kivawk khawmin kituanhcil hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangma in na ngam susia a, na mite mama na thatlup hu in nang sia kumpi dangte bangin hong kiphum ngawl tu hi. A tatsia na innkuan sungah kuama nungta ngawl tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihon kithalupna kipan hen! Hi kumpipa ii tapate sia a taanghpupite mawnate hangin thi tu uh hi. Amate kuama in leitung uk ngei nawn ngawl tu a, khuapite saat zo ngei nawn ngawl tu hi,” ci in nunau tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, “Babylon simin, ka siasak tu hi. Keima in nausente pan kipan kuama ka khoaikhe buatu hi, a nungta kuama om ngawl tu hi. Keima, Topa in, ka son zo hi.","title":"Pathian in Babylon Lalcipsak tu"},"23":{"text":"Keima in Babylon khuapi buannawng pui khat ka suaksak tu a, tua munah simbute teang tu hi. Babylon sia munphia khat taw ka phiat tu a, tua in na theampo phiatkeak tu hi. Keima vaanglianbelpa Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in: “Ka ngeal bangin piang tu hi. Vawt tu in ka khensat sa bangin kivawt tu hi.","title":"Pathian in Assyria Mite Lalcipsak tu","ref":"Is 10:5-34; Nah 1:1—3:19; Zep 2:13-15"},"25":{"text":"Israel, ka ngam sungah Assyria te ka lalcipsak tu a, ka mualte tungah amate ka tuanhcil tu hi. Ka mihingte sia Assyria te ii hakkol pan le a puak tu a vanhngitte pan ka suatak tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Hi ngealna sia leitung atu hi a, minamte daan pia tu in ka khut ka vaan hi,” ci in kiciam hi."},"27":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in hisia vawt tu in khensat zo hi; ama in daan pia tu in a khut vaan zo a, kuama in khaam thei ngawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Hi thu sia Ahaz Kumpipa ii thi kumin, a kipualaak thu ahi hi.","title":"Pathian in Philistine te Lalcipsak tu","ref":"2 Kum 16:20; 2 Khang 28:27"},"29":{"text":"Philistia mite awng, note hong saat ciangkhut sia kithiaktan hi, ahihang note lungdamna tu thu om ngawl hi. Ngul khat a thi ciang, a ngilo zaw khat a taangin hong pai hi. Ngul ii tuui panin a leang thei ngulpui khat keu hi.","ref":"Jer 47:1-7; Eze 25:15-17; Jol 3:4-8; Amo 1:6-8; Zep 2:4-7; Zec 9:5-7"},"30":{"text":"Topa in ama mi a cimaw mizawngte ii tuucing pa hi tu a, thinmuang takin nungtasak tu hi. Ahizong ama in no Philistine mite tungah nasia takin kialpi hong tungsak tu a, khat zongh hong hingkhoai ngawl tu hi."},"31":{"text":"No Philistine khuapi theampo awng, huna ngenin kapin au vun! Na vekpi uh in lauthawngin om vun! Saksang pan ngalkapte hong paina leivui khu sia meei bang hi a — tua ngalkaphon sungah a lauthauh khat zongh om ngawl hi."},"32":{"text":"Philistia ngam pan hong pai kamtaite tung bangbang son tu khu ziam? Topa in Zion khua kipsak zo hi, tuaciang a ngim nga ama ii mite sia tua munah ngammuanna nga tu hi, ci in amate ka son tu uh hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia sia Moab taw kisai thupuak khat ahi hi. Zan khat thu in Ar le Kir khuapite kilalcipsak a, Moab ngam thim dide hi.","title":"Pathian in Moab Lalcipsak tu","ref":"Is 25:10-12; Jer 48:1-47; Eze 25:8-11; Amo 2:1-3; Zep 2:8-11"},"2":{"text":"Dibon khua mihingte a thiangtho biakna mun mual tungah kap tu in kaato uh hi. Nebo le Medeba khuapite tungtaang ah khuangai in Moab khua mite nasia takin kap uh hi; a khuangai hu in a samte le a khamulte meet uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Lampi tungah a om mite khau-ip puan kisilhsak a; innkhum dawn le khuapi khawlmunte ah a om mite tau in kap uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Heshbon le Elealeh khua mite kapin, amate kaana awnging sia Jahaz khua dongin kiza thei hi. Ngalkapte ngawngawn liingin; a hanna teng bo siat hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka thin takpi taw Moab atu in ka kap hi! Mihingte Zoar khua le Eglath Shelishiyah ah tai zo uh hi. Pawlkhat te Luhith paina lampi ah kap kawmin paito uh a; pawlkhat ahile Horonaim khua ah suakta a, khuangai in ngamlum siasua uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Nimrim Luitui kang hi, tua luihui ah a po lopate vul zo a, lohing mun om nawn ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihingte sia amate ii neisa theampo taw a suatak natu hanciam in Pakngiam Kuam kaantan in pai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Moab ii ngamngi theampo ah kaana awnging kiza hi. Eglaim le Beerelim khuate ah kaana aw kiza hi."},"9":{"text":"Dibon khua ah nguntui sia chisan taw kidim a, Pathian in tualai ah a om mite atu in a sia zawlai pawlkhat nei hi. Hi hi, Moab ngam sungah a kikhe lai mi theampo chisan luangin hon kithalupna khat om tu hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sennealngam sungah a om Sela khuapi pan Moab mihingte in Jerusalem ah a om ngamukpa tungah tuuno khat letsong in puak uh hi.","title":"Moab atu Lametna Om ngawl"},"2":{"text":"Amate in Arnon Ngun vaalbo tung pan ngak a, vacimte a bu uh pan a kinawkeak ciang a ci a law a heak ngawl bangin vak kawkoai uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in Judah mihingte tungah, “Bang seam tu khu ziam hong son tavun. Thingkung khat in suntang ni sat kimlai in, a limh vot khat a piak bangma in noma in hong dal tavun a, na limh sungah hong tawlngasak tavun. Ko sia ngaltaite ka hi uh hi, kuama ii hong mu thei ngawlna munah hong seal tavun."},"4":{"text":"Na ngam sungah ko hong teangsak tavun. Kote hong susia nuamte kung pan hong dal tavun,” ci uh hi. (Zawthawkna le suksiat nate bo tu a, ngam lalsak mite thotsak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, David suan le paal sung pan khat sia kumpi suak tu a, ama in mihingte thumaanna le itna taw uk tu hi. Ama in a maan sia seam papaih tu a, thukhaikim thu omsak tu hi.)"},"6":{"text":"Judah mihingte in, “Moab mihingte bang zata in kiphasak ci thu ih za zo hi. Amate a kisaktheina le a kiletsakna ih he hi, ahihang amate ii kisuantaakna sia a luithawthong hi,” ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Moab mite sia ngimna a thuak hu in kap tu uh hi. Kir Heres khuapi sungah a om lai in a neak bul uh anlimte a phaw kik uh ciangin, amate a vekpi in kap tu uh hi. A thin kiam tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Heshbon khua hui a lote le Sibmah ii sapithuante kilalsak hi — tua sapithuan pan a piang sapittuite in minam ukte zu khamsak ngei bul hi. Khatvei lai in a khualana Jazer khuapi dong, nisuana sang sennealngam dong, nitumna sang Tuipi Thi ngalkhat dong sapitkungte zaam hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu in Jazer atu ka kaa bangma in tu in Sibmah ii sapitkungte atu in ka kap hi. Mihingte lungdamsak natu in anlaak poai om ngawl ahikom Heshbon le Elealeh atu in ka thitui taak hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu in lo ngam pha sungah kuama lungdam ngawl hi. Sapit huan sungah kuama au ngawlin lasa ngawl uh hi. Sapittui vawt tu in kuama in sapitngate cil ngawl uh hi; lungdam in, au nate bo hi."},"11":{"text":"Moab atu in khuangai in Kir Heres atu in ka tau hi."},"12":{"text":"Moab mihingte in mualtung a thiangtho biakna munte le a biakinnte ah thungen tu in pai a, thapaai thawthong in, amate atu bangma phattuamna om ngawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuasia in Moab taw kisai Topa thupuak maksak ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu in Topa in, “Kum thum a cin lianin Moab ii hauna letnate mangthang tu a, a mite tam mama sung pan amate tawm bek nungta lai in, thazawm tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in, “Damascus sia khuapi khat hi nawn ngawl tu hi; ninthuk kholna khat bek hi tu hi.","title":"Pathian in Syria le Israel Daan pia tu"},"2":{"text":"Syria khuapite kinusia top tu hi. Tua mun sia tuu le khui tatna mun hi tu a, kuama in tuate bengkeak ngawl tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel sia a dal tu om ngawl tu a, Damascus te sia a suatakna taan tu hi. Syria mi a nungta laite sia Israel mite bangma in maimawl tu uh hi. Keima, Vaanglianbelpa Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Jer 49:23-27; Amo 1:3-5; Zec 9:1"},"4":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel ii letna a bo tu ni khat hong theng tu a, a hauna sia zawnna taw kilaih tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel sia ankung a kisaattan, an kila sa lo khat, Rephaim kuam sung lo kolh khat taw kibang tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Israel mi tawm bekma nungta lai tu a, a kungdawn pek ah a nga pum nii pum thum simngawl, ahibuale a nuaisang a baakte tungah a kikhe lai tawmno teng simngawl, a nga dang teng theampo a kilo siat sa olive kung khat taw kibang tu hi. Keima, Topa Israel te ii Pathian in, ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ni a thet ciang, mihingte in amate a Bitphuapa ahi, Israel te ii a thiangtho Pathian kungah hu ngenin zuan tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in a khut uh taw a vawttawm biaknataute suang nawn ngawl tu a, ahibuale a khut vateak taw a vawt sa — Asherah numeipathian limte le ngimnamtui halna taute muang nawn ngawl tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni a thet ciang pha tak a kidal khuapite sia Israel te kung pan a taikeak Hiv te le Amor te ii nusiat khuapite bangin lalcipin taisan tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel awng, nang hong suatak a, a thahat suangpi khat bang a hong dal Pathian sia na mangil zo hi. Tuasia taangin, ngamdang pathian khat biak natu in huan thiangthote na vawt hi."},"11":{"text":"A kungte na suan ni zing mama in meangin, a paak hial zongin an laak tu na nei peang buatu hi. Ngimna le a dam thei ngawl natna bek om tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Ngam thahatte ii ngam sungah tuipi nging bang, tuihual puite kisuk bangin buaina om lialua hi.","title":"Ngal Ngamte Kizo"},"13":{"text":"Minamte sia tuihualte bangin maisang manaw in pai uh hi, ahihang Pathian in amate teih in pau ahikom nungkin kik a, suumpei sungah taangphawte bang le mualpangh ah leivui bangin kinotkeak hi."},"14":{"text":"Nitak sangin amate kiitakhuai mama a, ahihang zingsang in bo hi. Tuasia in ih ngam ih lei hong suttolte theampo ii thuak tu ahi hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ethiopia ngunte ngalkhat ah ngam khat om a, tualai ah thaphil nging kiza hi.","title":"Pathian in Ethiopia Daan pia tu","ref":"Zep 2:12"},"2":{"text":"Tua ngam panin, tongciinte sia pumpa taw a kivawt ngunkuang taw Nile ngun zui in paisuk uh hi. Sawl tangzang kamtaite awng, na inn uh ah cia kik vun! Nguntuite ii a khentanna ngam ah a om a thahat, a vaanglian minam, a tun saangin a ciineal, leitung theampo ii kiitak na mite teng tungah thu khat puak kik vun."},"3":{"text":"Ngai vun, leitung ah a teang mite theampo awng! Mualdawn ah a kikhai tu limlakna laandial khat zong vun! Lemle a kitum tu aw ngai vun!"},"4":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah, “Keima in anlaak hun zan khualum lai daaituite a taak bang vakhial le, sun lai nitaang kiukiau bangin vantung pan kong ensuk tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Sapit ngate a kikaikhop ma, a paakte pul siat in a ngate a min ciang, sapitkung pan a baakte nam taw ol takin a kiheu bangin, ngalte in Ethiopia te susia tu hi."},"6":{"text":"A ngalkap te ii mithi luangte sia vacimte le ngamsate atu in kinusia thal tu hi. Khaal sungin vacimte le, phalbi sungin ngamsate in tuate taw kivaak tu uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngunte ii khentan hi ngam, a thahat a vaanglian hi minam, a tun saangin a ciineal, leitung theampo ii a kiitak hi mihingte tung panin biakpiaknate Vaanglianbelpa Topa ii a saan thei tu hun khat hong theng tu hi. Vaanglianbelpa Topa a kibiakna mun, Zion Mual tungah amate hong pai tu uh hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia sia Egypt ngam taw kisai thupuak ahi hi. Topa sia meei tungah to in, manlang mama in Egypt ngam ah hong pai hi. Ama mai ah Egypt milimte liingin, Egypt mihingte a hanna bo hi.","title":"Pathian in Egypt Daan pia tu","ref":"Jer 46:2-26; Eze 29:1—32:32"},"2":{"text":"Topa in, “Egypt ngam sungah tualngal thosakin, unau khat le khat, innpaam khat le khat ka kidosak tu hi. A kidem khuapite khat le khat kido in, a kidem kumpite khat le khat vaangletna kituu in kihau tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Egypt te ii ngealnate lalsakin, a thin kho nate ka siasak tu hi. Amate in a milimte tungah huna ngenin, thaa sam theite thu dongh in, mithite ii thaa te tungah ngaisutna ngen tu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A ngoltol a tatkha, zawthawk thu taw a ngilo kumpi khat tungah Egypt te aapin ka uksak tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianbelpa Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Nile nguntui kiamsuk in, ngun sia dadamin kang tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Nguntui luanna tuilamte dadamin ko in ui tu hi. Pumpa kung le phaipheang kungte ko ngaw tu a,"},"7":{"text":"Nile ngundung vaalbo tungah a kiciing ankung theampo ko ngaw in, hui in seamkeak tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Nile ngun sungah ngasa mat taw nuntakna a zong theampo tau in kap tu uh hi; a ngasa tangthaakna le a ngeente kimanna om ngawl tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Puanneal puan a takte thinkiam tu uh hi;"},"10":{"text":"thiamtakte le khutthiam naseamte thin tamthamin a thin lal tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Zoan khua lampuite sia mi mawmawte ahi uh hi! Egypt mipil belte in a mawmawthuai ngaisutna pia uh hi! Amate in taanghlai mipilte le kumpite zalaih tu ka hi uh hi ci in bangbangin kumpipa tungah son ngam ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa awng, ngaisutna a pia thei tu tua na mipilte koisungah om ziam? Egypt atu in Vaanglianbelpa Topa in bang ngealnate nei cisia amate in nang tungah hong son thei tha tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Zoan le Memphis lampuite mawmaw uh hi. Amate sia minam lampui tute ma in kingaisun ahihang lampui khial uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in a lungmanhuai bialbual ngaisutna amate in piasak hi. Tua hu in, Egypt te in a maan ngawl theampo seamin, ama luak naal tawk thei zukham pa khat bangin hoi vatut hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt ngam sungah a om, a hau a zawng, mi thupi mi thupi ngawl, kuama in Egypt te hu thei ngawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Egypt mihingte sia numeite bangin meidoai tu hun khat theng tu hi. Vaanglianbelpa Topa in amate daan pia tu in a khut a vaan sia a mu uh ciang, amate lau in liing tu uh hi.","title":"Egypt in Bia tu"},"17":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa ii Egypt mihingte daan piak tu in a seesa thu a phaw kik simin Egypt mihingte in Judah te kiita tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hun a thet ciang, Egypt khuapi ngate sungah Hebrew kam kipau tu hi. Tualai a mihingte in Vaanglianbelpa Topa min suangin kiciamnate vawt tu uh hi. Khuapite sung pan khuapi khat sia, “Ni ii Khuapi” kici tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuasia hun a thet ciang, Egypt ngam sungah Topa biaknatau khat om tu a Egypt ngamngi ah, ama min in khansuang khat kiphut tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuate sia Vaanglianbelpa Topa ii Egypt ngam sungah a om hunlam a kilakna limte hi tu hi. Tualai ah a om mite kizothaw in Topa tungah huna a nget uh ciang, ama in amate a suatak tu mihing khat puak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa sia Egypt mihingte tungah ama mama kilangh tu hi, tuaciang amate in ama he in, bia tu a, sangaw biakpiakna le meihal biakpiaknate pia tu uh hi. Amate in Topa tungah a ciliap huai kamciamnate pia in, tua a kamciamna bangin seam tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa in Egypt te daan pia tu hi, ahihang tua zawkciang damsak tu hi. Amate in Topa sangah kiheak tu uh a, ama in a thungetnate za in a ci uh damsak tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua hun a thet ciang, Egypt le Assyria ngam kilaklaw ah lampi lian khat om tu hi. Tua ngam nii te pan mihingte khat le khat kihaw in minam niite in Topa bia khawm tu uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuasia hun ciang, Israel sia Egypt le Assyria taw za kikim tu a, hi minam thumte leitung theampo atu in thupha a hi tu uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in amate thupha pia in, “Ka mi Egypt te awng; no kong bitphua sa Assyria te awng; tuaciang no kong teal mi Israel te awng, thupha kong pia tu hi,” a ci hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Assyria kumpilianpa Sargon thupiakna taw in, Assyria ngalkapmang lianbelpa in Philistine khuapi Ashdod sim hi.","title":"A Pumnguak om Kamsaangpa taw Limlakna"},"2":{"text":"Tua hun ma kum thum lai in Topa in Amoz ii tapa Isaiah tungah a silh khau-ip puan le a peangdapte suut tu in sawl hi. Ama in thu ni in a pumnguak le a peangnguakin vak kawkoai hi."},"3":{"text":"Ashdod khua a kilaak zawkciang, Topa in, “Ka naseampa Isaiah sia a pumnguak, a peangnguakin kum thum sung vak kawkoai hi. Hi thu in Egypt le Ethiopia te tungah maisang bang teng piang tu cisia, lakna lim ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ngamte nii pan a ngal matte sia a pumnguakin Assyria kumpilianpa in paipui tu hi. Egypt mite maizum kipia tu hi, a moi a haam ci tuan om ngawlin, a ngoaibulte zongh kiseal ngawlin a pumnguak le a peangnguakin vak tu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ethiopia te muangin, Egypt te hangin a kiphasak tha te a khial hunlam kiphawksak tu a, a lametna uh bo siat tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuasia hun a thet ciang, Philistia ngam tuipi dung ah a teang mite in, ‘Assyria kumpipa kung pan ei hong dal tu in ih suan ih muanbel mite bang tat thong ziam, en vun! Eite bangbang nungta nawn thong tu hi ziam’ a ci tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia sia Babylon taw kisai thupuak ahi hi. A lauhuai ngam khat panin suumpei khat bangin sennealngam kaantan in, tuasiatna hong pai tu hi.","title":"Babylon Bo natu Mukholna"},"2":{"text":"A ngitlo huai thupiangte mukholna khat ka mu a, kilee heakna le lalcipna ahi hi. Elam ngalkapte awng, sim vun! Media ngalkapte awng, khuapite kiim uum vun! Babylon ii a piansak ngimna a thuakna sia Pathian in bosak tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Mukholna sungah ka zaak le ka mute in hong lausakin, numei khat nau a tut ciangin na a sak bangin na ka sa hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka lu hong vai in, lau in ka liing hi. Nitak hong thet tu ka thangai a, ahihang hong thet takpi ciang liinna le launa bekma hong puak hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka mukholna ah anneakpoai khat kingingin ka mu hi; leangnate to natu in puan saate kipha hi. Amate an ne tui dawnin a om laitak thakhat thu in thupiakna khat nging hi; “Uliante awng! Na lumte pua khol vun!” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa in kei tungah, “Pai in a ngal encik khat koi in, a mu bangin thu hong puak tu in sawl in."},"7":{"text":"Mihing nii veu, nii veu siphu tungto in hong pai ahizong, mihingte laa tung le kalaoh tung to in hong pai ahizong ama in a mu le, pha takin tuate a etcik tu ahi hi,” hong ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngal encik pa au in, “Topa awng, a sun a zanin ngalvilin ka ding tan hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Thakhat thu in amate hong theng hi! Mihing nii veu nii veu siphu tung to hi. Ngal encik pa in, thu puak in, “Babylon bo zo hi! Amate ii biak milim theampo lei ah tamhtham dipdeapin om hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Tpl 14:8; 18:2"},"10":{"text":"Israel ka mite awng, mangtaang bangin no hong kicil zo hi, ahihang tu in Israel te ii Pathian ahi, Vaanglianbelpa Topa tung pan ka zaak, a zaaknophuai thuphate kong son zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Hisia in Edom taw kisai thupuak ahi hi. Edom pan khat in kei hong samin, “Phualcing pa awng, zan hun a bo nai tu ziam? A bo pal tu ziam hong son ta'n,” hong ci hi.","title":"Edom taw kisai Thupuak"},"12":{"text":"Ka zo kikna pan, “Zingsang hong thetheng hi, ahizong zan hun hong theng kik leleau tu hi. Nong dongh kik nuam le hong heak kikin hong dongh ta'n,” ka ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Hisia in Arabia taw kisai thupuak ahi hi. Dedan mi, Arabia ngamkol sungah kalaoh hon taw ngiaphual saatin a om note awng,","title":"Arabia taw kisai Thupuak"},"14":{"text":"note kungah hong pai tuidu dangtaak mihingte tui pia vun. Tema ngammi note awng, ngaltaite an pia vun."},"15":{"text":"Namsau taw kithalupna pan, thal taw kikaplupna pan le ngal launa theampo pan a suakta tu in mihingte tai uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa in kei tungah, “Kum khat sung lianin Kedar minamte ii a letna bo tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Kedar mite sung pan thal toaite sia ngalhang belte hi a, ahihang amate sung pan tawm bek taang lai tu hi. Keima, Israel te ii Topa Pathian in ka son zo hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia in Mukholna Kuam taw kisai thupuak ahi hi. Bang thu piang ziam? Banghangin khua mite theampo in innkhum tungah poai vawtin om uh ziam?","title":"Jerusalem taw kisai Thupuak"},"2":{"text":"Khuapi bup ngamlum siasua a, aw sa le thin patauna taw kidim hi. Hi ngal sungah a thi na mite sia ngal simin a thi hi ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Na lampuite theampo taikeak in, thaltang khat beak zongh a kaap ma in kiman uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka mihing a thite theampo atu in nasia tak ka kaa thei natu in, tu in keima nguak hong nusia ta'n. Hong heeneam heak in."},"5":{"text":"Hi hun sia Mukholna Kuam sungah a liinglawng patauna, ngallelna le ahi biaibuai a pian hun hi a, tuate sia Vaanglianbelpa Topa Vaanglianpipa in ei tungah hong thengsak hi. Ih khuapi uumna luphungte kisaattham zo a, huna ngenin auna awte mualte kawm ah hawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Elam ngam pan ngalkapte thal le thaltang toai in siphu tung to in, hong pai uh hi. Kir ngam pan ngalkapte a lum tek taw kithoai sa in om uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Lei pha mama Judah kuamte sia siphu ngalleangte taw kidim hi; siphu ngalkapte Jerusalem kongpite mai ah ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Judah te ngal dalnate theampo cimhtham hi. Tuabang a pian ciang, ngalvanh koina phual pan ngalhiamte na la uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Jerusalem luphung koisung teng pua tuak cisia na mu hi. Jerusalem khua ah a om innte theampo na en kawkoai a, khuapi luphungte pua kik natu in, zak tu suangte nga natu inn pawlkhat na pheltham hi. Tui khol natu in,","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"tuikhuk a lui sia pan a luangsuk tuite khol natu in khuapi sung sangah tuibeam khat na vawt uh hi. Ahihang nidang lai pekin, hite theampo hong ngealsak le a piangsak Pathian na thusim bua uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaciang Vaanglianpipa Topa , Vaanglianbelpa in a kap tu a mau tu le sam meettol in, khau-ip puan silh tu in note hong sam hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua taangin note nuiza in poai na vawt uh hi. Neak tu in tuu le khuite na ngo uh a, sapittui na dawn uh hi. Noma in, “Ei teng zongh ne in dawnin ih om thei tha tu hi! Zing ciangin a thi tu ih hi hi,” na ci uh hi.","ref":"1 Cor 15:32"},"14":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa , Vaanglianbelpa ama mama in kei hong paupui a, “Amate a nuntak lai teng a siatna kimaisak ngeingawl tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa Vaanglianbelpa ka pau zo hi,” hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in keima tungah kumpi innkuan sung thuzeakpa ahi, Shebna kungah pai in hi bangin va ci ta'n,","title":"Shebna tungah Kidop natu Thupiak"},"16":{"text":"“Nang akua kisa ni ziam? Mualpangh suang sungah nangma atu thaan khuk khuak tu in bang thu nei ni ziam?"},"17":{"text":"Thupi zongh thupi tha tu ni hi, ahihang Topa in nang hong zamhin hong vawk tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in bawlung top bangin nang hong tawm tu a, a lian zaw na ngam khat ah hong vawk tu hi. Na kiphatsak pui mama ahi siphu ngalleangte ii kungah na thi tu hi. Na topa te innkuan maimawlsak ni hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa in na zum panin hong not tu a, na za letna pan hong khia suk tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in Shebna tungah, “Tuabang a pian ciang, Hilkiah ii tapa, ka naseampa Eliakim ka samsak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Na zum puantual ama ka silsak tu a, na kawngkhau thuasak in, na thuneina theampo ama ka pia tu hi. Ama in Jerusalem le Judah mite tungah pa khat bang hi tu hi."},"22":{"text":"David ii suan le paal kumpipa nuai ah a pawlcing thuneina ama ka pia tu hi. Ama in zum tawtangte nei tu hi; ama hon sia, kuama in khak ngawl tu a, ama kha sia, kuama in hong ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Tpl 3:7"},"23":{"text":"Ama sia vanh khaina khat sawm bangin kip takin ka koi tu a, ama ii innkuan bup atu in maipha ngana ii a naak hi tu hi."},"24":{"text":"“Ahizong a beete le ama a bealhte theampo sia ama atu in vanhngit khat suak tu hi. Amate sia vanh khaina ah um le bealte a kikhai bangin ama tungah kibomkhai tu hi!"},"25":{"text":"Tuabang a pian ciang kho takin a kikhen vanh khaina sia zuukin taak tu hi. Tua in a tungah a kikhai nate theampo ii bona hi tu hi,” ci hi. Topa pau zo hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia in Tyre taw kisai thupuak ahi hi. Tuipi tung a pai teambaw hawlte awng, khuangai in kap vun! Teambaw tawlngakna na khuapi Tyre sia kilalsak zo hi; a innte le teambaw tawlngakna munte lalcip in om hi. Na teambawte Cyprus pan hong heak kik ciang hi thute na za uh hi.","title":"Phoenicia taw kisai Thupuak","ref":"Eze 26:1—28:19; Jol 3:4-8; Amo 1:9-10; Zec 9:1-4; Mt 11:21-22; Lk 10:13-14"},"2":{"text":"Sidon sumvawtte awng, tau in kap vun!"},"3":{"text":"Egypt ngam ah a piang ante a lei a zuak tu le ngam theampo taw sum vawt kipee tu in tuipi kaantan in mihingte na paisak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Sidon khuapi awng, na maimawl hi! Tuipi le tuipi thuk liante in nang hong nialin, “Kei ta khat zongh nei ngei bong. Tapate, tanute ka vaak ka taa ngei bua hi” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tyre khua lalna thu a zaak uh ciang Egypt mite ngawngawn liinglawngin thinkiam tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"No Phoenicia mite awng, he in kap vun! Na suatak natu in Spain ngam zot tu hanciam vun!"},"7":{"text":"Hisia in taanghlai pekin a kisaat Tyre khua nuam hi thei na tu ziam? Tuipi kaantan in ngamthakte saatin a teang tu mite a puak sia hi khuapi ahi ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Kumpi khuapi ahi, leitung ah ngual ii zatak, sumvawt thiamte ii khuapi ahi, Tyre khua ah hi bang theampo a pian natu in akua in ngeal ziam?"},"9":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in ngeal hi. Amate ii nasepna tungah a kiphatsak nate a bo natu le a zatak mite maizum natu in Topa in ngeal hi."},"10":{"text":"Spain ngam ah ngamthak saatin a teang no mihingte awng, pai in lotho vun! No hong khoi tu kuama om nawn ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in tuipi tungah a khut vaan in kumpi ngamte lawnthal zo hi. Phoenicia sum vawtna phualpite a kilalsak natu in ama in thupia zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Sidon khuapi awng, na lungdamna bo zo in, na mite in zawthawk thuak uh hi. Amate Cyprus ah a suakta zongin, ngammuang tuan ngawl tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"(Tyre khuapi ngamsate tatna a suaksak sia Assyrian te hi ngawlin, Babylon te ahi uh hi. Ngal matna tausaangte a sa, Tyre khua kulhte a pheltham le khuapi susia in a nusiate sia Babylon te ahi hi.)"},"14":{"text":"Tuipi tung a pai teambaw naseamte awng, khuangai in kap vun! Na muan uh khuapi sia kilalcipsak zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Tyre khua sia kumpi khang khat, kum sawmsali sung a kimakngil tu hun hong theng tu hi. Tua kumte a cin zawkciang, Tyre sia hi la sungah pumpi kizuak numei bang hi tu hi:"},"16":{"text":"Kuama ii phaw ngawl, a khuangai huai pumpi kizuak numei awng, na tengtongh la in khuapi kiimkot in pai in! Pate khatvei na kung hong zot kik thei natu in tengtongh tumin na lasakte sa kik in."},"17":{"text":"Kum sawmsali a cin ciang, Topa in Tyre khuapi sia ama sep ngei sia ma seam kiksak tu a, leitung kumpi ngam theampo ah ama le ama a pumpi kizuak tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama ii sumvawtna pan a thalaw sumte Topa tungah ki aap tu hi. Ama in tua sumte kholcip thawthong ngawlin, Topa a bia mite in amate atu a kisamh an le puante leina in zangh tu hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in leitang lalsakin ngamkhingsak tu hi. Ama in lei maitang heakcipin, a mite thethaang tu hi.","title":"in Leitang Daan pia tu"},"2":{"text":"Mihing theampo — thiampite le mihingte silate le tote, vanh leite le vanh zuakte, sum pukthaakte le sumpute, a hau a zawng, a thuakna uh kibang kim tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Leitang tamhtham in kisiacip tu hi. Topa in son zo a tuabangin kivawt tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Leitang ko ngaw in tul hi; leitung buppi zawngkhal hi; lei le van a nii in lal hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihingte in Pathian thukhamte paltan na taw le a tawntungin a kikhomsuan tu a vawt thuciamna a siatsakna taw leitang ninsak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom Pathian in leitang haamsiat zo hi. A mite in amate ii vawt bangin thuak uh hi. A nungta mihing tawm vaial hi."},"7":{"text":"Sapitkungte vul in sapittui tawm hi. Khatvei lai in a lungdamte tu in khuangai a,"},"8":{"text":"a lungdamhuai tengtongh le khuang ngingte thim zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Sapittui a neak uh hang lungdam in lasa thei nawn ngawlin; kuama in a limna he nawn ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Khuapi sungah na theampo kibuai in om a, kihuk natu in amate a inn sung tek ah kikhabil uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Sapittui a om nawn ngawl hu in mihingte lampi ah au uh hi. Lungdamna mangtatam siat zo a, leitung pan kibosak zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Khuapi sia siacip in, a kongpite kisaat tham zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Hi sia in leitung theampo ah a om minam sim tungah a piang tu thu ahi hi. Tuasia in Olive ngate kithing siatin, sapitkung tung pan sapit sanghte a kilaw siat zawkciang an kila siat sa lo taw kibang tu hi."},"14":{"text":"A suakta sunte lungdam in lasa tu uh hi. Nitumna sangah a omte in Topa ii letna thu son tu a,"},"15":{"text":"nisuana sangah a omte in ama pok tu uh hi. Tuipi dung ah a teang mihingte in Israel te ii Pathian, Topa pok tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Leitung a khuala belnate panin a thumaan Israel minamte a kipokna late ih za tu hi. Ahihang kei atu in lametna bangma om ngawl hi! Kei zawm dikdek ing! Ngual a leeheakte in tawp ngawlin thetheam lai a, ngual a leeheakna nasia vaial hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihing theampo awng, hong ngai tavun! Launate, dumte le thaangsia nate in note hong ngak nginge hi."},"18":{"text":"A lauhuai patauna pan suatak tu a hanciam pawpo dum sungah taak tu a, dum sung pan a suakta pawpo thaang sungah kiman tu hi. Vantung pan a biing a bealin a sun bangin nguazu tu a, lei tawdapte liing tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Leitang kektham, tamhtham in, kikhen keak tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Leitang mama sia zukham khat bangin hoi vatut tu a, vuipi sungah vui ii seam buk bangin huang tu hi. Leitung sia a mawnate in nengcip ngawpin, puk in tho kik ngei nawn ngawl tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa ii, tungsang vaang neite le leitung ukte daan a piak tu hun khat hong theng tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Dum sungah thongtaakte bangin Pathian in kumpi honkhat kaikhawm tu hi. Amate daan piak tu hun hong thet mateng Topa in thong sungah khabil tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Tha mial tu a, ni taang nawn ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile, Vaanglianbelpa Topa sia kumpi hi tu hi. Jerusalem khua Zion Mual panin ama in uk tu a, mipi lampuite in a vaangletna mu tu uh hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa awng, nangma in ka Pathian na hi hi; nang kong patoai tu a, na min ka pok tu hi. Nangma in nalamdangte na vawt siat zo hi; taanghlai pek a na ngealnate thumaan takin na vawt siat zo hi.","title":"Pokna Biakna La khat"},"2":{"text":"Khuapite na siasak zo a, a kulhte na lalcipsak zo hi. Ih ngalte ii sak kumpi innte bo zo hi."},"3":{"text":"A thahat ngammite in nang hong pok tu hi; a ngilo mite ii khuapite sungah nang hong kikiita tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Mizawngte le a cimawte in nang hong beal zo a, ngim le kham hun sungah ngammuanna nga uh hi. Vuipi vak ciang bukna na pia a, ni sat ciang nilim na pia hi. A ngilo mite in phalbi vuipi bangin le,"},"5":{"text":"kongaw ngam ah nguatui hang bangin sim hi. Ahihang Topa nangma in ka ngalte na thimsak zo hi; mihing ngilote ii aunate, sun nisa sia meei ii a votsak bangin, na thimsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in hi sung Zion Mual tungah leitung minamte theampo atu in anneakpoai khat — a limbel an le a phabel sapittui taw na vawtsak tu hi.","title":"Pathian in Anneakpoai khat Vawt"},"7":{"text":"Hi lai ah minam theampo ii heena meeikaaite ama in thakhat thu in hepsak tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in thina a tawntungin mangthangsak tu hi! Ama in mihing theampo ii thitui nawlsak in, a mite ii leitung mun theampo ah a thuak maimawl na sia laaksak tu hi. Topa ama mama in ci zo hi!","ref":"1 Cor 15:54; Tpl 7:17; 21:4"},"9":{"text":"Tuasia a pian ciang, mihing theampo in, “Ama ih Pathian hi! Ama ka muang zo uh a, ama in hong suatak zo hi. Ama in Topa hi! Ama ka muang zo uh a, ama in kote hong ngum zo ahikom. tu in lungdam thinnuamin ka om uh hi” ci tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in Zion Mual dal tu hi, ahihang nganhing eak sungah taangphawte a kitotcil bangin Moab mite kituanhcil tu hi.","title":"Pathian in Moab Daan pia tu"},"11":{"text":"Amate in tui op tu hanciam bangin a khut vaan tu uh hi, ahihang Pathian in amate niamsuksak tu a, a khutte cimaw in khuumsuk tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Moab te ii a muanhuai luphung saangte susia in leivui suaksak tu hi.","ref":"Is 15:1—16:14; Jer 48:1-47; Eze 25:8-11; Amo 2:1-3; Zep 2:8-11"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah ngam sungah mihingte in hi la a sak tu ni khat hong theng tu hi; Ih khuapi muanhuai hi! Pathian mama in tua luphungte hung hi!","title":"Pathian in A Mihingte Ngalzawna Pia tu"},"2":{"text":"Khuapi kongpite hongin a thumaan minam, a maan a seam a mihingte tumsak vun."},"3":{"text":"Topa awng, nang hong muangin, tupna kho a nei mihingte a kicing thinnopna na pia hi."},"4":{"text":"A tawntung Topa muang in; ama in a tawntungin eite hong dal tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in mihing kiphasakte kiniamkhiaksak hi; amate teenna a muanhuai khuapi lalsakin, a kulhte cimhthamsakin leivui suaksak hi."},"6":{"text":"Zawthawk vawt a thuak mihingte in tu in tua khua zothal a, a peang nuai ah tuanhcil uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa awng, mihing phate atu in a lampi ngilsakin; a khualhawna lampi na tamkimsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Na deina bang kong zui uh a, nang sungah lametna kong nei uh hi; Kote deina theampo sia nangma na hi hi."},"9":{"text":"Zan in ka thin theampo taw nang kong thangai uh hi; leitung le a mihingte tungah thu na khen ciang amate theampo in thukhaikim thu sia he tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing seksolte tungah nang dik napi in, amate in a maan a vawt tu he ngeingawl uh hi. Mihing thutangte teenna hi ngam ngawngawn zongh ah amate in khialna vawt veve lai hi; amate in na letna thusim ngawlin nial uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Na ngalte in amate daan na piak tu hunlam he ngawl uh hi. Topa awng, amate maizumsak in a, ngim ngasak in; amate atu in, na koisak sa daan piaknate thuaksak in. Na mite na it mama zia amate lak in.","ref":"Heb 10:27"},"12":{"text":"Topa awng, kote mavan daupaina nong pia tu hi; kote ii matutna theampo sia nangma ii sepna hang ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Kote Topa Pathian awng, kote sia ngual dangte in hong uk zo a, ahihang nangma bekma in kote Topa na hi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu in amate thi zo a, nungta kik ngawl tu uh hi; amate ii thaa te thoto ngawl tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile nangma in amate daan na pia zo a, na lalsak zo hi. Kuama in amate phawk nawn ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa awng, nangma in koma ii minamte nong khangtosak a, a ngamngi theampo na keak hi, hi thu in nang hong thupisak hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa awng, na mihingte daan na pia hi, a thinna sa in nang tungah thu hong ngen uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Numei nausuak tu a tut ciang na sa in a au bangin Topa awng, kote nong ausak zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Kote in na sa bot sa in om ka hi uh hang bangma a piang bua hi. Kote ngam atu in ngalzawna bangma ka nei bua uh hi; bangma taangtut ka nei bua uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka mipui a thisate nungta kik tu uh hi! A pumpi uh nungta kik tu uh hi. Thaan sungah a mute theampo thoto tu a, lungdamin lasa tu uh hi. A tee vasip daaitui in leitung thathak a piak bangin Topa in taanghlai pek a, a thisate nungtasak tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka mihingte awng, na inn sung uh ah tum vun a, na inn uh khak vun. Pathian ii thin uukna a thai dong tawmvei sung buu zii vun.","title":"Thu Khenna le Kipua kikna"},"21":{"text":"Topa in vantung a teenna mun panin leitung mihingte mawna hangin daan pia tu in hong pai tu hi.
