Leitung ah a kithatlum ku mihingte kipualaak tu a, leitang in tua a kithatlumte seal nawn ngawl tu hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni in tuipi sungah a om nganhing pui sia a that tu le kizialin a kual, a kiitakhuai Leviathan ngul sia daan pia tu in Topa in a vaang nei, thisakna namsau zangh tu hi.","ref":"Job 41:1; Ps 74:14; 104:26"},"2":{"text":"Tua ni in a dei huai sapithuan thu Topa in son tu a,"},"3":{"text":"“Keima in tua huan cingin tui ka buak tawntung hi. Kuama ii suk siat thei ngawl tu in sun le zanin ka cing hi."},"4":{"text":"Sapit huan tungah ka thin uuk nawn ngawl hi. Mot tu ling le lingkungte a om le ka haltum tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang ka mite ii ngalte in, kei ii huuk tu a dei le, keima taw kilemna hong vawt tahen. Hi hi, amate in kei taw kilemna vawt tahen,” ci tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Mailam sangah, Jacob ii suan le paal ahi Israel mite, thingkung khat bangin zung tha tu a, hong mom in a paak palh tu hi. Leitung sia amate ii nga taw kidim tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in Israel te ii ngalte nasia takin daan a piak za in Israel te daan pia ngawl a, a thi a bo zongh tam ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in a mihingte ngamdang ah saltaang tu in a puakna taw daan pia hi. Topa in amate sia nisuana sang pan hong va vui ngilo in seamkeaksak hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahizong, Israel te ii mawnate sia, lawkite ii biaknatau suangte, leikaang bangin a kingoaicip zawkciang le Asherah numeipathian lim te a bo zawkciang, le ngimnamtui halna biaknataute a om nawn ngawl ciang bekin, kimaisak bek tu hi."},"10":{"text":"A muanhuai khuapi sia lalcip in om hi. Ngamkol khat bangin kinusia hi. Ngan thana le ngan lup thei na mun suak hi."},"11":{"text":"Thingbaakte kongaw in taltan a, numeite in thingkang tu in tom uh hi. Banghang ziam cile mihingte in bangma tel ngawl ahikom amate a Bitphuapa Pathian in amate khuangai huai sa ngawl tu a, hesuakna lak ngawl tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ni in, Euphrates ngun pan kipan Egypt ngamngi dong, taangcilte khat po in a zungtaang a tak le a si a khen bangin, Topa in a mihingte khat zawkciang khat kaikhawm tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ni a thet ciang, Assyria le Egypt ngam ah saltaang in a om Israel te theampo tua mun pan sap kikna tu lemle khat kitum tu hi. Amate hong cia a, Jerusalem khua ama ii mual thiangtho tungah Topa bia tu uh hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel kumpi ngam sia a lal ahi hi! Ama ii minthanna sia zukham a lampuite ii lu tungah a khuk paak taw a kivawt kumpi lukhute taw kibangin mang vadi tu hi. Paaknamtui pha tak kinoai napi in a kiphasak amate ii lutangte sia, zu a kham hu in khuaphawk ngawlin tua munah lumcip uh hi.","title":"Saksang Kumpi ngam ii Kidop natu Thu khat"},"2":{"text":"Topa in amate sim tu in a kinging a vaanglian, a thahat khat nei a, tua pa sia hui le ngial bang, ngua a biing a bealin sun bang, tuipawm hawktai bang, tuiliim bangin hong pai in tua ngam zothal tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua zukham lampuite kiphatsakna sia peang nuai ah kituanhcil tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua a kiphasak lampuite ii a kiamsuk minthanna sia theipal min hun ciang a min masa pawpo kilo in, a kine khawng papai bangin mang vangeu tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa sia a nungta lai ama mihingte atu in, paak taw a kivawt, a minthang kumpilukhu bang ahi tu ni khat hong theng tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in thukhenmangte tungah thutang khennate heak theina thin pia tu a, khuapi kongpi cingte sia ngalte hong sim ciang thinhanna pia tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Kamsaangte le thiampite ngawngawn zu kham in hoi vatut uh hi. Sapittui le zuhang tam ne lei ahikom amate lungmangin lutu uh hi. Kamsaangte zukham lei ahikom Pathian ii a musak khol thute tel zo ngawl uh a, thiampite zongh zukham lei ahikom amate kungah a kipuak thute khensat thei ngawl uh hi.","title":"Isaiah le Judah te ii Zukham Kamsaangte"},"8":{"text":"A tona sabuai theampo luak taw kidim in, a thiangtho mun khat zongh om ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in kei hong phunsan uh hi. Amate in, “Tua pa in akua ka hihil ci in kingaisun ziam? Akua in ama ii thupuak dei ziam? Ama ii thupuak sia a nu noai a ten tuung naunote atu bekin pha hi!"},"10":{"text":"Laimal khat zawkciang mal khat, lailam khat zawkciang lam khat, thu khat zawkciang thu khat ama in ei hong hil tiuteu tu hanciam hi,” ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Kei thuson nong ngai bua uh ahile, no tungah thu hong hil tu in kam tumdang a pau ngamdangmite Pathian in zangh tu hi.","ref":"1 Cor 14:21"},"12":{"text":"Topa in note theampo tungah tawlngakna le noptuamna hong pia napi ama thu na ngai nuam bua uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua hu in laimal khat zawk mal khat, lailam khat zawk lam khat, thu khat zawk thu khat, Topa in no hong hil tu ahi hi. Tua zawkciang kal khat na suan simin na lutu tu uh hi. Note hong kiliamsak tu a, thaang sungah hong ki awksakin, thong hong kitaaksak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Hisung Jerusalem khua panin hi mihingte a uk, no a kisathei mite awng, tu in Topa thu ngai vun.","title":"Zion atu Innking Suang"},"15":{"text":"Note in, thina taw thuciamna khat ka vawt zo uh a, mithi khua taw thukimna khat ka nei zo uh hi, ci in na kisuangtaak uh hi. Siatna hong pai ciang, hong pial tu hi ci in na kimuang uh hi, banghang ziam cile no hong huu tu in theamna le leilot thute na suang uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tu in Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Keima in Zion ah a kip a kho inn tawdap khat ka koi hi. Tua ii sungah innking suang sak khat ka phut a, tua tungah hi bang kammalte ki at hi, ‘A kho upna sia a thin zongh sau hi.’","ref":"Ps 118:22-23; Rom 9:33; 10:11; 1 Pe 2:6"},"17":{"text":"Thutang khenna sia inn tawdap atu in a teena khau hi a, thumaanna sia a thikbawk khaukhai hi tu hi,” ci hi. Ngialtang le vuipi in na belh na suan leilot thute theampo seamkeak tu a, tuikhangte in na ngam muanna bosak tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Thina taw na kiciam na kiphiat tu a, mithi khua taw na thukimna kiphiat tu hi. Siatna ii hong nawk ciang, note hong zothal tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuasia in note sia zing khat zawk zing khat hong suu kikik tu hi. Sun zong zan zong na thuak uh kul tu hi. Topa kung pan hong pai thuthak khat sim in, patauna thak veu hong puak tu hi!"},"20":{"text":"A kikhuathuang tham ngawl lupna tom mama khat tungah lum a, a kicing zo ngawl puanvan no mama khat silhin, mut tu a hanciam, paunak sungah mihing khat pa taw na kibang tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in ama ngamtatna te a lamdang bang ahi hial zong — ama ii vawt tu a ngaisut sia vawt tu in Perazim Mualtung le Gibeon kuam ah ngal a sim bangin sim tu hi. Ama in ama ii a tel hak a nasepna khuang khim tu hi.","ref":"2 Sa 5:20; 1 Khang 14:11; Jos 10:10-12"},"22":{"text":"Keima ii kidop natu kong thupiak sia nuisan heak vun! Na nuisan uh le, na suatak natu uh haksa vaial zaw tu hi. Ngam buppi lalcipsak natu in Vaanglianbelpa Topa ii thukhensat nate ka za zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Kong paunate ngai vun; kong sonte nadon vun.","title":"Pathian ii Ciimna"},"24":{"text":"Lotho pa khat in an ciin natu a kingin ciang in tawlnga ngawl liangin lo laaih thapaai ngawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Khatvei lei laaihin a puua zawkciang ama in taang cite le an namtuisak ankung cite poai hi. Ama in zungtaang le mangtaang te a ngual in tu a, a lo hui sangah ancii dangte tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in a nasep tu zia he hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian in ama hil zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in simit ciite le an namtuisak ankung ciite saat natu in khetbuk ngit khat zangh ngeingawl hi; tua taangin ama in a zaang a pha bek ciangte zangh hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in zungtaangte a lal tu liang dongin, a cil tan viuveu hi ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile antangte a zaantham ngawl tu in leang taw cilna zia ama in he hi."},"29":{"text":"Hi bang ciimna heakna theampo sia Vaanglianbelpa Topa kung pan hong pai ahi hi. Pathian ii ngealnate sia ciimna taw a ngeal hi a, tuate a tawntungin taangtung hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ii biaknatau ahi Jerusalem mama a lal ahi hi! David ii ngiana khuapi sia a lal ahi hi! A an neak poaite le poai khaamnate taw kum khat, kum nii omsak zii po vun,","title":"Jerusalem ii Thuakna"},"2":{"text":"tua zawkciang, “Pathian ii biaknatau” a kici khuapi tungah Pathian in siatna thengsak tu hi. Kaana le tauna om tu a, a khuapi buppi sia chi taw a kituam biaknatau khat bang hi tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Pathian in tua khuapi sia kiim uum in, sim tu in uumci tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem sia leinuai pan pau nuamin a kisaan thithaa khat bang le leivui sung pan hong suak aw theap khat taw kibang tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem awng, nang hong sim ngamdangmite theampo leivui bangin kimut keak tu a, a kiitakhuai ngalkapte sia taangphaw bangin leangkeak tu hi. Muanmawk ngawl het le thakhat thu in,"},"6":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in vanto le zinliing taw nang hong suatak tu hi. Ama in vuipi nguapi le a kuang vazak mei khiak tu a,"},"7":{"text":"tuasia ciang Pathian ii biaknatau khuapi a sim minamte ii ngalkap hon theampo, a ngalhiam le a ngalvanh a vekpi — na theampo — zanin khua ngaisut bang, mangmat khat bangin mang vadi tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem sim tu in a kikhawmtua minamte theampo sia, andu ngilkial in a pukthi dek mihing khat in a mang in an ne a, a khanlaw ciang a ngilva tuan ngawl, ahibuale tuidu dangtaak mihing khat in a mang in tui ne a, a khanlaw ciang a dangko in a thoto taw kibang tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Paisuak vun a, mawmaw in om vun! Paisuak vun a, mittaw in om vun! Sapittui ne ngawl bulin kham vun! Zu mal khat zongh ne ngawlin hoi vatut vun!","title":"A ki awlmawk ngawl Kidop natu Thupiakte"},"10":{"text":"Mutthip natu in Topa in na mut hong suaksak hi. Kamsaangte sia mihingte ii mittang hi tu a, ahihang Pathian in amate mit humcipsak hi.","ref":"Rom 11:8"},"11":{"text":"Kamsaan mukholnate theampo ii a khiakna sia note hong lak ngawl tu hi; a kikhakcip laizial khat taw kibang tu hi. Laisim thei khat kungah paipui in, nang hong sim tu in sawl le te a laizial kikhak cip ahikom kei sim thei bong hong ci tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Laisim thei ngawl khat tungah tua lai pia in hong simsak ta'n ci in sawl le te, ama in kei sim thei bong ci in hong zo kik tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in, “Hi mihingte in kong bia tu uh hi hong ci a, ahihang amate kammalte sia khiakna nei ngawlin, a thinsung in thudang ngaisun hi. Amate biakna sia bangma hi ngawlin, a teptee pak uh mihingte zui tu ngeinate bekma hi lel hi.","ref":"Mt 15:8-9; Mk 7:6-7"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahiciang keima in amate muanmawk khol ngawlin a kiitakhuai tuasiatna, khat zawkciang khat ka tungsak tu a, lamdang ka sasak tu hi. Mihing ciimte a mawmaw suakin, a pilna theampo sia kimanna nei ngawl tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"1 Cor 1:19"},"15":{"text":"A ngealnate Topa tungah a iimcip nuamte, a lal ahi hi! Amate a tup a sawmte vawt ku uh a, kuama in hong mu buan te, hong he buan te ci in ngaisun uh hi.","title":"Maisang atu Lametna"},"16":{"text":"Amate in na theampo lumlet uh hi. Beal seakpa le tungman a koisia thupi zaw ziam? Mihing khat ii a vawt sa na khat in a vawt pa tungah, “Nang in kei nong vawt bua hi,” ahibuale, “Na vawt sia nangma in na he bua hi,” ci thei tu ziam?","ref":"Is 45:9; Rom 9:20"},"17":{"text":"Kam tepteena sungah, khuangei ngawlin taam thukpui sia lo ngam hong suak tu a, tuaciang lo ngam sia taam suak kik tu hi, ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ciang, nangongte in laibu a ngingin a kisim sia za thei tu a, khuazing sungah a om mittawte in, a mit uh hakin khuamu tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Zawngkhal in, a kiniamkhiak mihingte in, Topa ahi, Israel ii a thiangtho Pathian ii a piak lungdamna sia khatvei nga kik tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuasia sia midangte a zawthawk vawtte le Pathian a melsiate ii bona hi tu hi. Mawnei theampo kilalsak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Ngual dang a sonsiate, khialna lian neite, daan piak tu a khaktante le thumaan mihingte tungah thu khaikim in thu a khen thei ngawl natu leilot thusonte sia Pathian in lalsak tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom tu in ngimna pan Abraham a suatak, Israel te ii Pathian Topa in, “Ka mite awng, note hong kimaimawlsak nawn ngawl tu a, maizumna taw na mai uh daang nawn ngawl tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Keima kong piak tu tanote na mu uh ciang, keima sia Israel ii a thiangtho Pathian ka hi hunlam na tel tu uh hi. Zatakna nong pia tu uh a, lamdang sa in launa taw ka mai ah na ding tu uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Mihing mawmawte in thu tel thei tu a, a phuphun mihingte in a kihil tu uh sia lungdam tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in: “Judah ngamukte a lal ahi hi, banghang ziam cile amate in kei hong langpan uh hi. Amate in kei ngealna ahi ngawlte zui in, kei deina langpanin thuciamnate vawt a, mawna khat zawkciang khat vawt thawthua uh hi.","title":"Egypt taw A manh nei ngawl Thuciamna"},"2":{"text":"Amate in kei ngaisutna hong dongh ngawlin huna ngen tu in Egypt ah pai uh hi. Egypt te ii huuk tu a thangai manin, Egypt kumpipa muang uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang kumpipa in amate hu zo ngawl tu a, Egypt te ii huukna in siatna taw tawp tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate ii tongciinte sia Egypt te ii khuapite ahi, Zoan le Hanes theng zo napi,"},"5":{"text":"Judah mite in huna a muanmawk uh bang a pia zo ngawl, a muanhuai ngawl minam khat sia a muan thaak phawphot uh a kisiik tu hi,” ci in son zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Hi thu sia thangsang sennealngam sungah a om nganhingte taw kisai Pathian thupuak ahi hi: “Tongciinte sia tawpite teenna, a nguu nei ngulte le a leang thei ngulpui omna, a lauhuai ngam sungah vak kawkoai uh hi. Amate huna mal khat zongh a pia zo ngawl minam khat a piak tu in a manham letsongte, a kalaoh le a laate tungah suanh uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Egypt te ii a piak huna sia lui thawthong ahi hi. Tua ahikom Egypt sia, ‘Bangma hong law thei ngawl Ngulpui’ ci in min ka phua hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua mihingte bang taw kibang ziam cisia laibu khat sungah at in ci in Pathian in kei hong sawl hi, tua hile mihingte bangza in tatsia ziam ci in tepteena kho khat om tu hi.","title":"Thuni ngawl Mihingte"},"9":{"text":"Amate in Pathian langpan tawntung, leilot tawntungin, Topa hilnate nial tawntung uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in kamsaangte a thim khipkhep natu in sawl uh hi. Amate in, “A maan sia bang ziam ci in ko hong son heak vun. Koma zaak nopte bek hong son tavun. A maan bua zong koma ii om ngei bangin hong omsak tavun."},"11":{"text":"Ka lampi uh hong awn tavun a, hong khak heak vun. Na Israel te ii a thiangtho Pathian ii thu za nuam ngawl khu hi,” ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahizong Israel te ii a thiangtho Pathian in, “Kei kong sonte thusim ngawlin zawthawk tatna le theamna na suang uh hi."},"13":{"text":"No, a maw na hi uh hi. No sia a kektham suk pang saang khat taw kibang nu hi; thakhat thu in puk tu nu hi."},"14":{"text":"Zan niknek ahikom meikhuk sung pan meikam lua tham natu ahizong, tuikuang sung pan tui sua tham natu ahizong a bek lian zongh a om ngawl leibeal khat bangin nang hong kitamhthamsak tu hi” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa Israel te ii a thiangtho Pathian in mihingte tungah, “Hong heak kik tavun a, keima hong muang hiithiat tavun. Tua hile na tha uh hat tu a, ngammuang tu nu hi,” ci hi. Ahihang nong nial uh hi!"},"16":{"text":"Tuasia luangin, siphu tai ngang mama tung to in na ngalte khut sung pan suatak tu na sawm uh hi. Maan nu hi — suatak natu ahile noma sep tu ma hi! Na siphute ngang khop hi ci in ngaisun nu hi, ahihang no hong delte ngang zaw lai tu hi!"},"17":{"text":"Ngalte ngalkap khat na mu uh ciang no, a tulkhat in na taikeak tu uh a, tuaciang ngalte nga in note theampo hong taikeaksak zo tu hi. Mualdawn ah a kiphut laandial mung om liiliai khat simngawl buang, na ngalkap honte sung panin bangma kinusia ngawl tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuabang hi napi note hong hesuak tu in Topa in hong ngak veve hi. Ama sia note tungah hesuakna lak tu in a kinging sa in om hi, banghang ziam cile ama in a tawntungin a maan seam hi. Topa tungah muanna a nei te in mi lungdamte ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"No Jerusalem ah a teang mihingte kap nawn ngawl tu nu hi. Topa sia hesuak thei a, ama tungah huna ngenin na kaa uh ciang ama in hong zo tu hi.","title":"Pathian in A Mihingte Thupha pia tu."},"20":{"text":"Topa in haksatna hunte no hong phulsak zo tu a, ahizong ama mama tua munah note hong hil tu in om tu hi, tua ahiciang note in ama na zon uh kul nawn ngawl tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Lam ziat, ahibuale lam vei ah na pial tha uh le na nungsang pan ama in, “A lampi in hisia hi. Zui in,” hong cina aw na za tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Ngunn taw kizut in khamh taw a kituam, na milimte na la tu uh a, tuaciang ninteak bangin vawkkeak in, “Ka muna ah om heak vun!” ci in na ausan tu uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Anciite na poai po uh ciang po a, khang a an tam na laak natu in Topa in nguazusak tu hi, tuaciang na ngante in a tat natu mun zai nei tu uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Na lo hong thawsak khuitalte le laate in a phabel le a limbel lopate ne tu uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Na ngalte ii kulhte a kilaak ni ciang le a mite a kithalup ni ciang, muallian le mualnote theampo tung panin luitui luang tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tha in nitaan za ma in taang tu a, ni in a taan ngeina sangin a zaa salivei in taang zaw tu hi, ni sali sung nitaanna bup sia ni khat a kingawm taw kibang tu hi. Topa in a mihingte tungah a thuaksak liammate tuamsakin a damsak ciangin hi thu theampo hong piang tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Topa ii vaangletna le minthanna sia a khuala panin kimu thei hi. Mei le meikhu in Topa ii thin uukna lak hi. Ama pau a, a kammalte mei taw kibangin kuang hi.","title":"Pathian in Assyria te Daan pia tu"},"28":{"text":"Tuipawm in na theampo a taikeak bangin a mai ah vui vasak hi. Tua in minamte phialmang in susia ngawpin, amate ii a sia a ngealnate bosak hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahizong Pathian ii mihing, note in, poai thiangtho khaam ni zan a, na vawt uh bangin lungdam in la na sa tu uh hi. Israel te a huu Topa sia Biakinnpi ah a pai uh lai in tamngai aw zui in a paite bangin na lung uh dam tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Topa in ama ii vaangletna aw mihing theampo in zasak tu a, ama ii thin uuk tutna thuak tu hi. Meikuangte, meei puakthamte, ngialtang kiate, a biing a bealin sun bangin nguazuknate om tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Assyria mite in Topa ii aw a zaak uh ciang le a daan piakna a nasia mama sia a thuak uh ciang lau tu uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Topa ii amate ngim a piak kikik ciang, ama mite in khuang le tengtongh aw zui in lungdam tu uh hi. Pathian ama tatak ma in Assyria mite sim tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Nidang pek panin Assyria kumpilianpa kihal natu mei phualpi mun khat kivawt zo hi. Tua mun sia thukin zai a, thing a vum in kiseng hi. Topa ii husan ahi a kipee tan meikuang in tua mei taw tu hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt ngam ah huna ngenin a paite a lal ahi hi! Amate in Egypt te ii ngalkap thahatna — siphute, siphu ngalleangte le ngalkapte suang uh hi. Ahihang amate in Israel mite ii a thiangtho Pathian ahi, Topa suang ngawlin huna zongh ngen ngawl uh hi.","title":"Pathian in Jerusalem Sungsia tu"},"2":{"text":"Topa in a sep sia he hi! Ama in siatna tungsak hi. Ama in mi tatsiate le a panpuite daan ka pia tu ci in a tawn bangin seam hi."},"3":{"text":"Egypt te sia pathiante hi ngawlin — leitung mihing bekma hi. Amate ii siphute in a pianzia tumdang hi ngawl hi. Topa in a dian tak ciang, a thahat ngam topsuk tu a, tuasia ii a hu a thazawm ngam sia zong puk tu hi. Tua te ngeal kilalcipsak khawm tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah, “Tuucingte bang zata in a au hial zongin, amate in tawpi khat sia ama ii a thalupsa nganluang kung pan bengkeak zo ngawl hi; tuasia bangma in, keima, Vaanglianbelpa Topa ii Zion Mual ka kepna pan hong khaktan thei kuama om ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Vacim khat in a bu tung pan a note a cin bangma in keima, Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, Jerusalem sungsia in ka hung tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Pathian in, “Israel mihingte awng, kei tungah nong maw zo uh a, nong langpan zo uh hi. Ahitazong tu in kei kung hong zuan kik tavun!"},"7":{"text":"Ngunn le khamh taw na vawt sa uh ahi mawna a piangsak milim teng note theampo ii na vawkkeak tu uh hun khat hong theng tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Assyria sia ngal sungah kilalcipsak tu hi, ahihang mihingte thahatna taw hi ngawl hi. Assyria te ngal kisimna pan tai tu a, a tangvalte sia sila in kikai tu hi."},"9":{"text":"A kumpilianpa lau in tai tu a, a ngalkap maangte lauthawng mama ahikom ngalsimna in a zak a laandial nusia tu uh hi,” ci hi. Jerusalem khua ah kibia a, sangaw biakpiakna atu a kihal mei ii Topa — tua Topa pau zo hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatvei ciangin thutuumna taw a uk kumpi khat le, thukhaikim thu taw a uk ngam lampuite om tu hi.","title":"A Thutuum Kumpipa"},"2":{"text":"Amate khat simin vui vak ciang le suangval vak ciang belhna le bukna bang hi tu hi. Senneal kongaw ngam sungah luitui luang bang le ngam kolhna munah a om suangpi lian khat ii limh bang hi tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang amate ii mit le bil in mihing cimawte kisapna mu in, za tu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate thintom nawn ngawlin, heakna telthiangna taw diangin, a ci nopte ahi bang tatak son tu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Kuama in mihing mawmaw khat sia zatak huai sa ngawl tu a, mihing tatsia khat sia thumaan kici ngawl tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing mawmaw khat in mawmawt kam veu pau in, a sia vawt tu vive ngaisun hi. A nasep le a kampau in Topa selnona vive hi a, ama in ngilkial dangtaakte an le tui pia ngeingawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngaisutna kicing ngawl pa sia ngilo in, a sia vive vawt hi; leilot thu taw mizawngte suksiat sawmin, a nga tu a kilawmte khaktansak tu sawm hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang a zatak huai mipa in thumaan takin ngamta a, a maanna sangah kho din hi."},"9":{"text":"Thinngimna nei ngawl, a ol no in, a nungta no numeite awng, ka ci bang hong ngai tavun.","title":"Thukhenna le Kipuuaphat kikna"},"10":{"text":"Tu laitakin lungkim tha tu nu hi, ahihang mai ciang tu hunin sapitngate na law tu uh om ngawl tu a, na thin uh kiam tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Thinngimna le nei ngawlin, nuntak ol in na nungta uh hi; ahihang tu in, patau in liing vun! Na puante suutkeak vun a na kawngah puansia lom sawm vun."},"12":{"text":"Khuangai in na awm uh beang vun, banghang ziam cile leiphana lote le sapithuante kilalsak zo a,"},"13":{"text":"lingnguite le lingkungte ka mite ii leitang tungah po zo hi. Mihingte lungdam takin a teenna innte theampo atu le nuntakna a nuam khuapi atu in kap vun."},"14":{"text":"Kumpi inn ngawngawn kinusia tu a, khuapi taisan in kiloai tu hi. Innte le amate a dal kulhte a tawntung lalcip tu hi. Tua mun ah ngam laate vakin tuute an zong tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahizong Pathian in ama thaa khatvei ma hong puak kik tu hi. Leisiate leipha suak kik tu a, lo panin an tam mama piang tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Ngamsung mun theampo ah thumaan thutang le thukhaikim thu om tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihing theampo in a maan sia seam tek tu ahikom, kilemna le ngam muanna om tawntung tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Pathian ii mihingte in thinngimna te taw kipeal in, a innte sia thinnopna le ngam muanna taw kidim tu hi."},"19":{"text":"(Ahihang duisung ah ngial kia in, khuapi sia kicimhthamsak tu hi.)"},"20":{"text":"An ciin natu tui kicing piikpeak in, laate le khuite a tat natu mun theampo muanhuai ahiciang mihing theampo bang zata in lungdam tu uh ziam?"}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ih ngalte a lal ahi hi! Kuama in amate suttol ngawl, leeheak ngawl napi in, amate in ngual ii neisa suttol in leeheak uh hi. Ahihang ngual ii neisa a sutol tu le a leeheak tu hun bo tu a, tuaciang amate mama sia ngual ii sutol le theam thuak tu uh hi.","title":"Hu natu Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Topa awng, kote hong hesuak ta'n. Ka lamet uh sia nangma na hi hi. Ni khat zawk ni khat kote hong khoi ta'n a thinngim hunin, hong hun ta'n."},"3":{"text":"Ko atu ngal na sim ciangin minamte sia ngal kisimna awnging panin taikeak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate ii neisate kizamh tu a ngalvanh mat bangin kilaaksak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa bangza in lian ziam! Ama in na theampo uk hi. Ama in thukhaikim le thutuumna taw Jerusalem dimh tu a,"},"6":{"text":"ngam bup kikhealna om ngawlin khosak tu hi. Ama in a mite sungsia tawntungin, ciimna le heakna pia tu hi. A nei lianbel uh sia Topa a thasiana uh ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngalhangte in hu ngen uh hi. Kilemna omsak tu a hanciam tongciinte nasia takin kap uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Lampi liante lauhuai mama ahikom kuama in tawn ngawl hi. Thuciamnate ciampealin, thukimnate kipaltan hi. A kizakta khat zongh om nawn ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Leitang kinusia cip in a awng thongin om hi. Lebanon ngam duisung ah thingte ngeau zo in, Sharon leipha kuam sia sennealngam bang hi a, Bashan ngam le Carmel mual tungah thingkungte a tee pul uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in minamte tungah, “Tu in kong diang tu hi. Ka vaangletna kong lak tu hi.","title":"in A ngalte Kidop natu Thupia"},"11":{"text":"Na ngealnate kimanna om ngawl a, na nasep theampo luithawthong hi. Ka thaa sia note hong lalcipsak tu meikuang khat bang ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Leikaang nga natu in suang a kihal bangin na zaanvui tu uh a, lingkungte vut suakin a kihaltum bang na hi tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A naina le a khualana ah a om mihingte theampo in ka sep sate za tek tahen a, ka vaangletna hong heaksak tahen,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Zion ah mawnei mihingte lau na taw liing uh hi. Amate in, “Pathian ii thukhenna sia a kuang tawntung mei khat taw kibang hi. Tuabang meikuang sung pan akua suakta zo thong tu ziam?” ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Thumaan son in a maan na seam uh le na suakta zo tu uh hi. Na vaang neina uh sia mizawngte theamna in zangh heak vun a, sumnguk sang heak vun. Mihing thalup a sawmte taw ahizong, a dang a sia vawt theite taw ahizong, kipawl heak vun."},"16":{"text":"Tua hile na ngammuang tu uh hi; a muanhuai kulh sungah om bangin thinmuang lungmuangin na om tu uh hi. Note in anneak tu le tuidawn tu na nei tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"A zai mama ngam khat, et hoi takin a uk kumpipa sia khatvei na mu kik tu uh hi.","title":"Minthanna taw a kidim Maisang"},"18":{"text":"Nidangin na kiitak ngamdangmi shiadongte le thukankute sia thu nung phaw kik khat hi lel tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Na tel thei ngawl uh kam a pau, a kisathei ngamdangmite na mu nawn buatu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ih biakna poaite khaamna khuapi ahi, Zion khua en vun. Jerusalem khua en vun! Teen natu in bang zata in a muanhuai a bitna mun khat ahi ziam? Tua in a khetphinte a kidok ngeingawl, a sawmna khaute a tattan ngeingawl, a kikhiin ngeingawl puanbuk khat taw kibang tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in a vaangletna eite hong lak tu hi. Ngun zaite le lui zaite hui ah ih teang tu hi, ahihang ngal teambawte tuate tungah pai nawn ngawl tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua teambawte tungah a kizangh khaute theampo a luithawthong hi; Teambaw puankhakte kiphal thei ngawl hi! Ih ngalte ii ngalkap honte nei na manpha theampo ih matsak tu a, vanh tam mama tu ahikom peangbaite ngawngawn zongin hawmtel khat tek nga tu uh hi. Topa mama sia ih kumpi hi tu a; ama in eite hong ukin hong sungsia tu hi.","merge":"23"},"24":{"text":"Ih leitang tungah a teang mite kuama in ka ciina hi ci in phun kik ngei nawn ngawl tu a, tuaciang mawna theampo kimaisak tu hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minam theampo te awng, hong pai tavun! Hong kikhawm tavun a hong ngai tavun. Leitung buppi le leitung ah a teang mihingte theampo hi lai ah hong pai in thu ngai hen.","title":"Pathian in A ngalte Daan pia tu"},"2":{"text":"Topa sia minam theampo le a ngalkap honte theampo tungah thin uuk hi. Topa in tuate a lalcip tu in ningkhiin zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate ii luangte kiphum ngawlin, tualai ah a muat a ui in om tu hi; tuaciang mualte chi taw san tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ni, tha le aksite leivui suak tu hi. Van sia laizial bangin kizialin mang vadi in, aksite sia sapitkung, theikung tung pan a teete a pul bangin taak tu hi.","ref":"Mt 24:29; Mk 13:25; Lk 21:26; Tpl 6:13-14"},"5":{"text":"Topa in vantung ah a namsau kinging khol zo a, tu in suksiat tu a see sa Edom mite saat tu hi.","ref":"Is 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Eze 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amo 1:11-12; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"},"6":{"text":"Topa namsau sia amate ii a chi le a thau taw kituam tu a, biakpiakna in a kinei tuu le kealte ii chi le thaute taw kibang tu hi. Topa in hi biakpiakna sia Bozrah khuapi ah pia tu hi; ama in hisia Edom ngam sungah kithalupna lian mama khat suaksak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihingte sia ngamsung khuital le khuital note bangin pukvawk in, leitang sia chisan taw sanin nganthau taw kituam tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu hun sia Topa in Zion a suatak tu le a ngalte a thuk kik tu hun ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Edom ngunte sia kattazasi suak tu a, leitang sia kaan suak tu hi. Ngam buppi sia kattazasi hal bangin kuang tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Sun taw zan taw kuang topin, a khu suak tawntung tu hi. Tua ngam sia khang khat pan khang khat ngam tul suakin, kuama in khualhawin kaantan kik ngeingawl tu hi.","ref":"Tpl 14:11; 19:3"},"11":{"text":"Simbu le va-akte in tua ngam lua tu uh hi. Lei a piansak ma bang keakin tua mun sia Topa in ngamkol suaksak tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Ngam uk tu kumpi om ngawl tu a, lampuite theampo bo siat tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpi innte theampo sung le luphung taw ki uum khuapite sungah lingte le a mulnei lingkungte po in, ngia le simbute tua ii sungah teang tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ngamsate tualai ah taa tu a, doaite khat le khat kisam tu uh hi. Zantaa doai in a tawlngak natu mun zongin tua munah pai tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Simbute in a bu uh tomin, tuui in, a no keu a tua munah khoi in keam tu uh hi. Vaciikte khat zawkciang khat tua munah kikhawm tua tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa ii laibu sungah a nungta ngamsate ii thu zong vun a, bang ci ziam sim vun. Hi ngamsate khat zongh bo ngawl tu a, a kopin om siat tu hi. Tuabang ahi natu in Topa in thupia zo hi; ama mama in ngamsate kaikhawm tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuate leitang a hawmsak tu le tel khat tek a pia tu sia in Topa ahi hi. Amate in tua leitang tungah khang sim khang simin teang tu uh a, a tawntungin tang suak tu uh hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sennealngam lungdam tu a, ngam tawnghtol sungah paakte palh tu hi.","title":"Thianthona Lampi"},"2":{"text":"Sennealngam in lasa in, lungdam in au tu hi; Tuasia in Lebanon mualte bangin et hoi a, Carmel le Sharon lote bangin lei pha tu hi. Mihing theampo in Topa ii a nasiatna, a letna le a vaangletnate mu tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"A toi khutte le tha zawmin a liing vadil khupte a tha khosak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"“Hat vun a lau heak vun! Pathian sia note hong suatak tu le na ngalte uh daan pia tu in hong pai tu hi,” ci in a thinkiamte theampo son vun."},"5":{"text":"Mittawte in khuamu thei tu uh a, nangongte in khuaza tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Peangbaite leangin laam tu uh a, a pau thei ngawlte lungdam in au tu uh hi. Sennealngam sungah luituite luang tu hi;"},"7":{"text":"a kaangh sen sate sia tuili khat suak tu a, lei kona sia ciktui taw kidimh tu hi. Ngiate teen ngeina munah buannawng sung a po lopa le pumpa kungte po tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua munah, “Thianthona ii lampi” a kici lampi lian khat om tu hi. Mawneite kuama in tua lampi tawn nawn ngawl tu hi; tua lampi a tawnte sia a mawmawte zongh lam pial ngawl tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua munah tawpite om ngawl tu a, a kiitakhuai nganhingte in tua lampi kaantan ngawl tu hi. Topa ii suatak sa mihingte in tua lampi tawnin a inn uh ah cia tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in thinnopna taw lasa in, au in lungdamna taw Jerusalem khua theng tu uh hi. Amate heena le khuangaina taw kipeal tawntungin, lungdam top tu uh hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekiah ii Judah kumpi a sep zawk kum sawm le kum li kumin, Assyria kumpilianpa Sennacherib in Judah ngam sungah kulh taw a ki uum khuapi muanhuai theampo simin la hi.","title":"Assyria te in Jerusalem Tawng (2 Kumpite 18:13-27 ; 2 Khangtaanghthu 32:1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Sennacherib kumpipa in ama ii khutnuai ah Hezekiah kumpipa a tum natu sawl tu in ama ii ulianbel pa sia ngalkap honkhat taw Lachish pan Jerusalem ah paisak hi. Tua ulian pa in puantakte nasepna phual omna lampi, tuili tungnung pan tui laakna luamhui ah omna la hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama taw a kimu tu in Judah mite ulian thum; kumpi inn sung sai pa Hilkiah ii tapa Eliakim; kumpi inn sung thuzeakpipa, Shebna; le thu tepteena keam pa, Asaph ii tapa Joah pai uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Assyria ulian pa in, bangbel in Hezekiah kumpipa sia hi zata in kimuangsak ziam ci sia kumpilianpa in he nuam hi ci in amate son hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in, “Ngal sim thiamna le thazaw suanna taangin kammal bek kizangh thei tu in um nu ziam? Assyria te leedo natu in akua in note hong hu tu in muangmaw nu ziam?"},"6":{"text":"Egypt te in hong hu tu hi ci in um nu hi, ahihang tuabangin na muanmawkna sia pumpa kung khat ciangkhut in zak taw kibang tu a — taltan in na khut hong sun tu hi. Egypt kumpipa a suang mihing khat pawpo sia tuabang veu ahi hi,” ci in thudokna nei hi.","ref":"Eze 29:6-7"},"7":{"text":"Assyria ulianpa in hi bangin dongh thua lai hi, “Tua ahibuale note in Topa na Pathian ka suang uh hi nong ci tu uh ziam? Hezekiah in biaknatau mun khat bek ah Pathian na bia tu uh hi ci in Judah le Jerusalem mite tungah thu a son lai in, ama ii suksiatte sia Topa ii munsaang biakinn le biaknataute ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpilianpa min tawin kikhap thukimna khat ih nei tu hi. Siphu tung to tu mihing tam na nga zo na uh le siphu tul nii kong pia tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Note in Assyria ngalkap mang a za nobel khat ngawngawn zongh na dem zo buatu uh hi; tua hi napi Egypt te kung panin leang le siphu ngalkapte hong puak tu na muangmaw lai uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa ii panpuina ngawl taw kei in na ngam uh hong simin lalsak zo tu in hong um nu ziam? Topa mama in na ngam uh simin lalcipsak tu in kei hong sawl hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Eliakim, Shebna, le Joab in ulianpa tungah, “Aramaic kam in hong paupui ta'n. Koma tel khu hi. Hebrew kam taw hong paupui heak in; luphung tungah a om mihingte theampo in hong ngai hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in, “Assyria kumpilianpa in note le na kumpipa tung bek ah hi thute theampo son tu in hong sawl sa nu ziam? Hi ngawl hi, noma taw a kibang ma in amate zun le eak ma a ne tu ahi, luphung tungah a to mihingte tung zongh ah ka son hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaciang ulianpa dingto in Hebrew kam taw au in, “Assyria kumpilianpa ii hong son sia ngai vun."},"14":{"text":"Hezekiah ii na theamsak ngawl natu in ama in note tungah kidop natu in hong son hi. Hezekiah in note hong ngum thei ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa suan le muanin a nei tu in, ama in note zolsak heak vun. Topa in note hong ngum tu a, Assyria ngalkapte ii na khuapi simin a laak natu pan tawlngasak tu ci in ngaisun tha heak vun."},"16":{"text":"Hezekiah ii thu ngai heak vun! Assyria kumpilianpa in khuapi pan pusuakin ama ii khutnuai ah na tum natu in thu hong pia hi. Note theampo na sapitkung tung uh pan sapitngate, na theikung uh pan theingate hong nesak tu a, na tuikhuk uh pan tui hong dawnsak tu hi —"},"17":{"text":"sapittui nei natu in sapitkung om a, anluum vawt natu in an omna, na ngam uh taw a kibang ngam khat ah kumpilianpa ii hong om kik sak mateng tuabangin na om tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in note hong suatak tu ci in ngaisutna taw Hezekiah in note theamsak heak vun. Minam dangte khat pawpo ii pathiante in Assyria kumpilianpa ii khut sung panin amate ngam hun zo na ziam?"},"19":{"text":"Tu in Hamath le Arpad ii pathiante koi sungah om ziam? Sepharvaim ii pathiante koi sungah om ziam? Akua in Samaria hun zo ziam?"},"20":{"text":"Hi ngamte theampo ii pathian khat pawpo in ih kumpilianpa khut sung pan, bang hunin amate ii ngam hun ngei ziam? Tua ahile Topa in Jerusalem hun thei hi ci in a bang in hong ngaisunsak ziam?” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Hezekiah Kumpipa ii sonkhol bangma in amate thim khipkhepin om hi; kam khat zongh huthe ngawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaciang Eliakim, Shebna, le Joah khuangai in a puante balkeak in Assyria ulianpa ii ci teng kumpipa kungah pai in ko uh hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekiah Kumpipa sia amate ii thupuakte a zaak pawpo ciang khuangai in a puan balkeak a, khau-ip puan silhin Topa Biakinnpi zuan hi.","title":"Kumpipa in Isaiah ii Ngaisutna Dongh (2 Kumpite 19:1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in kumpi inn sung ukpa Eliakim, zumsung thuzeakpipa Shebna, le thiampi khanghaamte sia Amoz ii tapa kamsaang Isaiah kungah puak hi. Amate zongh in khau-ip puan silh uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi thu sia Isaiah tungah a son tu kumpipa ii thupuak hi a: “Tuni sia ngim thuak ni khat ahi hi; daan ih kha a ih maimawl hi. Eite sia numei khat nau suak tu kithoai zo napi, a tha zawm lei hu in a suak zo ngawl taw ih kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"Assyria kumpilianpa in a ulianbel pa sia a nungta Pathian nunau tu in paisak zo hi. Hi bang nunaunate Topa na Pathian in za tahen a, nunauna kampaute daan pia tahen. Tua ahiciang a nungta lai ih mite atu in Pathian tungah thungen vun,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Isaiah in Hezekiah kumpipa tung pan thupuak sia a nga ciang,"},"6":{"text":"hi bangin zo kik hi: “ Topa in note hong hun zo ngawl tu hi ci a, Assyria te ii hong son hangin na patau ngawl natu uh in Topa in note hong son hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua kumpilianpa sia a ngam ah a cia kik natu in Topa in kamleang khat zasak tu a, tua zawkciang Topa in tua munah ama kithatlumsak tu hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Assyria kumpilianpa sia Lachish khua pan ding zo a, Libnah khuapi naina ah ngalsimin a omna thu Assyria ulianpa in za hi; tua ahikom ama ii tungah thu dongh tu in tua munah ama pai hi.","title":"Assyria te in Tawng kik (2 Kumpite 19:8-19)"},"9":{"text":"Ethiopia kumpipa Tirhakah in Egypt ngalkapte lampui in Assyria te sim tu in hong kuanna thu sia Assyria te in za zo hi. Kumpilianpa in hi thu a zaak ciang, Judah kumpipa Hezekiah tungah lai khat thaak a,"},"10":{"text":"“Na muan uh pathian in note sia ka khut sung theng ngawl tu hi ci in note hong son zo hi, ahitazong tua thu in note theamsak heak vun."},"11":{"text":"Assyria kumpilianpa in lalsak tu in, a khensat sa ngam khat pawpo a vawtna thu sia na za zo uh hi. Suakta zo tu in ki um nu ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Ka taanghpupite in Gozan, Haran le Rezeph khuapite lalcipsakin, Telassar ah a teang Betheden mite thatlum hi, amate ii pathiante khat zongh in amate hun zo ngawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena le Ivvah khuapite ii kumpite koi sungah om ziam?” ci in at hi."},"14":{"text":"Hezekiah kumpipa in kamtaite tung pan laithak sia saangin sim hi. Tua zawkciang Biakinnpi ah pai in Topa mai ah tua laithak koi in,"},"15":{"text":"a thungetna ah"},"16":{"text":"“Cherubim tungah a to, Vaanglianbelpa Topa Israel ii Pathian awng, nangma bekma Pathian hi a, leitung kumpi ngam theampo na uk hi. Nangma in lei le van na bitphua hi.","ref":"Pu 25:22"},"17":{"text":"Tu in Topa awng, hong ngai ta'n a, kote tungah hong piang thute hong en ta'n. A nungta Pathian ahi nang tungah Sennacherib papau in hong nunauna thute theampo ngai in."},"18":{"text":"Topa awng, Assyria kumpiliante in minam tam mama susia in, a ngam uh siasak a,"},"19":{"text":"a pathiante — tuate sia pathian tatak hi ngawl het a, khut taw a vawttawm thing le suang po ii limte bek ahi a pathiante a haltumsak sia ka he siat uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tu in Topa kote Pathian awng, nangma bek Topa na hina thu, leitung ngam theampo in a heak natu in, Assyria te khut sung panin kote hong suatak ta'n,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaciang kumpipa ii thungetna, Topa ii a zona thu teng sia Isaiah in Hezekiah kumpipa kungah thupuaksak hi.","title":"Kumpipa tungah Isaiah ii Thupuak (2 Kum 19:20-37)"},"22":{"text":"Topa in, “Sennacherib awng, Jerusalem khuapi in nang hong nuisan in hong nomu hi."},"23":{"text":"Na selno a na nunau sia akua hi tu na um ziam? Keima Israel te ii a thiangtho Pathian hong melsia na hi hi."},"24":{"text":"Na siphu ngalleang theampo taw Lebanon mualsaangbel sia na zawna thu, kei tungah a kisuangtaak tu in na naseamte nong puak hi. Nangma in a saangbel cedar thingkung le a hoibel cypress thingkungte tua munah phuktan in, ngam thuk belnate dong na thetna sia kisuantaak na in nong nei hi."},"25":{"text":"Ngamdang ah tuikhuk to in tui na neak theina le na ngalkapte in a peangte taw tuanhin Nile ngun a kosak sia na kiphatsak pui hi."},"26":{"text":"“Taanghlai pek pan hite theampo ka ngeal sa ahi hunlam za ngeingawl ni ziam? Tuasia, tu in ka zomto zo hi. Kulh taw ki uum khuapi muanhuaite sia niinthukte na suasak natu in thahatna kong pia hi."},"27":{"text":"Tualai ah a teang mite sia thahatna nei ngawl a; lau in lungmang uh hi. Amate in lo sungah lopate bang, ahibuale innkhum tungah a po lopate, nisuana sang pan vuisate ii seamkeak bang ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"“Ahitazong na thu theampo, bang vawtin, a koisung teng pai cisia ka he siat hi. Ka tungah na thin uukna ka he hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua na thin uukna thu le na kiphatsakna thu he siat zo ka hikom tu in na naak ah thikkoai khat kong thua tu a, na kam ah kamkhau thua in, nong paina lampi zui in kong cia kiksak tu hi,” ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaciang, Isaiah in Hezekiah kumpipa tungah, “Hi thu in maisang hong piang tu lakna lim ahi hi. Tu kum le mai kum ciangin ngamh an bek na ne tu uh hi; ahizong kum kik ciangin thaicii tu in an na la tu uh a, sapitkung suanin a nga na ne tu uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Judah minam sung pan a suakta mite sia khangto in, lei thukna ah zung tha in nga a nga thingno kungte bang hi tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Jerusalem khua sung le Zion Mual tungah a suakta mihing om tu hi, banghang ziam cile Vaanglianbelpa Topa in hi bang piangsak tu in khensat zo hi."},"33":{"text":"“Tuaciang hi thu sia Assyria kumpilianpa taw kisai Topa ii sonsa ahi hi: ‘Ama in hi khuapi sung tum ngawl tu a, thaltang khat taw zong kap ngawl tu hi. Lum toai ngalkapte kuama khuapi nai ah pai ngawl tu a, a kiim ah ngalnan natu kulh kivawt ngawl tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama sia hi khuapi sungah tum ngawlin, hong paina lampi ma zui in cia kik tu hi. Keima Topa pau zo khi hi."},"35":{"text":"Ka minthan natu le ka naseampa David tungah ka kamciam hu in hi khuapi hungin ka dal tu hi,’ ci hi,” ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Topa ii vantunglalang khat Assyria te ngiaphual ah pai in ngalkap 185,000 thatlum hi. A zing ciang zingsang khuavak tuungin tua munah amate a thi siatsa in kisial hi!"},"37":{"text":"Tuaciang Assyria kumpilianpa Sennacherib sia nungkin in Nineveh ah heak kik hi."},"38":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Sennacherib in a biakinn sungah a pathian Nisroch bia in a om laitak, a tate sung pan nii ahi, Adrammelech le Sharezer te in amate ii namsaute taw a pa thatlum in, tua zawkciang Ararat ngam ah ngelin suakta uh hi. A tate sung pan a dang khat ahi Esarhaddon in a kumpilian za lua hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi hunin Hezekiah Kumpipa a ciina in thi dektak hi. Amoz ii tapa, kamsaang pa Isaiah in ve a, ama tungah, “ Topa in a kul theampo vawt siat hen, banghang ziam cile dam kik ngawl tu hi hong ci hi. Tua ahiciang a thi tu in kinging in,” ci hi.","title":"Hezekiah Kumpipa ii Natna le Dam kikna (2 Kumpite 20:1-11,2 Khangtaanghthu 32:24-26)"},"2":{"text":"Tuaciang Hezekiah sia pang sang nga in hi bangin thungen hi:"},"3":{"text":"“Nangma tungah thumaan tak muanhuai takin na na ka sepnate le sepsak tu nong dei bangin a tawntung hanciam in ka nasepnate hong phawk ta'n, Topa awng,” ci hi. Tuaciang ama sia nasia tak kap tu in kipan hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaciang, Topa in Isaiah tungah hi bangin thupia hi."},"5":{"text":"Hezekiah kungah pai kik in a, ama tungah, “Na taanghpupi David ii Topa Pathian ahi, Keima in, na thungetna ka za zo a, na thituite ka mu zo hi; na nuntakna kum sawm le kum nga kong khangkhan tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Assyria kumpipa khut sung pan nangma le Jerusalem khuapi kong suatak tu a, hi khuapi ka sungsia suak tu hi,” ci in son in."},"7":{"text":"Isaiah in, “ Topa in hong kamciam a peal ngawlna lim nang tungah hong lak tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahaz Kumpipa ii a vawt keallei tungah, Topa in a limh nungsangah kal sawm heak kiksak tu hi,” ci in zo kik hi. Tuaciang a limh kal sawm heak kik hi."},"9":{"text":"Hezekiah a natna pan a dam kik zawkciang, hi pokna la at hi;"},"10":{"text":"Ka khan kimlaitakin mithi khua zuan tu hi thong tang a, Huaikut teakkut in nungta ngawl tu hi tang a, ci in ka ngaisun hi."},"11":{"text":"A nungtate omna hi leitung ah Topa mu ngei nawn ngawlin, A nungta mi kuama mu nawn ngawl tu hi tangh a ci in ka ngaisun hi."},"12":{"text":"Puanbuk khat a kiphelthap bang, thiambu pan puan a ki attan bangin, ka nuntakna hong ki attan a, hong kibosak hi. Pathian in ka nuntakna hong bosak hi ci in ka ngaisun hi."},"13":{"text":"Tawpi in ka ngute hong thiatansak bang keakin zankhuateak na sa in ka au hi. Pathian in ka nuntakna hong bosak hi ci in ka ngaisun hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka aw theapin nging zo ngawl a, vakhu bangin ka kuul hi. Vantung ka etna in ka mit toi hi. Topa awng, hi ngimna theampo pan hong suatak ta'n."},"15":{"text":"Hi thu sia Topa vawt sa hi a, kei in bang ka ci thei thong tu ziam? Ka thinngim lei in, ka mu thei bua hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa awng, nang atu, nang atu bekma in ka nungta tu hi; Ka cii hong damsakin, hong nungtasak ta'n."},"17":{"text":"Ka thinngimna sia thinnopna suak tu hi. Lauhuaina theampo pan ka nuntakna nong ngum hi; ka khialna theampo nong maisak hi."},"18":{"text":"Mithi khua ah a om mite kuama in nang hong pok thei ngawlin, mithite in nang ii thumaanna hong muang thei ngawl uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu laitakin nang kong pok uh bangin, nang hong pokte sia a nungta laite ahi hi. Pate in a tate tungah na thumaan nate son uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa awng, kei nong damsak zo hi. Tumtheite tumin nang pokna la ka sa tu uh hi. Ka nuntak lai uh tengin, na Biakinn sungah pokna la ka sa tu uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Isaiah in kumpipa tungah na meima sia thei naai noai lete dam kik tu ni hi ci in son hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaciang Hezekiah Kumpipa in, “Biakinn ah ka pai zawk natu bang lim in hong lak tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi hun sungin Baladan ii tapa, Babylon kumpipa ahi Merodach Baladan in Hezekiah kumpipa cii natna thu za ahikom lai khat le letsong khat thaak hi.","title":"Babylon pan Kamtaite (2 Kumpite 20:12-19)"},"2":{"text":"Hezekiah in kamtaite pha takin vaidawn a, a hau nate — a ngunn le a khamh, a hel namtui te le a paaknamtui te banah a ngalvanh theampo lak hi. A vanh kholna inndoite ah vanhte ahizong, a ngamsung theampo ah a om vanhte ahizong a lak ngawl khat zongh om ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang kamsaang Isaiah sia Hezekiah kumpipa kungah pai in, “Hi mite koisung pan hong pai a, nang tungah bang hong ci ziam” ci in dongh hi. Hezekiah in, “Amate sia a khuala mama na ngam Babylon pan hong pai ahi uh hi,” ci in zo hi."},"4":{"text":"“Amate in kumpi inn sungah bang teng mu ziam?” “Na theampo mu uh hi. Vanh kholna inndoite ah amate ka lak ngawl bangma om nawn ngawl hi,” ci in Hezekiah in zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaciang Isaiah in kumpipa tungah, “Vaanglianbelpa Topa in,"},"6":{"text":"na kumpi inn sungah a om, na taanghpupite ii tu ni dong a kholsa vanh theampo Babylon khua ah a kipuak tu hun khat hong theng tu hi. Bangma taang ngawl tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma sung pan a piang na suan na paalte pawlkhat sia kipaipui tu a, Babylon kumpipa inn sungah numei uk seam tu in a cil kinget tu hi,” ci in son hi.","ref":"Dan 1:1-7; 2 Kum 24:10-16; 2 Khang 36:10"},"8":{"text":"Hezekiah kumpipa in ama ii nuntak sung tengin thinnopna le ngammuanna om tu hi, a cinopna ahi hunlam tel ahikom, “ Topa kung pan hong pai nong thupuak sia pha hi,” ci in zo kik hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ih Pathian in, “Ka mite heeneam vun” ci hi. “Amate heeneam vun!","title":"Lametna Kammalte"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem mite hanthawn vun. Amate in ngei hialma thuak zo a, tu in a mawna teng kimaisak zo hi ci in son vun. A mawna theampo atu a kicingin amate daan ka pia zo hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Aw khat in, “Ngam tawnghtol sungah Topa atu in lampi khat vawtkhol vun! Ih Pathian atu in sennealngam sungah lam sial vun!","ref":"Mt 3:3; Mk 1:3; Jn 1:23"},"4":{"text":"Munkuam theampo dimh vun; mualpi theampo maaitamsak vun. Mualnote zaangtam suak tu a, a hamna mun kinealsak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa minthanna kilangh tu a, minam bup in mu tu uh hi. Topa ama mama in hi thu kamciam zo hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Lk 3:4-6"},"6":{"text":"Aw khat hong ngingin, “Thu khat thangsak in!” hong ci hi. “Bang thu thangsak tu khi ziam” ci in ka dongh hi. “Mihing theampo sia lopa taw kibang a; ngam sungah a om paakte sangin khuangei nungta zaw tuan ngawl ahi sia thangsak in.","ref":"Jas 1:10-11; 1 Pe 1:24-25"},"7":{"text":"Topa in tuate vui in a seamsak ciang lopate kongaw in paakte vul hi. Mihingte sia lopate sangin thuak zo zaw tuan ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Hi hi, lopate kongaw in paakte vul a, ahihang ih Pathian ii kammal sia a tawntung kip hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jerusalem awng, mualsaang khat tungah kaato in lungdamna thupha thangsak in! Zion awng, nging takin au keakin, lungdamna thupha taangko in! Lau ngawlin son khe in. A Pathian uh hong pai tu hi ci in Judah khuate tungah son vun!"},"10":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa sia vaangletna taw uk tu in hong pai a, ama ii a suatak sa mite hong tonpui tu hi.","ref":"Is 62:11; Tpl 22:12"},"11":{"text":"Tuucing pa khat taw kibangin ama in a tuuhon keamcing tu hi; ama in tuunote kaikhawmin a baan ah toai a, tuate ii puite dam takin paipui tu hi.","ref":"Eze 34:15; Jn 10:11"},"12":{"text":"Akua in khutkuak dim taw tuipi tee thei tu ziam, ahibuale a khutte taw vantung tee thei tu ziam? Akua in hai khat sungah leitung leitang heang thei tu ziam? tua ahibuale akua in mualliante le mualnote toai tee thei tu ziam?","title":"Teengat thei ngawl, Israel ii Pathian"},"13":{"text":"Bang vawt tu ci sia Topa tungah akua in son thei tu ziam? Akua in ama hil thei tu ahibuale ngaisutna pia thei tu ziam?","ref":"Rom 11:34; 1 Cor 2:16"},"14":{"text":"Nate bangbangin vawt tuak hi ci a, heak natu le tel natu in Pathian in akua dongh ziam?"},"15":{"text":"Topa atu in minamte sia bangma hi ngawlin, tuimal khat bang zongh hi ngawl hi; a khuala na ah a om tuikulhte sia leivui bangin zaang hi."},"16":{"text":"Lebanon ngam duisung ah a om nganhing theampo sia ih Pathian biakpiak natu in kicing zo ngawl a, a thingkungte zongh biakpiakna meihal natu in tawm lei hi."},"17":{"text":"Minamte theampo sia ama atu in bangma tham hi ngawl het hi."},"18":{"text":"Pathian sia akua taw kitee ngat thei tu ziam? Ama sia bang taw kibang hi ci in bangbang na son thei tu uh ziam?"},"19":{"text":"Ama sia thikseakte khutthiamte ii vawt, ngunn huanna sungah a sun suk khamh taw a zut milim taw kibang ngawl hi.","ref":"Sawl 17:29"},"20":{"text":"Ngunn ahibuale khamh taw a vawt zo ngawl pa in a muat ngawl tu thing teal hi. A pukvawk ngawl tu milim khat vawt tu in ama in khutthiamna neipa khat zong hi."},"21":{"text":"He ngawl nu ziam? Nidang pekin note tungah hong kison hi ngawl ka na ziam? Leitung sia bangbangin kipan cisia za ngeingawl nu ziam?"},"22":{"text":"Tuasia in van kalh ah a om leitung ii tungsia ama kumpi tokhum tungah a to pa ii vawt sa ahi hi; a nuai ah om mite sia mitsa nocik bang ahi hi. Puan dalna khat a kikhak bang le a sungah teen natu in puanbuk khat a kiphal bangin Ama in van a phalh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in a thahat ngamukte khiasukin bangma ngawl suaksak hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate sia a kung moino, a po tuung, a zung kho ngawl laite taw kibang hi. Topa in vui a vaksak ciang tuate kongaw in taangphaw bangin lenkeak hi."},"25":{"text":"A thiangtho Pathian sia akua taw kitee ngat thei tu ziam? Ama taw a kibang akua dang om ziam?"},"26":{"text":"Van ento in! Na mu aksite akua in bitphua ziam? Ngalkap honkhat lampui bangin, aksite lam a puipa in aksite a phakza he a, khat simin a min taw sam hi! Ama vaanglian mama a — amate khat zongh peuhe ngeingawl hi!"},"27":{"text":"Tua ahile Israel te awng, ngimna na thuak uhte Topa in hong heaksak ngawl hi ahibuale thukhaikim om ngawlin na thuak uh ciang Topa in hong awlmawk ngawl hi ci in banghangin phun nu ziam"},"28":{"text":"He ngawl nu ziam? Za zo hi ngawl nu ziam? Topa sia tawntung Pathian ahi hi; ama in leitung theampo bitphua hi. Ama sia toi ngeingawl a, ngim ngeingawl hi. Ama ii ngaisutnate kuama in tel ngawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in a thazawmte le a toite thahatsak hi."},"30":{"text":"Khangmoite ngawngawn a tha uh kiam hi; tangvalte a tha uh bo in puk thei hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahihang a hu tu in Topa a muangte in a tha uh thathak a dim kik sia mu tu uh hi. Amate muvanlaite bangin a tha uh taw leangto tu hi; amate a tai hangin toi ngawl tu uh hi; lam a pai uh hangin a thazawm ngawl tu uh hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in, “A khuala ah a om ngamte awng, thimdide in om vun a ka thu hong ngai tavun! Zum ah na thu sung tu in kinging vun; thu son thei natu hun nga tu nu hi. Akua thumaan ziam ci in khensat tu in paikhawm tek tawng.","title":"Israel tungah Pathian ii Telsakna"},"2":{"text":"“Nisuana sang panin ngalzo pa hong paipui in, a paina theampo ah ngal a zosak sia akua ziam? Akua in kumpite le minamte tungah ama zawna pia ziam? Amate sia leivui bang keakin ama ii namsau in saatsuk hi. Taangphaw sia vui ii letkeak bangin a thaltangte in amate thethaang hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in ngammuang takin a nung pan zui in a del ciang, a peang in lei thutha man ngawl tu za in manlang hi!"},"4":{"text":"Hi bangin, a piangsak sia akua ziam? A kua in taanghthu suak tu in piangsak ziam? Tua munah a kipatciil pan kipan keima Topa ka om a, keima Topa sia a khakbel dongin tua munah ka om tu hi."},"5":{"text":"“A khuala ngammite in ka sep sate mu zo hi; amate lau in kiitakna taw liing uh hi. Tua ahikom amate a vekpi kikhawmin hong pai uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Khutthiamte sia khat le khat kihu in kihanthawn uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Lettama pa in khamh seakpa tungah ‘Pha mama hi!’ ci hi. Milim a nealin a zeam pa in thikpim taw a kilh pa hanthawn hi. Amate in, ‘A kipeena pha hi’ ci uh hi — tuaciang amate in milim sia a koina munah kho takin kilh uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Ahihang nang, ka naseampa Israel awng, kong tealsa mi na hi a, ka lawmpa Abraham ii suan le paalte na hi hi.","ref":"2 Khang 20:7; Jas 2:23"},"9":{"text":"Leimongte panin nang kong paipui hi; a khualabel a kingte panin kong sam a, ‘Nang sia ka naseampa ni hi’ kong ci hi. Kei in nang kong nial bua a, nang kong teal hi."},"10":{"text":"Lau heak in — nang kong ompui hi! Keima in na Pathian ka hi hi — bangma lau heak in! Kong thahatsak tu a, kong hu tu hi; kong dal tu a, kong ngum tu hi."},"11":{"text":"“Nang tungah hong thin uukte sia ngallel maizumna he tu uh hi. Nang hong sim mite thi tu a,"},"12":{"text":"leitung panin mang vadi tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima in na Topa Pathian ka hi hi; nang kong thahatsak a, ‘Lau heak in; hong hu tu khi hi’ ci in kong son hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel awng, note in mi cii tawmte le a thazawmte na hi uh hi. lau heak vun; hong hu tu khi hi. Keima, Israel ii a thiangtho Pathian sia nang hong ngumpa ka hi hi."},"15":{"text":"A hiam, ha thak a nei ancilna bangin kong vawt tu hi. Note in mualpite cilin na susia tu uh hi; mualnote leivui suak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate sia vui sungah na lawn tu uh hi; vui va in amate len a, vuipi in amate thethaang tu uh hi. Tuasia ciang keima in na Pathian ka hi hu in na lungdam tu uh hi; Israel ii a thiangtho Pathian ahi keima nong pok tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"“Ka mite tui kisamh in tui a zon uh ciang, tuidu in a dang a ko ciang, Topa , keima in amate thungetna ka zo tu hi; Israel te ii Pathian, keima in amate ka nusia ngei buatu hi."},"18":{"text":"Mualkolte kawm ah ngunte ka luangsak tu a, mun kuamte sungah ciktui ka luangsak tu hi. Sennealngam sia tuilite ka suaksak tu a, leiko na mun sia ciktui luangte ka suaksak tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Sennealngam ah cedar kungte, acacia, myrtle le olive kungte ka posak tu hi. Ngamkolna ah taakthingte, juniper thing le cypress thingte po in dui hong suak tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Hi teng mite in mu in Topa, keima in hi nate vawt zo hi ci sia he tu uh hi. Israel te ii a thiangtho Pathian in hite a piansakna thu sia amate in he tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel te ii kumpi ahi, Topa in hite son tu nei hi: “No, minamte ii pathiante awng, na thu uh hong sung tavun. Na nial natu a phabel thute hong paipui tavun!","title":"ii Pathian Maan ngawlte a Thatona"},"22":{"text":"Hi sungah hong pai tavun a, bang piang tu ziam hong sonkhol tavun, tua hile tuasia hong pian ciang ih he tu hi. A piang sa thute zum ah thiang son vun a, tuate ii cinopna hong son tavun."},"23":{"text":"Mai sangah bang thu hong piang tu ci sia hong son tavun — tuaciang note sia pathiante na hi hunlam kong he thei tu uh hi! Thupha pawlkhat vawt vun, ahibuale siatna pawlkhat tungsak vun; launa le lamdangsakna taw hong kidimsak tavun!"},"24":{"text":"Noma le na vawtte theampo bangma hi ngawl hi; no hong biate kiihuai hi!"},"25":{"text":"“Nisuana sangah a teang mihing khat ka teal zo hi; saksang pan a sim tu in ama ka puak tu hi. Beal seakpa khat in tungman a totcil bangin, ama in ngamukte sia buan bangin tuanhcil tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Maan tatak nu hi kong ci thei natu in hi thu piang tu hi ci in akua in sonkhol nu ziam? Amate inn ah hong cia uh hi!’ ci thu a son tu in Jerusalem ah kamtai khat ka paisak hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua pathiante sung ka et ciang, son tu a nei kuama om ngawl hi; ka thudokte khat zongh in hong zo thei ngawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Hi pathiante theampo sia a luithawthong ahi hi; amate in bangma vawt thei vet ngawl hi — hi milimte sia thazawmin vaang nei ngawl hi.”"}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in, “A tha ka hatsak ka naseampa sia hi sungah om hi — ama sia ka teal pa hi a, ka lungkim hi. Ama in mihing theampo tungah a kip thukhaikim thengsak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in lametna bo ngawlin thin kiam ngawl tu hi; leitung ah thukhaikimna piangsak tu hi. A khuala ngamte in ama ii thuhilna ngakla uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 12:18-21"},"5":{"text":"Pathian in vantungte bitphua in, phalhkeak hi; ama in leitung le leitung ah a teangte theampo vawt hi; leitung mite theampo tungah nuntakna le husanna pia hi. Tuaciang tu in, Topa Pathian in a naseampa tungah,","ref":"Sawl 17:24-25"},"6":{"text":"“ Topa, keima in, leitung ah thukhaikimin a kiseam ziam ci thu en tu in, nangma kong sam a, vaangletna kong pia zo hi. Pathian dang khat tungah ka vaangletna kihawm ngawl tu hi; kei hong kipoknate sia milimte ka hawm buatu hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu in ka sonkhol thute taangtung tu hi. Tu in a piang ngawl lai thu thakte hong pian ma ngawngawn in, kong son tu hi.” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa tungah la thak khat sa vun; leitung theampo awng, ama pokna lasa vun! A nai in en vun, no mittawte awng!","title":"Israel te ii Thuheak Laakna"},"19":{"text":"Ka naseampa sang khuamu ngawl zaw khat po, kamtai in ka sawlpa sangin nangong zaw khat po a om ziam?"},"20":{"text":"Israel awng, nang in tam mama na mu zo hi, ahihang nang atu in bang khiakna nei ziam? Na khuazaak natu in bil na nei hi, ahihang bang tatak na za ziam?” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa sia hong ngup tu a ngakla Pathian hi a, tua ahikom a thukhamte le a hilnate thupisak hi, tuaciang ama in tuate a mite ii zatak tu dei hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang tu in a mite kisuttol zo hi; leinuai thong ah kikalhcipin thong sungah kiseal hi. Amate ii vanhte kiphuulin kisuttol a, amate suatak tu in kuama hong pai ngawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Note sung pan akua in hi thu ngai tu nu ziam? Tu pan kipan pha takin, na ngai tu uh ziam?"},"24":{"text":"A suttolte tungah Israel te a pia sia akua ziam? Eite ii a tungah ih maw, Topa ma ahi hi! Ama ii dei le oai bangin ih nungta bua a, ama ii hong hilnate bang ih mang bua hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahiciang ama ii thin uuk tut nate eite hong thuaksakin, ngal ii daan hong thuaksak hi. Nangma kong suataksak natu in Egypt ka suplaw tu a; Ethiopia le Seba ka suplaw tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Na nuntakna ngum tu in minamte theampo ka suplaw tu hi, banghang ziam cile nang sia kei atu in na manpha a, nang kong it a kong upat hi."},"5":{"text":"Lau heakin — nangma hong ompui khi hi! “Ni suana a khualana pan le nitumna sang a khuala belna panin, na mite inn ah kong ciapui tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Saksangte tungah amate paisak vun ka ci tu a; thangsang te tungah amate khaktan heak vun ka ci tu hi. Ngam khuala na pan le leitung mun theampo panin ka mite heak kik tahen."},"7":{"text":"Amate sia keima mite hi a, keima hong minthangsak tu in ka bitphua ahi hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Pathian in, “Ka mite zum ah sam vun. Amate pukin tho kik nawn ngawl a, meivak kuang muutmit bang ahi hi!"},"18":{"text":"Ahizong Topa in, “Nungsang thute len heak vun a, taanghlai a piang thute thupi in ngaisun heak vun."},"19":{"text":"A thak na khat ka vawt tu sia en vun. Ahihang na mawnate taw kei tungah vanhngit nong suan zaw pumsai a; khialna na vawtnate taw in ka thin nong ngimsak hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahitazong, na mawna hong maisak sia Pathian keima hi a, keima ka hikom hi bangin ka vawt hi. Nangma in a maan na hina thu lak tu in na thu sung in!"},"27":{"text":"Na taanghpupi masa belpa uh maw hi; na lampuite ka tungah hong khial hi,"},"28":{"text":"no hong ukte in ka inn thiangtho sia ninsak uh hi. Ama inn sungah a koi tu in, ama in leikaang taw lim khat suai in, ama na zakte taw khuakin, a mealpha mihing lim khat vawt hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in a zak tu in cedar thingkungte phuk tu hi, tua ahibuale oak thingkung ahizong cypress thing ahizong duisung panin teal tu hi. Hi munah thingtawng khat ii mai ah ka kunsuk hi!” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama sia vut ne te taw kibang lel hi. Ama ii mawmawt ngaisut nate in lamkhialsak zo a ama sia kihu zo nawn ngawl hi. Jerusalem ah mite teang kik tu hi ci in Jerusalem tungah ka son a, Judah ngam khuapite kisa kik tu hi ci in Judah ngam khuapite ka son hi. Tua khuapite sia a siatcipnate sung pan tho to tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Thupiakna kam khat taw tuipi ka kangcipsak hi."},"28":{"text":"Keima in Cyrus tungah, ‘Nangma in keima luangin a uk tu pa na hi hi; Keima dei bangin na seam tu hi: Jerusalem khua a kisak kik natu le Biakinnpi tawdapphate a kipha natu in thu na pia tu hi,’ ka ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2 Khang 36:23; Ezra 1:2"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Cyrus sia kumpi tu in teal zo hi! Cyrus tungah Topa in,","title":"in Cyrus Nasep pia"},"2":{"text":"“Keima in muallian mualnote tamkimsakin, na lampi ka puua tu hi. keima in taau kongpite thiaktan in a thikzawlte ka saattham tu hi."},"3":{"text":"A zingna munah, a thimtham munah a kiphual sumngumte nang kong pia tu hi; tuasia ciang keima in Topa ka hi hunlam le Israel ii Pathian in na minlo in nang hong sam zo hi cisia na tel tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka tealsa mi ahi Israel ka naseampa hu tu in nang kong sep hi, nang in kei hong he ngawl na hitazong upatna lian kong pia hi."},"5":{"text":"“Keima in Topa ka hi hi; pathian dang om ngawl hi. Topa ahi, keima in hite theampo ka vawt hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in ngalzawna sia ngua bangin van pan ka zusak tu a; a saang tu in lei kihong tu a suatakna le thumaanna taw paak bang hong palh tu hi.
