Amate ii vawt thei tu bangma dang om ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile ka kipaupuina hong za ku kuama om ngawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Jerusalem khua a kilaak ni dong kumpi innhuang sungah kei hong keam hi.","ref":"Eze 33:21"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zedekiah ii Judah kumpi a sua zawk a kum kuana, a tha sawm tha in Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar sia a ngalkap buppi taw hong pai in Jerusalem sim hi.","title":"Jerusalem Khuabona"},"2":{"text":"Zedekiah ii kumpi a sua zawk kum sawm le kum khatna, a tha li tha, ni kua ni in khuapi luphungte kisulet hi."},"3":{"text":"(Jerusalem khuapi a kilaak ciang Babylon kumpipa ii uliante theampo hong pai in Kongpi Laita ah mun hong la uh hi. Tuate sungah Nergal Sarezer, Samgar Nebo, Sarsechim le Nergal Sarezer dangkhat kihel hi.)"},"4":{"text":"Zedekiah kumpipa le a ngalkapte theampo in a piang thu a mu uh ciang zanlai in khuapi pan a suatak natu hanciam uh hi. Amate sia kumpi huan sung lam tawnin luphungte ngeal kikawnna kongpi lam tawnin, Jordan Kuam sangah suakta uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang Babylon ngalkaphonpi in delin Jericho khua nai zaangtam ah Zedekiah man uh hi. Tuasia ciang amate in Zedekiah sia Hamath ngamsung Riblah khua ah a om Nebuchadnezzar kumpipa kungah paipui uh a, tua munah Nebuchadnezzar in ama tungah thukhen hi."},"6":{"text":"Riblah khua ah Nebuchadnezzar kumpipa in Zedekiah ii mu tang ma in a tapate thatlum a, Judah ngam kumpi uliante zongh thatlumsak hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Zedekiah ii mittangte khelsak a, Babylon ah paipui tu in kol bulsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hun sung ma in Babylon te in kumpi inn le mipite ii innte haltum a Jerusalem khua luphungte sutham uh hi."},"9":{"text":"A khakbel in ngalkap hon ukpa, Nebuzaradan in khuapi sungah a taanglai mite sia ama kung a zuan teng taw Babylon ah thongtaak tu in paipui khawm hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in bangma nei ngawl a, a zawngkhalbel mihing pawlkhat sia Judah ngam ah nusia in sapithuante le lote pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang Nebuchadnezzar kumpipa in a nuai a thute a piak natu in ngalkap hon ukpa, Nebuzaradan tungah thupia hi:","title":"Jeremiah ii Suatakna"},"12":{"text":"“Pai in Jeremiah na mu ciang pha takin keam in. Vawtsia heak in, a dei pawpo vawtsak in,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom Nebuzaradan in kumpi uliante Nebushazban le Nergal Sarezer le Babylon kumpipa ii ulian dangte theampo taw"},"14":{"text":"kumpi innhuang sung panin kei hong la uh hi. Amate in Shaphan ii tupa, Ahikam ii tapa Gedaliah kungah, keima inn ah ngam muang takin hong thet natu le pha tak hong kep tu in hong aap uh hi. Tuabangin tua mun ah om mite sungah ka teang hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpi innhuang sungah thong hong kitaaksak lai in, Vaanglianbelpa Topa , Israel ii Pathian in hi bangin a ci teng sia,","title":"Ebedmelech atu Lametna"},"16":{"text":"Ethiopia mi Ebedmelech tungah a son tu in Topa in kei hong sawl hi. “Ka vawt tu hi ka ci bangin hi khuapi tungah nopsakna ahi ngawl siatna ka tungsak tu hi. Hi bangin hong pian ciang a mu tu in tua munah na om tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahihang Keima, Topa in nang kong dal tu a, na kiitak mihingte khut sungah hong ki aap ngawl tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Nang sia kong keamcing tu a, hong kithatlum ngawl tu hi. Kei hong muang na hikom na nuntakna suakta tu hi. Keima, Topa in ka ci zo hi.”"}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngalkap mangpa Nebuzaradan in Ramah khua ah kei hong suatak zawkciang, Topa in kei hong paupui hi. Keima sia kol bul sa in, Babylon ah luangta tu in a kipaipui Jerusalem le Judah pan midangte theampo taw tua mun ah hong kipaipui khawm zo hi.","title":"Gedaliah taw Jeremiah Omkhawm"},"2":{"text":"Ngalkap mangpa in keima hong sam tuam a, “Na Topa Pathian in hi ngam sia suksiat tu in tawng a,"},"3":{"text":"ama in ka vawt tu hi a ci sia tu in vawt zo hi. Na mite in Topa tungah mawna vawtin a thu ni ngawl a hi hu in hite theampo piang hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu in na khut ah a kibul kolte kong suutsak tu a kong thaa tu hi. Keima taw Babylon ah na pai nuam le na pai thei a, nang kong keam tu hi. Ahihang na pai nuam buale pai kul ngawl hi. Hi ngam buppi sungah na uukna mun teal in, na uukna po ah pai thei ni hi,” hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangma zo kik ngawl a ka om ciang, Nebuzaradan in, “Babylon kumpipa ii Judah ngam khuate uk tu in a koi ngamkhen ukpa Shaphan ii tupa, Ahikam ii tapa Gedaliah ii kungah pai kik ta'n. Ama taw om ta'n a, a mite sungah teang thei ni hi, tua ahibuale na pai nopna mun po ah pai thei ni hi,” hong ci hi. Tua zawkciang ama in letsong khat le nguai an hong henin ka pai nopna ah hong paisak hi."},"6":{"text":"Mizpah ah Gedaliah taw om tu in ka pai a, ngam sungah a taanglai mite sungah ka teang hi."},"7":{"text":"Judah ngalkapmang pawlkhatte le ngalkapte sia a ngalte khut sungah tum ngawl uh hi. Babylon kumpipa in Gedaliah sia ngamkhen ukpa tu in koi zo a, Babylon ah a kipaipui ngawl theampo — ngamsung pan a zawngbel mite teng uk tu in a kikoina thu amate in za uh hi.","title":"Judah Ngam Ngamkhen ukpa Gedaliah (2 Kumpite 25:22-24)","ref":"2 Kum 25:22-24"},"8":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Nathaniah ii tapa Ishmael, Kareah ii tapa Johanan, Tanhumeth ii tapa Seraiah, Netophah pan Ephai ii tapate le Maacah pan Jezaniah sia a mite taw Mizpah khua ah a om Gedaliah kungah pai uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Gedaliah in amate tungah, “Babylon te nuai ah na tum tu uh sia lau kul ngawl hi kong ci hi. Hi ngam sungah teangin Babylon kumpipa ii na seam le uhte no atu in pha siat tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Keima mama Mizpah ah ka teang tu a, Babylon te hi munah hong pai ciangin noma taangmi ka hi tu hi. Ahihang sapittui, thingnga le olive sathaute khawmin khol vun a, na laak uh khuate ah teang vun,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuasia hunin Moab ngam, Ammon ngam, Edom ngam le ngamdangte ah a om Israel te theampo in Babylon kumpipa ii Israel te pawlkhat Judah ngam sungah a teen suaksakna thu le Gedaliah sia a ngam khen ukpa in a koina thu za uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi manin, amate sia a kithethaang na ngamte nusia in Judah ngam ah cia kik uh hi. Amate Mizpah khua Gedaliah kungah pai in, tua munah sapittui le thingnga tam mama khawmtua uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Hisia zawkciang a tum nuam ngawl Johanan le ngalkapte ii lampuite sia Mizpah khua Gedaliah kungah pai in,","title":"Gedaliah KiSuamlum (2 Kumpite 25:25-26)"},"14":{"text":"ama tungah, “Ammon kumpipa Baalis in nangma hong suam tu in Ishmael hong paisak sia he ngawl ni ziam?” ci hi. Ahihang Gedaliah in tua thu um ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Johanan in ama tungah, “Keima hong paisak ta'n a Ishmael hong thatsak ta'n, tua hile a that sia pa kuama in he ngawl tu hi. Banghangin ama in nang hong suam thei thong tu ziam? Nang hong kisuam le tua in na kiim ah hong kikhawm Jew mite theampo kithethaangsak tu a, Judah ngam ah a taanglai mite theampo ii tungah tuasiatna thengsak tu hi,” ci ku hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang Gedaliah in, “Tua sia hi heak in! Ishmael thu na son sia maan ngawl hi!” ci in zo hi."}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua kum a tha sali tha in, kumpi innkuan sung pan le kumpipa ii a ulianbelte sung pan khat ahi, Elishama ii tupa, Nethaniah ii tapa Ishmael sia mihing sawm taw Mizpah ah Gedaliah taw kimu tu in pai uh hi. Amate teng an a neakkhop laitakin,","ref":"2 Kum 25:25"},"2":{"text":"Ishmael le tua mihing sawmte in a namsau uh dokin Gedaliah thatlum uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ishmael in Mizpah khua Gedaliah kungah a om Israel mite theampo le Babylon ngalkap tua munah a omte zongh thatlum hi."},"4":{"text":"A zing ciang, Gedaliah a kisuamlupna thu kuama heak ma in"},"5":{"text":"Shechem, Shiloh le Samaria panin mihing sawmliat hong theng uh hi. Amate in Biakinnpi ah piak tu in antang le paaknamtui keng uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom Ishmael sia amate muak tu in Mizpah panin kap kawkawm in pai hi. Amate sia a paina lampi Bethlehem khua hui Chimham ah tawlnga uh hi.","merge":"18"}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ngalkap lampuite theampo, Kareah ii tapa Johanan le Heshaiah ii tapa Azariah le mihonte a lian a no ka kungah hong pai uh a,","title":"Mipite in Amate atu Thungetsak tu in Jeremiah Sawl"},"2":{"text":"“Kong nget uh sia hong vawtsak ta'n! Khatvei lai in mihing tam mama ka hi uh a; tu ahile nangma nong mu bangin mihing tawmno bek ma ka taang lai uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Kote pai natu lampi le ko ii sep tu nate Topa ih Pathian in hong lak natu in thu hong ngetsak ta'n,” hong ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Keima in, “Tua ahile pha mama hi. Nong nget uh bangin Topa ih Pathian tungah thu ka ngen tu a, ama ii hong ci babang kong son tu hi. Bangma kong iim buatu hi,” ci in ka zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuasia ciang amate in keima tungah, “Ko atu a Topa ih Pathian ii hong thupiakte theampo ka ni bua uh le Topa sia ko ii lang ah thumaan le thutak tetti hi tahen."},"6":{"text":"Koma dik ka sa a dik ka sa bua uh zong ama ii tungah thungetsak tu in kong sawl uh Topa, ih Pathian ii thu ka ni tu uh hi. Ama ii thu ka ni uhle ka mai uh vangin pha tu hi,” hong ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ni sawm zawkciang Topa in kei hong paupui hi;","title":"Jeremiah ii Thungetna Zona."},"8":{"text":"tua ahikom keima in Johanan, a ompui ngalkap lampui te theampo le mihing dang teng taw ka sam khawm hi."},"9":{"text":"Keima in amate tungah, “A kungah hesuak ngetna taw nong puak na pa ahi Topa Israel ii Pathian in,"},"10":{"text":"‘Hi ngam ah na teang suak nuam uh le, kong laamto tu a, kong lalsak buatu hi; kong phut tu a, kong phaikeak buatu hi. Noma kong ompui a, ama khut sung panin kong suatak tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima sia a hesuak thei pa ka hi manin, ama in no tungah hesuak theina ka neisak tu a, na inn le lo ah hong ciasak kik tu hi. Keima, Topa in ka son zo hi,’ hong ci hi."},"13":{"text":"“Ahihang Judah ngam sungah a taanglai note in Topa na Pathian na nial buatu uh a, hi ngam ah ten tu na nial peuma buatu uh hi. Noma in, ‘Hi ngawl hi, ngal kido nawn ngawlna, ngalsim tu kithotna aw zaak nawn ngawlna ahibuale ngilkial ngawlna mun ahi, Egypt ngam ah pai in ka teang tu uh hi.’ na ci bua het tu uh hi. Hi bangin na ci uh le Vaanglianbelpa Topa , Israel ii Pathian in, ‘Egypt ah pai in teen tu na tum tatak uh le,","merge":"14"},"16":{"text":"na kiitak uh ngal in no hong pha tu a, na kiitak uh kialpi in hong zui in, tua mun Egypt ah na thi tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt ngam ah tai a, teen tatak tu a sawm mihingte theampo sia ngal ahibuale kialpi ahibuale natna taw thi tu uh hi. Hi mun sia na mu kik ngei nawn buatu uh hi,’ ci hi,” ka ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaciang ka zomto lai a, “ Topa in Judah ngam ah a taang lai note, Egypt ngam ah na pai ngawl natu in hong son zo hi. Noma atu in Topa ih Pathian tungah thungetsak tu in nong sawl uh a, ama ii hong thupiak theampo seam tu in kamciam nong pia uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu in no tungah kong son zo hi, ahihang Topa ih Pathian in hong sonsak theampo na ni bua uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom, hi thu ciamtee vun: noma pai nopna le ten nopna ngam ah ngal ahibuale ngilkialna, ahi buale natna taw in na thi tu uh hi,” ci in ka son hi."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa , amate ii Pathian in amate tungah a vekpi a son tu in hong thataak keima in mipite tungah ka son zo hi.","title":"Egypt ngam ah Jeremiah Kipaipui"},"2":{"text":"Tuaciang Hoshaiah ii tapa Azariah le Kareah ii tapa Johanan le a kisa thei midangte theampo in kei tungah, “Leilot ni hi. Tuasia ciang an hau in, nuamsa in, ngimna ka nei bua uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahihang Vantung Kumpinu tungah sangaw biakpiakna nei nawn ngawl a, biakpiakna sapittui ka buak nawn ngawl uh hun pan kipan bangma ka nei nawn bua uh hi, ka mite sia ngal le kialpi taw in thi uh hi,” hong ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaciang numeite in, “Vantung Kumpinu ii lim taw kibang moh vawt a, biakpiakna pia in sapittui ama tungah ka buak uh ciang koma ngamtatna sia ka pasalte a lungkim uh hi,” ci lai uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ka pauna hi bang a hong zo kik pasalte le numeite theampo ii tungah keima in,"},"21":{"text":"“Noma le no ii taanghpupite, kumpipate le lampuite, ngamsung mipite vawt Judah khuate le Jerusalem khua lampite tungah na biakpiakna uhte Topa in he ngawl ahibuale a mangilin ngaisun nu ziam?"},"22":{"text":"Tuni mama in na ngam uh sia a lalcip sa in om a, a sungah kuama teang ngawl hi. Keima, Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"“Ka mite awng, lau heak vun, Israel mite awng, patau heak vun. Na thongtaakna uh ngam khuala na pan kong suatak tu hi. Keima, Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa in Gaza khua a sim ma in Philistia mite taw kisai in Topa in keima tungah thu hong son hi.","title":"Philistia taw kisai ii Thupuak","ref":"Is 14:29-31; Eze 25:15-17; Jol 3:4-8; Amo 1:6-8; Zep 2:4-7; Zec 9:5-7"},"2":{"text":"Ama in: “En in! Keima, Topa in Crete tuikulh pan a hong pai Philistia te theampo ka susia tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Gaza mite tungah heena lian theng zo a, Ashkelon ii mite dai dide in om uh hi. Kisuksiatna!’ ci in au uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“Moab sia kisusia zo hi; patangte kaana aw ngai vun."},"5":{"text":"Luhith mual kaatona lam tawntung ah amate naangin a kaana awte, Horonaim khuapi paisukna lampi ah ngimin khamin a kaana awte ngai vun."},"6":{"text":"‘Manlang vun, na suatak natu uh in tai vun! Sennealngam a om ngam laate bangin tai vun!’ amate in ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"“Moab awng, na hatna le na hauna na suang hi, ahihang tu in nang ngawngawn hong kizo tu a; na pathian Chemosh sia a kumpi tapate le a thiampite taw saltaang khawm tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Khua khat beak zongh suksiatna pan suakta ngawl tu a; mualkuam le zaangtam zong kisiasak khawm tu hi. A khuala le a nai a om Moab ngam khuapite theampo ii tungah thukhenna theng zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Moab ii thahatna kisucip zo a; a vaangletna kisiasak zo hi. Keima, Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in, “Moab vaisak vun, banghang ziam cile ama in kei hong langpan hi. A mite kiphatsakna, a kisak theina, a kiletsakna le bang zata amate le amate kithupi ngaisut ziam ci thute ka za zo hi."},"30":{"text":"Keima, Topa in amate ii a kihisakna thu ka he hi. Nimrim lui ngawngawn kang zo hi."},"35":{"text":"Moab mite sia a biakna munte ah meihal biakpiaknate le a pathiante tungah a sangaw biakpiaknate a piak ngawl natu in ka khaktan tu hi. Amate a vekpi in a khut ki at uh a, mi simin khau-ip puan silh hi."},"38":{"text":"Moab ngamsung innkhum theampo le taangpi khawlmun theampo ah khuangaina ci ngawl bangma dang om ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile kuama dei ngawl thambeal khat bangin Moab ka sutham zo hi."},"39":{"text":"Moab ngam kitamhtham zo hi! Kap vun! Moab kimaimawlsak zo hi. Moab kisiacip zo a, a kiim a paam minamte theampo in nuisan uh hi. Keima, Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"40":{"text":"A tha a phalh muvanlai khat bangin minam khat sia Moab ngam tungah hong suktun tu hi ci in Topa in kamciam zo hi,","title":"Moab atu Suatakna Om ngawl"},"41":{"text":"tuaciang a khuate le a kulhte kila tu hi. Tua ni in Moab ngalkapte sia numei nausuak tu khat bangin patau tu uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Moab sia kisusia tu a, minam khat suak zo nawn ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile ama in kei hong langpan hi."},"43":{"text":"Patauna, dumte le thaangte in Moab mite ngak nginge hi. Topa in ci zo hi."},"44":{"text":"A patauna pan suatak tu a hanciam pawpo dum sungah taak tu uh a, dum sung panin a kaato pawpo thaang sungah kiman tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile Moab mite lal natu in Topa in hun ciangtan zo hi."},"45":{"text":"A cimaw ngaltaite in Sihon kumpipa ii khatvei a uk ngei na Heshbon khuapi sungah bel natu zong in hanciam uh hi, ahihang tua khuapi sia mei in kaanghtum hi. Ngalsim a kin Moab mite ii ngamngi sang teng le mualsaangte sia mei in kaanghtham zo hi."},"46":{"text":"Moab mite hesuak vun! Na pathian Molech sia a thiampite le a kumpi tapate taw saltaang tu in kipaipui tu hi."},"4":{"text":"A thumaan ngawl mihingte awng banghangin kisathei nu ziam? Na thahatna kiam susuk hi. Banghangin na thahatna uh suangin kuama in ko hong sim ngam buan te ci nu ziam?"},"5":{"text":"Na kiim na paam panin launa kong thengsak tu hi. Na taikeak siat tu uh hi. Na suatak natu in na tai tek tu uh a, na ngalkapte a kaikhawm kik tu kuama om ngawl tu hi."},"6":{"text":"“Ahihang nidang ciang Ammon sia ka nuamsasak kik tu hi. Keima, Topa in ka ci zo hi.”"},"7":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in Edom te ii thu hi bangin son hi: “Edom mite in a thumaan a khen thei na sia bosua zo ziam? Buu vun! Esau ii suan le paalte ka susia tu hi, banghang ziam cile amate daan ka piak tu hun hong theng zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihingte in sapitnga a law uh ciang a kung tungah tawm khe a, tuaciang ngutate zanin hong pai ciang amate dei teng bek la uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang Esau ii suan le paalte a puan ka suutsak siat zo a tuaciang a buk thei nawn ngawl natu in a bukna munte ka kilanghsak zo hi. Edom mite a vekpi in kisusia zo hi. Khat zongh taang ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Na tangate ka kungah hong nusiat tavun. Keima in amate ka keam tu hi. Na meingongte in kei hong bealh thei hi."},"12":{"text":"“Daan piak tu a, a kilawm ngawl mite ngawngawn in daan thuakna hai pan dawn tu ahile no, daan piak ngawlin om tu in ki um nu ziam? A nai a om khuanote theampo a tawntungin kisiacip tu hi. Keima, Topa in ka ci zo hi.”"},"14":{"text":"Keima in, “Edom awng, Topa kung panin thu khat ka nga zo hi. Nang sia suangliang tung le mualdawn saangna ah na teang a; muvanlai khat bangin a saangna ah na ten hangin Topa in nang hong khiasuk veve tu hi. Topa in son zo hi,” ka ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in, “Edom tungah a theng tu suksiatna sia nasia mama tu a, a kaantan theampo lau in ingh tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Sodom khua, Gomorrah khua le a kiim a khuate a kisiatsak lai bangin Edom khua kisiasak tu hi. Tua munah kuama teang kik ngeingawl tu hi. Keima, Topa in ka ci zo hi.","ref":"Pian 19:24-25"},"19":{"text":"Tawpi in ngam tawnghtol sung pan hong pusuak a, lopa hingna Jordan ngundung zui in a pai bangin, keima kong pai tu a, Edom mite a ngam uh panin thakhat thu in ka taikeaksak tu hi. Tuasia ciang keima ii teal lampuipa in ngam uk tu hi. Kei taw kitee ngat thei tu akua om ziam? Akua in kei hong thato ngam tu ziam? Kei hong nalh zo tu ukpa akua om ziam?"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahikom Edom mite suksiat natu ka tupna le Teman khuapi mite tungah vawt tu ka tupnate ngai vun. A patangte uh ngawngawn kikaikeak tu a, a kuama po liinglawng tu uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Edom a siat ciang leitung buppi kiliing tu za in a nging khat om tu a, patau auna le kaana awte sia Aqaba tuipi dok dongin kiza tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Muvanlai in a tha phalhin a suktun taw kibangin ngalte in Bozrah sim tu hi. Tua ni in Edom ngalkapte sia nausuak tu a tun numei bangin thin patau in om tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in Damascus ii thu hi bangin son hi: “Hamath le Arpad khuapite sungah a teang mihingte sia thusia a zaak uh manin patau a, thinngimin om uh hi. Numei nausuak tu a tun bang keakin na sa in ngim thuakin om uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua a minthang, a lungdam bul khuapi sia kinusia cip zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ni in a tangvalte sia khuapi sung lampi tungah kithat tu a, a ngalkapte theampo kimaimot tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Damascus luphungte mei taw ka hal tu a, Benhadad ii kumpi innte sia ka haltum tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianbelpa Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar ii a zaw Kedar minam le Hazor ii uk ngamkhennote taw kisai in Topa ii cina pan: “Kedar mite sim vun a, nisuana sangah a om minam sia susia vun!","title":"Kedar Minam tung le Hazor Khuapi tungah Thukhenna"},"29":{"text":"A puanbukte le a tuu honte, a buk kongkha puankhaite le a buk sungah a om nate theampo laksak vun. A kalaoh te la vun a, a mite tungah, ‘Na kiim na paam theampo ah launa om hi’ ci in son vun."},"30":{"text":"“Hazor mihingte awng, a khuala na ah tai vun a buu vun ci in keima, Topa in kong sonkhol hi. Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in no hong thasawm a, ama in,"},"31":{"text":"‘Hong pai tavun! Ngammuang a kisa mite ih sim tu hi! A khuapi in kongpi le nei ngawl, tawkalh natu tawbu le nei ngawl a, kidal vet ngawl hi,’ ci hi."},"32":{"text":"“A kalaoh te le nganno a hul a khoaite theampo la vun! A sam uh a tom in a meet mihingte sia mun theampo ah ka thethaang tu a, mun theampo pan amate tungah tuasiatna ka thengsak tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Hazor ngam sia a tawntungin sennealngam kisuaksak tu a, ngiate bek tua munah teang tu hi. Tua munah kuama teang kik ngeingawl tu hi. Keima, Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Zedekiah ii Judah kumpi a sua zawk po ciang, Vaanglianbelpa Topa in Elam ngam thu ka tungah hong son hi.","title":"Elam tungah ii Thukhenna"},"35":{"text":"Ama in, “Elam ngam a thahatsak mama thalkaap thiamte theampo ka that tu hi."},"36":{"text":"Mun theampo panin Elam ngam sia vui in ka seamsak tu a, a ngaltai mite a thet ngawlna ngam khat beak om ngawl dongin a mite mun theampo ah ka thethaang tu hi."},"37":{"text":"Amate a that nuam a ngalte Elam mite in ka kiitasak tu hi. Ka thin uuk mama na taw in Elam mite ka susia tu a, ka lalcipsak dongin amate a do tu in ngalkaphonpi ka puak tu hi."},"38":{"text":"A kumpite le a lampuite ka susia tu a, tua munah ka kumpi tokhum ka nga tu hi."},"39":{"text":"Ahihang nidang ciang Elam mite ka nuamsasak kik tu hi. Keima, Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon khuapi le a mite taw kisai in Topa in hi bangin a thupuak sia ka tungah hong son hi:","title":"Babylon A Kilaakna","ref":"Is 13:1—14:23; 47:1-15"},"2":{"text":"“Minamte tungah hi thu son in! Hi thu thangsak in! Limlakna pia in a, a thu taangko in! Thuku in koi heak in! Babylon taak zo hi! A pathian Marduk kisemtham zo hi! Babylon ii milimte kimaizumsak zo hi; a kiihuai a milimte kisutham hi!"},"3":{"text":"“Saksang panin minam khat Babylon sim tu in hong theng zo a tua sia sennealngam suaksak tu hi. Mihing le nganhingte taikeak tu uh a, tua munah kuama teang ngawl tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in, “Tua hun hong thet ciang, Israel le Judah mite kap kawmin hong paikhawm tu uh a, amate ii Pathian, keima hong zong tu uh hi.","title":"Israel ii Heakkikna"},"5":{"text":"Amate in Zion lampi dongh tu uh a, tua zawkciang tua sang ah pai tu uh hi. Amate sia tuute bangin mual khat pan mual khat ah vakthap kawkoai uh a, a inn omna mun mangil zo uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate sia a mute theampo in sim uh hi. A ngalte in, ‘Amate sia Topa tungah maw uh hi, tua ahikom hi bang a amate tungah ih vawt sia kikhial ngawl hi. A taanghpupite in Topa muang hi, tua ahiciang amate mama sia Topa tungah a thumaan top tu uh ahi hi,’ ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Israel mite awng, Babylon panin taikeak vun! Hi ngam nusia vun! A nusia phitbel hi vun!","ref":"Tpl 18:4"},"9":{"text":"Sak sangah a om ngam thahat pawlkhat ka thawn tu a Babylon ka simsak tu hi. Amate in tua ngam sim tu in a thuangin kingual tu a, zo tu uh hi. Amate sia thal taw muiliim savai thiamte ahi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Babylon khuapi kiphuul tu a, a phuulte in a dei theampo la tu uh hi. Keima, Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in, “Babylon mite awng, ka minam na suttol uh hi. Note lungdam in na kipaak uh a, khuipui an cicil ahibuale a hahaam siphu khat bangin vak kawkoai nu hi,","title":"Babylon Bona"},"12":{"text":"ahihang na khuapi lian uh sia a vaang kibosak tu a, kimaizumsak tu hi. Babylon sia ngam theampo sung panin a thupi ngawlbel ngam suak tu a, a kongaw le tui om ngawl sennealngam suak tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka thin uukna hu in Babylon ah kuama teang ngawl tu hi; a siacip in kinusia tu a, tua mun kaantan in a paite theampo in ingh in lamdang sa tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"“Thal toaite awng, Babylon sim tu in kingual vun a kiim uum vun. Babylon te in khuapi uumci hi napi, tua ngalkapte theampo zan lai in suakta uh hi. Amate sia kumpi huan paina lam zui in luphung te ni ii a kikawnna kongpi sia kaantan in Jordan Kuam sang zuanin tai uh hi.","ref":"Eze 33:21"},"8":{"text":"Ahihang Babylon ngalkaphonpi in Zedekiah kumpipa delkot in Jericho khua nai zaangtam ah man uh hi, a ngalkapte theampo in Zedekiah taisan uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Zedekiah sia Nebuchadnezzar kumpipa kungah kipaipui hi, tualai in Nebuchadnezzar sia Hamath ngam Riblah khuapi ah om a tua munah Nebuchadnezzar in ama tungah thukhen hi."},"10":{"text":"Riblah ah Nebuchadnezzar in Zedekiah ii tapate sia a pa ii mu tang ma in that hi, tuaciang ama in Judah uliante zongh thatsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, ama in Zedekiah ii mittangte khelsak a kol thaakin Babylon ah paipui hi. Zedekiah sia a thi ni dong Babylon thong sungah om hi.","ref":"Eze 12:13"},"12":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar ii Babylon kumpi a sep zawk kum sawm le kum kua kum a tha ngana, ni sawm ni in, kumpipa tungah ngaisutna a pia pa le a ngalkaphonpi ukpa Nebuzaradan sia Jerusalem khua ah tum hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Suksiatna (2 Kumpite 25:8-17)"},"13":{"text":"Ama in Biakinnpi, kumpi inn le Jerusalem khua sungah mi thupi theampo ii innte mei taw haltum hi;","ref":"1 Kum 9:8"},"14":{"text":"tuaciang a ngalkapte in khuapi luphungte sutham uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang Nebuzaradan in khua sungah a taanglai mite, khutthiam mi a taanglaite le Babylon te kungah hong taite Babylon ah paipui hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang ama in nei le lamh a nei ngawl, a zawngbel mihing pawlkhat, Judah ngam sungah nusia in sapithuan le lo sungah naseam tu in koi hi."},"17":{"text":"Babylon te in Biakinnpi sungah a om taau khuamte le khuileangte le taau tuikuang lian sia sutham hi, tuaciang taaute theampo amate in Babylon ah paipui uh hi.","ref":"1 Kum 7:15-47"},"18":{"text":"Amate in kawkeaute, biaknatau thianthosakna a, a kizangh vut kuangte, meiinn puuana a, a nazakte, sangaw biakpiakna chi donna kuangte, ngimnamtui halna kuangte le biakinn kikhopna a, a kizangh taau taw a kivawt nate theampo zongh la uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in khamh ahibuale ngunn taw a kivawt nate theampo la uh hi: tuate sia kuangnote, meikam toaina bealpeute, sangaw biakpiakna a chi donna kuangte, vut kuangte, meiinn ngaknate, ngimnamtui halna kuangte le sapittui sunna biakpiakna haite ahi uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Solomon kumpipa ii Biakinnpi a tu a vawt taau vanhte — khuam niite, khuileangte, tuikuang lian sia le, a nanna khuital sawm le niite — sia khaitee tu in ngit leih hi."},"21":{"text":"A khuam niite sia kibang linlian hi: khat sia metre 8 saang a, a kiimkot metre 5.3 pha hi. Tuate sia a sung hawm a, a thik sia millimetre 75 saa hi. Khuam dawn ah taau taw a kivawt a tungkhu khat veve om a, metre 2.2 saang hi, a kiimkot sia talee thingnga lim taw a kizeam thikpaona om a, a vekpi in taau taw kivawt hi.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Khuam khat sim ii tungkhuna theampo tungah talee nga zakhat veu om a, sawmkua le luk sia lei panin kimu thei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua bek dom ngawlin ngalkaphonpi ukpa, Nebuzaradan in Thiampi Lianbelpa Seraiah, thiampi dom Zephaniah le a thupi biakinn ulian dang thum te thongtaak tu in paipui hi.","title":"Judah Mite Babylon ah Kipaipui (2 Kumpite 25:18-21 , 27-30)"},"25":{"text":"Khuapi sung panin ngalkapte a uk ngalkap mangpa, khua sungah a taanglai, kumpipa ngaisutna a piate sung pan mihing sali, ngalkap zum lai a keam, ngalkapmang pa a hupa le a dang mihing thupi sawmlukte ama in paipui hi."},"26":{"text":"Nebuzaradan in amate sia Riblah khuapi ah a om, Babylon kumpipa kungah paipui hi,"},"27":{"text":"tua khuapi sia Hamath ngam sungah om hi. Tua munah kumpipa in amate saatsak in thatlum hi. Tua ahikom Judah mite sia a ngam panin saltaang tu in kipaipui hi."},"28":{"text":"Hisia in Nebuchadnezzar ii thongtaak a, a paipui mite teng kitepteena ahi hi: Ama ii kumpi a sep zawk a kum sali kum in ama in mihing 3,023 paipui hi;"},"29":{"text":"a kum sawm le kum liat kum in, Jerusalem panin 832;"},"30":{"text":"tuaciang a kum kul le kum thum kumin, 745 — Nebuzaradan in paipui hi. A vekpi in mihing 4,600 kipaipui hi."},"31":{"text":"Evilmerodach sia Babylon kumpi a sua kumin, ama in Judah kumpipa Jehoiachin sia thong panin a pusuasakna taw a dik na lak hi. Hi bang a suataksak ni sia Jehoiachin thongtaak a, a kipaipui zawk kum sawmthum le kum sali kum, a tha sawm le tha niina ni kul le ni nga ni ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Evilmerodach in Jehoiachin phat vawt a, Babylon ah ama taw saltaang khawm kumpi dangte sangin a vaang piakna lian zaw hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jehoiachin sia a thong puante kilaihsakin a nuntak lai teng kumpipa ii sabuai ah an kinesak hi."},"34":{"text":"A nuntak sung ni sim a kisap na ah a zak tu in ama sia dangka kipia tawntung hi."}}}}},"25":{"info":{"name":"Kaatap Late","shortname":"Lam","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khatvei lai in mihing taw a kidim Jerusalem khuapi bangza in ngamkhing ziam! Leitung ii khatvei a zatak ngei sia tu in meingongnu khat taw kibang hi; khuapi teng po pan a tuanngenbel sia sila dinmun ah taak zo hi.","title":"Jerusalem Khua Mite ii Khuangaina"},"2":{"text":"Zankhuateakin ama kap a; a biangkho ah thitui luang suk vahii hi. A lawm a ngual masa te khat zongh ama heeneam tu taang ngawl hi, A kipawlpuite in ama leeheak zo a, tu in langpan tek ta uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Judah ii mite sia inn pan zawthawk thu taw a kihawlkeak a cimaw silate ahi uh hi. Ngamdang ah amate sila in om a, a mun, a ngam ci tu nei ngawl uh hi — Ngalte in kiim uum a, a suatak natu lam bing hi."},"4":{"text":"Ni thiangtho nite ah biakna vawt tu in, Biakinnpi ah kuama hong pai ngawl hi. Tua munah lasa ngaknute in ngim thuak a, a thiampite mau vangui thei bek hi. Khuapi kongpite hawm a, Zion in ngim thuak hi."},"5":{"text":"A ngalte in ama zo a; amate khutnuai ah koi hi. A khialna tam mamate hangin Topa in ngim thuaksak hi; A tate kipummat in kipaipui hi."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem phatna sia bo zo hi. A lampuite sia sangai ngilkial a thazawm, savaite mai ah a tai ciang a tha bo dedek te bang ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu in a ngamkhing, a siacip sa Jerusalem khua in nidang a phatna nung phaw kik hi. A ngalte khut sung a thet ciang a hu tu kuama om ngawl hi; A ngallelna sia ama a zote in nuisan uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A minphatna teng bo a; a pumnguak in om a ngual zawnsak thuak hi. Ama tau a maizum in a mai seal hi. Jerusalem in lipkhaphuai mawna taw ama le ama kininsak hi."},"9":{"text":"A thiantho ngawlna ol tak kimu a, ahizong a thuak tu sia awlmawk ngawl hi. Ama lelna sia nasia leilam a kuama in heeneam zo ngawl hi. A ngalte in zothal ahiciang, Topa tungah hesuak ngen in kap hi."},"10":{"text":"A ngalte in ama ii a nei a lamh theampo suttol hi. Topa ii Gentile te pai tu a khaamna mun Biakinnpi sung mama ah a ngalte a tum sia ama in mu hi."},"11":{"text":"A mite in bang khat po neak tu a zon uh ciang mau vangui uh hi; Amate in a nuntak thei natu in a nei a lamhte an taw theak uh hi. “Kei hong en ka ven, Topa awng; ka ngim nga zia hong mu ta'n,” ci in a khuapi bup in ko hi."},"12":{"text":"“Kei hong en ka ven!” ci in ama kaantan in a pai theampo tungah ko hi. “Kei nat bangin kuama in a na thuak ngeingawl hi. Topa in a thin uuk laitak hong thuaksak natna a hi hi."},"13":{"text":"“Ama in tungsang pan mei hong khiaksuk a, tua mei in ka sung hong kaangh hi. Ama in kei thaang hong sia a, lei ah hong sial hi. Tua zawkciang ama in hong taisan a, a na thuak tan tu in hong nusia hi."},"14":{"text":"“Ama in ka mawna theampo ciamtee a, a vekpi in sawm khawm hi; Tuate ka ngawng kiim ah hong awsak a, a ngitna thuak la in ka thazawm hi. Topa in ka ngalte khut sungah hong aap a, ka cimaw hi."},"15":{"text":"“Topa in ka ngalkap thahatbelte theampo nuisan lel a; Ama in ka tangvalte a lalsak tu in ngalkaphonpi khat puak hi. Sapit ngoaina sungah sapitngate kingoai thap bangin ka mite ama in sucip hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tua hu in ka mittangte thitui taw kidim leet hi. Kuama in hong heeneam thei ngawl a; kuama in hong hanthawn thei ngawl hi. Ngalte in hong zothal a; ka mite in bangma nei nawn ngawl uh hi."},"17":{"text":"“Ka khutte zan kaleng kuama in hong hu ngawl hi. Mun theampo pan kei hong langpan tu ngalte Topa in sam zo hi. Amate in a kiihuai nate bangin kei hong vawt hi."},"18":{"text":"“Ahihang Topa sia a maan hi a, keima in a thu ka nit ngawl hang hi zaw hi. Hong ngai tavun, mun theampo a om mite awng; a na ka thuak hong en tavun. Ka ngaknute le ka tangvalte sia ngalmat in kipaipui siat zo hi."},"19":{"text":"“Ka pawlpuite ka sam a, ahihang amate in hong hu nuam ngawl hi. Thiampite le lampuite sia nuntak natu an a zon laitak ma in khuapi lampite tungah thi uh hi."},"20":{"text":"“ Topa awng, na ka sak nate, ka thinbot vangui nate hong en ta'n! Ka mawnate hangin khuangai in ka thin tamhtham hi. Lampite ah kithalupna om a; innsuum sungsang ngawngawn ah thina theng hi."},"21":{"text":"“Ka tau nate hong ngai ta'n; hong heeneam tu kuama om ngawl hi. Tuasiatna nong thuaksak manin ka ngalte lungdam uh hi. Nong kamciam ni hong thengsak ta'n a; keima thuak bangin ka ngalte thuaksak in."},"22":{"text":"“Amate seksolnate theampo hu in amate ningkhiin in; Ka mawnate hu in daan nong piak bangma in amate daan pia in. Thasiatna taw ka tau a, ka thin na hi.”"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa a thin uuk in Zion sia khuazing taw tuam zo hi. A vantung hoina te ama in sia sak zo hi. A thin uuk ni in a Biakinnpi ngawngawn nusia hi.","title":"ii Jerusalem Daan A piakna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Judah ngam khuano theampo hesuak ngawlin lalthamsak a, Ngam huukna kulhpite baltham hi. Ama in kumpi ngam le a ukte maizum pia hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in a thinso in Israel te thahatna saattham hi. Ngalte hong kuan ciang ama in hong hu nuam ngawl hi. Kaanghmei bangin ama in ei hong zaap keak a, na theampo lalthamsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Eite sia ngal bang phetin a thaltangte taw hong tuung hi; Ih lungdamna le ih diksak theampo ama in thatlum hi. Hi lai Jerusalem ah ama ii thin uukna meikuang eite in ih thuak hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in ngal khat bangin Israel susia zo hi. Ama in a kulhte le kumpi innte a zaancip sa in nusia hi. Ama in Judah mite tungah a bo thei ngawl heena tungsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama ih biakna mun Biakinnpi sia ama in a bebekin sutham hi. Ama in ni thiangthote le Sabbath te bosak zo hi. Kumpipa le thiampipa in ama thin uukna a kibangin thuak khawm uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa in a biaknatau nial a, ama ii a thiangtho Biakinnpi taisan hi. Ama in Biakinn pangte sia ngalte in balthamsak hi. Khatvei lai in lungdamna taw ih biakna munah amate ngalzo in au uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Zion khuapi luphungte a cipthap tu sia Topa in ciangtan zo hi. A vekpi a sia tu in ama in see zo hi. Tu in tausaangte le luphungte lal khawm hi."},"9":{"text":"Kongpite sia leivum suangvum sungah kivuknelh a, a zawlte a bebekin kivaat tham zo hi. Kumpipa le namliante tu in saltaang in om hi. Thukham kihil nawn ngawlin, kamsaangte in mu kholnate Topa ii tung pan nga ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem ii pasal huaite sia huthe ngawlin lei ah to khipkhep uh hi. A lu tungah leivui kithe in khau-ip puan silh uh hi. Ngaknu note lei ah a lu kun uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka ka kaana in ka mitte paat zo a, ka thin na mama hi. Ka mite lalna hangin hee in ka tha zawm ngawp hi. Patangnote le nausente khuapi lampite ah butthi uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate ngilkial dangtaak in a nute kaa uh hi. Amate sia a liamte bang phetin lampi ah puk uh a, Tuaciang a nute ii kaang sungah dadam in thi uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Jerusalem awng, kong it Jerusalem awng, bang kong ci thei tu ziam? Bangbangin nang hong heeneam thei tu khi ziam? Kuama in hi bang peuma in thuak ngeingawl hi. Na tuasiatna sia tuipi bangin mong nei ngawl a; bangma muanmawk thei tu om ngawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Na kamsaangte in leilot thu ngawl po nang tungah son tu nei ngawl hi. Na mawna a pholaak ngeingawl amate thuhilna taw nang hong theam ahi hi. Amate in na kisii kik tu a kul ngawl tu dongin hong ngaisunsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Khuapi kaantan in a pai mihingte in nangma hong ngaimawk et uh hi. Amate in Jerusalem ii zaanthapna sia a lu pei in nuisan uh hi: “Hisia, tua khuapi hoi sia ma hi kana ziam? Hisia, leitung bup ii kiphatsakpui sia hi ka na ziam?”"},"16":{"text":"Na ngalte theampo in hong selno in etsatna taw nang hong salh uh hi. Amate mukmen in “Khuapi lalthamsak zo hing! hisia ih ngalaakbel ni hi!” ci in selno uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in hong tawnna teng a khak belin tungsak hi. Ama in hun saupi lai a eite kidop natu hong hil sa bangin hesuakna om ngawlin hong lalsak hi. Ama in ih ngalte ngalzosak a, ih ngallelna ah amate lungdamsak hi."},"18":{"text":"Jerusalem awng, na luphungte mama in Topa ko tahen! Na thituite a sun a zanin ngun bangin luangsak in; kaana le khuangaina taw nangma le nangma kingawt in!"},"19":{"text":"Zankhuateak Topa tungah ko tu in tho kikik in! Na thin na lung takpi taw na patangte — lampi king sim ah neak tu nei ngawl pukhong in a thi tu na patangte atu in ama tungah hesuak ngen in."},"20":{"text":"En in, Topa awng! Banghang hi bangin daan hong thuaksak ni ziam! Nupite in a it a tate ii sa ne uh hi! Thiampite le kamsaangte sia Biakinnpi sung mama ah kithatlum hi!"},"21":{"text":"A moi a haam a kibangin lampi ah thi uh hi. Ngalte in ngaknu le tangval teng namsau taw thatlum uh hi. Na thin uuk ni in hesuak ngawlin amate na thatlum hi."},"22":{"text":"Nangma in keima ii kiim ah hong lausak poai vawt tu in ka ngalte na sam a, Tuaciang tua na thin uuk ni in kuama suakta zo ngawl hi. Amate in itna taw ka vak ka taa sa tanote suamlum uh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ii daan piakna bangbang tatak hi tu ziam ci in a he sia keima ka hi hi.","title":"Daan piakna, Kisii kikna le Lametna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in khuazing sungah a thuk vaial, a thuk vaial in kei hong hawlkeak hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in hong hesuak ngawlin kei hong vevel hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in ka samal sia a at babangin nusia a, ka ngu ka taang thiaktan hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in thasiatna le mauna thong sungah hong khum hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in a uih thina khuazing sungah kei hong teangsak hamtang hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in thikkhau taw hong heen a; suatak tu muanmawk om ngawl thongtaak a, a luangta khat ka hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hu ngenin nging takin ka kap a, ahizong Pathian in hong ngai nuam ngawl hi;"},"9":{"text":"Lam ka pai ciang ka hoi vadai a; ka heakna mun theampo ah suangpangte in ka mai hong khak hi."},"10":{"text":"Vompui khat bangin ama in kei hong pang nginge a; tawpi khat bangin ama in hong baw hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in lam puasia ah kei hong del a, hong balneen in hong nusia hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in a thal keak a, kei sia a thaltangte taw phutuunna in hong nei hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in a thaltangte taw ka pumpi thuk bunin hong kap hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihingte in sunkhuateak in kei hong nuisan a; amate theampo atu in kei sia ciammuina ka suak hi."},"15":{"text":"An le tui hong piak taangin ama in nasia takin hong thuaksak hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in ka maitang lei ah hong tat a, suangtum tungah ka hate sutan hi."},"17":{"text":"Cidamna, thinnopna le lungdamna cite bang ziam ci sia ka mangil zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Khuangei nungta nawn ngawl tu khi hi; Topa sungah ka lametna bo zo hi;"},"19":{"text":"Natna ka thuakna, inn le lo nei ngawlin ka omnate ka ngaisut sia nguu ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"A tawntungin tuate ka ngaisun a, ka thin kiam hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahizong hi thu khat ka phaw ciang, lametna hong piang kik hi:"},"22":{"text":"A kiam ngeingawl Topa ii hong itna le hong hesuakna kizom suak lai a;"},"23":{"text":"zing khuavak bangin thak suak tawntung a, nisuak pealmaw bang ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa bekma ka nei hi a, ama tung bek ah ka lametna ka koi hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama a muangte theampo tungah Topa pha hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom eite atu in, thin sauna taw ama ngakin ih om tu — eite hong ngum tu in ama ngakin ih om tu — phabel hi."},"27":{"text":"Ih khan moi lai in hi thinsauna sin tu phabel hi."},"28":{"text":"Ngimna ih thuak ciang thinsauna taw thimdide in eima nguak ih to tu ahi hi;"},"29":{"text":"Kipum aapin ih kun tu ahi hi, banghang ziam cile lametna om thei lai tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Hong kivua in hong kizawngsak kale tuate theampo ih saang thiam tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa sia hesuakna taw kidim a, a tawntungin eite hong nial ngawl tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Ama in eite heena hong thuaksak thei tu hi, ahihang ama ii eite hong itna sia maan in kho hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama in eite hong khuangaisak, hong natsak sia nuamsa tuan ngawl hi."},"34":{"text":"Topa in thong sungah thinngimna ih thuak ciang hong heaksak a;"},"35":{"text":"Ama ii eite hong piak hamphatna te ih taan ciang hong heaksak hi;"},"36":{"text":"thukhenzum ah thutang khenna a om ngawl ciang, ama in he hi."},"37":{"text":"Topa deina sia bekma kiseam suak tawntung hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama thu piakna zui in a pha le a sia a kibangin piang hi."},"39":{"text":"Ih mawna hangin daan hong kipiak ciang banghang phuphun tu hi ziam?"},"40":{"text":"Ih kalsuan nate en pha kikin Topa kungah heak kik tawng."},"41":{"text":"Vantung a om ih Pathian tungah ih thinsung kongkha hongin thungen tawng,"},"42":{"text":"“ Topa awng, kote mawin, kong langpan zo uh a, nangma in nong maisak bua hi."},"43":{"text":"“Nangma in kote nong zuizen a nong thatlum hi; na thin uukna in na hesuakna seal hi,"},"44":{"text":"na thinsona meeikaai sia saa leih ahikom kote thungetnate nang kungah hong theng zo ngawl hi."},"45":{"text":"Nangma in kote simlei ninthuk nong sua hi."},"46":{"text":"“Ka ngalte theampo in kote hong selno in hong nunau uh hi."},"47":{"text":"Kote in tuasiatna le siatna ka thuak zo uh a, launa le kiitakna sungah ka nungta uh hi."},"48":{"text":"Ka mite siatna hu in ka thituite ngun bangin luang hi."},"49":{"text":"“Ka thituite sia"},"50":{"text":"Topa in vantung pan hong ensuk a, eite hong mu dong a kangmaw lui bangin luang vapua top hi."},"51":{"text":"Khuapi sungah numeite bang tawk ziam ci sia ka mu ciang ka khuangai mama hi."},"52":{"text":"“Kei hong ngaimawk natu thu a nei ngawl ngalte in, vacim khat bangin thaang sungah kei hong awksak hi."},"53":{"text":"Amate in leidum khat sungah hingtangin hong khiasuk a suang khat taw akua vang khak uh hi."},"54":{"text":"Tui in hong khuum tu in kithoai a, tuaciang thina a nai sia ka ngaisun hi."},"55":{"text":"“ Topa awng, dum tawtawngh panin nang kong sam hi,"},"56":{"text":"Kong sapna hong ngai ta'n ci in kong nget ciangin nong za hi."},"57":{"text":"Nong zo a, lau heak in nong ci hi."},"58":{"text":"“ Topa awng, kei hong suatak tu in nong pai a, ka nuntakna nong hun hi."},"59":{"text":"Kei sangah pangin thu hong khen ta'n; kei tungah a maan ngawl hong kivawtnate na he hi."},"60":{"text":"Ka ngalte ii hong etsatzia le hong thasawm zia na he hi."},"61":{"text":"“ Topa awng, amate ii kei hong lan nate na za zo hi, amate ii hong thasawm nate theampo na he hi."},"62":{"text":"Amate in sunkhuateak in kei thu kikum in vaihawm uh hi."},"63":{"text":"Amate in kei sia zingsang pan khuazan dong ciammuina in hong nei uh hi."},"64":{"text":"“ Topa awng, amate a ngamtatnate hu in daan pia in;"},"65":{"text":"Amate haamsiat in, thinkiamna taw kidimsak in!"},"66":{"text":"Amate vai zui in a, leitung pan phiat keak in!”"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ih khamh tee vakilte mualmang zo hi; Biakinnpi sakna suangte lampi ah kithethaang in om hi.","title":"Jerusalem Khua bo zawkciang"},"2":{"text":"Zion ii tangvalnote sia khamh bangin ei atu in manpha hi, ahihang tu in leibeal thawthongte bangin kivawt hi."},"3":{"text":"Ngiapui khat ngawngawn zongh in a note ou tu hi, ahihang ka mite ahile a tate tungah a ngilo kalaoh vacim puite bang ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in a nausente ngilkial dangtaak in thisak hi; tanote in an ngen a, ahihang kuama in amate an pia ngawl tu hi."},"5":{"text":"An phabel a ne ngei mihingte sia lampi ah anngawlin pukthi uh hi; a nuamsa in a khangte in an zongin ninbung tok uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka mite sia thakhat thu in Pathian khut sa a thuak Sodom a teang mihingte sangin nasia zaw in daan kipia hi.","ref":"Pian 19:24"},"7":{"text":"Ih kumpi tapate sia kiihuai ngawl hi, vuuk bangin thiangtho a, thahat in taktai a ciidam sitset uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu in amate sia kuama heak ngawlin lampi ah kisial uh a; thi in a mai mual uh hi; a vun uh tun a, thingko bangin ko in a ngute tungah bel hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngal sungah a thite sia nuntak zawk natu an om ngawl a, dadam in a thi, a thi khakte sangin phazaw lai hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka mite tungah a tung tuasiatna sia cizat huai mama hi, a nute in a neak tu in a tanote huan uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 28:57; Eze 5:10"},"11":{"text":"Topa in a thinsona teng nasia takin hong buak hi. ama in mei taw Zion halin kaanghtumsak hi."},"12":{"text":"A kuama peuma, ngamdang ngamukte mihingte a a thisak uh hang ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Mittawte bangin a lampuite lampite ah vakvai uh a, chisan baang ngawp ahikom kuama in amate tham ngam ngawl uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihingte in amate oksan a, “Tai vun! note kiihuai nu hi! Kei hong thutha heak vun!” ci uh hi. Tua ahikom amate ngam khat pan ngam khat ah pai kawkoai a, kuama in muak ngawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in amate awlmaw nawn ngawl a; amate thethaang hi. Ama in ih thiampite le ih lampuite bangma in hong hensak ngawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Eite in hong pai ngeingawl tu bul huna lamen in khuadak zawk nawn ngawl tu dong khua ih dadak hi. Ih nite bo zo a; a tawpna hong theng zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Muvanlaite van pan suktun a hong len sang a manlang zaw in amate in ei hong zuizen suk hi. Amate in mual tungah ei hong sul zui a; sennealngam ah muanmawk ngawlin ei hong phaa hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in ngalte khut sung pan hong dal zo tu in ih muan, ih nuntakna ii naak a hi, Topa tealsa kumpipa sia man uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Edom le Uz mite awng, nui vun; na lungdam thei uh lai teng lungdam vun. Na tuasiat natu uh zongh hong tung tu hi; note zongh maizumna taw na pumnguakin na hoi vacit tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Zion in a mawna thaman pia zo a; Topa in eite saltaang in hong koi nawn ngawl tu hi. Ahihang Edom awng, Topa in nang daan hong pia tu hi; ama in na ngamtat khialnate pholaak tu hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa awng, ko tungah hong piang thute phawk in. Kote hong en ta'n a, ka maizumna uh mu in.","title":"Hesuak natu Thungetna Khat"},"2":{"text":"Kote neisa sia khualmite khut sungah om a; ngamdangmite sia koma inn sungah teang uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Koma pate sia ngalte in thatlum zo a, tu in koma nute sia meingong suak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kote dawn tu tuite man piak kul a, kote thu tu thingkangte lei kul hi."},"5":{"text":"Kalaohte le laate bangin hong kihawl ngawp a, toi mama hikale ung hong tawlngasak ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Nuntak khom natu an ka nga natu uh in Egypt le Assyria ah an ngenin ka pai uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Koma taanghpupite mawna hi a; ahihang tu in amate om nawn ngawl hi, amate mawna hu in kote in ngimna ka thuak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Silate sangin a phazaw tuan ngawl mihingte in ko hong uk a, amate khut sung pan kuama in hong hun zo ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngam sungah mithatte vak kawkoai a, an ka zon uh ciang, luangkhaamin ka zong uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngilkialna in ka ci uh hong suuksak a, koma vunte meikhuk bangin a sat dong ka thuak uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Zion Mualtung mama ah koma ii zite hong buansak uh a; Judah ngam khuano theampo ah koma ii tanute zothaw in khialpui uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Koma ii lampuite hong matsakin ngui awksak a; koma ii pasal huaite hong zataksak bua uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Koma ii tangvalte sia silate bangin zawthawk thu taw an ngoaisak uh a; patangnote sia a thing puak uh khopin hoi vatut uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Khanghaamte khuapi kongpi ah to nawn ngawl a, khangmoite sia tengtongh tum nawn ngawl uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Kote nuntakna sungah lungdamna bo zo a; kote ngualnop lapna teng sia khuangaina taw kilaih zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Ko kiphatsakpui nate khat zongh taang nawn ngawl hi. Kote ka maw uh a, tu in a bo ka hi uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Kote ii ka thin ka lung mama uh na a, ka thituite uh hangin pha tak khua ka mu thei bua uh hi,"},"18":{"text":"Zion Mual sia ngamkhing ngamdai in kinusia ahikom tua a kisia sa munte ah ngam uite vak hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahihang Topa awng, nangma sia a tawntung kumpipa na hi a, hun tawp dongin na uk tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Banghangin tu tanvei kote hong nusia ni ziam? Kote nong phawk kik ngei tu ziam?"},"21":{"text":"Na kungah ko hong ciapui kik ta'n, Topa ! Hong ciapui kik ta'n! Taanghlai in koma minthanna teng hong pia kik ta'n!"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahibuale kote a tawntungin hong nial tu ni ziam? Na thin uukna in ciangtan nei ngawl ahi ziam?"}}}}},"26":{"info":{"name":"Ezekiel","shortname":"Ezek","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum sawmthum kum a tha li na a ni nga ni in Babylon ngam Chebar ngunhui ah keima Buzi ii tapa thiampi Ezekiel in Judah mi saltaangte taw ka teang khawm hi. Van kihong a, tuaciang Pathian ii lak mukholna khat ka mu hi. (","title":"EZEKIEL II PATHIAN A MU PHITNA (1:1—7:27) Pathian Tokhum","ref":"Tpl 19:11"},"2":{"text":"Tua hun sia Jehoiachin kumpipa sal in a kipaipui zawk a kum nga kum ahi hi.)","ref":"2 Kum 24:10-16; 2 Khang 36:9-10"},"3":{"text":"Chebar ngunhui tua Babylon ngamah, Topa hong paupuina ka za a, ama ii vaangletna ka phawk hi."},"4":{"text":"Khua ka dakto le saksang pan vuipi suangval hong pai ka mu hi. Meeikaai lian pui khat sung pan khualeng vazak a, a kiimkot van taang hi. Khualeng tee vazalna munah taau bang khat taang hi."},"5":{"text":"Vuipi suangval laizang ah mihing pianlim bang ahi cherubim li ka mu hi,","ref":"Tpl 4:6"},"6":{"text":"ahihang tuate khat simin maitang li le tha li tek nei uh hi."},"7":{"text":"A peangte maam a, amate in khuital peangcin bang nei uh hi. Tuate sia taau nawt thiang bang keakin tee uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Maitang li le tha li te bek hi ngawlin, amate in a tha khat tek ii nuai ah mihing khut li tek nei uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Cherub te khat simin, a tha te nii tek phalhin, a tha dawn veve tek kiphasak a, king li nei khat suak hi. Amate tungin a kikhiin nop ciang, a pum uh kiheak kul ngawlin a hon in kikhiin uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Cherub khat simin a kibang ngawl maitang nam li nei uh hi: tuate sia a maisang ah mihing maitang, a ziatsang ah tawpi maitang, a veisang ah khuital maitang le a nungsangah muvanlai maitang ahi hi.","ref":"Eze 10:14; Tpl 4:7"},"11":{"text":"Nganhing khat sim a thate nii tek kilaamto a, a hui pan a dang khat ii thadawnte taw kisisak hi, tuaciang amate ii a tha dangte nii tek sia a pum tung tek ah zep uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Nganhing khat simin a mun li teng nga ahiciang lu heak kul ngawlin a uuk na po ah a hon in pai thei uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Cherub te sungah meisip kuang bang khat om a, tua meikuang sia a tawntungin kikhiin hi. Tua meikuang sia leng vazak in khua lengsak vazal hi.","ref":"Tpl 4:5"},"14":{"text":"Tua cherub te sia khualeng manlangza in nung le mai ah a manlangin tai uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Nganhing lite ka et ciangin khat ii pangh ah khat a om lei taw kipha a mui li teng ka mu hi.","ref":"Eze 10:9-13"},"16":{"text":"Tua a mui li teng kibang siat hi; tuate khat simin suangmanpha bangin taang hi. Tuaciang a muite khat simin, a sungah a mui dang khat tang takin a kiphaa in kithua hi,"},"17":{"text":"tuabangin a muite sia mun li ah a ukna sang pawpo pai thei uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua a muite ii kiil teng sia mittangte taw kidim uh hi.","ref":"Tpl 4:8"},"19":{"text":"Cherub te a kikhiin simin leangte taw kikhiin khawm a, cherub te lei panin a kikhaanto ciangin, a muite zongh a kikhaangto uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Cherub te sia amate ukna po ah pai uh a, a muite zongh a cherub te bang tatak ma in pai uh hi, banghang ziam cile cherub te in a muite uk uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom cherub te a kikhiin sim a tawlngak sim ahibuale vui sungah a kikhaangto simin a muite zongh in tuabang tatak ma in zui uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua cherub te lu ii tung san ah a tee vazal limlangh taw a kivawt kikhupsiin in a kikoi taw a kibang khat om hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua a kikhup siin sia ii nuai ah cherub te dingin, khat simin a thate nii tek a hui a om sia ii sang ah phalh a, a dang tha niite taw a pumpi seal hi."},"24":{"text":"A len uh ciang a thaphil nging ka za hi; tua awnging sia tuipi hawk bang hi a, ngalkap honpui lampai nging bang, Vaanglianbelpa Pathian ii aw bang ahi hi. A len a tawlngak ciang, a thate khup uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahihang amate lu tungah a om a kikhup siin sia ii tung panin aw nging khat om lai hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua a kikhup siin sia ii tungah Sapphire suangmanpha taw a kivawt kumpi tokhum taw a kibang khat om a, tua tokhum tungah mihing taw a kibang lim khat to hi.","ref":"Eze 10:1; Tpl 4:2-3"},"27":{"text":"Tua lim sia meikhuk laizang ah a om taau bangin taang hi. Tua in a kiim a paam theampo nasia takin khuavak taangsak hi.","ref":"Eze 8:2"},"28":{"text":"Tua ii sungah sangun ii meal namcin om hi. Hisia ka mu ciangin ka maisang ah ka puksuk hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang aw khat ka za a, “A thithei mihing awng, ding in. Nang hong paupui nuam khi hi,” hong ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua aw ii pau laitakin Pathian ii thaa ka sungah hong tum a, hong phong in ka peang taw ka dingto hi; tuaciang tua aw in,"},"3":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, Israel mite kungah kong puak tu hi. Amate in hong langpan a, a taanghpupite bangma in hong langpanin tualngalte suak lai uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate a thinpui in kei hong zakta bua uh hi, tua ahikom keima Vaanglianpipa Topa in amate tungah ka cinopte a son tu in nang kong puak hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua tualngalte in nang thu hong ngai zong hong ngai bua zong, amate sungah kamsaang khat om ci sia he tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"“Ahihang a thithei mihing awng, amate ahizong, amate hong ci pawpo ahizong, na kiita bua het tu hi. Amate in nang hong nalh in hong zawngsak tu hi; aikam hon kawm a teen bang hi tu hi. Tuabang ahihang tua tualngalte ahizong, amate ii cite ahizong kiita peang heak in."},"7":{"text":"Amate in hong ngai zong hong ngai bua zong son tu a kong sawl babang na son tu hi. Amate sia bangbang tualngalte ziam cisia ciamtee ta'n."},"8":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, kong sonte hong ngai ta'n. Amate bangin tualngal suak heak in. Na kam kaa in a, kong piak tu sia ne ta'n,” a ci sia ka za thua lai hi."},"9":{"text":"Khut khat kei sang hong kithaak ka mu a, laizial khat a toai hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua khut in tua laizial sia phalh a, tuaciang a lang le lang ah lai ki at te — khuangai a kaana te le mauna taunate a ki at ka mu hi.","ref":"Tpl 5:1"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in, “A thithei mihing awng, laizial hisia ne in; tua zawkciang Israel mite kungah pai in paupui ta'n,” hong ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka kam ka kaa a, tuasia ciangin ama in laizial sia ka neak tu in hong pia hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, kong piak hi laizial sia ne in; tua taw na ngil vasak in,” hong ci hi. Ka neak ciang, khuaitui bangin thum hi.","ref":"Tpl 3:9-10"},"4":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Pathian in, “A thithei mihing awng, Israel mite kungah va pai ta'n a, son a kong sawl po va son ta'n."},"5":{"text":"A telhak ngamdang kam haksa khat a pauna ngam ah kong paisak bua a, Israel te kungah kong paisak hi."},"6":{"text":"Na tel ngawl kam haksa a pau ngamliante kungah hong paisak hi leng, amate in nang thu hong ngai tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahihang Israel mite khat zongh in hong ngai nuam ngawl tu hi, amate in kei pau ngawngawn hong ngai ngawl tu hi. Amate theampo sia thinpui in nalh nopna thin vive nei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu in nang sia amate bangma in na thin kong puisak tu a, na thin kong khosak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Suangpi bangin kong kipsak tu a, diamond suang manpha bangin kong saksak tu hi; tua tualngalte kiita vet heak in,” hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Pathian in, “A thithei mihing awng, pha takin hong ngai ta'n, kong son pawpo ciamtee in."},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang saltaang a om, na ngammipuite kungah pai in, na pau hong ngai zong hong ngai bua zong, kei Vaanglianpipa Topa ii amate tungah ka ci teng va son ta'n,” hong ci thua hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, Pathian thaa in kei hong laamto a, tuaciang ka nung pan a hawk, awnging vazak khat ka za a, “Vantung ah a om Topa minthanna pok vun!” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Vui sungah cherub te thaphil khopna aw le zinliing nging za in a nging, a muite aw ka za hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa ii vaangletna sia ka tungah thahatna lianpi taw hong theng a, tuaciang ama thaa in kei hong paipui ciangin dik ka sa bua a ka thin a uuk hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom, saltaangte teenna Chebar ngunhui Tel Abib ah pai in tua munah ni sali sung ka taam a, ka mu ka zaak thu in hong ngawtcip hi."},"16":{"text":"Ni sali a cin zawkciang, Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"in Ezekiel Ngalvil nasep Pia (Ezekiel 33:1-9)"},"17":{"text":"Ama in “A thithei mihing awng, Israel minam atu ngalvil khat in nang kong koi tu hi. Kidop natu nang tungah kong piak thute, amate tungah sonsawn tu ni hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihing ngilo khat a thi tu in ka taangko a, ahihang a nuntakna a ngup natu in a ngamtatna kikheal natu na son bua ahile, ama sia mimaw ma in a thi tu hi, tuaciang ama ii thina sia nang tungah hong kisiik tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing ngilo khat kidop natu thu na pia a, ahihang ama in mawna kikheal ngawlin mawnei ma in thi tu hi, ahihang nang nuntakna hong kikhoaikhe tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Mihing pha takpi khat sia ngitlo nasep hong kipan a, tuaciangin a lauhuai dinmun ah ka koi ciang, a kidop natu thu na pia buale ama thi tu hi. Ama ii mawnate hu in ama thi tu hi — a pha a septe ka tepteesak buatu hi; tuaciangin ama ii thina hu in nangma in mawpu tu ni hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihing pha khat a maw ngawl natu in na hil a, na thu hong ngai in mawna a vawt buale ama nungta tan tu hi, tuaciang nangma nuntakna zong hong kikhoaikheetsak tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa hong ompuina ii vaang neina ka phawk a, ama in, “Ding in a, ngamkuam sungah pai in, tua munah nang kong paupui tu hi,” hong cina aw ka za hi.","title":"Ezekiel Pau thei Ngawl tu"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom ngamkuam sungah ka pai a, Chebar Ngunhui ah ka mu sa bangma in tua munah Topa vaangletna ka mu hi. Ka maisang ah ka puksuk hi,"},"24":{"text":"ahihang Topa thaa sia ka sungah hong tum in, hong phong a ka dingto hi. Topa in kei tungah, “Inn ah cia in a, inn sungah nangma le nangma kikhabil in."},"25":{"text":"Khauzeen taw nang hong kiheencip tu a, a thithei mihing awng, mipi sungah na pai thei buatu hi."},"26":{"text":"Hi tualngal a tho nuam mihingte kidop natu na son thei ngawl natu in na leei ka zawsak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua zawk kong paupui kik ciang le, pau theina vaang kong piak kik ciangin, keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ka ci teng amate tungah na son tu hi. Amate pawlkhat in hong ngai tu a, ahihang pawlkhat te in nang hong melsia tu hi; banghang ziam cile amate sia tualngal a tho minam ahi uh hi.” hong ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in, “A thithei mihing awng, uksuang khat la in a, na mai ah koi in, tuaciang a tungah Jerusalem khuapi lakna in lam ngiit in.","title":"Ezekiel in Jerusalem A ki Uumci natu zia Lak"},"2":{"text":"Tuaciang Jerusalem khuapi a ki uumci na lim lak natu in, kanhte, leiciante, ngiaphual te le kulh sukthapna moltumte a kiimkot ah koi in."},"3":{"text":"Thik daalkuang khat la in, nang le khuapi kilaklaw ah pang khat bangin koi in. Khuapi maingat in. Tua khuapi sia ki uumci a, a uumci sia nangma ni hi. Hisia in Israel ngammite atu in lim khat a hi tu hi."},"4":{"text":"“Tua zawkciang, na siiklam veisang delpha in lum in, tuaciangin Israel minam ii mawna sia nang tungah kong koi tu hi. Amate daan thuak tu, kum khat ai atu in, ni khat veu daan kong pia tu hi.","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Tua teng na man zawkciang, na ziatsang pangh delpha in a, Judah mite mawna hu in ni 40 sung thuak in -- amate daan thuakna kum khat ciang ni khat ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"“Jerusalem khuapi a ki uumci sia mitsuan nginge in. Khuapi sia na khuttum ngat in vau in a, tua khuapi siat natu thu sonkhol in."},"8":{"text":"Tua khuapi a ki uumci hun a bo mateng na pangh langkhat pan a langkhat ah na kiheak thei ngawl natu in kong heencip tu hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tu in mangtaang, zungtaang ham, benaang, be, taangzik le mangtaang nam dang pawlkhat veu la in. Tua anluum sia ni 390 sung na siiklam veisang delpha in na lup hun sung na neak tu an ahi tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Ni khat in anluum gram 230 veu hong kipia tu a, a zing ciang dong na khom tu hi tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tui zongh a kiciangtan in na ne tu a, ni khat in hai nii veu na ne tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing eakko taw mei na thut tu a, na anluumte a kaam tungah em in mihing theampo ii nang hong mu theina munah na ne tu hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in, “Hisia sia a ngam uh pan ngamdangte ah ka thethaang hun ciang, thukham ii a khaam an sia Israel te ii a neak natu lim ahi hi,” hong ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang ka zo kik a, “Vaanglianpipa Topa awng, hi ngawl hi, tuabang hong hisak heak in! Bangma hun in keima le keima kininsak ngeingawl khi hi. Ka no a kipan, ama thu in a thi thawthong nganhing sa ahibuale ngamsate thalup peuma ii sa ka ne ngei bua hi. A nin in a kingaisun an peuma ne ngawl khi hi,” ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom Pathian in, “Pha mama hi, khui eak kong zanghsak zaw tu a, tua tungah na anluum na em thei tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Jerusalem atu anluum hong paina ka khaktan tu hi. A anneak a tuidawn lealte vathiam in hong om uh ciang, tua munah mihingte sia khuangai in a thinngim tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in neak tu le dawn tu an le tui hong nei ngawl tu a; a thin uh kiamin, a mawnate hu in a ci a sa hingkiam tu uh hi,” hong ci thua lai hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in, “A thithei mihing awng, namsau hiam khat la in a, na khamul le na sam teng meet kol in. Tuaciang tua na sam le multe la in, khaikhin taw na tee zawkciang, khen thum in khen in.","title":"Ezekiel in A sam meet"},"2":{"text":"Khen thum sua khen khat sia hong uumcina a ven ciang, khuapi sungah hal in.
