A om lai khen thum teng sia vui sungah the in a, ka namsau taw ka delkot tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Samzam tawm keam in a, na puan mong ah tun in."},"4":{"text":"Tua zawkciang samzam tawm la leleau in a, mei sungah vawk in kaanghtumsak in. Tuate panin Israel ngam bup ah kaanghmei hong kizel tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Jerusalem en in, Ama sia leitung bup ii laizang ah ka koi a, a dang ngamte sia a kiimkot ah om hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang Jerusalem in ka thupiakte hong langpan a, a dang ngamte sangin a ngitlo zawkna hong lak a, kiim le paam ngamte sangin thuni ngawl zaw hi. Jerusalem in ka thupiakte nial a, ka thukhamte zui ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu in Jerusalem awng, kei Vaanglianpipa pauna hong ngai ta'n. Ka thukhamte ni ngawl a ka thupiakte na zui ngawl ciang, na kiim na paam ngamte sangin ngimna tam piangsak zaw ni hi. Ngamdangte ngeinate na zui zo ta hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom Vaanglianpipa Topa keima in na ngal khi hi ci in kong son hi. Minam theampo ii mu thei tu in na tungah thu kong khen tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka ngaimawk nate theampo na vawt hu in, Jerusalem sia nidang a ka piak ngeingawl, mai sang zongh ah ka piak nawn ngawl tu daan ka pia tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua hu in Jerusalem a om nute pate in tate ii sa ne tu uh a, tate in nute pate ii sa ne tu uh hi. No daan kong pia tu a, a nungta lai sun zongh mun theampo ah kong thethaang tu hi.","ref":"Kaa 4:10"},"11":{"text":"“Tua ahikom keima in a nungta Pathian ka hi bangma in — hisia in Vaanglianpipa Topa ii kammal hi — nangma in ka Biakinnpi sia, a sia le a kiihuai ngamtatnate theampo taw ninsak na hikomin, hong hesuak ngawlin kong saatvawk tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Na mite sung pan khen thum sua khen khat sia khuapi sungah natna taw le ngilkialna taw in thi tu hi; a dang khen thum sua khen khat sia khuapi pua sangah namsau taw kisaatvawk tu hi; tuaciang a khakbel khen thum sua khen khat sia hui sungah ka thethaang tu a, namsau taw ka zuizen tu hi."},"13":{"text":"“Ka lung a kim dong ka thin uukna le ka thangsiatna te na tel tu hi. Hite theampo a pian ciang, na thumaan ngawlna hu in ka thinso a, Topa keima in na tungah thu hong son zo ka hi hunlam na tel tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Na kiim na paam pan a minamte, nang hong kaantan pawpo in nang hong selno tu a, a kiheam tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"“Nang tungah ka thin uuk in ka thinso a daan kong piak ciang, na kiim a om minamte lau vadil tu uh hi. Amate in nang sia hong kii et tu a, hong nunau tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Na anneak tu hong paina ka khaktan tu a, kong pukthisak tu hi. Nang hong lalsak tu in, a kikap thaltang hiamte ii khak bangin, ngilkialna ii a natzia sia na thuak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Na tate thatlum tu in ngilkialna le ngamsa ngilote kong puak tu a, tuaciangin nangma thatlum tu in natna, ngoltolna le ngalte kong puak tu hi, Keima, Topa in ka son zo hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Tpl 6:8"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"in Milim Biakna Ningkhiin"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Israel mualte sang en in a, amate tungah kong thupuak sia son in."},"3":{"text":"Topa kammal sia Israel mualte ii zaak tu in — Vaanglianpipa Topa keima ii mualpite mualnote, luamthukte le lei kuamte tungah ka son thute a zaak tu in na son in: mihingte ii milim te a biakna munte susia tu in namsau khat kong puak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"biaknataute kinuaitham tu a, ngimnamtui halna biaknataute kisutan tu hi. Tua munah om mihingte theampo a milimte mai ah kithatlum tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel mite ii mithi luangte ka thethaang tu hi; amate ii ngu le taangte biaknatau kiim theampo ah ka thethaang tu hi."},"6":{"text":"A biaknataute theampo le a milimte a kisukthap natu, a ngimnamtui halna biaknataute a kisaatthapsak natu le, a vawtsa uh theampo a bo cimit natu in Israel khuapite theampo kilalthamsak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihingte sia mun theampo ah kithatlum tu hi, tuaciang a nungta laiteng in keima sia Topa ka hina hong tel tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Kithalupna pan pawlkhatte ka suaktasak tu a, ngam tuatuamte ah kithethaang tu hi,"},"9":{"text":"tua munah amate saltaang in teang tu uh hi. Tua munah amate in kei hong phawk tu uh a, daan pia in maizum ka piak sia he tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate ii upna sel lungtang in kei hong taisan a, kei sangin milimte deizaw uh hi. Amate tatsiatna le a etthawk huai nate a vawt hu in amate le amate kiihuai kisa tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in keima sia Topa ka hina le kidop natu a ka thupiakte sia kitawnna thawthong ahi ngawl hunlam he tu uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Na khut meak in! Na peang taw khuasiik in. Israel te ii tatsiatna theampo le a thasiathuai na te a vawt hu in khuangai in kap in. Amate sia ngal sung ahizong ngilkialna taw ahizong, natna taw ahizong thi tu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"A khualana ah a omte a ciina in thi tu uh hi; a naina a omte sia ngal sungah kithatlum tu hi. A thimong teng sia ngilkial in thi tu uh hi. Amate in ka thin uukna ii thahatna theampo phawk tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Mithi luangte sia milimte kawm le biaknataute kiimkot, tuaciang mualno saang theampo tung le mualpi dawn theampo, thingkung hingte le, oak thingkung lian theampo ii nuai, milim meihal biakpiakna mun theampo ah kithethaang tu hi. Tua zawkciangin mihing theampo in keima sia Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Hi hi, keima in ka khut ka vaan tu a, amate ngam ka lalthamsak tu hi. Thangsang sennealngam pan saksang Riblah khuapi dong, Israel mite teenna mun khat zongh khoaikhe ngawlin ngamtongta ka suaksak tu hi. Tuasia ciangin, a kuama po in keima sia Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Israel Bo Kuanh"},"2":{"text":"Ama in “A thithei mihing awng, hisia in Vaanglianpipa Topa Keima ii Israel ngam tungah ka son ahi hi: hisia in ngam bup atu in a bona ahi hi!"},"3":{"text":"“Israel awng, bona hun hong theng zo hi. Nang in ka thin uukna na phawk tu hi, banghang ziam cile na sep na vawt tungtaang ah thukhenna hong pia khi hi. A thasiathuai na ngamtatna theampo hong thuk kik tu khi hi."},"4":{"text":"Nang hong khoaikhe ngawl tu khi hi, tua ahibuale nang tungah hesuakna hong lak ngawl tu khi hi. Keima sia Topa ka hi hunlam na heak natu in a thasiathuai na ngamtatna te hu in, daan kong pia tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Hisia in Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci ahi hi: “Na tungah tuasiatna khat zawkciang khat hong tung tu hi."},"6":{"text":"A vekpi kiman zo hi. Hisia in bona ahi hi. Nang sia a mansa na hi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngam sungah a teang no mihingte atu in bona hong thetheng hi. Mual tung biakpiakna munte ah poai kikhaam nawn ngawlin buaina bek a om tu hun hong nai hi."},"8":{"text":"“Hai ngawlin ka thin uukna ii thahatna na phawk tu hi. Na sepna sate tungah thu kong khen tu a, a thasiathuai na ngamtat nate theampo kong thuk kik tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang kong khoaikhe buatu a, kong hesuak buatu hi. Keima sia Topa ka hi hunlam le nangma daan hong pia sia ka hi hunlam na heak natu in, a thasiathuai na ngamtatnate hu in daan kong pia tu hi.”"},"10":{"text":"Israel atu in tuasiatna ni hong theng tu hi. Ngoltol ngamtatna pung vaial hi. Kiphatsakna sia a saangbel mun theng hi."},"11":{"text":"Ngoltol ngamtatna in khansiat seksolna tam piangsak vaial hi. Amate ii neisa a hauna a phatna, ahibuale a minthannate bangma a kikhe nawn buatu hi."},"12":{"text":"A hun hong theng hi. Vanh lei vanh zuak sia khiakna a nei nawn ngawl tu ni hong nai hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian ii daan piakna sia a kuama theampo tungah a kibangin tung tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Sumvawt a kuama po in, a supsa teng a nga kik dong a nungta buatu hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian thin uukna sia a kuama theampo tungah theng hi. A ngilote luhai thei ngawl tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Lemle kitum a mihing theampo kithoai khol hi; ahihang kuama ngalsim tu in kuan ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian ii thin uukna sia a kibangin mihing sim tungah tung tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Lampite ah ngal kisimna om a, innte sungah natna le ngilkialna om hi. Ngam pua sangah a om khat pawpo sia ngal kisimna ah thi tu a, khuapi sung a om khat pawpo sia natna le ngilkialna taw thi tu hi.","title":"Israel ii Mawnate hangin Daan piakna"},"16":{"text":"Pawlkhatte sia leikuamte pan a lau vakhute bangin mual tungah suakta to tu hi. A mawna uh hu in amate theampo mau tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"A kuama po ii khutte sia thazawm tu a, a khupte huang tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in khau-ip puan silhin liing ngawp tu uh hi. A lute uh kimeet tol tu a, kimaizumsak tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in a khamh le a ngunnte lampi ah ninteak bangin vawk tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile Topa ii thin uuk ciangin, khamh le ngunn in amate hun zo ngawl hi. Khamh le ngunn in amate deina lungkimsak thei ngawl a, a ngil uh vasak thei ngawl hi. Khamh le ngunn in amate sia mawna sung zotpui hi."},"20":{"text":"Khatvei lai in amate ii a et hoi suang manphate kiphatsakpui hikale tu in amate in tuate sia a kiihuai milimte vawtna in zangh uh hi. Tua hu in Topa in amate haunate huatsasak hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in, “Ngamdangmite in amate ka suttolsak tu a, thukham paltante in amate hauna theampo la in, a ninsak tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Manpha ka sak Biakinnpi a mindaisak a, phalakte in sulet in a nitsak ciangin ka kamkumh buatu hi."},"23":{"text":"Na theampo buai a, ngamsung sia kithalupna taw kidim a, khuapite sia ngoltol ngamtatna taw kidim hi."},"24":{"text":"A ngilobel minamte hi munah kong paipui tu a, na innte uh amate in ka tangsak tu hi. Na biakpiakna munte tua minamte in a nitsak ciang, na mi a thahat belte in a kimuanna uh bosua tu uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Thin kiamna hong theng tu hi. Thinnopna na zong tu uh a, ahihang na mu ngei buatu uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuasiatna khat zawkciang khat hong kizui tu a, thusia lasia zongh piangin tui bang hong luang tu hi. A mu kholnate hong pualaak natu in kamsaangte tungah na ngen tu uh hi. Thiampite in mite a hil tu bangma nei ngawl tu uh a, tuaciang upate in ngaisutna a piak tu nei ngawl tu uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa khuangai in mau tu a, kumpipa tapa sia lametna bo in, tuaciang mite lau in liing tu uh hi. Na sepsa na vawtsate theampo hu in nang daan kong pia tu a, ngual tungah thu na khen bangin, na tungah thu kong khen tu hi. Hisia in, Keima sia Topa ka hina nang hong lak tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saltan zawk a kum lukna, tha luk tha, a ni nga ni in, Judah mi saltaangte ii lampuite taw ka inn sungah ka tokhawm uh hi. Thakhat thu in Vaanglianpipa Topa vaang ka tungah hong theng hi.","title":"Ezekiel ii Pathian Mukholsak A niina 8:1 — 10:22 Jerusalem ah Milim Biakna"},"2":{"text":"Ka etto ciang meikuang bang mihing pianlim khat mangmuna ka nei hi. A kawng nuai sia teng sia meikuang taw kibang a, a kawng tungsia teng sia taau nawt thiang bangin taang hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in khut taw a kibang khat hong zanin ka sam pan hong zamh hi. Tua zawkciang hi mang muna sungah Pathian ii thaa in vui sung a saangna ah kei hong khaito a Jerusalem ah hong paipui hi. Ama in Pathian a thin uuksak milim khat omna Biakinnpi ii saksang kongpi tumna sungnung ah hong paipui hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua mun Cheber Ngunhui ah ka om lai a ka mu bangma in, Israel ii Pathian ompuina a lak khuavak taang velvol sia ka mu hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian in kei tungah “A thithei mihing awng, saksang en in,” hong ci hi. Ka et ciang, kongpi tumna hui ah a om biaknatau kungah Pathian a thin uuksak milim sia ka mu hi."},"6":{"text":"Pathian in kei tungah hong ci hi, “A thithei mihing awng, a piang nate na mu ziam? Ka mun thiangtho pan a khuala vaial na ah hong not keak Israel mite ii hi sungah a vawt a kiihuai ngamtatna en in. Hi sangin a mindai huai zaw nate ngawngawn na mu tu hi”."},"7":{"text":"Ama in suumsung puanung tumna ah hong paipui a, panghawng khat hong lak hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, hi sung pan pang sulet in,” hong ci hi. Pang ka sulet a, kongkha khat ka mu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Tum in amate ii tua munah a sia le a kiihuai na a septe en in,” ci in hong sawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom tumin ka en hi. Pangte tungah ngul limte le a dang a thiangtho ngawl nganhing limte, tuaciang Israel mite ii a biak a dang nate ii lim a kisuai teng ka mu hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel mite lampui sawmsalite tua munah om a, tuate ii sungah Shaphan ii tapa Jaazaniah zongh kihel hi. Amate khat simin ngimnamtui halna khat tek toai a, ngimnamtui a hal sia panin meikhu suak hi."},"12":{"text":"Pathian in hong dongh hi, “A thithei mihing awng, Israel lampuite ii a sepkute na mu ziam? Amate a vekpi in limte taw a kidim inndoi sungah biakna vawt uh hi. Amate kam zonna hisia hi: ‘Topa in hong mu ngawl hi! Ama in hi ngam taisan zo hi.’ ” ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, Topa in kei tungah, “Tuate sangin a kiihuai zaw lai a vawtte na mu tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in Biakinnpi ii saksang kongpi ah hong paipui a, Tammuz pathian a thi hu in a kap nupite hong lak hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, tuasia na mu ziam? Tuasia sang a kiihuai zaw lai nate mu tu ni hi,” hong ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in Biakinnpi suum, a sungnung ah hong paipui hi. Tua mun thiangtho tumna nai, biaknatau le kongzin kilaklaw ah pasal kul le nga khawng a om hi. Amate in biakmun thiangtho sia nungngat in, nisuana sang nga in kunsuk a, nisuak sia bia uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah, “A thithei mihing awng, tua sia na mu ziam? Hi Judah mite in hi sungah na mu a kiihuai a vawt thawthongte theampo le ngamsung theampo a, a kizel ngoltol ngamtatna teng taw a lung a kim bua uh hi. Tua teng bek dom ngawlin amate Biakinn sung mama ah hong pai hamtang in tuate hong seam a, ka thin hong uuksak seseam uh hi. En in amate in thuak zawk mama ngawl tu za dongin kei hong selno hi!"},"18":{"text":"Amate in ka thin uuk tutna theampo thuak tu hi. Amate ka khoaikhe buatu a, ka hesuak buatu hi. Amate in a nging thei zaza au in ka tungah thu hong ngen tu uh hi, ahihang amate aw ka ngai buatu hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Pathian sia hi bangin a au ka za hi, “No, khuapi daan a pia tute awng, hi sungah hong pai tavun. Na ngalhiamte hong keng tavun” ci hi.","title":"Jerusalem Daan Kipia"},"2":{"text":"Thakhatin pasal luk sia Biakinnpi ii saksang kongpi puanung pan hong pai a ngalhiam khat tek toai uh hi. Amate taw lai at natu khat toai a, puanneal a silh pasal khat om hi. Amate a vekpi hong pai in, taau biaknatau hui ah ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel te ii Pathian ompuina a lak, khuavak taang velvol sia a om ngeina ah a om cherub te kung panin kikhaangto in, Biakinnpi tumna ah kikhiin hi. Topa in puanneal a silh pasalpa sam a,"},"4":{"text":"“Jerusalem khuapi bup sungah va pai ta'n a, khuapi sungah a kivawt, a kiihuai nate theampo hu in, a khuangai a thinngim theampo ii talki tungah tepteena vawt ta'n,” ci hi.","ref":"Tpl 7:3; 9:4; 14:1"},"5":{"text":"Tuaciangin a dang pasalte munah Pathian in, “Khuapi sung theampo ah ama zui in that tavun. Kuama khoaikhe heak vun; kuama hesuak heak vun."},"6":{"text":"Pasal huaite, tangvalte, ngaknute, nute le patangte thatlum siat vun. Ahihang a talki tungah tepteena a om pawpote thutha heak vun. Hi lai ka Biakinnpi panin pan vun,” a ci ka za hi. Tua ahikom amate in tua Biakinnpi ah a ding lampuite panin pan uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Pathian in amate tungah, “Biakinnpi ninsak vun. A suumsung sia mithi luang taw kidimsak vun. Nasep kipan vun!” ci hi. Tua ahikom, amate in khuapi sungah khua mite thatlum tu in kipan uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A kithalup saan hun sung tengin, tua munah keima bek ka om hi. Thakhatin lei ah pukin ka boksuk a, “Vaanglianpipa Topa awng, Israel ngam sungah a kinusia mite theampo thalup tu dongin Jerusalem tungah na thin uuk ziam?” ci in ka au hi."},"9":{"text":"Pathian in, “Israel le Judah mite in a lauhuai mama mawna khialnate nei uh hi. Amate in ngamsung theampo ah mihing that a, Jerusalem sia khialna lian taw kidimsak hi. Amate in Keima Topa in amate ngam nusia zo a, amate mu ngawl hi hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang amate tungah hesuakna nei ngawl tu khi hi; amate ii ngual tungah a vawt uh bangin, amate tungah ka vawt tu hi,” ci in hong zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, puanneal silh pa heak kik a, Topa tungah, “Nong thupiak bangin ka seam zo hi,” ci in thu puak hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cherub te ii lu tung san ah a kikhup siin sia ka en a, a tungah sapphire suang manpha taw a kivawt kumpi tokhum bang khat a om hi.","title":"Pathian Vaangletna in Biakinnpi Nusia","ref":"Eze 1:26; Tpl 4:2"},"2":{"text":"Pathian in puanneal a silh pa tungah “Cherub te ii nuai, a muite ii kawm ah pai in na khut dimin suang meihol kamte toai ta'n. Tua zawkciang khuapi tungah the suk in,” ci hi. Ama ii paikhiat ka en hi.","ref":"Tpl 8:5"},"3":{"text":"Cherub te sia ama ii tum laitakin Biakinnpi thang sangah ding uh hi, tuaciang a suumsung sungnung sia meeikaai in tuam hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa ii omna po ah khuavak taang velvol sia cherub te kung pan kikhaangto a Biakinn tumna ah kikhiin hi. Tua zawkciang meeikaai in Biakinnpi tuam a, leitual sia taang pempom hi."},"5":{"text":"Cherub te thaphil nging sia a suumsung puanung ngawngawn dongin kiza hi. Tua awnging sia Vaanglianpipa Pathian ii aw bang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in puanneal a silh pa tungah cherub te ii nuai a muite kawm pan meikuang la tu in sawl hi. Tua pa pai in tua a mui khat ii hui ah ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Cherub te sung pan khat in, amate sungah a om mei sia a khut taw sawkin, meikam pawlkhat la in, puanneal silh pa ii khut sungah koisak hi. Tua pa in meikamte toai in, tuaciang a paisan hi."},"8":{"text":"Cherub khat simin a thakhui nuai tek ah mihing khut bang veu a nei ka mu hi."},"9":{"text":"A kibang linlian mui li zongh ka mu hi, tuate sia kibang a, cherub khat ii pangh ah khat tek om hi. A muite sia suang manpha bangin taang a, tuaciang khat ii sungah a mui dang khat a king kitangin kithua hi.","ref":"Eze 1:15-21","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Cherub te a kikhiin uh ciang, a kiheak kul ngawlin a pai nopna pawpo ah pai thei uh hi. Amate sia a pai nopna san tek ah paikhawm tek a, kiheak a kul bua hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate ii pumte, nungzaangte, khutte, thate le a muite sia mittang taw kidim hi.","ref":"Tpl 4:8"},"13":{"text":"Hi a muite sia ka mangmu maksak sungah ka mute taw ma kibang hi."},"14":{"text":"Cherub sim in maitang li veu nei uh hi. A masa phitbel sia khuital maitang, a niina sia mihing maitang, a thumna sia tawpi maitang le a lina sia muvanlai maitang ahi uh hi.","ref":"Eze 1:10; Tpl 4:7"},"15":{"text":"(Tuate sia Chebar Ngunhui ah ka mu cherub te ma ahi uh hi). Cherub te vui sungah kikhaangto in,"},"16":{"text":"a kikhiin uh ciangin a muite in zui uh hi. Amate in leang tu in a thate a phil uh simin a muite in a zui lai uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Cherub te a tawlngak uh ciang a muite zongh tawlnga uh hi; tuaciang cherub te a len uh ciang a muite in zui uh hi; banghang ziam cile cherub te in a muite a uk uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciang Topa ii ompuina po ah khuavak taang velvol sia in Biakinnpi tumna mun nusia in cherub te ii tungsia mun khat ah kikhiin hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in a thate phalhin, lei panin ka mu tangin a lento ciang, a muite in zui uh hi. Amate sia Biakinnpi ii nisuana sang kongpi ah tawlnga zii a, khuavak taang velvol sia amate tungsia ah om hi."},"20":{"text":"Chebar Ngunhui Israel ii Pathian nuai ah ka mu sa cherub te ma hi ci sia ka tel hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate sim in maitang li tek, tha li tek le, thakhui nuai tek ah mihing khut taw a kibang khat tek nei uh hi."},"22":{"text":"A maitangte sia Chedar Ngunhui ah ka mu maitang te taw kibang linlian hi. Cherub sim in a maisang tek ah tang takin kikhiin uh hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ii thaa in kei hong laamto a, Biakinnpi kongpi nisuana sangah hong paipui hi. Tua kongpi naina ah mihing kul le nga ka mu hi, tuate sungah ngam lampui nii ahi, Azzur ii tapa Jaazaniah le Benaiah ii tapa Pelatiah te kihel hi.","title":"Jerusalem Kiningkhiin"},"2":{"text":"Pathian in kei tungah, “A thithei mihing awng, hi pasalte in a sia vawt tu ngaisutna tupna nei a, khuapi sungah ngaisutna pha ngawl a pia uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in ‘Eite in hai ngawlin innte ih sa kik tu hi. Khuapi sia an huanna beal bang hi a, tuaciangin, ei sia a sungah a omsa taw ih kibang hi. Ahihang tua beal in ei sia meisa panin hong dal hi,’ a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, tu in a thithei mihing awng, amate phat ngawlna son keak in,” hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa ii thaa in kei hong uk a, Topa in mihingte tungah hi kam vaithakte son tu in hong sawl hi: “Israel mite awng, bang veu son a bang veu tupna nei ci sia kong he hi."},"6":{"text":"No in hi khuapi sungah mihing tam mama na that zo uh a, lampite sia mithi luang taw a kidim hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tua ahikom hisia Keima Vaanglianpipa Topa in nangma tungah kong son hi. Hi khuapi sia an huanna beal hi takpi hi, ahihang tua sa sia bang sa ziam? Na thalup sate ii luangte ahi hi! Hi lai ah om ngawl tu nu hi — Khuapi pua sangah hong vawk tu khi hi!"},"8":{"text":"Namsaute na kiita uh ziam? Namsau taw hong sim tu kong puak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Khuapi pua sangah kong lakeak tu a, ngamdangmite kong aap tu hi. A thi tu in thu kong khen zo hi,"},"10":{"text":"tuaciangin note sia noma ngamsung ngal kisimna ah hong kithatlum tu hi. Tuasia ciang mihing theampo in Keima, Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A sung a omsa sia beal in a dal bangin hi khuapi in no hong dal ngawl tu hi. Israel ngam koisung po na om uh zongin, daan kong pia tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Kiimkot ngamte ii thukhamte ni a, kei thukhamte paltan in, ka thupiakte na nit ngawl uh hang ahi hi. Tuasia ciangin, Kei sia Topa ka hi hunlam nong he tu uh hi.”"},"13":{"text":"Kamsaanna ka son laitakin, Pelatiah topsuk in thi hi. Thakhatin lei ah pukin ka boksuk a, “Hi heak in Vaanglianpipa Topa awng, Israel ngam sungah a kinusia theampo thatlum siat tu ni ziam?” ci in ka au hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi. Ama in,","title":"Saltaangte tungah Pathian Kamciam"},"15":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, Jerusalem ah a teang mite in nang le saltaang a om na Israel mipuite ii thu a son uh hi. Amate in, ‘Saltaangte sia Topa a bia tu in a omna khuala lei hi. Topa in hi ngam sia ei tan tu in hong pia zo hi,’ ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tu in kong son teng sia na saltanpui teng tungah son in. Ngamdang a khuala na minamte sungah a teang tu in, a puak sia pa le ngamdangte ah amate a thethaang pa sia keima ka hi hi. Ahitazong tu hun sung sia amate paina ngam ah ka ompui tu hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tua ahikom, Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in ka ci teng amate tungah son in. Ngamdang ah ka thethaang na munte panin amate ka khawmtua kik tu a, Israel ngam ka pia kik tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate hong heak kik uh ciangin, a ninnoi a kiihuai milim a mu theampo a vawk keak tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Thin thak lung thak le ngaisutna thak amate ka pia tu hi. A thinpui suang lungtang ka lakeak tu a, thunit theina thin le lung ka pia tu hi.","ref":"Eze 36:26-28"},"20":{"text":"Tuasia ciang amate in ka thukhamte zui tu a, ka thupiak theampo thumaanna taw zui tu hi. Amate sia ka mihingte hi tu a, keima sia a Pathian ka hi tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang a ninnoi, a kiihuai milimte a bia nuam mite daan ka pia tu hi. A sepnasa tungah amate daan ka pia tu hi,” hong ci hi. Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua Cherub te leang tu in hong kithoai a, a muite in a lenna a zui uh hi. Israel te ii Pathian ii ompuina ahi khuavak taang velvol sia amate ii tungsia ah om hi.","title":"Pathian Vaangletna in Jerusalem Nusia","ref":"Eze 43:2-5"},"23":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin tua khuavak taang velvol sia in khuapi nusia in, tua ii nisuana sangah a om mual ah kikhiin hi."},"24":{"text":"Mukholna sungah Pathian ii thaa in kei hong laamto a, saltaangte kung Babylon ah hong paipui kik hi. Tua zawkciang mukholna hong bo a,"},"25":{"text":"tuaciangin saltaangte munah Topa ii hong lak sa theampo ka son hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Kamsaangpa Ngaltai khat bang"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, nang sia tualngal thin neite sungah teang ni hi. Amate in mit nei ahihang khuamu ngawl uh hi; bil nei ahihang khua za ngawl uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate in tualngal thin a nei hang ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"“Tu in, a thithei mihing awng, ngaltai khat ii vawt tu bangin vanh khat heang in khuazin ma in ding in. Mun khat nusia in mundang khat na zot sia a kuama theampo in musak in. Tua hile a langpante in nang hong phawk tha tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in nang hong mu thei natu in, khuavak lai in saltaang tu bangin na vanh heang in, tuaciangin saltaang tu bangin nitak a na din sia ensak in."},"5":{"text":"Amate in hong etcik laitakin, na inn pang tungah a hawng khat vutlet in, na vanh sia tuasung panin la keak in."},"6":{"text":"Na vanhte na liangko ah kisuanhin, na pai natu lampi na mu thei ngawl natu in na mit sawm in, khuazing sungah na pai sia musak in. Na vawt teng sia Israel te kidop natu hi tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa ii vawt a hong sawl teng ka vawt hi. Tua ni in ngaltai tu khat bangin ka vanhte ka heang hi. Tua nitak khuazin ciang, ka khut taw pang hawng khat ka vut a, ka pusuak hi. Mihing theampo mu tangin ka liangko ah ka vanh kisuanhin ka ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A zingsang ciang Topa in kei hong paupui hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in “A thithei mihing awng, tu in Israel tualngalte in bang vawt ni ziam ci in nang hong dongh tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa , Keima ii amate tungah ka ci teng son in. Hi kam vaithak sia Jerusalem a uk kumpipa le tua munah a teangte theampo atu ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Na vawt teng sia amate tungah a piang tu thute limlakna ahi sia va son ta'n — amate sia ngaltaite le ngalmatte hi tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate kumpipa in khuazing sungah a liangko ah a vanh pua in, ama atu a kitolet panghawng panin a suakta tu hi. Ama in a mit hong sawm tu a, a pai natu mun a mu buatu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang ka ngeen ka phalh tu a, a sungah ama ka awksak tu hi. Tua zawkciang ama sia Babylon khuapi ah ka paipui tu a, tua khuapi mu ngawlin a thi tu hi."},"14":{"text":"A zum naseppuite, ngaisutna a piate le ama a cingte theampo, mun theampo ah ka thethaang tu a, mihingte in thalup tu in amate zong tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"“A dang minamte sung le ngamdang te ah ka thethaang tak ciang amate in Kei, Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate sungah tawmno khat sia ngal kidona, kialpi le natnate pan ka luhaisak tu hi, tuasia ciangin, tua mun minamte sungah amate in a ngamtatnate sia bangza in thasiathuai ci sia phawk tu a, Kei Topa ka hi hunlam hong tel tu uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"A liing Kamsaangpa ii Limlakna"},"18":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, an na neak ciang liing in a, tui na dawn ciang launa taw na ci ngawksak in."},"19":{"text":"A ngam ah a teang lai Jerusalem mite tungah Vaanglianpipa Topa ii kam vaithak sia hisia hi, ci in ngam bup ah son in: amate in an a neak uh ciangin a ci liing tu a, tui a dawn uh ciangin launa taw a ci ngawk tu uh hi. A ngam uh sia bangma om nawn ngawl dongin kithiak kilkel tu hi, banghang ziam cile tua munah a teang teng theampo in thukham a palsat hang ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tu laitak mihing a dim omna khuapite sia kilalcipsak tu a, tuaciangin a ngam sia duisung ngampa kisuaksak tu hi. Tuasia ciangin, amate in Kei Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"A dei huai Paunak khat le A kidei ngawl Kam vaithak khat"},"22":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Israel mite in hi paunak; ‘Hunte papai a, thu a kison kholte taangtung ngawl hi,’ ci sia banghang lo kikik nuam hi tu ziam?"},"23":{"text":"Tu in Kei Vaanglianpipa Topa in tuasia huvau ka ci nop sia amate munah son in. Tua paunak sia ka bosak tu hi. Tuasia Israel ah kison kikik ngawl tu hi. Tuasia sangin hi bang sonzaw in: a hun hong theng zo hi, sonkholnate hong taangtung tu hi!"},"24":{"text":"“Israel mite sungah mukholna maan ngawl om nawn ngawl tu a, lam khialsak thei kamsaanna om nawn ngawl tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Keima Topa in amate tungah son tu khi hi, tuaciangin ka son babangin kiseam tu hi. Hai nawn ngawl tu hi. No tualngalte awng, noma nuntakna hun sungah na kingaisut khol tu kong sonte vawt tatak tu khi hi, kei hong son zo khi hi,” Vaanglianpipa Topa in kong ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah,"},"27":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, Israel te in na mukholnate le kamsaannate sia maisang a khuala mama hun atu hi, ci in a ngaisun uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom, amate tungah va son ta'n, Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in hi bangin ci zo khi hi: Haisaang nawn ngawl tu hi. Ka sonsate kiseam tu hi. Kei, Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo khi hi!” hong ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in hong paupui hi.","title":"A maan ngawl Pasal Kamsaangte thuak tu Sonkholna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, amate phuatawm kamsaanna a son Israel kamsaangte nalh in. Topa ii kammal a ngai natu in amate son in,” hong ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi sia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci ahi hi: “Hi a mawmaw kamsaangte a lal hi zo hi! Amate aituam ngaisut thiamna taw mu kholnate phuak tawm uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel mite awng, na kamsaangte uh sia khuapi lalcipna sungah a teang ngiate bangma in mannung ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in luphung cimhna munte cing ngawl a, ciang zongh ciang kik ngawl hi. Tua ahiciang, Israel te sia Topa ii ni, ngal hong thet ciang kihuu zo ngawl tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate mukholna sia maan ngawl a, a thu sonkholte sia leilot thu hi. Amate in kei kam vaithak hi ci ahihang, keima in amate thataak ngawl khi hi. Tua hi napi in, amate in a kammalte taangtung tu in muangmaw uh hi!"},"7":{"text":"Amate munah ka ci hi: Tua na mukhol uhte maan ngawl a, na sonkhol thute sia leilot thu hi. Tuate sia keima ii kammal na ci uh hi, ahihang no tungah hong son ngeingawl khi hi!”."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom Vaanglianpipa Topa in amate tungah “Noma kammalte sia maan ngawl a, na mukholna uhte sia leilot thu hi. No hong langpan khi hi."},"9":{"text":"A maan ngawl mukholna te le lamkhialsak tu sonkholnate a nei no kamsaangte daan kong pia tu hi. Thukhen tu in ka mite a kikhop ciang, tua munah na om buatu hi; Israel ngammite tepteena lai sungah na min uh a kihel buatu hi. Na ngam uh ah na heak kik ngei buatu uh hi. Tuasia ciangin kei sia Vaanglianpipa Topa ka hi hunlam na he tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"“Kamsaangte in ka mite sia na theampo pha hi a ci na taw lamkhialsak uh hi. Na theampo pha siat ngawl het hi! Ka mite in luphung sia suang thawthongte taw ciang a, tuaciang kamsaangte hong pai in, tua pang sia leikaang taw zut hi."},"11":{"text":"A luphung cimhtham tu hi ci in kamsaangte son vun. Buak bangin ngua ka zusak tu hi. A tungah ngialtangte hong kia tu a, vuipi thahat khat in seam tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Luphung sia topcip tu hi. Mihing theampo in leikaang tui ii kimanna sia bang ziam ci in nang hong dongh tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu in hisia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii pauna hi: “Ka thin uukna taw luphung susia tu in vuipi thahat khat, biing a beal a sun bangin nguatui le ngialtangte ka buak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate ii leikaang taw a zut luphung sia vaat thapsak tu, semthap tu le a phungkawng suang teng nguak kheetsak lai tu ka sawm hi. A luphung sia puk tu a, note theampo hong dellum tu hi. Tuasia ciang a kuama po in kei sia Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"“Luphung le tua luphung leikaang taw a zutte in ka thin uukna ii thahatna a thuak tu uh hi. Tuasia ciangin, tua luphung bo zo a, tuasia bangma in leikaang taw a zutte —"},"16":{"text":"na theampo a phat ngawl laitakin, pha siat hi ci a Jerusalem a thinmuangsak kamsaangte sia bo siat zo hi,” ci in nang kong son tu hi. Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in, “Tu in a thithei mihing awng, na mite sungah mailam thupiang tu a sonkhol numeite en in. Tuate nalh in a,","title":"A Maan ngawl Numei Kamsaangte thuak tu Sonkholna"},"18":{"text":"tuaciang, Vaanglianpipa Topa in amate tungah hi bang a ci sia son in: “No numeite a lal hi uh te! Note in midangte nuntakna ah vaang na nei thei natu uh in, a kuama theampo atu mitbum khut tuamnate na khuisak a, a kuama po ii lu tungah a khip tu in, mitbum dialnote na vawtsak uh hi. Ka mihingte tungah thina le nunna vaang na nei nuam uh a, tua vaang sia noma phattuamna tu in na zangh nuam uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Mangtaang tang tawm le anluum tawm na nga natu in, ka mite mai ah hong maimawlsak nu hi. Thi tu a, a kilawm ngawl mihingte na thatlum uh a, nungta tu a kilawm ngawl mihingte na nungtasak uh hi. Tua ahikomin, ka mite tungah leilot thu na son uh a, amate in no hong um uh hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Tu in hisia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci teng ahi hi: “Thina le nuntakna uk nuamin na hanciamna ah na zak uh khut tuamnate ngaimaw khi hi. Tuate na baan panin ka laaikeak tu a, na uk mihingte ka suaktasak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Noma dialnote ka baltham tu a, ka mite na vaangletna nuai pan a tawntung atu in, khatvei lian ka suaktasak tu hi. Tuaciangin, kei sia Topa ka hi hunlam na he tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ka liamsak nop ngawl mihing phate, na leilotna taw thinkiamsak nu hi. Mihing ngilote a siatna nusia in, a nuntakna uh a kihut natu pan na khaktan uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom, tu in na mukholna a maan ngawlte le lam hong pialsak thu sonkholte bo zo hi. Keima, Topa ka hi hunlam na heak natu in na vaangletna pan ka mite ka suatak hi,” ci hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel lampuite pawlkhat Topa ii deina dongh tu in hong haw hi.","title":"Pathian in Milim Biakna Ningkhiin"},"2":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin Topa in kei hong paupui hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, hi mite in a thinsung uh sia milimte pia zo a, milimte in amate mawna sung thet pui hi. Amate in tua thu keima in zo kik tu in hong um ziam?"},"4":{"text":"“Tu in amate tungah Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in hi bang ka ci sia son in: Israel milimte tungah a thinsung a pia peuma le tuate in mawna sung a thetpui zawkciang, kamsaang khat ii tungah thu a dongh te in, keima zo kikna khat a nga tu hi — tua in milim teng taw a kiphu zona hi tu hi!"},"5":{"text":"Tua milimte in Israel te sia kei kung pan kiheaksak hi, ahihang ka zona taw amate ii citakna hong nei kik tu in ka lamen hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tua ahikom tu in, kei Vaanglianpipa Topa ii Israel te tungah ka ci teng son in: Hong heak kik tavun a, a kiihuai milimte nusia vun."},"7":{"text":"“Israel te khat po ahibuale, Israel mite omna sungah a teang ngamdangmi khat po in kei kung pan kiheakin, milimte bia a, tua zawkciang, kamsaang khat thu a dongh le Keima, Topa in ama ii zona tu ka pia tu hi!"},"8":{"text":"Ama ka nalh tu hi. Ama sia ettee tu khatin ka koi tu hi. Ama sia Kei, Topa ka hi hunlam nong heak natu in ka mite huamsung panin ka heam tu hi."},"9":{"text":"“Kamsaang khat in theam thuakin, a maan ngawl zona a pia le Kei, Topa in ama ka theam hu a hi hi. Israel mite huamsung panin ama ka heam tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Kamsaangpa le a dongh pa sia daan a kibangin nga tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel te in kei hong taisat ngawl natu le a mawna a khialna te taw amate le amate a kininsak ngawl natu in hi bangin ka vawt tu hi. Amate sia ka mite hi tu a, Keima in a Pathian ka hi tu hi.” Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Noah, Daniel le Job"},"13":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, ngam khat maw a, kei tungah hong thumaan buale, ka khut ka vaan tu a, a an ngana lampi sia ka susia tu hi. Kialpi ka tungsak tu a, mihing le ngannote a kibangin ka thatlum tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Noah, Daniel, Job, mihing thumte tua munah a teang hial zong, a phatna in amate nuntakna bekma ngum tu hi,” ci hi. Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."},"15":{"text":"“Tua ahibuale mihing te a that tu in ngamsa te ka paisak tu a, kuama ngam sungah khualhaw in a kaantan ngam ngawl dongin ka lauhuaisak mama tu hi,"},"16":{"text":"tuaciang tua mihing thumte keak tua munah a teang hial zong — Keima Vaanglianpipa Topa , a nungta tatak Pathian ka hi bangma in — a tate ngawngawn zongh a hun zo buatu uh hi. Amate nuntakna bek ma kihun zo tu a, a ngam sia duipui suak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tua ahibuale, tua ngam ah ngal ka thengsak thei tu a, tuaciang mihingte le ngannote a kibangin ka maaimot natu in a susia thei ngalhiamte ka puak tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua mihing thumte tua munah a teang hial zong — Keima Vaanglianpipa Topa , a nungta tatak Pathian ka hi bangma in, a tate uh zongh, a suatak zo buatu uh a, amate nuntakna bek a hung zo tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"“Tua ngam ah a kilaw thei natna tungsak in, ka thin uukna taw nuntakna tam mama la a, mihing le ngannote ka thalup ciang,"},"20":{"text":"Noah, Daniel le Job te keak tua munah a teang hial zongin, Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa sia a nungta Pathian ka hi bangma, amate in a tate zongh, a hun zo buatu uh hi. Amate phatna in a nuntakna bek a hung zo tu hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Hi sia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii pauna ahi hi: ‘Jerusalem tungah a siabel daan nam li tungsak tu khi hi — ngal, kialpi, ngamsa ngilote le natna te — in mihingte le ngannote a kibangin susia tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"A suakta khat po om a, a tate a hun le na kungah hong pai ciang, na en in. Amate bangzata sia in ngilo ci sia na mu ciang Jerusalem tungah daan ka piakna sia piak tuak a hina thu tel in;"},"23":{"text":"tuasia ciangin na ka vawt peuma sia ahang pha khat om ci sia na he tu hi.” Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Sapitkung taw Sonteena"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, sapitkung le thingkung bangbangin kitee ngat thei tu ziam? Thingtaam sung a thingkungte le sapitbaak khat ih tee ngat ciang bang phatna om ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Bang khat po vawt natu in zangh thei na ni ziam? Vanh khai natu thawnkoai khat beak in na sui thei tu ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Tua sia meitawna in pha bek hi. A mongte kaanghin a lai sia meihol a sua zawkciangin, tua taw bang vawt thei ni ziam?"},"5":{"text":"A kihal ma ngawngawn in kimanna nei ngawl hi. Tu in mei in kaangh a, hol a sua seseam ciang kimanna nei ngawl zaw lai hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu in hisia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci nop teng ahi hi, “Thingtang sung pan khaungui kila in a kihal bangin, Jerusalem a teang ka mite ka la tu a,"},"7":{"text":"daan ka pia tu hi. Amate meikuang khat panin suakta zo hi, ahihang tu in mei in kaanghtum tu hi. Amate daan ka piak ciangin Keima sia Topa ka hi hunlam nong tel tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in kei tungah hong thumaan ngawl ahikom a ngam sia duisung ngampa ka suaksak tu hi.” Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui kik hi.","title":"A Thumaan ngawl Jerusalem"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Jerusalem ii a thasiathuai a sepnate lakin kawk in."},"3":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in Jerusalem tungah a ci teng son in: “Nang sia Canaan ngam ah piang ni hi. Na pa sia Amor mi hi a, na nu sia Hit mi ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na sua lai in kuama in na lai hong tan ngawl, hong sil ngawl, ci taw hong zut ngawl a, puan taw hong tun ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Kuama in nang atu hite hong vawtsak za tu in hesuakna hong nei ngawl hi. Na sua lai in kuama in hong it ngawl hi. Nang sia lozau sung a hong kivawk hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tuaciangin kei kong pai a, na chi sungah na kisaan kong mu hi. Chisan taw na kituam a, ahizong na thi tu kong oai bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Thingno ciidam bangin kong khangsak hi. A thahatin na khang tawto a, ngaknuno na suak hi. Na noai pha takin hong bawk a, na mul zongh sau zo ahihang na pumnguak in na om hi."},"8":{"text":"“Nang kaantanin kong pai kik ciang, ngual taw a kidei thei tu na hi hun hong theng zo na hi sia kong mu hi. Na pumnguaktang sia ka laktong puasilh taw kong khu a, itna kamciam kong pia hi. Hi hi, nangma taw kiteenna thuciam kong pia a, nang sia keima aa na suak hi,” ci hi. Hisia Vaanglianpipa Topa son teng ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua zawkciang, tui la in na chisan teng kong silsak hi. Olive thau taw kong zut hi."},"10":{"text":"A kizeam puantual kong silhsak a, savun phabel taw kivawt peangdap, puanneal dialkhip, naai laktong puasilh kong pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Suang manphate — haak le khite taw kong zeam hi."},"12":{"text":"Naakbaa le bilbaate, tuaciang na khuk tu a hoi mama kumpilukhu kong pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Khamh le ngunn taw kivawt kizepnate na nei a, a kizeam puanneal le naaipuan na silh tawntung hi. Anvui phabel taw a kivawt anluum na ne a, khuaitui le olive thau neak tu na nei hi. Na mealphat sia nasia mama a, kumpinu na suak hi."},"14":{"text":"Ngam theampo ah sitbaang ngawl mealphatna taw na minthang hi, banghang ziam cile a ithuai mama tu in hong vawt sia keima ka hi hang hi,” ci hi. Hi sia Vaanglianpipa Topa ci ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"“Ahihang na mealphatna le na minthanna te suangin hong pai po na luppui hi."},"16":{"text":"Na puansilh pawlkhatte na biakpiakna munte zepna in na nei a, pumpi zuak numeite bangma in na pumpi sia na sik theampo na pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Ngunn le khamh kizepna kong piakte la in, pa milimte vawtna in na nei a, tuate taw palngul mawna na vawt hi."},"18":{"text":"A kizeam puan kong piakte sia tua milimte na silhsak a, olive le ngimnamtui kong piakte milimte na pia hi."},"19":{"text":"Na neak tu an — anvui phabel, olive thau le khuaitui kong pia hi — ahihang milimte tung pan maipha na nga nopna taw milim biakpiak in na nei hi.” Hi sia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tuaciangin kei taw na nei tapate tanute la in, milim biakna in na pia hi. Kei tungah na thumaan ngawl sia,"},"21":{"text":"ka tate milim biakna in na nei bua zong, sia khop zo hi ngawl ziam?"},"22":{"text":"Pumpi zuakin a thasiathuai na nuntak sungah na no lai hun — na chisan sungah na pumnguakin na kisasaan lai hun, khatvei beak na phawk ngei bua hi.”"},"23":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Nang sia a lal hi te! Lal ni hi! Tua siatna theampo na vawt zawkciang,","title":"Jerusalem ii Nuntak sia Pumpi zuak khat bang"},"24":{"text":"lampi hui sim ah milim biak natu mun le pumpi zuak natu mun na vawt hi."},"25":{"text":"Na mealphatnate buan na noai zo hi. Hong pai pawpo kungah nangma le nangma na ki aap a, ni simin pumpi zuak khat na hi vaial hi."},"26":{"text":"A lan mama na innpaam Egypt te taw na lumkhawm a, na paktatna taw kei nong thin uuksak hi."},"27":{"text":"“Tu in nang daan kong piak natu in ka khut ka laamto zo a, nang ii tel saan ka thupha teng ka la kik tu hi. Nang hong ensan a, na ngamtat nate kiihuai a sa, Philistine te tungah nang kong aap zo hi."},"28":{"text":"“Banghang ziam cile midangte in hong lungkimsak ngawl a hikom Assyria te na del hi. Nang sia amate atu pumpi zuak na hi a, ahihang amate in nang sia hong lungkimsak peang bua hi."},"29":{"text":"Sumvawt minam Babylon te a tu zongh pumpi zuak khat na hi hi, ahihang amate in nang hong lungkimsak tuan ngawl hi”."},"30":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa pauna hisia hi: “Nang in a maizum maw pumpi zuak khat bangin hi teng na seam hi."},"31":{"text":"Lampi lian theampo tungah milim biakna tu le pumpi kizuak natu omna munte na vawt hi. Ahihang pumpi kizuak pawpo bangin sum dei na hi bua hi."},"32":{"text":"Nang sia na pasal na it taangin khualmite taw palngul mawna a vawvawt numei sia taw na kibang hi."},"33":{"text":"Pumpi zuak khat sia sum taw kithamh hi, ahihang nang in na lawmpate theampo letsong na pia a, nang taw lumkhawm tu in mun theampo panin amate hong pai natu in sumnguk na pia hi."},"34":{"text":"Nang sia a tumpian pumpi zuak nam na hi hi. Kuama in tuabang khat na sua natu in zawthawk thu taw hong vawt om ngawl hi. Nang hong kithamh ngawl a; nangma in amate na pia hi! Hi hi, nang sia lamdang ni hi,” ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahiciang tu in, Jerusalem, nang pumpi zuak nu! Topa ii hong ci teng ngai in.","title":"Pathian ii Jerusalem tung Thukhenna"},"36":{"text":"Hi sia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci hi: “Pumpi zuak numei khat bangin, na puan na sut khe a, na lawmpate le a kiihuai milimte tungah nang le nang kipia a, tua ciang, na tate thatlum in milimte tungah sangaw biakpiakna in na nei hi."},"37":{"text":"Hi sia hu in na lawmluite theampo — na etsat, na lawmpate kong khawmtua tu hi. Amate in a beamin kong kiim umsak tu hi, tua zawkciang na puante kong suut siatsak tu a, na nguaktang a na om sia kong ensak tu hi."},"38":{"text":"Palngul mawna le mihing thana taw kong ningkhiin tu a, ka thin uukna le ka thinsona taw nang sia thi daan kong pia tu hi."},"39":{"text":"Amate ii thahatna nuai ah nang kong koi tu a, pumpi na zuakna le milim na biakna munte sia amate in nuaitham tu uh hi. Amate in na nikteen na puansilh te le na kizepna suangmanphate hong laaksak in, na pumnguak tatakin hong nusia tu uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Amate in nangma suang taw hong deang tu in mihonte thawn tu uh a, a namsau te taw hong neensem tu uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Amate in na innte hong haltumsak tu a, na daan thuakna sia numei honte in hong ensak tu uh hi. Na pumpi zuak sia kong tawlngasak tu a, na lawmpate letsong na piak sia kong tawlngasak tu hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin ka thin uukna hong veng tu a, ka thim tu hi. Ka thin a uuk nawn buatu a, kong eang nawn buatu hi."},"43":{"text":"Na khanmoi lai in bangbangin hong phatvawt khi ziam ci sia na mangil zo hi, tua ciangin nasep na vawt theampo taw kei nong thin uuksak hi. Tua hangin na ngamtatnate theampo atu in nang kong liausak hi. A thasiathuai na dangte theampo na belapna in, banghangin numei le pa paktatnate vawt ni ziam?” Vaanglianpipa Topa in ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Topa in, “Jerusalem awng, ‘Tanu in a Nu suun’ ci paunak hisia mihingte in nang huvau in hong zangh tu hi:","title":"Tanu in A Nu sun"},"45":{"text":"Nang sia na Nu ii tanu hi takpi ni hi. Ama in a pasal le a tate huatsa hi. Na suapuinumeite taw kibang ni hi, amate in a pasalte le a tate huatsa hi. Nang le na khuapi puite in Hit te nu khat nei a, Amor te pa khat nei hi."},"46":{"text":"“Na u nu sia saksang ah a om, Samaria le a khuanote ahi hi. Na naunu le a khuanote ahi Sodom sia thangsang ah om hi."},"47":{"text":"Amate paina a khuani te zui in a thasiathuai ngamtat bang na zui ciangin na lungkim ziam? Lungkim vet ngawl ni hi. Na ngamtatna theampo sia tawmvei zawkciang amate siatna sangin lawmawk zaw ni hi."},"48":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Keima sia a nungta takpi Pathian ka hi bangma in na suapuinu Sodom le khuanote in siatna khaatna sia nang ii vawt za liangin vawt ngeingawl hi."},"49":{"text":"Ama le a tanute sia kiphasak hi, banghang ziam cile amate in neak tu hau mama a, ngal kilemin dai takin nungta uh hi, ahihang amate in mizawngte le a hamsia mite a awlmaw bua uh hi."},"50":{"text":"Amate kiphasak in, thinpui a, ka ngaimawk teng veu vawt uh hi, tua ahikom na heaksa bangma amate susia khi hi."},"51":{"text":"“Samaria in nangma ii vawt, mawna khialna a lang zongh a vawt bua hi. Ama sangin a thasiathuai zaw in na ngamta hi. Nang le na suapui te ih etkak ciangin, na huathuaina in amate maw hi napi mawna sel bangza in kimusak hi."},"52":{"text":"Tu in min siatna na thuak kul tu hi. Nangma ii mawnate sia na suapuinumeite ii mawna taw tee ngat ciang, amate sia a maw ngawl taw kibang hi. Tu in na suapuinumeite sia a thiangtho bangin kimusak na hi ciang, maisan liangin, maizum nga ta'n,” ci hi."},"53":{"text":"Topa in Jerusalem tungah, “Keima in amate — Sodom le a khuanote, Samaria le a khuanote khangto in, ka nuamsasak kik tu hi. Hi hi, nang zongh khangto in kong nuamsasak kik tu hi.","title":"Sodom le Samaria Kipua kik tu"},"54":{"text":"Nangma le nangma na maizum tu a, tua na maimawlna in na suapuinumeite bangza in nuamsa ci sia lak tu hi."},"55":{"text":"Amate nuamsa kik tu a, tuaciang nang le na khuanote zongh kipuuapha kik tu hi."},"56":{"text":"Na kiphatsak thei hun lai le"},"57":{"text":"a sia na vawtte hong kipholaak ma in, Sodom sia ciammuina in nei hi ngawl ni ziam? Tu in nang zongh ama bangma na hi hi — Edom te, Philistine te le nang hong ensan na innpaam dangte ii ciammuina na hi hi."},"58":{"text":"A thasiathuai zummawk thute nasep hu in na thuak kul hi.” Topa in son zo hi."},"59":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Na thuciamnate paltan a, na kamciamte ngaingon na hikom nang taw a kiphu bangin kong vawt tu hi.","title":"A kip Tawntung Thuciamna khat"},"60":{"text":"Ahihang na khanmoi lai in kong thuciamna ka kholet a, tuaciang a tawntung a kip tu thuciamna khat nang taw ka vawt tu hi."},"61":{"text":"Na unu le na naunu na nga kik ciangin, na ngamtatna sate phawk kik in, na maizum tu hi. Nang taw ih thuciamna sungah a kihel ngawl hangin, amate sia na tanute bangin ka omsak tu hi."},"62":{"text":"Nang taw ka kamciamte ka thaksua tu a, tuaciang Keima sia Topa ka hi hunlam na he tu hi."},"63":{"text":"Na khialnate theampo kong maisak tu a, ahizong, na khialnate phawk kik in, maizum leilam in na kam zongh na kaa ngam buatu hi.” Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Muvanlaite le Sapitkung Thu Sonteena"},"2":{"text":"Ama in “A thithei mihing awng, Israel mite tungah thu sonteena khat son in a,"},"3":{"text":"Kei, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ka ci teng amate hesak in: muvanlai a lian mama khat om hi, a mul hoi in a thate lian mama a, zalh in a zai in phalh hi. Ama in Lebanon Mualte ah leangin cedar thingkung khat ii dawn tutan a,"},"4":{"text":"sumvawtna ngam ah len pui in, sumvawtte khuapi khat ii sungah koi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in thingno moi khat Israel ngam panin la a, a khangsak tu tui a tawntungin a omna lei phana lo khat ah suan hi."},"6":{"text":"A kung meang a, a niam, a zai a beakin a zaam sapitkung khat suak hi. A baakte muvanlai omna sangah khangto a, zung thukte tha hi. Sapitkung sia a baak le a teete taw kidim hi."},"7":{"text":"“A lian mama, a tha a lian, a mul a saa mama muvanlai dang khat om hi. Tu in sapitkung pona huan sung sangin tui tamzaw muvanlai ii a piak natu lametna taw a zungte ama sang zaamsak a, a teete ama sang ngasak hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang sapitkung sia leiphana, a pha in tui kibuakna lo ah kisuan zo hi, a tee meang thei a, a nga nga thiam in a limci mama sapitkung a sua natu ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua ahikom, Kei, Vaanglianpipa Topa in, hi bangin ka dongh hi: hi sapitkung sia hingin a khang tu ziam? Muvanlai masa sia in a zung longhin, sapitngate thongh keakin, a baakte tattan sakin, vulsak ngawl tu ziam? Sapitkung a kaikeak natu thahatna lianpi ahibuale minam lian kul ngawl tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Hi hi, hi sapitkung sia a kisuan ma hi, ahihang hingin a khang natu ziam? Nisuana sang vui in a nawk ciang vul ngawl tu ziam? A kisuanna munah vul ngawl tu ziam?” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah,","title":"Thu Sonteena ii Khiakna"},"12":{"text":"“Hi a langpante munah thu sonteena ii a khiakna a he uh ziam, ci sia dongh in. Babylon kumpipa Jerusalem ah hong pai a, tuaciangin kumpipa le a uliante Babylon ah a ciapui kik sia amate tungah son in.","ref":"2 Kum 24:15-20; 2 Khang 36:10-13"},"13":{"text":"Ama in kumpipa innkuanpuite khat la in, thukimna khat vawt a, ama ii tungah a thumaan tu in kiciamsak hi. Ama in mi thupite luangkhaam tu in ciapui hi,"},"14":{"text":"amate in a kithukimna sia a kepcing natu le ngal thawkikna ngam ahi ngawl natu in, a khaamna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang Judah kumpipa in leedo veve a, Egypt ngam ah siphu le ngalkap honpui khat sam tu in palai seamte paisak hi. Ama in a taangtun zo tu ziam? Ama in tuabang teng taw suakta zo tu ziam? Ama in a thukimna paltan thei ngawl tu a, daan thuakna peng thei ngawl tu hi!"},"16":{"text":"“Keima a nungta Pathian ka hi takpi bangma hi kumpipa in a kiciamna le ama kumpi tokhum tungah a koi Babylon kumpipa taw a vawt thukimna paltan ahi hu in Babylon ah thi tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Babylon te in mihing tam mama a thalup natu in, kulhte vawt a, kanhte to ahikom a thahat Egypt kumpipa ngalkaphonpi ngawngawn in ngalsimna ah ama panpui zo ngawl tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in a kiciamna le a thukimna uh paltan hi. Hite theampo ama in vawt ahiciangin tu in ama a suakta buatu hi,” Vaanglianpipa Topa in ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Kei a nungta takpi Pathian ka hi bangma in a kepcing tu in ka min taw kamciam a piaksa thukimna paltan ahikom daan ka pia tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Savaipa ngeen ka khak tu a, ama ka man tu hi. Babylon ah ka paipui tu a, kei tungah hong thumaan ngawl ahikom tua munah daan ka pia tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Ngal sungah ama ngalkap phabelte kithatlum tu hi, tuaciang a thi mong teng mun theampo ah kithethaang tu hi. Tuaciang Kei, Topa ka hi sia na he tu hi,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in hi bangin ci hi: “Cedar thingkung saang khat ii dawn ka zamh tu a, tuaciang a meang moino khat ka thongh tu hi, tuasia mualsaang khat ii tung,","title":"Pathian ii Lametna Kamciam"},"23":{"text":"Israel mualsaangbel sia tungah ka suan tu hi. A baakte hong khangin a ci hong nei tu a, tuaciangin a mu nop huai mama cedar kung suak tu hi. Vacim namcin tua ii tungah teang tu a, a lim bealh tu uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ngamsung thingkung theampo in Keima, Topa ka hi sia hong he tu uh hi. Thingkung saangte ka phuk tu a, tuaciang thingkung niamte a saangin ka khangsak tu hi. Thingkung hingte ka vulsak tu a, tuaciang thingkung kote, a hing ka suaksak tu hi. Keima, Topa in son zo khi hi. Vawt tu ka ci sa te ka vawt tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui a,","title":"Mi sim ii sep tu Vaipuak"},"2":{"text":"tuaciang “Israel ngam sungah mite ii paunak a law kikik sia bang ziam? ‘Nu le pate in a thuk sapitngate ne a, Ahihang a tate a ha uh khim hi.’"},"3":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Keima a nungta takpi Pathian ka hi bangma in, Israel ngam ah hi paunak sia na lo kikik nawn buatu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihing theampo ii nuntakna sia keima neisa hi a, nute pate nuntakna le a ta nuntakna sia zongh keima neisa hi. Mihing a maw sia, a thi tu sia ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"“Mihing a pha takpi khat om ci in ngaisun tawng."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Israel te ii milimte bia ngawl hi, ahibuale a kikhaam biakna munte ah a kipia sate ne ngawl hi. Ama in ngualdang khat ii zi sia zolsak ngawl hi, ahibuale numei khat a nin nei laitak ompui ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in kuama theam ngawl, a neisa suttol ngawl hi. Sum a pu khat ii a vanh aapte pia kik hi; ngilkialte anvaak in, a pumnguak omte puansilh pia hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in a meet deina in sum pukthaak ngawl hi. A sia vawt tu nial a, thu kituu na po ah a maan in thukhen hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuabang mihing khat in ka thupiakte zui a, ka thukhamte pha takin tang hi. Ama sia thutang a, tua ahiciang nungta tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tua zawkciang, hi mi pa in tapa khat nei a tua tapa in ngual na suttol in that a,"},"11":{"text":"a pa ii vawt ngeingawl hi bang phat ngawlnate vawt hi ci in ngaisun tawng. Ama in a kikhaam biakna munte ah, a kipia sangaw biakpiakna sate ne in, ngualdang zite zol hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in a zawngte theam a, suttol in, sum a pu khat ii a aap vanhte tang paih hi. Ama doai biakna munah pai in, a kiihuai milimte bia hi,"},"13":{"text":"tuaciang, a meet deina taw sum pukthaak hi. Ama a nungta tu ziam? Nungta vet ngawl tu hi. Ama in hi a kiihuai nate theampo vawt ahikom thi tu hi. Ama ii thina tungtaang ama kimawsiat tu hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tu in mihing a niina pa in tapa khat nei hi ci tawng. Ama in a pa ii vawt mawnate theampo mu hi, ahihang a pa ngamtat bang zui ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in Israel te ii milimte bia ngawl, a kikhaam biakna munah a kipia sate ne ngawl hi. Ama in ngualdang khat ii zi zolsak ngawl a,"},"16":{"text":"ahibuale kuama nengcip ngawl, kuama suttol ngawl hi. Sumpupa ii aap vanhte pia kik hi. A ngilkialte anvaak a, a pumnguak omte puansilh pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Siatna vawt tu nial a, a meet deina taw sum pukthaak ngawl hi. Ka thukhamte tang a, ka thupiakte zui hi. A pa mawnate hu in ama sia thi ngawl tu a, nungta tatak tu hi."},"18":{"text":"A pa ahile ngualtheam in, suttol a, mihing theampo tungah siatna vawt tawntung hi. Tua ahikom ama mama ii vawt mawnate hu in thi hi."},"19":{"text":"“Ahihang, ‘Banghangin a tapa in a pa mawnate hu in thuak ngawl tu ziam?’ ci in dongh tu nu hi. A zona sia tapa in a maan le a phate seam hi. Ama in ka thukhamte keamcing a, belcing takin zui ahikom ama sia nungta tatak tu hi."},"20":{"text":"A khial a maw pa sia a thi tu sia ahi hi. Tapa khat in a pa mawnate hu in thuak ngawl tu hi, pa zongh in tapa ii mawnate hu in thuak ngawl tu hi. Mipha khat sia a pha a vawtna hu in thaman kipia tu a, mi ngilo khat in a sia a vawtna hu in thuak tu hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:16"},"21":{"text":"“Mihing ngilo khat in mawna vawt nawn ngawlin, ka thukhamte tangin, a pha le a maan a seam le ama thi ngawl tu hi; ama nungta tatak tu hi."},"22":{"text":"A mawna theampo kimaisak tu a, ama nungta tu hi, banghang ziam cile ama in a maan in ngamta hi."},"23":{"text":"Mihing pha ngawl khat a thi ciang dik sa tu nong um ziam?” ci in Vaanglianpipa Topa in dongh hi. “Dik sa ngawl khi hi, kisiik kikin nungta le oai zaw khi hi."},"24":{"text":"“Ahihang mihing thutang khat in, phatna a vawtte khealin, siatna theampo vawt tu hong kipan a, mi ngilote ii a thasiathuai ngamtatna te hong seam le a nungta tan lai tu ziam? Nungta ngawl tu hi! A pha a sepnate khat zongh kitepteesak ngawl tu hi. A thumaan ngawlna le a mawna khialnate hu in thi tu hi."},"25":{"text":"“Ahihang, ‘Topa sepna maan ngawl hi’ na ci uh hi. Israel te awng kei hong ngai tavun. Na ka sepzia sia maan ngawl hi ci in ngaisun nu ziam? A maan ngawl sia noma ngaisut zia hi zaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Mihing thutang khat in a pha nasepte tawpin, a siate a vawt a kipat zawkciang a thi le ama ii thina sia a sia a vawt hang ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Mihing ngilo khat in mawna a vawt sia khealin, a maan le a phate a vawt le ama in a nuntakna a huu ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama in a sep le a vawtte phawkin mawna a vawt sia kheal ahikom ama thi ngawl het in nungta tan lai tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaciang no Israel mite in, ‘Topa sep sia maan ngawl hi’ ci nu hi. Keima sepzia sia a maan ngawlin ngaisun takpi nu ziam? Noma ii ngaisut zia a maan ngawl hi zaw hi."},"30":{"text":"“Tu in kei Vaanglianpipa Topa in, no Israel te tungah hong ci khi hi, note khat sim ii tungah na sep na vawt uh bangin thu kong khen tu hi. A sia a kha na vawt theampo nungngatin nusia vun, na mawna in noma susiasak heak vun."},"31":{"text":"A sia a kha na vawt uh theampo kheal vun a, thinthak lungthak na nei tavun. No Israel mite banghang thi nuam nu ziam?"},"32":{"text":"Kuama a thi tu dei ngawl khi hi. Na mawnate panin, kikheal vun a, nungta tavun,” Vaanglianpipa Topa in ci hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel te kumpi tapate nii atu in hi khuangai lasa tu in Topa in kei hong sawl hi:","title":"Khuangai La"},"2":{"text":"Na nu uh sia tawpipui bangza ma a hi bua ziam! Ama in a note sia a kiitakhuai tawpi talte kawm ah khangsak hi."},"3":{"text":"A no khat khangsakin savaizia hil hi; mihingte ii sa a ne thei khat suak hi."},"4":{"text":"Minamte in a thu za in, vuum taw a sia uh hi. Thikkoai zum te taw ama sia Egypt ngam ah kaikeak uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua nu in a lametna a bo dong ngak hi. Tua zawkciang a no dangkhat khangsak leleau a, tuasia a kiitakhuai tawpi tal khat suak hi."},"6":{"text":"Hong khanthin tak ciang, tawpi dangte taw kithawlin vak hi. Ama zongh sa vai thei in mihing te sa ne hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in kulhte susia in khua te lalcipsak hi. Ama a hawk simin ngamsung mite lau mama uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Minamte in ama do tu in mun tuatuam pan pai in kikhawm uh hi; mun theampo pan mite hong pai uh hi. Amate in a sa siana ngeen hong phalh a, tua thaang sungah ama man uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Bawm khat sungah khumin Babylon kumpipa kungah paipui uh hi. Amate in a hawk a kizaak kik ngei nawn ngawl natu in Israel mualte tungah cing uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Na nu sia luihui ah a kisuan sapitkung khat taw kibang hi. Tui tam ahikom, a kung sia tee le nga taw kidim hi."},"11":{"text":"A baakte sia takin kho a, kumpi ciangkhut te a suak tu in hong khang hi. A kung in meeikaai ban tu za ma a saangin khangto a; a kuama po in bangza saang a, a tee boai ziam cisia mu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahihang a thin uuk khutte in a zung pan longhto in lei ah vawk uh hi. Nisuana vui in a ngate kosak hi. A baakte kithiaktan a; ko in kihaltum hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu in tua sia sennealngamsung tui om ngawlna lei kona ah kisuan hi."},"14":{"text":"A kung zikpi sia mei in kaangh a; a baakte le a ngate kaanghtum hi. A baakte bangma hunin takin kho kik ngeingawl tu a, kumpi ciangkhut suak ngeingawl tu hi. Hi sia khuangai la hi a; a kisa kikik la ahi hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saltaang in ka om zawk uh a kum sali, tha nga le ni sawm ni ahi hi. Israel te lampui pawlkhat Topa deina huvau a dongh tu in hong pai a, ka mai ah a to uh hi.","title":"Deina le Mihing ii Nalhna"},"2":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa in hong paupui hi."},"3":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, hi mihingte munah Vaanglianpipa Topa in hi teng hong son hi va ci ta'n: ka deina dongh tu hong pai ahi uh ziam? A nungta takpi Pathian ka hi bangma, kei tungah bangma donghsak ngawl tu khi hi. Kei, Vaanglianpipa Topa in kong ci zo hi."},"4":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, amate tungah thu tan tu in na kinging zo ziam? Tua ahile thu tan in. A taanghpupite ii a kiihuai ngamtatna te phawksak in."},"5":{"text":"Ka ci teng son in. Israel ka teal lai in kamciam khat ka pia hi. Egypt ngam amate kungah ka kilangh a, amate mun ah: Keima in Topa na Pathian khi hi, ka ci hi.","ref":"Pu 6:2-7,20"},"6":{"text":"Tuasia lai in amate Egypt ngam pan pusuapui in leitang teng po pan a phabel, leihoi lei phana ngam, amate atu ka tealsak sa ngam ah paipui tu ka kamciam hi."},"7":{"text":"A kiihuai milim a it te vawkin, Egypt te pathian theamte taw a kinitsak ngawl natu in ka son hi, banghang ziam cile Keima, Topa a Pathian ka hi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang amate in kei hong nalh a, ka thuson hong ngai bua uh hi. Amate in a kiihuai milimte vawk ngawl, Egypt te pathiante nusia ngawl uh hi. Tua mun Egypt ngam ah ka thin uuk tutna theampo thuaksak tu in ka kinging zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang tua bangin ka ngamta bua hi, banghang ziam cile amate teenna mite zaakna ah Egypt ngam pan hong pusuapui tu khi hi ci in Israel te tungah thangsak zo ka hikom tuabangin ngamta leng keima min dai tu hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tua ahikom Egypt ngam pan sennealngam ah ka paipui hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama te tungah a zui pawpo nuntakna a pia thupiak te ka nei a, ka thukhamte ka hil hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:5"},"12":{"text":"Koma kilaklaw thukimna limlakna in Sabbath tanna ka vawt a, keima Topa in amate a thiangthosak sia keima ka hi hunlam a phaw natu ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 31:13-17"},"13":{"text":"Ahihang sennealngamsung ngawngawn ah kei hong nalh uh hi. Ama te in a zui pawpo nuntakna a pia ka thukham te paltan a, ka thupiakte a nial uh hi. Amate in Sabbath sia niincipsak uh hi. Amate sennealngam ah ka thin uuk tutna taw sucip tu in ka kinging zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang Egypt ngam pan Israel mite ka pusuapui hong mu minamte sungah ka mindai tu ahikom tuabangin ka ngamta bua hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom sennealngam ah kamciam khat ka pia a, leitang po pan a phabel, leihoi leiphana ngam, amate ka piaksa ngam ah kong then nawn buatu hi ci in ka kamciam hi.","ref":"Mi 14:26-35"},"16":{"text":"Kiciamna ka vawt sia banghang ziam cile amate in ka thupiakte nial in, ka thukhamte paltan hi, tuaciang Sabbath niinsak a — amate ii milim ma bia nuam zaw uh hi."},"17":{"text":"“Ahihang amate hesuak huai ka sa hi. Tua mun sennealngam ah thalup ngawl tu in ka khensat hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua taangin, amate sungah khangnote kidop natu thu ka pia hi: na taanghpupite vawt thukhamte tang heak vun; amate ngeinate zui heak vun, tua ahibuale a milimte taw noma na kininsak heak vun."},"19":{"text":"Keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hi. Ka thukhamte le ka thupiakte zui vun."},"20":{"text":"Sabbath sia ni thiangtho khat hisak vun a, tua hile tuasia in ih vawt thuciamna ii lim khat hi tu hi, tuaciang keima sia Topa na Pathian ka hi hunlam hong phawksak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"“Ahihang tua khang kikte zongh in kei hong nalh uh hi. Amate in ka thukhamte paltan a, a zui pawpo nuntakna a pia ka thupiakte a zui bua uh hi. Sabbath niinsak uh hi. Amate sennealngam ah ka thin uuk tutna ka phawksak tu a, thalup siat tu in ka kinging zo hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang Egypt ngam pan Israel mite ka pusuapui hong mu minamte mai ah ka mindai tu ahikom tuabangin ka ngamta bua hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom sennealngam ah kamciam dang khat ka pia hi. Amate leitung theampo ah thethaang tu in ka kiciam hi.","ref":"Thiam 26:33"},"24":{"text":"Hi bang a ka hi sia banghang ziam cile amate in ka thupiakte nial a, ka thukhamte paltan in ka Sabbath niinsak uh hi, tuaciang a taanghpupi te ii biak milimte ma bia uh hi."},"25":{"text":"“Tuasia ciang thukham pha ngawlte le nuntakna a piangsak ngawl thupiak te ka pia hi."},"26":{"text":"A biakpiakna te taw amate ka ninsak a, a tapa upa belte zongh sangaw biakpiakna in ka piasak hi. Hi sia a taanghpupite ii a thumaan ngawlna taw hong zawnsak vawtna nam khat ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Ka piak tu a kamciam ka piaksa ngam ah ka paipui hi. Mualsaangte le thingkung hing te a mu uh ciang amate in tuate theampo tungah sangaw biakpiakna pia uh hi. A sangaw meihal biakpiakna le sapittui biakpiakna te in kei hong thin uuksak hi."},"29":{"text":"Keima in na zot uh munsaangte bang hi kabel ziam ci in amate ka dongh hi. Tua ahikom tua hun pan kipan ‘Mun Saangte’ kici suak hi."},"30":{"text":"Tu in Israel mite munah Vaanglianpipa Topa keima ci teng son in: banghangin na taanghpupite mawna vawt teng ma vawt hamtang in a milimte ma dedel tu nu ziam?"},"31":{"text":"Tuni dong ngawngawn in na piak ngei tengma pia in, noma le noma tua milimte taw na tate uh sangaw biakpiakna in nei in, mei sungah na halna uh taw kininsak nu hi. Tuasia zawkciang no Israel mite in kei deina bang ziam ci sia dongh tu in nong pai lalai uh hi! Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa sia, a nungta takpi Pathian ka hikom kei tungah thu bangma hong donghsak nawn ngawl tu khi hi."},"32":{"text":"Mi nam dang te le ngamdang a teang mite taw kibangin thing le suang a bia te bang suak nuam in na thin uh khensat zo nu hi. Ahihang tuabang suak ngeingawl tu hi."},"33":{"text":"“Kei, Vaanglianpipa Topa sia a nungta takpi Pathian ka hi bangma, na kidawm vun, ka thin uuk hu in a thahat khut le ka vaangletna theampo taw kong uk tu hi.","title":"Pathian in Daan pia a Maisak"},"34":{"text":"Na kithethaang na ngam theampo pan kong khoptua kik tak ciang ka thin uukna le ka thahatna kong lak tu hi."},"35":{"text":"‘Minamte ii Sennealngam’ a kici na ah kong paipui tu a, tua mun na mai ma ah kong ningkhiin tu hi."},"36":{"text":"Sinai Sennealngam ah na taanghpupite ka puavawk bangin tu in kong puavawk tu hi,” Vaanglianpipa Topa in ci hi."},"37":{"text":"“Ngat takin no kong uk tu a, ka thuciamna kong zuisak tu hi."},"38":{"text":"No sung pan hong langpan theite le mi mawte ka lakeak tu hi. Tu a, a teenna ngam le lei panin amate ka la khia tu a, ahizong Israel ngam ah ka heak kiksak buatu hi. Tuasia ciang Kei, Topa ka hi hunlam nong he tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Tu in no Israel mite awng, noma lungkim babangin om vun! Na milimte ma bia tan tavun. Ahihang kidawm tavun a, hisia zawkciang ka thu nong nit uh kul tu a, na milim biakpiaknate taw ka min thiangtho na daisak uh kheal tu nu hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ngamsung ka mual thiangtho Israel mual saang tungah no Israel mite theampo in kei nong bia tu uh hi. No tungah ka lungkim tu a, tuaciang sangaw biakpiakna a phabelte le a thiangtho letsongte nong paipui tu ka muangmaw tu hi."},"41":{"text":"Na kithethaang na ngamte panin kong kaikhop zawkciang, na sangaw meihal biakpiaknate kong saang tu a, tuaciang minam tuatuamte in a thiangtho ka hi na hong mu tu uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Na taanghpupite tungah piak tu in ka ciamsa ngam, Israel ah kong ciapui kik ciang, Keima Topa ka hi hunlam na he tu uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tuasia ciang a thasiathuai na vawt theampo taw noma le noma bangza in kininsak nu ziam ci sia na phawk kik tu uh hi. Siatna na vawtte theampo hu in noma le noma na kithasiat sua tu uh hi."},"44":{"text":"A zatak huai ka vaang ka huuk ciangin no Israel te in Kei, Topa ka hi sia na he tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile na seksolna, na ngitlona taw a kiphu in kong vawt bua hi.” Vaanglianpipa Topa pau zo hi."},"45":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Thangsang Kaanghmei"},"46":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, thangsang en in. Thangsang le thangsang taam ngam siat natu sonkhol in."},"47":{"text":"Thangsang taam ngam tungah Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci teng a zaak tu in son in: En vun! Keima in kaanghmei khat kipansak khi hi, tuasia in na sungah a om a hing, a ko thingkung theampo kaanghtum tu hi. Bangma in tua kaanghmei sia sumit zo ngawl tu hi. Tua kaanghmei sia thangsang panin saksang dong kizel tu a, mihing theampo in meisa thuak tu uh hi."},"48":{"text":"Amate in keima Topa ii hal hi ci in a mu tu uh a, kuama in a sumit thei buatu hi,” hong ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Ahihang keima in ka nial a, “Vaanglianpipa Topa awng, tuabangin kei hong vawtsak heak in! Kei sia a telhak kam soaiheamte veu pau tawntung hi ci in ngual theampo phun zo hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"ii Namsau"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Jerusalem siatson in. Mihingte biakpiakna munte siatson in. Israel ngam tungah a kidop natu in,"},"3":{"text":"Keima, Topa in hi bang ci khi hi: Keima na ngal ka hi hi. Ka namsau ka dok tu a, mipha misia a kibangin na vekpi in kong that siat tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Saksang pan thangsang dong a kuama theampo tungah ka namsau kong zangh tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing theampo in Kei, Topa in ka namsau dok zo ka hina le sot kik nawn ngawl tu ka hi sia hong he tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, na lungtang sia thinngimna taw a tamhtham bangin tau in. Mihing theampo ii hong et thei natu munah khuangaina taw tau in."},"7":{"text":"Amate in banghangin tau ni ziam hong ci ciangin, hong tung tu thu hang hi ci in. Tua thu hong tun tak ciang a mate launa taw kidim tu a, a khutte zaw in a thin letna bo tu a, a khupte liing tu uh hi. A hun hong theng zo hi; tu hun ahi hi,” Vaanglianpipa Topa in pau zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah,"},"9":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, maisang thu tu sonkhol in. Mihingte tungah Kei, Topa ii ci teng va son tan: Namsau khat, namsau khat sia kitaat hiam in kinawtthiang zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuasia kithalup natu in kitaat hiam zo a, khualeng bang a tee vazal tu in kinawtthiang zo hi. Thin lawp natu bangma om thei ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile kidop tu sawlna le daan piak natu theampo ka mite in awlmawk ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Namsau sia zak tawm thei tu in kinawtthiang zo hi. Mihing that pa khut sungah a ki aap tu in kitaat hiam a, kinawtthiang zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Thasiatna taw au in, a thithei mihing awng; hi namsau sia keima mite tung le Israel lampuite tungah a kizangh tu ahi hi. A taanglai ka mite theampo taw cipin amate kithatlum tu hi. Thinkiam in na awm beang in!"},"13":{"text":"Ka mite ka sitna hi, tuaciang amate a kisiik kik bua ahile hite theampo amate tungah tung tu hi."},"14":{"text":"“Tu in, a thithei mihing awng, maisang thu tu sonkhol in. Na khutbeang in, tua hile namsau in saat kikik tu hi. Tua namsau sia mihing a that, a lausak le a ngolum namsau ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuasia in ka mite lauthauhsak a lutusak hi. Amate khuapi sia khualeng bangin a tee vazal, a that tu in a kinging namsau khat taw in ka tawng hi."},"16":{"text":"A hiam namsau awng, na ziat na vei vaat ngawpin! A nii ngealin, ngam khat sung panin kipan khawm tu hi. Lamkaabom ah lamlakna khuam khat phut in."},"20":{"text":"Khat in Ammon te khuapi Rabbah paina lam hi ci in kumpipa lak tu hi, a dang khat sia in Judah te khuapi, kulh taw a ki uum Jerusalem paina lak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa sia lamkaabom lamlakna khuam hui ah ding hi. Koi sia tawn zaw tu ci sia a tel natu in a thaltangte lok a; a milimte dongh hi; a sangaw biakpiakna nganhing ii a thin en hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu in! A ziatsang khut in “Jerusalem” ci in a kiciamtee thaltang sia toai hi. Tua aisaanna in, va pai a, thingluangte taw a kithoai natu, ngal thotna aw au tu, thingluangte taw kongpite khaktan natu, kanhte to in kidalna vawt natu a hil hi."},"23":{"text":"Jerusalem mite in hi bang thute a um bua uh hi, banghang ziam cile ngallem thukimnate a vawt uh hang ahi hi. Ahihang hi thu sonkholna sia in a mawnate phawksak tu le a kipummat tu thu a kidop khol natu ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawkciang hisia in, Keima Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ka ci ahi hi: Na mawnate kipholaak zo hi. No bangza a mawnei na hi sia a kuama po in hong he hi. Na ngamtatnate pan na mawna uh kilak hi. No sia ningkhiin sa hi zo na hi uh kom na ngalte khut sungah kong aap tu hi."},"25":{"text":"“Nang a seksol a thiangtho ngawl Israel ngam ukpa awng, na ni, a khakbel daan na khak ni sia hong pai hi."},"26":{"text":"Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo khi hi. Na kumpilukhu le na dialkhip suut in. Khat zongh a ngei bang hi kik ngawl tu hi. Mizawngte a vaang nei tu in laamto in! A uk uliante khiasuk in!"},"27":{"text":"Siatna, siatna vive! Hi hi, khuapi sia ka siacipsak tu hi. Ahihang khuapi daan a pia tu in ka teal pa hong pai mateng hi thu a piang buatu hi. Ama tungah tua nasep ka pia tu hi."},"28":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, kam saanna son in. Israel a zawngsak Ammon te tungah Kei, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ka ci teng taangko in. Nang sia seksol a ngilo ni hi, tuaciang a khakbel daan na khak ni, na ni sia hong pai tu hi. Na ngawng ah namsau hong ki ngat tu hi."},"30":{"text":"“ ‘Namsau a paai sungah thun kik vun! Nang kong bitphuana mun, na pianna ngam ah nang thu kong khen tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Ka thin uukna meikuang leang bangin kong tha ciang note in na phawk tu uh hi. Suksiat zia a thiam mihing cizat nei ngawl te tungah nang kong aap tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Nang sia meikuang in hong kaanghlum tu hi. Na chisan sia na ngam sungah kee tu a, kuama in nang hong phawk nawn ngawl tu hi;’ ” Topa in son zo hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Jerusalem ii Khialna liante"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, mi thatte taw a kidim khuapi sia tungah thukhen tu in na kinging zo ziam? Pawlkhat te in milim biakpiakna sa a ne uh hi. Pawlkhat te sia cii le sa deinate a lungkimsak tawntung uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhatte in a pate ii zi taw lumkhawm uh hi. Amate in kei hong mangil uh hi.” Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi.","ref":"Pu 23:8; Thkna 16:19; Pu 22:25; Thiam 25:36-37; Thkna 23:19"},"13":{"text":"“Ngual na suamlupna le ngual na sutolna uh tungah ka khuttum kong thasuk tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Na tungah kong vawt tu teng ka man zawkciang na khut uh laamto zo tu in hanna, ahibuale hatna a khom nei lai tu in na ki um uh ziam? Keima, Topa in ka pau zo a, ka pau bangin ka ngamta hi."},"15":{"text":"Na mite ngam sim le minam sim sungah ka thethaang tu a, na ngitlo ngamtatnate ka bosak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuasia ciang minam dangte in no hong nomu tu a, ahihang Keima sia Topa ka hi hunlam nong he tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah,","title":"Pathian ii Thiansakna Pummei"},"18":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, Israel te sia kei atu bangma mannung ngawl hi. Ka thin uukna le ka thinsona in meikuang ii thiklom te a tuithapsak bangma in ka tuithamsak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Hi hi, Jerusalem ah amate ka khawmtua tu a, a nuai uh ah mei thut in ka thin uukna taw ka tuithamsak tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate sia pummei sungah ngunn a tuithap bangma in, Jerusalem ah ka tuithamsak tu hi, tuasia ciang amate in Topa ii thin uukna a thuak hunlam hong he tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui kik hi.","title":"Israel Lampuite ii Mawnate"},"24":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Israel te munah son in a, a leitang thiangtho ngawl ahikom ka thin uuk a ngim ka pia tu hi."},"25":{"text":"A lampuite sia a thalup sa nganhingte a hawk tawpite taw kibang hi. Tua taw kizui in Israel mite in kei hong zakta bua uh hi.","ref":"Thiam 10:10"},"27":{"text":"Kumpi zum ulian te sia nganhing a mat sate a laaitham ngia te taw kibang uh hi. Amate in mukholna a maan ngawlte mu a, thuson kholna maan ngawlte veu son uh hi. Amate in Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa kam pau hi hong ci a, ahihang Keima, Topa in amate ka paupui bua hi."},"29":{"text":"Sumhaute in ngual theamin suttol uh hi. Amate in a zawngte vawtsia a, ngamdangmite tung pan hamphatna la uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Keima in ka thin uukna taw ka suksiat ciang kulh a vawt zo tu, kulh a cipna munah ding a, amate ngam a hu zo tu khat ka zong hi, ahizong kuama ka mu zo bua hi."},"31":{"text":"Amate ii ngamtatna teng hu in ka thin uukna meikuang bangin a tungah ka thaa tu a, ka lalcipsak tu hi,” ci hi. Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Mawnei Unau Numeite"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, khatvei lai in numei unau nii om hi."},"3":{"text":"A khanmoi lai in Egypt ngam ah ngaknu thiangtho a hina bosua a, pumpi zuakte suak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A u zaw ii min sia Oholah (ama sia Samaria taang) hi, tuaciang a nau zaw sia Oholibah (ama sia Jerusalem taang) hi. A nii in ka teenpui a, amate in tate hong hinpui uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Oholah sia keima aa hi napi a pumpi zuak ma seam suakin Assyria pan a lawmpate taw omkhop tu lungngul mama hi"},"6":{"text":"Amate sia puan sandup a kibang a silh ngalkapte, kumpi uliante le za neite hi a; a vekpi in a mealhoi siphu ngalkap bute ahi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama sia Assyria uliante theampo ii zak pumpi zuak nu hi a, ama ii sikvilna in Assyria milimte a biak dongin ama le ama a kininsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Egypt ngam ah ngaknu thiangtho a hina bosua a, pumpi zuak khat in a kipat sia zom suak lai hi. A ngaknutno lai pan ma in, pate in luppui a, pumpi zuak khat bangma in a zak sa ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom a dei mama Assyria a lawmpate tungah ama ka aap hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in a puan suutsakin a pumnguak a koi zawkciang, a tapate le a tanute matsakin ama sia namsau taw thatlum uh hi. Mun theampo ah numeite in tua nu ii thuakna teng nawnsem uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“A suapuinu Oholibah in mu ahihang ama sia Oholah sangin zongh khai zaw a, pumpi zuak hi kaan zaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuanu zongh Assyria nampite, min nei za neite — a tee sitset puansilh kibang a silh ngalkapte — siphu ngalkap bute le a mealhoi khangmoite theampo atu in sikvil loklenna taw kidim hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama sia paktat cip a, a nii uh ma, a sia in ka mu hi."},"14":{"text":"“Ama sia paktatna sungah a thuksuk vaial in kidia hi. Ama sia Babylon uliante ii limte pang tungah kingelh a, a san sitset dialno khat a kawng ah sawm in, a lu tungah a kizeam dialkhipte in a thin khoi mama hi.","merge":"15"},"16":{"text":"Ama in tua limte a mu po ciang uukna taw kidim a, Babylon ah kamtai te paisak hi."},"17":{"text":"Babylon te sia ama taw omkhawm tu in hong pai uh hi. Amate in ama nasia zak mama in, niinsak ngawp ahikom a khakbel ciang ama in thasiathuai sa hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama le ama sia mipi mai ah kipholaak in pumpi zuak nu a hina a kuama theampo in hesak hi. A suapuinu kiihuai ka sak za ma in ama zongh kiihuai ka sa hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama sia a khai zaw seseam pumpi zuak khat hong suak a, a ngaknutno lai Egypt ngam ah pumpi zuak ahi bangma in om suak hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in siphu ahibuale laa tal te lanna taw a kidim pasalte taw omkhop tu lungngul hi.”"},"21":{"text":"(Oholibah awng, Egypt ngam ah na ngaknutno lai in na paktat nate, pasalte ii na noai hong sawsak a, ngaknut thianthona bosua a na tat bangin na paktat kik nuam hi.)"},"22":{"text":"“Tu ahile Oholibah awng, hisia Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii nang tungah kong ci teng hi.
