Tua na lawmpate sia cimtak zo ni hi, ahihang nang tungah amate kong thin uuksak tu a, nang hong kiim uum tu in kong paipui tu hi.","title":"A Naunu tungah Pathian Thukhenna"},"23":{"text":"Babylon te le Chaldean te theampo, Pekod, Shoa, Koa le Assyria pasalte theampo kong paipui tu hi. Tua mealhoi namlian khangnote le zaliante, a thupi ulian theampo le a zalian siphu ngalkap bute kong khawmtua uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in siphu ngalleang le vanh puakna leangte kengin ngalkaphonpi khat taw saksang pan hong sim tu uh hi. Lum le thik lukhu taw kidalin nang hong kiim uum tu hi. Nang sia amate tungah kong aap tu a, amate ii thukham te taw thu hong khen tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Nang tungah thin uuk ka hikom amate zongh a thin uukna taw diangsak tu khi hi. Na naak le na bilte hong at tansak tu a, na tate hong thalupsak tu hi. Hi hi, na tapate na tanute na kung pan la in a hingtangin hal tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Na puansilh lai hong laaikeaksak tu a, na suangmanphate hong laaksak tu uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Egypt ngam ah na om lai pan kipan na sikvil na loklenna te le a maizumhuai na ngamtatnate kong khealsak tu hi. Milimte na en nawn buatu a, Egypt ngam na lungngul nawn buatu hi.”"},"28":{"text":"Hisia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci ahi hi: “Na ngaimawk le kiihuai na sak mite khut sungah nang kong aap tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaciang amate in nang hong ensan ahikom, na thalaw sa theampo hong laaksak tu a, tuaciang na puan hong suutsakin pumpi zuak khat bangin hong pholaak tu hi. Na sikvilna le na pumpi zuakna in"},"30":{"text":"hi teng na tungah hong tungsak hi. Nang sia ngam tuatuam te a tu pumpi zuak na hi a, milimte taw nangma le nangma na kininsak zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Na suapuinu ii khuani teng ma zui na hikom, daan piakna hai a kibangin kong dawnsak tu hi”."},"32":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Na suapuinu hai panin na dawn tu hi; tua hai sia lian in thuk hi. Mihing theampo in hong maisiat in, hong nunau tu hi; tua hai sia dim hi."},"33":{"text":"Nang hong lungmangsak tu a, hong luvaisak tu hi. Tua kiitakna le lalna hai sia na suapuinu Samaria ii hai ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Na dawn tu a na dawnkang tu hi, tua hai tamhbekte taw na noai na at tu hi. Vaanglianpipa Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Tu in hisia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci ahi hi: “Kei hong mangil in hong nungngat na hi ciang na sikvilna le na pumpi zuakna hu in ngim na thuak tu hi.”"},"36":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah, “A thithei mihing awng, Oholah le Oholibah tungah thukhen tu in na kinging ziam? A kiihuai a ngamtatna te taw amate mawsiat in,","title":"Unau Numei Niite tungah Pathian Thukhenna"},"37":{"text":"Amate in palngul mawna le mihing thana vawt zo hi — palngul mawna sia milimte taw vawt a, kei a tu a hin tapate thatlum hi. Ka tapate milim biakpiakna in hong neisak hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua teng bek vawt ngawl hi. Ka Biakinnpi ninsakin, ka piansak sa Sabbath sia paltan uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Ka tate milim biakpiakna in a thalup ni mama in ka Biakinnpi ah hong pai in ninsak uh hi!"},"40":{"text":"“Amate in ngam khualana ah a om pasalte tungah kamtaite pehialin paisak kikikin samsak uh a, amate hong pai tek hi. Unau numeite nii in kibual in mitkhu vom za kinoai in suangmanphate taw kizeam uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Amate tokhum hoi khat tungah to in, a mai ah sabuai khat dim a koi naphate sungah ngimnamtui le olive thau ka piakte zongh koikhawm uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Sennealngam panin hong kipaipui pasal honkhat ahi bangma thinngimna a nei ngawl mihon khat ii aw kiza thei hi. Amate in numeite ii baan ah haak bulsakin a lu tungah a hoi kumpi lukhute a khusak uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Keima le keima ka kici na ah, palngul mawna taw a tul sa numei khat sia pumpi zuak te bangin zangh hi ta a, ka ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Amate in hi pumpi zuakte kungah pai kikik uh hi. Amate in tua a paktat Oholah le Oholibah te kung zuan kikik uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Mihing thutang te in amate sia palngul mawna le mihing thana vawt nu hi ci in a ningkhiin tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile palngul mawna vawt in a khut uh chisan baang hi.”"},"46":{"text":"Hisia in Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci ahi hi: “A lausak tu le a suttol tu in a ngilo nuam honkhat hong paipui tavun."},"47":{"text":"Tua mi ngilote in suang taw deang tahen a, a namsaute taw simin a tate thalupsakin, a innte haltumsak tahen."},"48":{"text":"Amate paktat ngamtat bang palngul mawna vawt ngawlin numei a minpiang ii a kidop thei natu in ngamsung teng ah paktat nate ka khealsak tu hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuaciang no unau numei niite — noma paktatna le milim biakna mawnate hu in daan kong pia tu hi. Tuasia ciang Keima sia Vaanglianpipa Topa ka hi hunlam nong he tu uh hi.”"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sal ka tan zawk a kum kua kum, tha sawm le ni sawm ni in Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Anhuanna Beal Kaangh Kheangh"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, tuni sia bang ni ziam ci sia at in, banghang ziam cile tuni sia Babylon kumpipa ii Jerusalem khua uumci tu a kipat ni hi.","ref":"2 Kum 25:1; Jer 52:4"},"3":{"text":"Hong langpan ka mite munah Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii amate atu ka sonteena sia va son tan: Mei tungah beal suang vun a tua ii sungah tui dimh vun."},"4":{"text":"Sabak a phabel teng thasuk vun — saliangte le sapheite — a ngu limci belte zongh beal dim thasuk vun."},"5":{"text":"A phabel tuute ii sa zangh vun; beal nuai ah thing thut vun. Tui sosak vun; a ngu le a sate sosak vun.”"},"6":{"text":"Hisia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci nop teng hi: “Mihing thatte ii khuapi sia a lal ahi hi! Ama sia a kinawt ngeingawl beal kaangh kheangh taw kibang hi. Sate bak khat zawkciang bak khat kithuuk a, khat zongh kikhe ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Khuapi sungah mihing kithat hi, ahihang chisan sia leivui ii seal thei natu lei ah keesak ngawl hi. Chisan sia suang nguak tungah keesak hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuabang a kiseal thei ngawlna munah chisan ka nusia zo a, tua in thin uuk phulaak natu suaksak hi.”"},"9":{"text":"Hisia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci ahi hi: “Mihing thatte ii khuapi sia a lal ahi hi! Keima mama in thingkangte ka sia to tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Thingkang a tamzaw lai hong paipui tavun! Mei zaap vun! A sa huan vun! Satui so kangsak vun! A ngute kaanghthamsak vun!"},"11":{"text":"Tu in taau bealhawm sia a san dongin meikam tungah suang vun. Tua hile a kheangh teng kaanghin, a kok zawkciang beal sia a ngeina bang thiang kik tu hi,"},"12":{"text":"ahizong tua kheangh theampo meikuang sungah bo tuan ngawl tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Jerusalem awng paktat ngamtatnate in nang hong niinsak zo hi. Thiansua tu in kong hanciam hangin na nin veve lai hi. Ka thin uukna a cingin na thuak mateng na thiangtho kik buatu hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in ka son zo hi. Ka dian tu hun hong theng zo hi. Na maw na khialnate ka koithong buatu hi, ahibuale hesuakna ahizong, mulkimna ahizong kong nei buatu hi. Na ngamtatna sa tungah nang sia daan hong kipia tu hi.” Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Kamsaang pa ii Zi Thina"},"16":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, mihing na itbel khat sia thakhat thu in ka la tu hi. Phun thei ngawl tu, kap thei ngawl tu, thitui zongh taaksak thei ngawl tu ni hi."},"17":{"text":"Naang in na om hunlam kuama in zasak heak in. Khuangaina lim na lakna in lukhu khu ngawl, peangnguakin vak heak in. Na maitang seal heak in a, a khuangaite neak ante ne heak in,” hong ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Zing tuungin mite taw thu ka son hi. Tua nitakin ka zi hong thi a, a khuavak ni ciang hong sonsa bangin ka ngamta hi."},"19":{"text":"Mite in, “Banghang hi bangin ngamta ni ziam hong ci hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahikom, amate tungah, “ Topa in hong paupui a,"},"21":{"text":"no Israel te tungah hi kam vaithak son tu in hong sawl hi: Note in Biakinnpi ii a kip a khona sia kiphatsak pui nu hi. Mu nuamin a en tu na pai uh hi, ahizong, Topa in Biakinnpi sia minpaansak tu hi. Tuaciang Jerusalem ah na nusiat na innkuanpui khangmoite ngal sungah kithat tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuasia ciang keima ngamtat sa bangma in na ngamta tu uh hi. Na maitang uh seal ngawlin, a khuangaite ii anneakte na ne buatu uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Lukhu khu ngawl ahibuale peangnguakin vak heak vun a, khuangai ahibuale kapin om heak vun. Na mawnate hu in na hingkiam tu a, na tau hon tu uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuasia ciang kei sia no atu lim lakna khat kong hi tu a; keima ngamtat babangin na ngamta tu uh hi. Topa in hite hong pian ciangin ama sia Vaanglianpipa Topa ahi hunlam he tu nu hi, hong ci hi,” ka ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Topa in, “Tu in a thithei mihing awng, amate kisak thei pui, a lungdamna ahi, a et nop le a haw nop, a kho Biakinnpi sia, ka lakeak tu hi. Tuaciang, a tapate le a tanute ka laaksak tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Hi bangin ka vawt ni in, lalna sung pan a suakta khat po hong pai in, thupiangte nang hong ko tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ni in na taan sa kampau theina vaang sia na nga kik tu a, ama taw thu na son tu uh hi. Hi bangin nang sia mihingte atu lim khat na hi tu a, amate in keima sia Topa ka hi hong he tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Ammon Langpanin Kamsaanna","ref":"Jer 49:1-6; Eze 21:28-32; Amo 1:13-15; Zep 2:8-11"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Ammon ngam sonsia in."},"3":{"text":"Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci teng hong ngai natu in va son tan: Ka Biakinnpi minpaan a na mu tu, Israel ngam a lalthapna na mu tu le Judah mite sal in a pai na mu tu lawp nu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuabangin lawp na hi uh kom, nisuana sennealngam pan minamte in kong zothalsak tu hi. Amate in na ngam sungah ngiaphual hong saat tu a, tua munah teang tu uh hi. Noma neak tu noai le thingngate a ne tu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Rabbah khuapi sia kalaoh khoaina mun ka suaksak tu a, Ammon ngam bup sia tuu khoaina mun ka suaksak tu hi, tuasia ciang Keima, Topa ka hi sia nong he tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Hi sia Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci ahi hi: “Na khut beangin, lungdam in na kilawn uh hi. Israel ngam na zawngsak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuabang na hi hu in minam dangte tungah kong aap tu a, amate in hong suttol in, hong phuulsak tu uh hi. Kong sucip tu a, ngam khat in na ding kik zo nawn buatu a, noma ngam na ci tu uh a om nawn buatu hi. Tuasia ciang Keima, Topa ka hi sia nong he tu uh hi.”"},"8":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Moab in Judah sia minam dangte theampo taw kibang hi a ci hu in,","title":"Moab Langpanin Kamsaanna","ref":"Is 15:1—16:14; 25:10-12; Jer 48:1-47; Amo 2:1-3; Zep 2:8-11"},"9":{"text":"Moab ii ngamngi a cing khuapite ngual in ka simsak tu a, khuapi phabel teng — Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon le Kiriathaim te ngawngawn kihel tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Nisuana sennealngam minamte in Moab le Ammon te ka zothalsak tu hi, tuasia ciang Moab sia ngam khatin ding zo nawn ngawl tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Moab daan ka pia tu a, amate in Keima, Topa ka hi sia hong he tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Edom mite in Judah tungah a tatkha phulamna nei a, tua phulamna in Edom tungah a kiphel thei ngawl mawna then hi.","title":"Edom Langpanin Kamsaanna","ref":"Is 34:5-7; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Eze 35:1-15; Amo 1:11-12; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"},"13":{"text":"Tu in ka taangko na ah Edom daan ka pia tu a, tua munah mihing le nganhing theampo ka that tu hi. Teman khuapi pan Dedan khuapi dong lei awng thong ka suaksak tu a, a mite ngal sungah kithatlum tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel ka mite in kei atu in Edom tungah phulam tu a, tuaciang Edom sia ka thin uuk ka thinsona a phawksak tu uh hi. Kei ii phulamna a thuakte bangbang ziam ci sia Edom in he tu hi,” ci hi. Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Philistine te in a taangh ngalte tungah tatsia takin phula a, ngaimawkna taw susia uh hi.","title":"Philistia Langpanin Kamsaanna","ref":"Is 14:29-31; Jer 47:1-7; Jol 3:4-8; Amo 1:6-8; Zep 2:4-7; Zec 9:5-7"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom Philistine ka sim tu a ka maaimot tu hi, ci in ka taangko hi. Philistine Zaangtam ah a nungta lai theampo ka lalcipsak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate nasia takin daan ka pia tu a, a kicing phulamna ka nei tu hi. Amate in ka thin uukna phawk tu uh hi. Tuasia ciang Keima, Topa ka hi sia he tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sal ka tan zawk a kum sawm le kum khat kum, a ni khat ni in Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Tyre Langpanin Kamsaanna","ref":"Is 23:1-18; Jol 3:4-8; Amo 1:9-10; Zec 9:1-4; Mt 11:21-22; Lk 10:13-14"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Tyre khuapi sungah a teang mite ii a lungdamin a au ngawpna thu in hisia hi. ‘Jerusalem kisaat tham zo hi! A sum vawt thahatna teng bo zo hi! Ama in ei kidempui hi nawn ngawl tu hi!’ ci in amate au uh hi."},"3":{"text":"“Tua ahile tu in hisia Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ka pauna ahi hi: Tyre khuapi awng, keima in na ngal ka hi hi. Nang hong sim tu minam tam mama kong kuansak tu a, tuaciangin amate tuihualte bangin hong pai tu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in na khuapi kulh luphungte siasak tu uh a, na tausaangte sia nuaitham tu uh hi. Tua zawkciang a leivui teng ka phiatkeak tu a, suangpi khat nguak bek ka nusia tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuipi sungah a dok tua suangpi sia tungah ngasa paaite in a ngeen uh a pho tu uh hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo khi hi. Minamte in Tyre khuapi suttol tu uh hi,"},"6":{"text":"tuaciang a namsau uh taw a ngam sungah a om khuate sungah a teang mite thatlum tu uh hi. Tuasia ciang Tyre in Topa ka hi sia hong he tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Kumpi theampo sung pan a lianbel kumpi — Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar — sia Tyre khua sim tu in kong kuansak tu hi. Ama in saksang panin ngalkap honpui khat taw siphu le siphu ngalleangte le siphu ngalkapte taw hong kuan tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngam sungah a om khuate sungah a teangte ngal kidona sungah kithatlum tu uh hi. Ngalte in kanhte to in, phungciang in, kidal natu pangbitte vawt a, nang hong do, hong nang tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in na kidalna kulhte sia sukthapna moltumte taw suu in na ngal vilna tausaangte thikpumte taw vaattan tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"A siphute ii peang pan a leang leivui khu in nang hong tuam tu hi. Siphu leangte le siphu ngalleangte paina a nging sia in a lalsa khuapi kongpite a kaantan ciang, note luphung liingsak tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A siphu ngalkapte in na lampite zui in hong nawk a, a namsau uh taw na mite that tu uh hi. Na khuam lianpite lei ah puksak tu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Na ngalte in noma hauna uh le na sumbuk vanh zuakte tang tu uh hi. Noma luphungte cimhthamsak in, innnuamte hong saat thapsak tu uh hi. Amate in a thing a suangte le suangsi theampo la in, tuipi sungah sung tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Na lasak uhte ka tawlngasak tu a, na tum uh tengtongh music awte ka thimsak tu hi.","ref":"Tpl 18:22"},"14":{"text":"Ngasa paaite ii ngeen a pho thei natu in suangpi khat bek kong nusiat tu hi. Khuapi sia kisa kik ngeingawl tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo khi hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in Tyre tungah, hi bang teng ci nop nei hi: “No hong kizawthal ciang, tuipi vaalbo ah a teang mihingte in a kithatte ii ciik auna aw a zaak uh ciang lau vadil tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuipi tungah a vak a cia minamte ii kumpi theampo in kumpi tokhum panin tuak tu uh hi. Amate in a puantual te le a kizepna puansilhte suutin, lei ah liingin to tu uh hi. Noma ii thuakna hu in a liinna thim thei ngawl tu uh hi.","ref":"Tpl 18:9-10"},"17":{"text":"Amate in hi mithi vui la sia nang hong sak tu uh hi: Khuapi minthang sia kilalcipsak zo hi! A teambawte tuipi panin bocip zo hi. Hi khuapi ah a teang mite in tuipite uk hi, tuaciang tuipi vaalbo ah a teang theampo lausak hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu in ama ii bo ni in, Tuikulhte liing a, Tuaciang a mite in tuabang lalcip na a mu uh ciangin ingh uh hi.”"},"19":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in ci hi: “Nang sia kuama teen ngawlna khuapi lalcip sa te bang kong suaksak tu hi. Tuipi thukte in nang kong khuumsak tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Mithi khua ah taanghlai a nungta mihingte kung kong puak tu hi. Tua leinuai ngam, tawntung siatna munah mithite taw kithawl tu in kong koi tu hi. Tua zawk nungsang in na sungah hong kiteang kik nawn ngawl tu a, a nungtate ngam sungah om mun na la buatu hi."},"21":{"text":"A lauhuai mama ettee tu kong suaksak tu a, tua in na bocip natu hi tu hi. Mihingte in nang hong zong tu a, ahihang nang hong kimu ngeingawl tu hi,” Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi.","ref":"Tpl 18:21"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah:","title":"Tyre Atu Mithi Vuina La"},"2":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, Tyre atu in mithi vuina la khat sa in,"},"3":{"text":"tua khuapi sia tuipi kiil ah kiphutin, tuipi vaal dung theampo ah a teang mihingte taw sum a vawt hi. Hi khuapi munah Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci teng son in: “Tyre awng, a kicing na meal phatna kisuangtaak ni hi."},"4":{"text":"Na inn sia tuipi hi. Nang hong sate in teambaw hoi khat bangin hong sa hi;"},"5":{"text":"Amate in Hermon Mual pan mangtaakthingte innthing tu in zangh hi. Tuaciang na teambaw laandial mung tu in, lamziikpi Lebanon panin Cedar thing zangh uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in Bashan pan oak thingkungte ngunkuang haw natu in la uh hi; Na teambaw suat sia Cyprus pan a laak taakthing taw vawt a Tuaciang saiha taw zeam uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Na teambaw puankhak uh sia puanneal taw kivawt hi, Egypt pan a kitak a kingelh puan hi. A khuala na panin ol takin kitel thei paih hi. Na tuipuante sia puan phabel taw kivawt a, Cyprus tuikulh pan puan sandupte ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Na ngunkuang hotte sia Sidon le Arvad khuapite pan ahi uh hi. Na teambaw naseamte sia noma mihing a thiambelte ahi uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Teambaw lettamate sia Byblos pan a kisinsak a thiam sate veu ahi uh hi. Tuipi tung a pai teambaw theampo ii teambaw naseamte sia, na sumbukte sungah vanh lei vanh zuakte veu ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Persia, Lydia le Libya pan ngalkapte sia na ngalkaphonpi sungah hong seam uh hi. Amate in a lumte le a thik lukhute sia na ngalkap innte sungah khai uh hi. Amate sia na minthanna hong ngasakte ahi uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Arvad pan ngalkapte in na luphungte hong cinsak a, Gamad mite in na ngalvilna tausaangte hong cinsak hi. Amate ii lumte na luphung tungah khai uh hi. Amate in nang hong et hoi sakte ahi uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Spain ngam ah sum na vawt a, ngunn, thik, daan le haakte la in, vanh tam mamate thena in na nei hi."},"13":{"text":"Greece, Tubal le Meshech ah sum na vawt a, na vanh zuakte sia silate le taau vanhte thena in na nei hi."},"14":{"text":"Beth Togarmah panin Siphu, ngalsimna siphu le laate lei natu in na vanhte na zuak hi."},"15":{"text":"Rhodes mite in nang taw sum vawt hi; tuipi hui ah a teang mihing tam mamate in saiha le na vanhte ebony thingvomte taw hong theak uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Syria mite in na vanh zuakte le na vawtsa na tampite hong lei uh hi. Amate in emerald suang eng, puan sandup, paak kingelh puan, puanneal pha, tuipi muanpaak le ruby suangsante sia vanh manphate leina in hong nei hi."},"17":{"text":"Judah le Israel mite in vanh leina in zungtaang, khuaitui, olive thau le hel namtuite hong pia hi."},"18":{"text":"Damascus mite in na vanh zuakte le na vawtsa nate hong leina in, Helbon pan sapittui le Sahar pan tuumulte hong pia hi. Amate in a kihuansa thik le hel namtuite taw na vanhte hong theak uh hi.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"Dedan mihingte zongh in na vanhte sia siphukungh puandap hamte taw hong theak uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Arabia te le Kedar ngamukte in na vanh zuakte sia tuuno, tuu le kealte taw hong theak uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Sheba le Raamah pan sumvawtte in na vanhte sia suangmanpha, khamh le hel namtui phabelte taw hong theak uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Haran khuapite ahi Canneh le Eden, Sheba sumvawtte, Asshur le Chilmad khuapite — tua teng theampo nang taw vanh zuak vanh lei uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate in puan hoi manhamte, puan sandupte, paak kingelh puante le a pawl iim-iam dappha puante le pha tak a kivawt khauhualte le khauzeente hong zuak uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Na vanh zuakte sia vanh puakna teambaw lianbel honte taw kipua hi. Nang sia tuipi tungah a pai, vanh ngit a kiheang teambaw taw na kibang hi.","ref":"Tpl 18:11-19"},"26":{"text":"Na ngunkuang hotte in tuipi hong zotpui ciang, nisuana sang vuipi in lei taw kikhuala na ah hong lalsak hi."},"27":{"text":"Sumbuk vanh na neite theampo, teambaw sungah na seppui naseamte theampo, Na teambaw lettamate le sumvawtte, teambaw tungah ngalkapte theampo — tuipi sungah na teambaw a lal ciangin, a vekpi bo siat mang siat hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuitaa teambaw naseamte ii auna aw sia vaalbo tungah hawl hi."},"29":{"text":"“Teambaw theampo, tu in kinusia hi. tuaciang teambaw naseam theampo, vaalbo tungah kaato zo hi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in nasia tak khuangai in, nang atu mau uh hi. a lu tungah leivui kithe in, vuttun sungah kilumliik uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Nang atu in amate a lu uh meettol a, khau-ip puan silh uh hi. Amate kapin a thin na sa mama uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Amate in nang atu mithi vuina la khat hong sak hi: ‘Tuipi sungah tu in a thimcip Tyre taw akua teengat thei tu hi ziam?"},"33":{"text":"Tuipi ngal ah na sumbuk vanhte a pai ciang, nang in minam theampo ii kitaangsapte na kicingsak hi. Sumbuk vanh na hauna taw kumpipate na hausak hi."},"34":{"text":"Tu in nang tuipi sungah lalcip zo ni hi; Tuipi liante ii taw a thukna ah a taak na hi zo hi. Na vanhte le nang atu na a seam theampo nang taw tuipi sungah na bo siat zo uh hi.’"},"35":{"text":"“Tuipivaalbo ah a teang theampo in na thuakna hu in liinglawng uh hi. A kumpipate ngawngawn lau in a maitang uh ah a launa lim kilak hi."},"36":{"text":"Nang sia a tawntungin, a mangthang na hi hi. Tuaciang leitung theampo ah sumvawtte patau siat a, nang thuakna bang a thuak thaak tu lau uh hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Tyre Kumpipa Langpanin Kamsaanna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Tyre khua ukpa tungah Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ka ci teng son in: Kiphatsakna taw kidimin, pathian khat ka hi na ci hi. Tuipite kiim uum kumpi tokhum tungah pathian khat bangin ka to hi, na ci hi. Nang sia pathian khat bangin kiheang hikale te, tuabang hi ngawl ni hi, thithei ni hi, pathian pianzia na nei bua hi."},"3":{"text":"Nangma sia Daniel sangin ciim zaw kisa ni hi, tuaciang nang heak zawk ngawl tu in thuku om thei ngawl tu in na um hi."},"4":{"text":"Na ciimna le na thiamnate in khamh le ngunnte taw hong hausak hi."},"5":{"text":"Nangma in sumvawt thiamnate taw summeet na vawt tan hi. Na hauna suangin bangza in kiphasak ni ziam!"},"6":{"text":"“Tua ahiciang tu in hi sia, Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ka ci ahi hi: pathian khat bangin ciim kisa na hikom,"},"7":{"text":"cizat a nei ngawl ngalte kong paisak tu a, kong simsak tu hi. Na ciimna le na thiamna taw na kholsa na pha theampo amate in susia tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate in nang hong thatlum in, tui taw kidim thaan ah hong puak uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in nang thatlum tu in hong kuan ciangin pathian khat ka hi na ci ngam lai tu ziam? Hong thatlum tute na maingat ciang, nang sia a thithei na hi tu a, pathianzia a nei na hi bua het tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Pathian sel ngamdangmite khut sa taw ui thi in na thi tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in thupia zo khi hi,” hong ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui kik hi.","title":"Tyre Kumpipa Zatakna"},"12":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Tyre kumpipa tungah a tung tu a seesa thuaknate atu in khuangai in. Ama munah Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci teng son in: Khatvei lai in nang sia kicinna ii ettee pa na hi hi. Bangza in ciim in na mealpha ziam?"},"13":{"text":"Pathian huan Eden ah na teang a, suang manpha namcin: ruby le diamond; topaz, beryl, carnelian le jasper; sapphire, emerald le garnet suangte taw na kizeam hi. Nang in khamh kizepna te na nei hi. Nang hong kibitphua ni in tuate sia nangma atu in a kivawt ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua munah nang hong cing tu in, a kiitakhuai vantunglalang khat ka koi hi. Ka mual thiangtho tungah na teang a, suangmanpha tee vakil te kawm ah na vak hi."},"15":{"text":"Na ngamtatna sia nang hong bitphua ni pan kipan, a sia vawt tu na kipat dong paubanna a om bua hi."},"16":{"text":"Nang in vanh lei vanh zuakna taw na komla a, hite in ngoltol ngamtatna le mawna sung hong then hi. Tua ahikom ka mual thiangtho kong nusaisak a, vantunglalang, nang hong cing pa in suangmanpha tee vakil kawm pan nang hong not keak hi."},"17":{"text":"Na mealphat hu in na kiphasak a, tuaciang na minthanna in a mawmaw khat bangin hong diangsak hi. Hisia hu in nang sia lei denna in kong nei a, kumpi dangte kidop natu in kong nusia hi."},"18":{"text":"Vanh zuak vanh leina ah tua bang a sia na vawt hu in, na biakpiakna munte sia na siatsua hi. Tua ahikom tua khuapi sia a kaanghtum tu in ka hal hi. Nang hong ente theampo in tu in, vut le vai na sua hong mu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Nang sia a tawntung bo in mangthang ni hi, tuaciang nang hong he ngei minamte theampo sia patau siat a, nang thuak sia bang a thuak lei tu lau uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah,","title":"Sidon Siat natu Kamsaanna"},"21":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, Sidon khuapi sia sonsia in."},"22":{"text":"Amate huvau, Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci teng va son tan: Keima in na ngal ka hi hi, Sidon awng; nang tungah kong vawtte hu in mihingte in kei hong pok tu uh hi. Na sungah a teangte daan pia a, kei bangza in thiangtho ka hi sia ka lak ciang, amate in Keima, Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Nang tungah natnate kong tungsak tu a, na lampi te ah chi ka luangsak tu hi. Mun theampo panin nang, hong kisim tu a, na mite kithatlum tu uh hi. Tuasia ciang Keima, Topa ka hi hunlam nong he tu hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Jol 3:4-8; Zec 9:1-2; Mt 11:21-22; Lk 10:13-14"},"24":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel te nunau a, a zawnsak vawt kiim le paam ah minamte sia Israel te a na sak tu ling le lingkung te taw a kibang kik nawn buatu uh hi. Tuaciang amate in kei sia Vaanglianpipa Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi,” ci hi.","title":"Israel Thupha Kipia tu"},"25":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Israel mite ka thethaang na ngamte panin ka ciapui kik tu a, tuaciang minamte theampo in Keima sia, a thiangtho ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi. Ka naseampa Jacob tungah ka piak ngam ahi amate ii ngam ma ah Israel mite teang tu uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua munah amate sia ngam muangin teang tu uh hi. Amate in inn sa in sapithuan vawt tu uh hi. Amate a zawnsak vawt a ngampaamte theampo sia daan ka pia tu a, Israel te sia ngam muangin om tu uh hi. Tuasia ciang amate in, Kei sia Topa, a Pathian ka hi sia hong he tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sal ka tan zawk uh kum sawm kum, tha sawm le ni sawm le ni nii, ni in Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Egypt Langpanin Kamsaanna","ref":"Is 19:1-25; Jer 46:2-26"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Egypt kumpipa sonsia in. Ama le Egypt ngam leitang theampo daan ka pia tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi thu Vaanglianpipa Topa ii Egypt kumpipa tungah a ci ahi hi: Ngun sungah a om awle pui awng, kei sia nangma ii ngal ka hi hi. Nile ngun sia nangma vawt sa hi a, nangma neisa hi na ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Na kha ngu pailetin, thikkoai taw kong sun tu a, na ngun sungah a om ngasate nangma tungah kong belcipsak tu hi. Tua zawkciang na tungah hong bel ngasa theampo taw Nile ngun sung pan kong kaito tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Sennealngam sungah tua ngasa theampo taw kong vawk khawm tu hi. Na luang sia lei ah kisial tu a, kiphum ngawlin kinusia tu hi. Vacimte le nganhingte an tu in na luang ka pia tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Egypt mite theampo in Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi. Topa in, “Israel te in no Egypt mite sia amate a hu tu in hong suang hi; ahihang note in ciangkang tak ngawl khat sangin na phazaw bua uh hi.","ref":"Is 36:6"},"7":{"text":"Amate in nang hong neal ciang na taltan tu a, a lenuai sunlet in, a cingzaang na kithiaksak hi”."},"8":{"text":"Tu in, Kei, Vaanglianpipa Topa in kong son a, namsau taw no kong simsak tu a, na mite le na nganhingte hong thalupsak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt ngam sia a kolh ngamtongta suak tu hi. Tuasia ciang, Topa ka hi hunlam nong he tu uh hi. “Nile ngun sia nangma vawt sa nangma neisa ci na hikom in,"},"10":{"text":"keima in nang le na Nile ii ngalpa ka hi hi. Egypt ngam theampo saksang Migdol khuapi pan kipan thangsang Aswan khuapi ah, Ethiopia ngamngi dongin, ngamtongta ka suaksak tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihing ahizong, nganhing ahizong, tua ngam kaantan in pai ngawl tu hi. Kum sawmli sung tua ngam ah kuama teang ngawl tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Egypt ngam sia a kinusia cip, leitung bup a ngamkhing belin ka vawt tu hi. Kum sawmli sung Egypt ngam khuapite sia khuapi dang pawpo sangin a lalcip zaw suak tu hi. Egypt mite ngaltaite ka suaksak tu hi. Amate ngam theampo ah tai in midangte kawm ah teang tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Kum sawmli zawkciang Egypt mite ka thethaang na minamte kung panin ka kaikhawm kik tu a,"},"14":{"text":"Egypt ngam thang sang, amate ten cilna munah ka teangsak tu hi. Tua munah amate sia kumpi thazawm ngam khat hi tu a,"},"15":{"text":"kumpi ngam theampo sung pan a thazawmbel suak tu hi, amate in minam dangte uk kik ngei nawn ngawl tu uh hi. Ngam thupi ngawl mama in vawt tu ka hikom minam dang kuama zongh amate dei bangin zuisak zo ngawl tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel in Egypt sia suan le muan in nei kik ngei nawn ngawl tu hi. Egypt ii thuakna in amate a suan a muan sia khial ahi hunlam, Israel a phawksak tu hi. Tuasia ciang Israel in Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ka hi hunlam hong phawk tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Sal ih tan zawk kum kul le kum sali na, a tha masabel, ni khat ni in Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Nebuchadnezzar Kumpipa in Egypt ngam Zo tu"},"18":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in Tyre khua sim hi. A ngalkapte vanh ngit leilam a puaksak hu in, a sam uh zuukin a lutol a, a liangkote kokkeak hi, ahihang tua ngimna thaman a kumpipa le a ngalkapte in bangma leaplaw a nei bua uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom tu in Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in ci khi hi: Egypt ngam leitang Nebuchadnezzar kumpipa pia khi hi. Ama in Egypt hauna theampo suttol in laaksak tu a, a ngalkaphonpi thasum tu in ciapui tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Egypt ngam sia ama ii sepna thaman in ka pia hi; banghang ziam cile, a ngalkaphonpi in kei atu seam hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo khi hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tua thu hong pian ciang Israel mite ka thahatsak tu hi, Ezekiel awng, ngual theampo ii hong zaak thei natu mun panin thu kong sonsak tu a, tuasia ciang keima sia Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in keima hong paupui kik hi.","title":"in Egypt Daan pia tu"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, kamsaang in a, Keima Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci teng taangko in. Hi kammalte au in son in: A lauhuai ni hong tung tu hi!"},"3":{"text":"A ni hong nai zo hi, Topa ii a dian tu ni hong nai zo hi. Minamte atu in meeikaai ni le ngimna ni hi."},"4":{"text":"Egypt ngam ah ngal om tu a, Ethiopia ngam ah thinngimna lianpi om tu hi. Egypt ah om mite tam mama kithatlum tu hi: A ngam kisuttol in, A lal in kinusia tu hi."},"5":{"text":"“Tua ngal in Ethiopia, Lydia, Libya, Arabia, Kub ngamte pan a kicial ngalkapte, tuaciang, ka mite sung pan ngawngawnin a that tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in, “Saksang Migdol khua pan thangsang Aswan khua dong, Egypt ngam a huute theampo ngal sungah kithatlum tu hi. A kiphasak Egypt ngalkaphonpi kilalcipsak tu hi, Keima Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo khi hi."},"7":{"text":"A ngam sia leitung ah a ngamtongtabel suak tu a, a khuapite theampo a lalcip sa in kinusia tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Egypt mei taw ka hal a, ngam huute theampo a kithalup ciang, amate in keima sia Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua ni hong thengin Egypt ngam a siat ciang in, bangma khua phawk ngawlin a om Ethiopia mite a phawng tu in thupuakte teambaw taw ka paisak tu hi, amate sia liinglawngin lau mama tu uh hi. Tua ni hong theng tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar zanghin Egypt ii hauna ka bosak tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama le cizat nei ngawl a ngalkaphonpi sia, ngam susia tu in hong pai tu hi. Amate in namsau taw Egypt sim tu a, tua ngam sia mithiluang taw kidim tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Nile nguntui ka kangsak tu a, mi ngilote khutnuai ah Egypt ka koi tu hi. Ngamdangmite in tua ngam bup susia tu hi. Keima Vaanglianpipa Topa in ka son zo hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Memphis ah a om milimte le pathian maan ngawl te ka susia tu hi. Egypt a uk tu kuama a om nawn buatu a, mihing theampo ka lausak vadil tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Egypt thangsang teng ngamtongta ka suaksak tu a, saksang Zoan khuapi mei taw ka hal tu hi. Thebes khuapi daan ka pia tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt ii a kulh lian Pelusium khuapi in ka thin uukna ka he sak tu hi. Thebes ii nei le lamh teng ka siasak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Egypt meitaw ka hal tu a, tua ciang Pelusium sia ngimna nasia thuak tu hi. Thebes luphung te kisiatham tu a, tua khuapi ah namthuam tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Heliopolis khuapi le Bubastis khuapi tangvalte ngal sungah thi tu a, a dang teng thongtaak tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate ii kiphatsakpui Egypt vaangletna le thahatna ka bosak ciang, Tahpanhes khuapi sia khuazing tu hi. Meeikaai khat in Egypt tuam tu hi, tua ciang a khuapi teng theampo sungah mite thongtaak siat tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Egypt sia hi bangin daan ka piak ciang, amate in Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Sal a ih om zawk kum sawm le kum khat na a tha masabel, ni sali ni in Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Egypt Kumpipa Vaangletna Siatham"},"21":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Egypt kumpipa khut ka thiaktan zo hi. A khut dam kik a, namsau a toai kik zawk natu in kuama in a khut tuamsak ngawlin, puan taw zong kuasak ngawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahiciang tu in hi sia Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci ahi hi: Egypt kumpipa ngal ka hi hi. A khutte ngeal — a dam lai sia le a talsa sia — ka thiatansak tu a, a khut sung pan namsau hong taak tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Egypt te leitung mun theampo ah ka thethaang tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Babylon kumpipa ii khut a tha ka hatsak tu a, ka namsau a khut sungah ka koi tu hi. Ahihang Egypt kumpipa khut ka thiaktan tu a, a ngalte mai ah tau in a thi tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Hi hi, ama ii tha ka kiamsak tu a, Babylon kumpipa ka thahatsak tu hi. Ka namsau ama ka pia a, ama in Egypt ngam sang a ngat tak ciang ngual theampo in Topa ka hi hunlam he tu uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Egypt te leitung mun theampo ah ka thethaang tu hi. Tuasia hun ciang, Topa ka hi hunlam amate in hong he tu uh hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sal ih tan zawk kum sawm le kum khatna, a tha thum zawk ni masabel ni in Topa in keima hong paupui hi.","title":"Egypt ngam le Cedar Thingkung Kiteengat"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Egypt kumpipa tung le a mite theampo tungah hi bangin son in: Bangza in thahat ni ziam! Nang bang taw hong teengat thei tu khi ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Lebanon ngam a cedar thingkung taw na kibang hi. Tua thingkung ii baakte hoi a, a teete boai hi, Saang mama in van ah meeite banto hi."},"4":{"text":"A khangtosak tu tui om a, Tui a pia tu leinuai ngunte om hi. Tuate in a pona munah tui buak a, Duisung thing pona theampo ah luite puak hi."},"5":{"text":"Tui kham ahikom, thingkung dangte sangin saang zaw hi. A baakte ziing in sau hi."},"6":{"text":"Vacim namcin in a baakte tungah a bute vawt uh hi; A lim nuai ah ngamsate in no nei uh hi; Leitung minamte in a lim bealhin tawlnga uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangza ta in tua thingkung etlawm ziam — A kung saang mama in tuabang baak saute nei hi. A zungte in a thukna a, a luang tuite bansuk hi."},"8":{"text":"Pathian huan sungah a om cedar thingkung taw kitee ngat thei ngawl hi. Tuabangin baak a nei taakthing om ngeingawl hi. Tuaciang tua bang a meang pha a nei thing ngil om ngawl hi. Pathian ii neisa huan sungah a hoi zaw dang om ngawl hi.","ref":"Pian 2:9"},"9":{"text":"A et hoi tu in keima in a baakte ka zaamsak hi. Pathian ii huan Eden ah om thingkungte theampo ii du ngawk ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"“Tu in Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in van ah meei a banto dongin a saang, tua thingkung tungah bang piang tu ziam kong son tu hi. Saangto vaial in khangto a, kiphasak vaial hi;"},"11":{"text":"tua ahikom, ama ka nial zo a, ngamdang kumpi khat in ka tangsak tu hi. Ama in a ngitlona taw kiphu in tua thingkung tungah vawt tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Cizat nei ngawl ngamdangmite in phuk in nusia tu hi. A baakte le a zikpi taltante sia ngamsung mual tung le kuam theampo ah taak tu hi. A lim nuai a bealh ngei minam theampo in paisan tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Vacimte tua a puksa thingkung tungah hong to tu a, ngamsate in a baakte tung tawn tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom, tu pan kipan bangza po in tui kham hikale thingkung khat zongh, tua tan a saang mama in khangto ngawl tu a, van ah meei kaanto in a dokto kik nawn buatu hi. A thithei mihingte bangin lalin thi siat tu a, mithi khua a zuansukte taw tonkhawm tu uh hi.”"},"15":{"text":"Hi sia in Vaanglianpipa Topa ci ahi hi: “Mithite khua ah tua thingkung a zot ciangin, heena lim lakna in leinuai tuite in ka tuamsak tu hi, Ngunte khak in luite tam ma ka luangsak nawn buatu hi. Thingkung thi zo ahikom Lebanon mualte tungah khua ka zingsak tu a, tua duisung ah a po thingkungte theampo ka vulsak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Mithi khua ah ka puaksuk ciang tua thingkung puksuk nging sia in minamte liingsak tu hi. Eden huan thingkung theampo le leinuai a theng sa tui pha tak a kibuak Lebanon thingkung deiteal theampo in ama ii puksuk hangin a lungdam tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate sia mithi khua a zuan sate kungah ama taw paikhawm tu uh hi. Tuaciang tuasia ii limh nuai bealhin a nungta theampo minamte sungah kithethaang tu hi."},"18":{"text":"“Tua thingkung sia Egypt kumpipa le a ngammite theampo ahi hi. Eden huan sung thingkung ngawngawn amate bangin saangin thupisakhuai ngawl hi. Ahihang tu in Eden huan thingkungte bangma in mithi khua ah paisuk tu a, ngalsung a thite le Pathianzia a hi ngawlte taw omkhawm tu uh hi. Keima ka pau zo hi,” Vaanglianpipa Topa in ci hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ih sal tan zawk kum sawm le kum nii kum, tha sawm le tha nii, a ni masabel ni in Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Egypt Kumpipa Awle khat taw kiTeengat"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Egypt kumpipa tungah hi bangin a ciliap huai kidop natu thupia in. Keima thupuak sia son in: Minamte sungah tawpi khat bangin na diang a, ahizong nang sia ngun sungah a kipeak awle khat taw na kibang zaw hi. Na peangte taw tui na nusak ngawp a, ngunte na ninsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Minam tam ma hong kikhop uh ciang, ka ngeen taw kong paai tu a, tua ngeen sia amate in vaalbo ah ka kaisak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Lei ah nang kong vawk tu a, leitung vacimte le nganhingte theampo sia na sa ne tu in ka kaikhawm tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Mualte le zaangkuamte a muat sa na luang taw ka dimsak tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Mualte tungah kizel in luamte a dim dong na chisan ka buasak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang kong lalsak ciang, van ka seal tu a, aksi te ka mitsak tu hi. Ni sia meei in ka liasak tu a, tha taang ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Is 13:10; Mt 24:29; Mk 13:24-25; Lk 21:25; Tpl 6:12-13; 8:12"},"8":{"text":"Vantung ah khuavak taang theampo ka sumit tu a, na leitung sia khua ka zingsak ek tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in ka son zo hi."},"9":{"text":"“Na zaak ngeingawl ngamte tungtawnin, na lalcip na thu ka thansak ciang, minam tam mama a thinngim tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang tung kong vawtnate hu in minam tam mama liinglawng tu uh hi. Ka namsau ka vik ciang kumpite lau in liing tu uh hi. Na puk ni ciangin tuate theampo in amate ii nuntak natu patau in liing tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in Egypt kumpipa tungah, “Babylon kumpipa namsau ngal na thuak tu hi."},"12":{"text":"A ngilo ngamte pan ngalkapte in a namsaute taw na mite theampo ka thatsak tu hi. Na mite theampo le na kiphatsak pui a dang nate theampo ka lalsak tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tui omna po ah a taa na ngannote kong ngawlupsak tu hi. Tui a nusak kik tu mihing le ngannote om nawn ngawl tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Na tuite ka ciim sitsetsak tu a na ngunte thim takin ka luangsak tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa pau zo khi hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt ngam sia ngamtongta suaksak in, a sungah a teang theampo ka lal siatsak ciang Keima, Topa ka hi hunlam amate in hong he tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Hi a ciliap huai kidop natu ka thu piak sia mithi vuina la suak tu hi. Ngam theampo pan numeite in Egypt le a mite theampo a tu a khuangaina a lakna in tua lasa tu uh hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in pau zo khi hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Sal ih tan zawk kum sawm le kum ni kum a tha masabel ni sawm le ni nga ni in Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Mithite Khua"},"18":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, a tam mama Egypt mi theampo atu in khuangai in na om in. Amate sia a thahat minamte taw mithi khua ah puaksuk in."},"19":{"text":"Amate tungah hi bangin va son tan: Ngualdang khat pawpo sangin na mealhoi zaw sa nu ziam? Mithi khua ah na tuaksuk tu uh a Pathianzia a he ngawlte sung tua mun ah na lum tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"“Ngal sungah a thite taw Egypt mite thi tu uh hi. Amate theampo a that tu in namsau khat kinging khol zo hi."},"21":{"text":"Ngalhang belh te le Egypt te sang pan a dote in mithi khua pan Egypt te a muak uh hi. Amate in: ‘Pathianzia a he ngawl ngal sungah a kithatte hong paisuk in hi sungah lum uh hi!’ ci in au uh hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tua munah Assyria om a, a ngalkapte thaan in kiim uum hi. Amate ngal sungah kithat siat a,"},"23":{"text":"amate thaan sia mithi khua a thuk belna munah om hi. A ngalkapte theampo ngal sungah thi a, ama thaan sia ngalkapte thaan in kiim uum hi. Ahihang khatvei hunlai in amate in a nungtate ngam liinglawngsak uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua munah Elam om a, a ngalkapte thaan in kiim uum hi. Amate ngal sungah kithat siat a, vunteap at ngawl ma in mithi khua ah tuaksuk uh hi. A nuntak lai in ngual lauthawngsak a, ahihang tu in mindai in thi uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Elam sia ngal sungah a thite taw lum a, a ngalkap thite thaan in kiim uum hi. Amate theampo vunteap ki at ngawlin ngal sungah a thite vive ahi uh hi. A nuntak lai in ngual lauthawngsak a, ahihang tu in amate thi in a maimawl in ngalsung a thite taw kisial khawm hi."},"26":{"text":"“Tua munah Meshech le Tubal te om a, a ngalkapte thaan teng a kiim ah om uh hi. Amate theampo vunteap ki at ngawlin ngal sungah a thite vive ahi uh hi. Ahihang, khatvei hunlai in amate in a nungtate liinglawngsak uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Amate sia mithi khua ah ngalhiam kicing taw pai in a namsaute lukhamin kineisak a, a lumte a pum tungah a kikoi, taanghlai ngalhangte bangin zatakna taw kiphum ngawl hi. Hi ngalhangte sia khatvei hunlai in a nungtate a liinglawngsak khom tu in a tha uh hat hi."},"28":{"text":"“Tuabangin Egypt te sia ngal sungah a kithat, vunteap at ngawlte sungah kisucip tu uh hi."},"29":{"text":"“Edom sia a kumpite le a ukte taw tua munah om hi. Amate sia a thahat ngalkapte hi a, ahihang tu in ngal sungah a kithat, vunteap at ngawl ngalkapte taw mithi khua ah lum uh hi."},"30":{"text":"“Saksang kumpipa tate theampo tua munah om a, Sidon te zongh tua mun ma ah om uh hi. A thahatna in khatvei lai in ngual liinglawngin lausak ngei hi, ahihang tu in amate sia ngalsung a thite taw vunteap at ngawlin mindai in kiphum khawm uh hi. Amate in mithi khua ah a paisukte taw a kibangin mindaina thuak khawm uh hi."},"31":{"text":"“Ngal sungah a kithatte a mu uh ciang Egypt kumpipa le a ngalkaphonpi in dik a sa tu uh hi,” Vaanglianpipa Topa in ci hi."},"32":{"text":"“A nungta te liinglawngsak tu in Egypt kumpipa ka sawl ahi hi. Ahihang ama le a ngalkaphonpi theampo sia kithatlum tu a, ngal sungah a thi, vunteap at ngawlte theampo taw kisial tu hi.” Vaanglianpipa Topa pau zo hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in keima hong paupui hi.","title":"Pathian in Ezekiel Ngalvil nasep pia (Ezekiel 3:16-21)"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, ngam khat tungah ngal ka thetsak ciang bang suak tu ci thu na mite son in. Tua ngammite in amate sung pan ngalvil tu khat teal uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ngalte hong nai a mu ciang a kidop thei natu in ama in patau daak tum hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua sia za napi khat po in awlmawk ngawl a, ngalte hong pai in ama a that le ama ii thina sia ama ii mawna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama khialna hu in ama thi hi, banghang ziam cile a kidop natu patau daak sia thusim ngawl hi. Thusim hi ka pole ama suakta tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahizong ngalvilpa in ngalte hong pai mu napi, patau daak a tum buale ngalte hong pai in tua mawneite that tu uh hi, ahihang mawneite thina sia ngalvilpa ka mawsak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tu in, a thithei mihing awng, nang Israel minam ii ngalvilpa in kong koi hi. Nang tungah kidop natu thu kong piak pawpo sia amate zasak sawn tu ni hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihing ngilo khat a thi tu in ka taangko a, ahizong a nuntakna a ngup thei natu a ngamtatna kikhealin a kidop natu na son bua ahile, ama sia mimaw khat ma in a thi tu hi, tuaciang ama ii thina sia nang hang a hi tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing ngilo khat kidop natu thu na son a, ahihang a mawna kheal ngawlin mimaw khat ma in thi tu hi, ahihang nang nuntakna hong kikhoaikhe tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in keima hong paupui hi. Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Israel te tungah amate ci teng son kik in: ‘Eite ii ih vawtsa ih mawna le ih khialna vanhngit te ih pua hi. Ih tha bo hi, bangbang nungta thei tu hi ziam?’","title":"Mi sim ii sep tu Vaipuak"},"11":{"text":"Amate tungah son in a, Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in a nungta takpi Pathian ka hi bangma in, mawnei te a thi ka mu sia lungdamin ka nei bua hi. A mawna kikheal in a nuntak tu ka dei zaw hi. Israel awng, na tatsiatna pan kheal in. Banghang thi nuam ni ziam?"},"12":{"text":"“A thithei mihing awng, tu in Israel te tungah mihing pha khat in mawna khialna a vawt le a pha a sepnate in ama ngum zo ngawl tu hi. Mi ngilo khat in siatna a vawt nawn buale ama daan kipia ngawl tu a, mipha khat in mawna vawt tu a kipan le a nuntakna kikhoaikhe ngawl tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Mipha khat po tungah nuntakna kamciam pia thei khi hi, ahihang ama in a pha a vawt sate kicing zo sa in, mawna a vawt le phatna a vawt sate peuma ka tepteesak nawn buatu hi. A mawnate hu in ama thi tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi ngilo khat po thi tu hi ci in a kidop natu sonkhol zo ka hihang, ama in mawna vawt nawn ngawlin a maan le a pha nate a vawt le —"},"15":{"text":"sonteena in, a sum pukthaak manin a laak vanhte pia kikin a nguk sa vanhte a pia kik le — mawna a vawt kheal in, nuntakna a pia thukhamte a zui le ama thi ngawl tu a, nungta tu hi."},"16":{"text":"A vawt sa mawna khialna te ka maisak tu a, a maan le a pha a vawtte hu in ama nungta tu hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tuaciang na mite in ka vawt sia maan ngawl hi hong ci hi! Hi ngawl hi, amate pai zia a maan ngawl hi zaw hi."},"18":{"text":"A thutang khat in a pha a vawt tawlnga in a sia a vawt le tua hu in ama thi tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi ngilo khat in a mawna kheal in, a maan le a pha a vawt le a nuntakna ngum zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahihang Israel te awng, ka vawt sate maan ngawl hi nong ci uh hi. Keima in na sepna bangin thu kong khen tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ih sal tan zawk kum sawm le kum nii kum a ni nga ni in, Jerusalem khua pan hong suakta khat in Jerusalem khuapi bo zo hi ci in hong son hi.","title":"Jerusalem khua Bona Thu","ref":"2 Kum 25:3-10; Jer 39:2-8; 52:4-14"},"22":{"text":"Ama hong pai ma a zei nitakin, Topa ii nasia takin hong ompui na ka phawk hi. A zing ciang zingsang in tua pa hong thet ciang, Topa in kampau theina vaang hong pia kik hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Mihingte Mawna Khialnate"},"24":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Israel ngam sungah a siacip sa khuapite sungah a teang mite in: ‘Abraham sia mihing khat bek hi a, ama tungah ngam bup kipia hi. Ei, mihing tam mama ih hiciang, tu in tua ngam sia eima ngam ahi hi,’ ci uh hi."},"25":{"text":"“Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci teng amate son in: A chi thai ngawl lai sa na ne uh hi. Milimte na bia uh hi. Mihing na that uh hi. Hi leitang sia koma neisa hi ci in, bang in hong ngaisunsak ziam?"},"26":{"text":"Na namsaute suang nu hi. Na ngamtatna uh thasiathuai hi. Mihing theampo in palngul mawna vawt nu hi. Hi leitang sia noma neisa hi ci in, bang in hong ngaisunsak ziam?"},"27":{"text":"“Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in a nungta takpi Pathian ka hi bangma in, tua khuapi siacip sate sungah a teang mihingte kithat tu hi ci in a kidop natu thu ka piak sia son in. Ngam sungah a teang teng sia ngamsate in ne tu hi. Mualtung le suanghawng sungah a buu te natna taw thi tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Keima in tua ngam sia a kinusia ngamtongta ka suaksak tu a, a kiphatsak pui a vaangletna bo tu hi. Israel mualte sia dui thukpui suak tu a, kuama in khualhaw in kaantan thei ngawl tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Mihingte a mawna a khialna te hu in daan ka piak ciang le a ngam sia ngamtongta ka suasak ciang Topa ka hi hunlam amate in hong he tu uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Topa in, “A thithei mihing awng, na mite in khuapi uumna pang hui ahibuale a inn kongbiangte ah a kisik uh ciang nangma thu son tu uh hi. Amate khat le khat ‘Tu in Topa kung pan bang kammal hong suak ziam, pai in ngai tawng,’ kici uh hi.","title":"Kamsaangpa Thu puakna pan Thupiangte"},"31":{"text":"Tua ahikom, ka mite na son tu thu a ngai tu in a hon in hong pai uh hi, ahihang seam tu na sawlte a seam bua uh hi. Ki itna kamthumte pau ahihang a duhop ngei ma in duhop veve lai uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Amate atu in nang sia tengtongh tum a, lawmla a sasa zindo khat bang lel na hi hi. Na kampau theampo hong ngai napi kam khat beak zongh hong ni ngawl hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahizong, na kampau theampo hong taangtun ciang — hong taangtung takpi tu a, tuasia ciang kamsaang khat amate sungah om ahi hunlam amate in he tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Israel ii Tuucingte"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Israel ngam ukte sonsia in, kamsaanna taw, Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii kong ci teng amate munah son in: No Israel ii tuucingte awng a lal na hi uh hi: Noma le noma na kikeam cing uh a, ahihang na tuute na keamcing ngei bua uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Note in a noai taw kivaak in, a mul taw a kivawt puante silh a, a limcibel tuute ngoin a sa na ne uh hi. Ahihang tuute na keamcing ngei bua uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Note in tuu zawngkhalte na ou bua uh a, a ciinate bawl ngawl, a liamte a liamma tuamsak ngawl, a lampialte khoi kik ngawlin, ahibuale a bote na zong kik bua uh hi. Tuasia luangin na vawtsia lalai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuute sia a cing nei ngawl ahikom, peakkeak a, ngamsate in manin a sa ne uh hi.","ref":"Mi 27:17; 1 Kum 22:17; Mt 9:36; Mk 6:34"},"6":{"text":"Ka tuute mualtung le mual bawk saang na munte ah a vakvai uh hi. Leitung theampo ah peakkeak a, kuama in amate zong ngawlin a kan bua uh hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tu in, no tuucingte awng, Topa ahi Keima ii son bang hong ngai tavun."},"8":{"text":"Keima in a nungta takpi Pathian ka hi bangma, keima ii thuson nong ngai tu uh phazaw hi. Ngamsate in ka tuute manin, thatin a sa ne uh hi, banghang ziam cile tuucing om ngawl hi. Ka tuucingte in tuute kanin zong ngawl hi. Amate le amate kikeam a, tuute a keam bua uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom, no tuucingte awng, ka thuson hong ngai tavun."},"10":{"text":"Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in note ngal ka hi na thu ka thangsak hi. Ka tuute noma khut sung pan ka la kik tu a, bangma hunin amate ii tuucingte kong hisak kik ngei buatu hi; noma le noma bekma a kikeam tu in kong koi kik ngei buatu hi. Noma khut sung pan ka tuute ka suatak tu a, no kong nesak buatu hi."},"11":{"text":"“Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in kong ci na pan keima mama in ka tuute ka zong tu a, ka keam tu hi,","title":"Tuucing Pha"},"12":{"text":"tuucing khat in a kithethaang tuute kaikhawm in a kep bangma in ka tuute ka keam tu hi. Tua khuazing le a lauhuai tuasiatna ni in, a kithethaang na mun theampo panin amate ka khawm kik tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ngamdang tuatuamte pan amate ka la tu a, kaikhawm in, a ngam leitang tungah ka ciapui kik tu hi. Israel ngam luite le mualte ah keima in lampui kikin, lo hingna ah an ka vaak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel ngam lopa omna mualtung le ngamkuam te, tua ciang lohingna theampo ah amate ngam muang takin ka taasak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Keima in ka tuute a cing tuucingpa ka hi tu a, a tawlngak natu mun khat ka zonsak tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ka pau zo hi."},"16":{"text":"“Keima in a bote ka zong tu a, a lampial te ka khoi kik tu hi, a liamte a liamma ka tuamsak tu a, a ciinate ka damsak tu hi; ahihang thau in a thahatte ka susia tu hi, banghang ziam cile keima in a maan in a ngamta tuucingpa ka hi hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tu in no ka tuuhonte awng, Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in kong cina pan, note khat sim tungah thu kong khen tu a, a pha le a sia, tuu le keal kong khen tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Note pawlkhat in lopa limcibel na neak uh taw lungkim zo ngawl a; na neak ngawl te ngawngawn na tuanhcil uh hi! Tui thiang na dawn uh a, na dawn ngawl teng na nusak uh hi!"},"19":{"text":"Ka tuu dangte in na totcil lopate le na nutsaksa tuite ma a neak uh kul hi."},"20":{"text":"“Tua ahikom tu in Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in no a thahat tuute le a thazawm tuute kilaklaw ah thu kong khen tu hi, ci in kong son hi."},"21":{"text":"Note in tuu a ciinate na kii uh taw na sii uh a, tuuhon sung pan na niil keak uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahizong ka tuute ka suatak tu a, kuama in ka vawtsiasak nawn buatu hi. Ka tuute khat sim tungah thukhenin a sia le a pha ka doi tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Ka naseampa David bang ahi kumpi khat amate ii khat bek ahi tuucing pa tu in ka pia tu a; amate a keam tu hi.","ref":"Tpl 7:17"},"24":{"text":"Keima, Topa sia amate ii Pathian ka hi tu a, ka naseampa David bang ahi kumpi khat in amate a uk tu hi. Keima ka pau zo hi.","ref":"Eze 37:24"},"25":{"text":"Amate thin muang hiithiat in a om natu in amate taw thuciamna khat ka vawt tu hi. Nganhing a kiitakhuaite theampo a ngamsung pan ka heam tu hi, tuasia in ka tuute ngammuang takin lote sungah nungta in, taam sungah a mut thei natu uh ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"“Amate thupha ka pia tu a, ka mual thiangtho kiimkot ah ka teangsak tu hi. Tua munah a kisap hunin thupha nguatui ka zusak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Thingkungte a nga nga tu a, lote pan an piangin, mihing theampo thinmuang takin a leitang tung tek ah a teang tu uh hi. Ka mite ii thikkol sutan in, a sila kaaina pan ka suut ciang Topa ka hi hunlam amate in he tu uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Pathian he ngawl minamte in amate ii neisate suttol nawn ngawl tu a, ngamsate in ne lum ngawl tu hi. Amate ngam muang takin teang tu a, kuama in lauthawn ngawl tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Leipha leihoi lote ka pia tu a, a ngam sungah ngilkialna ka omsak buatu hi. Ngamdangte in selno ngawl tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Mihing theampo in Israel te keima ii ka huuk hunlam le amate ka minam ahi hunlam he tu uh hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa pau zo khi hi."},"31":{"text":"“No, ka tuute, kong vaak sa tuuhon, keima mite na hi uh a, keima in note Pathian ka hi hi,” Vaanglianpipa Topa in ci hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in keima hong paupui hi.","title":"Pathian ii Edom Daan A piakna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Edom ngam sonsia in."},"3":{"text":"Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii son teng mipi te tungah son in: Edom mualte awng, Keima sia na ngal ka hi hi. Nangma sia a kinusia ngamtongta kong suaksak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Na khuapite lalcip in ka nusia tu a, Na ngam leitangte ngamtongta ka suaksak tu hi; Tua hun ciang Topa ka hi hunlam na he tu hi."},"5":{"text":"“Nang sia Israel te ii ngal na hi tawntung a, a mawna a khialnate hu in a khakbelh daan a thuak hun, a tuasiat hun sungin Israel mite na thi mangsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom — Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa sia a nungta takpi Pathian ka hi bangma — thina sia na thuak tu ma hi a, suakta thei ngawl tu ni hi. Mihing that in maw na hikom, nang sia thalup tu in hong kizuizen tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Edom mualtung ngam sia ngamtongta ka suaksak tu a, tua ngam kaantanin khual a haw pawpo ka thatlum tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Mualpite ahizong mualnote le kuam te ahizong ngalsung a kithat mithi luangte taw ka dimsak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"A tawntungin ngamtongta kong suaksak tu a, na khuapite sungah kuama teang kik ngawl tu hi. Tuasia ciang Topa ka hi hunlam nong he tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"“Keima Topa sia Judah le Israel ngamte ii Pathian hi napi, hi ngamte nii le leitangte sia nangma aa hi a ka neisa hi, na ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa sia a nungta takpi Pathian ka hi bangma, ka mite tungah na thin uukna, na eenna le na ngaimawkna te kong thuk kik tu hi. Amate tungah na vawt nate hangin daan hong pia ka hi hunlam amate in he tu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaciangin, nangma in, Israel mualte sia a ngamtongta suak a, ka siasak hial zong keima thu hi zo hi, ci in nomuna taw na paunate Keima Topa in za ka hi hunlam na he tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Kei hong langpan in, kiphatsakna taw na kamham pauna te kong za zo hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Is 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Eze 25:12-14; Amo 1:11-12; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"},"14":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Nang a ngamtongta mama khatin kong vawt tu a,"},"15":{"text":"Keima neisa Israel a lalcip ciang na lungdam bangma in leitung buppi in na kiamsuk sia a lungdam tu uh hi. Seir mualte bek dom ngawlin Edom ngam theampo ngamtongta suak tu hi. Tua hun ciang keima in Topa ka hi hunlam mihing theampo in he tu uh hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in, “A thithei mihing awng, Israel mualte tungah ka thupuak a ngai natu son in a,","title":"Israel te tungah Pathian ii Thupha"},"2":{"text":"Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ka son tu thute hi bang hi: Israel ii a ngalte in eenna taw en in, ‘Tu in tua taanghlai mualte sia koma aa hi!’ ci hi."},"3":{"text":"“Tua ahiciang kamsaanna son in a, Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci teng taangko in. A ngampaamte in Israel mualte la in, a sutol ciang, amate theampo in Israel te nunau uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom tu in, no, mualte, luamte le ngamkuamte, a lalsa in a kinusia munte, na kiimkot ngam theampo ii a sutol a nunau khuapite awng, Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii son teng hong ngai tavun."},"5":{"text":"“Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in, a kiimkot ngamte le a tuatuanin Edom ngam tungah ka thin uuk mama na taw thu ka son hi. Amate in zawnsakna le lawp toaina taw keima leitangte le nganthana munte hong laaksakin amate ii neisa sua uh hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tua ahiciang Israel ngam tungah kamsaanna son in a; mualpite, mualnote, luamte, ngamkuamte sia minamte in selnoin a vaang bosak ahikom Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ka thin uukna taw kong ci teng son in."},"7":{"text":"Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in na kiimkot minamte vaang bosak tu khi hi, ci in a ciliap huai kamciam kong pia hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang, Israel ka mite awng, Israel mualte tungah nang atu in thingkung pote a tee boai in a nga nga kik tu hi. Hai ngawlin inn ah nong cia kik tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Nangma sang kong pang hi, na leitang a kitho kik tu in ka vawt tu a, anciite kipoai kik tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Na mite ka pungsak tu hi. Khuapite sungah na teang tu uh a, a kisia sate theampo na pua kik tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Na ngannote le mihingte kong pungsak tu hi. Nidang sangin na tamzaw tu uh a, ta tam mama na nei tu uh hi. Na teen ngei bangin tua munah kong teangsak tu a, nidang sangin na nuamsa zaw tu uh hi. Tua hun ciang Topa ka hi hunlam nong he tu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"No Israel ka mite na leitang tungah teang kik tu in kong pui kik tu hi. Tua leitang sia noma ngam suak tu a, na tate pukthisak kik ngeingawl tu hi."},"13":{"text":"“Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in ka ci hi: Mihingte in tua ngam sia mihing sa ne ngam hi ci a, a ngam sungah a tate kisuttol hi a ci uh sia thumaan ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang tu pan kipan na tate hong suttol mihing sa ne khat hi nawn ngawl tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in pau zo khi hi."},"15":{"text":"Hong selno ngamte ii thu na nadon kul nawn ngawl tu a, a mite ii hong nunauna zongh na mu nawn buatu uh hi. Tua ngam in hi minam ii tate suttol nawn ngawl tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa in ka pau zo hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Israel ii Nuntakna Thak"},"17":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Israel te a ngam sungah a teen lai in, a nuntakzia le a ngamtatna taw a ngam ninsak uh hi. Amate ngamtat luheak sia numei khat tha simin a nin nei hun sung bangin biakna taw kisai a thiangtho ngawlin ka ngaisun hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in a ngam sungah mihing a thalupnate le a biak milimte taw in a ngam a nitsak nate hu in, ka thin uuk tutna daan a thuak tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate nuntakzia le a ngamtatnate ka mawsak a, ngamdang ah ka thethaang hi."},"20":{"text":"A paina pawpo ah ka min thiangtho mindaisak hi, banghang ziam cile mihingte in, ‘Hite in Topa mite hi napi Topa ngam a taisat uh kul hi,’ ci tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuasia in ka min thiangtho atu hong thintoisak hi, banghang ziam cile Israel mite in a paina theampo ah ka min daisak uh hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tu in Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ii thupuak sia Israel mite tungah son in: ka vawt tu sia in no Israel te atu hi ngawl a, na thetna ngam theampo ah na daisak sa ka min thiangtho atu ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Minamte sungah na daisak uh ka min — ka min lian ii thiangthona amate tungah ka lak ciangin — keima sia Topa ka hi hunlam amate in hong he tu uh hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ka pau zo hi. Nangma hong zanghin minamte tungah a thiangtho ka hi sia ka lak tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Minam theampo le ngam theampo pan kong la kik tu a, na ngam ah kong ciapui kik tu hi."},"25":{"text":"No tuithiangtho kong the tu a, milimte le hong ninsak nadangte theampo pan kong thiangsak tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Lungtang thak le thin thak kong pia tu hi. A thinpui na suang lungtang kong laaksak tu a, thu a ni lungtang kong pia tu hi.","ref":"Eze 11:19-20"},"27":{"text":"Ka thukhamte le ka thupiakte theampo na zui ka mu thei natu in ka thaa kong khum tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua hun ciang, na taanghpupite tungah ka piaksa ngam ah na teang tu uh hi. Note in keima mite na hi tu uh a, Keima in noma Pathian ka hi tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Hong ninsak nate theampo pan kong hun tu hi. No tungah kialpite hong tun nawn ngawl natu in an tam mama a pian natu thupia tu khi hi."},"30":{"text":"Minamte sungah kialpi hu in na mindai ngawl natu na thingnga kungte le na lote pan an tam mama ka piang thuasak tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Na ngitlonate le khialna na vawtte na phawk tu a, na mawna le na khialna te uh hu in, noma le noma na kinunau tu uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Israel awng, hi te theampo sia nang atu in a seam ka hi ngawl hunlam na heak tu ka dei hi. Na sep na vawtnate hu in na maizum in na maimawl tu ka dei hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in ka pau zo hi.”"},"33":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Na mawna theampo pan kong thiansua zawkciang na khuapite ah kong teangsak kik tu a, a lalcip sate theampo na pua kik tu uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Na lo paam ah a pai pawpo in lopa in na lote khunel in duipui suak ahi hunlam mu tu uh hi, ahihang na lote kong thosak kik tu hi."},"35":{"text":"Mihingte theampo in hi lo duipui a sua ngei hang, tu in Eden Huan bang hi zo a, khuapite kisutham, kiphuulin a kisia sa in om ngei, hikale tu in mihing teang kik zo a, kulh taw ki uum zo hi ci tu hi."},"36":{"text":"A bo ngawl a taanglai na ngampaamte in Keima, Topa sia a kikhul sa lote ah an ciing kikin, a lalsa khuapite a pua kik Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi; Keima, Topa in hi teng vawt tu in kong kamciam zo a — ka vawt tu hi,” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Israel te in ka tungah hu ka ngensak kik tu a, tuasia ciang tuuhon bangin amate ka pungsak tu hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua hun ciang, tu laitakin a lalcip khuapite sia poai sungah sangaw biakpiakna in a nei tuute taw a kidim ngei Jerusalem khuapi bangin mihing taw kidim kik tu hi. Tuasia ciang Keima, Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa ii a vaanglian hong ompuina ka phawk a, ama thaa in mithi ngute taw kidim ngamkuam ah hong paipui a, tua munah hong koi hi.","title":"Ngukote Omna Ngamkuam"},"2":{"text":"Ama in ngamkuam sungah hong vapui kawkoai a, a ko sa mithi ngute tam mama ka mu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in kei tungah, “A thithei mihing awng, hi mithi ngute a nungta kik thei tu ziam?” hong ci hi. Keima in, “Vaanglianpipa Topa awng, nangma bekma in zo thei tu ni hi,” ci in ka zo kik hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in, “Mithi ngute tungah kamsaanna pia in. Mithi ngu hite in Topa kammal ngaisak in."},"5":{"text":"Keima Vaanglianpipa Topa ii ci teng son in: Keima in hu ka mop tu a, nuntakna ka pia kik tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Thangui le sazangte ka pia tu a, vun taw ka tuam tu hi. Hu ka mop tu a, ka nungtasak kik tu hi. Tua hun ciang Topa ka hi hunlam na he tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom hong kison bangin kamsaanna ka pia hi. Ka thuson laitak mama in, awnging siasua ka za a, mithi ngute kipee tu in kipan hon hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka mu tang mama in, mithi ngute thangui le sazangte taw kituam a, tua zawkciang vun in tuam hi. Ahihang a pumpi sungah nuntakna hu a om bua hi."},"9":{"text":"Kei tungah Pathian in, “A thithei mihing awng, vui sungah kamsaanna pia in. Vui sia mun theampo pan hong pai natu, mithi luang hite sungah hu a khum natu le nuntakna a piak kik natu in, Vaanglianpipa Topa in thu ka pia hi ci sia vui kungah va son ta'n,” hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Hong kisawlna bangin kamsaanna ka pia hi. Pumpite sungah nuntakna hu tum a, nungta in hong dingto hi. Ngalkaphonpi khat a pha zo tu za in a tam hi.","ref":"Tpl 11:11"},"11":{"text":"Pathian in kei tungah, “A thithei mihing awng, Israel mite sia hi mithi ngute taw kibang hi. Amate in ka ngu uh tei zo a, maisang bangma muanmawkna nei nawn ngawl khu hi, a ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom Israel ka mite tungah Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in a thaankhukte ka honsak tu hi ci in kamsaanna pia in. Keima in amate ka lakeak tu a, Israel ngam ah ka pui kik tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka mite kiphumna thaante hongin amate ka laakkeak ciang, Topa ka hi hunlam amate in hong he tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Hu ka mop tu a, nungtasak kik in, a ngam ah ka teangsak kik tu hi. Tuasia ciang amate in kei sia Topa ka hi hunlam he tu uh hi. Tusia vawt tu in kamciam ka pia zo a — ka vawt tu hi. Keima, Topa in ka son zo hi,” hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in kei hong paupui kik hi.","title":"Judah le Israel Kumpi ngam khat Suak"},"16":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, thing ciangkhut khat la in a tungah ‘Judah kumpi ngam’ ci in at in. Tua zawkciang a dang khat la in ‘Israel kumpi ngam’ ci in a tungah at in."},"17":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a mong veve situa in a, ciangkhut khat bek bangin na khut sungah toai in."},"18":{"text":"Na mipuite in a khiakna bang ziam ci in hong dok ciang"},"19":{"text":"Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in, Israel taang ahiciangkhut sia la in a, Judah taang ahiciangkhut sia taw ka koikhop tu sia amate son in. Ciangkhutte ngeal sia khat ka sua tu a, ka khut sungah ka toai tu hi."},"20":{"text":"“Ciangkhutte ngeal sia na khut sungah toai in a, mihingte musak in."},"21":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in a paina ngam theampo panin, ka mite theampo kaikhawm in amate ngam leitang tungah ka ciapui kik tu sia amate tungah son in."},"22":{"text":"Israel ngam mualte tungah amate, minam khat in ka ngawm tu hi. Kumpi khat bek in amate uk tu a, minam nii ahizong, kumpi ngam nii ahizong kikhen nawn ngawl tu hi."},"23":{"text":"A kiihuai milimte taw amate le amate kininsak nawn ngawl tu a, mawna taw kilalsak nawn ngawl tu hi. Amate sia kei hong melsiatna mawna le hong leeheakna lampite theampo pan ka suaktasak tu hi. Amate ka thiansua tu hi; amate sia keima mite hi tu a, Keima in amate ii Pathian ka hi tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Ka naseampa David taw a kibang kumpi khat sia amate kumpi hi tu hi. Ngamuk khat ii khutnuai ah amate teng kilomkhat tu a, thumaan takin ka thukhamte a zui tu uh hi.","ref":"Eze 34:24"},"25":{"text":"Ka naseampa Jacob tungah ka piaksa a taanghpupite teenna ngam ah teang tu uh hi. Tua munah a tate le a suan a paal te theampo, a tawntungin teang tu uh hi. Ka naseampa David bang ahi kumpi khat in amate a tawntungin uk tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate a tawntung ngammuangin a omsak thuciamna khat amate taw ka vawt tu hi. Amate ka kipsak tu a, a mite pungsakin, ka Biakinnpi sia a ngam sungah a tawntung a om tu in ka koi tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Amate taw tua munah ka teang khawm tu hi; keima in amate ii Pathian ka hi tu a, amate in keima mite ahi tu uh hi.","ref":"2 Cor 6:16; Tpl 21:3"},"28":{"text":"Ka Biakinnpi sia amate sungah a tawntung atu ka phu ciang, minamte in Keima, Topa in Israel sia keima mi in ka teal hunlam hong he tu uh hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in kei hong paupui hi.","title":"Pathian ii vanhzak Gog"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “A thithei mihing awng, Magog ngam sungah om Mesheh le Tubal ngam ukpipa Gog sonsia in. Ama sonsia in a,","ref":"Tpl 20:8"},"3":{"text":"Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa sia ama ii ngal ka hi hunlam ama tungah son in."},"4":{"text":"Ama heak zazaan in a, a kha ngu sia thikkoai bulin ama le ama ii ngalkapte theampo ka kaikeak tu hi. Ama ngalkaphonpi sia a siphute le a kibang puan a silh siphu tungtote taw, tam mama a, ngalkapte theampo in lum le namsau khat tek toai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Persia, Ethiopia le Libya pan mite sia ama sang pangin lum le thik lukhute nei siat uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Saksang Gomer ngam le Beth Togarmah ngamte pan, ngalsim mite theampo le a dang ngam tam ma pan ngalkapte in ama panpui uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama a kingin khol natu son in a, a thupiak bangin, a ngalkapte theampo kinging kholsa in omsak hen."},"8":{"text":"Kum tam mama zawkciang, ngam theampo pan a cia kik, ngal muang sa in a om mihingte teenna ngam sim tu in ama ka sawl tu hi. Ama in ngei mama a kinusia sa hi a, ngamtongta ahihang tu in mihingte theampo ngammuang takin a teenna mun Israel mualte sim tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama le a ngalkapte le ama taw kipawl ngam tam mamate in vuipi bangin sim tu a, meei bangin a ngamsung a tuamcip tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Hi sia in Vaanglianpipa Topa ii Gog tungah a son ahi hi: “Tua hun hong thet ciangin nang in thusia tupna khat na ngaisun tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Nang in a mite thinmuang takin a teenna, a khuate ngaldalna kulh taw a ki uum ngawl, a hung tu om ngawl ngam khat sim tu in na khensat tu hi."},"12":{"text":"A lal ngeisa khuapite sungah a teang mite ii neisate suttol in na laaksak tu hi. Amate sia minamte sung pan kikaikhawm a, tu in vul le khoai, nei le lamh hong nei a, leitung lamkaa bomte ah a teang uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Sheba le Dedan mite le Spain ngam khuate pan sum vawtte in, ‘Na ngalkaphonpite ngual neisate suttol tu le a sim tu in na khawm zo ziam? Ngunn le khamh, vul le khoaite le a neisa a lamh sate laaksak siatin, tua vanhte theampo ciapui tu na sawm ziam?’ ci in nang hong dongh tu hi.”"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Vaanglianpipa Topa in ama ci teng Gog tungah a son tu in kei hong paisak hi: “Tu in Israel ka mite thin muang in a teen laitakin nangma in"},"15":{"text":"a khualana saksang mun na laakna panin, ngam tam mama pan a thahat le a tam mama siphu ngalkapte lampui in na kuan tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Vuipi suangval sia ngamsung kaantan in a vak bangin Israel ka mite na sim tu hi. A hun hong thet ciang, nang tungtawnin ka sep sia taw ka thianthona le keima akua ka hi sia minamte in hong heak natu ka lakna in ka ngam sim tu in nangma kong paisak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka naseam Israel kamsaangte tungtawnin, a ni a hun hong thet ciang Israel te a sim tu khat kong puak tu hi ci a nidang pek pan ka taangko sia nangma na hi hi.” Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Israel mite Gog ii a sim ni in ka thinso tu hi.","title":"Pathian ii Gog Daan A piakna"},"19":{"text":"Ka thin uuk mama hu in tua ni ciang Israel ngam ah nasia takin zinliing tu hi ci in ka thangsak hi."},"20":{"text":"Ngasa le vacim theampo, nganhing a lian a no theampo le leitung ah a om mihing theampo in kei hong kiita in a liing tu uh hi. Mualte le liangte cim tu a, luphung theampo puk tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Gog mite tuasiatna namcin taw ka lausak tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa in son zo khi hi. Ama ii mihingte khat le khat namsau taw kisaat tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Chisan luanna le natna taw ama daan ka pia tu hi. Nguapi le ngialtang, meikuang le kaan, ama le a ngalkaphonpi tung le ama taw kipawl minam tam mamate tungah buasuk tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Hi bangin keima letna le ka thiantho na sia minam theampo ka lak tu hi. Tua hun ciang amate in Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “A thithei mihing awng, Meshech le Tubal ngamte ukpi pa Gog sonsia in a, keima sia a ngal ka hi hunlam ama tungah son in.","title":"Gog A kizawna"},"2":{"text":"Keima in ama sia lam thak khat ah ka heak tu a, saksang pek panin, Israel ngam mualte a thet dong lam ka pui tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a khut veisang ah a toai thal le a khut ziatsang ah a toai thaltangte ka bekkeaksak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Gog le a ngalkaphonpite, a kipawlpuite Israel mualte tungah thi tu uh a, a mithi luangte sia ngamsate le vacimte an ka suaksak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate lozau sungah thi tu uh hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ka pau zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Magog ngam le thinmuang takin a mite teenna tuipi dung theampo mei taw ka hal tu hi, tuaciang mite theampo in, Keima, Topa ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel ka mite in ka min thiangtho ka hesak takpi tu a, ka min a kidaisak nawn buatu hi. Tuasia ciang, minamte in Keima, Topa sia Israel ii Thiangtho Pathian ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “A thu ka sonsa ni sia hong tung takpi tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel khuapite ah a teang mite pai in, a kinusia ngalhiamte thingthu tu in khawm tu uh hi. Lumte, thalte, thaltangte, teite le molte thingin thut tu a, kum sali sung khom tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in lo sung pan thing tom tu le duisung pan thing phuk tu kul ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile amate in ngalhiam nusiatte a thut tu in nei uh hi. A ngalte ii a suttol a laaksak vanhte, amate in suttol a, laaksak tu hi,” Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in, “Hi thu teng hong pian ciang, Gog kiphumna tu mun khat sia Tuipi Thi ii nisuana sang Israel ngam Khualhawte Ngamkuam sungah ka pia tu hi. Gog le a ngalkapte theampo tua munah kiphum tu a, tua kuam sia ‘Gog ii Ngalkaphonpi Kuam’ kici tu hi.,","title":"Gog Kiphumna"},"12":{"text":"Israel mite in mithi luangte theampo a phum natu le a leitang thiangthosak kik natu in tha sali hun bo tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ngamsung a teang mihingte theampo in mithi phumpui tu hi, tua ahiciang ka ngal zaw ni in amate minphatna kipia tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa in ka son zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Tha sali a bo zawkciang leitang a thianthosak thei natu in, ngamsung theampo ah khualhaw in mithi luang a kiphum ngawl lai theampo a zong tu le a phum tu pasalte kiteal tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate sia ngamsung suk le to ah vak kawkoai in, mithi ngu khat a mu simin, tua ii hui ah tepteena khat vawt tu hi, tua hile thaankhuk tote pai in Gog ii Ngalkaphonpi Kuam sungah phum thei tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"(Tua mun taw a kinai na ah ngalkaphonpi ii min a kitap khua khat om tu hi) Tuabangin a leitang kithiangthosak kik tu hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in kei tungah, “A thithei mihing awng, amate atu ka vawt sangaw biakpiakna sate ne tu in, kiim le paam theampo pan vacim le nganhingte theampo hong pai natu in sam in. Tua in Israel mual tungah poaipi khat hi tu a, tua munah sa ne in chi dawn thei tu uh hi.","ref":"Tpl 19:17-18"},"18":{"text":"Tuate in tuutalte ahibuale, tuunote ahibuale kealte ahibuale, khuital thaute bangin a kithatlum ngalkapte ii luangte ne in, leitung ngamukte ii chi dawn tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Sangaw biakpiaknate bangin hi mihingte ka thalup ciangin, vacimte le nganhingte in a chi le a thaute theampo a kham dongin ne tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima sabuai tungah tuate in siphute le a tungtote, ngalkapte le ngalsim mihingte ii sa a neak zawk zaza ne tu uh hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa in ka son zo hi,” hong ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in, “Minamte in ka vaangletna ka musak tu hi, tuaciang a maan a thu ka khensat natu in bangbangin ka vaangletna zangh khi ziam ci sia ka lak tu hi.","title":"Israel ngam Kipua kikna"},"22":{"text":"Israel te in tua hun pan kipan Keima sia Topa a Pathian ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Minamte in kei tungah mawna khialna hong vawt nate hangin Israel te sal tang a hina thu a tel tu uh hi. Amate nungngat in a ngalte in ka zosak a, ngal sungah ka thatlumsak hi."},"24":{"text":"Amate a ninnoi na le a seksol nate taw a kilawm bangin ka thuaksak a, amate ka nungngat hi,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Ahihang tu in Jacob suan le paal Israel mite ka hesuak tu a, ka nuamsasak kik tu hi. Ka min thiangtho ka sungsia tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Amate kuama in tawng nawn ngawlin, a ngam sungah ngammuangin khatvei a teen kik ciangin, keima hong leeheak hu in, bangbangin a mindai ci sia a mangil thei tu uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Keima thiangtho ka hi hunlam sia minam tampi ka lak natu in, a ngalte teenna ngam theampo panin ka mite ka pui kik tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin, ka minamte in Keima, Topa a Pathian ka hi hunlam hong he tu uh hi. Hi thu amate ii a tel theina sia, keima in amate matsa in ka puak a, tu in khawm kikin, khat zongh kikhe ngawlin, a ngam ah ka puak kik hu ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Israel mite tungah ka thaa ka buak tu a, amate ka nungngat kik ngei buatu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in son zo khi hi,” ci hi."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun sia ih sal tan zawk kum kul le kum nga kum, Jerusalem khua a kilaak zawk kum sawm le kum lina kumthak ni sawm ni hi. Tua ni in Topa ii nasia tak hong ompui hunlam ka phawk a, ama in mundang ah hong paipui hi.","title":"Mailam Biakinnpi Mukholna 40:1 — 48:35 Jerusalem ah Ezekiel Kipaipui"},"2":{"text":"Mukholna khat sungah Pathian in Israel ngam sungah hong paipui a, mualsaang khat tungah hong koi hi. Ka mai ah khuapi khat taw a kibang inn honkhat ka mu hi.","ref":"Tpl 21:10"},"3":{"text":"Ama in a nai zaw in hong neaksak a, tuaciang taau bangin a taang mihing khat ka mu hi. Ama in puanneal pikhau khat le piciang khat toai in kongpi hui khat ah ding hi.","ref":"Tpl 11:1; 21:15"},"4":{"text":"Ama in “A thithei mihing awng, en in. Pha takin hong ngai ta'n a kong lak na theampo nasia takin kin vawt in, banghang ziam cile nang sia hi thu huvau in hi sungah hong kipuak hi. Na mu theampo Israel mite tungah na son tu ahi hi,” kei tungah hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka mu sia Biakinnpi hi a, a kiimkot ah luphung khat om hi. Tua pa in metre thum a sau ama piciang la in tua luphung tee hi. Tua sia metre thum saang a, metre thum saa hi.","title":"Nisuana Kongpi","ref":"1 Kum 6:1-38; 2 Khang 3:1-9"},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang nisuana sang a maingat kongpi vangah ama pai hi. Keallei tungah ama kaato in a dawn ah a tumna tee a; metre thum thuk hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ngal khat ah lamzin khat om a, a cingte inndoi thum veu a lang veve ah om hi. Tua inndoite in a kikim king li tek nei a, a pangh sia metre thum veu sau hi, a inndoite kilaklaw pangte metre nii le lang saa hi. A cingte inndoite ngal ah metre thum a sau lamzin khat om a, Biakinnpi a maingat sungtanna inndoi paina ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in hi inndoi tee a, metre lithuk hi.
