Kumpipa awng ka maw ngawl hunlam le nang tungah kong khial ngawl hunlam Pathian in he a hikom hi bangin vawt hi,” ci in zo hi."},"23":{"text":"Kumpipa lungdam leilam a, tawpite khumna dum sung pan Daniel a kikaito natu in thupia hi. Tuabangin Daniel kaito uh a, liamna a nei vet ngawl hunlam mu uh hi, banghang ziam cile ama in Pathian muang hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kumpipa in Daniel a mawsak mihingte theampo mat tu in thupia a, a zite le a tate taw tawpi a dim dum sungah khiasuk hi. Dum taw a thet ma ngawngawn in, tawpi te in amate mat khat sua in a ngu a taang theampo duangleam hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Darius kumpipa in ngam theampo, minam theampo le paunam theampo pan mite tungah laithak hi: “Kong nukset hi!"},"26":{"text":"Ka kumpi ngamlian sung a om mihingte theampo in Daniel ii Pathian a kiitak natu le a zatak natu in thu ka pia hi. “Ama in a nungta Pathian hi a, a tawntungin uk tu hi. A ngam kisiasak ngeingawl tu a, a vaangletna bo ngeingawl tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama in ngum in suatak a; vantung le leitung ah a lamdangte le nalamdang laknate vawt hi. Ama in Daniel sia tawpite thalup natu pan suatak hi.”"},"28":{"text":"Daniel sia Darius ii maan hun sung le Persia mi Cyrus ii maan hun sungin nuamsa hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Belshazzar ii Babylon kumpi a sep kipat kumin keima in mang khat ka man a, zanin mukholna khat ka mu hi. Tuaciang ama sia mihing ngaisutna kipia hi.","ref":"Tpl 13:2"},"5":{"text":"A niina nganhing sia a nung peangte taw a ding vompui khat taw kibang hi. Tuasia in a hate taw telngu thum pu a, awnging khat in ama tungah, “Sa na neak zawk zaza ne tan lai in!” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka et laitakin nganhing khat kilangh hi. Tuasia pawlbeam taw kibang a, ahizong a nungzaang ah vacim tha taw a kibang tha li om in lutang li nei hi. Thu nei tuak khat in kimu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka et lalai le, nganhing a lina kilangh hi. Nganhing dangte taw kibang ngawlin, kii sawm nei hi.","ref":"Tpl 12:3; 13:1"},"8":{"text":"Tua kiite ka salh laitak a dang kiite sungah kiino khat hong poto ka mu hi. Hi kii in mihing mittangte le kiphatsak kam a pau kam khat nei hi.","ref":"Tpl 13:5-6"},"9":{"text":"Ka et laitakin kumpi tokhumte a om natu san tek ah hong kikoi hi. A nungta tawntung mihing khat sia tua kumpi tokhumte khat tungah to hi. A puante vuuk bangin paak a, a sam sia tuumul taw kibang hi. A kuang muite tungah a kinga a kumpi tokhum sia, meikaang a,","title":"A Tawntung A Nungta Khat ii Mukholna","ref":"Tpl 20:4; Tpl 1:14"},"10":{"text":"tua mun panin meikuang a kipee in hong pusuak hi. Ama ii naseam tu in mihing tul tam mama tua munah om a, ama mai ah mihing awn tam mama ding uh hi. Thukhen natu hun kipan a, laibute kihong hi.","ref":"Tpl 5:11; Tpl 20:12"},"11":{"text":"Ka et laitakin tua kiino ii kiphatsakna kam a papau ka za thei lai hi. Ka et lalai ciang nganhing a lina sia kithatlum a, a luang sia meikuang sungah kivawkin kaanghtum hi."},"12":{"text":"Nganhing dangte ahile a vaang kilaaksak a, ahizong a nuntak lai natu hun ciangtan khat kipia hi."},"13":{"text":"Hi mukholna ka mu ni zanin mihing taw a kibang khat ka mu hi. Ama sia meeikaai in kiim uum in ka kung hong neak a, tuaciang a nungta tawntung pa kung zuanin tua pa taw kimu hi.","ref":"Mt 24:30; 26:64; Mk 13:26; 14:62; Lk 21:27; Tpl 1:7,13; 14:14"},"14":{"text":"Ngam theampo, minam theampo le paunam theampo pan mite in ama ii na a sep natu in ama sia thu neina, upatna le kumpi vaangletna kipia hi. A thuneina in a tawntungin kip tu a, a kumpi ngam bo ngeingawl tu hi.","ref":"Tpl 11:15"},"15":{"text":"Ka mukholnate in hong patausak a, ka thin hong nawngkaisak mama hi.","title":"Mukholnate A Khiakna Kisonthiang"},"16":{"text":"Tua munah a ding mihingte khat kungah ka paito a, hi sia ii khiakna hong son siat natu in ka dongh hi. Tua ahiciang ama in a khiakna hong son hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in, “Hi nganhing lian lite sia leitung ah a piang tu kumpi ngamlian lite ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuaciang Lianbel Pathian ii mihingte in kumpi vaangletna nga tu a, a tawntung a tawntungin keam tu uh hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Tpl 22:5"},"19":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a dangte taw a kibang ngawl nganhing lina — a kiitakhuai mama, a mat sate sia a taau peangcin le a thik ha taw khimtham in a tuanhcil sia ii thu a tamzaw ka he nuam hi."},"20":{"text":"A lu tung a om kii sawmte ii thu le a zawkciang hong poto a, kii thumte a pukvawksak kii sia ii thu ka he nuam hi. Tuasia in mittangte le kam khat nei a, kiphatsak kam pau hi. Tuasia a dangte khat pawpo sangin kiitakhuai zaw hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka et laitakin, tua kii in Pathian ii mihingte do in zothal hi.","ref":"Tpl 13:7"},"22":{"text":"Tuaciang a nungta tawntung mihingpa hong pai a, Lianbel Pathian ii mihingte ngumin thu khen hi. Pathian ii mihingte ii kumpi vaangletna a nga natu hun hong theng zo hi.","ref":"Tpl 20:4"},"23":{"text":"Hi sia keima tungah hong kison a khiakna ahi hi: “Nganhing lina sia leitung ah a om tu kumpi ngamlian lina hi a, kumpi ngamlian dangte theampo taw kilamdang tu hi. Tuasia in leitung buppi sutham in tuanhcil tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Kii sawmte sia tua kumpi ngamlian uk tu kumpi sawmte ahi hi. Tua zawkciang kumpi dang khat hong piang tu hi; ama sia a om masate taw kilamdang mama tu a, kumpi thumte lawnthal tu hi.","ref":"Tpl 17:12"},"25":{"text":"Ama in Lianbel Pathian sia sonsia tu a Pathian ii mihingte nengcip tu hi. Ama in amate ii biakna taw kipawl thukhamte le poai vawtnate khealsak tu in hanciam tu hi, Pathian ii mihingte sia ama ii khutnuai ah kum thum le kumlang om tu hi.","ref":"Tpl 12:14; 13:5-6"},"26":{"text":"Tua zawkciang vantung thukhenna munah thu kikhen tu a, ama ii vaangletna kilaaksakin, kisusia dipdeap tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Leitung kumpi ngam theampo ii vaang le a letna sia Lianbel Pathian ii mihingte tungah kipia tu hi. Amate kumpi vaang sia bo ngeingawl tu a, leitung a ukte theampo in amate na sepsakin a thu ni tu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Tpl 20:4; Tpl 22:5"},"28":{"text":"Hi sia thu tepteena ii tawpna ahi hi. Ka lau mama hu in ka mai daang a, thu theampo keima thinsung bek ah ka koi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Belshazzar kumpi a sua zawk a kum thum kumin a nii veina mukholna ka nei hi.","title":"Daniel ii Mukholna, Tuutal khat le Keal khat"},"2":{"text":"Ka mukholna sungah thakhatin Elam ngamkhen sung a ki uumcip Susa khuapi sungah keima le keima ka kimu hi. Keima sia Ulai ngunhui ah ka ding a,"},"3":{"text":"tua ngun pangh ah kiisau nii a nei tuutal khat ka mu hi, a kii khat sia a dang sia sangin sau zaw in thak zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua tuutal in a kiite taw, nitumna sang, saksang le thangsang a sik kawkoai sia ka en hi. Nganhing dangin khaktan zo ngawl a, a thahatna pan suakta zo ngawl uh hi. Ama sia a uk bang po ngamta in kisathei hi."},"5":{"text":"Bang a cinopna ahi tam maw ci in lungmang a ka om laitak, nitumna sang pan keal khat hong tai vingveng a, a tai ngang mama ahikom a peang in lei zongh pha ngawl hi. Tua kealtal in a mitte kilaklaw ah a kician mama kii khat nei hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuasia in ngunhui ah a ding ka mu tuutal zuan a, a tha nei zaza taw manlang tak del hi."},"7":{"text":"Keima in tuutal a sik ka en hi. Tuasia a thin uuk mama ahikom, tua tuutal si ngawpin, a kiite nii taltansak hi. Tuutal in a nan zawk natu thangui thatang nei ngawl hi. Tuasia lei denna in kinei a, kituanhcil in, a hun zo tu kuama om ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua keal sia kisathei vaial a, ahizong a thahatbel laitakin a kii taltan hi. Tua a kii pona munah a kician mama kii li poto a, tuate in mun tuatuam tek kawk uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua kii lite sung khat tung pan kiino khat po a, a vaangletna in thangsang le nisuana sang le Kamciamsa Ngam sangah kizel hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama sia vantung ngalkaphonpi, aksite mama do zawk khom natu in thahat a, pawlkhatte leitung ah lawn suk in tuanhcil hi.","ref":"Tpl 12:4"},"11":{"text":"Ama in vantung ngalkaphonpi Ukpa ngawngawn nalh in ama tungah ni sim a kipia biakpiaknate khaamin Biakinnpi melsia hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua munah ni sim biakpiakna a piak luangin mihingte in mawna khialna vawt uh a, biakna maan sia lei ah vawk uh hi. Tua kii in a sepna theampo ah ma tun hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaciang vantunglalang khat in a dang khat ii munah, “Mukholna sungah a kimu hi thute bang tanvei kizom lai tu ziam? A kiihuai mawna khialna in ni sim biakpiaknate bang tanvei theak tu ziam? Vantung ngalkaphonpi le Biakinnpi sia bang tanvei kituanhcil tu ziam?” ci in a dok ka za hi."},"14":{"text":"A dang vantunglalang in, “Nitak le zingsang kingawm 2,300 vei ngei tu a, tua hun sung teng ah biakpiakna kivawt ngawl tu hi. Tuasia zawkciang Biakinnpi sia a ngeina bangin kipua pha kik tu hi,” ci in a zona ka za hi."},"15":{"text":"Mukholna ii a khiakna tel nuam a ka hanciam laitak, tha khat thu in ka mai ah mihing khat hong ding hi.","title":"Vantunglalang Gabriel in Mukholna ii A Khiakna Sonthiang"},"16":{"text":"Ulai ngun ngal pan bia puina aw khat ka za a, “Gabriel awng, ama ii mu sia ii a khiakna ama tungah son in,” ci hi.","ref":"Lk 1:19,26"},"17":{"text":"Gabriel hong pai in ka kungah hong ding a, lau mama ka hikom lei ah ka puk hi. Ama in kei tungah, “A thithei mihing awng, a khiakna tel in. Na mukholna sia leitung bo natu thu taw kisai hi,” hong ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama ii thu a son laitak khua phawk ngawlin lei ah ka puk hi. Ahihang ama in hong phong to a hong dingsak kikin,"},"19":{"text":"ama in, “Pathian thin uukna hangin hong piang tu thute kong lak hi. Tua mukholna in a tawpna hun a lakna ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"“Kii nii a nei tuutal na mu sia Media le Persia kumpi ngamte cinopna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Keal sia Greece kumpi ngam cinopna hi a, a mitte kilaklaw ah a po a kician kii sia kumpi masabel cinopna ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"A kii po masabel sia a tal zawkciang a po kii lite sia, tua ngam a kikhenna pan hong piang tu kumpi ngam li a cinopna ahi hi, tua ngam lite sia a masabel kumpi ngam za in thahat ngawl tu uh hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tua kumpi ngamte a bo kuan ciang seksol mama zo ahikom tuate daan kipia tu hi, tuaciang ama thu bek thu a sa, siatna nguicing a vawt a thinkoai le ngualtheam thei kumpi khat piang tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama a thahat tu a — ahihang ama ii hantang thahatna hi ngawl tu hi. Ama in a lauhuai siatna piangsak tu a, a sep theampo zo tu hi. Ama in mihing thahatte le Pathian ii mihingte susia tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama sia thimthel pil ahikom ngual theamna taw in a ma tun tu hi. Ama kiphasak tu a, hil khol ngawlin mihing tam mama susia tu hi. Ama in kumpite sung pan a lianbel Kumpipa ngawngawn nalh tu a, ahihang mihing thahatna zangh ngawlin ama kisusia tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Nitak le zingsang biakpiakna thu taw kisai a, hi mukholna ii khiakna bang nang tung hong kisonsa teng taangtung tu hi. Ahihang hi mukholna thu a taangtun tu hun khuangei lai tu ahikom tu in thuku in koi in,” hong ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka thin kiam in ni tam ma ka ciina hi. Tua zawkciang thoto in kumpipa hong sawl ka nasep ma ka seam kik hi, ahihang tua mukholna in ka lung hong mangsak a, ka tel zo bua hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Xerxes ii tapa, Mede mi Darius in Babylon ngam uk hi.","title":"A Mite atu Daniel Thungen"},"2":{"text":"Ama kumpi sua a kum khat kumin keima in thubu thiangthote ka sim a Topa ii kamsaang Jeremiah tungah a son kum sawmsali sung Jerusalem a lalsa in om tu hi, a ci sia thu ka ngaisun hi.","ref":"Jer 25:11; 29:10"},"3":{"text":"An ka tang a, khau-ip puan silhin vut sungah to in, Topa Pathian tungah hesuak ngenin nasia tak thu ka ngen hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa ka Pathian tungah thungen in ka mite ii mawna khialnate ka pualaak hi. Keima in, “ Topa Pathian awng, nang na lian a kong zakta uh hi. Na thuciamna tungah na thumaan a, nang hong it te le na thupiakna bang a seamte a tawntungin na it hi."},"5":{"text":"“Kote khialna ka vawt zo uh a, ngilo in ka maw zo uh hi. Sep tu in nong thupiakte kong nial uh a, a maan nong lakna pan ka pial zo uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Kote kumpite, hong ukte, taanghpupite le ko minam bup tungah na min taw thu a son na naseam kamsaangte ii thu ka ngai bua uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa awng, nangma in a tawntungin a maan na seam a, ahizong ko ka hi uh le koma le koma ka mai ka kimawlsak tawntung uh hi. Judea ngam le Jerusalem khua sungah a teang kote theampo le a nai le a khualana ngam tuatuam ah na thethaang Israel te theampo atu in hi thu sia maan hi, banghang ziam cile amate in nang tungah hong thumaan ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Kote kumpite, hong ukte le taanghpupite in a maizumhuai in ngamta uh a, Topa nang tungah hong maw zo uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Kote in nang hong langpan zo ka hita uh zongin nang in nong hesuak a, nong maisak hi."},"10":{"text":"Oh Topa kote Pathian awng, na naseam kamsaangte tungtawnin nong piak thukhamte bangin nungta tu a nong sawl sia kong nadon bua uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel mite theampo in na thukhamte paltan in na son thute ngai nuam ngawl uh hi. Nang tungah kong maw uh hi, tua hu in na naseampa Moses ii thukham sungah a ki at haamsiatnate ko tungah nong tungsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Kote tung le kote hong ukte tungah kong vawt tu hi nong ci sa bangma in nong vawt hi. Leitung a om khuapi dang khat po sangin Jerusalem khuapi sia a nasia zaw in daan na pia a,"},"13":{"text":"Moses thukham sungah a kison daan theampo nong thuaksak hi. Oh Topa kote Pathian awng, ahihang tu ngawngawn zongin ka mawna ka khialna te kisiik in, ahibuale na thumaan thutak zuina taw nang hong lungdamsak tu in, ka hanciam bua uh hi. Oh"},"14":{"text":"Topa kote Pathian awng, nangma in kote daan hong pia tu in na kithoai a, nong pia takpi hi, banghang ziam cile nangma in a maan bang na seam tawntung a, koma in nang kong nadon bua uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Oh “ Topa kote Pathian awng, na mite Egypt ngam pan nong paipuina taw in na vaangletna nong lak a, na vaangletna kiciamtee lai hi. Ka maw zo uh hi; khialna ka vawt zo uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Nidang in kote nong huu zo hi, tua ahikom Jerusalem tungah hong thin uuk nawn heak in. Tua in na khuapi, na mual thiangtho ahi hi. Kote ii mawna khialnate le ka taanghpupite ii tatsiatna hangin ka kiim ka paam ngamte theampo in Jerusalem le na mite hong nomu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Oh Pathian awng, ka thungetna le kong thuumna hong ngai ta'n. A kisia sa na Biakinnpi hong pua kik ta'n; mihing theampo in nangma Pathian na hi hunlam hong heak natu in puua kik in."},"18":{"text":"Oh Pathian awng, ko thuson hong ngai ta'n; ko hong en ta'n a, ka ngim thuakna uh le na min a pu khuapi ii thuaknate hong mu ta'n. Ko ii sepna a maan hang hi ngawlin, nangma ii hesuakna suangin thu kong ngen uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa awng, hong za ta'n. Topa awng, hong maisak ta'n. Topa awng, hong ngai ta'n a, hong seam ta'n! Mihing theampo in Pathian na hi hunlam hong heak natu in haisaang heak in! Hi khuapi le hi mihingte sia nangma aa ahi hi,” ka ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima mawna khialna le Israel ka mite ii mawna khialna pualaak in thu ka ngen tan a, Topa ka Pathian tungah a Biakinnpi thiangtho a ngeina bangin a pua kik natu tatsat ngawlin hesuak ka ngen hi.","title":"Gabriel in Kamsaanna thu Sonthiang"},"21":{"text":"Thu ka nget laitakin, a masa ka mukhol lai a ka mu sa Gabriel sia ka omna munah hong leangsuk hi. Tua hun sia nitak sang biakpiak tu hun ahi hi.","ref":"Lk 1:19-26"},"22":{"text":"Ama in, “Daniel awng, hi kamsaanna thu na tel thei natu in hong hu tu in kong pai hi."},"23":{"text":"Pathian tung hesuak ngen tu na kipat ciang ama in hong zo hi. Ama in nang hong it ahikom a deina thu son tu in kong pai hi. Tu in mukholna kong sonthiang laitak thudon in."},"24":{"text":"“Mawna le ngamtat siatna pan na mite le na khuapi thiangtho a suataksak natu in Pathian in kum sawmsali ii a salivei hunsung ciangtan zo hi. Mawna kimaisak tu a, tawntung thukhaikim thu om tu hi, tuasia ciang mukholna le kamsaanna taangtung takpi tu a, a Biakinnpi thiangtho sia aapna kinei kik tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Hi thu ciamtee in tel in: Jerusalem a kipua kik natu thupiakna a om hun pan kipan Pathian ii teal lampui pa hong thet dong kum sali mun salivei hun ngei tu hi. Jerusalem sia a lampite le a kidalna kulh khote taw kivawt kik tu a, kum sawmluk le kum nii ii a salivei kumte dong kho tu a, ahihang hi hun sia buaina hun hi tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua hun a bo ciang Pathian tealsa lampuipa sia thuak tuak ngawl bulin kithat tu hi. Tua khuapi le Biakinnpi sia ngal sim tu in hong kuan a thahat ngamukpa khat ii ngalkaphonpi in susia tu hi. A tawpna sia tuiliim bangin hong pai tu a, Pathian ii vawtkhol ahi ngal kisimna le suksiatna hong paipui tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ukpa in mihing tam mama taw kum sali atu thukimna kho khat vawt tu hi; hi hun ii khenlang hong cin ciangin ama in sangaw biakpiakna le biakpiaknate bosak tu hi. Kiihuai Lau huai Tophala sia Biakinnpi ii a saang belna munah kikoi tu a, Pathian ii vawtkhol bangin a koi pa a bo mateng in tua munah om top tu hi,” ci in hong son hi.","ref":"Dan 11:31; 12:11; Mt 24:15; Mk 13:14"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"(Cyrus ii Persia kumpilian a sua zawk a kum thum kumin Belteshazzar a kici Daniel tungah thu khat kipualaak hi. Tua thu in thumaan ahihang telhak mama hi. Tua thu sia ama tungah mukholna taw in kisonthiang hi.","title":"Tigris Ngun hui ah Daniel ii Mukholna"},"2":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin keima in, nipi thum sung mau in ka om hi."},"3":{"text":"Nipi thum a cin mateng in keima in anlim ahizong sa ahizong sapittui ahizong ka ne bua a, ka sam zongh ka pot bua hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua kum a tha masa tha, ni kul le ni li ni in Tigris ngun thahat sia hui ah ka ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka etto le puannealte silh a, khamh ciitak kawngkhau a thua mihing khat ka mu hi.","ref":"Tpl 1:13-15; 2:18; 19:12"},"6":{"text":"A pumpi sia suangmanpha khat bangin taang hi. A maitang sia khualeng bangin taang a, a mittangte sia mei kuang bangin a leng hi. A baan le a peangte sia taau kizut thiang bangin tee vakil a, a aw sia mi honpi au bangin nging hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua mukholna a mu sia keima bek ka hi hi. Keima taw a omkhawm mihingte in bangma mu ngawl uh a, ahihang amate lau in tai a, buu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua munah keima bek ka taang a, hi a lamdang mukholna sia ka en hi. Ka tha om nawn ngawl a, ka meal kikheal ngawp ahikom, kuama in hong tel ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama ii aw ka zaak ciang khua phawk ngawlin lei ah ka puk a, ka khuplam in ka om hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuasia ciang khut khat in hong len in, ka khut le ka khup taw kikhuangkho in hong phongto a; ka liing vadil lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua vantunglalang in ka tungah, “Daniel awng, Pathian in nang hong it hi. Dingto in a, kong son tu thu pha takin ngai in. Na kungah keima hong thataak zo hi,” hong ci hi. Ama in hi thu a son zawkciang, liing vadil kawm ma in ka dingto hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang vantunglalang in, “Daniel awng, lau heak in. Telthiamna na nei natu in nangma mama kiniamkhiak tu in, na khensat ni masabel ni pan kipan Pathian in na thunget nate hong za zo hi. Na thungetna a zo tu in kong pai hi."},"13":{"text":"Persia kumpi ngam a cing vantunglalang in ni kul le ni khat sung hong khak hi. Tuasia ciang vantunglalangte ii ukpi khat ahi Michael sia kei hong panpui tu in hong pai hi, banghang ziam cile tua mun Persia ngam sungah keima nguak hong kinusia hi.","ref":"Tpl 12:7"},"14":{"text":"Mai lamsang na mipuite tungah a piang tu thute a telsak tu in hong pai ka hi hi. Hi sia in maisang thu tu mukholna ahi hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama in hi bang hong son ciang, pau thei ngawlin lei ka sal hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaciang mihing taw a kibang tua vantunglalang in a khut hong thaak a, ka muk hong thamsak hi. Keima in ama tungah, “Syapa awng, hi mukholna in ka tha hong zawmsak mama a, ka ciliing a thai thei bua hi."},"17":{"text":"A topa mai ah a ding sila khat taw ka kibang hi. Bangbangin hong paupui thei tu khi ziam? Thangui thatang ka nei bua hi, ka husamh hi,” ka ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in khatvei ma hong len kik lai a, tuasia ciang ka tha hatzaw ka sa hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in, “Pathian in nang hong it hi, tua ahikom bangma in na thinngimsak heak in a, lausak heak in,” hong ci hi. Hi teng a ci zawkciang ka tha hatzaw seseam ka sa a, “Topa awng nong son tu po hong son ta'n. Ka ci hong damsak zaw ni hi,” ka ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in, “Banghangin na kungah hong pai khi ziam ci sia na he ziam? Thumaan thutak Laibu sungah a ki at thute a pualaak tu in hong pai ka hi hi. Tu in heak kikin Persia a cing vantunglalang sia ka do tu hi. Tua zawkciang Greece a cing vantunglalang hong kilangh tu hi. Israel a cing vantunglalang Michael simngawl kei hong hu tu kuama om ngawl hi.","merge":"21"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama in kei hong hu tu le hong dal tu in vaipuak nei hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua hi a, tu a kong son tu thu in thumaan ahi hi,” ci hi. Vantunglalang in, “Kumpi thum in Persia ngam uk lai tu a, tua zomin a dang teng sangin a hau zaw kumpi a lina hong khang tu hi. Ama in a thahatbel laitak le a haubel laitakin Greece kumpi ngam thato tu hi.","title":"Egypt le Syria Kumpi Ngamte"},"3":{"text":"“Tua zawkciang ngalhang kumpi khat piang tu hi. Ama in kumpi ngamlianpi khat uk tu a, ama uuk pawpo vawt tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahizong a tha a hatbel laitakin a kumpi ngamlian kitamhtham tu a, khen li kisua tu hi. Ama ii suan le paal ahi ngawl kumpite in ama taangin uk tu a, ahihang amate in ama ii vaangletna za in vaang nei ngawl tu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"“Egypt kumpipa thahat tu hi. Ahizong a ngalkap mang lianbelte khat sia thahat zaw lai tu a, kumpi ngam a zai zaw uk tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Kum tam mama zawkciang Egypt kumpipa in Syria kumpipa taw kipawl khopna vawt tu a, a tanu taw kiteangsak tu hi. Ahihang tua kipawl khopna sia kho ngawl tu a, tua tanu, a pasal, a ta le a tonpui naseamte theampo kithatlum tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zawk hai ngawlin Egypt kumpipa tanu ii mealheak khat kumpi suak tu hi. Tua kumpipa in Syria kumpipa ii ngalkaphonpi sim tu a, a kulh sungah tum in zo tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in amate ii pathian milimte le tua pathiante biak piakna in a ki aap khamh le ngunn taw kivawt nate sia Egypt ngam ah pua kik tu hi. Kum tam ma kilemin a om zawkciang,"},"9":{"text":"Syria kumpipa in Egypt ngam sim tu a, ahihang ama sia kinungkinsak kik tu hi."},"10":{"text":"“Syria kumpipa ii tapate ngalsim tu in kinging tu a, ngalkap tam mama khawm tu hi. Kumpipa tapate sung pan khat in tui liim bangin ngalte ii kulh sim tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa in a thin uukna taw, Syria kumpipa sim tu a, a ngalkaphonpi matsak tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama a ngalzawna le ngalkap tam mama a thalup hu in kiphasak tu a, ahihang ngalzo tan ngawl tu hi."},"13":{"text":"“Syria kumpipa cia kikin a masa a nei ngalkap phaza sang a tamzaw ngalkap khawm tu hi. A hun cing a sak ciang ama in ngalhiam vanhte taw a kinging phitphet ngalkap tam mama taw kuan kik tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang mihing tam mama in Egypt kumpipa leedo tu uh hi. Tuaciang a mu sa mukholna khat hu in, Daniel awng, na minam sung pan a maitat mihing ngoltol pawlkhat in leedo tu uh hi, ahizong lel tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom Syria kumpipa in kulh taw a ki uum khuapi khat uumci in la tu hi. Egypt ngalkapte in ngal do suak ngawl tu hi; amate sung pan a hatbel te ngawngawn zongh in thahatna a kicing nei ngawl tu hi."},"16":{"text":"A nalh tu om nawn ngawlin Syria ngalkap pa in a uuk bang pawpo in amate vawt tu hi. Ama in Kamciamsa Ngam sungah ding tu a, tua ngam sia a khutnuai ah koi tu hi."},"17":{"text":"“Syria kumpipa in a ngalkap buppi zanghin ngalsimin kuan tu ngeal hi. Tuasia zawkciang a ngal pa ii kumpi ngam a suksiat natu in ama in a ngalpa taw kipawlna khat vawtin a tanu taw kiteangsak tu hi; ahihang ama ngealna taangtung ngawl tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in tuipi hui ah ngamte sim tu a, tam mama zo ngawp tu hi. Ahihang ngamdang lampui khat in ama zo tu a, a kisaktheina teng bosak tu hi; ama in Syria kumpipa ii kisaktheina sia ama tung ma ah tungsak kik nanak tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama ngam kulhte zuan kik tu hi, ahihang ama in ngallel tu a, tuabangin ama bo tu hi."},"20":{"text":"“Kumpi dang khat in ama nungzui tu a, tua kumpipa in a kumpi ngam hauna khanto natu in phiangshia khonna taw mihingte a nengcip tu in ulian khat thataak tu hi. Tawmvei no sungin tua kumpipa kithatlum tu a, ahizong mihonpi mu na le hi ngal sungah hi ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Vantunglalang in sonthiang tawto hi: “Syria kumpipa a suak kik tu sia kumpi tu in a kilawm ngawl mi ngilo khat hi tu hi, ahihang muanmawk khol ngawlin ama hong pai tu a, thimthelna taw kumpi za suan tu hi.","title":"A Ngilo Syria Kumpipa"},"22":{"text":"Ama a nalh pawpo, Pathian ii Thiampi Lianbel ahi keak zong kinil keakin, kibosak tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Kilemna vawtna taw, ama in minam dangte theam tu a, ama sia minam no khat bek uk hi napi thahat vaial tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama in hesak khol ngawlin ngamkhen hau khat sim tu a, a taanghpupite kuama ii vawt ngeingawl nate vawt tu hi. Tua zawkciang ama in ngal sungah a laak vanhte le nate sia a nungzuite hawmsak tu hi. Ama in ngal dalna kulhte sim tu in ngeal tu hi, ahihang ama hun bo pal tu hi."},"25":{"text":"“Ama in Egypt kumpipa sim tu in hang takin ngalkap tam mama khawm tu hi, Egypt kumpipa zongh in amate do kik tu in a thahat ngalkap tam mama taw kinging tu hi. Ahihang Egypt kumpipa sia kitheam tu a, ngalzo ngawl tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama ii a nai puibel a thudokte in ama siasak tu uh hi. A ngalkapte tam mama kithatlum tu a, kibosak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua zawkciang tua kumpite ngeal sabuai khat ah an nekhawm tu uh hi, ahihang a ngaisutnate sia khawm uh a, khat le khat kitheam tu uh hi. A hun theng ngawl lai ahikom a dei bang nga ngawl tu uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Syria kumpipa sia Pathian mite ii biakna suksiat tu khensatna nei in ngal sungah a vanh laakte theampo taw a ngam zuan kik tu hi. Ama a uuk bang po in ngamta tu a, tua zawkciang a ngam ah cia kik tu hi."},"29":{"text":"“Tua zawkciang ama in Egypt ngam sim leleau tu a, ahihang hi hun ciang thutuam khat piang tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Rome mite ama nalh tu in, teambaw taw hong pai tu a, tuaciang ama a lau tu hi. “Tuasia ciang ama a thin uukin heak kik tu a, Pathian ii mite biakna susia tu in hanciam tu hi. Ama in tua biakna a taisan sate ii ngaisut piakna bang zui tu hi."},"31":{"text":"A ngalkap pawlkhatte in Biakinnpi melsia tu uh hi. Amate in ni sim biakpiaknate tawpsak tu uh a, Kiihuai Lauhuai Tophala khat koi tu uh hi.","ref":"Dan 9:27; 12:11; Mt 24:15; Mk 13:14"},"32":{"text":"Theamna taw kumpipa in a biakna uh a nusia sa mihingte ii panpuina nga tu hi, ahihang Pathian nung a zuite in do kik tu uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Mihingte ii lampui ciimte in amate ii a ciimna midang tam mama hawm tu uh hi. Ahihang hun tawmvei sungah amate pawlkhat ngal sungah kithatlum tu a, ahibuale mei taw kihallum tu hi, tuaciang pawlkhatte sia kisuttol tu a, thong kitaaksak tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuabangin thalupna a thuak laitakin, Pathian mite in huna no khat nga tu uh a, ahizong amate a pawl pui mihing tam mama te sia amate phat tuam natu bekin a pawlpui hi tu uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua mihing ciim lampuite pawlkhat kithatlum tu a, ahihang hi sia hu in mihingte kithiansua tu hi. Hi sia Pathian ii ciangtan hun, a tawpna a thet dong kizom suak tu hi."},"36":{"text":"“Syria kumpipa in ama uuk babangin ngamta tu hi. Ama in pathian khat pawpo sangin ka lian zaw a, a Lianbel Pathian sang zongin lian zaw ing, ci in kisathei tu hi. Ama sia Pathian ii daan a piak matengin tubangin kiphasak thei tu hi. Pathian in ama ii ngeal sa bang vateak in vawt tu hi.","ref":"2 Th 2:3-4; Tpl 13:5-6"},"37":{"text":"Kumpipa in a taanghpupite ii a biak pathian le numeite ii a it pathian zongh melsia tu hi. A tatakin ama in pathian theampo melsia tu hi, banghang ziam cile ama sia tuate sangin lian zaw kisa tu hi."},"38":{"text":"Tuate luangin ama in kulhte a cing pathian sia upat zaw tu hi. Ama in a taanghpupite ii a biak ngeingawl pathian khat tungah khamh, ngunn, suang manphate le a dang a manpha letsongte pia tu hi."},"39":{"text":"Ama ii kulhte cing tu in, ama in ngamdang pathian khat a bia mihingte zangh tu hi. Ama ukpa in a saangte sia ama in minphatna lian pia tu a, zalian pia hi, tuaciang a tel in leitang pia tu hi."},"40":{"text":"“Syria kumpipa ii hun a bo kuan ciang, Egypt kumpipa in ama sim tu hi, Syria kumpipa in a tha nei theampo taw, siphu ngalleangte, siphute le teambaw tam mama zanghin Egypt kumpipa do kik tu hi. Ama in namthuam tuikhang bangin ngam tam mama sim tu hi."},"41":{"text":"Ama in Kamciamsa Ngam ngawngawn simin, mi tul tam mama that tu hi. Ahihang Edom ngam, Moab ngam le Ammon ngam sungah a taanglai sun teng suakta tu uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Ama in tua ngamte theampo a sim ciang, Egypt ngam ngawngawn kikhoaikhe ngawl tu hi."},"43":{"text":"Ama in Egypt ii a phual khamh le ngunn le a dang a neisa manpha teng laaksak tu hi. Ama in Libya le Ethiopia ngam zo tu hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuasia ciang, nisuana sang pan le saksang pan hong pai thuthak sia in ama patausak tu hi, tuaciang ama in thin uuk tatakin do tu a, mihing tam mama that tu hi."},"45":{"text":"Ama in a kumpi puanbuk liante ngawngawn sia Biakinnpi dinna mual le tuipi kilaklaw ah sa tu hi. Ahihang tua mun ah ama a hu tu om ngawlin thi tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Puanneal a silh vantunglalang in, “Tua hun laitak na mite a cing, a lian vantunglalang Michael kilangh tu hi. Tua zawkciang minamte hong pianciil pan kipan a om ngeingawl a nasiabel ngim ngana hun theng tu hi. Tua hun a thet ciang Pathian ii laibu sungah a min a ki at, na ngammite theampo kingum tu hi.","title":"A Tawpna Hun","ref":"Tpl 12:7; Mt 24:21; Mk 13:19; Tpl 7:14; 12:7"},"2":{"text":"A thisate tam mama nungta kik tu uh hi: pawlkhatte sia tawntung nuntakna nga tu uh a, pawlkhatte in tawntung maimawlna thuak tu uh hi.","ref":"Is 26:19; Mt 25:46; Jn 5:29"},"3":{"text":"Lampui ciimte sia van ii taanna theampo taw taang tu uh hi. A maan seam tu in mihing tam thu a hilte sia aksi bangin taang tawntung tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in kei tungah, “Daniel awng, tu in leitung bo dong tua laibu khup in a, a tungah tazeik tum in. Tua hun sungin, mihing tam mama in bang thu piang ziam ci thu a heak nopna taw hanciam thawthong tu uh hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"Tpl 22:10"},"5":{"text":"Tuaciang keima in ngunvaalbo lang le lang ah a ding mihing nii ka mu hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate khat in tuilu sang a khuala zawhiatna ah a ding vantunglalang tungah, “Hi a lamdang thupiangte a bo tu sia bang tanvei ngei tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"7":{"text":"Vantunglalang in a khutte nii van sangah laamto a, Tawntung Pathian min taw a ciliap huai kamciamna khat vawt hi. Ama in, “Kum thum le kum lang hi tu hi. Pathian mite a kivawtsiatna a bo ciang hi thute theampo piang siat zo tu hi,” a ci ka za hi.","ref":"Tpl 10:5; 12:14"},"8":{"text":"Ama thu son ka za hi, ahihang a cinopna ka tel bua hi. Tua ahikom, “Tuale, topa awng, tuasia bangbangin bo tu ziam?” ci in ka dongh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Daniel awng, tu in na pai kul tu hi, banghang ziam cile hi kammalte sia a tawpna hong thet mateng kiseal in, thuku a koi tu ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing tam mama kithiansua tu hi. Mi seksolte in tel ngawl tu uh a seksol tan tu uh hi; miciimte bekin tel tu uh hi.","ref":"Tpl 22:11"},"11":{"text":"“Ni sim biakpiakna te a kitawpsak hun pan, ahibuale Kiihuai Lauhuaina hun pan kipan ni 1,290 ngei tu hi!","ref":"Dan 9:27; 11:31; Mt 24:15; Mk 13:14"},"12":{"text":"Ni 1,335 bo dong thumaanin a om zote sia mihing lungdamte hi!"},"13":{"text":"“Tua ahiciang, Daniel awng nangma, a tawp dongin thumaan in. Tuasia zawkciang na thi tu hi, ahihang a tawpna hun ciang, na minphatna tel saang tu in na tho tu hi,” ci in zo hi."}}}}},"28":{"info":{"name":"Hosea","shortname":"Hos","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia in Kumpi Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz le Hezekiah te Judah ngam ah kumpi in a maan hun le Jehoash tapa Jeroboam Israel kumpi in a maan hun a, Beeri tapa Hosea tungah Topa ii piak thupuak ahi hi.","ref":"2 Kum 15:1-7; 2 Khang 26:1-23; 2 Kum 15:32-38; 2 Khang 27:1-8; 2 Kum 16:1-20; 2 Khang 28:1-27; 2 Kum 18:1—20:21; 2 Khang 29:1-32,33; 2 Kum 14:23-29"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Hosea tungtawn a, Israel a paupui phitbel hunin Hosea tungah, “Pai in a, zi nei in; na zi in na vaang hong tang ngawl tu a, na tate ama bang lian ma hi tu hi. Tuasia bangma ka mite in kei hong nusia in, a thumaan ngawl te suak uh hi,” ci hi.","title":"Hosea ii Zi le Tate"},"3":{"text":"Tuabangin Hosea in Diblaim tanu Gomer kici numei khat teenpui hi. A ta phit tapa sia a sua zawkciang,"},"4":{"text":"Topa in Hosea tungah, “A min ‘Jezreel’ phuakin, banghang ziam cile Israel kumpipa sia a taanghpupi Jehu ii Jezreel ah mihing a thalupte hu in hai ngawlin daan ka pia tu hi. Jehu ii kumpi khangngui ka bosak tu hi.","ref":"2 Kum 10:11"},"5":{"text":"Tua hun ciang Jezreel Kuam ah Israel ngalkap thahatna ka susia tu hi,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Gomer in a ta niina — numei khat nei hi. Topa in Hosea munah, “A min ‘a ki it ngawl’ (Lo-Ruhamah) ci in phuak in, banghang ziam cile Israel mite tungah ka itna ka lak nawn buatu a, ahibuale mawna ka maisak nawn buatu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahihang Judah mite tungah ka itna ka lak tu hi, keima, amate ii Pathian, Topa in amate ka hun tu hi, ahihang ngal kisimna — namsau, thal le thaltang, ahibuale siphu le siphu ngalkapte ka zangh buatu hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Gomer in a tanuno noai a tensak zawkciang ama nau paai kik a, tapa dang khat nei hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in Hosea mun ah, “A min ‘Ka mi hi ngawl’ (Lo-Ammi ) ci in phuak in, banghang ziam cile Israel mite sia ka mi hi ngawl a, tuaciang kei sia amate ii Pathian ka hi bua hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel mite a kisim zo ngawl, a kitee zo ngawl tuipi sen za bang suak tu hi. Tu in Pathian in amate mun ah, “Note ka mite hi ngawl nu hi,” ci hi, ahihang, “Note sia a nungta Pathian ii tate hi nu hi!” a ci ni hong theng tu hi.","title":"Israel Kipuuapha kik tu","ref":"Rom 9:26"},"11":{"text":"Judah mite le Israel mite kingawm kik tu hi. Amate mama in amate atu lampui khat teal tu a, khatvei ma a ngam a lei ah khangto in nuamsa kik tu uh hi. Hi hi, Jezreel ii ni sia ni thupi ni khat hi tu hi!"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahikom na Israel mipuite sia, “Pathian ii mite” le “ Topa ii a it mite” ci vun."},"2":{"text":"Ka tate awng, ama sia ka zi hi nawn ngawl a, keima a pasal ka hi nawn ngawl hang na nu tungah na thuum vun. Ama ii hong palngulna le pumpi kizuakna a kheal natu in thuum vun.","title":"Thumaan ngawl Gomer — Thumaan ngawl Israel"},"3":{"text":"A kheal buale a suani in a pumnguak a om bangin a nik a puan ka sutkeaksak tu hi. Leiko le lei kolhna mun taw kibangin ama ka vawt tu a, dangko in thi tu hi."},"4":{"text":"A tate tungah hesuakna ka nei buatu hi; amate a maizum maw pumpi kizuak nu ii tate ahi hi. Ama mama in, “Ka lawmpate kungah ka pai tu a — amate in an le tui, samul puan le pat puan, olive thau le sapittui hong pia tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"2 Kum 10:11","merge":"5"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama sia lingdai taw ka uum tu a, a lampi khaktan tu in luphung ka ciang tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in a lawmpate del tu hi, ahihang pha zo ngawl tu hi. Ama in amate zong ahihang mu ngawl tu hi. Tuasia ciang ama in, “Ka pasal phit sia kungah heak kik ka tong — tua ka kiteen hun lai sia tu a sang nuam zaw ka na ve” ci tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama ii Baal biakna ah a zak ngunn le khamh theampo le olive thau, sapittui le antang a pia sia keima ka hi hunlam ama in kitelsak ngeingawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom anlaak hun ciang ka piakthongsa antang le sapittui te tuaciang a silh tu ka piak samul le patpuan te ka la kik tu hi."},"10":{"text":"A lawmpate mai ah a nguaktangin om tu in a puan a nikte ka suukeaksak tu a, kuama in ka khut sung pan ama hun zo ngawl tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama ii poai khaamnate theampo — kum sim le tha sim a poaite le Sabbath poaite — a biakna taw kisai kikhopna theampo ka bosak tu hi."},"12":{"text":"A pumpi a kipiak ciang, a lawmpate ii saapna in hong piak hi a ci sapitkungte le theikungte ka siasak tu hi. Ama ii sapithuante le a thingnga huante duipui ka suaksak tu a; ngamsate in susia tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Baal tungah ngimnamtui khat a hal ciang le a suangmanpha kizepnate taw kizeamin a lawmpate a del hun lai a kei hong makngil hu in ama daan ka pia tu hi. Topa in son zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom sennealngam sungah ama ka paipui kik tu a; tua munah ki itna kam taw ama ka zol kik tu hi.","title":"ii A mite A Itna"},"15":{"text":"A sapithuante ama tungah ka piakik tu a, Ngimna Kuam sia lam etna kongpi ka suaksak tu hi. Lei tungah ngua ka zusak tu a, tuaciang leitang in lo an, sapit le olive nga te piangsak tu hi.","merge":"22"},"23":{"text":"Ka mite tua ngam ah ka khosak tu a, ka nuamsasak tu hi. “A ki it ngawl” a kicite tungah itna ka lak tu a, tuaciang “Ka mi hi ngawl” a kicite tungah, “Note ka mi nu hi,” ka ci tu hi, tuaciang amate in, “Nangma kote Pathian na hi hi,” ci in hong zo tu uh hi.","ref":"Rom 9:25-26; 1 Pe 2:10"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah, “Pai kik ta'n a, a lawmpa taw nang hong palngul numei tungah na itna lak ta'n. Tuasia ciang amate in Topa kiita tu a, ama ii letsong phate saang tu uh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi ngam sungah a teang mite tungah Topa in mawsakna khat nei hi. Israel awng, ama pauna ngai vun: “Hi ngam sungah thumaanna hikale ki itna hikale om ngawl a, mite in keima Pathian in hong saang ngawl hi.","title":"ii Israel A Mawsakna"},"2":{"text":"Amate in kamciamte pia a, paltan hi; amate leilot in, mihing that a, nguta in, kipalngul uh hi. Paunak khat sungah, ‘Ngaisutna nei ngawl mihingte kilalsak tu hi,’ a ci bang ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"“No Israel mite in kei tungah hong thumaan ngawl na hi uh hang Judah te in tuabang in mawna nei heak tahen. Note in Mizpah ah thaang khat, Tabor mual tungah ngen kikhak khat,"},"2":{"text":"Acacia Khuapi ah dum thuk khat na suak uh a, na vekpi in daan kong pia tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel bangbang hi ziam, he khi hi — ama kei kung pan buu thei ngawl tu hi. A numeite ciingsak in! A nausente a op thei ngawl tu in vawt in!"},"15":{"text":"Topa in, “Amate ngamtat siatnate theampo Gilgal pan kipan hi. Tua mun in amate ka etsat kipatna mun ahi hi. Amate ngamtat siatna hu in ka ngam panin amate ka notkeak tu hi. Amate ka it nawn buatu hi; a lampuite theampo in kei hong langpan zo uh hi.","title":"Israel tungah ii Thukhenna"},"16":{"text":"Israel mite sia a zungte ko in, a nga nga ngawl thingkung khat taw kibang hi. Amate in ta nei ngawl tu a, a nei hial zong a it mama a tate ka thatlum tu hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"A na ka sepsak Pathian in a mite nial tu hi, banghang ziam cile amate in a thu nangai ngawl uh hi. Amate sia minam tuatuamte kawmah a vakvaite suak tu uh hi.","title":"Israel atu Kamsaangpa Pauna"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite sia a ngathiam sapitkung khat taw kibang hi. A ci thei vaial ciang biaknatau tam seseam vawt uh hi. A leitang panin a piang a tam seseam ciang a biak uh suangkhuam thiangthote zepna hoisak vaial uh hi."},"2":{"text":"A lungtang uh theam nopna taw a kidim mite sia tu in a mawnate hu in a thuak kul tu hi. Pathian in a biaknataute sutham tu a, a khuam thiangthote susia tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi mite in hai ngawlin, “Eite kumpi ih nei ngawlna in Topa ih kiitak ngawl hang ahi hi. Ahihang kumpi khat in ei atu in bang hong vawtsak thei tuan tu ziam?” ci tu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in a luithawthong kamte pau in, a maan ngawl kamciamte pia a, a kizangh thei ngawl kilem natu thukimnate vawt uh hi. Thutang sia thutang ngawl suak zo a, lothawna sa sungah a nguu nei lopate bangin po hi."},"5":{"text":"Samaria khuapi ah a teang mite lau in, Bethel ah khamh khuital a bo hu in khuangai tu uh hi. Amate le milim biakna ah a seam thiampite sia tuasia thangai in kap tu uh hi. A khamhcii kizepna hoi teng a kihawkeaksak ciang amate mau tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua milim sia a kumpilianpa maivil natu in Assyria ah kipua tu hi. Tua ngaisut piakna bang a zui hu in Israel minpaan tu a, kimaizumsak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Tui tungah a laam thingbek khat bangin a kumpipa kipaipui tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel mite ii milim biakna mun ahi Aven mualdawn biakbukte kisusia tu hi. Lingkungte le lophungte in a biaknataute khunel tu hi. Mite in mualpite tungah, “Hong seal tavun!”, tuaciang mualnote tungah, “Hong siin tavun!” ci in sam tu uh hi.","ref":"Lk 23:30; Tpl 6:16"},"9":{"text":"Topa in “Gibeah ah mawna a vawt hun pan kipan Israel mite kei tungah mawna a vawt uh kheal ngawl hi. Tua ahikom Gibeah ah ngal in amate lap tu hi.","title":"in Israel tungah Thukhenna pia","ref":"Thkte 19:1-30"},"10":{"text":"Hi mimawte ka sim tu a, daan ka pia tu hi. Minam tuatuamte kikaizawnin amate langpan tu a, amate mawna a tam hu in daan kipia tu hi."},"11":{"text":"“Israel sia khatvei lai in a pha takin taangcil tu a kihil sa, taangcil nuamin a kinging khuila khat taw kibang hi. A ngawng hoi sia tungah hakkol khat bulsak in nasep hamsa zaw seamsak tu in ka khensat hi. Judah in lo thawna thingha sia ka kaisak a, Israel in lei kalthapna thik-ha ka kaisak hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima in, “Noma atu in leithak tho vun a, thutang suana ciingin, kei nong biakna pan a piang tu thuphate at vun. Na Topa ahi kei sangah nong kiheak tu hun zo a, tuaciang kong pai tu a, no tungah thupha kong buak tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Jer 4:3"},"13":{"text":"Ahihang siatna thaicii na ciing uh a, tuate anlaak in na nei uh hi. Na leilotnate pan a piang a ngate na ne zo uh hi. “Na siphu ngalleangte le ngalkap tam na neina na suan hu in"},"14":{"text":"na mite tungah ngal hong theng tu a, na kulh theampo kisusia tu hi. Tua ni in Kumpi Shalman ii Betharbel khuapi ngal sungah a lalcipsak le, nute le a tate a kisuklup siat ni bang hi tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua in no, Bethel mite ii a kiitakhuai siatna na vawt uh hu in hong tung tu thu ahi hi. Ngal kido a kipat po ciang Israel kumpipa thi tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel sia patangno khat ahi lai in ama ka it a, ka tapa bangin Egypt ngam pan ka samkhia hi.","title":"Ama a Langpan A mite Pathian ii itna","ref":"Pu 4:22; Mt 2:15"},"2":{"text":"Ahihang ama ka sap a tam vaial ciang hong nungngat san vaial hi. Ka mite in Baal tungah sangaw biakpiakna pia hi; amate in milimte atu in ngimnamtui hal uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahitazong, Israel lampai tu a hil sia keima ka hi hi. Ka mite ka khut sungah ka toai hi, ahihang keima ii ka khoi hunlam amate in tel ngawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Itna le deisakna taw keima sangah amate ka kai hi. Ka domto a ka biangkho taw ka kiphatosak hi; ka kunsuk a, amate an ka vaak hi."},"5":{"text":"“Kei kungah hong heak kik nuam ngawl ahiciang, Egypt ma ah a heak kik uh kul tu a; tuaciang Assyria te in amate uk tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ngal in a khuapite phialmang tu a, a kongpite sutham siat tu hi. A uuk thu in phabel a sak bang po in ngamta ahikom tuasia in ka mite susia hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in kei kung pan puapial tu bebek ma sawm vatan uh hi. Amate tungah hakkol kisuanh ahi hu in kap tu ahihang kuama in a vanh dawn ngawl tu hi."},"8":{"text":"“Israel awng, bangbangin hong thasua thei tu khi ziam? Bangbangin hong nusia thei tu khi ziam? Admah ka suksiat bangin hong susia ngei tu khi ziam? tua ahibuale Zeboiim tungah ka vawt ngei bangin nang hong vawt tu khi ziam? Ka lungtang in tuabang hong vawtsak ngawl tu hi! Nang kong itna sia nasia lei hi.","ref":"Thkna 29:23"},"9":{"text":"Ka thin uuk hu in nang daan kong pia buatu hi; Israel ka susia kik buatu hi. Banghang ziam cile kei mihing hi ngawlin Pathian khi hi. Keima a Thiangtho Pa in note taw kong omkhawm hi. Thin uuksa in nang kung kong pai buatu hi."},"10":{"text":"“A ngalte tawpi bangin ka hawksan ciang ka mite in kei hong zui tu hi. Amate in nitumna sang pan kei kung manlang takin hong zuan tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate Egypt pan vacim bangin, Assyria pan vakhute bangin manlang takin hong pai tu uh hi. Amate a inn tek ah ka ciasak kik tu hi. Keima Topa in ka ci zo hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel mite in kei leilot thu le theamna taw hong kiim uum a, Judah mite in kei a thumaan le a thiangtho Pathian hong langpan lai uh hi.","title":"Israel le Judah Kipuavawk"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zingsang pan nitak dong Israel mite ngamtatnate theampo kimanna om ngawl a, siatna vive hi. Ciampealna le ngoltol ngamtatna sia amate sungah khangto vaial hi. Amate in Assyria taw ngal kilemna thukimnate vawtin Egypt taw sum vawt khawm uh hi,” ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Judah mite tungah Topa in mawsakna khat nei hi; Israel zongh a mite ngamtatna bangin daan pia tu hi. Amate ngamtatna sate bangin ama in thuk kik tu hi."},"3":{"text":"A taanghpupi Jacob sia apeang a suapuipa Esau taw a nu ngil sungah a omkhop lai ma in kilaai hi; Jacob hong khan ciang ama in Pathian langpan hi —","ref":"Pian 25:26; Pian 32:24-26"},"4":{"text":"ama in vantunglalang khat buanin zo hi. Ama kapin thupha ngen hi. Tuaciang Bethel ah ih taanghpupi Jacob kungah Pathian pai in paupui hi.","ref":"Pian 28:10-22"},"5":{"text":"Hisia in Vaanglianbelpa Topa Pathian ahi hi — Topa sia ama ih biak natu min ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom tu in Jacob suan le paalte awng, na Pathian muang vun a, ama kungah heak kik vun. Pathian tungah citakin thutang vun, tuaciang na Pathian ii note atu hong sep tu sia thinsau takin ngak vun."},"7":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel mite sia Canaan mite bangza ma in thumaan ngawl uh hi; amate in vanh leite toaisuang maan ngawl taw theam thanuam uh hi.","title":"Thukhenna Kammal A zom"},"8":{"text":"Amate in ‘Ko hau khu hi, nei le lamh khol zo khu hi. Kuama in thimthelna taw hau hi ci in, ko hong mawsak thei ngawl hi,’ ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang, Egypt ngam pan hong pusua pui keima, Topa na Pathian in, senneal ngamsung noma kungah kong pai lai bangma in tuipuan buk sungah kong teangsak kik tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 23:42-43"},"10":{"text":"“Kamsaangte ka paupui a, mukholna tam mama ka pia hi, tuaciang kamsaangte tungtawnin ka mite kidop natu thu ka pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hi napi Gilead ah milimte kibia a, a biate thi tu hi. Gilgal ah khuitalte sangaw biakpiakna in kipia a, tua munah biaknataute zong lozau sungah suang kholte suak tu hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ih taanghpupi Jacob sia Mesopotamia ah tai a, zi khat a nga natu in tua munah midang khat ii na seamin a tuute cing hi.","ref":"Pian 29:1-20"},"13":{"text":"Egypt a saltanna pan Israel mite a suatak tu le a keam tu in Topa in kamsaang khat puak hi.","ref":"Pu 12:50-51"},"14":{"text":"Israel mite in Topa nasia takin thin uuksak hi; amate khialna liante hangin a thi tu in kilawm hi. Ama min a daisak uh hu in Topa in amate daan pia tu hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hun bosa sungah Ephraim namte a pau ciang, Israel nam dangte lau a; amate in Ephraim thupi et hi. Ahihang tua mite Baal bia in mawna vawt ahi uh ciang hi sia hu in amate thi tu uh hi.","title":"Israel tung A khakbel Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Mihing ngaisutna le mihing khut taw a suai ngunn milimte — thik milimte a biak tu in a vawtna taw amate maw thua seseam uh hi. Tuasia zawk ciang amate in, “Tuate tungah sangaw biakpiakna pia vun!” ci hi. Bangbangin akua in tua milimte — khuital lim a, a kivawtte — namh thei tu ziam!"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahiciang hi mite in zingsang mokkaaite bangin mang tu a, nisua tuung a bo daaituite taw kibang hi. Amate sia taangcilna phual pan, vui ii seamkeak a site bang, meikhu suana pan meikhu bang hi tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in, “Keima in Topa noma ii Pathian, Egypt pan hong pui pa khi hi. Kei simngawl Pathian dang nei ngawl nu hi. Keima bekma na ngumpa ka hi hi."},"5":{"text":"Senneal lei kona ah note kong keam hi.","ref":"Thkna 8:11-17"},"6":{"text":"Ahihang tua ngam phana ah na tum uh ciang ankham in na lung uh kim a, tuasia ciang, kiphasakin, kei nong mangil uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahiciang tawpi khat bangin no kong sim tu hi. Na lampi tungah pawlbeam khat bangin kong pang tu hi."},"8":{"text":"A note a bosua vompui khat bangin note kong sim tu a, kong baltham tu hi. Tawpi khat bangin thakhatin kong ne tum paih tu a, ngamsa khat bangin kong balneen tu hi."},"9":{"text":"“Israel mite awng, hong susia tu khi hi! Tuasia ciang akua in no hong hu thei tu ziam?"},"10":{"text":"Note in kumpi khat le lampuite ngen nu hi, ahihang amate in na ngam uh bangbang hu thei tu ziam?","ref":"1 Sa 8:5-6"},"11":{"text":"Ka thin uukna taw kumpite kong pia zo a, ka thinso in thangsiatna taw amate ka la keak zo hi.","ref":"1 Sa 10:17-24; 1 Sa 15:26"},"12":{"text":"“Israel ii mawna le khialna te kiciamtee a, a kitepteenate bit takin kikeam hi."},"13":{"text":"Israel in nuntak natu hunpha nei napi a mawmawt lei hu in tua nuntakna la thei ngawl hi — a suak dektak nausen khat naubu sung pan a pusuak nuam ngawl taw kibang hi."},"14":{"text":"Hi mite sia mithi khua pan ka ngum buatu a, ahibuale thina vaang pan ka suatak buatu hi. Thina awng, na pul natnate hong paipui ta'n! Mithi khua awng, na suksiat theina hong paipui ta'n! Hi mite ka hesuak nawn buatu hi.","ref":"1 Cor 15:55"},"15":{"text":"Israel in lopa bangin pung hikale, sennealngam pan nisuana vuisa khat ka vasak tu a, a tuinaakte le a tuikhukte ka kangsak tu hi. Tua vuisa in a mannei na theampo lenmang tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Kei hong langpan hu in Samaria sia daan kipia nanak tu hi. A mite ngal sungah thi tu uh hi; nausente sia lei denna in kinei tu a, naupaai nupite ngil kikui tham tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite awng, Topa na Pathian kungah heak kik vun. Noma mawna in hong lutusak a, hong puksak hi.","title":"Israel tungah Hosea ii Thuumna"},"2":{"text":"Topa kungah heak kik vun a, hi thungetna sia ama tungah na biakpiakna uh hisak vun: “Koma mawna theampo hong maisak ta'n a, ka thungetna uh hong saang ta'n. Tuaciang kong kamciam bangin nang hong pok tu khu hi."},"3":{"text":"Assyria in ko hong hung thei ngeingawl a, ngal siphute in ko hong dal thei ngawl hi. Kote in milimte tungah ka Pathian hi ci kik ngei nawn bua vak ung. Topa awng, nangma in belh tu dang a nei ngawlte hesuak ni hi.”"},"4":{"text":"Topa in, “Ka mite ka kung ka then kik tu hi. Ka thin theampo taw amate ka it tu a; amate tungah ka thin uuk nawn ngawl hi.","title":"in Nuntakna Thak Israel te Kamciam Pia"},"5":{"text":"Keima in Israel mite tungah ngam kona ah nguatui bang ka hi tu hi. Amate in paakte bangin a palh tu hi; Lebanon thingkungte bangin a zung kho tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in khantona thak taw nungta tu a, olive kung hoi te bangin etlawm tu hi. Lebanon Cedar te bangin amate namtui tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Khatvei ma amate sia keima angvanna sungah nungta tu uh hi. Amate in an ciing in, sapithuan bangin ngathiam tu hi. Amate sia Lebanon sapittui bangin minthang tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel mite sia milimte taw kisai nawn ngawl tu hi. Amate ii thungetnate ka zo tu a, amate ka keam tu hi; A tee a hing tawntung thingkung bangin amate ka uap tu a; a thupha theampo ii naak ka hi hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Miciimte in hi sung a, a ki atte tel tahen a, a thinsung uh ah ciing thei tahen. Topa ii lampite maan a, thutang mite in tuate a zuina taw nungta uh hi, ahihang mimaw mikhial te lutu in puk uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate in tua thute awlmaw ngawl uh hi.","title":"Thukhupna"}}}}},"29":{"info":{"name":"Joel","shortname":"Joel","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi sia in Pethuel tapa Joel tungah Topa ii thupuak ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Khanghaamzawte awng, nadon vun; Judah ngamsung a om mihing theampo awng ngai vun. Hi bang thu peuma noma khan sung ahizong na taanghpupi te khan sung ahizong a piang ngei ziam?","title":"Lo An Lal hu in a Mite Khuangai"},"3":{"text":"Na tate tungah tua thu son vun; amate in a tate tungah sonsawn tu hi, tuate in a khang kikte tungah sonsawn tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Khaumaw honkhat zawkciang honkhat in lo ante topha hi; Hon khat ii nusiat sate hon dang khat in khawng tum hi."},"5":{"text":"No zu khamte awng, khanglo vun a kap vun; no sapittui nete awng, kap vun; sapittui thak vawt natu sapitngate kisusia zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Khaumaw ngalkaphonpi khat in ih ngam hong sim hi; tuate thahatin tam leih a, kisim zo ngawl hi; a hate tawpi ha bangin hiam hi.","ref":"Tpl 9:8"},"7":{"text":"Amate in ih sapitkungte susia zo a, ih theikungte khimtham zo hi. Amate in thingbaakte a kaang dongin a haw khok keak hi."},"8":{"text":"No mite awng, a teenpui tu pa a thi ciang ngaknu khat a khuangai bangin kap vun."},"9":{"text":"Biakinnpi sungah piak tu antang ahibuale sapittui om ngawl hi; Topa biakpiak natu bangma nei ngawl ahikom thiampite khuangai hi."},"10":{"text":"Lote kolh hi; leitangte khuangai hi banghang ziam cile ankungte kisusia in sapitngate kikosak a, olive kungte kivulsak hi."},"11":{"text":"No, lothote awng, khuangai vun; sapithuan cingte awng kap vun, banghang ziam cile zungtaangte, mangtaangte, ankung theampo kisusia hi."},"12":{"text":"Sapitkungte le theikungte kongaw zo hi; thingnga kungte theampo vulin thi zo hi. Mite ii lungdamna bo hi."},"13":{"text":"No, biaknatau ah naseam thiampite awng, khau-ip puan silhin kap vun! Biakinnpi sungah tumin, zankhuateak khuangai vun! Na Pathian na piak tu uh antang, ahibuale sapittui om ngawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Antan natu thupia vun; kikhoppi khat sam vun! Lampuite le Judah mi theampo Topa na Pathian Biakinnpi sungah khawmtua in, ama ko in au vun!"},"15":{"text":"Topa ni nai hi; Vaanglianbelpa ii siatna hong tunsak tu ni ahi hi. Tua ni in bangza launa piang tu ziam!","ref":"Is 13:6"},"16":{"text":"Ih ante a suksiat ciang cimaw in ih en lel hi. Ih Pathian Biakinnpi sungah lungdamna om ngawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Anciite leiko sungah thi hi. Khol tu antang om ngawl hi; tua ahikom ansaal hawmte lalcip hi."},"18":{"text":"Khuite ngilkialin haam uh hi, banghang ziam cile a tat natu lohing mun om ngawl hi; tuuhonte zongh in thuak uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa awng, nang kong ausan hi, banghang ziam cile mei ii halthap bang keakin nganthana le thingkungte kongaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Luituite kang ahikom ngamsate ngawngawn in nang hong ko uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lemle tum vun; Pathian mual thiangtho Zion tungah patau daak tum vun, Judah mite awng, liing vun! Topa ni hong theng pal tu hi.","title":"Ni atu Kidop natu Khaumawte taw lak"},"2":{"text":"Tua ni sia khuatuapin, a zing le meeivom kaai ni khat hi tu hi. Mualte tungah khuazing kizel bangin khaumaw ngalkaphonpi in maisang nawk hi. Hi bang peuma om ngeingawl a, om kik ngei nawn ngawl tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Meikuang bangin tuate in ankungte netum hi. A mai sangah ngam pha in Eden Huan bang hi a, ahihang a nungsangah ngam kolhin sennealngam ahi hi. Tuate kung pan bangma suakta ngawl hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuate siphute taw kibang a; ngal siphute bangin tai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Mualdawnte ah a lento uh ciang siphu ngalleangte bangin nging vatel a; lopa kote mei taw hal bangin puak vatam hi. Tuate sia ngalsim tu in a kithoai ngalkap honpui khat bangin kingual uh hi.","ref":"Tpl 9:7-9"},"6":{"text":"Tuate a nai ciang kuama theampo lau a; a maitang theampo daang siat uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngalhangte bangin tuate in sim a; luphungte tungah ngalkapte bangin kaato uh hi. A vekpi ma in mai sangah tang tak nawk in, a pai natu san pial ngawl hi,"},"8":{"text":"ahibuale khat le khat a mai kikhak ngawl uh hi. Ngal nannate kaantan vanuau in kuama in khak zo ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuate in khuapi bulu a; a luphungte kaantan uh hi; tuate inn tungah kaato in ngutate bangin khelkite pan tum uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Mai ah a manaw uh ciang lei liing a; van kilok hi. Ni le tha mial a, aksite taang nawn ngawl hi.","ref":"Tpl 8:12"},"11":{"text":"Topa in a ngalkaphonpi tungah vanto aw taw thupia hi. A thuni ngalkap honte tam a, thahat hi. Topa ni sia bangza in lauhuai ziam! akua suakta zo tu ziam?","ref":"Tpl 6:17"},"12":{"text":"Topa in “Ahihang tu mama zongh in, thintak taw kisiik kik in kei kungah an tanna, kaana le mauna taw hong heak kik tavun.","title":"Kisii kik natu Kikaizotna"},"13":{"text":"Na thin tapthapna taw in na heena lak vun; na puansilh balthapna bek sia kicing ngawl hi,” ci hi. Topa na Pathian kungah pai kik vun. Ama cingh a, hesuakna taw kidim hi; ama a thinsau a, a kamciam len hi; ama in khialna mawna maisak tu le daan piak ngawl tu in kinging tawntung hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa na Pathian in a thin kheal tha tu a, an hauna taw nang thupha hong pia tu hi. Tuasia ciang antang le sapittui te ama na pia thei tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Zion Mual ah lemle tum vun; antan natu thupia vun a, mipi kikhop sam vun!"},"16":{"text":"Mite khawmtua vun; a thiangtho kikhop natu in kithoaisak vun; khanghaamte hong paipui tavun; patangte le nausente zongh khawmtua vun. A kiteang tuung nupate zongh a inn nusia in hong pai uh kul tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Biaknatau le Biakinnpi tumna kilaklaw a, Topa na a seam thiampite kapin thu a nget uh kul tu hi: “ Topa awng, na mite hesuak in. Minam dangte in, ‘Na Pathian koisung om ziam?’ ci in hong zawngsak hong nunausak heak in,” ci tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa in ama leitang atu thinbot a; ama in a mite hesuak hi.","title":"Pathian in Leitang Phasak kik"},"19":{"text":"Ama in amate tungah hi bang in zo hi: “Tu in an, sapittui le olive thau kong pia tu a, na lung uh kim tu hi. Minam dangte in no hong zawngsak nawn ngawl tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Saksang pan hong pai khaumaw honpite ka heam tu a, pawlkhatte sennealngam sungah ka hawlkeak tu hi. A mai dok ngual teng Tuipi Thi sungah, a nung ngual teng Mediterranean tuipi sungah kihawlkeak tu hi. A thisate muat in ui tu hi. Note tungah hong vawtnate hangin tuate ka susia tu hi,"},"21":{"text":"“Lote awng, lau heak vun, Topa hong sepsak sate hu in lungpil in lungdam vun."},"22":{"text":"Nganhingte awng lau heak vun, Ngan thana munte hing a; thingkungte a nga nga in, thei le sapitngate tam mama om hi."},"23":{"text":"“Zion mite awng, lungdam vun, Topa na Pathian ii note atu a sep sate hu in lungdam vun. Ama in tangngam ngua a khombek khat in hong pia a; ama in phalbi nguate no atu hong buaksuk in, khuapi ngua zongh hong piak ngei bang hong pia hi."},"24":{"text":"Taang cilna munte sia antang taw kidim tu a; thingngatui sukna hui ah leidumte sia sapittui le olive thau taw dimleet tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Khaumaw honte ii na lo an hong neaktumsak kumte sungah na sup uhte kong pia kik tu hi. Hi khaumaw honpi hong puak sia keima khi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tu in neak tu tam mama nei in, na lung uh kim tu hi. Na lamdangte no atu hong sepsak Topa na Pathian na pok tu uh hi. Ka mite kizawnsak vawt kik ngei nawn ngawl tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Israel awng, note sungah ka om hunlam na he tu uh hi, keima in Topa , noma ii Pathian ka hi a, Pathian dang om ngawl hi. Ka mite kizawngsak kik ngei nawn ngawl tu hi."},"28":{"text":"“Tuasia zawkciang a kuama po tungah ka Thaa ka buak tu a: na tapate le tanute in ka thu thangsak tu uh hi; na khanghaamte in mang man tu uh a, na khangnote in mukholna mu tu uh hi.","title":"ii Ni","ref":"Sawl 2:17-21"},"29":{"text":"Tua hun in naseam nupite le pasalte tung ngawngawn ah ka Thaa ka buak tu hi."},"30":{"text":"“Tua ni hun atu kidop thei natu in van le lei ah limte ka pia tu a; chisan luanna, meikuang le meikhu lomte om tu hi."},"31":{"text":"A lian le a lauhuai Topa ii ni hong pai ma in, ni kimialsak tu a, tha zongh chi bangin san tu hi.","ref":"Mt 24:29; Mk 13:24-25; Lk 21:25; Tpl 6:12-13"},"32":{"text":"Ahihang Topa tungah huna a ngen theampo kingum tu hi. Topa ci sa bangin ‘Jerusalem a om pawlkhatte suakta tu a; ka teal mite suakta tu uh hi.’","ref":"Rom 10:13"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in, “Tua hun in Judah le Jerusalem puuapha in nopsakna ka pia kik tu hi.","title":"Pathian in Minamte Thukhen tu"},"2":{"text":"Minam theampo ka khawmtua tu a, Thukhenna Kuam ah ka paipui tu hi. Ka mite tung a, a vawt na sa theampo huvau in tua munah amate thu ka khen tu hi. Amate in Israel te ngamdang ah thethaang in, ka Israel ngam khentham uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in a ngalmatte akua teng in nga tu ziam ci in, nuangtang lawnin khensat uh hi. Amate in pumpi zuakte a thapna le sapittui leina in, patangno le numeinote salin zuak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“Tyre, Sidon le Philistia ngamkhente theampo awng, kei, bang hong law nuam nu ziam? Bang khat po hangin hong thuk kik nuamin hanciam nu ziam? Tuabang nong hi uh le keima in manlang takin kong thuk kik tu hi!"},"5":{"text":"Note in ka ngunn ka khamh te la in, ka sumngum manphate na biakinnte uh ah na pua uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Judah le Jerusalem mite sia amate ngam pan a khuala mamana ah paipui in Greek te tungah na zuak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu in amate na zuakna munte pan ka pui kik tu hi. Amate tung na vawt uh bangin note tungah kong vawt tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Na tapate le na tanute Judah mite tungah ka zuaksak tu a; amate in a khualana Sabean te tungah zuaksawn tu hi. Keima Topa in ka ci zo hi.","ref":"Is 14:29-31; 23:1-18; Jer 47:1-7; Eze 26:1—28:26; Amo 1:6-10; Zep 2:4-7; Zec 9:1-4; Mt 11:21-22; Lk 10:13-14"},"9":{"text":"“Minamte sungah hi thu thangsak vun: ‘Ngalsim tu in kithoai vun; na ngalhangte sam vun; na ngalkapte khawm vun a, kuan vun!"},"10":{"text":"Na lo thawna thikzumte seak vun a, namsau suaksak vun, na thingno attanna namte tei sua vun. A thazawmte ngawngawn in ngalsim hamtang tu uh hi.","ref":"Is 2:4; Mic 4:3"},"11":{"text":"Manlang in hong pai tavun, no, kiim le paam a om minamte awng, a kuam sungah kikhawm tavun,’ ci vun,” ci hi. Topa awng, amate sim tu in, na ngalkaphonpite puak suk in!"},"12":{"text":"“Minamte kithoai in, Thukhenna Kuam ah hong pai kul tu hi. Tua munah kiim le paam minamte theampo tungah thukhen tu in keima, Topa ka to tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate seksol mama hi; anlaak hun lai ankungte saattan bangin amate saattan vun; sapitngate a tuisuukna sung dimin a tui let dong a kingoaitham bangin amate sucip vun,” ci hi.","ref":"Tpl 14:14-16; Tpl 14:19-20; 19:15"},"14":{"text":"A tul a tulin Thukhenna Kuam sungah om uh hi. Tua munah Topa ii ni hong theng pal tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Ni le tha zing a, aksite taang nawn ngawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Zion mual pan Topa hawk hi; Jerusalem pan a aw vanto bangin nging a; van le lei liing hi. Ahihang ama in a mite sungsia tu hi.","title":"Pathian in A mite Thupha Pia tu","ref":"Amo 1:2"},"17":{"text":"“Tuasia ciang Israel awng, keima in Topa na Pathian ka hi hunlam nong he tu uh hi. Ka mual thiangtho Zion tungah ka teang hi. Jerusalem sia khuapi thiangtho khat hi tu a; ngamdangte in tuasia zothal kik ngeingawl tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hun ciang mualpite sia sapithuan taw kidim tu a, mualno sim ah khuihon kimu tu hi; Judah ngamsung lui theampo atu in tui tam mama om tu hi. Topa Biakinnpi panin lui khat luang tu a, tua lui in Acacia Kuam tui pia tu hi."},"19":{"text":"“Egypt ngam sia sennealngam khat suak tu a, Edom kisia in dui suak tu hi. Banghang ziam cile amate in Judah ngam simin mawbaang ngawl, a mite thatlum uh hi."},"20":{"text":"A kithatte ii phu ka lam tu hi; a mawte ka thasua buatu hi. Ahihang Judah le Jerusalem te ah a tawntungin mihing teang tu hi, tuaciang Zion Mualtung ah keima Topa ka teang tu hi,” ci hi.","merge":"21"}}}}},"30":{"info":{"name":"Amos","shortname":"Amos","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hite sia Tekoa khua pan tuu cingpa khat ahi Amos ii kammalte ahi hi. Judah kumpi in Uzziah maang a, Israel kumpi in Jehoash tapa Jeroboam a khan hun, zinliin ma kum nii lai in, Pathian in Amos tungah Israel huvau hi thute theampo lak hi.","ref":"2 Kum 15:1-7; 2 Khang 26:1-23; 2 Kum 14:23-29"},"2":{"text":"Amos in, “ Topa sia Zion mual pan hawk a; Jerusalem pan a aw sia hong nging keak hi. Ngan thana munte ko a, Carmel mual a lopate vul hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Jol 3:16"},"3":{"text":"Topa in, “Damascus mite maw kikik khial kikik ahiciang amate daan pia tatak tu khi hi. Amate in Gilead mite tungah ngilo in vawtsia hi.","title":"Israel ii Ngampaamte tungah Pathian ii Thukhenna. Syria","ref":"Is 17:1-3; Jer 49:23-27; Zec 9:1"},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom Kumpipa Hazael saksa kumpi inn sia meikuang khiakin Kumpi Benhadad ii kulhte haltham tu khi hi."},"5":{"text":"Damascus khuapi kongpite sutham in, Aven Kuam a teang mihingte le Betheden a ukpa heam tu khi hi. Syria mite sia Kir ngam ah luangta tu hi,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in “Gaza mite maw kikik khial kikik ahiciang amate daan ka pia tatak tu hi. Amate in minam bup paipui in Edom mite tungah salin zuak uh hi.","title":"Philistia","ref":"Is 14:29-31; Jer 47:1-7; Eze 25:15-17; Jol 3:4-8; Zep 2:4-7; Zec 9:5-7"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Gaza khuapi luphung tungah meikuang ka khiak tu a, a kulhte ka haltum tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ashdod le Ashkelon khuapite a ukte ka heam tu hi. Ekron khuapi daan ka pia tu a, Philistine mite a taanglai theampo thi tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in, “Tyre mite maw kikik, khial kikik ahiciang amate daan ka pia tatak tu hi. Amate in minam bup Edom ah sal tang tu in paisak a, kipawlmat natu thukimna a vawt sia len ngawl hi.","title":"Tyre","ref":"Is 23:1-18; Eze 26:1—28:19; Jol 3:4-8; Zec 9:1-4; Mt 11:21-22; Lk 10:13-14"},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom Tyre khuapi luphung tungah meikuang ka khiak tu a, a kulhpite ka haltham tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in, “Edom mite maw kikik khial kikik ahiciang daan ka pia tatak tu hi. Amate in a suapui Israel te savai bangin vai a, hesuak ngawl hi. Amate thin uukna sia ciangtan nei ngawl a, thaisak ngeingawl uh hi.","title":"Edom"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom Teman khuapi tungah meikuang ka khiak tu a, Bozrah kulhpite ka haltum tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Eze 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Oba 1-14; Mal 1:2-5"},"13":{"text":"Topa in, “Ammon mite maw kikik khial kikik ahiciang amate daan ka pia tatak tu hi. Amate in ngamkeau ngal kisimna sung Gilead khua ah naupaai numeite ngawngawn ii ngil kuikeak uh hi.","title":"Ammon","ref":"Jer 49:1-6; Eze 21:28-32; 25:1-7; Zep 2:8-11"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom Rabbah khuapi luphungte tungah meikuang ka khiak tu a, a kulhpite ka haltum tu hi. Tuasia ciang ngal kisim ni in auna awsa om ngawp tu a, kidona nasia in vuipi suangval bang phet ma hi tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate kumpipa le a uliante saltaang in pai tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in, “Moab mite maw kikik khial kikik ahiciang amate daan ka pia tatak tu hi. Amate in Edom kumpipa ii ngute sia zawnsak vawtin haltham a, vut suaksak hi.","title":"Moab","ref":"Is 15:1—16:14; 25:10-12; Jer 48:1-47; Eze 25:8-11; Zep 2:8-11"},"2":{"text":"Moab ngam ah meikuang ka khiak tu a, Kerioth kulhpite ka haltham tu hi. Ngal kisimna ah ngalkapte au in lemle tum a, tua awsa lialua sungah Moab mite thi tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Moab ngamukpa le ngam lampuite theampo ka thatlum tu hi.” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in, “Judah mite maw kikik khial kikik ahiciang amate daan ka pia tatak tu hi. Amate in ka hilnate thusim ngawl a ka thupiakte zui ngawl uh hi. A taanghpupi ii biak a maan ngawl pathiante ma in amate lam pialsak hi.","title":"Judah"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom Judah tungah meikuang ka khiak tu a, Jerusalem kulhpite ka haltum tu hi,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel mite maw kikik khial kikik ahiciang amate daan ka pia tatak tu hi. Amate in leiba a lo zo ngawl mi thumaante, peangdap kop khat ii man zongh a pia kik zo ngawl mizawng teng sal in zuak hi.","title":"Israel tungah Pathian Thukhenna"},"7":{"text":"Amate in a thazawm a cimawte tuanhpeak in mizawngte sawn vawk hi. Pasal khat le a ta in a sila nu luppui khawm a, tua bangin ka min thiangtho daisak hi."},"8":{"text":"Biak kikhopna mun theampo ah, a zawngte ii leitoai natu a pon puante sia mite in luppha in nei uh hi. Amate in sum a bate tung pan a laak sapittui zongh, a Pathian biakinn sungah ne uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua ahitazong ka mite awng cedar thingkungte bangin saang a, oak thingkungte bangin a thakho, Amor te ka sukcipna sia noma kong khualna hi.","ref":"Thkna 3:8-11"},"10":{"text":"Egypt ngam pan kong pusuaksak a, sennealngam kaantanin kum sawmli sung lam kong pui a, noma atu in Amor te ngam kong pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Na tapate pawlkhat kamsaang tu in ka teal a, na khangmoi tangval pawlkhat Nazirite tu in ka teal hi. Hi thute thumaan hi kana ngawl ziam, Israel mite awng? Keima Topa in ka ci zo hi.","ref":"Mi 6:1-8"},"12":{"text":"Ahihang tua Nazirite te sapittui na nesak uh a, ka thusonte a son kik ngawl natu in kamsaangte thu na pia uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu in note lei ah kong henpeak tu a, antang a dimin a kiheang leang khat bangin na mau tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tai manlangte zongh suakta ngawl tu uh hi; mihing thakhote a tha bo tu a, tuaciang ngalkapte zongh in a nuntakna uh kihuu zo ngawl tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Thal toaite in nalh zo ngawl tu a, tai manlangte suakta ngawl tu hi, siphu tung to mite in a nuntakna suatak ngawl tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ni in a hangbel ngalkapte zongh a ngalhiamte khia in tai tu uh hi,” ci hi. Topa in ci zo hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt ngam pan minam bup in ama ii hong pusuasak Israel mite awng, note huvau Topa pauna hi thu ngai vun:"},"2":{"text":"“Leitung minam theampo sung pan kong heak le kong thin nop mawk sia noma bek na hi uh hi. Hi thu in noma mawna khialna nasiasak seseam a, tua hu in daan kong piak kul tu hi.”"},"3":{"text":"Kisiktua natu in vaihawmna omkhol ngawlin mihing nii khualhaw khawm thei tu ziam?","title":"Kamsaangpa ii Nasep"},"4":{"text":"Tawpi in sa mat tu khat mu ngawl bulin duisung ah hawk thawthong na ziam? Tawpi moi khat in mat khat nei buale a kua sungah thuum vangam na ziam?"},"5":{"text":"Thaang a kisia ciang aitaana khat om buale vacim awk ngei na ziam? Thaang keaksa sia a pealsak khat a om buale peal na ziam?"},"6":{"text":"Khuapi sungah khua mite a lausak ngawl tu ngal patau lemle a kitum om na ziam? Topa in a puak buale khuapi khat ah tuasiatna theng tu ziam?"},"7":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in a naseam kamsaangte tungah a tupna kilanghsak phot ngawlin bangma seam ngeingawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Tawpi a hawk ciang akua lau ngawlin om thei tu ziam? Vaanglianpipa Topa a pau ciang a thu thangsak ngawlin akua om thei tu ziam?"},"9":{"text":"Ashdod le Egypt kumpi innte sung a teangte munah hi bangin taangko vun: “Samaria kiimkot mualte tungah kikhawm vun a, tua munah a nasia mama buaina le khialna liante en vun.”","title":"Samaria Lalna"},"10":{"text":"Topa in, “Hi mite in a innpite sia khialna lian le ngongtatna taw a laaksak vanhte taw dimh uh hi. Amate in thumaan natu zia ngawngawn he ngawl uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom ngal in a ngam kiim uum in, a kidalnate susia tu a, a innte phuulsak tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in, “Tuucing khat in tawpi khat ii a neakmong tuu ii peang nii ahibuale tuu ii bil khat bekma a top kik vathiam bangma, tu in lupna nuam niknek tungah a nop om Samaria te tawm bek luhai tu nu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu in ngai vun, Jacob suan le paalte tungah kidopna tu zasak vun,” Vaanglianpipa Topa in ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel te a mawnate hu in daan ka piak ni ciang, Bethel a biaknataute ka susia tu hi. Biaknatau sim ii a taw king teng kisutan tu a, lei ah puk tu hi.","ref":"2 Kum 23:15"},"15":{"text":"Phalbi innte le khuakhaal innte ka susia tu hi. Saiha taw a kizeam innte siacip in, cimh tu hi; inn lian theampo kisusia tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A thaneamte vawtsia a, mizawngte a nengniam, na pasalte ii zuhang hong piak tan tu a ngen, pha takin a kivaak, Bashan a khuipuite bangin a thau, no, Samaria numeite awng, hi thu ngai vun!"},"2":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa thiangtho ahi bangma ama in, “Amate in note thikkoai taw hong kai tu hun hong theng tu hi; note khat simin ngasa tangthaakna thikkoai khat tung a awk ngasa khat bang hi tu nu hi."},"3":{"text":"Luphung hawngvang nai belna ah note hong kikai keak tu a, a pua ah hong kilawnthal tu hi,” ci in hong kamciam zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Israel mite awng, na hi nuam vangaat uh le mun thiangtho Bethel ah pai in mawna khialna vawt tavun! Gilgal ah pai vun a, na tha neiza uh taw maw tavun! Paisuak vun a, zing khat zawk ciangin zing khat sangaw biakpiak tu ngannote hong paipui tavun, ni thum simin na sawm a khat hong paipui tavun.","title":"Israel ii Thuheak Laakna"},"5":{"text":"Paisuak vun a, Pathian tungah lungdamkona in na anluumte pia vun a, na piak thua uh biakpiaknate tungtaang ah kisuangtaak vun! Hisia in na sep thanop uhte nam ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in, “Na khuapite theampo tungah kialpi a tungsak sia keima khi hi, ahihang kei kung nong zuan kik bua uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Na lo ante ii kisapbel hun laitakin nguatui ka hangsak hi. Khuapi khat sungah ngua ka zusak a, khat sungah ngua ka hangsak hi. Lo khat sungah nguazu a, a dang lo khat kocip hi."},"8":{"text":"Dangkona taw tha zawmin, khuapi tam ma ii mite sia khuapi khat ah tui mu tu ki um in a pai uh hang neakkhom tu a om bua hi. Tua hi napi, kei kung nong zuan kik tuan bua lai uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Na lo ante nguataksak tu in vuisa ka vasak hi. Khaumawte in na huan an le sapitkung te, na theikung le olive kung te netum uh hi. Kei kung nong zuan kik bua lai uh hi."},"10":{"text":"“Pul natna khat Egypt ah ka tunsak bangin no tungah kong tungsak hi. Na khangnote ngal sungah ka thatlum a, na siphu te ka la hi. Na ngiaphual uh ah mithi uih taw na naakvang kong dim hi. Tuabang hi napi kei kungah nong heak kik tuan bua lai uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“No pawlkhat sia Sodom le Gomorrah ka suksiat bangin kong susia hi. No a thi mong teng sia meikhuk khat pan a kiteen thingkhua kaanghmong bang na hi uh hi. Tua hi napi, kei kung nong zuan kik tuan bua lai uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 19:24"},"12":{"text":"“Tuabang ahikom, Israel mite awng, note daan hong pia tu khi hi. Hi sia vawt tu ka hi ciang ka thukhenna thuak tu in kinging sa in om vun!” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Pathian in mualte a vawt pa le vuite a bitphuapa ahi hi. Ama in a ngaisutnate mihing in hesak hi; ama in sun sia zan suaksak hi. Ama in leitung saangnate tungah vak hi. Hisia ama min hi: Vaanglianbelpa Topa Pathian ahi hi!"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mite awng, note atu in hi mithi vuina la kong sak sia ngai vun:","title":"Kisii kik natu Samna"},"2":{"text":"Numei thiangtho Israel puk zo hi! Tho kik ngei nawn ngawl tu hi! Ama lei ah kinusia in lum hi, kuama in ama phongto ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in, “Israel khuapi khat in ngalkap tulkhat paisak ahihang, zakhat bek heak kik hi; khuapi dang khat in zakhat paisak ahihang, sawm bek heak kik hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa in Israel mite tungah, “Kei kungah hong pai tavun, tua hile na nungta tu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Biakkikhopna vawt tu in Beersheba ah pai heak vun. Bethel ah kei hong zong heak vun — Bethel sia a luithawthong suak tu hi. Gilgal ah pai heak vun — a mite saltaang in lal tu uh hi” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa kungah pai vun, tua hile na nungta tu uh hi. Na pai bua uh le Israel mite tungah meikuang bangin Topa hong tuaksuk tu hi. Bethel mite mei in kaanghtum tu hi, kuama in tua mei sumit zo ngawl tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Thukhaikimte siatsua a, tuaciang mite ii nga tute a theam note a lalsa na hi uh hi!"},"8":{"text":"Topa in siluk le zawlzawng aksite vawt hi. Ama in khuazing sia khuavak suaksak a, sun sia zan suaksak hi. Ama in tuipi tuite samin lei ah bunghkeak hi. Ama min in Topa ahi hi.","ref":"Job 9:9; 38:31"},"9":{"text":"Ama in a thahatte le a kulh muanhuaite suksiatsak hi."},"10":{"text":"Note in thukhenzum ah thutang khen ngawlna a nalhte le thumaan thutak vive a sonte na ensan uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A zawngte na nengniam uh a, a antangte na suttol uh hi. Tua hu in noma saksa suanginn phate sungah na teang buatu uh a, noma ciin sapithuan hoite pan sapittui na ne buatu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Na mawna uh bangza in kiitakhuai a, khialna lian bangza vawt zo nu ziam ci sia ka he hi. Mihing phate vawtsia in, sumnguk ne a, thukhenzum ah mizawngte atu in thukhaikim a kisep natu na khaam uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahiciang hi bang hunsia laitakin thim khipkhep a om na in a pilvang ngamtatna ahi hi!"},"14":{"text":"Na nuntak thei natu in siatna vawt ngawlin a maan vawt sawm vun. Tua hile kote kungah Vaanglianbel Topa Pathian om hi na ci uh bangin note taw om takpi tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Thusia ngaimaw in thu man dei vun a, thukhenzumte ah thukhaikim omsak vun. Hi ngamte sungah a nungta lai mite Topa in hesuak thei tha tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom Vaanglianpipa Topa Vaanglianbelpa in, “Khuapi lampite ah heena, kaana le tauna om tu hi. Lotho mite ngawngawn zongh a khuangaipui tu in a kicialte taw ma in mithi kaa tu kisam khawm tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Sapit huan theampo sungah kaana om tu hi. Hite theampo hong theng tu hi, banghang ziam cile keima in note daan pia tu in kong pai hi,” ci hi. Topa in ci zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa ni ngaingam in a ngakla note atu in bangza in lauhuai tu ziam! Tua ni in note bang phattuamna hong pia tu ziam? Note atu in tua sia khuavak ni hi ngawlin khuazin ni hi tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua sia tawpi kung pan tai a, vompui taw a kisi pasal sia bang hi tu nu hi! Tua ahibuale pasal khat inn hong cia a, pang tung zawt napo kinei sia, ngul ii tuk taw kibang tu nu hi!"},"20":{"text":"Topa ni in khuazing hong paipui tu a khuavak hong paipui ngawl tu hi; tua ni sia maitaina om ngawlin lungzin ni khat hi tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa in, “Na biakna poaite ngaimaw khi hi; tuate sia kiihuai sa khi hi!","ref":"Is 1:11-14"},"22":{"text":"Meihal biakpiakna le antang biakpiakna nong piak uh ciang hong saang ngawl tu khi hi; kei biakpiakna in nong paipui, thau takin na vak nganhingte hong saang ngawl tu khi hi."},"23":{"text":"A nangonhuai na lasak uhte tawp vun; na tengtongh awte ngai nuam ngawl khi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuate taangin thukhaikim sia luitui bangin luangsak vun a, thutang sia a kang ngeingawl ngun bangin luang tahen."},"25":{"text":"“Israel mite awng, sennealngam kaantan in kum sawmli sung kong lampui lai in sangaw biakpiaknate le piakkhiatnate kong ngen bua hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:42-43"},"26":{"text":"Ahihang tu in na pathian kumpi Sakkuth ii lim le na aksi pathian Kaiwan limte na biak uh ahikom tua milimte zongh"},"27":{"text":"Damascus kalhin saltaang tu in kong lak ciang, na puak uh kul tu hi,” Vaanglianbelpa Pathian a kici Topa in ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samaria ah ngammuang kisate le Zion ah nuntakna ol a sate — hi Israel ngamlian sung a, ngual ii hu hong kingetna, no lampui uliante atu in bangza in lauhuai ziam!","title":"Israel Lalcipna"},"2":{"text":"Va pai in Calneh khuapi en tavun. Tua zawkciang khuapi lian Hamath ah paisuak tavun a, tuaciang, Philistine te khuapi Gath ah paisuk tavun. Tuate in Judah le Israel kumpi ngamte sangin phazaw ziam? Amate ngam sia no a sangin zaizaw ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Tuasiatna ni hong thet tu thu sia na um nuam bua uh a, ahizong noma ii ngamtatna ma in tua ni naisak seseam bek hi."},"4":{"text":"A nuam niknek na lupna tungah nop om a, khuino sa le tuuno sa taw a kivaak note atu bangza in lauhuai ziam!"},"5":{"text":"David bangin la phuak nuam in, tengtongh taw lasak sia dik na sa uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Sapittui khawbeam dimin taalin, paaknamtui phabelte zangh nu hi, ahihang Israel zaancipna tungtaang ah na mau bua uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahiciang note salin a pai phit tute na hi uh hi. Na biakna poaite le anneak poaite bo tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa , Vaanglianbelpa in hi a ciliap huai kidopna tu thupia zo hi: “Israel mite ii kiphatsakna ka ngaimaw hi; amate ii inn nuam mamate ka kii hi. Amate khuapi le a sung a om theampo ngalte ka pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Innkuan khat sungah pasal sawm a kikhe le amate thi tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Mithi vui tu a kisee sa mithipa ii beepa in, inn sung pan a luang pusuapui tu hi. A beepa in inn sungah a taanglai khat pawpo sia tungah “Tua munah khat po nang taw a om dang a om lai ziam?” ci in sam tu hi. Aw khat in, “Om bo!” ci in zo tu hi. Tuaciang a beepa in, “Thim in! Topa ii min ngawngawn zongh ih law thaak ngawl natu in kidop kul tu hi,” ci tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in thu a piak tak ciang, innte a lian a no a bebekin kisaattham tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Suangte tungah siphute kinuntaw ziam? Mite in khuital taw tuipi tungah lotho ziam?
