Tua hikasap note in thutang sia nguu na suaksak uh a, a maan sia a khial na suaksak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Lodebar khua a kilaak huvau in na kiphasak uh hi. “Karnaim a la zo tu in thahat khom ngawp hi zam,” ci in na kiphasak uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa Pathian Vaanglianbelpa mama in, “Israel mite awng, na ngam a la tu in ngamdang ngalkaphonpi khat hong paisak tu khi hi. Tuate in saksang Hamath Mual Ciangh pan thangsang Arabah Lui dong ah note hong zothaw tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa tung panin mukholna khat ka nga hi. Tua ii sungah kumpipa ii tel, ngan ante a ki at zawk bek, lopate a po kik sawngin khaumaw honpui khat Topa in a piansak ka mu hi.","title":"Khaumaw hon Mukholna"},"2":{"text":"Ka mukholna sungah khaumawte in ngam sungah a hing theampo netum a, tuasia ciang keima in, “Vaanglianpipa Topa awng, na mite mawna maisak in! Bangbangin amate nungta zo tu ziam? Amate tawm mama a, thazawm uh hi!” ka ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in a thin kheal kik a, “Na mu bang piang ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa tung panin mukholna dang khat ka nei hi. Tua ii sungah ama in a mite meikuang taw daan pia tu in a kithoai ka mu hi. Mei in leinuai a tuipi lian sia kaanghtham a, tuaciang leitang mama kaanghtham tu kipan hi.","title":"Meikuang Mukholna"},"5":{"text":"Tuasia ciang keima in, “Vaanglianpipa Topa awng, tawlnga in! Na mite bangbangin nungta thei tu ziam? Amate no mama a, thaneam hi!” ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in a thin kheal kik a, “Hi sia zongh piang ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa tung panin mukholna dang khat ka nei hi. Tua ii sungah ama in teena khaukhai taw tee in, a kisa pang khat ii hui ah a ding ka mu hi. Ama khut sungah teena khaukhai khat om hi.","title":"Teena khaukhai khat Mukholna"},"8":{"text":"Ama in, “Amos awng, bang na mu ziam?” ci in kei hong dongh hi. “Teena khaukhai khat” ci in ka zo hi. Tuaciang ama in “Ka mite khaukhai bangin a tang ngawl pang khat taw a kiban hunlam lakna in hi teena khaukhai ka zangh hi. Amate daan ka piak tu huvau ka thin ka kheal kik buatu hi."},"9":{"text":"Isaac ii suan le paalte biakpiakna munte kisusia tu hi. Israel te ii a thiangtho munte zaancip in kinusia tu hi. Kumpipa Jeroboam ii kumpi khangngui ka bosak tu hi.” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Bethel thiampi Amaziah in Israel kumpipa Jeroboam tungah thu khat puak hi: “Amos in a mite sung panin nang hong thasawm hi. Ama ii kampaute in ngam susia tu hi.","title":"Amos le Amaziah"},"11":{"text":"Hi sia ama pauna hi: ‘Jeroboam sia ngal kisimna ah thi tu hi, tuaciang Israel mite sia amate ngamsung pan salin kipaipui tu hi.’ ”"},"12":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Amaziah in Amos tungah, “Kamsaang pa awng, tu a teng pha zo hi! Judah ngam ah heak kik ta'n a, tualai ah thuhil ta'n. Amate in nang sum taw hong tham tahen."},"13":{"text":"Hi lai Bethel ah kamsaanna nei nawn heak in. Hi mun sia kumpipa ii biakna mun hi a, ngammi bup ii biakinn hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Amos in, “Kei sia sum thangaina taw kamsaang nam ka hi bua hi. Keima in ngancingpa khat ka hi a, theikungte ka keamcing hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang Topa in ka tuucin nasepna pan hong la in, a Israel mite kungah pai a, mukholna son tu in thu hong pia hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom tu in Topa paunate ngai in. Nangma in kamsaanna ka tawlngak natu le, Israel mite thuak tu in ka sonkeakna ka tawlngak natu nong son hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom Amaziah awng, Topa in nang tungah, ‘Na zi sia lampi tungah pumpi zuak khat suak tu a, na tate ngal sungah kithatlum tu hi. Na leitang kihawmtham tu a, ngualdangte kipia tu hi, tuaciang nangma mama lawki ngam khat sungah na thi tu hi. Tuaciang Israel mite a ngam a lei pan leidang ah saltaang tu in kipaipui takpi tu hi,’ hong ci hi” ci in zo hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mukholna dang khat Vaanglianpipa Topa tung pan ka nei hi. Tua ii sungah thingnga a dim khum khat ka mu hi.","title":"Thingnga A dim Khum khat Mukholna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in, “Amos awng, bang mu ni ziam?” ci in hong dongh hi. “Thingnga a dim khum khat” ci in ka zo kik hi. Topa in kei tungah, “Israel ka mite atu in a tawpna hong theng zo hi. Amate daan ka piak tu huvau ka thin ka kheal kik buatu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ni ciang kumpi inn sungah a kisa late sia kaana le mauna aw suak tu hi. Mithi luangte mun theampo ah om tu hi. Tuate a thimtham in kivawk tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngamsung a mizawngte susia in, a kitaangsamhte a tuanhpeak note awng, hi thu ngai vun.","title":"Israel ii Lalna"},"5":{"text":"Noma le noma “ih antang ih zuak thei natu in ni thiangthote a bo tu ih ngak zo bua phial hi. Sumzuak ih kipat thei kik na tu in bang hun ciang Sabbath kiman tu ziam? Tuasia ciang, khaikhin maan ngawlte zanghin van leite a toai phaza theam a, na man ih khan thei tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Zungtaang mannung ngawlte a man tamin ih zuak thei tu hi. A peangdap kop khat ii man zongh a pia zo ngawl, leiba a lo zo ngawl mizawng khat ih mu tu a, ama sal khatin ih lei tu hi,” na kici uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa , Israel te ii Pathian in, “Amate tatsiatnate ka mangil ngei buatu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom zinliing tu a, ngam sungah a om theampo ngim nga tu hi. Ngam bup liinglawng tu a, Nile ngun bangin khang tuak, kiam tuakin om tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Sun kimlai in ni ka tumsak tu le suntangin leitung khua ka zinsak tu hun hong theng tu hi. Keima Vaanglianpipa Topa ka pau zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Na poaipite mithi vuinate ka suaksak tu a, na lungdamna late sia heena, kaanate taw ka laih tu hi. Na lu uh a tolin meetsak in, khau-ip puan kong silhsak tu hi, tapa khat bek a nei sun thi a, a nu le a pa a kaa bangin kong kapsak tu hi. Tua ni sia a tawp dongin thuak hak tu hi."},"11":{"text":"“Ngam sungah kialpi ka tunsak natu hun hong theng tu hi. Mihingte ngilkial tu ahihang andu ngilkial hi ngawl tu hi; a dangko tu ahihang tuidu dangtaak hi ngawl tu hi. Amate in Topa kung pan thupuak khat a deina in ngilkial dangtaak hi tu hi. Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa ka pau zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihingte sia Tuipi Thi pan Mediterranean ah, tuaciang saksang pan nisuana sangah vakvai tu uh hi. Amate in mun theampo ah Topa ii thupuak kammal khat kan tu ahihang mu ngawl tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ni in ciidam khangmoi pasalte le numeite ngawngawn dangtaakin puk tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Samaria milimte ahi, ‘Dan pathian min taw’ ahibuale ‘Beersheba pathian min taw’ a kiciam peuma — tua mite puk tu a, tho kik nawn ngawl tu uh hi.”"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biaknatau hui ah Topa a din ka mu hi. Ama in thupia a: “Biakinn bangkua tung buppi a ngawk natu in a khuam dawnte nasia takin saat vun. Tuate taltansak vun a, mite lu tungah taaksak vun. A taanglai mite ngal sungah ka thatlum tu hi. Kuama puapial ngawl tu a; khat zongh suakta ngawl tu hi.","title":"ii Thukhennate"},"2":{"text":"Mithi khua dong lam a vawtsuk hial zong, amate ka man tu hi. Vantung keak ah a kaato zong ka kaisuk tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Carmel mualdawn ah a buu hial uh zong amate ka zong tu a, ka man tu hi. Kei kung pan tuipi taw ah a buu hial uh zong tuipi nganhingpui in ka petsak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"A ngalte in manin luangtasak kale amate a thalup natu thu ka pia tu hi. Amate ka suksiat tu le ka hu ngawl tu sia khensat zo khi hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa Vaanglianbelpa in leitung tham a, leitung liing hi; tua munah a teang theampo khuangai uh hi. Leitung buppi Nile ngun bangin khang tuak, kiam tuak hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in vantungte ah a inn sa a, leitung ii tungah van ii khuvum koi hi. Ama in tuipi tuite samin leitung ah buak hi. Ama min in Topa ahi hi!"},"7":{"text":"Topa in, “Israel mite awng, note kong ngaisut bangza ma in Ethiopia mite ka ngaisun hi. Note Egypt pan kong paipui bangma in, Philistine te Crete pan, Syria te Kir pan ka paipui hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima, Vaanglianpipa Topa in, hi a maw a khial Israel kumpi ngam ka encik nginge a, lei mai panin ka susia tu hi. Ahihang Jacob suan le paalte theampo ka susia buatu hi."},"9":{"text":"“Keima in thu ka pia tu a, ciang sungah an a kisak bangin Israel mite ka lok tu hi. A mannung ngawl theampo ka hep natu in minam tuatuamte sung pan amate ka lok tu hi."},"10":{"text":"‘Pathian in eite kungah natna satna hong naisak bua in teh a ci theampo — ka mite sung a mawneite ngal sungah kithatlum tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in, “Inn zaancip sa khat taw a kibang David kumpi ngam ka puuaphat kik tu ni khat hong theng tu hi. A luphung pangte pua kikin ka phasak kik tu hi. Tuasia ka sa kik tu a, nidang tawngh lai bang ka hisak kik tu hi.","title":"Israel ii Maisang Kipuuaphat kik natu","ref":"Sawl 15:16-18"},"12":{"text":"Tuabangin Israel mite in Edom ngam sungah a om lai sun teng le keima ngam ahi ngei theampo zothal tu hi,” ci a, Topa in hi thu a piangsak tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in, “Lo ante kila man ngawl liangin a khan tu hun, sapitngate sapittui in kivawt man ngawl liangin a khan tu hun le a tun tu nite hong theng tu hi. Mualpite tung pan sapittui thum taak vakeu tu a, mualnote ah sapittui luang tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka mite a ngam a lei ah ka paipui kik tu hi. A khuapi zaancip sate, sa kikin, tua munah amate teang tu uh hi; Amate in sapithuan vawtin sapittui ne tu uh hi. Amate in huan vawt tu a, a ciinte ne tu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka mite ka piaksa ngam sungah ka teangsak tu hi, tuaciang amate kila keak kik ngawl tu hi,” ci hi. Topa na Pathian pau zo hi."}}}}},"31":{"info":{"name":"Obadiah","shortname":"Obad","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi sia in Obadiah ii kamsaanna — Edom ngam taw kisai Vaanglianpipa, Topa ii thusonte ahi hi. Topa in a kamtaipa minam tuatuamte kungah paisak zo a, tuaciang eite in ama ii thupiakna ih za zo hi: “Kithoai vun! Edom sim tu in kuan tek tawng!” ci hi.","title":"in Edom Daan pia tu"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Edom tungah, “Na tha kong zawmsak tu a; kuama theampo in nang hong zawngsak tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Na kiphatsakna in nang hong theam zo hi. Na khuapi sia suang taw kivawt kulhpi hi a; na inn sia mualtung a saangna ah om hi, tua ahikom nang le nang ‘Akua peuma in kei hong kaivawk zo tu ziam?’ na kici hi."},"4":{"text":"Na inn sia aksi kawmah a om bang na hisak natu in muvanlai bu saanna za in a saangna ah na vawt hial zongin, Keima in kong kaisuk tu hi."},"5":{"text":"“Zan in ngutate hong pai ciang, amate in a dei teng bek la uh hi. Mihingte in sapitnga a law uh ciang, amate in a sangh tawm khe tawntung uh hi. Ahizong na ngalte in hong diitmaai zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Esau suan le paalte awng, na sumngumte hong kilaaksak zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Na kipawlpuite in hong theam zo a; amate in na ngam pan hong notkeak zo hi. Na kilempui minamte in tu in hong zothal zo hi; Na an neak khoppui na lawmte in nang thaang hong sia zo hi; amate in, ‘A pilna teng koi sungah koi ziam?’ hong ci uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Edom daan ka piak ni in, a mipilte ka susia tu a, tuaciang a ciimna theampo ka zutmaai tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Teman ii a ngalkapte kilausak vadil tu a, tuaciang Edom a om ngalkap theampo kithatlum tu hi."},"10":{"text":"“Jacob ii suan le paal na suapui pate ii neisa suttol in that na hi ciang nang hong kisusia tu a a tawntungin na min hong kidaisak tu hi.","title":"Edom Daan piakna ii A hangte"},"11":{"text":"Ngalte ii a kongpite a sukthap ni in na tungh nuam bua hi. Jerusalem ii nei le lamh te laaksak a, amate sungah a hawmtham khualmite za ma in nang a sia na hi hi."},"12":{"text":"Judah ah a om na suapuite kaamsiat a thuak lai in diksa ku buale teh pha hi. Amate ii kisiat ni in na lungdam tu hi ngawl hi. Amate ii ngim nga ciang na nuisan buatu hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate ii tuasiat ni in ka mite ii khuapi sungah diksa ku in na tum buatu a, a tuasiat ni in a haunate na sut buatu hi."},"14":{"text":"Suatak tu a hanciamte a man tu in lamkaa ah na ding buatu hi. Amate ii ngim nga ni in ngalte khut sungah na aap buatu hi.","ref":"Is 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Eze 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amo 1:11-12; Mal 1:2-5"},"15":{"text":"“Keima, Topa in Minamte theampo tungah thu ka khen tu ni nai zo hi. Edom awng, na ngamtatna bangin nang hong kivawt tu hi. Na piak bangin na nga kik tu hi.","title":"Pathian in Minamte Thukhen tu"},"16":{"text":"Ka mual thiang tungah ka mite in daan khakna hai khaa sia dawn zo hi. Ahizong a kiimkot ah minam theampo in a khaa zawlai daan khakna hai dawn lai tu uh a; a dawn khawng zawkciang mangthang tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"“Ahizong Zion Mual tungah pawlkhatte suakta tu uh a, tuaciang tuasia a thiangtho mun hi tu hi. Jacob mite in amate nga tu ahi a leitang sia tang tu uh hi.","title":"Israel ii Ngalzawna"},"18":{"text":"Jacob le Joseph mite meikuang bang hi tu uh hi; amate in Esau mite sia ninteakte mei ii kak bangin susia tu uh hi. Esau suan le paalte khat zongh suakta ngawl tu hi, Keima, Topa pau zo khi hi."},"19":{"text":"“Judah thangsang mite in Edom la tu a; nitumna sang mualpeang ah a teang mihingte in Philistia la tu hi; Israel mite in Ephraim le Samaria ngam tang tu a; Benjamin mite in Gilead la tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Israel saksang pan saltaang ngalkaphonpi hong heak kik in, Phoenicia sia saksang ah Zarephath dong zothal tu uh hi. Sardis ah Jerusalem pan saltaangte in Judah thangsang khuate la tu uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Jerusalem ngalzote in Edom ngam simin, uk tu uh hi. Tuaciang Topa ama mama kumpi hi tu hi,” ci hi."}}}}},"32":{"info":{"name":"Jonah","shortname":"Jonah","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Topa in Amittai tapa Jonah paupui hi.","title":"Jonah in Thu ni ngawl","ref":"2 Kum 14:25"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “Khuapi lian ahi Nineveh khua ah va pai ta'n a, hi thu va son khe ta'n; a mite bangza in seksol ziam ka heak ahi hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang Jonah in Topa a pial thei natu in a kisawlna sangah pai ngawlin a leelam sangah pai hi. Ama Joppa ah pai in, tua munah Spain ngam ah a pai tu teambaw khat mu hi. Teambaw saapna sum a piak zawkciang Topa taw a kikhuala natu mun Spain ngam ah pai tu in teambaw hawlte taw teambaw tungah kaa hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahizong Topa in vuipi khat tuipi tungah vasak a, vuipi suangval nasia mama ahikom teambaw a tapthap tu lauhuai hi."},"5":{"text":"Teambaw naseamte patau mama ahikom amate khat simin a pathian tung tek ah huna ngenin au uh hi. Tua zawkciang, a lauhuai ngawl zawhiat natu in teambaw vanh puakte tui sungah vawk uh hi. Tua hun sungin Jonah sia a nuai ah tuak a, teambaw sungah lumin mutthip hi."},"6":{"text":"Teambaw ukpipa in tua munah Jonah a mu ciangin, “Banghangin mu thong ni ziam? Tho in a, hong hu natu in na pathian tungah thungen in. Ama in eite hong mulkimin ih nuntakna hong khoaikhe tha tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Teambaw naseamte khat le khat tungah, “Hi bang a lauhuai sung hong then sia akua mawna hi tu ziam, lai meetang sawkin zong tawng,” kici uh hi. Amate in a zon uh ciang Jonah min kisawk hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang ama tungah amate in, “Tua ahile tu in hong son ta'n! Hi thu huvau in akua mawsiat tu hi ziam? Hi lai ah nang bang vawt ni ziam? Koisung ngam pan hong pai ni ziam? Bang minam ni ziam?” ci uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“Kei Hebrew mi khat khi hi,” ci in Jonah in zo hi. “Lei le tuipi a vawt, vantung Pathian, Topa ka bia hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Jonah in amate tungah, ama sia Topa kung pan a taithap ahi hunlam son thua hi. Teambaw naseamte lau a, ama tungah, “Tuasia a lauhuai ngamtatna hi thong ngawl ziam!” ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Vuipi suangval nasia vaial ahiciang, teambaw hawlte in ama tungah, “Vuipi suangval a thim natu in bang hong law tu khu ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Jonah in, “Tuipi sungah hong khia tavun, tua hile vuipi suangval thim tu hi. Hi a lauhuai vuipi suangval na taw uh sia keima khialna hang a hina thu he khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuabang a vawt sangin teambaw naseamte in teambaw vaalbo a thet tu hanciamin a tha neiza uh taw hot uh hi. Ahihang vuipi suangval nasia vaial, nasia vaial a, amate koima theng meal ngawl uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahiciang amate in Topa biakpui a, “ Topa awng, thu hong ngen ung, hi sia pa ka thisak uh hu in thidaan hong pia heak in! Topa awng, hite theampo ah vaipuak nei ni hi; nangma vawt hi,” ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate in Jonah toaito in tuipi sungah khiasuk uh a, thakhat thu in vuipi suangval thim hi."},"16":{"text":"Hi thu hangin teambaw naseamte in Topa kiita mama in, sangaw biakpiakna khat pia a, ama na a seam tu in kamciam pia uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa sawl bangin ngasa lian khat in Jonah valh a, ama sia ngasa ngil sungah sun thum le zan thum om hi.","ref":"Mt 12:40"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngasa ngilsung tawngh pan Jonah in Topa a Pathian tungah thungen a:","title":"Jonah ii Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"“Ka ngim nga laitakin Topa awng, nang kong biakpui a, nong zo hi. Mithi khua a thukna mun panin, hu ngenin ka au a, nong za hi."},"3":{"text":"A thukna mun tuipi taw tatak ma, tuite ii hong uumcipna munah kei nong vawksuk a, a thahatna tuihual theampo in kei hong khunel hi."},"4":{"text":"Na omna panin hawlkeak sa in, ka kingaisun a, na Biakinnpi thiangtho mu kik ngei nawn ngawl tu in ka kingaisun hi."},"5":{"text":"Tui in hong khum a, hong haaksak hi; tuipi in hong khumcip a, tuaciang tuipi tuipaante in ka lu vialcip hi."},"6":{"text":"Mualte ii bul, a tawntung a kikhakcip lei kongpite dong ka zuansuk hi. Ahizong Topa ka Pathian awng, nangma in a thukna munte pan, a nungta in nong la kik hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka nuntakna a kiam susuk ka phaw ciang Topa awng, nang tungah thu kong ngen a, na Biakinnpi thiangtho pan nong za hi."},"8":{"text":"Zak thei ngawl milim a biate in, nang tungah hong thumaan nawn ngawl uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang kei ka hile pokna la kong sak tu hi; sangaw biakpiakna khat kong nei tu a, ka kamciamsa bangin ka seam tu hi. Ngupna in Topa tung pan hong pai ahi hi!” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa in vaalbo tungah Jonah a luak natu in ngasa tungah thupia a, tuabangin ngasa lua hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa in Jonah khatvei paupui kik hi.","title":"Jonah in Thu ni"},"2":{"text":"Ama in, “Tua khuapi lian Nineveh ah va pai ta'n a, a mite tungah kong thupiak sa teng thangsak ta'n,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jonah in Topa thu ni in Nineveh khua ah pai a, tua khuapi lian mama ahiciang a kaantan natu in ni thum hai hi."},"4":{"text":"Jonah sia khuapi sungah ni khat tangciing a pai zawkciang ama in, “Ni sawmli sungsang Nineveh khua kisiatham tu hi!” ci in thangsak hi.","ref":"Mt 12:41; Lk 11:32"},"5":{"text":"Nineveh khua mite in Pathian ii thupiak um uh hi. Tua ahiciang amate in mi theampo a lianbel pan a nobel dong kisiik kikna lakna in, antan tu le khau-ip puan silh tu in khensat uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Nineveh kumpipa in hi thu a zaak ciang, a kumpi tokhum pan dingto in, a puantual suut a, khau-ip puan silhin vuttun sungah tosuk hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in Nineveh khua mite tungah thu thansakna khat puak a: “Hi thu in kumpipa le a uliante tung pan thu piak khat ahi hi: kuama in bangma ne ngawl tu hi; mi theampo, khuite le tuute an, ahibuale a tuidawn tu kikhaam hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi theampo le nganhing theampo in khau-ip puan silh tu hi. Mi simin Pathian tungah nasia takin thungen tu a, ngitlo ngamtatna le a siathuai a tuk a diannate nusia tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Pathian a thin kheal kik tha tu hi; a thin uukna thaisak tha tu a ih thi buatu hi!” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Pathian in amate vawt teng mu a; a ngitlo ngamtatna nusia zo hi ci in mu hi. Tua ahikom ama in a thin khealin daan pia tu a ci bangin pia ngawl hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jonah sia hi thu huvau in lungdam ngawl hetin thin uuk hi.","title":"Jonah ii Thin uukna le Pathian ii Hesuakna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahiciang ama in thungen a, “ Topa awng, ka inn pan ka din ma in tubang ngengei in ngamta tu ni hi hong ci hi ngawl khi ziam? Tuasia hu in Spain ngam ah ka hi thei za in tai tu hanciam khi hi! Nang in a it thei le a hesuak thei Pathian hi a, thinsau tawntung, cingh tawntung a, thin kheal tu le daan a pia ngawl tu in kinging tawntung ni hi, ci in kong he hi.","ref":"Pu 34:6"},"3":{"text":"Tu in Topa awng hong thisak ta'n. Ka nuntak nial sang thi leng phazaw hi,” ci hi.","ref":"1 Kum 19:4"},"4":{"text":"Topa in, “Na thin uuk thei natu in nang bang thu nei ni ziam?” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Khuapi nisuana sang mun khat ah Jonah pai in to hi. A kibeal thei bukno khat ama atu vawtin, a lim ah to a Nineveh bang tat tu ziam ngakin en hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaciang Jonah ii a nuamzaw in a lim a belh thei natu in Topa Pathian in a kung hing khat potosak hi. Hi a kung hing sia hangin Jonah lungkim mama hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahizong a zing ciang khuavak tuungin, Pathian thupiakna taw lung khat in tua a kung hing sia ne a thi hi."},"8":{"text":"Nisua zawkciang Pathian in nisuana sang pan vuisa vasak in, nisa in a lu kap a Jonah butthi tu in kithoai hi. Tua ahikom ama thi nuam hi. Ama in, “Ka nuntak nial sang thi leng phazaw hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in ama tungah, “Hi a kung hing huvau in na thin uuk thei natu nang bang thu nei ni ziam?” ci hi. Jonah in, “Thi ngam natu in thin uuk na — ka thin uuk thei natu thu nei leilam khi hi!” ci in zo kik hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in ama tungah, “Hi a kung hing sia zan khat thu in po a, a zing ciang bo hi; tuasia atu in nang ii sep bangma om ngawl hi, tuaciang nang ii posak hi ngawl hi — tua hi napi tuasia a tu in khuangai thawthong ni hi!"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahile tua khuapi lian Nineveh tungah bangzata in hesuak zaw kan tu khi ziam. Tua son ngawlin tua khuapi sungah mawbaang ngawl patang mealmawl 120,000 vaal le nganhing tam mama zongh om hi!” ci hi."}}}}},"33":{"info":{"name":"Micah","shortname":"Mic","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpite ahi Jotham, Ahaz le Hezekiah te ii maan laitakin Moresheth khua mi Micah tungah Topa in hi thupuak pia hi. Samaria le Jerusalem taw kisai in Micah tungah Topa in hi thu teng pualaak hi.","ref":"2 Kum 15:32-38; 2 Khang 27:1-7; 2 Kum 16:1-20; 2 Khang 28:1-27; 2 Kum 18:1—20:21; 2 Khang 29:1—32:33"},"2":{"text":"No minamte theampo awng, hi thu za tek vun; simlei tungah a teang theampo awng, hi thu ngai vun! Vaanglianpipa Topa in note langkhat panin tetti pang tu hi. Ngai vun! Ama in a vantung biakinn panin son hi.","title":"Samaria le Jerusalem atu Kaa la"},"3":{"text":"Topa in ama ii mun thiangtho pan hong pai tu hi; ama hong tuaksuk tu a, mualte dawn ah vak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuasia ciang meikhuk khat ii sungah khuainun a tuithap bangin mualpite ama ii nuai ah tuitham tu hi; mualno khat tungah tui buaksuk bangin ngamkuamte sungah buaksuk tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Hite theampo piang tu hi, banghang ziam cile Israel mite maw in, Pathian langpan uh hi. Israel ii langpanna sia akua mawsiat tu ziam? Ngam bup khuapi mama ahi Samaria hi! Akua in Judah ah milim biakna taw maw ahi ziam? Jerusalem ama mama hi!"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Topa in, “Samaria sia ngam taanzauna sung a siasa teng kholna mun, sapitkung ciin natu mun ka suaksak tu hi. A khuapi sungah suangte zongh kuam sungah ka sungsuk tu a, a khuapi tawphate ka lawtsak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"A milim manpha theampo a bebekin kisunen tu a, biakinn sungah pumpi zuak numeite a kipia nate theampo mei taw kihaltum tu hi, tuaciang a milimte theampo sia a kinusia vuumthuk khat suak tu hi. Samaria in hi nate sia a pungto a sua natu poai vawt natu in a nga uh hi a, tu in a ngalte in tuate sia biakinn sung pumpi kizuakte atu in mundang ah puak tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Micah in, “Hi sia hu in khuangai in ka kap tu hi. Ka heena ka lakna in peangnguak le pumnguakin ka vak kawkoai tu hi. Ngam ui bangin ka au tu a, kalaoh vacim bangin ka tau tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Samaria ii liammate kidamsak thei ngawl tu hi, tuaciang Judah zongh tuabang ma in thuak nai tu hi; suksiatna in ka mite teenna Jerusalem kongpite mama ah hong theng zo hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Gath a om ih ngalte tungah ih ngallelna thu son heak vun; na kaa uh musak heak vun. Beth Leaphrah mite awng, na thinkiamna lakna in leivui sungah kilumliik vun!","title":"Ngalte in Jerusalem Neak"},"11":{"text":"No, Shaphir mite awng, na pumnguak om in maizumin ngamdang ah saltaang tu in pai tavun. Zaanan ah a teangte a khuapi sung pan pusuak ngam ngawl uh hi. Bethezel mite mauna na zaak uh ciang tua munah bukna a om ngawl hunlam na he tu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Maroth mite in huna noptuam a nga natu thinngimin ngak uh hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in Jerusalem nai na ah tuasiatna thengsak zo hi."},"13":{"text":"No, Lachish ah a teangte awng, na siphute ngalleangte tungah khit vun. Note in Israel mawna khialna na zui uh a, tuabangin Jerusalem khialsak nu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciang tu in Judah mite awng, Moresheth Gath khua mangpha thaak tavun. Israel kumpite in Achzib khua pan huna nga ngawl tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Mareshah mite awng, na khua hong la tu ngalte khut sungah Topa in no hong aap tu hi. Israel lampuite pai in Adullam suanghawng sungah buu tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Judah mite awng, na it patangnote atu in khuangai in na sam uh meet vun. Vaciik bangin lutolin om vun, banghang ziam cile na patangnote sia ngamdang ah salin no kung pan kila tu hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mutmawklaw liangin thusia a ngealte atu in bangza in lauhuai tu ziam! Amate in zingsangin hunpha a nga pawpo ciang a ngeal sa tatsiatna sia vawt uh hi.","title":"Mizawngte A zawthawk vawt te ii Thuak tu Thu"},"2":{"text":"Amate in lote a dei uh ciang suttol uh hi; innte a dei uh ciang laksak uh hi. A kuama po ii innkuan, ahibuale neisa bit ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Topa in, “No tungah tuasiatna puak tu in ngeal khi hi, tuaciang note suakta thei ngawl tu nu hi. Ngimnga in na om uh kimu tu nu hi; tuaciang kiphasak in vak nawn ngawl tu nu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hun a tun ciang, mite in no sia tuasiatna huvau sonteena in hong nei tu hi, noma thuakna teng khuangai la in na sa tu uh hi: Eite ih lalcip dikdek zo hi! Topa in ih ngam ih lei la zo a, tuaciang ei hong mante tungah tuasia kipia zo hi,” ci tu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuabang ahiciang Topa mite tungah leitang a kipiak kik tu hun a thet ciang note kuama atu tel om ngawl tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Mipite in kei tung ah, “Ko, thu hong hil heak in. Tuabang thute hong hil heak in. Pathian in kote hong maimawlsak ngawl tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel mite haamsiatna thuak sa nu ziam? Topa in a thin sausak zo nawn ngawl ziam? Tuabang tatak ma in vawt tu ziam? A maan in a seamte ama in dikna taw paupui hi ngawl ziam?” ci in thu hong hil hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in, “Noma in ka mite sia ngalte bangin sim nu hi. Pasalte ngalphual pan cia a, inn ah ngam muangin om tu kisa hi, ahihang note tualai ah om in a silh lai laktong puasilhte nguksak tu in na ngak uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka mite sung pan numeite sia a it a innte pan na hawlkeak tu uh a, a tate tung pan ka thuphate a tawntungin na sut uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tho vun a, pai vun; hi lai ah ngam muanna om nawn ngawl hi. Na mawnate in hi mun siasak in lalna sung then hi."},"11":{"text":"“Hi mihingte ahile, ‘Sapittui le zu no atu in hong luang tu hi ci in kamsaanna kong son hi’ ci in leilot thu bebek sonin a vak, ngualtheam kamsaang namte, dei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"“Ahihang no Israel mi a taanglai theampo kong kaikhawm tu hi. Tuute a khawk sungah a cia bangin kong khawmtua tu hi. Tuute a dimin a om nganthana mun bangin na ngam sia mihing tam mama taw khatvei kidim kik tu hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"13":{"text":"Pathian in amate atu in lampi honsak tu a, a saltanna mun pan suatak tu hi. Amate in khuapi kongpite suthamin suakta tu uh hi. A kumpipa ahi, Topa mama in amate pusuapui tu hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No, Israel a ukte awng, ngai vun! Note in thumaan thutang dei tu hong kimuangmaw hi,","title":"Micah in Israel ii Lampuite Sonsia"},"2":{"text":"tua hi napi, note in a phate ngaimaw in a siate na it uh hi. Ka mite a hingtangin a vun hoai in, a ngute tung pan a sa na sem uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka mite na netum uh hi. A vun hoai in, a ngu siiktanin beal sung huan tu sa bangin na sem uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa tungah na ko tu hun hong theng tu a, ahihang ama in hong zo ngawl tu hi. Note thungetna ama in hong ngai ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile a sia na vawt uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Sum a pia zote tungah kilemna om tu hi ci in kamciam pia a, ahihang a pia zo ngawlte tungah ngal om tu hi ci in a tawng kamsaangte ii theamna sia ka mite in thuak hi. Hi kamsaangte tungah Topa in,"},"6":{"text":"“Kamsaangte awng, na ni uh bo dektak hi; no tungah ni tum tu hi. Ka mite lam khialsak na hi uh ciang kamsaan mukholnate na nei nawn buatu uh a, bangma na sonkhol thei nawn buatu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Mailam atu a sonkholte, a son bang a taangtut ngawl hu in minsia tu uh hi. Amate theampo ki enthaw tu hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian in amate ci bangin zo ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang kei ka hile Topa in a thaa le a vaangletna taw hong dim a, thukhaikim heak theina le Israel mite tungah amate mawna khialna teng son ngam natu hanna hong pia hi."},"9":{"text":"Thukhaikim ngaimaw in, a maan sia a khial a sua, no Israel ngamukte awng, hong ngai tavun."},"10":{"text":"Pathian khuapi Jerusalem sia mihing thalupna le thutan ngawlna tawdap tungah na sa uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Khuapi ukte in sumnguk neak natu in uk a, thiampite in thaman nga natu in Thukham pheen a, kamsaangte in sum nga natu in thupualaakna pia hi — a vekpi ma in Topa in amate ompui hi ci tek hi. Amate in “Ko tungah siatna hong theng ngawl tu hi. Topa in ko hong ompui hi,” ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom note hu in Zion sia lo khat bangin kitho tu a, Jerusalem sia nin kholna suakin, Biakinnpi mual sia dui suak tu hi.","ref":"Jer 26:18"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mailam hun ah Biakinnpi dinna mual sia a saangbel mual khat hi tu a, mualnote theampo tungah dokto tu hi. Minam tam mamate tua munah tuiluang bangin hong pai tu a,","title":"ii Vaannuai bup a zel Kilemna (Is 2:2-4)"},"2":{"text":"tuaciang a mite in, “ Topa ii mual, Israel ii Pathian Biakinnpi ah kaato tawng. Banghang ziam cile seam a hong oaite ama in hong hil tu hi; ama tealsa lampi ih zui tu hi. Banghang ziam cile Topa hilcianna in Jerusalem pan hong pai hi; ama in Zion panin a mite paupui hi,” ci tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in minamte sung ahizong, a nai a khuala a vaanglian ngamte sungah ahizong, ama in a kituu uh thute lemtua tu hi. Amate in a namsaute lothawna in seak tu a, a teipite thingbaak heuna nam sua tu uh hi. Ngamte ngal kido kik ngei nawn ngawl tu a, ngal kido kik tu in kithoai ngei nawn ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Is 2:4; Jol 3:10"},"4":{"text":"A neisa sapithuante le a theikungte sungah mi theampo kilemin teang tu hi, tuaciang kuama in ama lausak ngawl tu hi. Topa Vaanglianbelpa in hi kamciam pia zo hi.","ref":"Zec 3:10"},"5":{"text":"Minam simin amate tek ii pathian bia in a thu ni hi, ahihang eite in Topa, ih Pathian a tawntung, a tawntungin ih bia tu a, a thu ih ni tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in, “Daan ka piak mite, sal taang in ngim a thuak mite ka khoptua kik tu hun hong theng tu hi.","title":"Saltanna pan Israel Cia kik tu"},"7":{"text":"Amate liamin bai a, inn panin kikhuala hi, ahihang a taanglaite atu kipat kikna thak khat ka vawtsak tu a, amate minam lian khat suak tu hi. Amate tua hun pan kipan Zion Mual tung pan a tawntungin ka uk tu hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang nang Jerusalem, tuucing khat bangin Pathian ii a mite a etcikna mun sia, khatvei ma noma neisa kumpi ngam khuapi suak kik tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Banghang a nging tatakin kap nu ziam? Nausuak tun numei khat bangin banghang thuak nu ziam? Kumpi na nei ngawl uh hang le na thu kikuppuite a thi uh hang ziam?"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem mite awng, nausuak tu numei bangin kisaan in tau vun, banghang ziam cile tu in khuapi na nusia tu uh a, ngam taanzau sungah na teang tu uh hi. Babylon ah na pai uh kul tu hi, ahizong tua munah Topa in na ngalte khut sung pan hong hun tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Minam tam mamate note sim tu in kikhawm zo hi. Amate in, “Jerusalem kisusia nanak tu hi! Hi khuapi a zaancip in ih mu tu hi!” ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahihang hi minamte in Topa ngaisutna sungah a om sia he ngawl uh hi. Lo ante cil tu in a paipui bangin amate daan piak tu in a kikaikhop ahi hunlam amate in phawk ngawl uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in, “Jerusalem mite awng, pai vun a, na ngalte daan pia vun! Thikkii a nei le taau peangcin a nei khuital khat za in kong hatsak tu hi. Note in minam tam mamate tuanhpeak in, ngongtatna taw a nga, nei le lamhte keima, leitung buppi ii Topa nong pia tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem mite awng, na ngalkapte khawm vun! Eite hong uumci hi! Amate in Israel lampuipa sim uh hi!"},"2":{"text":"Topa in, “Bethlehem Ephrathah khua awng, nang in Judah ngam sungah khuanobel khat na hi a, ahizong nang sung pan Israel a ukpa tu khat ka piangsak tu hi. Ama khang ngui in taangh tawngh pek taw kizom hi,” ci hi.","title":"Pathian in Bethlehem pan Ukpa khat Kamciam","ref":"Mt 2:6; Jn 7:42"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom nau nei tu numei nu ii a tapa a pian mateng Topa in a mite sia a ngalte khut sungah a nusia tu hi. Tua zawkciang ngamdang ah saltaang a mipuite sia a mite taw kingawm kik tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama hong pai ciang, ama in a mite Topa tung pan hong pai thahatna le Topa Pathian mama ii vaang neina taw uk tu hi. A mite ngammuang takin teang tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile leitung bup mihingte in ama ii letna saang thei tu a,"},"5":{"text":"ama in kilemna puak tu hi. Assyria te in ih ngam hong sim a, ih ngalnanna kulh le taapte hong kaantan ciang, amate do tu in a hatbel ih lampuite ih puak tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Ngalhiam tha hatna taw amate in Nimrod ii leitang Assyria sia zothal tu hi, tuaciang Assyria te in ih ngam hong sim ciang amate in eite hong hun tu hi.","title":"Hutkhiatna le Daan piakna","ref":"Pian 10:8-11"},"7":{"text":"Israel mi a suakta laite sia minam tam atu in Topa piak tha thak nga kikna daaitui bang hi tu a, thingno suante tung a nguazu vapeak bang hi tu hi. Amate in Pathian bealh tu a, mihing suang ngawl tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Minamte sungah a taanglai mite sia duisung ahibuale, ngamsa tatna mun ah, an zong tawpi savai khat bang hi tu hi: ama in tuuhon sungah tum a, tuute manin a bek a bekin laai a — tuaciang suatak natu lametna om ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel in a ngalte zothalin susia siat tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in, “Tua hun ciang, na siphute la in na ngalleangte ka susia tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Na ngam sungah khuapite ka susia tu a, na kidalna theampo ka balkeak tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Na zak uh bum le ai theampo ka susia tu a, khutlam en aisaan thei khat zongh ka khoaikhe buatu hi."},"13":{"text":"Na milimte le na biak suangkhuam thiangthote ka susia tu hi; note in na vawt tawm nate na bia nawn buatu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Na ngam sungah a om numeipathian Asherah milimte ka kaivawk tu a, na khuapite ka susia tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka thu a ni ngawl minamte theampo tungah thin uukna lianpi taw ka thuk tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa ii Israel te a mawsakna thu ngai vun. Topa awng tho in, na thu sung in; mualpite le mualnote in na son teng zasak in.","title":"ii Israel te A Mawsakna"},"2":{"text":"No mualte le a tawntung a kip no simlei tawdapte awng, Topa thu ngai vun! Topa in a mite mawsak tu hi. Ama in Israel tungah mawsakna khat nei tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Topa in, “Ka mite awng, note tungah bang hong vawt zo khi ziam? Note atu bangbangin vanh ngit khat suak zo khi ziam? Hong zo tavun."},"4":{"text":"Egypt ngam pan kong pusuaksak hi; saltanna pan kong suatak hi; note lam hong pui tu in Moses, Aaron le Miriam kong puak hi.","ref":"Pu 12:50-51; 15:20; Pu 4:10-16; Pu 15:20"},"5":{"text":"Ka mite awng, Moab kumpi Balak in note bang law hong sawm a, Beor tapa Balaam in bangbang zo kik ziam cisia phawk kik vun. Acacia ngiaphual pan Gilgal paina lampi ah a piang teng phawk kik vun. Hite phawk kik vun, tua hile note kong ngup natu in ka septe phawk tu nu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mi 22:2—24:25; Jos 3:1—4:19"},"6":{"text":"Vantung Pathian Topa bia tu in ka pai ciang ama atu bang puak tu khi ziam? Biakpiakna a hal tu khuino phabelte paipui tu khi ziam?","title":"ii tangkal Thu"},"7":{"text":"Tuu a tul sim ahizong, a bomaw lui bang in a luang Olive thaute ahizong puak leng Topa a lungkim tu ziam? Ka mawphel natu in ka taciil ka pia tu ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Hi ngawl hi Topa in thupha hong son zo hi. Ama ii ei tung pan bang hong tangkal thu in hisia hi: a maan sia seam tu, ki itna kip lak tu le, kiniamkhiak in ih Pathian taw kipawl khawmin nuntak tu ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa kiitakna in ciimna hi. Ama in tua khuapi sam a, “No khuapi sung a kikhawm mite awng, na ngai vun!"},"10":{"text":"Mihing tatsiate ii inn sungah thumaan ngawlna taw a nga sumngumte om hi. Amate in ka ngaimawk khaikhin maan ngawlte zangh uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Bangbangin khaikhin le toaisuang maan ngawl a zanghte a khialna maisak thei tu khi ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Na mihaute in mizawngte duupkang a, note theampo leilot thusonte na hi uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom, na mawnate hangin a lalsak le a siasak tu in kong kipan zo hi."},"14":{"text":"An na neak uh hang na lungkim buatu uh a — a tatakin na ngil uh kial veve lai tu hi. Vanhte pua in, nate paipui tu na hi uh hang na keamcing zo buatu uh hi. Na top uh vanh pawpo ngal sungah ka susia tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Lo an na ciing tu uh a, ahihang an na la buatu uh hi. Olive ngate sathau suak tu in na ngoai tu uh a, ahihang na zangh ngei buatu uh hi. Sapittui na vawt tu uh a, ahihang na ne ngei buatu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Hi bang hong piang tu hi, note in Omri kumpipa le a tapa Ahab kumpipa ii ngamtat siate na zui uh hang ahi hi. Amate ngamtat ziate zomto na hi uh ciang kong siacipsak tu a, a kuama po in note hong zawngsak tu hi. Mite in mun theampo ah note hong zawnsak vawt tu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"1 Kum 16:23-28; 21:25-26; 1 Kum 16:29-34; 21:25-26"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lametna bo hi! Thingnga pangh sa, sapitnga thot sa a vil mihing ngilkial khat taw ka kibang hi. Sapit theampo le theinga lim theampo kilo siat zo hi.","title":"Israel ii Ngamtat Siatna"},"2":{"text":"Ngam sungah thumaan mihing khat zongh taang ngawl a, Pathian tungah kuama thumaan ngawl hi. A kuama po in ngual a thalup thei natu hunpha ngak hi. A kuama po in a mipuite savai bangin vai hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate siatna vawt tu thiam siat uh hi. Uliante le thukhenmangte in sumnguk ngen uh hi. Mihing ci thei khat in ama uuk teng amate tungah son a, tuabangin amate vaihawm khawm uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate sung pan a phabelte le a thumaan belte ngawngawn lopate bangin mannung ngawl uh hi. Pathian in amate a encik kamsaangte tungtawnin amate a kidop natu a hil khol bangin ama in tua mite daan a piak tu ni hong theng zo hi. Tu in amate lungmang uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Na innpaam ahizong, na ngualtamh ahizong umin muang heak in. Na zi tungah na pauna ngawngawn kidawm in."},"6":{"text":"Hi hun sungah tapate in a pate sia a mawmaw bangin vawt tu a, tanute in a nute nalh tu uh hi, mote in a tonupite taw kihau tu a; mihing khat ii ngalte sia ama innkuanpuite ma hi tu hi.","ref":"Mt 10:35-36; Lk 12:53"},"7":{"text":"Ahihang keima in Topa ka mitsuan tu hi; kei hong ngum tu Pathian kimuang takin ka ngak tu hi. Ka Pathian in kei hong za tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ih ngalte in ei tungah hong oaiaam natu thu om ngawl hi. Ei ih pukvawk zo a, ahihang ih tho kik tu hi. Tu laitak khuazing sungah ih om a, ahihang Topa in khuavak hong pia tu hi.","title":"in Ngupna Hong puak"},"9":{"text":"Eite in Topa tungah ih maw zo hi, tua ahikom tu in ama ii thin uuk tutna tawmvei ih thuak kul tu hi. Ahihang a tawpna ah ama in eite hong dal tu a, ei tungah hong kitat khialnate a maan taw hong laihsak tu hi. Ama in khuavak sung hong then tu a; hong ngupna ih mu dong ih nungta tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuasia ciang ih ngalte in hi sia mu tu a, kimaimawlsak tu hi — tua ngalte in “ Topa na Pathian uh koisung a om ziam?” ci in hong tawtawte ma hi tu hi. Amate ngallelna, lamlai ah buan bangin a kitotcil nate ih mu tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Jerusalem mite awng, khuapi luphungte cian kik tu hun hong theng tu hi. Tua hun ciang na ngam kikeak tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Na mite mun theampo pan — nisuana sang Assyria pan, thangsang Egypt pan, Euphrates ngamkhen sung pan, tuipi ngalkhat pan le mual khualanate pan no kungah hong heak kik tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang tua leitang sia a tungah a teangte ngitlo seksol hu in sennealngam suak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa awng, na tealsa na mite tungah tuucing khat hong hi ta'n. Amate in duisung ngampa ah a tuatuamin teang hikale, a kiimkot ah leihoi leipha om hi. Nidang tawngh lai, a kivaak bangin lohing tamna ngam phana Bashan le Gilead ah amate paisak in kivaak tahen.","title":"ii Israel A Hesuakna"},"15":{"text":"Topa awng, Egypt pan nong pusuasak lai hun a na vawt bangin kote atu in nalamdangte vawt in."},"16":{"text":"Ngam tuatuamte in hi sia mu tu a, a thahatna theampo kawm pan a thin lal tu uh hi. Thin kiamin lungmang a, amate a kam im in, a bilte hum tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate leivui sungah ngulte bangin bokvak tu uh a; a kulhpite pan liingin lauin hong pai tu uh hi. Amate in Topa ih Pathian kungah kiitakna taw hong heak kik tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa awng, nang bang ahi pathian dang om ngawl hi, a nungta lai na mite ii mawnate na maisak hi. A tawntungin thin uukin na om bua a, na itna kip nong lak sia nuam na sa hi."},"19":{"text":"Nangma in kote khatvei ma nong hesuak kik tu hi. Kote ii mawna khialnate na peang nuai ah na siikcip tu a, tuipi taw ah na khiasuk tu hi!"},"20":{"text":"Taanghlai koma ii taanghpupite tungah na kamciam bangin Abraham le Jacob ii suan le paal na mite tungah na thumaanna le tatsat ngawl na itna na lak tu hi."}}}}},"34":{"info":{"name":"Nahum","shortname":"Nah","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thu in Nineveh taw kisai thu hi a, Elkosh khua mi Nahum ii mukholna thu khat tepteena ahi hi.","ref":"Is 10:5-34; 14:24-27; Zep 2:13-15"},"2":{"text":"Topa Pathian in ama a demte kuama dual ngawl hi; ama in ama a nalhte daan pia hi. A thin uukna taw amate thuk kik hi.","title":"Nineveh tungah ii Thin uukna"},"3":{"text":"Topa thin uuk papaih ngawl a, ahihang ama vaanglian in a maw a khial te daan pia ngawlin tha thong ngeingawl hi. Topa paina munah vuipi suangval va a; meeite sia a peang taw a sina pan a leang leivui khute ahi hi!"},"4":{"text":"Ama in tuipi thupia a, tuasia kang hi! Ama in ngunte kosak ngiungeu hi. Bashan lote vulin, Carmel mual sia ang a, tuaciang Lebanon paakte vul hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa mai ah mualpite liingin kektham a; ama mai ah mualnote tuitham hi. Topa a kilangh ciang leitung kilok a; leitung le a mite theampo liing hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama a thin uuk ciang akua nungta zo lai tu ziam? A lauhuai mama a thinsona ah akua nungta zo nawn tu ziam? A thin uukna meikuang tha suk a; suangte tamhthamin ama ii mai ah leivui suak hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa pha hi; ngimna hun sungah a mite sungsia hi; Ama kung a zuante ama in keamthiam hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuipawm lian khat bangin a ngalte sucip a; ama a nalhte thina thuaksak hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa langpan in bang vawt sawm nu ziam? Ama in no hong susia tu hi. Kuama in khatvei kaan ama nalh ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Lingngui kivialte le taangphaw ko bangin no zukhamte hong kihaltum tu hi!"},"11":{"text":"Nineveh awng, ngitlo vai vive a tum, Topa langpan a sawm khat na kung pan hong pai hi."},"12":{"text":"Hisia in Israel a mite tungah Topa ii cina hi; “Assyria te hat in mihing tam napi amate kisusia a bo tu hi. Ka mite awng, note kong thuaksak a, ahizong tuabangin kong vawt kik buatu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu in note tungah Assyria vaangletna ka bosak tu a, hong heenna thikkhaute ka sutan tu hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Hisia in Assyria te taw kisai Topa thutanna hi: “Amate min a zomto tu in suan le paal nei ngawl tu hi. Amate ii pathiante biakinnte sungah a om milimte ka susia tu hi. Assyria te atu in thaankuul khat ka vawtkhol tu hi — amate a nungta tu in kilawm ngawl uh hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"En vun, thupha puak kamtai khat mualtung tawnin hong pai hi! Ama in zawna taangko tu in hong pai ahi hi! Judah mite awng, na poaipi khaam vun a, Pathian tungah ciliap huai takin, na kamciam sate pia vun. Mi ngilote in na ngam uh hong sim ngei nawn ngawl tu hi. Amate kisusia diipdeap zo hi!","ref":"Is 52:7"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nineveh awng, nang hong kisim hi! Nang hong vaat tham tu vaangletna hong pai zo hi. Ngalnan natu te kinging vun! Lampi cing vun! Ngalsim tu in kithoai vun!","title":"Nineveh Khua Bona"},"2":{"text":"(A ngalte ii sutol ma hun lai bangin Topa in Israel mite ii a minthanna pia kik dektak hi.)"},"3":{"text":"Ngalte ii ngalkapte in lumsante toai a, a kibang puansante silh hi. Amate ngalsim tu in kithoai hi! a ngalleangte meikuang bangin tee vazak hi! A siphute pai nuamin a peang laam zo hi!"},"4":{"text":"Lampite kaantanin siphu ngalleangte tai kheukho a, khuapi khawlmunte kaantan in kinuntaw kawkoai hi. Amate mei lomsawm det te bangin taang vazak a, khualeng bangin peak kawkoai hi."},"5":{"text":"Ngalkap bute kisam a; maisang a phul ciang amate lutu uh hi. A simte in khuapi uumna luphung sangah tai a lumte taw kidalin, kulh sukthapna moltumte bul hi."},"6":{"text":"Ngunhui a kongpite kihong keak a; kumpi inn sia launa taw kidim hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpinu kiman a; a naseamte vakhu kuul bangin kap uh hi; khuangai in a awm beang uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A cimhtham tui cimna khat pan tuiluang bangin Nineveh pan mihingte taikeak uh hi! “Tawlnga vun! Tawlnga vun!” ci in khuapi pan aw nging hi — ahizong kuama heak kik ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Ngunnte phuul vun! Khamhte phuul vun! Khuapi sia sumngum taw kidim hi!"},"10":{"text":"Nineveh sia kisusia in, kinusia a, ngamkhing hi! Launa taw thin tamhtham a; khupte liingin, a thahatna bo hi; maitangte daang hi."},"11":{"text":"Tawpite ii kua khat taw a kibang, tawpi note kivaakna mun, tawpital le tawpipui vana, a note ngammuangin a omna tua khuapi sia tu in koi sungah om ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Tawpi in a neak tu sa manin a pui le a note atu balneen a; ama in akua sia sabekte taw dimh hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa Vaanglianbelpa in, “Keima in na ngalpa ka hi hi! Na siphu leangte haltum tu khi hi. Na ngalkapte ngal sungah kithatlum tu a, midangte tung pan na laakte theampo hong laaksak tu khi hi. Na palaite ii ngetnate kiza nawn ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kitheamna, mi kithalupna, sutol tu le phuul tu bek ahi hauna taw a kidim khuapi a lal hi zo hi!"},"2":{"text":"Nganno saatna a nging, leangmui nging, Siphu kitawte khuasuan nging, siphu ngalleang kithinna awnging te ngai vun!"},"3":{"text":"Siphu ngalkapte kidel a, namsaute tee vazal in, teite nizang la vazial hi! Mithiluangte vum vinvun in kiseng a, mithiluangte sim zawk ngawlin om a — tuate tungah mihingte lutu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Pumpi zuak ahi Nineveh sia daan kipia hi. Dei huai in thina piangsak thei ai taw kidim a, ama in minamte ai taw zol in sal suaksak hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa Vaanglianbelpa in, “Daan kong pia tu hi, Nineveh awng! Na pumnguak kong koi tu a, ngam tuatuamte in kong musak tu hi, na maizum huaina theampo hong mu tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Nang kong zawnsak vawt tu a, a kiihuai ninteak taw kong siin tu hi. Mihingte lau in nang hong salh tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Nang hong mu po nungkin kik tu hi, Amate in, ‘Nineveh sia zaancip zo hi! Akua in ama hesuakhuai sa ziam? Akua in ama heeneam nuam tu ziam?’ ci tu uh hi” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Nineveh awng, nang sia Egypt khuapi Thebes, sangin phazaw ni ziam? Ama zongh pang bangin a dal tu ngun khat nei hi — Nile ngun sia ama kidalna hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in Ethiopia le Egypt uk hi, ama ii vaangletna ciangtan om ngawl hi; Libya sia ama kipawlpui ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahitazong Thebes mite salin kipaipui veve hi. Lampi king sim ah a patangte kivellum hi. A lampuite thikkol bul sa in kipaipui a, a mante kihawmhsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Nineveh awng, nang zongh zu khamin na puk tu hi: Nang zongh na ngalte kung pan suatak natu na hanciam tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Na kulhte theampo sia thei min kungte bang hi tu a: theikungte thing vun, tua hile a nga na kam sung tatak ah taak tu hi!"},"13":{"text":"Na ngalkapte sia numeite bang hi a, na ngalte mai ah na ngam sia ngalnanna sel hi. Na kongpi kilhnate meikuang in lalsak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ngalte hong uumci tu kingin kholna in tui toai vun a, na kulhpite ciangthua in khosak vun! Uksuang seak natu in buan cil vun a, uksuang bekna kuang a kinging sa in koi vun!"},"15":{"text":"Bangpo na vawt zong hong kihallum veve tu hi, ahibuale ngal sungah hong kithatlum veve tu hi. Khaumaw te ii lo ante a khawn tum bangin note hong kimaimot tu hi. Khaumawte bangin na pung uh hi!"},"16":{"text":"Van a aksite sangin a tamzaw sumvawtte na piangsak hi! Ahizong tu in tuate a tha phalhin a leang khaumawte bangin thot zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Na uliante sia khuatuap ni in pang tung a bok khaumaw honkhat bang ahi uh hi. Ahizong ni hong sua ciang amate leang vingveng in, a zotna mun kuama in he ngawl hi!"},"18":{"text":"Assyria kumpilianpa awng, na ngamuk mangte thi uh hi, na kumpi uliante a tawntung mutthip uh hi! Na mite mualtung tengah kithethaang a, a inn ah a ciapui kik tu kuama om ngawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Na liam nate bawl natu bangma om ngawl a, na liammate kidamsak thei ngawl hi. Na lalna thu a za theampo in lungdam in a khutbeang uh hi. Na khealmawk ngitlona uh pan, a suakta akua om na ziam?"}}}}},"35":{"info":{"name":"Habakkuk","shortname":"Hab","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thu sia Topa in kamsaangpa Habakkuk tungah a pualaak thu ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Topa awng, ngongtatna pan nong ngup natu, nong zaak ma in bang tanvei hu ngenin, kong biakpui kul tu ziam?","title":"Thukhaikim om ngawlna hangin Habakkuk Phun"},"3":{"text":"Tuabang ngimnate banghangin hong musak ni ziam? Tuabang tatkhialnate en in bangbangin thuak zo ni ziam? Siatna le ngongtatnate ka kiimkot ah om a, kihauna le kidona mun theampo ah om hi."},"4":{"text":"Upadi in thu nei zo ngawlin a luithawthong suak a, thutangin thu a kikhen bua hi. Thutang khenna thute kileekai in misia te in thutang mite zo zawsap hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa in a mite tungah, “Na kiim na paam a minamte encik vun, tua hile na mu uh thu hangin lamdang na sa tu uh hi. Tuasia na zaak ciang zong na up ngawl natu in bang khat po kong vawt tu hi.","title":"Zo kikna","ref":"Sawl 13:41"},"6":{"text":"Tua a kiitakhuai a om thong thei ngawl Babylon te tungah vaangletna ka pia tu hi. Amate in ngamdangte a zawthal natu in leitung theampo ah kuan tu hi.","ref":"2 Kum 24:2"},"7":{"text":"Amate in kiitakna le patauna kizelsak a, amate ii kiphasakna taw amate ma in upadi khat suaksakin a dei bang thukhen hi."},"8":{"text":"“A siphute pawlbeam sangin manlang zaw a, ngia ngilkialte sangin kiitakhuai zaw hi. A siphu ngalkapte ngam khuala pan hong pai a; a siphute in lei khuat uh hi. Muvanlaite suktun in a mat tute a zap bangin amate hong pai uh hi."},"9":{"text":"“A ngalkaphonpite ngongtat a, zawna taw hong kuanin, amate hong nai ciang a kuama po patau hi. A ngal matte, senvui za in tam hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in kumpipate zawnsak vawt a, zanei uliante nuisan zazaan lel uh hi. Amate a khaktan zo tu kulh om peuma ngawl a — amate in tua kulh sia lei sunnel in la hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a thahatna sia amate ii pathian ahi, hi mite, sia vuiva bangin paisuak a bo uh hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa awng, a kipatciil a kipan nangma in Pathian na hi hi. Nangma in ka Pathian na hi a, thiangtho in, a tawntungin na om hi. Topa ka Pathian le hong dal pa awng, nangma in Babylon te na teal zo a, ko daan hong piak thei natu in na hatsak hi.","title":"Habakkuk tungah Phun kik"},"13":{"text":"Ahizong banghangin hi a thumaan ngawl misiate koithong thei ni ziam? Na mittangte siatna et natu in thiangtho leih a, khialna a vawt mite na mu thei bua hi. Tua ahikom amate sangin a thutangzawte a suksiat ciangin banghangin thim om thei ni ziam?"},"14":{"text":"Bangbangin tua mite sia lamlak tu ukpa nei ngawl ngasa le lungno honkhat bangin vawt thei ni ziam?"},"15":{"text":"Babylon te in ngasa tangthaak bang keakin mite man uh hi. Amate in tua ngeente taw kaikeak in a mat hu in lungdam in au ngawp lai hi!"},"16":{"text":"Amate in a ngeente ngawngawn bia in tuate atu sangaw biakpiakna vawt hi, banghang ziam cile na theampo sung pan a pha belte tua ngeente in ngasak hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in a tawntungin namsau zangh a, hesuakna nei ngawlin minamte susia tawntung tu ziam?"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ngalvilna tausaang tungah ka kaa tu a, ka lungkim ngawl nate taw kisai Topa ii hong zo kikna le ka pau natu in hong son tu thute ngakin ka en tu hi.","title":"ii Habakkuk A Zo kikna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in hi bangin hong zo hi: “Et po ciang a kisim thei tu in kong pualaak thu sia suangpheak tungah thiang takin at in."},"3":{"text":"Lai taw at in, banghang ziam cile tuasia a taangtut tu hun theng ngawl lai hi. Ahihang hun sia a manlangin hong theng tu a, kong lak sia taangtung tu hi. Hong pian tu haisaang thei tha tu hi, ahizong tuasia ngak in; hong piang tatak tu a, hong haisaang ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Heb 10:37"},"4":{"text":"Hi sia in a thupuak ahi hi: ‘A tatsia mite nungta ngawl tu a, ahizong thutang mite in Pathian tungah thumaan ahikom nungta tu uh hi,’ ” hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Hauna in hong theam thei hi. A duhop a huaiham mihingte kiphasakin thim om thei ngawl hi — thina mama taw kibangin amate lungkim hun nei ngawl hi. Tua hu in amate in ngam khat zawkciang ngam khat amate atu in suanthal hi.","title":"Thutang ngawlte Lalna"},"6":{"text":"Ngallelte in ngalzote thato tu a, huasaakna lak tu hi. Amate in, “Noma neisa ahi ngawlte laaksak nu hi, ahihang a lal na hi uh hi! Note tungah leei hong bate zawthawk thu in na siikna taw bang tanvei na hau tan lai tu uh ziam?” ci tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahizong tuasia na heak ma in, noma ngual zothalte mama in leiba na nei tu uh a, a meet taw na piak tu in zawthawk thu taw leiba hong kinot tu hi. Ngalte hong pai in hong liingsak tu hi. Na vanhte hong suttol tu uh hi!"},"8":{"text":"Ngam tam mama ah mihingte na suttol uh hi, ahizong tu in a nungta laite in no hong suttol tu hi, banghang ziam cile noma in mihing na that uh a, leitung mite tung le a khuapite tungah na ngongtatna hang ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Na lal zo hi! Ngongtatna taw na laak te taw na innkuan na hausak a, siatna le launa pan na inn ngam muang tu in na hanciam hi!"},"10":{"text":"Ahihang na tup na sawmnate in na bangkua maizumsak hi; minam tam ma na suksiatna taw nangma tungah lalna bek na piangsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Luphung suangte ngawngawn in hong langpanin au a, zawlsaute zongh in tua aw thangko ma hong hawl kik hi."},"12":{"text":"Na lal zo hi! Khuapi khat sia kithalupna le khialna lian doppha in na saat hi."},"13":{"text":"Na zawthal minamte in a tha a ngal uh a thawthong in bosak a, amate saksate theampo kaanghtum siat hi. Hi sia Topa Vaanglianbelpa ii vawt hi.","ref":"Is 14:19"},"14":{"text":"Ahihang tuipi sia tui taw a kidim bangin leitung in Topa vaangletna heakna taw kidim tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Na lal zo hi! Na thinso hu in na innpaamte zawngsak in maizum pia ni hi; zukham bang keakin amate na hoisak hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma zongh min phatna sangin maizumna taw na kituam zaw tu hi. Nangma zongh zu ne in na hoi vatut tu hi. Topa in daan piakna hai hong dawnsak tu a, na minphatna sia min siatna hong suak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Lebanon taamthing na phuktham zo a; tu in nang hong kiphuk vawk tu hi. A ngamsate na that a, tu in tua ngamsate in hong lausak tu hi. Leitung le a khuapite tungah na ngongtatnate hang le tual na tha uh hang in tuabang in piang tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Milim ii kimanna bang ziam? Mihing ii vawt sa na khat hi bek a, leilot thu ngawl po bangma hong son ngawl hi. Tua a pau thei ngawl pathian — tua sia a vawtpa ii a muan sia bang phattuam pui tu ziam!"},"19":{"text":"Nang a lal na hi zo hi! Thingbek khat tungah “Khanglo in!” tua ahibuale suangtum khat tungah “Tho in!” ci ni hi. Milim in na khat pawpo hong lak thei ziam? Khamh le ngunn taw kituam tha tu hi, ahizong a sungah nuntakna om ngawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in a Biakinnpi thiangtho sungah om hi; ama mai ah leitung mihing theampo in thim dide in om tahen."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia in kamsaangpa Habakkuk thungetna ahi hi.","title":"Habakkuk Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Topa awng, na sep na vawtte ka za zo a, zakta in lamdang ka sa mama hi. Tu in ko hun sung zongh ah nasep lianpi na sep ngeite hong seam kik ta'n. Na thin uuk ciang zong hesuakna hong nei ta'n."},"3":{"text":"Edom panin Pathian hong pai kik tu hi; Paran mualte pan a thiangtho Pathian hong pai tu hi. A hoina in vantungte siin a; leitung in ama pokna taw kidim hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama khualeng taanna taw hong pai tu a; a khut pan khuavak tee keak a, tualai ah a vaangletna kiseal hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in natnate a mai ah puak a, thina ii a zui tu in thupia hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama a tawlngak ciang, leitung kithing a; Ama ii a et ciang minamte liinglawng hi. A tawntungin a om mualte kektham a; taanghlai hunin, a va ngeina mualte, a kip tawntung mualte kiasuk hi."},"7":{"text":"Cushan mite launa ka mu a, Median mite liinglawng uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa awng, ngunte in hong thin uuksak ziam? Nang hong thinsosak sia tuipi ahi ziam? Meeite tungah na to hi; na mite zawna na puak ciang vuipi suangval meeikaai sia na leang ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Na thal zangh tu in na kinging zo hi, thaltangte kap tu in na kithoai hi. Na khualeng in simlei khentham hi."},"10":{"text":"Mualte in nang hong mu ciangin liing uh a, van panin tui hong buasuk hi. Leinuai a tuite hawk vabuat a, a tuihualte khangin saangto hi."},"11":{"text":"A manlang na thaltangte a teet vazal ciang le na teitee te a taan ciang ni le tha te a omna ah tawlnga hi."},"12":{"text":"Thin uuk sa in leitung na kaantan a; thinsona taw minamte na tuanhcil hi."},"13":{"text":"Na mite le na teal kumpipa hun tu in na kuan hi. Mi ngilote lampui pa na vaatvawk a, a nungzuite na lalcipsak hi."},"14":{"text":"A zawngkhalte a zawthawk uh ciang a oaiaam mite bangin kote hong thethaang tu in a ngalkapte vuipi bangin hong pai ciang na thaltangte in a ngalkaphonpi ukpa kaaplet hi."},"15":{"text":"Na siphute taw tuipi na tuanhcil a, tuaciang a thahat tuite phuan hi."},"16":{"text":"Hite theampo ka za a, lau in ka liing hi; ka muk zongh liing hi. Ka pumpi zaw vaneal hi, ka nuai ah ka peang sui tha in ka liik hi. Keima in ko hong simte Pathian ii daan piak hun hong tun tu thim dide in ka ngak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Theikungte nga ngawl a, sapitkungte a nga bua zong, olive kungte nga ngawl a, lote sungah an a piang bua zong, tuute thi siat a, khuibukte a hawm zong,"},"18":{"text":"ka lungdamin ka thinnuam veve lai tu hi. Banghang ziam cile Topa Pathian in ka ngumpa ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Vaanglianpipa Topa in thahatna hong pia hi. Ama in sangai bangin ka peang hong khosak a, mualte tungah hong keamcing hi."}}}}},"36":{"info":{"name":"Zephaniah","shortname":"Zeph","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thu in Amon tapa Josiah ii Judah kumpi a sep laitak, Topa ii Zephaniah tungah a piak thu ahi hi- (Zephaniah pa Cushi, Cushi pa Gedaliah, Gedaliah pa Amariah hi a, Amariah pa sia Kumpi Hezekiah ahi hi.)","ref":"2 Kum 22:1—23:30; 2 Khang 34:1—35:27"},"2":{"text":"Topa in, “Keima in leitung na theampo ka lalsak tu hi,","title":"ii Thukhenna Ni"},"3":{"text":"mihing le nganhing, vacim le ngasa dongin ka susia tu hi. Mi ngilote bo natu ka vawt tu hi. Mihing nam buppi ka susia tu a, kuama taang ngawl tu hi. Keima Topa in ka son zo hi."},"4":{"text":"“Jerusalem mite le Judah mite theampo daan ka pia tu hi. Baal biakna a khakbel te dongin ka bosak siat tu a, tua nasep a seam lawki thiampite zongh kuama in phawk ngawl tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Innkhum tungah kaato in, ni, tha, aksite a bia pawpo ka susia tu hi. Kei hong bia hong paai in, a thumaan tu in kiciam pia zo napi, a zawk ciang Molech pathian min suangin a kiciam theampo ka susia tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei hong nungngat in, kei hong zui nawn ngawlte, kei tungah lamlak natu ngen ngawl a, hong zuan ngawlte ka susia tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Topa thukhen tu ni hong nai zo hi; tua ahikom ama mai ah thim dide in om vun. Topa in a mite pum aap siat tu in kithoai a, Judah a suttol tu in ngalte sam hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in, “Tua kingawlup ni in, uliante, kumpi tapate le ngamdang ngeinate a zui theampo daan ka pia tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Lawkite bangin biakna a vawt theampo le sutol vanh taw a tote inn sung a kidim natu in, a ngute le a thatte theampo daan ka pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in, “Tua ni ciang, Jerusalem Ngasa Kongpi ah kaana aw na za tu uh hi. Khuapi khen a thak zawna munah tauna aw le mual tungah sukthapna awnging lian khat na za tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"No, khuapi taw sangah a teangte awng, hi thu na zaak uh ciang tau in kap vun, banghang ziam cile sumvawtte theampo thi siat tu uh hi!"},"12":{"text":"“Tua hun ciang in meiinn khat la in, Jerusalem ka zong tu hi. Amate le amate tumtakin lungkim a, a kimuang mite in, ‘ Topa in a pha, a sia bangma vawt nei ngei bo’ a cite daan ka pia tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate nei le lamh kisuttol in, a innte kisusia tu hi. Amate in a sak tu innte sungah teang ngeingawl tu a, a ciin tu sapitkungte pan sapittui ne ngeingawl tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa ii Ni a thupi sia hong nai zo hi — hong nai mama zo a, manlang takin hong theng tu hi! Tua ni in a thuak hak ni hi tu hi, banghang ziam cile, ngalkap hangsan belte zongh thinkiamin kap tu hi!"},"15":{"text":"Tua ni sia thinso ni khat, ngim nga ni le thinkiam ni khat hi tu a, siatna le lalna ni khat, khuazing le khuasia ni khat, meeikaai a, khuatuap ni khat hi tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Luphungte taw a kidal khuapite le tausaangte a sim ngalkapte ii ngal kisimna awnging le ngal lemle aw taw a kidim ni hi tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Topa in, “Mihingte tungah tuabang tuasiatna ka tungsak tu a, a vekpi in mittawte bangin lei a zawt tu uh hi. Amate in kei tungah hong maw zo ahikom tu in a chisan uh tui bang in luang tu a, a mithi luangte lei ah kisial in a muat tu hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni in Topa in a thinsona hong lak ciang a ngunn a khamh te theampo zongin amate a hun zo buatu hi. Leitung bup sia a thin uukna meikuang in susia tu hi. Leitung a teang mihing theampo bona — thakhat thu in a bona — ama in tungsak tu hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A maizum maw minam awng,","title":"A kisiik kikna tu Thuumna"},"2":{"text":"note vui ii muut taangvai bangin hong kibet ma, Topa thin uukna a kuang sia hong thet ma, ama thinsona hong lak ma in khua hong phawk tavun."},"3":{"text":"Ama ii thupiakte a ni, ngam sungah a kiniamkhiak note theampo awng, Topa sangah hong kiheak tavun. A maan sia vawt vun a, Topa mai ah noma le noma kiniamkhiak vun. Tua hile Topa ii a thin uukna hong lak ni ciangin daan khak natu pan suakta tha tu nu hi."},"4":{"text":"Gaza khuapi ah a kinusia kuama om ngawl tu hi. Ashkelon kitaisan tu hi. Ni lang sungah Ashdod mite kihawlkeak tu hi, tuaciang Ekron mite sia amate khuapi pan kihawlkeak tu hi.","title":"Israel kiim A ngamte Lal natu"},"5":{"text":"Tuipi hui ah a teang no Philistine mite awng, a lal hi zo nu hi. Topa in no tungah thukhen zo hi. Ama in hong susia tu a, khat zongh na taang buatu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuipi hui na ngam uh sia tuucingte bukte le tuukhawkte omna lozau suak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Judah mi a nungta laiteng in na leitang uh la tu hi. Amate in a ngan honte thana in nei tu a, Ashkelon innte ah ngiak tu uh hi. Topa a Pathian in amate taw omkhawm tu a, amate nuamsasak kik tu hi.","ref":"Is 14:29-31; Jer 47:1-7; Eze 25:15-17; Jol 3:4-8; Amo 1:6-8; Zec 9:5-7"},"8":{"text":"Topa Vaanglianbelpa in, “Moab le Ammon mite in ka mite a zawnsakna, a nomuna le, a ngam ka sut tu hi ci in a kiphatsakna zongh ka za zo hi.","ref":"Is 15:1—16:14; 25:10-12; Jer 48:1-47; Eze 25:8-11; Amo 1:13-15; Jer 49:1-6; Eze 21:28-32; 25:1-7; Amo 1:13-15; Pian 19:24"},"9":{"text":"Israel te ii Pathian, a nungta Topa ka hi bangma in Moab le Ammon sia Sodom le Gomorrah bangin kisusia tu hi, ci in ka kiciam hi. Tuate sia cikhukte le a laltham top, lopa bek pona mun suak tu hi. Ka mi a nungta laite in amate vanh suttol tu a, a ngam laaksak tu uh hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Moab le Ammon mite kiphatsakna, a kisaktheina le vaanglianbelpa Topa ii mite a selno hu in daan a piak tu zia sia tuabang ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in amate lausak tu hi. Ama in leitung pathiante sia bangma ngawl suaksak tu a, tua zawkciang minam theampo in amate ngam tek ah ama bia tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa in Ethiopia mite zongh thisak tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in Assyria suksiat natu in a vaangletna zangh tu hi. Ama in Nineveh khuapi sia a lalsa a kinusia sa, tui om ngawl sennealngam suaksak tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua mun in tuuhon, khuihon le nganhing namcin tatna mun hi tu hi. Tua a lalsa munah simbute teangin khelkite panin haam tu hi. Kongkha saamkiil tungah va-akte haam tu hi. A inn sakna thingkal ahi cedar thingte kilakeak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Khuapi kiphasak mama, a thahatna suangin, ngam muang a kisa khat tungah tuabangin piang tu hi. A mite in amate khuapi sia simleitung ah khuapi lianbelin ngaisun uh hi. Bangza a ngamtongta mun, ngamsate tawl omna mun suak tu ziam! A kaantan in a pai pawpo in a mu ciang patau in ton tu hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A mite a zothaw, tatsia in ngalphuang nuam Jerusalem khuapi a lal hi zo hi.","title":"Jerusalem ii Mawna le Kitatna"},"2":{"text":"Tua sia in Topa thu ngai ngawl a, a kiteknate zongh saang ngawl hi. Topa muang ngawlin, huna zongh ngen ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"A uliante sia tawpi hawk bang hi a; a thukhenmangte sia, duhop leih kisa in a zing ciang dong sangu khat zongh a khe ngam ngawl ngiapui ngilkialte bang ahi uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kamsaangte in sep nop vacin nei ngawl a, thimthel uh hi; thiampite in a thiangtho nate ninsak in, Pathian thukhamte amate phattuam natu in deikai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang khuapi sungah Topa om lai hi; ama in a maan bang seam a, a hi ngawlte vawt ngeingawl hi. Zing sim a pealmaw in a mite tungah thutang lak hi. Tua hi napi thutang ngawl mite in a maan ngawlte ma vawt tan viuveu a, a mai uh zum ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in “Minam theampo ka maaimot zo hi; a khuapite ka susia a, a luphungte le a tausaangte a siacip sa in ka nusia hi. A khuapite kitaisan a; lampite a tawn om ngawl a — mihingte kuama om nawn ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka ngaisutna ah tuasia ciang ka mite in kei hong thasia tu a, tuaciang ka tek nate hong saang tu hi, ka hilnate mangil ngeingawl tu hi ci in ka tuat hi. Ahihang hai ngawlin a ngamtat siat ngei ma in, a sia ngamta veve uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in, “Ngak zi vun, ka minamte ka mawsak tu ni ngak vun. Ka thin uukna ii thahatna ka heaksak nopna in minamte le kumpi ngamte khoptua tu in ka thin ka khensat zo hi. Ka thinsona meikuang in simlei bup ka kaanghthamsak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua sia ciang ngam tuatuamte sungah mihingte ka kikhealsak tu a, amate in kei tung bek ah thu hong ngen in pathian dangte tungah thungen nawn ngawl tu hi. Amate a vekpi in keima thu hong ni tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngam khuala Ethiopia pan ngawngawnin a kithethaang ka mite in kei tungah biakpiakna hong pia tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hun ciang, kei nong langpan huvau in no ka mite in na maizum tu kul nawn ngawl tu uh hi. A kiphasak le a kisathei theampo ka heam tu a, ka mual thiangtho tungah kei nong do kik ngei nawn buatu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"A kiniamkhiak, a thinnip mite tualai ah ka nusia tu a, kei kungah hu ngenin hong pai tu hi."},"13":{"text":"A taanglai Israel mite in kuama tungah khial ngawl tu a, leilot thu son ngawlin ngual a theam buatu uh hi. Amate ma vang daupai in ngammuang tu a, kuama a kiita buatu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Tpl 14:5"},"14":{"text":"Israel mite awng, Lungdamna taw lasa in au vun! Jerusalem awng, na thin theampo taw lungdam vun!","title":"Lungdamna La"},"15":{"text":"Topa in na daan thuakna bosak zo hi; Na ngalte theampo hong hepsak hi. Topa , Israel kumpipa sia note taw omkhawm hi; tu in bangma lau natu thu om ngawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Jerusalem tungah amate ii hi bangin a ci tu hun hong theng tu hi, “Lau heak in, Zion khuapi awng! Na khutte zawsak in khia vanuang heak in!"},"17":{"text":"Topa na Pathian in nang taw omkhawm hi; ama ii thahatna in zawna hong pia hi; Topa in nang tungah lungdam tu hi, tuaciang ama ii itna sungah nuntakna thak hong pia tu hi. Ama in lasa tu a, na tungah lungdam tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihingte poai khat sungah a lungdam bangma hi tu hi.” Topa in “Lal natu hong tawnnate ka vengsak zo hi; tuaciang na min daina teng kong laaksak zo hi."},"19":{"text":"A hun hong theng tu hi! Nang hong zothawte daan ka pia tu hi; a peangbai theampo ka suatak tu a tuaciang saltaangte inn ah ka ciapui tu hi. Amate ii maizumna sia patoaina taw ka laih tu hi; tuaciang leitung theampo in amate pok tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"A hun hong tung tu hi! A kithethaang na mite inn ah kong ciapui tu hi; Simleitung bup ah na min kong thangsak tu a, tuaciang khatvei a khangto a nuamsa in kong vawt kik tu hi,” ci hi. Topa in ci zo hi."}}}}},"37":{"info":{"name":"Haggai","shortname":"Hag","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darius ii Persia kumpilian a sep zawk a kum niina kum, a tha luk tha, ni masabel ni in Topa in kamsaangpa Haggai tungtawnin thu son hi. Shealtiel tapa Judah ngamukmangpa Zerubbabel atu le Jehozadak ii tapa Thiampi Lianbel Joshua atu in thupuak ahi hi.","title":"in Biakinnpi Sakkik natu Thupia","ref":"Ezra 4:24—5:2; 6:14"},"2":{"text":"Vaanglianbel Topa in Haggai tungah a cina pan, “Hi mite in tu hun sia Biakinnpi sakkik natu hunpha hi ngawl hi, ci uh hi.”"},"3":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa in kamsaangpa Haggai tungtawnin hi thu teng mite tungah pia hi:"},"4":{"text":"“Ka mite awng, ka Biakinnpi a siacip sa in a om laitakin pha tak a kisa innte sungah banghang teang tu nu ziam?"},"5":{"text":"No tungah bang thupiang cisia mu ngawl nu ziam?"},"6":{"text":"Thaicii tam mama na tu uh a, ahizong an tawm bek na la uh hi. Anneak tawm tu na nei uh a, ahizong na khamkhop tu na nei bua uh hi. Sapittui neak tu na nei uh a, ahizong na kham tham tu na nei bua uh hi. Puansilh na nei uh a, ahizong a lum tham tu na nei bua uh hi. Tuaciang naseam khat in a nuntak khom natu thalaw zo ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Hisia a pian theina thu he ngawl nu ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Tu in mual tungah kaato tavun a, inn thingte la in Biakinnpi sa kik vun; tuasia ciang kei ka lungkim tu a, a kilawm bangin kei hong kibia tu hi."},"9":{"text":"“Anlaak tu tam mama na lamen uh a, ahizong tawm bek piang hi. Tuaciang an laakte na ciapui uh ciang kong muutkeaksak hi. Banghang tuabang vawt khi ziam? Banghang ziam cile note mi sim in ama inn vawtin a komlaak laitakin ka Biakinnpi a siacip sa in om hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua hu in nguazu ngawl a, bangma po thei ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima in leitang tung — a mualte, anciinna lote, sapithuante, olive ciinnate tung — lei pan a piang an namcin tung, mihingte le ngannote tung, na ciin sa theampo tungah nguatui kong hangsak hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Zerubbabel, Joshua le Babylon ngam saltanna pan hong cia kik theampo in Topa a Pathian sawl bangin vawt uh hi. Amate lau ahiciang, Topa ii kamtaipa, kamsaang Haggai thu ni uh hi.","title":"A Mite in Thupiakna Zui"},"13":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Haggai in hi Topa thupuak sia mipite tungah son hi: “Note taw kei kong omkhawm tu hi, ci in kong kamciam hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in Biakinnpi sak tu vai mi theampo thawn hi: Judah ngamuk mangpa Zerubbabel; Thiampi Lianbel Joshua, le saltanna pan hong ciakik mite theampo ahi hi. Amate ii Vaanglianbel Topa, a Pathian Biakinnpi ah a nasep kipat ni sia,"},"15":{"text":"Darius kumpilianpa maan zawk a kum nii kum, tha luk tha, 24 ni ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua kum, a tha sali tha, ni 21 ni in Topa in kamsaang pa Haggai tungtawnin paupui kik hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Thak ii A Nasiatna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in Haggai tungah Shealtiel tapa Judah ngamuk mangpa Zerubbabel, Thiampi Lianbel Joshua le mite tungah hi bang in sonsak hi,"},"3":{"text":"“No sungah mihing khat po in Biakinnpi bangza in nasia ngei kana ziam ci sia a ciamtee lai na om uh ziam? Tu in bangbangin na mu uh ziam? Tu a sia, son thamman ngawl bang hi nanak tha tu hi.","ref":"Ezra 3:12"},"4":{"text":"Ahizong tu in note khat zongh thinkiam heak vun. Na seam vun banghang ziam cile no taw keima kong omkhawm hi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt ngam pan nong pusua uh lai in a tawntung note taw kong omkhawm tu hi ci in kamciam kong pia hi. Tu zonghin note taw kong omkhawm nginge lai hi, tua ahikom lau heak vun.","ref":"Pu 29:45-46"},"6":{"text":"“Hai ngawlin vantung le leitung, lei le tuipi ka lok tu hi.","ref":"Heb 12:26"},"7":{"text":"Minam theampo ka lawnthal tu a, amate sumngum theampo hi lai ah hong kipuak tu hi, tuaciang Biakinnpi in hauna taw kidim tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Simleitung a ngunn le khamh theampo keima aa ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Biakinnpi thak in a lui sia sangin nasia zaw tu hi, tuaciang tualai ah ka mite maa vanna le kilemna ka pia tu hi,” cisak hi. Vaanglianbelpa Topa in son zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Darius ii kumpilian a sep zawk a kum niina, a tha kua tha, ni 24 ni in Vaanglianbelpa Topa in kamsaangpa Haggai paupui kik hi.","title":"Kamsaangpa in Thiampite Thu dongh"},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Thiampite tungah hi dokna huvau thukhensatna khat ngen in:"},"12":{"text":"Sonteena in sangaw biakpiakna sungah a kithiansua sabak khat a thiampi puantual sungah tun ci tawng. Tua zawkciang ama in a puantual taw anluum, an min sa, sapittui, olive thau, ahibuale an nam khat pawpo thutha le, tua an zong thiangsak tu ziam?” ci hi. Tuabang a dok ciang Thiampite in, “Thiangsak ngawl tu hi” ci in zo uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaciang Haggai in, “Sonteena, mihing khat in mithi a tham hu in nin hi ci tawng. Tua zawkciang ama in hi ante khat pawpo a tham le tuate zongh ninsak tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Thiampite in, “Ninsak tu hi,” ci in zo hi.","ref":"Mi 19:11-22"},"14":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Haggai in, “ Topa in, hi ngam sungah mite le a piansak nate theampo tungah a piangte a kibangma hi ci hi; tua ahikom biaknatau tungah a piak theampo ninsak hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in “No tungah hong piangsate mu thei ngawl nu ziam? Biakinnpi na sakkik ma in,","title":"in A Thupha Piak tu Kamciam"},"16":{"text":"ansaal khat ah an kilogramme za nii mu tu in muangmaw a, na pai uh hang kilogramme za khat bek om hi. Bung khat sung pan sapittui litre zakhat duup tu in na pai uh hang sawmli bek om hi."},"17":{"text":"Na ciin sa na theampo lalsak tu in vuisa le ngialtang kong puak hi, ahizong na kisiik kik tuan bualai uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuni sia tha kua tha, ni kul le ni li ni hi a, Biakinnpi tawdap phaana a kiman ni hi. Tu pan kipan bang hong piang tu ziam en tavun."},"19":{"text":"Antang om nawn ngawl a, sapitkungte, theikungte, talee te le olive kungte nga ngawl lai ahitazong, tu pan kipan thupha kong pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua tha, ni 24 ni ma in Topa ii Haggai tungah hi thupuak a niina sia,","title":"in Zerubbabel Kamciam Pia"},"21":{"text":"Judah ngamuk mangpa Zerubbabel atu in puak hi: “Keima in van le lei lok tu in kithoai khi hi,"},"22":{"text":"kumpi ngamte lumletin a thahatna ka bosak tu hi. Ngalleangte le a hawlte ka sawnthal tu hi; siphute thi in, a tung tote khat le khat kithatlum tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ni ciang ka naseampa Zerubbabel awng, nang kong la tu a, keima min suangin a uk tu in panmun kong pia tu hi. Nangma kong teal sa khat na hi hi.” Vaanglianbelpa Topa in son zo hi."}}}}},"38":{"info":{"name":"Zechariah","shortname":"Zech","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Persia kumpilianpa Darius maan zawk a kum niina, a tha liat tha sungah Topa in Iddo tupa, Berechiah tapa kamsaangpa Zechariah tungah hi thu pia hi.","title":"kungah A Mite A cia kik natu Sapna.","ref":"Ezra 4:24—5:1; 6:14"},"2":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in mipite tungah hi thu a son tu in Zechariah sawl a, “Na taanghpupite tungah keima, Topa ka thin uuk mama hi,"},"3":{"text":"ahihang tu in no tungah kong ci hi, ‘Kei kungah hong heakkik tavun, tuaciang keima no sangah kong kiheak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Na taanghpupite taw kibang nawn heak vun. Khuangeipi lai in kamsaangte in amate kungah ka thupuak sonin, ngamtat sia, mawna taw a nuntak nawn ngawl natu in thuhil uh hi. Ahihang amate in ka thu hong ngai nuam ngawlin hong mang nuam bua uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Na taanghpupite le tua kamsaangte nungta nawn ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Na taanghpupite tungah ka naseam kamsaangte tungtawnin thupiaknate le kidop natu thute ka pia hi, ahihang amate in tuate thusim ngawl a, a ngamtatna taw a kizui in ngimna thuak uh hi. Tuasia ciang amate kisiik kikin, keima, a Vaanglianbelpa Topa in amate taw a kiphu bang le ka sep tu tatak a ka khensat bangin daan ka piak hunlam hong tel uh hi,’ ” cisak hi."},"7":{"text":"Darius sia kumpilianpa in a maan zawk a kum niina, a tha sawm le tha khatna (Shebat tha), ni 24 ni zanin Topa in mukholna khat sungah thupuak khat nei hi.","title":"Kamsaangpa ii Siphute A Mukholna"},"8":{"text":"Siphu san khat tungah a to khat ka mu hi. Ama sia myrtle thingkung pawlkhat kawm, kuam sung khat ah tawlnga a, ama nungsangah siphu dangte — a san, a pawl tiptep le a kaangte om hi.","ref":"Tpl 6:4; Tpl 6:2"},"9":{"text":"Ama ka dongh a, “Topa awng, hi siphute in bang khiakna nei ziam?” ka ci hi. Ama in, “Bang ci nuam ziam kong lak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in tuate leitung a enkot tu in paisak hi,” ci in hong zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in tua vantunglalang tungah: “Leitung theampo ah pai zo ung, leitung buppi sia a cimaw, a kizo sa in om hi,” ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang vantunglalang in, “Vaanglianbelpa Topa awng, Jerusalem tung le Judah ngam khuapite tungah kum sawmsali sung thin uuk zo ni hi. Amate na hesuak tu bang tanvei hai lai tu ziam?” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in heenepna kammal taw vantunglalang tungah zo kik a,"},"14":{"text":"tuaciangin hi Vaanglianbelpa Topa pauna thangsak tu in vantunglalang in kei hong sawl hi: “Ka khuapi thiangtho Jerusalem atu in thinbotna le itna thukpi ka nei hi,"},"15":{"text":"tuaciang kilemna le ngamdaina a nga minamte tungah ka thin uuk mama hi. Banghang ziam cile ka mite tungah ka thin uukna iip kenkonin ka om laitak tua minamte in ka mite thuakna nasiasak seseam hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jerusalem khuapi tungah ka hesuakna lak tu in kong pai kik zo hi. Ka Biakinnpi kipua pha kik tu a, khuapi kisa kik tu hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Vantunglalang in Topa kammal hi teng zongh thangsak tu in hong sawl hi: “Vaanglianbelpa Topa in a khuapite nuamsa kik tu a, ama in Jerusalem khatvei hu kikin, ama khuapi in nei kik tu hi, ci hi.”"},"18":{"text":"Mukholna dang sungah khuital kii li ka mu hi.","title":"Sakiite Mukholna"},"19":{"text":"Keima hong paupui vantunglalang tungah, “Hi sakiite a khiakna bang ziam,” ci in ka dongh hi. Ama in, “Tuate in Judah, Israel le Jerusalem mite a kithethaangsak simlei vaangliante a cinopna ahi hi,” ci in hong zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa in sek veu a toai naseam pasal li hong lak hi."},"21":{"text":"Keima in, “Hi mite bang vawt tu in hong pai ziam?” ci in ka dongh hi. Topa in, “Amate in Judah ngam suthamin a mite a thethaangsak minamte a lausak tu le a lawnthal tu in hong pai hi,” ci in hong zo hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mukholna dang khat ah a khut sungah piteena khau a toai pasal khat ka mu hi.","title":"Piteena Khau Mukholna"},"2":{"text":"“Koisung pai tu ni ziam?” ci in ka dongh hi.
