Ama in, “Jerusalem bangza in sau a, bangza in zai ziam, ci in tee tu khi hi,” ci in hong zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang keima hong paupui vantunglalang sia mai sangah kal hong suan ka mu a, vantunglalang dang khat ama taw kisi tu in hong pai hi."},"4":{"text":"A masa sia in a dang khat sia munah, “Zia sung a pikhau toai khangmoipa kungah va tai ta'n a, Jerusalem ah mihing le ngannote tam leilam tu ahiciang luphung taw uum tu in lian lei tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa in khuapi huu tu in ama mama khuapi kiimkot a mei luphung khat hi tu a, ama tua munah a vaangletna theampo taw a teang tu in kamciam pia zo hi va ci ta'n,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Topa in a mite tungah, “Mun theampo ah note kong thethaang hi. Ahihang tu in, no saltaangte awng, Babylon panin suakta in Jerusalem ah heak kik tavun.","title":"Saltaangte Inn ah Cia tu in Kisam","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Khat pawpo in note hong saat le, kei a tu manphabel ka sak sia a saat ahi hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom Vaanglianbelpa Topa in a mite ii vanh a suttol minamte tungah hi thu son tu in keima hong puak hi:"},"9":{"text":"“ Topa ama mama in note hong sim tu a, khatvei lai a na naseam ahi ngeite in na vanh uh hong suttol kik tu hi,” hong cisak hi. Hi bangin hong pian tak ciang Vaanglianbelpa Topa in kei hong puak hunlam a kuama po in he tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa in, “Jerusalem mite awng, lungdamin lasa vun! Note sungah a teang tu in kong pai hi!” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hun ciang minam tam mama Topa kungah pai tu a, ama mite suak tu uh hi. Ama in note sungah hong teang tu a, no kungah kei hong puak hunlam na he tu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Judah mite khatvei ma ama ngam thiangtho sungah Topa ii nei tuam hong hi kik tu a, Jerusalem khua sia ama itbel khuapi hong hi kik tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama sia a teenna mun thiangtho panin hong pai ahiciang mi theampo awng, Topa mai ah thim dide in om vun."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mukholna dang khat ah Topa in Thiampi Lianbel Joshua sia Topa vantunglalang mai ah dingin a om hong lak hi. Tuaciang Joshua kungah Satan ding a, ama mawsuan tu in kinging hi.","title":"Kamsaangpa ii Thiampi Lianbelpa Mukholna","ref":"Ezra 5:2; Tpl 12:10"},"2":{"text":"Topa vantunglalang in Satan munah, “ Topa in nang hong puavawk tahen, Satan awng! Jerusalem a it Topa in nang hong puavawk tahen. Hi sia pa in meikhuk sung pan a kiteen kik thingkhua khat taw kibang hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Joshua in puansiate silhin tualai ah ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Vantunglalang in a vantung sawllamhte munah, “Hi sia pa ii a silh puansia teng suutkeak vun,” ci hi. Tua zawkciang ama in Joshua munah “Na mawna teng kong laak keaksak zo a, na silh tu puan thakte kong pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in a sawllamhte munah, Joshua lu tungah dial thiang khat a khipsak natu in thupia hi. Tuabang ma in amate in seam uh a, Topa vantunglalang ii din sung teng ma in puan thakte ama kisilhsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang vantunglalang in Joshua tungah,"},"7":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa ii ci teng son hi: “Ka thukhamte zui in kong sawl tuamte na seam le, tuasia ciang ka Biakinnpi le a suumte na uk suak tu hi, tuaciang ka omna munah a om vantunglalangte thungetna ka zaak bangin na thungetnate kong za tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahiciang nang, Thiampi Lianbel ahi Joshua awng, na ngai in; no, a thiampi seppuite awng, mailam hun phate ii limlakna ahite awng, ngai vun: Thingbaak a kici ka naseampa kong pualaak tu hi!","ref":"Jer 23:5; 33:15; Zec 6:12"},"9":{"text":"Joshua mai ah mai sali a nei suang khat nguak ka koi tu hi. Tua tungah lai kong khen tu a, ni khat thu in hi ngam ii mawna teng ka lakeak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ni hong thet ciang, note khatsim in na sapitkungte le na theikungte taw a kidimna sungah kilemna le ngal muanna nga tu in hong pai natu na innpaamte tek na sam tu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mic 4:4"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei hong pau pupui ngei tua vantunglalang sia hong pai kik a, a mu kimlai phok bang phetin kei hong phong hi.","title":"Meivakna khuam Mukholna"},"2":{"text":"“Bang na mu ziam?” ci in hong dongh hi. “Khamh taw a kivawt meivak khuam khat hi. A dawn ah sathau koina kuang khat om hi. Meivak khuam tungah meiinn sali om a, a simin meivakkhau koina nei tek hi."},"3":{"text":"Meivak khuam lang le lang ah olive thingkung khat veve om hi,” ci in ka zo hi.","ref":"Tpl 11:4"},"4":{"text":"Tua zawkciang vantunglalang munah, “Topa awng, hite ii khiakna bang ziam?” ci in ka dongh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in, “He ngawl ni ziam?” hong ci hi. “He ngawl khi hi, topa awng,” ci in ka zo kik hi."},"6":{"text":"Vantunglalang in Topa tung pan hong pai hi thu teng Zerubbabel tungah son tu in kei hong sawl hi: “Nangma in ngalkap thahatna hang hi ngawl, nangma thahatna hang hi ngawl, ahihang keima thaa bek taw na ma na tun tu hi.","title":"Zerubbabel tungah Pathian Kamciam","ref":"Ezra 5:2"},"7":{"text":"Mualte za in a lian hong khak hong hal haksatnate na mai panin mang tu hi. Biakinnpi na sa kik tu hi, tuaciang suang khakbel sia a om natu sanah na cian ciang mite in ‘Hoi hi, Hoi hi!’ ci in au tu uh hi,” ama in ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa tung panin thupuak dang khat kei tung hong theng hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in, “Zerubbabel in Biakinnpi tawdap phaa zo a, a inn sak zo thiang tu hi. Tuabang hong pian ciang, nang sia keima ii amate kungah kong paisak na hi hunlam ka mite in hong he tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Vantunglalang in, “Meiinn salite in leitung theampo a mu Topa mittang salite ahi hi,” hong ci hi. Nasepna sungah khantona tawm mama ahiciang amate thinkiam hi. Ahihang amate in Zerubbabel ii Biakinnpi sak tu a zop tawtona a mu uh ciang, a lungdam tu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Tpl 5:6"},"11":{"text":"Tuaciang keima in, “Meivak khuam lang le lang ah a om olive kungte nii in bang a cinopna ziam?","ref":"Tpl 11:4"},"12":{"text":"Olive thau sunna khamh lawng niite pangh ah olive baak niite sia bang a cinopna ziam?” ci in ama ka dongh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in, “He ngawl ni ziam?” hong ci hi. “He bong, Topa awng” ci in ka zo kik hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuasia ciang ama in, “Hite in leitung bup ii Topa na a seam tu in Pathian tealsa le sathau a noisa mihing niite ahi hi,” ci hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khua ka et kik le vui sungah laizial leang khat ka mu hi.","title":"Laizial Leang Mukholna"},"2":{"text":"Vantunglalang in ka mu sia hong dongh hi. “Laizial khat vui sungah leang hi; tuasia metre kua sau a, metre li le lang zai hi,” ka ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in kei tungah, “Tuasia tungah ngam bup sungah a tung tu haamsiatna ki at hi. A laizial langkhat ah ngamsung panin nguta a minpiang kinotkeak tu hi; a langkhat ah kiciamna taw leilot thu a son theampo zongh kikaikeak tu hi, ci in ki at hi."},"4":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in tua haamsiatna ka tungsak tu a, tuasia in nguta pawpo ii inn le, kiciamna taw leilot thuson pawpo ii inn te sungah tum tu hi ci hi. Tua haamsiatna sia amate inn sungah teang tu a, tua innte a lalcipsa in kinusia tu hi,” hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Vantunglalang kilangh kik a, “En in! Na dang khat hong pai hi!” hong ci hi.","title":"Khum sungah Numei Mukholna"},"6":{"text":"“Bang ziam?” ci in ka dongh hi. Ama in, “Tuasia khum khat hi a, ngam bup ii mawna a lakna hi,” ci in hong zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Khum sitna sia haak taw kivawt hi. Ka et le, a sitna hong kilaamto a, tua khum sungah numei khat to hi!"},"8":{"text":"Vantunglalang in, “Hi numei in ngitlona lak hi,” ci hi. Tuaciang ama in tua numei sia khum sungah hensuk in, a sitna taw sin kik hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka etto ciang hilniang vacimlian ii thate bangin, a hat thate taw keima sangah hong leang numei nii ka mu hi. Amate in khum hong zamh a, lenpui vingveng hi."},"10":{"text":"Vantunglalang tungah, “Amate in tuasia koisungah paipui tu ziam?” ci in ka dongh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Tuasia atu in biakinn khat a saksak natu mun Babylon ah kipaipui tu hi. Biakinn sak a kiman ciang, a biak tu in a sungah tua khum kikoi tu hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mukholna dang khat ma ka nei hi. Tusia hun ciang taau mual nii kilaklaw pan siphu ngalleang li hong pusuak ka mu hi.","title":"Siphu ngalleang Li Mukholna"},"2":{"text":"Siphu ngalleang khatna sia siphu sante, a niina sia siphu vomte,","ref":"Tpl 6:4; Tpl 6:5"},"3":{"text":"a thumna sia siphu kaangte, a lina sia siphu pawl tiptepte in kai hi.","ref":"Tpl 6:2"},"4":{"text":"Tuaciang vantunglalang munah, “Topa awng, hi siphu ngalleangte ii a khiakna bang ziam?” ka ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in, “Hite sia vui lite hi a; tuate in leitung bup ii Topa omna pan hong pai tawm hi,” ci in hong zo hi.","ref":"Tpl 7:1"},"6":{"text":"Siphu vomte ii kai leang sia saksang Babylon zuan tu a, siphu kaangte nitumna sang zuan tu hi, siphu pawl tiptepte thangsang ngam zuan tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Siphu pawl tiptepte hong pusua ciangin leitung enkot nuam kisa in a pai tu kaal ngakla uh hi. Vantunglalang in, “Pai vun a, leitung enkot tavun!” ci a — tuaciang tuate pai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua zawkciang vantunglalang in hong oksan a, “Saksang Babylon ah a pai siphute in Topa thin uukna thimsak zo hi,” hong ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa in hi thu hong pia hi.","title":"Joshua Kumpilukhu khuksak natu Thupiakna"},"10":{"text":"Ama in, “Saltaangte ahi Heldai, Tobijah le Jedaiah te ii piak letsongte la in Zephaniah tapa Josiah inn ah thakhat ma pai in. Hi mite Babylon ah a saltanna pan hong heak kik siat zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate hong piak khamh le ngunn te taw kumpilukhu khat vawt in a, Jehozadak tapa Thiampi Lianbel Joshua lu tungah khusak in."},"12":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, ‘Thingbaak a kici mihing khat ama omna munah khangto tu a, Topa Biakinnpi sa kik tu hi.","ref":"Jer 23:5; 33:15; Zec 3:8"},"13":{"text":"Tuasia a sa tu sia ama hi a, kumpi khat patoai natu a kilawm teng ama in tangin, a mite uk tu hi. Thiampi khat ama kumpi tokhum kungah ding tu a, amate in kilemna le kituiton natu seam khawm tu hi,’ a ci teng ama munah son in."},"14":{"text":"Tua kumpilukhu in, Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah le Josiah te upatna le phawk natu in Topa Biakinnpi sungah om tu hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"A khuala ah a teang mite hong pai tu a, Topa Biakinnpi sakkikna ah hong hu tu hi. A sakkik sia a man ciang, Vaanglianbelpa Topa in kei sia nang kungah hong paisak hunlam na he tu hi. Topa na Pathian hong thupiak teng na zui le hi thu teng theampo hong piang tu hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darius sia kumpilianpa in a maan zawk a kum lina, a tha kuana (Kislev tha), a ni li ni in Topa in kei tungah thu khat hong pia hi.","title":"An tanna Maan ngawlte in Mawsak"},"2":{"text":"Bethel mite in Sharezer le, Regemmelech le a mite sia Vaanglianbelpa Topa Biakinnpi ah Topa thupha dei in thungen tu le"},"3":{"text":"thiampite le kamsaangte tungah hi bangin thu dongh tu in paisak hi, “Biakinnpi a kilalsak hu in kum tam mama sung ka vawt sa uh bangma, tu in a tha nga tha in, an tanna taw khuangai in om lai tu khu ziam?” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Hi thu sia Topa ii thupuak hi a, kei tungah hong theng hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama in, “Ngamsung a mite le thiampite ii hi kum sawmsali sung tawntung a tha ngana le a tha sali na ah khuangai in an a tan uh ciang kei hong patoai ahi ngawlna sia amate tungah son ta'n."},"6":{"text":"Amate in a neak a dawn ciang amate lungkim natu bek ahi hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Hi thu in Jerusalem khangto a, mihing taw a kidim hun lai, mihing tam mamate tua khuapi kiim a om khuate sung bek ah teang ngawlin thangsang ngamkhen le nitumna sang mualpeang te zongh ah a teen hun lai pekin kamsaang masate tungtawn a, Topa ii sonsa ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa in Zechariah tungah hi thu puak hi:","title":"Thunit Ngawl hu in Saltanna"},"9":{"text":"“Khua ngeipi lai in ka mite munah hi thupiakte ka pia hi: ‘Thukhaikim in seam vun a, khat le khat dikna le kihesuakna nei hamtang tavun."},"10":{"text":"No sungah hong teang ngamdangmite, meingong tangate ahizong, a cimaw dangte ahizong, zothaw ngawl tu nu hi. Khat le khat kisuksiat natu a nanamin sawm ngawl tu nu hi.’"},"11":{"text":"“Ahihang ka minamte thinpui in hong nangai ngawl uh hi. Amate in a thinsung kongkhate khakin,"},"12":{"text":"a lungtangte suang bangin saksak uh hi. Khua ngeipi lai a kamsaangte tungtawn a ka hil thute ngai nuam ngawl ahikom, ka thin uuk mama hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka pau ciang hong ngai ngawl uh ahikom, thu hong nget uh ciang ka zo bua hi."},"14":{"text":"Amate ngamdang ah a teang tu in, vuipi suangval bangin ka niil keak hi. Hi ngampha na sungah a teang om ngawl a, ngamtongta in kinusia hi,” ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in Zechariah tungah hi thupia hi:","title":"Jerusalem Puuaphat kik natu Kamciam"},"2":{"text":"“A mite ka it mama manin Jerusalem ka hu tu kaal ka ngakla hi, tua itna in a ngalte tungah hong thin uuksak hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka khuapi thiangtho Jerusalem ah ka cia kik tu a, tualai ah ka teang tu hi. Tua khuapi sia a citak khuapi kici tu a, Vaanglianbelpa Topa mual sia a thiangtho mual kici tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Khatvei ma, nupi huai pasal huaite, huai leilam kisa in ciangkhut khunin a vakte sia khuapi khawlmunte ah to tu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaciang lampite sia a kimai numeino patangno te taw kidim kik tu hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tu in minam sungah a om laite atu in hi thu sia suak thei ngawl tu bang hikale kei atu in suak maw ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka mite a kilaakna ngamte pan ka suatak tu a,"},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem ah a teang tu in nisuana le nitumna panin amate ka paipui kik tu hi. Tuaciang amate ka mi hi tu a, keima in amate thumaan le thutang taw a uk a Pathian ka hi tu hi."},"9":{"text":"“Hangsan vun! Ka Biakinnpi sa kik tu in, a tawdap a kipha lai hunin kamsaangte pau kammal teng ma, tu in na za uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua hun masia in kuama in mihing ahizong nganhing ahizong tha cial zo ngawl a, a ngalte kung pan kuama ngammuang ngawl hi. Mihingte khat le khat ka kilangpansak hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang tu in, hi minam sung pan a nungta laite sia a tuamin ka vawt hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate in thinnuam takin lo ante ciing tu hi. A sapitkungte hong nga tu a, leitang in ante piangsak in, ngua tam mama hong zu tu hi. Hi thuphate theampo ka minam sung pan a nungta lai ka mite tungah ka pia tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Judah le Israel mite awng! Hun bosa sungah ngamdangmite khat le khat, a kihaamsiat uh ciangin ‘Judah le Israel mite tungah a tung tuasiatnate ma no tungah hong tung tahen’ kici uh hi. Ahihang note kong hun tu a, tuaciang tua ngamdangmite khat le khat in, ‘Judah le Israel te tungah a theng thuphate ma nga tavun!’ kici tu uh hi. Tua ahikom hangsan vun a, lau heak vun.”"},"14":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, “Na taanghpupite ii hong thin uuksak ciang, amate tuasiatsak tu ka sawm a, ka thin kheal kik ngawlin ka ngeal bangin ka seam suak hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang tu in Jerusalem le Judah mite thupha piak ka sawm hi. Tua ahikom lau heak vun."},"16":{"text":"Na sep tu uh sia hi teng hi: Khat le khat tungah thumaan thutak kison vun. Thukhenzum ah thutang khenna tatak — kilemna a piangsak thukhenna namte pia vun.","ref":"Eph 4:25"},"17":{"text":"Khat le khat kinatsak tu tum heak vun. Kiciamna taw leilot tetti pang heak vun. Leilotna, thukhaikim ngawl thukhenna le ngongtatna ka ngaimaw hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in Zechariah tungah hi thu pia hi:"},"19":{"text":"“A tha li tha, a tha nga tha, a tha sali tha le a tha sawm tha te sungah antan nate sia Judah mite atu in lungdam thinnop poai hong suak tu hi. Thumaan thutak le kilemna dei hamtang vun.”"},"20":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, “Khuapi tam mamate pan mite Jerusalem ah a pai tu hun hong theng tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Khuapi khat pan hong pai mite in khuapi dang pan hong pai mite tungah ‘Ko Vaanglianbelpa Topa bia tu le ama thupha nga natu thungen tu in pai tu khu hi. Ko taw hong paikhawm tavun!’ kici tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Mihing tam mama le minam a hat mamate sia Vaanglianbelpa Topa bia tu le ama thupha nga natu thungen tu in Jerusalem ah pai tu uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua hun ciang, ngamdangmi sawm in Judah mi khat kungah hong pai tu a, ‘Note taw Pathian om hi ci in za ka hi uh ciang note taw a sia a pha kumkhawm nuam khu hi, ci tu uh hi,’ ” ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thu in Topa ii thupuak ahi hi: Ama in Hadrach ngam le Damascus khuapi tungah daan piakna thutan zo hi. Israel namte bek hi ngawlin Syria khuapi zongh Topa neisa hi.","title":"Ngampaamte tungah Thukhenna","ref":"Is 17:1-3; Jer 49:23-27; Amo 1:3-5"},"2":{"text":"Hadrach taw a kingamngi Hamath zongh ama ii neisa ahi bangma, Tyre le Sidon khuapite le a khut thiamna te theampo zongh ama ii neisa hi."},"3":{"text":"Tyre in ama atu in khuapi kulhpite vawt a, ngunn le khamhte a kholsa tam leilam ahiciangin leivui bang bek hi lel hi!"},"4":{"text":"Ahihang a neisa theampo Topa in laak keaksak tu hi. Topa in a nei a lamh teng tuipi sungah vawksak tu a, tua khuapi kihaltum tu hi.","ref":"Is 23:1-18; Eze 26:1—28:26; Jol 3:4-8; Amo 1:9-10; Mt 11:21-22; Lk 10:13-14"},"5":{"text":"Ashkelon khuapi in hi teng mu in lau tu hi. Gaza khuapi in tuasia mu in na sa mama tu hi. Ekron zongh tuabang ma hi tu a, a lametnate bo tu hi. Gaza in a kumpi taan tu a, Ashkelon sia kitaisan in kinusia tu hi.","ref":"Is 14:29-31; Jer 47:1-7; Eze 25:15-17; Jol 3:4-8"},"6":{"text":"Minam kihel mite in Ashdod ah teang tu uh hi. Topa in, “Tua a kiphasak Philistine te theampo ka niamsak tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in chi baanglai sate ahibuale a kikhaam an dangte ne nawn ngawl tu uh hi. A nungta laite theampo ka mite ii khen khat suak tu a, Judah nam sungah bee le phung khat in om tu hi. Ekron sia Jebus te bangma in ka mite suak tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka ngam ka cing tu a, ngalkaphonpite in ka kaantansak buatu hi. Kumpi ngilote in ka mite ka zothawsak nawn buatu hi. Ka mite thuakna sa teng mu zo khi hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Lungdam vun, lungdam vun, Zion mite awng! No Jerusalem mite awng, lungdam in au vun! En vun, na kumpipa no kungah hong pai hi! Ama in ngalzawna mualsua in lungdamna taw hong pai hi, Ahihang kiniamkhiak in laa khat — Laano, laatal no khat tungah to hi.","title":"Hong piang tu Kumpipa","ref":"Mt 21:5; Jn 12:15; 9:10; Ps 72:8"},"10":{"text":"Topa in, “Ngal siphu leangte Israel pan ka heam tu a, Jerusalem pan siphute ka la tu hi; Ngal kisimna sung a kizangh thalte ka lalsak tu hi. Na kumpipa in minam tuatuamte sungah kilemna omsak tu hi; ama in tuipi khat pan tuipi khat dong, Euphrates ngun pan leitung mong dong uk tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in, “Sangaw biakpiakna chisan taw a kikipsak ka thuciamna hangin na saltanna mun, tui om ngawlna dum sung pan note kong suaktasak tu hi.","title":"Pathian Mite Kipuuaphat Kikna","ref":"Pu 24:8"},"12":{"text":"Tu in lametna a nei no, saltaangte awng, heak kik vun; na ngam muanna munah heak kik tavun. Na thuakna sa theampo hangin a zaa nii in thupha kong piak kik natu thu, tu in note tungah kong son hi."},"13":{"text":"Keima in Judah sia ngalkap khat ii thal bangin, Israel sia thaltangte bangin ka zangh tu hi. Greece mite do tu in Zion pasalte sia namsau khat bangin ka zangh tu hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Topa in a mite tungah hong kilangh tu hi; ama in a thaltangte khualeng bangin kap tu hi. Vaanglianpipa Topa in a lemle tum tu a; thangsang pan vuipi suangval bangin hong kuan tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in a mite sungsia tu hi, tuaciang amate in a ngalte susia tu uh hi. Amate sia ngal kisimna sungah zukhamte bangin au in, a ngalte chisan luangsak tu uh hi; tua chisan sia biaknatau tungah beal sung pan a kisung sangaw biakpiakna khat ii chi bangin luang tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin, tuucingpa in a tuute launa pan a huuk bangin, Topa in a mite hun tu hi. Amate in ama ngam sungah kumpilukhu tungah a suang manphate bangin taang tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ngam sia bangza in pha a et hoi tu ziam! Khangnote in tua ngam pan a piang thaw an le sapittui neakna taw a thahat tu uh hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khaal kipat hunin Topa tungah nguatui ngen vun. Ngua a paai meeikaai hong puak a, ngua zusak in, kuama theampo atu lote a hingsak pa sia Topa ahi hi.","title":"in Hutkhiat natu Kamciam"},"2":{"text":"Mite in milimte le aisaan theite thu dongh ahihang a zo kiknate sia leilot thu le luithawthong thu veu hi. Pawl khat in mangkhia a, ahihang tuate in nang hong lampialsak bek hi; amate hong piak thinnopna in man nei ngawl hi. Tua ahikom tuu bote bangin tua mite vakthap uh hi. Amate in lampui nei ngawl ahikom ngim nga uh hi.","ref":"Mt 9:36; Mk 6:34; 10:9-10"},"3":{"text":"Topa in, “Ka mite a uk ngamdangmite tungah ka thin uuk a, daan ka pia tu hi. Judah mite sia keima aa hi, tuaciang keima Vaanglianbelpa Topa in amate ka keam tu hi. Amate sia a thahat ka ngal siphute hong hi tu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate sung panin ka mite a uk tu ngamukte, lampuite le ngalkap maangte hong piang tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Judah mite in a ngalte lampi buan sungah a siikcil ngalkapte bangin ngalzo tu uh hi. Topa in amate panpui ahiciang amate in ngalsim tu uh hi, amate in a ngalte siphu ngalkapte ngawngawn zo tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"“Keima in Judah mite ka hatsak tu hi; Israel mite ka suatak tu hi. Keima in amate khuangaihuai ka sa tu a, a vekpi in inn ah ka ciapui kik tu hi. Amate sia ka nial ngeingawl mite bang hi tu hi. Keima in Topa, a Pathian ka hi hi; A thungetnate ka zo tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngalkapte bangin Israel mite thahat tu uh hi. Sapittui ne te bangin lungdam tu uh hi. Topa nasepna hangin a suan a paalte in hi zawna phawk in, lungdam tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Ka mite ka sam tu a, ka kaikhawm tu hi. Amate ka suatak tu a, a ngei bangin ka tamsak mama tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Minam tuatuamte sungah amate thethaang hi kaleng, a khualana pan ngawngawn in kei hong phawk tu uh hi. Amate le a tate nungta lai tu a, inn ah cia khawm tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Egypt le Assyria panin amate inn ah ka ciapui tu a, amate ii mun le ngam ah ka teangsak tu hi. Amate Gilead le Lebanon zongh ah ka teangsak tu hi; ngam bup sia mihing taw kidim tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in ngimna tuipi a kaan uh ciang, keima Topa in tuihualte ka saat tu a, Nile ngun thuk nate ko tu hi. A kiphasak Assyria kiniamsuksak tu a, a thahat Egypt in a thahatna taan tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Keima in ka mite ka hatsak tu hi; amate in kei hong bia tu a, ka thu hong mang tu hi,” ci hi. Topa in ci zo hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lebanon awng, mei in na cedar thingkungte a kaktum thei natu in na kongkhate hong in.","title":"Kumpi Ngilote Taakna"},"2":{"text":"Cypress thingkungte awng, kapin tau vun — cedar thingte puk zo hi; tua thingkung minthangte kisusia zo hi! Bashan oak thingkungte awng, kapin tau vun — taamthing zingte kiphuk zo hi!"},"3":{"text":"Ngam ukte khuangai in kap hi; amate minthanna bo zo hi! Tawpite hawk ngai vun: Jordan ngundung, amate ii teenna duithuk sia kisusia zo hi!"},"4":{"text":"Topa ka Pathian in kei tungah, “Ngaw tu a kikoi tuu honte a cingpa bang hi in.","title":"Tuucing Niite"},"5":{"text":"Tua tuute sia a tote in that a, a thatte daan kipia ngawl hi. Amate in a sa zuakin, ‘ Topa pok vun! Ei hau zo hing!’ ci hi. A tuucingte ngawngawn in hesuakna nei ngawl uh hi,” hong ci hi."},"6":{"text":"(Topa in, “Leitung ah kuama hesuak nawn ngawl tu khi hi. Keima mama in a ukte khut sungah mi theampo ka koi tu hi. Hi ngamukte in leitung siacipsak tu a, amate thahatna panin tua leitung ka suatak buatu hi,” ci hi.)"},"7":{"text":"Tuu a lei, a zuakte in kei hong cial a, kei sia a kingo tu tuute a cingpa ka suak hi. Ciangkang nii ka la a: khat sia “Maipha piakna” ka ci a, a dang khat sia ‘Kilomkhatna’ ka ci hi. Tuaciang tuuhonte ka cing hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei hong ensan tuucing dang thumte tungah ka thin a sau zo bua hi, amate teng sia tha khat sungin ka tawpsak hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua zawkciang tuuhonte tungah, “No ii tuucing pa hi nawn ngawl tu khi hi. A thi tu teng thi vun a, a kisusia tu teng kisusia hen. A taanglai teng in amate khat le khat kisucip ta uh hen,” ka ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ‘Maipha piakna’ a kici ciangkang la in, Topa ii minam theampo taw a vawt thuciamna phiat na tu in tuasia ka thiaktan hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom tua thuciamna sia, tua ni in kiphiat hi, tuu a zuak le a leite in kei hong en nginge a, ka sep ka vawtte tungtawnin Topa in thuson ahi hunlam he uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate tungah, “Na uuk uh le ka thaman hong pia tavun. Na uuk bua uh le noma tang vun,” ka ci hi. Tua ahikom amate in ka thaman tu in ngunntang sawmthum hong pia hi.","ref":"Mt 26:15; Mt 27:9-10"},"13":{"text":"Topa in, keima tungah “Tua sumte biakinn sumkholna ah koi ta'n hong ci hi. Tua ahikom ngunntang 30 — kei taw kiphu a sak a tam mama sum — tua teng la in biakinn sumkholna ah ka koi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ‘Kilomkhatna’ a kici ciangkang niina sia ka thiaktan a, Judah le Israel kilomkhatna kitamhtham hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa in keima tungah, “Khatvei ma tuucingpa heang leleau in a, tutung sia a mannung ngawl tuucingpa in, kiheang in."},"16":{"text":"Ka tuuhonte uk tu in tuucing khat ka koi hi, ahihang ama in lalna a thuak tu tuute le huu ngawl a; a bote le zong ngawl, a liamte le bawl ngawl, a ciidamte zongh anvaak ngawl hi. Tuabang a sep tu luangin ama in tuu a thaubelte ii sa ne in a peangcinte khok keak hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua a mannung ngawl tuucingpa a lal hi zo hi! Ama in a tuuhonte nusia zo hi. Ama thahatna sia ngalte in lalcipsak tu hi. A baan ngawtaak tu a, a mit ziatsang taw tu hi,” hong ci hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thupuak in Israel taw kisai vante a phalh, lei a bitphua, mihing nuntakna a pia Topa tung pan ahi hi. Ama in,","title":"Mai sangah Jerusalem Kihut natu"},"2":{"text":"“Jerusalem sia sapittui hai khat bangin ka vawt tu hi; a kiimkot a minam tuatuamte in ne tu a, zu kham bangin hoi vatut tu uh hi. Amate in Jerusalem a uumci uh ciangin, Judah khuapi dangte zongh ki uumci tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang tua hun hong thet ciang, Jerusalem sia a ngit suangtum pui khat bangin ka vawt tu a — tuasia laamto tu a kipan minam pawpo liam tu hi. Leitung minam theampo kipawlin ama sim tu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hun ciang a siphute theampo ka lausak tu a, a tung to teng ka mawmawsak tu hi. Judah mite ka encik tu hi, ahihang a ngalte ii siphute a mit ka tawsak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Judah bee le phungte in amate le amate tungah, ‘Vaanglianbelpa Topa in Jerusalem ah a teang a mite thahatna pia hi’ kici tu hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tua hun ciang Judah bee le phungte duisung ahibuale, thaw an min lak pha lo sung a meikaang bangin ka vawt tu hi — amate in a kiimkot minamte theampo susia tu uh hi. Jerusalem mite ahile khuapi sungah ngammuangin om tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"“Keima, Topa in Judah ngalkaphonpite zawna ka pia masa tu hi, tua hile David suan le paalte le Jerusalem mite ii a nga tu patoaina sia a taanglai Judah mite nga tu patoaina sangin lian zaw ngawl tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hun ciang Topa in Jerusalem a teangte dal tu a, amate sungah a thazawm belte ngawngawn David bangin hat tu uh hi. David suan le paalte in Topa ii vantunglalang bang ahizong Pathian mama bang ahizong amate lampui tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua hun ciang Jerusalem sim tu a kipan minam theampo ka susia tu hi."},"10":{"text":"“Keima in David suan le paalte le Jerusalem a teang a dangte sia hesuakna thin le thungetna thin taw ka dimh tu hi. Amate in nam taw a tuplup pa en tu uh a, ta khat bek a nei a thisuate khuangai bangin khuangai tu uh hi. Amate in a tapaciil a khuaite bangin nasia tak khuangai tu uh hi.","ref":"Jn 19:37; Tpl 1:7"},"11":{"text":"Tua laitakin Jerusalem ah heena kaana sia Megiddo zaangtam a Hadad-rimmon atu heena le kaana za in nasia tu hi.","ref":"Mt 24:20; Tpl 1:7"},"12":{"text":"Ngamsung innkuan simin khuangai in om tek tu hi: David suante innkuan, Nathan suante innkuan, Levi suante innkuan, Shimei suante innkuan, a dang innkuante hi siat tu hi. Ngamsung innkuan simin khuangai tek in a om ciang, pate ahile numeite taw kihel ngawlin a tuamin khuangai tu uh hi.","merge":"13"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in “Tua hun hong thet ciang, David suan le paalte le Jerusalem mite mawna le milim biakna pan thiansua natu in tuinaak khat hong phuul tu hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua hun ciang ngamsung pan milimte min theampo ka phiat tu a, kuama in ciamtee nawn ngawl tu hi. Kamsaang ka hi a ci khat pawpo le, milim biak tu a lungngulna ka heam tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang khat po in kamsaanna a zom nuam hamtang lai le, a pa le a nu in nang hong kithatlum nanak tu hi, ci tu hi, ama in Topa ii kammalte ka pau ci napi, leilot thu a son hang ahi hi. Ama ii kam a san ciang, a pa le a nu in nam taw hollum tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hun hong thet ciang kamsaang kuama in a mukholna hu in kiphasak ngawl tu a, kamsaang khat bangin ngamta ngawlin, kamsaangte puan hampuite ngualtheam natu in silh ngawl tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua taangin ama in, ‘Kei kamsaang hi bong. Kei lothopa khi hi — ka khan tawntung lo ka tho hi’ ci zaw tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuasia ciang khat po in, ‘Na awm a liammate bang ziam?’ ci in a dongh le ‘Lawmte khat ii inn pan ka nga hi’ ci in zo tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, “Namsau awng, khanglo in kei atu a seam tuucingpa sim ta'n! Ama thatlum in, tuaciang tuute kithethaang tu hi. Ka mite ka sim tu a,","title":"Pathian Tuucingpa Thalup natu Thupiakna","ref":"Mt 26:31; Mk 14:27"},"8":{"text":"tuaciang, ngam bup sungah mihingte see thum sua see nii thi tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"A nungta lai khen thum sua khen khat teng ka sit tu a, meikuang taw ngunnte a kithiansak bangin amate ka thiangsak tu hi. Khamh a kisit bangin amate ka sit tu hi. Tuaciang amate in thungen tu a, keima in ka zo tu hi. Amate tungah ka mite ahi hunlam ka son tu a, amate in keima Pathian ka hi hunlam pualaak tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Topa sia thukhenin a to tu ni nai zo hi. Tuaciang Jerusalem kiphuul tu a, na mu tangin a vanh laakte kihawm tu hi.","title":"Jerusalem le Minam Tuatuamte"},"2":{"text":"Topa in Jerusalem sim tu in minam theampo khawmtua tu hi. Khuapi kila in, innte kiphuul tu a, numeite buan in khialpui tu hi. Khua mite a lang sia sal in kipaipui tu a, a taanglai teng ahile khuapi pan kipaipui ngawl tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, nidang lai in a sim ngei bangma in Topa kuanin tua minamte sim tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hun ciang Jerusalem nisuana sang Olive mual tungah ama ding tu hi. Tuaciang Olive Mual sia nisuana sang pan nitumna sangah phel nii in kikhen a kuam lian khat om tu hi. Mual a lang sia saksangah kikhiin tu a, a lang sia thang sangah kikhiin tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Mual khen nii in a khen, tua kuam kaantanin no na suakta tu uh hi. Judah kumpipa Uzziah hunsung zinliin lai in, na taanghpupite tai bangin na tai tu uh hi. Topa ka Pathian in vantunglalang theampo hong pai pui tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua hun hong thet ciang, khuasik, ahibuale thuamluak"},"7":{"text":"le khuazing cite om nawn ngawl tu hi. Zan ngawngawn in khuavak top tu hi. Topa bekin hisia a pian tu hun he hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ni hong thet ciang, Jerusalem pan tui thiang hong luang tu a, a lang sia Tuipi Thi ah, a lang sia Mediterranean tuipi ah luang tu hi. Tua tui sia tuk taw khaal taw kum tawntungin, luang tu hi.","ref":"Eze 47:1; Jn 7:38; Tpl 22:1"},"9":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Topa sia leitung theampo ii kumpipa in hong mang tu a; ama ii Pathian sia a kuama po in bia tu a, tua min taw ma in ama he tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Saksang Geba panin thangsang Rimmon dong ngamkuam buppi leitam kisua tu hi. Jerusalem sia kiim le paamte sangin saangzaw tu hi; khuapi in Benjamin kongpi pan nidang kongpi omna ngei Kiing Kongpi dong, tuaciang Hananel Tausaang pan kumpite sapittui suuknate dongin kithung tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihingte tua munah ngam muangin teang tu a, siatna in a lauthawn nawn buatu uh hi.","ref":"Tpl 22:3"},"12":{"text":"Topa in Jerusalem a sim minamte theampo tungah a kiitak huai mama natna tungsak tu hi. Amate nungta nginge lai in a sa uh muat tu hi; a mitte le a leeite muatcip tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua hun ciang Topa in amate lungmangsak biaibuai in lausak tu a, a kuama po in a kungah a om khat pawpo zamhin ngal vawt tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Judah mite in Jerusalem a huu tu in ngaldo tu uh hi. Amate in minam theampo ii nei le lamh — khamh, ngunn le puan tam mamate laaksak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"A kiitak huai mama natna khat sia ngalte ngiaphual a om nganhingte theampo — siphute, laate, kalaohte, laano namte tung zongh ah tung tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jerusalem khua a sim minamte sung pan a nungta laite theampo sia Vaanglianbelpa Topa bia tu le Buk Poai khaam tu in kum simin Jerusalem ah pai tu uh hi.","ref":"Thiam 23:39-43"},"17":{"text":"Minam khat pawpo in Vaanglianbelpa Topa sia kumpi bangin biak tu a nial le amate ngam ah nguazu ngawl tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Egypt te in tua Buk Poai khaam tu a nial le, tua poai khaam tu a nial pawpo tung ah Topa ii puak tua natna sia ma taw daan thuak tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua Buk Poai a khaam nuam ngawl Egypt te le minam dangte tungah hi natna daan tung tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin siphu ngawlokte tung ngawngawn ah “ Topa atu Kitavaw” ci kammalte ki at lai tu hi. Biakinn sung a an huanna bealte zongh biaknatau mai a kuangte bangma in thiangtho tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Jerusalem le Judah ngam bup sung a an huanna beal theampo sia Vaanglianbelpa Topa biakna a zak tu in kituam koi tu hi. Sangaw biakpiakna a pia mite in tua bealte biakpiakna sate huanna in zangh tu hi. Tua hun hong thet ciang Vaanglianbelpa Topa Biakinnpi sungah sumvawtte khat zong om nawn ngawl tu hi."}}}}},"39":{"info":{"name":"Malachi","shortname":"Mal","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia in Malachi ii Israel mite tungah a son tu Topa ii a piak thupuak ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Topa in a mite tungah, “No kong it tawntung hi,” ci hi. Ahihang amate in, “Bangbangin nong itna hong lak kana ni ziam?” ci in zo kik hi. Topa in, “Esau le Jacob te sia unau laipee ahihang Jacob le a suan a paalte ka it a,","title":"ii Israel te A itna","ref":"Rom 9:13; Is 34:5-17; 63:1-6; Jer 49:7-22; Eze 25:12-14; 35:1-15; Amo 1:11-12; Oba 1-14"},"3":{"text":"tuaciang Esau le a suan a paalte ka ngaimaw hi. Esau ii mualtung ngam ka susia a, a leitang sia ngiate atu in ka nusiat hi,” ci in zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Esau suan le paal Edom te in, “Ka khuate hong suksiatsak hi, ahihang tua khuate ka sa kik tu uh hi,” a ci ciang Topa in, “Khua sa kik ma hen — ka nuaitham kik tu hi. Mipite in tuate tungah, ‘Siatna ngam’ le ‘Topa ii a tawntung a thin uukna ngam’ a ci tu hi,” ci in zo kik tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel mite in hite a mittang uh taw mu tu a, tuaciang amate in, “Israel ngam puasia ngawngawn ah Topa thahat hi,” ci tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in thiampite tungah, “Tapa khat in a pa thasia a, innteang khat in a topa zakta hi. Keima sia na pa ka hi a — banghangin hong patoai ngawl nu ziam? Keima sia na topa khi hi — banghang hong zakta ngawl nu ziam? Note in kei hong zawngsak napi, ‘Bangbangin hong zawngsak khu ziam?’ na ci lai uh hi.","title":"in Thiampite Teih"},"7":{"text":"Bangbang ziam cile hi bang hi — ka biaknatau tungah a man nei ngawl ante nong pia uh hi. Tua zawkciang note in, “Bangbangin hong zakta ngawl khu ziam, ci in nong dongh uh hi. Hong son tong — ka biaknatau na zawnsak vawtna, na thusim ngawlna taw nong zatak ngawlna uh kilangh hi."},"8":{"text":"A mittaw, a ciina, ahibuale a peangbai nganno taw sangaw biakpiakna nong nei uh ciang, tuabangte phamaw sa ngawl na hi uh ziam? Ngamukmangpa tungah tuabang ngannote pia ka sin vun. Note tungah ama lungkimin maipha hong pia tu ziam?” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 15:21"},"9":{"text":"Tu in no thiampite awng, ei tungah Pathian hong dik natu in hong ngen ka sin vun. Ama in na thungetna hong zo ngawl tu a, tua in noma mawna hi tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, “Ka biaknatau tungah a kimang ngawl meite na hal ngawl natu in note khat in biakinn kongkhate khak le uh teh kong oai hi. No tungah ka lungkim ngawl a; kei kung nong paipui biakpiaknate kong saang buatu hi."},"11":{"text":"Leimong khat pan mong khat ah a om mihingte in kei hong patoai uh hi. Amate in mun theampo ah ngimnamtui hong hal a, tuaciang a saan thamman sangaw biakpiaknate hong pia hi. Amate theampo in kei hong patoai uh hi!"},"12":{"text":"Ahizong note in keima biaknatau sia bangma man nei ngawlin na son uh ciang le tua biaknatau tungah na nialnamh ante na piak uh ciangin, keima hong simmaw na hi uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Noma in, ‘Hite bangza in cimtak huai ziam!’ ci in nong mukmen uh hi. Nong biakpiak natu in a kingu nganno ahibuale a peangbai, a nanghno khat nong paipui uh hi. Note tung pan tuabangte hong saang tu in hong um nu ziam?"},"14":{"text":"A nganhon sung pan keima piak tu in hong kamciam a limci khat nei napi, a man nei ngawl nganno khat taw sangaw biakpiakna nei tu in hong theampa in haamsiatna thuak tahen! Banghang ziam cile keima kumpi lian khat ka hi a, ngam theampo pan mihingte in kei hong kiita uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in thiampite tungah, “Hi thupiakna sia note atu hi:"},"2":{"text":"Na sep, na vawtna taw keima nong patoai uh kul tu hi. Kong ci bangin nong ngai bua uh le no tungah haamsiatna kong tungsak tu hi. Na kivaak natu a, na saan uh vanhte tungah haamsiatna ka tungsak tu hi. A tatakin ci leang, tuate tungah, haamsiatna tungsak zo khi hi, banghang ziam cile kong thupiakte no in na thupi sim bua uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Na tate daan ka pia tu a, na sangaw biakpiakna nganhingte ii eak sungah na mai kong taat tu hi — tuaciang note eak kholna munah hong kipaipui tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Levi suan le paal thiampite taw ka thuciamna a peal ngawl natu in hi thupiakna kong piak hunlam na he tu uh hi.","ref":"Mi 3:11-13"},"5":{"text":"“Amate ii hong thasia thei natu in ka thuciamna sungah ka kamciamsa nuntakna le nopsakna ka pia hi. Tua hunlai in amate in kei hong zakta a hong kiita uh hi.","ref":"Mi 25:12"},"6":{"text":"Amate in a maante hil a, a maan ngawlte hil ngawl hi. Amate in kei taw hi vadiamin nungta uh a; amate mama in a maan teng a sep dom ngawlin midang tam mamate zongh siatna a vawt ngawl natu in hu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Pathian a maan bang a heak takpi natu in hilna sia thiampite vaipuak ahi hi. Mite in amate kungah pai in ka deina a sin kul hi, banghang ziam cile amate sia Vaanglianbelpa Topa ii kamtaite ahi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"“Ahihang tu in no thiampite in lampi maan panin na pial zo uh hi. Na hilna in mihing tam mama khialsak hi. No taw ka vawt thuciam sia paltan zo nu hi."},"9":{"text":"Note in ka deina nong ni bua uh a, ka mite na hil uh ciang zong, khat le khat doidan na hi uh ciang, Israel mite in note kong simmawsak kik tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Eite theampo in a kibang pa nei kana ngawl hi ziam? A kibang Pathian in eite theampo hong bitphua kana ngawl ziam? Tua ahile eite khat le khat, ih kamciamte banghangin paltan a, ih taanghpupite taw Pathian ii a vawt thuciam sia banghangin zawnsak vawt tu hi ziam?","title":"Mihingte ii Pathian tungah A Thumaan ngawlna"},"11":{"text":"Judah mite in Pathian tungah a kamciamte paltan a Jerusalem le ngamsung bup ah a thasiathuai mama khat vawt uh hi. Amate in Pathian ii a it Biakinnpi sia ninsak uh hi. Pate in ngamdang pathiante a bia numeite teenpui zo hi."},"12":{"text":"A kuama po hi bangin a ngamtate sia Topa in Israel taangpite sung pan heam tahen a, Vaanglianbelpa Topa tungah ih minamte ii a paipui biakpiakna sungah kihel kiksak nawn heak hen."},"13":{"text":"Na ngamtatna dang khat sia hi bang hi. Ama tungah na biakpiaknate hong saang nawn ngawl ahikom kap a tau in, Topa biaknatau sia na thitui taw na khuumsak uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Banghangin hong kisaang nawn ngawl ziam ci in na dongh uh hi. Tua thu in na khanmoi lai a na teenpui na zi tungah na kamciamna paltan zo na hi sia a heak hu ahi hi. Na zi sia na koppui hi a, ama tungah a thumaan pasal ka hi tu hi ci in Pathian mai ah kamciam pia napi na paltan zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Pathian in ama le nang pumkhat thinkhat tu in hong vawt hi kana ngawl ziam? Hi thu ah ama ii tupna bang ziam? Pathian mite tatak ahi tu in tate na nei natu ahi hi. Tua ahikom note kuama in a zi tungah a piak kamciam paltan peuma heak hen."},"16":{"text":"Israel ii Topa Pathian in, “Nupa kikhulna ngaimaw khi hi. Note khat po in a zi tungah tuabang a ngitlo ciang ngaimaw khi hi. Na zi tungah na thumaan tu a, na kamciam na paltan ngawl natu in kidawm in,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Na kampauna uh taw Topa toisak nu hi. Ahihang, “Ama bangbangin toisak khu ziam?” ci in dongh nu hi. “Vaanglianbelpa Topa in ngamtat siate theampo phasa hi; tuabangte diksa takpi hi,” ci nu hi. Tua ahibuale, “Thutangin ih heen Pathian sia koisungah om hi tu ziam?” ci in dongh nu hi.","title":"Thukhenna Ni hong Nai hi"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, “Ka lampi a sialkhol tu in ka kamtaipa ka paisak tu hi. Tua zawkciang na zon uh Topa zongh ama Biakinnpi sungah thakhat thu in hong pai tu hi. Mu tu kaal na ngalaak uh kamtaipa hong pai in, ka thuciamna thangsak tu hi,” ci in zo hi.","ref":"Mt 11:10; Mk 1:2; Lk 1:76; 7:27"},"2":{"text":"Ahihang ama ii hong pai ni ciang, akua peuma in thuak zo tu hi ziam? Ama hong kilangh ciang akua nungta zo tu ziam? Ama in a pha satpia le thik a thiangsak meikuang taw kibang hi.","ref":"Jol 2:11; Tpl 6:17"},"3":{"text":"Ama in ngunn a thiangsak pa khat bangin thukhen tu in hong pai tu hi. Thik seakpa in khamh le ngunn a thiansak bangin a maan biakpiakna te Topa kungah hong paipui natu in, Topa kamtaipa in thiampite thiansua tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Judah le Jerusalem mite ii paipui biakpiaknate in nidang hun bangma in Topa lungkimsak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, “Note thukhen tu in no kungah kong kilangh tu a, bum le ai toaite, palngul mawna vawtte, leilot tetti pangte, a naseamte ii thaman a demte, meingong tanga le ngamdangmite tung pan meet natu a zongte — kei hong zakta ngawlte theampo ii langkhat ah tetti ka pang tu hi.”"},"6":{"text":"“Keima in Topa ka hi a, ka kikheal bua hi. Tuaciang no, Jacob suan le paalte zongh na mong siat bualai uh hi.","title":"Sawm a khat Piakna"},"7":{"text":"Note, na taanghpupi masate bangin ka thukhamte pan na puapial uh a, na zui bua uh hi. Kei kungah hong heak kik tavun, tua hile kei zongh no sang kong nga tu hi. Ahizong ‘Nang kung kong zot kik natu in bang ka sep uh kul tu ziam?’ ci in nong dongh uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Thu khat hong dongh tong, mihing khat in Pathian a theam tu kilawm ziam? Kilawm mama ngawl hi, tua hi napi note in kei nong theam uh hi. ‘Bangbangin maw?’ ci nu hi. Sumpi sawm a khat le biakpiaknate sungah hong theam nu hi."},"9":{"text":"No theampo tungah haamsiatna khat hong tung hi, banghang ziam cile minam buppi in kei nong theam uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Biakinnpi sungah an tam mama a om thei natu in sawm a khat a cingin hong paipui tavun. Kei hong sin tavun, vantung khelkite ka hong tu a, na pha namcinte kicing takin no tungah kong buaksuk na mu tu uh hi.","ref":"Thiam 27:30; Mi 18:21-24; Thkna 12:6; 14:22-29; Neh 13:12"},"11":{"text":"Lungnote in na lo ante a lalsak buatu a, na sapitkungte sapitnga taw kidimsak tu khi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaciang, na ngam na lei uh sia a teen nophuai mun le ngam pha suak tu ahikom minamte theampo in mi lungdamte hong ci tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa in, “Kei taw kisai in a lauhuai thute son nu hi. Ahizong note in, ‘Nang taw kisai bang teng son na khu ziam?’ ci nu hi.","title":"Pathian ii Hesuakna Kamciam"},"14":{"text":"Note in, ‘Pathian na ih sep sia a luithawthong hi. Ama ci bangin ih sep hangin bang kimanna om a, ih sepna sate huvau Vaanglianbelpa Topa mai ah khuangaina ih lak nop hangin bang phat tuamna om ziam?"},"15":{"text":"Ih mu bangma mihing kiphasak teng ma in a lungdam hi. Mi siate sia nuamsa bek ngawlin a ngamtat siatnate taw Pathian thin sauna ze et napi, bangma tat tuan ngawl hi,’ ” na ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Topa a kiitate khat le khat kipaupui hi, tuaciang Topa in amate son teng ngai in za hi. Ama mai ma ah Topa a kiitate le a zaktate tepteena sia laibu khat sungah ki at hi."},"17":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, “Amate ka mite hi tu hi. Ka dian ni tak ciang amate mama keima neisa hi tu hi. A pa atu a seam tapa tungah pa khat in hesuakna a nei bangin amate hesuak tu khi hi."},"18":{"text":"Kei atu a seamte le a seam ngawlte, tuaciang thutangte le a seksolte tungah a piang thute ii kilamdanna sia ka mite in khatvei mu kik tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vaanglianbelpa Topa in, “A kiphasakte theampo le misiate theampo taangphaw bangin a kak tu ni hong theng tu hi. Tua ni in amate kaanghtum tu a, amate taw kisai bangma a taang nawn buatu hi.","title":"Ni Hong theng tu"},"2":{"text":"Ahihang kei thu hong ni note tungah kong ngupna vaangletna sia ni bangin hong suak tu a, nizangte bangin damna hong puak tu hi. Ngankhawk khat sung pan a kitha khuinote bangin suakta in lungdam tu nu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka dian ni ciang, mi seksolte na zothal tu uh a, amate sia na peang nuai a leivuite bang hi tu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“Israel mite theampo zui tu in, Sinai Mual tungah ka naseampa Moses ka piak thukhamte le thupiaknate, tuaciang hilciannate ciamtee tavun."},"5":{"text":"“Ahihang a lauhuai le a lian Topa ni hong thet ma in kamsaangpa Elijah kong paisak tu hi.","ref":"Mt 11:14; 17:10-13; Mk 9:11-13; Lk 1:17; Jn 1:21"},"6":{"text":"Ama in pate le tate hong ngawmtua kik tu hi; tuabang ahibuale keima kong pai tu a, na ngam ka suksiat kul tu hi,” ci hi."}}}}},"40":{"info":{"name":"Matthew","shortname":"Matt","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham ii suan, David ii tu le ta ahi, Jesus Christ ii taanghpupite ii min tepteena lai sia hi bang hi a, Abraham pan David kumpipa dong, a taanghpupite ii minte a nuai a bang ahi hi.","title":"Jesus Christ ii Taanghpupite (Luke 3:23-38)"},"2":{"text":"Abraham ta Isaac, Isaac ta Jacob, Jacob ta Judah le a suapuite ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Judah in a zi Tamar taw Perez le Zerah hing a, Perez ta Hezron, Hezron ta Ram,"},"4":{"text":"Ram ta Amminadab, Amminadab ta Nahshon, Nahshon ta Salmon,"},"5":{"text":"Salmon ta Boaz hi. Boaz ii nu sia Rahab ahi hi. Boaz in a zi Ruth taw Obed hing a Obed ta Jesse hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesse ta sia David Kumpipa ahi hi. David pan Babylon khua ah Israel mite salin a kimat hun dong, a nuai a bangin taanghpupite khang kiciamtee hi. David in Uriah zi taw Solomon hing a,"},"7":{"text":"Solomon ta Rehoboam, Rehoboam ta Abijah, Abijah ta Asa,"},"8":{"text":"Asa ta Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat ta Jehoram, Jehoram ta Uzziah"},"9":{"text":"Uzziah ta Jotham, Jotham ta Ahaz, Ahaz ta Hezekiah,"},"10":{"text":"Hezekiah ta Manasseh, Manasseh ta Amon,"},"11":{"text":"Amon ta Josiah, Josiah ta Jehoiachin le a suapuite ahi uh hi.","ref":"2 Kum 24:14-15; 2 Khang 36:10; Jer 27:20"},"12":{"text":"Babylon ah salin a kiciapui pan kipan Jesus khang dong a nuai a bangin taanghpupite khang kiciamtee hi. Jehoiachin ta Shealtiel, Shealtiel ta Zerubbabel,"},"13":{"text":"Zerubbabel ta Abiud, Abiud ta Eliakim, Eliakim ta Azor,"},"14":{"text":"Azor ta Zadok, Zadok ta Achim, Achim ta Eliud,"},"15":{"text":"Eliud ta Eleazar, Eleazar ta Matthan, Matthan ta Jacob,"},"16":{"text":"Jacob ta Joseph hi a, Christ kici Jesus Nu Mary pasal ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom Abraham khang panin David khang dong khang sawm le khang li hi a, David khang pan Babylon ah salin a kipaipui uh dong khang sawm le khang li, Babylon te mat hun pan Messiah sua dong khang sawm le khang li ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Jesus Christ suana sia hi bang ahi hi. A nu Mary sia Joseph taw teang tu in a kidongh sa ahi hi. Ahihang a kiteen uh ma in, ama Thaa Thiangtho taw naungil om hi.","title":"Jesus Christ Suana (Luke 2:1-7)","ref":"Lk 1:27"},"19":{"text":"Joseph sia thumaan a ngamta tawntung pa khat hi a, ahizong ngual mai ah Mary maimawlsak nuam ngawl ahikom amate nii bek vaihawm in kikhen sawm hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuabangin a ngaisut laitakin, Vantunglalang khat a mang sungah hong kilak a “David ii suan Joseph awng, Mary sia na zi tu in teenpui kiita heak in. Banghang ziam cile ama sia Thaa Thiangtho in ngaisak hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in tapa khat hong hing tu a, a min Jesus ci in na phuak tu hi — banghang ziam cile ama in a mite mawna pan a hun tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Lk 1:31"},"22":{"text":"“Tu in hite theampo a pianna sia Topa kamsaangpa sonkhol teng a taangtun natu ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ngaknu thiangtho khat naungil om tu a, tapa khat hing tu hi, a min Immanuel kiphuak tu hi.” (Tua in “Eite taw Pathian omkhawm hi,” a cinopna hi.)","ref":"Is 7:14 (LXX)"},"24":{"text":"Joseph khanglo in vantunglalang ii sawl bangma in Mary teenpui hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahihang taciil nau a sua dong a zi ompui ngawl hi. Tuaciang Joseph in nau min Jesus ci in phuak hi.","ref":"Lk 2:21"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus sia Herod Kumpipa maan lai in, Judea ngam Bethlehem khua ah suak hi. Tua zawk hai ngawlin aksi huvau a kante in nisuana sang pan Jerusalem ah hong pai uh a,","title":"Nisuana sang pan Leangnate"},"2":{"text":"“Jew te Kumpipa tu in a piang nausen sia koisung a suak ziam,” ci in dongh hi. “Nisuana sang panin ama ii aksi hong suak ka mu uh a, ama bia tu in kong pai uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Herod Kumpipa in hi thu a zaak ciang, Jerusalem a om midangte bangma in liinglawng hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in thiampi liante theampo le Thukham hil sya theampo kaikhawm in, “Messiah koisungah suak tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"5":{"text":"“Judea ngam Bethlehem khua ah suak tu hi, banghang ziam cile kamsaang khat in hi bangin at zo hi:"},"6":{"text":"‘Judah ngam Bethlehem khua awng Judah ngam khuapi thupite sungah, nang sia a nobel na hi bua hi, banghang ziam cile nang sung panin, ka Israel mite lam a lak tu lampuipa khat, hong piang tu hi.’ ”","ref":"Mic 5:2"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom Herod in nisuana sang pan hong pai leangnate sam ku a, aksi a kilangh bang hun tatak ziam, ci in dongh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang, hi bang sawlna taw Bethlehem ah paisak hi. “Pai tavun a, patangno sia pha tak hong zong tavun. Na mu zawk uh ciang hong zasak kik tavun, kei zongh pai in ka bia tu hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaciang amate ding kik a, nisuana sang pan a mu sa uh aksi sia ma a pai kawmin mu uh hi. Amate in tua aksi a mu ciangin, a thinnopna le a lungdamna kison zo ngawl hi! Aksi sia amate mai ah pai a patangno omna tung san a thet ciang tawlnga hi.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Amate inn sungah tum a patangno le a nu Mary a mu uh ciang khupdin in bia uh hi. Amate in a ken uh a letsongte khamh, frankincense paaknamtui le myrrh thil namtuite sua in pia uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Pathian in amate Herod kungah, a heak kik ngawl natu in, a mang sungah hilkhol ahikom lampi dang khat tawn in, a ngam ah cia kik uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate a pai zawkciang, Topa vantunglalang khat Joseph mang sungah kilangh a, “Herod in patangno sia that tu in zong tu hi. Tua ahikom patangno le a nu Egypt ngam ah taipui ta'n, cia kik a kong sawl dong, tua munah om tavun,” ci hi.","title":"Egypt ah Taipui"},"14":{"text":"Joseph tho a patangno le a nu Egypt ngam ah zan lai in, taipui hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua munah Herod thi dong taam uh hi. “Egypt ngam pan ka Tapa ka sam hi,” ci thu kamsaangpa ii sonkholnate a taangtunna ahi hi.","ref":"Hos 11:1"},"16":{"text":"Nisuana sang pan hong pai mihing pilte in theam ahi hunlam Herod in a phaw ciangin a thin uuk mama hi. Bethlehem khua sung le a kiim a paam a om, kum nii le a nuaisia patangno theampo thalup tu in thupia hi. Mipilte ii aksi a mu hun taw tuatin tuabangin ngamta hi.","title":"Patangnote A Kithalupna"},"17":{"text":"Kamsaangpa Jeremiah ii a sonkholna teng hi bangin taangtung a:"},"18":{"text":"“Ramah ngam ah nasia tak kaana awnging khat kiza hi. Rachel sia a tate a thi siat hu in kiheneam zo ngawlin kap hi.”","ref":"Jer 31:15"},"19":{"text":"Herod thi zawkciang Egypt ngam a om Joseph mang sungah Topa vantunglalang khat kilangh a,","title":"Egypt ngam pan Heakkikna"},"20":{"text":"“Tho in nauno le a nu, Israel ngam ah ciapui kik ta'n. Banghang ziam cile patang a that nuam sia thi zo hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom Joseph tho a, nauno le a nu taw Israel ngam ah cia kik uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang Judea ngam ah Herod za a laih sia Archelaus hi, ci in Joseph in a zaak ciang tua ngam a pai tu lau hi. A mang sungah a ngamtat natu kihil thua ahikom Galilee ngam ah pai in Nazareth khua ah teang hi."},"23":{"text":"Kamsaangte sonkhol bangin, “Ama sia Nazareth mi kici tu hi,” a cina thu taangtung hi.","ref":"Mk 1:24; Lk 2:39; Jn 1:45"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Tuiphumpa John sia Judea sennealngam ah hong pai a, thuhil kipan hi.","title":"Tuiphumpa John Thuhilna (Mark 1:1-8 ; Luke 3:1-18 ; John 1:19-28)"},"2":{"text":"“Na mawna uh pan kisiik kik vun, banghang ziam cile Vantung ngam hong nai zo hi!” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 4:17; Mk 1:15"},"3":{"text":"Kamsaangpa Isaiah kammal sia John huvau a sonkholna hi a, “Sennealngam sungah mihing khat hong taangko a, ‘Topa atu in lampi pua khol vun; Ama ii khualhaw natu in lamzin tang khat vawtsak vun!’ ” ci hi.","ref":"Is 40:3"},"4":{"text":"John ii puansilh sia kalaoh mul taw kitak a, ama in savun kawngkhau thua in, ama an sia khaumaw le ngam khuaitui ahi hi.","ref":"2 Kum 1:8"},"5":{"text":"Mihingte in Jerusalem pan, Judea ngamkhen bup le Jordan ngunhui ngam theampo panin hong pai uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in a mawna uh pualaak a, tuaciangin Jordan ngun sungah ama in tuiphum hi."},"7":{"text":"Pharisee te le Sadducee te tam ma ama kungah tui kiphum tu in, hong pai a mu ciangin, amate tungah, “No ngul ngilote awng — Pathian ii daan hong piak natu panin suakta tu nu hi ci in akua in hong son ziam?","ref":"Mt 12:34; 23:33"},"8":{"text":"Mawna pan kisii kikna lim kilanghsak vun."},"9":{"text":"Na taanghpupi Abraham suan le paalte na hi uh hu in, daan thuak natu pan suakta tu in, kimuangmaw heak vun. No tungah hong ci khi hi, Pathian in hi suangte zongh la in Abraham suan le paalte suaksak thei hi!","ref":"Jn 8:33"},"10":{"text":"Thingkungte phuk tu in a bul ah, heimai kingat zo hi, ngapha a nga ngawl thingkung theampo kiphuk tu a, meimang sungah kisep tu hi.","ref":"Mt 7:19"},"11":{"text":"Na kisii kikna uh a kitel natu in tui kong phum hi, ahihang kei nung pan hong pai lai tu pa in no sia Thaa Thiangtho le meikuang taw hong baptize tu hi. Kei sangin ama lian zaw pek a, a peangdap toai tu zonghin ka kilawm bua hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in taangkheaplaw a khut sungah toai zo hi. Zungtaangte hong kheap tu a taangtang teng taangsaal sungah khawmtua in, taangsi taangvai teng a mit ngeingawl meikuang sungah hal tu hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Galilee pan Jesus hong theng a, John ii tuiphum tu in, Jordan ngun, John kungah hong pai hi.","title":"Jesus tui a kiphumna (Mark 1:9-11, Luke 3:21-22)"},"14":{"text":"Ahihang John in ama tho tu in kithoai a, “Kei sia nangma ii nong tuiphum tu hizaw napi, kei kungah nang hong paizaw ni ziam?” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang Jesus in zo kik a “Pathian ii deina theampo a kicin natu in, tu in hong seam ta'n,” ci hi. Tuaciang John zongh thukim hi."},"16":{"text":"Jesus tui a kiphum zawk po ciang tui sung pan hong pusuak to hi. Tuaciang ama atu van kihong a, Pathian ii Thaa ngam vakhu bangin hong tuaksuk in, ama tungah hong tusuk a mu hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaciang van panin aw khat in, “Hisia in ka it ka Tapa hi a, ama tungah ka lungkim hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 22:2; Ps 2:7; Is 42:1; Mt 12:18; 17:5; Mk 1:11; Lk 9:35"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Thaa in Jesus sia Doaimangpa ii ze et tu in ngam sungah paipui hi.","title":"Jesus ii Ze et Thuakna (Mark 1:12-13 ; Luke 4:1-13)","ref":"Heb 2:18; 4:15"},"2":{"text":"Sun sawmli le zan sawmli an ne ngawlin a om zawkciang Jesus ngilkial hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Doaimangpa hong pai a, “Pathian Tapa na hi le suang hite anluum suaksak in,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang Jesus in zo a, “Laithiangtho in, ‘Mihingte sia anluum bek taw nungta thei hi ngawl a, Pathian kam sung pan a pusuak kammal khat sim nuntak pui hi,’ ” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 8:3"},"5":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Doaimangpa in Jesus sia Khuapi Thiangtho Jerusalem ah paipui a, Biakinn khuvum a saangbel na ah suanhto hi."},"6":{"text":"“Pathian Tapa na hile nangma le nangma kitaaksuksak in, banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in ci hi, ‘Pathian in a vantunglalangte nang huvau in sawl tu a, na peang beak zongh suang taw a kisutha ngawl natu in, a khut taw hong domto tu hi.’ ” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 91:11-12"},"7":{"text":"Jesus in, “Ahihang laithiangtho in, ‘Na Topa Pathian na ze et heak vun,’ zongh ci si hi,” ci in zo kik hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:16"},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang Doaimangpa in mualsaang mama khat ii tungah paipui a, leitung ngam tuatuamte ii letna theampo lak hi."},"9":{"text":"“Khupdin in kei hong bia lete, hi teng theampo nang kong pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Jesus in, “Satan awng, tai in! Laithiangtho in, ‘Na Topa Pathian bek bia vun a, Ama atu bek sepsak vun!’ ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:13"},"11":{"text":"Tuasia ciang, Doaimangpa in Jesus nusia a, vantung mite hong pai in Jesus ou uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Jesus in John thong sungah kikhum hi, ci in a zaak ciang, ama Galilee ah pai hi.","title":"Jesus Galilee ah Nasep Kipan (Mark 1:14-15 ; Luke 4:14-15)","ref":"Mt 14:3; Mk 6:17; Lk 3:19-20"},"13":{"text":"Ama Nazareth khua ah taam ngawlin, Zebulun le Naphtali ngamsung Galilee tuili hui khuapi Capernaum ah teang tu in pai hi.","ref":"Jn 2:12"},"14":{"text":"Hi bang a ngamtat sia, kamsaangpa Isaiah pauna teng a taangtun natu ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"“Zebulun ngam le Naphtali ngam, Tuipi sung zotna lampi tung, Jordan ngun lang khat, Galilee, Gentile te ngam!","ref":"Is 9:1-2"},"16":{"text":"Khuazing sungah a teang mihingte in, Khuavak taang lian mama khat mu tu hi. Thina khuazing ngamsung a teangte tungah khuavak a taang tu hi.”"},"17":{"text":"Tua hun pan kipan Jesus in, “Na mawna uh pan kisiik kik vun, banghang ziam cile Vantung ngam hong nai zo hi,” ci in ama thuhilnate hil tu in a kipan hi.","ref":"Mt 3:2"},"18":{"text":"Galilee tuili hui ah a va laitakin, Jesus in ngasa mante ahi unau nii Simon (Peter kici) le a suapuipa Andrew, tuili sungah ngeen khat taw ngasa manin a om mu hi.","title":"Jesus in Ngasa mante Li Sam (Mark 1:16-20 ; Luke 5:1-11)"},"19":{"text":"Jesus in amate tungah, “Hong zui tavun, mihing mante kong suaksak tu hi,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Thakhatin a ngeente nusia uh a, ama zui paih uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua mun pan a paisuak uh ciang Zebedee tapate unau James le John mu hi. Amate in a pa taw ngunkuang sungah a ngeente puua in om uh hi. Jesus in amate sam hi."},"22":{"text":"Thakhatin a ngunkuang le a pa nusia in zui uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesus Galilee ngam bup ah vakin, synagogue te ah hilna nei a, Kumpingam Lungdamna Thu thuhilna nei in, natna satna namcin le ciluang natna a neite damsak hi.","title":"Jesus in Hilcian, Thuhil, Damsak (Luke 6:17-19)","ref":"Mt 9:35; Mk 1:39"},"24":{"text":"Ama thu sia Syria ngam bup ah kizel ahikom mihingte in ama kungah ciina theampo, natna satna le mealhem theampo: doai veite, butthi theite, langngawte, paipui in — Jesus in damsak siat hi."},"25":{"text":"Galilee ngam khuapi sawmte le Jerusalem, Judea le Jordan ngunngal panin, mihonte in zui uh hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus in mihonpite a mu ciangin mual tungah kaato hi. A nungzuite a kiim ah kikhawm a,","title":"Mualtung Thuhilna"},"2":{"text":"tuaciang amate tungah hil tu in kipan hi."},"3":{"text":"“Thaa thu ah a zawngkhal hunlam a kihete in, mihing lungdamte ahi hi; Vantung ngam sia amate aa ahi hi!","title":"Lungdamna Tatak (Luke 6:20-23)"},"4":{"text":"“A thuum a taute in mihing lungdamte ahi uh hi! Pathian in amate heeneam tu hi.","ref":"Is 61:2"},"5":{"text":"“A kiniamkhiakte in mihing lungdamte ahi uh hi; amate in Pathian kamciamte a saang tu uh hi!","ref":"Ps 37:11"},"6":{"text":"“Pathian ii tangkalte sep tu a lungngulbel te in mihing lungdamte ahi uh hi; Pathian in a kicing lungkimna pia tu hi!","ref":"Is 55:1-2"},"7":{"text":"“Ngual hesuak theite in mihing lungdamte ahi uh hi; Pathian in amate hesuak tu hi!"},"8":{"text":"“Thinsung thiangthote in mihing lungdamte ahi uh hi; amate in Pathian mu tu uh hi!","ref":"Ps 24:3-4"},"9":{"text":"“Kilemna a vawtte in mihing lungdamte ahi uh hi; Pathian in ka tate ci tu hi!"},"10":{"text":"“Pathian ii deina bang ngamtatna hangin vawtsiat a thuakte in, mihing lungdamte ahi uh hi; Vantung ngam in amate aa hi tu hi!","ref":"1 Pe 3:14"},"11":{"text":"“Kei nungzui na hi uh hu in ngual in hong zawngsak hong vawtsia in, ngitlo leilot thu a nanam taw mawna hong zong le mihing lungdamte na hi uh hi.","ref":"1 Pe 4:14"},"12":{"text":"Na thinnuamsak vun, lungdam vun, banghang ziam cile vantung ah na thaman saan tu hong kikoisak sia lian mama hi. Taanghlai kamsaangte zongh tuabang ma in, na kivawtsia hi.","ref":"2 Khang 36:16; Sawl 7:52"},"13":{"text":"“Mihingte atu in no sia ci taw na kibang uh hi. Ahihang ci sia a alna a thai le ki alsak kik thei nawn ngawl hi. Tua in kimanna nei nawn ngawl a, kivawkin, mihingte in tuanhcil tu hi.","title":"Ci al le Khuavak (Mark 9:50 ; Luke 14:34-35)","ref":"Mk 9:50; Lk 14:34-35"},"14":{"text":"“No sia leitung bup atu in khuavak taw na kibang uh hi. Mualtung ah a kisa khuapi sia a kiseal thei bua hi.","ref":"Jn 8:12; 9:5"},"15":{"text":"Mei a det ciang, kuama in kuang taw sincip ngeingawl hi. Inn sung a om theampo a taan natu mun meivakna tungah kikoi zaw hi.","ref":"Mk 4:21; Lk 8:16; 11:33"},"16":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in, napha na sep uhte mihingte in a mu ciang, vantung a om na Pa uh a pok natu in, amate mai ah na khuavak uh taangsak vun.","ref":"1 Pe 2:12"},"17":{"text":"“Moses thukham le kamsaangte hilnate bosak tu in hong pai hong sa heak vun. A bosak tu hong pai hi ngawlin, a khuangkhimsak tu in hong pai ka hizaw hi.","title":"Thukham taw kisai Hilna"},"18":{"text":"Na theampo ii tawp natu a khuangkhim mateng, simlei le vanpi a kip laiteng, thukham sung a thu nobel khat zongh a bo thong buatu hi.","ref":"Lk 16:17"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom, a kuama po thupiakte sung pan a nobel khat ni ngawlin midang zongh tuabangin a nit ngawl natu a hil sia in Vantung ngam sungah a nobel hi tu hi. Tuaciangin a kuama po ahizong thukham ni a, midangte zongh tuabangin a nit natu a hil sia Vantung ngam sungah lian tu hi."},"20":{"text":"A tatakin kong ciciang, Pathian ii deina bang na vawtna sungah Thukham hil Syate le Pharisee te sangin na thumaan zaw uh le bekin Vantung ngam sungah na tum thei tu uh hi."},"21":{"text":"“Mihing na that uh le thusitna na thuak tu hi. ‘Mihing na that heak vun,’ ci in taanghlaite kihilna sia na he uh hi.","title":"Thin uukna huvau Hilna","ref":"Pu 20:13; Thkna 5:17"},"22":{"text":"Ahihang tu in kong ci in ah: a suapuipa tungah a thin uuk pawpo te in thusitna thuak tu hi, a kuama po ahizong a suapuipa ngina ngawl hi, a ci peuma, Council te mai ah kipaipui tu a, a kuama po a suapuipa mannung ngawl mihing mawmaw, a ci peuma hell meikuang sungah a pai tu lauhuai hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom biaknatau tungah biakpiakna nei tu in, na kithoai laitakin, na suapuipa in, nang tungah lungkim ngawlna nei hi, ci in na phawk le,"},"24":{"text":"na piak tu vanh sia biaknatau mai ah nusia phot zii ta'n a, na suapuipa taw kilemna vawt phot ta'n, tua zawkciang hong pai kik ta'n a, Pathian tungah biakpiakna nei pheang in."},"25":{"text":"“Khat po in thu hong vawt a, zumkong hong then le a hun om lai, zum na thet ma in, na kituu uh thu sia saatmit masa tavun. Tua ahibuale ama in thukhenmangte tungah hong then tu a, tuate in palikte munah hong aapin, thonginn sungah hong khum tu hi."},"26":{"text":"A maan tatak kong ci ciangin, tua na liausum teng a cingin na piak siat mateng thonginn sung pan na suakta thei buatu hi."},"27":{"text":"“ ‘Nupa kipalngul heak vun’ ci thu na za zo uh hi.","title":"Kipalngulna huvau Hilna","ref":"Pu 20:14; Thkna 5:18"},"28":{"text":"Tu in hi bangin kong ci hi: khat po in numei khat khialpui nopna thin taw a en le a thinsung ah nupa palngul khialna vawt hi zo hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahikom na mit ziatsang in hong mawsak le khelkeak in vawk in! hell sungah na pumpi bup in na pai sangin, pumpi cing ngawlin, om lete phazaw hi.","ref":"Mt 18:9; Mk 9:47"},"30":{"text":"Na khut ziat sangin hong khialsak le, saattan in vawk in. Na pumpi cingin hell sungah na pai sangin, khutsamh peangsamh in om lete phazaw pek hi.","ref":"Mt 18:8; Mk 9:43"},"31":{"text":"“ ‘A zi a khul mihing khat pawpo in kikhulna lai pia tahen,’ kici si hi.","title":"Kikhulna huvau Hilna (Matthew 19:9 ; Mark 10:11-12 ; Luke 16:18)","ref":"Thkna 24:1-4; Mt 19:7; Mk 10:4"},"32":{"text":"Ahihang tu in kong ci in ah: a zi ii thumaan ngawlna simngawl thudang taw pasal khat in a zi khul a, tua nu in pasal dang khat a nei kik le, nupa palngul mawna a vawtsak suak hi. A pasal kik sia zongh in, nupa palngul mawna vawt ahi hi.","ref":"Mt 19:9; Mk 10:11-12; Lk 16:18; 1 Cor 7:10-11"},"33":{"text":"“ ‘Na kamciam vawtte ciampeal heak vun. Topa tungah vawt tu a na kamciamnate uh na vawt vun,’ ci in khangluite tungah a kison thute na heaksa uh hi.","title":"Kiciamna huvau Hilna","ref":"Thiam 19:12; Mi 30:2; Thkna 23:21"},"34":{"text":"Ahihang tu in kong cina panin: kamciam na kipiak uh ciangin kiciamna zangh heak vun. Vantung min lo in na kiciam heak vun, banghang ziam cile tua in Pathian tokhum ahi hi;","ref":"Jas 5:12; Is 66:1; Mt 23:22"},"35":{"text":"leitung taw zong kiciam heak vun, banghang ziam cile tua in a peang ngakna ahi hi; Jerusalem min lo in zongh kiciam heak vun, banghang ziam cile tua in Kumpilianpa khuapi ahi hi.","ref":"Ps 48:2; Is 66:1"},"36":{"text":"Na lutang taw zonghin na kiciam heak in, banghang ziam cile na samzam khat a kaang tu le a vom tu in na vawt thei bua hi."},"37":{"text":"A hite ‘Hi’ ma ci vun, ahi ngawlte ‘Hi ngawl’ ma ci vun — tua tungsia pauna sia Ngilopa kung pan hong pai ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"“ ‘Mittang khat luang mittang khat, hatang khat luang hatang khat, ci thu na zaaksa uh hi.","title":"Thuk kikna huvau Hilna (Luke 6:29-30)","ref":"Pu 21:24; Thiam 24:20; Thkna 19:21"},"39":{"text":"Ahihang kei kong cina pan: no tungah hong khialte na thuk kik heak vun; khat po in na biangkho ziatsang hong beang le na biangkho veisang zongh na ngat vun."},"40":{"text":"Tuaciang khat po in na laktong khat dei in zum ah thu hong vawt le na laktong puasilh zongh na pia thua lai vun."},"41":{"text":"Tua mun a ngak ngalkapte in, tai khat vanh pua in hong sawl le, tai nii puaksak vun."},"42":{"text":"Khat po in na khat hong ngen le pia vun; khat po in na khat hong zawng nuam le zawn vun."},"43":{"text":"“ ‘Na lawmte it vun a, na ngalte ensan vun,” ci thu na zaaksa uh hi.","title":"Ngalte It natu (Luke 6:27-28 , 32-36)","ref":"Thiam 19:18"},"44":{"text":"Ahihang kei kong cina pan: na ngalte it vun a, hong vawtsiate atu thungetsak vun."},"45":{"text":"Vantung a na Pa ii tate na sua thei natu in, tuabangin ngamta vun. Banghang ziam cile ama in mihing phate tung le mihing siate tungah a kibangin ni taangsak a, na pha seamte le a sia seamte tung zongh ah a kibangin nguazusak hi."},"46":{"text":"“No hong itte bek na it uh le, Pathian in banghangin thaman hong pia tu ziam? Shiadongte ngawngawn zongh, tuabangin ngamta kana ngawl ziam?"},"47":{"text":"Tuaciangin na lawmte bek na paupui uh le, ngualdang taw bang na kilamdanna uh om ziam? Doai biate zongh in tuabangin ngamta kana ngawl ziam?"},"48":{"text":"Vantung a na Pa uh cialcing ahi bangma in, no zongh na cialcing uh kul hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Thiam 19:2; Thkna 18:13"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Biakpiak vaipuakte na sep uh ciangin, mihon ii hong mu tu in, ngual sungah vawt heak vun. Tuabangin ngual sungah na vawt uh le, vantung a na Pa kung pan, thaman khat zongh na nga buatu hi.","title":"Cimaw Huna huvau Hilna","ref":"Mt 23:5"},"2":{"text":"“Mihing cimaw khat huna na nei uh ciangin, mihing a kihitheamsakte in lampi liante tung le biakna innte ah a vawt uh bangin, pokngaina taw vawt heak vun. Amate ahile, mihingte pok tu thangai in tuabangin ngamta hi. A tatakin ka ci ciang, amate ii a thaman uh a cing takin kipia zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang a cimaw khat na hu uh ciangin, na lawm phabel khat zongh in hesak heak vun."},"4":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin kuama in hong heakpui ngawl tu hi. Tuaciang a kilangh ngawl a, na nasep hong mu, na Pa in thaman hong pia tu hi."},"5":{"text":"“Thu na nget uh ciangin a kihisak mihingte bangin ngen heak vun! Amate lamkaa khawng le biakna innte ah ngual mu tu in ding a thungen thanuam uh hi. A tatakin ka ci ciang, amate a thaman uh a cing takin kipia zo ahi hi.","title":"Thunget huvau Hilna (Luke 11:2-4)","ref":"Lk 18:10-14"},"6":{"text":"Ahihang no thu na nget uh ciangin, inndoi sungah tumin, inn na kha zawk uh ciang, a kimu thei ngawl, na Pa tungah thungen tavun. Tua hile noma ii heak bek a na ngamtatna uh hong mu na Pa in thaman hong pia tu hi."},"7":{"text":"“Thu na nget uh ciangin, doai biate bangin, khiakna nei ngawl kammal tam mamate zangh heak vun, amate in thunget sau thethei a zak uh ciangin, a pathiante in za tuan tu in um uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amate bang hi heak vun. Na nget uh ma in na Pa uh in, na kitaangsap uh teng hong he siat zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahiciang hi bangin thu ngen vun: Vantung a om kote Pa awng: Na min thiangtho ki upat tahen;"},"10":{"text":"na Kumpingam hong piang tahen; Vantung ah na deina a kicin bangin Leitung ah kicing tahen."},"11":{"text":"Tu ni in ka khamkhop tu an hong pia ta in."},"12":{"text":"Ko tungah hong khialte ka maisak uh bangma, Kote khialna zongh hong maisak ta in."},"13":{"text":"Ze etna haksa hong thuaksak heak in a, Ngilopa ii khutsung pan hong tan ta in. Uk zawkna, vaangletna le minthanna Nang aa hi tawntung tahen, Amen."},"14":{"text":"“Ngual ii note tung a hong khialnate na maisak uh le, vantung a na Pa zongh in, note khialna zongh hong maisak tu hi.","ref":"Mk 11:25-26"},"15":{"text":"Ahihang ngual khialna na maisak bua uh le na Pa zongh in note khialna hong maisak ngawl tu hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tuaciang, an na tan uh ciang, a kihisak theamte bangin maikhingin om heak vun. Amate sia a antan hunlam uh ngual heak tu in kipua ngawl lui in om hi. A tatakin ka ci ciang, amate in a thaman uh a cing takin a kipiasa ahi hi.","title":"Antan huvau Hilna"},"17":{"text":"An na tan uh ciang, na mai uh phiatin na sam uh pot vun,"},"18":{"text":"tua hi le na antan uh hunlam ngualdang in hong he tuan ngawlin, a kimu ngawl na Pa bek in hong he tu hi. Tuaciang, nangma bek heak a na ngamtat sia na Pa in, hong mu tu a, thaman hong pia tu hi."},"19":{"text":"“Na nei na lamh uhte, nget ii neak tu, a eakseau tu le ngutate in phuul a, a nguk theina, leitung ah noma atu in khol heak vun.","title":"Vantung Haunate (Luke 12:33-34)","ref":"Jas 5:2-3"},"20":{"text":"Tua hi zaw ngawlin, na nei na lamh uhte, nget neak thei ngawl, eakseau thei ngawl ngutate in phuul a, a nguk thei ngawlna, vantung ah na khol vun."},"21":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile na neisate omna munah na thin na lung uh om tu hi."},"22":{"text":"“Mittangte sia pumpi atu in meivak ahi hi. Na mittangte a ciidam le na pumpi khuavak taw kidim tu hi. Ahihang na mittangte a pha buale na pumpi khuazing sungah om tu hi.","title":"Pumpi Khuavak (Luke 11:34-36)"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom na sungah a om khuavak sia khuazing hi thong le bangza in zingcip tu ziam?"},"24":{"text":"“Kuama in to nii ii sal hi thei ngawl hi. Ama in khat ensan tu a, khat it tu hi; khat ii tungah thumaan tu a khat puavawk tu hi. Pathian le sum ii sal na seam khawm thei buatu hi.","title":"Pathian le Neisate (Luke 16:13 ; 12:22-31)"},"25":{"text":"“Na nuntak thei natu in, an le tuite ahizong, na pumpi atu in puante ahizong, tuate huvau thintoi heak vun, kong ci sia hisia hang ahi hi. Nuntakna sia an sangin manpha zaw kana ngawl ziam? Pumpi sia puan sangin manpha zaw kana ngawl ziam?"},"26":{"text":"A leang kawkoai vacimte en vun: amate in thai tu ngawl, anla ngawl a, saal sungah an khol ngawl hi; ahihang vantung ah na Pa in, amate vaak hi! Note sia vacimte sangin manpha mama zaw ngawl kana nu ziam?"},"27":{"text":"Note sung pan thinngimna taw na khan uh bekno khat beak sauzawsak thei natu nu ziam?"},"28":{"text":"“Tuaciang puansilh tu banghangin thintoi nu ziam? Duisung paakte en tavun, bangbangin khang ziam: amate in na le seam ngawl a, puansilh nikteen le vawt ngawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahihang a maan tatakin kong ci ciangin, Solomon Kumpipa in, a hau mama hang, hi paakte za in a hoi puan nei ngawl hi.","ref":"1 Kum 10:4-7; 2 Khang 9:3-6"},"30":{"text":"Tuni in po a, zing ciang a bo tu meikhuk sung a kihal tu lopa — hi lopa a zeam sia Pathian hi. Ama in no hong zeam zaw tu ahi sia muang ngawl nu ziam? Na nei uh upna sia bangza in no ziam!"},"31":{"text":"“Tua ahikom, ‘bang ka ne tu a, bang ka dawn tu? bang puan ka silh tu ziam?’ ci in thinngim heak vun."},"32":{"text":"(Hite sia doai biate ii thinbot thei bul thute ahi hi.) Vantung a om na Pa in, hite theampo na kitaangsap uh hong he nginge hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua sangin Pathian Ukna-ngam le ama in nang tung pan bang dei ziam, ci sia thupisak masa vun, tua hile ama in tua nadang theampo zongh hong sik tu hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ahikom zing ciang atu in, thinngim heak vun; zing ciang in ama khom tu ma thinngimna nei tu hi. Ni sim hong piang thinngimnate belap kul ngawl hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Pathian ii note tungah thu hong khen ngawl natu in, ngual tungah thu na khen heak vun,","title":"Ngual tung Thukhenna (Luke 6:37-38 , 41-42)"},"2":{"text":"banghang ziam cile ngual tungah thu na khen uh babangin note tungah Pathian in thu hong khen tu hi. Ngual tungah na zak uh na ngeina let uh teng ma no tungah hong kizangh tu hi.","ref":"Mk 4:24"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahile banghangin na suapuipa mittang sungah ninteak sia mu thei in, noma mittang sungah thingluang sia thupi laak ngawl nu ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Noma mittang sunga, thingluang khat om nginge sia, awlmawk ngawlin na suapuipa munah, ‘Na mittang sungah ninteak sia laaksak tong,’ banghangin ci ngam nu ziam?"},"5":{"text":"No a kihisak minamte awng! Noma mittang sungah thingluang sia la keak phot vun, tua hile na suapuipa mittang sung ninteak sia na laak thei natu in, thiang takin na mu thei tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"“A thiangtho nate uite na pia heak vun — amate in noma hong pet kik zaw tu hi. note sia tonbawm tam mamate sangin manpha zaw nu hi."},"32":{"text":"“Mihingte mai ah khat po in kei neisa a hina a pualaak le, vantung ka Pa mai ah, kei zongh in tuabang ma in ka pualaak tu hi.","title":"Pualaakna le Christ Nialna (Luke 12:8-9)"},"33":{"text":"Ahihang mihingte mai ah khat po in kei hong nial a ahile, vantung ka Pa mai ah kei zongh in ka nial tu hi.","ref":"2 Tim 2:12"},"34":{"text":"“Leitung ah kilemna puak tu in hong pai hi, ci in ngaisun heak vun; kei sangin a tapa ahibuale a tanu a it zaw te kei nungzui tu in kiphu ngawl hi;"},"38":{"text":"a kuama po, a thinglamtee kisuanhin ka nung hong zui ngawlte, kei nungzui tu in kiphu ngawl hi.","ref":"Mt 16:24; Mk 8:34; Lk 9:23"},"39":{"text":"A nuntakna a nga natu a hanciam khat pawpo sia a nuntakna taan tu hi; ahihang a kuama po kei hangin a nuntakna a taan le, nuntakna tatak nga tu hi.","ref":"Mt 16:25; Mk 8:35; Lk 9:24; 17:33; Jn 12:25"},"40":{"text":"“A kuama po no hong saangte sia, kei hong saang ahi hi; tuaciang kei hong saangte sia kei hong sawlpa saang ahi hi.","title":"Thamante (Mark 9:41)","ref":"Mk 9:37; Lk 9:48; 10:16; Jn 13:20"},"41":{"text":"A kuama po in mihing khat sia Pathian thupha puak a hina taw a saang le Pathian thupha puakte ii thaman kihawm tu hi. Vui ii a kuaikhum lopate khat po ziam?"},"8":{"text":"A bangbel mu nuamin kuan nu ziam? Puansilh hoi nawno a silh pasal khat mu nuam na hi uh ziam? Mihing tuabang a, a kizeamte kumpite teenna innpite huang sungah teang bek hi!"},"9":{"text":"Hong son tavun; bang mu tu in pai nu ziam? Kamsaang khat ahi ziam? Hi tatak hi, na mu uh sia kamsaang thawthong bek hi ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile John sia laithiangtho ii: ‘Pathian in, ka kamtaipa na mai ah na lampi hong honsak khol tu in ka paisak tu hi,’ a ci sia pa hi.","ref":"Mal 3:1"},"11":{"text":"A tatak ka ci ciangin tuiphumpa John sia a piang ngei mihing khat pawpo sangin lianzaw hi. Ahihang Vantung ngam sungah a om a nobel khat sia John sangin lianzaw hi."},"12":{"text":"John ii thuhil a kipat pan tuni dong tatak ma Vantung ngam in nasia takin zawthawk thu taw sutolna thuak hi, a ngoltol mihingte in laak tu in hanciam uh hi.","ref":"Lk 16:16"},"13":{"text":"John khang dong ma in, kamsaang theampo le Moses thukhamte in, Kumpingam thu huvau son uh hi;"},"14":{"text":"tuaciang amate thuhilte na um nuam uh le John sia Elijah hi a, hong pai tu a kisonkhol sa sia ahi hi.","ref":"Mal 4:5; Mt 17:10-13; Mk 9:11-13"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahiciang bil na nei uh le ngai vun."},"16":{"text":"“Tu in, tu hun a mihingte bang taw teengat tu khi ziam? Amate sum zuakna phual a to, patangte taw kibang hi. Pawl khat in pawldang khat te oksan a;"},"17":{"text":"‘Mo kiteenna music kong tum uh a, laam nuam ngawl nu hi! Mithi vuina la kong sak uh a, kap nuam ngawl nu hi!’ kici uh hi."},"18":{"text":"John in an tang a sapittui ne ngawlin hong pai ciang, ‘Ama ii sungah doai om hi,’ mihing theampo in ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing Tapa hong pai a, ama in ne in dawnin a om leleau ciang, ‘Hisia pa en vun! Antuangpa, zutuangpa, shiadongte le pawlsung pan a kipuavawkte ii lawmpa!,’ mihing theampo in ci uh hi. Ahitazong Pathian ii ciimna sia maan tatak hi ci in a piang thute panin kilak hi.”"},"20":{"text":"Jesus ii nalamdang lakna a tamzaw a vawtna khuapite sungah a teang mihingte in, a mawna uh panin, kisiik kik tuan ngawl ahikom, ama in tua khuapite teih hi.","title":"Thu Um ngawl Khuapite (Luke 10:13-15)"},"21":{"text":"“Nang atu in bangza in lauhuai ziam, Chorazin awng! Nang atu in bangza in lauhuai ziam, Bethsaida awng! Tyre le Sidon khuate tungah note sungah hong kivawt nalamdang laknate kivawt thong le, a mihingte in khau-ip puan silh in, amate tungah vut kithe in, mawna kisiik kikna a lak zawk ngei zo tu hi.","ref":"Is 23:1-18; Eze 26:1—28:26; Jol 3:4-8; Amo 1:9-10; Zec 9:2-4"},"22":{"text":"A tatakin ka ciciang, Pathian thukhenna Ni hong thet ciang, note tung sangin Tyre le Sidon khua mite tungah Pathian in hesuakna tam lak zaw tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaciangin, Capernaum, nang na hile, nangma le nangma vantung dongin kilapto sawm na hi ziam? Hell khuk sungah na kisepsuk tu hi.
