Pa simngawl kuama in Tapa a tel zo bua a, Tapa le Tapa ii a telsak nop a teal mihingte simngawl kuama in Pa a tel bua hi.","ref":"Jn 3:35; 1:18; 10:15"},"28":{"text":"“Vanhngit pua in, a toite theampo awng, kei kungah hong pai tavun, tawlngakna kong pia tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka hakkol la in kisuanh vun, kei tung pan hong kisin tavun, banghang ziam cile keima in cingh in a kiniamkhiak pa ka hi hi; tua ahikom toithaina na nga tu uh hi.","ref":"Jer 6:16"},"30":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, hakkol kong sot tu sia puak nop a, vanh kong sot tu sia zaang hi,” ci hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawk khuangeingawlin Jesus in Sabbath ni khat zungtaang lo sungah vak hi. A nungzuite a ngilkial ahikom zungtaang huite hiat in a humte ne uh hi.","title":"Sabbath huvau Dokna (Mark 2:23-28 ; Luke 6:1-5)","ref":"Thkna 23:25"},"2":{"text":"Pharisee te in hi bang a ngamtat uh a mu ciangin Jesus munah, “En in, Sabbath ni in na nungzuite hi bangin a ngamtat sia ih thukham taw kileebul hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Jesus in, “David le a mite a ngilkial uh laitak a ngamtatna thu a ki atte sim ngeingawl nu ziam?","ref":"1 Sa 21:1-6"},"4":{"text":"Ama in Pathian inn sungah a mite taw tum in, amate neak tu a kilawm ngawl thiampite bek neak tu kilawm anluum thiangtho a neakna thu sim ngeingawl nu ziam?","ref":"Thiam 24:9"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahibuale thiampite in Sabbath sim ma in Biakinn sungah Sabbath thukham khial napi in, mawsakna a nga tuan ngawlna thu Moses thukham sungah sim ngeingawl nu ziam?","ref":"Mi 28:9-10"},"6":{"text":"A tatakin kong ci ciang, hi sungah Biakinnpi sangin a lianzaw khat om nginge hi."},"7":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, ‘Thuthiamna ka dei a, sangaw biaknate ka dei bua hi,’ a ci sia he tatak hi le uhte, a maw ngawl khat sia mawsak lalai ngawl tu nu hi.","ref":"Mt 9:13; Hos 6:6"},"8":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Mihing Tapa sia Sabbath ii Topa ahi hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jesus in tua mun nusia in Synagogue inn khat ah pai hi.","title":"Pasal Khut langzaw Khat (Mark 3:1-6 ; Luke 6:6-11)"},"10":{"text":"Tua munah pasal khat sia khut langkhat zaw in om hi. Mihing pawlkhat in, Jesus ii ngamtat khialna encik in, a maw natu zong nuam ahikom hi bangin dongh uh hi, “Sabbath ni in ciina damsak tu sia ih thukham taw kileebul ziam?” ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesus in, “Note sungah mihing khat in tuu khat nei le a, tua tuu sia Sabbath ni in dum sungah taaksuk le ama in dum sungah zamh suk in pusua ngawl tu ziam?","ref":"Lk 14:5"},"12":{"text":"Mihing sia tuu khat sangin manh neizaw pek hi! Tua ahiciang ih thukham in, Sabbath ni in mihing khat pawpo ih hu tu sia hong oai hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua zawkciang a khutzawpa ii munah, “Na khut vaan in,” ci hi. Ama in a khut vaan a, a khut langkhat sang bangma in, a khut dam thiang hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin Pharisee te pusuak in Jesus a thalup thei natu vaihawm uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Jesus in ama a kithasawmna thu a zaak ciangin, tua mun panin ama mundang zuan a, mihon tam mama in zui uh hi. Ama in ciina theampo damsak hi.","title":"Pathian Teal sa Naseampa"},"16":{"text":"Tuaciangin, kei thu kuama munah son heak vun, ci in thupia hi."},"17":{"text":"Hi bangin a vawtna sia kamsaangpa Isaiah ii a sonkhol sa teng a taangtut natu ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"“Hi sungah ka tealsa ka naseampa om hi. Ka lung hong kimsak ka itpa ahi hi. ama tungah ka Thaa ka pia suk tu a, tuaciang ama in, ka thukhenna minam tuatuamte tungah thangsak tu hi.","ref":"Is 42:1-4"},"19":{"text":"Ama in thu nial ngawl tu a, a au buatu hi. Lampi lian tungah au vazakin thu a son buatu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in a kikuaikhum sa pumpa a thiaktan buatu a, a mit dek tak meiinn zongh a mit buatu hi. Ama in thutang khenna ii zawna a ngasak dong hanciam tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaciang ama ii tungah minam theampo in lametna nei tu hi”."},"22":{"text":"Tua zawkciang mihing pawlkhat in Jesus kungah doai a vei hu in mittaw a, a pau thei ngawl pasal khat hong paipui uh hi. Khuamu thei a, a pau thei natu in, Jesus in damsak hi.","title":"Jesus le Beelzebul (Mark 3:20-30 ; Luke 11:14-23)"},"23":{"text":"Jesus sep teng a mu uh ciang mipite in lamdang sa uh hi. Amate in, “David tapa hi takpi tu ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Pharisee te in hi thu a zaak uh ciang “Doaite a ukpa Beelzebul in ama ii vaangletna pia a tua hu in doaite notkeak thei hi thong zam,” ci uh hi.","ref":"Mt 9:34; 10:25"},"25":{"text":"Jesus in amate khua ngaisutnate tel ahikom amate tungah, “Ngam khat pawpo pawl tuatuamin kikhen hen a, kidawdo le tua ngam a kip ngei buatu hi. Khuapi khat ahizong innkuan khat ahizong, pawl tuatuamin kikhenin, kihau siasua le a kitamhtham tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom Satan ngamsung zongh ah pawl tuam khat in, a dang pawltuam dangkhatte do in a om uh le Satan ngam a kikhen tham hi zo a, hai ngawlin zaantham tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Beelzebul hong piak vaangletna taw doaite notkeak hi hong ci nu hi. Pha hi, tua ahile na nungzuite akua in doai nawkeak theina vaang pia ziam? Na nungzuite ngamtatna panin, na khial hunlam kitel hi!"},"28":{"text":"Hi ngawl hi. Doai nawkeak natu vaangletna hong pia sia Beelzebul hi ngawl a Pathian Thaa ahi hi. Tua ahikom hi thu mama in, Pathian Ngam sia note tungah hong theng zo hi,” ci in kitelsak hi."},"29":{"text":"“Kuama in mihing thahatpa inn sungah tumin, a neisa ol takin a laaksak thei bua hi, tua mihing a thahatpa sia a letheen cip phot kul hi. A letheen zawkciang bekma in, a inn kiphuul thei pheang tu hi."},"30":{"text":"“Khat pawpo kei sang a hong pang ngawl sia in kei hong langpan pa ahi hi; khat pawpo hong kaikhawm pui ngawl sia in, a thezau tatak pa ahi hi.","ref":"Mk 9:40"},"31":{"text":"Hi thu hangin kong ci in ah, mihingte mawna le kamsia paunate kimaisak thei hi; ahizong Thaa Thiangtho sonsiate kimaisak zo ngawl tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Mihing Tapa a sonsiate kimaisak thei hi; ahihang Thaa Thiangtho a sonsiate tu hun ahizong, maisang a tawntung ahizong kimaisak ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Lk 12:10"},"33":{"text":"“Thingnga pha a pian natu in, thingkung ciidam kul hi; thingkung ciidam ngawlte panin thingnga mannung ngawlte piang hi. Thingkungte a nga panin kihe hi.","title":"Thingkung khat le A nga thu (Luke 6:43-45)","ref":"Mt 7:20; Lk 6:44"},"34":{"text":"No ngul ngilo suante awng — mihing ngilote na hi uh ciang, bangbangin thupha son thei tu nu ziam? Banghang ziam cile thinsung pan a, a dimleet teng sia kam panin kipau ahi hi.","ref":"Mt 3:7; 23:33; 15:18; Lk 3:7; 6:45"},"35":{"text":"Mihing phate in a thinsung a ngaisutna pha a kholsa te sung panin pau uh a; mihing ngilote in a thinsung thusia a kholte panin kamsia pau hi."},"36":{"text":"“A tatakin kong ci ciang, Thukhenna Ni ciangin, mihing sim in, phattuamna hong pia ngawl kammal khat a paute tungtawnin, thusitna thuak tu hi."},"37":{"text":"Noma kammalte mama in, na maw uh le na tan uh thu hong khen tu hi.”"},"38":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin Thukham hil syate le Pharisee te pawlkhat in, “Syapa awng, nalamdang lakna na vawt ka mu nuam uh hi,” ci hi.","title":"Nalamdang khat Ngetna (Mark 8:11-12 ; Luke 11:29-32)","ref":"Mt 16:1; Mk 8:11; Lk 11:16"},"39":{"text":"Jesus in, “Tu hun mihingte sia, bangzata in sia a, Pathian nei ngawl ziam! Nalamdang lakna hong ngen na hi uh ziam? Hong pia ngawl tu khi hi! No tung a hong kipia tu nalamdang lakna in kamsaangpa Jonah, nalamdang lakna sia bek hi tu hi.","ref":"Mt 16:4; Mk 8:12"},"40":{"text":"Jonah in sun thum le zan thum ngasa lian ii ngil sungah a om bangin, Mihing Tapa zongh sun thum le zan thum leithukna sungah om tu hi.","ref":"Jn 1:17"},"41":{"text":"Thukhenna Ni ciangin Nineveh khua mite hong ding tu a, note hong mawsak tu hi, banghang ziam cile amate in Jonah thuhilna a zaak uh ciangin a mawna uh pan kisiik kik hi; a maan tak kong ci ciang in hi sungah Jonah sangin a lianzaw khat om hi.","ref":"Jn 3:5"},"42":{"text":"Thukhenna Ni ciangin, Sheba kumpinu zongh hong ding tu a, note hong mawsak tu hi, banghang ziam cile, ama in a khuala mama ngam pek pan in, Solomon kumpipa ciimna taw thuhilna ngai tu in khual hong haw hi; a maan tak kong ci ciangin, hi lai ah Solomon kumpipa sangin a lianzaw khat om hi.","ref":"1 Kum 10:1-10; 2 Khang 9:1-12"},"43":{"text":"“Mihing khat sung pan doai ngilo khat sia a pusua ciang a tawlngak natu zongin, munko ngawtaakna ngam ah vak kawkoai hi.","title":"Thaa Ngilo hong Heak kikna (Luke 11:24-26)"},"44":{"text":"A mu ngawl ciang, ‘Ka inn zuan kik ka heu tong,’ ama le ama kici a, a inn ah a cia kik le a inn awng a, kipua thiang sa in a om mu hi."},"45":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin ama pusuak in, ama sangin a siazaw lai doai a dang sali hong tumpui a, tua munah teang uh hi. A tawpna ah tua doai ii teenna mihing sia a kipat lai sangin lawmawk zaw hi. Tu lai mihing siate tungah hi bangma piang tu hi,” ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Jesus in mihonpite thu a hil laitakin, A nu le a suapuipate hong theng hi. Amate in paupui nuam in doipua ah ding uh hi.","title":"Jesus Nu le A Suapuipate (Mark 3:31-35 ; Lk 8:19-21)"},"47":{"text":"Tua munah a om mihing khat in ama munah “En in! Na nu le na suapuipate in hong paupui nuamin doipua panin hong ngak hi,” ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Jesus in, “Ka nu akua ziam? Ka suapuite akua teng ziam?” ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuaciang, a nungzuite kawkin, “En vun! hite sia ka nu le ka suapuipate ahi uh hi."},"50":{"text":"Vantung ah ka Pa deina bang a ngamtate sia ka suapuipa, ka suapuinu le ka nu ahi hi,” ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni ma in Jesus inn pan pusuak in, tuili hui ah to a, thuhilna nei hi.","title":"Thaicii Poaipa Thusonteena (Mark 4:1-9 ; Luke 8:4-8)"},"2":{"text":"A kiim ah hong kikhawm mihonpite tam mama ahikom, hilna nei tu in ama ngunkuang tungah to a, mipite vaalbo ah ding uh hi.","ref":"Lk 5:1-3"},"3":{"text":"Ama in thu tam mama a son natu in, thusonteenate zangh hi. “Khatvei lai in, pasal khat sia thaicii poai tu in kuan hi."},"4":{"text":"Lo sungah thaiciite a poai ciangin, thaicii pawlkhat sia lamzin tungah taakin, vacimte pai a, ne siat uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Thaicii pawlkhat suang tam, lei daina ah taak hi. Tawmvei sungin thaicii po hi, banghang ziam cile lei thuk ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang ni a sat ciangin ankung note kaanghlum hi; zung thuk tha ngawl ahikom, ankungte ko ngawtaak cip hi."},"7":{"text":"Thaicii pawlkhat lingphung sungah taak a, tua lingte khangin ankungte deapcip hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang thaicii pawlkhat lei phana ah taakin, ankungte hui a; a kung pawlkhat ii tung pan a zaa zakhat, pawlkhat a zaa sawmluk, pawlkhat a zaa sawmthum in nga hi.”"},"9":{"text":"“Bil nei po in za tavun!” ci in Jesus in a thuson khup hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaciangin nungzuite Jesus kungah pai a, “Mihingte tungah thu na son ciangin, banghangin thusonteena veu taw thuson ni ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi.","title":"Thusonteena ii Deina (Mark 4:10-12 ; Luke 8:9-10)"},"11":{"text":"Jesus in, “Vantung ngam thuku sia note tungah hong kipia hi; ahihang amate tungah kipia ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile neisa khat po a nei kholte tungah kipia thua tu hi, tam seseam a nei natu in, kipia thua tu hi; ahihang bangma a nei ngawl khat tung panin a nei sun teng zongh, kilaaksak tu hi.","ref":"Mt 25:29; Mk 4:25; Lk 8:18; 19:26"},"13":{"text":"Amate tungah thusonteena taw thu ka son sia, banghang ziam cile, amate in en ahihang mu ngawl a, ngai ahihang za ngawlin tel ngawl uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Isaiah sonkholna sia amate tungah kibul thei hi; ‘Hi mihingte in ngangai ahihang tel ngawl tu hi. Amate in e en ahihang mu ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Is 6:9-10"},"15":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile amate thin bulthu zo a, a bil uh kihu cip zo in, a mit uh si cip zo uh hi. Tua ahibuale a mittang uh taw mu tu a, a bil uh taw za tu a, a thinsung taw tel tu uh hi. Tuaciang kei kungah hong zuan tu uh hi. Tuasia ciangin amate ka damsak tu hi, Pathian in ci hi.’"},"16":{"text":"“Note na hi uh le bangza in hampha nu ziam! Hi thutak sia mihing chi le sa sung pan nang tung a hong pai ahi bua a, vantung a ka Pa kung pan in, hong kipia thu ahi hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"“Tuaciang, a maan takin kong ci ciang, Peter awng: nang sia suangpi na hi hi, tuaciangin, hi suangpi phungkawng tungah ka pawlpi ka phut tu a, thina ngawngawn zongh in a zo zo buatu hi."},"19":{"text":"Vantung ngam tawtangte nang kong pia tu a, leitung a na khakte vantung ah kikhak tu a, leitung a na honte vantung ah kihon tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 18:18; Jn 20:23"},"20":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, ama sia Messiah ahi hunlam kuama munah a son ngawl natu in a nungzuite munah thupia hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hun panin kipan a nungzuite munah Jesus in thiang takin son a, “Jerusalem ah ka pai kul tu a, upate, thiampi liante le Thukham hil syate tung panin, nasia takin thuak tu khi hi. Hong kithatlum tu a, ahihang, ni thum zawkciang, nuntakna sungah hong kiphongto kik tu hi,” ci hi.","title":"Jesus in A Thuak natu le A Thi natu Sonkhol (Mark 8:31—9:1 ; Luke 9:22-27)"},"22":{"text":"Peter in Jesus sia samtuamin teih hi. “Topa awng, tuabangin na thuak tu sia Pathian in hong khaam tahen! Tuabang peuma in, nang tungah hong piang heak hen!” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesus kingeilee in, Peter munah, “Kei kung panin tai in, Satan awng! Nang sia kei mai hong khaktan na hi hi, banghang ziam cile hi khua ngaisutnate sia Pathian kung panin hong pai hi ngawlin, mihing pianzia sung pan hong pai ahi hi,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jesus in a nungzuite munah, “Khat po in kei hong zui nuam le ama le ama kinial in, a thinglamtee pua in, ka nung hong zui tahen.","ref":"Mt 10:38; Lk 14:27"},"25":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, a nuntakna a huu nuam sia in taan tu a, ahihang kei hu a, a nuntakna a taan sia in nuntakna mu tu hi.","ref":"Mt 10:39; Lk 17:33; Jn 12:25"},"26":{"text":"Mihing khat in leitung theampo a nga zonghin, ama nuntakna a taan le bang meetna nei tu ziam? Meet ngawl tu hi! Ama nuntakna a nga kiksak natu a piak thei khat zongh om ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Mihing Tapa in Pa vaangletna le a vantunglalangte taw hong pai ciangin, ama in mihing khat sim ii a sepna babangin thaman pia tu hi.","ref":"Mt 25:31; Ps 62:12; Rom 2:6"},"28":{"text":"A tatak kong ci ciang, hi lai ah a om mihing pawlkhatte ahile, Mihing Tapa Kumpipa in hong pai a mu mateng in a thi buatu hi,” ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni luk zawkciang Jesus in Peter, James le John te unau samin mual tungah paipui to a tua munah amate teng nguak om uh hi.","title":"Jesus Meal Kikhealna (Mark 9:2-13 ; Luke 9:28-36)","ref":"2 Pe 1:17-18"},"2":{"text":"Amate mu tangin meal kikhealna sia Jesus tungah hong piang hi: a maitang sia ni bangin taang a, a puansilhte sia tee velvol hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jesus sia Moses le Elijah taw thu son khawmin a om uh nungzui thumte in mu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom Peter in, “Topa hi munah ih om sia bangza in nuam ziam? Na uuk le nang atu buk khat, Moses atu buk khat, le Elijah atu buk khat, puanbuk thum kong saksak tu uh hi,” Jesus munah ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuabangin a pau laitakin, a taang meeikaai khat in amate teng tuam a tuaciangin meeikaai sung panin awnging khat in, “Hi sia in ka it ka Tapa hi a, ama tungah ka lungkim hi; a thu na ngai tavun,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 22:2; Thkna 18:15; Ps 2:7; Is 42:1; Mt 3:17; 12:18; Mk 1:11; Lk 3:22"},"6":{"text":"Nungzuite in tua aw a zaak uh ciangin, amate sia lau mama ahikom lei ah bokcip uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate kungah Jesus hong pai in, amate tham in, “Tho vun, lau heak vun!” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in a et uh ciang Jesus simngawl kuama dang a mu bua uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Mual tung pan hong tuaksuk kawmin Jesus in, “Mihing Tapa sia thina pan a kithawsak kik mateng hi mukholna sia kuama tungah son heak vun,” ci in thupia hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaciang nungzuite in Jesus tungah, “Thukham hil syate in Elijah hong pai masa tu hi banghangin ci ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi.","ref":"Mal 4:5"},"11":{"text":"Jesus in, “Elijah sia hong pai masa takpi tu hi, tuaciang in ama in na theampo kithoai sa in koi tu hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"“A tatakin ka ci ciang, Elijah hong pai zo a, ahihang mihingte in ama tel ngawl ahikom, ama tungah a uuk uh bang tek po in, ngamta uh hi. Tuasia bangma in, amate in Mihing Tapa zongh vawtsia tu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 11:14"},"13":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin a nungzuite in ama sia Tuiphumpa John huvau son hi ta a, ci in tel uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihonpite kungah amate hong heaksuk kik zawkciangin pasal khat Jesus kungah pai a, a mai ah khupdin in,","title":"Jesus in Doaivei Patang khat Damsak (Mark 9:14-29 ; Luke 9:37-43)"},"15":{"text":"“Topa, ka tapa hong hesuaksak ta'n! Ama butthi thei a, kaikin in, mei sungah ahibuale tui sungah puksuk thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Na nungzuite kungah ka paipui uh hangin, amate in damsak thei ngawl uh hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"“Bangza ta in upna nei ngawlin a khial mihingte hi nu ziam! No taw bang tan vei hong omkhawm tu khi ziam? A bang tanvei hong dual zo tu khi ziam? Patang sia keima kungah hong paipui tavun!” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Jesus in doai tungah thupia a, tuasia ciangin patang sung pan doai pusuak a, tua hun lian ma in a patang sia dam hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate nguakin a om laitak, nungzuite Jesus kungah hong pai a, “Banghangin doai hi sia notkeak thei ngawl khu ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Jesus in, “Banghang ziam cile noma in upna kicing nei ngawl nu hi. A tatakin kong ci ciang, ankamhtang cia upna nei hi le uhte hi mual munah, ‘Hi sung panin zialai ah kikhiin in,’ ci in sawl le uhte kikhiin tu hi. Na khat pawpo na vawt thei tu uh hi.","ref":"Mt 21:21; Mk 11:23; 1 Cor 13:2"},"21":{"text":"Thungetna le an tanna in, hite pawl notkeak zo bek a, nadang in notkeak zo ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Nungzuite theampo Galilee ah hong kikhop uh ciangin, Jesus in amate tungah, “Mihing Tapa sia mihingte khut sungah thalup tu in ki aap dektak zo hi.","title":"Jesus in A thi natu Son kik (Mark 9:30-32 ; Luke 9:43-45)"},"23":{"text":"Tua mihingte in ama sia thatlum tu hi. Ahihang ni thum zawkciangin ama nuntakna sungah kiphongto kik tu hi,” ci hi. Nungzuite sia khuangai mama uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Capernaum khua ah Jesus le a nungzuite hong thet uh ciangin, Biakinn atu shiadongte hong pai a, Peter munah, “Na syapa in Biakinn atu shia a pia ziam?” ci in dongh hi.","title":"Biakinn atu Shia Piakna","ref":"Pu 30:13; 38:26"},"25":{"text":"“Pia hi,” ci in Peter in zo hi. Peter inn sungah a tum zawkciang, Jesus pau masa a “Simon awng, nang ngaisutna bangbang ahi ziam? Hi leitung kumpite tungah akua bangte in sum zuakna tung pan shia pia ziam? Ngamsung mite in pia ziam maw ngamdangmite in pia ziam?” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"“Ngamdangmite in pia hi,” Peter in ci hi. “Pha hi, tua ahile ngamsung mite in piak kul ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahihang mihingte thin uuksak nuam bua hing. Tua ahikom tuili ah va pai ta'n a, ngasa tangthaak ta'n. Ngasa a awk phitbel sia manin, a kam sung en lete, dangkatang khat om tu hi. Biakinn shia piak tu in kei atu le nang atu kicing tu hi. Va la ta'n a, ih shiate amate va pia ta'n,” ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin a nungzuite sia Jesus kungah hong pai a, “Vantung ngam sungah akua lianbel ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi.","title":"Akua Lianbel Ziam? (Mark 9:33-37 ; Luke 9:46-48)","ref":"Lk 22:24"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jesus in patang khat samin, amate mai ah dingsak a,"},"3":{"text":"“A tatakin kong ci ciang kikheal in patangte bang na suak bua uh le Vantung ngam sungah na tum thei buatu uh hi.","ref":"Mk 10:15; Lk 18:17"},"4":{"text":"Vantung ngam sungah a lianbel sia in, ama le ama kiniamkhiak a, hi patang bang ahite ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaciangin hi bang patang khat kei min taw a saangte in, keima hong saang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"“Mihing khat po in patang khat ii kei hong upna a lalsak le, tua pa ngawng ah an ngoaina suangpheak kikhii in tuipi thukna sungah kikhiasuk le phazaw hi.","title":"Maw natu Ze etna (Mark 9:42-48, Luke 17:1-2)"},"7":{"text":"Mihingte upna a lalsak thei nate om ahikom, hi leitung atu bangza in kiitakhuai ziam? Tuabangte sia hong piang tawntung tu hi, ahihang tuabang a piangsakte atu in, bangza in lauhuai ziam?"},"8":{"text":"“Na khut ahibuale na peang in, na upna hong taansak le saattan in vawk in! Tawntung meikuang sungah khutcing peangcing hong kibum sangin, nuntakna sungah khutsamh peangsamh in tum lete phazaw hi.","ref":"Mt 5:30"},"9":{"text":"Tuaciang mittang khat in na upna hong taansak le, khelkeak in vawk in! Hell meikuang sungah mittangte ngeal taw hong kibumsuk sangin mittang langkhat sel in, nuntakna sungah tum lete nang atu in, phazaw hi.","ref":"Mt 5:29"},"10":{"text":"“Hi patang khat po na zawnsak ngawl natu in, na kidawm vun. Amate ii vantunglalangte sia ka Pa omna munah om tek nginge hi, ci in hong son ka hi hi.","title":"A Bo Tuu Thusonteena (Luke 15:3-7)"},"11":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Mihing Tapa sia a bote hun tu in hong pai ahi hi.","ref":"Lk 19:10"},"12":{"text":"“Mihing khat in tuu zakhat a nei sung pan, tuu khat a bosua sia in bang law tu in na um uh ziam? Ama in a om lai tuu sawmkua le kua mual tungah taasakin nusia a, a bosua tuu sia zong tu in kuan hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in tua tuu a bosua sia a mu ciangin, a bo ngawl sawmkua le kua tungah a lungdamna sangin, hi a bosua tuu khat tungtaang ah lungdam zaw tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuabang ma in vantung a na Pa in, hi patangte khat po a bo tu sia a oai bua hi."},"15":{"text":"“Na suapuipa in nang tungah hong khial le, va pai ta'n a, ama khialna teng lak ta'n. Noma tuamin kilemtua tavun. Na thu hong ni a ahile na suapuipa na nga kik zo hi.","title":"Hong khial Suapuipa Khat","ref":"Lk 17:3"},"16":{"text":"Ahihang hong ni nuam buale, ngualdang khat le nii mai ah son pui in, tua hile laithiangtho ci bangin, ‘na mawsakna teng sia mihing nii le a tamzaw in tetti in hong pang tu hi.’","ref":"Thkna 19:15"},"17":{"text":"Tuaciangin amate zongh in, a sonpui thei bua lai le, pawlpi bup mai ah a vekpi in son siat tavun. Pawlpi thu zongh a ni nuam bua ahile, ama sia doai biate khat bang ahizong, shiadongpa bang ahizong ngaisun tavun."},"18":{"text":"“Tua ahikom na vekpi tungah hong ci khi hi: leitung ah na kha uhte vantung zongh ah kikhak tu hi; leitung ah na hon uhte vantung zongh ah kihon tu hi.","title":"Khana le Honna","ref":"Mt 16:19; Jn 20:23"},"19":{"text":"“Thudang kong son lai natu panin, mihing nii in leitung ah na khat pawpo tungtaang ah thukim in thu a ngen uh le, vantung ka Pa in hong vawtsak tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ka min taw nii le thum kikhopna sungah amate taw ka omkhawm hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaciang Peter in Jesus kungah pai a, “Topa, ka suapuipa in ka tungah hong khial kikik le bang tanvei maisak tu khi ziam? Salivei dong ziam?” ci hi.","title":"Mawmaisak ngawl Naseampa Thusonteena","ref":"Lk 17:3-4"},"22":{"text":"“Salivei dong hi ngawlin, sali mun sawmsalivei dong, maisak in,” Jesus in ci hi."},"23":{"text":"“Banghang ziam cile Vantung ngam sia hi bang ahi hi. Khatvei lai in kumpipa khat in a naseamte sazian sit tu in khensat hi."},"24":{"text":"Hi bangin vawt tu a kipat ciangin, amate sung panin, talen awn tam mama leiba nei khat hong kipaipui hi."},"25":{"text":"Naseampa in a liau tu sum nei ngawl hi. Tua ahikom Kumpipa in, tua pa ii zi taw a tate taw a neisa theampo taw sila a zuak tu in thupia hi. A leiba kilo natu ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Kumpipa mai ah naseampa khupdin hi. ‘Thinsau takin hong ngak lai ta'n, kong bat theampo hong lo kik tu khi zam,’ ci in ngen hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa zongh in ama sia khuangaihuai sa in, a leiba teng maisakin ciasak hi."},"28":{"text":"“Tuaciangin tua naseampa pusuak in, ama tungah sum tawm a ba naseam dang khat taw kisi uh hi. Tua pa sia manin a tawlsaan a, ‘Sum nong bat teng hong lo ta'n,’ ci hi."},"29":{"text":"A naseppuipa in a mai ah bokin ‘Thinsau takin hong ngak lai ta'n; sum kong bat teng hong lo siat tu khi zam,’ ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahizong ama in za nuam ngawlin, a leiba a lo siat dong thong sungah khum hi."},"31":{"text":"Naseam dangte in, thupiang teng a mu ciangin, a thinnuam ngawlin, kumpipa kungah pai in thupiang theampo son uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in naseampa sam a, ‘Nang a mannung ngawl silapa awng, ka tungah nong bat theampo hong maisak ta'n ci in nong nget hu in, hong maisak siat khi hi."},"33":{"text":"Nang kong hesuak bangin, na naseppuipa na hesuak tu kilawm hi ngawl ziam?’ ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Kumpipa thin uuk mama a, naseampa in ama tungah a bat theampo a lo siat dong thongtaak tu in puak hi,” ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Jesus in a thukhupna ah, “Na thin tak taw na suapuipa na maisak buale vantung ah a om ka Pa in mihing sim tungah tuabangin hong vawt tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus in hi teng a ci zawkciang, Galilee ngam nusia in Jordan ngun ngalkhat Judea ngam ah pai hi.","title":"Jesus in Nupa Kikhulna huvau Thuhil (Mark 10:1-12)"},"2":{"text":"Mihonpi in zui a, tua munah amate damsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Pharisee te pawlkhat in, ama aitaa nuam ahikom hi bangin dongh uh hi. “Pasal khat in a zi sia bang thu po taw ahizong a khul nuam le khul thei hi ci thu, ih thukham in a oai ziam?” ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"“A kipatciil in Bitphuapa in mihing sia pa khat le numei khat vawt hi, ci in a ki at laithiangtho sia sim ngeingawl nu ziam?","ref":"Pian 1:27; 5:2"},"5":{"text":"Tuaciangin hi thu hangin, ‘Pasal in a pa le a nu nusia tu a, a zi taw kingawm in, amate ngeal sia khat suak tu hi,’ Pathian in ci hi.","ref":"Pian 2:24"},"6":{"text":"“Tua ahikom amate sia nii hi nawn ngawlin khat suak hi. Tua ahikom Pathian ii ngawmsa sia mihing in khen thei ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Pharisee te in, “Tua ahile banghang Moses in, Pasal in a zi a khul le kikhulna lai pia tahen, ci in thukham vawt ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:1-4; Mt 5:31"},"8":{"text":"Jesus in, “Moses in zi khul thei natu thu hong pia hi, banghang ziam cile noma sia hil hak mama nu hi. Ahihang bitphua ciil hunin tuabang thu om ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"A tatakin kong ci ciang, pasal khat in a zi sia, vaang kitan ngawlna simngawl, thudang taw a khul a, numei dang a teenpui le ama in palngul mawna vawt ahi hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 5:32; 1 Cor 7:10-11"},"10":{"text":"A nungzuite in ama tungah, “Pasal le zi kilaklaw ah ngamtat natu sia tu a bang ahi thong le kiteang bualeang phazaw hi,” ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesus in, “Hi kihilna sia mihing theampo atu kici ngawl a, Pathian ii piakte atu bek hi:"},"12":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile pate ii zi a nei thei ngawl natu thu tam mama om hi; pawlkhat sia a nei thei ngawl tu in piang hi; pawlkhat sia ngual in tuabang tu ma in vawt hi; tuaciang pawlkhat in Vantung ngam thu hangin nei ngawl hi. Hi kihilna a saang theite in, tuabangin ngamta tahen,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhat in patangte tungah khut nga a, thungetsak tu in Jesus kungah paipui uh hi; ahihang nungzuite in tua mihingte teih hi.","title":"Jesus in Patangnote Thupha pia (Mark 10:13-16 ; Luke 18:15-17)"},"14":{"text":"Jesus in, “Patangte ka kungah hong pai tahen, khaam heak vun, banghang ziam cile Vantung ngam sia tuabangte atu ahi hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate tungah a khut nga a tua zawkciangin paisan hi."},"16":{"text":"Khatvei lai in Jesus kungah pasal khat hong pai hi. “Sya awng, tawntung nuntakna nga natu in, bang nasep pha ka seam tu ziam?” ci in Jesus dongh hi.","title":"Sumhau Khangnopa (Mark 10:17-31 ; Luke 18:18 -30)"},"17":{"text":"“A banghangin naphate huvau kei tungah hong dongh ni ziam? A pha khat bekma om hi. Nuntakna sungah na tum nuam le thupiakte tang in,” Jesus in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in “A bang thupiakte ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Jesus in “Mihing that heak in, palngul mawna vawt heak in, ngu heak in, leilot thu taw ngual suanhkhial heak in;","ref":"Pu 20:13; Thkna 5:17-20"},"19":{"text":"na pa le na nu zakta in, nangma le nangma na ki it bangin na innpaamte zongh it in,” ci in zo kik hi.","ref":"Pu 20:12; Thkna 5:16; Thiam 19:18"},"20":{"text":"“Hi thupiakte theampo ka zui siat sa hi,” khangnopa in ci hi. “A dang bang ka sep tu kul lai ziam?” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Jesus in ama munah, “Na cialcing nuam le, va pai ta'n a, na neisa theampo zuak in, sum na nga teng a zawngte pia ta'n, tua hile vantung ah na hau tu hi; tua zawkciang ka nung hong zui ta'n,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Khangnopa in hi thu teng a zaak ciangin khuangai in paisan hi, banghang ziam cile ama hau mama hi."},"23":{"text":"Jesus in a nungzuite munah “A tatakin ka ci ciang sumhaute Vantung ngamsung a thet tu sia haksa mama tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Kong ci kik hi: kalaoh khat phin bilvang sungah a tum tu sangin sumhaute Pathian Ngam sungah a tum tu sia haksa zaw lai hi,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Nungzuite in hi thu a zaak uh ciangin, amate lungmang mama uh hi. “Tuabang hi thong le akua peuma ngupna nga thei tu ziam?” ci uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Jesus in amate tangtan in en a, “Mihing atu in suak thei ngawl ahihang Pathian atu na khat pawpo suak thei hi,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaciang Peter in, “En in, na theampo nusia in nang hong zui khu hi, bang ka nga tu uh ziam?” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Jesus in, “A maan takin kong ci hi. David in,"},"44":{"text":"‘Topa in ka Topa munah: Na ngalte na peang nuai ah ka koi dong, hi sung ka ziatsang ah hong to ta'n,’ ci hi.","ref":"Ps 110:1"},"45":{"text":"“David in ama sia ‘Topa’ ci ahile Messiah sia bangbangin, David ii suan hi thei tu ziam?” ci in Jesus in zo kik hi."},"46":{"text":"Jesus dokna kuama in a zo thei bua uh a, tua ni pan kipan kuama in ama thu a dongh ngam nawn bua uh hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang Jesus in mipite tung le nungzuite tungah thu son hi.","title":"Jesus in Thukham hil Syate le Pharisee te pan Kidop natu Hil (Mark 12:38-39 ; Luke 11:43 , 46 ; 20:45-46)"},"2":{"text":"“Thukham hil syate le Pharisee te sia Moses Thukham a pheen thei tu, thu neite ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in vawt a hong sawl peuma ni in zui vun; ahihang amate ngamtatnate zui heak vun, banghang ziam cile amate in a hil uh bangin ngamta ngawl uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihingte ii nungzaang ah vanhngit a puak hakte sia tua mite ma ii sot to ahi hi, ahihang amate in tua vanhngitte puakpui tu in, a khutme dawn zongh a tung nuam bua uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihingte mu tu in amate in na theampo seam uh hi. Note atu in bangza in lauhuai ziam? No a kihitheamsakte awng! Ngual mai panin, vantung Ngam kongkha khaktan nu hi, tuaciang noma mama in a sungah na tum bua uh a, tum nuam in a hanciamte zongh, a tum tu na oai bua uh hi!","title":"Jesus in Amate Kihi theamsaknate Mawsiat (Mark 12:40 ; Luke 11:39-42 , 44 , 52 ; 20:47)"},"14":{"text":"Thukham hil syate le Pharisee te awng! No atu in bangza lauhuai ziam? A kihitheamsakte awng! Meingongte na zothaw uh a, a inn uh na phuul uh hi. Tua zawkciang na thunget a sau mama in na kivawt tawm uh hi! Tua hu in daan na thuak tu sia nasia mama tu hi!"},"15":{"text":"“Thukham hil syate le Pharisee te awng! No a kihitheamsakte awng! No atu in bangza in lauhuai ziam? Nang in kamsaangte na thatlum a, Pathian kamtaite suangtum taw na hua hi. Akpui in aknote a thakhui nuai ah a uap bangin, bang tanvei na mihingte angvan nuam khi ziam? ahihang na oai bua hi!","title":"Jesus ii Jerusalem A itna (Luke 13:34-35)"},"38":{"text":"Tua ahikom Biakinn sia kitaisan tu a, a hawm in om tu hi.","ref":"Jer 22:5"},"39":{"text":"Hong ci khi hi; tu pan kipan, ‘Topa min taw hong pai pa sia Pathian in thupha pia tahen,’ na ci uh mateng in, kei nong mu kik nawn buatu hi.” a ci hi.","ref":"Ps 118:26"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biakinn pan Jesus a pusua zawkciang a nungzuite in Biakinn huang sung a inn dangte lak nuam in neak uh hi.","title":"Jesus in Biakinnpi Lalthap natu Son (Mark 13:1-2 ; Luke 21:5-6)"},"2":{"text":"Jesus in, “Hi hi, en tek vun. A tatakin kong ci ciang, hi sungah suangte khat zongh a omna ngei san ah om nawn ngawl tu hi; a vekpi kilawn keak siat tu hi,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Jesus in Olive Mual tungah a to laitakin, a nungzuite ama kungah hong pai tuam uh hi. “Hi thu sia bang hun ciangin hong tung tu a, tuaciang nong pai kik tu hun le hun bo tu hun, a lak tu in bang hong piang tu ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi.","title":"Ngimna le Vawtsiatna (Mark 13:3-13 ; Luke 21:7-19)"},"4":{"text":"Jesus in, “Kidawm tavun, kuama in theamsak heak vun."},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile mihing tam mamate kei min zanghin hong pai tu a, ‘Keima in Messiah ka hi hi’ ci tu a mihing tam mama theam tu hi."},"6":{"text":"A naina ah ngal kidona aw na za tu uh a, a khualana ah ngal kidona thu hong kison tu hi; ahihang patau heak vun. Tuabangte hong piang nanak tu a, ahihang hun bona hong theng zo hi, cina hi ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngam khat le ngam khat kisim tu hi; kumpi khat le khat kido tu hi. Mun theampo ah kialpi tung tu a, zinliing tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Hite theampo sia nautut kipat ciang, a nat bang ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Tua zawkciang note hong kiman tu a, daan piak tu le thalup tu in hong ki aap tu hi. Keima hu in mihing theampo in note hong ngaimaw tu hi.","ref":"Mt 10:22"},"10":{"text":"Mihing tam mama in tua hun ciangin, a upna uh nusia tu hi; amate khat le khat kileeheak tu a, khat le khat kingaimaw tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang leilot kamsaang tam mama piang tu a, mihing tam mama theam tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuabangin siatna hong kizel tu a, mihing tam mamate ki itna kiam tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang a tawp dong a thumaante kingum tu hi.","ref":"Mt 10:22"},"14":{"text":"Tuaciangin, hi Kumpingam Lungdamna Thupha sia, leitung theampo ah tetti tu in minam theampo tungah kihil kawkoai tu hi; tua zawkciang hun bona hong theng tu hi."},"15":{"text":"“Kamsaangpa Daniel ii son ‘A kiitakhuai mama sia’ na mu tu uh hi. Ahitazong a tealtuam mihingte atu in Pathian in a ni khiam tu hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tuasia ciang khat po in, ‘En in, hi sungah Messiah om hi!’ ci in ahizong, ‘Zia sungah om hi!’ ci in ahizong hong cile um heak vun."},"24":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Messiah theam le kamsaang theamte hong piang tu hi; hi thei hile Pathian tealsa mihingte ngawngawn a theam natu in, amate in nalamdang lakna liante le a tumdang nate tam mama hong vawt tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Ngai vun! a hun hong thet ma in hong sonkhol zo khi hi."},"26":{"text":"“Tua ahibuale mihingte in, ‘En vun, ama sia sennealngam sungah om hi!’ hong cile zong, tua munah pai heak vun; tua ahibuale ‘En vun, ama sia hi sungah buu hi,’ hong cile zong na um heak vun.","ref":"Lk 17:23-24"},"27":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Mihing Tapa sia van buppi ah nisuana pan nitumna dong a kaantan khualeng taang bangin hong pai tu hi."},"28":{"text":"“Mithi luang omna mun po ah vaciikte kikhawmtua tu hi.","ref":"Lk 17:37"},"29":{"text":"“Tua hun ngimnate zawk a hai ngawlin, ni hong taang nawn ngawl tu a, tha zongh taang nawn ngawl tu hi, aksite van panin taaksuk tu a, van ah a om nate sia amate ii zin tek panin kipialsak siat tu hi.","title":"Mihing Tapa hong Paina (Mark 13:24-27 ; Luke 21:25-28)","ref":"Is 13:10; 34:4; Eze 32:7; Jol 2:10,31; 3:15; Tpl 6:12"},"30":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Mihing Tapa ii lim sia van ah hong kilangh tu hi; Mihing Tapa sia van ah meeikaai tung pan vaangletna le minthanna lianpi taw hong pai a mu uh ciangin, leitung mihing theampo kap tu uh hi.","ref":"Dan 7:13; Zec 12:10-14; Tpl 1:7"},"31":{"text":"Lemlepui aw hong nging tu a, tuaciang ama in leimong king lite ah a vantunglalangte sawl in, amate in ama tealsa mite leimong khat pan mong khat dongin khawmtua tu hi."},"32":{"text":"“Theikung in hilsak tavun. A baakte zongh hingin hong moisua ciangin, a teeno meang tu in kithoai a, tuasia ciang khuakhaal hun hong nai hi ci in na he uh hi.","title":"Theikung taw Thuheak theina (Mark 13:28-31 ; Luke 21:29-33)"},"33":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in, hite theampo na mu uh ciangin, a hun hong nai a, hong kipapan zo hi, ci in na he tu uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Tu laitak a nungta mihingte a thi siat ma in, hi thu sia hong piang tu hi ci in phawk tavun."},"35":{"text":"Vantung le simlei a bo tu hi, ahihang ka kammalte a bo ngei buatu hi."},"36":{"text":"“Ahitazong tua a ni le a nai tu sia kuama in he ngawl hi — vantung ah vantung mite ahizong, Tapa ahizong, he ngawl hi; Pa bek in he hi.","title":"Kuama in a Ni le a Nai He ngawl (Mark 13:32-37 ; Luke 17:26-30 ; 34-36)"},"37":{"text":"Mihing Tapa hong pai natu sia Noah hun lai thupiang bang hi tu hi.","ref":"Pian 6:5-8"},"38":{"text":"Tuipi liim ma in mihingte an ne tui dawnin om a, numei le pa kiteangin, Noah ii teambaw sungah a tum tatak ni dong sia tuabangin om uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua hi napi tuiliim a, tui ii a taikeak dongin, bang thu piang ziam ci in amate in a phawk bua uh hi. Mihing Tapa hong pai ciang zong tuabang ma hi tu hi.","ref":"Pian 7:6-24"},"40":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin pasal nii sia lo sungah naseam khawm tu hi: khat kila tu a khat kikhe tu hi."},"41":{"text":"Numei nii an ngoaina ah diang tu hi: khat kila tu a, khat kikhe tu hi."},"42":{"text":"“A kingingta sa in om vun, banghang ziam cile Topa hong pai tu ni sia na he bua uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Inn neipa khat in ngutate ii hong pai hun tu he le, mu ngawlin om tu a, ngutate in inn a phuulsak buatu hi, ci in na heak uh ahi hi.","ref":"Lk 12:39-40"},"44":{"text":"Tua ahiciang no zongh, a tawntung kinging sa in om vun, banghang ziam cile Mihing Tapa in na muanmawk ngawl hun laitakin hong pai tu hi."},"45":{"text":"“Thumaan a, a ciim naseampa sia akua bangte ziam? Ama sia naseam dangte a uk tu le a hun a hun in an a pia tu in a kikoipa ahi hi.","title":"Thumaan Ahibuale Thumaan ngawl Naseampa (Luke 12:41-48)"},"46":{"text":"A topa hong cia laitakin a kisawl bang a naseam hi ci in a topa ii mu naseampa sia bangza in lungdam tu ziam?"},"47":{"text":"A tatakin kong ci ciang, a topa in tua naseampa sia a neisa theampo uk tu in koi tu hi."},"48":{"text":"Ahihang tua naseampa sia a ngina ngawl khat ahile, a topa sia hong cia hak lai vak, ci in ama le ama kitheam tu a,"},"49":{"text":"tuaciangin a nasep khoppui naseam dangte saatin, zukham theite taw, an ne zu ne in om tu hi."},"50":{"text":"Tuaciangin tua naseampa ii topa sia a muanmawk ngawl hun le a heak ngawl ni hun khat ciang hong cia tu hi."},"51":{"text":"A topa in ama sia nasia takin ngim pia tu a, a kihitheamsakte ii thuak tu teng thuaksak tu hi. Tua munah ama sia kap in ha ngoai tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tua hun ciangin Vantung ngam sia hi bang hi tu hi. Hong pai tavun a muak vun,’ ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngaknu sawmte khanglo in a meiinnte puua tek uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A mawmawte in a ciimte munah, ‘Na meitui uh tawm hong hawm tavun, banghang ziam cile ka meiinnte mit tu hi’ ci uh hi."},"9":{"text":"A ciimte in, ‘hi thei mama ngawl hi; no atu le ko atu in kicing ngawl hi. Sumbuk ah pai in lei tavun;’ ci uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom a mawmaw ngaknute sia meitui lei tu in pai uh hi; tuaciang amate pai lanin zineipa hong theng hi. A kinging sa a om ngaknu nga teng sia ama taw kiteenna poai ah sungtang uh a, tuaciang kongkha kikhak hi."},"11":{"text":"“Tua zawkciangin ngaknu dangte hong theng hi. ‘Topa, topa! Tua zawkciang ama sia khualhaw tu in ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Dangka tulnga a kipia naseampa in, thakhat ma in sumvawt in, a dang tulnga ma nga thua hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in dangka tulnii a nga sia zongh in, a dang tulnii ma nga thua hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahihang dangka tulkhat a nga naseampa in pai a, leidum to in, a topa dangka teng phual hi."},"19":{"text":"“A khuangei zawkciang naseamte ii topa hong cia kik a, amate sum tepteena tek sit hi."},"20":{"text":"Dangka tulnga a saang naseampa hong pai a, a dang tulnga ama tungah aap hi. ‘Topa, dangka tulnga hong pia ni hi. En in! Hi sungah dangka tulnga ka meetsak hi,’ ci hi."},"21":{"text":"‘Pha hi, a thumaan naseam pha pa awng, tawmno na zeakna tungah thumaan na hikom, tampi zeakna ah a uk tu in kong koi tu hi. Kei taw lungdam khawm tu in hong pai ta'n!’ ci hi."},"22":{"text":"“Tuaciang tulnii a kipia naseampa hong pai a, ‘Topa, dangka tulnii hong pia ni hi. En in! Hi sungah ka thalaw dangka tulnii om hi,’ ci hi."},"23":{"text":"‘Pha hi, a thumaan naseam pha pa awng! Na tawmno tungah thumaan na hikom, na tampite uk tu in, kong koi tu hi. Kei taw lungdam khawm tu in hong pai ta'n!’ ci hi."},"24":{"text":"“Tuaciang in dangka tulkhat a saang naseampa hong pai a, ‘Topa, nang sia mihing sonham khat na hi hunlam kong he hi; na tuu ngawlna munah a at pa, na poai ngawlna munah anla pa na hi sia kong he hi."},"25":{"text":"Lau ka hikom pai in, lei sungah na sum teng ka phual hi. Hi hi, Pa awng, hi bang tu ma na deina ahi hi,” ci hi.","title":"Jesus Lungdam (Matthew 11:25-27 ; 13:16-17)"},"22":{"text":"“Ka pa in na theampo kei hong pia zo hi. Tapa akua ziam ci sia Pa simngawl kuama in a he bua hi, tuaciang Pa akua ziam ci sia Tapa le Tapa ii heaksak tu in a tealte ngawl po in a he bua hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Jn 3:35; 10:15"},"23":{"text":"Tuaciang Jesus in, a nungzuite sang nga in, hi bangin ci tuam hi, “Na mu uh nate hu in, bangza in hampha nu ziam!"},"24":{"text":"Kei kong cina pan, kamsaang tam mamate le kumpite in, no ii mute mu nuam ahihang mu ngawl uh hi, za nuam ahihang za ngawl uh hi,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Thukham hil sya khat hong pai in Jesus aitaa nuam a, “Sya awng, tawntung nuntakna ka nga natu in bang ka vawt tu ziam?” ci in dongh hi.","title":"Samaria Miphapa taw Thusonteena","ref":"Mt 22:35-40; Mk 12:28-34"},"26":{"text":"Jesus in zo kik a, “Laithiangtho in bang ci ziam, nang tua thu bangbangin na tel ziam” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua pa in zo kik a, “Na Topa Pathian sia na thin theampo, na thaa theampo, na thahatna theampo le na ngaisutna theampo taw na it in. Tuaciangin nangma le nangma na ki it bangma in, na innpaamte na it in,” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:5; Thiam 19:18"},"28":{"text":"Jesus in, “Na ci teng maan hi, tuabangin ngamta lete na nungta tu hi,” ci in zo kik hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:5"},"29":{"text":"Ahihang Thukham hil syapa in, ama le ama kitangsak nuam ahikom, hi bangin Jesus dongh thua hi, “Ka innpaam pa sia akua ziam?” ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Jesus in zo kik a, “Khatvei lai in pasal khat, Jerusalem panin Jericho khua ah a paisuk laitakin, ngual suam phalakte in suam a, a pum tung a om teng sutin, saat zazaan a, a thi dektakin nusia uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Thiampi khat tua lampi tawnsuk luilam ahihang, tua a liampa a mu ciangin, lampi langkhat ah pial in, paisan hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuabang ma in, Levi mi khat hong pai a, mihing liampa a mu ciangin, lam langkhat tawnin paisan hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahihang khualhaw Samaria pa khat hong pai a, mihing liampa a mu ciangin, a thinsung ah hesuakhuai sakna taw kidim hi.","ref":"2 Khang 28:15"},"34":{"text":"Ama kungah zuan a, a liammate sathau le sapittui noisak in, tuamsak hi. Tua zawkciangin, a liampa sia a laa tungah suanhto a, zintun inn khat ah paipui in ou hi."},"35":{"text":"A zing ciangin, ama in ngun dangka pheak nii la in, zin innneipa pia hi. ‘Ama na ousak in. Kong pai kik ciangin, ama tungah na bona dang theampo zongh kong pia tu hi,’ ” ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuaciang Jesus in thukhupna in, “Nang ii ngaisutna ah, tua mihing thumte sung pan akuabel in, mihing suamte ii sukcippa tungah innpaamte ngamtat tu bangin, ngamta na sa ziam?” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Thukham hil syapa in, “Ama tungah a thuthiam sia hi,” ci in zo kik hi. Jesus in, “Tua ahile va pai ta'n a, tuabangin seam ta'n,” ci in zo kik hi."},"38":{"text":"Jesus le a nungzuite a papai uh ciang, khuano khat theng a, Martha a kici numei khat in a inn ah zin do hi.","title":"Jesus in Martha le Mary te Inn ah Haw","ref":"Jn 11:1"},"39":{"text":"Ama in Mary a kici suapuinumei khat nei a, tua nu in Topa peang kungah to in, ama hilnate ngai hi."},"40":{"text":"Martha sia nasep theampo ama ki awn ahikom diksa ngawlin hong pai a, “Topa awng, ka suapuinu in na theampo kei sep tu in, hong nusiat sia samh sa ngawl ni ziam?” Kei hong hu natu in hong sawlsak ta'n!” ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Topa in zo kik a, “Martha, Martha awng, Na tam mama tungah thinngim in buai ni hi."},"42":{"text":"Ahihang a kisamh khat bek om hi. Mary in vawt tu a kilawm sia teal zo hi. Ama tung pan tuasia kilaaksak ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat ni in Jesus in mun khat ah thungen hi. A man ciangin a nungzuite khat in, “Topa awng, John ii a nungzuite a hil bangin, ko zongh thunget natu hong hil ta'n,” ci hi.","title":"Jesus in Thungetzia Hil (Matthew 6:9-13 ; 7:7-11)"},"2":{"text":"Jesus in amate tungah, “Thu na nget uh ciangin hi bangin ci vun: ‘Pa awng, Na min thiangtho ki upat tahen; Na Ngam hong piang tahen,"},"3":{"text":"Ni simin ka khamkhop tu an hong pia ta in,"},"4":{"text":"Ko tung hong khialte ka maisak uh bangma in, kote khialna zongh hong maisak ta in, Ze etna haksa hong thuaksak heak in,’ ” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Jesus in a nungzuite munah, “Sonteena in no sung pan khat in, na lawmte inn khat ah, zankim laitak pai in, ‘Lawm awng, anluum thum hong puk ta'n."},"6":{"text":"Ka lawmte khat khualhaw in ka inn ah hong tung a ka piak tu nei ngawl khi hi!’ ci le uhte tuasia ciang,"},"7":{"text":"na lawmpa in a inn sung panin hong zo kik hen a, ‘Hong nawngkaisak heak in! Kongkha kikalh zo a, ka tate zongh lum siat zo hi; tho kik in bang khat po kong piak tu suak thei ngawl hi, ’"},"8":{"text":"hong cile bangbang hi tu ziam? A ngualtamh khat na hikomin hong tho kik a, anluum hong piak ngawl hang maizum ngawlin ngen kenkon po lete ama in, tho in na kitaangsap theampo hong pia tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom a tatakin kong ci ciang: Ngen vun, hong kipia tu hi; zong vun, na mu tu uh hi; king vun, kongkha hong kihon tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile a ngente theampo in nga tu a, a zongte theampo in mu tu hi; a king pawpo tungah kongkha kihon tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Pa ahi note khat po in, na tapa ii ngasa hong nget ciang, ngul na pia tu uh ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Aktuui hong nget ciangin, aikam na pia tu uh ziam?"},"13":{"text":"Na phat ngawl uh kawm panin, na tate atu na pha piak tu na he uh hi. Tua ahile vantung a om na Pa uh in, a ngente tungah Thaa Thiangtho pia kan ngawl tu ziam!” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Jesus in a pau thei ngawl doai khat notkeak hi; doai hong pusua zawkciang mihingpa pau thei hi. Mihonpi in lamdang sa uh a,","title":"Jesus le Beelzebul (Matthew 12:22-30 ; Mark 3:20-27)"},"15":{"text":"ahizong pawlkhatte in, “A nawkeak thei natu vaang a pia pa sia, doaite sung pan a lianbel Beelzebul ahi hi,” ci uh hi.","ref":"Mt 9:34; 10:25"},"16":{"text":"A dang pawlkhatte in Jesus aitaa a, ama nasepna tungtaang ah Pathian lungkimpuina a om le a om ngawl a tel nopna in, nalamdang lakna khat ngen uh hi.","ref":"Mt 12:38; 16:1; Mk 8:11"},"17":{"text":"Ahihang Jesus in amate ngaisutna teng tel ahikom, amate tungah hi bangin, ci hi, “Ngam khat sia ama le ama kikhen in a kido le bangma hun in kip ngeingawl tu hi; innkuan khat zongh kikhen in a kilem buale tamhtham tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom Satan ngamsung teng zongh pawl tuatuamin kikhen hen a, khat le khat kido le, bang tanvei kip tu ziam? Note in kei sia Beelzebul ii vaangletna taw doaite not hi hong ci nu hi."},"19":{"text":"Kei in tuabangin doaite not ka hile, na nungzuite in bangbangin not ziam? Noma ii nungzuite in, na khial uh hunlam lak hi!"},"20":{"text":"No ci bang hi ngawl hi. Pathian vaang taw doaite not ka hi zaw hi, tuaciang Pathian Ngam sia no sungah hong theng zo hi, ci in hi thu mama in lak hi."},"21":{"text":"“Pasal thahat khat in a ngalhiamte taw kithoai sa in a inn a cing le, a neisa theampo bit tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang a hat zaw khat in ama simin a zo le, a suan a muan ngalhiam theampo sut tu a, tua pa ii neisa ngalvanh teng ama in ngual hawmsak tu hi."},"23":{"text":"“Khat pawpo kei sang hong pang ngawl sia in kei hong langpan takpi ahi hi; khat pawpo in kei hong khoptua pui buale a tatakin a thethaang ahi hi.","ref":"Mk 9:40"},"24":{"text":"“Thaa ngilo khat in mihing khat sung pan a pusua zawkciangin, munko na ah vak in, tawlngak natu zong hi. Tawlngak natu a mu buale ama le ama hi bangin, ‘Ka inn ah cia kik tong,’ kici hi.","title":"Thaa Ngilo hong Heak kikna (Matthew 12:43-45)"},"25":{"text":"Tuabangin a cia kik ciangin, a inn sia a thiangtho in kipuua sa in a om mu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuaciang in ama sangin a ngilo zaw thaa dang sali hong ciapui a, amate in tuasung ah teang uh hi. A tawpna ah tua mihingpa sia, a masa lai sangin lawmawk zaw hi,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Jesus in hi teng a ci zawkciang, mihonpi sung panin numei khat in, “Nang hong hing a noaitui hong pia numei in, bangza in thupha nga ziam!” ci hi.","title":"Lungdamna Tatak"},"28":{"text":"Ahizong Jesus in, “Tua sangin Pathian kammal za a, a zuite in bangza in thupha nga zaw ziam!” ci in, zo kik hi."},"29":{"text":"Mipite in Jesus kiim pan in, hong uumci uh ciangin, “Tu hun mihingte bangzata in ngilo ziam! Nalamdang lakna khat hong ngengen hi. Ahizong Jonah ii nalamdang lakna sia simngawl, a dang bangma kipia ngawl tu hi.","title":"Nalamdang Khat Ngetna (Matthew 12:38-42)","ref":"Mt 16:4; Mk 8:12"},"30":{"text":"Nineveh khua mite atu in kamsaangpa Jonah sia, lim lakna khat ahi bangma in, Mihing Tapa zong tu hun mihingte atu in, lim lakna khat hi tu hi.","ref":"Jon 3:4"},"31":{"text":"Thukhenna Ni ciangin, Sheba Kumpinu hong ding tu a, tu hun mihingte hong mawsak tu hi. Banghang ziam cile ama ii ngam panin Solomon Kumpipa ii ciimna taw hilnate ngai tu in khual hong haw hi. A tatakin ka ci ciang, Solomon sangin a lianzaw khat hi sungah om hi.","ref":"1 Kum 10:1-10; 2 Khang 9:1-12"},"32":{"text":"Thukhenna Ni ciangin, Nineveh khua mite hong ding tu a, no hong mawsak tu hi, banghang ziam cile amate in Jonah thuhilna a zaak uh ciangin a mawna uh panin, kisiik kik uh hi; a tatakin ka ci ciang, hi sungah Jonah sangin a lianzaw khat om hi!","ref":"Jon 3:5"},"33":{"text":"“Kuama in mei a vaak ciang phual ngawl a, kuang taw zonghin khup ngawl hi. Tua hi ngawl zaw in, hong sungtang po ii mu thei tu in, meivakna khuam tungah kikoi hi.","title":"Pumpi ii Khuavak (Matthew 5:15 ; 6:22-23)","ref":"Mt 5:15; Mk 4:21; Lk 8:16"},"34":{"text":"Na mittangte uh sia na pumpi atu meivak taw kibang hi. Na mittang uh a ciidam le, na pumpi uh sia khuavak taw kidim hi; ahizong na mittang uh a pha buale na pumpi bup uh sia khuazing sungah om tu hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahikom na pumpi sungah khuavak sia khuazing na suaksak heak vun."},"36":{"text":"Na pumpi bup uh sia, khuavak taw kidim a khen khat po khuazing sungah a om bua nale, meivak sia na tungah hong taan bangma in, a vekpi taang tu hi,” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Jesus in a pau tu teng a man zawkciang, Pharisee khat in an ne tu in sam hi. Tua ahikom ama pai in an ne tu in to hi.","title":"Jesus in Phariseete le Thukhamhil Syate Mawsak (Matthew 23:1-36 ; Mark 12:38-40)"},"38":{"text":"Pharisee pa in Jesus anneak ma in a khut sil ngawlin om a mu ciang lamdang sa hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa in ama tungah, “Tu in no Phariseete na kuang na hai uh a puasang panin na thiangsak uh hi. Ahihang na sungsang uh ah ngitlona le ngoltolna taw na kidim uh hi."},"40":{"text":"A mawmawte awng! A puasang a vawt Pathian in a sungsang zongh vawt hi ngawl ziam?"},"41":{"text":"Ahihang na kuang le na haite ii sung a omte sia a zawngte pia le uhte no atu in na theampo sia zeksa huvau in thiang tu hi."},"42":{"text":"“No Phariseete atu bangza in lauhuai ziam! Pathian atu in, ante, lonamsia, bokbawnkha le khuahun zui in a piang an tuatuamte tung pan sawm a khat na pia uh hi. Ahihang Pathian it natu le thutang khenna ngaingon nu hi. A dangte zongh ngaingon tuan ngawlin hite na sep tatak tu uh ahi hi.","ref":"Thiam 27:30"},"43":{"text":"“No Phariseete atu in, bangza in lauhuai ziam! Synagogue sungah a kikhealsia tokhumte na thangai uh a, vanh zuakna munah kizatak piaknate dik na sa uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Bangza in lauhuai ziam! No sia a kilangh ngawl thaan, ngual in a tungtawn a, a heak ngawlin a sicilte taw na kibang uh hi,” ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Thukham hil sya khat in, “Sya awng hi teng na ci ciangin ko zongh hong selno na hi hi,” ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Jesus in zo a, “No thukham hil syate atu zongh bangza in lauhuai ziam! Mihingte ii nungzaang ah vanhngitte na suanh uh a, ahihang tua vanhngitte puak zawk natu in, na khutme dawn beak zongh taw na hu nuam bua uh hi."},"47":{"text":"No atu in bangza in lauhuai ziam! Na taanghpupite ii suamlup kamsaangte atu in a hoi mama thaante na vawt uh hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ahikom noma ii na sepna in na taanghpupite ii ngamtatnate a lungkimpui na suak uh hi. Amate in kamsaangte suamlum a, note in a thaan uh na vawtsak uh hi."},"49":{"text":"Hi thu hu in Pathian ii Ciimna in hi bangin ci hi. ‘Kamsaangte le kamtaite ka paisak tu hi. Amate in pawlkhat thatlum tu a, a dangte vawtsia tu uh hi.’"},"50":{"text":"Tua ahikom simlei kibitphua pan kipan a kisuamlum kamsaang theampo hangin, tu hun a mihingte daan kipia tu hi,"},"51":{"text":"Abel kisuamlupna pan kipan biaknatau le Thiangtho Mun, kilaklaw ah Zechariah a kisuamlupna dong huam tu hi. Hi hi, hong son khi hi, tu hun a mihingte tuate theampo hu in, daan kipia tu hi!.","ref":"Pian 4:8; 2 Khang 24:20-21"},"52":{"text":"“Thukham hil syate awng, no atu in, bangza in lauhuai ziam! Heakna kikholna inn kongkha tawtangte na keam uh hi; tua inn sungah noma tatak na tum nuam bua uh a, tum tu in a hanciamte na khaktan uh hi!” ci hi."},"53":{"text":"Jesus in tua mun a nusiat ciangin, Thukham hil syate le Phariseete in ama nasia takin a maw natu zong uh a, thu tam mama dongh uh hi."},"54":{"text":"a kampau khialna khat po taw a mat thei natu, aitaa tu in hanciam uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihing tul tam mamate kiphulungin khat le khat peang kisiik tha in a om laitak Jesus in a nungzuite munah a masa phitbelin hi bangin ci hi, “Pharisee te ii tol panin na kikeam vun — amate kihisak theamna ka cinopna hi.","title":"Kihisak theamna Kidop natu Jesus in Hil (Matthew 10:26-27)","ref":"Mt 16:6; Mk 8:15"},"2":{"text":"A kisiin theampo kihong tu a, thuku a minpiang kipholaak tu hi.","ref":"Mk 4:22; Lk 8:17"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom khuazing sungah a kison peuma suntangin kiza tu a, inn doituam kikhak sungah na kihuau uh peuma innkhum dawn panin ki au keak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"“Ka lawmte awng, hong ci khi hi. Pumpi bek that thei a tua zawkciang a sia zaw a hong vawt thei ngawlte na kiita heak vun.","title":"Akua Kiita tu ziam? (Matthew 10:28-31)"},"5":{"text":"Kiitak tu akua ziam ci sia kong lak tu hi. Pathian na kiita vun, ama in a thalup zawkciang meikuang sungah bum thei lai hi. Hong um tavun, na kiitak tu uh sia ama ahi hi!"},"6":{"text":"“Tonbawm nga ciang dangka san pheak nii taw kizuak hi ngawl ziam? Hi nave tonbawm khat zongh Pathian in mangil ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Na lu tung a samzamte ngawngawn hong kisimsak siat sa ahi hi. Tua ahikom lau heak vun. No sia tonbawm tam mamate sangin manpha zaw nu hi."},"8":{"text":"“A maan takin kong ci ciang, mipite mai ah keima ii mi ahi hunlam a pualaakte sia Mihing Tapa zongh in Pathian vantunglalangte mai ah tuabang ma in a pualaak tu hi.","title":"Christ Pualaakna le Nialna (Matthew 10:32-33 ; 12:32 ; 10:19-20)"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang mihonpi mai ah kei hong nialte sia Mihing Tapa in Pathian vantunglalangte mai ah nial tu hi."},"10":{"text":"“Mihing Tapa langpanna kam khat a pau pawpo sia kimaisak thei hi; ahizong Thaa Thiangtho langpanna kamsia a pau khat pawpo kimaisak ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Mt 12:32; Mk 3:29"},"11":{"text":"“Synagogue mai ah ahizong, ngam uk maangte le hong ukte mai ah ahizong, thusit tu in hong kipaipui ciang noma bangbangin kihung tu a, bang teng pau tu ci in thinngim heak vun.","ref":"Mt 10:19-20; Mk 13:11; Lk 21:14-15"},"12":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Thaa Thiangtho in tua hun ciangin na pau natu hong hil tu hi.”"},"13":{"text":"Mihon sung panin pasal khat in Jesus tungah, “Syapa awng, ka pa ii nei le lamh hong nusiatte, ka suapuipa ii hong hop natu in hong sawlsak ta'n,” ci hi.","title":"A mawmaw Sumhaupa taw Thusonteena"},"14":{"text":"Jesus in zo kik a, “Pasalpa awng, no nii ii kilaklaw ah neisate hawm tu le thukhen tu in akua in kei tungah thuneina hong pia ziam?” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate tungah hi bangin ci thua hi. “Duhopna namcinte panin, noma le noma kikeam tavun. Banghang ziam cile bangza po in a haubel hangin mihing khat ii nuntakna tatak sia neisa lamhsate hi ngawl hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jesus in hi thusonteena amate tungah son hi: “Khatvei lai in, sumhau khat om a, a leitang tung panin thaw an tam mama piang hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama le ama hi bangin ngaisun hi, ‘Ka an theampo ka koi natu ansaal nei ngawl khi hi. Bang law tu khi ziam?’"},"18":{"text":"‘Hi bangin vawt tong,’ ama le ama kici hi, ‘Ka ansaal luite pheltham tong ii, a lianzaw in ka sa tu a, tua munah ka an teng le ka vanh dang teng ka khol tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin keima le keima hi bangin ka kici tu hi. Mihing hamphapa awng! Kum tam mama na khom tu na pha theampo nei zo ni hi. A ol nawno in nungta ta'n a, ne in dawn lel in. A nuam in om ta'n!’"},"20":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in ama tungah hi bangin ci hi, ‘Mihing mawmaw pa awng! Zan ciang mama in na nuntakna na aap kul tu hi; tua hile nangma atu na kholsa hi teng sia akua in tang tu ziam?’ ” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuaciang in Jesus ii a thukhupna ah, “Pathian muna ah hauna ahi ngawl leitung haunate amate atu a kholte sia tu a ih son sia pa bang ahi hi,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jesus in a nungzuite munah, “Tua ahikom nuntak natu a kisamh ante atu ahizong, pumpi atu a kisamh puante atu ahizong, tuate huvau in, thinngim heak vun kong ci hi.","title":"Pathian Muan natu (Matthew 6:25-34)"},"23":{"text":"Nuntakna in an sangin thupizaw pek a, tuaciang pumpi in puante sangin thupi zaw hi."},"24":{"text":"Va-akte en vun: amate in anciite tu ngawlin, an le la ngawlin, ansaal le beamte a nei bua hi. Pathian in amate vaak hi! Vacimte sangin note tam mama in manpha zaw pek nu hi!"},"25":{"text":"No sungah akua in thinngimna taw na khan uh tawm na khangkhan thei uh ziam?"},"26":{"text":"A son thamman ngawl tuabang thuno khat zongh, na vawt thei bua uh le, nadang tungtaang ah banghangin thinngim nu ziam?"},"27":{"text":"Unok paakte en vun, bangbangin khang ziam: amate in na le seam ngawl a, khau le zom ngawl hi. Ahizong a tatak ci leang Solomon Kumpipa a haubel sia zongh hi paakte sangin a hoi zaw puansilh nei ngawl hi.","ref":"1 Kum 10:4-7; 2 Khang 9:3-6"},"28":{"text":"Tuni in hing a zing ciang a vul, a kihal lopate a zeam sia Pathian ahi hi. Ama in no sia puan taw hong khu seseam ngawl tu ziam? Na nei uh upna sia bangza in no ziam!"},"29":{"text":"“Tua ahikom bang ka ne tu, bang ka dawn tu ci in thintoi heak vun."},"30":{"text":"(Banghang ziam cile leitung ah, Pathian a he ngawlte in, hi bang teng thinbot in nei uh hi.) Na Pa in hite na kisap hunlam uh hong he hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama Ngam na zong masa vun. Tua hile ama in hite theampo zongh hong pia thua tu hi."},"32":{"text":"“Tuu honnote awng, lau heak vun. Banghang ziam cile na Pa in Ngam hong pia nuam hi.","title":"Vantung Hauna (Matthew 6:19-21)"},"33":{"text":"Na neisa theampo zuak vun a, na nga uh sumte a zawngte pia vun. Na hauna uh sia van ah na khol vun, tua munah a man sulh ngeingawl tu hi. Banghang ziam cile tua munah ngutate in ngu thei ngawl a, nget in ne thei ngawl hi."},"34":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile na sum na paai omna munah, na thin na lung uh zongh om tu hi."},"35":{"text":"“Hong tung tu thu khat pawpo atu in, a kingingta sa in om vun. A diang tawm tu in puansilh kholsa le meiinn vaak sa in om vun.","title":"A Kingingta sa Naseamte","ref":"Mt 25:1-13"},"36":{"text":"Mopoai panin a topa hong cia kik tu a ngak naseamte bang na hi vun. Ama hong cia a, kongkha hong kih ciangin, amate in thakhat thu in kongkha hon tu uh hi.","ref":"Mk 13:34-36"},"37":{"text":"Ama hong cia kik ciangin a kinging sa in a om, a khuaphawk naseamte, a topa in a mu ciang amate bangzata in thupha a nga tu ziam? A maan takin kong ci ciangin, a topa in a laktong puasilh suut tu a, amate a tosak zawkciang anvaak tu hi."},"38":{"text":"Zankim laitak ahizong, tua zawkciang ahizong, ama hong cia hun in, a kinging sa a om naseamte in bangzata in thupha a nga tu ziam?"},"39":{"text":"Inn nei khat in nguta hong pai tu hun he khol le a inn sia nguta in phuulsak ngawl tu ci in na tel uh hi.","ref":"Mt 24:43-44"},"40":{"text":"No zongh a kinging sa in om vun, banghang ziam cile, Mihing Tapa sia na muanmawk ngawl uh hun khat in hong pai tu hi,” ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Peter in, “Topa awng, tu a thusonteena sia ko atu na ci ziam tua ahibuale ngual theampo atu ziam?” ci hi.","title":"Thumaan ahibuale Thumaan Ngawl Naseam (Matthew 24:45-51)"},"42":{"text":"Topa in, “Tua ahile thumaan a, a ciim naseampa akua ziam? Tua pa in a inn a uk tu le, naseam dangte a hun ciang an pia tu in a topa ii sawlpa ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"A topa hong cia kik ciang, hi bangin naseampa nasep mu thong le naseampa bangzata in lungdam tu ziam?"},"44":{"text":"A tatak ka ciciang, a topa in tua naseampa sia a neisa theampo a uk tu in koi tu hi."},"45":{"text":"Ahizong tua naseampa in a topa hong cia kik tu khuangei lai tu zam ci in, naseam dang pate le numeite vel ngawp tu in kithoai hen a, anne tuidawn zukham in om le,"},"46":{"text":"a topa sia muanmawk ngawl ni khat, a heak ngawl hun khat ciangin hong heak kik tu hi. A topa in ama saat zazaan tu a, thu ni ngawlte ii thuak teng thuaksak tu hi."},"47":{"text":"“A topa ii seam le a oai teng, tel napi a, a seam tu in, a kithoai ngawl tua naseampa nasia takin, velna kithuaksak tu hi."},"48":{"text":"Ahizong a topa ii deina tel ngawlin, vel thuak natu ngamtatna a nei le, ama sia a nasia lei ngawlin kivel tu hi. Tam a kipiate tung panin tam kingen tu hi; tam seseam a kipiate tung pan, a tam seseam kingen tu hi."},"49":{"text":"“Leitung a hal tu in kong pai a, tu in a kuangsa hile ka oai hi!","title":"Jesus hangin Kikhenna piang (Matthew 10:34-36)"},"50":{"text":"Kibaptize na ka nga tu khat om a, tuasia a kimanthiang mateng in bangza in ka thin patau ziam!","ref":"Mk 10:38"},"51":{"text":"Leitung ah kilemna puak tu in hong pai hong sa nu ziam? Hi ngawl hi, kilemna hi ngawlin, kikhenna pia tu in kong pai hi."},"52":{"text":"Tu panin kipan mihing nga a pha innkuan khat sia kikhen tu a, a lang ah thum pang tu a, a lang ah nii pang tu hi."},"53":{"text":"Pate in tapate langpan tu a, tapate in pate langpan tu hi; nute in tanute langpan tu a, tanute in nute langpan tu hi; tonupite in mote langpan tu a, mote in tonupite langpan tu hi,” ci in zo kik hi.","ref":"Mic 7:6"},"54":{"text":"Mipite tungah Jesus in hi bangin ci hi. “Nitumna sang pan meeikaai khat na mu uh ciang nguazu vak thakhat thu in na ci uh a, zu takpi hi.","title":"Hunte Khentel Theina (Matthew 16:2-3)"},"55":{"text":"Tuaciang thangsang panin vui hong vak na phaw uh ciangin, nisa vak, na ci uh a, sa takpi hi."},"56":{"text":"A kihisak theamte awng! van le lei en in khuahunte na sonkhol thei uh hi; tua ahile banghangin tu hun ii a khiakna tel ngawl nu ziam?"},"57":{"text":"“Thumaan thutang vawt tu in banghang khensat ngawl nu ziam?","title":"Hong Langpante taw Kilem vun (Matthew 5:25-26)"},"58":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in na tungah thu hong vawt in zum tungah hong then le thukhenzum na thet ma in, na kituu uh thute ama taw kilemtua tu in hanciam vun. Tua ahibuale thukhenmangte mai ah hong kai in, tuate in palikte khut sungah hong aap tu a, thong sungah hong khum tu hi."},"59":{"text":"A maan tak kong ci ciang, tua munah na om tu a, na liausum a cin dong thong na taak tu uh hi,” ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin, tua munah a om mihing pawlkhat in, sangaw biakpiakna pia in Pathian a bia Galilee mite Pilate ii a thalup huvau Jesus tungah son uh hi.","title":"Mawnate pan Na Kisiik kik buale Thi tu"},"2":{"text":"Jesus in zo kik a, “Tua Galilee mite sia tuabangin a kithalup hu in, Galilee midangte sangin mawzaw ahi hunlam kilangh hi ci nuam na hi uh ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Hi ngawl het hi! A tatakin kong ci ciang, no zongh na mawna uh pan na kisiik kik bua uh le amate bangma in na thi tu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Siloam ah tausaang khat a cipsuk lai in, sawm le liat a thina thu bangbangin na ngaisun uh ziam? Hi mite in Jerusalem midang theampo sangin mawna lianzaw nei ahi hunlam kilangh hi ci in na ngaisun uh ziam?"},"5":{"text":"Hi ngawl het hi! A tatak kong ci ciangin no zongh na mawna pan, na kisiik kik bua uh le, amate bangma in na thi siat tu uh hi.”"},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jesus in hi thusonteena amate tungah son hi. “Khatvei lai in mihing khat ii sapithuan sungah theikung khat po hi. Ama bawngcip in a dingmaam thei bua hi."},"12":{"text":"Jesus in a mu ciangin biakpui a, “Numei awng na natna panin na suakta zo hi!” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"A tungah a khut nga a, tuasia ciang thakhat thu in, dingmaam a, Pathian pok hi."},"14":{"text":"Synagogue keam upa pa in Sabbath ni a, Jesus ii ciina a damsak hu in, a thin uuk hi. Tua ahikom mipite tungah, “Nipi khat sungah na ih sep natu ni luk om hi. Tua ahiciang, tua nite ah ciidam nga tu in hong pai tavun a, Sabbath ni in hong pai heak vun” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 20:9-10; Thkna 5:13-14"},"15":{"text":"Topa in zo a, “No mihing a kihitheamsakte awng! Sabbath ni in tua kolkhau panin suut tu in kilawm ngawl ziam?” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"A zo kikna kammalte hu in, a ngalte a mai uh zum a, mipite ahile, a lamdang nasepnate tungah lungdam uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Jesus in, “Pathian Ngam sia bang taw kibang ziam? Jesus in zo kik a,"},"24":{"text":"“Kongkha ciakna sungah na tum thei natu in, hanciam vun; banghang ziam cile mihing tam mamate in tum tu in hanciam tu a, a tum zo buatu uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Inn nei pa in tho in, kongkha hong khak tu hi. Tuasia ciang doipua pan in, kongkha king in, ‘Topa kong hong hon ta'n,’ na ci uh hang, ‘No koisung pan hong pai ci hong he ngawl khi hi,’ ci tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuasia ciang, ‘Nang taw annekhawm tuidawn khawmte khu hi, ka khuapi sung a thu zongh hong hil ni hi!’ na ci uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahihang hi bangin hong ci tu hi. ‘Ka kung panin tai vun, mihing ngilote awng!’ hong ci tu hi.","ref":"Ps 6:8"},"28":{"text":"Noma teng doipua ah hong kipuavawk laitakin Abraham, Isaac, Jacob le kamsaang dangte sia Pathian Ngam sungah na mu uh ciang, bangza in kap in ha ngoai in om tu nu ziam!","ref":"Mt 22:13; 25:30"},"29":{"text":"Mihingte sia nisuana le nitumna, sak le thang panin hong pai tu a, Pathian Ngam sungah poai hong siim tu uh hi.","ref":"Mt 8:11-12"},"30":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin tu laitakin a nungkhakte hong masa tu a, tu laitakin a masate hong nungkhak tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 19:30; 20:16; Mk 10:31"},"31":{"text":"Tua laitak ma in Phariseete pawlkhat, Jesus kungah hong pai a, “Hi sung panin pusuak in, leidang mun khat zuan ta'n, banghang ziam cile Herod in nang hong that nuam hi,” ci hi.","title":"Jesus ii Jerusalem A itna (Matthew 23:37-39)"},"32":{"text":"Jesus in zo a, “Noma pai tavun a, tua ngia tungah hi bangin ci tavun. ‘Tuni le zing ciangin, doai ka not tu a, ciina ka damsak tu hi, a ni thum ni ciangin ka nasep ka man tu hi.’"},"33":{"text":"Ahihang tuni, zing ciang le thai ciangin ka pai tu kul hi. Jerusalem simngawl mundang ah kamsaangte kithalup tu ngeina om ngawl hi."},"34":{"text":"“Jerusalem, Jerusalem awng! Nang in kamsaangte na thatlum a, Pathian kamtaite na deanglum uh hi! A tatakin ka ci ciang, ‘Topa min taw hong pai pa tungah Pathian thupha tung tahen,’ na ci uh hun mateng kei nong mu buatu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 118:26; Jer 22:5"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus sia Phariseete lampui khat ii inn ah Sabbath ni khat, an ne tu in pai hi; tua munah a om mihingte in Jesus encik uh hi.","title":"Jesus in Ciina pa khat Damsak"},"2":{"text":"A khut le a peang a tum pasal khat Jesus kungah pai a,"},"3":{"text":"tuasia ciang Jesus in Thukham hil syate le Phariseete munah hi bangin dongh hi. “Ih Thukham in Sabbath ni in ciina damsak tu oai ziam, oai ngawl ziam?”"},"4":{"text":"Ahihang amate a pau nuam bua uh a, Jesus in pasalpa sam in damsakin ciasak hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate tungah “No sungah na tapa uh khat ahizong, na khuital uh khat ahizong Sabbath ni in tuikhuk sungah taak luilam le tua Sabbath ni mama in thakhat thu kaito kik ngawlin na om tu uh ziam?” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 12:11"},"6":{"text":"Ahizong amate in hi thu huvau a zo thei bua uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Leangnate pawlkhat in tona nuambel teng a teal uh Jesus in a mu ciang, a om theampo ii zaak tu in hi thusonteena son hi.","title":"Kiniamkhiakna le Zindo Thiamna"},"8":{"text":"“Mopoai siim tu in hong kisap ciang, tona nuambelna ah to paih heak vun. Mihing phate thaw kik ni ciangin Pathian in hong thuk kik tu hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Sabuai ah a to mihing khat in hi thu a zaak ciangin Jesus tungah “Pathian Ngamsung poai vawtna ah a to tute sia bangzata in thupha nga ziam?” ci hi.","title":"Poai Lian vawtna taw Thusonteena (Matthew 22:1-10)"},"16":{"text":"Jesus in ama tungah, “Khatvei lai in mihing khat in, poai lian khat vawt a, tua munah ama in mihing tam mama sam hi."},"17":{"text":"Anneak tu hun hong thet ciangin leangnate munah hi bang a sonna tu in a naseampa sawl hi, “Hong pai tavun, na theampo a kinging sa in om zo hi!”"},"18":{"text":"Ahihang amate khat zawkciang khat in kamzong tek hi. A topa thin uuk mama a, a naseampa munah, ‘A manlang in khua sung lam theampo ah va pai ta'n a, a zawngte, a koncipte, mittawte, le peangbaite hong ciapui ta'n,’ ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Hai ngawlin naseampa in, ‘Topa awng, nong thupiak bangin ka seam zo hi, ahizong a tamzaw lai om thei natu mun awng lai hi,’ ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuasia ciang a topa in naseampa tungah, ‘Ngamsung lampi liante le lampinote ah va pai ta'n a, ka inn sung a dim tu in, mihingte hong tumsak ta'n."},"24":{"text":"A tatak ka ci ciang, khual ka hil maksakte kuama in ka nitak an tep ngawl tu hi!’ ” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Khatvei mihonpite Jesus taw tonin, a paikhop laitak, amate tungah,","title":"Jesus Nungzui Sua thei natu (Matthew 10:37-38)"},"26":{"text":"“A kuama po kei nung hong zui tu sia in, a pa, a nu, a zi, a tate, a suapuipate, a suapuinute le, ama le ama mama sang zonghin kei hong it zaw buale kei nungzui a suak thei buatu hi.","ref":"Mt 10:37"},"27":{"text":"Ama thinglamtee pua in hong zui ngawl po ka nungzui a suak thei buatu hi.","ref":"Mt 10:38; Mt 16:24; Mk 8:34; Lk 9:23"},"28":{"text":"No sung panin mihing khat in, tausaang khat sak a sawm le, ama in a masa phitbel in, ngeal phot tu a, sum bangza bo tu ziam ci in tuat tu hi, a sak zawk natu sum a kicing in a nei le a nei ngawl en phot tu hi."},"29":{"text":"A nei buale a phungkawng a cian zawkciang, tua tausaang a man zo buatu hi; Bil nei po in hi thu na za tavun!” ci in Jesus in thukhup hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat shiadongte le ngual ii puavawk mihing pawlkhatte in, thu ngai tu in Jesus kungah pai a,","title":"A Kibosua Tuu (Matthew 18:12-14)","ref":"Lk 5:29-30"},"2":{"text":"tuasia ciangin Phariseete le Thukham hil syate phun lialua uh hi, “Hisia pa in ngual ii puavawkte taw in an ngawngawn zongh nekhawm hi!” ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jesus in amate tungah hi thusonteena son hi."},"4":{"text":"“No sungah khat in tuu zakhat nei hen a, tuu khat bosua le bang law tu ziam? Keal khat beak zongh ka ngualtamhte taw ka neak tu nong pia ngei bua hi!"},"30":{"text":"Ahihang hi na tapa in pumpi zuak numeite tungah a sum teng zangh tum siat a, tuaciang inn hong thet ciangin khuino thau sia ngaw ni hi!’ ci hi."},"31":{"text":"A pa in, ‘Ka tapa awng, nang sia a tawntungin keima taw hi sungah a om ni hi. Simon tungah kilak hi!”"},"35":{"text":"Tuaciang amate nii in lampi tungah a piang thu le, anluum a balneen ciang, Topa ahi hunlam a telna uh bang teng son uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Mihing niite in hi thu teng a sawson laitakin, thakhat thu in Topa amate laizang ah ding a, “Thinnopna na nga tavun,” ci hi.","title":"Jesus A Nungzuite tungah Kilak (Matthew 28:16-20 ; Mark 16:14-18 ; John 20:19-23 ; Sawl 1:6-8)"},"37":{"text":"Thithaa khat mu kisa in amate patau mama hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahihang ama in, “Banghangin patau nu ziam? Banghangin hi up laaknate na thinsung ah hong piang ziam?"},"39":{"text":"Ka khut ka peang hong en tavun. Keima tatak ma ka hi hunlam hong en tavun. Hong tham tavun, banghang ziam cile thithaa in ngu le taang le samalte, tu a ka nei nong mu thei uh bangin a nei bua hi,” ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Hi teng ci in amate a khutte le a peangte lak hi."},"41":{"text":"Amate in a um thei bualai hi, banghang ziam cile, amate lungdamna le lamdangsakna taw kidim uh hi; tua ahikom ama in, “Neak tu khat po na nei uh ziam?” ci in ngen hi."},"42":{"text":"Amate in ngasa pumhuan bek khat pia uh a,"},"43":{"text":"amate ii mu tangin la in ne hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in, “Note taw kong om lai a, kong sonsa thu teng veuma ahi hi: kei taw kisai a ki at, Moses thukhamte, kamsaangte lai atte, le Psalm te hong taangtun kul hi,” ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate Laithiangtho a tel natu in, ama in a thinsung uh honsak a,"},"46":{"text":"tuaciang ama in amate tungah, “A ki at sia hisia hi: Messiah in thuak tu hi, a ni thum zawkciangin thina pan tho kik tu a;"},"47":{"text":"tuaciang ama min taw kisiik kikna le mawmaisakna sia Jerusalem pan kipan minam theampo tungah kihil tu hi."},"48":{"text":"No sia hi thute ii tetti na hi tu uh hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuaciangin ka Pa ii hong kamciamsa sia noma sungah keima tatak ma in kong puak tu hi. Ahihang note in tungsang pan vaangletna note tungah hong thet dong khuapi sungah na ngak tu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 1:4"},"50":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in amate teng khuapi sung pan Bethany dong paipui a, tua munah khut laamin thupha pia hi.","title":"Jesus Van ah Kila (Matthew 16:19-20 ; Sawltak 1:9-11)","ref":"Sawl 1:9-11"},"51":{"text":"Thupha a piak laitakin, ama sia amate taw kikhen a, vantung ah kila to hi."},"52":{"text":"Amate in, ama a biak zawk uh ciang, lungdamna lianpi taw kidim uh a, Jerusalem ah heak kik in,"},"53":{"text":"a hun nei uh theampo Biakinn sung Pathian tungah lungdamkona in zangh uh hi."}}}}},"43":{"info":{"name":"John","shortname":"John","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kipatciilin, Kammal na omkhol zo hi; tua Kammal in Pathian taw om a, tua Kammal in Pathian ahi hi.","title":"Nuntakna Kammal"},"2":{"text":"A kipatciil lai mama panin Kammal in Pathian taw a omsa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama tungtawnin Pathian in na theampo piangsak hi; a kibitphua theampo ama ngawl taw a kipiangsak na khat beak a om bua hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua Kammal in nuntakna ii naak ahi hi. Tuaciang hi nuntakna in mihing a minpiang atu in khuavak hong puak hi."},"5":{"text":"Khuavak in khuazing sungah taang a, khuazing in sumit zo ngeingawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Pathian in John a kici ama kamtaipa hong paisak a,","ref":"Mt 3:1; Mk 1:4; Lk 3:1-2"},"7":{"text":"mihing theampo in za a, a up natu in, tua khuavak thu mihingte tungah a son tu in hong pai ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama tatak ahile khuavak hi ngawl hi; khuavak ii thu son tu in hong pai ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi khuavak in khuavak tatak hi a — leitung ah hong pai in mihing sim tungah a taang hi."},"10":{"text":"Kammal in leitung ah om a, Pathian in leitung sia ama tungtawnin piangsak hi napi, leitung in ama a he bua hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in ama ii ngamsung ma a hong pai ahihang a mite in ama a saang bua uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahizong pawlkhat in ama saangin um uh hi; tua ahikom ama in tuate tungah Pathian ii tate sua thei natu thupia hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate leitung pianziate taw Pathian ii tate a suak hi ngawl hi, cinopna in, pa khat ii hin tate bangin a piang ahi bua hi; Pathian mama sia amate ii Pa ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Kammal in mihing hong suak a, thuthiamna le thumaan thutak taw kidimin, ei sungah hong teang hi. Eite in ama ii vaangletna, Pa ii Tapa khat bek a hina taw a saan vaangletna ih mu zo hi."},"15":{"text":"John in ama huvau son hi. Ama in, “Hisia pa sia a thu ka sawson pa hi a, ‘Kei nung pan hong pai hi, ahihang kei sangin lianzaw hi, banghang ziam cile kei ii pian ma in ama om zo hi,’ ka ci sia ahi hi,” ci in au hi."},"16":{"text":"A kidimin a om, ama ii thuthiamna sung panin, ei theampo thupha hong pia zo a, thupha khat zawkciang khat hong piak ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Pathian in Moses tungtawnin Thukham pia hi. Ahihang thuthiamna le thumaan thutak sia Jesus Christ tungtawnin hong pai hi."},"18":{"text":"Kuama in Pathian mu ngeingawl hi. Pa kungah a om, Pathian ma ahi, Tapa khat bek in Pathian hong hesak hi."},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem khua a om Jew thuneite in John kungah thiampite le Levi te pawlkhat paisak a, “Nang akua ni ziam?” ci in donghsak uh hi.","title":"Tuiphumpa John ii Thupuak (Mt 3:1-12; Mk 1:1-8; Lk 3:1-18)"},"20":{"text":"John in a zo thada bua a, phualseal ngawlin hi bangin thiangson hi. “Kei Messiah hi ngawl khi hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"“Tua ahile akua ni ziam? Elijah ni ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi. “Hi ngawl khi hi,” ci in John in zo hi. “Kamsaangpa ni ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi. “Hi ngawl khi hi,” ci in ama in zo kik hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:15,16; Mal 4:5"},"22":{"text":"“Tua ahile akua ni ziam hong son ta'n” ci uh hi. “Ko hong sawlte munah thu ka puak kik uh kul hi. Nangma le nangma bang kici ni ziam?” ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Isaiah kamsaangpa ii sonna teng doppha in, John in hi bangin zo hi: “Kei sia ‘Sennealngam sungah a au khat ii aw ka hi hi: Topa ii khualhaw natu lampi tangsak vun!’ ”","ref":"Is 40:3"},"24":{"text":"Phariseete ii kamtaite in,"},"25":{"text":"John munah, “Nang Messiah le hi ngawl, Elijah le hi ngawl, Kamsaangpa le hi ngawl na hile, banghangin tuiphum ni ziam,” ci in dongh uh hi."},"26":{"text":"“Kei in tui taw tui kong phum hi, ahihang no sungah na heak ngawl uh khat om hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama sia kei nung panin hong pai ahihang ama peangdap suut tu zong ka kilawm bua hi,” ci in John in zo hi."},"28":{"text":"Hi thu theampo sia John ii tui a phumna Jordan Ngun ii nisuana sangah a om Bethany khua ah piang hi."},"29":{"text":"A zing ciangin John in ama kungah Jesus hong pai a mu ciangin, “Leitung buppi mawna a lakhia Pathian Tuuno, zialai ah om hi!","title":"Pathian Tuuno"},"30":{"text":"‘Mihing khat kei nung panin hong pai tu a, ama in kei pian ma in omkhol zo ahikom, kei sangin ama lianzaw hi,’ ci in ka sawson sia pa ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama sia akua hi tu ziam, ci in ka he bua hi, ahihang Israel mite ii ama a heak natu in, tui taw tuiphum tu in keima hong pai ka hi hi,” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaciang in John in hi bangin tetti pang hi: “Thaa sia vantung panin ngam vakhu bangin hong tuaksuk a, ama tungah hong tu ka mu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama sia tua pa ahi hunlam telcian tatak ngawlin ka om lai hi, ahihang tui taw tuiphum a hong sawl Pathian in, ‘Thaa sia hong paisuk in mihing khat ii tungah, hong tuaksuk na mu tu hi; ama sia Thaa Thiangtho taw hong baptize tu pa hi,’ ci in hong son zo hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuasia mu zo khi hi, tuaciangin ama sia Pathian Tapa hi ci in hong son khi hi,” John in ci hi."},"35":{"text":"A zing ciangin John sia tua munah ama ii nungzuite nii taw a dinkhop kik laitakin,","title":"Jesus ii Nungzui Phitbel teng"},"36":{"text":"Jesus hong pai mu hi. “Zia sia in Pathian Tuuno hi!” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Nungzuite nii in tu a bangin a son za uh a, tuaciangin Jesus taw ton uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Jesus kiheak a, amate in a nung a zui a mu ciang, “Bang zong nu ziam?” ci in dongh hi. (Tua hun sia nitak nai li bang hi) Tua ahikom amate in ama taw paikhawm a, a teenna a mu uh hi, ama taw tua ni hun om lai teng a zangh khawm uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuate sung pan khat in Simon Peter ii suapui Andrew ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Thakhatin a suapuipa Simon mu in hi thu ko hi. “Ko Messiah mu zo khu hi,” (Hi kammal sia Christ a cinopna hi) ci in ko hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama in Jesus kungah Simon paipui hi. Jesus in ama en in, “Na min sia Simon hi a, John ii tapa ni hi, ahihang nang sia Cephas hong kina tu hi,” ci hi. (Cephas ii khiakna sia Peter ma hi a, “suangpi khat” a cinopna hi.)"},"43":{"text":"A zing ciangin Jesus in, Galilee ngam ah pai tu in, khensat hi.
