Ama sia Nazareth pan Joseph tapa Jesus hi,” ci in ama munah son hi."},"46":{"text":"“Nazareth panin na pha khat pawpo piang thei thong tu ziam,” ci in Nathanael in dongh hi. “Hong pai in hong en ta'n,” ci in Philip in zo hi."},"47":{"text":"Jesus in ama kungah Nathanael hong pai a mu ciangin, ama thu hi bangin son hi. “Hi sungah, Israel mi tatak khat om hi; ama in paubanna nei ngawl hi!” ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Nathanael in, “Bangbangin hong he ni ziam,” ci in dongh hi. “Philip ii hong sam ma theikung nuai ah na om lai in, kong mu zo hi,” ci in Jesus in zo hi."},"49":{"text":"Nathanael in, “Syapa awng, nang sia Pathian Tapa na hi hi! Amate in thambeal ngong ciang in tui dimh uh a,"},"8":{"text":"tua zawkciang ama in, “Tu in tui hong suak tavun a, poai ukpa kungah paipui tavun,” ci hi. Ka Pa inn sia vanh zuakna mun suaksak heak vun!” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"A nungzuite in, laithiangtho ii, “Na inn ka thangaina in, ka sungah mei bangin kuang hi, Pathian awng,” a ci teng phawk uh hi.","ref":"Ps 69:9"},"18":{"text":"Jew thuneite in, “Hi bang ngamtat thei natu in, na thu ngana sia bang nalamdang lakna taw hong lak tu ni ziam?” ci in thudokna taw zo kik uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Jesus in, “Hi Biakinnpi baltham vun, ni thum sungin sa kik tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi.","ref":"Mt 26:61; 27:40; Mk 14:58; 15:29"},"20":{"text":"“Ni thum sungah sa kik thei tu ni ziam? Hi Biakinnpi sak natu sia kum sawmli le kum luk hai hi,” ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang Jesus ii son biakinn sia ama ii pumpi ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom thina panin ama a kithaw kiksak ciangin a nungzuite in, hi thu a son sia phawk kik uh a, amate in laithiangtho le Jesus ii a sonsate um uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Paisan Poai sungin Jerusalem ah Jesus a om laitakin, ama ii nalamdang laknate a mu uh hu in, mihing tam mamate in ama um uh hi.","title":"Mihing Pianzia Jesus ii Heakna"},"24":{"text":"Ahihang Jesus in muang ngawlin amate tungah ama le ama a ki aap ngam bua hi, banghang ziam cile ama in amate he siat hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama tungah amate thu sia kuama ii son kul ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile ama mama in amate ii thinsung teng a heaksa hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nicodemus a kici Jew te lampui khat om a, Pharisee pawlmi ahi hi.","title":"Jesus le Nicodemus"},"2":{"text":"Zan khat Jesus kungah ama pai in, “Rabbi awng, nang sia Pathian ii sawl sya khat hi ci in kong he uh hi. a um ngawlte ahile thukhenna a thuaksa hi zo hi, banghang ziam cile amate in, Pathian ii Tapa khat bek sia a um bua uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Hisia in thukhenzia hi: khuavak sia leitung ah hong pai zo hi, ahihang mihingte in, khuavak sangin khuazing deizaw uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate ii ngamtatnate sia hi."},"20":{"text":"A sia a vawt theampo in khuavak ngaimaw a, khuavak sungah hong pai ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile amate ii a tatsiatnate kilanghsak nuam ngawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang thumaan a seamte in, amate ii ngamtatna sia Pathian thunitna ahi hunlam tua khuavak in a lak thei natu in khuavak sungah a pai hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, Jesus le a nungzuite in, Judea ngamkhen sungah hong pai uh a, tua munah amate taw hun zangh khawmin, tuiphumna pia hi.","title":"Jesus le John"},"23":{"text":"Salim pan a kikhuala ngawlna Aenon ah tui tam ahikom John in tui sungah tuiphumna pia hi. Hisia in keima lungdamna a pawlcinna ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama hong thupi vaial tu a, kei sia thupi ngawl vaial tu khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Tungsang pan hong pai sia in, a kuama theampo sangin, lian zaw hi. Leitung pan hong pai sia in, leitung neisa hi a, leitung nate thuson in nei hi. Ahihang vantung pan hong pai sia in, a kuama theampo ii tungsia ahi hi.","title":"Vantung pan Hong pai Pa"},"32":{"text":"Ama in a mu sate le a zaaksate son hi, ahihang ama ii thu hong puak sia kuama in saang ngawl hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahihang ama ii thupuak a saang pawpo in Pathian thumaan hi, ci thu kipsak hi."},"34":{"text":"Pathian ii sawlpa in, Pathian ii kammalte pau hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian in ama Thaa taw kidimsak hi."},"35":{"text":"Pa in a Tapa it a, na theampo ama ii vaangletna sungah koi hi.","ref":"Mt 11:27; Lk 10:22"},"36":{"text":"Tapa a um pawpo in, tawntung nuntakna nei hi; Tapa ii thu a ni ngawl po sia nuntakna a nei buatu a, Pathian ii daan piakna nuai ah om lai tu hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus in John sangin, nungzui tamzaw nga a, tuiphum hi ci thu Phariseete in za uh hi.","title":"Jesus le Samaria Numei"},"2":{"text":"(A tatakin Jesus in kuama tuiphum ngawl hi; ama ii nungzuite bek in tuiphum uh hi.)"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jesus in tuabang a kisonna a zaak ciang, Judea ngam nusia in Galilee ah pai kik hi;"},"4":{"text":"tua mun a paina lampi sia Samaria ngam a kaantan tu kul hi."},"5":{"text":"Samaria ngam Sychar kici khuano khat ah ama theng hi, tua khua sia Jacob ii a tapa Joseph a piak lo sia taw kikhuala ngawl hi.","ref":"Pian 33:19; Jos 24:32"},"6":{"text":"Jacob ii tuikhuk tua munah om a, Jesus sia a khualhawna pan toi in, tua tuikhuk hui ah to hi. Tua hun sia sunkim khawng ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Samaria numei khat tui toai tu in hong pai a, tuasia ciang Jesus in ama munah, “Tui neak tu hong pia ta'n,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"(A nungzuite khua sungah an lei tu in pai uh hi.)"},"9":{"text":"Tua numei in, “Nang Jew mi hi a, kei Samaria mi khi hi — tua hi a, banghangin tui hong ngen thei ni ziam,” ci in zo hi (Jew te in Samaria te ii zak hai le kuangte zangh khawm ngawl hi.)","ref":"Eze 4:1-5; Neh 4:1-2"},"10":{"text":"Jesus in, “Pathian in bang teng pia a, nang tungah tuineak tu hong ngen sia akua ziam, ci thu tel thong lete nangma in ama munah na ngen tu hi, tuaciang ama in nuntakna tui hong pia tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua numei in, “Syapa awng tuipheal nei ngawl ni hi, tuaciang tuikhuk sia thuk hi. Tua nuntakna tui, koisung pan nga tu ni ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Hi tuikhuk hong pia sia in ih taanghpupi Jacob hi; ama le a tapate le a nganno honte, a vekpi in hi tuikhuk panin dawn tek uh hi. Jacob sangin lianzaw kisa na hi bua na ziam,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Jesus in, “A kuama po hi tui a dawn sia in, a dangko kik tu hi,"},"14":{"text":"ahihang kei ii ka piak tui a dawn peuma a dangko kik ngei nawn ngawl tu hi. Ka piak tu tui sia ama sung pan ciktui khat hong suak tu hi, tua in nuntakna a pia tui hi tu a, tuaciangin tawntung nuntakna pia tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua numei in, “Syapa awng, tua tui kei hong pia ta'n! Tua hile ka dangko kik ngei nawn ngawl tu a, tui toai tu in hi sungah ka pai kul nawn ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Jesus in, “Pai in, na pasal sam ta'n, tuaciang hong pai kik ta'n,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama in, “Kei pasal ka nei bua hi,” ci in zo hi. Jesus in, “Pasal ka nei bua hi na ci sia thumaan hi."},"18":{"text":"Pasal nga na teenpui ngei zo a, tu a na teenkhop puipa sia na pasal tatak hi ngawl hi. Thumaan hong son ni hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua numei in, “Syapa, nang sia kamsaang khat na hi hunlam kong he hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka Samaria taanghpupite in, hi mualtung ah Pathian bia hi, ahihang no Jew te in Jerusalem sia noma ii Pathian biakna tu mun hi, ci nu hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Jesus in ama munah, “Hong um ta'n, numei awng, Pa sia hi mual tungah ahizong, Jerusalem ah ahizong mihingte ii biak ngawl tu hun hong tung tu hi."},"22":{"text":"No Samaria te in na biak uh akua ziam, ci in he tatak ngawl nu hi; ahihang ko Jew te in, ka biak uh sia ka he uh hi, banghang ziam cile ngupna sia Jew te tung panin hong pai hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang, Pa sia Pathian ii Thaa vaangletna taw, ahi bang tatakin ama ii dei biakna maan taw mihingte ii biak tu hun hong tung tu a, tu mama in hi sungah hong tutung zo hi."},"24":{"text":"Pathian sia Thaa hi a, a Thaa ii vaangletna bekma taw mihingte in ama sia ahi bang tatakin bia thei hi,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua numei in, “Messiah hong pai tu a, ama hong pai ciangin, thu theampo hong son tu hi, ci in ka he hi,” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Jesus in, “Nang taw a kipaupui keima in tuasia pa ka hi hi,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Jesus nungzuite hong heak kik a, Jesus sia numei khat taw thu sawson in om a mu uh ciang, amate in lamdang sa mama uh hi. Ahihang kuama in, “Nang bang nuam ni ziam,” ci in tua numei mun ahizong, “Banghangin hisia nu taw thuson ni ziam,” ci in ama mun ahizong a dongh bua uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin tua numei in a tuibeal nusia in, khua sungah heak kik a, tualai mihingte munah,"},"29":{"text":"“Keima ngamtat ngei theampo hong son sia pa en tu in hong pai tavun. Ama in Messiah ahi thei tu ziam?” ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahikom, amate in a khua uh nusia in, Jesus kungah pai uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua hun sungin, a nungzuite in Jesus munah, “Syapa awng, bang khat pawpo ne in!” ci uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahihang ama in, “No ii heak ngawl anneak tu ka nei hi,” ci in zo hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahikom nungzuite amate teng kidongh a, “Khat po in ama an puak zo hi tu ziam?” ci uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Jesus in, “Kei ii an sia, kei hong sawlpa ii deina ka zui tu le hong piak nasep ka zaw tu ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Noma in ‘Tha li zawkciang sia anlaak hun hi,’ ci kam teptee nei nu hi. Ahihang lote pha tak en vun; tu in lo ante min zo a, laak tu bekin om zo hi, ci in kong son hi!"},"36":{"text":"Anla pa sia thaman kipia a, ama in tawntung nuntak natu ante kaikhawm hi; tua ahikom thaicii poaipa le anlapa lungdam khawm tu hi."},"37":{"text":"‘Mihing khat in thaicii poai a, a dang khat in anla hi,’ a ci sia thumaan hi."},"38":{"text":"No ii thawna ahi ngawl lo khat sungah anla tu in hong paisak khi hi; ngualdangte in tua munah seam uh a, tuaciang in no sia amate sepna tung panin hamphatna na nga uh hi,” ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua numei ii “Keima ngamtat ngei theampo hong son hi,” a cina hangin tua Samaria khua mi tam mama in Jesus um uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua hi a Samaria mite ama kungah hong pai ciangin, amate kungah a taam natu in kunh uh hi, Jesus in tua munah ni nii taam hi."},"41":{"text":"Ama thusonna hu in a tamzaw seseam in um uh hi;"},"42":{"text":"tua numei munah amate in, “Tu in um khu hi, nang nong son sia hang hi ngawl a, koma mama in ama ii thuson ka zaak uh hang hi, ama leitung Hunpa ahi takpi sia ka he uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua munah ni nii a taam zawkciang Jesus vaidingin, Galilee ngam zuan hi.","title":"Jesus in Ulian khat ii Tapa Damsak"},"44":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ama mama in, “Kamsaangpa khat sia ama ii ngam sungah kizakta ngawl hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 13:57; Mk 6:4; Lk 4:24"},"45":{"text":"Galilee ngam a thet ciangin, tualai mihingte in muak uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate Paisan Poai siimin Jerusalem ah pai a, poai sungah ama vawt theampo mu siat zo uh hi.","ref":"Jn 2:23"},"46":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Galilee ngam Cana khua ah Jesus pai kik hi, tua mun sia ama in tui pan sapittui a suasakna mun ahi hi. Tua munah kumpi naseam ulian khat om a, a tapa sia Capernaum khua ah a cina hi.","ref":"Jn 2:1-11"},"47":{"text":"Ama in Judea ngam panin Galilee ngam ah Jesus hong pai hunlam a zaak ciangin Jesus kungah pai a, Capernaum khua ah a thi dektak a tapa a damsak natu in ngen hi."},"48":{"text":"Jesus in, “No sungah nalamdang laknate le, a lamdangte na mu bua uh le, kuama in na um ngei buatu uh hi,” ci hi."},"49":{"text":"Ulianpa in, “Syapa awng, ka tapa a thi ma in hong zui ta'n,” ci in zo kik hi."},"50":{"text":"Jesus in ama munah, “Va pai ta'n, na tapa nungta tu hi!” ci hi. Tua pa in Jesus kammalte um in pai paih hi."},"51":{"text":"Inn ah a cia lamin a naseamte in, “Na tapa nungta tu hi!” ci thu taw ama muak uh hi."},"52":{"text":"A tapa a dam zawhiat sia bang hun ziam ci in amate tungah a dok ciang, “Zeini nitak sang nai khat hun in, a ci suk hong thai hi,” ci in zo hi."},"53":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Jesus ii, “Na tapa nungta tu hi,” a ci hun lian ma ahi sia a pa in phawk hi. Tua ahikom ama le a innkuanpui theampo in um uh hi."},"54":{"text":"Hisia in Judea pan Galilee ah hong pai zawkciang Jesus ii vawt nalamdang lakna a niina ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, Jerusalem khua Biakna poai ah Jesus pai hi.","title":"Tuili ah Ciidamsakna"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem Tuu Kongpi hui ah, talaap nga taw kithua tuicing khat om hi; tua mun sia Hebrew kam in Bethzatha kici hi."},"3":{"text":"Mittaw, peangbai, pumzaw ciina honpui khat sia, tua talaapte sungah lum uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in tui a kilok tu ngak uh hi, banghang ziam cile tu le tu in Topa ii vantunglalang khat in tua tui sungah tuaksuk a, tui sau hi. Tui kinok laitak a tuaksuk phit cina sia in, bang natna po a vei zong dam thiang hi."},"5":{"text":"Kum sawmthum le kum liat cina sa pasal khat tuak ah om hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesus in tua pa a lup sia mu a, khuangei mama a ciinat hunlam he hi; tua ahikom, “Na dam nuam ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"7":{"text":"Cinapa in, “Syapa awng, tui a kinok laitak kei hong khiasuk tu, hi sungah kuama ka nei bua hi; tuisung theng nuamin, ka hanciam hang, ngualdang veu tuaksuk masa hi,” ci in zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Jesus in “Tho in, na lupna phah luakin a, lampai in,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Thakhat thu in tua pasalpa dam hi; ama in a phah luakin, lampai tu in kipan paih hi. Hi thu a pian ni sia Sabbath ni ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jew thuneite in a kidamsakpa munah, “Tuni Sabbath ni hi, na phah na puak tu sia ih thukham taw kisi ngawl hi,” ci uh hi.","ref":"Neh 13:19; Jer 17:21"},"11":{"text":"Ama in, “Hong damsakpa in ka phah ka lua tu le lampai tu in hong sawl hi,” ci in zo hi."},"12":{"text":"“Hi bang ngamta a hong sawlpa akua ziam,” ci in dongh uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang damsakna a ngapa in, Jesus akua cisia a he bua hi, banghang ziam cile tua munah mihon khat om ahiciang Jesus kiheam hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciang Jesus in Biakinnpi sungah ama mu a, “Hong ngai ta'n, tu in dam zo ni hi; tua ahiciang, mawna vawt nawn heak in, tua ahibuale a nasia zaw thuak thei tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua zawkciang pasalpa in paisan a, ama a damsak sia Jesus ahi hunlam Jew thuneite kungah son hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom, amate in Jesus vawtsia tu kipan uh hi, banghang ziam cile ama in hi ciidamsakna Sabbath ni in seam hi."},"17":{"text":"Jesus in amate tungah, “Ka Pa a tawntungin naseam a, kei zongh ka sep kul hi,” ci in zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Hi bang a pauna in, Jew thuneite ii Jesus a thalup nopna khangsak seseam hi; Sabbath thukham paltan bek dom ngawlin, Pathian sia ama ii aituam Pa hi a ci ciang, ama le ama Pathian taw a za kikimsak ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate kungah Jesus in, “A tatakin kong ci hi: Tapa in ama thu taw bangma vawt thei ngawl hi; a Pa ii vawt a mu teng bekma vawt hi. Pa ii vawt teng Tapa zongh in vawt hi.","title":"Tapa ii Thuneina"},"20":{"text":"Pa in Tapa it ahikom ama ii vawt teng theampo ma lak hi. Hite sangin a lian zaw lai, a vawtte ngawngawn lak tu a, note theampo in lamdang na sa tek tu uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Pa in mithite thosak a, nuntakna a piak bangma Tapa in a piak nopte tungah nuntakna pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Pa in kuama tungah thukhen ngawl hi. Ama in a Tapa tungah thukhen theina thu a cingin pia hi,"},"23":{"text":"tua thu sia mihing theampo in Pa a zatak bangma in, Tapa a zatak natu ahi hi. Tapa a zakta ngawl po in ama a sawl ahi Pa sia zakta ngawl hi."},"24":{"text":"“A tatakin kong ci hi: ka kammalte za a, kei hong sawlpa a um pawpo tawntung nuntakna nei hi. Amate tungah thu kikhen ngawl tu a, thina pan nuntakna sungah theng zo hi."},"25":{"text":"A tatakin kong ci hi: a hun hong tung tu a — hong tutung zo hi — tua hun ciang a thisate in Pathian Tapa ii aw za tu a, tuaciangin a zate hong nungta tu uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Pa mama in nuntakna ii naak ahi bangma ama Tapa zongh nuntakna ii naak suaksak zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaciang ama ii Tapa sia thukhen theina thupia zo hi, banghang ziam cile ama Mihing Tapa ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Hi thu tungtaang ah lamdang sa heak vun; a thisate theampo in ama aw za tu a,"},"29":{"text":"thaankuul sung panin hong pusua tu hun hong theng tu hi; na pha a seamsate tho in nungta tu a, siatna vawtte tho in mawsakna thuak tu hi.","ref":"Dan 12:2"},"30":{"text":"“Keima aituam thuneina taw bangma ka vawt thei bua hi; Pathian hong son bang bekin thukhen ka hikom, ka thukhenna maan hi, banghang ziam cile, keima dei bangin sep tu ka hanciam bua a, hong sawl pa dei bangin ka seam hi.","title":"Jesus atu Tetti Pannate"},"31":{"text":"Keima le keima tetti in ka kipang le ka son sia maan tatak hi, ci in kisaang ngawl tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahihang kei taangin tetti hong pang a dang khat om a, tuaciangin kei huvau ama sonte maan hi, ci in ka he hi."},"33":{"text":"John sia na kamtaite na paisakna uh pa hi a, tuaciang ama in thumaan thutak son hi.","ref":"Jn 1:19-27; 3:27-30"},"34":{"text":"Mihing khat ii tetti panna ka nei tu kul tuan ngawl hi; hisia noma ii na suatak thei natu ka ci bekma ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"John sia meiinn taw kibang a, kuangin taang hi, tuaciangin tawmvei sung teng ama ii khuavak sia na leaplaw nuam uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahihang John ii tetti panna sangin, a lianzaw kei taang a ding tu tetti khat ka nei hi: Pa ii sep tu hong piakte ka sepna po in kei taangin a pau hi a, kei sia Pa hong sawl ahi hunlam lak hi."},"37":{"text":"Kei hong sawlpa ahi Pa zongh in, keima taangin tetti pang hi. Note in ama aw na za ngei bua uh a, a maitang zongh na mu ngei bua uh hi,","ref":"Mt 3:17; Mk 1:11; Lk 3:22"},"38":{"text":"tuaciangin ama ii thu hong puak sia na thinsung ah na keam bua uh hi, banghang ziam cile a ma ii hong puakpa na um bua uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Laithiangthote na entel uh hi, banghang ziam cile tuate sungah tawntung nuntakna mu tu na ki um uh hi. Tuaciangin hi Laithiangthote mama in, keima ii thu son hi!"},"40":{"text":"Tua hi napi nuntakna na nga natu in kei kungah nong pai nuam bua uh hi."},"41":{"text":"“Keima in mihingte ii pokna a zong hi ngawl khi hi."},"42":{"text":"Ahihang no bangbang mihing nam ci sia le na thinsung uh ah Pathian ii itna na nei ngawl uh kong he hi."},"43":{"text":"Pa ii thuneina tengma kengin kong pai hangin nong saang bua uh hi; ahihang khat po in ama ii thuneina taw hong pai ciang na saang tu uh hi."},"44":{"text":"No khat le khat kipok tu na thangai uh hi, ahihang khat bek ahi Pathian tung pan pokna nga tu na hanciam bua uh hi; tua ahile bangbangin kei hong um thei tu nu ziam?"},"45":{"text":"Ahihang ka Pa mai ah note maw hong pusak tu sia, kei hi tu in hong um heak vun. Na lam et uh pa Moses sia note hong mawsak tu pa ahi hi."},"46":{"text":"Moses na um takpi uh le kei nong up tu uh hi zo hi, banghang ziam cile ama in keima thu at hi."},"47":{"text":"Ahihang ama at thute um ngawl na hi uh nungsang, kei kampau bangbangin um thei tu nu ziam?” ci in zo hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, Galilee tuili (Tiberias Tuili zongh kici) kaantanin Jesus pai hi.","title":"Jesus in Pasal Tulnga Anvaak (Mt 14:13-21; Mk 6:30-44; Lk 9:10-17)"},"2":{"text":"Mi honpi khat in a nungzui hi, banghang ziam cile ciina damsakna taw ama ii nalamdang laknate mu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Jesus sia mual khat tungah kaato a, a nungzuite taw tokhawm hi."},"4":{"text":"Paisan Poai hun hong nai hi."},"5":{"text":"Jesus in a kiimkot a et ciangin, mi honpi khat ama kungah hong zuan mu a, tua ahikom Philip munah, “Koisung pan hi mihingte theampo ih vaak khom natu an lei thei tu hi ziam,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"(Hi bangin a ci sia Philip a ze etna hi; ama in a vawt tu tatak sia a heakkhol sa hi.)"},"7":{"text":"Philip in, “Mihing sim ii tawmno tek a neak khom tu bek zongh ngun dangka zanii vaal taw anluum lei kul tu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"8":{"text":"A nungzuite sung pan a dang khat Simon Peter ii suapuipa Andrew in,"},"9":{"text":"“Hi sungah om patangno khat in, mangtaang anluum nga le ngasa nii nei hi. Ahihang tua teng sia hi mi theampo atu in, kicing ngawl het tu hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesus in amate tungah “Mihingte tosak vun,” ci hi. (Tua munah lopa tam om hi.) Tua ahikom mihing theampo to siat uh hi; pasal 5,000 bang pha uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesus in anluumte la a, Pathian tungah lungdamko in, tua munah a to mihing teng hawmsak hi. Ama in tuabang ma in ngasate zongh hawm a, amate a vekpi in a du zaza ne uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate a kham siat zawk uh ciang, a nungzuite munah ama in, “A kham vaal teng kaikhawm vun; bangma pakvawt bua tawng,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in a khop siat uh ciangin, mihonte neak mangtaang anluum nga panin, a kham vaal uh khum sawm le khum nii nga uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Hi nalamdang lakna Jesus ii vawt a mu uh ciangin, tua munah a om mihingte in, “Hi sia leitung a hong pai tu Kamsaangpa hi takpi hi!” ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate hong pai in kumpi suaksak tu in zawthawk thu taw ama man tu kipan ahi sia Jesus in he hi; tua ahikom ama nguakin, mual tungah pai san kik hi."},"16":{"text":"Nitak sang ciangin, Jesus ii nungzuite tua tuili ah paisuk uh a,","title":"Jesus Tui tungah Lampai (Mt 14:22-33; Lk 6:45-52)"},"17":{"text":"ngunkuang sungah to in, Capernaum ah tuili kaantan in pai kik uh hi. Khua hong zan zo a, Jesus amate kung hong zuan ngawl lai hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hun laitak, nasia takin vuiva a, tui kilok hi."},"19":{"text":"Nungzuite in kilometre 5 bang 6 bang ngunkuang a haw zawkciang, Jesus tui tungah lampai in, ngunkuang nai ah hong pai a mu uh ciang, amate lau uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Jesus in, “Lau heak vun, keima khi hi!” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin amate tha lawp takin, Jesus ngunkuang tungah kaasak uh a, amate zot nopna mun ah thakhat thu in theng uh hi."},"22":{"text":"A zing ciangin, tuili langkhat ah a taam mihonpite in, tua mun ah ngunkuang khat bek a om hunlam phawk kik uh hi. Tua ngunkuang sungah, ama ii nungzuite taw Jesus paikhawm ngawlin amate nguak a pai hunlam phawk uh hi.","title":"Mihingte in Jesus Zong"},"23":{"text":"Topa ii lungdam a ko zawkciang mihon ii anluum neakna mun taw a kinaina tuili vaal ah, Tiberias pan hong pai ngunkuang dangte hong theng hi."},"24":{"text":"Mihonte in Jesus ahizong, ama ii nungzuite ahizong tua munah a mu ngawl uh ciang, ngunkuangte tungah kaa in, ama zong tu in Capernaum khua ah pai uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Mihingte in tuili langkhat ah Jesus a mu uh ciangin, ama munah, “Syapa awng, hi sung bang hunin theng ni ziam,” ci uh hi.","title":"Jesus Nuntakna Anluum"},"26":{"text":"Jesus in, “A tatakin kong ci ciang, kei nong zon uh sia, nalamdang ka laknate na tel uh hang hi ngawlin, anluum na du uh za a na neak uh hang ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"A sia thei an atu in, naseam heak vun; tua sangin a kikhomsuan tawntung nuntakna an atu in seam zaw vun. Hisia in Mihing Tapa ii no hong piak tu an ahi hi, banghang ziam cile Pa Pathian in ama tungah lungkimin tepteena koi zo hi,” ci in zo hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom, amate in, “Pathian in kote seam le hong oai te ka sep thei natu in bang vawt thei tu khu ziam,” ci in dongh uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Jesus in, “Pathian ii no sep tu a dei nasep sia, ama ii a sawlpa na up tu uh ahi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"30":{"text":"Amate in “Ko ii mu thei tu uh le nang kong up thei natu in, bang nalamdang lakna vawt tu ni ziam? Bang vawt tu ni ziam?"},"31":{"text":"laithiangtho in ‘Ama in vantung panin amate neak tu anluum pia hi,’ a ci bangma in, ka taanghpupite in sennealngam sungah manna ne uh hi,” ci in zo kik uh hi.","ref":"Pu 16:4; 15; Ps 78:24"},"32":{"text":"Jesus in “A tatakin ka ci hi: Moses ii no hong piak anluum sia vantung pan hi ngawl hi. Ahizong no sia Pathian kung pan na hi bua uh a, tua hu in hong ngai nuam ngawl nu hi,” ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Amate in Jesus munah, “Nang sia Samaria mi hi a, doai vei ni hi kong ci uh sia, maan hi ngawl khu ziam,” ci uh hi.","title":"Jesus le Abraham"},"49":{"text":"Jesus in, “Doai vei ngawl khi hi, ka Pa ka thasia hi, ahihang note in kei nong thasia bua uh hi."},"50":{"text":"Keima atu in patoaina ka zong bua hi. Ahihang tuabangin zong a, kei hong panpui in thu a khen khat om hi."},"51":{"text":"A maan takin kong ci hi: a kuama po ka hilcianna a nite, a thi ngei buatu hi,” ci in zo hi."},"52":{"text":"Amate in, “Tu in nang sia doai vei na hi hunlam kong telcian uh hi! Abraham thi a, kamsaangte zongh thi hi, tua hi napi na hilcianna a nite peuma thi ngeingawl tu hi, ci ni hi."},"53":{"text":"Ih pa Abraham thi zo hi; Abraham sangin lianzaw khi hi a ci nuam na hi bua na ziam? Ahihang ama ka heak hi a, tuaciangin ama ii thu ka ni hi."},"56":{"text":"Na pa uh Abraham in kong pai hun a mu tu sia lawp hi; ama in mu zo a, a lungdam hi,” ci in zo hi."},"57":{"text":"Amate in ama munah, “Nang kum sawmnga zongh pha ngawl lai ni hi — Abraham sia mu zo ni ziam?” ci uh hi."},"58":{"text":"A maan takin kong ci hi, “Abraham pian ma in, ‘Keima’ ka om zo hi,” ci in Jesus in zo kik hi."},"59":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin, amate in a den natu suangte zamh ahihang Jesus kiheam a, Biakinnpi nusia hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus in lam a papai laitakin, mittaw sa a, a suak, pasal khat mu hi.","title":"Jesus in Mittaw sa a Suak khat Damsak"},"2":{"text":"A nungzuite in, “Syapa awng, akua mawna hangin, ama mittaw sa a suaksak ziam? Ama mawna hang ziam maw, a nu a pate ii mawna hang ziam,” ci in ama dongh uh hi."},"3":{"text":"“Ama mawnate hang ahizong, a nu a pa mawnate hang ahizong, a mittaw hi ngawl hi. Ama in “He ngawl khi hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaciang amate in a mittaw ngeipa sia, Phariseete kungah paipui uh hi.","title":"Phariseete in A Damna Thu kan"},"14":{"text":"Jesus in buan vawt a mittawpa a damsak ni sia Sabbath ni ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Phariseete in a mit khua a mu kik theina thu, pasalpa munah dongh kik uh hi. “Ama in ka mitte buan hong noisak hi; ka mai ka phiat a, tu in khua ka mu thei hi,” ci in ama in zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Phariseete pawlkhat in, “Hi bang a vawt, mihing in, Pathian kung pan hi thei ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile ama in Sabbath Thukham ni ngawl hi,” ci uh hi. Tuaciangin amate sungah pawl kikhenna khat hong om hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Phariseete in pasalpa khatvei ma dongh kik uh hi. “Ama in na khuamu ngawlna pan hong damsak hi, ci ni hi — ama huvau bangbangin na ngaisun ziam?” “Ama kamsaang khat hi,” ci in pasalpa in zo kik hi."},"18":{"text":"Jew thuneite in, bang po ahizong hisia pa mittaw a, tu in khuamu thei hi ci thu, a pa le a nu samin a dok phot ngawl peuma in a um nuam bua uh hi;"},"19":{"text":"tuaciangin, “Hisia na tapa ahi ziam? Ama mittaw sa in suak hi ci nu hi; tua ahile tu in bangbang khuamu thei ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi."},"20":{"text":"A pa le a nu in “Ama ka tapa uh hi a, tuaciangin mittaw sa in suak ci sia he khu hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang bangbangin tu in khuamu thei a, akua in damsak ziam ci zongh ka he bua uh hi. Ama dongh vun; a khan haam zo hi, ama ii thu ama in hong zo thei hi!” ci uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Jew biakna thuneite ii lungkimna sa khat om a, a kuama po Jesus sia Messiah hi ci in a um peuma, synagogue sung pan kihawlkhia tu hi, ci ahikom amate in Jew biakna thuneite a kiitak hu in, a nu le a pa in hi bangin ci ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua hangin, “Ama a khan haam zo hi, ama dongh vun!” a nu le a pa in ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Mittaw sa a suakpa sia, a nii veina sam kik uh a, ama tungah, “Thumaan ka son tu hi, ci in Pathian mai ah kiciam in! Nang hong damsak pa sia, mimaw khat hi ci in he khu hi,” ci uh hi."},"25":{"text":"“Ama mimaw ahile ahi ngawl he ngawl khi hi. ahihang khuamu thei khu hi, ci na hi uh kom, a maw nginge hi lai nu hi,” ci hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus in, “A tatakin kong ci hi: tuukhawk sungah a kongpi pan tum ngawlin leidang pan kaato a, a tum sia nguta le ngualsuam phalakte ahi hi.","title":"Tuucingpa Thusonteena"},"2":{"text":"Kongpi pan a tum sia in, tuucingpa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Kongkhacingpa in ama atu kongkha honsak hi; ama ii neisa tuute a min taw a sam ciangin a tuute in ama aw a za uh hi, tuaciang ama in, a tuute lampui in pusua pui hi."},"4":{"text":"A tuute a pusuasak zawkciang, ama in a mai ah pai in, tuute in a nung zui uh hi, banghang ziam cile a tuute in a aw tel uh hi."},"5":{"text":"A tuute in ngualdang khat zui ngawl tu uh hi; Kei kong paina sia, nuntakna na nga natu uh le a kicing nuntakna na nga thei natu uh ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Keima in tuute atu in a nuntakna a pia ngam tuucing pha ka hi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuu neipa a hi ngawl, a kicial tawm tuucingpa ahile ngiapui hong pai a mu ciangin, a tuute nusia in taisan hi; tua ahikom ngiapui in a tuute man a, kithethaangsak hi."},"13":{"text":"A kicial tawm pa banghangin tai ziam cile, ama sia a kicial tawm hi bek a, tuute a awlmawk bua hi."},"14":{"text":"Keima in tuucing pha ka hi hi. Amate atu in ka nuntakna ka pia ngam hi.","ref":"Mt 11:27; Lk 10:22","merge":"15"},"16":{"text":"Hi tuukhawk sung a om ngawl keima neisa tuu dangte zongh om lai hi. Hisia in ka Pa ii ka sep tu hong thupiak ahi hi,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaciang hi kammalte hu in mihingte sungah kikhenna om leleau hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate sung pan tam mama in, “Ama doaivei hi! Thumaan tatak sia hong son tan: nangma sia Messiah na hi ziam,” ci uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Jesus in “Hong son zo khi hi, ahihang kei hong um nuam ngawl nu hi. Ka Pa thuneina taw ka septe in keima luangin pau hi;"},"26":{"text":"ahihang nong um bua uh hi, banghang ziam cile note in ka tuute na hi bua uh hi,"},"27":{"text":"Ka tuute in ka aw hong ngai hi; amate ka he a, amate in ka nung hong zui uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate tawntung nuntakna ka pia a, tuaciangin amate a thi ngei nawn buatu hi. Tua ahile, Pathian Tapa khi hi ka ci ciang, bangbangin Pathian zawnsakna kam pau hi hong ci thei nu ziam?"},"37":{"text":"Pa ii seam a hong oaite seam ngawl ka hile, tuasia ciangin hong um heak vun."},"38":{"text":"Ahihang tuate ma ka seam nale, Pa sia kei sungah om a, kei sia Pa sungah om ka hina thu na up thei natu in, kei nong um bua uh zong, ka septe beak na up tu uh ahi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"39":{"text":"Khatvei ma amate in Jesus man tu in hanciam ahihang, amate khut taw kipeal hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Jesus in, Jordan ngun kaantan in John ii tuiphumna munah pai kik a, tua munah taam hi.","ref":"Jn 1:28"},"41":{"text":"Mihing tam mama ama kungah hong pai uh hi. Hisia pa ii nalamdang lakna a vawt theampo en vun!"},"48":{"text":"Hi bangin ama ih tha thong le, mihing theampo in ama um tu a, Rome thuneite in ih Biakinn le ih minam hong susia tu hi,” ci uh hi."},"49":{"text":"Amate sung pan tua kumin Thiampi Lianbel ahi Caiaphas kici sia in “Bang mawmawt nu ziam!"},"50":{"text":"Minam bup ii lal tu taangin, pasal khat sia mihingte atu thi le note atu phazaw ahi hunlam phawk ngawl nu ziam?” ci hi."},"51":{"text":"A tatak sia ama uuk thu taw, hi bangin pau ahi bua hi; tua taangin, ama tua kum sung Thiampi Lianbel ahi bangma, Jesus sia Jew mite atu in thi tu ci sia a sonkhol ahi zaw hi,"},"52":{"text":"tuaciang, amate atu bek hi ngawlin, Pathian mihing a kithethaang theampo pumkhat suak tu in kaikhop natu zongh a sonkhol ahi hi."},"53":{"text":"Tua ni pan kipan Jew thuneite in Jesus a thalup natu, ngealnate nei uh hi."},"54":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jesus, Judea ngam ah a kilangh takin, khualhaw nawn ngawl hi, ahihang tua mun nusia a, sennealngam nai Ephraim a kici khua khat ah pai in, a nungzuite taw taam hi."},"55":{"text":"Paisan Poai hun hong nai a, poai hun ma in ngamsung pan mihing tam mama kithiansua zeksa vawt tu in, Jerusalem ah pai uh hi."},"56":{"text":"Amate in Jesus zawzong uh hi, tuaciang, Biakinnpi sungah a kikhoptua uh laitakin khat le khat, “Bang na ngaisun uh ziam? Poai sungah hong pai ngawl het tu hi ngawl ziam?” ci in kidongh uh hi."},"57":{"text":"Thiampi liante le Phariseete in Jesus a kimat thei natu in ama omna a he a om le thu hong puak nanak tu nu hi, ci in thupia uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paisan Poai tu ni luk a kisap ciangin, Bethany ah Jesus pai a, thina pan a thawsak Lazarus ii inn ah tung hi.","title":"Jesus Bethany ah Sathau Kinoai (Mt 26:6:13; Mk 14:3-9)"},"2":{"text":"Amate in ama atu nitak an tua munah huansak uh hi. Sathau namtui in inn sung bup zel hi.","ref":"Lk 7:37-38"},"4":{"text":"Jesus nungzuite khat ahi Judas Iscariot — ama a leeheak tu pa — in,"},"5":{"text":"“Banghangin sathau namtui sia ngunn dangka zathum taw zuakin mizawngte kipia ngawl ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama ii hi bang a paute sia a zawngte awlmaw takpi hi ngawl a, ngutapa khat ahihang ahi hi. Hi sungah na kumpipa hong pai a, laano tungah to hi.”","ref":"Zec 9:9"},"16":{"text":"A nungzuite in hi thu sia tua hun laitakin a tel bua uh hi; ahihang Jesus minthanna sungah a thawtosak ciangin, laithiangtho in ama huvau, hi bangin at a, amate in hi bangin ama atu in vawt hi, ci sia phawk kik uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Lazarus thaan sung pan sam a, thina pan a thawsak lai in, Jesus taw a omkhawm mihingte in bang thu piang ci thu kiko tek uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuasia hu in mihon in ama muak uh hi — banghang ziam cile hi nalamdang a vawt sia amate in za zo uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Phariseete in khat le khat, “Na mu bang hi, eite in ih zo zo peuma bua hi! A thi le a tang tam piangsak hi."},"25":{"text":"A kuama po ama ii nuntakna a it sia in taan tu hi; ama ii nuntakna hi leitung ah a ngaimaw peuma in, tawntung nuntakna a keam ahi tu hi.","ref":"Mt 10:39; 16:25; Mk 8:35; Lk 9:24; 17:33"},"26":{"text":"Ka naseampa sia keima omna po ah, keima taw a om thei natu in, kei atu hong sepsak nuam peuma in kei hong zui kul tu hi. Leitung ngum tu in kong pai a, a tungah thukhen tu in kong pai bua hi."},"48":{"text":"Kei hong nial a, kong thupuak a saang ngawl peuma ama tungah thukhen tu khat a nei hi. Tua ahiciang ka thuson teng sia Pa ii son a hong sawl teng ahi hi,” ci hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in Paisan Poai vawt tu ni khat samh lai hi. Topa awng,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Jesus in “Tu a ka sep sia tu laitakin tel ngawl na hi uh hang nidang ciangin na tel tu uh hi,” ci in zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Peter in “Bang hun po ahizong kei peang hong silsak ngeingawl tu ni hi!” ci hi. “Na peang ka sil buale ka nungzui na hi nawn buatu hi,” ci in Jesus in zo kik hi."},"9":{"text":"Simon Peter in, “Tua ahile Topa awng, ka peang bek hong silsak heak in! Noma khat le khat tuabangin, na kisilsak vun."},"15":{"text":"No ii ettee tu ngamtatna khat kong koisak hi, tua hi a kei ii no tungah kong hi bang tatakin, no zongh khat le khat tungah na ngamta tavun."},"16":{"text":"A tatakin kong ci hi: sila khat sia a topa sangin lianzaw ngawl a, kamtaipa khat sia a sawlpa sangin lianzaw ngawl hi.","ref":"Mt 10:24; Lk 6:40; Jn 15:20"},"17":{"text":"Tu in thumaan he zo na hi uh kom, seam paih le uhte bangza in a lungdamte hi tu nu ziam!"},"18":{"text":"“Na vekpi atu ka sonna hi ngawl hi; ka teal sate keima in ka he hi. Na zaaksa uh hi hilcianna sia kei aa hi ngawl a, kei hong sawlpa Pa kung pan hong pai ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"“No taw kong omkhop lai ma in, hi thu hong son zo khi hi."},"26":{"text":"Pa ii keima min taw hong paisak tu Thaa Thiangtho ahi Hupa in na theampo hong hil tu a, kong son teng zongh hong phawk kiksak tu hi."},"27":{"text":"“Thinnopna kong nusiat hi; keima aituam neisa thinnopna kong pia hi. Leitung ii piak bangin kong pia bua hi. Thinngim in thinkiam heak vun; lau heak vun."},"28":{"text":"‘Hong nusia tu khi hi, ahihang no kung hong pai kik tu khi hi, ka ci sia na za zo uh hi.’ Nong it uh le Pa kung ka zot tu sia na lungdam tu uh hi; banghang ziam cile ama kei sangin lianzaw hi."},"29":{"text":"Hite theampo a pian ma tu laitakin hong sonkhol zo khi hi, hong pian takpi ciangin, na up thei natu uh ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"No taw hun sauzaw thuson thei nawn ngawl tu khi hi, banghang ziam cile hi leitung a ukpa hong pai hi. Ama in kei tungah bangma vaang hong nei bua hi,"},"31":{"text":"ahihang Pa ka itna sia, leitung in a heak kul tu hi; tua hu in ama ii thu hong piak babangin, na theampo ka vawt hi. “Hong pai tavun, hi mun panin pai tawng."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Keima in Sapitkung tatak ka hi a, ka Pa in huan neipa ahi hi.","title":"Jesus Sapitkung Tatak"},"2":{"text":"Ama in kei tungah a nga ngawl baak theampo sattan tu hi, sapitnga a ngana baak pawpo a thiantho natu le tamzaw a nga thei natu ho in heu tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Note sia hilcianna kong piakte hangin hong kithiangthosak zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Kei sungah hong om po tavun, no sungah kong om tu hi. A baak khat nguak bek a nga thei bua hi; a kung taw a kizop ciang bekin nga thei hi. Tuasia bangma in kei sungah nong om bua uh le a nga na nga thei buatu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Keima in sapitkung hi a, note in a baakte na hi uh hi. A kuama po in kei sungah hong om a, ama sungah kei ka om le ama in nga tam mama nga tu hi; banghang ziam cile kei ngawl taw bangma na vawt thei buatu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"A kuama po kei sungah hong om ngawlte thingbaak bangin kivawkin, kocip hi; tuabang a baakte kitawm in meimang sungah kibum a, kaanghtum hi."},"7":{"text":"Kei sungah nong om uh a, ka kammalte note sungah a om le tuasia ciang na uuk pawpo nong ngen tu a, na nga tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A nga tam na nga uh ciang ka Pa minthanna kilanghsak hi; tuabangin keima nungzuite na suak uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Pa ii kei hong it bangma in note kong it hi; kong itna sungah kip vun."},"10":{"text":"Ka Pa thupiakte ni a, ama ii itna sungah ka kip bangmain, kong thupiakte na ni uh le kong itna sungah na kip tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"“Note sungah ka lungdamna a om natu le na lungdamna uh a kicin natu in hi thu kong son hi."},"12":{"text":"Kong thupiak in hi thu ahi hi: keima ii kong it bangma in, khat le khat na ki it vun.","ref":"Jn 13:34"},"13":{"text":"Mihing khat ii a lawmte atu a nei thei a lianbel itna in amate atu ama ii nuntakna a piakna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciangin, ka thupiak bangin na seam uh le, ka lawmte na hi uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Naseamte awng, kong ci nawn bua hi, banghang ziam cile naseampa in a topa in bang teng vawt ziam, ci in a he bua hi. Tuasia taangin lawmte awng kong ci hi, banghang ziam cile Pa kung pan ka zaak thu theampo kong son zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Note in kei nong teal bua uh hi; keima in note a kikhomsuan a nga namte tam mama na nga natu in, kong teal a, nasep kong pia hi. Tua ahikom Pa in kei min taw, ama tungah na nget uh po, hong pia tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua hi a, hi thu in note tungah kong thupiak ahi hi: khat le khat na ki it tavun.","ref":"1 Jn 3:23; 2 Jn 5"},"18":{"text":"“Leitung in note hong ensan le keima hong ensan masa ahi sia phawk tavun.","title":"Leitung ii Etsatna"},"19":{"text":"Note leitung neisa hi le uhte leitung in ama aituam bangin hong it tu hi. Ahihang hi leitung panin note kong teal zo a, note leitung neisa na hi nawn bua uh hi; tua hu in leitung in note hong ensan hi"},"20":{"text":"Kong sonsa thu phawk tavun: ‘Silapa in a topa sangin lianzaw ngawl hi.’ Amate in kei hong vawtsia le no zongh hong vawtsia tu hi; amate in ka hilna a mang uh le no hilna zongh zui tu hi.","ref":"Mt 10:24; Lk 6:40; Jn 13:16"},"21":{"text":"Ahihang amate in hite theampo note tungah hong vawt tu hi, banghang ziam cile note keima neisa na hi uh hi; banghang ziam cile amate in kei hong sawlpa he ngawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate kungah pai in thuson ngawl hi leng amate in mawna a nei buatu uh hi; tu in ahile amate a mawna huvau in kamzon natu a nei nawn bua uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei hong ensan sia in ka Pa zongh a ensan ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Ngualdang ii vawt ngeingawlte amate sungah vawt ngawl hi leng amate in mawna a nei buatu uh hi; tu in ahile amate in ka sep teng hong mu zo a, kei le ka Pa hong ensan khawm hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahizong, amate Thukham sungah, ‘Amate in thu om ngawlpi in, kei hong ensan hi,’ ci in a ki at sia, a taangtun natu hi bang teng a pian kul hi.","ref":"Ps 35:19; 69:4"},"26":{"text":"“Thaa ahi Hupa hong pai tu a — Pathian ii thumaan thutak le Pa kung pan hong paipa sia hong pualaak tu hi. Pa kung panin ama kong puak tu a, ama in kei thu hong son tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaciang note zongh in kei thu na son tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile a kipatciil panin note kei taw nong omkhawm zo uh hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Na upna uh na thasua ngawl natu in, hi teng hong son khi hi."},"2":{"text":"Note synagogue pan hong kihawlkhia tu a, tuaciang note hong thatlum khat po in tuabang a ngamtat sia Pathian atu naseam in a kingaisut hun hong theng tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihingte in note tungah hi bang a ngamtat natu te sia amate in Pa ahizong kei ka hizong hong heak ngawl hang ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang hi bang kong sonna in, amate atu in hite a sep tu hun hong thet ciang kong sonsa teng na phaw thei natu uh ahi hi. “A kipatciil in hite kong son bua hi, banghang ziam cile keima in note taw ka omkhawm hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang tu in hong sawlpa kung zuan tu khi hi, tua hi napi kuama in ka pai natu mun nong dongh bua uh hi.","title":"Thaa Thiangtho Nasepna"},"6":{"text":"Tuaciang tu in hi thu kong son zawkciang na thinsung uh heena taw kidim hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahihang thumaan thutak hong son khi hi: kei pai leng no atu phazaw hi, banghang ziam cile kei ka pai buale Hupa note kungah hong pai ngawl tu hi. Ahihang kei ka pai le ama no kungah kong paisak tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciangin ama hong pai ciangin, mawna thu, a maan thu le Pathian thukhenna huvau a ngaisutna uhte maan ngawl hi ci in leitung mihingte tungah kilanghsak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Amate in mawna huvau ngaisun khial hi, banghang ziam cile amate in kei hong um ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in a maan thu zongh ngaisun khial hi, banghang ziam cile kei Pa kung ka zuan tu a, note in nong mu nawn buatu uh hi;"},"11":{"text":"tuaciang amate in, thukhenna thu telkhial hi, banghang ziam cile hi leitung a ukpa tungah thu kikhen zo hi."},"12":{"text":"“Thu son tu tam ma ka nei lai hi, ahihang tu laitak ahile note thuciin tu in tam lei tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahizong Thaa hong pai ciangin, Pathian thumaan thutak hong pualaak pa in thumaan thutak theampo sungah lam hong pui tu hi. Ama in ama aituam thuneina taw hong son ngawl tu hi, ahizong ama zaak teng hong son tu a, hong piang tu thute hong son tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in kei minthanna hong pia tu hi, banghang ziam cile ka sonte la tu a, tua teng note tungah hong son tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka Pa ii neisa theampo keima neisa hi; tua hu in Thaa in ka piakte la in no tungah hong son tu hi,” kong ci hi."},"16":{"text":"“Tawmvei no sungin kei nong mu nawn buatu uh a, tuaciang tawmvei zawkciangin nong mu tu uh hi,” ci hi.","title":"Heena le Lungdamna"},"17":{"text":"A nungzuite pawlkhat in amate sungah kidongh uh a, “Bang ci nuam hi tu ziam? Tawmvei sung eite in ama mu nawn ngawl tu a, tawmvei zawkciang ih mu tu hi; tuaciang ama in, ‘Banghang ziam cile Pa kungah ka pai tu hi’ ci si hi."},"18":{"text":"‘Tawmvei sung’ a ci sia bang a cinopna ziam? Ama in bang thu teng son ci sia ih he bua hi!” ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Jesus in ama thu dongh nuam ahi sia tel ahikom amate tungah, “ ‘Tawmvei sungin nong mu buatu uh a, tuaciang tawmvei zawkciangin nong mu tu uh hi,’ hong ci khi hi. Noma sung a na kidok thu in tu sia ahi ziam?"},"20":{"text":"A tatakin kong ci hi: note au in kap tu nu hi, ahihang leitung lungdam tu hi; note hee tu nu hi, ahihang na heena uh sia lungdamna hong suak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Numei khat nau a sua tu ciangin, hee hi, banghang ziam cile a ngim natu hun hong theng ahi hi; ahihang nau hong sua ciang ama in a ngimna teng mangil hi, banghang ziam cile leitung ah nausen khat hong suak ahi hu in, ama lungdam hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuasia bangma na hi tu uh hi: tu in hee nu hi, ahizong kei in note kong mu kik tu a, na thinsung uh lungdamna taw kidim tu hi, tua lungdamna in kuama ii hong laaksak thei ngawlte ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"“Tua ni hong thet ciangin, kei tungah bangma nong ngen buatu uh hi. A maan tatak kong ci hi: Pa in kei min suangin na nget pawpo hong pia tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuciang dong kei min suangin, bangma na ngen bualai uh hi; na lungdamna uh a pawlcin thei natu in, ngen vun na nga tu uh hi."},"25":{"text":"“Sonteena kammalte zangh in, hi thute kong son zo hi. Ahihang sonteena kammalte zangh ngawlin, Pa ii thu thiang takin kong son tu hun hong theng tu hi.","title":"Leitung Zawna"},"26":{"text":"Tua ni hong thet ciangin kei min suangin na ngen tu uh hi; tuaciang no luangin kong ngetsak tu hi kong ci bua hi,"},"27":{"text":"banghang ziam cile Pa, ama mama in note hong it hi. Ama in banghang note hong it ziam cile noma in kei nong it uh a, tuaciang Pathian kung pan hong pai ka hi sia nong um uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Pa kung panin kong pai takpi a, leitung ah kong pai zo hi; tu in leitung nusia in, Pa kungah ka pai tu hi,” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuasia ciang nungzuite in, “Tu ahile sonteena kamte zangh ngawlin a thiangin na son hi."},"30":{"text":"Na theampo na heak sia tu in kong he uh hi; kuama ii thu hong dok tu na kulsak bua hi. Hi thu in Pathian kung pan nong paina hong umsak hi,” ci uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Jesus in, “Tu in na um uh ziam?"},"32":{"text":"Note theampo kithethaang in, na inn tek zuanin, kei nguak nong nusiat tu uh hun hong theng tu hi, hi sung hong theng zo hi. Ahihang keima nguak ka hi bua hi, banghang ziam cile Pa in kei taw omkhawm hi."},"33":{"text":"Kei taw ih kikopna hangin thinnopna na nga natu hi thu kong sonsa hi. Leitung ka zo zo hi,” ci in zo hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus in hi teng a son zawkciang van ento in, “Pa awng, a hun hong theng zo hi. Tapa in nang tungah minthanna hong piak thei natu in, na Tapa tungah minthanna hong pia ta'n.","title":"A Nungzuite atu Jesus Thungen"},"2":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ama tungah na piaksa mi teng tawntung nuntakna a piak thei natu in, mihing theampo tungah thuneina ama tungah na pia zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang in tawntung nuntakna ci sia in nangma bek Pathian a maan ahi sia heakna le na sawlpa Jesus Christ heakna ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na minthanna leitung ah ka lak zo hi; sep tu a nong piak nasep sia ka man zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Pa awng! simlei pian ma a nangma taw a kibangin ih nei khop tua minthanna sia, tu in na mai ah kei hong pia ta'n."},"6":{"text":"“Leitung pan a nong piaksa mite kungah nangma kong hesak zo hi. A Thiangtho Pa awng! Nang le kei khat ih hi bangma in, amate pumkhat ahithei natu in, nong piaksa min ahi na min vaanglian taw amate keamcing ta in."},"12":{"text":"Amate taw ka omkhop lai in, nong piaksa min ahi na min vaanglian taw, amate ka keamcing zo hi, laithiangtho a tun thei natu, a mangthang tu in a kilaitan sa khat simngawl amate ka keam a, ka bosua bua hi.","ref":"Ps 41:9; Jn 13:18"},"13":{"text":"Tu in nang kungah kong zuan a, hi bang teng leitung ah ka sonna sia in a thinsung uh ah ka lungdamna a cingin a nei thei natu ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Na thupuak amate ka pia a, tuasia ciang leitung in amate ensan hi, banghang ziam cile keima leitung ii neisa ka hi ngawl bangma, amate leitung ii neisa ahi bua hi."},"15":{"text":"Hi leitung panin amate na laak natu in, kong ngen bua hi, ahihang Ngilo Pa khut sung pan na kepcing natu in kong ngen hi."},"16":{"text":"Keima leitung ii neisa ka hi ngawl bangma in, amate leitung ii neisa ahi bua uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Thumaan thutak taw nangma atu in amate na keam tuam in; na kammal in thumaan thutak hi."},"18":{"text":"Nangma in leitung ah kei nong sawl bangma in, amate leitung ah ka sawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate zongh maan tak a, nang tungah hong ki aap thei natu, amate atu ka ngaisutsakna in, keima le keima nang tungah kong ki aap hi."},"20":{"text":"“Amate atu bek ngen ngawlin, amate ii thupuak hangin, kei hong um teng atu zongh kong ngen hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate a vekpi in pumkhat ahithei natu in kong ngen hi. Pa awng! Nangma in keima sungah nong om a, keima in nangma sungah kong om bangma in, amate in eima sungah hong om tahen. Leitung in nong sawl ka hi hunlam hong up natu amate pumkhat suak thei tahen."},"22":{"text":"Nang le kei pumkhat ih hi bangma, amate pumkhat ahithei natu in, kei nong piak minthanna sia ma amate ka pia hi:"},"23":{"text":"Leitung in nong sawlna thu le, keima nong it bangma amate na itna thu a heak thei natu, amate pumkhat a sua bup thei natu in, keima in amate sungah om in, nangma in keima sungah nong om hi."},"24":{"text":"“Pa awng! Amate nong piaksa hi a, nong piaksa ka minthanna sia a mu thei natu in, ka omna munah hong om tek tu ka dei hi; banghang ziam cile, simlei a kipiansak ma in, nong it zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Thumaan thutang Pa awng! Leitung in nang hong he bua hi, ahihang keima in kong he hi, tuaciang hite in nong sawl ahi hunlam he uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Kei nong itna amate sungah a om thei natu le amate sungah kei zongh ka om thei natu in, nang sia amate in ka hesak zo a, tuabang ma in ka seam suak lai tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 41:9; Jn 13:18"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus in hi thungetna teng a nget zawkciang a nungzuite taw Kidron luam a kici sia kaantan in pai hi.
