Ama sia sawltakte in mu uh a, Pathian Ngam thu ama in sonpui hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate hong kikhoptua uh ciangin, hi bangin thupia hi: “Jerusalem nusia heak vun, no tungah kong sonsa Pa ii kamciam hong piaksa letsong sia, na ngak vun,","ref":"Lk 24:49"},"5":{"text":"John in tuidam taw tui hong phum hi, ahihang ni tawmvei no sungin, note Thaa Thiangtho taw na ki baptize tu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 3:11; Mk 1:8; Lk 3:16; Jn 1:33"},"6":{"text":"Sawltakte in Jesus taw a kisik uh ciangin, “Topa awng, Israel mite tungah a Ngam na pia kik tu ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi.","title":"Jesus Vantung ah Kilato"},"7":{"text":"Jesus in, “Hunte le thunei theinate sia ka Pa zeak hi a, bang hun ciang hi tu cisia no heak tu thu hi ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang Thaa Thiangtho note tungah hong pai ciang, vaangletna taw na kidim tu uh a, Jerusalem pan kipan Judea ngam bup le Samaria ngam le leimong dongin, ka tetti na hi tu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 28:19; Mk 16:15; Lk 24:47-48"},"9":{"text":"Hi teng a ci zawkciang, amate mu tangin, van ah ama kilato a, meeikaai in lia hi.","ref":"Mk 16:19; Lk 24:50-51"},"10":{"text":"Ama ii paina san vantung salh in, a om uh laitakin, puankaang silh pasal nii sia amate kungah hong ding a,"},"11":{"text":"amate in, “Galilee mite awng, van ento in banghangin tua munah ding top nu ziam? Hi Jesus sia note kung pan vantung ah a kilaak to na mu uh bang tatak ma in hong pai kik tu hi,” ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Sawltakte in Jerusalem pan kilometre khat bang a khualana Olive Mual panin, Jerusalem ah cia kik uh hi.","title":"Judas Iscariot Laihpa (Mt 27:3-10)"},"13":{"text":"Amate Jerusalem khua sungah tumin, a taam ngeina mun inn tung dawl sungah om uh hi. Amate teng sia Peter, John, James le Andrew, Philip le Thomas, Bartholomew le Matthew, Alphaeus, ii tapa James, Minam it Simon, le James ii tapa Judas ahi uh hi.","ref":"Mt 10:2-4; Mk 3:16-19; Lk 6:14-16"},"14":{"text":"Jesus ii suapui pate, a nu Mary le numei dangte taw amate pawlkhat, thungen tu in kikhawmtua nithi uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ni tawmvei zawkciangin, thu um teng kikhopna khat om a, mihing za le kul bang pha uh hi. Tuaciang Peter sia thuson tu in, ding hi."},"16":{"text":"“Ka suapuite awng, Thaa Thiangtho in David tungtawnin, Jesus a man tute, lam a lak Judas huvau a sonkholna laithiangtho kammalte a taangtut kul hi."},"17":{"text":"Judas sia koma ii pawl mi khat ahi hi, banghang ziam cile koma ii nasepna sungah, ama zongh nasep khat nei tu in, a kiteal pa ahi hi.”"},"18":{"text":"(Judas in ama ii ngitlo ngamtatna taw a nga sum taw lo khat lei a, tuasung ah pukvawk in thi hi; ama sia puaktham in, a ngil keekeak hi.","ref":"Mt 27:3-8"},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem ah a teang mihing theampo in tua thu za ahikom, tua lo sia, amate kam in Akeldama, a khiakna sia “Chisan Lo” ci in min phuak uh hi.)"},"20":{"text":"“Banghang ziam cile Psalm late ii sungah, ‘Ama ii bangkua awngthong tahen a, kuama a teang om heak hen,’ ci in ki at a, ‘A nasepna mun zongh midang khat in laih tahen,’ ci in ki at si hi.","ref":"Ps 69:25; 109:8"},"21":{"text":"“Tua ahikom, Topa Jesus thaw kikna tetti in a pang tu mihing khat kote sungah hong kibelap kul hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama sia bangbang mihing hi tu ziam cile, John ii tuiphumna huvau a hil hun pan kipan Jesus van ah a kilaak to dong a kilaklaw teng, Jesus khualhawna theampo sung, ko pawl sungah hong kihel top khat ahi kul hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 3:16; Mk 1:9; 16:19; Lk 3:21; 24:51"},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in, mihing nii ii min aap uh hi. Barsabbas a kici Joseph (Justus zongh kici si) khat le, Matthias ahi uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate in, “Topa awng, mihing theampo ii thinsung na he hi. Tua ahiciang, Topa awng, hite nii sung pan koisia teal ni ziam hong lak ta'n."},"25":{"text":"Judas in a zot natu zuanin a nusiat sawltak za a awng sia dip natu in hong hesak ta'n” ci in thungen uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin amate in, tua mite nii sung pan, a kiteal natu in, lai aisaan a, Matthias kiteal ahikom, sawltak sawm le khat te ii pawl sungah ama kibelap hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pentecost ni hong thet ciangin, thu um theampo mun khat ah kikhawm uh hi.","title":"Thaa Thiangtho Hong paina","ref":"Thiam 23:15-21; Thkna 16:9-11"},"2":{"text":"Thakhat thu in, van pan a nging khat hong om a, vui nasia tak a vak ngawp ciang, a luum himhum bang hi in, amate tona inn buppi sia tua a nging taw kidim hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin amate in leei taw a kibang meikuang mu uh a, tua munah a om mihing khat sim sia, tua meikuang in thutha hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate sia Thaa Thiangtho taw kidim uh a, Thaa ii a pausak bangin, kampau dangte taw pau uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua laitak leitung theampo pan hong pai biakna kin Jew te Jerusalem khua ah teang uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Hi awnging sia a zaak uh ciangin, mihon khat hong kikhawm uh hi. Amate liinglawng ngawp uh hi. Banghang ziam cile thu umte ii pauna sia, amate tek ii kam taw za uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Lamdangsakna taw amate in hi bangin ci uh hi. “Tu a bangin a pau mihingte sia Galilee mite ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hikasap amate pau sia, eima kam tek taw ih zaak sia bangbang ziam?"},"9":{"text":"Eite sia Parthia, Media le Elam pan hikale, Mesopotamia, Judea le Cappadocia pan, Pontus le Asia pan,"},"10":{"text":"Phrygia le Pamphylia pan, Egypt le Cyrene taw a kinai Libya pan, pawlkhat Rome pan,"},"11":{"text":"Jew le Gentile te Jew biakna a suakte, tuaciang eite pawlkhat sia Crete le Arabia pan — hi napi ih mihing sim in eima kam tek taw Pathian nasep lianpi a sepna ih za tek hi!”"},"12":{"text":"“Hisia in bang thu ziam?” ci in lamdangsakna le lungdamna taw khat le khat kidongh uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahizong pawlkhatte in thu umte sia nunau a, “Hi mihingte in zukham hi!” ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang Peter in a dang sawltak sawm le khat te taw ding a, mihonte tungah nging takin thuson hi: “Jew minampuite le Jerusalem ah a teang note theampo awng, hong ngai tavun, hisia in bang thu ziam ci sia hong sonsak tavun.","title":"Peter ii Thu Sonna"},"15":{"text":"Hi lai a, mihingte sia no upmawk bangin, zukham hi ngawl hi. Tu laitak sia zingsang nai kua hi pheang hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hi zaw ngawlin, hisia in kamsaangpa Joel ii sonsa thu hi a:"},"17":{"text":"‘Hisia in ni tawpkhak sang ciangin ka vawt tu thu ahi hi, Pathian in ci hi: Ka thaa ka buak tu hi. Na tapate le na tanute in, keima thu thangsak tu uh hi. Na khangnote in mang mu tu uh hi; Na khanghaamte in, mang man tu uh hi.","ref":"Jol 2:22-32"},"18":{"text":"Hi hi, pate zongh numeite zongh ka naseamte ngawngawn tung zongh ah tua ni ciangin, ka thaa ka buak tu a, tuaciang amate in keima ii thu thangsak tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Van ah a lamdang laknate ka vawt tu a, leitung ah a lamdang nate ka piangsak tu hi; chisan, meikuang le meikhu ciikte hong om tu hi:"},"20":{"text":"Ni hong mial a hong zing tu hi. Tha in chi bangin san tu hi. A lian a minthang Topa Ni hong thet ma in, tuabang hong piang tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin, huna ngen a, Topa a biakpui peuma kingum tu hi,’ ci hi."},"22":{"text":"“Hi kammalte ngai vun. Israel mipuite awng! Nazareth mi Jesus sia Pathian in ama tungtawnin a vawt nalamdang laknate le a lamdangte theampo hu in Pathian piak thunei pa tatak ahi hunlam kilangh hi. Noma mama in zongh, hi thu he nu hi, banghang ziam cile hi mun note sungah hi thu piang hi."},"23":{"text":"Pathian in ama thuneina le tupna taw Jesus sia no khut sungah ki aap tu in zeak zo hi; tuaciang mimawte in, ama sia thinglamtee tungah na kilhsakna uh taw note in ama na thatlum zo uh hi.","ref":"Mt 27:35; Mk 15:24; Lk 23:33; Jn 19:18"},"24":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in ama sia, a thite kawm pan phong kik a, thina vaang panin suaktasak hi, banghang ziam cile, thina in ama thong sungah a khumcip tu sia suak thei ngawl hi.","ref":"Mt 28:5-6; Mk 16:6; Lk 24:5"},"25":{"text":"Tua ahikom, David in ama huvau ah, ‘Topa sia a tawntungin ka mai ah ka mu hi; ama sia ka kungah om ahikom, ngim ka nga buatu hi.","ref":"Ps 16:8-11"},"26":{"text":"Hi thu hangin lungdamna taw ka kidim a, tuaciang ka kammalte in lungdamna taw kidim hi. Tuaciang kei sia a thithei ka hi hangin, muanmawkna sungah, thin muangin ka tawlnga tu hi,"},"27":{"text":"banghang ziam cile, nang in ka thaa sia mithite khua ah nong nusia buatu hi; nang in na naseampa, thaan sungah a muatcip tu in nong oai buatu hi."},"28":{"text":"Nuntakna lampi nong lak zo a, tuaciang nangma nong ompuina in, lungdamna taw nong kidimsak tu hi,’ ci hi."},"29":{"text":"“Suapuite awng, a minthang ih taanghpupi David kumpipa thu sia thiangtho takin, ka son kul hi. Ama sia thi in kiphum hi. Ama thaan zongh tuni dongin, eima kungah om nginge hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama sia kamsaang khat hi a, David ii suan sung pan khat sia, David bangma in kumpi khat a suasak natu, Pathian ii kamciam a piaksa ahi hunlam ama in he hi.","ref":"Ps 132:11; 2 Sa 7:12-13"},"31":{"text":"David in Pathian ii a vawt tu khat mukhol zo ahikom, Messiah thaw kikna thu, hi bangin son hi. ‘Ama sia mithite khua ah kinusia ngawl hi. a pumpi thaan sungah muat ngawl hi.’"},"32":{"text":"Pathian in hi Jesus mama mithite sung pan phong a, ko theampo in hi thu ah tetti ka pang uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama sia Pathianziatsang ah to tu in kiphong a, ama in, a Pa kamciam bangma in, Thaa Thiangtho saang hi. Tuaciangin tu a na mu uh na zaak uh sia, ama letsong kote tungah hong buaksuk sia ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile vantung ah a kaato pa in David hi ngawl hi, ama in, ‘Topa in ka Topa tungah: Hi sung ka ziatsang ah,","ref":"Ps 110:1"},"35":{"text":"Na ngalte na peang nuai ah peang ngakna bangin kong koisak mateng in, hong to ta'n,’ ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Israel mite theampo ii telthiang tu thu in, hi Jesus thinglamtee tungah na kilh uh pa sia, Topa le Messiah tu a, Pathian vawt sa ahi hi!” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua mihingte in hi thu a zaak uh ciangin, nasia takin a thin uh ngim a, Peter le sawltak dangte munah, “Suapuite awng, bang law tu khu ziam?” ci uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Na mawnate uh hong kimaisak a, Pathian ii tel, Thaa Thiangtho na saan natu in, note khat sim in, na mawnate pan kikheal nanak vun a, Jesus min taw tui kiphum tavun,"},"39":{"text":"banghang ziam cile Pathian kamciam sia, no le na tate le, a khualana ah a omte atu in a kivawt hi a, tuaciangin Topa Pathian ii ama kungah a samsa theampo atu ahi hi,” ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Peter in amate tungah zolna le hanthotna kammal tam mama zangh a, “Hi mihing seksolte ii thuak tu daan pan suakta tavun!” ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Mihing tam mama in a thuson um a, tui kiphum uh hi. Tua ni in mihing tulthum bang pawlpi sungah kibelap hi."},"42":{"text":"Amate in a hun neite uh sia, sawltakte tung pan thusinna in zangh a, kipawlna sung, pawl anneakkhopna le thungetna sungah kihel tek uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Nalamdang laknate le a lamdang tam mamate, sawltakte tungtawnin kivawt a, hi thu hu in mihing theampo in lamdangsakna taw kidim uh hi.","title":"Thu Umte sungah Nuntakna"},"44":{"text":"Thu umte theampo in kithawl vadiam in, a neisate khat le khat kihawm in, om suak uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 4:32-35"},"45":{"text":"Amate in a neisate zuak a, mihing khat sim ii a kitaangsapna babang taw kizui in, a sum hawm uh hi."},"46":{"text":"Kipawlkhawm in Biakinnpi ah ni sim kikhawm uh a, lungdamna le kiniamkhiakna thin taw inn ah an zongh nekhawm uh hi,"},"47":{"text":"Pathian pokin mihing theampo ii diksakna zongh nga uh hi. Topa in ni simin, ngupna nga mihing amate pawl sungah belap hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat Peter le John sia thunget hun, nitak nai thum in Biakinn ah pai uh hi.","title":"Peangbai Pasal khat Kidamsak"},"2":{"text":"Kongpi Hoi kicina munah a khan tawntung peangzaw pasal khat om hi. Biakinnpi ah a pai mite ii tung pan sum ngen tu in ama sia nisimin tua kongpi hui ah puakin kikoi hi."},"3":{"text":"Peter le John sungtang tu a mu ciangin, bang khat po ama a piak tu in, ngen hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in pasalpa sia a tangtan in salh uh a, Peter in, “Hong en ta'n!” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate tung pan, na khat pawpo nga tu in, kimuanmawkna taw en hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang Peter in, “Sum le paai nei ngawl khi hi, ahizong ka nei sia hong pia tu khi hi: Nazareth mi Jesus Christ min taw thoto in lampai in, ci in thu kong pia hi!” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin a khut ziatsang pan len in, dingsak hi. Thakhat thu in, pasalpa peangte le a siakmitte hat hi;"},"8":{"text":"ama sia kilawn in, a peang taw ding a, lampai tu in kipan hi. Tua zawkciangin, amate taw Biakinnpi sungah tum a, lampai in, kilawn in, Pathian pok hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihon bup in, tuabang kalsuan a, Pathian a pok laitakin, mu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"“Kongpi Hoi” kici Biakinn tumna a, khutdaw ngenpa ahi hunlam, a heak uh ciangin, ama tungah thupiang sia lamdang sa mama uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua pasalpa in Peter le John lenin, a om laitak, tua munah a om mihing theampo in Solomon ii Talaap a kicina mun dong del uh hi.","title":"Biakinnpi sungah Peter Thusonna"},"12":{"text":"Peter in mipite a mu ciangin, “Israel mipuite awng, banghangin hi tungtaang ah lamdang sa in, ko sia hong salh ngengu nu ziam? Ko ii vaangletna, ahibuale Pathianzia ka neina uh taw, hisia pa lampaisak thei hong sa nu ziam?"},"13":{"text":"Abraham, Isaac le Jacob te ii Pathian, ih taanghpupite ii Pathian in, a Naseampa Jesus sia Pathian piak minthanna pia hi. Noma in ama sia Jew lampuite tungah na aap uh hi. Pilate in ama suaktasak tu in, a khensat zawkciang zong, Pilate mai ah na nial uh hi.","ref":"Pu 3:15"},"14":{"text":"Ama sia thiangtho a, pha hi napi na nial uh a, ama taangin, mihing thatpa khat Pilate ii suatak a piak tu in, na ngen zaw uh hi.","ref":"Mt 27:15-23; Mk 15:6-14; Lk 23:13-23; Jn 19:12-15"},"15":{"text":"Tua hi a, nuntakna a pia pa, note in na thatlum uh hi. Ahitazong, Pathian in ama thina panin, phongto a, hi thu huvau ah, kote in tetti ka hi uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama' min ii vaang in hi peangzaw pa thahatna pia hi. Na mu uhte le na heak uhte sia, ama ii min upna taw a kivawt hi; Na mu tek siat uh bangma in Jesus a upna in, ama damsak ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"“Tu in ka mipui Israel te awng, note le na lampuite ii, Jesus tungah na ngamtat uhte, tel ngawl vai ahi hunlam hong he khi hi."},"18":{"text":"Pathian in nidang lai pekin, kamsaang theampo ii muk panin, Messiah in a thuak kul tu hi, ci in a thu thangsak khol zo hi; tuaciang hi bangin tungsak hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahiciang kisiik kik vun a, Pathian kung zuan vun, tua hile na mawnate hong kimaisak tu hi. Tuabang na hi uh le,"},"20":{"text":"Topa hong ompuina panin, thahatna hong piang tu hi, tuaciangin, no atu a kiteal kholsa Messiah ahi Jesus sia ama in hong paisak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Pathian kamsaang thiangthote ii khuangei hunlai a, a sonkhol sa bangma in, na theampo a kithaksua siat dong, ama in vantung ah om hamtang tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Moses in, ‘Na Topa Pathian in kei hong paisak bangma in, kamsaang khat hong paisak tu a, ama sia noma mite sung pan khat hi tu hi. Ama ii sep tu hong son thu theampo na ni tu uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:15-18"},"23":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in, tua kamsaangpa ci bang a ni ngawl sia Pathian mite sung pan kituam khenin kisusia tu hi’ ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:19"},"24":{"text":"Tuaciangin Samuel le ama zawkciang hong piangte pan kipan, thu son tu a nei kamsaang theampo in tu hun dongin a piang tawto thute son lai hi."},"25":{"text":"Kamsaangte tungtawn a, Pathian kamciamte note atu ahi hi. Pathian le na taanghpupite thuciamna a siimte na hi uh hi. Pathian in Abraham tungah, ‘Na suan, na paalte tungtawnin, leitung mihing theampo thupha ka pia tu hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Pian 22:18"},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom note theampo in na ngitlo nate pan kikheal a, thupha hong piak thei natu in, Pathian in a Naseampa teal in note kungah hong sawl masa hi,” ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Peter le John mihingte tungah thu a son laitakin, thiampite pawlkhat, biakinn cingte a ukpa le Sadducee te pawlkhat amate kungah theng uh hi.","title":"Council mai ah Peter le John Thu kisit"},"2":{"text":"Amate lungkim ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile, mithite thaw kik tu thu a kilanghsakna in, Jesus sia thina pan tho kik zo hi, cina thu sawltakte nii in mihingte tung a hil hu ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in, sawltakte nii manin, ni niam zo ahikom a zing ciang dong thong sungah khum uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang a thuson a za mihing tam mama in um a, thu um mi tulnga bang khang hi."},"5":{"text":"A zing ciangin Jew lampuite, upate le Thukham hil syate, Jerusalem ah kikhawm uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in Thiampi Lianbel Annas, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, le Thiampi Lianbel ii innkuanpui dangte taw kimu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in sawltakte sia a mai ah dingsak a, “Hi sia bangbangin seam nu ziam? Note in bang vaang nei a, akua min zangh nu ziam?” ci in dongh uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Thaa Thiangtho taw a kidim Peter in zo a, “Minamte lampui le upate awng,"},"9":{"text":"peangzaw pa tungah thupha vawtna le ama a kidamsakna hu in, kote tuni in, thu sit thuak ka hi uh le"},"10":{"text":"no teng le Israel mi theampo in hi mihingpa sia thinglamtee tung na thalup, Pathian ii thina pan a phok kik Nazareth mi Jesus Christ min taw dam thiang in hi sung note mai ah hong ding ahi hunlam na heak uh kul tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesus sia laithiangtho in hi bangin a ci pa ahi hi. ‘No inn sate ii na nil uh suang sia, a theampo sung pan a thupibel suang suak hi.’","ref":"Ps 118:22"},"12":{"text":"Ngupna sia ama bek tungtawnin kinga thei hi; leitung bup ah eite hong ngum thei tu in, Pathian piaksa midang khat zongh om ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Council upate in, Peter le John sia mihing thawthong hi a, pilna nei ngawl hi napi, tuza in a hansanna sia lamdang sa uh hi. Tuasia ciangin amate ngeal sia Jesus ii kitholpui ngeite ahi hunlam phawk uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahizong amate in bangma a ci thei bua uh hi, banghang ziam cile a kidamsakpa sia, Peter le John taw tua munah dingkhawm in a om mu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate Council zum pan pusuak tu in sawl a, tua zawkciang amate sungah, kikum uh hi."},"16":{"text":"“Hi mite bang law tu hi ziam?” ci in amate kidongh uh hi. “Jerusalem a teang mihing sim in, hi a lamdang mama nalamdang lakna amate in vawt uh hi, ci in he siat zo uh a, ih nial thei bua hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahihang mihingte sungah, hi thu a kizel ngawl natu in, Jesus min suang a, a pau kikik nawn ngawl natu amate tawngin thupia tawng,” ci uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate sam a, sungtangsak kikin, Jesus min taw thu a son ngawl natu, a hil ngawl natu in thupia uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahihang Peter le John in zo kik a, “Pathian mai ah — note thu kong nit tu le, Pathian thu ka nit tu uh, koisia maan zaw ziam, noma tek in khensat tavun."},"20":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ka mu sa uh, ka zaaksa uh thute son ngawlin, ka om thei buatu uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Council te in, nasia seseam in a kidop natu in, tawng a, thu a piak zawkciang suaktasak hi. Amate daan piak tu suak thei ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile mi theampo in thupiang sa sia tungtaang ah Pathian pok kim uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Hi nalamdang lakna ahi a kidamsak pa sia kum sawmli vaal pha zo hi."},"23":{"text":"A kisuataksak po ciang Peter le John sia a pawlte kungah heak kikin, thiampi liante le upate ii son teng son uh hi.","title":"Thu umte in Han natu Thungen"},"24":{"text":"Thu umte in a zaak uh ciang, Pathian tungah hi bangin thungen khawm uh hi: “Vantung, leitung le tuipi le a sungah a om theampo ii Topa le Bitphuapa!","ref":"Pu 20:11; Neh 9:6; Ps 146:6"},"25":{"text":"Thaa Thiangtho tungtawnin, kote taanghpupi David, na naseampa tungah hi bangin na ci hi. ‘Banghangin Gentile te sia a thin uuk ngawp ziam; banghangin mihingte in a vaal thawthongin vaihawm ku ziam?"},"26":{"text":"Leitung kumpite in amate le amate kithoai kholin, tuaciangin ukpite kikhawmtua a, Topa le ama ii Messiah langpan uh hi.’","ref":"Ps 2:1-2"},"27":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Herod le Pontius Pilate in hi khuapi ah Gentile te le Israel mite taw kisitua in, a thiangtho na Naseampa Jesus, Messiah tu a, na vawt pa sia langpan takpi uh hi.","ref":"Mt 27:1-2; Mk 15:1; Lk 23:1,7-11; Jn 18:28-29"},"28":{"text":"Nangma vaangletna le na deina taw tuabangin piang hen ci a, na khensat sa theampo a taangtun natu in, amate kisitua uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tu in Topa awng, amate hong tawnnate, na za in a, ko na naseamte in, na thu hangsan tak ka son thei natu in, hong piangsak ta'n."},"30":{"text":"Cidamna a pian natu in, na khut hong vaan ta'n a, nalamdang laknate le, a lamdang vawtte, a thiangtho na Naseampa Jesus min taw a kisep thei natu, hong thukim ta'n,” ci uh hi."},"31":{"text":"A thunget a man uh ciangin amate kikhopna mun sia kingawk hi. Amate sia Thaa Thiangtho taw kidim a, Pathian thu sia hanna taw son tu in kipan uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Thu umte pawl sia thinkhat lungkhat in, om uh hi. Kuama in kei aituam neisa hi, a ci om ngawlin, a neisa uh theampo khat le khat kihawm vadiam uh hi.","title":"Thu umte in A neisa Theampo Kumkhawm","ref":"Sawl 2:44-45"},"33":{"text":"Sawltakte in Topa Jesus thaw kikna thu, vaangletna lian taw, tetti pang uh a, Pathian in thupha tam mama amate theampo tungah buak hi."},"34":{"text":"Amate pawl sungah kitaangsapna a nei kuama a om bua hi. Lo neite le inn neite in, zuakin a nga uh sumte paipui a,"},"35":{"text":"sawltakte tungah aap uh hi. Tuaciang, tua sumte mihing sim in, a kisapna uh bangin, hawm tek uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuaciang, Cyprus ah a suak, Levi mi Joseph, sawltakte ii Barnabas a nak pa (a khiakna “hanthawnpa”)"},"37":{"text":"in, a neisa lo khat zuakin, a sum teng paipui a, sawltakte tungah aap hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahihang Ananias min nei mihing khat om a, a zi Sapphira taw a neisa pawlkhat zuak hi.","title":"Ananias le Sapphira"},"2":{"text":"A zi zongh ii thukimpuina taw sum pawlkhat amate atu keam tuam a, a om lai teng sawltakte aap hi."},"3":{"text":"Peter in, “Ananias awng, banghangin Satan in na thin uksak a, Thaa Thiangtho theam in, na neisate zuak man sum aheap banghangin keam ni ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Na neisa na zuak ma in, nangma aa ahi hi; tuaciang na zuak zawkciangin, tua sum sia nangma aa ma ahi hi. Tua hikasap banghangin tuabang ngamtat tu khensat ni ziam? Mihingte a theam na hi bua hi — Pathian a theam suak zo ni hi!” ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi thu a zaak po ciang, Ananias pukin thi hi; tuaciang tua thu a za theampo lau uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Khangnote hong tum a, a luang tun in, pusuapui in phum uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Nai thum bang kihal zawkciangin, bang thu piang ci he ngawlin a zi hong sungtang hi."},"8":{"text":"Peter in ama munah, “Na neisa na zuak uh sung pan, hi teng sia nang le na pasal ii na nga uh a buppi ma ahi nam, hong son ta'n,” ci hi. “Hi hi, a buppi ma hi,” ci in zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom Peter in ama tungah, “Banghangin nang le na pasal in, Topa ii Thaa sia ze et nu ziam? Na pasal a phumte sia tu laitakin, kongbiang ah om hi, nangma zongh amate in hong pua tu a, hong pusuapui tu hi!” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Thakhat thu in ama sia Peter peang ah puk in thi hi. Khangnote sungtang a, ama sia a thisa in mu uh hi, tua ahikom amate in doipua ah pusua in, a pasal hui ah phum uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Pawlpi bup le hi thu a za mihing theampo lau mama tek uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Sawltakte in mihingte sungah nalamdang laknate le a lamdangte tam mama vawt uh hi. Thu um theampo Solomon Talaap ah kisitua uh hi.","title":"Nalamdang laknate le A lamdang vawtte Thu"},"13":{"text":"Mihingte in amate sia phat son mama napi a puasang mi kuama in a pawm ngam bua uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang mihing tam vaial amate pawl sungah kibelap a — Topa a um pa le numei honkhat suak hi."},"15":{"text":"Sawltakte nasepna hangin, lampite tungah ciinate hong kipua a, Peter hong pai ciang ciinate pawlkhat tungah ama ii limh beak ii a liap thei natu dei in, lupnate tung le phahte tungah sialin lampi hui ah lumsak uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaciang in Jerusalem kiim khuate pan mihonpite hong pai in, ciinate le doaiveite paipui uh hi; tuaciang amate theampo kidamsak hi."},"17":{"text":"Thiampi Lianbelpa le a pawl a lawm theampo, le tua mun a om Sadducee pawlte in sawltakte sia nasia takin eang uh hi; tua ahikom thu vawt tu in khensat uh hi.","title":"Sawltakte Kivawtsia"},"18":{"text":"Amate in sawltakte manin, nautaangte kikhumna thong sungah khum uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahihang tua zanin Topa vantunglalang khat in thong kongkha hon a, sawltakte a pusuasak zawkciangin, amate tungah,"},"20":{"text":"“Pai tavun a, Biakinn sungah dingin, hi nuntakna thak thu, mihingte tungah son tavun,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Sawltakte in, a sawl bangin ni a, khuavak ciangin Biakinnpi sungah tumin, hilcianna nei tu in kipan uh hi. Thiampi Lianbelpa le a pawl a lawmte in Jew lampuite theampo Council bup kikhopna ah kikhawm tu in sam uh hi; tua zawkciangin sawltakte amate mai ah a paipui natu in thonginn ah thupia uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang thong ukte thonginn a thet uh ciangin, sawltakte thong sungah a mu bua uh hi, tua ahikom Council zum ah heak kikin a thu bang teng son a,"},"23":{"text":"“Thonginn ka thet uh ciangin, thong kongkhate kikalh bikbek in om a, kongkhacing theampo zongh thong kongcing in ka mu uh hi; ahihang kongkha ka hon uh ciang, a sungah kuama ka mu bua uh hi!” ci uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Biakinn cingte ukpa le thiampi liante in, hi thu a zaak uh ciangin, sawltakte bang tat hi tu ziam, ci in lamdang sa uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuasia ciang pasal khat hong sungtang a, amate munah, “Ngai vun! Thong sung a na khum uhte in mihonte hilcian in, Biakinnpi sungah om uh hi!” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom Biakinn cing ukpa sia, a khutnuai mihingte taw pai in, sawltakte paipui kik uh hi. Amate in mihingte ii suangtum taw a den tu lau ahikom, sawltakte tungah zawthawk thu a zangh ngam bua uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Sawltakte sungtan pui uh a, Council te mai ah, dingsakin, Thiampi Lianbelpa in thusit hi."},"28":{"text":"“Hisia pa min taw thu hilcian thei nawn ngawl tu nu hi, ci in nasia takin thu kong pia zo uh hi; ahihang tu in bang vawt kik nu ziam! Jerusalem khuathing ah, na thu hilcianna uh kizelsak zo a, ama thina thu kote maw hong pusak nuam nu hi!” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 27:25"},"29":{"text":"Peter le sawltak dangte in zo kik a, “Pathian thu ka nit tu uh hi a, mihingte thu ka nit tu uh hi ngawl hi."},"30":{"text":"Note in Jesus thinglamtee tungah kilh in, na thalup zawk uh ciang, ka taanghpupite ii Pathian in Jesus thina panin phong kik hi."},"31":{"text":"Israel mite a mawna uh panin, kisiik kik a, mawmaisakna a nga natu hunpha pia tu in, Pathian in ama thosak kik a, a ziatsang ah koi in Lampuipa le Hunpa suaksak hi."},"32":{"text":"Ama thu a nite tungah a piak letsong ahi, Thaa Thiangtho le kote in hi thu huvau ah tetti ka hi uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Council upate sung a kihelte in, hi thu a zaak uh ciangin, a thin uh uuk mama a, sawltakte thatlum nuam uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahihang amate sung panin Phariseete Gamaliel kici Thukham hil syapa khat ahi ngual theampo ii zatak pa sia Council sungah hong ding hi. Ama in sawltakte tawmvei a pusuasak natu in thupia a,"},"35":{"text":"tuaciang Council te tungah, “Israel mipuite awng, hi mite tungah na vawt tu uh kidawm tavun."},"36":{"text":"Tu nung hiat in, Theudas kici khat hong piang a, ama le ama sia a nasia mama mi khat in kison a, tuaciang pasal zali bang in ama pawm uh hi. Ahihang ama sia kithat a, a nungzuite kithethaang in, a vai teng a bona thu na he nginge uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Hisia zawkciangin, Galilee mi Judas kici khat mihing simna a kivawt hun lai in, hong piang hi; ama zongh nungzui mihonpi khat nei a, ahihang ama zongh kithatlum in, a nungzuite sia kithethaang hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ahikom hi thu tungtaang ah, hi mite bangma law heak vun kong ci hi. Amate nguak koi nginge po vun! Banghang ziam cile amate ngealna le sepna in, mihing sepna ahile hong bo tu a,"},"39":{"text":"ahihang tuate in Pathian kung pan hong pai ahile, zo zo ngawl tu nu hi. Noma le noma Pathian langpan a, a do kisua tu nu hi!” ci hi. Council in Gamaliel ii ngaisut piakna zui hi."},"40":{"text":"Sawltakte sungtang in sawl a, vel in, Jesus min taw a hil nawn ngawl natu thupia hi; tua zawkciang amate tha uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Sawltakte in Council a nusiat ciang, Jesus atu in maizum thuak tu, Pathian in kiphu sa ahikom lungdam uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuaciang ni simin Biakinnpi sung le ngual innte ah Jesus Messiah ii Lungdamna Thupha hilcianna le thuhilna nei uh hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zawk hun khat ciangin, a nungzuite khakhang a, Greek kampau Jew te le innteak Jew te kilaklaw ah kihau na khat piang hi. Greek kampau Jew te in ni sim sum a kihawm ciangin, amate ii meingongte sia, kingaingon hi, ci uh hi.","title":"Hupa Salite"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom sawltak sawm le niite in, nungzui theampo khawmtua a, “Ko sia sum vai taw komlaak hu in, Pathian kammal taw thuhilna, ka ngaingon tu uh sia maan ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, suapuite awng, Thaa Thiangtho le ciimna taw a kidim hi ci in a kitel pasal sali noma sung pan hong teal tavun a, amate khut sungah, hi nasep sia ih aap tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ko ka hi uh le tuasia ciangin ka hun uh a bit in thungetna le thuhilna in, ka zangh tu uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Pawl buppi ma in sawltakte ii ngaisut piakna bangin, lungkim uh ahikom, amate in, Thaa Thiangtho le upna taw a kidim Stephen, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, le Nicolaus a kici Antioch khua pan, Jew biakna ah tu mahiat in a kikheal Gentile mi khat teal uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua pawlte in tua mite teng sia sawltakte tungah aap uh a, sawltakte in amate lu tungah a khut nga in thungetsak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuabangin Pathian kammal hong kizel to hi. Jerusalem khua ah a nungzuite khang vaial a, thiampi tam mamate in hi upna saang uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Pathian ii a thupha nasia takin a piak, vaangletna taw a kidim Stephen in, nalamdangte le a lamdangte tam mama mipite sungah vawt hi.","title":"Stephen ii Kimatna"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang pasal pawlkhat in langpan uh a, tua mite sia A Kisuatak Mite ii synagogue sungah pawlmite hi a, Cyrene pan le, Alexandria pan Jew te kihel hi. Amate sia Cilicia ngamkhen le Asia ngamkhen te pan Jew dangte taw kikopin, Stephen taw kam kinial hong kipan uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang Thaa in Stephen sia tuabang ciimna pia ahikom ama a pau ciangin a nalh zo bua uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahiciang amate in, pasal pawlkhat sumnguk pia a, “Moses le Pathian langpan in, a pauna za khu hi!” cisak hi."},"12":{"text":"Hi bang danin mihonte, upate le Thukham hil syate hol uh hi. Amate in Stephen manin Council mai ah paipui uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin, leilot tetti pang tu in, mihing pawlkhat sungtangsak hi. Amate in, “Hisia pa in, a thiangtho ih Biakinnpi le Moses Thukham sia langpan tawntung hi."},"14":{"text":"Nazareth mi Jesus in, hi Biakinnpi sutham tu a, Moses tung pan hong paisuk ih ngeina theampo hong khealsak tu hi, ci in a son laitakin za khu hi!” ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Council sungah a to te theampo in, Stephen en tek uh a, a maitang sia vantunglalang maitang taw kibangin mu uh hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thiampi Lianbelpa in Stephen munah, “Hi thu a maan ziam?” ci in dongh hi.","title":"Stephen ii Thusonna"},"2":{"text":"Stephen in zo kik a, “Suapuite le pate awng, hong ngai tavun! Ih taanghpupi Abraham sia Haran ah teang tu in, a pai ma, Mesopotamia ah a ten laitakin, ama tungah vaanglian Pathian kilak a,","ref":"Pian 12:1"},"3":{"text":"‘Na innkuanpuite le na ngam nusia in, kong lak tu ngam ah va pai ta'n,’ ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom a ngam nusia in, Haran ah pai hi. Abraham ii pa a thi zawkciang, tu laitak note teenna hi ngam ah Pathian in kikhiinsak hi.","ref":"Pian 11:31; 12:4"},"5":{"text":"Tua laitak hunin Pathian in, Abraham aituam neisa tu in, leitangh metre khat kiimhuam zongh a pia bua lai hi, ahihang Pathian in piak tu in, kamciam pia hi, ama nung pan a suan a paalte atu zongh ahi hi. Pathian ii hi kamciam a piak hunin, Abraham in ta a nei bua hi.","ref":"Pian 12:7; 13:15; 15:18; 17:18"},"6":{"text":"Pathian kamciam in hi bang ahi hi: ‘Na suan na paalte sia, ngamdang ah peam tu a, amate sila suakin kum zali tawntung kivawtsia cip tu hi.","ref":"Pian 15:13-14"},"7":{"text":"Ahihang a silate tungah a kilawm thukhenna ka tungsak tu a, tua zawkciangin amate tua ngam panin pusuak in, hi sungah amate in kei hong bia tu hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Pu 3:12"},"8":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciangin Pathian in, Abraham sia thuciamna ii lim tu in vunteap atsakna zeksa pia hi. Tua ahikom Abraham in, Isaac sua zawk nipi khat a cin ciangin, a vunteap atsak hi, Isaac in a tapa Jacob a vunteap atsak hi; Jacob in a minthang ih taanghpupite sawm le niite ii vunteap atsak hi.","ref":"Pian 17:10-14; 21:2-4; 25:26; 29:31—35:18"},"9":{"text":"“Jacob tate in a suapui Joseph sia eang uh a, Egypt ah sila in na zuak uh hi. Ahihang ama taw Pathian omkhawm hi.","ref":"Pian 37:11; 28; 39:2; 21"},"10":{"text":"Tuaciangin a ngim ngana theampo pan suatak pia hi. Egypt kumpipa mai ah, Joseph a kilak ciang, Pathian in thuzawkhuaina le ciimna pia a, tuaciang kumpipa in Joseph sia ngamuk mangpa le kumpi bangkua a uk suaksak hi.","ref":"Pian 41:39-41"},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Egypt le Canaan ngam bup ah kialpi tung a, ngimna nasia takin piang hi. Ih taanghpupite in anneak tu nei ngawl a,","ref":"Pian 42:1-2"},"12":{"text":"tuasia ciang Jacob in Egypt ngam ah antang om hi, ci in a zaak ciang, ama in ih taanghpupite ahi a tate sia tuak ah a khat veina in paisak hi."},"13":{"text":"A nii veina a pai ciang Joseph in ama le ama a suapuite munah kison a, tuasia ciang, Egypt kumpipa in Joseph innkuanpuite huvau he hi.","ref":"Pian 45:1-16"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom Joseph in, a pa Jacob tungah thupuaksak a, ama le a innkuan bup, a vekpi a kingawm mihing sawmsali le nga teng sia Egypt ngam ah a pai natu in zasak hi.","ref":"Pian 45:9-10,17-18; 46:27"},"15":{"text":"Tuaciangin Jacob sia Egypt ngam ah pai a, tua munah ama le a tate thi hi.","ref":"Pian 46:1-7; 49:33"},"16":{"text":"A luanghawmte sia Shechem ah kitua hi. Abraham ii Hamor minamte tung pan a sum taw a lei, tuak a thaan sia sungah amate kiphum uh hi.","ref":"Pian 23:3-16; 33:19; 50:7-13; Jos 24:32"},"17":{"text":"“Abraham tungah Pathian ii kamciam teng, a tunsak tu ciangin, Egypt ngam ah ih minamte sia nasia tak khangto zo hi.","ref":"Pu 1:7-8"},"18":{"text":"A khakbel ciangin, Joseph a he ngawl kumpi khat sia Egypt ngam uk tu in kipan hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama in ih taanghpupite theambawl in, ngitlona taw a nausente a thi tu in daaipua ah a vawk natu thupia hi.","ref":"Pu 1:10-11,22"},"20":{"text":"Hi hun sia Moses ii pian hun hi a, ama in a mealhoi mama patang khat ahi hi. Ama sia inn ah tha thum kikeam a,","ref":"Pu 2:2"},"21":{"text":"inn panin a hep uh ciangin, kumpipa ii tanu in, ama sung pan a piang ta bangin vawt a, vaak in taa hi.","ref":"Pu 2:3-10"},"22":{"text":"Egypt te ciimna theampo kisinsak a, mihing thupi khat ii kampau luheakzia hong nei hi."},"23":{"text":"“Moses sia kum sawmli a phak ciangin, a minampui Israel te bangbangin kivawt ziam ci in kan tu in khensat hi.","ref":"Pu 2:11-15"},"24":{"text":"Egypt mite khat in a minampui Israel te khat a vawtsia zazaan sia ama in mu hi, tua ahikom hun tu in pai a, Egypt pa thatlum in phulam hi."},"25":{"text":"(Ama ngaisutna ah, a minampuite suatak natu in, Pathian in ama zangh tu hi ci in a mite in tel tu in um a, ahihang amate in a tel bua uh hi.)"},"26":{"text":"A zing ciangin Israel te nii, kihau in om mu a, ama in lemtua tu in hanciampui hi. ‘Hong ngai tavun, note unau khat na hi uh hi; banghangin khat le khat kihau nu ziam?’ ci hi."},"27":{"text":"A lawmpa a vawtsia sia pa in, Moses sawn a, ‘Akua in nang sia ko hong uk tu le ko tungah, thukhen tu in hong koi ziam?"},"28":{"text":"Zeini a Egypt te khat na thalup bangin, kei hong thatlum nuam ni ziam,’ ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in hi thu a zaak ciangin, Egypt ngam pan tai a, Midian ngam ah teang hi. Tua munah tapa nii nei hi.","ref":"Pu 18:3-4"},"30":{"text":"“Kum sawmli hong kan zawkciangin Sinai mualhui sennealngam sung sawlpaang kuang khat sungah vantunglalang khat Moses mai ah hong kilak hi.","ref":"Pu 3:1-10"},"31":{"text":"Moses in a mu teng lamdang sa in, a kitel zaw in a mu thei natu sawlpaang sang neak hi. Ahihang Topa ii aw hi bangin za hi:"},"32":{"text":"‘Kei sia na taanghpupi Abraham, Isaac le Jacob te ii Pathian ka hi hi’ ci hi. Moses lau in liing ngawp a, en ngam ngawl hi."},"33":{"text":"Topa in ama tungah, ‘Na peangdap suut in, banghang ziam cile na dinna mun sia thiangtho hi."},"34":{"text":"Ka minamte Egypt ngam ah vawtsiat a thuakna teng ka mu zo hi. Amate tauna ka za a, amate suatak tu in kong paisuk zo hi. Tu in hong pai ta'n; Egypt ngam ah hong paisak tu khi hi,’ ci hi."},"35":{"text":"“Moses sia Israel te ii a nial pa ahi hi. ‘Akua in nang sia, ko hong uk tu le ko tungah thukhen tu in, hong koi ziam?’ ci in dongh uh hi. Sawlpaang kuang sung pan ama tungah a kilak vantunglalang ii huna taw, Pathian in amate a uk tu le a suaktasak tu in ukpa le hunpa tu in, a thataak pa ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 2:14"},"36":{"text":"Ama in Israel te sia Egypt ngam pan pusua pui a, Egypt ngam le San Tuipi ah ahizong, kum sawmli sung sennealngam sungah ahizong, nalamdang laknate le a lamdangte ama in vawt hi.","ref":"Pu 7:5; 14:21; Mi 14:33"},"37":{"text":"Israel te tungah, ‘Pathian ii kei hong thataak bangma in, Pathian in note atu kamsaang khat hong paisak tu hi,’ tua pa in noma mi pui khat hi tu hi’ a ci pa sia Moses ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 8:15-18"},"38":{"text":"Sennealngam ah a kikhawmtua Israel mite taw a omkhawm pa sia Moses ahi hi; Sinai mual tungah ama a paupui vantunglalang sia le ih taanghpupite taw tua munah omkhawm a, ei tungah hong piak sawn tu, Pathian ii a nungta thute ama in saang hi.","ref":"Pu 9:1—20:17; Thkna 5:1-33"},"39":{"text":"“Ahihang ih taanghpupite in ama thu a ni nuam bua uh hi; amate in Moses puavawk in, Egypt ngam ah heak kik thei le uuk uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tua ahikom Aaron munah, ‘Eite hong lampui tu in milim pathian pawlkhat hong vawtsak ta'n. Egypt ngam pan hong pusua Moses sia bang tawk hi tu ziam he bua hing,’ ci uh hi.","ref":"Pu 32:1"},"41":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin, amate in khuital khat ii lim taw a kibang milim khat vawt a, sangaw biakpiakna nei in, amate vawttawm vangiat khat sia upat piakna in poaikhaam uh hi.","ref":"Pu 32:2-6"},"42":{"text":"Tua ahikom Pathian in amate nungngat in, kamsaangte laibu sungah, a om bangma in, van a aksite bia tu in thazau hi: ‘Israel mite awng! Kum sawmli tawntung sennealngam sungah, sa na ngo uh a, nganhing taw biakpiakna, na vawt uhte sia, kei tungah hong vawt na hi bua uh hi.","ref":"Amo 5:25-27"},"43":{"text":"Na puak uh sia Molech pathian ii tuipuan buk le noma ii aksi pathian Rephan lim ahi hi. Tuate in noma ii na biak tu in, na vawttawm uh milimte ahi hi. Tua ahikom Babylon kalh ah sal in kong puak tu hi,’ kici hi."},"44":{"text":"“Ih taanghpupite in Pathian ompuina a kilakna Puanbuk sia sennealngam sungah keng kawkoai hi. Tua Puanbuk sia Moses tungah Pathian sawl bang le a kilak lim bangin a kivawt ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 25:9,40"},"45":{"text":"A khaksang ciangin tua tuipuanbuk a lua, ih taanghpupite in amate mai ah, Pathian ii hawlkeak minamte ii ngam a suan tu in, Joshua taw a pai uh ciangin, tua tuipuan buk sia keng uh hi. David khan hun dong, tua munah om hi.","ref":"Jos 3:14-17"},"46":{"text":"Ama in Pathian maipha nga a, Jacob ii Pathian inn tu khat a sak thei natu in Pathian tungah ngen hi.","ref":"2 Sa 7:1-16; 1 Khang 17:1-14"},"47":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian inn tu a sa pa sia Solomon ahi hi.","ref":"1 Kum 6:1-38; 2 Khang 3:1-17"},"48":{"text":"“Ahihang a saangbel Pathian sia mihingte sak inn sungah a teang bua hi; kamsaangpa ci bangma in,"},"49":{"text":"‘Vantung in ka kumpi tokhum hi, Topa in ci hi, tuaciangin leitung sia ka peang ngakna ahi hi. Bangbang innte, kei atu hong saksak tu ni ziam? kei teen natu mun sia koisung ziam?","ref":"Is 66:1-2"},"50":{"text":"Hite theampo keima vawtsa hi ngawl ziam?’"},"51":{"text":"Stephen in, “Note bangza in thinpui nu ziam! Bangza in note thin in Pathian he ngawl ziam? Pathian kammal na zaak ngawl natu in, bangza in nangong nu ziam! Na taanghpupite bang lian hi nu hi: note zongh in Thaa Thiangtho nalh tawntung nu hi!","ref":"Is 63:10"},"52":{"text":"Na taanghpupite ii a vawtsiat ngawl kamsaang khat beak om ngei kana ziam? Khuangei pek panin, Pathian ii a thutang Naseampa hong pai natu a sonkhol, Pathian kamtaite na thatlum uh hi. Tu in, note in ama leeheak a, suamlum nu hi."},"53":{"text":"Vantunglalangte hong piak Pathian ii thukham a saangte na hi uh hi — ahihang tua thukhamte ni ngawl nu hi!” ci lai hi."},"54":{"text":"Council sung a kihelte in, Stephen thuson a ngai uh ciangin, amate in thin uukna taw a ha ngoai san uh hi.","title":"Stephen Suangtum taw Kidenlupna"},"55":{"text":"Ahihang Stephen sia Thaa Thiangtho taw kidim a, vantung ento in, Pathian ii minthanna le Pathianziatsang ah a ding Jesus mu hi."},"56":{"text":"“En vun! Vantung kihong mu khi hi, tuaciang Mihing Tapa sia Pathianziatsang ah, dingin om hi!” ci hi."},"57":{"text":"Council sung kihel mihingte in nging takin au a, a khut taw a bil uh hum hi. Tua zawkciang amate teng in, thakhatin ama del uh a,"},"58":{"text":"khuapi pua ah lawn in, suangtum taw deang uh hi. Tua tetti te in amate puantualte sia, Saul kici tangval khat ii kep tu in, aap hi."},"59":{"text":"Amate in Stephen sia, suang taw a hawhua laitakin, ama in Topa biakpui a, “Topa Jesus awng, ka thaa hong saang ta'n!” ci hi."},"60":{"text":"Ama in khupdin a, awnging tak taw, “Topa! hi mite mawna na tepteesak heak in!” a ci zawkciangin thi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang Stephen a thalupna sia Saul in lungkimpui hi. Tua ni mama in Jerusalem a om pawlpi sia vawtsiatna nasia takin thuak tu kipan hi. Sawltakte simngawl thu um dangte theampo sia Judea le Samaria ngamkhente sungah kithethaang siat uh hi."},"2":{"text":"Thu umte pawlkhat in Stephen phum uh a, hee in awnging tak taw ama kaa uh hi.","title":"Saul in Pawlpi Vawtsia"},"3":{"text":"Ahihang Saul ahile Pawlpi sukthap natu hanciam hi; inn khat pan inn khat ah pai in, thu umte kaikeak a, pate zongh numeite zongh thonginn sung denna in nei hi.","ref":"Sawl 22:4-5; 26:9-11"},"4":{"text":"A kithethaang thu umte in mun theampo ah pai in thuhil uh hi.","title":"Samaria ah Lungdamna Thu Kihil"},"5":{"text":"Philip in Samaria khuapi ah pai in tua mun mipite tungah Messiah ii thu hil hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihonpite in Philip ii thuson ngai a, nalamdang lakna a vawtte a mu uh ciang ama neakin pha tak ngai uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing tam mamate sung pan doai ngilote sia a nging in au a, pusuak hi; pumzawte, peangbaite tam mama dam uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom tua khuapi sungah lungdamna lian om hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua khuapi ah Simon min nei pasal khat om a, tawmvei hun sung tengin Samaria te sia ama ii mitbum lakna taw lamdang sasak hi. Ama sia mi thupi khat in ama le ama kison a,"},"10":{"text":"tuaciang khuapi sungah om theampo kidoidanna om ngawlin, ama thu ngai uh hi. “Ama in ‘Vaangletna Lianpi’ a kici tua Pathian ii vaang sia ahi hi,” ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Khuangei mama sung ama ii mitbum taw lamdang sasak ahikom, a thusonte pha takin ngai uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian Ngam lungdamna thupha le Jesus thu Philip ii sonna a up ciangin, pate zongh numeite zongh tui kiphum uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Simon mama zongh in um hi; tui a kiphum zawkciang Philip nai ah om top a, a nasia a lamdangte le nalamdang laknate a kivawt a mu ciangin lamdang sa hi."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem a om sawltakte in, Samaria a mihingte ii Pathian kammal a saan uh sia za ahikom amate in Peter le John sia tua mite kungah paisak hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate hong thet uh ciang, Thaa Thiangtho a nga thei natu in, thu umte atu thungetsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Thaa Thiangtho sia amate khat ii tung zongh ah tuaksuk ngawl lai hi; amate sia Topa Jesus min taw a ki baptize hi bek hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaciang Peter le John in, amate tungah a khut uh nga a, tuasia ciangin Thaa Thiangtho nga uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate tungah sawltakte a khut a ngak uh ciangin, thu um mite tungah Thaa Thiangtho a kipiak sia Simon in mu hi. Tua ahikom Peter le John tungah sum pia in,"},"19":{"text":"“Ka khut ka ngakna pawpo tungah Thaa Thiangtho a nga natu in, hi vaangletna sia kei zongh hong pia tavun,” ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahihang Peter in zo kik a, “Pathian letsong sia sum taw kilei thei tu in na up hu in, nang le na sum teng sia hell ah pai tahen!"},"21":{"text":"Nang in kote nasepna taw kisai nawn ngawl ni hi, banghang ziam cile, Pathian muna ah na thin maan ngawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua hi a, hi a sia na ngealna panin kisiik kik ta'n a, tuaciang tuabang ngaisutna na nei hu in, hong maisak natu in Topa tungah thungen ta'n."},"23":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile nang sia ngual eenna thin taw a kidim mawna sungah, koltaang pa hi, ci in kong mu hi,” ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Simon in Peter le John tungah, “Tu a nong ci teng kei tungah hong tun ngawl natu, nong hesuakna in Topa tungah thu hong ngetsak tavun,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Amate in tetti pangin Topa thute a thansak zawkciangin, Peter le John te Jerusalem khua ah cia kik uh hi. A cia lam in, Samaria ngam khuano tam mamate ah Lungdamna Thupha hil uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Topa vantunglalang khat in, Philip munah, “Kithoai in a, thangsang zuanin Jerusalem pan Gaza paina lampi zui in va pai ta'n,” ci hi. (Hi lampi sia kizangh nawn ngawl hi.)","title":"Philip le Ethiopia Maangpa"},"27":{"text":"Tua ahikom Philip in kithoai in pai hi. Tu in Ethiopia kumpinu ii sum kholna a uk cil kinget Ethiopia mi a thupi ulian khat sia a inn ah cia tu in pai hi. Ama sia Jerusalem ah Pathian bia tu in a theng hi a, a siphu ngalleang taw cia kik hi. Tuabangin a cia kawmin, Isaiah thubu sim hi.","merge":"28"},"29":{"text":"Thaa Thiangtho in Philip munah “Va pai ta'n a, tua leang taw a kinai in va om ta'n” ci in sawl hi."},"30":{"text":"Philip in del a, a phak ciangin, ama in kamsaangpa Isaiah thubu a sim sia za hi. “Na sisim teng na tel ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ulian pa in “Hong thiangson khat a om buale bangbangin tel tu khi ziam?” ci in zo kik hi. Leang tungah Philip kaato tu in sam a, amate tokhawm hi."},"32":{"text":"A sim laithiangtho mun sia hi bang ahi hi: “Ama in ngawlup tu in a kikai tuu khat taw kibang hi, ama in a mul a kimeetsak ciangin, a haam ngawl tuuno taw kibang hi. Kam khat zongh a pau bua hi.","ref":"Is 53:7-8"},"33":{"text":"Ama sia kizawnsak vawt a, thukhaikim thu kitaansak hi. Ama ii suan le paalte huvau sia kuama in a son thei buatu hi, banghang ziam cile, ama ii leitung nuntakna bo hi.”"},"34":{"text":"Ulianpa in, Philip munah “Kamsaangpa pauna hisia akua a cinopna ziam hong son tan? Ama le ama kici nuam ziam maw midang khat ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuaciang Philip in son tu in kipan hi; hi Lai Thiangtho kammal pan panto in, Jesus ii Lungdamna Thupha son hi."},"36":{"text":"Tuabangin a pai susuk ciangin tui omna mun khat theng hi, tuaciang Ulianpa in, “Hi sungah tui om hi. Tui ka kiphum natu in bang in hong khak ziam,” ci hi."},"37":{"text":"Philip in ama tungah “Na thin theampo taw na um le, tui kiphum thei tu ni hi,” ci hi. Ama in “Um khi hi. Jesus Christ sia Pathian Tapa hi, ci in um khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"38":{"text":"Ulianpa in a leang a tawlngak natu thupia a, amate nii tui sungah tuaksuk in, Philip in ama tuiphum hi."},"39":{"text":"Tui sung pan hong kaato uh ciangin, Topa Thaa in Philip la hi. Ulianpa in ama mu kik nawn ngawl ahihang, lungdamna taw kidim in, a pai ngei in paisuak hi."},"40":{"text":"Philip sia Azotus khua ah theng ahi hunlam ama le ama kitel hi; ama Caesarea ah pai suak a, lamdung khua theampo ah Lungdamna Thupha hil hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitak Saul in Topa nungzuite suamlup tu in nasia takin tawng tawntung hi. Thiampi Lianbelpa kungah pai a,","title":"Saul Kikhealna (Sawltakte 22:6-16 ; 26:12-18)"},"2":{"text":"Topa Lampi a zui pate le numeite a mu peuma man khawmin Jerusalem ah a ciapui thei natu, Damascus khua synagogue ukte a lak tu ama thu a kisonna lai ama in ngen hi."},"3":{"text":"Damascus ah a pai lam in, khuapi a thet dektak ciang, thakhat thu in van pan a taang khat in, ama kiimkot theampo taan hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama lei ah puk a, tuaciang aw khat hi bangin za hi. “Saul! Saul awng! banghangin kei hong vawtsia ni ziam?”"},"5":{"text":"“Akua ni ziam Topa?” ci in dongh hi. “Kei sia nong vawtsiat pa Jesus ka hi hi,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"“Ahihang, tho in a, khuapi sungah va pai ta'n, Tualai ah na vawt tu a kul teng hong kison tu hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Saul taw khual a haw khawmte in, kam khat zongh pau ngawlin, ding uh hi; amate in awnging za ahihang, kuama a mu bua uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Saul sia lei panin thoto a, a mit hak ahihang bangma a mu thei bua hi. Tua ahikom amate in, a khut pan len in, Damascus khua sung zotpui hi."},"9":{"text":"Ni thum sung ama in khua a mu thei bua a, tua hun sung teng in, ama in an hikale tui hikale neak a nei bua hi."},"10":{"text":"Damascus ah Ananias kici Tapidaw khat om hi. Ama in mukholna nei a, Topa in ama munah, “Ananias awng!” ci in biakpui hi. “Hi sungah om ing, Topa” ci in zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Topa in ama munah, “Lampi Tang kicina munah, pai tu in kithoai in a, tuaciangin Judas inn ah Tarsus khua mi Saul kici khat va kan ta'n. Ama sia tu laitakin thunget saan hi,"},"12":{"text":"tuaciangin ama mukholna sungah Ananias kici pasal khat hong pai a, khua a mu thei kik natu in, ama tungah a khut ngak sia mu zo hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ananias in zo kik a, “Topa awng, mihing tam ma in, hisia pa thu hong son a, Jerusalem ah na mite tungah a cizat huai ama ngamtatna theampo hong kison hi."},"14":{"text":"Nang hong biate theampo a mat thei natu in, thiampi liante tung pan, thu ngana taw, Damascus khua ah hong pai hi,” ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Topa in ama munah, “Va pai ta'n, banghang ziam cile, ama sia Gentile te sung, kumpite sung le Israel mite sungah, ka min hong kiheak natu in, ka naseam tu in, ka teal zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaciang keima mama in kei ii hu a, a thuak tu theampo zongh ka lak tu hi,” ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom Ananias pai a, Saul tunna inn sungah tum in, a tungah a khut nga hi. “Suapui Saul awng, hi sungah nong pai lai in, lampi ah nang tungah hong kilak — ih Topa Jesus in, khua na mu thei kik natu le Thaa Thiangtho taw na kidim natu in nang kungah kei hong paisak hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Thakhat thu in ngasa hawlip taw a kibang pawlkhat sia, Saul mittangte panin, hong taaksuk a, ama in khuamu thei kik hi. Ama ding a tui kiphum hi;"},"19":{"text":"Tuaciangin, an a neak zawkciang, a tha hat kik hi. Saul sia Damascus ah thu umte taw ni tawmvei sung om tu in taam hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in Jew te ii synagogue ah paisuak a, Jesus sia Pathian Tapa hi ci in thuhil tu in kipan hi.","title":"Saul in Damascus ah Thuhil"},"21":{"text":"A zate theampo in lamdang sa in, “Jerusalem ah Jesus a biate a thatlum bul sia ama hi kana ngawl ziam? Tuaciangin hi lai hong paina thu zongh, thu umte man a, thiampi liante kungah ciapui tu, ngiimna taw hong pai hi ngawl ziam,” ci uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang Saul thuhilna in vaang nei vaial a, Jesus sia Messiah hi ci a, a sonthiangna sia, up huai mama ahikom, Damascus khua ah a teang Jew te in, ama a nial thei bua uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ni tam mama hong kan zawkciang, Jew te kikhawmtua a, Saul sia thalup sawm uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahihang amate sawmnate, ama tungah kison hi. Ama a thalup thei natu in, sun taw zan taw khuapi kongpite, encik uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahihang zan khat ciangin, a nungzuite in, Saul sia khuapi luphung vang khat pan bawm khat taw in khiasuk uh hi.","ref":"2 Cor 11:32-33"},"26":{"text":"Saul sia Jerusalem ah pai in, nungzuite pawl sungah tum sawm hi. Ahihang amate in, Saul sia nungzui khat hi, ci in um thei ngawl a kiita uh hi.","title":"Saul Jerusalem ah Haw"},"27":{"text":"Tuaciang Barnabas in ama panpui a, sawltakte kungah paipui hi. Saul in lampi tungah Topa taw a kimuna thu le, Topa ii ama a paupuina thu teng zongh son hi. Damascus ah hang takin Jesus min taw thu a hil zongh son si hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom Saul sia amate kungah taam a, Jerusalem khuathing bup ah vak kawkoai in, Topa min taw hang takin thuhil hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama in Greek kampau Jew te taw zongh, kam kikum in kinialna nei a, ahihang Saul sia amate in thasawm uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Thu umte in hi thu a phaw uh ciang, Saul sia Caesaria ah paipui a Tarsus khua ah puak uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuabangin Judea ngam Samaria ngam le Galilee ngam bup ah pawlpite in ngammuang takin om theina hun khat nga hi. Pawlpi sia Topa min thasiana taw a nuntak bangma in Thaa Thiangtho huna tungtawnin, thakho in pawlpi mi khangto hi."},"32":{"text":"Peter sia mun theampo ah khualhaw a, khatvei sia Lydda ah a teang Pathian mite kungah haw hi.","title":"Peter, Lydda le Joppa ah Khualhaw"},"33":{"text":"Tua munah Aeneas a kici pasal khat taw kimu a, tua pa sia kum liat tawntung a pumzaw ahikom a tho thei bua hi."},"34":{"text":"Peter in “Aeneas awng, Jesus Christ in hong damsak hi. Tho in a, na lupna zial in,” ci hi. Tha khat thu in, Aeneas tho hi."},"35":{"text":"Lydda khua le Sharon khua a teang mihing theampo in, ama mu uh a, Topa kungah kiheak siat uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Joppa khua ah Tabitha kici numei khat om a, ama sia thu um khat ahi hi. (Ama ii Greek min sia Dorcas hi a, “sangai khat” cinopna hi) Ama in a hun nei theampo thupha vawtna le, a zawngte huna in zangh hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin ama, a ciina in thi hi. A luang sia kibual a, inn tung doituam khat sungah sial uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Joppa sia Lydda panin a khuala bua hi, tuaciangin thu umte in, Peter sia Lydda khua ah om hi ci in a zaak uh ciangin kamtai nii paisak a, “A manlang in hong pai ta'n,” cisak uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ahikom Peter kithoai in a samte taw ton hi. Ama a thet ciangin, inn tung doituam sungah paipui a, nupi meingong theampo in bawm hon a, kap kawmin, Dorcas a nuntak lai a, a vawt laktongte le laktong puasilhte theampo lak uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Peter in amate theampo inn doituam pua sangah pusuaksak a, khupdin in thungen hi; tuaciang mithi luang maingat in, “Tabitha awng, tho in!” ci hi. Numei in a mit hak a, Peter a mu ciang, hong to hi."},"41":{"text":"Peter in a khut thaak a, ama dingsak hi. Tua zawkciang thu um theampo sam a, meingongte zongh kihel in, amate tungah, numei sia a nungta in aap hi."},"42":{"text":"Hi thupiang sia Joppa khuazaang ah thang a, mihing tam mama in, Topa um uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Peter sia Joppa ah savun vawt ahi Simon kungah ni tam mama taam hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Caesarea khua ah Rome kumpite ngalkap ahi “Italy Ngalkapte” kici ngalkap honkhat sungah ngalkap bu a seam Cornelius kici khat om hi.","title":"Peter le Cornelius"},"2":{"text":"Ama sia biakna kin khat hi; ama le a innkuan bupin Pathian bia uh hi. Tuaciangin amate taw kithawl tu nakna heak in, banghang ziam cile amate in keima sawl ahi hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom Peter tuaksuk a, pasalte munah, “Na zon uh sia keima khi hi. Bang vai a hong pai nu ziam,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"“Ngalkap bu Cornelius in kote hong sawl hi,” ci hi. “Ama sia Pathian a bia mihing pha khat hi a, Jew te theampo in zakta uh hi. Pathian vantunglalang khat in, ama tungah na son tu thute a zaak thei tu in nang hong sap tu in sawl hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Peter in amate sungtang tu in sam a, zan khat ngiaksak hi. A zing ciang kithoai in amate taw ding uh hi; tuaciangin Joppa pan nungzui pawlkhat taw zong, paikhawm uh hi."},"24":{"text":"A zing ciangin, Caesarea khua theng uh a, tua munah ama ii a sam mealheakte le a muan a ngualtamhte taw Cornelius in ngak hi."},"25":{"text":"Peter sia inn sung tum tu a kithoai ciangin Cornelius in muak a, a peang ah bokin ama mai ah a kun hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahihang Peter in dingsak hi. Ama in, “Ding in, keima sia mihing khat ma hi lel khi hi,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Peter sia Cornelius taw thuson kawmin, inn sungah a tum ciangin, mihing tam mama kikhawm mu hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate tungah, “Na heak tek uh hi a, Jew te khat sia Gentile te khat ii inn ah a haw tu ahizong, kithawl tu ahizong a biakna in oai ngawl hi. Ahihang Pathian in mihing khat pawpo biakna taw kisai in, thiang ngawl hi, nin hi, ka ci ngawl het natu in hong lak hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahikom nong samsak uh ciangin nial ngawlin kong pai hi. Tua ahiciang nong sapna thu sia banghang ziam ci in kong dongh hi,” ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Cornelius in, “Tu nung ni thum lai tubang hun nitak nai thum hun khawngin ka inn ah thu ka ngen hi. Thakhat thu in a tee vakil puan a silh pasal khat ka mai ah hong ding a,"},"31":{"text":"‘Cornelius awng! Pathian in na thungetna hong za a, ngual na hu thongna teng hong musak zo hi."},"32":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhat Joppa ah paisak in a, a min tatak Simon Peter kici, pasal khat sia samsak ta'n. Ama sia tuipi hui a teang savun vawt pa Simon kici khat ii inn ah tung hi,’ hong ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahikom thakhatin kong samsak a, na dikna hangin nong pai hi. Tu in Pathian mai ah ko teng na om ung, Topa ii nang son a hong sawl po ngai tu in hong ngak khu hi,” ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Peter sia thuson tu hong kipan a, “Tu in Pathian in mihing theampo a kibangin ngaisun hi ci in ka phawk hi.","title":"Peter Thusonna","ref":"Thkna 10:17"},"35":{"text":"Ama a biate le a maan a ngamtate sia, bang minam po ahizong ama in saang hi."},"36":{"text":"Israel te tungah a puak thu na heak uh hi, mihing theampo ii Topa ahi, Jesus Christ tungtawnin kilemna Lungdamna Thu thansakna ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuiphumpa John in tui kiphumna thu a hil zawkciang Galilee ngam pan Israel ngam bup sungah thu lian a piang sia, na heak uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Nazareth khua mi Jesus tungah Pathian in Thaa Thiangtho le vaangletna a buak thu huvau tel nu hi. Ama in mun theampo ah pai in, thupha vawt a, Doaimangpa vaangletna nuai ah a om theampo damsak hi. Banghang ziam cile Pathian sia ama taw omkhawm hi."},"39":{"text":"Israel te ngamsung le Jerusalem ah a sep a vawt theampo tungtaang ah, kote in tetti ka hi uh hi. Amate in ama sia thinglamtee tungah kilh in, thisak uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in a ni thum ni ciangin, thina pan thosak a, ama kilanghsak hi,"},"41":{"text":"ahihang mihing theampo tungah hi ngawlin, Pathian ii tetti tu a hong teal sate, thina panin a thaw kik zawkciangin, ama taw an nekhawm tui dawnkhawmin a om kote tungah hong kilangh hi."},"42":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in, lungdamna thu sia mihingte tungah a hil tu le a thisate le a nungta laite tungah thukhen tu in, Pathian in ama a aap hunlam tetti pang tu in ko hong sawl hi."},"43":{"text":"Kamsaang theampo in ama huvau sonsiat uh hi. Ama a umte theampo mihing sim in ama min vaangletna taw a mawnate kimaisak tu hi ci in son uh hi,” ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Tuabangin Peter a papau laitakin, thu ngai theampo tungah, Thaa Thiangtho tuaksuk hi.","title":"Gentile te in Thaa Thiangtho Saang"},"45":{"text":"Peter taw Joppa khua pan hong pai, Jew thu umte in, Gentile te tung zongh ah, Pathian Thaa Thiangtho letsong a buak sia lamdang sa uh hi."},"46":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile amate in, kam tumdangte taw pau in, Pathian letna pok uh hi. Peter in,"},"47":{"text":"“Hi mite in, eima saan bangma in, Thaa Thiangtho saang zo uh hi. Tua ahile amate tui taw ki baptize tu, akua in khaam thei tu ziam?” ci hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jesus Christ min taw, a ki baptize natu in thupia hi. Tua zawkciangin, ni tawmvei amate kungah a taam lai natu in, Peter tho uh hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judea ngam bup a om sawltakte, le thu um dangte in, Gentile te zongh ii Pathian kammal a saanna thu za uh hi.","title":"Jerusalem Pawlpi ah Peter Thu ko kikna"},"2":{"text":"Peter sia Jerusalem ah a cia ciangin, Gentile te vunteap atna a deite in, Peter ngamtatna sit uh a,"},"3":{"text":"“Vunteap at ngawl Gentile te inn ah zintung in, an ngawngawn nekhawm nu hi!” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom Peter in thupiang teng sia a patna panin son hi:"},"5":{"text":"“Joppa khua ah thu ka nget laitakin mukholna khat ka nei hi. Van panin puanza bang na khat a king li pan kilen in, a kikhiasuk ka mu a, tuaciang ka kungah hong tawlnga hi."},"6":{"text":"Pha takpi ma in a sung ka en a, innsa, ngamsa, le awmtaal in a vak nganhingte le ngam vacimte ka mu hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaciang aw khat in hong paupui a, ‘Peter awng, tho in; hite ngo in a, ne in!’ hong ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang keima in, ‘Ne peuma bua tong Topa awng! Biakna taw kisai a nin le a thiang ngawlin a kisepte sia, ka kam sungah tum ngeingawl lai hi,’ ka ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua aw taw vantung panin, hong pau leleau a, “Pathian thiansua sate sia bang po ahizong, a thiang ngawlin ngaisun heak in,” hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Hi bangin thumvei hong kilak a, a khakbel ciangin, vantung ah kidok to kik hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hun laitak lian in, Caesarea pan a hong kipaisak mihing thum sia, ka zintunna inn ah hong theng hi."},"12":{"text":"Thaa in, amate taw haisaang ngawlin, ka tonkhop natu hong sawl hi. Joppa khua a thu uppui luk teng zongh in, Caesarea ah hong zui a, ka vekpi in Cornelius inn ah ka tum uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Vantunglalang khat a inn ah na ding a, ama in, ‘Joppa khua ah mihing pawlkhat paisak ta'n a, Simon Peter kici khat sia samsak ta'n."},"14":{"text":"Ama in nang le na innkuanpui theampo ngupna na nga natu kammalte hong son tu hi,’ ci in son hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuabangin thuson ka kipat ciangin, Thaa Thiangtho sia eite tungah a masa a hong pai bang tatakin, amate tungah tuaksuk hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaciang ‘John in tui taw hong baptize hi. Ahihang no sia Thaa Thiangtho taw hong ki baptize tu hi,’ a ci Topa kam sia ka phawk hi.","ref":"Sawl 1:5"},"17":{"text":"Topa Jesus ih up ciang ei tungah letsong hong kipiak bangin, Pathian in tua letsong sia Gentile te tung zongh ah pia hi, ci in thiangtho takin kimu hi; tua ahile kei sia akua hi a, Pathian nasepna a khaktan zo tu pa, hi na khi ziam!” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Hi thu a zaak uh ciangin, Peter sia mawsak nawn ngawlin, Pathian pok uh hi. “Tua ahile Pathian in, Gentile te tung zongh ah, kisii kik natu le nuntak natu hunpha pia zo hi!” ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Stephen a suamlup zawkciang vawtsiatna hangin a kithethaang thu umte pawlkhat sia Phoenicia, Cyprus le Antioch dongin pai uh a, Jew te tung bek ah thuhil uh hi.","title":"Antioch Khua ah Pawlpi","ref":"Sawl 8:1-4"},"20":{"text":"Ahihang Cyprus le Cyrene pan a, thu umte pawlkhat in Antioch khua ah pai in, Gentile te tung zongh ah Topa Jesus Lungdamna Thupha hil uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Topa vaangletna sia amate taw kop a, mihing tam mama in thu um in, Topa sangah kiheak uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Hi thupha Jerusalem Pawlpi dong theng a, tua ahikom amate in, Barnabas sia Antioch khua ah paisak hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama a thet ciang, Pathian ii a mite thupha a piakzia mu ahikom ama lungdam a, Pathian tungah thin tak lung tak taw a thumaan natu in, amate theampo hanthawn hi."},"24":{"text":"Barnabas sia mihing pha khat hi a, Thaa Thiangtho le upna taw kidim in, mihing tam mama Topa kung then hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin Barnabas in Saul zong tu in, Tarsus khua ah pai hi."},"26":{"text":"A zon pa a mu zawkciangin Antioch khua ah paipui a, amate nii in, pawlpi mite taw kum khat bup omkhawmin, Pawlpi mihon khat hilcianna nei hi. Tuabangin Antioch khua ah thu umte sia Tapidawte ci in kina masabel hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin, kamsaang pawlkhat in Jerusalem pan Antioch ah pai uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate sung panin, Agabus min nei khat hong ding a, simleitung theampo ah kialpi a tun natu Thaa vaangletna taw ama in sonkhol hi. (Kumpilianpa Claudius maan hun laitakin, tua kialpi tung hi.)","ref":"Sawl 21:10"},"29":{"text":"Nungzuite in amate hi zawk zaza tek, Judea ngam ah a teang a thu up puite atu a neisate puak tu in, khensat uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Tubang ahi zawkciangin, a sum uh sia, Pawlpi upate ii nga tu in, Barnabas le Saul khut tungah thaak uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi hun laitakin, Kumpipa Herod in, pawlpi mi pawlkhat vawtsia tu in kipan hi.","title":"A tam zawlai Vawtsiatna"},"2":{"text":"Ama in John suapuipa James namsau taw thatlumsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi bang a, a ngamtat ciangin, Jew te thukim hi ci in a mu ciang, Peter zongh mansak hi. (Hi hun sia Tol saw ngawl Anluum Poai sung ahi hi.)"},"4":{"text":"Peter sia a kimat zawkciang thonginn sungah khum a, ngalkap li veu pawl li kisua a, tuate in cingsak hi. Ama mipite mai ah Paisan Poai zawkciangin thusit tu in Herod in ngealna nei hi.","ref":"Pu 12:1-27"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom Peter thong sungah koi a, ahihang pawlpi mite in Pathian munah ama atu in nasia tak thu ngengen uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Mipite mai ah Herod in Peter thusit tu ni ma zanin Peter sia thongcingte nii ii kilaklaw ah mutthip hi. Ama sia thikkhau nii taw kikhii a, a thong kongkha ah thongcingte in cing hi.","title":"Peter Thong sung pan Suakta"},"7":{"text":"Thakhat thu in Topa vantunglalang khat tua munah ding a, thonginn doituam sung khuavak taang khat hong om hi. Vantunglalang in, Peter liangko panin lokin phong a, “Manlang in! Tho in!” ci hi. Thakhat thu in, thikkhaute Peter khut panin kizuk hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin vantunglalang in, “Na kawngkhau sawm in a, na peangdap thua in,” ci hi. Peter in tuabangin a vawt zawkciangin, vantunglalang in, “Na puantual silhin hong zui ta'n,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Peter in thonginn doipua ah zui hi, ahizong ama in vantunglalang ii ngamtatna sia a takpi ma ziam ci in a tel bua hi; mukholna khat a mu kisa hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in thongcingte ii phual masa sia a kaantan zawkciang a niina sia zongh kaantan uh a, a khakbelin khuapi sung tumna thik kongkha ah theng uh hi. Amate atu in kongkha sia ama thu in kihong a, amate pusuak hi. Tuaciang khuapi sung lampi khat a totsuk laitak thakhat thu in vantunglalang in Peter nusia hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua zawkciang Peter in ama tungah bang thu piang, ci in phawk a, “Tu in a maan tatak sia ka he hi!” ci hi. “Topa in a vantunglalang khat sia, Herod ii vaangletna pan le Jew te ii kei tungah hong piang tu a upna theampo pan hong suatak tu in, hong paisak hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in a dinmun kitel ahikom, John Mark ii nu Mary inn ah pai hi, tua munah mihon kikhawm a, thungen uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Peter in kongkha puanung sia king a, Rhoda kici numei naseam khat in inn hon tu in pai hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in Peter aw tel a, lungdam leilam in, kongkha zongh hon meal ngawlin, heak kik hi. Inn sung a omte munah, Peter doipua ah ding hi, ci in son hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in, “Na thin amh hi!” ci uh hi. Ahihang numei nu in, a takpi ma hi, ci veve hi. Tua ahikom amate in, “Ama a keam vantunglalang hi vak,” ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua lan tengin, Peter in kongkha king top hi. A khakbel ciangin, amate in kong hon uh a, Peter a mu uh ciangin, lamdang sa uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate a thim natu in a khut taw lak a, thonginn sung pan Topa ii ama a pusuasakna thu teng son hi. “Hi thu James le thu um dangte munah son tavun,” a ci zawkciangin amate nusia in mun dang khat ah pai hi."},"18":{"text":"Zingsang khuavak ciang, thongcingte sungah — Peter bang tawk ziam, ci in nasia takin buai uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Herod in ama a zon natu thupia hikale, a mu zo bua uh hi. Tua ahikom ama in thongcingte thu donghsakin amate thalup tu in thupia hi. Hisia zawkciang, Herod in, Judea ngam nusia in, Caesarea ah hun tawmvei zangh hi."},"20":{"text":"Herod in Tyre le Sidon mite tungah a thin uuk mama hi, tua ahikom amate in Herod taw kimu tu in, pai hon uh hi. A masa in kumpi inncingpa Blastus sia amate a hu tu in, a thinzosak phot uh hi. Tua zawkciang amate in Herod kungah pai in kilemna ngen uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate ngam ii anneak tu sia kumpipa ii ngam panin nga uh hi.","title":"Herod Thina"},"21":{"text":"A kiciam ni a thet ciangin, Herod in a kumpi puantual silhin kumpi tokhum tungah to a, mipite tungah thusonna khat nei hi."},"22":{"text":"“A papau sia mihing hi ngawl a, pathian khat hi!” ci in amate au uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Thakhat thu in Topa vantunglalang khat in Herod velvawk hi, banghang ziam cile ama in Pathian vaang a pia bua hi. Ama sia lungte in ne a thi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua hun sungin, Pathian kammal kizel suak a, khang vaial hi."},"25":{"text":"Barnabas le Saul in, amate ii ngamthak nasep man a, John Mark, tonpui in Jerusalem panin heak kik uh hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Antioch khua pawlpi sungah, kamsaang pawlkhat le syate om hi: Barnabas, (Civompa kici) Simeon, (Cyrene pan) Lucius, (Ngamuk mangpa Herod taw a no ciang a khang khawm) Manaen le Saul ahi uh hi.","title":"Barnabas le Saul Kiteal a Kipaisak"},"2":{"text":"Topa ii na seamin antangin a om laitak, Thaa Thiangtho in, “Barnabas le Saul sia, amate ka sapna bangin nasep seam tu in, kei atu koituam tavun,” ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate an tangin thungen a, amate tungah a khut uh a ngak zawkciangin, paisak hi."},"4":{"text":"Barnabas le Saul sia, Thaa Thiangtho in tuabangin sawl ahi bangma, Seleucia khua ah pai a tua mun panin, Cyprus tuikulh ah teambaw taw ding uh hi.","title":"Cyprus ah"},"5":{"text":"Salamis khua a thet uh ciangin, Jew te ii synagogue te ah Pathian thuhil uh hi. A nasepna hu tu in, John Mark zongh amate taw omkhawm hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in tuikulh kaantan in, Paphos ah pai uh a, tua munah mitbum thiampa Bar-Jesus min nei, kamsaang ka hi a ci Jew te khat taw kisii uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in tuikulh ngamuk mangpa Sergius Paulus ii ngualtamh khat hi a, tua pa in mihing ciim khat ahi hi. Ngamukpa in Barnabas le Saul ama mai ah sam hi, banghang ziam cile, ama in Pathian thu za nuam hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang mitbum thiampa Elymas (Greek min) in amate langpan hi, ama in ngamuk mangpa sia tua upna panin, a lampial natu in, hanciam hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin Paul a kici Saul in Thaa Thiangtho taw kidim hi; ama in mitbum thiampa tangtan in salh a,"},"10":{"text":"“Nang Doaimangpa tapa awng! Nang in a pha ci theampo ii ngalin pang ni hi. Nang in ngitlo thimthel pilna theampo taw kidim ni hi, tuaciangin, Topa ii thumaan thutakte sia leilot thu suaksak tu in hanciam tawntung ni hi!"},"11":{"text":"Topa khut in tu in, nang tungah hong paisuk tu hi; na mit tawcip tu a, tuaciangin, sun khuavak sia hun khat sung teng na mu thei buatu hi,” ci hi. Thakhat thu in, Elymas in, ama mittangte khuavui tuamcip bangin, thuak a, ama khut lenin lamlak tu mihing zongin, vak kawkoai hi."},"12":{"text":"Ngamuk mangpa in, thupiang teng a mu ciangin, ama in um hi. banghang ziam cile Topa thu a kihilciannate nasia takin, lamdang sa hi."},"13":{"text":"Paul le a pawl a lawmte sia Paphos khua panin, teambaw taw ding a, Pamphylia ngam khuapi khat ahi Perga a thet uh ciangin, tuak ah John Mark in amate nusia in Jerusalem ah heak kik hi.","title":"Pisidia Ngam Antioch Khua ah"},"14":{"text":"Amate sia Perga pan paisuak in, Pisidia ngam Antioch khua theng a, tuaciang Sabbath ni in synagogue sungah tum in to uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Moses Thukham le kamsaangte lai atte a sim zawk uh ciangin, synagogue uliante in: “Suapuite awng, hanthot nopna thupuak nong nei uh le, mihingte tungah nong son tu ka dei uh hi,” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Paul dingto in, a khut vaan a, thuson tu in kipan hi: “Hiak ah Pathian bia in a om, Israel minampuite le Gentile theampo awng: hong ngai tavun!"},"17":{"text":"Israel minamte ii Pathian in ih taanghpupite na teal a, Egypt ngam ah peamta in a teen hun sungin, minam lian khat in, na siam hi. Pathian in amate sia Egypt ngam panin, vaangletna lian taw pusua pui a,","ref":"Pu 1:7; 12:51"},"18":{"text":"kum sawmli sung sennealngam sungah, amate a thuak kenkon hi.","ref":"Mi 14:34; Thkna 1:31"},"19":{"text":"Amate in Canaan ngam ah, minam salite lalsak in ama minamte in, a ngam uh luasak hi.","ref":"Thkna 7:1; Jos 14:1"},"20":{"text":"Hi hun sung theampo kum zali le kum sawmnga sung bang ahi hi. “Tuasia zawkciang Pathian in amate sia, kamsaangpa Samuel hun dong, thukhenmangte pia hi.","ref":"Thkte 2:16; 1 Sa 3:20"},"21":{"text":"Tuaciang amate in, kumpi khat a nget uh ciang Pathian in Benjamin suan Kish ii tapa Saul sia kum sawmli sung kumpi seam tu in pia hi.","ref":"1 Sa 8:5; 10:21"},"22":{"text":"Saul a hep zawkciang Pathian in David sia kumpipa suaksak hi. Pathian in tua pa huvau hi bangin ci hi: ‘Jesse tapa David in ka thin taw a kisi mihing nam hi a, seam a ka oai theampo a seam tu pa khat hi ci in ka mu zo hi.’","ref":"1 Sa 13:14; 16:12; Ps 89:20"},"23":{"text":"David ii suan Jesus sia Pathian in kamciam a piaksa bangma in, Israel mite ii Hunpa hisak hi."},"24":{"text":"Jesus in a nasep a kipat ma in, John in Israel te theampo a mawnate uh pan, kisiik kik hamtang in, tui a kiphum uh kul tu hi, ci in thuhil hi.","ref":"Mk 1:4; Lk 3:3"},"25":{"text":"Tuaciang, John in a nasep a zaw kuan sang ciangin, mihingte munah, ‘Kei sia akua hong sa nu ziam? Ama in kei nungah hong pai lai tu a, ama peangdap suut tu in, ka kilawm bua hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Mt 3:11; Mk 1:7; Lk 3:16; Jn 1:20-27"},"26":{"text":"“Abraham suan Israel ka mipuite le, hi sungah Pathian a bia Gentile te theampo awng, hi ngupna thu ei tungah hong kipuak zo ahi hi!"},"27":{"text":"Tua in banghang ziam cile, Jerusalem ah a om mihingte le a lampuite in ama sia Hunpa ahi hunlam he ngawl a, Sabbath ni sim a kisim kamsaangte ii kammalte zongh a tel bua uh hi. Ahihang amate in Jesus a puavawk na uh taw, kamsaangte sonna teng, a taangtungsak a suak hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in, Jesus tungah thidaan a piak natu thu mu zo ngawl ahihang Pilate munah, a thalupsak natu in ngen uh hi.","ref":"Mt 27:22-23; Mk 15:13-14; Lk 23:21-23; Jn 19:15"},"29":{"text":"Laithiangtho sungah ama huvau a kison theampo a vawt zawkciang amate in thinglamtee tung pan khiasuk a, thaankuul khat sungah koi uh hi.","ref":"Mt 27:57-61; Mk 15:42-47; Lk 23:50-56; Jn 19:38-42"},"30":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in thina pan thosak kik hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuaciang Galilee pan Jerusalem ah a khualhaw puite tungah ni tam ma kilak hi. Tu in amate in Israel mite tungah ama ii tetti te ahi uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 1:3"},"32":{"text":"Tuaciangin Lungdamna Thupha no tungah hong puak tu in, kote hi sungah kong om uh hi: Pathian ii ih taanghpupite tungah a sep a vawt tu kamciam a piak sia, Jesus nungta kik tu in, a thaw kiksakna taw, ei a suan a paalte tungah, tu in tua kamciam hong tungsak ahi hi. Psalm a niina sungah hi bangin ki at hi, ‘Nang in ka Tapa na hi hi; tuni in na Pa ka suak zo hi.’","merge":"33","ref":"Ps 2:7"},"34":{"text":"Thina sung pan a thaw kik natu le, thaan sungah a muat ngeingawl natu in, Pathian sonna in hi bangin ci hi, ‘David tungah ka kamciam ahi a thiangtho le a maan thupha sia no tungah kong pia tu hi.’","ref":"Is 55:3"},"35":{"text":"Laithiangtho mundang khat ah zongh hi bangin ci takpi hi. ‘Nang tungah a thumaan na naseampa thaan sungah na muatsak nuam buatu hi.’","ref":"Ps 16:10"},"36":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile David in a nuntak lai in Pathian ii deinate a sepsak zawkciang thi a, a taanghpupite taw kivui khawmin thaan sungah muat hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian ii thina pan a thaw kiksak pa sia thaan sungah muat ngawl hi."},"38":{"text":"Ka mipui Israel te awng, na heak tu ka dei uh thu sia Jesus tungtawnin mawnate kimaisakna hong kihilna thu hi; ama a um peuma in, Moses thukham ii hong suataksak zawk ngawl mawnate theampo panin, hong kisuataksakna thu ahi hi.","merge":"39"},"40":{"text":"Tua ahikom kamsaangte ii hi bangin a ci teng sia, no tungah hong tun ngawl natu in, kidawm tavun;"},"41":{"text":"‘En vun, ngual selno theite awng! Lamdang sa in thi tavun! Banghang ziam cile tuni in ka nasep sia a khiakna hong son a om hial zong, na um thei buatu hi!’ ” ci hi.","ref":"Hab 1:5"},"42":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas in synagogue a nusiat uh laitakin, Sabbath ni kik ciang, amate pai kik a, hi thute a son thua lai natu in mite in sam uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Kikhopna panin mipite a cia zawkciangin, Paul le Barnabas sia Jew mi tam mama le Jew te biakna sungah a tum Gentile mi tam mama in zui uh hi. Pathian ii thuthiamna sungah kip in, a nuntak natu sawltakte in, amate sonpui in hanthawn uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Sabbath ni kik ciangin, khuapi sungah a om mihing theampo phial in Topa kammal ngai tu in pai uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Jew te in mihonpite a mu ciangin, eenna thin taw kidim uh a; Paul thusonte nialin, selno uh hi."},"46":{"text":"Ahihang Paul le Barnabas in, hang seseam in thuson uh hi: “Pathian thu, no kungah hong kihil maksak tu kisamh hi.
