Amate in a khuathing in buaisak uh a, Paul le Silas zongin mipite mai ah a kaikeak thei natu in Jason ii inn sim uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang amate a mu ngawl uh ciang, Jason le thu um dang pawlkhat khuapi thuneite mai ah kai a, “Hi mite in mun theampo ah nawngkaisak uh hi! Tu zonghin amate ei khua ah hong pai uh a,"},"7":{"text":"tuaciang Jason in, amate sia ama inn ah keam hi. Amate theampo in, Kumpilianpa ii thukhamte paltan a, Jesus a minnei kumpipa dang khat om hi ci uh hi,” ci in au uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Hi kammal teng taw khuapi sungah mihonte le khuapi thuneite buaisak uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Thuneite in Jason le a dang teng a suatak natu in, a kisamh za sum piasak a, tua zawkciangin amate paisak uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Khuazan po ciang, thu umte in Paul le Silas sia, Berea khua ah puak uh hi. A thet ciangin, amate synagogue ah pai uh hi.","title":"Berea khua ah"},"11":{"text":"Tua khua mite in Thessalonica khua mite sangin ngaisun kaak thei zaw uh hi. Amate in lawpna lian taw thusonte ngai in, Paul thusonte maan tatak ziam ci in a heak natu in ni simin Laithiangtho en uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate sung pan mihing tam mama in thu um a; Greek te a ci thei numei tam mama le Greek te pasal tam mama zongh in um uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang Thessalonica ah a om Jew te in, Pathian kammal sia Bereate tung zongh ah, Paul in hil zo hi ci in, a zaak uh ciangin, hong pai a, mihing ngilo nuam honkhat hol hi."},"14":{"text":"Thu umte in thakhat thu in, Paul sia tuipivaal ah puak uh hi; ahihang Silas le Timothy te ngeal Berea ah taam uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Paul a thate in Athens dong zui uh a, tua zawkciang Berea ah heak kikin, Silas le Timothy in, a manlang thei zaza in, a del natu Paul ii kam vaithak teng son uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Silas le Timothy ngakin, a om laitak Paul in Athens khua ah milim biakna a dim in om a mu ciangin Paul sia nasia takin a thinkiam hi.","title":"Athens khua ah"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jew te le Pathian a bia Gentile te taw synagogue sung le, ni simin hong pai pawpo taw zongh mipi kikhopna leitual ah Paul in thu kikuppui hi."},"18":{"text":"Epicurean syate le Stoic syate zongh in, ama taw thu kinial uh hi. Pawlkhat in, “He ngawl napi, a kihesak hisia pa in, bang teng son nuam ziam,” ci in dongh hi. A dangte in, “Ama ii son sia, ngamdangte pathiante hi tuak hi,” ci in zo kik hi. Banghang hi bangin ci ziam cile, ama in Jesus thu le a thaw kikna thu a hil hang ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in Paul sia Areopagus kici Athen te ii council kikhopna munah paipui a, hi bangin ci uh hi, “Hi hilna thak na sawson sia, he nuam khu hi."},"20":{"text":"Thu pawlkhat na son kong zaak uhte sia, ko atu in tumdang ahikom, a khiakna he nuam tu khu hi,” ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"(Banghang ziam cile, Athens khua mi theampo le tuak ah a teang ngamdangmite in, thuthak sonna le zaakna taw a hun theampo zangh nuam uh hi.)"},"22":{"text":"Khuapi council kikhopna mai ah Paul ding a, “Athen te awng, na theampo sungah biakna lamsang kin mamate na hi hunlam ka mu hi."},"23":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile na khuapi sung kaantan in, ka pai a, na biakna munte ka et ciangin, ‘A kihe ngawl Pathian khat Atu,’ ci in biaknatau khat tungah, lai ki at ka mu hi. Tua ahiciang na heak ngawl bul na biak uh Pathian sia, tu in a thu kong thansak sia ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Leitung le a sung a om theampo a vawt, Pathian sia vantung le leitung ii Topa hi a, mihing khutte taw a kivawt biakinnte sungah a teang bua hi.","ref":"1 Kum 8:27; Is 42:5; Sawl 7:48"},"25":{"text":"Mihingte ii ama atu ih sepsakna pan, ih piak thei tu na khat zongh, ama atu in a kitaangsamh bua hi, banghang ziam cile mihing theampo atu nuntakna, husanna le na theampo ama ii hong piaksa hi zaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in mihing khat panin, mihing nam theampo bitphua a, leitung buppi ah teangsak hi. Ama in amate teen natu a hunte le a munte see kholsa in koi hi."},"27":{"text":"Mihingte ii ama a zon thei natu le ama a mu thei thaak natu in hi bangin vawt hi. Ahizong a tatakin Pathian in ei khat pawpo kung panin khuala ngawl hi;"},"28":{"text":"mihing khat in, ‘Ama sungah ei ih nungta a, ngamta in ih om hi’ a ci bangma ahi hi. Noma ii la phua pawlkhat zongh in, ‘Ei zongh ama tate ih hi hi’ ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Ei sia Pathian ii tate ih hi zawk nungsang in, ama pianzia sia mihingte pilna le thiamna taw a kivawt khamh, ngunn le suang milim khat pawpo bangin ih ngaisun buatu hi."},"30":{"text":"Mihingte ii ama ih heak ngawl lai hunte, Pathian in heak ngawl bawl hikale tu hun ciang, mihingte a vekpi in mun theampo ah, amate tatsiatnate pan a kikheal natu ama in thupia hi."},"31":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ama in, leitung bup ah thukhaikim thu taw, ama ii tealsa mihing khat zangh in, thu a khen natu in, ni khat, ciangtan sa in koi hi. Hi thu a maanna thu sia, tua pa thina panin a thawsak kikna taw mihing sim tungah a lak zo hi!” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Thina panin a thawsak kikna huvau, Paul ii son a zaak uh ciangin, pawlkhat in nunauna in nei uh a, ahihang a dangte in, “Hi thu huvau na son sia za kik nuam lai khu hi,” ci uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ahikom Paul in kikhopna nusia hi."},"34":{"text":"Pasal pawlkhat in ama pawmin thu um uh hi, tuate sungah council mi ahi Dionysius om a; Damaris a kici numei khat le a dang pawlkhat zongh kihel hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia zawkciang, Paul in Athens nusia in Corinth ah paisuak hi.","title":"Corinth khua ah"},"2":{"text":"Tua munah ama in Italy pan a zi Priscilla taw hong pai tawm Pontus khua ah a suak Jew te Aquila a kici khat taw kimu hi, banghang ziam cile Kumpilianpa Claudius in Jew te theampo Rome khua a nusiat natu in, thupia hi. Paul in amate taw kimu tu in pai a,"},"3":{"text":"amate taw taam khawm naseam khawm in om hi, banghang ziam cile amate bangma in, Paul in a nuntak natu in tuipuan buk khui hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in Jew te le Greek te a telsak thei natu in, Sabbath ni simin synagogue ah thu kikum khawm uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Macedonia pan Silas le Timothy a thet ciang, Paul in hunbit in thuhilna zangh a, Jesus sia Messiah hi ci in Jew te tungah tetti pang hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in nalh in, ama huvau kamsia a pau uh ciang, ama in a lungkim ngawlna a lakna in, a puan tungah leivui baangte thin a, “Na mangthang uh le noma mawna hang hi tu hi! Kei hang hi ngawl tu hi. Tu pan kipan Gentile te kungah pai tu khi hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate nusia in, Titius Justus kici Pathian a bia Gentile mite khat ii inn ah teang tu in, pai hi; tua pa ii inn sia synagogue hui ma ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Jew te ii synagogue ah a lampuipa Crispus le a innkuanpui theampo in Topa um uh hi; Corinth a midang tam mama in ngupna thu za uh a, um in tui kiphum uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Zan khat Paul in mukholna nei a, Topa in ama tungah, “Lau heak in, na son ngei bangma in son in a, tua thu thasua heak in,"},"10":{"text":"banghang ziam cile keima in nang hong ompui ka hikom, kuama in nang hong susia thei ngawl tu hi. Hi khuapi sung a om mihing tam mamate sia keima mi ahi hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom Paul in tua munah kum khat le kum lang taam a, mihingte tungah Pathian kammal hil hi."},"12":{"text":"Gallio sia Rome kumpite in Achaia ngamuk mangpa tu in a koi uh ciangin, Jew te hong kikhawmtua a, Paul manin, thukhenzum ah paipui uh hi."},"13":{"text":"“Hi sia pa in thukham taw a kisi ngawl biaknazia taw Pathian biak natu mihingte zol tu in hanciam hi!” ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Paul in thuson tu in a kithoai laitak, Gallio in Jew te tungah, “Hi thu sia ngitlo khialna lian ahibuale khialna khat po a vawt ahi tha le, no Jew te tungah kong thinsau kenkon natu kilawm hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang hi thu sia kammalte, minte le noma thukham taw kisai thu kinialna ahikom noma tek ma in khensat hamtang tavun. Tuabangte tungtaang ah thukhenpa seam ngawl tu khi hi!” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaciangin amate sia zum sung panin, not hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate theampo in synagogue lampuipa Sosthenes man uh a, zum mai ah vel uh hi. Ahihang Gallio in tuasia tawm zongh a awlmaw bua hi."},"18":{"text":"Paul in Corinth khua ah thu umte taw ni tam ma taam a, tua zawkciang amate nusia in Priscilla le Aquila taw Syria ah teambaw taw ding uh hi. Cenchreae pan teambaw taw a din ma in, a kiciamna khat hu in, a lu a tol in meet hi.","title":"Antioch khua ah Heak kik","ref":"Mi 6:18"},"19":{"text":"Amate in Ephesus khua theng a, tua munah Paul in Priscilla le Aquila nusia hi. Ama in synagogue ah pai a, Jew te taw thu kikum hi."},"20":{"text":"Amate in khuangei zaw a taam lai natu in ama tho uh hi. Ahihang ama a thukim bua hi."},"21":{"text":"Taam ngawl zaw in a din tu ciang, “Pathian ii deina ahile no kungah kong pai kik tu hi,” ci hi. Tuabangin ama Ephesus panin teambaw taw ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Caesarea a thet ciangin, Jerusalem ah pai a, pawlpi mite paupui in, tua zawkciang Antioch ah pai hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua munah hun tawmvei a zak zawkciang ding kik hi. Ama in Galatia le Phrygia ngamte kaantan in pai a, thu um theampo thakhosak hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Alexandria khua ah a suak Apollos kici Jew te pasal khat Ephesus khua ah hong pai hi. Ama in thuson thiam khat hi a, Laithiangtho zongh a khawng a kheakin he hi.","title":"Ephesus le Corinth ah Apollos Haw"},"25":{"text":"Ama sia Topa Lampi a kihil sa khat hi a, tha lawpna lianpi taw Jesus thu thangsak a, maan takin hil hi. Priscilla le Aquila in ama thu a zaak uh ciang, amate inn ah ciapui uh a, Pathian Lampi a maan zaw lai in hil thiang uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuasia ciang Apollos in Achaia ah pai tu in khensat ahikom, Ephesus ah thu umte in, ama a huna in Achaia ngam a om thu umte laithaksak a, pha takin vai a mua natu in hanthawn uh hi. Ama a thet ciangin, Pathian ii thuthiamna taw thu um a suakte atu in, a huna lian mama hi."},"28":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, Jesus sia Messiah a hina thu, Laithiangtho sisanh in a lak telna taw in mihonte mai ah, Jew te taw kam kinialnate sungah a mawngnei mama kam nialnate taw Jew te a zo ngawp hi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Corinth khua ah Apollos a om laitak, Paul sia tua ngamkhen sungsang kaantan in khualhaw a, Ephesus theng hi. Tua munah nungzuite pawlkhat mu a,","title":"Ephesus khua ah Paul"},"2":{"text":"tuaciang, ama in “Thu um mite na sua uh ciang, Thaa Thiangtho na nga uh ziam?” ci in dongh hi. Amate in “Thaa Thiangtho a om hunlam za zongh za bua ung,” ci in zo uh hi."},"3":{"text":"“Pha hi, tua ahile bang tui kiphumna nam sia na saang uh ziam?” ci in Paul in dongh hi. “John ii tuiphumna sia hi,” ci in zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Paul in, “John ii tuiphumna sia in mawnate pan a kisiikte atu ahi hi; tuaciang ama in Israel te tungah, ama nung pan hong paipa na um vun — - tua pa in Jesus hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 3:11; Mk 1:4,7,8; Lk 3:4,16; Jn 1:26-27"},"5":{"text":"Amate in hi thu a zaak uh ciangin, Topa Jesus min taw tui kiphum uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Paul in amate tungah a khut nga a, Thaa Thiangtho amate tungah hong theng hi; amate in kam tumdangte taw pau uh a, Pathian ii ngupna thute zongh thangsak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate a vekpi in, sawm le nii khawng pha uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Paul in Jew te synagogue ah pai a, tha thum sung hangsan takin mihingte tungah thuson a, amate taw thu kikum in, Pathian Ngam thu a upsak zawk natu hanciam hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang pawlkhatte a thinpui in, a um nuam bua uh a, mihon bup mai ah amate in Topa Lampi sonsia uh hi. Tua ahikom Paul in amate nusia in, thu umte paipui a, ni simin Tyrannus laihilna inndoi lian sungah kikupna nei uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Hi bangin kum nii tawntung a kalsuanpui ciangin Asia ngamkhen a teang Jew te le Gentile te in Topa kammal za uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Paul tungtawnin Pathian in nidang in a om ngeingawl, nalamdang laknate vawt hi.","title":"Sceva ii Tapate Thu"},"12":{"text":"Ama zak mai nawlna le awmdap puante ngawngawn ciinate kungah a kipaipui ciangin a natnate dam a, thaa ngilote zongh amate sung pan pusuak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Jew te pawlkhat khualhaw in vakkot a, thaa ngilo a notte zongh in thaa ngilo a naw natu in, Topa Jesus min zak tu hanciam uh hi. Amate in thaa ngilo te munah, “Paul ii a hil Jesus min taw keima in thu kong pia hi,” ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Unau salite ahi, Jew te Thiampi Lianbel Sceva a kici sia ii tapate in hi bang seam uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang thaa ngilo in amate tungah, “Jesus sia he khi hi, tuaciang Paul zongh he khi hi; ahihang no akua te nu ziam?” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Thaa ngilo veipa in amate nasia takin buan ngawp a, zocip siat hi. Tua ahikom a liam a bai le puan ekkeak sa in tua pa inn panin tai uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ephesus khua a teang Jew te le Gentile te theampo in hi thu za uh hi; amate sia launa taw kidim in, Topa Jesus min kipatoai seseam hi."},"18":{"text":"Thu um mite sung pan tam mama hong pai a, amate ngamtatnasate mipi mai ah kheet nei ngawlin pualaak uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Mitbum thiam tam mama in a laibute khawmtua in hong paipui uh a, mipi mu tangin, mei taw haltham uh hi. A laibu man teng a kingawm ciang, ngunntang tul sawmnga pha hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa thu sia hi bangin vaangletna taw kizel a, hat vaial hi."},"21":{"text":"Hi thu teng a pian zawkciang Paul in Macedonia le Achaia ngam kaantan in khualhaw a, Jerusalem ah paitan tu in, khensat hi. Ama in “Tua munah ka pai zawkciang, Rome khuapi zongh ah ka haw kul tu hi,” ci hi.","title":"Ephesus khua ah Buaina"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama a hute nii Timothy le Erastuste zongh Macedonia ngam ah paisak a, ama ahile, Asia ngamkhen ah hun a tamzaw zangh thua hi."},"23":{"text":"Hi hun laitakin, Ephesus khua ah Topa ii Thu hangin buaina nasia khat hong om hi."},"24":{"text":"Demetrius min nei ngunn seakpa in, a numeipathian Artemis ii biakinn limte veu, ngunn taw vawt a, ama nasepna pan a naseamte meetsak mama hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in, a naseam theampo le, tua nasepna taw a kibang a seam mihing dangte khawmtua in, “Pasalte awng, eite nopsakna in hi nasepna pan hong piang hi, ci in na heak tek uh ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tu in hi Paul a ci sia pa ii ngamtatna babang noma tek in mu thei a, za thei nu hi. Ama in khut taw vawttawm pathian in pathian hi peuma ngawl hi ci a, hi sung Ephesus khua le Asia ngamkhen bup phialma ah mihing tam tatak umsak zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaciang ih nasepna a minsiat tu lauhuai hi. Tua bek dom ngawlin, Asia ngam le leitung mun theampo ii a biak tua a lian numeipathian Artemis ii biakinn zongh a luithawthong suakin — a letna teng a kisuksiat tu lauhuai hi!” ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Mihonpite in hi kamte a zaak uh ciangin, a thinso a, “Ephesus khua ah om Artemis ma lian hi!” ci in au uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ngamlumna sia khuapi bup kilaw hi. A ngilo nuam mihon in, Paul ii khualhawpui Macedonia te nii Gaius le Aristarchus pummat a, poai lakna inn ah taipui uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Paul in mihonte mai ah, pai nuam ahihang, thu um mite in a oai bua uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama lawm ngamkhen sungah thunei pawlkhatte in zongh poai inn ah ama le ama a kilaak ngawl natu in thu zasak uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua laitakin a kikhopna buppi sungah ngamlum seseam hi; pawlkhat in thu pawlkhat taw au a, a dangte in thudang khat taw au uh hi, banghang ziam cile mihing a tamzaw in, amate banghangin kikhawmtua ziam ci zongh a tel bua uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhat in Alexander maw hi vak ci uh hi, banghang ziam cile Jew te in ama sia mai ah paisak uh hi. Tuasia ciangin, Alexander in mihonpi a thim natu a khut vaanin ama a kihuk natu in, thuson tu hanciam hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahihang ama sia Jew te hi ci in a tel uh ciangin, a au ngei uh bangin, “Ephesus khua ah, Artemis lian hi!” ci in nai nii sung au hon uh hi."},"35":{"text":"A khakbel ciangin khuapi lai atpa in, mihonte thimsak thei hi. Amate in a top ciang, ama thi zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang Paul tuaksuk a, ama tungah bok in koai a, “Patau heak vun, ama nungta lai hi!” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaciang ama in inn tungah kaato in, anluum baltham in ne hi. Ama in hi bang tu ma in, hong sonsa hi a, ama in lei lam tawnin tua munah pai hi.","title":"Troas pan Miletus ah"},"14":{"text":"Assos ah ka kisik uh ciangin, teambaw tungah ama hong kaato a, Mitylene khua ah ka paisuak uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua mun panin teambaw taw ka ding uh a, a zing ciangin, Chios ngal ka theng uh hi. Ni khat zawkciangin, Samos ka theng uh a, a zing ciangin, Miletus ka theng uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Asia ngamkhen sung tengah hun a bo thong ngawl natu in, Paul in Ephesus khua kaantan in, teambaw taw pai tu khensat hi. Hi thei le Pentecost ni lapin, ama Jerusalem khua a theng tu in pai memeang hi."},"17":{"text":"Paul in Miletus panin, Ephesus ah thu zasak a, pawlpi upate ama taw a kimu natu in vaitha hi.","title":"Ephesus Upate tungah Paul ii Vaithakna"},"18":{"text":"Amate hong thet ciangin, Paul in amate tungah, “Asia ngamkhen ah kong thet phit ni pan kipan no taw hun bup bangbangin zangh khi ziam, ci sia na heak uh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Jew te ii hong thasawm hu in, haksatna hunte sungah Topa ii naseam bangin kiniamkhiakna theampo le, thitui tam mama taakin na ka seam zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Mipite mai le noma inn uh ah thuhilna le hilciannate kong nei ciangin, note phattuam natu in bangma kheet ka nei ngawl sia na heak uh ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Jew te le Gentile te tungah a kibangin a mawna tetek pan Pathian sangah kiheak kik a, ih Topa Jesus a up natu in, thupi takin kong phawksak hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu in Thaa Thiangtho thu ka nitna taw Jerusalem ah pai tu khi hi, tua munah bang tat tu khi ziam he ngawl khi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ngimnate le thonginn in, keima hong ngak hi, ci in khuapi sim ma ah Thaa Thiangtho in hong phawksak hi ci sia bek ka he hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahihang keima nuntakna sia bangma man nei ka sa bua hi; keima vaipuak ka khuangkhim natu le Topa Jesus ii nasep hong piak ahi, Pathian ii thuthiamna Lungdamna Thupha ka thansak tu ka man thiang tu bek ka uuk hi.","ref":"2 Tim 4:7"},"25":{"text":"“Pathian Ngam thuhil in, note theampo sungah kong vak zo hi. Tuaciang note sung pan kuama in, kei nong mu kik ngei nawn ngawl tu uh sia tu in ka he hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom tuni mama in, no tungah a ciliaphuai takin kong taangko hi: a mangthang khat po na om uh le, kei ii ka vaipuak lel hu hi ngawl tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian tupna a buppi in kong sonna ah bangma kheet nei ngawl khi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom noma le noma kikeam tavun a, Thaa Thiangtho ii noma khut sung a hong aap tuuhonte zongh en in keam tavun. A Tapa ii chisan tungtawnin, ama atu a piansak Pathian ii pawlpi ii tuucingte na hi tavun."},"29":{"text":"Kong nusiat zawkciangin, a kiitakhuai ngiate, no sungah hong pai tu a, tua tuuhon a khoaikhet ngawl tu sia ka he hi."},"30":{"text":"Noma pawlsung pan ma in, pawlkhat in thu umte sia leilot thu taw amate a zui tu in, a zol tu hun hong theng tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahiciang encik tavun, kum thum sung sun taw zan taw thitui tam ma taakin note khat sim kong hilcian sia ciamtee tavun."},"32":{"text":"“Tu in no sia Pathian kepna sung le a thuthiamna thu sungah kong aap hi, tuasia in ama mihing theampo hong puuato thei a, Pathian thuphate hong pia thei hi."},"33":{"text":"Khamh ahizong, ngunn ahizong, puansilhte ahizong, kuama ii neisa ka dungawk ngei bua hi."},"34":{"text":"Ka kitholpuite le keima kitaangsapna teng ka sik natu in hi ka khutte taw na ka sep sia noma tatak ma in, na he uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Topa Jesus mama in, ‘Saanna sangin piakna in lungdamna tamzaw hi’, a ci thu phawk kawmin, hi bangin nasia tak na sepna taw na theampo ah, a thazawmte ih hu nanak tu hi, ci in no tungah kong lak zo hi,” ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Paul in a son tu teng a man ciang, amate taw khupdin in, thungen hi."},"37":{"text":"Amate in ama koai a namhin, a vaithak uh ciang, a vekpi ma in kap uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Ama a mu kik nawn ngawl natu, a son hu in, amate a tuanin khuangai uh hi. Tuaciang amate in teambaw kungah ama tha uh hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amate ka vaitha uh a, ka nusia uh hi. Teambaw taw a tangtan in, ka pai uh ciang, Cos ka theng uh hi; a zing ciangin Rhodes ka theng uh a, tua mun panin Patara ka zuan suak uh hi.","title":"Jerusalem ah Paul Pai"},"2":{"text":"Tua munah Phoenicia ah a pai tu teambaw khat ka mu uh hi, tua ahikom teambaw tungah kaato in, ka zui uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Cyprus a kimu theina mun ka theng uh a, tua zawkciang a thangsang Syria ah ka pai uh hi. Tyre khua ah ka kaa uh a, tua mun sia teambaw vanh sua natu mun ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua munah thu um mi pawlkhat ka mu uh a, amate kungah nipi khat ka taam uh hi. Amate in Paul sia Jerusalem ah a pai ngawl natu in, Thaa vaangletna taw tho uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang amate taw hun ka zak zawkciangin, vai ka ding uh a, koma pai natu ah ka pai uh hi. Amate in a zite a tate taw khuapi puasia dong hong tha in, vaalbo ah ka vekpi khupdin in thu ka ngen uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, khat le khat kivaitha in teambaw tungah ko ka kaa uh a, amate inn ah a cia kik uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tui tung ka khualhawna uh ka zom uh a, Tyre pan, Ptolemais ah pai in, tua munah thu umte ka nukset uh a, amate kungah ni khat ka taam uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A zing ciangin ka ding uh a, Caesarea ka theng uh hi. Tua khua ah thupha puak syapa Philip ii inn ah ka taam uh hi. Ama sia Jerusalem ah a kiteal husya sali sungah khat ahi hi.","ref":"Sawl 6:5; 8:5"},"9":{"text":"Ama in Pathian thu a thangsak, pasal a nei ngawl tanu li nei hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua munah ni tam ma ka taam uh sungin, Judea ngam panin, Agabus a kici kamsaang khat hong theng hi.","ref":"Sawl 11:28"},"11":{"text":"Ama ko kungah hong pai a, Paul kawngkhau la in, ama le ama a khut a peang kisawm a, “Thaa Thiangtho cina pan: Hi kawngkhau a neipa sia Jerusalem ah hi bang danin Jew te in khaukhii tu a, Gentile te khut sungah aap tu hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Hi thu ka zaak uh ciangin ko le a dang teng in Paul tungah Jerusalem ah a pai ngawl natu in ka thuum uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang Paul in, “Bang son nu ziam? Hi bangin kapin ka thin hong tamhsak nu ziam? Jerusalem ah khau kikhii bek dom ngawlin, Topa Jesus hangin, tua munah a thi tu ngawngawn zong kingingta zo khi hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"14":{"text":"A thin zaw natu in ka sonpui zo bua uh a, ka ci ka law he ngawlin “Topa deina bang hi tahen,” ka ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tawmvei tua munah hun ka zak zawk uh ciangin, vanh teng kithoai in, Jerusalem ka zuan uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Caesarea pan nungzuite pawlkhat zongh in hong tonpui a, ka taam natu uh Cyprus ngammi thu um ciil khat ahi Mnason inn ah hong then hi."},"17":{"text":"Jerusalem ka thet uh ciangin, thu umte in, nuam takin vai hong muak uh hi.","title":"James kungah Paul Haw"},"18":{"text":"A zing ciangin, Paul taw James kungah ka haw uh hi; tua munah pawlpi upa theampo om uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Paul in amate a nukset zawkciang, ama nasepnate tungtawnin, Pathian ii Gentile te sungah a sep a vawt theampo cing takin ko hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama thuson a zaak zawk uh ciangin, amate theampo in, Pathian pok uh hi. Tua zawkciangin, amate in Paul tungah, “Suapui Paul awng, Jew te mihing tul tam mama thu um hong suak zo uh a, amate theampo Thukham nasia takin, a zuite ahi sia na mu thei hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate tungah nang ii thu a kisonna panin, Gentile ngamsung teng ah a teang Jew theampo ma in, Moses Thukham a nusiat natu, nangma in hilcian a, a tate ii vunteap a at ngawl natu le, Jew ngeinate a zui ngawl natu in sawl hi, ci thu ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate in nang nong thet hunlam za nanak tu hi. Tua ahiciang bang law tu hi ziam?"},"23":{"text":"Hi bangin na ngamtat tu in, kong dei uh hi. Kiciamna a vawt sa pasal li hi sungah om hi.","ref":"Mi 6:13-21"},"24":{"text":"Amate taw va paikhawm ta'n a, amate ii kithiansuana poai sungah kihel in, sum bona teng zongh piaksak ta'n; tuasia ciangin, amate in a lu uh meettol thei tu hi. Hi bangin hi leang nang thu huvau hong kisonna sia thumaan a hi ngawl hunlam le, nangma mama sia Moses Thukham bang a, a nungta pa na hina thu a kuama po in hong he tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Gentile te sung pan thu um a suakte ahile, lai khat thaak zo khu hi, milim biakna in a kizangh an lamsangte neak ngawl natu, chisan ahibuale nganhing a kitawlmeakte ii sa a neak ngawl natu, tuaciang numei le pa paktatna pan a kikep natu in, thu ka khensat uh te, ka son uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 15:29"},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom Paul in, tua pasalte paipui a, a zing ciangin amate taw a kithiansua hi. Tua zawkciang, ama sia Biakinnpi sungah tum a, kithiansuana hun a man tu dong le amate khat sim atu in sangaw biakpiakna a piak thei tu hun sia zongh ni bangza hi tu ziam ci sia zasak hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahihang, a ni sali hun a bo dektak laitakin, Asia ngamkhen pan hong pai Jew te pawlkhat in, Paul sia Biakinnpi sungah mu uh hi. Amate in mihon bup hol in, Paul pummat uh hi.","title":"Biakinnpi sungah Paul Kiman"},"28":{"text":"“Israel pasalte awng! Hong hu tavun! Hisia pa sia mun theampo ah pai in, Israel te, Moses Thukham le hi Biakinnpi langpan in, hilcianna a neipa hi. Tu zonghin, ama in Gentile te pawlkhat Biakinnpi sungah paipui in, hi a thiangtho mun sia ninsak hi!” ci in au uh hi."},"29":{"text":"(Hi bangin a ci theina sia Ephesus khua mi Trophimus sia Paul taw khuapi sungah kithawl khawm in mu uh a, Paul in, tua pa sia Biakinnpi sungah tumpui hi tu in muangmaw uh hi.)","ref":"Sawl 20:4"},"30":{"text":"Telmeal om ngawlin khuapi bup thu kizel a, mihingte tai lialua in, Paul man uh a, Biakinnpi pan kaikeak uh hi. Thakhat thu in Biakinnpi kongkhate kikhak hi."},"31":{"text":"A ngilo nuam mihonpi in Paul thalup a sawm uh laitakin, Rome ngalkap hon ukpa tungah Jerusalem khua bup buai hi, ci in kiko hi."},"32":{"text":"Thakhat thu in tua ngalkap hon ukpa in ngalkap bu pawlkhat le ngalkap te samin mihonpite del uh hi. Mite in ngalkap bupa le a ngalkapte a mu ciangin, Paul sia a vel nawn bua uh hi."},"33":{"text":"ngalkap hon ukpa in Paul kungah pai a, ama manin thikkhau nii taw khit tu in thupia hi. “Hi sia pa akua ziam? Ama in bang ngamtatna nei ziam,” ci in dongh hi."},"34":{"text":"Mihon sung pan pawlkhat in thu khat son a, a dangte in thudang taw au uh a, telmeal om ngawl ahikom, ngalkap hon ukpa in, bang thu tatak piang cisia a tel zo bua hi, tua ahikom ngalkapte teenna kulh huang sungah Paul paipui tu in, a mite sawl hi."},"35":{"text":"Keallei dong paipui uh a, tua zawkciangin ngalkapte in, a puak kul hi, banghang ziam cile a ngilo nuam mihonpite thinso ngawp uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Amate theampo in, ama nung pan hong pai uh a, “That vun!” ci in aukeak uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Ngalkapte in kulh huang sungah Paul a tumpui dektak laitakin, ngalkap hon ukpa tungah, “Thu tawm kong son thei tu ziam?” ci hi. “Greek kampau hi ngawl ni ziam?” ci in ngalkap hon ukpa in dongh hi.","title":"Paul in Ama le Ama Kihung"},"38":{"text":"“Tua ahile nang sia khatvei lai a, ngalphuang in sennealngam sungah ngalhiam toai mi ngilo tul li a lampui Egypt pa sia na hi bua na ziam?,” ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Paul in, “Keima in Jew mi ka hi a, Cilicia ngam Tarsus khua ah suakin, khuapi thupi khat ii ngammi ka hi hi. Hi mihingte tungah nong hesuakna in, thu hong sonsak ta'n,” ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Ngalkap hon ukpa in a khuan pia ahikom Paul in keallei tungah ding a, mihonte a thim natu in, a khut vik hi. Amate a thim uh ciangin, Paul in amate tungah Hebrew kam taw thuson hi:"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka mipui Jew te awng, note mai ah keima le keima ka kihuukna kammalte hong ngai tavun!”"},"2":{"text":"Hebrew kam in a pau a zaak uh ciang, amate thim seseam uh hi; tuaciang Paul in zom to lai a:"},"3":{"text":"“Kei sia Jew mi khat hi in, Cilicia ngam Tarsus khua ah ka suak a, ahihang hi sung Jerusalem ah, Gamaliel ii sangpatang khat in a khangto ka hi hi. Ih taanghpupite ii nasia takin Thukham kihil nate, ka sin zo hi, tuaciang tuni in hi sungah a om no theampo taw ma kibangin, kei zongh Pathian atu a ki aap mama pa ka hi hi.","ref":"Sawl 5:34-39"},"4":{"text":"Hi Lampi a zuite sia a thi dongin, a vawtsiapa ka hi hi. Pate le numeite manin, thong sung denna in, a neipa ka hi hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 26:9-11"},"5":{"text":"Thiampi Lianbelpa le Council buppi in, ka son teng sia, thumaan hi ci in hong lak thei tu hi. Amate kung panin, Damascus a om, ih mipui Jew te a laithakte zongh keima in ka nga hi. Tua ahikom, tua munah a om hi mite man tu in ka pai a, tuaciang amate thikkol bul sa in, Jerusalem ah daan piak tu in ka ciapui kik hi."},"6":{"text":"“Tuabangin khualhaw a, Damascus khua ka thet dektak sunkim laitak hun khawngin, thakhat thu in van pan, a taang mama khuavak khat in ka kiimkot hong taankeak hi.","title":"Paul in A Kikhealna Thuson (Sawl. 9:1–19; 26:12–18)"},"7":{"text":"Lei ah ka puk a, ‘Saul, Saul awng! Banghangin kei hong vawtsia ni ziam?’ hong ci aw khat ka za hi."},"8":{"text":"‘Akua ni ziam Topa?’ ci in ka dongh hi. ‘Keima in nong vawtsiat Nazareth khua mi Jesus ka hi hi,’ hong ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Kei taw a omkhawm mite in, khuavak taang sia mu ahihang, kei hong paupuipa aw a za bua uh hi."},"10":{"text":"‘Bang vawt tu khi ziam, Topa’ ci in ka dok ciangin, Topa in kei tungah, ‘Tho in a, Damascus khua sungah va pai ta'n, tua munah Pathian ii nangma sep tu hong seesak theampo hong kison tu hi,’ hong ci hi."},"11":{"text":"khuavak taang mama sia hu in, ka mit hong taw a, tua ahikom ka kitholpuite in, Damascus khua sung dong ka khut panin, hong len a hong paipui hi."},"12":{"text":"“Tua khuapi sungah Ananias minnei pasal khat om a, ama sia biakna mi Thukham a zui tua munah a teang Jew te theampo ii a zatak pa ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama hong pai a ka kungah dingin, ‘Suapui Saul awng, khuamu kik in!’ hong ci hi. Tua hun lian laitakin, khua ka mu thei kik a, ama ka en hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama in, ‘Ih taanghpupite ii Pathian in, ama deina a tel tu, a thutang a Naseampa a mu tu le ama aw taw a pau a za tu in nang hong teal zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile na mu le na zaak teng mihing theampo tungah a son tu in nang sia ama ii tetti khat na hi tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tu in banghang ngangak lai ni ziam? Tho in a, tui kiphumin, ama tung thungetna taw, na mawnate, kisilthiangsak in,’ hong ci hi."},"17":{"text":"“Jerusalem khua ah ka cia kik a, Biakinn sungah thungen in ka om laitakin, mukholna khat ka nei a,","title":"Gentile te tungah Thuhil tu in Paul Kisam"},"18":{"text":"tua ii sungah Topa ka mu a, ama in, ‘Manlang takin Jerusalem nusia zok in, banghang ziam cile hi sungah a om mihingte in, kei huvau tetti na pan nate hong saang ngawl tu hi,’ hong ci hi."},"19":{"text":"‘Topa awng, synagogue te ah ka pai a, nang hong umte manin ka vel bul sia, amate in pha takin hong he nginge hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaciang, na tettipa Stephen a kithalup lai in keima mama zongh tua munah ka om a, a thalup tu thukim in, a thatte ii puantualte zongh kepsak lai khi hi,’ ci in ka zo hi.","ref":"Sawl 7:58"},"21":{"text":"Kei tungah Topa in ‘Va pai ta'n,’ ‘banghang ziam cile a khualana Gentile te kungah kong puak tu hi,’ hong ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Paul ii hi bang teng a son ciang dong, amate in ngai uh hi; ahihang tua zawkciangin, amate in a aw nei za taw au a, “Ama heam vun! Thatlum vun! A nungta tu in kilawm ngawl hi!” ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate in ciik au uh a, a puansilh uh vik in, vui sungah leivui lawn uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Rome ngalkap hon ukpa in Paul sia kulh huang sungah paipuisak in, banghangin Jew te in hi bangin, ciik au in oksan ziam ci sia a kiheak thei natu ama vel in thu dongh tavun, ci in a mite thupia hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahihang vel tu in a sawmcip uh ciang, a kung a ding ngalkap bupa munah Paul in, “Rome ngammi khat sia khialna lian khat pawpo atu thu kisit pepeu ngawl lai in, vel tu sia, no atu upadi taw kisi na ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ngalkap bupa in tua thu a zaak ciang, ngalkap hon ukpa kungah pai in “Bang law tu ni ziam? Tuasia pa sia Rome ngammi khat hi!” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahikom ngalkap hon ukpa Paul kungah pai in, “Hong son ta'n, Rome ngammi khat na hi ziam,” ci in dongh hi. “Hi khi hi,” ci in Paul in zo hi."},"28":{"text":"Ngalkap hon ukpa in, “Sum tam mama ka piak ciangin kei zongh ngammi khat ka suak thei pheang hi,” ci hi. Paul in “Ahihang kei ka hile ka pian panin Rome ngammi khat khi hi,” ci in zo hi."},"29":{"text":"Thakhat thu in, Paul thu a dongh tute ama kung pan heak kik uh hi; Paul sia Rome ngammi khat hi ci in a heak ciang, thikkol a bulsak huvau ngalkap hon ukpa patau hi."},"30":{"text":"Ngalkap hon ukpa in, Jew te in Paul sia bang teng tatak taw mawsiat ziam, ci in he nuam hi; tua ahikom a zing ciangin, a thikkol suusak a, tuaciang thiampi liante le Council bup kikhop natu in, thupia hi. Tuaciang, ama in Paul paipui a, amate mai ah dingsak hi.","title":"Council mai ah Paul"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul in Council te tangtan in en a, “Ka Israel mipuite awng! Pathian mai ah ka nuntakzia sia tuni mama dong ka thin thiangtho a, kithasunna nei ngawl khi hi,” ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Thiampi Lianbel Ananias in, Paul nai ah a dingte munah, a muk beksak vun, ci in sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Paul in, “Pathian in note hong vel tatak tu hi — no leikaang taw a kizut innpangte awng! Thukham taw kizui in, kei thu hong khen tu in, tuak ah na to uh a, ahihang kei vel tu a, na kisawl uh ciangin, Thukham paltan na hi uh hi!” ci hi.","ref":"Mt 23:27-28"},"4":{"text":"“Pathian Thiampi Lianbelpa selno ni hi!” ci in Paul kungah a om pasalte in ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Paul in “Ka Israel mipuite awng, ama Thiampi Lianbel ahi hunlam ka he bua hi. Laithiangtho in, ‘Note ii na mite a ukpa sia sonsia thei ngawl tu nu hi,’ ci hi,” ci in zo kik hi.","ref":"Pu 22:28"},"6":{"text":"Tuate sungah pawlkhat Sadducee te hi a, a dangte sia Phariseete hi ci in, Paul in a mu ciangin, Council te tungah, “Ka Israel mipuite awng! Hi sungah thusit ka thuak theina ii ahang sia mithi sa te tho kik tu hi, ci in lametna ka nei hang ahi hi!” ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 26:5; Php 3:5"},"7":{"text":"Hi thu a son po ciangin, Phariseete le Sadducee te kihau tu in, hong kipan paih a, tuaciang, Council upate sia hong kikhen hi."},"8":{"text":"(Banghang ziam cile Sadducee te in thina panin mihingte tho kik ngawl tu hi, tuaciang, vantunglalang ahizong, thaa ahizong om ngawl hi, ci uh hi; ahihang Phariseete in, hi thu nam thum teng sia um siat hi.)","ref":"Mt 22:23; Mk 12:18; Lk 20:27"},"9":{"text":"Auna aw nging vaial a, Pharisee pawl mi Thukham hil sya pawlkhat hong ding a, nasia takin nalh uh hi: “Hisia pa tungah bangma khialna mu zo ngawl khu hi! Vantunglalang khat ziam, thaa khat ziam in, ama paupui takpi hi thei tu hi!” ci uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Kam kinialna uh a aw hong ngam vaial a, ngalkap hon ukpa in, Paul pumpi mama a kilaaithap tu lau hi. Tua ahikom tu a mipawlte sungah ngalkapte paisak a, amate kung pan Paul la keak in, ngalkap huang sungsang ah paipui uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A zan ciangin, Topa in Paul kungah ding a, “Lau heak in! Hi sung Jerusalem ah kei atu tetti pang zo ni hi, Rome khua sung zongh ah tuabang ma in, seam nanak lai tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"A zingsang ciangin Jew te pawlkhat kisitua in, ngealna khat nei uh hi. Amate in Paul a thalup mateng in an le tui ne ngawl tu hi, ci in kiciamna vawt uh hi.","title":"Paul Suamlup Kisawm"},"13":{"text":"Hi bangin a ngeal khawmte mihing sawmli vaal pha uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang amate in thiampi liante le upate kungah pai a, “Paul ka thalup uh mateng bangma ne ngawl tu, ci in thupi takin, ka kiciam uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang, tu in, noma le Council te in, Paul ii thu a maanzaw a kan nuam bangin, nong kiheang tu uh a, Rome ngalkap hon ukpa munah Paul hong paipui suk natu in na son tu uh hi. Ahihang hisung hong thet suk ma in, ama thatlum tu in ka kingingkhol tu uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang Paul suapuinu ii tapa in, hi kisuam nopna thu za hi; tua ahikom kulh huang sungah pai in a thu bang teng Paul munah son hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaciang Paul in ngalkap bute khat sam a, “Ngalkap hon ukpa kungah hi tangvalpa paipui ta'n; ngalkap hon ukpa munah son tu thu khat ama in nei hi,” ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Ngalkap bupa in paipui in, ngalkap hon ukpa kung then a, “Thongtaak Paul in hi tangvalpa nang kungah paipui tu in hong sawl hi. Banghang ziam cile ama in nang tungah son tu thu khat nei hi,” ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ngalkap hon ukpa in a khut panin len a, ama mama in paipui in, “Kei tung nong son tu, bang thu nei ni ziam?” ci in dongh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama in, “Jew upa thuneite in, thukimna khat nei a, Paul ii thu a maan zaw kan nuam bangin, kivawt theam in, Council te kungah Paul na paipuisuk natu in, zing ciang hong ngen tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang amate thu na um heak in, banghang ziam cile mihing sawmli vaal in, ama pangin ngak tu uh hi. Ama a thalup mateng, anne ngawl tuidawn ngawlin, om tu in kiciamna vawt zo hi. Tu in amate in tuabang vawt tu in, kingingta zo a, nangma thukhensatna hong ngak lai hi,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ngalkap hon ukpa in, “Hi thu teng nong ko hunlam kuama tungah son heak in,” ci in tangvalpa ciasak hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin, ngalkap hon ukpa in, ngalkapbu nii sam a, “Tu nitak nai kua in ngalkapte zanii Caesarea ah pai tu in, kithoaisak vun a, tuate taw a kop tu in, siphu ngalkap sawmsali le tei toai zanii taw a ding tu in kithoaisak vun,","title":"Paul sia Ngamuk mangpa Felix kungah Puak"},"24":{"text":"Paul to natu siphu pawlkhat zongh, vaihawmsak tavun a, ngamuk mangpa Felix kungah a pha takin then tavun,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin, ngalkap hon ukpa in, hi bangin lai khat at hi."},"26":{"text":"“Claudius Lysias in a zatak huai ngamuk mangpa Felix kong paupui hi."},"27":{"text":"Jew te in hisia pa man a, thatlum tu in kithoai hi. Ama sia Rome ngammi khat hi ci in ka heak hu in, ka ngalkapte taw pai in ka suatak uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amate in bang teng mawsak nuam ziam ci in ka heak nopna taw amate ii Council ah ka paipui suk hi."},"29":{"text":"Kei muna pan ama in thi natu ahizong, thongtaak natu ahizong, a thuak natu za dongin ngamtat khialna bangma nei ngawl hi; a maw zonna uh sia amate thukham taw bek kisai ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuaciang Jew te pawlkhat in a thasawmna uh ka zaak ciangin, nangma kungah puak tu in thakhat thu in ka khensat hi. Ama a mawsakte munah, ama sia nangma mai ah thu vawt tavun ka ci hi,” ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Ngalkapte in thupiaknate seam suak uh hi. Amate in, Paul la a, tua nitakin, Antipatris dong paipui uh hi."},"32":{"text":"A zing ciangin peang a pai ngalkapte sia kulh huang ah heak kikin, siphu ngalkapte taw paisuak tu in aap uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Amate in Caesarea ah paipui uh a, ngamuk mangpa lai pia in, Paul sia ama tungah aap uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Ngamuk mangpa in, laithak sim a, Paul munah bang ngamkhen sung pan ni ziam ci in dongh hi. Cilicia ngam pan ahi hunlam a tel ciangin,"},"35":{"text":"ama in “Thu hong sua nuamte hong thet ciangin, na thu kong sit tu hi,” ci hi. Tua zawkciangin ama in, Paul sia ngamuk mangpa phualpi ah a cingte taw a kikoi natu thupia hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni nga zawkciangin, Thiampi Lianbel Ananias in Caesarea ah upa pawlkhat le sitni Tertullus taw pai hi. Amate in Felix mai ah pai in, Paul a mawsakna thute son uh hi.","title":"Jew te in Paul Mawsiat"},"2":{"text":"Tuasia ciang, Paul samin, Tertullus in Paul a mawsakna thu hi bangin son hi: “A zatakhuai pa awng! na ciimna taw nong lampui hu in, khuangei mama sung kilemna om a, ih ngam phattuam natu, a kul kipuuaphatna tam ma kivawt saan hi."},"3":{"text":"Mun theampo ah a tawntungin, hi thu kiza nuam a, nangma tungah kilungdam mama hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahizong na hun tam lei hong laaksak nuam ngawl khi hi, tua ahitazong, koma thu tawm kong son tu sia, nong ngai natu hesuak kong ngen hi."},"5":{"text":"Hisia pa sia a kiitakhuai mihing nawngkai khat in ka mu uh hi; ama in leitung mun theampo ah a om Jew te sungah, buaina phuang pa hi a, Nazarenes pawl ii lampuipa ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Biakinnpi ninsak tu in zongh hanciam ahi hu in ka man uh hi. Koma thukham taw kizui in, ama tungah thukhen tu ci in ka ngeal uh hang,"},"7":{"text":"ngalkap hon ukpa Lysias hong pai a, zawthawk thu taw ko khut sung pan hong sut hi. Tuaciang ama a mawsak nuamte in nangma mai ah hong pai natu in, Lysias in thupia hi."},"8":{"text":"Hisia pa thu dongh lete, nangma ma in, ama ka mawsakna uhte tel siat tu ni hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jew te in hi mawna a kisotna sungah, hong pawm hon uh a, hi thu theampo maan hi, a ci uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ngamuk mangpa in, Paul ii pau natu in, a khut taw sawl hi. Paul in, “Hi minam tungah kum tam mama thukhenin na om kong he a, tua ahikom nangma mai ah keima le keima ka kihuk tu sia ka lungdam hi.","title":"Paul in Felix Mai ah Kihung"},"11":{"text":"Nangma hantang in thu kan theipa na hi bangma, tu nung ni sawm le ni nii sangin a tamzaw ngawl hun lai, biakpiakna vawt tu in Jerusalem ah ka pai hi."},"12":{"text":"Biakinnpi sungah khat po taw kam kinialna ahizong, synagogue le khuapi sung mundang ah, mite hol in ngamlumsak natu hanthotna ahizong, ngamta ka hi hunlam Jew te in hong mu ngeingawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu in hong mawsiat nate zongh maan hi ci in, hong lak thei ngawl tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Na mai ah ahi bang ka pualaak nop thu panin, amate ii maan ngawl hi a ci tua Lampi zui in ka taanghpupite ii Pathian ka bia hi. Ahihang Moses Thukham le kamsaangte thubute sung a ki at theampo sia kei zongh in ka um hi."},"15":{"text":"Hi lai ah a om mihingte bangma in Pathian sungah lametna kibang khat ka nei thu sia, a pha taw a sia taw mihing theampo in thina pan tho kik tu ci thu ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Pathian mai le mihingte mai ah, kithasunna om ngawl thinsung thiangtho ka nei natu in, ka hanciam thei za in ka seam tawntung hi."},"17":{"text":"“Kum tam mama sung Jerusalem ka nusiat zawkciang, ka mite kungah sum pawlkhat kengin, sangaw biakpiakna vawt tu in, tua munah ka pai hi.","ref":"Sawl 21:17-28"},"18":{"text":"Biakinnpi sungah kithiansuana a zeksa nate, ka man zawkciang, tua biakpiakna ka vawt laitakin, amate in hong mu hi. Tua munah keima taw mihon om ngawl a, buaina bangma om ngawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahihang Asia ngamkhen panin, Jew te pawlkhat om hi; tua mite in kei langpan natu nei ahile, amate mama hi sung na mai ah hong pai kul tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahibuale zong, Council mai ah ka din lai in, bangbang khialna lian ka vawt hong mu ziam ci in hi sungah a om mite in sonsak in —"},"21":{"text":"amate mai ah ka din lai in: ‘Mithite in tho kik tu hi, ci thu ka up hangin, tuni in nong thusit uh ka thuak hi,’ ci in ka son tu simngawl ka son tu dang om ngawl hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Sawl 23:6"},"22":{"text":"Tuaciang Felix in, Lampi ii thu a heak siat sa ahiciang, thusitna tawlngasak hi. Ama in “Ngalkap hon ukpa Lysias hong thet ciangin, na thu uh kong khensak tu hi,” ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama in Paul a keam ngalkap bupa munah, Paul sia a kepcing natu thupia ahihang, ama suatakna pawlkhat le a kitaangsapte a lawmte in a piak thei natu thupia hi."},"24":{"text":"Ni tawmvei zawkciangin, Felix le Jew mi ahi a zi Drusilla hong pai uh hi. Ama in Paul samsak a, Jesus Christ ih upna huvau a thusonna ngai hi.","title":"Felix le Drusilla mai ah Paul dingsak"},"25":{"text":"Ahihang Paul in ngamtat phatna, pumpi kitekna le, Thukhen Ni hong thet natu thute kikuppui top a, Felix sia lau hi. “Tu in na pai phot ta'n, hunpha ka nga ciangin, kong sam kik tu hi,” ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua laitak ma in, Paul in ama sumnguk pia tu in muangmaw hi; tua hu in ama samsak nithi in thu son pui hi."},"27":{"text":"Kum nii a kan zawkciangin, Porcius Festus in ngamuk mangpa Felix ii za laih hi. Felix in Jew te tung pan, maipha nga nuam ahikom, Paul sia thong sungah nusia hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngamkhen sungah hong thet zawk ni thum ni ciangin, Festus in Caesarea panin Jerusalem zuan a,","title":"Paul in Kumpilianpa tungah A zukhaan"},"2":{"text":"tua munah thiampi liante taw kikopin, Jew lampuite in, Paul langpanin thu vawt uh hi. Amate in Festus munah,"},"3":{"text":"Paul sia Jerusalem ah a paisak natu ngen uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate in, lampi ah suamlup sawm uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Festus in, “Paul sia Caesarea ah thongtaak in kikoi hi. Keima mama zongh hai ngawlin tua munah heak kik tu khi hi."},"5":{"text":"Na lampuite sia Caesarea ah keima taw paikhawm in, Paul in khialna khat po vawt ahile, ama tungah maw kisuanh tahen,” ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Festus in amate kungah ni liat pan ni sawm dong bang a taam zawkciangin, Caesarea ah pai hi. A zing ciangin thukhenna zum ah to in Paul a sungtan pui natu in thupia hi."},"7":{"text":"Paul a thet ciangin Jerusalem pan hong pai Jew te in, a kiimkot ah dingin, a nasia mawsakna tam mama nei ahihang amate in, a maan takin a lak thei bua uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang Paul in ama le ama kihung a, “Jew te Thukham langpanna ahizong, tua ahibuale Biakinnpi langpanna ahizong, Rome Kumpilianpa langpanna ahizong, bangma sep khial nei ngawl khi hi,” ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Festus in Jew te ii maipha nga nuam ahikom, Paul munah “Jerusalem ah pai in, hi maw kisotnate huvau sia, tualai keima mai ah thusitna na thuak nuam ziam,” ci in dongh hi."},"10":{"text":"Paul in, “Kumpilianpa ii thukhenna zummai ah thusit thuak tu in ka ding hi. Nangma mama ii na heak bangin, Jew te tungah bangma sep khial nei ngawl khi hi."},"11":{"text":"Thi daan taw kiphu in, thukham paltanna le sepna khat po nei hi leng suatak natu kong ngen bua hi. Ahihang amate ii kei tungah, maw hong sot nopnate sungah thumaan om ngawl ahile, amate khut sungah kuama in kei hong aap thei ngawl tu hi. Kumpilianpa tungah a zukhaan khi hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin Festus in, ama ngaisutna a pia upate taw a kikup zawkciangin, “Kumpilianpa tungah a zukhaan zo na hikom Kumpilianpa kungah pai tu ni hi,” ci in zo kik hi."},"13":{"text":"Hun tawmvei zawkciangin, Kumpipa Agrippa le Bernice sia Festus taw kimu nuam in Caesarea ah haw uh hi.","title":"Agrippa le Bernice mai ah Paul ding"},"14":{"text":"Tua munah ni tam ma a om zawkciang, Festus in Paul omzia sia kumpipa tungah sonthiang hi. “Hi sungah Felix ii a nusiat thongtaak pasal khat om hi,"},"15":{"text":"tuaciang, Jerusalem ah ka pai ciangin, Jew te ii thiampi liante le upate in, ama tungah thu vawtin, mawsak natu hong ngen uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang ko Rome mite in khialna lian khat taw a kimawsiat mihing khat pawpo sia ama tungah maw a suanhte taw maitang kisi in, ama tungah a kisuanh mawnate panin, ama le ama a kihuk natu hun a nga mateng, kuama khut sungah aap thei ngawl ka hi uh hunlam ka son hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate hi sungah hong pai ciangin, hun bosak thong ngawlin, a zing ciang mama in, thukhenna zum ah ka to a, a mihing pa sia hong paipui natu in ka sawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama a langpante hong ding a, ahihang ka muanmawk bangin, a sia khialna liante taw a mawsiat bua uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate vai theampo sia a biakna le Jesus min nei mihing thisa khat ii thu huvau a kinial uh teng ahi hi; Paul in tua pa sia nungta hi, ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Hi thute tungtaang ah thu a cingin ka nga thei natu lam sia, ka khensat thei paih bua hi, tua ahikom Paul munah hi mawsiatnate huvau in Jerusalem ah, thu na kisit nuam ziam, ci in ka dongh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang Paul in a zukhaan hi; ama a kicin lai natu le, Kumpilianpa ii thu a khen natu, ngen hi. Tua ahikom Kumpilianpa kungah ka puak thei dong, ama a kicin lai natu in, thu ka pia hi,” ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Agrippa in Festus munah, “Kei mama in hisia pa ii thuson za nuam khi hi,” ci hi. “Zing ciangin ama ii thuson za tu ni hi,” ci in Festus in zo hi."},"23":{"text":"A zing ciangin Agrippa le Bernice sia, mipi kikhopna inndoi sungah ngalkap ukpite le khuapi lampui upate taw, nasia tak kithoai in hong pai a, kiletsakna taw hong tum uh hi. Festus in thupia a, Paul tumpui hi."},"24":{"text":"Festus in, “Kumpipa Agrippa le hi sungah ko taw a omkhawmte theampo awng: hi sung le Jerusalem a om Jew te theampo ii kei tungah hong khiakpa sia hisia pa hi a, mu tek nu hi. Amate in ciik au uh a, nungta nawn mama heak hen, ci uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahihang thidaan taw a kiphu tu ngamtatna nei hi, ci in ka mu zo bua hi. Tuaciang, ama mama in Rome Kumpilianpa tungah a zukhaan ahiciang puak tu in ka khensat zo hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahihang Kumpilianpa tungah ama thu huvau a kician lai at tu bangma ka nei bua hi. Tua ahikom noma mai hi sungah kong paipui hi — a tuanin Kumpipa Agrippa mai ah kong paipui hi! tua hile a thu a kikat zawkciangin, thu pawlkhat ka at tu om thei tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, ama mawna hi bang teng hi ci in, a kician om ngawl pipi in, thongtaak pa khat ka puak tu sia, suak thei ka sa bua hi,” ci hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Agrippa in Paul munah, “Nangma thu sia nangma mama ii son thei natu thu kong pia hi,” ci hi. Paul in a khut laam in, ama le ama sia hi bangin kihung hi.","title":"Paul in Agrippa mai ah Kihung"},"2":{"text":"“Kumpipa Agrippa awng! Jew te ii maw hong zonna theampo pan, tuni in na mai ah keima le keima ka kihun thei tu le,"},"3":{"text":"a tuanin Jew te ngeinate le a thu kinial theina theampo pha takpi in tel na hikom hampha ka kisa hi. Tuaciang thinsau takin nong ngai natu in kong thuum hi."},"4":{"text":"“Jew te theampo in ka no tuung a kipan, ka nuntakzia hong he hi. A masa in keima pianna ngam le tua zawkciang Jerusalem khua ah ka nuntakzia theampo hong he uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in tetti hong pansak nuam thong le, a ciil panin, biakna sungah a phinciingbel Pharisee pawlmi khat ka hi sia, hong heak tawntung sa hi.","ref":"Sawl 23:6; Php 3:5"},"6":{"text":"Tuaciang tu in hi sungah thusit ka thuakna ii ahang sia Pathian ii taanghpupite tungah kamciam a piakte ka lamet hu ahi hi —"},"7":{"text":"koma minam sawm le niite ii a sun a zanin Pathian ka biak uh ciang tua kamciam bangin nga tu sia ko ii lamet thu ahi hi. Vaangnei Kumpi awng, hi lametna hangin, Jew te in kei sia hong mawsak hi!"},"8":{"text":"Banghangin no hi sungah a omte in, a thisate sia Pathian in thosak kik tu in um thei ngawl nu ziam?"},"9":{"text":"Keima mama in Nazareth mi Jesus thu langpanin ka sep thei za in seam tong a ci pa ka hi hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 22:4-5"},"10":{"text":"Tuabang sia Jerusalem ah ka ngamtatna ahi hi. Thiampi liante tung panin, thu ka nga a, Pathian ii mihingte tam ma thong sungah ka khum hi; tuaciangin, amate sia thidaan a kipiak ciangin, kei zongh in ka thukimpui hi."},"11":{"text":"Tamvei ma, synagogue te ah daan ka piasak a, a upna uh a kheal thei natu in, ka hanciam hi. Amate tungah ka thin uuk mama ahikom, ngamdang a khuapite ngawngawn ah, ka pai a ka vawtsia hi."},"12":{"text":"“Hi bang tupna le sawmna seam tu in, Damascus khua ah ka pai a, thiampi liante ii thuneina le thupiaknate ka keng hi.","title":"Paul in Ama Kikhealna Son"},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa awng, lampi tungah sun laitakin ni sangin, a taang zaw khuavak taang khat in kei le ka khualhawpuite, kiim ah van panin hong taangsuk keak hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka vekpi in lei ah ka puk uh hi. Tuaciang aw khat ka za a, kei tungah Hebrew kam in, ‘Saul, Saul awng! Banghangin hong vawtsia ni ziam? Khuital khat in a neipa ii toai ngan hawlna ciang sia a peak kik bangin, nangma le nangma kikha kik in kiliamsua ni hi,’ hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"‘Akua ni ziam? Topa’ ci in ka dongh hi. Tuaciang Topa in, ‘Kei sia nong vawtsiat Jesus khi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang tho in a ding in, nang tungah kong kilakna sia ka naseam tu a, kong koi nop hang ahi hi. Tuni a keima nong mu teng le maisang a kong lak pheang tu teng midangte munah son tu ni hi."},"17":{"text":"Keima in Israel te khut sung pan le nangma kong puak natu Gentile te khut sung panin kong suatak tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Nang in amate mit na honsak tu a, amate sia khuazingna sung panin, khuavakna ah, Satan vaangletna panin, Pathian kungah na kiheaksak tu hi. Tua hile amate in keima hong upna tungtawnin, a mawnate uh kimaisak tu a, Pathian tealsa mite sungah amate in omna nga tu uh hi.’"},"19":{"text":"“Tua ahikom, Kumpipa Agrippa awng, vantung pan ka nga mukholna sia ni ngawlin ka om bua hi.","title":"Paul in Ama Nasepna Son"},"20":{"text":"A masa phitbel in Damascus le Jerusalem ah, tua zawkciangin, Judea ngam bup le Gentile te sungah, amate in a mawnate kisiik nanak a, Pathian sangah kiheak in, a kisii kikna thu a lak tu nasepte a sep natu in, thu ka hil hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:20"},"21":{"text":"Hi thu hangin, Jew te in Biakinnpi sungah ka om laitakin hong man a, thatlum tu in, hanciam uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang tuni mama dong Pathian in hong hu top zo ahikom, hi sungah dingin a lian a no mi theampo tungah a kibangin, tetti ka pang hi. Tuabang ka son sia in kamsaangte le Moses ii hong tung tu hi ci in a sonkhol teng ma ahi hi:"},"23":{"text":"Jew te le Gentile te tungah ngupna khuavak thu thangsak tu in, Messiah in hong thuak kul tu a, thina panin a tho kik phitbel ahi tu hi, ci sia thu ahi hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 42:6; 49:6; 1 Cor 15:20"},"24":{"text":"Paul in ama le ama hi bang a kihuk ciangin, Festus in oksan a, “Paul awng, na thin amh hi! pilna tam na sinna in na thin hong amhsak hi!” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Paul in, “Kei ka thin amh ngawl hi, A zatakhuai pa awng, keima in thumaan thutak ka son hi."},"26":{"text":"Kumpipa Agrippa awng! Nang tungah hang takin hong son thei khi hi; banghang ziam cile nangma in hite huvau he ni hi. A piang sa nate khat simin, ciamtee tu in kong um hi, banghang ziam cile, hi thu sia a kingsong khat ah a piangku thu hi ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Kumpipa Agrippa awng, kamsaangte na um ziam? Na up sia hong he khi hi!” Paul in ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Agrippa in Paul munah, “Hi hun tomno sungah Tapidaw hong suaksak zo tu in ki um ni ziam?” ci hi."},"29":{"text":"“Hun tom kale, sau kale, nang le tuni a ka thuson hong ngaite theampo, hi thikkolte kihel ngawlin, keima bang na hi thei natu uh sia Pathian tungah ka thungetna ahi hi!” ci in zo hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin Kumpipa, ngamuk mangpa, Bernice le a dang teng ding a,"},"31":{"text":"a nusiat zawk uh ciangin, khat le khat tungah, “Hisia pa in thongtaak natu ahizong, thi natu ahizong, bangma vawt nei ngawl hi,” kici uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Agrippa in Festus munah, “Kumpilianpa tungah a zukhaan ngawl hile, hisia pa kisuatasak thei tu hi,” ci hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Italy ah teambaw taw pai tu in a kikhensat zawkciang Paul le thongtaak dang pawlkhat sia “Kumpilianpa ii ngalkaphon” a kici Roman ngalkapte ii ngalkap bu Julius tungah amate in aap hi.","title":"Paul Teambaw taw Rome ah pai"},"2":{"text":"Adramyttium pan teambaw khat tungah ka kaato uh hi, tuasia in Asia ngamkhen a teambaw tawlngakna sang zuan tu in a kithoai teambaw hi a, tua taw ka ding uh hi. Thessalonica khua pan, Macedonia mi Aristarchus taw ka ton uh hi."},"3":{"text":"A zingsang ciangin, Sidon ka theng uh hi. Julius sia Paul tungah hong dik a, a kitaangsap pawpo a kipiak thei natu in, a lawmte kungah hawsak thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua mun panin ka paisuak uh a, ko sangah vui hong lee vak ahikom, a kibeal theina Cyprus tuikulh pangh vui kidalna mun tawnin ka pai uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Cilicia le Pamphylia hui panin, tuipi ka kan uh a, Lycia ngam Myra khua ka theng uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua munah ngalkap bupa in, Alexandria pan Italy ngam a zuan tu teambaw khat mu a tua teambaw tungah hong kaasak hi."},"7":{"text":"Ni tam ma dam takin, ka pai uh a, a khakbel ciangin, Cnidus khua hui dong haksa pi in ka theng uh hi. Tuak sangah ka paitan thei ngawl natu in, vui in hong khak ahikom, Salmone leidok hui panin Crete tuikulh pangh vui kidalna mun bealhin ka paisuk uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuipi vaalbo ka neak uh a, Lasea khua pan a kikhuala ngawl Muanhuai Teambaw tawlngakna kicina mun haksa pi in ka theng uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua munah ni tam mama taam ka hi uh kom, tu in Mawsuutna Ni zongh kan zo a, tui lam taw khualhaw tu sia lauhuai hi. Tua hikom, Paul in amate sia hi ngaisutna pia hi."},"10":{"text":"“Pasalte awng, ih khualhawna sia, hi sung pan kipan, lauhuai tu in ka mu hi; vanhte le teambaw ii tungah siatna lian piang tu a, mihing thina zongh om tu hi,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang ngalkap bupa in, teambaw ukpa le a neipa thuson um zaw a, Paul sonte sia a thupi laak bua hi."},"12":{"text":"Teambaw tawlngakna mun in phalbi sung om natu a phabel mun ahi bua hi; tua ahikom, mihing a tamzaw in, ahithei le, tuipi tungah paisuakin phalbi sung teng a om thei natu mun Phoenix thet tu hanciam nuam uh hi. Crete a om Phoenix teambaw tawlngakna sia nitumna thangsang le nitumna saksang maingat hi."},"13":{"text":"Thangsang panin vui hong va vahiau a, mihingte in a tupna uh bangin, pai thei tu in ki um uh hi. Tua ahikom tawlngaksakna thikkip dokto in, Crete vaalbo hui a neak thei zaza neakin pai uh hi.","title":"Tuipi sungah Suangval"},"14":{"text":"Ahihang hai ngawlin, “Nisuana saksang vuipi” kici, vui thahat khat tuikulh panin hong vasuk hi."},"15":{"text":"Vui in teambaw sawn a, vui sang maingat in, kipai thei nawn ngawl ahikom, hanciam tuan nawn ngawlin, vui ii seamna pawpo ah ka pai uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Cauda tuikulh no ii thangsang ka kan uh ciangin, belh natu tawm om hi. Tua munah teambaw taw a kikop ngunkuang sia haksa pi in, a lal ngawl natu in ka huu zo uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in teambaw tungah tuasia kaito in, teambaw kiimkot khauzeen pawlkhat taw sawmcip uh hi. Amate in, Libya ngam sen vaalbote phulin teambaw a awk tu lau uh hi. Tua ahikom amate in, teambaw puankhakte, luak in, vui ii sawnna pawpo ah pai tu in a om uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Suangval thahat sia, hong kizom tan ahikom, a zing ciangin, teambaw sungah a puak uh vanh pawlkhat tuipi sungah khia uh hi,"},"19":{"text":"a zing ciangin teambaw taw kisai vanhzak pawlkhat tuipi sungah khia uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ni tam mama hun sung, ni ahizong, aksi ahizong, ka mu thei bua uh hi. Tuaciang vui nasia takin hong va tan hi. A khakbel ciangin, suatak natu lametna bangma ka nei nawn bua uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihingte sia an ne ngawlin, khuangei a om zawkciang, Paul in amate mai ah dingin, “Pasalte awng, ka thuson hong ngai pole uhte a, Crete panin din awl hi po leang hiza supna le lalna taw kipeal tu ve hing."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang tu in kong thuum hi. Na thin uh liansak vun! Note khat zongh in, na nuntakna taan ngawl tu nu hi; teambaw bekma kisumh tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ama ii neisa ka hi a, ka biak Pathian ii vantunglalang khat tu zanin hong pai a,"},"24":{"text":"‘Paul awng, lau heak in! Kumpilianpa mai ah na din kul tu hi. Pathian in nang tungah hong phatna taw na khualhaw pui theampo ii nuntakna suatak zo ni hi’ hong ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahikom, pasalte awng, thinlian vun! Banghang ziam cile, Pathian ka muang a, kei tungah hong kison bangin, tung tu hi, ci in ka um hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahihang eite sia tuikulh khat ii vaalbo ah hong kisawn tu hi,” ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ni sawm le ni li ni zanin, vuipi suangval in, Mediterranean tuipi sungah ko hong then hi. Zankim hun khawngin, teambaw naseamte in, lei taw kinai zo vak hing, ci in ummaw uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom khau khat ii tungah, a ngit khat sawm a, a khiaksuk uh le, metre 40 thuk hi ci in mu hi; tawmvei zawkciangin, a tee kik uh le metre 30 thuk hi."},"29":{"text":"Amate in teambaw sia suangpi tung a tot thaak tu lau ahikom, teambaw nungsang panin, tawlngaksakna thikkip li khia suk a, khuavak natu in, thungen uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua zawkciang teambaw naseamte in, teambaw panin a suatak natu in, hanciam uh hi; ngunkuang sia tui sungah khiasuk in, teambaw maisang panin, tawlngaksakna thikkip pawlkhat khia tu bangin kiheang uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahihang Paul in ngalkap bupa le ngalkapte munah, “Hi teambaw naseamte sia teambaw tungah a om po bua uh le, no suatak natu lamet om ngawl hi,” ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahikom a ngunkuang khii na khau attan uh a, ngunkuang sia tui in taisak uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Khua hong vak mahiat in, Paul in a vekpi in, an tawm tek a neak natu in thuum a: “Tu in ni sawm le ni li ngak zo nu hi. Hi hunsung teng bangma neak nei ngawl nu hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ahiciang an tawm tek na neak natu uh in, kong thuum hi; na thi ngawl natu in, an kitaangsamh hi. Na lu tung a samzam khat zongh, sum ngawl tu nu hi,” ci hi."},"35":{"text":"Hi bangin a ci zawkciang, Paul in anluum pawlkhat la in, Pathian pok in, amate theampo mai ah balneen in ne tu in kipan hi."},"36":{"text":"Amate a thinlian a, mihing simin anluum ne uh hi."},"37":{"text":"A vekpi kingawm in, mihing 276 teambaw tungah ka om uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Mihing simin, an a neak siat zawk uh ciangin, amate in zungtaang teng tuipi sungah vawkin teambaw vanh zaangsak uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Khua hong vak ciangin, teambaw naseamte in, vaalbo a tel meal bua uh hi. Ahihang amate in, vaalbo a nei tuidok khat mu ahikom, ahithei le tua munah teambaw sia kingaksak sawm uh hi.","title":"Teambaw Kisia cip"},"40":{"text":"Tua ahikom amate in tawlngaksakna thikkipte ii khau attan in, tui sungah khiasuk uh a, teambaw heaknate sawmna khau a phel paih uh hi. Tua zawkciang vui in teambaw sia, a mai sangah a sawn natu, amate in teambaw mai sangah puan khai a, tuaciang vaalbo sang ka manaw uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Ahihang teambaw in sen bo khat phul a, lei ah kinga hi; teambaw maisang sia awk in, a tung thei nawn bua hi. Tua laitakin tuihual nasia mama ahikom, teambaw nungsang teng a bebek in tamhtham hi."},"42":{"text":"Ngalkapte in, thongtaak theampo tui op a, vaalbo ah a suatak ngawl natu in, thalup sawm uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Ahihang ngalkap hon ukpa in, Paul hunnuam ahikom, tuabangin a ngamtat ngawl natu in tho hi. Tua hi ngawl zaw in, tui op thei peuma, teambaw tung panin, leangin, vaalbo dong tui a op natu thupia hi;"},"44":{"text":"a dangte in zui in, thingpheak ahizong, teambaw bek ahizong, a pom tek natu thupia hi. Hi bangin ka vekpi ma vaalbo ah ngammuang takin ka theng uh hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngammuang in vaalbo tung ka thet uh ciang, tua tuikulh sia Malta hi ci in ka he uh hi.","title":"Malta ah"},"2":{"text":"Tua munah a teang mihingte in, hong pawlvawt mama uh hi. Nguazu tu kithoai in khuasik mama ahikom, amate in meimang sep in, hong muak uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Paul in thingkang lom khat toai in, mei sungah a thut ciangin, meisa thuak la in, ngul khat hong pusuak a, ama khut tungah hong kivial hi."},"4":{"text":"A khua mite in, Paul khut tungah a kaai ngul a mu uh ciangin khat le khat sia, “Hi sia pa in tualthat khat hi nak tu hi. Tuipi pan suakta ahihang a nuntak tu sia Thumaan in oai ngawl hi,” ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang Paul in, tua ngul sia mei sungah thing a, ama bangma tat ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Amate in Paul sia a ci a sa tum keak tu a, tua ahibuale, pukvawk in a thi tu ngak hi. Ahihang ngei hialma a thi tu a ngak zawk uh ciang, a tumdang piang ngawl ahikom, a ngaisutna uh kheal kik a, “Ama sia pathian khat hi ei!” ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua mun panin a khuala ngawlna ah tuikulh ukpa Publius ii neisa lo pawlkhat om hi. Ama in hong muak a, ni thum sung zin hong do hi."},"8":{"text":"Publius ii pa sia ciisuk natna le ngilsan natna taw lupmuntung ngak hi. Paul in, ama ii inndoi sungah tumin, thungen a, ama tungah a khut nga in damsak hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi bangin hong pian ciangin, tuikulh tung a cina dang theampo zongh hong pai tek a, dam siat uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate in letsong tam ma hong pia a, teambaw taw ka din uh ciangin, khualhawna sung a ka kisap uh nate amate in teambaw tungah hong koisak uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tha thum zawkciangin, Alexandria panin, phalbi hunsung tua tuikulh tungah a taam “The Twin Gods (Apeang Pathiante)” a kici teambaw khat taw ka ding uh hi.","title":"Malta panin Rome ah"},"12":{"text":"Syracuse khuapi ka theng uh a, ni thum ka taam uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua mun panin ka ding suak uh a, Rhegium khuapi ka theng uh hi. A zing ciang, thangsang panin, vuiva tu in hong kipan hi, tuaciangin ni nii sungin Puteoli khua ka theng uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua munah thu um pawlkhat ka mu uh a, amate in nipi khat taamin hong sawl hi. Tua mun panin, Rome khua ka theng uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Rome a thu umte in ko thu hong za a, Appius Sumbuk le Zin inn Thum a kicina khuate dong hong muak uh hi. Paul in amate a mu ciangin, Pathian tungah lungdamko in, tha nga tuam mama hi."},"16":{"text":"Rome khua sungah ka thet uh ciangin, Paul sia ama nguakin, a cing ngalkap khat taw kikoi hi.","title":"Rome khua sungah"},"17":{"text":"Ni thum zawkciangin, Paul in tua munah a om Jew lampuite sam a, kikhopna khat vawt hi. Amate hong kikhop ciang, amate tungah, “Ka Israel mipuite awng, ih mite tungah ahizong, taanghpupite tung pan ih lua ngeina zeksate tung ahizong, langpanna bangma nei ngawl napi, Jerusalem ah kei thong hong taaksak a, Rome mite tungah hong aap uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Rome mite in kei thu hong sit zawkciang, thi natu kilawm bangma sep nei ngawl ka hi komin, hong tha nuam hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahihang Jew te in tuabang tu sia nial ahikom, Kumpilianpa tungah ka zukhaan kul hi, tua ahihang, ka mipuite langpanin mawsak natu ka nei bua hi.","ref":"Sawl 15:11"},"20":{"text":"Tua hangin, no taw kimu in kong paupui natu ka nget ahi hi. A tatak ci leang, Israel mite ii a lamet uh pa hu in, hi bangin kei thikkol hong kibul hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in ama munah, “Kote in nang thu huvau sia Judea panin, laithak ka nga bua uh hi, tua mun panin, ih mipuite hong pai in, nang taw kisai thupiang khat pawpo ahibuale a sia son tu khat po hong puak bua uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang nangma ngaisut nate ka za nuam uh hi, banghang ziam cile, mun theampo ah mihingte in, na pawl puite a siatson tek sia ka he uh hi,” ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Paul taw a ni kiciam a, tua ni in mihing tam mama Paul omna ah hong pai uh hi. Zingsang pan zan dong, amate tungah Pathian Ngam thu hil thiang a, Moses Thukham le kamsaangte lai at nate sisanh in, Jesus thu a tel thei natu hanciam in son hi."},"24":{"text":"Pawlkhatte sia ama kammalte um uh a, ahihang a dangte in, a um bua uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahikom, amate kithukim thei ngawlin, Paul ii hi bangin, a ci zawkciang nusia uh hi. “Thaa Thiangtho in, Isaiah kamsaangpa tungtawnin, na taanghpupite tungah a sonna sia bangza in pha ziam!"},"26":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ama in, ‘Pai in hi mite tungah son in: No in na ngangai, na ngangai tu a, ahihang na tel buatu uh hi; Na e en, na e en tu uh a, ahihang na mu buatu uh hi,"},"27":{"text":"banghang ziam cile, hi mite ii thin sia bulthu hi, amate in a bil uh humcip a, a mit uh si hi. Tua hi buathong le, amate ii mit in mu tu a, a bil taw a za tu uh hi, tuaciang a thinsung in a tel tu uh hi, tuaciangin kei sangah hong kiheak tu a, amate ka damsak tu hi,’ Pathian in ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"Is 6:9-10"},"28":{"text":"Tuaciang Paul ii thukhupna ah: “Tuasia ciang, Pathian ii ngupna thu sia Gentile te tungah, kipuak zo hi ci in note in na heak tu uh ahi hi. Amate in ngai tu hi!”"},"29":{"text":"Paul in hi teng a ci zawkciang Jew te amate teng nasia tak kinialin a cia uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Paul in kum nii sung atu a saap inn sungah teang a, ama taw a kimu tu in a pai theampo leangna do hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama in hangsan tak le suakta takin Pathian Ngam thuhil a, Topa Jesus Christ thu hilcian hi."}}}}},"45":{"info":{"name":"Romete","shortname":"Rom","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungdamna Thupha hil tu in Pathian ii a sap, sawltak khat tu in a teal, Jesus Christ ii naseampa ahi Paul ii laithak ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua Lungdamna Thupha sia Lai Thiangtho sungah a ki at sa bangma taanghlai pek panin a kamsaangte tungtawnin Pathian ii kamciam a piaksa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua in ih Topa Jesus Christ, ama Tapa huvau ahi hi: cii le sa panin ama David suan hi a;"},"4":{"text":"Pathian pianzia taw ci leang thina panin a lian vaangletna taw a kithawsak kikna in Pathian Tapa a hina kilanghsak hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama tungtawnin mi namcin sung pan mihing theampo ii a up thei natu le a thu a nit thei natu in Christ hu in Pathian in kei sia sawltak khat sua theina thupha hong pia hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesus Christ neisa a suak tu in Pathian hong sapsa Rome khua a om note zongh hi thu in hong huam hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom Pathian in hong it a, ama minam suak tu in, hong sapsa no Rome khua a omte theampo tungah lai kong thaak hi. Ih Pa Pathian le ih Topa Jesus Christ in thuthiamna le thinnopna hong pia tahen."},"8":{"text":"A masa phitbel in no tungtaang ah Jesus Christ tungtawnin Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko hi, banghang ziam cile leitung theampo in na upna thu uh hong za hi.","title":"Lungdamko Thungetna"},"9":{"text":"A Tapa ii Lungdamna Thupha ka hilsak, ka thin theampo taw ka sepsak, tu a ka son teng sia thumaan a hina thu ah — Pathian sia ka tetti ahi hi. No kong phawna sia Pathian in,"},"10":{"text":"thu ka nget simin hong he hi. Pathian ii deina ahi nale tu in no kungah kong haw tu sia hong suaksak thei takpi le ci in ka ngen hi."},"11":{"text":"Note hong thakhosak tu, Thaa thupha hong hawm sawn tu in kong mu nuam mama hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka cinopna pan kei upna hu in note phat tuamna nga in, note upna hu in kei zongh phat tuamna nga tu a, hun khat sungah a kihu tetek ih hina thu ka son nopna hi."},"13":{"text":"Suapuite awng hi thu na teptee tu ka dei a, tamvei ma note kungah hong haw tu in ka ngeal zo hi, ahihang tuabang ka hi thei natu in na khat po in hong khak tawntung hi. Gentile te sung panin a kikheal ka omsak bangma in, no sung pan zong kikhealsak zawk nei leng ka uk hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:21"},"14":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile heakna nei te ahizong a nei ngawlte ahizong, pilna neite ahizong a nei ngawlte ahizong mihing theampo ii tungah vaipuak ka nei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom Rome khua ah a teang no tung zongh ah Lungdamna Thupha hil tu ka lawp hi."},"16":{"text":"Lungdamna thupha sungah a kicingin muanna ka nei hi; tua in a umte theampo kingup natu Pathian ii vaangletna hi a Jew mite atu hi photin, tua zawkciang Gentile te atu zongh ahi hi.","title":"Lungdamna Thupha ii Vaangletna","ref":"Mk 8:38"},"17":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile lungdamna thupha in Pathian le mihingte bangbangin kilemzawng thei tu ziam ci in hong pualaak hi: a patna panin a tawp dong upna tungtawnin a piang ahi hi. Laithiangtho sungah “Upna tungtawnin Pathian mai ah thutang a kisuaksak sia in nungta tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Hab 2:4"},"18":{"text":"Thumaan thu a kiheak tu a khaktan mihingte ngitlona le mawnate hu in Pathian thin uukna sia vantung panin hong kilanghsak hi.","title":"Mihing Theampo ii Mawneina"},"19":{"text":"Pathian in amate daan pia hi, banghang ziam cile mihingte ii Pathian a heak natu sia Pathian mama in amate tungah telthiangsak hi."},"20":{"text":"Pathian ii simlei a bitphua pan kipan a kimu thei ngawl Pathian phatna ahi, ama ii tawntung vaangletna le thaa pianziate thiang takin kimu a; tuate sia Pathian ii vawt nate tung panin kitel thei hi. Tua ahikom mihingte in kam zon natu bangma a nei bua uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate in Pathian he ahihang a upat tu bangin upat ngawl uh a, ama tungah lungdam a ko tu bangin ko ngawl uh hi. Amate khua ngaisutna mannung mama ngawl a, amate thinsung hawmin, khuazing taw kidim hi.","ref":"Eph 4:17-18"},"22":{"text":"Amate ciim kisa ahihang mawmaw uh hi;"},"23":{"text":"a nungta tawntung Pathian a biak tu luangin a thithei mihing, vacim, ngamsa, awmtaal in a vak nganhingte meal taw kibang limte bia uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:16-18"},"24":{"text":"Tua ahikom, amate thinsung ah a uuk kiihuai ngamtatnate vawt tu in, Pathian in amate thazau a, tuaciangin amate khat le khat tungah maizumhuai nate kivawt uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Pathian huvau thumaante sia leilot thu suaksak uh a, Bitphuapa Pathian bia ngawlin a bitphua sa nate bia zaw uh hi. Pathian a tawntungin kipok tahen! Amen."},"26":{"text":"Amate hi bangin ngamta ahikom, Pathian in amate sia a maizumhuai cii le sa deina sungah thazau hi. A numeite ngawngawn in amate pumpi zak tu bangin zangh ngawlin ngeina ngawl bangin zangh uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuabang ma in pate zongh in numei taw omkhop tu sangin, pa le pa khial nopna thin nei uh hi. Pate in a maizumhuai pa le pa khialnate vawt a, tua hu in amate taw a kiphu daante kipia hi."},"28":{"text":"Pathian huvau heakna maante sia mihingte in khua ngaisut in nei nuam ngawl ahikom Pathian in amate ngamtat tuak ngawlte ngamtat theina ngaisutna sungah thazau hi."},"29":{"text":"Amate in ngitlona, siatna, duhopna le kilalsak theina namcinte taw kidim a; ki eenna, kisuamlupna, kihauna, ngualtheamna le siatvawt nopna thin taw kidim uh hi. Amate nawnsan a,"},"30":{"text":"khat le khat kingensia hi; amate in Pathian ensan a, sisuak in, kiphasak a kisuangtaak hi; siatna namcin phuang a; nute pate thu ni ngawl uh hi;"},"31":{"text":"A pha le a sia khentel theina thinsung nei ngawl, kamciam len ngawlin ngual hesuak theina le thuthiamna nei ngawl uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Hi bangin a nungtate sia Pathian thukham in thidaan thuak hen a ci hunlam zongh amate in he uh hi. Ahitazong, a ngamtatna kheal ngawl bek dom ngawlin, tuabang a ngamtate zongh thukimpui lai uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note in ngual tungah thukhen hi ngawl nu ziam? Akua po na hi uh zong na paulap tu om ngawl hi. Banghang ziam cile ngual tungah thu na khen uh ciangin noma zongh amate ngamtat bangma in na ngamta veve uh le noma le noma thu kikhen na suak uh hi.","title":"Pathian Thukhenna","ref":"Mt 7:1; Lk 6:37"},"2":{"text":"Pathian in hi bang a ngamtate tungah thu a khen ciangin thutang taw thukhen hi ci in ka he uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang no, ngual tung a thukhente awng, noma zongh in amate ngamtat bangma in ngamta na hi uh hi! Pathian thukhenna taw kipeal thei tu ki um na hi uh ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Tua ahibuale ama ii cikna, thiamna le dual zawknate zawnsak vawt na hi uh ziam? A tatakin Pathian cingh mama hi, banghang ziam cile na kisiik kik natu in ama in hanciam in lam hong pui hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang note na thin uh pui in na lungtang uh sak hi, tua ahikom Pathian sia thin uukna le thutang taw thu a khen Ni ciangin na daan khak tu uh sia a nasia seseam in hong kilangh tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian in mihing sim in a sep a vawt bangin thaman a pia tu hi.","ref":"Ps 62:12; Pau 24:12"},"7":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhat in nasep pha seam zomin minthanna, upatna le thi mawk nuntaknate Pathian kungah zong uh hi. Tuate tungah Pathian in tawntung nuntakna pia tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Midangte ahile amate atu bek ngaisun in, thumaan nial in a maan ngawl thu zui uh hi; tuate tungah Pathian in a thangsiatna le a thin uukna buak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Siatna a vawt mihing theampo tungah thuakna le natna hong om tu a, Jew te masa phot tu a tua zawkciangin Gentile te zongin thuak tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in minthanna, upatna le thinnopna sia thupha vawtte theampo tungah, Jew te masa photin Gentile te zongh pia tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian in mihing khat sim tungah a kibang khaiteena taw thukhen hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:17"},"12":{"text":"Gentile te in Moses Thukhamte a nei bua uh hi; amate in Thukham puasia ah om in, mawna vawtin mangthang uh hi. Jew te in Thukham nei uh hi; amate maw a Thukham in amate thukhen hi."},"13":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian mai ah thutang suana in Thukham zaakna taw piang ngawl a Thukham sawlnate zuina taw piang hi."},"14":{"text":"Gentile te in Thukham nei ngawl hi; ahihang Thukham sawl bangin ngamta tu in amate le amate in a thinsung uh ah a khensat uh simin Thukham nei suak uh hi. Thukham nei ngawlte hi phot ahihang a neite suak uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate ngamtatna in Thukham sawlnate a thinsung ah ki at hi ci in lak hi. A thinsung uh ah, kithasun theina le kithutangsak theina a nei theina zongh in, hi thu maan hi ci in lak hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom Lungdamna Thupha ka hilna bangin ci leang, mihing theampo ii a thimtham ngaisutnate tungah Jesus tungtawnin Pathian in thu a khen Ni ciang, tu a ih son bangin hong piang tu ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"No, Jew te ka hi uh a cite awng, note sia Thukham suangin Pathian huvau ah a kisuangtaakte na hi uh hi;","title":"Jew te le Thukham"},"18":{"text":"Pathian in bangbangin ngamta le hong oai ziam ci in na he uh a, Thukham panin a maan le a maan ngawl thute teal thei natu na sin zo uh hi;"},"19":{"text":"note in mittawte lamlak tu, khuazing sung a omte atu khuavak,"},"20":{"text":"a mawmawte atu a hilpa, khuatel ngawlte atu syapa na hi uh hi. Thukham sungah thumaan le heakna kicing in om hi ci in a kholette na hi uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ngual zongh hil thei na hi uh le noma le noma banghangin kihil ngawl nu ziam? “Nguta heak vun,” ci in na hil uh hi. Ahihang noma mama in na ngu uh ziam?"},"22":{"text":"“Palngul mawna na vawt heak vun,” na ci uh hi — Noma in palngul mawna na vawt uh ziam? Milim biakna na ngaimaw uh hi — ahihang, biakinnte zawthawk thu taw na phuul uh ziam?"},"23":{"text":"Pathian Thukham nei hing ci in kisuangtaak nu hi — ahihang a thukham na paltanna uh taw Pathian min na paansak uh ziam?"},"24":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “No Jew te hu in Gentile te in Pathian sonsia hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 52:5"},"25":{"text":"Thukham na tang uh le na vunteap atna in man nei hi; ahihang Thukham na tang bua uh le na vunteap at bua le uhte phazaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Gentile mite vunteap a at ngawlte in Thukham thupiakna a ni uh le Pathian in vunteap atte bangma in ngaisun ngawl tu ziam?"},"27":{"text":"Tua ahikom Thukham nei a vunteap at napi in, tua Thukham a zui ngawl no Jew te sia vunteap at ngawl napi thukham a zui Gentile te in hong ningkhiin tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Vunteap ki at takpi a, Jew tatak a kicite sia akua bangte hi peuma tu ziam? A puatham bek Jew hi a vunteap atna in cii le sa bek ahite Jew tatak kici ngawl hi."},"29":{"text":"Jew tatak a kicite sia a sungsang Jew hi a, a thinsung vunteap a ki at, tua zongh Pathian Thaa ii sepna taw a ki at hi in, thukham ii sep le vawt ahi ngawlte hi. Hi bang mite in mihingte pokna hi ngawlin Pathian pokna saang uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 30:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahile Jew te in Gentile te sangin hamphat zawkna khat po a nei ziam? Tua ahibuale vunteap atna ah bang phat tuamna om ziam?"},"2":{"text":"Phat tuamna nam tam mama om hi! a masa phitbel in Pathian in a thu a kizaaksak natu in Jew te muang phot hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang hi thu huvau ah amate sungah thumaan ngawl pawlkhat om le, bang suak tu ziam? Hisia in Pathian thumaan ngawl tu hi cina hi tu ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Tuabang hi ngawl het hi. Mihing sim in leilot kale zong Pathian ahile a thumaan kul veve tu hi. Laithiangtho in hi bangin ci hi. “Na pau ciangin thumaan na hi hunlam kilak tu a, thu hong kisit ciangin a thu na zaw kul hi.”","ref":"Ps 51:4"},"5":{"text":"Ahihang eite thutang ngawl ih hina in Pathian sia thutang ahi hunlam kiciansak ahile eite in bang ih son tuan nawn tu ziam? Pathian in daan hong piak ciangin ama sia thutang ngawl hi ih ci thei ziam? (Tu a teng sia mihing ngeina bangin ka pau hi.)"},"6":{"text":"Hi vet ngawl hi! Pathian thutang ngawl hile bangbangin ama in leitung buppi thukhen thei tu ziam?"},"7":{"text":"Ahihang keima ii thumaan ngawlna in Pathian thumaanna kiciansak zaw kan a, ama ii minthanna suaksak le bangbang hi tu ziam? Tua ahile banghangin kei mawnei hi ci in hong kipuavawk lalai tu ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahile banghangin “Thupha pianna tu in thusia vawt tawng,” ci ngawl hi ziam? Mihing pawlkhat in tu a ka ci bangin pau hi ci in mawsiatin hong lang hi! Tuabang mihingte in a kiphu bangin puavawkna thuak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahile ei Jew te in Gentile te sangin phazaw ih hi ziam? Hi tuan ngawl hi! Ka sonsa bangma in Jew te le Gentile te sia a kibangin mawna vaangletna nuai ah om siat hi.","title":"Kuama Thumaan Thutang Om ngawl"},"10":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “A thumaan thutang kuama om ngawl hi.","ref":"Ps 14:1-3; 53:1-3"},"11":{"text":"A ciim kuama om ngawl a, Pathian a bia kuama om ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihingte a vekpi in Pathian sang panin lampial zo a, amate lamkhial siat zo uh hi.
