A maan na a seam, kuama om ngawl a, khat bebeak zongh om ngawl hi."},"13":{"text":"A kampau te in thi theina kitheamna thu taw kidim a; a leei uh panin leilot thu pusuak hi, a lauhuai tawnnate ngulnguu bangin a muk uh panin pusuak hi;","ref":"Ps 5:9; 140:3"},"14":{"text":"a kam uh sia longsia khakngal taw kidim hi.","ref":"Ps 10:7"},"15":{"text":"Amate in ngual liamsua tu le a thatlum tu in palvang a,","ref":"Is 59:7-8"},"16":{"text":"a paina theampo ah amate in siatna le lalna piangsak uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amate in kilemna lampi a he bua uh hi,"},"18":{"text":"Pathian thasia natu zongh a sin ngei bua uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 36:1"},"19":{"text":"Leitung buppi Pathian thukhenna sungah a thet natu le mihingte kam zon theina theampo a bo thei natu in Thukham sungah thu omte theampo in Thukham khutnuai ah a omte atu ahi hunlam ka he uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian mai ah Thukham tanna hangin kuama thutang suak zo om ngawl a; Thukham nasepna in mihing khat mawnei ahi hunlam a kiheak natu ahi hi.","ref":"Ps 143:2; Gal 2:6"},"21":{"text":"Ahihang tu in Pathian ii mihingte thutang a suasakzia hong kipualaak zo hi. Thukham le kamsaangte lai atte in maan hi ci in tetti pang ahitazong, tuasia in thukham taw kisai ngawl hi.","title":"Pathian in Eite Ama taw Thutang hong Suasak khopzia"},"22":{"text":"Pathian in mihingte sia Jesus Christ a upna uh tungtawnin thutang suaksak hi. Christ a umte theampo tungah Pathian in hi bangin vawt hi, banghang ziam cile kuama a kilamdang tuatuan a om bua uh hi.","ref":"Gal 2:16"},"23":{"text":"Mihing theampo maw siat zo a Pathian ii ngum tu in hong ompuina pan kikhuala siat uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahihang amate a suaktasak Jesus Christ tungtawnin, Pathian ii man piak ngawlin hong piak thuthiamna letsong taw amate thutang kisuaksak hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama ii kipumpiak biakpiak natu in hong thina taw amate upna tungtawnin, mihingte mawna kimaisakna a pian natu in, Pathian in ama hong pia hi. Pathian in thutang ahi hunlam hong lak natu in, hi bangin a vawt hi. A bosa hun sungah ama a thin uai a, mihingte mawnate hong tha thong hi; ahihang tu in ama sia, thutang ahi hunlam a kilak natu in, mihingte mawna tungtaang ah na hong seam hi. Hi bangin Pathian in ama sia thutang ahi hunlam le Jesus Christ a um peuma thutang a suasakna thu hong lak hi.","merge":"26"},"27":{"text":"Tua ahiciang eite kisuantaak natu bang om ziam? Bangma om ngawl hi! Tua hile thutang suana in koisung pan hong piang ziam? Thukham nitna sepna pan ziam? Hi ngawl hi, upna pan bek hi."},"28":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile mihing khat sia Pathian mai ah upna tungtawn bek in thutang suak thei bek a, Thukham sawl bang a sepna pan hi ngawl hi ci in ih he hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahibuale Pathian sia Jew te ii Pathian hi bek ziam? Gentile te Pathian zongh hi ngawl ziam? Hi leilam hi."},"30":{"text":"Pathian sia khat hi a, Jew te zongh a upna uh tungtawnin, thutang suaksak a, Gentile te zongh a upna tungtawnin, thutang kisuaksak hi.","ref":"Thkna 6:4; Gal 3:20"},"31":{"text":"Upna in Thukham phiat hi cinopna ahi ziam? Hi ngawl het hi; eite in Thukham ih kipsak zaw hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahile ih pianna pa ahi Abraham thuakna sa tungtaang ah bang ih son tu ziam?","title":"Abraham Etteena"},"2":{"text":"Ama ii ngamtatna tung panin Pathian in thutang suaksak ahile a kisuantaak natu nei tu hi — ahihang Pathian mai ah ama in bangma kisuantaak natu om ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “Abraham in Pathian um a, tua a upna hu in Pathian in thutang suaksak hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 15:6; Gal 3:6"},"4":{"text":"Naseam khat in sep thaman saang hi, tua thaman sia letsong kici thei ngawl hi; a thalaw sa hi ci in kingaisun hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang sepna hi ngawl a upna a nei sia in, mimawte maw ngawl hi a ci Pathian a up hu in, a upna sia Pathian in saang a, thutang suaksak hi."},"6":{"text":"Hi thu in sepna kihel ngawl Pathian ii thutang hi ci in a saan, mihingte ii lungdamna, David ii son sia ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"“Tatkhialnate kimaisak a, a mawna pan a kisuatak te bangza in a lungdam ziam!","ref":"Ps 32:1-2"},"8":{"text":"Topa ii a mawnate sazian in a teptee ngawl tu sia in mihing lungdam ahi hi!”"},"9":{"text":"Hi lungdamna David ii son sia vunteap atte bek atu ahi ziam? Hi ngawl hi! Vunteap at ngawlte atu zongh ahi hi. Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho sungah a ki at bangin ih sonsa hi a, “Abraham in Pathian um a, tua a upna hangin Pathian in ama thutang hi, ci in saang hi.”"},"10":{"text":"Hi thu bang hun laitakin piang ziam? Abraham vunteap a at zawkciang ziam? A at ma ziam? A at ma hi a, a at zawk hi ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama sia a khak sang ciangin a vunteap at pheang hi. Vunteap a atna zongh, Abraham in Pathian um ahikom Pathian in ama a vunteap a at ma in thutang hi ci a tepteena lim ahi hi. Tua ahikom Abraham in Pathian um a, thutang hi ci in ama ii a saante theampo, a vunteap at vateal ta buale kuama theampo ii thaa lamsang ah a pa uh ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 17:10"},"12":{"text":"Ama in vunteap atte ii pa zongh hi a, vunteap a at bek dom ngawlin, ih pa Abraham vunteap a at ma a, upna taw a nuntakna sungah ama bangma in a nungta te ii pa zongh ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Pathian in Abraham le a suan a paalte munah hi leitung sia amate atu hi ci in kamciam pia hi, hi kamciam in Abraham ii thukham a nit hu hi ngawl a, a up hangin thutang hi ci a, Pathian in a teptee hu ahi hi.","title":"Pathian Kamciam sia Upna tungtawnin Kisaang","ref":"Pian 17:4-6; 22:17-18; Gal 3:29"},"14":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian ii kamciam sia Thukham a tangte atu hi thong le mihingte upna sia a lui thawthong suak tu a, Pathian kamciam zongh man nei ngawl hi tu hi.","ref":"Gal 3:18"},"15":{"text":"Thukham in Pathian thin uukna piangsak hi; Ahihang thukham om ngawlna munah thukham paltanna om ngawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Pathian kamciam in upna bulphu in nei a, tua ahikom Abraham suan le paal Thukham tangte bek hi ngawlin — Abraham up bangin a umte theampo tungah man nei ngawlin a piak tu in kho takin vawt hi. Banghang ziam cile Abraham in eite theampo ii thaa lam sangah ih pa ahi hi.","ref":"Gal 3:7"},"17":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “Minam tam mama ii pa kong suaksak zo hi,” a ci bangma ahi hi. Tua ahikom a thisa a nungtasak kik thei, a om ngeingawl laite thupiakna taw a piangsak thei, Abraham ii a up Pathian ii a muna ah tua kamciam sia kip hi.","ref":"Pian 17:5"},"18":{"text":"Muanmawk lamet natu om ngawl kawm panin Abraham in um a muangmaw ahikom ama sia “minam tam mamate pa” suak hi. Laithiangtho in “Na suan na paal te aksi za in tam tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 15:5"},"19":{"text":"Tua hun lai in ama kum zakhat pha dektak zo a, a pumpi sia a thithi ma hi zo in, tua bek dom ngawlin Sarah in ta nei thei ngawl ahitazong a upna a thaneam tuan bua hi.","ref":"Pian 17:17"},"20":{"text":"Ama in a upna thasua ngawl a, Pathian kamciam zongh a muang la bua hi. A upna in ama thahatna taw kidimsak a, ama in Pathian pok hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama ii a thinsung tawngh pan a upna sia, Pathian in kamciam a piak bangin tungsak tu hi ci in um hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua thu hangin Abraham in upna tungtawnin, “Pathian in thutang hi ci in saang hi.”"},"23":{"text":"“Ama sia thutang hi ci in kisaang hi,” ci kammal zongh ama bek atu a kici ahi bua hi."},"24":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus thina pan a tho kiksak ama a um, thutang hi ci in hong kiciamtee ei atu zonghin a ki at kammal ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Jesus sia eite ii mawna hu in a thi tu in ki aap a, Pathian mai ah thutang ih sua natu in nuntakna sungah ama kinungta kiksak hi.","ref":"Is 53:4-5"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in eite upna tungtawnin Pathian in thutang hong suaksak a, ih Topa Jesus Christ tungtawnin, Pathian taw kilemna ih nei hi.","title":"Pathian taw Thutang Kisuak"},"2":{"text":"Tu laitak a ih dinmun ahi Pathian ii thuthiamna sung a theng tu in upna tungtawnin ama in tua munah hong then hi. Tua ahikom eite in Pathian minthanna ih siim natu lametna ih nei hu in ih kisuangtaak hi!"},"3":{"text":"Ih ngimnate hu zonghin ih angtang hi, banghang ziam cile ngimna in thuak zawkna piangsak a,"},"4":{"text":"thuak zawkna in Pathian thukimna piangsak in, ama hong thukimpuina in lametna piangsak hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi lametna in hong thinkiamsak bua hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian hong piakthong letsong ahi Thaa Thiangtho zangh in ih thin sungah ama ii itna hong buak hi."},"6":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile cimaw a ih om laitakin Pathian ii a teal hun ciangin Christ sia mi ngilote atu in hong thi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing thutang khat atu thina thuak tu sia thu haksa ahi hi. Mihing pha khat atu a thi ngam khat po zongh om tha tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang eite mimaw ih hi laitak ma in eite atu Christ hong thina taw Pathian in eite bangzata in hong it ziam ci hong lak hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, tu in ama chisan taw eite Pathian mai ah thutang ih suak hi; tua ahile Pathian thin uukna pan ama in bangza in eite hong ngum zaw kan lai tu ziam!"},"10":{"text":"Eite in Pathian ngalte ih hi laitakin, a Tapa thina tungtawnin eite sia ama taw a kilem a lawmte hong suaksak hi. Tu in Pathian lawmte hi zo ih hi le Christ nuntakna in bangza in hong ngum zaw kan lai tu ziam!"},"11":{"text":"Ahihang tua teng bek hi ngawl hi; Pathian lawmte hong suaksak Topa Jesus Christ tungtawn a Pathian sepna tungah ih lungdam hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihing khat tungtawnin mawna leitung ah hong theng a, tuaciang ama mawna in thina hong puak hi. Tua taw kizui in mihing suan theampo tungah thina hong kizel hi. Banghang ziam cile mihing theampo maw zo uh hi.","title":"Adam le Christ","ref":"Pian 3:6"},"13":{"text":"Thukham a kipiak ma in leitung ah mawna om zo hi; ahihang thukham om ngawlna ah mawna sazian kikoi ngawl hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang Adam hun pan kipan Moses hun dongin thina in mihingte uk a, Adam bang a Pathian thupiakna a ni ngawlte bek hi ngawlin a dangte zongh thi uh hi. Adam sia hong pai pheang tu mihing khat ii lim ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang tuate ngeal kibang ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian ii a thong a hong piak letsong in Adam ii mawna taw kibang ngawl hi. Tua mihing khat ii hu in mihing tam mama thi hi. Ahihang Pathian ii thuthiamna lian zaw pek a, tuasia bangma in mihing khat ahi Jesus Christ ii thuthiamna tungtawnin a thong a hong piak letsong sia lian zaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuabangin Pathian piak letsong le mihing khat ii mawna kilaklaw ah kilamdanna om hi. Mawna khat hang “maw hi” ci a thukhenna piang a, ahihang mawna tam mama kale zong “maw ngawl hi” cina letsong sia kilawm ngawlin hong piang hi!"},"17":{"text":"Mihing khat ii mawna tungtawnin thina in hong uk hi. Ahihang Jesus Christ a kici mihing khat ii sepna taw kizui in bangza in a lianzaw thu piang ziam! Pathian ii a kicing thuthiamna le man nei ngawl a hong piak thutang suana a saangte in Christ tungtawnin a ngualzo nuntakna nga tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom mawna khat in mihing theampo hong puavawk a, thukhenna a piansak bangma in thutang nasepna khat in mihing theampo suaktasak a, nuntakna pia hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing khat ii thunit ngawl hu in mihing theampo mawnei a kisuasak bangma in, mihing khat thunit hu in mihing theampo Pathian mai ah thutangte kisuaksak hi."},"20":{"text":"Mawna ngamtatna a khanto vaial natu in thukham kipia hi, ahihang mawna a khantona munah, Pathian ii thuthiamna khangto seseam hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom mawna in thina taw hong uk bangma in, Pathian ii thuthiamna in thutang suana taw hong uk a, ih Topa Jesus Christ tungtawnin tawntung nuntakna sungah hong then hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahile bang ih son tu ziam? Pathian ii thuthiamna a khanto vaial natu in mawna sungah ih nungta tan lai tu ziam?","title":"Mawna ah Thi, Christ taw Pum khat suana ah Nungta"},"2":{"text":"Hi ngawl het hi. Eite in mawna thi san zo ih hi ciang bangbangin mawna sungah nungtata lai tu hi ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile hi thu na heak uh ahi hi. Eite Christ taw kikopkhawm tu in ih ki baptize ciang ama thina sung zongh ah a kikopkhawm tu in a ki baptize ih hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahiciang ih ki baptize na taw eite ama taw kivuikhawm a, ama thina ih siim hi. Banghang ziam cile Pa ii minthan thahatna taw Christ sia thina panin a kithawsak kik ciang eite zongh nuntakna thak sungah a nungtate ih sua natu ahi hi.","ref":"Col 2:12"},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ama ii a thi bangma in ih thi ciangin ama taw pumkhat suak ih hile, ama a kinuntaksak kik bangma in, eite hong kinuntaksak kikna taw ama taw pumkhat ih suak tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaciangin hi thu ih he hi, ih nuntakna a lui sia thinglamtee tungah Christ taw ih thisak zo a, mawna silate ih hi nawn ngawl natu, mawna vaangletna a kilalcipsak natu in ih nuntakna lui sia Christ taw ama thinglamtee tungah kithisak zo ci in ih he hi."},"7":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile mihing khat a thi ciangin mawna tha hatna panin a kisuaktasak ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Christ taw thi khawm zo ih hi nungsang, ama taw ih nungta khawm tu hi, ci zonghin ih um hi."},"9":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Christ sia thina panin kitho kiksak zo a, bangma hunin a thi kik ngei nawn buatu hi — thina in ama uk ngei nawn ngawl tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahiciang ama thi ahi hu in, mawna in ama tungah vaang nei nawn ngawl hi; tu in ama nuntakna in Pathian taw kipawlkhawm in nungta ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in no zongh mawna taw kipee thute ah a thisa in, na kituat vun a, ahizong, Christ Jesus tungtawnin Pathian taw kipawlkhopna sungah a nungta in na kituat vun."},"12":{"text":"Na cii le sa deina na zui ngawl natu in, a thithei na pumpi sia mawna in hong uk nawn ngawl tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bek dom ngawlin, a pha ngawl tupnate sungah a kizangh tu in na pumpi nate khat pawpo aap thei ngawl tu nu hi. Tua hi ngawl zaw in thina pan a kinungtasak kik mihingte bangin na pumpi uh thumaan thutang taw a kizak natu in, Pathian tungah kipia vun."},"14":{"text":"Mawna in hong uk nawn ngawl tu hi; banghang ziam cile note in thukham nuai ah nungta nawn ngawl a, Pathian ii thuthiamna nuai ah a nungta na hi zo uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahile bang ci tu hi ziam? Thukham khutnuai ah om nawn ngawl a Pathian ii thuthiamna khutnuai ah om zo ih hile mawna ih vawt lai tu ziam? Hi ngawl hi!","title":"Thutang ii Silate"},"16":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo ii thu ni tu in noma le noma na ki aap uh ciangin a sila na suak uh sia maan takin na he uh hi — mawna sila na hi uh le thina taw kizom a, tua ahi bua a, thunitna sila na hi uh le Pathian mai ah thutang suana taw kizom hi."},"17":{"text":"Bangpo ahizong Pathian tungah lungdamko tawng! Banghang ziam cile khatvei lai in note in mawna silate na hi uh a, na saansa uh hong kihil thumaan thutakte na thin theampo uh taw na ni zo uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Note mawna panin hong kisuaktasak zo a, thutang ii silate na hi zo uh hi."},"19":{"text":"(A zawngkhal mihing na hi uh hu in na tel thei tu in, ni sim ih zak kammal ol te kong zangh hi.) Khatvei lai in siatna le thiangtho ngawlna sungah a sia tu le a nin tu in noma le noma silate bangin na kipum aap uh bangma in, tu in thutang ii silate bangin tupna thiangtho sungah na kipia tavun."},"20":{"text":"Mawna silate na hi uh laitakin thumaan thutang taw na kipeal uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Maizum huai na saknate na vawt uh ciangin, bang meetna na nga uh ziam? Tuate taw a kizom thu in thina ahi hi!"},"22":{"text":"Ahihang tu in note sia mawna panin hong kisuaktasak zo a, Pathian silate na hi uh hi. Na meetna uh sia nuntakna a cialcingin ama tungah na kipum aapna uh hi a, tua taw kizom thu in tawntung nuntakna ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile mawna thaman in thina hi a; ahihang tawntung nuntakna sia, ih Topa Jesus Christ taw ih kikopna hangin a thong a hong piak letsong ahi hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Suapuite awng, thukham huvau tel siat na hi uh ciang, son tu a kong kipat thu zongh tel mama tu nu hi. Mihing khat a nuntak laiteng bekma in thukham in uk hi.","title":"Nupa Kiteenna taw Sonteena"},"2":{"text":"Sonteena in numei pasal nei khat sia, a pasal nuntak lai teng bekma in thukham in khii hi; ahihang a pasal a thi le a zi sia tua pasal taw a kikhii khawm tua thukham panin suakta hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom a pasal nungta nginge lai in, numei in pa dang khat taw a teang le a pasal palngul hi kici tu hi; ahihang a pasal a thi le, thukham panin a suakta numei hi a, ngualdang khat a teenpui hangin ama in palngul mawna vawt ahi bua hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, note zongh tua taw kibang nu hi. Thukham tungtaang ah note zongh thi zo nu hi, banghang ziam cile note in Christ ii pumpi khen khat veu na hi tek uh hi; tuaciang tu in Pathian tungah a taktai sepnate ih nei thei natu in thina pan a, a kitho kiksak Pa ii neisate na hi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile mihing pianzia bangin ih nuntak laitakin Thukham ii holna taw maw nopnate in ih pumpi sungah na hong seam a, tuaciang thi theina nasepna sungah eite ih kiva mama hi."},"6":{"text":"Bangpo ahizong, tu in eite Thukham taw ih kipeal zo hi, banghang ziam cile khatvei lai a hong luangtasak tua Thukham ih thi san zo hi. A ki at thukham ngeina lui bangin na ih seam nawn bua a, Thaa ii ngeina thak bangin ih seam hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahile bang ih ci tu ziam? Thukham mama pha ngawl hi ih ci tu ziam? Hi ngawl het hi! Thukham in mawna a ci sia hong hesak hi zaw hi. Thukham in, “Ngual khat ii neisa na dungawk heak vun,” ci buale dungawk ci sia bang ziam ci in ka he buatu hi.","title":"Thukham le Mawna","ref":"Pu 20:17; Thkna 5:21"},"8":{"text":"Thupiakna ii sawl hu in mawna in ka sungah dungawk nopna tuatuam hong piansak natu hunpha nga hi. Thukham om ngawlna munah mawna sia a thi ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Keima ma zongh khatvei lai in thukham ngawl taw ka nungta ngei hi; ahihang thupiakna a om hunlam ka heak tak ciangin, maw nopna hong thahat a,"},"10":{"text":"tuaciang kei ka thi hi. Tuasia ciangin nuntakna a piangsak tu thupiak sia kei atu thina ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Mawna in hunpha nga in thupiakna tungtawnin na hong seam a, kei hong theam in hong thatlum hi.","ref":"Pian 3:13"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom Thukham in thiangtho a, thupiakna zongh thiangtho in pha a, tang hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahile hi bangin a pha thu khat in, kei thina hong piangsak hi ci tu hi ziam? Hi ngawl hi! Hong thisak sia in mawna hi, mawna in a pianzia tatak sia a kilangh natu in a pha khat hong zangh a, kei tungah thina hong piangsak ahi hi. Tua ahikom thupiakna a om hu in mawna ii a lauhuai a phat ngawlna kician seseam hi."},"14":{"text":"Thukham sia thaa taw kisai hi ci in ih he hi; ahihang keima in a thithei mihing hi a, mawna sungah sila bangin a kizuak sa ka hi hi.","title":"Thinsung Buaina"},"15":{"text":"Ka sep ka vawt sia bang ziam ci in ka tel bua hi; banghang ziam cile ka vawt nopte ka vawt bua a, ka vawt nop ngawl teng ka vawt hi.","ref":"Gal 5:17"},"16":{"text":"Ka vawt nop ngawlte ka vawt ciangin, Thukham sia maan hi ci in ka thukimpuina hong kilangh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom hite a vawt sia in kei tatak ka hi bua hi; ka sung a teang mawna sia ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Mihing ka hina sungah — a pha bangma om ngawl hi ci in ka he hi. Banghang ziam cile a pha vawt nopna ka sungah a om bel hangin ka vawt thei bua hi."},"19":{"text":"A pha ka vawt nopte ka vawt bua a, ka vawt nop ngawl a siate ka vawt zaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka vawt nop ngawlte ka vawt le tuabangin a vawt sia kei ka hi bua hi. Ka sung a teang mawna in vawt ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom ngeina khat om hi ci in ka phawk hi. A pha khat ka vawt nop ciangin, a sia vawt tu bek teal theina ka nei hi."},"22":{"text":"Ka sungah a nungta sia in Pathian thukham diksa hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang ka pumpi sungah ngeina dangkhat in na hong seam hi — ka thinsung ii dik a sak ngeina sia a langpan ngeina khat sia ahi hi. Ka pumpi sung a na hong seam mawna taw kisai thukham ii thongtaakpa hong suaksak hi."},"24":{"text":"Bangza in a thinngim mihing khi ziam! Thina sung hong zotpui hi pumpi panin akua in hong suatak tu ziam?"},"25":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus tungtawnin hong suaktasak Pathian tungah lungdamko tawng! Tua ahikom ka dinmun sia hi bang hi: keima hantang in ci leang Pathian thukham sia ka thinsung bek in zui zo a, ka mihing pianzia ahile mawna ngeinate zui hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in Christ taw pumkhat in a nungtate atu in kipuavawkna a om bua hi.","title":"Thaa sungah Nuntakna"},"2":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Jesus Christ taw kop a nuntakna sungah hong then thaa ngeina in mawna le thina ngeinate panin hong suaktasak hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihing thaneamna hu a Thukham ii vawt zawk ngawlte Pathian in vawt zo hi. Ama in mihing pianzia sungah mawna a bo cimitsak natu in mihingte mawna pianzia teng ma hong keng a, ama Tapa sia mawna kitat natu in hong pia hi."},"4":{"text":"Pathian ii hi bangin a sepna in ei, mihing pianzia bangin nungta ngawl a, Thaa ngeina bangin a nungtate in Thukham ii thutang sua natu a deina sia a khuangkhim natu in seam ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing pianzia bangin a nungtate thinsung sia cii le sa deina in uk hi. Thaa ii sawl bangin a nungtate thinsung sia Thaa ii deina in uk hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing pianzia in na uksak uh le thina piang a; Thaa in na uksak uh le, nuntakna le thinnopna piang hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahiciang mihing khat sia mihing pianzia in a uk le Pathian ngal suak hi; banghang ziam cile ama in Pathian thukham ni ngawl hi, a tatakin ni thei ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihing pianzia a zuite in Pathian a lungdamsak thei bua hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang note in mihing pianzia ii hong sawl bangin na nungta bua uh hi; Pathian Thaa note sungah hong nungta takpi ma ahi nale — Thaa ii sawl bangin na nungta uh hi. A kuama po Christ ii Thaa a nei ngawl sia in, Christ ii neisa ahi bua hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang Christ note sungah hong teang le Thaa sia no atu in nuntakna ahi hi, banghang ziam cile na pumpi uh mawna hangin thi tu ahitazong note Pathian taw hong kilemzawngsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesus thina pan a thosak kik Pathian Thaa note sungah hong teang le thina pan Christ a tho kiksak pa in, a Thaa note sungah a om hu in a thithei na pumpi uh nuntakna hong pia tu hi.","ref":"1 Cor 3:16"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka suapuite awng, mihing pianzia ii deina bangin ih nuntak ngawl natu in zui tu vaipuak ih nei hi."},"13":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile mihing pianzia bangin na nungta uh le na thi takpi tu uh hi; ahihang mawna ngamtatnate Thaa taw na thatlum uh le na nungta tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Pathian Thaa ii lampuina a nga mihing peuma Pathian ii tate ahi uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian hong piak Thaa in nang sia sila hong suaksak ngawl a, hong kiitasak ngawl hi; tua hizaw ngawlin, Thaa in Pathian ii tate hong suaksak a, Thaa vaangletna taw eite in Pathian tungah “Pa awng, ka Pa awng!” ih ci thei hi.","ref":"Mk 14:36; Gal 4:5-7"},"16":{"text":"Pathian Thaa in eima thaa taw kikopin, Pathian ii tate ih hina tetti in hong pang khawm hi."},"17":{"text":"A tate ih hi zawk nungsang a mite atu a khealsia thuphate ih lua tu a, Christ atu a Pathian ii a koi nate zongh ih lua tu hi; banghang ziam cile Christ ii thuakna ih thuakpui le a minthanna zongh ih lua tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu hun a ih thuakte in hong kilangh pheang tu, a minthanna taw kiteengat thei ngawl hi.","title":"Hong tung Pheang tu Minthanna"},"19":{"text":"A kibitphua sa theampo in Pathian ii tate sia akua bang teng hi tu ziam ci in hong kilaak tu kaal ngakla in om uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile bitphua sate sia amate ii tupna le sawmnate a taan natu in, amate ii uuk thu hi ngawlin Pathian ii deina taw puavawkna a thuak uh hi. Ahitazong lametna om lai hi,","ref":"Pian 3:17-19"},"21":{"text":"bitphua sate in ni khat ni ciangin a muatcip theina sungah sila a tanna sung panin kisuaktasak tu a Pathian ii tate in suatak minthanna nga khawm tu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile nausuak tun a nat bangin tu hun dong ma bitphuasa theampo in na a sakna taw tau in om hi ci ih he hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang bitphua sate bek hi ngawlin Pathian ii a leap a letsong hong piak ahi ei Thaa a neite zongh in, Pathian ii tate hong suaksak a, ih nuntakna buppi hong suataksak tu ngakin ih sung sangah ih tau tek hi.","ref":"2 Cor 5:2-4"},"24":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile eite sia lametna hangin hong hun a; ahizong ih lametna sia ih mukhol thei le tuasia in lametna kici thei ngawl tu hi. A mu, nate a muangmaw lai akua om ngei nu ziam?"},"25":{"text":"Ahihang ih mu ngawl lai khat muangmaw ih hile, thinsauna taw ih ngak hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua bangma in eite in bangza in tha zawngkhal hi ka leang, eite hong hu tu in Thaa hong pai hi. Banghang ziam cile eite in thu ih ngetzia tu ih he bua hi; kammal taw a kilo thei ngawlte tauna taw Pathian tungah Thaa in hong maangkaasak hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuaciangin mihingte thinsung a mu thei Pathian in Thaa ii khua ngaisutnate he hi; banghang ziam cile Thaa in Pathian tungah a mite atu in ama dei babangin maangkaasak hi."},"28":{"text":"Pathian ii tupna taw a sam sa ahi ama a itte atu in na theampo Pathian in a phabel in piangsak hi."},"29":{"text":"Pathian teal sate a Tapa taw a kiban natu in, doituam a, tua hu in a Tapa in unau tam mama sung panin ta upabel suaksak hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahikom Pathian in a tuamin a koi sate sam a, a samte thutang suaksak hi, tua thutang a suasakte ama ii minthanna hawm hi."},"31":{"text":"Hi teng zawkciangin ih son tu, bang om lai tu ziam? Pathian ei sangah hong pang le akua in eite hong langpan thei tu ziam?","title":"Jesus Christ sungah Pathian ii hong Itna"},"32":{"text":"Pathian in hong langpan ngawl het tu hi. Ama in a Tapa takpi khoaikhe ngawlin, ei atu in hong pia hi! A Tapa ngawngawn hong pia ahile — na theampo a thongin hong pia ngawl tu ziam?"},"33":{"text":"Pathian tealsa mihingte tungah akua in, mawna zong thei tu ziam? Pathian mama in amate mawnei ngawl a suasakte ahi hi!"},"34":{"text":"Tua ahile amate akua in maw pusak thei tu ziam? Thina thuak a, a kinungtasak kik pa, Pathianziatsang ah to a, Pathian tungah ei atu in hong ngetsakpa Christ Jesus in hong mawsak ngawl tu hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahile Christ ii eite hong itna panin, akua in hong khen thei tu ziam? Ngimna, haksatna, vawtsiatna, ngilkialna, zawnna, lau huaina, thinate khat pawpo in, hong khen thei tu ziam?"},"36":{"text":"Laithiangtho in hi bangin a ci bangma “Nang hu in kote thina ii lauhuaina sungah a ni bup in ka om uh hi; kote sia a kingolum tu tuute bangin hong kivawt hi,”","ref":"Ps 44:22"},"37":{"text":"Hong itpa tungtawnin eite in hi thute theampo sungah zawna kicing ih nga hi!"},"38":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ama hong itna panin, bangma in hong khen thei ngawl tu hi ci in maan takin ka mu hi: thina ahizong nuntakna ahizong, vantunglalangte ahizong, vantung ukna le thahatna nei dangte ahizong, tu hun hikale mailam hikale,"},"39":{"text":"leitung a saangbelna mun ahizong, leinuai a thuk belna mun ahizong, bitphua sa a minpiang bangma in ih Topa Jesus Christ sungah ih neisa ahi Pathian hong itna taw hong khen zo a om buatu hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thumaan ka son hi; Christ neisa ka hi a, ka leilot bua hi. Thaa Thiangtho ii a uk ka thinsung zongh in leilot ngawl ka hina hong telthiangsak hi.","title":"Pathian le Ama Mite"},"2":{"text":"Ka chi ka sa ahi ka mite atu in bangza in khuangai khi ziam! A kizom tan in bangza in lainat law khi ziam,"},"3":{"text":"a phattuamna om tu hi thong le amate atu in Pathian haamsiatna thuak leng a, Christ taw zong kikhen law leng zong ka uk hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in Pathian ii mihingte hi uh a; ama in amate sia a tapate suaksak in, a minthanna kilanghsak hi; amate taw kamciamna vawtin Thukham pia hi; amate in a maan biakpiakna nei uh hi; amate in Pathian kamciam saang uh hi.","ref":"Pu 9:4"},"5":{"text":"Amate in khanglui Hebrew minthangte ii suan le paal te hi uh a, Christ ii mihing a hina taw amate ii minampui ahi hi. Na theampo a uk Pathian sia a tawntungin kipok tahen! Amen."},"6":{"text":"Pathian kamciam taangtung ngawl hi ci ngawl khi hi; banghang ziam cile Israel mi theampo Pathian tealsa hi siat ngawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Abraham ii suan theampo zongh Pathian ii tate hi siat ngawl hi. Pathian in Abraham tungah “Nang kong kamciamna panin na suan le na paalte Isaac tungtawnin na nei tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 21:12"},"8":{"text":"Hisia a khiakna in mihing pian ngei bangin a piang thawthongte sia Pathian ii tate hi ngawl a, Pathian kamciam panin a piangte bek a suan le a paal tatakin kingaisun hi."},"9":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian kamciam sia, hi kammalte bangin kipia hi. “A hun ciangin kong pai kik tu a, Sarah in tapa khat hing tu hi.”","ref":"Pian 18:10"},"10":{"text":"Hisia bek hi ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Rebecca in ih pu Isaac ahi a pasal taw tapa nii nei hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang tapa khat tealtuam tu sia Pathian ii deina vingveng ahi natu thu huvau in, Pathian in a nu munah, “A u zaw in a nau zaw ii na sepsak tu hi,” ci hi. Ama in hi thu a pau laitakin amate ngeal sia piang ngawl lai a, a sia a pha bangma vawt a nei bualai hi. Tua ahikom Pathian tealna in ama sapna tung pan hi a, amate sepna tung pan hi ngawl hi.","ref":"Pian 25:23","merge":"12"},"13":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “Jacob ka it a, Esau ka ensan hi,” ci in a ki at bang ahi hi.","ref":"Mal 1:2-3"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahile bang ih ci tu ziam? Pathian in a kilawm tu bang a thukhen ngawl hi ih ci tu ziam? Kici thei ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Moses tungah, “Ka hesuak nopte ka hesuak tu a; ka mulkim nopte ka mulkim tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 33:19; 9:16"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom mihing deina le sepna thu hi ngawlin, Pathian ii hesuakna tungah thu om zaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Laithiangtho in Egypt kumpipa tungah a cina pan, “Hi tupna hang le ka vaangletna lak in, leitung theampo ah ka min a kiheak natu in, kumpi kong suaksak a nang kong zangh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 9:16"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom Pathian in a hesuak nopte tungah hesuak a, thin sahna a piak nopte tungah thin sahna pia hi."},"19":{"text":"Note sung pan khat po in hong ci tu nu hi. “Hi bang ahile Pathian in mihing khat po tungah mawsakna pia thei tu ziam? Pathian ii deina akua in nial thei tu ziam?","title":"Pathian Thin uukna le Hesuakna"},"20":{"text":"Ahihang lawmpa awng, Pathian kam a zo kik tu in nang akua na hi ziam? Tungbeal khat in a vawtpa munah, “Banghangin kei hi bangin hong vawt ni ziam?” ci in a dongh thei bua hi.","ref":"Is 29:16; 45:9"},"21":{"text":"A tatak ci leang bealte a vawtpa in tungmante a dei babangin a zak thei natu thunei a, tungman lom khat panin beal nii vawtin, khat sia hun thupi sung a zak tu, a khat sia hun thawthong sung a zak tu in vawt theina thunei hi."},"22":{"text":"Pathian nasepna zongh tuasia bangma ahi hi. Ama in a thin uukna lak nuam a, a vaangletna kihesak nuam hi. Ama a thin a uuksak, lalcipna sung a theng tu mihingte thinsauna tatak taw thuak hi."},"23":{"text":"A kicing ama ii vaangletna zongh hong pualaak nuam a, a minthanna a nga tu in hong vawt sa eite a hesuakna a saang tu mihingte tungah tua a vaangletna hong buak hi."},"24":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile eite sia Jew te sung pan bek hi ngawlin, Gentile te sung pan zong hong sap a minamte ih hi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hi thu in Hosea laibu sungah a son teng ahi hi, “Ka mihing ahi ngawlte ‘keima ii mihing’ ka ci tu hi. Ka it ngawl minamte sia ‘ka itte’ awng ka ci tu hi.","ref":"Hos 2:23"},"26":{"text":"“Tuaciangin, note sia ka mihing hi ngawl nu hi,” a kicina mun mama ah amate sia a nungta Pathian ii tate kici tu hi.”","ref":"Hos 1:10"},"27":{"text":"Tuaciangin Israel mite huvau Isaiah in hi bangin ci hi: “Israel mite tuipi hui ah senvui za in a tam hial zong, amate sung panin tawm bek kingum tu hi;","ref":"Is 10:22-23"},"28":{"text":"banghang ziam cile Topa in leitung bup ah hai ngawlin a vai theampo thiangsak tu hi.”"},"29":{"text":"Isaiah in a masa in hi bangin ci hi. “Vaanglianbelpa Topa in suan le paal tawm hong kheetsak ngawl hi kapo le, eite Sodom bang ih hi tu a, Gomorrah bang ih suak tu hi.”","ref":"Is 1:9"},"30":{"text":"Pathian mai ah thutang sua natu a hanciam ngeingawl Gentile te sia a upna tungtawnin thutang suak uh hi, ih ci hi;","title":"Israel atu Paul ii Thungetna"},"31":{"text":"Tua laitakin Pathian ii mihingte in Pathian mai ah thutang suana tu in thukham khat zong uh a, a mu bua uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Banghangin mu ngawl ziam? Banghang ziam cile amate in upna bulphu ngawl a, sepna bulphu uh hi. Amate in laithiangtho sungah a kison “Lutuna Suang” tungah lutu uh hi:"},"33":{"text":"“En vun, Zion ah suang khat ka koi a, tua in mihingte lutusak hi, amate a puksak tu suangpi ahi hi. Ahihang ama a umte a thin a kiam buatu hi.”","ref":"Is 28:16"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Suapuite awng, ka minamte ngupna a nga natu in ka thinsung theampo taw deisak in Pathian tungah thu ka ngetsak hi!"},"2":{"text":"Amate sia Pathian thu sungah a kipia mama ahi hunlam tetti ka pang hi; ahihang amate kipiakna in heakna tatak bulphu ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Pathian mai ah mihingte thutang a suasakzia he ngawl a, lampi tuam dang khat sial tu hanciam uh hi. Tua ahikom amate in Pathian ii mihingte thutang a suasakna sungah a ki aap bua uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile a umte theampo Pathian mai ah thutang a sua natu in Christ in thukham bosak zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian tungah a thutang na sua natu in, Thukham nitna taw kisai in, Moses ii lai at in hi bang ahi hi: “Thukham sawl bangin a ngamta theampo in tua taw nungta tu hi.”","title":"Ngupna in Mihing Theampo atu","ref":"Thiam 18:5"},"6":{"text":"Ahihang upna hang a Pathian mai ah thutang suana taw kisai in laithiangtho in hi bangin ci hi. “Noma le noma vantung ah akua kaato tu ziam?” ci in kidongh heak vun. (Tuasia Christ khiaksukna, a cinopna hi.)","ref":"Thkna 30:12-14"},"7":{"text":"“Akua leinuai ah tuaksuk tu ziam?” ci in kidongh heak vun. (Tuasia in Christ thina pan a thawsak kikna, a cinopna hi.)"},"8":{"text":"Hi bangin ci zaw hi: “Pathian hong piak kammal sia na kung nai ah om a, na muk tung le na thinsung ah om hi.” — Tua in upna thu ka hil uh sia ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"“Jesus in Topa hi ci in na kam taw pualaak a, na thinsung panin, Pathian in ama sia thina pan thosak kik hi ci in na um le ngupna na nga tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ih thinsung pan ih up ciangin thutang ih suak a, ih kam taw ih pualaak ciangin hong kingum hi."},"11":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “A kuama theampo ama a umte in a thin a kiam buatu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 28:16"},"12":{"text":"Hi thu in a kuama po huam siat hi. Banghang ziam cile Jew te le Gentile te kilaklaw ah lamdanna a om bua hi. Pathian in mihing theampo ii Topa hi a, ama tungah a ngen theampo atu in a kicing takin thupha pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Laithiangtho ci bangma in Topa tungah huna a ngen theampo kingum tu hi.","ref":"Jol 2:32"},"14":{"text":"Ahihang ama a um bua uh le amate in bangbangin huna ngen thei tu ziam? A thupha puak a za bua uh le, amate in bangbangin um thei tu ziam? A thupha a kithangsak buale amate in bangbangin za thei tu ziam?"},"15":{"text":"Thuhil tute a kipaisak buale a thupha bangbangin kithangsak thei tu ziam? Laithiangtho ci bangma in, “Lungdamna thupha puak a hong paite peang sia bangza in etlawm ziam?”","ref":"Is 52:7"},"16":{"text":"Ahihang amate theampo in Lungdamna Thupha saang thei ngawl uh hi. Isaiah mama in, “Topa awng, ko thupuakte akua in hong um ziam?” ci hi.","ref":"Is 53:1"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom upna in a thu zaakna pan piang a, a thu zaakna in, Christ ii thuhilna pan piang ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahile amate in a thu za ngawl hi tu ziam?, ci in kong dongh hi. Za hi — laithiangtho in hi bangin ci hi: “Leitung theampo ah amate ii aw theng hi; Amate ii kammal leimong dong theng hi.”","ref":"Ps 19:4"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahile: Israel mite in he ngawl ziam? ci in kong dongh kik hi. Moses ama mama in hong zo phit hi: “Minam in a kisim ngeingawl mihingte in, eenna thin hong neisak tu hi. A mawmaw minam khat zanghin na thin uh kong uuksak tu hi.”","ref":"Thkna 32:21"},"20":{"text":"Isaiah in hangsan seseam in hi bangin ci hi. “Hong zong ngawlte in kei hong mu hi; Hong kan ngawlte tungah ka kilak hi.”","ref":"Is 65:1"},"21":{"text":"Ahihang Israel taw kisai in ama in, “Thu ni ngawlte le hong langpante tungah nitangtum in muakin ka khut ka thaak hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 65:2"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahile Pathian in ama ii minamte nial hi ci tu hi ziam? Nial ngawl hi! Keima mama zongh Israel te ka hi a, Abraham suan, Benjamin nam sung a kihel khat ka hi hi.","title":"Israel te tungah Pathian ii Hesuakna","ref":"Php 3:5"},"2":{"text":"A kipat pan a tealsa ahi a minamte Pathian in nial ngawl hi, Pathian tungah Israel te sia Elijah in mawsak a, tua Laithiangtho kammalte na heak uh ahi hi:"},"3":{"text":"“Topa awng, amate in na kamsaangte thatlumin, na biaknataute susia hi; keima bekma taanglai khi hi. Tuaciang keima ngawngawn thalup hong sawm lai hi,” ci hi.","ref":"1 Kum 19:10,14"},"4":{"text":"Pathian in bangbangin zo kik ziam? “Keima atu in Baal pathian a bia ngawl mihing tulsali koi lai khi hi,” ci hi.","ref":"1 Kum 19:18"},"5":{"text":"Tu laitakin zongh tuabang ma ahi hi. Thuthiamna taw Pathian tealsa mihing tawm om lai hi."},"6":{"text":"A tealna in ama thuthiam hu hi a, amate sepna hang hi ngawl hi. Banghang ziam cile Pathian tealna sia mihing sepna tung pan hi thong le thuthiamna ih ci sia in thuthiamna maan hi ngawl tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahile bang ih ci tu ziam? Israel mite in a zon uh sia mu ngawl hi. Pathian tealtuam mi pawlkhat in mu bek hi. A dangte ahile Pathian samna nangonthaak hi."},"8":{"text":"“Pathian in a thinsung uh le, a khua ngaisutna bulthusak hi; tuni dong mama in, amate in a mit uh taw mu thei ngawlin a bil uh taw a za thei bua uh hi,” laithiangtho in ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 29:4; Is 29:10"},"9":{"text":"Tuaciang David in, “Amate in a poaipi khaamna sungah thaang kisia tahen a, kiman tahen; amate puk hen a, daan kipia tahen!","ref":"Ps 69:22-23"},"10":{"text":"Khua a mu thei ngawl natu in a mit uh kitawcipsak tahen a, ngimna nencipna taw a tawntungin bawngcip tahen,” ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahile Jew te a lutu uh ciangin a lalcip tu in a liik ziam? ci in kong dongh hi. Hi ngawl hi! Amate maw ahikom ngupna sia Gentile te tungah theng a Jew te ii een tu in kivawt ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Jew te ii mawna hu in leitung bup in thupha nasia takin saang hi. Tuaciang amate ii thaa zawngkhalna hu in Gentile te thupha nasia takin kipia hi. Tua ahile Jew te sia a pawlcing in a kihuam siat ciangin thupha saanna bangza in lianzaw seseam tu ziam!"},"13":{"text":"Tu in no Gentile te tungah hong son ka hi hi: Gentile te atu a sawltakpa khat ka hi laiteng in, keima nasepna sungah ka kiphasak tu hi.","title":"Gentile te Kingupna"},"14":{"text":"Ka minampuite in eenna thin neisakin, pawlkhat beak amate ii sung pan ka suatak thei katawm maw ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile amate tuabangin a kinial ciangin leitung mihing dangte Pathian ngal dinmun panin, Pathian lawmte cina dinmun ah theng uh hi. Amate a kisaan ciangin bangbang hi tu ziam? A thite atu in nuntakna suak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Anluum a kileap masa sia Pathian atu in a kipia le a anluum buppi zongh ama aa ahi hi. Thingzungte Pathian atu in a kipia le a baakte zongh ama aa ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Inn olive baak pawlkhat kithiaktan a, ngam olive baak sia inn olive kung tungah kipee hi. No Gentile te sia tua ngam olive baakte taw na kibang uh hi, tu in Jew te ii a kho thaa nuntakna na nga uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom thingbaak bangin a kithiaktante sia na zawngsak bua het tu uh hi. Banghangin note kiphasak thei tu nu ziam? Note in a baak khat na hi bek uh hi. Note in a zung na vaak na taa bua uh hi — a zung in note hong vaak hi."},"19":{"text":"“Hi hi, ahihang kote om thei natu in a baakte kithiaktan hi ngawl ziam,” ci tu nu hi."},"20":{"text":"Hi hi, amate a kithiaktan sia banghang ziam cile amate in a up ngawl uh hang ahi hi. Note, tu a na dinmun uh ah na om theina in, na up uh hang ahi hi. Ahihang kiphasak heak vun; tua hi ngawlin kiitakna thin nei tavun."},"21":{"text":"A pianpui a baak ahi Jew te Pathian in dual tuan ngawl hi; no hong dual tu in na um uh ziam?"},"22":{"text":"Hisia san ah Pathian in bangza in cingh a, bangza nasia takin thukhen thei ziam ci in ih mu thei hi. Ama in a puk sate tungah nasia takin thukhen hi — ahihang ama ii cikna le thiamna sungah na om uh le ama cingh hi. Tuabang na hi bua uh le, no zongh hong kithiaktan tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaciang Jew te in a up thei ngawlna uh teng nusia hile, amate a om natu san ah kikoi kik tu hi; banghang ziam cile Pathian in amate koi kik thei hi."},"24":{"text":"No Gentile te ahi ngam olive thingbaak sia kithiaktan a, ngeina om ngawlin, inn olive thingkung tungah hong kipee hi. Jew te sia inn olive thingkungte taw kibang hi, tua ahikom Pathian atu in, hi a kithiaktan a baakte amate kung tek tungah a pee kik tu ol zaw lai tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Suapuite awng, thumaan thutak ahi thuku khat a om sia na heak tu uh ka dei hi. Tua in noma le noma ciim na kisakna uh hong khaam tu hi. Hi thu ahi hi. Israel mite thinpuina sia a tawntungin a om tu hi ngawl hi. Ahihang Pathian kungah Gentile mite a theng tu in a kisee za a cin dong bek hi tu hi.","title":"A vekpi tungah Pathian ii Hesuakna"},"26":{"text":"Tuaciang hi thu in Israel mite theampo a kihut tu zia hi tu hi. Laithiangtho in: “Hunpa Zion panin hong pai tu a, Jacob suante tung panin ngitlona theampo heam tu hi."},"27":{"text":"Amate ii mawna ka maisak ciangin, amate taw hi thuciamna ka vawt tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Jer 31:33-34; Is 27:9"},"28":{"text":"Jew te in Lungdamna Thupha a nial uh hu in no Gentile te phattuam natu in Pathian ngalte suak uh hi. Ahihang Pathian tealna hangin a pute a pate hu in amate in, Pathian ii lawmte ahi uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile tealin thupha a piakte tungtaang ah Pathian in a thin a kheal bua hi."},"30":{"text":"No Gentile te na hi uh le a bosa hun sungah Pathian thu na ni bua uh hi; ahihang tu in Jew te thu nit ngawl hu in Pathian ii hesuakna na saang uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in, note saansa hesuakna hu in amate zongh Pathian ii hesuakna a saan thei natu, tu in Jew te in Pathian thu a ni bua uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile amate theampo tungah a hesuakna a lak natu in Pathian in mihing theampo thunit nop ngawlna ii kol a bul luangtaate suaksak siat hi."},"33":{"text":"Pathian hauna bangza in lian ziam! a ciimna le a heakna bangza in thuk ziam! Ama ii thukhensat nate akua in sontel thei tu ziam? Ama zia akua in he ziam?","title":"Pathian Pokna","ref":"Is 55:8"},"34":{"text":"Laithiangtho in: “Topa ii khua ngaisutna akua in he ziam? Akua in ama, ngaisutna pia thei ziam?","ref":"Is 40:13"},"35":{"text":"Hong lo kik tu in akua in ama tungah bang pia ngei ziam?” ci hi.","ref":"Job 41:11"},"36":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile na theampo ama bitphua sa hi a, na theampo ama tungtawnin piang a, ama atu ahi hi. Pathian tungah minthanna a tawntungin om tahen! Amen.","ref":"1 Cor 8:6"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahikom suapuite awng, Pathian ii a lian mama hong hesuakna hu in hi bangin note tungah kong ngen hi; noma le noma Pathian tungah a hingtang biakpiakna in kinei tavun a, ama ii dik a sak naseam tu in na ki aap tavun. Na piak tu uh biakna maan sia hisia ahi hi.","title":"Pathian Nasepna sungah Nuntakna"},"2":{"text":"Hi leitung pianzia zil in na om heak vun a, na thinsung uh kikhealthiangna taw Pathian in na sungsang uh panin na puuathaksak sitset vun. Tua hile a pha, dik a sak kicing a sak Pathian ii deinate na he tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang Pathian ii thuthiamna letsong hong piak hu in, note theampo tungah hi bangin kong ci hi: Noma le noma a kilawm za sangin a saangzaw in na kingaisun heak vun. Tua hi ngawl zaw in, na khua ngaisutna sungah na hina bangin kingaisun tavun, tuaciangin mihing sim in Pathian piak upna za taw khat tek kisitna nei tahen."},"4":{"text":"Ih pumpi sungah na tam mama om hi, tuaciang hi nate in sepna tuatuam tek nei uh hi.","ref":"1 Cor 12:12"},"5":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in eite mihing tam ih hi hangin Christ sungah kipawlin pumkhat ih hi hi. Khat le khat pumpi sung nate bangin ih kizom hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom ih saan letsong tuatuamte Pathian ii hong piak thuthiamna taw kizui in ih zangh tu hi. Ih letsong sia Pathian thupuakte son natu ahile upna ih neiza ciaciang taw ih son tu hi.","ref":"1 Cor 12:4-11"},"7":{"text":"Sepsak natu ahile zong ih sepsak tu hi. Hil natu ahile zong ih hil tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngual hanthot natu ahile tuabang ma in ih seam tu hi. A neisa ngual a hawmte in ngo takin hawm tu hi. Thuneina neite in nasep hanciam tahen a, ngual tungah cikna le thiamna a zanghte in maitai takin zangh tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ki itna in thin tak ahi tu thupi hi. A sia theampo ensan vun a, a pha ci theampo keamcing tavun."},"10":{"text":"Khat le khat Tapidaw unau khat bangin ki it in, khat le khat kizatak vawt vun."},"11":{"text":"Nasep hanciam vun a, datham heak vun. Thinsung bup kipiakna taw Topa atu seam vun."},"12":{"text":"Na lametna in hong lungdamsak tahen a, ngim ngana sungah thinsau tavun. Tuaciang a tawntungin thungen tavun."},"13":{"text":"Na neisa uhte na suapui a cimaw na Tapidaw puite hawm vun a, khualmite zindo tavun."},"14":{"text":"Hong vawtsiate thupha a saan natu in Pathian munah thungetsak vun — hi hi, Pathian in haamsiat ngawlin thupha a piak natu ngen vun.","ref":"Mt 5:44; Lk 6:28"},"15":{"text":"A lungdamte taw na lungdam khawm vun a, a kapte taw na kap khawm vun."},"16":{"text":"A kuama theampo atu a kibangin thinbotna na nei vun. Kiphasak heak vun a, nasep a niamte zongh seam thada heak vun. Noma le noma ciim kisa heak vun.","ref":"Pau 3:7"},"17":{"text":"A sia in hong vawt a om le a sia taw thuk heak vun. Mihing theampo ii pha hi ci in a ngaisutte sep tu hanciam vun."},"18":{"text":"Mihing theampo taw kilem a na nuntak thei natu in, noma sang panin na vawt thei theampo na vawt vun."},"19":{"text":"Lawmte awng, phu kilam heak vun. Pathian thin uukna ii a sep tu in koi zaw vun. Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in, “Phu ka lam tu a, ka thuk kik tu hi, Topa in ci hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:35"},"20":{"text":"Laithiangtho ii ci bangma in phulam luangin, “Na ngalpa a ngil a kial le an na vaak in, a dang a ko le a dawn tu khat na pia in, banghang ziam cile hi bangin na sep hu in, a maizumna in meikaang bangin kaangh tu hi.”","ref":"Pau 25:21-22"},"21":{"text":"Siatna in zosak heak vun; siatna sia phatna taw na zozaw vun."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihing khat simin ngam uk thuneite thu na ni vun, banghang ziam cile Pathian oai ngawl po kuama in thuneina nei thei ngawl hi, tua thuneite sia amate sepna san tek ah Pathian ii a koi ahi hi.","title":"Ngam uk Thuneite taw Kizopzia"},"2":{"text":"A seam nginge lai thuneite a nalh sia in Pathian thupiak nalh suak hi; tuabangte in amate le amate tungah thukhenna a tungsak suak hi."},"3":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ngamukte sia mihing phate ii kiitak tu hi ngawl a, mihing ngilote ih kiitak tu hi bek hi. Thuneipa kiita ngawlin na om nuam ziam? Tua ahile na pha khat seam in, ama in hong pok tu hi,"},"4":{"text":"banghang ziam cile amate in Pathian naseam hi a, nangma phattuam natu in naseam hi. Ahihang ngitlona na vawt le lauthawng in, banghang ziam cile ama in daan piak theina vaang nei tatak hi. Amate sia Pathian naseam hi a, mihing ngilote tungah Pathian daan tungsak hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi thu hu in thuneite thu na ni tavun — Pathian ii daan hong piak thei hang bek zongh hi ngawlin noma in khentel theina thin na nei uh hang zongh hi tahen."},"6":{"text":"Hi thu hu in shia na pia vun, banghang ziam cile, tua thuneite in a kicing takin a sep uh ciangin, amate in Pathian atu seam a suak uh hi.","ref":"Mt 22:21; Mk 12:17; Lk 20:25"},"7":{"text":"Amate tungah na batte uh na lo vun, nangma pumpi tung pan ahizong na neisa tung pan ahizong shia cite peuma na pia vun, zatak tute na zakta vun a, upat tute na upat vun."},"8":{"text":"Ki itna khat simngawl kuama tungah leei na ba heak vun. Hi bangin a ngamta te Thukham zui ahi hi.","title":"Khat le khat tungah Sepzia"},"9":{"text":"Thupiak sungah, “Na kipalngul heak vun; mihing na that heak vun; na nguta heak vun; midangte neisa dungawk thin na nei heak vun,” hite theampo le a dangte sia, “Na innpaamte nangma na ki it bangin na it in,” ci thukham in huam siat hi.","ref":"Pu 20:13-15; Thkna 5:17-19; Pu 20:17; Thkna 5:21; Thiam 19:18"},"10":{"text":"Ki itna in a innpaamte tungah, a ngamta khial ngei buatu hi; tua ahikom ki itna in Thukham buppi nitna ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Hisia na vawt uh kul hi, banghang ziam cile, na mutna uh panin, na khanlaw natu a hun cing zo hi, ci in na he uh hi. Ih upciil lai sangin tu in ih kingup natu naizaw zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Zan hun bo dek zo a, sun hun hong theng dektak zo hi. Khuazing taw a kisai nate ih sepna panin tawp tawng; khuavak sungah kidona ngalvanhte zamh tawng."},"13":{"text":"Sun khuavak sungah a teangte bangin, eite a kilawmin ih ngamta tu hi — Lawplaina, zukhamna, a maizumhuai ngamtatna, kihauna tua ahibuale ki eennate ih vawt buatu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuate taangin Topa Jesus Christ ngalhiamte zamhin, cii le sa deina a lungkimsak thei lungngulnate na kheal tavun."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note sungah upna zawngkhalte na saang vun. Ahihang amate ii aituam ngaisutnate tungtaang ah na kinial heak vun.","title":"Khat le Khat tungah Thukhen Heak vun","ref":"Col 2:16"},"2":{"text":"Mihing khat in a upna hu in, neak thei theampo a ne hi, ahihang upna zawngkhal khat in nga le tee bek ne hi."},"3":{"text":"Neak thei theampo a nepa in, tuabangin a ne ngawl pa zawngsak heak hen; tuabang ma in nga le tee te bek a nepa in a sik theampo a nepa sit heak hen, banghang ziam cile Pathian in ama zongh saang zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngualdang khat ii naseamte a sit tu in nang in bang thu nei ni ziam? Amate nasepna a zaw le a lel huvau a sit tu in a Topa om hi. Amate in zo tu hi, banghang ziam cile Topa in amate zosak tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihing khat in ni tuam khat sia a dang nite sangin thupi zaw in ngaisun hi, tua laitakin mihing dang khat in ni theampo a kibangin ngaisun hi. Amate khat simin a thinsung uh khensat tahen."},"6":{"text":"Ni tuam khat a thupi tuamin a ngaisun sia in Topa upatna taw ngaisun ahi hi; bang khat po a ne khat in Topa upatna taw ne ahi hi; banghang ziam cile ama in Pathian ii a piak an atu in lungdamko hi. Bang khat po neak tu a ten sia zongh in Topa upatna taw a ten hi a, ama zongh in Pathian tungah lungdamko hi."},"7":{"text":"Eite sungah khat zongh in ama nguak atu in a nungta ih om bua a — ama nguak atu in a thi zongh ih om bua hi."},"8":{"text":"Ih nungta le Topa atu a nungta ih hi a, ih thi le zong Topa atu a thi ih hi hi. Tua ahikom ih thi a ih nungta zong Topa ii neisa ih hi hi."},"9":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile a thite le a nungtate ii Topa ahi natu in Christ thi a nuntakna sungah tho hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahile note antee bek a nete in — na suapuite tungah banghangin thusit nu ziam — Banghangin no na theampo a nete in na suapuite zawngsak nu ziam? Eite theampo thusitna thuak tu in, Pathian mai ah ih ding tu hi.","ref":"2 Cor 5:10"},"11":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in, “A nungta Pathian ka hi bangma in, mihing theampo ka mai ah khupdin tu a, tuaciangin mihing theampo in kei sia Pathian ka hina pualaak tu uh hi, Topa in ci hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 45:23"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom eite khat simin ih hi babang Pathian tungah ih pualaak tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom khat le khat, thu ih kikhen buatu hi. Tua hi ngawl zaw in na khensat tu uh sia in hisia ahi hi. Na suapuipa lutu natu ahizong, mawna sung a pu natu ahizong bangma vawt heak vun.","title":"Na Suapuipa Puksak Heak in"},"14":{"text":"Topa Jesus taw ka kikopna panin ka heak thu khat in bang ziam cile an khat pawpo in ama nguakin a nin om ngawl hi; ahihang mihing khat in an khat nin hi ci in a um le ama atu in tua an sia nin hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang khat po na neak uh sia in na suapuipa thin nop ngawlna a piangsak le ki itna taw ngamtatna hi nawn ngawl hi. Na neakna uh taw Christ ii thina taw a tat sa mihing khat na lalsak heak vun."},"16":{"text":"Pha hi ci in na ngaisutte uh na zangh khial heak vun."},"17":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian Ngam in neakna le dawnna thu hi ngawl a, Thaa Thiangtho ii piak thutang suana, thinnopna le lungdamna thu ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"A kua po ahizong hi bang a, Christ atu nasep a seamte in Pathian lungdamsak a, mihingte in lungkim pui hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom khat le khat atu in thinnopna le kithahatsak nate a piangsak nate na ngiim tawntung tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Anneak huvau taw Pathian nasepna lalsak heak vun. An theampo neak thei ahihang, mihing khat po mawna sungah a puksak tu an ne heak vun."},"21":{"text":"Na suapuipa a puk natu a piangsak thei sa ahizong, sapittui ahizong, ngamtatna khat pawpo ahizong, tang le uhte ngamtatna maanbel ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Hite huvau ah na upnate in nangma le Pathian kilaklaw thu ahikom na thinsung ah keam po tavun. Maan a sakte a sep ciangin a kithasung ngawl pa sia a lungdampa ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang ama in a neak a dawnte tungah thinnop ngawlna a nei le, tuate a neak laitak mama in, Pathian in ama mawsak hi, banghang ziam cile ama ngamtatna in upna tungah a kibulphu bua hi. Upna a kibulphu ngawl na khat pawpo in mawna ahi hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Upna sungah a thahat eite in, upna note vanh ngit dawnin ih hu natu ahi hi. Eima nop bek ih zong buatu hi.","title":"Mihing dangte Diksak tu in Ngamta zaw vun"},"2":{"text":"Tua hi ngawlin eite khat simin ih suapuipa phattuam natu le upna sungah ih khantosak natu in, ama diksak tu in ih ngamta tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Christ in ama ii nop a kizui bua hi. Tuabang hi ngawlin, laithiangtho ci bangin, “No hong selnote ii hong selnona sia kei tungah hong tu hi,” a ci bangin ngual atu in nungta hi.","ref":"Ps 69:9"},"4":{"text":"Eite thin sauna le hanthotna tungtawn a, upna ih nei natu in, Laithiangtho sungah a ki atte theampo in eite hong hil natu a ki at ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Thuak zawkna le hanthotna ii a naak ahi Pathian in, Jesus Christ zia na zuina uh taw note sungah tuabang khua ngaisutna hong piangsak tahen."},"6":{"text":"Note theampo in aw khat sa in, ih Topa Jesus Christ ii pa ahi Pathian na pok vun."},"7":{"text":"Pathian minthan natu in Christ ii note hong saan bangma in, note zongh khat le khat na kisaang vun.","title":"Gentile te atu Lungdamna Thupha"},"8":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian in thumaan a, amate ii pute pate tungah a kamciamte tungsak tu ahikom,"},"9":{"text":"Gentile te ngawngawn zongh in Pathian ii hesuakna a pok thei natu in Christ in Jew te naseampa suak hi kong ci hi. Laithiangtho in, “Tua ahikom Gentile te sung pan ka lungdamna nang tungah kong ko tu a, pokna la ka sa tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"2 Sa 22:50; Ps 18:49"},"10":{"text":"Hi bangin ci thua hi, “Gentile te awng, Pathian ii mite taw lungdam vun!”","ref":"Thkna 32:43"},"11":{"text":"A ci kikna panin, “Topa pok vun, Gentile theampo awng; Pok vun, mihing theampo awng!”","ref":"Ps 117:1"},"12":{"text":"Isaiah zongh in, “Jesse suan khat hong piang tu a; ama in Gentile te a uk tu in hong pai tu hi, tuaciangin amate in ama ii tungah, lametna nei tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 11:10"},"13":{"text":"Thaa Thiangtho thahatna taw, na lametna sungah na khanto natu in, lametna ii naak ahi Pathian in ama na upna uh hu in, lungdamna le thinnopna taw hong kidimsak tahen."},"14":{"text":"Suapuite awng, note phatna taw kidim tu in kong um a, heakna ci theampo zongh nei in, khat le khat kihil thei tawntung tu in kong um hi.","title":"Paul ii Hangsan takin Lai a at Ngamna"},"15":{"text":"Ahihang kong phawksak ngei thute tungtawnin hi laithak sungah ka hangsan mama hi. Tuabangin ka han ngawpna in banghang ziam cile Pathian in hunpha hong pia a, Gentile te atu a diang tu in,"},"16":{"text":"Jesus Christ ii naseampa hong suasak hang ahi hi. Thaa Thiangtho ii a aap Gentile te, Pathian ii saan thamman biakpiakna ahi thei natu in Pathian tung panin hong pai Lungdamna Thupha hil in thiampi khat bangin ka diang hi."},"17":{"text":"Jesus Christ taw pumkhat ka hina hangin Pathian nasep ka sepna huvau ah ka kisuangtaak thei hi."},"18":{"text":"Gentile te ii Pathian thu a nit natu lamhil tu in Christ in kei tungtawnin na hong sepna sa hang bekin hang takin ka pau ngam hi. Tua nasepna sia kammal le ngamtatna taw hong seam zo a,"},"19":{"text":"nalamdang lakna le a lamdang nate ii vaangletna le Pathian Thaa ii vaangletna taw hong seam zo hi. Tua ahiciang Jerusalem pan Illyricum ah khualhaw in ka paina ah Christ huvau Lungdamna Thupha a cingin ka thangsak zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka tup ka sawm sia in, ngualdang khat po ii cian sa phungkawngte tungah inn a sa ka sua ngawl natu in Christ min a kiza ngeingawlna munte bek ah Lungdamna Thupha thansak tawntung tu ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Laithiangtho zongh in, “A thu a kihil ngeingawl mite in ama a mu tu hi, tuaciangin a za ngeingawlte in a tel tu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 52:15"},"22":{"text":"Hi bangin note kungah kong pai tu tamvei ma hong kikhak zo hi.","title":"Paul ii Rome khua Haw tu A sawmna","ref":"Rom 1:13"},"23":{"text":"Ahihang tu in hi ngamkhente sungah ka nasepte ka man zo a, kum tam mama note taw kimu tu in hong pai nuam top ka hi hu in,"},"24":{"text":"tu in hong pai thei tu in ka kilamen hi. Spain ngam ah ka pai lamin note taw ka kimu nuam a, tawmvei kong taam zawkciangin, tua munah ka pai natu hong hu le uhte ka uk hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahitazong, tu laitak Jerusalem ah a om Pathian mite atu seam tu in ka pai tu hi.","ref":"1 Cor 16:1-4"},"26":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Macedonia le Achaia pawlpite in Jerusalem ah Pathian mi a cimawte huna tu sum pia tu in, amate thu in khensat zo uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Hisia amate mama ii khensat ahi hi; ahihang a tatakin ci leang amate in tua mizawngte a hu tu sia a sep tu ahi hi. Jew te in thaa lam sangah thuphate Gentile te a hop bangma, Gentile te zongh in Jew te sia a leitung neisate taw a hu kik kul hi.","ref":"1 Cor 9:11"},"28":{"text":"Hi nasep ka man zawkciang amate atu a kikhon sumte a bup in, amate tungah ka aap zawkciang Spain ngam ah ka pai tu a, ka pai lam in kong baang tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Kong pai ciangin Christ thupha a kicing taw kong pai tu sia ka he hi."},"30":{"text":"Suapuite awng, ih Topa Jesus Christ hang le, Thaa ii hong piak itna hu in, Pathian tungah kei atu in nasia takin thu nong nget pui natu in kong thuum hi."},"31":{"text":"Judea ngam thu um ngawlte khut sung pan hong kep natu le Jerusalem ah ka nasepna in Pathian ii mihingte atu a kisaang thei ahi natu in thu hong ngetsak tavun."},"32":{"text":"Tua hi a, lungdam in note kungah kong pai tu a, Pathian ii deina ahile, thathak laakna in note kungah kong haw tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Ih thinnopna ii naak ahi, Pathian in note theampo taw hong om tahen. Amen."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cenchreae pawlpi ah a seam ih suapuinu Phoebe sia note tungah ka pokna kam kong thaak hi.","title":"Aituam Paupuina"},"2":{"text":"Pathian ii mihingte ngamtat tu bangin Topa min taw ama na saang vun a, tuaciangin huna zongh note tung panin a kisap babang na pia vun; banghang ziam cile ama in mihing tam ma ii lawm pha hi a, kei atu zong lawm pha khat ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Jesus Christ sungah ka naseppui Priscilla le Aquila tungah paupuina kam ka thaak hi;","ref":"Sawl 18:2"},"4":{"text":"Amate in kei atu in a nuntakna aitaa ngam hi; amate tungah ka lungdam hi — kei nguak bek zongh hi ngawlin, Gentile pawlpi mite theampo zongh a lungdam uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate inn ah a kikhawm pawlpi tung zongh ah paupuina kam ka thaak hi. Asia ngamkhen pan Christ a um phitbelpa, ka it ka lawm Epaenetus tung zongh ah paupuina kam ka thaak hi."},"6":{"text":"Note atu in nasia takin na a seam Mary ka paupui hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka Jew mipui, kei taw thongtaak khawm Andronicus le Junia tungah paupuina kam ka thaak hi; amate sia sawltakte in pha takin a heak uh hi a, kei sangin Tapidaw a suak masazawte ahi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa kipawlna sungah ih seppui Ampliatus ka it ka lawm zongh ka paupui hi."},"9":{"text":"Christ nasepna sungah ih seppui Urbanus le Stachys ka it ka lawmte zongh ka paupui hi."},"10":{"text":"Apelles ka paupui hi, ama ii Christ tungah a thumaanna sia sit natu om ngawl hi. Aristobulus innkuanpuite tungah paupuina kam ka thaak hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka Jew mipui Herodion le Narcissus innkuanpuite sung Tapidaw suapuite ka paupui hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa nasepna sungah a seam Tryphaena le Tryphosa luangin, Topa nasepna sungah nasia takin a seam ka it ka lawm Persis ka paupui hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa nasepna sungah a kician tuamin a seam Rufus le a tapa bang tatak a hong vawt, a nu tungah paupuina kam ka thaak hi.","ref":"Mk 15:21"},"14":{"text":"Ka paupuina kam Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas le Hermas le a dang amate taw a om Christ mite ka thaak hi."},"15":{"text":"Philologus le Julia, Nereus le a suapuinu le Olympas le amate taw a om Pathian mite theampo ka paupui siat hi."},"16":{"text":"Khat le khat unau ki itna taw kipaupui in na kinamh vun. Christ pawlpite theampo in no hong paupui hi."},"17":{"text":"Suapuite awng: pawl khenna piangsak a, mihingte upna a lumlette, tuaciang na saansa kihilnate a langpante encik tavun a, amate kung pan na kikeam tavun.","title":"A khakbel Kihilna"},"18":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile tuabangin a ngamtate in ih Topa Christ atu in a seamte hi ngawl a, amate ngilpi atu in a seamte ahi uh hi. Amate in kamneal le kisialpoknate taw bangma a he ngawl mihing pawlkhat a theam uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Lungdamna thu tungah na thumaan uh sia a kuama po in hong he a, tua hu in note huvau in ka lungdam hi. A pha nate ah na ciim tavun a, a sia tungtaang ah na paubaang heak vun."},"20":{"text":"Tuaciang ih thinnopna ii naak ahi Pathian in Satan sia hai ngawlin na peang nuai ah siiktham tu hi. Ih Topa Jesus thuthiamna in note taw hong om tahen."},"21":{"text":"Ka naseppui Timothy in hong paupui hi; tuasia bangma Lucius, Jason le Sosipater, ka Jew minampuite zongh in hong paupui hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"22":{"text":"Hi lai a atpa keima, Tertius in Tapidaw kipaupuina lai kong thaak hi."},"23":{"text":"A inn sia pawlpi kikhopna in a kizangh ka zintunna pa Gaius zongh in hong paupui hi; khuapi sumkeampa Erastus le ih suapui Quartus in hong paupui hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:29; 1 Cor 1:14; 2 Tim 4:20"},"24":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus Christ ii thuthiamna note theampo taw hong om tahen."},"25":{"text":"Eite in Pathian tungah minthanna pia tawng. Jesus Christ huvau Lungdamna Thupha ka hilna bang le a bosa hun sau mama sungah a kiseal thumaan thutak hong kilak bangin Ama in na upna uh sungah kip takin na din thei natu in vawt thei hi.","title":"Pokna Thunget Khupna"},"26":{"text":"Tu in ahile kamsaangte lai atna sung panin tua thumaan thutak sia a kilanghtakna ah kikoi zo hi; tuaciangin a nungta tawntung Pathian sawlna taw minam theampo in um a, a nit thei natu in amate tungah kihesak zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Ciimna namcin a nei, khatbek ahi Pathian tungah Jesus Christ tungtawnin minthanna kip tawntung tahen! Amen."}}}}},"46":{"info":{"name":"Corinthte Khatna","shortname":"1Cor","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ii deina taw Jesus Christ sawltak tu in a kisam Paul le ih suapuipa Sosthenes in —"},"2":{"text":"Corinth khua ah a om Pathian ii pawlpi tung le Pathian ii mi thiangthote suak tu in a kisam sa, Jesus Christ taw kipumkhatna ah ama ii neisa a suak mi theampo, mun theampo ah amate le eite ii Topa ahi ih Topa Jesus Christ a bia mihing theampo tungah lai kong thaak hi:","ref":"Sawl 18:1"},"3":{"text":"Ih Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ in thuthiamna le thinnopna hong pia tahen."},"4":{"text":"Jesus Christ tungtawnin note a thuthiamna hong piak hu in, ka Pathian tungah note atu lungdam ka ko tawntung hi.","title":"Christ sungah Thuphate"},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Christ taw na kipumkhat uh hu in, kampauna le heakna theampo pan kipan na theampo ah a hau na suak zo uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Christ ii thu sia no sungah kip takin kiphut zo ahikom,"},"7":{"text":"ih Topa Jesus Christ hong kilangh tu ngakin na om laitakin, thupha khat beak zongh na taan bua uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Topa Jesus Christ ii Ni hong thet ni ciang, na pauban ngawl natu in ama in a tawpna dong kip takin hong keam si tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Eima ii Topa ahi a Tapa Jesus Christ taw kipawl khawm tu a, note hong sam Pathian sia ih muan tu Pathian ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus Christ thuneina taw, ka suapui note theampo tungah kong maangkaa hi, note sungah kikhenna a om ngawl natu in, na ci uh po kithukim vadiam vun. Ngaisutna khat le tupna khat bek taw na kipawl siat vun.","title":"Pawlpi sungah Kikhennate"},"11":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, ka suapuite awng, note sungah kihauna om hi ci in Chloe ii innkuanpui pawlkhat in thiang takin hong son zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Kong cinopna pan, note khat simin thu tuatuam son nu hi. Khat in “Kei sia Paul ii nungzui ka hi hi,” ci a; a dang khat in, “Kei sia Apollos ii nungzui ka hi hi,” ci a; a dangkhat in, “Kei sia Peter ii nungzui ka hi hi,” ci a; tuaciang a dangkhat in, “Keima sia Christ ii nungzui ka hi hi,” na ci uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:24"},"13":{"text":"Christ sia pawl tuatuamin kikhentham hi! No atu in thinglamtee tungah a thi sia in Paul hina ziam? Paul nungzui tu in tui na kiphum uh ziam?"},"14":{"text":"Crispus le Gaius simngawl, note kuama tui kong phum ngawl hu in, Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:8; 19:29; Rom 16:23"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom kuama in note sia kei nungzui suak tu in tui kiphum hi hong ci thei ngawl tu hi."},"16":{"text":"(Oh hi peu hi, Stephanas le a innkuanpuite zongh tuiphum peu khi hi; tua ngawl po kuama dang tui ka phum le ka phum ngawl ciamtee ngawl khi hi.)","ref":"1 Cor 16:15"},"17":{"text":"Christ in tuiphum tu in kei hong sawl bua hi. Ama in Lungdamna Thupha son tu in, hong sawl hi, tuaciang thinglamtee tungah Christ a thina ii vaangletna a bo thong ngawl natu in, mihing ciimna kam zangh ngawlin son tu in hong sawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile a mangthang mihingte atu in thinglamtee tungah Christ ii thina thu sia, luithawthong thu ahi hi, ahizong ngupna a nga eite atu in Pathian ii vaangletna ahi hi.","title":"Christ sia Pathian ii Vaangletna le Ciimna"},"19":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “Mihing a ciimte ii ciimna ka lalsak tu a, pilna saang neite ii heakna sia ka hepsak tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 29:14"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahile mihing ciimte, pilna saang neite, ahibuale leitung ah thu kinialna a thiamte sia bang suak tu ziam? Hi leitung ciimna sia mawmawtna hi ci in Pathian in lak zo hi!","ref":"Job 12:17; Is 19:12; 33:18; 44:25"},"21":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian in ama ii ciimna hong zangh a, mihingte in amate ciimna taw Pathian a heak zawk ngawl natu in vawt hi. “Mawmawt” thu hi a ci uh kote thuhilna taw, Pathian in thu umte ngup tu in khensat zaw hi."},"22":{"text":"A up thei natu in Jew te in nalamdang laknate kalhsuut uh a, tuaciang Greek te in ciimna zong uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ko ka hi uh le thinglamtee tung a kithat Christ thu ka thangsak uh a, tua thu sia Jew te atu in a maktak huai thu le Gentile te atu in a luithawthong thu ahi hi;"},"24":{"text":"ahizong Pathian ii sapsa Jew te le Gentile te atu in hi thu sia Pathian ii vaangletna le Pathian ii ciimna ahi Christ ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian ii mawmawtna bang ahi sia in mihingte ciimna sangin ciimzaw a, tuaciangin Pathian ii thazawmna bang ahi sia in mihingte thahatna sangin hat zaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Suapuite awng, Pathian in note hong sap laitakin, na omzia uh ngaisun vun. Mihingte hong muna ah note sungah a ciim, ahibuale a vaanglian, ahibuale a ci thei tawm bek na om uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Pathian in mihing ciimte maizumsak natu in, leitung mite ii lui thawthong a sakte teal a, mihing thahatte a maizumsak natu in, leitung mite ii thazawm a sakte teal luih hi."},"28":{"text":"Leitung ii thupi a sakte, a lalsak natu in leitung ii a nomu, a zawnsak le bangma in a hen ngawlte teal hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua sia in, Pathian mai ah a kisathei tu kuama a om bua hi, a cinopna hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahihang, Pathian in note Christ Jesus taw hong kipumkhatsak zo hi; Pathian in Christ sia eite ii ciimna suaksak zo hi. Ama hangin Pathian mai ah thutang in hong koi hi; eite Pathian ii mi thiangthote suakin, hong suaktasak hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahiciangin laithiangtho in, “A kisuangtaak nuamte in, Topa vawtsate tungah a kisuangtaak kul tu hi,” a ci bangma ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 9:24"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Suapuite awng, Pathian ii a thumaan thuku hil tu in note kungah kong pai lai in kamthukte le pilna thiamna kong zangh bua hi.","title":"Thinglamtee tung a kithat Christ ii Thu"},"2":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile note taw ka om laitakin, Jesus Christ thu, a tuanin thinglamtee tungah hong thina thute simngawl po thudang teng makngil natu ka khensat sa hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahikom note kungah kong pai lai in, thazawmin launa taw ka liingcip a,","ref":"Sawl 18:9"},"4":{"text":"thu kong hil ciangin mihing ciimna thiamna kammalte kong zangh bua hi, ahizong Pathian Thaa vaangletna hong lakna taw kong hil ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom note upna sia mihing ciimna tungah kinga ngawlin Pathian ii vaangletna tungah kinga zaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahizongin thaa lamsang ah a khanthin sate tungah ciimna thu ka thangsak hi. Ahihang tua ciimna in hi leitung ciimna, ahibuale a bo kuan ahi, hi leitung vaangletna a nei leitung ukte ciimna ahi bua hi.","title":"Pathian ii Ciimna"},"7":{"text":"Tua ka thansak ciimna thu sia mihingte ii heak ngawl tu in a kiseal Pathian ii ciimna thuku hi a, ahihang eite minthanna tu in, leitung pian ma ngawngawn in, Pathian koi sa thu ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Hi leitung a uk mihingte kuama in, hi ciimna thu a he bua uh hi. He hile, a minthang Topa sia thinglamtee tungah a thatlum buatu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahitazong, laithiangtho in, “Kuama ii a mu ngeingawl a zaak ngeingawl, suak thei tu in a ngaisut ngeingawl thu sia, ama a itte atu in Pathian ii a vawtkhol sa ahi hi,” a ci bangma ahi hi.","ref":"Is 64:4"},"10":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in a Thaa taw tua thuku sia eite hong telsak hi. Tua Thaa in Pathian tupnate ii a kiseal a thuthukte dong ngawngawnin na theampo a kan hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihing khat ii thu theampo sia ama sungah a om a thaa bekma in he hi; tuabang ma in Pathian thu theampo zongh, Pathian Thaa bekma in he hi."},"12":{"text":"Eite in hi leitung ii thaa ih saang bua hi; Pathian ii hong piaksa thu theampo ih heak thei natu in, Pathian hong puak Thaa a saangte ih hizaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Thaa a neite tungah thaa taw kisai thumaan thutakte ka hil uh ciangin mihing ciimna ii hong hil kammalte ka pau bua uh a, Thaa ii hong hil kammalte ka pau uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua Thaa a nei ngawl peuma in, Pathian Thaa kung pan hong pai thute a saang thei bua hi. Tuabang mihing khat in tua thute tel tatak ngawl hi; ama atu in tuate luithawthong thu ahi hi, banghang ziam cile thaa bulphuna taw bekin a man neina kikhentel thei ahihang hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua Thaa a nei peuma in na theampo ii man neina khentel thei ahihang kuama in ama tungah thu a khen thei bua hi."},"16":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “Topa thinsung akua in he ziam? Akua in ama, ngaisutna pia thei tu ziam?” a ci bangma ahi hi. Ahizong, eite in Christ thinsung ih nei hi.","ref":"Is 40:13"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Suapuite awng, a tatakin ci leang, Thaa a nei mihingte tungah ka pau bangin note tungah kong pau thei bua hi; hi leitung ii neisa, Tapidaw upna sungah patang a hite bangin note tungah kong pau kul hi.","title":"Pathian ii Naseamte"},"2":{"text":"No sia noaitui bek taw kong vaak a, antak kong pia bua hi, banghang ziam cile antak ne thei tu na hi bualai uh hi. Tu ma zonghin antak a ne thei tu hi ngawl lai nu hi,","ref":"Heb 5:12-13"},"3":{"text":"banghang ziam cile note in hi leitung mihingte nuntak zia taw ma in na nungta lai uh hi. Note sungah ki eenna om a, khat le khat na kihau uh ciangin, hi thu in note leitung neisa na hi na uh le leitung om zia taw nungta na hina uh hong lak hi ngawl ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Note sung pan khat in, ‘Kei Paul nung ka zui hi,’ a dang khat in, ‘Kei Apollos nung ka zui hi,’ na ci uh ciang leitung mihingte pianzia bangin a ngamta hi ngawl nu ziam?","ref":"1 Cor 1:12"},"5":{"text":"A tatakin Apollos sia akua ziam? Tuaciang Paul sia akua ziam? Kote in note ii thu na up thei natu uh in hong lampui Pathian naseamte hi bek lel khu hi. Topa ii seam a hong sawl bangin koma khat simin a seam ka hi uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Kei in thaicii ka poai a, Apollos in a kung tuibuak in, ahihang a khangtosak sia Pathian ahi hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:4; 11:24-28"},"7":{"text":"A poaipa le tui a buakpa sia a thupi tatak bua hi. A thupi sia in Pathian ahi hi, banghang ziam cile ama in a kung khangsak hi."},"8":{"text":"A poaipa le tui a buakpa in kilamdanna nei ngawl hi; Pathian in amate sep babangin tel pia tek tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile kote sia Pathian taw kipawlin naseam khawmte ka hi uh a, note in Pathian ii lo na hi uh hi. Note in Pathian inn na hi si uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Pathian hong piak hesuakna thupha zangh in, inn sa thiampa ii nasep teng ka seam a, a tawdap phungkawng ka phasak hi, tuaciangin ngualdang khat in tua ii tungah sa to hi. Ahihang mihing sim in, bangbangin inn kisa ziam, ci in a kidop kul hi."},"11":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian in Jesus Christ sia khat bek ahi tawdap phungkawng tu in pha zo a, a dang tawdap phungkawng a kipha thei nawn buatu hi."},"12":{"text":"Pawlkhatte in khamh, ahibuale ngunn, ahibuale suangmanpha sia phungkawng tungah inn sakna in zangh tu hi; a dangte in thing, ahibuale lopa, ahibuale taangphaw zangh tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaciang mihing khat sim ii nasepna a phat le a phat ngawl sia Christ Ni in a pholaak ciangin kimu tu hi. Banghang ziam cile tua Ni in meikuang in mihing sim ii nasepna kilanghsak tu hi; meikuang in tua nasepnate sittel tu a, a phatna le a siatna lak thiang tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Phungkawng tungah a kisa sia meikuang in a kaanghsak zo buale, inn sapa in tel nga tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang khat po ii nasepna sia a kaanghtum le, a nasep teng sumh tu hi; ahihang ama ahile kaanghmei sung pan a suakta khat bangin ngupna nga tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Note in Pathian biakinn na hi uh a, no sungah Pathian Thaa hong teang nginge ahi sia na he takpi uh hi!","ref":"1 Cor 6:19; 2 Cor 6:16"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom khat po in Pathian biakinn a susia le, Pathian in ama susia tu hi. Banghang ziam cile Pathian biakinn sia thiangtho a, note mama in ama biakinn na hi uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Kuama in ama le ama kitheam heak hen. Note sungah khat po in ama le ama sia, leitung paizia taw etna in, ciim a kisa le a ciim takpi ahi natu in a mawmawt phot kul tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile hi leitung ii ciimna hi ci in a ngaisutte sia Pathian muna ah luithawthong ahi hi. Laithiangtho in, “Pathian in a ciimte sia amate pilna thaang sungah man hi,” ci hi;","ref":"Job 5:13"},"20":{"text":"tuaciang Laithiangtho dangkhat in, “Topa in a ciimte ngaisutna sia mannung ngawl hi, ci in he hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 94:11"},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom kuama in mihingte vawt thei thute sungah kisuangtaak heak hen. A tatakin na theampo note neisa ahi hi:"},"22":{"text":"Paul, Apollos le Peter; hi leitung, nuntakna le thina, tu hun le maisang hun — hite theampo noma aa ahi hi,"},"23":{"text":"tuaciangin note sia Christ neisa na hi uh a, Christ sia Pathian neisa ahi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kote sia Pathian thumaan thukute a keamcing tu a, hong kikoi Christ ii naseamte hi ci in nong ngaisut tu uh ahi hi.","title":"Christ ii Sawltakte"},"2":{"text":"Tuabang naseam khat ii a taangsap thu sia a topa tungah a thumaan tu bek ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu in kei tungah note na hi uh zong, mihing muna bang ahizong thu nong khen uh hang ka awlmaw bua hi; keima le keima zongh thu ka kikhen bua hi."},"4":{"text":"Kithasunna ka nei bua hi, ahihang tuasia in mawnei ngawl tatak hi ci na ahi bua hi. Kei tungah thu hong khen sia in Topa ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom note in a hun tatak hong thet ma in kuama tungah thu na khen heak vun. Thukhenna a khakbel sia in Topa hong pai dong a ngak kul tu hi; ama in khuazing sungah a om thukute, khuavak sungah kilanghsak tu a, tuaciang mihingte thinsung ah a kiseal tupnate a pholaak tu hi. Tuaciang mihing sim in ama taw kilawm Pathian ii pokna nga tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, suapuite awng, “Ngeina maante na zui vun,” a ci kam tepteena sia ii a cinopna na heak thei natu uh in hi teng theampo sia Apollos le keima tungah ka sin zo uh a, koma nii sia ettee tu lim bangin ka kizangh uh hi. Note in mihing khat pawpo kiphatsak pui in, midang khat pawpo zawngsak heak vun."},"7":{"text":"Akua in note ngualdangte sangin a thupizaw in hong piangsak ziam? Na neisa uh theampo Pathian hong piaksa hi ngawl ziam? Tua ahile pha hi, na neisa uhte sia letsong ahi ngawl bang phetin, bangbangin kiphatsak pui thei tu nu ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Na kisap uh theampo nei zo nu ziam? A hau sa hi zo nu ziam? Ko zongh kumpi suak ngawl lai a, no kumpipate suak zo nu ziam? Pha hi, kote noma taw kumpipate ka sua khop thei natu in kumpi suak takpi le uhte kong oai hi."},"9":{"text":"Ko sawltakte sia vantunglalangte le mihing nam bup ii a et tu in mihon mai ah thidaan thuak tu mite bangin Pathian in a tawp khakna mun ma ah hong koi taw kibang ka sa hi."},"10":{"text":"Christ atu in kote a mawmaw ka suak uh a, ahihang note in Christ taw na kipumkhatna uh hu in, mihing ciimte na hi uh hi! Kote ka tha uh zawm a, ahihang note sia na hat uh hi: Kote hong kizawngsak ahihang note hong kizatak vawt hi!"},"11":{"text":"Hi hun dong mama in kote ngilkial dangtaak in ka om uh hi; puansia ngapkaai ka sil uh a; kote hong kisaat hi; mun khat pan mun khat ah ka vak kawkoai uh hi;"},"12":{"text":"nasep haksate ka sep uh manin ka zawm dikdek uh hi. Hong kitomlaw ciangin thupha ka pia uh hi; hong kivawtsiat ciangin ka thuak uh hi;","ref":"Sawl 18:3"},"13":{"text":"hong kilan ciangin kamthiam taw ka zo kik uh hi. Kote in hi leitung ninteakte bang ka hi lel uh a; tu hun dong mama in, ko sia leitung mihing nilnamte ka hi uh hi!"},"14":{"text":"Hisia note tungah kong atna in, no hong maizumsak nuam hi ngawlin, keima ii ka it ka tate bang a, kong pau nop hang ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, na Tapidaw nuntakna sungah hong keam hong en tu 10,000 na nei hial uh zong pa khat bek na nei uh hi. Banghang ziam cile Christ taw kipumkhat in na nuntakna sungah Lungdamna Thupha note tungah kong puak hu in note ii pa ka suak zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahiciang keima ettee in nong zui tu uh kong dei hi.","ref":"1 Cor 11:1; Php 3:17"},"17":{"text":"Hi thu hu in, Tapidaw nuntakna sungah ka it a thumaan ka tapa Timothy kong paisak hi. Christ Jesus taw kipumkhat a, nuntakna thak sungah ka zui thubulphute le, mun theampo ah a om pawlpi teng tungah ka hil thu sia ama in hong phawksak tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Keima sia note kungah hong haw ngawl tu hi ci in nong ngaisut uh hu in, mihing pawlkhat kiphasak zo uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahizong Topa deina a om le, note kungah hong pai pal tu khi hi, tuasia ciang, hi mihing kiphasakte in a kam teng bek hi ngawl a, bangza vaangletna nei ziam, ci sia keima tatak ma in ka mu tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian Ngam in kammal taw hi ngawlin vaangletna taw kip hi."},"21":{"text":"Ciang uai taw kong pai tu ahibuale ki itna le cikna taw kong pai tu a koisia deizaw nu ziam?"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in, Pathian he ngawlte sung zongh ah a om ngeingawl, a patau huai numei le pa paktatna note sungah om hi, ci in kison takpi hi. Pasal khat sia a nu kik taw lumkhawm hi, ci in hong kison hi!","title":"Pawlpi sung Paktatna","ref":"Thkna 22:30"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahile bangbangin kiphasak thei tu nu ziam? Tua ci thada, na khuangai mama natu uh hi a, tuabang a ngamta pasal sia zongh no kipawlna sung panin na hawlkhiat tu uh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka pumpi sia note taw kikhuala hi kaleng, ka thaa sia note taw omkhawm nginge hi.
