Note taw keima hong om khawm bang keakin, hi a patau huai mama ngamtatna a neipa tungah Topa Jesus min suangin thukhenna ka pia zo hi. Na kikhop uh ciang kei zongh ka thaa taw kong kingawm a, Topa Jesus vaangletna ei sungah a om sia taw,","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Topa Ni ciang a thaa a suatak natu in, a pumpi Satan suksiat natu in tua pa ii pumpi Satan na aap vun."},"6":{"text":"Note na kiphatsak thei natu bangma om ngawl hi! Kam teptee khat ah “Tol tawmno khat in anvuinoai bup pawmsak hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Gal 5:9"},"7":{"text":"Na thiantho sinsen natu in, mawna tol lui sia na lakeak vun. Tua hile tol saw ngawl anvuinoai thak bang na hi tu a, tuabang takpi ma hi ci in, kong heak bang tatak ma na hi tu uh hi. Banghang ziam cile tu in Christ, ih Paisan Poai tuuno sia sangaw biakpiakna in kinei zo ahikom, ih Paisan Poai sia a kinging sa in om zo hi.","ref":"Pu 12:5"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom ih ngitlona le mawna tol lui taw a kivawt anluum taw hi ngawlin tol saw ngawl thumaanna le thianthona anluum taw ih Paisan Poai khaam tawng.","ref":"Pu 13:7; Thkna 16:3"},"9":{"text":"Laithak kong at sa sia sungah mihing paktatte taw na kipawl heak vun ci in kong son zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu in doai bia a, mihing paktat a duhop, ahibuale a nguta, ahibuale milim a biate ka cinopna hi ngawl hi. Tuate pial natu sia, leitung pan na pusua siat uh kul tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Thu um mi khat ka hi a ci hang a paktat, a duhop, milim bia, ngual a siatson, zukham, a nguta sia taw na kipawl heak vun, ka cinopna ahi hi. Tuabang mihing khat taw ankuang uum khawm tu in na to heak vun."},"12":{"text":"A tatakin a pua a om mihingte tungah thukhen tu sia kei taw kisai ngawl hi. Pathian in amate tungah thukhen tu hi. Ahihang noma pawl sung na pawlpuite tungah thu na khen tu uh hi ngawl ziam? laithiangtho sungah, “Note sung panin a ngilo mihing pa na heam vun,” a ci bang ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 13:5; 17:7","merge":"13"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihing khat in a Tapidawpuite khat taw thu a nei ciangin, Pathian ii mihingte ii a khensak tu luangin, bangbangin Pathian he ngawl thukhenmangte mai ah pai ngam ziam?","title":"Tapidaw puite taw Thu kineina"},"2":{"text":"Pathian ii mihingte in leitung ii thukhen tu ahi hunlam he ngawl nu ziam? Pha hi, leitung ii thukhen tu na hi uhle, thunote tungtaang ah thukhen zo ngawl nu ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Vantunglalangte tungah thukhen tu na hi uh hunlam kihe ngawl nu ziam? Tua ahile hi nuntakna sungah thute na khen thei zaw kan tu uh hi!"},"4":{"text":"Tuabang thute hong piang le, pawlpi sungah dinmun a nei ngawl mihingte ii thukhen tu in paipui tu nu ziam?"},"5":{"text":"Note atu in maizumhuai mama hi! Thu kinei Tapidaw puite kilaklaw ah thu a khen thei tu mihing ciim khat beak na pawl sungah om nanak tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua hi napi in Tapidaw thunei khat in a dang khat sia thukhenzum then a, thu um ngawlte in tua thu na khensak zawpum uh hi!"},"7":{"text":"Note sungah na thu kineina uh mama in na nginat ngawlna uh lak hi. Ngual in no tungah hong khial le no atu phazaw ngawl ziam? Ngual in hong suttol le no atu phazaw ngawl ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Tuabang hi tu kimlai, khat le khat tungah khialna na kivawt uh a, suapui tatakte ngawngawn na kisuttol uh hi!"},"9":{"text":"Mihing ngilote in Pathian Ngam lua ngawl het tu ci in he nu hi. Noma le noma kitheam heak vun; mihing a paktatte le milim a biate, palngul mawna a vawtte, pa le pa, numei le numei a khialte,"},"10":{"text":"na ngu theite, a duhopte, zukhamte, ngual ngensia theite, ngutate, hite kuama in Pathian Ngam lua ngawl tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Note pawlkhat in tuabang na ngamta ngei uh hi. Ahihang note sia mawna panin hong kithiansua zo hi; Pathian tungah hong ki aaptuam zo hi. Topa Jesus Christ le eite Pathian ii Thaa in Pathian mai ah note thutang hong suaksak zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Khat po in, “Na khat pawpo ka vawt thei natu thu om hi,” ci tu hi. Hi hi; ahihang na theampo sia nang atu pha siat ngawl hi. Kei zongh na theampo ka vawt thei natu thu om hi ci thei khi hi, ahihang kei sia na khat pawpo ii sila ka kisuaksak buatu hi.","title":"Na Pumpite Pathian Minthan natu zangh vun","ref":"1 Cor 10:23"},"13":{"text":"Khat po in, “An sia ngilpi atu hi a, ngilpi sia an atu hi,” ci tu hi. Hi hi; ahihang tuate ngeal sia Pathian in bosak tu hi. Pumpi sia numei le pa paktatna a zak tu hi ngawl a, Topa ii na seam tu ahi hi; tuaciang Topa in pumpi sia vaakin taa hi."},"14":{"text":"Pathian in Topa sia thina pan tho kiksak a, tuaciang ama ii vaangletna taw eite zongh hong tho kiksak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Na pumpite uh sia Christ' pumpi ii a khen tuatuamte ahi hunlam na he uh hi. Christ ii pumpi sungah a kihel khen khat la in pumpi zuak numei ii khen khat, suaksak tu khi ziam? Tuabang suak thei ngawl hi!"},"16":{"text":"Ahibuale pumpi zuak numei taw a pumpi a ngawm sia in ama taw cii le sa in pumkhat tak khat suak ahi hunlam he ngawl na hi bua uh ziam? Laithiangtho in, “Tuate nii in pumkhat suak tu hi,” ci in thiang takin son hi.","ref":"Pian 2:24"},"17":{"text":"Topa taw a kingawm khat sia ahile ama taw Thaa thu sungah pumkhat suak tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Paktatnate na pial vun. Mihing khat ii mawna dang khat a vawt sia in a pumpi a lalsak bua hi; ahihang numei le pa lamsang a paktatna taw a maw sia ama pumpi tungah maw ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Na pumpi uh sia Pathian hong piak, note sungah a teang Thaa Thiangtho ii biakinn ahi hunlam he ngawl nu ziam? Note pumpi sia noma neisa hi ngawl a, Pathian neisa ahi hi;","ref":"1 Cor 3:16; 2 Cor 6:16"},"20":{"text":"ama in note man pia a, hong leisa na hi uh hi. Tua ahikom na pumpi uh sia Pathian minthan natu in zangh tavun."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in, nong laithakna uh thute huvau kong son tu hi. Pasal khat sia zi nei ngawlin om le pha hi.","title":"Kiteenna vai Doknate"},"2":{"text":"Ahihang paktat ngamtatna tam mama ahikom, pasal khat simin zi khat a nei tu hi a, numei khat simin pasal khat a nei tu ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Pasal in a zi tungah a vaipuak zo a, zi in pasal tungah a vaipuak zo in, a kitaangsapna tetek ah kilungkimsak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Zi in ama ii pumpi a uk hi ngawl a, a pasal ii uk ahi hi; tuasia bangma in a pasal in ama ii pumpi a uk hi ngawl a, a zi ii uk ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Hun khat sung thungetna in hun na zak thei natu uh thukimna nei masa na hi bua na uh le, khat le khat na kinial heak vun; ahihang tua zawkciangin nupa ngeinate zom kik vun. Hi bangin hi le uhte pumpi kitek laakna hangin, a piang Satan ze etna na lel natu uh pan kikeam zo tu nu hi."},"6":{"text":"Hi bang kong ci ciang thu hong pia hi ngawl a, a zangh nuamte zak thei hi cina ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"A tatakin ci leang note theampo, keima bangin om thei le uhte kong oai zaw hi; ahitazong, mihing sim in Pathian tel ih saan tuam tek om a, khat atu in hi tel, a dang khat atu in tua tel, ci in om hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu in zi le pasal nei ngawl laite le meingongte atu in keima bangin, noma nguak ma om suak le uhte phazaw hi ka ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang cii le sa deina, na kitek zo bua uh le, zi le pasal nei vangiat tavun — uukna taw ommawk sangin kiteenna in phazaw hi."},"10":{"text":"A kiteang sa mite atu in keima aituam thupiakna hi ngawlin, Topa thupiakna taw thu kong pia hi: zi in a pasal nusia ngawl het tu hi;","ref":"Mt 5:32; 19:9; Mk 10:11-12; Lk 16:18"},"11":{"text":"ahihang a nusia le ama nguakin tang om top tu hi, tua ahibuale a pasal taw kilem kikna vawt tu hi; tuaciang pasal khat in a zi khul thei ngawl tu hi."},"12":{"text":"A dangte tungah (Topa ci hi ngawl a, keima ci hi): Christ mihing khat in thu um ngawl zi a nei a, tua nu in ama taw a teang tan tu in a thukim le, ama in a zi khul thei ngawl tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaciangin Tapidaw numei khat ii pasal sia thu um ngawl khat hi a, ahihang a zi taw a teang tan tu in a thukim le a zi in khul thei ngawl tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile a zi taw a kingawmna hangin thu um ngawl pasal khat sia Pathian in saang thei hi, tuaciang thu um ngawl zi khat sia Tapidaw pasal khat taw a kingawm uh hu in Pathian in saang thei hi. Hi bang hi ngawl hi thong le a tate sia doai biate tanote taw kibang tu uh hi; ahihang tu a bangin, Pathian in tua tate saang thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahizong thu um ngawl sia in, a teenpui Tapidaw sia a nusia nuam le, nusia thei hi. Tuabang thute sungah Tapidaw ahi zaw sia in, zi ahizong, pasal ahizong, ama uuk bangin ngamta thei hi. Pathian in thinnopna sungah nungta tu in nang hong sam zo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tapidaw zi khat in a pasal ngupna a ngasak zawk tu le a ngasak zawk ngawl tu ahizong, Tapidaw pasal khat in a zi ngupna a ngasak zawk tu le a ngasak zawk ngawl tu sia, he natu ziam?"},"17":{"text":"Note khat simin Topa ii tel hong piak bang le Pathian ii hong sap lai na om uh bangin nungta suak tavun. Hisia in pawlpi theampo tungah zui tu ka hil thu ahi hi.","title":"Pathian Sapna bang Nungta in"},"18":{"text":"Vunteap ki at sa khat in Pathian sapna a saang le ama in vunteap at kitepteenate vawk tu hanciam kul ngawl hi. Vunteap a ki at ngawl khat in, Pathian sapna a saang le, vunteap at kul ngawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile pasal khat vunteap at le at ngawl sia bangma thupi ngawl hi; Pathian thupiakte zui tu sia a thupi ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Pathian ii sapna a saan hun lai a, a omzia babangin, mihing khat simin om tahen."},"21":{"text":"Pathian hong sam laitakin sila khat na hi ziam? Phamaw ngawl hi; ahihang a suakta khat na sua thei natu hunpha na nga le tuasia zangh in."},"22":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Topa ii a sapsa sila khat sia Topa atu a suakta ahi hi; tuasia bangma in, Christ ii a sapsa a suakta mihing khat sia Christ ii sila ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Pathian in man pia in hong leisa na hi uh hi; tua ahikom mihingte sila na suak heak vun."},"24":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, note khat simin hong kisap lai hun a na omzia uh bangin, Pathian taw kithawlin na om top tu uh ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tu in zi nei ngawl pasal nei ngawlte huvau nong dokna taw kisai in: Topa tung panin thupiakna nga ngawl khi hi. Ahihang Topa hesuakna taw a muan taak khat bangin keima ngaisutna kong pia hi.","title":"Zi le Pasal Nei ngawlte le Meingongte"},"26":{"text":"Tu a thinngimna a om sia ngaisun leang, pa khat in ama om babangin a om po tu sia phazaw ka sa hi."},"27":{"text":"Zi na nei zo ziam? Tuabang na nei zo le kikhen tu sawm heak in. Zi nei ngawl lai ni ziam? Tua ahile zi zong heak in."},"28":{"text":"Ahihang zi na nei le mawna khat a vawt na hi bua hi; pasal nei ngawl numei khat in, pasal a nei le ama in mawna vawt ahi bua hi. Ahihang a kiteang mihingte ii ni simin a thuak thei ngimnate taw kipeal le uhte hong oai ka hi hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, ka ci nop sia in hisia ahi hi: hun tam om nawn ngawl ahiciang, tu pan kipan zi nei pasal neite in a nei ngawl bangin om tu uh hi;"},"30":{"text":"a kapte, a hee ngawl bang; a nuite, a lungdam ngawl bang; na a leite, a leisa nate a nei ngawl bang,"},"31":{"text":"leitung thil le vanhte taw kisai in nasep neite in tuate taw hunbit a komla ngawl bangin a om uh kul tu hi. Banghang ziam cile hi leitung in tu a bang ahile, ngei kip nawn ngawl tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Thinngimna pan na suatak tu sia kong deisak hi. Zi nei ngawl khat in Topa nasepna thinbot hi, banghang ziam cile ama in Topa lungkim natu hanciam hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahihang zi nei khat in leitung nate thinbot hi, banghang ziam cile, a zi lungkimsak nuam hi;"},"34":{"text":"tua ahikom ama sia a lang le a lang mun nii panin kikai hi. Pasal nei ngawl numei ahibuale ngaknu thiangtho khat in Topa ii nasepna thinbot hi, banghang ziam cile ama in a pumpi le a thaa kipum aap nuam hi; ahihang pasal nei numei khat in leitung nate thinbot hi, banghang ziam cile ama in a pasal lungkimsak nuam hi."},"35":{"text":"Hi bang teng kong sonna in, noma kong hu nopna hang ahi hi. Note tungah kikhaatnate hong pia nuam hi ngawl khi hi. Tua hizaw ngawlin, a maan le ahi tu bangin seamin, Topa ii na, na sepna sungah kheet nei ngawlin noma le noma na kibuppiak tu ka deina ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Nupa kop tu in a kilungkim sa, a teang ngawl tu in a khensatte thu huvau: a pa sia in a teenpui buale numei tungah a kilawm bangin ngamta ngawl kisa a, tuaciangin cii le sa uukna nasia mama ahikom a kiteen ngawlin phamaw hi ci in a ngaisun kik le, ama uuk bangma in amate kiteang tahen. Hisia sungah khialna mawna om ngawl hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahihang pa khat sia zawthawk thu taw hi ngawlin, kiteang ngawl tu in a thin a khensat le, tuaciang ama deina ki uk takpi zo a, a vawt tu sia khensat zo ahi nale, tua numei a teenpui buale a pha in ngamta ahi hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ahikom zi nei sia zongh thupha seam hi a, ahihang zi nei ngawl pasal sia in thupha seam zaw lai ahi hi."},"39":{"text":"Pasal nei numei khat in a pasal nuntak laiteng a suakta bua hi; ahihang a pasal a thi le a teenpui nop pawpo taw a kiteen thei natu in suakta hi, ahizong Tapidaw khat ahile bek teenpui thei tu hi."},"40":{"text":"Ahihang ama ii om ngei in om pole pasal a nei kik sangin a lungdam zaw tu hi. Tua in keima ngaisutna hi a, tuaciang keima zongh Pathian ii Thaa nei in ka kingaisun hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in milim biakna ah a kizangh an huvau lai nong thaak uhte kong son tu hi. Amate ci bangma in, “Eite theampo in heakna ih nei hi,” ci thu in thumaan ahi hi. Ahizong tuabang heaknate in mihing khat kisatheisak hi; ahihang itna in lemh tawto hi.","title":"Milim Biakna ah A kizangh An huvau"},"2":{"text":"A kuama po he a kisa sia in a heak tu bang tatakin he ngawl ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian a it mihing khat sia Pathian in he hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, milim biakna in a kizangh an neakna huvau ah: milim ih ci sia a om takpi ngawl khat ii taang ahi sia ih he hi; eite in Pathian khat bek om ahi hunlam ih he hi."},"5":{"text":"Vantung ah ahizong leitung ah ahizong “pathiante” a kicite a om hial zong, tuaciang “pathiante le topate” tam ma om kale zong,"},"6":{"text":"eite atu in Pa ahi Pathian khat bek om hi, ama sia na theampo a Bitphuapa hi a, ama atu in eite a nungta ih hi hi; tuaciangin Topa khat bek ahi Jesus Christ om a, ama tungtawnin na theampo kibitphua a, ama tungtawnin eite ih nungta hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahihang hi thumaan thutak sia mihing sim in he ngawl hi. Tuni dong ma mihing pawlkhat te in milimte huvau ah kingeinasee zo a, tua a piaksa an a neak uh ciang milim khat ii neisa an ne bangin kingaisun lai uh hi; amate sia thu tel zo ngawl ahikom, tua an in amate ninsak ci in ngaisun uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahizong an in Pathian taw kizopna phatuamsak ngawl tu hi; ih neak ngawl hang bangma ih sumh buatu a, ih neak hang zong bangma kimeet tuan ngawl tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahizong note suakta in na ngamtatna in, upna ah a thaneam mihingte mawna sungah na puksak ngawl natu in na kidawm tavun."},"10":{"text":"Sonteena in hi thu huvau ah “heakna” a ci sia a nei note ii milim biakbuk ah na anneak uh, ngaisutna thazawm mihing khat in hong mu tu ci leang; tuasia in milim biakna ah a kizangh an a neak ngam natu in thapia suak ngawl tu nu ziam?"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama atu in Christ a thi, hi a thaneam na suapuipa sia nang ii “heakna” hu in lal tu hi!"},"12":{"text":"Hi bangin, na Tapidaw suapuite tungah na maw uh ciang le amate ii a thazawm ngaisutna na belap uh ciangin Christ tungah a maw na tang uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom an in ka suapuipa a khialsak le, ka suapuipa sia mawna sungah ka puksak ngawl natu in, sa ka ne kik ngei nawn buatu hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima sia a suakta mihing khat hi ngawl khi ziam? Sawltakpa khat hi ngawl khi ziam? Ih Topa Jesus mu ngei hi ngawl khi ziam? Topa atu ka sepna ii a nga sia note hi ngawl nu ziam?","title":"Sawltak khat ii Nga tuakte le Sep tute"},"2":{"text":"Ngualdangte in sawltak khat bangin hong saang bua phial zong, note in nong saan tu uh ahi hi! Topa taw kipumkhat a na nuntak uh hu in, noma mama sia sawltak khat ka hina a kilakna ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihingte in hong sit ciang, hisia in keima le keima ka kihuukna ahi hi:"},"4":{"text":"Ka nasepna hu in kei in an le tuite hong kipiak natu thu om hi ngawl ziam?"},"5":{"text":"Sawltak dangte, Topa suapuite le Peter ettee in, ka khualhaw ciang ka kitholpui tu Tapidaw zi khat nei thei natu thu om hi ngawl ziam?"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahibuale koma kivaak natu zongin na a seam sia Barnabas le kei bek hi khu ziam?"},"7":{"text":"Ama ii sum zangh a, ngalkap sung a seam ngalkap om ngei na ziam? A sapithuan sung pan a piang sapitnga a ne ngawl lothopa akua om ngei ziam? Ama tuute ii noai a ne ngawl tuucingpa a om ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Ni sim a ettee thei hi bangte taw keima le keima ka kidep tu kul ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Thukham in tuabang ma in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Moses Thukham sungah, “Khuital khat an cil in na zak uh ciangin, a muk na tuamsak heak vun,” ci in ih sim hi. Tu in, Pathian in khuitalte a thinnuammaw ziam?","ref":"Thkna 25:4; 1 Tim 5:18"},"10":{"text":"Ama in tuabang a ci ciang koma hong cinopna tatak hi ngawl ziam? Hi hi, tua thu in koma atu in a ki at ahi hi. Lothopa le anlapa in an a kilate hawm khawm tu ci in lametna taw diang ahi uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Kote in note sungah thaa thaicii kong poai uh hi. Tuaciang note tung panin, leitung hamphatnate nga le ung tam lei tu ziam?","ref":"Rom 15:27"},"12":{"text":"Ngualdangte in note tung panin, hite nga natu lametna nei thei ahile, ko in a lianzaw ngawngawn muangmaw thei ngawl tu khu ziam? Ahihang hi ka nga tuak, ka zak tuak uhte hong zangh ngeingawl khu hi. Tua hizaw ngawlin, Christ huvau Lungdamna Thupha lampi a nokkhaksak ngawl natu in haksatna theampo a thuak hi zo khu hi."},"13":{"text":"Biakinn sungah naseamte in Biakinnpi panin an nga a, biaknatau tungah sangaw biakpiakna seamte in, a satel nga uh hi.","ref":"Thkna 18:1"},"14":{"text":"Tuasia bangma lungdamna thu a hilte in, tua ii tung panin a nuntak kivaak kitaa natu nga tu ci in Topa thupiaksa ahi hi.","ref":"Mt 10:10; Lk 10:7"},"15":{"text":"Ahihang hi ka nga tuak, ka zak tuak uhte ka zangh ngei bua a, tu a lai kong thaakna zongh tuabangte keima atu in a la nuam ka hi bua hi. Tua sangin ka thi nuamzaw hi! Hi kisaktheinate kuama in a luithawthong thu a sua buatu hi."},"16":{"text":"Lungdamna thu ka hil hu in, ka kisuantaak natu thu ka nei bua hi. Tuasia tatak ma seam tu in hong kisawl hi. Tuaciang lungdamna thu hil bua leng kei atu in bangza in lauhuai tu ziam!"},"17":{"text":"Keima uuk thu in ka tealna taw ka nasep seam hi leng, thaman hong kipiak tu ka lamen tu hi; ahihang sep tu pealmaw in nei a, a seam ka hi hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian in kei hong muang a, hi vaipuak hong aap hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahile bang thasum ka saang ziam? Lungdamna Thupha atu nasepna sungah nga tuakte la ngawl, sum la ngawlin, lungdamna thu hil theina hunpha ka nga sia in, ka noptuamna thupha ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Keima in kuama ii sila ahi ngawl, mihing suakta khat ka hi hi; ahihang mihing a tam thethei ka nga natu in ngual theampo ii sila ka kisuaksak hi."},"20":{"text":"Jew te taw na ka sepkhop laitakin, amate ka nga thei natu in Jew khat taw kibangin ka nungta hi; Moses Thukham ukna nuai ah om ngawl ka hi hang, tuabang a omte ka nga thei natu in, Thukham ukna nuai ah a omte bangin ka ngamta hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuasia bangma Gentile te taw na ka sepkhop ciangin, amate ka nga thei natu in, Jew Thukham puasia ah a om Gentile te khat bangin ka om hi. Hi bangin ih ci ciang, Pathian thukham ni ngawl khi hi ka cinopna hi ngawl hi; a tatak sia Christ ii Thukham nuai ah ka om hi."},"22":{"text":"Upna thaneamte kawm ah ka om ciang, amate ka nga thei natu in, amate khat bangin thaneam in ka om hi. Tua ahikom ahithei tu lampi khat po taw ahizong amate pawlkhat beak ngupna a nga thei natu in, mihing theampo ii a diksak thethei tu in ka om hi."},"23":{"text":"Hite theampo sia lungdamna thu hangin thupha ka hop thei natu a seam ka hi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tai kidemna sungah a kihel tam mama ahihang amate sung pan a zo khat bek in zawna tel nga ahi hunlam sia na heak uh ahi hi. Tua ahikom zawna tel na nga thei natu in tai vun."},"25":{"text":"A kikhomsuan ngawl paakkual lukhu khat a kikhuksak natu in, a kimai khat sim in a sinna sungah a haksa mama kitekna nuai ah kipum aap hi; ahihang eite ih hile, a tawntungin a kip tel atu in ih seam hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua hu in matut natu mun khau kithungna dong ah, tang takin ka tai hi; tuasia hu ma in ngual a thong khial ngawl kithok thiampa taw ka kibang hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua kidemna ah ngual thato zo kasap a kihel zo ngawl pa ka sua ngawl natu in keima le keima kithongin ka pumpi ka ngimsakin ka kitek dipdeap hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Suapuite awng, Moses nungzui ih taanghpupite tungah bang piang ziam ci in na phawk kik natu ka dei hi. Amate a vekpi in meeikaai ii dalna nuai ah om a, San Tuipi kaantanin suakta siat uh hi.","title":"Milim huvau Kidop natu","ref":"Pu 13:21-22; 14:22-29"},"2":{"text":"Meeikaai sung le tuipi sungah, amate teng Moses nungzui a hina uh taw ki baptize uh hi."},"3":{"text":"A vekpi in thaa anluum a kibangin ne uh a,","ref":"Pu 16:35"},"4":{"text":"thaa tui a kibangin dawn uh hi. Amate taw a tonkhawm thaa suangpi panin tui dawn uh hi; tua suangpi sia Christ ama mama ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 17:6; Mi 20:11"},"5":{"text":"Tuabang ahibel hang, amate a tamzaw tungah Pathian in diksa ngawl ahikom a luanghawm uh sia sennealngam sungah kithethaang hi.","ref":"Mi 14:29-30"},"6":{"text":"Tu in hite theampo sia eite atu in, ettee tu lim hi a, amate dei bangin a sia nate ih dei ngawl natu kidopna hong piakna hi,","ref":"Mi 11:4"},"7":{"text":"tua bek hi ngawlin, amate pawlkhat ii milim a biak bangin, ih biak ngawl natu in kidop natu hong piak ahi hi. Laithiangtho ci bangin, “Mihingte in zuneakna le numei le pa maitatna a om poai sungah kihel uh hi”.","ref":"Pu 32:6"},"8":{"text":"Eite sia amate pawlkhat bangin, numei le pa paktatna a vawt uh bangin ih ngamta bua het tu hi — ni khat thu in amate mihing tulkul le tulthum pukin thi uh hi.","ref":"Mi 25:1-18"},"9":{"text":"Amate pawlkhat bangin Topa ih ze et bua het tu hi — amate ngul in tulum uh hi.","ref":"Mi 21:5-6"},"10":{"text":"Amate pawlkhat bangin ih phuntaal bua het tu hi — Thina ii Vantunglalang in amate lalcipsak hi.","ref":"Mi 16:41-49"},"11":{"text":"Hi thupiang theampo sia ngual ii ettee tu lim hi a, eite kidop thei natu in lai sungah a kiciamtee ahi hi. Banghang ziam cile leitung bo kuan hun sungah eite ih om hi."},"12":{"text":"Kip takin ding a kisa pawpo in, a puk ngawl natu in kidawm tahen."},"13":{"text":"Ze etna na thuaksa uh theampo sia mihingte tungah a tung bul thute ahi hi. Ahihang Pathian in a kamciam kholet hi, tuaciang ama in a kipin na om thei natu note thuak zawk ngawl tu ze etna hong thuaksak ngawl tu hi; hong kize et ciangin zongh thuak zawk thahatna hong pia tu a, na suatak natu lampi khat hong hon tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahiciang ka it lawmte awng, milim biakna na pial tavun."},"15":{"text":"Mihing thu tel theite tungah thuson tu bangin note tungah kong son hi; ka sonte sia noma le noma in na khensat tavun."},"16":{"text":"Topa ii Zan An neakna hai hangin Pathian tungah lungdam ih ko hi; tua hai taw ih dawn ciang Christ ii chisan a siim khawmte ih hi hi. Tuaciang anluum ih balneen hi: hi a kibalneen anluum ih neak ciang, Christ ii pumpi a siim khawmte ih hi hi.","ref":"Mt 26:26-28; Mk 14:22-24; Lk 22:19-20"},"17":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile tua anluum sia khat bek hi a, ei teng tam ih hihang, anluum khat bek nekhawm tek ih hi manin eite pumkhat ih hi hi."},"18":{"text":"Israel mite thu ngaisun vun; sangaw biakpiakna an a nete in, Pathian biaknatau nasepna sungah a kihel uh hi.","ref":"Thiam 7:6"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahile milim, ahibuale milim biakna ah a kipia ante thupisak ka hi ziam?"},"20":{"text":"Hi ngawl hi! Ka cinopna in doai biate ii biaknatau tungah sa ngawte sia doaite atu a kipia hi a, Pathian tungah a kipia hi ngawl hi. Tuaciang doaite taw na kipawlkhop tu ka dei bua hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:17"},"21":{"text":"Topa hai le doaite hai pan zong, na dawnkhawm thei buatu uh hi; Topa sabuai le doaite sabuai zongh zangh khawmin an na ne thei buatu uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahibuale Topa sia a eang pa suaksak nuam ih hi ziam? Ama sangin eite hat zaw kisa ih hi ziam?","ref":"Thkna 32:21"},"23":{"text":"Amate in, “Na theampo vawt thei natu thu ih nei hi,” ci uh hi. Tua thu maan hi, ahihang na theampo pha siat ngawl hi. “Na theampo vawt thei natu thu ih nei hi,” — ahihang na theampo in hong hu thei ngawl hi.","ref":"1 Cor 6:12"},"24":{"text":"Kuama in ama phat tuam natu a et tu hi ngawlin, ngualdangte phattuam natu a et thei tu kisamh hi."},"25":{"text":"Sa kizuakna munah a kizuak theampo na neak thei natu in suatakna na nei uh a, thinnopmawkna taw bangma dok kul ngawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in, “Leitung le a sungah a om na theampo sia Topa ii neisa ahi hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 24:1"},"27":{"text":"Thu um ngawl khat in an ne tu in hong sam a, pai na sawm le thin nopmawkna taw bangma dongh se ngawlin na mai ah hong kilui po ne in."},"28":{"text":"Ahihang khat po in, “Hi an sia milim a kipia an hi,” hong cile, tua an sia hong sonpa le ama ii thinsung ngaisutna na khualna taw ne heak vun —"},"29":{"text":"tuabang ka ci ciang, noma thinsung ka cina hi ngawlin, hong sonpa thinsung ka cinopna ahi hi. Hi thu tungtaang ah khat po in, “Tua ahile pha hi, ngualdang khat ii ngaisut natu khualna in, ka uk bang ka ngamtat tu, banghangin hong kikhaktan thei tu ziam, ci thei tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Ka an atu in, Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko nale, banghangin ngualdang khat in lungdam ka ko sa an huvau sia bangbangin hong sit thei tu ziam,” a ci om tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Pha hi, bang pawpo na vawt zong, bang pawpo na ne na dawn zong, Pathian minthan natu in na hi vun."},"32":{"text":"Jew te atu ahizong Gentile te atu ahizong, Pathian ii pawlpi atu ahizong, haksatna a piangsak ngawl nuntakzia taw nungta tavun."},"33":{"text":"Keima vawt bangin vawt po vun; ka vawt theampo sungah mihing khat sim ka lungkimsak natu in ka hanciam a, amate ngupna a nga thei natu in, keima phattuam natu ngaisun ngawlin, a vekpi phattuam natu ka ngaisun hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Christ ii zia le tong ka zui bangin, kei ii zia le tong hong zui tavun.","ref":"1 Cor 4:16; Php 3:17"},"2":{"text":"Nong phaw tawntung uh hu le note tungah kong piak hilciannate na zui uh hu in kong pok hi.","title":"Biakpiakna sungah Lu Tuamna"},"3":{"text":"Ahihang na tel tu uh ka dei thu pan, Christ in mihing theampo tungsia ah a lianbel hi a, pasal in zi tungsia ah a lianbel hi, Pathian in Christ tungsia ah a lianbel ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom pasal khat in, mihon sungah a thunget ciang ahizong, Pathian thu a thansak ciang ahizong, a lu tungah khuk khat a nei le, Christ mindaisak suak hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaciang numei khat pawpo in mihon sungah thu a nget ciang ahizong, Pathian thu a thansak ciang ahizong, a lu tungah bangma a om buale, a pasal mindaisak suak a; a lu a meettol numei dangkhat taw, kilamdanna nei ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua nu in a lu tungah khuk khat a nei buale, a sam zongh a meet vet tu ahi hi. Tuaciang khat in a lu a tol in meet tu ahibuale a sam a tan tu sia maizumhuai thu ahi bangma a lu tungah tuamna khat nei le pha hi."},"7":{"text":"Pasal khat in a lu seal kul ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile ama in Pathian lim le vaangletnate, ama tung panin kilanghsak hi. Ahihang numei in pasal vaangletna a kilanghsak hi;","ref":"Pian 1:26-27"},"8":{"text":"banghang ziam cile pa sia numei sung panin kibitphua ngawlin, numei sia pa sung pan kibitphua hi.","ref":"Pian 2:18-23"},"9":{"text":"Pa in numei atu kibitphua hi ngawl a, ahihang numei in pa atu in a kibitphua hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahiciang vantunglalangte hangin, numei in a pasal ii thuneina nuai ah om hi, ci in lak natu in a lu tuamna khat nei tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang Topa sung ih nuntakna ah, numei in pasal ngawl taw tuam din thei ngawl a, pasal zongh numei ngawl taw tuam din thei ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile numei sia pasal panin a kivawt bangma in, pasal zongh numei sung pan a suak ahi hi; tuaciangin na theampo a piangsak sia Pathian ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"A lu tungah bangma a om ngawl numei khat sia mihon biak piakna sungah Pathian tung thu a nget tu sia a kilawm le a kilawm ngawl noma in khensat tavun."},"14":{"text":"Banghang ziam, leitung pianzia mama zongh in pasal khat sam a sau in a hoai le a maizumhuai hi a,"},"15":{"text":"ahihang numeite tungah tuasia in hoina khat hi ci in hong hil hi. Numei samsau sia ama a kituam natu in, a kipia ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang khat po in hi thu a nial nuam tha le, eite ih hi zong, Pathian ii pawlpite ahizong, biakpiakna ah ngeina dang kinei ngawl hi ci sia bekma son tu ka nei hi."},"17":{"text":"Hi a nuai ah ngamtatzia tu hilnate sungah ahile no kong pok bua hi, banghang ziam cile biak kikhopna ah a tatakin phatna sangin siatna piang zaw hi.","title":"Topa ii Zan An (Mt 26:26-29;Mk 14:22-25; Lk 22:14-20)"},"18":{"text":"A masa phitbel in na kikhopna uh sungah a kilangpan pawl tuatuamte om hi ci in hong kison hi; hisia in a maan na mun om tu ka um hi."},"19":{"text":"(No sungah thutangzaw sia a kimu thiang natu in kikhennate ahile a om kul hi.)"},"20":{"text":"A pawl in na kikhop uh ciang, na neak uh sia Topa ii Zan An hi ngawl hi."},"21":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile na neak uh ciang mihing khat sim in, noma an tek ma leap papaih na hi uh kom pawlkhat sia ngilkial in na om uh a, a dang teng sia zukham in om hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuabangin na neak na dawn natu uh, inn tek nei hi ngawl nu ziam? Tua ahibuale Pathian ii pawlpi zawngsakin, a nei ngawlte na maizumsak nopna uh ziam? Hi thu huvau ah bang son tu in nong muangmaw uh ziam? No hong pok tu khi ziam? Hong pok ngawl het tu khi hi!"},"23":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Topa ii hilcianna ama ii tung pan ka saante sia note tungah kong pia sawn hi: a thu in Topa Jesus a kileeheak tu nitakin, ama in anluum la a,"},"24":{"text":"Pathian munah lungdam a ko zawkciang anluum balneen a, “Hisia in note atu in a kipia ka pumpi ahi hi. Kei nong phawna in hi bangin vawt vun,” ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuasia bangma zan an a neak zawkciang ama in hai la in, “Hi hai in ka chi taw a kikipsak Pathian ii thuciamna thak ahi hi. Na dawn uh simin, kei nong phawna in na dawn vun,” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 24:6-8; Jer 31:31-34"},"26":{"text":"Hisia ii khiakna sia, hi anluum na neak uh sim le, hi hai panin na dawn uh simin ama hong pai kik dongin, Topa ii thina thu a thangsak na hi uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Hi thu taw kipee in khat po in, ama zatak ngawlna taw Topa ii anluum ne a, hai a dawn le, tua mi in Topa ii pumpi tung le a chi tungah a maw ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom mihing sim in, ama le ama kisittel phot tu a, tua zawkciang anluum ne in, hai panin dawn tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile anluum a neak ciang le hai panin a dawn ciangin, Topa ii pumpi ii a khiakna a tel buale, a neak a dawn hu in ama le ama tungah thukhenna a tungsak suak hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua hu in note sungah mihing tam mama thazawmin a ciina a, tam ma na thi zo uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Eima le eima kisittel phot in hi leang, Pathian thukhenna sungah ih theng buatu hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahihang eite sia leitung bup taw hong kimawsak ngawl natu in, Topa in thu hong khen a, daan hong pia ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Suapuite awng, tua ahikom, Topa ii Zan An ne tu in, na kikhoptua uh ciangin, khat le khat na kingak vun."},"34":{"text":"Tuaciang na kikhop uh ciangin a ngilkial khat po a om le, Pathian ii thukhenna nuai ah na tum ngawl natu in inn ah an ne tahen. Thudangte sia, kong pai ciangin ih son tu hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in Thaa Thiangtho letsong huvau nong at uh teng kong son tu hi. Ka suapuite awng, tuate huvau thumaan thutak sia na heak tu uh ka dei hi.","title":"Thaa Thiangtho Letsongte"},"2":{"text":"Pathian he ngawlte na hi uh lai in, note sia nuntakna a nei ngawl milimte biakna sungah lampialna tam mama taw hong kipaipui ahi sia na heak uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Pathian Thaa ii a lampuite kuama in, “Jesus in haamsiat thuak hen,” ci thei ngawl a, tuaciang Thaa Thiangtho ii lamlakna a om ngawl po kuama in, “Jesus in Topa hi,” ci thei ngawl hi ci thu kong hesak nuam hi."},"4":{"text":"Thaa Thiangtho letsongte sia a nam tuatuam om hi, ahihang a kibang Thaa khat bek in tuate pia hi.","ref":"Rom 12:6-8"},"5":{"text":"Nasepna a nam tuatuam om hi, ahihang a kibang Topa khat atu kiseam hi."},"6":{"text":"Sepna sungah thiamna nam tuatuam om hi, ahihang mihing sim atu amate sepna san tek ah thiamna nam tuatuam a pia Pathian sia a kibang hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing theampo phattuam natu in mihing khat sim sungah Thaa a om hunlam a nanamin kilak hi."},"8":{"text":"Thaa in mihing khat tungah ciimna taw kidim thu khat pia a, a dang khat tungah tua Thaa ma in heakna taw kidim thu khat pia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua a kibang Thaa khat sia ma in mihing khat tungah upna pia a, a dang khat tungah ciina damsak theina vaang pia hi."},"10":{"text":"Thaa in khat tungah nalamdang lak theina vaang pia a; a dang khat tungah Pathian Thuhil theina letsong pia hi; tuaciang a dang khat tungah, letsongte sia Thaa Thiangtho pan hong pai ahile ahi ngawl khentel theinate pia lai hi. Khat tungah kam tumdang pau theina pia a, a dang khat tungah kam tumdangte pheen theina pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang hite theampo a vawtpa in a kibang Thaa khat bek ahi hi; tuaciangin ama uuk babangin letsong tuatuam mihing khat sim tungah pia hi."},"12":{"text":"Christ in khen tuatuam tam mama a nei pumpi khat taw kibang hi. Khen tuatuam nei ahihang, pumpi khat hi veve hi.","title":"Pumpi khat sungah Khentuamte","ref":"Rom 12:4-5"},"13":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in, eite theampo sia Jew te ih hizong, Gentile te ih hizong, sila le sila ngawlte ih hizong, a kibang Thaa khat in, pumpi khat sungah hong ki baptize a, tuaciangin ih dawn tu in Thaa khat sia ei theampo hong kipia zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile pumpi in khen khat bek taw a kivawt bua a, khentuam tam mama taw a kivawt ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Peang in, “Kei sia khut hi ngawl ka hi ciang pumpi ii neisa ka hi bua hi,” cile zong tua in pumpi ii khen khat a hina a bosak tuan buatu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaciangin bil in, “Kei sia mittang hi ngawl ka hi ciang, pumpi neisa ka hi bua hi,” cile zong tua in pumpi ii neisa a hina a bosak tuan buatu hi."},"17":{"text":"Pumpi buppi in mittang khat hile bangbangin khua za thei tu ziam? Tuaciangin bil bek hile bangbangin a ngimnam he thei tu ziam?"},"18":{"text":"Ahizong Pathian in pumpi khen tuatuamte sia ama deina sasan tek ah koi hi."},"19":{"text":"A buppi in a khen tuam nam khat bek hile pumpi a om buatu hi!"},"20":{"text":"A khentuam tam mama om ahihang pumpi khat bek om hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom mittang in khut kungah, “Nang kong tulmaw bua hi!” ci thei ngawl tu hi. Lutang in peang munah, “Nang kong tulmaw bua hi!” ci thei ngawl tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua hi ngawlin, pumpi sungah a thazawm tuak zaw pumpi khentuamte ngawl taw bangma ih vawt thei bua hi;"},"23":{"text":"tuaciangin kimanna tam nei ngawlin ih hen tua khentuamte sia ih thupi vawt tu te hizaw hi; tuaciang pumpi khentuamte sungah a et hoi keak ngawlte ahile ciliapna taw a tuan in ih kep kul a,"},"24":{"text":"tuabang kep tuam tu sia pumpi sungah a hoi zaw khentuamte in a tulmaw bua hi. Pathian mama in ciliap tu a taangsamh khentuamte a kiciliap thei zawk natu in pumpi sia ngawmtua hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuabangin pumpi sungah kikhenna a om bua hi, ahihang ama ii khen tuatuamte khat le khat kithinbotna nei uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Pumpi sungah khen tuam khat in, thuakna a nei le, a dang khentuam theampo in thuakpui hi; khentuam khat a kipok le, a dang khentuam teng in lungdam pui tek hi."},"27":{"text":"Note theampo in Christ ii pumpi na hi uh a, tuaciang khat sim sia tua ii khentuam khat veu ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Pawlpi sungah Pathian in a vekpi ma a om natu san tek ah koi hi: a masa phit in sawltakte, a niina ah kamsaangte, a thumna ah lai hil syate; tua zawkciangin nalamdang lakna a vawtte, tua zom ah ciidamsakna vaang a kipiate, ngual hu thei ahibuale, lamlak thiamte, tua ahibuale kam tumdang taw a paute ahi uh hi.","ref":"Eph 4:11"},"29":{"text":"Amate in sawltakte, kamsaangte, lai hil syate hi siat ngawl hi. Mihing khat simin nalamdang lakna vawt thei natu in vaang ahizong,"},"30":{"text":"ciina damsak theina ahizong, kam tumdang taw pauna le tua kamte pheen theina ahizong, vawt theina vaang a nei kim bua uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ahikom, letsong a thupizawte deibel in na nei tavun. Ahitazong, a vekpi sung pan a phabel sia in a nuai a bang ahi hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihingte ii kampaute le vantunglalangte ii kampau ngawngawn ka pau thei hial hangin, itna ka nei buale ka paute sia zam nging daak nging bang bek ahi hi.","title":"Itna"},"2":{"text":"Pathian ii hu mop thuhil theina nei a; heakna theampo le thuku theampo telna nei a, mualte khiin zawk natu a kisamh upna teng ka nei hangin — itna ka nei buale kei sia bangma ka hi bua hi.","ref":"Mt 17:20; 21:21; Mk 11:23"},"3":{"text":"Ka neisa na theampo pia siatin, ka pumpi ngawngawn a kihallum tu dongin, ka piak hial hangin, itna ka nei buale, hite in kei atu bangma phatna hong pia bua hi."},"4":{"text":"Itna in thin uai a, dik hi; itna in ki eenna nei ngawl a, kisathei ngawl, kiphasak ngawl hi;"},"5":{"text":"itna in philphit ngawl, duhop ngawl, thintom ngawl hi; itna in ngual khialnate ciamtee ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Itna in ngitlona thu ah lungdam ngawl hi, thumaan thutak ah lungdam hi."},"7":{"text":"Itna in thinkiam ngeingawl a; a upna, a lametna le a thinsauna bo ngeingawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Itna in a tawntungin kip hi. Kamsaannate om ahihang tawmvei atu bek ahi hi; kam tumdangte pau theina letsongte om ahihang bo tu hi; heakna letsong om ahihang bo tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile eite heakna le kamsaanna letsongte sia a cingtaak hi ngawl hi;"},"10":{"text":"ahihang a kicing sia hong thet ciangin a cingtaak ngawl teng bo tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Patang ka hi lai in ka pauna, ka phawna, ka khua ngaisutte in patang bang ahi hi; tu in pasal khat ka hi ciangin patang vai teng ka nusia hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu in ih muna in, limlangh sungah a kimu thiang ngawl lim le meal bang ahi hi; tua hun ciangin maitang kisi in ih kimu tu hi. Tu a ka heak sia kicing tak ngawl lai hi; tua zawkciang Pathian in kei hong heakna bangma in, a kicingin ka he tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu laitakin a taanglai thu thum teng sia: upna, lametna le itna hi a; hi teng sung pan a lianbel sia in itna ahi hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahikom na hanciam tu uh sia, ki itna ahi hi. Thaa Thiangtho letsongte, a tuanin Pathian thu thansak theina letsong na lungngul vun.","title":"Thaa ii Letsongte huvau Sonthuana"},"2":{"text":"Kam tumdang a pau sia in ngualdang tungah pau hi ngawlin, Pathian tungah pau ahi hi, banghang ziam cile kuama in tel ngawl hi. Ama in Thaa vaangletna taw a kiseal thumaan thutakte son ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian thu a thangsakte in mihingte tungah pau hi a, amate tungah huna, hanthotna le heenepna pia ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Kam tumdang taw a paute in ama phat tuam natu bek hi a, Pathian thu a thangsakte in pawlpi bup phattuamna a pia hi."},"5":{"text":"No theampo kam tumdang pau thei le uhte kong oai hi; ahizong Pathian thu thansak theina letsong nei le uhte kong oai zaw hi. Banghang ziam cile pawlpi bup in phattuamna a nga thei natu in, no sungah a khiakna a son thei pai om ahi bua nale, kam tumdang a paute sangin Pathian thu a thangsak sia in man neizaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka suapuite awng, no kungah kong pai ciangin, kam tumdangin hong pau leng, note atu in ka kimanna om tu ziam? Pathian tung pan thupualaakna, heakna, thuhilna ahibuale hilcianna khat pawpo ka nei buale note atu in bekcik zongh kimanna ka nei buatu hi."},"7":{"text":"Nuntakna a nei ngawl tumthei tamngai ahizong, tengtonghte ahizong la in —, a aw kitelthiang vaset in a tum buale akua in bang aw hi ci in tel thei tu ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Tuaciangin ngalkap sungah lemle tumpa in, sapna aw a kitel takin, a tum buale akua ngalsim tu in kinging thei tu ziam?"},"9":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in kam tumdang taw thu na sonte a thiang buale, akua in hong tel tu ziam? Na kammalte sia vui sungah bo thong tu hi!"},"10":{"text":"Simleitung ah kampau nam tuatuam om hikale, tuate sung pan khiakna nei ngawl khat zongh a om bua hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang a kipau kam sia ka tel buale, hong paupui pa sia kei atu in ngamdang mi suak a, ama mun pan zong, keima sia ngamdang mi ka suak hi."},"12":{"text":"Thaa ii letsongte nga tu sia lawp na hi uh ciang, nadang theampo sangin pawlpi a khanto thei natu a hu tu in tua letsongte zak vaial tu na hanciambel vun."},"13":{"text":"Kam tumdang a pau sia in ama son teng a khiakna pheen theina letsong a nga natu in, thungen nanak tahen."},"14":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile kam tumdang taw thu ka nget ciangin, ka thaa taw thungen takpi ka hihang ka thungetna sungah ka ngaisutna kihel ngawl hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahile bangbangin ngamta tu khi ziam? Ka thaa taw thu ka ngen tu hi, ahizong ka ngaisutna taw zong thu ka ngen tu hi; ka thaa taw la ka sa tu hi, ahihang ka ngaisutna taw zong lasa tu khi hi."},"16":{"text":"Pathian tungah lungdam na ko ciangin thaa bek taw na ko le, kikhopna sungah a kihel mihing thawthong khat in, nang lungdamko thungetna sia “Amen” bangbangin hong ci pui thei tu ziam? Ama in nang pauna teng a tel thei natu thu om ngawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Pathian tungah lungdamkona na thungetna sia pha teei ahihang ngualdang khat in phat tuamna nei ngawl het hi."},"18":{"text":"No sangin kam tumdang tamzaw pau ka hikomin, Pathian ka pok hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahihang pawlpi biak kikhopna sungah ngualdangte hilna tu in, kam tumdang kammal a tul simin ka pau sangin, a kitel thei kammal nga ka pau zaw tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, na khua ngaisutna uh ah, patang bang hi heak vun; siatna lam ah patang bang na hi vun, ahihang khua ngaisutna ah na khanthin vun."},"21":{"text":"Laithiangtho sungah, “Kam tumdangte a pau mihingte tungtawnin, ka mihingte tungah ka pau tu hi, Topa in ci hi. Ngamdangmite kam le muk tungtawnin ka pau tu hi, tua ahitazongin ka mite in kei hong ngai buatu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 28:11-12"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom, kam tumdang pauna letsong sia thu um ngawlte atu in a maan lakna hi a, thu umte atu hi ngawl hi, thuhilna letsong ahile thu umte atu in a maan lakna hi a, thu um ngawlte atu hi ngawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom pawlpi bup kikhawm hen a, tuaciangin mihing sim in, kam tumdangte taw a pau siasua laitakin — mihing thawthong pawlkhat ahizong, thu um ngawl pawlkhat ahizong hong pai le, note sia mawmaw siat hi hong ci ngawl tu ziam?"},"24":{"text":"Ahihang mihing khat simin Pathian thu a son laitakin thu um ngawl pawlkhat ahizong, mihing thawthong pawlkhat ahizong hong pai le a zaak thu taw a mawna kitel tu uh hi. Ama zaakna teng taw ama tungah thu kikhen tu hi,"},"25":{"text":"ama ii thuku a ngaisut teng a pua ah hong kilangh tu a, ama in kunin Pathian bia in, “A maan tatakin Pathian sia hi sung, note sungah om hi!” ci in pualaak tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Suapuite awng, ka ci nop sia hi teng hi. Biakpiakna nei tu in na kikhop uh ciang, mihing khat in biakna la a sak tu khat nei tu a, a dang khat in hilciannatu khat, a dangkhat in Pathian tung pan thupualaakna, a dang khat in kam tumdang taw thusonna, a dangkhat ma in thu kison teng pheen theina, nei tu hi. Na theampo sia pawlpi phattuamna ahi tu kisamh hi.","title":"Pawlpi sungah Kalsuanzia"},"27":{"text":"Khat po in kam tumdang a pau le, nii ahibuale a tambel in thum in pau tu a, tua zom ah khat zawkciang khat in a ban in pau tu hi, tuaciangin a dangkhat in a kipau teng ii khiakna a pheen kul tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahihang a pheen thei a om buale, kam tumdang a paute thim tahen a, ama le Pathian kilaklaw bek ah pau tahen."},"29":{"text":"Pathian thupuak a sang nii le thum te in son tu a, a dangte in, a pauna teng sia a maan le a maan ngawl khensat tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahizong kikhopna sungah a to khat po in, Pathian ii thupuakna a saang le, a pau masa sia tawlnga tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Na vekpi in khat zawkciang khat in, Pathian thupuak sia thangsak thei tu nu hi, tuasia ciangin mihing sim in, heakna hong nei tu a, tha hong nga tu hi."},"32":{"text":"Pathian thu thansak thei na letsong sia a pau sia ii ukna nuai ah om tu hi."},"33":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian in note sia ahi bialbual tu in hong dei ngawl a, thu kihual le a kilem tu in hong dei hi. Pathian ii mihingte ii pawlpi theampo te ah a kizangh bangma in,"},"34":{"text":"numeite sia kikhopnate sungah thim khipkhep in om tu hi. Amate a pau tu ki oai ngawl hi; Jew te thukham ii a ci bangma in amate sia a ukte hi thei ngawl tu hi."},"35":{"text":"Amate in bang khat po heak nop a nei le, inn ah a pasalte uh dongh tahen. Pawlpi sungah numeite a pau tu sia kilawm ngawl hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ahibuale Pathian kammal sia no kung panin hong pai a hi thei tu ziam?. Tua ahibuale note tung bek ah hong tung a hi ziam?"},"37":{"text":"Mihing khat po in ama le ama Pathian kamtaipa a kisa a, tua ahibuale thaa letsong nei a kisa le, tu a note tungah kong at teng sia Topa thupiak hi ci in tel nanak tu hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahizong ama in hi thu a nadon buale ama na nadon heak vun."},"39":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka suapuite awng, Pathian thuthansakna ah, na lungngul tavun a, ahizong kam tumdang paunate na khaam heak vun."},"40":{"text":"Na theampo ahi tu bang le, a kiphu a kilawm bangin vawt tu ahi hi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, na saansa uh le na upna tung kho tak na dinna uh, kong hil Lungdamna Thupha huvau tu in kong phawksak kik nuam hi.","title":"Christ ii Thawkikna"},"2":{"text":"Tua lungdamna thu sia note tungah kong hil sia ahi hi. A luithawthong in a um na hi buana uh a, pha takin lungdamna thu na kholet uhle tua thupha in note hong ngum tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Keima ii ka nga sa teng note tungah kong pia sawn hi, tua thu in thupibel hi: banghang ziam cile Laithiangtho ii at bangma in Christ in eite ii mawna hangin thi hi;","ref":"Is 53:5-12"},"4":{"text":"tuaciang ama kiphum a, ni thum zawkciangin Laithiangtho ii at bangma in nuntakna sungah kithosak hi;","ref":"Ps 16:8-10; Mt 12:40; Sawl 2:24-32"},"5":{"text":"ama in Peter kungah kilak a, tua zawkciang sawltak sawm le nii teng kungah kilak hi.","ref":"Mt 28:16-17; Mk 16:14; Lk 24:34-36; Jn 20:19"},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang ama sia a nungzui 500 vaalte kungah thakhatin kilak a, tuate sung pan pawlkhat thi zo ahihang a tamzaw sia nungta nginge lai hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciang ama in James kungah kilak a, tua zawkciang sawltakte theampo kungah kilak hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in nau a sua tu hunin a suak ngawl khat bang ka hi tazongin — a khakbel in kei tung zongh ah hong kilak hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:3-6"},"9":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile keima in sawltak sung panin a nobel ka hi a — sawltak khat ci in minpu tu zong ka kilawm bua hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian ii pawlpi ka vawtsia ngei hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3"},"10":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian ii thuthiamna taw keima sia hi bang ciang ka hi a, ama hong piak thuthiamna sia a luithawthong a suak bua hi. Kei sia sawltak dangte sangin, nasia zaw in na ka seam hi. Tua zongh a tatakin kei ii sep hi ngawlin kei taw a om Pathian ii thuthiamna ii a sep ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom kei tung pan hong pai ahizong, amate tung pan hong pai ahizong, hisia ma ka vekpi in kong hil uh thu hi a, hisia ma in note ii up thu ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu in kote ii kong hil uh thu in, Christ sia thina panin kitho kiksak hi ci kasap, bangbangin note pawlkhat in a thite nuntakna sungah kithosak ngawl tu hi, ci thei nu ziam?","title":"Eite ii Thawkikna"},"13":{"text":"Tuasia in thumaan ahile Christ kitho kiksak ngawl hi tu hi;"},"14":{"text":"tuaciang thina pan Christ tho kik ngawl hile, kote ii hil tu bangma om ngawl tu a, note ii up tu bangma om ngawl tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua bek dom ngawlin kote sia Pathian tungtaang ah leilot thu son hong kici tu hi, banghang ziam cile Christ sia thina panin tho kik hi ci khu hi — ahihang mithite a nungta in kithosak ngawl hi takpi ahile, ama in Christ a thosak ngawl hi tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile a thite nuntakna sungah tho kik ngawl hile Christ zongh kithosak ngawl hi tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuaciangin Christ kithosak ngawl hile, na upna uh sia cithep thu hong suak tu a, note sia noma mawnate sung ma ah a mangthang lai na hi tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Christ sungah thu um mi a thite a bocip hi cina zongh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Christ sungah ih lametna in, hi nuntakna sung atu bekin kimang a, a dang om ngawl ahile leitung theampo ah a khuangai huai belte ih hi tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahihang thumaan thu in bang ziam cile, Christ sia thina panin a kithaw kik sakna sia, thina sungah a mute zongh, kitho kiksak tu hi ci in a kip kamciam hong piakna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile thina in mihing khat tungtawnin hong pian bangma in, thina panin thawkikna zongh, mihing khat tungtawnin hong piang hi."},"22":{"text":"Adam taw a kipumkhat mihing theampo a thi bangma in Christ taw a kipumkhat theampo nuntakna sungah kitho kiksak tu hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang mihing sim amate hun tekin kitho kiksak tu hi: Christ sia a masa phitbelin tho hi; tua zawkciang ama hong pai kik ciang, ama ii mihing teng tho tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuasia ciang a tawpna hong theng tu hi; Christ in thaa lamsang ah a ukte, thuneite, vaangletna a neite theampo zo tu a, tuaciangin a Kumpi Ngam sia Pa Pathian tungah aap tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian in a ngalte theampo zo a, ama peang nuai ah a koisak dong Christ in uk tu hi.","ref":"Ps 110:1"},"26":{"text":"A khakbel a zaw tu a ngal sia thina ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in, “Pathian in na theampo a peang nuai ah koi hi,” ci hi. A kithiangtel thu in “na theampo” ci ciangin, Christ ii peang nuai ah na theampo a koipa, Pa Pathian a kihel bua hi.","ref":"Ps 8:6"},"28":{"text":"Ahihang Christ ukna nuai ah na theampo a kikoi zawkciang, Tapa ahi ama mama sia, na theampo ama nuai ah a koi Pathian nuai ah ama le ama kikoi tu hi; tuaciang Pathian in a vekpi in uk siat tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Tu in mithite atu ki baptize na a vawtte bangbangin ih ngaisun tu ziam? Amate in bang phattuamna piangsak tu in kimuangmaw ziam? Pawlkhat ci bangin, a thite sia nuntakna sungah kitho kiksak ngawl tu ahile tua mihingte in, banghangin mithite atu ki baptize ziam?"},"30":{"text":"Kote sia nai simin banghangin launa thuak hi tu khu ziam?"},"31":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, ni simin thina ka maingat hi! Note hu in, ih Topa Christ Jesus taw kipumkhat a, ih nuntakna hangin note sungah ka nei, hi kiphatsakna in hi bangin hong pausak hi."},"32":{"text":"Ngamsa ngilote taw kido bang phet in, hi Ephesus khua ah ka dian nate sia mihing tupnate bek hile, ka nga tu bang phattuamna om tu ziam? Mithite sia nuntakna sungah kitho kiksak ngawl tu hile, “An ne zu dawn in om tawng, banghang ziam cile zing ciangin ih thi tu hi,” ci kam teptee om bangin ih om lel tu hi.","ref":"Is 22:13"},"33":{"text":"Theamna thuak heak vun. “Kitholpui pha ngawlte in ngamtatna pha lalsak hi.”"},"34":{"text":"Ahi tu bangin khua hong phawk kik tavun a, na mawnate kheal vun. No pawlkhat in Pathian he ngawl na hi uh kom a maizumhuai na hina uh kong hesak hi."},"35":{"text":"Pawlkhat in, “Bangbangin a thisate kitho kiksak tu ziam? Amate in bangbang pumpi nei tu ziam?” ci tu nu hi.","title":"Thaw kikna Pumpi"},"36":{"text":"No mihing mawmaw te! Thaicii khat lei sungah na tu uh ciangin, a thi phot buale a po bua hi."},"37":{"text":"Tuaciang, zungtaang ahizong a dang thaicii khat pawpo ahizong, tua na tu uh thaicii sia a khangto tu, a kung po sa hi ngawlin, a thaicii nguak a tu na hi uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Pathian in tua thaicii tek sia ama dei bangin a kung pia a; thaicii khat sim atu in a kung pha pia hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuaciangin a nungta theampo ii sa sia a kibang sa nam khat bek ahi siat bua hi; Mihing sa in nam khat hi a, nganhingte, vacimte, ngasa te ii sa in a dang nam tuam tek nei hi."},"40":{"text":"Vantung pumpite le leitung pumpite a om hi; vantung pumpi hoina le leitung pumpi hoina sia kilamdang hi."},"41":{"text":"Ni in hoina a tuam nei a, tha ii hoina, tuaciang aksite hoina a tuam tek ahi hi; aksi tetek sung zongh ah, hoina a tuatuamin om lai hi."},"42":{"text":"Mithisate a kinuntak kiksak ciangin, tuabang ma hi tu hi. Pumpi a kiphum ciangin a thithei pumpi ahi hi; a kithawsak ciangin a thi maw pumpi ahi tu hi."},"43":{"text":"A kiphum ciangin a meal sia in zawngkhal hi. A kithawsak kik ciangin, a mealhoi in thahat tu hi."},"44":{"text":"A kiphum ciangin cii le sa pumpi hi a; a kithawsak kik ciangin, thaa pumpi ahi tu hi. Ci le sa pumpi a om bangma in, thaa pumpi zongh a om kul hi."},"45":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in “Mihing masabel Adam sia nuntakna a nei mihing in kibitphua hi,” ci hi; ahihang a khakbel Adam sia nuntakna a pia Thaa ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 2:7"},"46":{"text":"Thaa sia pai masa ngawl hi, cii le sa hi phot a, tua zawkciang thaa hi pheang hi."},"47":{"text":"Adam masa sia lei taw kivawt a, lei panin hong piang hi; Adam niina sia vantung panin hong pai hi."},"48":{"text":"Leitung ii neisa ahite sia lei taw kivawt khat taw kibang hi; vantung neisate sia vantung pan hong pai pa taw kibang hi."},"49":{"text":"Lei taw a kivawtpa lim le meal ih puak bangma in, vantung pan hong pai Pa lim le meal ih pua tu hi."},"50":{"text":"Ka ci nop thu in, suapuite awng, chi le sa taw a kivawt sia in, Pathian ii Ngam lua thei ngawl a, a thithei sia in thithei ngawlna lua thei ngawl hi."},"51":{"text":"Hi a kiseal thumaan thutak sia ngai vun: Eite theampo ih thi siat buatu hi, ahihang lemle khakbel sia a kitum ciang, eite in tawmvei no sungin, ih kikheal tu hi, mitphet khat sung za in manlang tu hi. Banghang ziam cile lemle a kitum ciangin a thisate tho kik in thi kik ngei nawn ngawl tu a, ih vekpi in ih kikheal tu hi.","ref":"1 Th 4:15-17","merge":"52"},"53":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile thina sia thithei ngawlna ah kikheal nanak tu hi; a thi tu sia a thithei ngawlin hong kikheal nanak tu hi."},"54":{"text":"Hisia hong piang in a thithei sia a thithei ngawlin a kikheal ciang, laithiangtho kammal: “Thina kisucip zo hi; zawna kikhuangkhim zo hi!” a ci sia taangtung tu hi.","ref":"Is 25:8"},"55":{"text":"“Thina awng na zawna koisung om ziam? Thina awng, na suksiat theina vaang koisung om ziam?”","ref":"Hos 13:14"},"56":{"text":"Thina in, a suksiat theina vaang sia mawna panin nga a, tuaciang mawna in a vaang sia Thukham panin nga hi."},"57":{"text":"Ahihang Topa Jesus Christ tungtawnin zawna hong pia Pathian tungah lungdam ih ko hi!"},"58":{"text":"Tua ahikom, kong it suapuite awng, kip tak le maan takin om vun. Topa atu na nasep uh peuma a luithawthong suak ngawl het tu hi ci in na heak uh ahiciang Topa atu na nasepna sungah a tawntung komla vun."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judea ngam ah Pathian ii mihingte huna sumkhon natu vai lai nong thaak uh sia taw kisai in kong son tu hi. Galatia ah a om pawlpite tungah ka sawl teng ma note in na vawt uh kul tu hi.","title":"Thu Uppuite atu Piakna","ref":"Rom 15:25-26"},"2":{"text":"Nipi ni simin na sum thalaw za uh taw kizui in sum pawlkhat na koituam hamtang vun a, na khol vun. Kong pai ciangin sumkhon a kul ngawl tu in na tawm vun."},"3":{"text":"Kong pai zawkciang Jerusalem ah na huna letsong uhte a puak tu in pha na sak uh mihingte sawlin kiheaksakna laite taw ih paisak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Keima pai hangin a phatuam tu le, amate taw ka tonkhawm thei tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Macedonia sang ka manaw zawkciangin, note kungah kong pai tu hi — Banghang ziam cile Macedonia kaantanin kong pai kul tu hi.","title":"Paul ii Tupna","ref":"Sawl 19:21"},"6":{"text":"No kungah tawmvei hunsung hong taam tu khi hi, phalbi bup hong taam tha tu khi hi. Tuasia ciang ka khualhaw kik natu mun pawpo ah ka paitan thei natu in keima nong hu thei tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tawmvei sung hong nawkin a kimu nuam bek hi ngawlin, Topa deina a om nale, note taw hun sau mama zak khop tu ka lamen hi."},"8":{"text":"Pentecost ni dong hi sung Ephesus ah ka taam tu hi.","ref":"Thiam 23:15-21; Thkna 16:9-11"},"9":{"text":"Hong langpan mihing tam mama om ahihang, a lian le a vawt thamman nasep natu in hunpha tatak khat a om hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:8-10"},"10":{"text":"Timothy sia note kungah hong theng le, note sungah nuam a sak thei natu in na vawt vun, banghang ziam cile ama sia keima bangma in Topa atu in a seam khat ahi hi.","ref":"1 Cor 4:17"},"11":{"text":"Kuama in ama zawngsak heak vun a, kei kung hong kilee kik thei natu in, ama khual hawna thinnuam takin a zop to thei natu in na hu nanak vun; banghang ziam cile ama sia suapui teng taw hong heak kik tu ka lamen hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu in suapui Apollos huvau ah, ama sia suapui dangte taw no kung hong haw natu in ka hanthawn hi, ahihang tu hunin hong pai tu sia a thinzo paih ngawl hi. Hun pha a nga ciang ahile, ama hong pai tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Pilvang in om vun, upna sungah kho takin ding vun, hang vun a thahat vun.","title":"Kammal Khakbelte"},"14":{"text":"Nasepna theampo ah ki itna taw seam vun."},"15":{"text":"Note in Stephanas le a innkuanpuite thu na heak uh hi; amate sia Achaia ah Tapidaw suakciilte hi a, Pathian mite atu nasepna sungah a kipiate ahi uh hi.","ref":"1 Cor 1:16"},"16":{"text":"Suapuite awng, hi bang mihingte ii lampuina le amate taw a diang a seam dang khat pawpo ii a lampuina na zui natu uh kong thuum hi."},"17":{"text":"Stephanas, Fortunatus le Achaicus ii hong pai hu in ka lungdam hi; amate sia hong om thei ngawl note ii luang hi,"},"18":{"text":"amate in note hong thinnuamsak a, tuabangin kei zongh hong thinnuamsak hi. Hi bang mihingte sia teptee thamman hi."},"19":{"text":"Asia ngamkhen ah pawlpite in paupuina kam hong thaak hi; Aquila, Priscilla le amate inn ah a kikhawm pawlpi in Tapidaw kideisakna kamthiam taw hong paupui hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:2"},"20":{"text":"Hi sungah suapuite theampo in paupuina kam hong thaak hi. Khat le khat suapui khat hina taw kinamh tavun."},"21":{"text":"Keima Paul in hi kong paupuina lai sia: keima khut tatak taw kong at hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa a it ngawl po haamsiatna thuak tahen! Maranatha — Ih Topa hong pai tahen!"},"23":{"text":"Topa Jesus thuthiamna note taw hong om tahen."},"24":{"text":"Christ Jesus sungah a om note theampo tungah kong itna om tahen. Amen."}}}}},"47":{"info":{"name":"Corinthte Niina","shortname":"2Cor","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ii deina taw Christ Jesus ii sawltakpa ahi Paul le ih suapuipa Timothy in — Corinth khua ah Pathian ii pawlpi le Achaia ngam bup ah Pathian ii mihingte theampo tungah lai kong thaak uh hi:","ref":"Sawl 18:1"},"2":{"text":"Ih Pa Pathian le ih Topa Jesus Christ in thuthiamna le thinnopna hong pia tahen."},"3":{"text":"Pathian le ih Topa Jesus Christ ii Pa, hesuak thiam Pa, huna theampo hong paina Pathian tungah lungdamko tawng!","title":"Paul in Pathian tungah Lungdamko"},"4":{"text":"Pathian tung pan ih saan hunate ma zanghin ngimna namcin a thuakte ih hu thei natu in, ama in ih ngimna theampo sungah hong hu hi."},"5":{"text":"Christ ii thuakna tam mama sungah ih kihel bangin Christ tungtawnin Pathian huna tam mama ih nga hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka thuak uh le note atu in, huna le ngupna na nga natu uh hi a; kote hong kihu le note zongh hong kihu a, kote ii thuakte ma zong thinsau takin na thuak zawk natu thahatna hong kipia ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom note sungah ka lametna uh sia ngawk zo ngeingawl hi; ko thuaknate nong thuak pui uh bangma in, huna ka nga uhte sungah note zongh na kihel uh sia ka he uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Suapuite awng Asia ngamkhen sungah ngim ka ngana uhte kong phawksak nuam hi. Kote tungah hong kisuanh vanhte lian mama a ngit leih ahikom, nungta tu zong ka ki um ngam bua uh hi.","ref":"1 Cor 15:32"},"9":{"text":"Kote tungah thi daan hong kipia bangza in ka ngaisun uh hi. Ahihang hi thu sia, koma le koma kisuang ngawlin, a thite a thosak kik, Pathian khat bek ka suan thei natu uh in a piang ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuabang a kiitakhuai thithei natu panin, ama in hong ngum zo a, hong ngum lai tu hi; mai sang zongh ah ama in hong ngum kik lai tu hi, ci in lametna ama tungah ka nei zo uh hi,"},"11":{"text":"tua in kote nong panpui na uh taw thu nong ngetsakna uh hang ahi hi. Tua ahikom kote atu thu tam mama hong kingetsaknate hong kizo tu a, Pathian in ko thupha hong pia tu hi; tuaciang mihing tam mama in, kote atu nging takin lungdamkona nei thei tu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Hi leitung ah ka nuntakna uh le a tuanin note taw ka kizopna uh sia Pathian ii hong piaksa thinmamna le citakna ii hong ukna le Pathian' thuthiamna ii vaangletna hang hi a, mihingte pilna hang hi ngawl hi, ci in telthiang in ka kiphasak uh hi.","title":"Paul ii Ngealnate Kikheal"},"13":{"text":"Na sim thei tu le na tel thei tu teng bek kong at uh hi. Ahizong tu in a lalang bek hong tel tu na hi uh hang, ih Topa Jesus Ni hong thet ciang, note hu in ka kiphatsak uh bangma kote hu in na kiphatsak thei natu uh in a cing tak ma nong tel tu uh kong lamen uh hi.","merge":"14"},"15":{"text":"Hite theampo thumaan hi ci in ka telthiang hu in, thupha niivei na nga thei natu in note kungah haw tu in ka ngeal phot hi."},"16":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Judea ngam ah ka khualhaw natu taw kisai in note tung pan huna dei ka hikom Macedonia ka pai lam le ka cia lamin note kungah baang tu in ka ngeal hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:21"},"17":{"text":"Hi bang ka ngeal ciangin thukheal memeang nong sa uh ziam? Hi bangin ngealnate ka nei ciangin keima deina bek taw, “Hi hi,” le ci a, “Hi bo,” le a ci si tu in a om ka hi ziam?"},"18":{"text":"Pathian ii thumaan a son bang tatak ma in, note tungah kong kamciamna sia “Hi hi” cile “Hi bo” ci sia thu hi ngawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Silas, Timothy le keima ii kong hil Pathian Tapa Jesus Christ sia “hi” le “hi bo” ci khop tu hi ngawl hi; ama sia Pathian ii “Hi” a cisia pa ahi zaw hi;","ref":"Sawl 18:5"},"20":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, Pathian kamciam theampo tungah “Hi” a ci pa ahi hi. Hi thu hangin Jesus Christ tungtawnin, Pathian minthanna ah “Amen” ka ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Note taw kingawm in kote Christ taw kipawl khawm a, ih nuntakna hong kipsak sia in Pathian hi a; eite hong tuam koisia Pathian ma hi in,"},"22":{"text":"ama ii neisa ka hina uh kote tungah tepteena hong koi zo a, eite atu hong koikholsak na theampo a kipsakna in eite thinsung ah Thaa Thiangtho hong pia pa in ama ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Keima tetti tu in Pathian ka sam hi — ama in ka thinsung hong he hi! Corinth khua ah kong pai ngawlna sia note kong maapna hizaw hi."},"24":{"text":"Na up hamtang tu uh thu sia hamtangin kong sawl buatu uh a, na upna uh kip hi ci in kong he uh hi. Noma lungdam natu in note taw na a seam khawm ka hizaw uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahikom note kong heesak ngawl natu in note kungah pai kik ngawl tu in ka khensat zo hi."},"2":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile note hong heesak thong leng kei hong lungdamsak tu akua om nawn tu ziam? Keima ii kong heesak te ma om bek tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua hu in no tungah tua laithak kong at ahi hi — Keima hong lungdamsak tute ma in hong heesak tu ahiciang, no kungah pai tu ka uuk bua hi. Banghang ziam cile keima ka lung a dam le, note zongh lungdam ci in ka um hi."},"4":{"text":"Lai kong thaak lai in thinsung buaingawpna le khuangaina taw thitui taakin lai kong at hi; ka tupna sia note kong heesak nopna hi ngawl a, bangza in note hong it khi ziam, ci in kong telsak nopna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu in mi khat pawpo in, mihing khat a khuangaisak le kei bek hong heesak hi ngawlin, a nobelin ci leang — note theampo hong heesak ahi hi. (Hi bangin ka ci sia ama tungah a nasia kamkhal ka pau nop ngawl hang ahi hi.)","title":"A Mawpa tung Mawmaisakna"},"6":{"text":"Note a tamzaw in hisia pa sia tu a bangma in daan pia zo na hi uh ciangin, pha zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu in bang po ahizong ama mawna maisak tavun a, hee leilam in a thin a lal ngawl natu in na hanthawn vun."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama na it takpi na uh na telsak natu in kong thuum hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua lai kong thaak sia banghang ziam cile ze etna sia bangbangin do zo a, tuaciangin kei ii hilna bangza dongin ni nu ziam ci in kong heak nop hang ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Khat po ii a ngamtatna tungtaang ah mawna na maisak uh ciang, kei zongh in ama ka maisak hi. Banghang ziam cile maw ka maisak ciangin — tuabang a kul takpi ma ahile — Christ ii hong ompuina taw in note hang in mawmaisak ka hi hi;"},"11":{"text":"Satan ngealnate he ka hikom in; ama hong nopzaw ngawl natu in ka maisak ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Christ huvau Lungdamna Thupha hil tu in Troas khua ka thet ciang tua munah Topa in nasep natu lampi hon sa in a koi ka mu hi.","title":"Troas ah Paul ii Thinngimna","ref":"Sawl 20:1"},"13":{"text":"Ahihang tualai ah ih suapuipa Titus mu zo ngawl ka hikom nasia takin ka thinngim hi. Tua ahikom tua munah a om mihingte mangpha thaak in Macedonia ah ka pai suak hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian tungah lungdamnate kiko tahen! Banghang ziam cile Christ taw kipumkhatna hu in, Pathian in Christ ii ngalzawna sungah a mat sate bangin Pathian in eite lam hong pui tawntung hi. Christ thu heakna sia mun theampo ah paaknamtui bangin a kizel natu in Pathian in eite hong zangh hi.","title":"Christ tungtawnin Zawna"},"15":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile eite sia Christ ii Pathian tungah a piak paaknamtui taw ih kibang a, ngupna a ngate le a mangthangte sungah ih kizel hi."},"16":{"text":"A mangthangte atu in tuasia in ngual a thisak thei a ui mama thina ngim hi a; ahihang ngupna a ngate atu in nuntakna a pia ngimnamtui ahi hi. Tua ahile tuabang nasepte a seam zo tu akua om ziam?"},"17":{"text":"Kote sia Pathian thu takpi vanh ngina ngawl te zuak bangin a son midang tam mama te taw ka kibang bua uh hi; ahihang Pathian in hong sawl ahikom, thinsung maan tak taw ama mai ah Christ ii naseamte bangin thu ka son uh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu a teng ih son ciang koma le koma a kisuangtaak kik bang hi nong sa uh ziam? Ngualdang pawlkhatte bangin note tungah piak tu ahizong, noma in ko tung a nong piak tu uh ahizong, kiheaksakna laite kul tu ziam?","title":"Kiciamna Thak ii A Naseamte"},"2":{"text":"Noma mama sia mihing theampo ii heak tu le sim tu in, kote lungtang tungah a ki at, ka nei uh laithak sia na hi uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Christ ama mama in hi laithak at in kote puak tu in hong thaak a hina thu kitel mama hi. Tua lai sia laitui taw ki at ngawlin, a nungta Pathian ii Thaa taw ki at a, suangpheak tungah ki at ngawlin, mihingte lungtang tungah ki at hi.","ref":"Pu 24:12; Jer 31:33; Eze 11:19; 36:26"},"4":{"text":"Christ tungtawnin Pathian ka muan uh manin hi bangin ka ci thei uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi nasep ka sep thei natu in koma sungah son ngam tu sep theina bangma ka nei bua uh hi. Tua sep theina ka nei uh sia Pathian kung panin hong pai ahi hi;"},"6":{"text":"Lai taw ki at Thukham pan hi ngawl a, Thaa pan hong piang thuciamthak a tu in, hong seamsak thei sia ama ahi hi. A ki at thukham in thina piangsak a, ahihang Thaa in nuntakna pia hi.","ref":"Jer 31:31"},"7":{"text":"Thukham sia suangpheak tungah a kikhuak laimalte hi a, a kipiak laitakin, Pathian ii vaangletna kilangh hi. Moses ii maitang tungah a taang sia mial vaial ahihang nasia takin taang ahikom, tua laitak Israel mite in a maitang a salh zo bua uh hi. Thina hong puak Thukham in, ama hun sung tua za in vaangletna taw hong pai ahile,","ref":"Pu 34:29"},"8":{"text":"Thaa ii tukna le dianna taw kisai vaangletna in bangza in nasia zaw tu ziam!"},"9":{"text":"Kimawsakna a piangsak thu sia vaanglian ahile; ngupna a piangsak sia ii tukna le dianna sia bangza in vaanglian zaw tu ziam!"},"10":{"text":"Tua vaangletna a taangzaw pek sia hangin a bosa hunsung a, a taang mama sia ii vaangletna sia a bo zo hi, kici thei hi."},"11":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, tawmvei sung bek a kikhom sia sungah vaangletna om ahile a tawntungin a kikhomsuan vaangletna sia bangza in tamzaw kan tu ziam!"},"12":{"text":"Hi lametna ka nei uh hu in, kote ka hang mama uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kote in a maitang pan a vaangletna, a mial vaial in a bona sia Israel mite ii mu ngawl natu in, dial taw a maitang a seal, Moses bang ka hi bua uh hi.","ref":"Pu 34:33"},"14":{"text":"Amate thinsung kikhak takpi hi; amate in thuciamlui thubute a sim uh ciang tuni dongin, tua dial in a thinsung uh siin lai hi. Mihing khat in Christ taw a kizop ciang bek in, tua dial sia kihepsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuni ngawngawn dongin Moses Thukham a sim uh ciangin tua dial in amate thinsung siincip lai hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang kiheam thei hi. Moses thu laithiangtho sungah: “Topa sang ah a kiheak ciangin ama dial sia kiheam hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 34:34"},"17":{"text":"Tu in hi lai sungah “Topa” ci in a ki at sia Thaa ahi hi; Topa ii Thaa omna munah suatakna om hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom eite theampo in, a kisiin ngawl maitangte taw Topa vaangletna kilanghsak vun. Thaa ahi Topa kung pan hong pai tua vaangletna sia ma in a nasia vaial vaangletna sungah ama ii pianzia bangin eite hong kheal hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian in ama ii hong hesuakna taw hi nasep tu hong pia ahikom ka thin uh a kiam bua hi.","title":"Tungbealte sungah Thaa Sumngum"},"2":{"text":"Thuku theampo le a maizumhuai ngamtat nate theampo ka vawk uh hi; theamna taw na ka seam bua uh a, Pathian ii kammal zongh leilot thu ka suaksak bua uh hi. Pathian muna ah thumaanna ii a kicing khuavak sungah ka nungta uh a, mihing sim ii a pha in a tel thei natu ka hanciam uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, kong hil uh lungdamna thu kiseal ahile a mangthangte mun pan bekma in a kiseal ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Hi leitung pathian ngilopa in amate thinsung sia khuazing sungah keamcip ahikom um ngawl uh hi. Pathian taw a kibang linlian Christ ii minthanna huvau tua Lungdamna Thupha pan hong pai, amate tungah hong taang khuavak a mu thei ngawl natu in ama in vawt hi."},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, kote kong hil thu in koma ii thu ahi bua hi; Jesus Christ sia Topa hi ci in kong hil uh a, Jesus hangin note ii naseamte bang ka hi uh hi."},"6":{"text":"“Khuazing sung pan khuavak hong taang tu hi!” a ci Pathian sia ma in Christ ii maitang ah a taang Pathian ii vaangletna heak natu in kote thinsung ah a khuavak hong taangsak ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 1:3"},"7":{"text":"Ahitazong vaangletna lianbel sia Pathian neisa hi a, kote aa hi ngawl hi ci sia a kilak natu in thaa thu ah sumngum a nei kote sia tungbeal thawthong taw kibang khu hi."},"8":{"text":"Kote ngim nga nithi ka hi uh hang, ka lalcip bua uh a, khat vevei lungmang ka hi uh hang, thinkiam ngeingawl khu hi;"},"9":{"text":"ngal tam mama a om hang ngualtamh sel ngeingawl khu hi. Khat vevei nasia takin hong kiliamsua kale hong kisusia zo ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesus ii nuntakna ka pumpi uh sungah a kimu thei natu in, ama thina sia, a thithei ka pumpi uh sungah ka vom top uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Hi a thithei ka pumpi uh pan ama ii nuntakna a kimu thei natu in, ka nuntak sung tawntung, Jesus hangin thi tu launa ka nei tawntung uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Thina in kote sungah na hong seam hi, ahihang nuntakna in note sungah na hong seam hi, cinopna hi."},"13":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “Um ka hikomin ka son hi,” ci hi. Tua upna thin bangma in kote zongh in um ka hi uh hu in, ka son uh hi.","ref":"Ps 116:10"},"14":{"text":"Topa Jesus sia nuntakna sungah a thosak kik Pathian in kote zongh Jesus taw hong thotosak tu a, note taw kingawm in ama omna munah hong la khawm tu hi, ci in ka he uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Hite theampo sia note atu hi a; Pathian ii thuthiamna in mihing a tam vaialte tungah a thet ciangin, amate in Pathian minthan natu in lungdamko thungetnate a tamzaw nei tu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Hi thu hu in kote ka thin uh a kiam ngei bua hi. Ih pumpi cii le sa sia dadam in muamuat ahihang ih thaa nuntakna sia ni khat zawk ni khat hong kithaksua hi.","title":"Upna taw Nuntakna"},"17":{"text":"Tuaciang, hi tawmvei hunsung ka thuak uh ngimna tawmnote in, tua ngimna sangin a tamzaw pek, a lian mama tawntung minthanna sungah kote hong then tu hi."},"18":{"text":"A kimu thei nate mitsuan ka hi bua uh a, a kimu thei ngawl nate hizaw hi. A kimu theite sia tawmvei sung bek kikhom a, a kimu thei ngawlte sia a tawntungin kikhom hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, hi ih teenna buk — hisung leitung ah ih pumpi kisia le — a tawntungin a kikhomsuan tu, eite teen natu Pathian in vantung ah inn khat nei tu hi ci in ih he hi."},"2":{"text":"Vantung pan hong pai ih inn sia eite tungah hong kikhu natu ih thangaina sia, tu in nasia mama ahikom ih vuisa hi;"},"3":{"text":"tuabangin tuasia hong kisilhsak ciangin eite sia pumpi nei ngawlin ih om buatu hi."},"4":{"text":"Hi leitung buk sungah ih teen laiteng in, hong kizothaw kisa in ih tau hi; tuabang ih ci ciang hi leitung pumpi suut nuam ih hi bua a, thi theina sia nuntakna taw hong kikheal natu in vantung pumpi sia ei tungah hong silhsak tu in ih deina ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian in hi kikheal natu in, eite hong puuakhol a, ei atu hong kholsakte theampo hong kipsakna in ama ii Thaa hong pia hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom eite in thin letna taw ih kidim tawntung hi. Ih pumpi inn sungah ih om lai tengin, eite in Topa inn taw a kikhuala ih hi hi."},"7":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile eite in upna taw ih nungta a, muna taw ahi bua hi."},"8":{"text":"Eite in thinletna taw ih kidim a, hi ih pumpi inn nusia in Topa taw om tu sia ih uuk zaw hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom hi sung inn ah ahizong, tuasung inn ah ahizong thudang theampo sangin Ama ih lungkimsak tu sia ih deibel ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile eite theampo thukhenna thuak tu in Christ mai ah ih ding nanak tu hi. Mihing khat simin a leitung pumpi nuntak sungah ama ii sepna a pha a sia taw a kiphu a kilawm in nga tek tu uh hi.","ref":"Rom 14:10"},"11":{"text":"Topa kiitakna ii a cinopna ka he uh a, tua hu in, ngual zongh, tuabang ahithei natu in ka hanthawn uh hi. Pathian in kote sia a khawng a kheakin hong heak bangma in na thinsung uh ah, keima zongh hong he tu in kong muangmaw hi.","title":"Christ tungtawnin Pathian taw Kilawmtatna"},"12":{"text":"Note tungah ko le ko a kiphatson tu in a hanciam kik ka hi bua uh hi. Mihingte ngamtatna en ngawl a, a meal a sa en in a kisuangtaakte na zo kik thei natu in kote nong kiphatsak pui natu ahang sia hong lak nuam ka hizaw uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A thin amh tatak ka hi uh ziam? Thin amh ka hi uh le Pathian atu hi a, tua ahibuale thinciim ka hi uh ziam? Tua ahile zong note atu hi."},"14":{"text":"Christ hong itna in kote hong uk hi, tu in ahile mihing khat in mihing theampo atu thi hi ci in ka tel uh hi, tua in amate theampo sia ama thina sungah thi khawm hi a cinopna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"A nungtate in amate atu nungta nawn ngawlin amate atu thi a, ahihang amate atu in nuntakna sungah a kithosak kik pa atu a nungta ahithei natu in ama in mihing theampo atu in thi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, mihingte munate taw kuama tungah thu ka khen nawn bua uh hi. Khatvei lai in Christ sia mihing munate taw thukhen ngei ka hita uh zong tu in tuabangin ka khen nawn bua uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo in Christ taw a kizom le ama in mihing thak ahi hi; a nuntakna lui sia bo in a thak hong piang zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Hiteng theampo Pathian nasepna hi a, ama in Christ tungtawnin, a ngalte ih hina panin a lawmte hong suaksak zo a, ngualdangte zongh a lawmte ih suasak natu in, eite tungah vaipuak hong pia hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka thupuak uh sia in Christ tungtawnin Pathian in mihing nam theampo ama lawmte hong suaksak hi, ci thu ahi hi. Pathian in amate mawna sazian keam ngawl a, tuaciang bangbangin ama in a lawmte suaksak cina thu ko hong hil hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahiciang hi sungah kote Pathian ma in kote tungtawnin note tungah hong thuum bangma in Christ atu in thuson ka hi uh hi. Christ ii taangin kong thuum uh hi: Pathian in a ngalte na hina uh pan, a lawmte hong suaksak tahen!"},"21":{"text":"Ama taw ih kipumkhatna hangin Pathian bang a, thumaan thutang ih sua thei natu in, mawnei ngawl Christ sia Pathian in eite taangin mawnei suaksak hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, Pathian taw ko ii nasep khopna sungah Pathian ii thuthiamna a saangte in, tua thu thiamna sia a luithawthong a suasak ngawl natu in kong thuum uh hi."},"2":{"text":"Pathian pauna ngai vun: “Note maipha kong piak tu hun hong thet ciang, note ngetna kong za hi; kong ngup tu ni hong thet ciang, note kong hu hi.” Ngai vun! Pathian ii hesuakna saan thei tu sia tu hun hi; hong kingup tu ni sia tuni ahi hi!","ref":"Is 49:8"},"3":{"text":"Ka nasepna uh taw kisai in khat pawpo ii mawna hong zon tu sia ka dei bua uh a, tua ahikom kuama haksatnate a nga natu in ka hanciam bua uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Na ka sepna sung theampo ah Pathian naseamte ka hina uh ka lakna uh in, thinsau takin ngimna thuak zawkna, haksatna le buainate ka thuak kenkon zaw uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Kote sia hong kivel a, thong sungah hong khumin, hong vawtsia uh hi; naseam leilam in, mu ngawlin, an ne ngawlin ka om uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:23"},"6":{"text":"Pathian naseamte ka hina uh sia thiangtho nuntakna, thu heakna, thinsauna le dikna — Thaa Thiangtho taw, ki itna tatak taw,"},"7":{"text":"a maan thuhilna le Pathian ii vaangletna teng taw ka lak uh hi. Thutang suana sia ka ngalhiam uh hi a, ngaldo natu le koma le koma kihuukna tu in ka nei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Kote sia hong kithasia a, hong kizawngsak si hi; hong kilang a hong kipok si hi. Kote sia thumaan ka son uh hang a leilot theite bangin hong kivawt hi;"},"9":{"text":"ngual theampo in hong he ahihang a kihe ngeingawlte bangin hong kivawt hi; nong mu uh bangma kote nungta napi a thisate bangin hong kivawt hi. Daan hong kipia ahizong, hong kithatlum ngawl hi;"},"10":{"text":"hong heesak ahihang ka lung uh dam tawntung hi; a zawng bang ka hi uh hangin, mihing tam mamate ka hausak uh hi; neisa bangma nei ngawl tu bang ka hi uh hangin, na theampo a nei tatakte ka hi uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Corinth khua a om ka it lawmte awng! No tungah ip nei ngawlin kong son zo uh hi; ka thinsung kongkha uh kong hon siat uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Note tungah kote in ka thinsung uh hong khakbil hi ngawlin; noma in kote sia na thinsung uh hong khabil nu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu in note sia ka tate bangin kong pau hi: note tungah kong nei uh thinpuak bangin, kote tungah thinpuak nong neina uh hong lak tavun. Na thinsung kongkha uh hongin na taanzausak vun."},"14":{"text":"Thu um ngawlte taw kipawl tu sia suak thei ngawl ahikom amate taw kibangin na na seam khawm heak vun. A maan le a maan ngawl sia bangbangin kipawl khawm thei tu ziam? Bangbangin khuavak le khuazing sia teang khawm thei tu ziam?","title":"Doai biate ii Hong zawna tu pan Kidop natu"},"15":{"text":"Christ le Doaimangpa sia bangbangin thu kisi thei tu ziam? Thu um khat in thu um ngawl khat taw bangbangin na khat nei khawm thei tu ziam?"},"16":{"text":"Pathian ii biakinn sia doai biakna milimte taw bangbangin thukimna vawt thei tu ziam? Banghang ziam cile eite sia a nungta Pathian biakinn ih hi hi! Pathian in: “Ka mite sungah ka inn ka vawt tu a, amate sungah ka teang tu hi; keima in amate Pathian ka hi tu a, amate in keima mihingte ahi tu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Thiam 26:12; Eze 37:27; 1 Cor 3:16; 6:19"},"17":{"text":"Tuaciangin Topa in, “Amate nusia nanak in a, amate taw kikhen tavun. A thiangtho ngawlte taw kipeena bangma nei heak vun, tua hile note kong saang tu hi, ci hi.","ref":"Is 52:11"},"18":{"text":"Vaanglianbel Topa in, Keima in note ii Pa kong hi tu a, note sia ka tapate le ka tanute na hi tu uh hi, ci hi,” a ci hi.","ref":"2 Sa 7:14; 1 Khang 17:13; Is 43:6; Jer 31:9"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka it ka lawmte awng, hi kamciamte theampo sia eite tungah hong kipia hi. Tua ahiciang pumpi le thinsung a ninsak thei nate theampo panin kithiansua in, Pathian ih thasiana taw a thiangtho sinsen suak tawng."},"2":{"text":"Kote na thinsung uh ah hong saang tavun.
