Kote kuama tungah khial ngawl khu hi; kuama siatsua ngawl, kuama tungah hamphatna la ngeingawl khu hi.","title":"Paul ii Lungdamna"},"3":{"text":"Noma hong mawsak nuam a, tuabangin kong ci hi ngawl hi; banghang ziam cile tu masia a kong ci sa bangma in note sia kote atu in ithuai mama na hi uh hang in, ih thi zong ih nung zong, a omkhawm tawntung ih hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Note kong muang mama hi; note hangin ka kisuangtaak hi! Thinngimna theampo sungah thin letna taw ka kidim lai hi; lungnopna taw ka kidim leet hi."},"5":{"text":"Macedonia ka thet zawk uh ciang zong tawlngak hun ka nei bua uh hi. Haksatna sia mun theampo ah om a, ngual taw kihauna, thinsung patauna taw ka om uh hi.","ref":"2 Cor 2:13"},"6":{"text":"Ahihang a thinkiamte a han sua Pathian in Titus hong paina taw kote hong hanthawn hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama hong pai hu bek hi ngawlin, noma ii ama na hanthotnate zongh hong ko hu in hong lungdamsak hi. Kei nong mu nop mama na thu, na khuangai mama na uh le kei nong huuk natu in a kinging sa in na omnate uh hong ko hi; tua ahikom tu in ka lungdam seseam hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua kong laithak sia in note hong khuangaisak ahile zong, tua ka at sia ka hee tuan bua hi. Tuasia in tawmvei sung teng hong khuangaisak sia ka heak ciangin, khuangai nuam leng khuangai thei tu khi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang tu in ka lungdam hi — kong heesak hang hi ngawlin, na heena uh sia in no hong kikhealsak ahi hu in ka lungdam hi. Tua heena sia Pathian in zangh a, tua ahikom note atu in, bangma siatna kong piangsak bua uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian ih zak heena in ngupna nga natu in thin kikhealna piangsak hi — tua ii sungah bangma kisii natu om ngawl hi! Ahihang mihing ii heena lel bek in thina piangsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Na heena uh sia Pathian in bangbang hi ziam ci sia en vun: tuasia in bangzata in nang hong lawpsak a, na maw ngawlna ah bangza in hong panpui nuam ziam! Tuabang thin uukna, patauna, thinsung phaw theinate, thangaina, a khialte daan piak nopna cite piangsak hi! Hi thu theampo ah note pau baang ngawl ci in noma le noma kilak zo nu hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom tua laithak kong at hang, a khialpa, ahibuale a thuakpa ngaisutna taw hong at hizaw ngawlin Pathian ii muna ah ko thu bangza in hong ni ci sia a kiheak natu hong at ka hizaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom tha ka nga mama uh hi. Tha ka nga uh bek dom ngawl hi; thinnopna a nga natu in note theampo in tha na piakna uh Titus ii lungdam hu in, ka lung uh hong damsak hi!"},"14":{"text":"Titus mai ah note hangin ka kisuangtaak a, kei nong thinkiamsak bua uh hi. Note tungah thumaan kong son tawntung bangma in Titus mai a ka kisuantaakna uh sia a maan ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Note theampo in bangbangin ama thupiakte ni nuam a, bangbangin liinna le launa taw ama zindo cisia a phaw ciang ama in note hong itna khang seseam hi."},"16":{"text":"Na theampo ah note kong suan thei manin ka lungdam mama hi!"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Koma suapuite awng, Pathian ii thuthiamna in, Macedonia pawlpite sungah bang matutna nei ziam ci sia kong hesak nuam hi.","title":"Tapidawte Piakna"},"2":{"text":"A thuak ngimna te taw amate nasia takin kize et hi; ahihang a lungdamna uh lian mama ahikom, amate zawng mama napi, piakna ah ngo thei mama uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate in ahi theiza uh pia a, a ci thei za tungsia ngawngawn zongh pia uh hi, ka ci ngam hi. Amate uuk thu in"},"4":{"text":"Judea ngam a om Pathian ii mihingte huna sungah a kihel thei lei natu in ko tungah hesuak hong ngen uh hi.","ref":"Rom 15:26"},"5":{"text":"Tuate in kote lametna sang zonghin nasia zaw hi! A masa phit in amate Topa tungah kipia uh hi; tua zawkciang Pathian ii deina taw amate in kote tung zongh ah hong kipia hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahiciangin hi nasep a pan Titus tungah a zopto suak natu le hi ki itna sungah sepna sia a khuangkhim dong na sep to thei natu in hong hu natu ka hanthawn uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Note ii na nei uh ahi: thu upna, thusonna, thuheakna, midangte hu tu lawpna le kote nong itna uh theampo ah kicing mama nu hi. Tua ahikom in, itna taw kisai nasepna zong ah na ngo tatak tu uh kong dei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Zui tu ngeinate hong koisak ka hi bua hi. Ngualdangte sia tua zata in ngual hu nuamin a lawpna thu kong lakna taw note zongh ngual na itna uh sia bangza ahi tatak ziam ci in ka tel nopna ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa Jesus Christ ii thuthiamna sia na heak uh hi; ama sia hau mama napi in, ama zawnna taw note a hau na sua thei natu in note atu in ama le ama a zawngin hong kivawt ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Kei ngaisutna pan, ningkum a na patsa uh nasep sia tu in na man thiang tu sia phazaw hi. Note sia a diang phitte na hi uh dom ngawlin, dian tu a uukte zongh na hi uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahiciang seam tan vet tavun a, man thiang tavun! Na ngeal uh lai in na lawp uh bangma in, man thiang tu zongh na lawp tavun a, tu in na neisun uh po taw naseam vun."},"12":{"text":"Piak tu na thalawp uh le, na nei ngawlna tung pan hi ngawlin, na neina taw kizui in na piak tu za letsong sia Pathian in hong saang tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ngualdangte noptuam natu in note tungah vanhngit hong suan nuam ka hi bua hi; ahihang tu laitakin note ci thei na hi uh ciang, a cimawte hu le uhte ma pha tu hi; tua hile note na cimawk hun ciang amate ci thei in no hong hu tu hi. Hi bangin noma ngeal a kikimin, na kihu vadiam tu uh ahi hi.","merge":"14"},"15":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “Tam a kaikhawm sia atu tam lei ngawl tu a, tawm a kaikhawm sia atu zongh tawm lei ngawl tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 16:8"},"16":{"text":"Kote ii no kong hu nop uh bangma in Titus ii note lawp tak a hong husak Pathian tungah bangza in ka lung uh dam ziam!","title":"Titus le A kitholpuite"},"17":{"text":"Kote ngetna hong saang bek hi ngawl hi; note hong hu tu sia lawp a, ama hantang in note kung hong zot tu sia ama thu taw khensat hi."},"18":{"text":"Lungdamna thuhil nasepna ah pawlpi theampo ii a thasia mama ih suapuipa khat sia ama taw kong paisak uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuasia bek hi ngawlin, ngual ka hu nopna uh ka lak thei natu in Topa minthan natu ka sep suak uh, hi itna taw kisai nasepna sungah kote taw khual a haw khawm tu in pawlpi ii tealsa, a kiseesa ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ngo tak a, letsong kipiaknate ka zeakna uh ah kuama a phun ngawl natu in ka kidawm uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka tupna uh sia Topa mai bek ah hi ngawlin, mihingte mai zongh ah a maan in a seam nuam ka hi uh hi.","ref":"Pau 3:4"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom ih suapuipa sia amate taw kong paikhawmsak uh hi; tamvei ma a zia ka en zo uh a, a tawntungin ngual hu tu lawp mama hi ci in ka mu uh hi. Tu in ama in note tungah muanna hong nei tatak ciangin ama in ngual hu tu lawp vaial hi."},"23":{"text":"Titus ahile, keima naseppui hi a, note hong hu tu in keima taw naseampa ahi hi; amate taw a kithawl suapui dangte sia pawlpite taangmi hi a, Christ minthangsak hi."},"24":{"text":"Note kong kiphatsak pui na uhte thumaan hi ci in pawlpi theampo in a tel natu in amate tungah na itna uh na lak tavun."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judea ngam ah Pathian ii mihingte atu huna a kipuak huvau in, lai kong at sia a kul vateal hi ngawl hi.","title":"Tapidaw Puite atu Huna"},"2":{"text":"Note sia ngual hu nuamte hi ci in kong he hi, tuasia bangma in Macedonia mite tungah note kong kisuantaakpui hi. “Achaia a om suapuite in, ningkum panin huna pia nuam zo hi,” ci in ka na son hi. Noma lawpna in amate a tamzaw thawn zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi thu huvau note kong kiphatsak pui nate a luithawthong a sua ngawl natu in hi suapuite tu in kong paisak hi. Ahihang kong ci sa bangma in, amate na hu natu uh taw na kingingta khol vun."},"4":{"text":"Ahizong, note tungah ta za muanna hong kinei napi keima taw Macedonia pan mihingte kong pai uh ciangin, huna taw a kinging sa in om bua le uhte, note maizum tu bek son ngawlin, kote atu zongh bangza in maizumhuai tu ziam!"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikomin, piak tu na kamciamsa letsongte a kinging kholsa in a om natu in, keima kong pai ma, hi suapuite hong paikhol tu sia hanthot tu kul ka sa hi. Tua hile kei kong thet ciang, kingin sa suak tu a, tuaciang piak tu a kul hang hi ngawlin, thinzawna taw a pia nuam ka hina uh hong kilangh tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Thaicii tawm a poaipa in an tawm bek at tu a; tam a poaipa in an tam mama a at tu hi, ci in na phawk tavun."},"7":{"text":"Tua hi a, mihing sim in ama khensat sa om bangin pia tu a, thinnop ngawlna taw, ahibuale piak nanak kul tu bangin ngaisutna taw pia ngawl tu hi; banghang ziam cile lungdam thinzo takin a pia sia Pathian in diksa hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuaciang noma atu in na kitaangsap theampo na nei tawntung natu le, thupha vawt natu theampo ah a kicing za sangin a tamzaw na nei natu in, Pathian in na kitaangsap za sangin a tamzaw hong pia thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Laithiangtho in: “Ama in a kitaangsamhte tungah ngo takin pia a; ama dikna sia a tawntungin a kikhomsuan hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 112:9"},"10":{"text":"Poai tu ancii le neak tu an hong pia Pathian in na kisap thaicii theampo zongh hong pia tu a, tuate po in, anlaak ciang nangma ii ngo tak a na piakna tung panin an na hau tu hi.","ref":"Is 55:10"},"11":{"text":"Pathian in ngo takin a pia thei tawntung tu in, a khom in hong hausak tawntung tu hi; tuabangin letsong na piak uhte ko tung pan a nga uh ciang mihing tam mama in Pathian pok tu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile hi piakna, nasepna in Pathian ii mihingte kitaangsapna bek a hu hi ngawlin, Pathian tungah nasia tak lungdamko honna piangsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaciangin hi nasepna tungtawnin a kimu thei thute hang in, na up uh Christ lungdamna thu tungah na thumaanna uh hu ahizong, amate le ngualdang theampo taw ngo tak a na kihopna uh hu ahizong, mihing tam mama te in Pathian minthangsak tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang in note tungah Pathian ii thuthiamna a lamdangin hong piak hu in, note atu amate in ki itna a thuk tatak taw thu hong ngetsak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"A manh a kisep zo ngawl letsong hong piak hu in Pathian tungah lungdamko tawng!"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima Paul in keima aituamin kong thuum hi — Note taw ka omkhop ciangin dikin cingh a, no taw a kikhuala a ka om ciangin hangsan hong kici hi. Christ cikna le thiamna hu in kei zongh note kung kong pai ciangin, ka hangsan a kul tu dong hong kivawt ngawl natu kong thuum hi;","title":"Paul in Pathian Nasepna A Huukna"},"2":{"text":"banghang ziam cile, leitung deinate taw ngamta hi hong cite tungah hangsan thei khi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi leitung ah a teang ka hi uh sia thumaan hi, ahihang leitung nate lungngulna taw ngalsim ka hi bua uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kidona sungah ka zak uh ngalhiamte sia leitung ngalhiamte hi ngawlin, kulh khote lalcipsak natu ka zak uh a thahat Pathian ii vaangletna ngalhiamte ahi hi. Kam kinialna maan ngawlte ka saatmit uh hi;"},"5":{"text":"Pathian thu heak natu hong nokkhaksak thei kiphatsakna teng ka sumit uh hi; ngaisutna a minpiang sia man in ka khumcip uh a, Christ ii thu ka nisak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuaciangin note na thumaanna uh na kitelthiangsak zawkciangin, thumaan ngawl ngamtatna pawpo daan pia tu in ka kinging tu uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Note sia a puatham omzia teng bek na en uh hi. Khat po in Christ ii neisa in a kituat a om ziam? Pha hi, ama le ama ngaisun kik tahen, banghang ziam cile kote zongh ama za ma in, Christ ii neisa ka hi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Topa ii thuneina hong piakte hu in, ka kisuangtaak ngawp tha le zong ka mai a zum bua hi — tua thuneina sia no kong sukcip natu hi ngawlin, kong lapto natu ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Lai kong thaakte taw no hong lausak nuam a, hanciam bang ka hi tu sia ka dei bua hi."},"10":{"text":"Khat po in, “Paul laithakte sia kamkhal kamciik veu zangh ahihang, ama tatak ei taw hong om ciang, ama thaneam in, a kammalte zongh bangma ahi tuan bua hi!” ci tha tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabang mihing khat in note taw kong omkhop ngawl uh ciang laithakte sung kong at uh thu le, tua munah note taw kong om uh ciang ka vawt tu uh thute sia a kilamdang buatu hi ci in tel hamtang tahen."},"12":{"text":"A tatak ahile amate le amate a kiliansak mama te taw a kibangin, ka kituat bua a, ka kitee ngat ngam buatu hi. Amate bangza mawmaw ziam! Amate le amate ki en in, a kitee natu vawt tawm a khat le khat a kimuna za uh taw thukhente ahi uh hi!"},"13":{"text":"Ahizong ko ka hi uhle, ka kisuantaakna uh in, a omsa ciangtanna a vaal buatu uh hi; Pathian ii hong see sa a kiciangtan nasepte sung bek ah ka kisuangtaak uh a, no sungah na ka sep uh sia zongh kihel hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangtanna huam sungah om na hi uh ciang, Christ huvau Lungdamna Thupha puakin note kungah kong pai uh ciangin tuate ka kan buatu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom Pathian hong koisak sa ciangtannate kalhin midangte sepna sungah ka kisuangtaak bua uh hi. Tua sangin Pathian hong koisak sa ciangtanna sung teng ah seam tawntung a, na upna uh khangto thei in note sungah ka nasepna uh a taangzai zaw thei tu in ka lamen uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin Lungdamna Thupha sia note ii ngalkhat ngamte ah ka hil thei tu uh a, ngualdang khat ii lo sungah a kiseam sa nasep tungtaang ah kiphatsak natu a om buatu hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahihang laithiangtho in, “A kuama po a kisuangtaak nuam sia in, Topa sep sa tungah kisuangtaak tahen,” a ci bang hi tu hi.","ref":"Jer 9:24"},"18":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile mihing khat sia, ama le ama pha a kisak ciang hi ngawlin, a phat takpi hunlam a kimu ciangin tua pa sia Topa in pha hi ci in a ngaisun hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka mawmaw phial zonghin, nong thuak zawk natu ka dei hi. Hong khual tavun!","title":"Paul le Sawltak Maan ngawlte"},"2":{"text":"Pathian in note hong thinbot bangma in kei zongh in kong thinbot hi; note sia pasal khat bek taw kiteang tu a kamciam ka piaksa ngaknu thiangtho khat bang na hi uh a, tua pasal in Christ mama ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Eve sia ngul ii leilot pilnate taw a theam bangma in — na thinsung uh lalin Christ tungah a kicing le a thiangtho in na kipiakna uhte na nusiat thaak tu uh ka lau hi.","ref":"Pian 3:1-5,13"},"4":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile kote ii kong hil Jesus ahi ngawl, Jesus a dang khat ii thu, hil a hong pai pawpo sia lungdamin saang nu hi; kote tung panin, na nga uh Thaa le lungdamna thu taw a kibang ngawl het thaa le lungdamna thu na saang uh hi!"},"5":{"text":"Note ii “sawltakte” na ci tuamte sangin kei sia bekcik zongh nozaw tuanin ka kingaisun bua hi!"},"6":{"text":"Thu sonna ah a kipan tuung hi kaleng heakna ah tuabang ka hi bua het hi; hi thu sia hun theampo sung le a omzia theampo thiang takin kong son tawntung sa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Pathian Lungdamna Thupha sia note tungah kong hil ciangin thaman bangma kong la bua a; noma kong thupi vawt na in keima le keima ka kiniamkhiak hi. Tuasia in khial ka hi ziam?"},"8":{"text":"Note sungah kong sep laitakin pawlpi dangte in kei sia sum taw hong tham hi. Note kong hu natu in amate a suasuam ci tu bang ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Note sungah na ka sep laitakin, huna sum ka kisap ciang, no kong konlaw bua hi; Macedonia pan hong pai suapuite in ka kisap theampo hong puak hi. A bosa hunsung bangma in mai sang zongh ah: note atu in vanhngit ka hi ngei buatu hi!","ref":"Php 4:15-18"},"10":{"text":"Achaia ngam koima theampo ah hi keima kisuantaakna sia, kuama in hong khaam ngawl tu ci in ka sungah a om Christ ii thumaanna taw kong kamciam hi."},"11":{"text":"Kong it ngawl hu in hi bangin pau ka hi ziam? Pathian in note kong it hunlam hong tel hi!"},"12":{"text":"Tua “sawltak” te in kote sep bangma ka seam uh ci in kisuantaak natu thu khat po a nei thei ngawl natu in, tu a ka sep teng ma ka seam tan lai tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua mihingte sia sawltak tatakte hi ngawl hi — amate sawltak maan ngawlte hi a, a nasepna huvau leilot in Christ sawltak tatak te bangin a kimealsealte ahi uh hi."},"14":{"text":"A lamdang hi ngawl hi! Satan ngawngawn zongh khuavak vantunglalang khat taw kibang tu in, kimealseal thei lai hi!"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama ii naseamte in, thutang naseamte taw kibang tu in a kimealseal le a lamdangpi hi ngawl hi. A tawpna ah amate in a ngamtatnate uh taw a kiphu bang tatakin nga tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Keima sia a mawmaw in kuama in hong tuat heak hen kong ci kik hi. Ahizong tuabangin, nong ngaisun uh le zong, kiphatsak pui tu tawmno ka nei thei natu beak in a mawmaw khat bangin hong saang lamh tavun.","title":"Sawltak khat a hina taw Paul ii Thuaknate"},"17":{"text":"Tu a ka papau teng ahile Topa ii hong pausak tute hi ngawl hi; hi kisuantaakna vai ah a mawmaw khat bangin ka pau takpi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahihang mihing ngaisutna lelte taw zong a kisuangtaak om ahiciang, kei zongh tuabang ma ka ngamta tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Noma tek ma ciim mama na hi uh komin, mihing mawmawte sia lungdam takin na dual uh hi!"},"20":{"text":"Note a uk bang po hong sawlte, note tung pan na neisa hong duupte, thaang taw hong siate, hong nomute ahibuale na maitang hong beangte khat pawpo na dual uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuabangte vawt tu in ih lauthauh leihna teng ka pualaak tu sia ka maizum hi! Ahihang khat pawpo in bang khat po huvau in a kisuangtaak ngam le — a mawmaw bangin pau tu ci leang — kei zongh ka kisuangtaak ngam tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Amate sia Hebrew mi ahi uh ziam? Kei zongh ka hi hi. Amate sia Israel te ahi uh ziam? Kei zongh ka hi hi. Amate sia Abraham suante ahi uh ziam? Kei zongh ka hi hi."},"23":{"text":"Amate sia Christ ii naseamte ahi uh ziam? A mawmaw bang ka hi tha ta zong, amate sangin a phazaw naseampa ka hi hi! A nasia zaw in na ka seam a, thong zong tamvei ka taak zaw hi, tamvei hong kivel zaw a, a tamvei zaw ka thi dektak bul hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:23"},"24":{"text":"Jew te in sawmthum le kuavei veu, ngavei tak hong saat hi;","ref":"Thkna 25:3"},"25":{"text":"thumvei sia Rome mite in hong saat hi; khatvei sia suangtum taw hong kihua hi. Thumvei teambaw lal ka tawk a, khatvei sia nai kul le nai li sung tui sungah ka om hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:22; 14:19"},"26":{"text":"Ka khualhawna tam mama sungah namthuamna pan, ngualsuamte pan, Jew mipuite le Gentile te tung panin, lauhuaina ka thuak hi; khuapi sung, duisung ngampa, tuipi tung le ngualtamh thumaan ngawlte tung panin lauhuaina tuatuam ka thuak hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:23; 14:15"},"27":{"text":"Nasep thil vawt kitatsat ngawl a, mut ka nga ngawl hun tamvei mama hi; ka ngilkial hun le ka dangko hun om a; an ngina ka neak ngawl hun, belh tu nei ngawlin, puansilh ka nei ngawl hun tam pheivei hi."},"28":{"text":"Thildang a vaal lai, pawlpite theampo atu in, ka thinbotna in, ni simin ka ngim hi."},"29":{"text":"Mihing khat po a tha zawm ciangin, kei zongh in ka tha zawmpui hi; khat po mawna sungah a puk ciangin, thin heena taw ka kidim hi."},"30":{"text":"Kisuantaak tu a kul le zong, ka thazawmna hong laknate tungah ka kisuangtaak tu hi."},"31":{"text":"Topa Jesus ii Pathian le Pa — a tawntungin ama min in thupha nga tahen! — tua Pathian in ka leilot ngawl hunlam hong he hi."},"32":{"text":"Damascus khua ah ka om lai in Kumpipa Aretas khutnuai a om ngamkhen uk mangpa in kei hong mat natu in khuapi kongpite ah a cingte koi hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:23-25"},"33":{"text":"Ahihang khuapi luphung vang khat panin bawm khat taw kei hong kikhiaksuk ciang ama kung pan ka suakta hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bangma phattuamna om ngawl ahitazong, ka kisuangtaak kul tu hi. Ahihang tu in Topa hong piak mukholnate le thupualaaknate huvau kong son tu hi.","title":"Paul ii Mukholnate le Thupualaaknate"},"2":{"text":"Tu nung kum sawm le kum li lai in Tapidaw khat sia vantung a saang belna ah kila to hi ci in ka he hi. (Hisia in a piang tatak ma ziam maw, mukholna khat nei ahi ziam ci sia ka he bua hi — Pathian bek in he hi.)"},"3":{"text":"Khatvei hong ci kik leng, hisia pa sia Paradise ah kila to hi ci in ka he hi. (Tusia zong a piang tatak ma ziam maw mukholna nei ziam ci sia ka he bua hi — Pathian bek in he hi.) Tua munah kammal taw a kilo thei ngawl, mihing kam le muk ii son thei ngawl kamte ama in za hi.","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom hisia pa huvau ka kisuangtaak tu hi — ahihang ka thazawmna hong kilanghsak thute simngawl keima tungtaang ah ka kisuangtaak buatu hi."},"6":{"text":"Hi ka son thu in thumaan ahikom, kisuangtaak nuam leng zong a mawmaw ka hi tuan buatu hi. Ahihang kisuangtaak ngawl tu khi hi, banghang ziam cile ka pauna hong kizaakna le ka sepna hong kimuna za sangin a vaalin kuama ii hong thupi ngaisut tu ka dei bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Na lamdang tam mama ka mute hu in, kiphatsakna taw ka kisakthei ngawl natu in keima pumpi sungah hong zo tu in Satan sawltak khat bangin na a seam, a bot pumpi natna khat hong kipia ahikom, ka kiphatsak ngawl natu in hong khaam hi."},"8":{"text":"Hisia hong laak keaksak natu in tua huvau Topa tungah thumvei thu ka ngen hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang ama ii hong zona in: “Ka thuthiamna in nang atu in kicing hi, banghang ziam cile na thazawm ciangin keima vaang sia lianbel hi,” hong ci hi. Christ ii vaangletna in kei tung panin hong dalna ka phaw natu in, ka thazawmnate hu in ka kiphatsak sia ka lungdam belna ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Christ atu in thazawmna, kiselnona, haksatna, vawtsiatna le buainate ah ka lung a kim hi. Banghang ziam cile ka thazawm ciangin a thahat ka suak hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima sia a mawmaw bangin ka ngamta hi — ahihang noma in tuabang a ngamta tu in nong vawt uh hi. Note in kei nong deina a lak tute na hi uh hi. Banghang ziam cile bangma ka hi ngawl hangin, note ii a lamdang tuamin na ngaisut uh “sawltakte” sangin ka nozaw tuan bua hi.","title":"Corinth te atu Paul ii Thinbotna"},"12":{"text":"Sawltak ka hina a kilak natu in nalamdang laknate le a lamdangte tam mama note sungah hong kivawtte sia thinsauna tatak taw hong kivawt ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Sum taw huna tu kong konlaw ngawl sia simngawl, pawlpi dangte sangin a siazaw in kong vawtna bangbang om ziam? Nong hesuakna in tuabang ka phat ngawlnate hong maisak tavun!"},"14":{"text":"Tu in no kungah hong haw tu in thumvei ka kithoai zo a — note tungah bangma kong ngen buatu hi. Ka dei sia in na sum na paai uh hi ngawl a, noma mama na hi uh hi. A tatakin ci leang tate in nute pate a vaak tu hi ngawlin, nute pate ii tate a vaak tu hizaw hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka nei theampo ka nuntakna dongin note kong hu natu in lungdam takin ka zangh siat tu hi. Tua za in kong it mama hu in, nong itna uh khiam zaw pumsai tu nu ziam?"},"16":{"text":"Tua zawkciang kei sia note atu in vanhngit ka hi ngawlna maan na sa tu uh hi. Ahizong khat po in kei sia theamna zangh thei a, leilotnate taw note hong aitaa hi hong ci tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Kamtai kong paisakte khat po tungtawnin note tung panin noptuam kong la ziam?"},"18":{"text":"Titus in hong pai in, Tapidaw suapui dang khat hong tonpui natu in keima nget ahi hi. Titus in a kilawm ngawlin, no tung pan laak hong nei ci tu nu ziam? Ama le kei sia a kibang tupna te tungtawnin a kibangin ngamta hi ngawl khu ziam?"},"19":{"text":"Note mai ah a tawntungin koma le koma kipanghong bangin, nong ngaisun tha tu uh hi. Hi ngawl hi! Pathian mai ah Christ ii pau le hong oai bangin ka pau uh a, ka it lawmte awng, na ka vawt theampo uh sia, noma kong hu natu a, a kivawt ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"No kung kong thet ciangin kong dei bang na hi ngawl na uh kong mu tu le, kei zongh nong dei uh bang ka hi ngawlna nong mu tu ka lau hi. Kihauna le ki eenna, thintomna le kaangsung heakna, kiselnona le kingensiatna, kiphatsakna le kilemngawlna te ka mu tu ka lau hi."},"21":{"text":"Kong pai kik ciangin, a bosa hun sung note tam mama in mawna na vawt uh a, cii le sa deina taw nu le pa mawna te — paktat ngamtatnate pan a kisiik kik ngawl mawneite hu in, keima ka kap tu a, note mai ah ka Pathian in kei hong maizum sak tu ka lau hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia in tu in note kungah a thum veina haw tu in kong paina ahi hi. “Kimawsiatna khat pawpo sia tetti nii ahibuale a tamzaw ii tetti panna taw kipsak kul hi.” — laithiangtho ci bangma ahi hi.","title":"A khakbel Kidop natu Sonkholnate le Vaithakte","ref":"Thkna 17:6; 19:15"},"2":{"text":"Hun bosa sungah mawna a vawt sa note tung le ngualdang theampo tungah kong son nuam hi; tu masia a, a nii veina kong pai lai in, hong ci zo khi hi, ahihang, tu in note kung pan a khualana ah om ka hi ciang hong ci kik tu khi hi: kong pai kik ciang ahile kuama daan thuakna taw na kipeal thei buatu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Christ in keima tungtawnin hong ci tatak ma a hina tetti lakna na dei uh teng na nga tu uh hi. Ama in note taw hong sep khop ciang, a thazawm bua hi; a vaangletna no sungah hong lak zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, thinglamtee tungah a kithisakna in, thazawmna khat ahitazong, Pathian ii vaangletna taw ama nungta hi. Ama taw ih pumkhatna ah eite zongh ih thazawm hi; ahihang note taw ih kizopna ah ama ii nuntakna sung a om Pathian ii vaangletna sia ih siim khawm tek tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Upna sungah na nungta uh ziam ci in na kitel natu in, noma le noma kisit vun a, noma le noma thu na kikhen vun. Christ Jesus in note sungah hong nungta hi ci in na he tatak na uh ziam? — noma a cingtaak ngawl het na hi buana uh le he tu ni hi."},"6":{"text":"Kote ii lel ngawl hunlam noma tel tu in kong um hi."},"7":{"text":"Kote zawna a lak tu hi ngawlin, ko sia a lelte bang zongh hi tha tu ka hi uh hang, a maan sia na sep thei natu in na tatkhial ngawl natu Pathian tungah thu kong ngetsak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile kote in thumaan thutak langpanin a seam thei te ka hi bua uh a, a panpui bek ka hi uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ko ka thazawm uh ciang, na thahat uh sia ka lung uh dam hi. Tua ahiciang note sia na cialcing thei natu in thu kong ngetsak si uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua hangin, hi lai sia no taw ih khualat laitak kong at ahi hi; note hong susia tu hi ngawlin, note kong puuaphat nopna in, Topa hong piak thuneina zanghin — no kung kong thet ciang hangsanin kong ci a kul ngawl natu in lai hong ngal thaak ka hi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuaciang tu in suapuite awng, mangpha na man tavun! Cialcin natu na hanciam vun; kong thuumna hong ngai tavun; khat le khat na kithukim vun a; kilem takin na nungta vun. Tuaciangin ki itna le thinnopna — Pathian sia note taw hong omkhawm tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Khat le khat sia suapui kinapna taw na kivaitha tavun. Pathian ii mihing theampo in paupuina kam hong thaak hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa Jesus Christ ii thuthiamna, Pathian ii itna le Thaa Thiangtho ii hong pawlpuina in note theampo taw hong om tahen."}}}}},"48":{"info":{"name":"Galatiate","shortname":"Gal","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihingte kung pan hi ngawl, mihingte ii piansak thu zongh hi ngawl, thina pan Jesus a tho kiksak Pa Pathian le Jesus Christ kung pan sapna a nga sawltak ahi keima Paul ii tung pan laithak ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Hi sungah a om suapuite theampo in Galatia ngam pawlpite tungah kimuana kam kong thaak khawm uh hi:"},"3":{"text":"Ih Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ in thuthiamna le thinnopna hong pia tahen."},"4":{"text":"Tu a hunpha ngawl sia panin ih suatak natu in ih Pa Pathian ii deina a zuina taw, Christ in eite ii mawna hangin ama le ama hong kipia hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian tungah minthanna a tawntung a tawntungin om tahen! Amen."},"6":{"text":"Note lamdang kong sa hi! Christ ii thuthiamna taw note hong sam pa, tawmvei no sungin na taisan uh a, tuaciang lungdamna thu a dang khat na saang uh hi.","title":"Khatbek ahi Lungdamna Thu"},"7":{"text":"A tatakin, “lungdamna thu a dang” om tuan ngawl hi, ahihang hi bang a kong ci theina in mihing pawlkhat in Christ ii lungdamna thu laih tu in hanciam uh a, na thin uh hong nawngkaisak hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang kote ka hi uh zong, ahibuale vantunglalang khat keak ahihialzong, note tungah kong hil sa lungdamna thu taw a kitumdangin hong hil a om le tua mi sia hell khuk sungah kivawk tahen!"},"9":{"text":"Tu masia zonghin kong ci zo uh hi, tu zonghin kong ci kik hi. Khat po in na saansa uh lungdamna thu sia taw a kitumdang khat hong hil le tua pa sia hell khuk sungah kivawk tahen!"},"10":{"text":"Hi bang a ka awsua sia mihingte ii diksak tu hi na sa uh ziam? Hi ngawl het hi! Pathian ii diksak tu bek ka deina hi! Mihingte maipha nga nuamin a hanciam ka hi ziam? Tuabangin hanciam lai ka hile Christ ii naseam khat ka hi buatu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, ka hil lungdamna thu in mihing tung pan a piang thu hi ngawl hi ci sia kong son nuam hi.","title":"Paul Sawltak A Suana Daan"},"12":{"text":"Mihing khat pawpo tung panin ka nga hi ngawl hi, kuama ii hong hil zongh ahi bua hi. Kei tungah hong pualaak sia Jesus Christ ama mama ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Jew te biakna sungah ka kipiak laitakin, kei sia bangbangin a nungta mi hi a, bangbangin Pathian ii pawlpi hesuakna nei ngawlin vawtsia a, a siasak tu in ka hi thei za in hanciam khi ziam, ci teng sia no tung ah hong kisonsa ahi hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 22:4-5; 26:9-10"},"14":{"text":"Jew te biakna ka zui sung teng in ka khanngualte a tamzaw mai ah ka madawk a, ih pute ii taangh ngeinate sungah amate sangin a nasia zawin a kipia pa ka hi hi.","ref":"Sawl 22:3"},"15":{"text":"Ahihang, Pathian in ka pian ma ngawngawnin a thuthiamna taw hong teal a, ama ii na a seam tu in hong sam hi. Ama ii a khensat hun hong cing a,","ref":"Sawl 9:3-6; 22:6-10; 26:13-18"},"16":{"text":"Gentile te tungah ama huvau Lungdamna Thupha ka hil thei natu in a Tapa kei tungah hong pualaak ciang, ngaisutna pha ngenin kuama kungah ka pai bua a,"},"17":{"text":"kei mai a, sawltak a seamte taw kimu tu zonghin Jerusalem ah ka pai bua hi. Tua taangin, Arabia ah thakhatin ka pai a, tua zawkciang Damascus ah ka heak kik hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua zawk kum thum ciangin Peter tung pan thu za tu in Jerusalem ah ka pai a, nipi nii sung, ama kungah ka taam hi.","ref":"Sawl 9:26-30"},"19":{"text":"Topa ii suapuipa James simngawl sawltak dangte ka mu bua hi."},"20":{"text":"Kong at teng thumaan hi. Leilot ngawl ka hi sia Pathian in hong he hi!"},"21":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin Syria le Cilicia ngamsung mun tuatuam ah ka pai hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Judea pawlpite sungah a om pawlpi mite in kei hong he tatak bua uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Midangte ii hi bang a, a pau teng bekma a he uh hi: “Eite hong vawtsia ngei mipa in khatvei lai a lalsak tu in a hanciamh upna sia, tu in thuhilna in nei hi.”"},"24":{"text":"Tuabangin amate in kei hu in Pathian pok uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum sawm le kum li zawkciang Barnabas taw Jerusalem ah ka cia kik uh a, Titus sia keima in ka tonpui hi.","title":"Paul le A dang Sawltakte","ref":"Sawl 11:30; 15:2"},"2":{"text":"Pathian in ka pai natu hong pualaak ahikom ka pai hi. Lampuite taw ka kimu tuamna sungah, Gentile te tung ka hil lungdamna thu teng ka sonthiang hi. A bosa hun ahizong, tu laitak ahizong, ka nasepna sungah lelna ka thuak tu ka uuk bua hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka kitholpuipa Titus sia Greek mi ahitazong zawthawk thu taw a vunteap ki atsak ngawl hi,"},"4":{"text":"ahizong mihing pawlkhat in vunteap atsak nuam hi. Christ Jesus taw ih kipumkhatna tungtawnin ih nga suatakna thu kan nuamin, hi mite pawlkhat sia ih thu uppuite bangin hong kivawt a, eite sungah thudawpku tu in hong tum ku hi. Amate in eite sila in hong kai nuam hi,"},"5":{"text":"ahihang lungdamna thu ii thumaanna sia note atu a kikepcing thei natu in, amate deina tawmvei bek zongh ih zawp hun a om bua hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahizong lampui tu bang ahi tuate — amate bang po ahizong kei atu a lamdan ngawlna taw hi bangin ka pau ahi hi; Pathian in a puasang pianzia te taw thukhen ngawl hi — tua lampui te in kei tungah ngaisutna thak piakna bangma hong nei ngawl hi ka ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:17"},"7":{"text":"Jew te tungah lungdamna thu hil tu nasep sia Peter tungah a piak bangin Pathian in kei sia Gentile te tungah lungdamna thu hil tu in nasep hong piak sia amate ii a musa ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian ii vaangletna taw kei sia Gentile te atu in sawltak ka hi a, Peter sia Jew te atu in sawltak ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Lampui ahi tuak James, Peter le John te in Pathian ii hi nasep tuam hong piakna hong heakpui hi; tua ahikom amate in Barnabas le kei hong nukset a, tuasia in ei teng maapang khawm tek tu ci in limlakna ahi hi. Barnabas le kei sia Gentile te sungah seam tu a, amate sia Jew te sungah seam tu in ka thukim uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate hong nget thu khat sia amate pawl sungah, a cimawte ka phaw pui natu hi a, tua thu in sep tu ka lawp thu tatak ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang Antioch ah Peter hong pai ciangin, mihon mai ah ama ka nalh hi, banghang ziam cile ama in khial citak ma in khial hi.","title":"Antioch ah Paul in Peter Teih"},"12":{"text":"James ii hong puak mihing pawlkhat tua mun a thet ma in, Peter sia Gentile suapuite taw an nekhawm zo hi. Ahihang hi mite hong thet zawkciang, vunteap a atsak nuamte a kiitak hu in, ama kikeam a, Gentile te taw an a nekhawm nuam bua hi."},"13":{"text":"Jew suapui dangte zongh Peter bangma in a lauthauh te bang hong hi paih hi; tuaciang Barnabas ngawngawn zongh amate lauthauh ngamtatna in zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Lungdamna thu thumaan lampi tang sia, amate in tawn ngawl hi, ci in ka mu ciangin, Peter munah amate theampo mai ah hi bangin ka ci hi. “Nang sia Jew mi khat hi napi Gentile te bangin a nungta nginge sa na hi a, Jew te bangin na nungta bua hi. Tua ahiciang Gentile te sia Jew te bangin a nuntak natu in bangbangin zawthawk thu taw na sawl zo tu ziam,” ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"A tatakin eite sia ih pian panin Jew te ih hi hi, “Gentile mawneite” a kici te ih hi bua hi.","title":"Jew te le Gentile te in Upna taw Ngupna nga"},"16":{"text":"Ahizong mihing khat sia Jesus Christ ih upna tung bek tawnin, Pathian mai ah thutang kisuaksak hi ci in ih he a, Thukham ii deina bang sepna taw hi ngeingawl hi. Eite zongh in Thukham ii deina bang ih sepna taw hi ngawlin, Christ ih upna tungtawnin Pathian mai ah thutang ih sua natu in, Christ Jesus ih um zo hi. Banghang ziam cile Thukham ii deina zuina taw Pathian mai ah kuama thutang kisuaksak ngawl hi.","ref":"Ps 143:2; Rom 3:20-22"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahile Christ taw ih kipumkhatna pan thutang suak tu in, ih hanciam tak ciang, Gentile te za ma in mimawte in hong kimu ahile Christ sia mawna a piangsak tu in a seam ahi tu ziam? Hi ngawl het hi!"},"18":{"text":"Thukham ka phiat sate puuapha kik tu in, ka kipan le — Thukham a paltan khat ka hi hunlam keima le keima a kipualaak ka hi hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahihang Thukham taw kisai in kei ka thi zo hi — Thukham mama in hong thatlum zo hi — Pathian atu ka nuntak thei natu ahi hi. Christ taw ama ii thinglamtee tungah ka thi khawm zo hi,"},"20":{"text":"tua ahikom, a nungta sia kei ka hi nawn bua a, ahihang kei sungah a nungta sia Christ ahi hi. Tu a ka nuntakna sia ahile kei hong it a, a nuntakna kei atu hong pia Pathian Tapa ka upna taw a nungta ka hi hi."},"21":{"text":"Pathian ii thuthiamna nial tu ka uuk bua hi. Ahihang mihing khat in Thukham tungtawnin Pathian mai ah thutang kisuaksak ahile Christ ii thina in khiakna nei ngawl a suak hi!"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Galatia mihing mawmawte awng! Akua in hong bum ziam? Jesus Christ ii thinglamtee tungah a thina thu sia na mittang uh taw, thiang takin na mu thei tu in hong kilak zo hi!","title":"Thukham ahibuale Upna"},"2":{"text":"Hi thu khat sia hong son tavun: Pathian Thaa sia Thukham ii deina, na zuina uh panin, saang nu ziam maw, lungdamna thu za a, na upna uh pan nga hizaw nu ziam?"},"3":{"text":"Bangbangin tu zata in mawmaw thei nu ziam! Pathian Thaa taw kipan phot nu hi; tu in noma thahatna taw khup sawm nu ziam?"},"4":{"text":"Na heaksa theampo no atu in bangma mama hi ngawl ahi ziam? Tawm peuma khiakna nei nanak tu hi!"},"5":{"text":"Pathian in Thaa hong pia a note sungah nalamdang lakna hong vawt sia Thukham ii deina na zui uh hang ziam maw lungdamna thu za a na up uh hang ziam?"},"6":{"text":"Abraham tungah thupiangte ngaisun vun; laithiangtho in, “Ama in Pathian um a, ama upna hangin Pathian in thumaan thutang in saang hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 15:6; Rom 4:3"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Abraham suan tatakte sia upna a nei mihingte ahi hi, ci in na tel natu ahi hi.","ref":"Rom 4:16"},"8":{"text":"Pathian in Gentile te sia upna tungtawnin thutang suaksak tu hi ci in laithiangtho in sonkhol hi. Tua ahikom laithiangtho in Lungdamna Thupha sia Abraham tungah, “Nang tungtawnin Pathian in mihing nam theampo thupha pia tu hi,” ci in son hi.","ref":"Pian 12:3"},"9":{"text":"Abraham in um a thupha kipia hi; tua ahikom a umte theampo ama bangin thupha kipia hi."},"10":{"text":"Thukham zuina a suangte sia haamsiatna nuai ah nungta hi. Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in, “A kuama po Thukham laibu sungah a ki at teng a vekpi in a zui tawntung ngawlte sia Pathian ii haamsiatna nuai ah om hi!” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 27:26"},"11":{"text":"Tu in Thukham taw Pathian mai ah kuama thutang kisuaksak ngawl ci sia kitel thiang hi, banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in, “Upna tungtawnin Pathian mai ah thutang a kisuaksak sia bek nungta tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Heb 2:4"},"12":{"text":"Ahihang Thukham in, upna taw a kisaina bangma om ngawl hi. “A kuama po thukham deina a vekpi in a seam peuma nungta tu hi,” laithiangtho in ci zaw hi.","ref":"Thiam 18:5"},"13":{"text":"Ahihang Christ in ei atu a kihaamsiatna taw Thukham ii hong puak haamsiatna panin eite ama in hong tan zo hi! Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in, “A kuama po, thing tungah a kikhai sia in Pathian ii haamsiatna nuai ah om hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 21:23"},"14":{"text":"Upna tungtawnin Pathian ii hong kamciamsa Thaa ih nga natu le Abraham tungah Pathian kamciamsa thuphate, Christ Jesus tungtawnin Gentile te tungah a kipiak thei natu in, Christ in tuabangin vawt ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, ni sim a piang sonteena khat kong zangh tu hi: mihing nii in na khat tungtaang ah thukim in lungkimna lai a vawt uh le kuama in tua thukimna paltan thei ngawl a, belap thei ngawl hi.","title":"Thukham le Kamciam"},"16":{"text":"Tu in, Pathian in Abraham le ama ii suan pa tungah kamciamte pia hi. Laithiangtho in mihing a tam cina a lak “a suan a paalte” ci kammal zangh ngawlin, mihing khat bek a cinopna “a suan” ci kammal sia Christ a cinopna hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka son nop sia Pathian in Abraham taw thuciamna vawt a, ka kholet tu hi, ci in kamciam pia hi. Kum zali le kum sawmthum zawkciang a kipia Thukham in tua thuciamna paltan in Pathian kamciam sia phiat thei ngawl hi.","ref":"Pu 12:40"},"18":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian letsong sia Thukham tungah kibulphu hile, ama kamciam tungah kibulphu ahi nawn bua hi. Ahizong ama ii kamciam hangin Pathian in Abraham sia tua letsong pia hi.","ref":"Rom 4:14"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahile Thukham ii tupna in bang ziam? Tatkhialna sia bang ziam ci in a lak tu in a kibelap ahi hi, tuaciang tua Thukham sia kamciam a kipiakna pa, Abraham ii suan sia hong pian mateng a kho tu in a kingaisun ahi hi. Thukham sia vantunglalangte in hong thaaksuk a, mihing khat in a kilaklaw ah palai hong seam hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahihang mihing khat nguak sepna sungah palai kul ngawl hi; tuaciang Pathian sia khat ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahile Thukham sia Pathian kamciamte taw a kileebul ziam? Kileebul ngawl het hi! Banghang ziam cile mihingte in nuntakna hong pia thei Thukham khat a saang zo le tua thukham zuina taw mihing sim in Pathian mai ah thutang kisuaksak thei tu hi.","title":"Thukham ii Tupna"},"22":{"text":"Ahihang laithiangtho in leitung bup sia mawna vaangletna nuai ah om hi, ci hi; tua ahikom Jesus Christ ih upna bulphu a, a kipia kamciam sia, ama a umte tungah kipia hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang upna nei natu hun hong thet ma in Thukham in hi hong pai tu upna hong kipualaak mateng eite theampo thongtaak bangin hong khabil hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaciangin Upna tungtawnin Pathian mai ah thutang ih sua thei natu in, Thukham in Christ ii hong pai mateng hong uk hi."},"25":{"text":"Tu in upna nei natu hun sia hisung hong theng zo ahikom, Thukham in eite hong uk nawn bua hi."},"26":{"text":"Note theampo sia upna tungtawnin Christ Jesus taw na kipumkhatna uh hu in Pathian ii tate na suak siat uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Note Christ taw na kipumkhatna sungah na ki baptize uh a, tuaciang Christ ama mama ii nuntakna taw puan bangin hong kisilhsak zo cinopna hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jew te le Gentile te, silate le sila ahi ngawlte, pate le numeite kilaklaw tek ah kilamdanna om nawn ngawl hi; Christ Jesus taw na kipumkhat uh ciangin note theampo sia pumkhat na hi uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Christ ii neisa na hi uh le, Abraham suante na hi uh a, Pathian hong kamciam sate na saang tu uh hi.","ref":"Rom 4:13"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahihang tu in zomto suak leang — Pa ii ngamh a lua tu tapa in na theampo ama ii neisa ahihang, a khanmoi lai in sila bangin kivawt hi."},"2":{"text":"Ama a khanmoi laitakin a pa ii a hun ciam dong a vai teng a hawmsak tu le ama a en tu in pasal pawlkhat om hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in eite zongh thaa lamsang ah ih khanthin matengin vaannuai bup a uk thaa te ii sila in ih om hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang a hun hong cin pepeet ciang, Pathian in a Tapa hong paisak hi. Ama sia mihing ahi leitung nu khat ii tapa bangin hong pai a, Jew te Thukham nuai ah nungta hi,"},"5":{"text":"Pathian ii tapate tanute ih sua natu in thukham khutnuai ah a omte a tat natu in tuabangin hong piang hi.","ref":"Rom 8:15-17"},"6":{"text":"Note sia ama ii tapa tanute na hina uh a lak natu in, Pathian in a Tapa ii Thaa “Pa awng, Ka Pa awng!” ci in a au Thaa sia ih thin sungah hong puak hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom nang sila hi nawn ngawlin tapa khat na hi hi. Tuaciangin ama tapa hi zo na hikom, Pathian in a tapate a tanute atu, a nei theampo nangma hong pia tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Hun bosa sungah note in Pathian na he bua uh hi, tua hu in a maan ngawl pathiante ii sila in na om uh hi.","title":"Galatia te atu Paul Thinbotna"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang tu in Pathian na heak zawk uh ciang — tua ahibuale Pathian ii no hong heak zawkciang ci leang — banghangin tua a zawngkhal, a khuangai huai ukna nei thaate kung zuan kik thei nu ziam? Banghangin amate sila suak kik nuam nu ziam?"},"10":{"text":"Nite, thate, khuahunte le kumte na thupi laak uh hi."},"11":{"text":"No huvau in ka thinngim hi! No atu ka sep sa teng bangma a kimang thei ngawl a suak bua natu ziam?"},"12":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, hong ngen khi hi, keima bang hong hi tavun. Ahi tatakin ci leang kei zongh noma bangma ka hi hi. Kei tungah no ii nong khialna uh bangma om ngawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Lungdamna thu note kong hil maksakna ahang sia na he lai uh hi; ka ciinat hu a hong hil ka hi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka pumpi omzia sia note atu in thinngimpi khat ahitazong, nong zawngsak bua uh a nong nial bua uh hi. Vantunglalang khat na saan tu uh bangin nong saang zaw uh hi; Christ Jesus na saan tu uh bangin, kei nong saang uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tualai in lungdam mama nu hi! Ahitazong bang teng piang man ziam? Na mittang uh khelkeak in kei hong pia thei le uhte hong pia nuam liangin om nu hi, ci in keima tatak ma in ka son thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahile, tu in thumaan thutak sia kong son hu in na ngalpa suak zo ka hi ziam?"},"17":{"text":"Tua midangte in note nasia takin hong thinnuammaw hi, ahihang amate tupna le sawmnate pha ngawl hi. Amate ii no hong kin bangin no zongh amate na kin thei natu in, no le kei hong khen nuam ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu in tuabang a kithin nopmawkna tatakte sia tupna le sawmna pha hithong le — hisia in note taw kong omkhop ciang bek hi ngawlin, a tawntung atu in pha hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka it tanote awng, Christ pianzia note sungah hong pian mateng in, numeite nausuak tu a tut ciangin a bot bangma in ka thuak hi."},"20":{"text":"Tu laitakin note taw kong omkhawm thei nuam hi, tua hile kong ngaisut zia kikheal thei tu hi. Note atu in ka thinngim mama hi!"},"21":{"text":"Thukham khutnuai ah a om nuamte, thu khat kong dongh tu hi. Thukham ii cina sia za ngawl nu ziam?","title":"Hagar le Sarah taw Sonteena"},"22":{"text":"Abraham in tapa nii nei a, khat sia sila numei taw a hin hi a, a dang khat sia sila ahi ngawl a suakta numei taw a hin ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 16:15; 21:2"},"23":{"text":"Sila numei taw a hin tapa sia mihing pian ngei bang a, piang hi. Ahihang a suakta numei taw a hin sia in Pathian kamciamna pan piang hi, ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Hi te sia limlakna khat bangin kihe thei hi. Numei nii sia thuciamna nam nii hi. Sila in a piang tate a hing sia Hagar hi, tuaciang ama in Sinai mual ah a kivawt thuciamna ii lim ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Hagar sia Arabia ngam Sinai Mual ii lim hi a, a mihingte theampo taw sila kaai in a om lai hun Jerusalem khuapi ii lim ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahihang vantung Jerusalem sia a suakta hi a, ama sia eite ii nu ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in, “Tasel numei awng, lungdam in! lungdamna taw aukeak in! Nang nautut nat a he ngeingawl nu awng! Banghang ziam cile, a kitaisan numei in, a pasal ii a nusiat ngeingawl numei sia sangin, ta tam a nei zaw tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 54:1"},"28":{"text":"Isaac sia kamciamna panin piang ahi bangma tu in no, ka suapuite awng, kamciamna pan a piang tate na hi uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua hunlai in a pian ngei bangin a piang tapa in Pathian Thaa taw a piang tapa sia vawtsia hi; tu in zongh tuabang ma ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 21:9"},"30":{"text":"Ahihang laithiangtho in bang na ci ziam? “Sila numei le a tapa paikhiasak vun; banghang ziam cile sila numei ii tapa in a suakta numei ii tapa taw a pa lamhsa a lua khawm buatu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 21:10"},"31":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka suapuite awng, eite sia sila numei ii tate ih hi bua a, a suakta numei ii tate ih hi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Suatakna sia ei neisa hi — Christ in hong suaktasak zo hi! Tua ahikom a suakta mihingte bangin, ding vun a, sila na suak kik nuam heak vun.","title":"Na Suatakna Keamcing vun"},"2":{"text":"Ngai vun! Keima Paul in kong ci hi, na vunteap uh na atsak nuam uh le Christ in note atu kimanna nei ngawl het ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Khatvei ma kong ci kik hi, pasal khat peuma in a vunteap a atsak nuam le Thukham buppi a zui kul hi."},"4":{"text":"Thukham zuina taw Pathian mai ah thutang sua natu na hanciam uh le no teng in noma le noma Christ kung pan a kikhaktan na hi uh hi. Note in Pathian ii thuthiamna puasia ah na om uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Kote ka hi uh le ka lam etna uh sia Pathian in thutang hong suasak tu ci thu ahi hi; hi thusia ka upna uh tungtawnin Pathian ii Thaa vaangletna taw hong seam tu hi ci in ka ngak uh sia ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Christ Jesus taw pumkhatin ka om uh ciang vunteap atna ahizong, at ngawlna ahizong bangma kitumdanna a omsak bua hi; a thupi sia in ki itna tungtawn a, na a seam upna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Na vawt uh sia pha mama hi! Akua in thumaan thu na nit tu sia hong khaktan ziam? Bangbangin ama in hong kaizawn ziam?"},"8":{"text":"No hong sam Pathian in tuabangin hong vawt ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"“A kithau sa anvui a khan natu in tol tawm bek kisamh hi,” a ci uh bangma ahi hi.","ref":"1 Cor 5:6"},"10":{"text":"Ahihang note huvau in thinmuanna ka nei lai hi. Topa taw pum khatin ih nuntakna in, ngaisutna tumdang na nei ngawl natu in hong lungmuangsak a, hong nawngkaisak pa sia akua po ahizong, Pathian in daan pia tu hi, ci in ka um hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang kei ka hile, ka suapuite awng, vunteap at kul hi ci in thu hil lai ka hile banghangin hong kivawtsia lai ziam? Tua sia in thumaan hi thongle Christ ii thinglamtee thu ka hilna in bangma ngimna a piangsak buatu hi."},"12":{"text":"No hong nawngkaisak mite tai siat le ka oai hi; amate le amate cil kinget vet tahen!"},"13":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, no sia a suakta tu in hong kisam hi. Ahihang hi suatakna in chi le sa deina ii hong ukna tu a paulap nuam hisak heak vun. Tua taangin ki itna taw khat le khat kihu vun."},"14":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Thukham buppi sia thupiak khat in kingawm hi: “Nangma le nangma na ki it bangin na innpaamte na it in.”","ref":"Thiam 19:18"},"15":{"text":"Ahihang ngamsate bangin na ngamta uh a, khat le khat kisuu in na kiliamsak uh le, tuasia ciang kidawm tavun, tua ahibuale khat le khat kilalcipsak tu nu hi."},"16":{"text":"Kong son thu in hi sia ahi hi: Thaa in na nuntakna uh zeaksak vun, tua hile mihing pianzia ii deinate na lungkimsak buatu uh hi.","title":"Thaa le Mihing Pianzia"},"17":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ih mihing pianzia ii deite sia Thaa ii deite taw kilangpan hi, tuaciangin Thaa ii deite sia mihing pianzia ii deite taw kilangpan hi. Hite nii in kingal hi, na ngamtat nop uh bangin na ngamta thei bua uh hi a cinopna hi.","ref":"Rom 7:15-23"},"18":{"text":"Thaa in hong lampui le Thukham khutnuai ah na om nawn bua uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihing pianzia ii sepna sia thiang takin kimu hi. Tua sia in nu le pa paktatna, a kiihuai le zummawk ngamtatnate;"},"20":{"text":"milim biakna le bum le ai toaina te hi. Mihingte khat le khat kingalin kido uh hi; amate ki eangin, thin uukin, ultup uh hi. Amate a pawl a pawlin kikhen hi;"},"21":{"text":"kidungawkna, zukhamna, sikvil loklenna le hite taw a kibang ngamtatna dangte nei uh hi. Kidop natu kong piak ngei bangin tu in kong ci hi: hi bang ngamtatna neite in Pathian Ngam lua ngawl tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang Thaa in itna, lungdamna, thinnopna, thinsauna, dikna, phatna, thumaanna,"},"23":{"text":"kiniam khiakna le eima le eima ki uk zawknate piangsak hi. Hi te a langpan thukham bangma a om bua hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuaciang Christ Jesus ii neisa ahite in, a mihing pianzia le tua ii uukna le deinate sia thi khawmsak zo hi."},"25":{"text":"Thaa in nuntakna ei hong pia zo hi; ama in ih nuntakna zongh hong uk nanak tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Ei sia khat le khat tungah kiphasakin, kitaw in, ih ki eang buatu hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, tatkhialna nam khat po taw mihing khat a kiman le, thaa taw a nungta note in, ama sia a dinmun maan ah na koi vun; ahihang cikna thiamna na zangh hamtang vun. Tuaciangin note zongh ze etna na thuak ngawl natu noma le noma ki en in kidawm vun.","title":"Vanhngit Kipuakpui vun"},"2":{"text":"Khat le khat vanhngitte na kidawn tavun, tuabangin Christ ii thukham na zui tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Khat po in ama sia bangma hi ngawl napi, hi a kisa le ama le ama kitheam hi bek hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihing khat simin ama le ama a ngamtatna kisit hen. A pha in a ngamta khat in ngualdang khat ii ngamtatna taw kiteengat ngawlin, ama ii ngamtat phatna tungah kisuangtaak thei tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile mihing sim in a vanh uh tek a puak kul tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tapidaw thu a kihil pasal khat in, ama ii neisa na pha theampo a Syapa taw hawm tahen."},"7":{"text":"Noma le noma kitheam heak vun; Pathian sia kuama ii theam zawk hi ngawl hi. Mihing khat in a poai bang lianin a at tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in leitung pumpi deina lo sungah a poai le, tua mun panin thina an kaikhawm tu hi; Thaa ii deina lo sungah a poai le Thaa panin tawntung nuntakna an kaikhawm tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom na pha sepna sungah toi kisa bua tawng; banghang ziam cile thinkiam in tawp bua po leang ih anlaak tu hun hong theng tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom hunpha ih nga simin mihing theampo tungah a pha ih seam tu a, a tuan in upna sung a ih innkuanpuite tungah ih seam tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Keima khut taw laithak kong at ciang, laimal lian taw ka at sia mu tu nu hi!","title":"A khakbel Kidop natu Sonkholna le Nuksetna"},"12":{"text":"Note tungah zawthawk thu taw vunteap hong atsak nuamte sia, a puatham thute ah kisa thei a, a kisuangtaakte ahi hi. Ahizong amate ii tuabang a vawtna sia, Jesus ii Thinglamtee hu in amate in vawtsiatna a thuak bua thei tha le ci in a ngaisut uh hang bek ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Vunteap at te ngawngawn zongh Thukham a zui bua uh hi; note vunteap hong atsak nopna thu in, pumpi tung a zeksa vawtna sungah na tum uh sia, a kisuantaak thei natu ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahizong kei ka hile ih Topa Jesus Christ ii thinglamtee bekma ka kiphatsak pui tu hi; banghang ziam cile ama ii thinglamtee hangin leitung sia kei atu in a thisa hi a, keima in leitung atu in a thisa ka hi hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihing khat vunteap a ki at le a ki at ngawl sia a phatmawkna mama om ngawl het hi; a pha maw sia in mihing thak suana ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"A nuntakna sungah hi ngeina a zuite tungah thinnopna le hesuakna om tahen a — amate le Pathian mihing theampo tung zongh ah om tahen!"},"17":{"text":"Thu khupna ah: kuama in kei tungah ngimna hong pia thuasak nawn heak vun, banghang ziam cile ka pumpi tung a meima pawn omte in kei sia Jesus ii sila ka hina lak hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, ih Topa Jesus Christ ii thuthiamna sia note theampo tungah hong om tahen. Amen."}}}}},"49":{"info":{"name":"Ephesuste","shortname":"Eph","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ii deina taw Christ Jesus ii sawltak khat ahi Paul in — Jesus taw kipumkhat nuntakna sungah a thumaan Ephesus khua Pathian ii mihingte tungah lai kong thaak hi;","ref":"Sawl 18:19-21; 19:1"},"2":{"text":"Ih Pa Pathian le Jesus Christ in thuthiamna le thinnopna hong pia tahen."},"3":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus Christ ii Pa le Pathian tungah lungdamko tawng! Banghang ziam cile Christ taw kipumkhatna sungah ama in eite sia vantung ngam taw kisai thaa thupha theampo hong pia hi.","title":"Christ sungah Thaa Thuphate"},"4":{"text":"Christ taw kipumkhatna tungtawnin, ama mai ah sit baang ngawl le ih thiantho natu in, Pathian in leitung a vawt ma ngawngawn in eite hong teal zo hi. Hong itna hangin,"},"5":{"text":"Pathian in Jesus Christ tungtawnin a tapa a tanute hong suasak natu in a khensat sa hi a — hi thu in ama diksak le tupna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"A minthang a thuthiamna hu le a it a Tapa sungah eite a thawthongin hong piak letsong hu in, Pathian pok tawng."},"7":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Christ ii chisan hangin eite kisuakta a, tua thu in ih mawna kimaisak hi, cinopna hi. Pathian ii thuthiamna bangza in lian ziam,","ref":"Col 1:14"},"8":{"text":"tua in, hi za ta a lian mama eite hong piak thuthiamna ahi hi! Ama ciimna theampo le a thuk mu theina taw,"},"9":{"text":"Pathian in a tupna sa bangin vawt a, a pawlcing tu in a khensat sa ama tupna thuku sia Christ zanghin, eite hong hesak hi."},"10":{"text":"A hun hong tun ciangin Pathian ii a khuangkhim tu, hi tupna in vantung leitung ah bitphua sa theampo kaikhawm tu a, a lutang tu in Christ koi tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Na theampo sia Pathian ii tupna le khensatna bangin kiseam a; Pathian in a kipatciil pan mama in a khensatsa thu bulphu in, ama ii tupna hu in eite Christ taw kipumkhat a, ama aituam mihingte ih sua natu in hong teal hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom Christ sungah lametna a nei phit eite in, Pathian ii minthanna pok tawng!"},"13":{"text":"No ngupna hong puak thumaan thu ahi Lungdamna Thupha sia na zaak uh ciang, note zongh Pathian ii mihingte na suak uh hi. Note in Christ na um uh a, tuaciang Pathian in hong kamciamsa Thaa Thiangtho hong piakna taw ama ii neisa na hina uh tepteena tazeik note tungah hong tuum hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua Thaa in Pathian ii mihingte hong kamciam sate ih nga natu kipsakna hi a, ama ii neisa ahite tungah suatakna a cingin Pathian in hong pia tu hi ci in hong lungmuangsak hi. Ama ii minthanna pok tawng!"},"15":{"text":"Hi thu hu in, Pathian ii mihingte na itna uh le Topa Jesus na upna uhte ka zaak nungsang,","title":"Paul ii Thungetna"},"16":{"text":"note atu in Pathian tungah lungdamkona ka tawlnga ngei bua hi. Ka thungetnate sungah kong phawk a,"},"17":{"text":"ih Topa Jesus Christ ii Pathian, a vaanglian Pa tungah nang hong ciimsak a ama na heak natu le Pathian hong lak tu Thaa hong piak natu in, ka ngen hi."},"18":{"text":"Bang lametna nei tu in note hong sam a, a mite a piak tu a, a kamciam thuphate bangza in nasia, ci in na heak natu in na thinsung uh hong kihonsak a, a khuavak na mu thei natu in kong ngetsak hi,"},"19":{"text":"tuaciangin ei, thu umte sungah na hong seam ama ii vaangletna sia bangza in lian ziam, ci in na heak natu kong ngetsak hi. Eite sungah na hong seam, hi a nasia thahatna in,"},"20":{"text":"Christ sia thina pan thosak a, vantung ama ii tokhum ziatsang ah a tosak sia ma ahi hi.","ref":"Ps 110:1"},"21":{"text":"Christ in tua munah vantung ukpite, thuneite, vaangletna neite, tote theampo ii tung panin uk hi; ama in hi leitung ah ahizong, hong pai pheang tu leitung ah ahizong, thunei min le zate theampo sangin a lianzaw min le za nei hi."},"22":{"text":"Pathian in na theampo sia Christ peang nuai ah koi a, na theampo ii ukpi Topa ahi tu in pawlpi tungah ama pia hi.","ref":"Ps 8:6; Col 1:18"},"23":{"text":"Pawlpi in Christ ii pumpi hi a, kicinna ahi ama mama in mun theampo ah na theampo khuangkhim hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A bosa hun sungah note in na thunit ngawl hang le, na mawnate hangin thaa lamsang ah a thisa na hi uh hi.","title":"Thina pan Nuntakna","ref":"Col 2:13"},"2":{"text":"Tua hunlai in note in, leitung ngitlona zia na zui uh hi; van awng sungah thaa vaangletnate a ukpa thu na ni uh hi, tua thaa in tu laitakin Pathian thu a ni ngawl mihingte a uk sia ma ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A tatakin eite zongh, amate bang ih hi ngei a, ih pianpui lungngulnate taw ih nungta zo hi, ih pumpi le ih thinsung taw a kisi bangin ih seam ih vawt hi. Ih pianlim in ngualdang bangma in, Pathian thin uukna thuak tu in, a kiciangtan sa ih hi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian ii hesuakna sia kicing lawlawm a, tuaciang eite hong itna sia lian mama hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua hi a eite ih thunit ngawlna taw thaa lamsang ah a thisa in ih om laitak Christ taw hong nungtasak kik hi. Pathian ii thuthiamna taw note hong kingum zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Christ Jesus taw pumkhat ih hina taw vantung ngam ah ama taw a uk khawm tu in, Pathian in eite ama taw hong thosak zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Hi bangin a sepna sia Christ Jesus sungah hong kilak, ki itna sungah a om, a tuanin a lian saap thuthiamna sia hong pai tu hun theampo ah a kikhomsuan tu ahi hunlam hong lakna ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile note in upna tungtawnin Pathian ii thuthiamna taw ngup sa na hi uh hi. Tua in note hanciamna hang hi ngawlin, note kisuantaak thaak ngawl natu in Pathian letsong ahi hi.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Eite in tu a ih hi babangin, Pathian hong vawtsa ih hi a, Jesus Christ taw kipumkhatna sungah ngamtat pha nuntakna nei natu in, hong bitphua sa ih hi hi, tua thu in eite sep tu in, hong koi kholsak sa ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate le amate “Vunteap atte” (Pate ii amate pumpi tungah a vawtte cinopna) a kici Jew te in “Vunteap at ngawlte” hong ci, pianna suana pan Gentile te ahi note in, hun bosa sungah na omzia uh kiphawk tavun.","title":"Christ sungah Pumkhat"},"12":{"text":"Tua hunlai in note in Christ taw kikhenin a omte na hi uh hi. Note in ngamdangmite na hi uh a Pathian ii tealsa mihingte na hi bua uh hi. Pathian ii mihingte tungah a kamciamte a bulphu thuciamnate sungah na kihel bua uh a, note in hi leitung ah lametna sel le Pathian selin na nungta uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang tu in, Christ Jesus taw na kipumkhat uh hu in, a khuala a om ngeisa note sia Christ ii chisan hu in a nai hong kithen zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Christ ama mama in, Jew te le Gentile te minam khat hong suasakna taw eite tungah kilemna hong puak zo hi. Amate a khen, ngal a suaksak kidoina pang sia ama pumpi taw sutham zo hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama taw kipumkhatna hangin, minam niite sung pan, a thak minam khat a bitphua thei natu in, minam a doi Jew te ii thukhamte, a thupiakte le a zui tute theampo phiatin hong kilemsak hi.","ref":"Col 2:14"},"16":{"text":"Thinglamtee tungah Christ a thi ciangin amate kilaklaw ah kingal vawtnate lalthamsak hi; ama ii thinglamtee hangin, tua minamte ngeal sia pumkhat a suak tu in ngawmtua a, Pathian kungah zotpui kik hi.","ref":"Col 1:20"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom Christ hong pai in Pathian taw a kikhuala, no Gentile te tung le Pathian taw a kinai Jew te tungah kilemna thu ahi Lungdamna Thupha hong hil hi.","ref":"Is 57:19"},"18":{"text":"Christ tungtawnin eite theampo, Jew te ih hi a, Gentile te ih hi zongin, Thaa khat sungah Pa omna ih theng thei hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Gentile te sia, ngamdang mi, khualmi hi nawn ngawl a; tu in note in Pathian ii mihingte taw ngam mipui, Pathian innkuan sungah a kihel mihingte na hi uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Note zongh, sawltakte le kamsaangte ii cian phungkawng tungah a kisate na hi uh a, tua phungkawng, innking suangpi sia Christ Jesus ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in inn bup a lenpa hi a, khangtosakin Topa tungah a ki aap biakinn thiangtho a suaksakpa ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama taw na kipumkhatna sung uh ah note zongh, Pathian ii a Thaa taw a teenna munah ngualdangte taw hong kisa khawm hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hisia thu hu in, no Gentile te atu in Christ Jesus ii thongtaakpa keima Paul in, Pathian tungah thu ka ngen hi.","title":"Gentile te atu Paul ii Nasepna"},"2":{"text":"Note phattuam natu in, Pathian in a thuthiamna taw hi nasep sia kei hong piakna thu, na za takpi zo uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Pathian in a tupku sia hong lak a, kei hong hesak hi. (Hi thu a tom in kong at zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Kong lai at sa sia na sim uh le, Christ thuku ka heakna thu na he tu uh hi.)","ref":"Col 1:26-27"},"5":{"text":"Hun bosa sungah tua thuku sia mihingte tungah kison ngawl a, ahizong tu in Pathian in a thiangtho sawltakte le a kamsaangte tungah Thaa taw lak zo hi."},"6":{"text":"A thuku sia bang ziam cile Gentile te le Jew te in Pathian thupha sia lungdamna thu hangin saang khawm thei hi; amate in pumpi khat ii nate hi tek a, Pathian ii Christ Jesus tungtawn a kamciam a piakte nga tek hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama ii vaangletna tungtawnin Pathian ii a tuam vilvelin hong piak letsong taw kei sia lungdamna thuhil naseampa ka suak hi."},"8":{"text":"Keima in Pathian ii mihingte sung pan a nobel sia sangin a nozaw lai pa ka hi hi; tua hi napi in, a kison zo ngawl Christ ii hauna Lungdamna Thupha Gentile te tungah a puak tu in Pathian in hamphatna hong pia hi,"},"9":{"text":"tuaciang mihing theampo in, koi bangin Pathian thuku sia kiseam thei tu ziam ci in a mu thei natu in hong seamsak hi. Vantung ngam ah vantunglalang a ukte le vaangletna a neite ii, Pathian ii ciimna a tuatuamte, tu hun sungah pawlpi tungtawnin a heak thei natu in, na theampo a bitphua Pathian in a thuku sia a bosa khang hunte sungah seal top hi.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Hi thu sia Pathian in ih Topa Christ Jesus tungtawnin a kitaksua ama ii tawntung tupna taw kizui in a vawt ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Christ taw ih kikopna le ama sungah ih upna hu in, Pathian omna munah kimuanna le hanna taw ih pai ngam hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua zawkciang, note atu in thuak ka hihang, na thin a kiam ngawl natu in kong thuum hi; tuate theampo sia noma phattuam natu ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Hi thu hu in ih Pa mai ah ka khupdin hi,","title":"Christ ii hong Itna"},"15":{"text":"ama tung pan vantung le leitung ah a om innkuan sim in a min maan a nga uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Pathian in ama ii a kicing minthanna panin a Thaa tungtawnin, na sungsang mi sia hong hatsak natu in, vaang hong piak natu kong ngetsak hi,"},"17":{"text":"na upna hangin note thinsung ah Christ hong teangin, ki itna thu ah zung thuk le, bulkip na nei natu in thu ka ngen hi,"},"18":{"text":"tuasia ciang note le Pathian ii mihingte theampo in Christ itna ii a zaina le a sauna, a saanna le a thuknate heak theina na nei tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Christ hong itna a kicing takin, kihe thei ngeingawl tu ahitazong, ama hong itna he thei in, Pathianzia mama taw na kidim sitset natu in, thu ka ngen hi."},"20":{"text":"Ih sungah a vaangletna taw hong sep hu in, ei ii nget thei le ngaisut theiza sangin tamzaw pek a seam thei pa:"},"21":{"text":"Pathian tungah pawlpi sung le Christ sungah minthanna sia hun theampo atu in a tawntung a tawntungin om tahen! Amen."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Topa ii na ka sep hu in, thongtaak keima in, Pathian ii note hong sap hun laitakin hong koisak bang nuntakna zia taw na nuntak natu in, kong hanthawn hi.","title":"Pumpi Khat hina Thu"},"2":{"text":"A tawntungin kiniamkhiak in, cinghkamh in, na thinsausak tavun. Khat le khat kidualna taw itna kilak tavun.","ref":"Col 3:12-13"},"3":{"text":"Na kilemna tungtawn a Thaa ii hong piak, no hong ngawmtua kipumkhatna sia ahi theiza in na keamcing tavun."},"4":{"text":"Note Pathian ii hong sapna sungah lametna khat a om bangma in, pumpi khat om a, Thaa khat om hi."},"5":{"text":"Topa khat, upna khat, baptize na khat om hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing theampo ii Pathian le Pa khat bek om hi, tua Pathian in mihing theampo ii Topa hi a, ama in mihing theampo tungtawnin naseam a, mihing theampo sungah om hi."},"7":{"text":"Eite theampo in Christ hong piakna taw kizui in, letsong a tuam khat tek ih nga hi."},"8":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “A saang mama na munah a paito lai in, ngalmat tam mama tonpui to hi. Ama in mihingte tungah tel pia hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 68:18"},"9":{"text":"Tu in, “Ama a paito hi,” a ci sia bang ci nuam ziam? A cinopna sia lei a thuk belna ah, paisuk masa zo hi, a cinopna hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom a paisuk pa sia vaannuai buppi ah a om siat natu in vantungte kalhin, a paitopa ma ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"“Mihingte tungah, letsong hong pia sia” ama ahi hi, pawlkhatte sawltak nasep, pawlkhat sia kamsaang nasep, a dangte thupha puak nasep, pawlpi keam le lai hil sya nasep pia hi."},"12":{"text":"Christ ii pumpi a kisak to natu in Tapidaw nasepna ah sep natu in, ama in hi bangin, Pathian ii mihingte theampo puuakhol natu in vawt hi."},"13":{"text":"Pathian Tapa ih heakna le ih upna sungah pumkhat ih sua natu in eite theampo ih kingawmkhawm tu hi; mihing puicingte ih suak tu a, Christ ii tun tan le a phakcia ih banto tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciangin phuatawm thimthel pilna taw ngualtheam a, a thuhilna uh taw ngual a lampialsak thei te hu in vuivak kikheal pawpo le tui kihual pawpo ii a paipui patangte na hi nawn buatu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ki itna thinsung nei in thumaan ih sonna taw lutang ahi Christ sangah a nanamin ih khangto zaw tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama ii ukna nuai ah pumpi ii a nate theampo kisi linlian a hong kipiasa kipee-awnate in, hong len khawm diimdiam hi. Tua ahikom pumpi sung na a tuatuamte in ahi tu bangin hong sep ciangin pumpi bup hong khang a, ki itna tungtawnin ama le ama hong kisa to hi.","ref":"Col 2:19"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Topa min taw kidop natu thu kong pia hi: a khua ngaisutna uh a mannung ngawl Pathian he ngawl mihingte bangin na nungta heak vun,","title":"Christ sungah Nuntakna Thak"},"18":{"text":"amate thinsung sia khuazingcip hi. Pathian piak nuntak ziate sungah amate atu bangma om ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile amate in heakna nei ngawlin a thin uh pui hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in maizum he vet nawn ngawl hi, amate in ngamtatna pha ngawlte sungah ki aap uh a, a thasiathuai thu tuatuamte sungah cizat nei ngawl uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Christ tung pan na sin uhte in tuabang hi ngawl hi!"},"21":{"text":"Ama thu sia na zaak takpi sa uh hi a, note a nungzuite na hina uh taw Jesus sungah thumaan thu note hong kihil hi."},"22":{"text":"Nidang a na nuntakziate uh taw hong nungtasak na milui uh — a maan ngawl duna le deinate ii a lalcipsak na milui uh sia vawkkeak vun.","ref":"Col 3:9"},"23":{"text":"Na thinsung uh le na ngaisutna uh sia a thak sitset na suaksak tavun,"},"24":{"text":"tuaciangin, Pathian lim bangin kivawt a, a thiangtho, a thutang le nuntakna maan taw ama le ama hong kilak, na mithak suana uh sia na silh tavun.","ref":"Pian 1:26; Col 3:10"},"25":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, leilot thu son nawn heak vun! Mihing sim in a thu uppuite tungah thumaan son tahen, banghang ziam cile eite in Christ ii pumpi sungah nate ih hi khawm siat hi.","ref":"Zec 8:16"},"26":{"text":"Na thin uh a uuk le, na thin uukna in, mawna sung thensak heak vun, thin uukna taw na nivui heak vun.","ref":"Ps 4:4 (LXX)"},"27":{"text":"Doaimangpa hunpha na ngasak heak vun."},"28":{"text":"Ngual neisa a suttol thei sia in sutolna kheal tahen a, ama nuntak natu a thalaw natu le a zawngte a hu thei natu in, naseam tahen."},"29":{"text":"Kamsia pau heak vun, kammal manphate bek pau vun; kitaangsapna sungah a kizangh thei le hong sato thei kammalte pau vun, tua hile hong za po in, phattuamna nga tu hi."},"30":{"text":"Pathian ii suatak hong piak tu Ni kipsakna le Pathian neisa na hina hong ciamtee Pathian Thaa Thiangtho khuangaisak heak vun."},"31":{"text":"Thin natna, thin tomna le thin uukna theampo na vawk vun. Ki oksatna ahibuale kiselnona, ki etsatna a tuatuamte theampo vawk vun."},"32":{"text":"Khat le khat tungah kithuthiam zaw vun a, thinneam tavun, Christ tungtawnin Pathian ii note mawna hong maisak bangma in, note zongh khat le khat mawna kimaisak tavun.","ref":"Col 3:13"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note sia Pathian ii it a tate na hi uh komin, ama bang na hi natu hanciam vun.","title":"Khuavak sungah Nuntakzia"},"2":{"text":"Christ in hong it a, Pathian diksak ngimnamtui biakpiakna le sangaw biakpiakna bangin, a nuntakna hong piak bangma, itna in na nuntakna uh uksak vun.","ref":"Pu 29:18; Ps 40:6"},"3":{"text":"Note in Pathian ii mihingte na hi bangma in, numei le pa paktatna, a thasiathuai nuntakna le duhopnate note sungah son tu in zongh na nei vet heak vun."},"4":{"text":"Kampauna sungah a kiihuai, a nin kammal le zummawk kammalte na zak tu uh zongh kilawm ngawl a, Pathian tungah lungdamkona kam na pau tu uh hizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"A kuama po a paktatte, a thasiathuai a, a kithoaite le a duhopte (duhop sia milim biakna nam khat hi) in Pathian le Christ Ngam lua ngeingawl tu hi ci sia pha takin na he uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Mawmawt kammal taw kuama in theamsak heak vun; hi thute mama hu in, Pathian ii thin uukna sia ama ii thu a ni ngawlte tungah tung tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom tuabang mihingte taw kizopna nei heak vun."},"8":{"text":"Noma mama zongh khuazing sungah om ngei na hi uh hang Topa mihingte na sua uh ciangin, khuavak sungah na om uh hi. Tua ahiciang khuavak ii neisa mihingte bangin na nungta tavun,"},"9":{"text":"tua khuavak in na a pha theampo, thutang suana le thumaanna hong puak hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa ii diksak thute sin vun."},"11":{"text":"Mihingte ii sep le vawt khuazing taw a kipawl a mannung ngawlte na thutha heak vun a, tua ngamtatnate khuavak sungah then siat zaw tavun."},"12":{"text":"(Amate ii khuazing sungah a sep a vawt kute sia son tu zongh in maizumhuai lei hi.)"},"13":{"text":"Tuaciang na theampo khuavak sungah hong kipusua tak ciang, amate pianzia babang thiang takin hong kilangh tu hi;"},"14":{"text":"banghang ziam cile a thiang takin a kilangh na khat pawpo sia khuavak suak hi. Tua hu in hi bangin kici hi; “A mutthippa awng, khanglo in, tuaciang thina pan tho in, tua hile Christ sia nang tungah hong taang tu hi.”"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom na nuntakzia kidawm in, heakmeal nei ngawlte bangin na nungta heak vun a, a ciimte bangin na nungta vun."},"16":{"text":"Hunpha na nga simin, a pha in zangh in, banghang ziam cile tu hun in ngitlo hun ahi hi.","ref":"Col 4:5"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom mawmaw heak vun a, Topa in nang sia bang vawt le hong oai ziam cisia na heak tu in na hanciam vun."},"18":{"text":"No hong lalsak thei, sapittui na kham heak vun: Thaa taw na kidim zaw tavun."},"19":{"text":"Psalm late, biakna late le la thiangtho te ii kammalte taw khat le khat na kipaupui tavun; biakna late le psalm late sa in, na thinsung theampo taw Topa pok vun."},"20":{"text":"Topa Jesus Christ min taw na theampo atu in Pathian ahi Pa tungah a tawntungin lungdam ko tavun.","ref":"Col 3:16-17"},"21":{"text":"Christ na thasiana uh taw khat le khat tungah thu kinitna nei tavun.","title":"Zite le Pasalte"},"22":{"text":"Zite awng, Topa ii thu na nit uh bangin na pasalte ii thu ni tavun.","ref":"Col 3:18; 1 Pe 3:1"},"23":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Christ in pawlpi tungah thu a nei bangma in, pasalte in zite tungah thu nei hi: tuaciangin Christ sia a pumpi ahi pawlpi ii Hunpa ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Pawlpi in Christ tungah thunitna a nei bangma in, zite in pasalte tungah a khawng a kheakin thunitna nei tahen."},"25":{"text":"Pasalte awng, na zite it vun. Christ in Pawlpi it a, a nuntakna a piak bangin na zite na it vun.","ref":"Col 3:19; 1 Pe 3:7"},"26":{"text":"Pawlpi sia thiangtho a, sit baang ngawl, paubanna om ngawl a, Pathian kammal ahi tui taw a kisilthiang zawkciang Pathian tungah tua pawlpi a ki aap thei natu in pawlpi atu Christ kipia hi.","merge":"27"},"28":{"text":"Tuabang ma in pasalte in amate pumpi a it bangma in, a zite a it natu ahi hi. Pasal khat a zi a itpa in, ama le ama ki it ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"(Kuama in ama ii pumpi a ensan a om bua hi. Christ ii pawlpi tungah a vawt bangma in, mihingte in a pumpi sia anvaak in ou zaw hi;"},"30":{"text":"banghang ziam cile eite in ama pumpi ii nate ih hi hi.)"},"31":{"text":"Laithiangtho ii, “Hi thu hangin pa khat in a nu le a pa nusia tu a, a zi taw a kop tu hi. Tuaciangin amate nii sia khat suak tu hi,” a ci bangma ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 2:24"},"32":{"text":"Laithiangtho sungah a thuk mama thuku khat kipualaak a, tua thu in Christ le pawlpi atu ahi hunlam ka tel hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahihang tuasia in note tung zongh ah kizangh thei hi; pasal khat simin ama le ama a ki it bangin a zi it tu a, zite khat simin a pasal zakta tu uh hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tate awng, nute pate thu na nit tu uh sia na Tapidaw vaipuak hi a, hisia in a maan sep tu sia ahi hi.","title":"Tate le Nute Pate","ref":"Col 3:20"},"2":{"text":"“Na nu le na pa zakta in,” a ci sia kamciam taw a kizui thupiak masabel ahi hi:","ref":"Pu 20:12; Thkna 5:16"},"3":{"text":"“Tua hile na theampo sungah na khangto tu a, leitung ah na khansau tu hi,” ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Nute pate awng, na tate thin uuk natu in vawt heak vun. Tapidawte kitekna le kihilna taw khangtosak zaw vun.","ref":"Col 3:21"},"5":{"text":"Silate awng, na leitung tote sia kiitakna le liinna taw a thu ni vun; tuabangin na hi uh ciang, Christ atu a seam bangma in thinsung takpi taw seam vun.","title":"Silate le Tote","ref":"Col 3:22-25"},"6":{"text":"Hong kipok tu thangaina taw amate hong mu sung teng bekin, tuabangin ngamta heak vun a; Christ ii sila bangin, Pathian dei sia na thin theampo taw seam vun."},"7":{"text":"Sila na hina uh taw na na sep uh ciangin, mihingte bek atu seam hi ngawlin Topa atu a seam bangin maitai takin naseam vun."},"8":{"text":"Topa in sila hikale sila ngawl hikale mihing sim ii a sep nasep pha tungtaang ah thaman pia tu ci in na phawk tavun."},"9":{"text":"To ahite awng, silate tungah tuabang ma in na ngamta vun a, tawnna kam na zangh nawn heak vun. Note le na silate in vantung ah Topa khat nei khawm a, tua pa in a kikhaikim in mihing khat sim tungah thu hong khen tu hi ci in phawk tavun.","ref":"Thkna 10:17; Col 3:25; 4:1"},"10":{"text":"A khakbel in, Topa taw kikopna pan le ama ii vaangletna lianpi taw na thahat tavun.","title":"Pathian ii Ngalvanh A bucing"},"11":{"text":"Doaimangpa ngitlo theamnate na nalh zawk natu in, Pathian hong piak ngalvanhte theampo na silh vun."},"12":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile eite in mihing ngal ih do bua a, vantung a thaa ngilote hatna, a ukte, thuneite, hi khuazing hun sungah vaangletna neite ih do hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahiciang tu in Pathian ngalvanhte silh vun! Tua hile hun ngilo ni hong thet ciangin ngalte ii hong simna te na nalh zo tu uh a, a tawp dongin na sim zawk uh ciang na dinmun kip lai tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, thumaan thutak sia na kawng ah kawngkhau bang, thutang suana sia awmdalna bang,","ref":"Is 11:5; 59:17"},"15":{"text":"Lungdamna Thupha thansak tu kinginna sia peangdap bangin zanghin, a kithoaisa in om vun.","ref":"Is 52:7"},"16":{"text":"Hun theampo sungah upna sia lum bangin toai vun; banghang ziam cile tua taw Ngilopa hong kaapna thaltang kuangte theampo na tulmit thei tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ngupna sia thik lukhu bangin na saang vun a, tuaciangin Pathian kammal sia Thaa ii hong piak namsau bangin na zangh vun.","ref":"Is 59:17"},"18":{"text":"Hite theampo thungetna taw seam vun a, Pathian munah huna na ngen vun. Thaa ii hong lampui bangin, hun theampo sungah thu na ngen vun. Hi thu hu in pilvangin, thinkiam ngei heak vun; Pathian ii mihingte theampo atu thu na ngen tawntung vun."},"19":{"text":"Lungdamna thuku sia hangsan tak le ngual ii tel tu ka son thei natu in, son tu ka kithoai ciang, Pathian ii ka son tu thu hong hil natu kei atu zongh thu hong ngetsak tavun."},"20":{"text":"Tu laitakin, thonginn sungah om ka hi hang, hi lungdamna thu atu in, keima sia tongciin ka hi hi. Lungdamna thu ka son tu bang a, hangsan takin ka son ngam natu thu hong ngetsak tavun."},"21":{"text":"Bangbangin om khi ziam ci in na heak thei natu in, Topa nasepna sungah thumaan naseam ih suapuipa Tychicus in kei huvau thu thakte hong son tu hi.","title":"A khakbel Paupuina","ref":"Sawl 20:4; 2 Tim 4:12; Col 4:7-8"},"22":{"text":"Tuasia hu in, kote ka vekpi in bangbangin om khu ziam ci thu hong son tu le, note hong hanthawn tu in — ama note kungah kong paisak laitak ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ in Tapidaw suapui theampo tungah thinnopna le ki itna, upna taw hong pia khawm tahen."},"24":{"text":"A thi ngei ngawl itna taw ih Topa Jesus Christ a it te theampo tungah Pathian ii thuthiamna hong om tahen."}}}}},"50":{"info":{"name":"Philippite","shortname":"Phil","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Christ Jesus ii naseamte ahi Paul le Timothy in — Christ Jesus taw pumkhat a om pawlpi lampuite le, Husyate a kihel Philippi ah a om Pathian ii mite theampo tungah lai kong thaak uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:12"},"2":{"text":"Ih Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ in thuthiamna le thinnopna hong pia tahen."},"3":{"text":"Noma kong ngaisut simin, noma hu in ka Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko hi;","title":"Paul ii Thungetsakna"},"4":{"text":"tuaciangin no teng theampo atu thu ka nget simin thinnop lungdamna taw thu ka ngen hi,"},"5":{"text":"banghang ziam cile ka kipat phit ni pan tu dong lungdamna thu nasepna sungah nong hu zia uhte ka ngaisut hang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom no sungah hi nasep pha hong patpui Pathian in nasep a kizaw tu hun Christ Jesus Ni ciang dong na hong seam suak tu ka ci ngam hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka thinsung ah no kong phawk tawntung hi! Tuabangin kong phaw sia kei atu in a kilawm thu ahi hi. Banghang ziam cile, tu laitak thonginn sungah ka om laitak ahizong, lungdamna thu ii a maanna sia huuk tu le kipsak tu in ka suatak laitak ahizong, Pathian ii hong piak hi phattuamna nong saan pui tek uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A thukin no kong phawna sia Christ Jesus mama ii thinsung pan hong luang tatak ahi hunlam ka tetti sia Pathian ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ki itna na khantosak seseam natu, heakna maan le thukhenna maan na nei khop thei natu,"},"10":{"text":"tua tungtawnin, a phabel sia na teal thei natu in thu kong ngetsak hi. Tuasia ciangin Christ ii Ni hong thet hunin niinnoina teng le mawsiatna theampo taw na kipeal tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Pathian minthan natu le ama pok natu in Jesus Christ bek ii piansak thei a maan pilna thiamnate taw na nuntakna uh hong kidim tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Suapuite awng, kei tungah hong tung thute sia lungdamna thu khangtosak takpi ahi hunlam na tel tu uh ka dei hi.","title":"Nuntakna in Christ hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua thute taw kizomin, kumpi inncing ngalkap bup le hi sungah a om a dang teng in kei sia Christ ii naseam ka hi hu a thongtaak ka hi hunlam he siat uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 28:30"},"14":{"text":"Thong sungah ka om hu in u le nau a tamzaw in Topa tungah thinmuanna neizaw uh a, tuaciang ngupna thu lau ngawlin hil ngam vaial uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate sung panin pawlkhatte ahile eenna le kingal vawtna thin taw Christ thuhil a, ahizong a dangte in thupha deina takpi taw hil uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Pathian ii kei sia lungdamna thu a maanna dinpui tu nasep hong piak hunlam amate in he ahikom hite in ki itna taw ma thu a hil uh hi."},"17":{"text":"A dangte ahile Christ thu sia thinpha taw thangsak ngawl a, amate kaang sung vai tupna thin taw hil uh hi; thonginn sungah ka om laitakin hong nawngkaisak thei zaw tu in ngaisun uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Phamaw ka sa bua hi!
