Hisia huvau ka lungdam hi — tupna maan taw ahizong, ahi bua zong Christ thu a nanamin kihil hi pole ka lungdam veve hi. Tuaciangin ka lungdamna sia kizom suak tu hi,"},"19":{"text":"banghang ziam cile nong thungetsakna uh le Jesus Christ ii Thaa kung pan hong pai huna taw kei hong kisuaktasak tu ci sia ka he hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka deina tatak le ka lametna sia bang ziam cile ka thi zong ka nung zong ka nuntakna buppi taw Christ vaang ka piak thei natu, hun theampo sung, a tuanin tu hun sung teng seseamin, hangsan takin ka panmun ka lel ngeingawl natu thu ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Nuntakna sia bang ziam? Kei atu in, nuntakna sia Christ hi a, thina sia hamphat zawk natu ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahizong ka nuntak ciangin a thupi nasepte seam thei zaw tu ka hile, thina le nuntakna, ka teal sawn tu ka he vaset bua hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei sia ka lang le ka lang panin hong kikang hi. Hi nuntakna nusia in Christ taw ka omkhawm nuam mama a, tua in a phazaw kan thu ahi hi;"},"24":{"text":"ahihang no atu in ci leang a nungta in om lai leng thupi zawlai hi."},"25":{"text":"Hi thu thiangtel ka hikomin a nungta a om tu ka hina ka he hi, upna sungah noma khantona le thinnopna a kibelap natu in no teng taw kong om lai tu hi,"},"26":{"text":"tua hile no kungah kong haw kik ciangin Christ Jesus taw kipumkhat in na nuntakna sungah kei nong kiphatsak pui seseam thei natu a hi hi."},"27":{"text":"Tu in a thupi thu in na nuntakna uh sia Christ lungdamna thu ii dei bang tatak ahi natu thu ahi hi, tua hile kei kong pai thei a, kong pai maw zong note tupna kibang khat tungah kip takin a dingte hi a, deina khat bek taw lungdamna thu upna atu ngaldo khawmte na hi hunlam kong za tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Na ngalte na kiita heak vun; na thinlian tawntung tavun, tua hile amate in hong lel tu a, noma in na zo tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile zawna hong pia sia Pathian ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Ama um bek ngawlin, ama hang a ngimna na thuakna uh taw, Christ atu nasep thei natu in hamphatna nga na hi uh hang hi."},"30":{"text":"Tu in keima taw kopin ngaldona sungah na kihel thei tu uh hi. Tua ngalkidona sia nidang zongin ka do nong mu uh a, tu zongh in na zaak uh bangma in ka do lai hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:19-40"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Christ sungah na nuntakna in, hong thahatsak a, tuaciang ama hong itna in hong thinnuamsak hi. Note in Thaa taw na kipawlkhawm uh a, tuaciang khat le khat ii tungah dikna le ciliapna na nei uh hi.","title":"Christ ii Kiniamkhiakna le A letna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka lungdamna nong pawlcinsak natu in ngaisutna kibangin, ki itna khat nei khawm a, thin khat lung khat hi in na om natu uh kong hanthawn hi."},"3":{"text":"Kaangsung atu tupna bek taw ahizong, kisak thei nopna lel taw ahizong bangma seam heak vun, tua hi ngawlzaw in, khat le khat ii tungah kiniamkhiakin noma sangin ngualdangte a phazaw in ngaisun tawntung zaw vun."},"4":{"text":"Noma ii kinsante bek na en heak vun a, khat le khat ii kinsante zongh na ki etpui tavun:"},"5":{"text":"Christ Jesus ii a nei thinpuak na nei tavun."},"6":{"text":"Ama in Pathian ii pianzia nei nginge a, ahihang Pathian taw kikim natu in zawthawk thu zanghin hanciam tu a ngaisun bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hi ngawlzaw in, ama uuk thu in a nei theampo nusia in naseampa pianzia la hi. Ama in mihing taw kibangin piang a, mihing bangin kilangh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in kiniamkhiak a, a thi tu in thunitna lampi tawn a — a thina thinglamtee tung dongah pai hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi thu hangin Pathian in ama sia a saangbelna munah laamto a mindang khat pawpo sangin a lianzaw min pia hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jesus min patoai natu in vantung, leitung ah nuntakna a nei theampo, nuai simlei ah a om theampo in khupdin tu uh a,","ref":"Is 45:23"},"11":{"text":"tuaciang a theampo in Pa Pathian minthan natu Jesus Christ sia Topa hi ci in, a kilangh takin thangsak tu uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka itte awng, no kungah kong om lai in ka thu nong nit tawntung uh bangma in, no taw kong omkhop ngawl ciang ngawngawn in, ka thu nong nit tu uh sia thupi zaw lai hi. Na ngupna a cingtaak natu in launa le liinna taw na seam tan tavun,","title":"Leitung ah Khuavak bangin a Taangte"},"13":{"text":"banghang ziam cile ama deina na zui thei natu le na uuk natu in Pathian sia a tawntung na sung uh ah na hong seam hi."},"14":{"text":"Na theampo ah phun ngawl, nial ngawlin seam vun,"},"15":{"text":"tua hile mawna le ngamtat siatna taw kidim leitung mite kawmah, a sitbaang ngawl Pathian ii tate bangin a maw ngawl, a thiangthote na suak thei tu uh hi. Aksite ii van ah a taan bangma in,","ref":"Thkna 32:5"},"16":{"text":"nuntakna thu amate na son uh ciangin amate sungah na taang tu uh hi. Tuabangin na hi uh le Christ Ni hong thet ciangin, no kong kiphatsak pui natu a thu ka nei tu hi, banghang ziam cile ka hanciamna sa le ka sepna sa teng a luithawthong hi ngawl hi ci in hong lak tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Note upna hangin Pathian a kipia sangaw biakpiakna tungah piakkhiatna khat bangin ka nuntakna chisan kibua tu ahile zong ka lungdam tu a, ka thinnopna no theampo kong hawmsawn tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in note zongh na lung uh na damsak vun a, na thinnopna uh kei nong hawm tu uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa ii deina a om le noma thu ka zaakna taw ka kihansua natu in Timothy kong paisak pal thei tu hi.","title":"Timothy le Epaphroditus"},"20":{"text":"Ama bekma sia kei taw ngaisutna kisi a, no hong thinnuammaw tatak pa ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Midang khat pawpo ahile Jesus Christ atu sangin, ama ii aituam thute bek kin hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama taktai ziate bangbangin hong lak a, ama le kei sia pata bangin lungdamna thu atu bangza in diangkhawm khu ziam ci sia na heak uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka vai bangbang takin hong piang tu ci in ka heak po ciang, no kungah ama kong paisak tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Keima mama no kung kong pai pal thei natu in Topa ka muang hi."},"25":{"text":"Keima hong hu tu in kamtai a na zak sa uh, kei taw kop a, naseamin ngal hong do pui ih suapui Epaphroditus kong paisak kul tu hi ci in ka ngaisun hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in note theampo hong mu tu kaal ngakla a, a cina hi ci in na zaak uh sia a thinnuam ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama a cina takpi peu a, thi dektak zawsap hi. Ahihang Pathian in ama hesuak a, ama bek hi ngawlin kei zongh, khuangaina nasia zaw ka thuak ngawl natu in hong hesuak hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom kong paisak tu sia ka thalawp kan hi. Tua hile ama na mu uh ciang na lungdam tu a, kei khuangaina bo tu hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa sungah suapui khat a hina hangin lungdamna taw na saang vun. Ama bang ahi tua mi theampo tungah zatakna lak tavun,"},"30":{"text":"banghang ziam cile kei nong hu thei ngawlna munah huna hong piak natu in, Christ ii na a sepna sungah a luangkhaamin a thi dektak pa ahi hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thukhupna ah, ka suapuite awng, Topa taw pumkhat na hina uh taw kisai in lungpil tavun. Ka at sa thute ka at kikik sia phamaw sa tuan ngawl khi hi, note thinmuan natu hi zaw hi.","title":"A maan Thutang Suana"},"2":{"text":"A sia a vawtte, tua uite, vunteap at kul hi a ci hamtangte, na encik tavun."},"3":{"text":"A maan vunteap atna a neite sia amate hi ngawl a, eima ih hi zaw hi, banghang ziam cile eite in Pathian sia ama Thaa taw ih bia a, Christ Jesus taw pumkhat a ih nuntakna sung ah, a lawpte ih hi hi. A puatham cii le sa limte tungtaang ah eite in muanna ih nei bua hi."},"4":{"text":"Keima zongh tuabang thute muan thei natu a neipa ka hi hi. A puatham cii le sa limte muan thei tu thu nei ing a ci khat po a om le tuabang ci thei natu thu a tamzaw ka nei hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka sua zawk nipi khat a cin ciangin ka vunteap hong ki atsak hi. Ka pianna sia Israel mi in ka piang a, Benjamin suan hi in, Hebrew chi tatak ka hi hi. Jew te Thukham zuina taw kizomin keima in Pharisee khat ka hi hi,","ref":"Sawl 23:6; 26:5; Rom 11:1"},"6":{"text":"a biakna sangah tha lawp leilam ka hi komin, pawlpi ka vawtsia zazaan hi. Mihing khat in thukham tanna taw thutang suak thei tu hile sitbaanna ka nei bua hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 22:4; 26:9-11"},"7":{"text":"Ahihang meetna in ka ngaisut thei thute theampo sia tu in Christ atu hangin supna hizaw hi ci in ka tuat hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuate bek ahi bua hi: ka Topa Christ Jesus heakna thu sia manpha zaw pek ahi hu in nadang theampo sia supna hi ci in ka tuat hi. Ama hangin na theampo ka vawk zo hi; Christ ka nei thei natu le, ama taw pumkhat ka sua bit thei natu in na theampo sia ninbu lomtangh bang bekin ka ngaisun hi,"},"9":{"text":"Thukham zuina taw a kinga theite nam ahi keima aituam thutang suana khat sia ka nei nawn bua hi. Christ ih upna tungtawnin hong kipia, Pathian kung pan hong pai upna a kibulphu thutang sia tu in ka nei zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Christ heak tu le ama thaw kikna vaangletna siim tu, ama thuaknate thuakpui tu, a thina sungah ama taw kiban tu sia ka dei bulpi ahi hi,"},"11":{"text":"tua in keima mama thina pan nuntakna ah ka thaw kik tu ka lametna ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka nasepna taangtun zo ing, tua ahibuale cialcing zo ing ci ngawl khi hi. Jesus Christ in ama atu in kei hong sungsuam zo a hina tel sia ka nga zawk natu in ka hanciam tan lai hi.","title":"Mungtupna sangah Tai"},"13":{"text":"Hi hi, ka suapuite awng, tua tel nga zo khi hi, ci in ka ngaisun bua hi; ahizong ka sepna khat sia, nungsang thute mangil in maisang thute ka phak natu in ahi theiza ka hanciam hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jesus Christ tungtawnin tungsang nuntak natu Pathian hong sapna ahi, tel a nga zo tu in tang takin mungtupna sangah ka tai hi."},"15":{"text":"Thaa lamsang ah a khanthin eite theampo in hi bang thin ih nei natu ahi hi. Ahihang no pawlkhat in thutuam na nei uh le Pathian in hong telsak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuabang ahi hial zong, tu dong ciang ih zui sa hi ngeinate taw ma mainawt tawng."},"17":{"text":"Suapuite awng, keima ngamtat bangin hong zui tawntung tavun. Noma ettee tu a ngamtatna maan kong koisak sia a zuite na nadon`` tavun.","ref":"1 Cor 4:16; 11:1"},"18":{"text":"Hi thute tamvei ma kong son ngei zo a, tu in thitui taw kong son kik hi: a nuntakna zia uh taw thinglamtee tungah Christ' thina ii ngalte a suak mihing tam mama om hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate sia a khakbel ciangin hell theng tu uh hi, banghang ziam cile cii le sa deinate sia amate ii pathian ahi hi. A maizum huai, a thasiathuaite thangphatna in la uh a, leitung neisa nate bekma ngaisun uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Eite ih hile vantung ngammite ih hi a, vantung panin ih Hunpa Topa Jesus Christ hong pai tu thalawp takin ih ngak hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama in a thazawm a thithei ih pumpite sia na theampo ama uk sung a thet natu, a vawt theina vaang zangh a, ama ii vaang nei pumpi taw kibangin hong vawt tu hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahikom suapuite awng, no sia kei atu bangza in na ithuai uh a, bangza in hong phawk khi ziam! Nong lungdamsak mama uh a, note hu in ka angtang mama hi! — ka it suapuite awng, hisia in na nuntak sung teng Topa sungah na khodin tu uh zia ahi hi.","title":"Kihilna"},"2":{"text":"Euodia le Syntyche te awng, kong nget nop thu in kei nong hesuakna in Topa sungah unau numeite bangin na thukim thei natu uh na hanciam vun."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciang a thumaan ka naseppui noma zongh in, hi numeite na hu tu uh ka dei hi; banghang ziam cile amate sia Pathian ii nuntakna laibu sungah a om Clement le ka naseppui dangte theampo taw kop in, lungdamna thu kizel natu in keima taw nasia tak a diangte ahi uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Topa taw pumkhat na hi hu in, a tawntung lungdam tavun. Kong ci kik hi: na lungdam tavun!"},"5":{"text":"Mihing khat sim tungah na cikna uh lak tavun. Topa hong pai pal tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Na khat pawpo atu in thinngim heak vun, ahihang na thungetna theampo ah na kisap uh te, Pathian tungah lungdamko nopna thin taw na ngen tawntung vun."},"7":{"text":"Tua hile mihing tel zawk ngawl Pathian ii thinnopna in Christ Jesus taw na kipumkhatna hangin, na thin na lung hong ngammuangsak tu hi."},"8":{"text":"A khakbel kong cinopna ah ka suapuite awng, thupha le a pok huai thute: a thumaan, mipi tan huai, a thutang, a thiangtho, a ithuaite le a thasiahuai nate na ngaisun tavun."},"9":{"text":"Ka kammalte le ka ngamtatnate pan na heak uh, na saan uhte sia na zangh vateak tavun. Tua hile eite thinnopna hong pia Pathian in no taw hong omkhawm tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa taw kipumkhat a ka nuntak sungah a khuangei hun khat zawkciangin khatvei ma nong thin nopmawkna uh nong lak thei lai natu in, hunpha nga kik na hi uh ciangin ka lungdamna lian hi. Hong kin ngawl nu hi kong ci bua hi — nong thin nopmawkna uh nong lak tu hun om ngawl hi bek hi.","title":"Letsong huvau Lungdamkonate"},"11":{"text":"Hi bang ka ci ciang hong kingaingon kong sakna hi tuan ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile ka nei babang taw lungkim natu ka sin sa ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Cimawkna le ci thei zawknate ka he hi. A koima pawpo ah bang hun po ahizong ngilvana le ngilkialna, hauna le zawnna sungah, lungkim thei natu in hi thuku ka sin sa ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Christ ii hong piak vaangletna taw na theampo phul zawk natu thahatna ka nei hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahitazong, ka ngim nganate ah nong hu uh sia na phat mamana uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Lungdamna Thupha ka hil kipat sawng, Macedonia ka nusiat ciangin kei hong hu pawlpi sia noma bekma na hi hunlam noma Philippi te in pha tak ma na heak uh ahi hi; ka nganate le ka supnate ah noma bekma in nong sikpui uh hi.","ref":"2 Cor 11:9"},"16":{"text":"Thessalonica khua ah huna ka kisap laitakin khatvei bek hi ngawlin, huna nong thathaak uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 17:1"},"17":{"text":"Letsong nga tute a thangai ka hi bua hi; na thupha vawt sate tungah a meet a kibelap tu ka mu nopna hizaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom hi sungah nong piaksa uh theampo kong saanna lai om a — kicing vaal hi! Epaphroditus in na letsong uh theampo hong puak ahikom, tu in ka kitaangsap theampo nei zo khi hi. Tuate in Pathian mai ah ngimnamtui piak taw kibangin a saannophuai le dik a sak biakpiakna hi.","ref":"Pu 29:18"},"19":{"text":"Tuaciang ka Pathian in Jesus Christ tungtawnin a kicing ama hauna theampo taw kizui in na kitaangsap theampo hong sik tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ih Pathian le Pa tungah minthanna a tawntung, a tawntungin om tahen! Amen."},"21":{"text":"Jesus Christ ii neisa ahi Pathian mihing khat sim tungah kong paupui hi. Hi sungah keima taw a om u le naute in nuksetna kam hong thaak hi.","title":"A khakbel Nuksetnate"},"22":{"text":"Hi sungah a om Pathian mite theampo, a tuanin Kumpilianpa inn sungah a omte in hong paupui hi."},"23":{"text":"Topa Jesus Christ ii thuthiamna note theampo taw om tahen."}}}}},"51":{"info":{"name":"Colossaete","shortname":"Col","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ii deina taw Jesus Christ ii sawltak khat ahi Paul le ih suapuipa Timothy in —"},"2":{"text":"Colossae khua ah a om Christ taw pumkhat ahi a thumaan suapui le Pathian mite tungah lai kong thaak uh hi. Ih Pa Pathian in thuthiamna le thinnopna hong pia tahen."},"3":{"text":"No atu thu ka nget uh ciangin, ih Topa Jesus ii Pa ahi Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko tawntung uh hi.","title":"Lungdamko Thungetna"},"4":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Jesus Christ na upna uh le Pathian ii mite theampo na itna uh ka za uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Lungdamna Thupha a maan thuhilna no tungah hong theng masa a, tua ii hong piak tu lametna sia na za zo uh hi. Tua ahikomin vantung ah no atu in hong kikoisak na lamet uh sia ii tungah na upna le na itna uh, kingaa in om hi."},"6":{"text":"Pathian ii thuthiamna na zaak phit ni uh pan kipan, no in a maan tatakin na heak uh bangma, tua lungdamna thu in, thuphate no tungah hong puapuak a, leitung theampo ah kizel hi."},"7":{"text":"Pathian ii thuthiamna sia kote taangin Christ ii thumaan naseampa ka nasep pui Epaphras tung panin heakna na nga uh hi.","ref":"Col 4:12; Phm 23"},"8":{"text":"Ama in Thaa ii hong piak itna na neina uh ko tungah hong son zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua thu hangin note thu ka zaak pan kipan thu kong ngetsak tawntung uh hi. Ama deina tel theina le a Thaa ii hong piak ciimna le heakna theampo taw note hong kidimsak natu in Pathian tungah ka ngen uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaciang Topa deina bangin na nungta thei tu uh a, ama ii diksak bangin na vawt tawntung tu uh hi. Na nuntakna in nasep pha theampo piangsak tu a, Pathian heakna sungah na khangto tu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Na theampo thinsauna taw na thuak zawk natu uh in, ama ii minthang vaangletna in note hong thahatsak tahen."},"12":{"text":"Thinnopna taw Pa tungah lungdam na ko tavun. A ma in khuavakna ngam sungah a mite ii lua tu a khealsiate nga tu in hong kilawmsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama in khuazing vaangletna sung pan eite hong hun a, a it a Tapa ngam sungah bit takin hong paipui hi."},"14":{"text":"A chisan hangin eite ih suakta a, ih mawnate hong kimaisak zo hi.","ref":"Eph 1:7"},"15":{"text":"Christ sia mu thei ngawl Pathian ii pianzia muna ahi hi. Ama sia bitphua sa theampo sung pan Tapa upabel ahi hi.","title":"Christ ii Mihing A hina le A nasep"},"16":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile vantung leitung na theampo, a kimu thei le a kimu maw nate thaa taw kisai vaangletna neite, tote, a ukte le thuneite theampo sia ama tungtawnin Pathian in bitphua hi. Pathian in ama tungtawnin vaannuai buppi ama atu in bitphua hi."},"17":{"text":"Christ sia tuate theampo om ma in om a, ama taw kikopin a omna mun tu tek ah om uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama in a pumpi ahi pawlpi lutang hi a, ama in pumpi ii nuntakna naak ahi hi. Ama in Tapa upabel hi a, na theampo sungah ama bek a masa phitbel ahi natu in thina panin tho kiksak zo hi.","ref":"Eph 1:22-23"},"19":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian ii khensatna om bangin Tapa in Pathian ii zia theampo nei hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaciang Tapa tungtawnin Pathian in vaannuai buppi sia ama kung a thet kik thei natu in khensat hi. Thinglamtee tungah a kibua Tapa ii chisan tungtawnin Pathian in kilemna piangsak a, leitung vantung ah a om, na theampo ama kungah then kik siat hi.","ref":"Eph 2:16"},"21":{"text":"Hun khat lai in note in Pathian taw na kikhuala uh a, ngitlo ngamtatna le ngitlo khua ngaisutna na nei uh manin a ngalte na hi uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahihang tu in ama omna munah a thiangtho, a kidoituam, a sitbaang ngawlin hong thet thei natu in a Tapa ii pumpi thina hangin Pathian in a lawmte hong suaksak zo hi."},"23":{"text":"A kho thu doppha tungah na thumaan tawntung vun a, lungdamna thu na zaak ciil uh lai a na nga uh lametna taw na kipeal nuam heak vun. Leitung mihing sim tungah a kihil hi lungdamna thu hu in keima Paul sia naseam khat suak ka hi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tu in no atu ka thuak nate tungtaang ah ka lungdam hi, banghang ziam cile a pumpi ahi pawlpi atu Christ ii thuak tu a om laite a khuangkhim natu in keima in cii le sa taw ka thuak ciangin a hu ka hi hi.","title":"Pawlpi Naseam khat bang a Paul ii Nasepna"},"25":{"text":"Tuaciangin kei sia Pawlpi naseam tu in Pathian in hong vawt hi a, note phat natu in hi nasep lian sia sep tu in hong kipia hi. Tua nasep lian sia ama thu a cing takin thansak natu hi a,"},"26":{"text":"tua thu in hun bosa sungah mihing nam theampo te sung pan a kiseal, tuciangin ama mite tungah a kilak thuku ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Pathian ii ngealna sia ama ii thuku, mihing theampo atu in, ama ii a nei a tuanngen thuku sia a mite ii a heaksak tu ahi hi. Tua thuku in bangziam cile Christ in note sungah om a tua hu in note in Pathian ii vaangletna na lua tu uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahikom Christ sia mihing khat sim tungah ka hil uh hi. Pathian omna munah mihing khat simin Christ taw kikop in, a khanthin natu in ciimna theampo taw hil in a kidop natu thu ka pia uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Hi nasep a kizaw thei natu in ka sungah na hong seam Christ ii nasia tak a tha hong piakna zanghin diangin ka kisaan hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kei akua ci hong he ngawl midangte le Laodicea a om mihingte le note atu in bangzata haksa in naseam khi ziam ci sia kong son tu hi."},"2":{"text":"Hi bang ka ngamtat sia amate thinletna taw a kidim natu, ki itna sungah a kikaizot natu, le thumaan heakna pan a piang thinmuanna a kicing hauna a nei thei natu deina ahi hi. Hisia lam panin Pathian thuku ahi Christ ama mama sia amate in he tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Pathian ciimna le heakna a kiphualseal sumngum theampo a kihonna tawtang sia ama ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom kong son hi, bangza po in pha tu bang ahitazong, kinialna maan ngawlte taw kuama in na theamsak heak vun."},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ka pumpi taw hong omkhawm ngawl ka hihang ka thinsung taw note kungah kong om hi, tuaciangin Christ ih upna sungah kip takin na din khopna uh ka mu ciangin ka lungdam hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesus Christ sia Topa a na saan zawk uh nungsang, ama taw kikopin nungta tavun.","title":"Christ sungah A kicing Nuntakna"},"7":{"text":"Ama sungah zung thuk tha vun a, ama tungah na nuntakna uh sa to tavun, tuaciangin hong kihil sa bangin na upna sungah hat seseam vun. Lungdamkona taw na kidim tavun."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom Christ sung pan ahi ngawl, vaannuai a uk thaa te ii mihingte tungah a piak susuk a mannung ngawl kitheamna, mihing ciimnate taw kuama in sila a hong mat ngawl natu in kikeam tavun."},"9":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile thaa pianzia sia Christ le ama ii mihing a hina sung mama ah a cing takin teang a,"},"10":{"text":"tuaciangin ama taw na kikopna uh sungah a kicing nuntakna hong pia zo hi. Ama sia thaa lam sangah a ukte le thuneite khat sim sangin lianzaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesus taw kikopna sungah note vunteap at sa na hi uh a, mihing vunteap atzia taw hi ngawlin, hi mawna pumpi thahatna pan hong suatak Christ vunteap atzia taw hong ki at zo hi."},"12":{"text":"Cinopna in na ki baptize uh ciang Christ taw a kivui sa na hi zo uh a, na ki baptize na in thina pan a thokiksak Pathian ii vaangletna sungah na upna tungtawnin note zongh Christ taw hong kitho kik khawmsak zo hi.","ref":"Rom 6:4"},"13":{"text":"Hun khat lai in, na mawna uh hang le Thukham nei ngawl Gentile te na hi uh hangin note sia thaa lam ah a thisa na hi uh hi. Ahitazong tu in Pathian in Christ taw nuntakna sungah hong then zo hi. Pathian in ih mawna theampo hong maisak zo hi.","ref":"Eph 2:1-5"},"14":{"text":"Ama in eite hong heencip ahi thusia tepteena leiba theampo hong phiatsak a, thinglamtee tungah hong kilcipsak siat zo hi.","ref":"Eph 2:15"},"15":{"text":"Tuaciang tua thinglamtee tungah Christ in thaa lam sangah ukna neite le thuneite ii vaangletna pan ama le ama kisuaktasak hi; tuate sia ama ngalzaw poai sungah sila tu in a kimante bangin mihonte ii mu tu in kai hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom neak le dawn huvau ahizong, a thiangtho nite huvau ahizong, Thadet poai le Sabbath nipi huvau ahizong note tungah zui tu ngeina vawtsak heak vun.","ref":"Rom 14:1-6"},"17":{"text":"Tuabangte theampo sia maisang a hong pai pheang tu nate ii limh ahi hi; a tatak sia Christ ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Vawttawm kiniamkhiakna le vantunglalangte bia in hong sawl a, mukhol thei tuam a neina hangin thupi a kisate ii hong puavawk tu sia noma le noma na ki oai heak vun. Bangma thu om ngawl bulin tuabang mihingte sia a mihing khua ngaisutna taw kisuangtaak uh a,"},"19":{"text":"tuaciang pumpi lutang ahi Christ thasua uh hi. Christ ukna nuai ah pumpi bup kipuua to a, a ngu le a sapiatte in a om natu san tek len in Pathian dei bangin khangto uh hi.","ref":"Eph 4:16"},"20":{"text":"Note Christ taw thi khawm zo a, vaannuai a uk thaa te panin hong kisuaktasak zo hi. Tua ahile banghangin hi leitung ii neisa bangin nungta nu ziam?","title":"Christ taw Thina le Nuntakna"},"21":{"text":"“Hisia tham heak in, tuasia tep heak in, a dang sia thutha heak in,” ci bang thukhamte banghangin ni nu ziam?"},"22":{"text":"Hite in khatvei a kizak zawkciang, kimanna a nei nawn ngawl thute a cina hi; tuate in mihing vawttawm ngeinate le hilnate hi bek hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuabang ngeinate sia ciimna bulphu in a piang hi tuak a, vantunglalangte biak tu sawl ngawpna sung, vawttawm kiniamkhiakna sung le pumpi nasia tak a ngim piakna sungah kizangh hi; ahihang tuate in pumpi deinate ukna tu in bangma man nei ngawl hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note nuntakna sungah Christ taw hong kithosak kik zo ahikom Pathian ii ziatsang kumpi tokhum tung Christ tona mun vantung ah a om nate thangai vun.","ref":"Ps 110:1"},"2":{"text":"Tua munah na ngaisutna uh phut vun a, hi leitung ah phut heak vun."},"3":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile note thi zo a, tuaciang na nuntakna uh sia Pathian sungah Christ taw kiseal zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Na nuntakna tatak uh sia Christ hi a, tuaciang ama hong kilangh ciangin note zongh ama taw na kilangh khawm tu uh a, ama ii vaangletna na siim tu uh hi!"},"5":{"text":"Note in na sungah na hong seam leitung deinate na thisak uh kul tu hi, tuate sia numei le pa khialna, kiihuai ngamtatna, cii le sa deina zui nopna, ngamtat sia tatnopna, duhopna (duhopna sia milim biakna nam khat ahi hi) te ahi hi.","title":"Nuntakna Lui le Nuntakna Thak"},"6":{"text":"Tua bangte hu in ama thu a ni ngawlte ii tungah Pathian thin uukna hong tung tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Na nuntakna uh tuate ii hong huknelh hunlai in noma mama zongh tuabang uukna deinate taw kipawl in na nungta ngei zo uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang tu in note in, thin uukna, a sia thangaina, etsatna thin neina, hite theampo na vawk siat vun. Kiselnona le a kiihuai kammalte na muk uh pan pusuaksak ngei heak vun."},"9":{"text":"Khat le khat na kitheam heak vun, banghang ziam cile na nuntakna lui taw a kikop zongsang nate na suut zo uh a,","ref":"Eph 4:22"},"10":{"text":"a thak nuntakna zia na silh zo uh hi. Tua in, a kicing takin ama ih heak seseam natu in, Bitphuapa Pathian ii ama a suun tu in hong thaksua tawntung nuntakna thak ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 1:26; Eph 4:24"},"11":{"text":"Tua hu in Gentile le Jew, vunteap at le at ngawl, khualmi le tualmi, sila le sila ahi ngawlte ci bangin kidoidanna om ngawl hi. Ahihang Christ sia na theampo hi a, na theampo sungah Christ om hi."},"12":{"text":"Note sia Pathian ii mite na hi uh hi, ama in hong it a ama atu in hong teal hi. Tua ahikom note sia kiciliapna, cikna, kiniamkhiakna, thinneamna le thinsau nate puan bangin na silh uh kul hi.","ref":"Eph 4:2"},"13":{"text":"Khat le khat na kidual vun a, a dang khat ii tungah lungkim ngawlna a nei khat po na om uh ciangin, khat le khat kimaisak vun. Topa in note mawna hong maisak bangma in note zongh khat le khat na kimaisak vun.","ref":"Eph 4:32"},"14":{"text":"Tuaciangin hi kicinna tungsia ah ki itna belap vun, tua in na theampo a cingin pumkhat suak tu in hong hencip hi."},"15":{"text":"Christ ii thinnopna hong piak sia bang tu ziam cile na thukhensat nate sungah lam hong lak tu in, hong piak ahi hi. Banghang ziam cile hi thinnopna sungah note theampo pumkhatin a omkhawm tu, Pathian in hong sam hi. Tuaciangin lungdamko na thiam tavun."},"16":{"text":"A kicing Christ ii thu na thinsung uh ah hong teang tahen. Khat le khat ciimna theampo taw kihil kilak tavun. Psalm late, pokna late le la thiangtho te na thinsung uh ah lungdamkona in Pathian tungah na sa vun.","ref":"Eph 5:19-20"},"17":{"text":"Na sep, na son uh theampo hu in, Pa Pathian tungah lungdam na ko uh ciangin, Topa Jesus min taw na vawt tu uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Zite awng, na pasalte thu ni tavun, banghang ziam cile Tapidaw na hina uh taw hi bangin na ngamtat tu uh ahi hi.","title":"Nuntakna Thak sungah Aituam Kizopna","ref":"Eph 5:22; 1 Pe 3:1"},"19":{"text":"Pasalte awng, na zite uh na it vun, amate tungah na ngongtat heak vun.","ref":"Eph 5:25; 1 Pe 3:7"},"20":{"text":"Tate awng, nute pate ii thu na nit tawntung tu uh sia Tapidawte vaipuak hi a, tua in Pathian ii lungkim thu ahi hi.","ref":"Eph 6:1"},"21":{"text":"Nute pate awng, na tate uh a thin na uuksak heak vun, a thin na uuksak uh le a thin kiam tu hi.","ref":"Eph 6:4"},"22":{"text":"Silate awng, thu theampo ah na tote thu ni vun, pha hong sak tu deina taw amate hong etcik laitak bek hi ngawlin, Topa na thasia uh hu in, thin tak taw a thu ni vun.","ref":"Eph 6:5-8"},"23":{"text":"Na nasep uh theampo sungah mihing atu hi ngawlin Topa atu a seam bangin kingaisunin na thin theampo taw naseam vun."},"24":{"text":"Topa in ama ii mite atu a khealsia thamante note hong pia tu hi ci in na phawk tavun. Banghang ziam cile na Topa tatakin Christ ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaciangin ngamtat khialna a nei theampo sia a khialna bangin thuak tu hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian in mihing sim a kibangin thukhen tu hi.","ref":"Thkna 10:17; Eph 6:9"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"To ahite awng, na sila te tungah dikna le thutang taw na ngamta vun. Vantung ah note zongh in Topa khat na nei uh hunlam phawk tavun.","ref":"Eph 6:9"},"2":{"text":"Thu na ngen tawntung nanak vun. Thu na nget uh ciang na pilvang vun a, Pathian tungah lungdam na ko vun.","title":"Kihilnate"},"3":{"text":"Ko atu zongh hong ngetsak tavun, tua hile Pathian in Christ ii thukute huvau ka hil natu hunpha hong pia tu hi. Banghang ziam cile tua thu in tu laitak a, thongsung a ka omna thu ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom tua thu a thiang a, ka son tu bangin ka son thei natu in thu na ngetsak vun."},"5":{"text":"Thu um ngawlte tung na ngamtatna uh ah ciimna na zangh vun a, hunpha na nga uh theampo a pha takin na zangh vun.","ref":"Eph 5:16; 4:7; Sawl 20:4; 2 Tim 4:12"},"6":{"text":"Na kampau na uh sia a zaak nop huai hi tu a, a lawp huai hi tawntung tu hi, tuaciangin mihing khat sim tungah a maanin na zo kik thei tavun."},"7":{"text":"Ih it ih suapuipa Tychicus, a thumaan naseampa le Topa nasepna sungah ih naseppui pa in kei huvau thupiang thakte hong son siat tu hi.","title":"A khakbel Paupuina","ref":"Eph 6:21-22"},"8":{"text":"Note kungah ama kong paisakna in tua thu hang ahi hi, kote bangbangin om ka hi uh hunlam hong son ciangin na thin uh a nop natu ka deina ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in Onesimus a kici khat taw hong ton hi, tua pa in a thumaan suapui hi a, no pawl sungah hong kihel khat ahi hi. Amate nii in hi sungah thupiang theampo hong son tu hi.","ref":"Phm 10-12"},"10":{"text":"Kei taw thong sungah a om Aristarchus in hong paupui hi, tuasia bangma Barnabas suapuisealpa Mark zongh in hong paupui hi. (Mark sia no sangah hong pai ahile vai na muak vun ci in sawlna zongh nga zo nu hi)","ref":"Sawl 19:29; 27:2; Phm 24; Sawl 12:12-25; 13:13; 15:37-39"},"11":{"text":"Justus zongh a kici Joshua zongh in paupuina kam hong thaak hi. Hite thum in Jew te sung pan hong kikhealte hi a Pathian ngam atu kei taw na a seam khawmte hi a, amate in nasia takin hong hute ahi uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Epaphras zongh in hong paupui hi, ama in Jesus Christ ii naseampa khat hi a noma pawl sungah a kihel khat ahi hi. Ama in Pathian tungah note sia a khanthin le a cingtaak tak a, a thinzo Tapidawte, Pathian ii deina bang a, khuangkhim takin a zuite bangin kho takin, na din natu in nasia tatakin thu hong ngetsak tawntung hi.","ref":"Col 1:7; Phm 23"},"13":{"text":"No atu le Laodicea le Hierapolis ah a om mihingte atu in nasia takin na a seampa hi ci in keima tatak ma in tetti ka pang hi."},"14":{"text":"Ih it syavuan Luke le Demas in paupuina kam hong thaak hi.","ref":"2 Tim 4:11; Phm 24; 2 Tim 4:10; Phm 24"},"15":{"text":"Laodicea khua ah a om ih suapuite le Nympha le tua nu inn ah a kikhawm pawlpi tungah thupha ka deisaknate na sonsak vun."},"16":{"text":"Hi laithak na sim zawk uh ciangin Laodicea pawlpite zongh in na simsak hamtang vun. Laodicea khua a om ih suapuite hong puak tu lai sia zongh na sim vun."},"17":{"text":"Tuaciangin Archippus munah, “Topa nasepna sungah, na sep tu hong kipiate na zaw thei natu na son in,” na cisak vun.","ref":"Phm 2"},"18":{"text":"Paul ii hong paupuina ci in hi lai, keima khut vateak taw ma kong at hi. Koltaang ka hi hong mangil heak vun! Pathian ii thuthiamna in no taw hong om tahen."}}}}},"52":{"info":{"name":"1 Thessalonicate","shortname":"1Thess","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Silas le Timothy kung pan — Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ ii neisa ahi Thessalonica pawlpi mite tungah: Thuthiamna le kilemna sia no aa hi tahen.","ref":"Sawl 17:1"},"2":{"text":"Note theampo atu in Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko tawntung a, tuaciang thungetna sungah na min kong lo tawntung uh hi.","title":"Thessalonica te Nuntakna le Upna"},"3":{"text":"Upna na zakzia uh, itna na nei uh hu a, nasia takin na nasepna zia le ih Topa Jesus Christ sungah na lametna uh a kipzia sia ih Pa Pathian mai ah kong phawk uh hang ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ko ii suapuite awng, Pathian in note hong it a, ama atu in hong tealsa na hi uh sia ka he uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Lungdamna Thupha sia, kammal nguak taw hi ngawlin, vaangletna le Thaa Thiangtho taw zongh le a thumaan thutak saan tatakna taw no kungah kong puak uh hi. Note taw ka om uh lai in bangbangin nungta khu ziam ci in nong he uh hi; tuate in noma ii phat natu ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Koma le Topa ettee in nong zui uh hi; nasia takin thuak na hi ta uh zong, Thaa Thiangtho kung pan hong pai tua thu sia lungdamna taw na saang zo uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 17:5-9"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom note sia Macedonia le Achaia ah thu umte theampo atu in ettee tu khat na suak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Bangbang ziam cile Topa thu in no tung pan Macedonia le Achaia kaantan in pai a, tua bek dom ngawlin, Pathian na upna uh thu sia mun theampo ah thang hi. Tua ahikom thudang bangma ka son tuan tu kisamh ngawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua mihing theampo in kong haw uh lai a, nong saan zia uh, milim biakna pan Pathian sangah na kikhealna uhte son tek a, a maan le a nungta Pathian atu sepsak tu le,"},"10":{"text":"hong tung tu Pathian thin uukna pan hong suatak, ama ii thina pan a thawsak, vantung pan hong pai tu — ama Tapa Jesus ngak tu in na om uh thute son hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ko ii suapuite awng, no kung kong hawna uh sia, nguaksuak ngawl hi ci in noma mama ii na heak uh ahi hi.","title":"Thessalonica khua ah Paul Nasep"},"2":{"text":"Noma kung Thessalonica ah kong pai uh ma in Philippi ah kote hong kivawtsia zo a, hong kizawnsakzia sia na heak uh ahi hi. Tuaciangin hong langpan tam kale, ama kung pan a hong pai Lungdamna Thupha note tungah kong son natu in, ih Pathian in thinletna hong pia hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:19-24; 17:1-9"},"3":{"text":"Note tungah kong maangkaana uh sia khialna ahibuale a thiangtho ngawl niimnate tungah kibulphu ngawl hi, khat po theam tu zongh ka hanciam bua uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuate luangin Pathian in pau a hong dei bangin ka pau tawntung uh hi, banghang ziam cile Lungdamna Thupha son tu in kote kiphu hi ci in ama in khensat hi. Mihingte diksak tu in ka hanciam bua uh hi, ahihang ka niimna uh hong sittel Pathian diksak tu in ka hanciam uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Note kungah kong pai uh lai in, kisialpokna kampauna taw kong pai bua uh a, duhopna a phualseal natu kammalte kong zangh bua uh hi. Tuabang ka hi uh sia noma in nong he mama uh hi — Pathian sia koma tetti ahi hi!"},"6":{"text":"No tung pan hikale, ngualdangte tung pan hikale, kuama tung pan pokna nga tu in ka hanciam bua uh hi,"},"7":{"text":"Christ ii sawltakte ka hina uh taw, ka deina uhte no tung pan kong nget thei uh hi napi, kong ngen bua uh hi. Ahihang note taw ka om uh lai in nu khat ii tate a kep bangin kong khoi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"No kong it hu in Pathian kung pan hong pai Lungdamna Thupha bek hi ngawlin ka nuntakna uh no hong hawm tu in ka kinging uh hi. Note sia ko atu in a ithuai mama na hi uh hi!"},"9":{"text":"Ko ii suapuite awng, ka sep ka dianna uh teng ciamtee nak vak uh te! Pathian tung pan hong pai Lungdamna Thupha no tungah kong hil uh ciangin, no ngim kong piakna uh ahi ngawl natu in, a sun a zanin na ka seam uh hi."},"10":{"text":"No thu umte tungah ka ngamtatna uh sia thiangtho, maan, khialna om ngawl ahi hunlam note in ka tetti te na hi uh a, Pathian zongh ka tetti uh ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Pa ii tate tung, a vawt tu bangin note khat sim tungah kong vawt uh sia na he uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama Ngam le a minthanna hong hawm tu in hong sam Pathian ii diksak nuntakna a nei tu in, kong hanthawn a, kong heeneam a, kong thawn top uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaciangin, Pathian tungah a tawntung lungdam ka kona uh ahang khat zongh om hi. Pathian thu kong puak uh lai in, mihing ii thupuak bang hi ngawlin Pathian thupuak bang ahi takpi sia na za uh a, na saang uh hi. Banghang ziam cile no thu umte sungah Pathian in na hong seam hi."},"14":{"text":"Ko ii suapuite awng, no sungah thupiangte ma Judea ah Pathian ii Pawlpite, tua mun a om Christ Jesus ii neisa mihingte tung zongh ah piang hi. Note in na mipuite ii vawtsiatna na thuak uh bangin, amate zongh Jew te ii vawtsiatna thuak hi,","ref":"Sawl 17:5"},"15":{"text":"tua Jew te in Topa Jesus le kamsaangte thatlum a, ko hong vawtsiate ma ahi uh hi. Amate Pathian atu in bangza in lungkimhuai ngawl tu ziam! A kuama po atu in amate bangza in ngal ciipha ahi ziam!","ref":"Sawl 9:23,29; 13:45,50; 14:2,5,19; 17:5,13; 18:12"},"16":{"text":"Ngupna a piangsak tu thute Gentile te tungah ka hil tu uh ngawngawn khaktan tu in hanciam uh hi. Hi bangin amate ii a paltan tawntung sa mawna theampo pawlcingsak uh hi. Tu in Pathian thin uukna sia amate tungah a khakbel ciangin hong thengsuk zo hi!"},"17":{"text":"Ko ka hi uh le suapuite awng, note taw tawmvei ih kikhen zawkciang — ka ngaisutna uh taw hi ngawlin, pumpi mama taw — bangza in no hong ngai a, kong mu kik natu bangza haksa in hanciam khu ziam!","title":"Amate kungah Paul A Haw kik Nopna"},"18":{"text":"Note kungah kong heak kik nuam uh hi. Keima mama heak kik tu in khatvei bek dom ngawl ka kithoai bul a, ahihang Satan in hong oai bua hi."},"19":{"text":"A huamin ci leang, note sia — ngualdang hi ngawl! — note sia kote lametna, lungdamna le zawna ka nga uh hu in Topa Jesus hong pai ciang, ama mai ah ka kisuantaakna na hi tu uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Note sia kote kiphatsakna le lungdamna tatak na hi tu uh hi!"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A khakbel ciang ka thuak zo nawn bua uh hi. Tua ahikom Athens ah koma nguakin, om tu in ka khensat uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 17:15"},"2":{"text":"Tua lanin, Christ huvau Lungdamna Thupha hil a, Pathian atu ko taw naseam khawm ko ii suapui Timothy kong paisak uh hi. Hong thakhosak tu le, na upna uh sungah hong hu tu in kong paisak uh a,"},"3":{"text":"hi vawtsiatna hu in, kuama na nungtol kik ngawl natu ka deina uh ahi hi. Tuabang vawtsiatna in Pathian ii ei atu a deina thu khat om hi ci in, noma ma in na he uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile noma taw ka om nginge laitakin, ko hong kivawtsiat natu te kong sonkhol zo uh hi; tuaciang na heaksa uh bangma in, tuabang tatak ma in hong piang hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuasia hu in Timothy kong paisak kul hi. Vei zo nawn ngawl ka hikomin na upna uh dawp tu in ama kong paisak hi. Doaimangpa in no hong ze et zo a, ko nasep teng a luithawthong hi zo ci sia suak thei mama ngawl tu hi!"},"6":{"text":"Tu in Timothy hong heak kik zo a, tuaciangin ama na upna uh le, na itna uh taw kisai ka ngalaak uh thu, hong puak hi. Ama in kote tung hong sonna pan, a pha in nong ngaisut tawntung na uh le, ko ii kong mu nop uh bangma no zongh in nong mu nopna thu ahi hi.","ref":"Sawl 18:5"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka ngimna uh le ka thuakna theampo sungah, note ii thu in thin letna hong pia hi, suapuite awng. Ko hong thinliansak sia in noma upna ahi hi,"},"8":{"text":"banghang ziam cile tu in na nuntakna sungah Topa taw pum khat a, a kho in na ding uh le a nungta takpite ih hi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu in note atu in Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko thei zo uh hi. Note hangin ama mai ah lungnopna ka nei uh hu in Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Maitang kisi a, kimu thei natu le na upna uh sungah a kisamh sia hong piak thei natu a sun a zanin, ka thin theampo taw thu ka ngen uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ih Pa Pathian mama le ih Topa Jesus in no kungah kong pai thei natu in lampi hong sialsak tahen!"},"12":{"text":"Khat le khat na ki itna uh le mihing theampo na itna sungah khangto vaialin, noma kong itna a lian za ma in na ki it natu uh, Topa in hong siam tahen."},"13":{"text":"Hi bangin ama in no hong thahatsak tu a, ama ii neisa mihing theampo taw Topa Jesus hong pai ciang, ih Pa Pathian omna ah sit baang ngawlin na thiangtho tu uh hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A khakbelin suapuite awng, Pathian ii diksak nuntakzia sia, ko tung panin na sin sa uh ahi hi. Hisia in note nuntakzia sia ma ahi hi. Tu in tua sang zong a nasia zaw in na nuntak natu uh Topa Jesus min taw kong ngen uh a, kong thawn uh hi.","title":"Pathian ii Dik a sak Nuntakzia"},"2":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Topa Jesus thuneina taw hilna kong piakte na he uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Pathian in note thiangtho in, numei le pa paktatna pan a thiangtho tak a, a kipealte na hi tu uh hong dei hi."},"4":{"text":"No pasalte khat sim in, na zi uh taw a thiangtho le a thasiahuai in nuntakzia tu na heak uh kul hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian a he ngawlte bangin cii le sa deina taw na nungta heak vun."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom hi thu tungtaang ah, kuama in ama ii Tapidawpuipa tungah khial ngawl tu a, hamphatna in la thei ngawl tu hi. Hi thu kong son ngei zo uh a, tuabang a ngamtate Topa in daan pia tu hi, ci in nasia takin kidop natu kong son zo uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Pathian in eite sia paktatna taw nungta ngawlin a thiangtho nuntakna taw a nungta zaw tu in hong sam hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom, hi kihilna a nial pawpo sia mihing nial ahi bua a, a Thaa Thiangtho no tungah hong pia Pathian nial ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Noma thu up puite itna tu huvau lai at tu kul ka sa bua uh hi. Khat le khat na ki it natu in Pathian in no tung mama ah hong hil zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuaciang a tatak ci leang Macedonia ngam mun theampo ah a om, suapui teng tungah tuabangin na ngamta zo uh hi. Tua ahikom suapuite awng, tu a sangin zongh a kician zaw lai in na ngamta tavun."},"11":{"text":"Kong son ngeisa bangma in, na nuntakna sungah nuam hithiatin na nuntak tu, noma taw kisaite bek ngaisutin nei tu, noma nuntak natu in na thalaw natu uh teng sia tup in na nei vun."},"12":{"text":"Hi bang teng taw in thu um ngawlte ii zatakna na nga tu uh a, tuaciang na kitaangsapna tungtaang ah kuama na konlaw uh a kul buatu hi."},"13":{"text":"Ko ii suapuite awng, lametna a nei ngawlte bangin na khuangai ngawl natu in, a thisate huvau thumaan thutak na heak tu uh ka dei uh hi.","title":"Topa hong Pai natu"},"14":{"text":"Jesus thi a, tho kik hi, ci in ih um hi, tua ahikom ama um a, a thite sia Pathian in Jesus taw hong la kik tu hi, ci in ih um hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu a kong hil uh sia in Topa ii hilcianna ahi hi: Topa hong pai ni in, ei a nungta laite in a thisate mai ah ih pai buatu hi.","ref":"1 Cor 15:51-52"},"16":{"text":"Vantunglalangte sung pan a lianbel sia ii aw taw thupiak auna, Pathian lemle aw om tu a, tuaciang Topa ama mama vantung pan hong tuaksuk tu hi. Christ um a, a thite hong tho masabel tu a,"},"17":{"text":"tua hunin a nungta lai eite sia Topa taw vui sungah kisi tu in, amate taw meei sungah hong kikaikhawm tu hi. Tuabangin eite in a tawntungin Topa taw ih omkhawm tu hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom, hi kammalte taw khat le khat na kihanthawn tavun."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Suapuite awng, hi thute hong pianna tu a hun a taang huvau, lai kong at tu uh kul sa ngawl khu hi.","title":"Topa ii Hong Pai tu Na Kinging vun"},"2":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile noma ma in Topa Ni sia, zan lai a, nguta khat hong pai bang in, hong pai tu hi, ci in a pha tak na he uh hi.","ref":"Mt 24:43; Lk 12:39; 2 Pe 3:10"},"3":{"text":"Mihingte in, “Na theampo thim khipkhep hi, lungmuanna om hi,” a ci laitakin thakhat thu in, siatna sia amate tungah hong theng vat tu hi! Nau a suak tu numei khat sia nautun a, a nat bangin thakhatin hong pai tu hi, tuaciang mihingte a suakta buatu uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang suapuite awng, note in khuazing sungah om ngawl nu hi, tua ahikom tua Ni in nguta khat hong pai a, lamdang na sak bang ahi buatu hi."},"5":{"text":"Note theampo in khuavak ii neisa, sun hun ii neisa na hi uh hi. Eite sia zan ii neisa, khuazing sungah a omte ih hi bua hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom ngualdangte bangin ih mutthip buatu hi; eite khangciimin ih pilvang tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Zan sia mihingte mut hun hi; zanin amate zukham uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang eite in sun hun ii neisa ih hi a, ih pilvang kul tu hi. Eite in upna le ki itna sia awmdalna in ih silh tu a, ih lamet ngupna sia thik lukhu bangin ih khuk kul hi.","ref":"Is 59:17; Eph 6:13-17"},"9":{"text":"Pathian in eite sia a thin uukna thuak tu in hong teal bua a, Topa Jesus Christ tungtawnin, ngupna a nga tu in hong teal hi zaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama hong pai ciang, ih thi a ih nung zong, ama taw ih nuntak khop thei natu in eite atu a thi ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahiciang tu laitak a, na sep uh bangma in khat le khat kihanthawnin na kihuu tavun."},"12":{"text":"Suapuite awng, Tapidaw nuntakna sungah lam hong lak, hong hil a, no sungah na hong seamte tungah ahi tu bang zatakna na piak natu in kong ngen uh hi.","title":"A khakbel Hilna le Nuksetna"},"13":{"text":"Amate ii sepna hu in itna le zatakna lianbel taw na kizom tavun. Noma sungah kilemna taw na om tavun."},"14":{"text":"Suapuite awng, hi bangin kong hanthawn uh hi. A zuzaute kidop natu thu na pia vun a, a lauthauhte na hansua vun, a thazawmte na hu vun, a kuama theampo tungah thinsau in na khual vun."},"15":{"text":"Khialna sia khialna taw in na thuk heak vun a, khat le khat tung le mihing theampo tungah phatna vawt tu sia hun theampo sungah na tup na sawm uh na hisak tavun."},"16":{"text":"A tawntungin lungdam vun,"},"17":{"text":"hun theampo sungah thu ngen tawntung vun,"},"18":{"text":"na theampo sungah lungdamko vun. Christ Jesus taw pumkhat a, na nuntak sungah Pathian hong deisak thu in hisia ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Thaa Thiangtho na khaam heak vun;"},"20":{"text":"Pathian tung pan hi a kici kamsaannate sia zawngsak heak vun."},"21":{"text":"Na theampo na sittel vun: a pha teng na keam tavun,"},"22":{"text":"A sia nam theampo na pial tavun."},"23":{"text":"Eite thinnopna hong pia Pathian in note a nanam in hong thiangthosak tahen, na nuntakna buppi - na thaa, na thinsung le na pumpi — hong keam tahen, Topa Jesus Christ hong pai ciangin sepkhial vawtkhial theampo taw hong kipealsak tahen."},"24":{"text":"Hong sampa ama in na hong seam tu hi, banghang ziam cile ama thumaan hi."},"25":{"text":"Suapuite awng, ko atu zongh thu hong ngetsak tavun."},"26":{"text":"Thu um theampo suapui kinapna taw na kimuak tavun."},"27":{"text":"Thu um mi theampo tungah hi laithak na sim natu in Topa thuneina suangin kong thawn hi."},"28":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus Christ ii thuthiamna no tungah hong om tahen."}}}}},"53":{"info":{"name":"2 Thessalonicate","shortname":"2Thess","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul, Silas le Timothy in — Ih Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ neisa Thessalonica pawlpi mite tungah lai kong thaak uh hi:","ref":"Sawl 17:1"},"2":{"text":"Ih Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ in note tungah thuthiamna le thinnopna hong pia tahen."},"3":{"text":"Suapuite awng, note atu in hun theampo ah Pathian ka pok uh kul hi. Tuabang ka ngamtat tu uh sia maan hi, banghang ziam cile na upna uh nasia khan mama a, tuaciang note khat sim ii midangte na itna uh lian vaial hi.","title":"Christ hong Pai kik hun Thukhenna"},"4":{"text":"Pathian ii pawlpite sungah no huvau ka kisuantaakna uh sia in hi thu hang ahi hi. Vawtsiatna le ngimna teng theampo na thuak uh kawm panin, thuak zawkna le upna na nei tan uh hu in a kisuangtaak ka hi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu a na thuakna teng in Pathian thukhen na sia thumaan a hina kilanghsak hi, tua in noma ii na ngimlaw uh ama Kumpi Ngam taw a kilawm hong suaksak tu hi,"},"6":{"text":"Pathian in a maan bangin seam tu hi: note hong thuaksakte tungah thuakna tungsak tu a,"},"7":{"text":"tuaciang no a thuakte le ko zongh nopsakna hong pia tu hi. Topa Jesus in ama ii a thahat vantunglalangte taw"},"8":{"text":"Pathian a nialte le Topa Jesus Lungdamna Thupha a zui nuam ngawlte daan pia tu in meikuang taw hong pai ciang ama in tuasia seam tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama ii mihing theampo le a thu um mihingte tung pan minthanna le vaang piakna a nga tu in, tua Ni Topa hong pai ciang, Topa mai le vaanglet minthan na pan amate kikhen tu a, tawntung lalcipna daan thuak tu hi. Note zongh, ko ii kong son thute um zo na hi uh ciangin tua thu um te sungah na kihel tu uh hi.","ref":"Is 2:10","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Note atu in a tawntungin thu kong ngetsakna in hi thu hang ahi hi. A nungta tu in ama hong sap na nuntakna sungah a kiphu a kilawm hong suasak natu in, Pathian munah kong ngetsak uh hi. Ama in a vaangletna taw phat natu na deina theampo khuangkhimsak tahen a, upna taw nasepna hong taangtungsak tahen."},"12":{"text":"Hi bangin ih Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ ii thuthiamna taw ih Topa Jesus min in, note tung pan minthanna saang tu a, note zongh in ama tung pan minthanna na saang tu uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus Christ hong pai kik natu le ama taw omkhawm tu in, ih kikhoptuana thu taw kizomin: suapuite awng,","title":"A Seksol Pa","ref":"1 Th 4:15-17"},"2":{"text":"Topa hong pai tu Ni sia hong tung zo hi ci in a kison thu taw na khua ngaisutna uh nawngkaisak heak vun a, na thin kiamsak memeang heak vun ci in kong thuum uh hi. Hi thu sia kote kamsaanna sung, ahibuale thuhilna sung, tua ahibuale laithak atna sungah kote in son hi ci in kingaisun hi thei tha tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Bangbang po ahizong kuama in na theamsak heak vun. Banghang ziam cile a khakbel Kileedona, hong om a, hell sung a theng tu in a kisep sa A Seksolpa hong kilangh mateng in tua Ni sia hong tung ngawl tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama in pathian a kici theampo ahibuale biak thei theampo langpan tu a, tuate tungsia ah ama le ama kikoi tu hi. Ama in Pathian Biakinnpi sung ngawngawn ah tum in to tu a, Pathian ka hi hi ci tu hi.","ref":"Dan 11:36; Eze 28:2"},"5":{"text":"Ciamtee ngawl nu ziam? Hite sia no taw ka omkhop lai in kong sonsiat sa ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahitazong, tu laitak hisia a pian ngawl natu in a khak khat om a, tuasia bang ziam na heak uh hi. Tua ahikom a hun a cin ciang A Seksolpa hong kilangh tu hi."},"7":{"text":"A lamdang Seksolna in tu in na hong seam zo hi, ahihang a khaktanpa a kihepkeak matengin a piang tu thu sia piang ngawl lai tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciangin A Seksolpa sia hong kilaak tu a, ahihang Topa Jesus hong pai ciang, a kam sung pan a huu pusuak sia taw ama that tu a, a taang velvol a vaangletna taw lalcipsak tu hi.","ref":"Is 11:4"},"9":{"text":"A Seksolpa sia Satan vaangletna taw hong pai tu a, nalamdang lakna a theam le a lamdang na nam tuatuamte hong vawt tu hi,","ref":"Mt 24:24"},"10":{"text":"tuaciangin a lal tu teng tungah a seksol theamna namcin zangh tu hi. Amate lal tu hi, banghang ziam cile amate a kihutna tu thumaan thutak sia a saang bua uh a, a it bua uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom Pathian in telkhialna vaang ama te sungah puak a, amate in a maan ngawl thute a up natu in na seamsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikomin, tua thumaan thutak a um ngawl, mawna sungah a nuamsa theampo, kipuavawk tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa hong it suapuite awng, note atu in Pathian tungah a tawntungin lungdam ka ko hamtang tu uh hi. Banghang ziam cile Thaa ii vaangletna taw ama mi thiangthote hong suasak natu le thumaan thutak na upna uh taw a kingum phitbelte na sua natu uh in Pathian ii tealte na hi uh hi.","title":"Note Ngupna nga tu hong Kiteal"},"14":{"text":"Lungdamna Thupha no tungah kong hilna uh tungtawnin Pathian in hisia atu hong sam hi; Ama in ih Topa Jesus Christ minthanna tel na nga natu hong sam ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom suapuite awng, thuhilna le laithakna taw kong hil uh thumaante kholet vun a, kip takin ding vun."},"16":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus Christ ama mama le eite hong it a, a thuthiamna taw a kiam ngeingawl thinletna le lametna kho hong pia, ih Pa Pathian in,"},"17":{"text":"a tawntungin a pha sep natu le pau natu hong hanthawn in hong thahat sak tahen."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A khakbel in suapuite awng, Topa thu sia note sungah na saan bangma in, manlang takin a kizel natu le thasiana taw a kisaan thei tawntung natu in, kote atu thu hong ngetsak tavun.","title":"Thu hong Ngetsak tavun"},"2":{"text":"Mihing seksolte le misiate khut sung pan Pathian ii hong suataksak natu in thu hong ngetsak si tavun; banghang ziam cile mihing simin tua thu um ngawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang Topa sia thumaan a, ama in note A Ngilopa kung pan hong keamcingin hong thahatsak tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Note kungah kong son thute na zui uh bangma in zui paisuak tatak tu ci in note muanna thin kote sungah Topa in hong pia hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian hong itna le Christ ii hong piak thuak zawkna a thukzaw in na tel thei natu Topa in lam hong pui tahen."},"6":{"text":"Suapuite awng, kong lamlak nate zui ngawl a, datham nuntakzia taw a nungta suapuite theampo kung panin na kikeam tavun ci in Topa Jesus Christ min taw thu kong pia uh hi.","title":"Nasep tu Vaipuak"},"7":{"text":"Ko ngamtat bang na ngamtat tu uh sia noma ma in na heak uh ahi hi. Note taw ka om uh lai in ko datham ngawl khu hi."},"8":{"text":"Man piak ngawlin kuama tung pan huna saang ngawl khu hi. Tua taangin naseam a, diang khu hi; note khat po atu in supna zanna ka hi ngawl natu in a sun a zanin ka seam tan uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi bangin ka hi uh sia, ngual ii hu tu le et tu in, a kilawm ngawl ka hi uh hang, ahi bua hi; nong ettee tu le nong zui tu in tuabangin ngamta ka hi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"No taw ih om lai in, “Na a seam nuam ngawl peuma an nesak ngawl tu hi,” kong ci uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Hi bangin kong ci theina uh sia, no sungah mihing pawlkhat datham a, ngual nasepna kamkumh in, nawngkaisak tu ci simngawl sep dang nei ngawl ci in ka za uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Topa Jesus Christ min taw hi mihingte tungah ahi tu bangin nungta tahen a, nasepna taw a nuntak natu thalaw tahen, ci in kidop natu thu ka pia uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang suapuite awng, a pha sepna sia cimtak peuma heak vun."},"14":{"text":"Hi laithak sungah kong son uh thute a zui ngawl tu khat po om tha tu hi. Tuabang ahile, ama sia ciamtee tavun a, na koithong lel vun, tua hile, ama a maizum tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahihang ama na ngal vawt heak vun; tua hi ngawl zaw in, suapui khat bangin a kidop thei natu na hil vun."},"16":{"text":"Eite thinnopna ii naak ahi Topa ama mama in, a tawntung le a nanam in, thinnopna hong pia tahen. Topa in note theampo taw hong omkhawm tahen.","title":"A khakbel Kammalte"},"17":{"text":"Paul in kong paupui hi ci in lai kong thaak sia keima khut tatak taw ka at hi: Laithak ka at sim ka minthuna sia hisia ahi hi; lai ka atzia hi bang ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus thuthiamna in note theampo taw hong om tahen."}}}}},"54":{"info":{"name":"Timothy khatna","shortname":"1Tim","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus Christ sawltak khat ahi Paul in, eite hong Ngumpa Pathian le eite lametna Jesus Christ thupiak na bangin —"},"2":{"text":"Upna sungah ka tapa tatak ahi Timothy tungah lai kong thaak hi: Pa Pathian le ih Topa Jesus Christ in, thuthiamna, hesuakna le thinnopna nang hong pia tahen.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"3":{"text":"Macedonia ah ka pai lai, kong sawl sa bangma in Ephesus ah na taam tu kong deisak hi. Tua munah mihing pawlkhat in a maan ngawl upna thubulte hil hi, amate tuabang hilna pan a tawp natu in, thu na pia in.","title":"Kihilna Maan ngawlte pan Kidop natu"},"4":{"text":"Kinialna bek a piangsak taanghthute le taanghpupite khang tepteena saute a vawk natu in na son in; tuate in upna taw a kihe Pathian ngealna taangtut natu in kizangh ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi thupiakna ii tupna sia, lungtang thiangtho, thinsung thiangtho le upna tatak panin hong piang ki itna a khanto thei natu deina hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhat in hite panin lampial in a mawmawthuai kam kikupnate sungah ngammang uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate in Pathian thukham hil syate suak nuam ahihang, amate kammal tatak ma ahizong, kimuan tatakna taw a son uh thute ahizong a tel bua uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A kizak tu bangin a kizangh nale Thukham sia pha hi ci in ih he hi."},"9":{"text":"Ih phawk tu a kul thu sia, thukhamte sia mihing phate atu a kivawt hi ngawlin, thukham paltante le khialna lian vawtte, pathian selte le a mawte, biakna kin ngawl le thaa mi ahi ngawlte, pate nute a thatlumte, mihing thatte,"},"10":{"text":"numei le pa huvau a paktatte, numei le pa ngeina ngawlin a ngamtate, mihing a mante, leilotin thumaan ngawl tetti a pangte tua ahibuale a pha a kho upna thubul taw a kileebulin ngamtatna a neite atu in a kivawt ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuabang hilcianna sia ka thansak tu in hong ki aap lungdamna thu sungah kimu a, tua Lungdamna Thupha sia a minthang thupha toai Pathian kung pan hong pai ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka nasep natu in thahatna hong pia Jesus Christ ih Topa tungah lungdam ka ko hi. Ama ii na seam tu in kilawm hong sakna le nasep hong piak hu in, ama tungah ka lungdam hi,","title":"Pathian ii Hesuakna hu in Lungdamkona"},"13":{"text":"ahihang hun bosa sungah ama ngensia in, vawtsia in lang zazaan ngei hi kaleng, upna ka nei ma, heakna nei ngawlin ngamta ka hikom Pathian in kei hong hesuak hi.","ref":"Sawl 8:3; 9:4-5"},"14":{"text":"Tuaciangin ih Topa in a thuthiamna a kicing takin hong buak a, Jesus Christ taw pumkhat hina sungah eite neisa ahi upna le ki itna kei tungah hong pia hi."},"15":{"text":"Jesus Christ in mawneite hun tu in leitung ah hong pai hi: ci sia thumaan hi a, a cing takin up tu le saan tu ahi hi. Tua a mawte sung pan keima in a mawbelpa ka hi hi,"},"16":{"text":"ahihang nungsang ciangin ama umin tawntung nuntakna a saang tute ii a ettee tu in, kei a mawbelpa tungah Jesus Christ in thinsauna a cingin hong lak thei natu, Pathian in kei hong hesuak hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama bek Pathian ahi a thi thei ngawl, a kimu thei ngawl Tawntung Kumpipa tungah patoaina le minthanna a tawntung a tawntungin om tahen! Amen."},"18":{"text":"Ka ta Timothy awng, nangma huvau a hun bosa sungah kamsaan sonkholna a om bangin, hi thupiakna sia na khut sungah muangin kong aap hi. Ngal pha tak na sim thei natu in tua kammalte ngalhiam in zangh in a,"},"19":{"text":"na upna kholet in, thinsung thiangtho na nei ta'n. Mihing pawlkhat a thinsung uh pan a phaw thute ngai ngawlin a upna uh lalsak uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Satan vaangletna nuai ah aapna taw daan ka piaksate sungah Hymenaeus le Alexander te kihel uh hi; Pathian min a daisak nawn ngawl natu in hi thu in amate hil tu hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuaciang a masa phitbel kong hanthot nopna panin, maangkaana, thungetna, hu ngetna le lungdamkona sia mihing theampo atu Pathian tungah na vawt vun;","title":"Pawlpi Biakpiakna"},"2":{"text":"eite nuam takin kilem vadiam in om thei a, Pathian thasia in a kilawm ngamtatna taw ih nuntak thei natu in kumpite le a dang thu nei uliante atu zongh tuabangin na vawtsak natu kong thawn hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi bangin a pha ih vawtte in Pathian ih Ngumpa lungkimsak hi,"},"4":{"text":"mihing khat sim ngupna nga a, thumaan thutak a heak tu sia Pathian in dei hi."},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian khat bek om a, Pathian le mihing hong kilemsak kik, mihing ahi Jesus Christ khat bek om hi."},"6":{"text":"Ama in mihing nam theampo tat natu in, a nuntakna pia hi. Tua in a hun a cin ciang Pathian ii mihing khat sim ngupna a piak nopna thu a lakna hi a,"},"7":{"text":"tua thu hu in upna le thumaan thutak thangsak tu in, Gentile te ii sawltak khat le sya khat bangin hong kipuak hi. A leilot ka hi bua a; thumaan thutak son ka hi hi!","ref":"2 Tim 1:11"},"8":{"text":"Pawlpi sungah biakpiak simin, thin uukna le kinialna om ngawlin, a khut laamin thungen thei a, Pathian tungah a kipumpiak pasalte ii thu a nget tu ka dei hi."},"9":{"text":"Numeite zongh a kiniamkhiak ngamtatna le puansilh kizepna ah a etlawm, a hoi ciaciangin khua ngaisutna a nei tu ka dei hi; sam khawng a lamdadang in vawtna taw ahizong, khamhte, keptangte le a manham nikteen puansilhte taw ahizong kizeam ngawlin,","ref":"1 Pe 3:3"},"10":{"text":"biakna kin numeite atu taw a kilawm ngamtat phate taw om tahen."},"11":{"text":"Numeite in thim khipkhep in om thei in, kiniam khiakna theampo sin tahen."},"12":{"text":"Amate in pasalte tungah a hilcian tu ahizong, thu a nei natu ahizong, ka oai bua hi; amate thim khipkhep in om tahen."},"13":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Adam kibitphua masa a, tua zawkciang Eve kibitphua hi.","ref":"Pian 2:7,21-22"},"14":{"text":"Tuaciangin theam a thuak sia in Adam hi ngawl hi; theam thuak a, Pathian thukham a paltan sia in numei ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 3:1-6"},"15":{"text":"Ahihang, ama in upna, ki itna le thianthona sungah omdan thiamna taw zom suak pole numei sia ta a neina tungtawnin kingum tu hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A maan kam teptee khat sia: Pasal khat in pawlpi lampui khat hi tu a uuk le, ama in nasep pha mama khat lungngul ahi hi.","title":"Pawlpi sung Lampuite"},"2":{"text":"Pawlpi lampuipa khat in sit baanna nei ngawl ahi tu kisamh hi; ama in zi khat bek a nei, thinpha a nei, ama le ama a ki uk zo, a cilngil ahi kul hi; zindo thiam, ngual a hil thei ahi tu kisamh hi.","ref":"Tit 1:6-9"},"3":{"text":"Ama sia zukham thei le a ngoltol hi ngawl het tu a, cinghin ngual taw kilem thei tu hi; ama in sum bek ngaisun ngawl het tu hi;"},"4":{"text":"ama in a bangkua sung pha takin uk thei tu a, a tate in zatakna takpi taw a thu a nitsak thei tu kisamh hi."},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile pasal khat in ama ii bangkua a uk natu zia a he buale Pathian ii pawlpi bangbangin keam thei tu ziam?"},"6":{"text":"Ama in kiphatsakna taw a kidim Doaimangpa bangin pua vawkna a thuak ngawl natu in, upna sungah a khanthin sa khat hi tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama in mindai in Doaimangpa thaang sungah a awk thak ngawl natu in, pawlpi puasia a om mihingte ii zatak khat hi tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Pawlpi upate zongh ngamtat pha nei tu a, a citakte ahi tu kisamh hi; amate in sapittui tam lei ne ngawl tu a, sum lam sangah duhop ngawl het tu hi;","title":"Pawlpi sung Upate"},"9":{"text":"amate in upna thumaan a kipualaakte thinsung thiangtho taw kholet tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Amate kisinsak phot tu a, a kisinna a ong le seam tak tu hi."},"11":{"text":"A zite uh zongh, ngamtat pha nei tu a, ngual ngen ngawl tu hi; amate in na theampo sungah thutuumin thumaan tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Pawlpi upa khat in zi khat bek nei tu a, a tate le a bangkua sia pha takin uk zo tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Pawlpi upa nasep pha takin a seamte in amate atu dinmun pha khat nga hi a, Jesus Christ sungah a upna hangsan takin son ngam tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Hi lai kong at laitakin no kungah hong pai in hong mu pal tu, ci in lametna ka nei hi.","title":"A lian Thuku"},"15":{"text":"Ahihang kong hai tha le hi laithakin a nungta Pathian ii pawlpi, thumaan thutak ii dinna le a panpui ahi Pathian bangkua sungah ih ngamtat natu hong hesak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Eite biakna in a lian thuku khat a hina sia kuama in, a nial thei buatu hi: Ama sia mihing mealin hong kilangh a, Thumaan hi ci in Thaa in lakin, vantunglalangte in mu hi. Ama sia minamte sungah a thu kihil a, leitung theampo in ama umin, tuaciang vantung ah ama kila to hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thaa in thiangtho takin a sonna pan hun khaksang ciangin, mihing pawlkhat in a upna uh nusia tu hi; amate in, leilot thaa te thu ni tu a, doaite hilna zui tu hi ci hi.","title":"Sya Maan ngawlte"},"2":{"text":"Tuabang hilciannate sia leilot theite in theamna taw kizelsak hi, amate thinsung sia thiksa taw hal bangin thi hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuabang mihingte in zi nei ngawl pasal nei ngawlin omna le an pawlkhat neakna in khialna hi ci in hil hi. Ahihang thumaan thutak a hete le a umte in lungdamkona thungetna taw a neak tu in, tua ante sia Pathian piansak ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Pathian bitphua sa nate theampo pha hi; bangma nil tu vawk tu om ngawl hi, ahihang na theampo lungdamko thungetna taw saan tu ahi hi,"},"5":{"text":"banghang ziam cile tuasia Pathian kammal le thungetna in Pathian ii saan thei suaksak hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma in thaa thu ah upna kammalte taw kivaak a, thuhilna maan na zui kawmin, hi kong hilnate suapuite sungah na son nale nangma in Jesus Christ ii naseam pha khat na hi tu hi.","title":"Jesus Christ ii Naseam Pha khat"},"7":{"text":"Ahihang a son thamman ngawl, Pathian ii thu taw a kisi ngawl phua tawm taanghthute pan na kikeam ta'n. Pathian dei bang na nuntak zawk natu in kisinna nei ta'n."},"8":{"text":"Pumpi thasaalin kisinna in phatna pawlkhat nei hi, ahihang thaa thu ah kisinna in, tu hun le maisang hun atu nuntakna ahikom manpha zaw pek lai hi."},"9":{"text":"Hi thu in thumaan kam teptee khat hi a, up tu le a cing tak saan tu thumaan thutak ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihing theampo le, a tuan in a umte a Ngumpa, a nungta Pathian sungah lametna ih nei hu in eite in nasia takin hanciam a, na ih seam hi."},"11":{"text":"Hi lamlaknate le hilnate amate tungah sonsawn in."},"12":{"text":"Khangmoi na hi hu in, kuama in na zawngsaksak heak in a, ahihang na pauna, na ngamtatna, na itna, upna le thiangthona sungah, thu umte ii ettee tu hi ta'n."},"13":{"text":"Kong pai mateng in, na hun le na hanciamnate mihonpite tungah Laithiangtho simna, thuhilna le hilna in, na zangh in."},"14":{"text":"Na sungah a om Thaa thiangtho telte na ngaingon heak in, tuate sia kamsaangte in pau a, pawlpi upate in na tungah khut hong ngak uh ciangin na nga uh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Hite, na kisisin ta'n a, nangma le nangma tuate atu in kipia ta'n, tua hile na khantona ngual theampo in hong mu tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma le nangma ki en in a, na hilna zongh en in a, kidawm in. Hi bang na vawtte zom to ta'n; banghang ziam cile tuabangin na vawt le nangma le na thusonna hong za te in ngupna nga tu uh hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasal khanghaam zaw khat sia teih heak vun a, na pa bangin ngaisun in, na thuum zaw vun. Pasal khangmoizawte na suapui bangin vawt vun,","title":"Thu Umte tungah ih Vaipuak"},"2":{"text":"nupi a haamzawte sia na nute uh bang, numei a moizawte sia thinsung thiangtho tak taw na suapuinumeite uh bangin na vawt vun."},"3":{"text":"Amate nguak a, a om takpi meingongte thasia vun."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang meingong khat in ta le tu a nei le, amate in biakna huvau sep tu a neite a innkuan sungah sin phot tahen, tua hile a nute a pate le a pute a pite ii ama tungah a sepnate a thuk kik hi tu hi, banghang ziam cile tua in Pathian diksak thu ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama nguak om a, kuama ama a en tu a nei ngawl meingong khat in, a lametna sia Pathian tungah koi a, sun taw zan taw ama ii hu natu in thungen hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang meingong khat ama le ama cii le sa nopsakna sungah a kidia khat sia nungta napi a thisa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Amate tungah kuama in maw a zon thei ngawl natu in, hi lamlaknate hil sawn in."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang khat pawpo in a mealheakte, a tuanin ama innkuanpuite a en nuam bua uh le ama in upna thu a nial suak a, thu um ngawlte sangin sia zaw lai hi."},"9":{"text":"Meingong khat sia kum sawmluk a vaal bualai nale meingong tepteena lai sungah hel heak vun. Tua bek hi ngawlin tepteena lai sungah a tum thei tute sia khatvei bek pasal a neite,"},"10":{"text":"tuaciangin ngamtat pha nei hi ci in a kisonte: a tate pha takin a khangtosakte, a inn ah zin pha takin a dote, Tapidaw puite tungah a kiniamkhiakte, a ngim nga mi a hute, na pha seam tu in a kipumpiakte a hi tu kisam lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang a khangmoi zaw meingongte sia tua tepteena lai sungah hel heak vun, banghang ziam cile a pumpi deina zui in pasal a nei nop kik ciang, Christ kung panin lampial uh hi,"},"12":{"text":"tuabangin ama tungah kamciam a piak maksak sia a paltanna taw a maw suak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate in inn khat pan inn khat ah vak kawkoai in hunte a luithawthongin bosak uh hi; a siazaw lai thu in, amate in ngual ngen a, mihing theampo nuammawin, a pau tuak ngawl thute pau uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom kei deina ah meingong khangmoite in pasal nei in ta nei a, a bangkua uh en tahen, tua hile ih ngalte in amate siatna a son tu hunpha a nga buatu uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile meingong pawlkhat in Satan nungzui tu in heakkik zo uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahihang Tapidaw numei khat in, a bangkua sungah meingong a om le, pawlpi tungah vanhngit suan ngawlin ama in en tahen, tua hile pawlpi in amate nguak a om meingong tatak teng en thei zaw tu hi."},"17":{"text":"Lampuite bangin na pha tak a seam pawlpi upate, a tuanin thuhilna le laithiangtho hilna nasia tak a seamte, thaman a thuap nii in nga tuak hi ci in ngaisut tu ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, laithiangtho in, “Taang a cil khuital muk tuamsak heak vun,” ci a, “Naseamte in a thaman a nga hamtang tu kilawm hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 25:4; Mt 10:10; Lk 10:7"},"19":{"text":"Pawlpi upa khat a kimawsakna ah, nii ahibuale a tamzaw tetti a om buale, thu in sim heak vun.","ref":"Thkna 17:6; 19:5"},"20":{"text":"Ngualdangte zongh a lau thei natu in a maw a khialte mihonpi mai ah teih in."},"21":{"text":"Na nasep napo kuama nguptuam paihtuam nei ngawlin kong thupiakte na nit natu in Pathian mai, Christ Jesus mai le a thiangtho vantunglalangte mai ah ciliap huai takin kong sawl hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa naseam tu in aapna in mihing khat pawpo tungah na khut nga memeang heak in. Ngualdangte mawna vawtna sungah kihel heak in; nangma le nangma thiangtho takin kikeam in."},"23":{"text":"Na cina thei tawntung ahikomin, na ngilsung an a zaan natu tui bek dawn ngawlin sapittui tawm ne in."},"24":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhatte mawna sia kilangh papai a, a mawna tungtaang ah thu khenna thuak masa pai hi; ahihang a dangte mawna ahile kinungmu pheang hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuabang ma in ngamtat phatnate zongh kilangh pal a, a kilangh lei ngawlte ngawngawn zongh kiseal cip thei ngawl hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kuama in Pathian min le eite hilcianna a sonsiat ngawl natu in, sila ahi theampo in a tote zatakna piak tu kilawm hi, ci in a ngaisut kul hi."},"2":{"text":"Tapidawte nei silate in a tote simmaw heak hen, banghang ziam cile, amate in unau khat ahi uh hi. Tua hi zaw ngawlin amate in a phazaw in na sepsak tahen, banghang ziam cile, phattuamna a ngate sia amate ii a it thu umte ahi hi. Hi thute hilin na hanthawn in."},"3":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus Christ ii thumaan kammalte le ih biakna ii hilna taw a kisi ngawl upna thubul tumdang a hil sia in","title":"A maan ngawl Hilna le A maan Haunate"},"4":{"text":"kiphatsakna taw a kidim hi a, bangma heak a nei bua hi. Ama in a pha ngawl kam kinialna le kihaunate kin a, tuasia in ki eenna, kikamtamna, kiselnona, thusia taw kimuanlaakna,"},"5":{"text":"thumaan thutak nei nawn ngawl a, thinsung maan ngawlte ii kam kinialna te piangsak hi. Amate in biakna sia sumhau thei natu lampi khat in ngaisun uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing khat in a nei pawpo taw a lungkim nale biakna paaina in ama sia sumhau mama pa a suaksak takpi ma ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Hi leitung ah bang ih keng ziam? Bangma ih keng bua hi! Leitung panin bang ih pusuapui thei tu ziam! Bangma ih pusuapui thei buatu hi!"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahiciang eite in anneak le puansilh ih nei le, eite atu in a kicing hi tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang sum a hau nuam mihingte sia ze etna thuakin, a mawmawthuai le siatna a piangsak thei deinate ii thaang sungah awk a siatna le lalna nga uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Sum dei leilamna in siatna namcin ii a naak khat ahi hi. Pawlkhat in sum dei leilam ahikomin, upna pan pialin heena thinngimna tam mama thuak uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian mihing ahi nangma in hite theampo na pial in. Thumaan thutanna, Pathian thu sungah nopsakna, upna, itna, thuak zawkna, ciknate na nei zawk natu hanciam in.","title":"Aituam Lamlakna"},"12":{"text":"Upna tai kidemna sungah na hi thei tawpin tai in a, tuaciang nangma atu in tawntung nuntakna na sungsuam in; banghang ziam cile tetti tam mamate mai ah na upna kho takin na pualaak ciang hi nuntakna ah Pathian in nang hong sam ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Na theampo nuntakna a pia Pathian mai le Pontius Pilate mai ah a upna kho takin, a pualaak Christ Jesus mai ah, nangma thu kong piakna pan","ref":"Jn 18:37"},"14":{"text":"ih Topa Jesus Christ hong kilak kik Ni matengin, nang hong thupiaknate zui in thumaanna taw na keamcing in."},"15":{"text":"Kumpite ii Kumpi, topa te ii Topa, thupha sang Ukpa khat bek ahi Pathian in a hun a tun ciangin ama hong kilanghsak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Ama bek thi maw a; kuama in a nai a neak thei ngawlna khuavak sungah teang hi. Kuama in ama mu ngeingawl a; kuama in ama mu thei ngeingawl tu hi. Ama ii tungah zatakna le tawntung ukzawkna om tahen! Amen."},"17":{"text":"Hi nuntakna sungah a kizangh nate hauna taw a kiphatsak ngawl natu, tuabang a kho ngawl haunate tungah lametna koi ngawlin, ih nopsak natu a, na theampo ngo takin hong pia Pathian tungah lametna koi vun ci in a haute tungah na hil in."},"18":{"text":"Nasep pha te hau a, a pha ngamtatna nei in, a sep natu, ngo takin midangte na a hop nop natu hil in."},"19":{"text":"Tu bangin maisang ah a kip doppha khat a suak tu sumngumte amate atu in a khol tu uh hi. Tua hile amate in nuntakna maan tatak a nei zo hong hi tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Timothy awng, nangma khut sungah muanna taw hong ki aapte pha takin keamcing in. Pawlkhatte ii “Heakna” ci in, a min a vaw khial, a kiihuai kampauna le mawmawt kam kinialnate na pial in."},"21":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile mihing pawlkhatte in tua heakna ka nei uh hi, ci in kisuangtaak uh a, tua hu in a upna lampi bo sua uh hi. Pathian ii thuthiamna in note theampo tungah om tahen."}}}}},"55":{"info":{"name":"Timothy niina","shortname":"2Tim","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Christ Jesus taw kikop a, ih nei hong kikamciam nuntakna a thangsak tu in Pathian ii deina taw a kisawl Christ Jesus sawltakpa Paul in,"},"2":{"text":"Ka it ka tapa Timothy tungah lai kong thaak hi: Ih Pa Pathian le ih Topa Christ Jesus in thuthiamna, hesuakna le thinnopna hong pia tahen.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"3":{"text":"Ka taanghpupite ii sep bangin thinsung thiangtho taw a na ka sepsak Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko hi. Sun taw zan taw ka thungetna sungah nang kong phawk a, ama tungah lungdam ka ko hi.","title":"Lungdamkona le Hanthotna"},"4":{"text":"Na thituite ka phawk a, tua ahikom, ka lungdamna a kicin natu in, nang kong mu nuam mama hi."},"5":{"text":"Na pi Lois le na nu Eunice te zongh ii a nei bang a na nei thintak upna sia ka phawk hi. Nang zongh tuabang ma in nei tu ni hi ci in kong muang tatak hi.","ref":"Sawl 16:1"},"6":{"text":"Hi thu hu in, na tungah khut kong ngak ciang Pathian hong piak tel sia na nuntaksak natu in kong phawksak hi."},"7":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian hong piak Thaa in eite hong lauthauhsak bua hi; tua hizaw ngawlin, a Thaa in vaangletna, itna le eima le eima ki uk zawkna taw hong kidimsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Topa atu tetti panna ah maizum heak in, Christ atu in thongtaakpa kei atu zonghin maizum heak in. Tua hi zaw ngawlin Pathian nasep natu thahatna hong piak bangin, Lungdamna Thupha atu thuakna sungah na kihel in."},"9":{"text":"Ama in ama aituam mihingte ih sua natu in eite hong hun a, hong sam hi; eite ii sepnate hang hi ngawlin, ama tupna le thuthiamna hang ahi hi. Hun kipat ma in ama in Christ Jesus tungtawnin hi thuthiamna hong pia hi,"},"10":{"text":"ahihang tu in ih Hunpa Christ Jesus hong paina tungtawnin tua thu hong kilak hi. Ama in thina vaangletna bosak zo a, tuabangin lungdamna thu tungtawnin thimawk nuntakna hong lak zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Lungdamna Thupha a thangsak tu le a hil tu in, Pathian in sawltak panmun kei hong suanh a,","ref":"1 Tim 2:7"},"12":{"text":"tuaciangin hi thu hu in hite ka thuak hi. Ahihang thinmuanna taw ka kidim nginge lai hi, banghang ziam cile ka uppa ka he a, ama in kei hong muang a hong aapsa teng sia tua Ni dong ama in hong kepcingsak thei tu ci in ka he hi."},"13":{"text":"Thumaan kammal kong hilte na kholet in a, na zui tu etteena in nei in, tuaciangin Christ Jesus taw kikopna sungah, eite aa ahi upna le ki itna sungah na kip in."},"14":{"text":"Ih sungah hong teang Thaa Thiangtho vaangletna tungtawnin, nang tungah, hong kimuang a hong ki aap naphate keamcing in."},"15":{"text":"Phygelus le Hermogenes kihelin, Asia ngammi theampo ii kei hong taisat siat sia na he hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in Onesiphorus innkuan sungah hesuakna tungsak tahen, banghang ziam cile tamvei ma ka thin hong nuamsak hi. Thonginn sungah ka om sia, ama in hong maizumpui ngawl a,"},"17":{"text":"Rome khua a thet po ciangin hong mu dawdong hong zong hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua Ni ciangin Topa in ama tungah hesuakna pia tahen. Ephesus khua ah zongh, kei atu in ama in bangza in hong seam ci sia na heak mama ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa awng, nang na hi le, Jesus Christ taw ih kikopna tungtawnin ih nga thuthiamna hangin thahat in.","title":"Jesus Christ ii Thumaan Ngalkappa"},"2":{"text":"Tetti tam mamate ii mai ah ka thansak hilnate la in, ngualdang a hil sawn thei tu a muanhuaite tungah aap in."},"3":{"text":"Jesus Christ ii a thumaan a ngalkappa bangin ngimna thuak in,"},"4":{"text":"a seam lai ngalkap khat in, a mangpa diksak tu uuk a, khua mi thawthongte ii vai sungah kihel ngawl hi."},"5":{"text":"Tai kidemna sungah a tai khat in ngeina a kikoite a zui buale tel saang thei ngawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Lothopa khat nasep haksa a seam sia in, anlaak ciangin ama ii tel tu in an a tung masabel sia nga tu hi."},"7":{"text":"Kong son teng sia na ngaisusun in, banghang ziam cile Topa in a vekpi in hong tel theisak tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Lungdamna Thupha sungah a kihil, keima thuhilna ahi, thina pan a kitho kiksak David suan ahi Jesus Christ sia na phawk ta'n."},"9":{"text":"Lungdamna Thupha thuhilna in ka nei hu in, ka thuak a, mihing a maw a khialte bangin thikkol taw ngawngawnin hong kikhit hi. Ahihang Pathian kammal sia thikkhau kibul ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Jesus Christ tungtawn a hong pai ngupna le tawntung minthanna sia Pathian tealsa mite zongh in a nga thei natu in, na theampo ka thuak kenkon hi."},"11":{"text":"Hi thu sia thumaan hi: “Ama taw ih thi khawm zo ahile, ama taw ma in ih nungta khawm tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Thuakna ih zom to suak le ama taw ih maangkhawm tu hi. Ama ih nial le, ama zongh in hong nial tu hi.","ref":"Mt 10:33; Lk 12:9"},"13":{"text":"Ih thumaan bua zonghin, ama sia hong thumaan top hi, banghang ziam cile ama le ama kitheam thei ngawl hi.”"},"14":{"text":"Mihingte tungah hi thu phawksak in a, tuaciang kam kinialin a kihau ngawl natu in, Pathian mai ah a ciliap huai kidop natu in hilkhol in. Hite in bangma phat tuamna hong pia ngawl a, a zate atu in siatna piangsak bek hi.","title":"A Kikipsak Naseampa"},"15":{"text":"Pathian muna ah a kicing kikipsakna na nga natu in a phabelin naseam in a, nasep tungtaang ah a maizum natu a om ngawl naseampa bang hi in, Pathian thumaan thute a maan tak a hil theipa na hi in."},"16":{"text":"A kiihuai le a mawmawthuai kam kikupnate pan kikeam in, tuate in mihingte Pathian kung panin kikhualasak bek hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuabang kihilnate in ih sa hong neaksak meima balhte bang ahi hi.
