Tuabang a hil pasal niite sia Hymenaeus le Philetus ahi uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in thumaan lampi nusia in, ih thaw kikna sia hong piang zo hi ci in a hilna uh taw mihing pawlkhatte upna lalsak hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahitazong Pathian ii a phaa sa, a kip tawdap sia kingawksak thei ngawl hi; tuaciang tua tungah hi kammalte ki at hi. “Topa in ama ii neisate he hi,” tuaciang “A kuama po Topa ii neisa ka hi a cite in ngamtat khialna pial tu hi.”","ref":"Mi 16:5"},"20":{"text":"Inn lian khat ii sungah kuang le keau a namcin in om hi: pawlkhat sia ngunn le khamh taw kivawt a, a dangte sia thing le tungman taw kivawt hi, pawlkhatte sia hun thupi sungah zak tu hi a, a dangte sia hun thawthong sungah zak tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Khat po in a siate theampo panin, a kithiangsak le ama sia tupna theampo ah kizangh tu hi, banghang ziam cile ama sia a Topa atu in a kipia a taktaipa hi a, na pha sep natu sung theampo ah a kizangh tu in kinging khol hi."},"22":{"text":"Khangno lungngulnate pialin, tuaciangin thumaan thutang, upna, ki itna, thinnopna sia, thinsung thiangtho taw Topa tungah huna ngen a, a aute taw nga khawm tu in na hanciam in."},"23":{"text":"Ahihang mawmawthuai le telmeal om ngawl kam kinialnate na pial in, tuate sia kihauna taw tawp ahi sia na heak ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Topa ii naseampa in ngual taw kihau ngawl tu hi. Ama in mihing theampo tung a thinneam tu a, a thin uai sya pha hi tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama a langpante a puuaphat kik ciangin, thu khualna zangh tu hi. Banghang ziam cile Pathian in amate tungah kisii kikna pia in thumaan thutak a heak natu zongh hi thei tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tuasia zawkciangin amate sia khuaphawk tu a, ama thu nisak nuamin a manpa Doaimangpa thaang sung panin amate suakta tu uh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni tawpkhak hun ciangin hun haksa hong om tu hi, ci in na ciamtee in.","title":"Ni Tawpkhak Nite"},"2":{"text":"Mihingte sia duhop, kaangsung he, kisathei, kiphasak tu hi; amate in ngual langin, nu le pa thu ni ngawlin, lungdamna he ngawl, biakna nei ngawlin hong om tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Amate sia dikna nei ngawl, hesuakna sel, ngual min siasak, ngoltol, kiitakhuai, a phate ensan,"},"4":{"text":"muan thamman ngawl, lopthop, tuaciangin kisak theina taw kidim tu uh hi. Pathian sangin pumpi nopsakna deizaw tu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amate in ih biakna sia a pua zuunna in nei tu a, ahihang a vaangletna tatak sia nial tu uh hi. Tuabang mihingte kung pan kiheam ta'n."},"6":{"text":"Tuate sung pan pawlkhat sia ngual inn sungah tumin mawna vanhngit a pua, deina ukna tuatuam a nei numei thaneamte,"},"7":{"text":"sin nuam he nuam tawntung leei ahihang thumaan thutak a tel zo ngawl numeite, amate ii upna sangah zo uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Jannes le Jambres in Moses a langpan uh bangma in — hi mihingte in thumaan thutak langpan uh hi. Amate sia a khua ngaisutna uh naseam ngawl a upna sangah a lel ahi uh hi.","ref":"Pu 7:11"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang amate sia mainawt ngawl tu hi, banghang ziam cile mihing theampo in amate mawmawtna hong mu tu a, Jannes le Jambres te ii thuak bangma ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahizong nangma in ka hilna hong zui a ka ngamtatna hong zui in, nuntakna sungah ka tupna nong zui hi. Ka upna, ka thinsauna, ka itna, ka thuak zawkna,","title":"A khakbel Hilnate"},"11":{"text":"hong kivawtsiatna le ka thuak thute theampo nong mu zo hi. Antioch, Iconium le Lystra ah vawtsiatna nasia mama ka thuak sate theampo na he zo hi. Ahihang, Topa in tuate theampo pan hong suatak hi.","ref":"Sawl 13:14-52; 14:1-7,8-20"},"12":{"text":"A kuama po Jesus Christ taw kipawlin, Pathian dei bang nuntakna a nungta nuamte sia kivawtsia tu hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuaciang mihing ngilote le a kimealsealte in, phat ngawlna pan, phat ngawl seseam na ah zuan tu uh a, ngual theamin amate le amate dongin theam thuak tu uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang nang na hile hong kihil sa, kho takin na upna thumaan thutakte na zomto suak in. Na Syate sia a kuate ziam ci in na he hi."},"15":{"text":"Jesus Christ ih upna tungtawnin ngupna thu sungah hong lampui ciimna hong pia thei Lai Thiangtho sia na no ciang a, na heaksa thu ahi hunlam ciamtee ta'n."},"16":{"text":"Laithiangtho sia a vekpi in Pathian hu mop ahi hi. Thumaan thutak hil natu, teih natu, khialna pua natu, a maan a nuntakna tu in hil natu sung theampo ah manpha hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Pathian na a seamte in naphate theampo a vawt natu in, kicinna a cingin a nei thei natu ahi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian mai le Kumpi a hong maang tu in hong pai tu, a thite le a nungtate tungah thukhen tu, Jesus Christ mai ah, ciliap huai takin kong sawl nopna panin,"},"2":{"text":"ngupna thu sia thuhilna in na nei in, (a hun a lem zong, a lem bua zong) upsak natu, teih natu, hanthot natu in thinsauna taw na thansak natu na vawt hamtang in."},"3":{"text":"Mihingte in upna thubul maante hong za nuam nawn buatu a, amate deina uh zui in, bilthak liang a, a zaak nop uh thute a son tu syate tam vaial hong khoptua tu hun hong theng tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Amate in thumaan thute ngaina pan puapial in, phuatawm thute hong ngai nuamzaw tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang nangma le nangma sia hunte theampo sungah na ki uk in; ngimnate na thuak kenkon in, Lungdamna Thupha thuhilpa nasepte naseam in a, Pathian naseampa bangin nasep tu theampo na seam in."},"6":{"text":"Kei ka hile sangaw biakpiak bangin hong kivawt tu hun, hong theng zo hi; kei atu in nuntakna ka nusiat tu hun hong theng hi."},"7":{"text":"Tai kidemna ah ka hi thei tawpin ka hi zo a, ka tai tu tan ka tai zo hi, upna ka keamcing zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu in thumaan thutang thukhenpa, Topa in tua Ni ciangin kei hong piak tu, Pathian mai ah thutang suana zawna thaman in kei hong ngak nginge hi. Kei bek hong pia tu hi ngawl a, ama hong pai kik tu itna taw a ngakte theampo zongh pia tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Kei kungah hai ngawlin nong pai natu in, hong hanciam ta'n.","title":"Aituam Kammalte"},"10":{"text":"Demas in hi leitung it zaw a, kei hong taisan zo hi. Thessalonica hong zot san hi. Crescens sia Galatia zuan hi, tuaciang Titus sia Dalmatia zuan hi.","ref":"Col 4:14; Phm 24; 2 Cor 8:23; Gal 2:3; Tit 1:4"},"11":{"text":"Luke bek kei taw om lai hi. Mark samin hi sungah hong paipui ta'n, banghang ziam cile ama in ka nasep hong hu thei hi.","ref":"Col 4:14; Sawl 12:12,25; 13:13; 15:37-39; Col 4:10; Phm 24"},"12":{"text":"Ephesus ah Tychicus ka paisak hi.","ref":"Sawl 20:4; Eph 6:21-22; Col 4:7-8"},"13":{"text":"Nong pai ciang Troas khua Carpus kungah ka nusiat ka laktong puasilh hong paipui ta'n; laibute zongh hong keng ta'n, savun taw a kivawt sia a tuanin ka dei hi.","ref":"Sawl 20:6"},"14":{"text":"Thik seakpa Alexander in hong nawngkaisak mama hi. Topa in ama ii sepna sa tung pan thaman pia tu hi.","ref":"1 Tim 1:20; Ps 62:12; Rom 2:6"},"15":{"text":"Nang mama zongh ama tungtaang ah na kidawm in, banghang ziam cile ama in ih ngupna thuhilnate nasia takin hong langpan hi."},"16":{"text":"Keima le keima ka kihuuk phitbel lai in, kuama in kei hong dinpui ngawl a hong taisan siat uh hi. Pathian in amate tungah na siik heak hen."},"17":{"text":"Ahitazong Topa sia kei kungah hong om a, thahatna hong pia hi. Tuasia ciangin Gentile te theampo ii a zaak tu in ngupna thu a cing in ka thangsak thei hi; tuaciang kei sia thidaan panin hong suaktasak hi."},"18":{"text":"Topa in kei sia siatna theampo panin, hong suatak tu a, ama Vantung Ngam sungah muanhuai takin hong lato tu hi. Ama tungah vaangletna a tawntung le a tawntungin om tahen. Amen."},"19":{"text":"Priscilla, Aquila le Onesiphorus te innkuan tungah paupuina kong thaak hi.","title":"A khakbel Paupuinate","ref":"Sawl 18:2; 2 Tim 1:16-17"},"20":{"text":"Erastus sia Corinth ah taam hi. Trophimus sia a ciina ahikom Miletus ah ka nusia hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:22; Rom 16:23; Sawl 20:4; 21:29"},"21":{"text":"Phalbi ma in nong pai natu hong hanciam tavun. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus le Claudia te in paupuina hong thaak hi. Tuasia bangma in Tapidaw suapui dangte zongh in hong thaak hi."},"22":{"text":"Topa sia nangma ii thaa taw hong om tahen. Pathian ii thuthiamna sia note theampo taw hong om tahen."}}}}},"56":{"info":{"name":"Titus","shortname":"Titus","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian ii naseampa le Jesus Christ ii sawltakpa, keima Paul in lai kong thaak hi. Kei masia Pathian teal sate upna khantosak natu le, ih biakna ii hil thumaan thutak ah, a lampui tu in hong kiteal a, hong kipuak hi."},"2":{"text":"Tua thumaan thutak sia tawntung nuntakna lametna tungah kiphut hi. A leilot ngawl Pathian in hi nuntakna sia, ei atu in, hun kipat pan ma hong kamciam zo a,"},"3":{"text":"tuaciang a hun hong tun tak ciangin, ama ii hong puak thu sungah hong pualaak hi. Hi thu sia kei hong ki aap a, tuaciang ih Ngumpa Pathian hong thupiakna taw ka thangsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Ih nei khop tek upna sungah ka tapa tatak ahi Titus tungah lai kong at hi. Pathian le ih Hunpa Christ Jesus in, thuthiamna le thinnopna hong pia tahen.","ref":"2 Cor 8:23; Gal 2:3; 2 Tim 4:10"},"5":{"text":"Sep tu a kitaangsamh lai teng, ahi tu bangin a vaihawmsak tu le khuapi simin pawlpi upate na koi thei natu in, Crete ah nang hong nusia ka hi hi. Kong vaithakte na phawk tan:","title":"Crete ah Titus ii Nasepna"},"6":{"text":"pawlpi upa khat sia sitbaang ngawl tu hi; ama in zi khat bek a nei hi tu a, tuaciang, a tate sia thu um mi hi tu hi, a uuk po ngamtate le thu ni ngawlin a minthangte hi ngawl tu hi.","ref":"1 Tim 3:2-7"},"7":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pawlpi lampui khat sia Pathian ii nasepna a uk ahikom, ama sia paubanna nei ngawl tu hi. A ma sia a kihisak, a thintom, zukham thei, a ngoltol, ahibuale sum lamsang a duhop hi ngawl tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in zindo thiam tu a, a phate dei tu hi. Ama le ama ki uk zo tu a, thutangin, thiangtho in, phinciing tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama in up tu thubul taw a kisi, a muan thamman thu sia kho takin len tu hi. Tuabang hile thumaan hilcianna taw ngualdangte hanthawn thei tu a, tuaciang, tua thumaan kihilna a nalhte ii khialna zongh lak thei tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, tuabang mihing tam mama om a, a tuanin Jew biakna sung pan hong kikhealte in, amate ii thu nawnsante taw ngual langpanin theam uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Maizum maw in sum nga nopna bek taw, a kilawm ngawl thute a hilna uh taw, innkuan bubup buaisak ahikom, a thuson ih khaktan kul tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate ii kamsaang khat ahi thumaan a son Crete mipui khat ma in, “Crete mite sia a leilot tawntungte, ngamsa ngilote le a datham antuangte hi,” ci hi. Hi thu hu in, amate nasia takin teih lete amate in a maan upna nei tu hi.","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang Jew te ii phuatawm taanghthute le thumaan thutak a nial mihingte ii thupiakte amate in len nawn ngawl tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Thinsung thiangtho mihingte atu in, na theampo thiangtho hi; ahihang a ninnoite le a um ngawlte atu in, bangma a thiangtho om ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile amate thinsung le a khua ngaisutnate ninnoi hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate in Pathian ka he uh ci ahihang, amate ngamtatnate taw kileebul hi. Amate sia ki etsatna taw kidim a, thu ni ngawl ahiciang a pha khat zongh seam tu in kiphu ngawl hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahihang nang na hile, upna thubul maan taw a kisi thute na hil kul tu hi.","title":"Upna Thubul Maan"},"2":{"text":"Pasal khanghaamzawte sia a kilawm bang ngamtatna nei tu, khuangaisun thei tu, amate le amate ki uk zo tu; a upna uh maan tu, ki itna nei tu, tuaciang thuak zawkna a nei natu uh in na hil in."},"3":{"text":"Tuasia bangma, numei khanghaamzawte a thiangtho nuntakna taw a nungta numeite bangin, a ngamtat natu hil in. Amate sia ngual ngensia theite hi ngawl tu a, sapittui ii sila hi ngawl tu hi. Amate in a pha teng hil thei tu a,"},"4":{"text":"amate sungah numei khangmoizawte in a pasal uh le a tate uh a it natu in hil tu uh hi,"},"5":{"text":"amate le amate a ki uk zo, a thiangtho, tuaciang a pasalte ii thu a ni, bangkua nupi pha ahi thei tu in hil tu nu hi, tua hile Pathian kung pan hong pai thute, kuama in sonsia ngawl tu hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuabang ma in pa khangmoite sia, amate le amate ki uk zawk natu in hanthawn ta'n."},"7":{"text":"Na theampo ah ngamtat phatna taw kisai in nangma mama a ettee taak na hi kul tu hi. Na hilna sungah deisak takpina le thupi laakna taw hil in."},"8":{"text":"Sit thei tu ahi ngawl kammal kilawmte zangh in, tua hile na ngalte in, ei huvau a sia hong pau natu, a heak ngawl uh ciangin, amate maizum thei tu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Sila te in na theampo sungah, a tote thu zawp tu a, amate lungkimsak tu hi. Amate kam zo kik ngawl tu a,"},"10":{"text":"a neisa nguksak ngawl tu hi. Tua hi zaw ngawlin, silate in, a tawntung a uphuai le mihing pha ahi hunlam a lak kul tu hi, tua hile ih Ngumpa Pathian thu kihilna sia a sepna theampo ah man neisak tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian in mihing theampo ngupna nga natu in, a thuthiamna hong pualaak hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua thu thiamna in, eite Pathian dei ngawl nuntakna zia, leitung taw kisai lungngul nate nusia in hong sawl a, hi leitung ah eima le eima a ki uk zo nuntakna, thutang le Pathian dei bang nuntaknate taw ih nuntak tu in hong hil hi."},"13":{"text":"A lian ih Pathian le Hunpa Jesus Christ minthanna taw hong kilangh tu ih lam et thupha hong tun Ni ngak in, ih om laitak tuabangin ngamta tawng."},"14":{"text":"Seksolna theampo pan ih suatak natu le ama bek ii neisa hi in, a pha sep tu a lawp, a thiangtho mite hong suasak natu in ama le ama sia ei atu hong kipia hi.","ref":"Ps 130:8; Pu 19:5; Thkna 4:20; 7:6; 14:2; 1 Pe 2:9"},"15":{"text":"Na thu hong ngaite, na hanthot ciang le na hil na pau ciangin nangma thuneina theampo na zangh in a, hi thute na hil ta'n. Amate kuama in nangma nomusak heak in."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ngamukte le thuneite thu zawpin a thu a nit natu le thupha theampo vawt tu in a kingin khol natu na mihingte na phawksak in.","title":"Tapidawte Ngamtatzia"},"2":{"text":"Kuama siat son ngawlin, ngual taw kilem a, a kuama theampo tungah, cikna thiamna a lak tawntung natu na son in."},"3":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, eima zongh khatvei lai in, a mawmaw, thu ni ngawl le a khial thei mi ih hi ngei hi. Ci le sa deina le nopsakna namcin ii sila ih hi ngei hi. Ih nuntakna sia hazatna le eenna taw ih zangh hi; ngual in hong ensan a, tuaciang ei zongh in ih ensan hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang ih Ngumpa Pathian ii cikna le itna hong pualaak ciang,"},"5":{"text":"ama in ei hong ngum hi. Tua in eite ii naphate ih sep hang hi ngawl a, pianthakna le nuntakna thak hong pia Thaa Thiangtho tungtawnin, ama hong hesuakna taw hong ngup ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Pathian in Jesus Christ ih Hunpa tungtawnin, Thaa Thiangtho sia a kicing takin, eite tungah hong buak hi,"},"7":{"text":"tuasia ciangin ama ii thuthiamna taw, eite sia Pathian taw thutang suak thei in ih lamet ahi tawntung nuntakna hong neisak hi."},"8":{"text":"Hisia in a maan thu sonna ahi hi. Pathian umte in mihing khat sim atu thinbot thei a, a manphate sep natu in a hun uh a piak thei natu in hi thute na thupi laak tuam tu in ka dei hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang a mawmawthuai kam kinial nate, taanghpupite khang simna saute, kihauna le thukham huvau khat le khat kinialna te na pial tavun. Tuate sia phattuamna om ngawl a, man nei ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Pawl kikhenna a piangsak mihing khat ii tungah a kidop thei natu, niivei peuma na hil tavun, tua zawkciang ahile, ama taw na kipee nawn heak vun."},"11":{"text":"Tuabang mihingte sia a lal hi a, a mawnate in ama a khial hunlam kilanghsak ahi sia na he hi."},"12":{"text":"Artemas ahibuale Tychicus sia nang kungah kong puak ciang, kei kung Nicopolis ah nong pai natu in hong hanciam ta'n, banghang ziam cile, phalbi hun sia tua munah zak tu in ka khensat zo hi.","title":"A khakbel Hilnate","ref":"Sawl 20:4; Eph 6:21-22; Col 4:7-8; 1 Tim 4:12"},"13":{"text":"Sitnipa Zenas le Apollos khualhaw hong kipat thei natu in na hu in a, a kisap tu theampo ahithei za in na vaihawmsak in.","ref":"Sawl 18:24; 1 Cor 16:12"},"14":{"text":"A kitaangsamh tatak teng a piak thei natu in mihingte in a hun uh sia thupha vawtna in a zak thei natu a sin uh kul tu hi; amate in a nuntak nate man nei ngawlin zangh heak hen."},"15":{"text":"Ka ompui theampo in, hong paupui tek uh hi. Upna sungah ih lawmte theampo tungah nuksetna kam na sonsak in. Pathian ii thuthiamna sia note theampo taw hong om tahen."}}}}},"57":{"info":{"name":"Philemon","shortname":"Phlm","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Christ Jesus atu a, thong a taak Paul le ih suapuipa Timothy in — koma ngualtamh le ka nasep puipa uh Philemon tungah,"},"2":{"text":"Tuaciang Philemon le na inn ah a kikhawm pawlpi le koma suapuinu Apphia le ngalkap bang a ka seppui uh Archippus tungah lai kong thaak uh hi:","ref":"Col 4:17"},"3":{"text":"Ih Pa Pathian le ih Topa Jesus Christ in thuthiamna le thinnopna hong pia tahen."},"4":{"text":"Suapui Philemon awng, thu ka nget simin na min kong lo a, ka Pathian tungah lungdam ka ko hi.","title":"Philemon ii Itna le Upna"},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, Pathian mihing a kici peuma na itna le Topa Jesus sungah upna na neina thute ka za hi."},"6":{"text":"Ka thungetna sia, thu umte ih hina taw ih kipawl khopna in Christ taw kipumkhat a, ih nuntakna sungah ih nei thupha a minpiang a thuk zaw in hong telsak thei natu ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Suapui awng, nong itna in, kei atu lungdamna lianpi le hanthotna tam ma hong pia hi! Pathian ii mihingte theampo ii thin nong nuamsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Hi thu hu in, Christ sungah na suapui khat ka hina taw, sep tu a kul khat sia hangsan takin kong sawl ngam hi.","title":"Onesimus atu Ngetsakna"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang nang hong it ka hikomin, kong thuum zaw hi. Keima Paul sia Christ Jesus ii tongciin hi a, ama hu in tu laitak mama in thongtaak zongh hi napi, hi bangin thuumna kong zangh zaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom, Onesimus luangin ngetsakna khat kong nei hi, ama sia Christ sungah ka tapa hi zo hi; banghang ziam cile thong sungah ka om sung ma in, thaa vai ah ama ii a pa ka suak zo hi.","ref":"Col 4:9"},"11":{"text":"Hun khat lai in ahile ama sia nang atu in, a kimanna om ngawl hi, ahihang tu in, ama sia nang le kei atu in a kizangh thei khat hong suak hi."},"12":{"text":"Tu in nang kungah ama kong puak kik a, ka thinsung theampo taw ka phawk nginge hi."},"13":{"text":"Lungdamna thu hu in, luangta in ka om laitak, nangma luangin kei hong hu thei tu, ama sia hi sungah ka keam nuam hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahitazong, nong hu natu kong sawl hamtang nuam bua hi; tua sangin, nangma thu in na ngamtat tu kong dei zaw hi. Tua ahikom, na thukim ngawl po bangma ka vawt buatu hi."},"15":{"text":"Onesimus sia nang kung panin tawmvei sung a tai sia, a tawntungin na omkhop kik thei natu uh hang hizaw tha tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tu in ama sia sila khat lel po hi nawn ngawlin, sila dinmun tungsia ah om zo hi: ama sia Christ sungah ih it suapuipa khat hi zo ta hi. Ama sia kei atu in bangza in, manpha ziam! Tuaciang nang atu zonghin, sila khat a hina le, Topa sungah suapuipa khat a hina taw bangza in manpha zaw lai tu ziam!"},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom nangma ii na naseppui bangin, kei nong ngaisun le, keima nong saan tu bangin, ama na saang kik in."},"18":{"text":"Nang tungah ngamtat khialna hong nei a, ahibuale, leiba hong nei le zong, keima ii kong bat bangin na ciamtee in."},"19":{"text":"Hi sungah keima khut tatak taw ma in lai hong at tu khi hi: Keima Paul in, kong lo kik vateei tu hi. (A tatakin ci leang, nangma pumpi mama kei tungah hong ba nginge na hi sia, kong phawsak tu kul ngawl hi.)"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahikom suapui awng, Topa atu in, thupha hi sia hong seam ta'n; Christ sungah suapui khat hina taw ka thin hong nuamsak ta'n!"},"21":{"text":"Lai hi sia kong at laitakin, kong sawl bangin vawt hamtang tu in kong muang hi — a tatakin kong sawl za sangin a tamzaw vawt tu ci in kong he hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuaciang kei atu in inn doituam khat, na koi kholsak in, banghang ziam cile note theampo ii thungetna sia, Pathian in hong saang tu a, note kungah kei hong zuansak kik tu hi, ci in lametna ka nei hi."},"23":{"text":"Christ Jesus atu in ka thongtaakpui Epaphras in note hong paupui hi,","title":"A khakbel Vaithakna","ref":"Col 1:7; 4:12"},"24":{"text":"tuabang ma in ka naseppui Mark, Aristarchus, Demas le Luke in note hong nukset uh hi.","ref":"Sawl 12:12,25; 13:13; 15:37-39; 19:29; 27:2; Col 4:10,14; 2 Tim 4:10,11"},"25":{"text":"Topa Jesus Christ ii thuthiamna sia note theampo taw hong omkhawm tahen."}}}}},"58":{"info":{"name":"Hebrewte","shortname":"Heb","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A bosa hunin, Pathian in ih taanghpupite tungah kamsaangte tungtawnin, lam tuatuam taw tamvei ma paupui hi,","title":"A Tapa tungtawnin a kison Pathian Kammal"},"2":{"text":"ahihang hi hun khakbel hunte ah, a Tapa tungtawnin hong paupui hi. Ama tungtawnin Pathian in vaannuai bup bitphua a, a khakbel ciangin na theampo ama ii neisa suak tu in ama sia Pathian ii tealsa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama in Pathian' minthanna ii vaangtaang hong lengsak a, ama sia Pathian ii hina zia bang tatak ma hi in, vaannuai bup ama ii a vaang nei a kammal taw khosak hi. Mihingte ii mawnate atu in mawmaitsakna a nga sak zawkciangin Vaanglianpipa Pathian ii ziatsang vantung ah to hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama tungah Pathian piak min sia vantunglalangte min sangin lianzaw ahi bangma in, Tapa sia vantunglalangte sangin lian zaw hi.","title":"Pathian Tapa ii Letna"},"5":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian in vantunglalangte khat po tungah, “Nang sia ka Tapa na hi hi; tu ni in kei sia na Pa ka hi hi,” a ci ngei bua hi. Tuasia bangma in Pathian in, vantunglalangte khat po tungah, “Kei sia ama ii Pa ka hi tu a, ama sia ka Tapa hi tu hi,” ci ngeingawl hi.","ref":"Ps 2:7; 2 Sa 7:14; 1 Khang 17:13"},"6":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in a Tapaciil leitung ah a paisak tu ciangin, “Pathian ii vantunglalangte theampo in ama bia tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:43"},"7":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in vantunglalangte huvau ahile, “Pathian in a vantunglalangte vui suaksak a, a naseamte sia meikuang suaksak hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 104:4"},"8":{"text":"Tapa huvau ahile Pathian in: “Pathian awng, na ngam sia a tawntung a tawntungin kip tu hi! Nangma in na mihingte thutang taw na uk hi.","ref":"Ps 45:6-7"},"9":{"text":"A maan thute na dei a, a maan ngawl thute na ngaimaw hi. Tua hu in Pathian, na Pathian in nang hong teal zo hi. Tuaciang na lawmte a piak sangin nang tungah lungdamna le upatna a lianzaw hong pia hi,” ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama in a ci laina panin, “Topa awng, nangma in a kipatciilin simlei na bitphua hi, tuaciang na khut mama taw vantungte na vawt hi.","ref":"Ps 102:25-27"},"11":{"text":"Tuate mangthang tu a, ahihang nang na kip tu hi; Tuate in puan bang lui in sia tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Amate laktong puasilh bangin na thep tu a, puan bangin na laih tu hi. Ahihang nang na hile a tawntungin na kibang a, na nuntakna a bo ngei bua hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Pathian in a vantunglalangte khat po ii tungah: “Na ngalte na peang nuai ah sisanhin kong neisak mateng, ka ziatsang ah to in,” ci ngeingawl hi.","ref":"Ps 110:1"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahile vantunglalangte sia bang ziam? Amate sia Pathian naseam thaa te hi a, ngupna a saang tute a hu tu in, a sawlte ahi uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hu in ei in thumaan thu ih zaak te pan, lam ih pial ngawl natu in ih kholet seseam kul hi.","title":"A Lian Ngupna"},"2":{"text":"Vantunglalangte in ih taanghpupite tungah a thupiakte maan hi ci in lak hi, tuaciang a zui ngawl a ni ngawl khat pawpo sia ama taw a kiphu in daan thuak tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua hi a, hi zata in a lian ngupna thusim buathong leang bangbangin suakta tu hi ziam? Topa ama mama in hi ngupna thangsak masa a, tuaciangin a zate in ei tungah tua thu a maanna hong lak zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua kawmkaal ah Pathian in nalamdang laknate, a tumdang tuatuamte vawtna le, Thaa Thiangtho letsong te ama ii a dei bangin a hawmsakna taw in amate tetti panna tungah tetti panna belap thua hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian in hong pai tu ci in ih son leitung thak sia, a uk tu in vantunglalangte a koi bua hi.","title":"Ngupna Nga natu Lampuipa"},"6":{"text":"Tua hi ngawl zaw in Laithiangtho mun khat ah: “Pathian awng, mihingte sia bang hi a; tuaza in banghang thinbot ni ziam? mihing ma hi lel napi a bang tu in thinnuammaw ni ziam?","ref":"Ps 8:4-6"},"7":{"text":"Vantunglalangte sangin a niamzaw in tawmvei sung na koi a; upatna le minthanna ama na khusak hi,"},"8":{"text":"tuaciang na theampo tungah a uk tu in na vawt hi.” Pathian in mihing sia “na theampo a uk tu” in vawt hi, ci hi. Hi thu in na theampo huam siat hi. Ahihang tu laitak hunin, mihing in na theampo uk hi, ci in ih mu bua hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian ii thuthiamna tungtawnin, mihing theampo atu a thi tu in, vantunglalangte sangin tawmvei hunsung teng a niamzaw in a kivawt Jesus ih mu hi. Thina a thuak hu in tu in minthanna le upatna lukhu a khuk ih mu hi."},"10":{"text":"Ta tam mama in ama ii vaangletna a siim thei natu in, na theampo bitphua in a keam Pathian in, Jesus sia a thuakna tungtawnin a cialcing pa a suasak tu sia a maan thu hi takpi hi. Banghang ziam cile amate ngupna sung a then sia Jesus ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama in mihingte sia a mawnate uh panin, thiansua a, tuaciang ama le tuabangin a kithiansua sa theampo in, Pa kibang a nei uh hi. Tua hu in Jesus in, amate sia innkuanpui a nak tu in, a mai a zum bua hi."},"12":{"text":"Ama in Pathian munah, “Ka mite munah na sep sa teng ka son tu hi; amate ii a kikhopna sungah nang kong pok tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 22:22"},"13":{"text":"Ama in, “Ka muanna sia Pathian tungah ka nga tu hi,” ci hi. Tuaciang, “Hi sungah Pathian ii kei hong piak tanote taw ka om hi,” zongh ci lai hi.","ref":"Is 8:17,18"},"14":{"text":"Ama ci bangin tua tanote sia chi le sa taw a om mihingte ahi bangma, Jesus ama mama zongh amate bang hong suak a, amate mihing pianzia teng hong siim hi. Hi bang a hina sia banghang ziam cile ama thina tungtawnin thina tungah vaang a nei doaimangpa a lalcipsak natu hi a,"},"15":{"text":"thina a kiitak hu in a nuntak sung teng sila a, a kaai mihingte tuabangin suaktasak hi."},"16":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ama ii huna a piakte sia vantunglalangte hi ngawl hi ci in kitelthiang hi. Tua hi ngawl zawin, ama in Abraham ii suan le paalte a hu hizaw hi.","ref":"Is 41:8-9"},"17":{"text":"Hisia hu in ama in a suapuite taw na theampo sungah a kiban uh kul hi, banghang ziam cile mihingte a mawna pan mawmaisakna kipiak thei natu in, Pathian na a sepna ah, a thumaan ngual a hesuak thei Thiampi Lianbel a sua natu ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Tu in ama in ze etna a thuakte sia hu thei hi. Banghang ziam cile ama mama zongh kize et zo a, thuak ngei zo hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian hong sapsa zongh ahi, ka Tapidaw suapuite awng! Ih pualaak upna ii Thiampi Lianbel tu in, Pathian ii a sawlpa Jesus ngaisun vun.","title":"Jesus sia Moses sangin Lianzaw"},"2":{"text":"Pathian ii inn sungah Moses sia a nasepna ah a thumaan bangma in, ama in hi nasep seam tu in a teal Pathian tungah thumaan hi.","ref":"Mi 12:7"},"3":{"text":"Inn khat a sa pa in tua inn sangin upatna nga zaw hi. Tuasia bangma in, Jesus sia Moses sangin vaang piakna lianzaw taw kiphu hi."},"4":{"text":"Inn theampo a sa khat tek om a, ahizong na theampo a vawt pa sia Pathian ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Moses sia Pathian inn sungah naseampa bangin, thumaan hi. Tuaciangin ama in maisang a Pathian ii son tu thute son hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang Christ sia Pathian inn uk Tapa bangin thumaan hi. Eite in, ih lametnate sungah thinletna le kimuanna ih kholet le ama inn ih hi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom Thaa Thiangtho ii cina taw kizui in, “Tuni in Pathian aw na za uh le,","title":"Pathian ii Mihingte atu Tawlngakna Khat","ref":"Ps 95:7-11"},"8":{"text":"na taanghpupite sennealngam sungah a om uh lai, Pathian a langpan lai, Pathian a ze et uh hun lai bangin, na thin uh na sahsak heak vun."},"9":{"text":"Amate in kum sawmli tawntung ka sep teng mu zo napi Kei hong ze et uh a, hong sin zazaan uh hi, Pathian in ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom tua mite tungah ka thin uuk a, hi bangin ka ci hi, ‘Amate in kei tungah hong thumaan ngawl tawntung a, ka thupiakte hong nial uh hi.’"},"11":{"text":"Ka thin uuk a, ‘Tawlngakna ka piak natu ngam ah amate tum ngeingawl tu hi!’ ci in: a ciliaphuai kamciamna ka vawt hi,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka thu uppuite awng, a nungta Pathian kung pan na lampial ngawl natu in, no sungah kuama peuma in ngitlona thinsung le up ngawlna thin na nei ngawl natu in kidawm tavun."},"13":{"text":"Laithiangtho sungah, “Tuni” a kici kammal sia a kizak thei lai teng mawna ii hong theam ngawl natu le na thin uh a sak ngawl natu in, khat le khat ni simin na kihu zawk uh kul tu hi."},"14":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile a kipat pan ih nei kimuanna sia a tawp dongin ih kholet le ei theampo sia Christ taw a kikopte ih hi hi."},"15":{"text":"Hisia laithiangtho ii ci ahi hi: “Tuni in Pathian ii aw na za le, na taanghpupite ii Pathian a langpan lai uh bangin na thin uh na sahsak heak vun.”","ref":"Ps 95:7-8"},"16":{"text":"Pathian aw za a, ama a langpante a kuate ziam? Moses ii Egypt ngam panin a pusuapui theampo ahi hi.","ref":"Mi 14:1-35"},"17":{"text":"Pathian sia kum sawmli tawntung a kuate ii tungah thin uuk ziam? Sennealngam sungah puk a, a thi mawneite tungah Pathian a thin uuk hi."},"18":{"text":"Pathian in a ciliaphuai kamciam pia a, “Amate tawlngakna ka piak natu ngam ah a tum ngei buatu uh hi,” a ci sia — akua te ii thu a sonna ziam? Ama a langpante ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in tua ngam sungah tum thei ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile amate in um ngawl ahihang hi ci in ih he hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in Pathian in, ama sonsa tawlngak nuam sia ih nga thei natu in kamciam hong pia hi. Tua ahiciang, tua tawlngak nuam sia saang ngawlin khat zongh ih om thaak ngawl natu eite kidawm tek tawng."},"2":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile eite zongh amate bangma in lungdamna thu ih za zo hi. Amate ahile tua thu za napi amate atu phatuamna a pia bua hi. Banghang ziam cile amate in a zaak uh ciangin upna taw a saang bua uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua hi a, ei a umte in, Pathian hong kamciamsa tawlngak nuam sia ih saang hi. “Ka thin uuk a, hi bangin a ciliap huai kamciam ka vawt hi. ‘Amate in ka piak tu tawlngakna ngamnuam ah a tum ngei buatu hi!’ ” a ci bang tatak ma ahi hi. Ama ii nasep sia simlei a bitphua hun panin a kiman sa hi napi tu a bangin ci veve hi.","ref":"Ps 95:11"},"4":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Laithiangtho sung mun khat ah ni sali ni huvau hi bangin ci hi: “Pathian sia a nasepna theampo pan a ni sali ni in tawlnga hi.”","ref":"Pian 2:2"},"5":{"text":"Hi thu a kison kik leleau na ah, “Amate in tawlngakna ka piak natu ngam ah a tum ngei buatu hi.” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 95:11"},"6":{"text":"Lungdamna Thu a za phit te in tua tawlngak nuam sia a saang bua uh hi. Banghang ziam cile amate in a um bua uh hi. Tua ahikom a saang tu in, a deisak midang om hi."},"7":{"text":"Hi thu sia koi bangin kilak ziam cile Pathian in, “Tuni,” a kici nidang khat koi hi. Tua zawk kum tam mama ciangin, a kisonsa laithiangtho khante sungah a om bangma in Pathian in David tungtawnin, tua thute hi bangin son hi: “Tuni in Pathian aw na za uh le, na thin na sahsak heak vun.”","ref":"Ps 95:7-8"},"8":{"text":"Joshua in Pathian kamciam ahi tawlngak nuam sia mihingte tungah pia zo hi thong le, Pathian in nidang khat ciang son kik nawn ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Thkna 31:7; Jos 22:4"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom ni sali ni in Pathian a tawlngak bangma in, Pathian mite atu in tawlngak nuam khat om lai hi."},"10":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile tua Pathian kamciam a piak tawlngak nuam sungah a tawlnga peuma in, Pathian tawlngak bangma in, amate nasepna pan a tawlnga tu uh hi.","ref":"Pian 2:2"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahikom, amate upna a sel hu in tawlngakna a nga ngawl bang ih sua ngawl natu in, ei zongh tua tawlngakna sia ih saan thei natu in, ih hi theiza in hanciam tawng."},"12":{"text":"Pathian kammal in nungta a, thahat in, lang nii hiam namsau sangin hiam zaw hi. Ama in thaa le thinsung kisiktuana mun, ngu le taang ngungeak kipeena mun teng pailet hi. Ama in mihing deina le lungngulna te tungah thukhen hi."},"13":{"text":"Pathian mai ah bangma a kiseal thei bua hi; bitphua sa na theampo sia ama mai ah kipualaak siat hi. Tuaciangin ih sep ih vawt sa theampo tungah thu hong sit tu sia ama ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahikom ih upna ih pualaak sate ii tungtaang ah eite kip tek tawng. Banghang ziam cile eite in Pathian omna tatak ah a pai sa, Thiampi Lianbelpa — Pathian Tapa Jesus ih nei hi.","title":"Jesus Thiampi Lianbelpa"},"15":{"text":"Ih Thiampi Lianbelpa in ei tha zawmna hong khuangai pui thei ngawlpa ahi bua hi. Tuabang hi ngawl zaw in, Thiampi Lianbelpa in, eima bangma in ze etna namcin na thuak a, ahizong a khial ngei bua hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom, kimuanna nei in thuthiamna a omna mun Pathian kumpi tokhum kung zuan tek tawng. Tua munah hesuakna ih saang tu a, ih kitaangsap laitak hong hu tu in, thuthiamna ih mu tu hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thiampi lianbel peuma a mipuite sung panin kiteal a, mawmai natu sangaw biakpiakna le piakkhiatna vawt tu in, amate taangin Pathian naseam tu a kitavaw te ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Ama mama in thaneamna tuatuam nei ahikom, thu tel ngawlte le khialna vawtte tungah ama in, cingh thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama mama thaneam ahikom, a mihingte mawna atu bek hi ngawlin ama mawnate atu zongh sangaw biakpiakna a sep kul hi.","ref":"Thiam 9:7"},"4":{"text":"Thiampi lianbelpa za sia ama le ama kiteal a, a kipia kuama om ngeingawl hi. Aaron tungah a kipiak bangin — mihing khat sia Pathian ii samna bek taw thiampi lianbel kisuaksak hi.","ref":"Pu 28:1"},"5":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in Christ in ama le ama thiampi lianbel za a kipia bua hi. Pathian in ama munah, hi bangin ci zaw hi, “Nang sia ka Tapa na hi hi; tuni in Kei sia nangma ii Pa ka suak hi.”","ref":"Ps 2:7"},"6":{"text":"Mundang khat ah a sonna panin, “Nangma sia thiampi na hi tawntung tu hi. Melchizedek taw a kinguizui thiampi na hi tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 110:4"},"7":{"text":"Leitung ah a nuntak lai in Jesus in thina pan a ngum thei, Pathian tungah a nging auna le thitui luanna taw thungetna le dei ngetnate nei hi. Ama kiniam khiak a, Pathian ii deina a zuipa ahi hu in, Pathian in za hi.","ref":"Mt 26:36-46; Mk 14:32-42; Lk 22:39-46"},"8":{"text":"Ama in Pathian Tapa ahihang, thuakna tungtawnin thunitna sin hi."},"9":{"text":"Ama sia a cingtaak a kisuasak zawkciang, ama thu a ni theampo atu in, tawntung ngupna ii naak a suak hi."},"10":{"text":"Pathian in ama sia Melchizedek pan a kinguizui susuk thiampi lianbel in saang hi."},"11":{"text":"Hi thu tungtaang son tu tam mama om hi. Ahihang no tungah son tel thei tu haksa hi. Banghang ziam cile note in thu na tel hak mama uh hi.","title":"Upna Nusiat huvau Kidop natu"},"12":{"text":"Note in sya na sep natu uh, hun tam ma om zo napi — Pathian thu kipatciilna taw hong hil tu khat na kisamh lai uh hi. Antak ne tu hi zo napi noai na neak uh kul lai hi.","ref":"1 Cor 3:2"},"13":{"text":"Noai ne khat pawpo sia patang hi lai a, a maan le a maan ngawl a khentel thei ngawl laite na hi uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Antak sia ulian sate atu hi a, amate in, kisinna tungtawnin a pha le a sia khentel thei uh hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahikom Tapidawte tungah thuhil phitnate nungsangah nusia in, a puicing kihilna taw eite mainawt tawng! A mannung ngawl nasepnate nusia in Pathian ih upna,"},"2":{"text":"baptize na nanamte, khut ngakna. tawntung thukhenna le a thisate thawkiknate, kansuut kikik pheang nawn bua tawng."},"3":{"text":"Eite mainawt tawng! Pathian in hong lungkimpui le, ih vawt tu sia hisia ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile a upna uh a nusia sate sia a kisii kik natu in, kikaizawn kik thei nawn na ziam? Amate sia khatvei lai in Pathian ii khuavak sungah om ngei zo uh hi. Amate sia vantung letsong tep ngei zo uh hi. Amate sia Thaa Thiangtho zongh a saang ngeisa ahi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian kammal pha hi ci in a tel sa, maisang a hong pai pheang tu, hun ii vaangletna zongh a he sate ahi uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua zawkciang amate in a upna uh taisan uh hi! Amate sia a kisii kik tu sia suak thei nawn ngawl hi. Banghang ziam cile, amate in Pathian Tapa sia Thinglamtee tungah kilh kik a, mipi mai ah a maizumhuai in a pholaak ahi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Lothote atu a limci ankungte a posak nguatui a dawn leitangte ii tungah Pathian in thupha pia hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang lopa le lingkungte a posak a ahile, tua leitang sia a mannung bua hi. Pathian ii haamsiat tu le, meikuang taw a halcip tu lauhuai hi.","ref":"Pian 3:17-18"},"9":{"text":"Ahizong hi bangin ih pau hang, kong it lawmte awng, no atu sia ka lungmuang hi. Note ii ngupna taw kizui thupha a phazawte na nei uh sia kong he uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Pathian sia a maan ngawlin a ngamta ngei bua hi. Ama in na a sepnate ahizong, ama ii tungah itna na lakna uh ahi, Tapidawpui te ii tungah huna na piakte le na piapiak laite sia hong makngilsak ngawl tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Deisakna lianpi kong neisakna uh sia, bang ziam cile, na lamet uh thute hong taangtung takpi thei natu in, na lawpna uhte a tawp dongin, mihing sim in, na kepcing tek tu ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Na datham tu sia kong deisak bua uh hi, Pathian ii kamciamte na nga natu in, a umte le a thinsaute bang na hi natu in kong deisak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Pathian in Abraham tungah kamciam a piak ciangin, a kamciam teng a taangtun natu ama in kiciamna vawt hi. Ama sangin a lianzaw om nawn ngawl ahikom, ama ii min taw kiciam hi.","title":"Pathian Kamciam a Tung Takpi tute"},"14":{"text":"Ama in “Thupha kong pia tu a, suan le paal tam mama kong pia tu hi ci in kamciam kong pia hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 22:16-17"},"15":{"text":"Abraham sia a thinsau ahikom Pathian ii kamciam teng a saang hi."},"16":{"text":"Mihing khat in kiciamna a vawt ciangin, ama sangin a lianzaw khat ii min zangh a, tua in kinialna theampo bosak hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama ii kamciam a piakte, a saang tute tungah, Pathian in a tup a sawmna peal ngeingawl hi, ci in thiang takin telsak nuam ahikom a kamciamte sia, kiciamna taw in belap hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hi a, thu nam nii om hi, tuate sia kikheal thei ngawl a, Pathian in tua thute taw kisai in leilot thei ngawl hi. Tua ahikom ama sungah ngammuanna a ngate in, ih mai ah hong kikoi lametna sia kho takin ih let natu in nasia takin hanna ih nei hi."},"19":{"text":"Hi lametna sia ih nuntakna atu in, thikkip bangin, ih nei hi. Tuasia in, maanin, muanhuai a, vantung biakinn a kidalna puankhai sia kaantanin mun thiangtho sungnung ah pai hi.","ref":"Thiam 16:2"},"20":{"text":"Ei taangin, Jesus in eite mai tua munah paikhol zo hi. Tuaciang, Melchizedek thiampi sia taw a kinguizui, a tawntung atu in, thiampi lianbel hong suak hi.","ref":"Ps 110:4"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi Melchizedek sia Salem kumpipa hi a, a Saangbel Pathian ii thiampipa ahi hi. Abraham sia kumpi li taw kisimin, ngalzo a hong cia ciang, Melchizedek taw kisi a Melchizedek in thupha pia hi.","title":"Thiampi Melchizedek","ref":"Pian 14:17-20"},"2":{"text":"Tuaciang Abraham in ngalte ii neisa a laak theampo tung pan see sawm sua see khat ama pia hi. (Melchizedek min ii khiakna masa sia “Thutang Kumpipa,” cina hi a, tuaciang, Salem kumpipa zongh kici ahikom, “Kilemna Kumpipa,” zongh kici si hi.)"},"3":{"text":"Melchizedek ii pa ahizong a nu ahizong a taanghpupite min ahizong a kiciamtee mun om ngawl hi. A suana ahizong a thina ahizong tepteena om ngawl hi. Ama sia Pathian Tapa bang ahi hi. Ama in a tawntungin thiampi hi top hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama bangza in lian ziam ci in na ngaisun thei uh hi. A minthang ih taanghpupi ahi Abraham zongh in, ngal kisim na phual pan a, a nga vanhte sung pan see sawm sua see khat ama pia hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaciang, Levi suan thiampite sia Thukham in Israel mite tung pan see sawm sua see khat, a laak natu thupia hi. Tuate in, a minampuite hi a, tua a minampuite sia Abraham suante ma ahi hi.","ref":"Mi 18:21"},"6":{"text":"Melchizedek sia Levi suan hi ngawl hi. Ahihang Abraham tung panin see sawm sua see khat la in, Pathian kamciam a saang Abraham sia thupha pia hi."},"7":{"text":"Thupha a pia pa in, thupha a saang sia sangin, lianzaw ahi hunlam tel laak om ngawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Thiampite tungtaang a, see sawm sua see khat sia, a thithei mihingte in la hi. Ahihang Melchizedek ahile, laithiangtho son bangma in, see sawm sua see khat sia a nungta pa in la hi."},"9":{"text":"Bang ci nuam hi ziam cile, Abraham in see sawm sua see khat a piak ciangin Levi in zongh a pia suak hi (A suan a paalte in khon hi)."},"10":{"text":"A tatakin ci leang, Levi sia piang ngawl lai hi, Melchizedek in, Abraham taw a kimu lai in Levi sia a taanghpupi Abraham pumpi sungah om hi, ci tu ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Levi thiampite bulphu in, Israel mite tungah Thukham a kipia ahi hi. Tu in Levi thiampite nasepna sia a cialcing sa hile thiampi nam dang khat a pian kul ngawl tu hi. Tua Thiampi in Aaron za laih hi ngawlin, Melchizedek za laih tu a kulna sia hi thu hang ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile thiampi huvau ah kikhealna a om ciang, thukham zongh a kikheal kul hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu a ih son teng huvau sia ih Topa in phung dang pan hi a, ama bee le phung sung pan thiampi a seam ngei kuama a om bua hi."},"14":{"text":"Ama sia Judah minam a piang ahi hunlam sia a kuama po ii heak ahi hi. Tuaciang thiampite huvau a son ciangin Moses in Judah min a lo ngei bua hi."},"15":{"text":"A thu paizia sia thiang vaial hi; thiampi tuam dangkhat hong khang a, tua pa sia Melchizedek bangma ahi hi.","title":"Melchizedek bang Thiampi Dangkhat"},"16":{"text":"Ama sia thiampi kisuaksak hi. Mihingte ngeina le zui tu thu omte taw hi ngawlin mong nei ngawl nuntakna khat ii vaang taw kisuaksak hi."},"17":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in, “Nang sia thiampi khat na hi tawntung tu hi. Melchizedek taw a kinguizui thiampi za lua pa na hi hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 110:4"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom ngeina lui sia, kiheam hi. Banghang ziam cile tua in thaneam a, a mannung bua hi."},"19":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Moses thukham in bangma a cialcingsak thei bua hi. Tu in Pathian taw ih kinai thei natu lametna phazaw khat hong kipia zo hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuaban ah, Pathian kiciamna zongh om si hi. Midangte thiampi a kisuasak lai in, tuabang kiciamna a om bua hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahihang Jesus sia kiciamna khat taw thiampi a sua natu Pathian in, “Topa in a ciliap huai kamciamna khat vawt zo a, tuaciang, ama in a dawk kik buatu hi. ‘Nang sia a tawntungin thiampi na hi tu hi’ ” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 110:4"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom hi a kilamdanna in, Jesus sia a phazaw thuciamna a kipsak pa zongh suaksak hi."},"23":{"text":"A kilamdanna dang khat zongh om lai hi: thiampi dang tam mama a om hi, banghang ziam cile amate sia thithi a, a nasep uh a zomto thei bua hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahihang Jesus sia nungta tawntung ahikom ama ii thiampi nasep sia ngualdang a ki aap sawn bua hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama in, tu le a tawntungin, ama tungtawn a, Pathian kung a zuante sia hun thei hi, banghang ziam cile ama in amate atu Pathian munah thu ngetsak tu in, a nungta tawntung hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom Jesus sia ih kitaangsapnate hong kicingsak thei, Thiampi Lianbel ahi hi. Ama thiangtho a; ama in mawna ahizong, khialna ahizong, ama sungah a nei bua hi; ama sia mawneite sung panin, kidoi tuam a, vantungte sangin a saang zaw in kilaamto hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama sia thiampi lianbel dangte taw a kibang bua hi; a masa phitbelin, ama mawna atu le tua zawkciang midangte mawna atu in, sangaw biakna ni simin a piak kul ngawl hi. Ama le ama a kipiak ciangin, a tawntung atu in khatvei lian sangaw biakpiakna vawt zo hi.","ref":"Thiam 9:7"},"28":{"text":"Moses Thukham in a cialcing ngawl mihingte thiampi lianbel tu in sep hi; ahihang Thukham om zawkciang hong piang, Pathian ii kiciamna taw a vawt kamciam in a tawntung atu in a cialcing Tapa sia Thiampi suaksak hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ih sawson theampo ii bulpi in, tuabangin eite ii Thiampi Lianbel khat ih neina thu ahi hi. Tua pa in vantung ah Vaanglian Pathian tokhum ziatsang ah to hi.","title":"Ih Thiampi Lianbel Jesus","ref":"Ps 110:1"},"2":{"text":"Ama in mihingte ii sak ahi ngawl, Topa ii sak buk tatak ahi A Thiangthobel Mun ah Thiampi Lianbel seam hi."},"3":{"text":"Thiampi Lianbel theampo sia Pathian tungah piakkhiatnate le nganhing taw biakpiaknate a pia tu in, a kisep ahi hi. Tua ahi bangma, ih Thiampi Lianbelpa zongh in, na khat peuma a piak nanak tu ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Jew te Thukham deina bangin letsong a pia tu in thiampite om ahi nungsang, hi leitung ah ama hong om le zong thiampi hi ngawl tu hi."},"5":{"text":"A tatakin ci leang ama ii a thiampi nasep in vantung a sia a zui hi a, tua ii limh bek ahi hi. Tua in Moses ii sepna sia bangma ahi hi. Ama in Puanbuk Thiangtho a sak tu ciangin, Pathian in, “Mualtung ah hong kilak sia ii lim bang tatakin, na theampo na vawt hamtang in,” ci hi.","ref":"Pu 25:40"},"6":{"text":"Ahihang tu in, Jesus a ki aap thiampi nasepna sia amate aa sangin lianzaw a, Pathian le a mihingte kilaklaw ah a vawt thuciamna sia zongh amate aa sangin, a phat zawk bangma ahi hi. Banghang ziam cile tua thuciamna sia a phazaw nate kamciam piaknate tungah kidoppha ahi hu hi."},"7":{"text":"A masa thuciamna sia ah khialna om ngawl hi thong le, a niina thuciamna sia kul ngawl tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian in, a mite tungah khialna mu ahikom thu a sonna ah, “Topa in, Israel mite le Judah mite taw thuciamna thak khat, ka vawt tu hun hong theng tu hi.","ref":"Jer 31:31-34"},"9":{"text":"Amate ii taanghpupite taw thuciamna ka vawt bang ahi buatu hi. A khut uh pan kai in, Egypt pan ka pusuapui hunlai bang ahi buatu hi. Amate taw ka vawt thuciamnate tungah a thumaan bua uh hi, tua ahikom amate ka awlmawk bua hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu in hisia in, maisang hong pai lai tu hun sungah, Israel mite taw ka vawt tu thuciamna ahi hi, Topa in ci hi: Ka thukhamte amate thinsung ah ka koi tu a, a lungtang tungah ka at tu hi. Kei sia amate ii Pathian ka hi tu a, amate sia keima ii mite ahi tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate kuama in a minam puite a hil sawn a kul nawn buatu hi. ‘Topa he vun,’ zongh amate tetek tungah a kici buatu hi. Banghang ziam cile amate in kei hong he siat tu a, a nobel panin a lianbel dongin hong he tu hi."},"12":{"text":"A mawnate uh ka maisak tu a, a khialnate uh ka ciamtee nawn buatu hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Pathian in thuciamna thak sia a son ciangin, a masa sia a lui suaksak hi; tuaciangin bang khat pawpo a lui a tul sate sia hai ngawlin bomang tu hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thuciam masa sia in biakpiakna ngeinate le mihing ii vawt biakna mun zongh nei hi.","title":"Leitung le Vantung ii Biakpiakzia"},"2":{"text":"Puanbuk khat kisa a, a puanung sia Thiangtho Mun kici hi. Tua ii sungah mei detna khuam le Pathian a piak anluum koina sabuai om hi.","ref":"Pu 26:1-30; 25:23-30,31-40"},"3":{"text":"Kidalna puankhak a niina sia ii nungsangah Thiangthobel Mun a kici puanbuk khat om hi.","ref":"Pu 26:31-33"},"4":{"text":"Tua ii sungah sathau namtui halna, khamh biaknatau le, khamh taw a kituam Thuciamna Thingkuang om a, a sungah manna koina khamh uum le a teeno a suak Aaron ciangkhut le thupiakte a ki atna suangpheak niite om uh hi.","ref":"Pu 30:1-6; 25:10-16; 16:33; Mi 17:8-10; Pu 25:16; Thkna 10:3-5"},"5":{"text":"Tuate tungah Pathian ompuina lim a lak, cherub te om a, maw kimaisakna mun ii tung pan a tha taw siin uh hi. Ahihang tu laitak sia tua nate theampo a vaikhua in son tu hun ahi bua hi.","ref":"Pu 25:18-22"},"6":{"text":"Hite sepzia sia hi bang ahi hi. Thiampite in ni simin puanbuk puanung sungah tumin a sep tute seam uh hi,","ref":"Mi 18:2-6"},"7":{"text":"ahihang a sungnung doituam sungah, Thiampi Lianbelpa bek kum khatin khatvei tum hi. Ama ii mawna le a mihingte ii a phaw thaak ngawl mawnate atu in, chisan la in, Pathian bia hi.","ref":"Thiam 16:2-34"},"8":{"text":"Puanbuk puanung sia a kip in a om laitengin Thiangthobel Mun kihong ngawl lai hi, ci in Thaa Thiangtho in thiang takin hil hi."},"9":{"text":"Hisia in tu hun kilakna lim khat ahi hi. Pathian tungah a kipia biakpiakna le, nganno taw biakpiakna in, a biate thinsung cialcingsak thei ngawl hi ci thu kimu hi,"},"10":{"text":"banghang ziam cile tuate in anneak, tuidawn le kithiansuana tuatuamte taw kisai bek hi. Hite sia a puatham zui tu ngeinate hi a, Pathian ngeina thak a piak sia a kipsak mateng atu hi bek hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang Christ sia hi lai ah a omsa naphate theampo ii Thiampi Lianbel tu in hong pai zo hi. Ama ii thiampi sepna puanbuk sia lianzaw a, cialcing zaw hi; tuasia in mihingte ii vawt hi ngawl a, a kibitphua simlei taw a kisai ahi bua hi."},"12":{"text":"Christ in Thiangthobel Mun ah khatvei lian a tum zawkciang, ama in, kealte le khuitalte ii chi sia biakpiakna tu in a keng bua hi. Ama chisan piazaw in, ei atu in tawntung ngupna hong ngasak hi."},"13":{"text":"Kealte le khuitalte ii chi le khuino halna vaamte a kithe ciang biakna huvau a, a thiangtho ngawl mihingte thiangthosak hi.","ref":"Thiam 16:15-16; Mi 19:9,17-19"},"14":{"text":"Hisia thumaan ahikom, Christ ii chisan in bangza in seam zozaw seseam tu ziam! Tawntung Thaa tungtawnin, ama in Pathian tungah ama le ama a cialcing sangaw biakpiakna in, kipia zo hi. Ama chisan in a mannung ngawl biakna huvau panin, ih thinsung hong thiangsak tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Tawntung thupha Pathian kamciamte a saan thei natu in, Pathian sapsa mihingte atu, Christ in thuciam thak khat hong vawtsakna in, hisia hang ahi hi. Hisia kipiangsak thei hi, banghang ziam cile thina khat om a thuciam masa sia a om kimlai ma in, mihingte a khialnate pan tua thina in suaktasak hi."},"16":{"text":"Ngamhlua natu lai a kinusiat tungtaang ah tua lai atpa sia thi zo ci in a lak thei tu kisamh hi,"},"17":{"text":"banghang ziam cile thi zawkciang atu in a ki at lai sia, a at pa nuntak lai teng kizangh thei ngawl a, a at pa thi zawkciang bekin kizangh thei pheang hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hi a, thuciam masa sia ngawngawn zongh chisan zakna bek taw thu suak thei hi."},"19":{"text":"A masa phitbel in Thukham sungah a thupiak theampo mihingte tungah Moses in sonthiang phot hi. Tua zawkciangin khuitalte le kealte chi la in tui taw a hel zawkciang, hyssop baak le tuu mulsan pawlkhat zanghin, Thukham laibu tung le mihingte tungah the hi.","ref":"Pu 24:6-8"},"20":{"text":"Ama in “Hi chi in Pathian ii ih zui tu a, hong thupiak thuciamna a kipsak sia ahi hi,” ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuasia bangma Moses in Puanbuk Thiangtho tung le biakna ah a kizangh nate theampo tungah chi the hi.","ref":"Thiam 8:15"},"22":{"text":"A tatakin, thukham ii ci bang hile na theampo phialma chisan in thiansua a, chisan a buak ciang bekin mawmaisakna om hi.","ref":"Thiam 17:11"},"23":{"text":"Vantung ah a om nate ii lim a late sia tuabangin kithiansua hi. Ahihang vantung nate mama in a phazaw biakpiaknate kulsak hi.","title":"Christ Kipiakna in Mawnate Maisak"},"24":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, Christ in a tatak sia ii lim ahi mihingte vawt Thiangtho Mun sungah a tum bua hi. Ama in vantung tatak ma ah tumin Pathian mai ah eite luangin, tu in a na kilak tawntung hi."},"25":{"text":"Jew te Thiampi Lianbelpa in Thiangthobel Mun ah kum simin nganno chi taw tum hi. Ahihang Christ in ama le ama a kipia kikik bua hi,"},"26":{"text":"tuabang hi thong le, simlei a kibitphua pan kipan tamveipi na thuak zo tu hi. Tu in hunkhen theampo a tawp natu hong nai ciangin, ama le ama a kipiakna taw mawna kithiansua natu in, ama in a tawntung atu, khatvei lian hong kilaak zo hi."},"27":{"text":"Mihing theampo khatvei tek thi tu a, tua zawkciang Pathian in amate tungah thukhen tu hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in, Christ zongh mihing tampite mawna a laaksak tu in, a nuntakna khatvei lian a kipia ahi hi. Ama sia a nii veina hong kilangh tu a, mawna taw kipekan tu hi nawn ngawlin, ama ngak nginge in a omte hun tu ahi hi.","ref":"Is 53:12"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jew te Thukham sia a tatakte ii a kicing le a maan lim ahi zo bua hi; hong pai tu naphate ii a kician tak ngawl a pianzia bek ahi hi. Tua sangaw biakpiaknate zongh kum simin kipia tawntung hi. Tua ahile hi sangaw biakpiaknate tungtawnin, Thukham sia in Pathian kung a zuan mihingte bangbang hong cialcingsak thei tu ziam?"},"2":{"text":"Pathian a bia mihingte sia a mawna panin, kithiansua takpi hi le amate sia mawna taw kithasung nawn ngawl tu a, sangaw biakpiakna theampo om nawn ngawl tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang kum khat zawkciang kum khat sangaw biakpiaknate in, mihingte mawna phawksak kik tu hi."},"4":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile khuitalte le kealtalte chi in mawnate a la keak thei ngei bua hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi thu hangin Christ sia leitung ah hong pai tu ciangin ama in Pathian tungah, “Sangaw biakpiaknate le piakkhiatna te na dei bua hi, ahihang kei atu in pumpi khat nong koisak khol zo hi.","ref":"Ps 40:6-8"},"6":{"text":"Nang in mawmaisak natu in biaknatau tungah nganhing a kipumhalte ahibuale sangaw biakpiaknate taw na lung a kim bua hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuaciangin, ‘Thukham laibu sungah keima thu a ki at bangma in, Pathian awng, na deina bang a seam tu in, Hi sungah om ing,’ ka ci hi,” ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama in a masa in, “Nang in sangaw biakpiakna, piaknate le mawnate laakkeak natu in, biaknatau tungah nganhing pumhalte na dei bua a, na lung a kim bua hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom Pathian in sangaw biakpiaknate Thukham bangin kipia hi napi, tu a bangin na ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin, ama in, “Pathian awng, na deina bang a seam tu in, hi sungah om khi hi,” ci hi. Tua ahikom Pathian in sangaw biakpiakna lui te phiat siat a, Christ ii kipumpiak biakpiakna taw theak hi."},"10":{"text":"Pathian dei bangin Christ in ngamta ahikom, ama ii tawntung atu khatvei lian a pumpi a kipiakna hu in eite theampo mawna pan hong kithiansua hi."},"11":{"text":"Jew thiampite khat simin, a nasep sia ni simin seam a, sangaw biakpiakna sia tamvei ma pia veve hi; Ahihang hi sangaw biakpiaknate in mawnate a la keak thei ngei bua hi.","ref":"Pu 29:38"},"12":{"text":"Ahihang Christ in mawnate atu in, sangaw biakpiakna khat pia a, tua biakpiakna sia a tawntung atu in, kikhomsuan hi, tua zawkciangin, ama sia Pathian ii ziatsang ah to hi.","ref":"Ps 110:1"},"13":{"text":"A ngalte sia peang ngakna tokhum bangin ama ii peang nuai ah Pathian ii a koi mateng, tu in ama in tua munah ngak hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahiciang ama in khatvei a kipumpiakna taw mawna pan a kithiansuate, a tawntung atu in a cialcing suaksak hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuaciangin Thaa Thiangtho zongh in, ama ii tetti panna hong pia hi. Hi bangin ci masa hi,"},"16":{"text":"“Hisia maisang ah hong pai tu hun sungah amate taw ka vawt tu thuciamna hi. Ka thukhamte amate lungtang sungah ka koi tu a, a thinsung ah ka at tu hi,” Topa in ci hi.","ref":"Jer 31:33"},"17":{"text":"Tuaciangin ama in, “Amate mawnate le ngitlo ngamtatnate ka ciamtee nawn buatu hi” ci hi.","ref":"Jer 31:34"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahikom hi mawnate hong kimaisak zawkciangin, mawnate laak keak natu piakkhiatna dang a kul nawn bua hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuaciangin suapuite awng, Jesus ii chisan hu in, Thiangthobel Mun ah ih tum natu in, suatakna a kicing takin ih nga hi.","title":"Pathian kung Zuan tawng"},"20":{"text":"Ama in eite atu ama ii pumpi ahi kidalna puankhak sia pailetin — a nungta lampi thak khat hong honsak hi."},"21":{"text":"Eite in Pathian ii innpi a uk thiampi lian khat ih nei hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahikom thintak le upna maan taw mawna kithasunna pan, a kithiansua sa lungtang le tuithiang taw a kisil sa pumpite taw Pathian kung zuan tek tawng.","ref":"Thiam 8:30; Eze 36:25"},"23":{"text":"Ih pualaak sa lametna kholet tawng, banghang ziam cile Pathian in, hong kamciam sate sia kholet tu hi, ci in ih muang ngam hi."},"24":{"text":"Khat le khat kithinbot tawng, ki itna kilak in a pha ngamtat natu kihu tek tawng."},"25":{"text":"Pawlkhatte bang hi ngawlin, eite in kikhoptua ngei sia thasua bua tawng. Topa Ni hong nai hi ci in, mu na hi uh ciangin, khat le khat kihanthawn seseam zaw tawng."},"26":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile thumaan hong kiheaksak zawkciang, mawna ih vawt kaltang lai le, mawna maisak natu, biakpiakna khat beak zongh om nawn ngawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Hong pai pheang tu thukhenna le Pathian a langpante a lalcipsak tu a kiitakhuai meikuang sia launa taw ngak a, ih om tu bek taang lai hi!","ref":"Is 26:11"},"28":{"text":"Moses thukham a paltan khat pawpo sia tetti nii ahibuale a tamzaw taw thukhenin a kimawsak le hesuakna om ngawlin kithisak hi.","ref":"Thkna 17:6; 19:15"},"29":{"text":"Tua ahile Pathian Tapa a zawngsak pa sia bang suak tu ziam? Mawna pan a, a thiansua Pathian thuciamna chisan a awlmaw ngawlte, thuthiamna Thaa a zawngsak te, bang tek suak tu ziam? Ngaisun vun, tuabang mihing khat ii thuak tu a kilawm daan sia bangza in nasia zaw tu ziam!","ref":"Pu 24:8"},"30":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, “Phu ka lam tu a, ka thuk kik tu hi,” a ci sia pa le, “Topa in ama mihingte thu a khen tu hi,” a ci sia pa zongh ih he hi.","ref":"Thkna 32:35-36"},"31":{"text":"A nungta Pathian khut sung ih taaksuk tu sia lauhuai mama hi!"},"32":{"text":"A bosa hun sungah note, bangbang hi kana nu ziam, phawk kik vun. Tualai in, Pathian khuavak sia no tungah hong taan zawkciang, na tam mama na thuak ngei uh hi. Ahitazong kisaan in na hanciamna ah, na lel bua uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Note khat vevei ngual sungah a kilanghin hong kivawtsia a, tuaciang hun dangte ah hi bangin a kivawtsiate na pawlpui ngam uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Thongtaakte na thuakpui uh a, na neisa theampo hong kimatsak ciangin, tua supna sia lungdam takin na thuak uh hi, banghang ziam cile a tawntung a, a kikhomsuan tu, a phazaw pek khat, nei nginge lai na hi uh sia na he uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahiciang na thinletna uh thasua heak vun. Banghang ziam cile tuasia in thaman lian mama taw hong kizom tu hi."},"36":{"text":"Pathian ii deina bangin na sep thei natu le, ama hong kamciamte na saan thei natu in, na thin na sausak kul tu hi."},"37":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in, “Tawmvei zawkciang, hong pai tu pa hong pai tu hi; ama haisaang ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Hab 2:3-4"},"38":{"text":"Bangpo ahizong a thutang ka mite in, um tu a nungta tu hi: ahihang amate khat po a heak kik le ama ii tungah ka lungkim ngawl tu hi,” ci hi."},"39":{"text":"Eite in heak kik a, a mangthangte ih hi bua hi. Ei sia upna nei in a kingumte ih hizaw hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Upna nei ih ci sia, lametna ih neinate tungah thinmuanna hi a, a kimu thei ngawl laite tungtaang ah muan ngamna ahi hi.","title":"Upna"},"2":{"text":"Taanghlai mihingte sia upna a nei hu in, Pathian lungkim hi."},"3":{"text":"Vaannuai bup sia Pathian kammal taw kibitphua a, a kimu thei nate sia a kimu thei ngawl nate panin, kivawt hi ci in upna taw ih tel hi.","ref":"Pian 1:1; Ps 33:6-9; Jn 1:3"},"4":{"text":"Upna taw Abel ii Pathian tungah a biakpiakna sia Cain ii biakpiakna sangin phazaw hi. Ama ii upna tungtawnin, ama sia Pathian in thutang hi ci in a saan pa hi a, banghang ziam cile Pathian mama in a piakte lungkim hi. Abel sia thi zo ahihang ama ii upna in thu hong son lai hi.","ref":"Pian 4:3-10"},"5":{"text":"Upna in Enoch sia thina panin keam hi. A thi tu luangin, Pathian in ama la to zaw a, kuama in ama mu thei nawn ngawl hi. Laithiangtho sungah Enoch sia a kilaak to ma in, Pathian lungdamsak hi, ci hi.","ref":"Pian 5:21-24"},"6":{"text":"Upna ngawl taw kuama in, Pathian lungdamsak thei ngawl hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian kung a zuan peuma in, ama sia om takpi a, ama a zongte thaman pia hi, ci in, a up uh kul hi."},"7":{"text":"Ama ii a mu thei ngawl maisang ah hong tung pheang tu nate huvau, Pathian ii kingintaak natu a sonte, Noah ii a zaak thei sia upna hang ahi hi. Ama in Pathian thu ni a, teambaw vawtin, tua ii sungah ama le a innkuanpuite kisuatak hi. Tua hu in leitung bup sia puavawkna thuak a, tuaciang upna pan hong pai thutang suana sia Noah in Pathian tung panin nga hi.","ref":"Pian 6:13-22"},"8":{"text":"Pathian ii kamciam a piaksa ngam ah a pai tu in, Abraham in Pathian ii sapna a nit sia upna hang ahi hi. Ama in koisung pai tu ci in he ngawl pipi ma in, a ngam nusia hi.","ref":"Pian 12:1-5"},"9":{"text":"Pathian ii ama tungah, a kamciamsa ngam ah ngamdangmi khat in a teen sia upna hang ahi hi. Ama in Pathian tung pan a kibang kamciamna ma a saang, Isaac le Jacob bangma in puanbuk sungah teang hi.","ref":"Pian 35:27"},"10":{"text":"Abraham in Pathian ii ngealin a sak, a bulkip khuapi ngak nginge hi."},"11":{"text":"Abraham huai mama zo a, a zi Sarah zongh ta nei thei ngawl hi napi upna in ama sia pa khat suaksak hi. Pathian in a kamciam sia tungsak tu hi, ci in muang hi.","ref":"Pian 18:11-14; 21:2"},"12":{"text":"Abraham sia a thithi ma hi zo napi, hi pasal khat ii a suan le a paal sia van a aksi za le tuipivaal ah a kisim zo ngawl senvui za ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 15:5; 22:17; 32:12"},"13":{"text":"Hi mite theampo sia upna sungah thi uh hi. Amate in Pathian ii kamciamte saang man ngawl a, a khualana pan ngal mu bek uh hi, ahitazong lungkim veve uh hi. Tuaciang amate in hi leitung ah ngamdangmi le ngaltaite bang ahi uh sia pualaak uh hi.","ref":"Pian 23:4; 1 Khang 29:15; Ps 39:12"},"14":{"text":"Tuabang a pualaakte in, amate aituam tu ngam khat zong hi ci in kitelthiangsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Amate in a nusiat sa ngam sia a ngaisusun nawn bua uh hi, ngaisun nuam le a heak kik natu hunpha om thei tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Amate ii lungngul sia ngam phazaw, vantung ngam hi zaw hi. Tua ahikom Pathian in amate ii Pathian hi a kici sia a mai a zum bua hi. Banghang ziam cile ama in, amate atu khuapi khat vawtkhol sa in koisak hi."},"17":{"text":"Pathian in Abraham a ze et lai in, a tapa Isaac sia sangaw biakpiakna bangin a pia ngamsak sia upna ahi hi. Abraham sia Pathian ii kamciam a piakna pa hi napi ama in a tapa khat bek a nei sia sangaw biakpiakna in nei tu kithoai hi.","ref":"Pian 22:1-14"},"18":{"text":"Pathian in Abraham tungah, “Isaac tungtawnin kong kamciamsa suan le paalte na nei tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pian 21:12"},"19":{"text":"Abraham in Isaac sia thina pan Pathian in thosak kik thei tu hi ci in tuat hi, tua ahiciang Abraham in Isaac sia thina panin nga kik — ci tu ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Isaac in Jacob le Esau ii maisang atu thupha a piak sia upna hang ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 27:27-29,39-40"},"21":{"text":"Jacob in a thi mahiat in, Joseph tapate thupha a piak sia upna hang ahi hi. Ama in a ciangkhut dawnah kinang in Pathian bia hi.","ref":"Pian 47:31; 48:1-20"},"22":{"text":"Joseph in a thi dektak ciangin Israel mite Egypt ngam pan a pusua natu thu a son sia le ama luanghawm tungtaang ah a ngamtat natu uh a vaithak teng sia upna hang ahi hi.","ref":"Pian 50:24-25; Pu 13:19"},"23":{"text":"Moses a sua zawk tha thum sung, a nu le a pa in, ama a sealcip uh sia, upna hang ahi hi. Amate in ama sia nauno hoi khat hi, ci in mu ahikom, kumpipa thupiakna a nit ngawl uh hang, a lau bua uh hi.","ref":"Pu 2:2; 1:22"},"24":{"text":"Moses hong khanthin tak ciang kumpipa tanu ii a tapa a kici tu uuk ngawlin a nial sia upna hang ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 2:10-12"},"25":{"text":"Tawmvei sung mawna sungah a nopsak tu sangin, Pathian ii mihingte taw a thuak khop tu sia uukzaw hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama in Messiah hangin huasaakna a thuak tu sia, Egypt ngam ii hauna theampo sangin, kimanh zaw pek sa hi, banghang ziam cile ama in maisang thaman a saan pheang lai tu te mitsuan hi."},"27":{"text":"Moses in kumpipa thin uuk tu lau ngawlin, Egypt ngam a nusiat sia upna hang ahi hi. A kimu thei ngawl Pathian sia a mu bang phetin, nungsang ah heak kik tu a uuk bua hi.","ref":"Pu 2:15"},"28":{"text":"Thina ii Vantunglalang in, Israel mite ii tapaciil theampo a thalup thaak ngawl natu in ama in Paisan Poai piangsak a, kongkhate tungah chisan a kinoi natu thu a piak zongh upna hang ahi hi.","ref":"Pu 12:21-30"},"29":{"text":"Upna in San Tuipi sia leiko tung tot bangin, Israel mite kaantansak zo a, Egypt mite in kaantan tu in a kipat ciang, tuipi in amate valhlum siat hi.","ref":"Pu 14:21-31"},"30":{"text":"Israel mite Jericho khua ni sali kiimkotin a pai zawkciang tua khua luphungte a cip thapna in upna hang ahi hi.","ref":"Jos 6:12-21"},"31":{"text":"Pumpi zuak numei Rahab sia Pathian thu a ni ngawlte taw a kithalup khop ngawl natu in a keam sia upna ahi hi. Banghang ziam cile ama in, Israel te ii ngalvilte pawlvawt in zindo hi.","ref":"Jos 2:1-21; 6:22-25"},"32":{"text":"Ka son tawto lai tu ziam? Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel le kamsaangte theampo ii thu ka son natu hun kicing ngawl hi.","ref":"Thkte 6:11; 8:32; 4:6; 5:31; 13:2; 16:31; 11:1; 12:7; 1 Sa 16:1; 1 Kum 2:11; 1 Sa 1:1; 25:1"},"33":{"text":"Upna tungtawnin, amate in, ngam bu bup sim uh a, zo uh hi. Amate in a maan nasepte seam a, tuaciang Pathian kamciamte saang uh hi. Amate in tawpite kam humcip a,","ref":"Dan 6:1-27"},"34":{"text":"a kiitakhuai meikuangte sumit in namsau taw thalup natu pan suakta uh hi. Amate sia thaneam kale thahatte suak uh hi; amate sia kidona sungah thahat a, ngamdangmi ngalkapte zothal uh hi.","ref":"Dan 3:1-30"},"35":{"text":"Upna tungtawnin a thisa a kinungtasak kik a mealheakte, numeite in nga uh hi. A dangte ahile, suatakna a saan tu nial in, a phazaw nuntakna sungah a kithaw kiksak natu in, vawtsiat zazaan thuakin thi uh hi.","ref":"1 Kum 17:17-24; 2 Kum 4:25-37"},"36":{"text":"Pawlkhat sia kiselno in kivel a, pawlkhat sia thikkol kibulin, thong sungah kikhum hi.","ref":"1 Kum 22:26-27; 2 Khang 18:25-26; Jer 20:2; 37:15; 38:6"},"37":{"text":"Amate suang taw kideang hi, tum nii sua in ki attan a, namsau taw kithat hi. Amate tuuvun ahibuale, kealvun silhin vak uh hi — zawngkhal in, kivawtsia a, ahi ngawl lalam in kivawt uh hi.","ref":"2 Khang 24:21"},"38":{"text":"Leitung sia amate taw a kiphu bua hi! Amate in ngaltaite bangin, sennealngamsung le mual tungah vakthap in, suanghawng leihawng sungah a teang uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Upna a nei hu in hi mite theampo sia bangza in teptee huai ziam! Ahihang amate in, Pathian kamciam a saang man bua uh hi,"},"40":{"text":"banghang ziam cile Pathian in ei atu a phazaw tupna, hong neisak hi. Ama ii tupna sia, eite taw ih kitholkhop ciang bekin a kicialcingsak pheang tu ahi hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ei ih hi le, ih kiimkot ah hiza a tam mihonpi tetti ih nei hi. Tua ahikom ih mai hong khak thei na theampo le hong lencip thei mawnate vawkin, ih mai ah tai kidemna sungah thin khensatsa in tai tek tawng.","title":"Ih Pa Pathian"},"2":{"text":"A kipatna pan a tawp dong upna a piangsak pa, a kicingsakpa Jesus mitsuan tawng. Ama sia thinglamtee hangin thinkiam ngawl hi! Ama a ngak nginge lungdamna hangin, thinglamtee tungah maizum thina sia pha maw sa ngawl zaw a, tu in Pathian tokhum ziatsang ah to hi."},"3":{"text":"Ama thuakna teng ngaisun vun; bangza in mawneite ii a nasia tatak etsatna thuak ziam! Tua ahikom note zongh thinkiam heak vun, hanciam vun."},"4":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile mawna taw na kidona sungah thalup thuak tu dongin, na nalh tu uh kul ngawl lai buang hi."},"5":{"text":"Pathian in a tate na hina uh taw hanthotna kam hong paute mangil zo nu ziam? “Ka tapa awng, Topa ii hong hil ciangin, a pha takin ngai in, hong teih ciangin thinkiam heak vun.","ref":"Job 5:17; Pau 3:11-12"},"6":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Topa in a itte theampo hil a, a ta bangin a saante theampo daan pia hi,” ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Pa ii daan hong piak bang na thuak po vun; tua na thuakna in Pathian ii a tate bangin hong tuat a hina kiciansak hi. A pa ii daan a piak ngeingawl tapa a om ngei ziam?"},"8":{"text":"A tate theampo a piak bangin daan hong pia ngei bua ahile, ta tatak hi ngawlin, lamlak ta na hi uh hunlam kilangh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ih leitung pate tungtaang ahile amate in daan hong pia a, eite zongh in zatakna ih pia hi. Tua ahile thaa lamsang ih Pa tungah bangza in ki aap zaw tu a, nungta zaw tu hi ziam!"},"10":{"text":"Ih leitung pate in pha a sak uh ciaciang, tawmvei sung daan hong pia hi; ahihang Pathian in, ahile, ama thianthona ih siim thei natu in eima phattuam natu a vawt ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Eite daan hong kipiak ciangin, tua hun laitak ih lungdam natu hi ngawlin, ih hee natu hong pia hile kilawm hi. Ahihang nungsang ciangin, tuabang kitekna a thuakte in thumaan thutang nuntakna ii thinnopna thaman nga uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahikom na khut uh a kha le laamto vun a, a huang vadil na khupte uh hatsak vun.","title":"Hilna le Kidop natu","ref":"Is 25:3"},"13":{"text":"Na peang a bai na sang a dam zawk natu le a kizak thei kik natu in, lamzin tang zui tawntung tavun.","ref":"Pau 4:26"},"14":{"text":"Mihing theampo taw na kilem tu hanciam vun a, a thiangtho nuntakna taw nuntak tu hanciam tavun, banghang ziam cile kuama in tua ngawl taw Topa a mu buatu hi."},"15":{"text":"Pathian ii thuthiamna pan na heak kik ngawl natu kikeam tavun. A khaa thingkung khangto a, lalna tam mama a piangsak nguu a nei thingkung bang na hi heak vun.","ref":"Thkna 29:18"},"16":{"text":"Esau bangin paktatna ahibuale thaa lamsang zawngkhalna kuama in na nei heak vun, ama in ta uzaw ii a nga tu hamphatnate theampo anneak khat taw zuak hi.","ref":"Pian 25:29-34"},"17":{"text":"Tua zawkciangin, na heak uh bangma, ama in a pa ii thupha saang nuam hi; ahihang ama kinolh hi, banghang ziam cile ama in ama ii a sep sate a kheal kik natu lampi sia thitui taak liangin a zon hang zong a mu thei bua hi."},"18":{"text":"Note in Israel mite Sinai mual a zot uh bangin cii le sa ii phaw theinate ahi meikuang ahizong, khuazing le khuangial ahizong, vuipi suangval ahizong,","ref":"Pu 19:16-22; 20:18-21; Thkna 4:11-12; 5:22-27"},"19":{"text":"lemle aw le awnging khat ahizong, tuate kung nong zuan bua uh hi. Israel mihingte in tua awnging khat a zaak uh ciangin, kammal dang a zaak ngawl natu in, thuum uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile amate in, “Nganhing khat ngawngawn in tua mual a thutha le suangtum taw hua lup kul tu hi,” ci in thupiakna sia a thuak zo bua uh hi.","ref":"Pu 19:12-13"},"21":{"text":"Tua a muna sia lauhuai leilam ahikom, Moses in “Lau in ka liing vadil hi!” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 9:19"},"22":{"text":"Note Zion Mual le a nungta Pathian khuapi vantung Jerusalem, vantunglalang tul tam mamate omna ah nong pai zaw uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Note in vantung ah a min a kikhum Pathian taciilte lungdam takin a kikhopna ah nong pai uh hi. Note in mihing theampo thukhenpa Pathian kung le a kicialcingsak mihingphate ii thaa omna munah nong pai uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Thuciam thak a vawtpa Jesus kungah nong pai uh a, Abel chi ii sep sangin a phazaw pek nate hong kamciam, a kithe chi kungah nong zuan uh hi.","ref":"Pian 4:10"},"25":{"text":"Tua ahikomin kidawm vun a, a sonpa sia ngai nuam ngawlin, nial heak vun. Pathian thu leitung ah a son pa nadon ngawl a, a nialte a suakta bua hi. Vantung pan hong sonpa na thusim buale bangbang suakta thei seseam tu hi ziam!","ref":"Pu 20:22"},"26":{"text":"Ama aw in tua hun laitakin, leitung liingsak ahihang tu in ama in, “Leitung bek hi ngawlin, vantung zongh khatvei ma ka liingsak lai tu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Hag 2:6"},"27":{"text":"Hi kammal “khatvei ma” ci sia in bitphua sa nate ngawk zazaanin, khiin tu a, a kingawksak thei ngawl teng bek taang lai tu a hina thiang takin lak hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ahiciang, lungdam tek tawng, banghang ziam cile eite in, a kingawk thei ngawl ngam ih nga hi. Ama lungkim tu bangin, eite in thasiana le kiitakna taw Pathian tungah lungdamko in, ama bia tek tawng;"},"29":{"text":"banghang ziam cile ih Pathian sia a haltum thei meikuang tatak ahi hi.","ref":"Thkna 4:24"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tapidaw mi unau khat bangin khat le khat ki it tawntung vun.","title":"Pathian Lungkimsak natu"},"2":{"text":"Na inn ah leangnate zin na do tu mangil heak vun. Tuabang a ngamta pawlkhat in vantunglalangte zin dawdo ahi hunlam a he bua uh hi.","ref":"Pian 18:1-8; Pian 19:1-3"},"3":{"text":"Thongsung a omte na phawk tavun a, noma zongh amate taw thongtaak khawm bangin kingaisun tavun. Ngim a thuakte na phawk tavun a, noma zongh amate taw ngim a thuak khawm bangin na kingaisun tavun."},"4":{"text":"Nupa kiteenna sia a kuama theampo in zatak vawt tahen a, pasalte le zite sia khat le khat tungah kithumaan hamtang tahen. Pathian in a paktatte le a kipalngulte tungah thukhen tu hi."},"5":{"text":"Na nuntakna uh sia sum le vanh manpha deina taw na kipealsak vun a, tuaciangin na nei uh sia taw na lungkim vun. Banghang ziam cile Pathian in, “Bangma hunin kong taisan ngei buatu a, kong nusia ngei buatu hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Thkna 31:6-8; Jos 1:5"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom hangsan takin, hi bangin ci tawng, “Topa sia kei hong hu pa hi a, ka pa tau buatu hi. Akua in kei bang hong law thei tu ziam?”","ref":"Ps 118:6"},"7":{"text":"No tungah Pathian thu hong son na lampui masate phawk vun. Amate bangbangin nungta a, bangbangin thi ziam ci in ngaisunin, amate upna bang na ettee tavun."},"8":{"text":"Jesus Christ sia zeini, tuni le a tawntungin a kibang ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"A lam dadang kihilna nam tuatuamte zui in, thumaan lampi pan pial heak vun. Neak le dawn vai thukhamte zuina taw hi ngawlin, Pathian ii thuthiamna pan, ih sungsang thahatna nga tu sia pha hi; neak le dawn lamsang thukham zuite tungah tua thukhamte in phattuamna pia ngawl hi."},"10":{"text":"Jew te ii biakna munah thiampi seamte in, ih biaknatau tungah a om sate a neak thei natu thu nga ngawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Jew te ii Thiampi Lianbelpa in ngannote ii chi sia Thiangthobel Mun ah mawphel biakpiak natu in tumpui hi; ahihang ngannote ii pum sia ngiaphual puasia ah hal hi.","ref":"Thiam 16:27"},"12":{"text":"Hi thu hu in, Jesus zongh mihingte mawna pan a chisan taw a thiansua natu in, khuapi puasang ah thi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom, eite zongh ngiaphual puasang, ama kung zuanin a maizumnate thuak pui tawng."},"14":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile hi leitung ah a kip khuapi khat zongh ih nei bua hi; eite in hong piang pheang tu khuapi sia ih zon laitak ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom, eite in Jesus tungtawnin ih kipum piak biakpiakna in Pathian pok tawntung tawng, Topa hi ci in a pualaakte ii kam taw a kipia biakpiakna in tuasia ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Na pha sep tu le khat le khat kihu tu sia, na mangil heak vun, banghang ziam cile hite sia Pathian a lungkimsak ih kipumpiak biakpiakna ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Na lampuite ii thupiakna na zui vun. Amate ii thu na ni vun. Amate in tawlnga ngawlin na thaa uh hong cinsak hi, banghang ziam cile amate in, Pathian tungah amate nasep huvau sazian a lak kul tu hi. Amate thu na ni uh le amate sia lungdam takin, naseam tu hi; tua hi buathong le, amate in heena taw naseam tu a, note atu in bangma phattuamna a om buatu hi."},"18":{"text":"Ko atu thu hong ngetsak tawntung tavun. Thin thiangtho nei ung, ci ngam khu hi, banghang ziam cile, a maan bekma seam tawntung nuam khu hi."},"19":{"text":"Note kungah hai ngawlin, Pathian ii kei hong paisak kik pal natu thu nong ngetsak thua lai tu uh nasia tak kong thum hi."},"20":{"text":"A nuntakna biakpiakna in a piak hu in Tuucing Lian ahi Topa Jesus sia Pathian in thina pan tho kiksak zo a, tuaciang a chisan hu in a tawntung thuciamna sia kikipsak zo hi. Kilemna Pathian in ama ii dei sia na vawt thei natu in na kisap uh vanh pha theampo hong pia tahen a, tuaciang ama diksak sia Jesus Christ tungtawnin ei sungah hong seam tahen. Christ tungah minthanna a tawntung a tawntungin om tahen! Amen.","title":"Thukhup Thungetna","merge":"21"},"22":{"text":"Suapuite awng, hi kihanthotna kammalte pha takin na ngai vun ci in kong thum hi; banghang ziam cile hi laithak kong at sia sau leih ngawl hi.","title":"Kammal Khakbelte"},"23":{"text":"Ih suapui Timothy sia thongsung panin kipusuaksak zo hi, ci sia kong zasak nuam hi. Hong theng pal nale, noma taw kimu tu in, kong tonpui tu hi."},"24":{"text":"Pathian mite theampo le na lampuite theampo tungah kong nuksetna kam na zasak vun. Italy pan suapuite in hong nukset hi."},"25":{"text":"Pathian ii thuthiamna sia note theampo taw om tahen."}}}}},"59":{"info":{"name":"James","shortname":"Jas","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ ii naseampa James in: leitung bup ah a kithethaang Pathian mite kong paupui hi.","ref":"Mt 13:55; Mk 6:3; Sawl 15:13; Gal 1:19"},"2":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, ze etna namcin na thuak uh ciangin hampha in na kingaisun tavun,","title":"Upna le Ciimna"},"3":{"text":"banghang ziam cile, na upna in tuabang ze etnate na zaw zawkciang, thuak zawkna piang hi ci in na he uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Note sia a kicing, a cialcing, bangma a kitaangsamh ngawlte na hi natu in na thuak zawknate in note, puk ngawlin lam tawntung hong khosak tahen."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang note khat po in, ciimna na nei buale, a pia tu pa Pathian tungah thu ngen tahen; banghang ziam cile Pathian in ngo tatak le thuthiam takin, a kuama theampo tungah pia hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang thu na nget uh ciangin, na up tu kul a, up laakna na nei ngawl het tu uh kisamh hi. Up laakna a nei khat pawpo sia, tuipi tungah vui ii seam kawkoai tuihual taw kibang hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuabang mihing khat, a sepna theampo ah a thin a khensat thei ngawl khat sia in, Topa tung pan bangma nga tu in ngaisun heak hen.","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"A zawng Tapidawte a zawnna pan Pathian in a lapto ciangin a lungdam tu uh a,","title":"Zawnna le Hauna"},"10":{"text":"tuaciangin a hau Tapidawte sia Pathian in a khiasuk le a lungdam tu uh ahi hi. Banghang ziam cile a hau khat sia ngam lopa paak bangin bo tu hi.","ref":"Is 40:6-7"},"11":{"text":"Ni hong suak a, nisa in a kung hal a; a paak pulin a hoina teng siacipsak hi. Tuasia bangma in mihaupa sia a nasepna ah, a sep laitakin kisusia tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Ze etna haksa a thuak zote in a lungdam mihing ahi hi, banghang ziam cile tuabang hong sit nate a zaw ciangin, Pathian a itte tungah a kamciamsa nuntakna sia tel in saang tu hi.","title":"Hong Sitna le Ze etna"},"13":{"text":"Mihing khat sia tuabang haksatnate taw ze etna a thuak le, “Hi ze etna sia, Pathian kung panin hong pai hi,” ci heak hen. Banghang ziam cile Pathian sia siatna in ze et zo ngawl hi, tuaciang ama mama in kuama a ze et bua hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahihang mihingte sia, amate ii a pha ngawl deinate in kai a, a awk ciang, ze etna thuak ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuasia ciangin amate ii deina pha ngawlte a sung uh ah paai in mawna piangsak hi; tuaciang, mawna hong khanthin tak ciangin thina piangsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka it suapuite awng, theamna um heak vun!"},"17":{"text":"A pha tel le ziakte le a cingtaak letsong theampo vantung panin hong pai hi; tua teng sia vantung khuavakte a bitphua, kikheal ngeingawl a, kihei in khua a zingsak ngawl Pathian kung pan hong paisuk hi."},"18":{"text":"Ama ii piansaknate theampo sung pan a thupibel ih sua thei natu in, thumaan kammal tungtawnin, ama ii deina om babangin eite hong piangsak hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka it suapuite awng, hi thu ciamtee tavun! Mihing khat simin thu ngaina thu zaakna ah manlang tu a, ahizong pau papaih ngawl tu a thin uuk papaih ngawl tu kul hi.","title":"Zaakna le Sepna"},"20":{"text":"Mihingte thin uukna in, Pathian ii thutang tupna taangtung ngawlsak hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom a kiihuai zongsang nate le seksolnate theampo vawk siat vun.
