Pathian tungah ki aap vun a, na thinsung ah hong khum a kammal na saang vun, tua in note hong ngum thei hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama ii kammal ngaina bek taw noma le noma kitheam heak vun a; ngamtatna taw zui paih zaw vun."},"23":{"text":"A kuama po kammal ngai a, a zui ngawlte sia limlangh sung ki en a, ama le ama a pian babangin a kimu mihing khat taw kibang hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama le ama pha tak a ki et zawkciangin pusuak a, ama meal bangbang hi ziam cisia mangil paih hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahihang mihingte a suaktasak a kicing thukham sia pha takin a et zawkciang thupi ngaisut tawntung a, a zaak sia a mangil kik paih sia hi ngawlin, a zui — a nuntak puite peuma sia Pathian in a sepna ah thupha pia tu hi."},"26":{"text":"Khat po in ama sia biakna kin mihing khat hi ing ci in a kingaisun ziam? Ama in a leei a uk zo buale ama ii a biakna sia a luithawthong suak a, ama le ama kitheam ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Pa Pathian ii a thiangtho le biakna tatak hi ci in, a ngaisut sia hi teng hi: tangate le meingongte ii thuakna sung pan khoi natu le leitung siatna panin eima le eima kikep natu ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, a minthang Topa, ih Topa Jesus Christ thu umte na hi uh bangma in, a puasang omzia etna taw kuama doidan ngei heak vun.","title":"Kidoidanna huvau Kidop natu"},"2":{"text":"Sonteena in, mihau khat sia khamh khutzungbu bun a, puan pha silhin, kikhopna munah hong pai hen a, tuaciangin mihing khat sia puansia ngapkaai silhin, kikhopna munah hong pai hi."},"3":{"text":"Puan pha taw a kizeampa zatak piak zawkna taw, “Hi sung tona phabel tungah to in,” ci a, ahihang mizawngpa munah “Nang zia lai ah ding in, tua ahibuale ka peang kung suat tungah to in,” ci le uhte"},"4":{"text":"tuasia ciangin noma pawlsung mama ah, kidoidanna a piangsak, a sia tupna bulphu in thukhenna taw a maw na hi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Hong ngai tavun, ka it suapuite awng! Pathian in hi leitung ah mizawngte sia, upna sungah a hau tu le ama a itte atu kamciam a piak kumpi ngam a lua tu in teal zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang note in mizawngte sia na thusim bua uh hi! A kuate in no hong zothaw a, thukhenmangte mai hong then ahi ziam? Mihaute hi!"},"7":{"text":"No hong kipiasa tua minphatna a sonsiate sia amate ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Laithiangtho sungah a kimu Kumpi ngam ii thukham na zui uh le, a maan in na a seam na hi tu uh hi. Tua thukham in, “Noma le noma na ki it uh bangma in, na innpaam pa na it vun,” ci hi.","ref":"Thiam 19:18"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang mihingte tungah a puasang omzia muna taw na en uh le, mawna vawt na hi uh a, tuaciang thukham in nang sia thukham paltan pa bangin hong mawsak hi."},"10":{"text":"A kuama po thupiak khat a paltan pa in, thukham a vekpi in paltan ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile “Palngul mawna vawt heak vun,” a ci pa mama in “Mihing that heak vun,” zongh ci si hi. Palngul mawna na vawt bua hial uh zong mihing na that uh le, thukham paltan na suak uh hi.","ref":"Pu 20:13,14; Thkna 5:17-18"},"12":{"text":"Eite hong suatak thukham sia taw thu a kikhen tu mihingte bangin pau in, ngamta vun."},"13":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile hesuakna a nei ngawl mihing khat tungah thu a khen ciangin, Pathian in hesuakna a lak buatu hi; ahihang hesuakna in thukhenna zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, khat po in upna ka nei ci napi in, a ngamtatnate taw a lak buale, bang phatuam ziam? Tua upna in, ama ngum thei tu ziam?","title":"Upna le Ngamtatnate"},"15":{"text":"Sonteena in u le nau sungah, puansilh kisamhte le, anneak tu kicingin nei ngawl om hi ci tawng."},"16":{"text":"Amate tungah, “Pathian in thupha hong pia tahen! Na khua lum in, na ngilva tahen!” na ci uh hang, nuntak natu a kisamh nate na pia bua uh le na pauna in bang phattuamna om ziam?"},"17":{"text":"Upna ih ci zongh ta bangma hi: ngamtatnate a om ngawl upna in ama nguak ahikom a thi ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahizong khat po in, hi bangin ci thei tu hi, “Mihing khat in upna nei a, a dangkhat in ngamtatnate nei hi,” ci hi. Keima zo kikna in hi bang ahi hi. “Bangbangin mihing khat po in, ngamtatna om ngawl upna nei thei tu ziam? Ka upna sia ka ngamtatnate taw hong lak tu khi hi,” ka ci tu hi."},"19":{"text":"Pathian khat bek om hi, ci in na um uh ziam? Pha hi! Doaite zongh in um a — kiitakna taw liing hi."},"20":{"text":"Mihing mawmawte awng! ngamtatna om ngawl upna in, kimanna nei ngawl hi, ci thu a kilak tu na dei uh ziam?"},"21":{"text":"Ih taanghpupi ahi Abraham sia bangbangin Pathian mai ah thutang a na suak ziam? Ngamtatnate pan hi, biaknatau tungah a tapa Isaac a piak ciang tua ngamtatna tungtawnin thutang a na suak hi.","ref":"Pian 22:1-14"},"22":{"text":"Hi thu mu thei ngawl nu ziam? A upna le a ngamtatna sia kithua khawm a; a upna sia a ngamtatnate tungtawnin khuangkhim hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuaciang laithiangtho in hi bang a ci ciangin, thumaan son ahi hi, “Abraham in, Pathian um a, tuaciang a upna hang komin, Pathian in ama sia thutang in saang hi.” Tua hi a, Abraham sia Pathian ii lawm hi kici hi.","ref":"Pian 15:6; 2 Khang 20:7; Is 41:8"},"24":{"text":"Tua hi a, en vun, mihing khat sia ngamtatnate taw Pathian mai ah thutang suak a, a upna bek pan hi ngawl hi."},"25":{"text":"Numei pumpi zuak Rahab zongh tuabang ma hi. Ama in Pathian mai a thutang a sua sia a ngamtatna pan hi, Israel thudawpkute huna pia in lampi dang khat panin, a suataksak ngamtatna pan ahi hi.","ref":"Jos 2:1-21"},"26":{"text":"Tua ahikom thaa om ngawl pumpi sia a thi ahi bangma in, ngamtatna om ngawl upna sia zongh a thi hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, note sya seam nuam tam na om heak vun. Na heak uh bangma in ngualdang sangin ko syate tungah nasia zaw in thu hong kikhen tu hi.","title":"Leei Thu"},"2":{"text":"Ih vekpi in, sep khial ih nei bul hi. Ahihang mihing khat in, pau khialna a nei ngei buale ama sia a cialcing hi a, a pumpi bup zongh, a uk thei mi ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Siphu in ih thu hong nit thei natu in, a kam sungah kamkhau ih koi a, ih uukna pawpo ah ih paisak thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahibuale teambaw khat ngaisun vun: tuaza in lian a, a thahat vui ii a seamna taw kihawl hikale, a heakna no mama khat taw kiheak zo hi, tuaciangin teambaw hawlpa ii paisak nopna pawpo ah pai hi."},"5":{"text":"Leei zongh tuabang ma ahi hi: tuasia in no ahihang, na liante huvau ah kisuangtaak thei hi. Meikuang no khat taw, duipui khat a kihal theina thu ngaisun vun!"},"6":{"text":"Tuaciang leei sia meikuang taw kibang hi. Ama sia khialna omna leitung hi a, ih pumpi sungah mun la in hong om a, ih pumpi bup tungtawnin thusia kizelsak hi. Hell pan a hong pai meikuang taw in nuntak sung tawntung hong hal hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing in a nungta dang theampo — duisung nganhingte, vacimte, awmtaalin a vakte le, ngasate zualsak thei zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahihang kuama in leei sia a zualsak zo ngei bua hi. Leei sia, sia a, uk thei hi ngawlin, thi theina nguu taw kidim hi."},"9":{"text":"Leei sia ih Topa le Pa tungah lungdamkona in ih zangh a, Pathian taw a kisunin a kivawt ih mipuite haamsiatna in ih zangh si hi.","ref":"Pian 1:26"},"10":{"text":"Lungdamkona le haamsiatna kammalte sia kamhawng khat sung panin pusuak khawm hi. Ka suapuite awng, tubang hi tu kilawm ngawl hi!"},"11":{"text":"Tuilim le tuikhaa sia ciktui naak khat sung pan pusuak khawm ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, theikung khat in olive ngate nga thei ngawl hi; sapitkung khat in thei ngate nga thei ngawl hi; sii tuinaak in tuilim piangsak thei ngawl hi."},"13":{"text":"Note sungah a ciim thutel thei na om uh ziam? Amate in tuasia a nuntakna pha taw ahizong, kiniamkhiakna le ciimna taw a pha sepnate taw ahizong lak tahen.","title":"Tung sang pan Ciimna"},"14":{"text":"Ahihang na thinsung ah eenna, thin natna le duhopnate a om le, na ciimna na kiphatsakpuina taw thumaan thutak sia langpanin mawna vawt heak in."},"15":{"text":"Tuabang ciimna sia vantung panin hong paisuk hi ngawl hi; tua in leitung neisa hi a, thaa vai hi ngawlin, doai vai ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ki eenna le duhopna omna munah buaina le siatna namcin zongh om hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahihang tungsang pan ciimna sia a masabel in thiangtho hi; tua in kilemna, cikna, lemzawngna zongh ahi hi. Tua in kihesuakna taw kidim a, a pha sepnate piangsak hi; tua in, kidoidanna nei ngawlin, kihithepsakna nei ngawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Phatna in kilemna piangsakte ii a tu thaicii panin a piang thaw an ahi hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note sungah kihauna le kidona teng sia koisung pan hong pai ziam? Na sungah a kido tawntung leitung nopna na deina uhte pan hong pai ahi hi.","title":"Leitung taw Lemzawngna"},"2":{"text":"Nate dei a, na nga thei ngawl uh ciangin, ngual thatlum tu in na kingingta uh hi; nate nasia takin na dei uh a, ahizong na nga zo bua uh hi, tuasia ciangin na kihau uh a, na kido uh hi. Na dei uhte na nga ngawl uh sia, banghang ziam cile Pathian munah na ngen bua uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuaciangin na nget uh ciang, na nga bua uh hi, banghang ziam cile na niimnate pha ngawl hi; noma nopsak natu sung bek ah na zak tu uh nate na ngen uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Thumaan ngawl mihingte awng! Leitung ii ngualtamh ih hi le Pathian ii ngal ih hi hunlam he ngawl nu ziam? A kuama po leitung ngualtamh a suak nuam sia Pathian ii ngal suak nuam ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Laithiangtho sungah, “Pathian ii ih sungah hong koisak thaa sia a nasia mama lungngulnate taw kidim hi,” a ci sia thumaan ngawlin ngaisun heak vun."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang Pathian hong piak thuthiamna sia khohzaw kan lai hi. Laithiangtho in “Pathian in a kiphasakte nalh a, ahihang a kiniamkhiakte thuthiamna pia hi,” a ci bangma hi.","ref":"Pau 3:34"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom Pathian tungah ki aap vun. Doaimangpa nalh vun, tua hile note kung pan tai tu hi."},"8":{"text":"Pathian kungah hong neak tavun, tua hile Pathian in note hong neak tu hi. Na khut uh sil vun, no mawneite awng! Na thinsung uh thiansua vun, no a kihitheamsakte awng!"},"9":{"text":"Heena, kaana, tauna taw om vun; na nuina uh sia kaana taw laih tavun a, na lungdamna uh sia, maikhinna taw laih tavun!"},"10":{"text":"Topa mai ah noma le noma kiniamkhiak tavun, tua hile ama in hong laamto tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, khat le khat na kisonsia heak vun. Tapidaw suapui khat a sonsia ahibuale a tung a thu a khen sia in, Thukham sonsia a thukhen ahi hi. Thukham tungah thu na khen le, Thukham a zui nawn ngawl, Thukham tungah thukhenpa na hi uh hi.","title":"Tapidaw Suapuite khat tung Thukhen Kidop natu"},"12":{"text":"Pathian bekma thukham pia Pa le thukhenpa ahi hi. Ama bek in, ngum thei a, susia thei hi. Na mipuite tungah thukhen tu in nang sia akua kisa ni ziam?"},"13":{"text":"“Tuni ahibuale zing ciangin, khua khat ah khual va haw tong i, tualai ah kum khat bang taamin, sum meet vawt in, sum tam mama thalaw tong,” a cite awng hong ngai tavun.","title":"Kisuantaakna ah Kidop natu","ref":"Pau 27:1"},"14":{"text":"Na nuntakna sia zing ciangin bangbang hi tu ci ngawngawn na he bua uh hi! Note in tawmvei hong kilangh zok a, a bo kik meikhu lomno khat taw na kibang uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Na pau tu uh sia hi bang hizaw tu hi: “Topa deina a om le ih nungta tu a, hisia ahibuale ziasia ih vawt tu hi.”"},"16":{"text":"Ahihang no, tu in kiphasak a, kisuangtaak nu hi; tuabang kisuantaakna theampo sia maan ngawl hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ahikom a pha tu he napi a pha a vawt ngawl sia in mihing mawnei ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu in, no sumhaute awng, hong ngai tavun! No tungah hong tung tu ngimna haksatnate huvau kapin mau vun!","title":"Sumhaute Kidop natu"},"2":{"text":"Na hauna uh teng sia muat zo a, na puansilh teng sia nget in ne zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Na khamhte le na ngunnte sia eakseau zo hi. Tuaciang hi a eakseaute in, no langkhat panin tetti hong hi tu a, meikuang taw kibangin, na sa uh hong ne khawng tu hi. Hi ni tawpkhak hun sungah, note in haunate na khol zo uh hi.","ref":"Mt 6:19"},"4":{"text":"Na lo sungah naseam mihingte ii thaman na pia bua uh hi. Amate ii phunnate ngai vun! Na an uh hong laksakte ii auna sia Topa Vaanglianbel Pathian bil sungah theng zo hi.","ref":"Thkna 24:14-15"},"5":{"text":"Hi leitung ah na nuntakna uh sia a liap a vaal nate le nopsakna taw kidim hi. Hong kingaw lup ni ciang na thau natu in noma le noma na kivaak zo uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Mawna nei ngawl mihingte mawsak in, na thatlum zo uh hi, tuaciang amate in no hong nalh ngawl uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahikom, ka suapuite awng, Topa hong pai mateng in, na thin uh sausak vun. Lothopa khat in, leitang tung pan an manpha hong pian natu sia, bangza in thinsauna taw ngak ziam en vun. Amate in khuapi ngua le tuk ngua sia thinsau takin ngak hi.","title":"Thinsauna le Thungetna"},"8":{"text":"No zongh na thin uh a sau kul hi. Na lametna uh saangsak vun, banghang ziam cile Topa ii hong pai tu ni hong nai zo hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, note khat le khat tungah lungkim ngawlna taw na kiphunsan heak vun, tua hile Pathian in no tungah thu hong khen ngawl tu hi. Thukhenpa sia hong nai zo a, hong kilangh tu in kithoai zo hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, Topa min suangin a pau kamsaangte phawk vun. Thuakna sungah thinsau takin a thuak zo amate ii thuak zawk hatna sia ettee in nei tavun."},"11":{"text":"Amate sia mihing lungdamte hi ih ci hi, banghang ziam cile amate in thuak zo uh hi. Job ii thin sauna te na za zo uh a, a tawpna ah Topa ii piakkikna thu na he zo uh hi. Banghang ziam cile, Topa sia hesuakna le ciliapna taw kidim hi.","ref":"Job 1:21-22; 2:10; Ps 103:8"},"12":{"text":"A thupibelin ci leang suapuite awng, kamciam na vawt uh ciangin tomlo in kiciam heak vun. Vantung taw ahizong leitung taw ahizong, nadang khat pawpo taw ahizong tomlo in kiciam heak vun. Hi na sak uh ciang, “Hi hi” bekma ci vun, ahi ngawlna ah, “Hi bo” ci lel vun, tua hile Pathian ii thukhenna na thuak buatu uh hi.","ref":"Mt 5:34-37"},"13":{"text":"A ngim nga khat po no sungah na om uh ziam? Thungen tahen. A lungdam khat po na om uh ziam? Ama in pokna late sa tahen."},"14":{"text":"A cina khat po na om uh ziam? Pawlpi upate sam hen a, amate in thungetsakin, olive thau taw Topa min suangin zut tahen.","ref":"Mk 6:13"},"15":{"text":"Hi upna taw thungetna in ciina damsak tu hi. Topa in ciidamna pia kik tu a, tuaciang mawna a vawtte kimaisak tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahikom, na mawna uh sia khat le khat tungah kipualaak vun a, khat le khat thu na kingetsak vun, tua hile hong damsak tu hi. Mipha thumaan thutang khat ii thungetna in vaang nei hi."},"17":{"text":"Elijah zong eima bangma mihing khat ahi hi. Ama in ngua a zuk ngawl natu in, nasia takin thungen a, kum thum le kum lang nguatui hang hi.","ref":"1 Kum 17:1; 18:1"},"18":{"text":"Nguazuk kik natu thungen kik leleau a, van in nguatui hong buaksuk a, lei in an piangsak hi.","ref":"1 Kum 18:42-45"},"19":{"text":"Ka suapuite awng, note sung panin, khat po in, thumaan thutak panin, lampial a, a dang khat in hong ciapui kik le,"},"20":{"text":"hi thu phawk tavun: a kuama po mihing a maw khat sia ama ngamtat khialna pan hong khealsak ahile, tua pa in mawneipa ii thaa a thi natu panin hun tu a, mawna tam mamate kimaisakna piangsak tu hi.","ref":"Pau 10:12; 1 Pe 4:8"}}}}},"60":{"info":{"name":"Peter Khatna","shortname":"1Pet","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus Christ ii sawltak Peter in — Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia le Bithynia ngamte ah ngaltai a, a kithethaang Pathian tealsa mite tungah lai kong thaak hi."},"2":{"text":"No sia Pa Pathian tupna taw hong tealsa hi a, Jesus Christ thu a ni tu le a chisan taw a kithiansua tu in, ama Thaa taw a thiangtho minam a suak sate na hi uh hi. Thuthiamna le thinnopna note sungah hong dim tahen."},"3":{"text":"Topa Jesus Christ ii Pa le Pathian tungah lungdamko tawng! Hong hesuakna lian ahikomin, Jesus Christ sia thina pan a thawsak kikna taw nuntakna thak eite hong pia hi. Hi sia in a nungta lametna taw hong dimh hi,","title":"A nungta Lametna"},"4":{"text":"tua ahikom a mite atu Pathian ii a koi, a thupha tam mamate a nei tu in ih kilamen hi. Ama in note atu in tua thuphate vantung ah keam a, tua munah muat thei ngawl, lal thei ngawl le vul thei ngawlin om hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua teng sia noma atu ahi hi, hun tawpkhak ni ciang a kilaak khia tu a kinging sa in a om, ngupna sia upna tungtawnin a nga note atu in, Pathian vaang taw tuate hong kepcingsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Na thuak uh haksatna namcin hu in tu laitak hun tawm vei no sung khuangaina na thuak uh kul hikale, hi thute ah lungdam vun."},"7":{"text":"Tua haksatna thuaknate ii tupna in na upna uh a maanna a kilak natu ahi hi. A kisia thei khamh ngawngawn zongh meisa taw kisit lai hi; tua ahikom khamh sangin tam mama in a man nei zaw na upna uh zongh a kip thei natu in hong kisit tu hi. Tua hile Jesus Christ hong kilaak Ni tak ciangin pokna, minthanna le vaang piakna na saang tu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ama mu ngeingawl na hi uh hang na it uh a, tu zongh in ama mu ngawl na hi uh hang na um uh hi. Tua ahikomin, kam taw a kison zo ngawl dongin lungdamna lianpi taw nasia takin na lawp uh hi,"},"9":{"text":"banghang ziam cile ama na upna uh hu in na upna uh ii tupna bulpi a hi thaa ngupna sia na saang uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Kamsaangte ii pha tak a zon le a kat sia hi ngupna thu hi a, Pathian ii no tung hong piak tu hi letsong huvau amate in sonkhol zo hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate in tua thu sia bang hun ciang tung tu a, bangbang hong pai tu ziam cisia, heak tu in hanciam uh hi. Tua hun sia Christ in ngim thuak tu a, tua zawkciang minthanna taw kizom tu hi ci in amate sung a, a om Christ Thaa ii a sonkholna taw a lak hun sia ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Vantung panin Thaa Thiangtho ii vang taw a sawl, Lungdamna Thupha a thangsak, thupuakte tung pan tu in na zaak uh thute Pathian in hi kamsaangte tungah a pualaakna ah cileang, amate nasep sia in amate phattuam na tu in a seam hi ngawl a, noma atu in a seam hizaw hi. Hi thute sia vantunglalangte dong ii a tel nop uh thu ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom a diang tu in, na thin sung uh ah kingin khol tavun. Jesus Christ hong kilangh ciangin, note hong piak tu thupha tungah lametna a cingin nei tavun, na kipilvangsak vun.","title":"A thiangtho Nuntakna tu Sapna"},"14":{"text":"Pathian thu ni vun, tuaciang bangma na heak ma na nei uh, deinate in na nuntakna uh uksak heak vun."},"15":{"text":"Tua hi ngawl zaw in, na sep na vawt theampo sungah note hong sam Pathian a thiantho bangma in thiangtho vun."},"16":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “Kei thiangtho ka hikom na thiangtho vun,” ci hi.","ref":"Thiam 11:44-45; 19:2"},"17":{"text":"Mihing khat sim ii a sepna bangin a kibang thukhenna taw mihing theampo thu a khen Pathian tungah thu na nget uh ciang, Pa awng, na ci uh hi; tua ahiciang hi leitung ah nungta in na om uh laiteng ama thasia tavun."},"18":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile na taanghpupite pan na luasuk uh, a mannung ngawl nuntakzia pan na suatak natu in, note bang taw hong tan ci thu na he uh hi. Ngunn le khamh bangin a kisia thei thilte taw hong kilei hi ngawl hi;"},"19":{"text":"a sitbaang ngawl, ahibuale a mealhem ngawl tuuno, Christ ii a manpha a kipumpiakna taw hong tan a hina he tavun."},"20":{"text":"Ama sia simlei a kibitphua ma in, Pathian teal kholsa hi a, hi ni tawpkhak nite sungah no atu hong kilaak ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama thina pan a thosak, minthanna a pia Pathian sia ama tungtawnin na um uh hi; tuaciang note upna le lametna sia Pathian tungah kibul hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu in thumaan thutak na zui uh hu in, noma le noma na kithiansua zo uh a, na thu uppui mihingte it zo takpi tu na hi uhkom na thin theampo uh taw khat le khat nasia takin ki it tavun."},"23":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile a nungta tawntung Pathian kammal tungtawnin, a thi maw a nungta tawntung nu le pa khat ii tate bangin, na piangthak zo uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “Mihing theampo sia lopa bang hi a, amate ii minthanna sia duisung paakte taw kibang hi. Tua lopa ko a, tua paakte pul hi.","ref":"Is 40:6-8"},"25":{"text":"Ahihang Topa kammal sia a tawntungin kip hi,” ci hi. Hi kammal sia no tung a hong kithangsak tua Lungdamna Thupha ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahiciang siatna a minpiang vawk siat in; leilotna, kihitheamsakna, ki eenna, ahibuale kiselnona kam note sungah om nawn heak hen.","title":"A nungta Suangpi le A thiangtho Minam"},"2":{"text":"Nausen suaktuungte bangin a thiangtho thaa noaitui tatak du tawntung tavun, tuabang a na neakna taw in na khangto tu uh a, ngupna na nga tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Laithiangtho in, “Noma mama in, Topa sia bangza in dik ziam ci in na mu zo uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 34:8"},"4":{"text":"Mihingte in mannung ngawl hi ci in nial hikale Pathian ii manpha a sak, a teal, a nungta suangpi ahi, Topa kungah pai tavun."},"5":{"text":"Nuntakna a nei suangte bangin pai tavun a, thaa biakinn sak natu in a kizanghte hi tavun, tua munah Jesus Christ tungtawnin, Pathian tungah a saan thamman, thaa taw kisai sangaw biakpiakna a pia a thiangtho thiampite bangin na seam tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile laithiangtho in, “A man nei suang khat ka teal a, Zion ah innkingh suang tu in ka phut hi, tuaciang ama a um peuma in, a thin a kiam ngei buatu uh hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Is 28:16"},"7":{"text":"No a umte atu in hi suang sia man nei mama hi; ahihang a um ngawlte atu in: inn sate ii mannung a sak ngawl, a nial suang sia a vekpi sung pan a thupibel hong suak hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Ps 118:22"},"8":{"text":"Laithiangtho mundang khat ma ah, “Hi suang in mihingte lutusak tu a, amate a liiksak suangpi suak tu hi,” ci hi. Kammal a up ngawl manin amate lutu uh hi; tuasia in amate atu in Pathian ii deina ahi hi.","ref":"Is 8:14-15"},"9":{"text":"Ahihang note sia a kiteal sa minam, Kumpi thiampite, a thiangtho minam, Pathian ii aituam mite, khuazing sung pan a lamdang ama ii khuavak sungah nang hong sam pa Pathian ii a lamdang ngamtatnate a thangsak tu a hong tealsate na hi uh hi.","ref":"Pu 19:5-6; Is 43:20-21; Pu 19:5; Is 9:2; Thkna 4:20; 7:6; 14:2; Tit 2:14"},"10":{"text":"Hun khat lai in, note sia Pathian mite na hi bua uh hi, ahihang tu in ama mite na hi uh hi; hun khat lai in, Pathian ii hesuakna na he bua uh hi, ahihang tu in ama ii hesuakna na saang zo uh hi.","ref":"Hos 2:23"},"11":{"text":"Hi leitung ah khualmite le ngaltaite ahi no ka lawmte tungah hi bangin, kong thuum nuam hi! Na pumpi cii le sa deinate zawp heak vun, tuate in thaa taw kido tawntung uh hi.","title":"Pathian Silate"},"12":{"text":"Pathian he ngawlte kawm ah na ngamtatna uh a phat mama hu in amate ii mihing tatsiate ci a hong zungkaw ciangin, na ngamtatna phate hong mu tu a, ama hong pai Ni ciangin, Pathian pok tu uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Topa hangin mihing thunei peuma ii ukna nuai ah om tavun: a lianbel thunei ahi Kumpilianpa le,"},"14":{"text":"mihing tatsiate daan pia tu le, thupha a vawtte a pok tu in a koi, ngamkhen uk maangte khutnuai ah na om tavun."},"15":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile a pha na vawt uhte taw, mihing mawmawte ii a mot paunate na thimsak tu uh Pathian in hong deisak hi."},"16":{"text":"A suakta mite bangin nungta vun; ahizong ngitlo ngamtatnate seal natu in na suatakna uh zangh heak vun a, Pathian ii silate bangin nungta tavun."},"17":{"text":"Mihing theampo zatak vawt vun, na thu uppuite it vun, Pathian thasiana nei vun a, Kumpilianpa zakta vun."},"18":{"text":"No naseamte in a dik thukhual theite bek hi ngawlin, a thuthiam ngawl a thinngam na tote zongh zatakna a cingin pia vun, amate ukna nuai ah na om uh kul hi.","title":"Christ Ngimthuakna lim Ettee na"},"19":{"text":"Ama deina na phawna uh hu in, ngimthuak ngawl tu bul na thuak uh le, hite tungtaang ah, Pathian in thupha hong pia tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile na khialna hangin velna na thuak le bang phattuamna om na ziam? Ahihang a maan na sep uh ciang ngawngawn in na thuak veve uh le, Pathian in tua hu in thupha hong pia tu hi."},"21":{"text":"Pathian in no hong sapna sia hi thu hang ahi hi, banghang ziam cile Christ ama mama in, no atu in thuak a, ama khuani na zui thei natu in ettee tu hong nusiat hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama in mawna vawt ngawl a, ama kam panin leilot thu pusuak hi ci in kuama in za ngeingawl hi.","ref":"Is 53:9"},"23":{"text":"Ama a kilan ciangin selnona kam taw thuk ngawl hi; ngimna a thuak ciang kuama tawng ngawl a thutang thukhenpa Pathian tungah a lametna koi zaw hi.","ref":"Is 53:7"},"24":{"text":"Eite, mawna sungah thi a, thutang suana sungah ih nuntak thei natu in, Christ ama mama in, thinglamtee tungah a pumpi taw ih mawnate hong puaksak zo hi. Ama liammate taw note hong damsak zo hi.","ref":"Is 53:5"},"25":{"text":"Note sia lam amh tuute bang na hi uh hi, ahihang tu in na thaa uh hong Keampa le Tuucingpa zui tu in, hong kipui kik zo hi.","ref":"Is 53:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in, no zite awng na pasalte khat po Pathian thu um ngawl a om le, na ngamtatna taw Pathian thu um khat na suasak thei natu in na pasalte thu na nit uh kul hi. Kam khat zongh na pau kul ngawl tu hi,","title":"Zite le Pasalte","ref":"Eph 5:22; Col 3:18"},"2":{"text":"banghang ziam cile amate in noma ngamtatna sia bangza thiangtho in thasiahuai ziam ci in hong mu tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Na hoi natu sam vawtzia taw, suangmanphate taw, nikteen puansilh daan taw, tuabang tungtham kipuuanate taw, kizeam heak vun,","ref":"1 Tim 2:9"},"4":{"text":"tuate taangin na hoina sungah Pathian ii muna ah a man neibel ahi a tul thei ngawl, a dik cikna thiamna le thinsung pha na nei tu uh hi zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"A bosa hun sung biakna sungah a takkha, Pathian tungah lametna a neite sia, a pasalte thu a nitna uh taw a mealhoi veu suak hi."},"6":{"text":"Sarah zongh tuabang ma ahi hi; Abraham ii thu ni a, ama sia topa ci in sam hi. Na pha seamin bangma sep kiitak na nei buana uh le, tu in no sia Sarah ii tanute na hi uh hi.","ref":"Pian 18:12"},"7":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in no pasalte zongh, na zite uh thaneam zaw ahi hunlam telthiam in na nuntakpui tu uh kul hi. Amate zatak vawt tavun, banghang ziam cile, amate zongh noma taw kibangin, Pathian ii nuntakna letsong sia sang khawm tu uh hi. Tuabangin na ngamta uhle na thungetna uh bangma in hong nawngkaisak ngawl tu hi.","ref":"Eph 5:25; Col 3:19"},"8":{"text":"A tawpna ah: note theampo in a kibang ngaisutna le khuaheakna nei tavun; tuaciang khat le khat unau bangin ki it vun. Khat le khat tungah dikin, kiniamkhiak tavun.","title":"Thumaan Nasepna hu in Thuakna"},"9":{"text":"Ngitlona sia ngitlona taw thuk kik heak vun a, haamsiatna zongh haamsiatna taw thuk kik heak vun; tua hi ngawl zaw in thupha taw kithuk zaw vun, banghang ziam cile, note Pathian hong sap lai in piak tu a hong kamciam sia thupha hi zaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Laithiangtho in: “Nuntak nuamin a nungta nuamte le hunphate a mu nuamte in, kam sia pau heak hen a, leilot thuson kheal nanak tahen.","ref":"Ps 34:12-16"},"11":{"text":"Amate in siatna pan kikhealin phatna vawt nanak tahen; amate in kilem natu a thin theampo taw a hanciam kul hi."},"12":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile, Topa in thutangte en a, a thungetna uh ngai hi; siatna a vawtte ahile ama in langpan hi,” ci hi."},"13":{"text":"A pha vawt tu na lawp uh le, akua in hong nasak tu ziam?"},"14":{"text":"Ahihang thumaan nasepna na sep uh ciang ngawngawnin na thuak uh le, bangza in lungdam tu nu ziam! Kuama kiita heak vun a, thinngim heak vun.","ref":"Mt 5:10; Is 8:12-13"},"15":{"text":"Ahihang na thinsung ah Christ sia thasiana nei tavun. Topa a hina bangin ama vaang pia vun. Na sungah lametna na nei uh sia sonthiang tu in hong dongh khat pawpo na zo thei natu in a tawntung kinging tavun,"},"16":{"text":"ahihang tuabang na son uh ciang, cikna thiamna le kithasiana nei tavun. Na thinsung ah, kithasunna omsak heak vun, tua hile hong kiselno ciangin, Christ nungzuite na hina uh taw na ngamtat phate hong sonsiate sia, amate pauna taw a maizum tu uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian ii deina ahi nale a pha sepna hu a thuakna in, a sia sepna hu a thuakna sangin phazaw hi."},"18":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Christ in mawna hu in a tawntung atu khatvei lian thi zo hi, note Pathian kungah hong zot pui natu in mipha khat sia mawneite taangin thi zo hi. Ama pumpi thi ahihang thaa sungah kinungtasak zo hi,"},"19":{"text":"tuaciang a thaa nuntakna taw ama pai in, thaa thongtaakte munah thuhil hi."},"20":{"text":"Hi thaa te sia Noah ii teambaw a sak lai hun a, Pathian ii thin uai takin a ngak, Pathian thu a ni nuam ngawlte ii thaa te ahi hi. Teambaw sungah mihing tawmno — a vekpi in liat bek — tui in laamto in suaktasak hi,","ref":"Pian 6:1—7:24"},"21":{"text":"tua tui sia tu in note hong kingupna lim a lak, tui kiphumna ahi hi. Pumpi tung ciniinte silthiangna hi ngawlin, thinsung khentel theina pha taw Pathian tungah kamciam piakna ahi hi. Tua in Jesus Christ thawkikna tungtawn a note hong ngum hi,"},"22":{"text":"ama, vantung ah pai zo a, Pathian ii ziatsang ah om in, vantunglalangte, vantung thuneite le vaang neite theampo uk siat hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Christ in a pumpi ngim thuak ahikom in, note zongh ama khua ngaisutna bangma nei in noma le noma na kithahatsak nanak vun; banghang ziam cile a kuama po pumpi taw a thuak sate sia, mawna sungah a tualta nawn bua hi.","title":"A kikheal Nuntaknate"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahikom tu pan kipanin, na leitung nuntakna uh a om laiteng, mihing ii deinate in uksak heak vun a, Pathian ii deina in uksak hamtang vun."},"3":{"text":"A bosa hun sungah Pathian he ngawlte ii sep nop teng, a khomin seam zo nu hi. Na nuntakna uh sia, zummawk ngamtatna, sikvilna, zu khamna, uangtatna, zuneakna, a thasiathuai milim biaknate taw zangh zo nu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu in Pathian he ngawlte in amate sansak po maitat, loklenna sungah na kihel nop nawn ngawl uh ciang, lamdang sa in note hong selno uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang a nungtate le a thisate tungah thukhen tu in a kingingta sa Pathian mai ah amate in thusitna thuak tu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihing khat sim tungah, thu kikhen ahi bangma in, amate pumpi nuntakna tungah thu a kikhen sa hi a, a thite zongh Lungdamna Thupha a kihilna sia, tua thu hang ahi hi; amate thaa nuntakna sungah Pathian nuntak bangin, a nuntak thei natu thu a kihil ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Na theampo a bo natu hun hong nai zo hi. Thu na nget thei natu in noma le noma ki uk thiamin, na pilvang tavun.","title":"Pathian Letsong A zeak Thiamte"},"8":{"text":"Khat le khat thinsung takpi taw na ki it tu sia thupi ngaisutbel tavun, banghang ziam cile ki itna in mawna tam mama sincip hi.","ref":"Pau 10:12"},"9":{"text":"Phun ngawlin khat le khat zin kido thiam tavun."},"10":{"text":"Mihing sim in Pathian letsong tuatuamte a zeak thiampa bangin, Pathian tung pan a tuam vilvel na saan uh letsongte sia ngualdangte phattuam natu in zangh hamtang vun."},"11":{"text":"Thuhil pawpo in Pathian ii ngupna thute hil nanak tahen a; na theampo ah Jesus Christ tungtawnin Pathian tungah pokna a kipiak thei natu in, na a seam pawpo in Pathian piak thangui thatang taw seam nanak tahen, tua Pathian tungah minthanna le vaangletna a tawntung a tawntungin om tahen. Amen."},"12":{"text":"Ka it lawmte awng, a haksa ze etna na thuak uh hu in, lamdang sa heak vun, a piang ngeingawl thute no tungah hong piang bangin ngaisun heak vun.","title":"Tapidaw khat hina taw Thuakna"},"13":{"text":"Christ ii vaangletna hong kilangh ciangin, lungdamna a cingin na nga thei natu in, ama thuaknate thuakpui na hi uh komin, lungdam zaw tavun."},"14":{"text":"Christ ii nungzui na hi uh hu in hong kizawngsak ahile, na lungdam tu uh hi; tua in a vaanglian Thaa ahi Pathian Thaa Thiangtho in no tungah a om hang ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Note sungah khat po in ngimna a thuak le zong, ama sia mihing a that, a nguta, khialna lian a vawt, tua ahibuale, midang a kamkup nop hu hi heak hen."},"16":{"text":"Ahizong Tapidaw na hi uh hu in a thuak na hi uh le, maizum in nei heak vun, Christ minpu na hi uh hu in, Pathian tungah lungdamko tavun."},"17":{"text":"Thukhen kipat tu hun hong tung zo a, Pathian aituam mihingte sia thu kikhen masa tu hi. Eite taw hong pan le Pathian kung pan hong pai Lungdamna Thupha a um ngawlte bang suak thong tu ziam?"},"18":{"text":"Laithiangtho in: “Miphate a kingup tu haksa hi; tua ahile Pathian a sel mawneite bang suak tu ziam?” ci hi.","ref":"Pau 11:31"},"19":{"text":"Tua ahiciang Pathian ii deina a om hu in a thuakte ahile, a kamciam a peal ngeingawl, amate a Bitphuapa sungah, a ngamtat phatnate taw amate le amate kipummuan tahen."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pawlpi upa khat ahi keima in no pawlpi upate tungah kong thuum hi. Keima sia Christ thuakna ii tetti khat ka hi a, maisang hong kilangh tu minthanna a nga tu khat ka hi hi.","title":"Pathian Tuuhon"},"2":{"text":"Uuk ngawl pipina taw hi ngawlin Pathian hong deisak bangin, uukna takpi taw Pathian hong piak tuuhonte keam tavun ci in kong thuum hi. Na nasep uh sia thasum saan natu lel hi ngawlin, uukna takpi taw a seam hi tavun.","ref":"Jn 21:15-17"},"3":{"text":"Noma ii kep tu a hong ki aapte tungah zawthawkna taw uk tu hanciam ngawlin, tuuhon atu in a ettee pha na hizaw vun."},"4":{"text":"Tuaciang Tuucing Pipa hong kilangh ciangin, a taanna a bo ngeingawl tu minthanna lukhu na saang tu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in no khangmoizawte zongh, khanghaamzawte thu na ni vun. Tuaciangin note theampo khat le khat, na na kisepsak thei natu in, kiniam khiakna awmdal sia puan bangin silh tavun; banghang ziam cile, laithiangtho in, “Pathian in a kiphasakte nalh a, a kiniamkhiakte tungah maipha pia hi,” ci hi.","ref":"Pau 3:34"},"6":{"text":"Pathian ii thahatna khutnuai ah kiniamkhiak vun, tua hile ama ii hunpha hong tun ciangin ama in hong laamto tu hi.","ref":"Mt 23:12; Lk 14:11; 18:14"},"7":{"text":"Ama in note hong thinnuam maw ahikom, na thinngimna theampo ama aap vun.","ref":"Pau 3:34"},"8":{"text":"Pilvang vun a, encik vilvel vun! Na ngalpa Doaimangpa sia a valhlup tu khat po zong a, a hawk tawpi taw kibangin, na kiimkot ah hong vak kawkoai hi."},"9":{"text":"Na upna sungah kip vun a, ama na nalh vun, banghang ziam cile, leitung theampo a om na thu uppuite zongh a kibang ngimnate thuak hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang tawmvei na thuak zawk uh ciangin, Christ taw pumkhat hina taw, ama ii a bomaw minthanna nga tu a hong sam, thuthiamna theampo ii Pathian, ama mama in no hong cialcingsak tu a, kipsakna, thahatna le, bul khona hong pia tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama tungah vaangletna om tawntung tahen! Amen."},"12":{"text":"A thumaan Tapidaw suapui in ka ngaisut Silas ii hong huna taw, hi lai tomno kong at hi. Hi thu sia Pathian ii thuthiamna tatak hi ci in tetti pangin, kong hanthawn hi. Tua thu sungah kho takin ding vun.","title":"A khakbel Vaithakna","ref":"Sawl 15:22,40"},"13":{"text":"Pathian teal ahi, Babylon khua ah a om, na pawlpike ii hong paupui bangma in ka tapa Mark zongh in hong paupui hi.","ref":"Sawl 12:12,25; 13:13; 15:37-39; Col 4:10; Phm 24"},"14":{"text":"Tapidaw ki it kinapna taw khat le khat kimuak tavun. Christ neisa ahi note theampo tungah thinnopna hong om tahen."}}}}},"61":{"info":{"name":"Peter Niina","shortname":"2Pet","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus Christ ii sawltakpa le silapa Simon Peter in — Ih Pathian le Hunpa Jesus Christ thumaan thutang tungtawn a, kote ii upna za ma in a manpha upna, a neite tungah lai kong thaak hi:"},"2":{"text":"Pathian le Jesus, ih Topa na heakna uh tungtawnin, thuthiamna le thinnopna kicing sia no aa hi tahen."},"3":{"text":"Pathian ii a nei vaangletna in, ama ii minthanna le phatna nga tu a, hong sam pa ih heakna tungtawnin, Pathian thu sungah a maan nuntakna ih nei natu in, ih kitaangsap theampo ei tungah hong pia hi.","title":"Pathian ii Sapna le Tealna"},"4":{"text":"Hi bangin hong kamciamsa ahi a lian mama le a manpha letsongte sia, leitung ah a om hong lalsak thei cii le sa deina pan suatakna na nga thei natu le ama pianzia na siim thei natu in hong piak ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Hi thu hang mama in, na hi thei tawpin phatna sia na upna tungah belap vun; na phatna tungah heakna belap vun;"},"6":{"text":"na heakna tungah pumpi ki ukzawkna belap vun; pumpi ki ukzawkna tungah thuak zawkna belap vun; na thuak zawkna tungah Pathian bang hina belap vun;"},"7":{"text":"Pathian bang hina tungah u le nau ki itna belap vun; tuaciang u le nau ki itna tungah ngual it theina belap vun."},"8":{"text":"Hi kicinnate sia na kitaangsap uh hi a, tuaciangin tuate tam mama na nei uh le, tua teng in no sia ih Topa Jesus Christ heakna sungah a diang zo tawntung le a muibunin hong nungtasak tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang hi kicinnate a nei ngawl peuma sia, a khua muna toi ahikom, a mawna luite pan kithiansua zo ahi hunlam mu thei ngawlin mangil zo uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka suapuite awng, Pathian hong sapna le hong tealna sia a kip a kho a sua natu in a nasia zaw kanin hanciam vun; tuabangin na hi uh le na upna na nusia ngei buatu uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Hisia tungtawnin ih Topa le Hunpa Jesus Christ ii tawntung Kumpi ngam sungah tum thei natu thu a cingin no hong kipia tu hi."},"12":{"text":"Hi thute sia na heaksa uh hi, na saansa thumaan thutak sungah kho takin a omsa na hita uh zong, kong phawksak kikik nuam hi."},"13":{"text":"Hi thute na tepteena kong satsuasak tu sia, ka nuntak lai teng kei atu in a maan nasep hi ci in ka ngaisun hi."},"14":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus Christ ii a thiang tak a hong sonsa bangin, hi a thithei pumpi sia suut pal tu cisia ka kihe hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahikom, ka thi zawkciang, hi thute a tawntungin na teptee thei natu lampi a kihon natu, ka hi thei tawpin ka seam tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Ih Topa Jesus Christ ii vaangletna taw hong pai natu thu kong heaksak ciangin, phuatawm taanghthute ka sisanh bua uh hi. Ama ii letna sia ka mit uh taw ka mu sa uh ahi hi.","title":"Christ Minthanna A mute"},"17":{"text":"A vaanglianbel Pa in, “Hisia ka it ka Tapa hi a, dik ka sak pa ahi hi!” ci a, Pa Pathian in patoaina le minthanna a piak laitak, tua munah ka om uh hi.","ref":"Mt 17:1-5; Mk 9:2-7; Lk 9:28-35"},"18":{"text":"Hi aw vantung panin hong pai lai in, kote mama mual thiangtho tungah, ama taw ka omkhawm uh a, ka za uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom kamsaangte son thute tungtaang ah thinmuanna ka nei seseam uh hi. Tua thute na thupi ngaisut tu pha hi, banghang ziam cile, tua Ni khua hong vak a, nikonghong aksi na thinsung uh ah hong taan dong in, khuazingna munah tua thu sia meivak taang taw kibang hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahizong, thildang a vaal lai, a thupibel in Laithiangtho sungah a om kamsaanna thu khat sia kuama in ama thu in, a khiakna son thei ngawl ahi hunlam ciamtee tavun."},"21":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile kamsaanna thute sia mihing deina pan bek hong pai ngeingawl a, ahihang Pathian kung pan hong pai thute a son uh ciangin, mihingte sia Thaa Thiangtho ukna nuai ah a om ahi uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A bosa hun in mihingte sungah kamsaang maan ngawlte piang hi, tuasia bangma in no sung zongh sya maan ngawlte hong piang tu hi. Amate in hong lalsak thei upna thubul maan ngawlte hong keng tu a, amate a tan Topa nial tu hi, tuasia ciang thakhat thu in, amate le amate kilalsua tu hi.","title":"Sya Maan ngawlte"},"2":{"text":"Tua hi napi in, mihing tam mama in amate paktat nopna lampite zui tu uh hi; tuaciang amate ngamtatna hu in ngualdangte in, thumaan Lampi sia sonsia tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi sya maan ngawlte sia duhop ahikom amate phuatawm taanghthute hong sonna taw no tung pan a meet hong vawt tu hi. Amate ii Thukhen pa sia a kingin zawk ngei zo a, amate a Lalsak pa khanglo zo hi!"},"4":{"text":"Pathian in a maw a khial vantunglalangte khoaikhe ngawlin, hell sung denna in nei hi, amate tua mun khuazing sungah Thukhenna Ni ngak tu in koltaang hi."},"5":{"text":"Taanghlai leitung mite sia Pathian in a khoaikhe bua hi, Pathian a sel mihingte ii leitung ah tuipi liimsak hi; a ngup mihingte sia thumaan thutang a hil Noah le a dang mihing sali teng bek hi.","ref":"Pian 6:1—7:24"},"6":{"text":"Pathian a selte tung a piang tu sia mu thei natu in, Sodom le Gomorrah khuapite sia meikuang taw Pathian in haltham hi.","ref":"Pian 19:24"},"7":{"text":"Ngeina pha zui ngawl a maitatte ii paktat ngamtatnate hu in a khuangai, mihing pha Lot bekma ama in suatak hi.","ref":"Pian 19:1-16"},"8":{"text":"Tua mihing pha Lot sia amate sungah teang a, ni khat zawkciang ni khat, amate ngamtat siatnate a mu a zaak ciangin, thinngimin na sa mama hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahikom Topa in Pathian ii dei bang a nungtate, haksatnate pan bangbang suatak tu ci thu, mihing seksolte Thukhenna Ni ciang bangbang daan thuaksak tu ci sia le"},"10":{"text":"a tuan in Pathian ii thuneina simmaw a, a kiihuai a pumpi deina a zuite daan piak tu ci sia he hi. Hi sya maan ngawlte sia hangsanin kisa thei hi, tuaciang minthanna a nei vantung mite a zakta bua uh a, selno zawlai uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Hi a maan ngawl syate sangin a nasia zaw pekin a tha khozaw, a hatzaw vantunglalangte zongh in, amate sia Topa mai ah selnona taw mawsiat ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahihang hi mihingte in, amate thinsung pan, a piangtawm thinpuakte taw ngamta uh a, mat tu le thalup tu a, a piang ngamsate taw kibang uh hi; amate heak zawk ngawl na theampo selno nate taw do uh hi. Amate sia ngamsate bangin kithat tu hi,"},"13":{"text":"tuaciang amate in mihingte ngim thuaksak ahikom, ngim thuakna taw ma in kithuk kik tu hi. Ci le sa deina a thaisak tu ngamtatna khat pawpo suntangin a vawtna sia, amate nopsakna hi; ngualtheam a nuntakziate nuamsa ahikom, ankuang na uumpui tu zongh maizumhuai a, mindai huai hi!"},"14":{"text":"Amate in numei paktatte simngawl a dang en nuam ngawl hi; a maw nopna bo ngeingawl hi. Amate in a tha zawm mite sia thaang sung zotpui uh hi. A thinsung uh ah duhop natu a sin ahi uh hi. Amate sia Pathian haamsiatna nuai ah om uh hi!"},"15":{"text":"Amate in lampi tang nusia in, lam amh uh hi; amate in a maan ngawl sepna taw sum a nga nuam Beor tapa Balaam ii lampi zui uh a,","ref":"Mi 22:4-35"},"16":{"text":"tuaciang tua pa sia a mawna hu in teih thuak hi. Ama ii laa a khoai sia mihing aw taw pau in, kamsaangpa ii mawmawt ngamtatna khaam hi."},"17":{"text":"Hi mihingte sia a kang sa cik taw kibang a, vuipi suangval ii a seamkeak meeikaaite bang ahi uh hi; Pathian in amate atu in, a zing belna mun khealsiasak hi."},"18":{"text":"Amate in kiphatsakna le mawmawt kamte pau a, tuaciangin khialna sung pan a suakta tu a kipan tuungte zongh pumpi lungngul khialnate zanghin aitaa uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amate in tuabangte suatak natu kamciam pia ahihang, amate mama sia lalna zongsangna ii silate ahi uh hi — banghang ziam cile mihing khat sia ama a zocip na khat pawpo ii sila ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Mihingte in, leitung siatna thahatnate sung pan, ih Topa le ih Hunpa Jesus Christ heakna taw suakta zo hi napi, tuate ma in man kik a, zosak kik ahile, tuabang mihingte sia a kipat lai sangin a tawpna ah, a sia zaw mun theng hi."},"21":{"text":"Amate tungah a kipia a thiangtho thupiakna pan a pial uh sangin, a heak uh thutang lampi sia he ngei phot buazaw le, amate atu phazaw lai tu hi."},"22":{"text":"Paunak sungah, “Ui khat in a luak sa ne kik a, a kisilthiang sa vok khat buan sungah bual kik hi,” ci thu a maan hunlam sia amate tung thupiang sia in lak hi.","ref":"Pau 26:11"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka it lawmte awng, hi sia in no tung kong laithak a niina hi. Laithakte ngeal sungah na thinsung a om a thiangtho ngaisutnate a kiphawlo thei natu in, hi thute phawsak tu in kong hanciam hi.","title":"Topa ii Hong pai tu Kamciamna"},"2":{"text":"Taanghlai in a thiangtho kamsaangte sonnate le noma ii sawltakte tung pan na nga uh Topa le Hunpa thupiak sia na teptee tu ka dei hi."},"3":{"text":"A masa phitin, hi hun khakbel sungah, a nuntakna uh pumpi deinate ii a uksak mihing pawlkhat hong pian tu sia na heak tu ka dei hi. Amate in hong nunau tu a,","ref":"Jud 18"},"4":{"text":"hi bangin, hong dongh tu uh hi. “Hong pai kik tu ci in kamciam hong pia ahi bua ziam? Ama koisung om ziam? Ih taanghpupite sia thi siat zo hi, ahihang simlei kibitphua lai pan bangma in, na theampo kibang lai hi!”"},"5":{"text":"Khuangei mama lai in, Pathian in thupia a, vantungte le leitung kibitphua ahi sia amate in thusim ngawl kaltang uh hi. Leitung sia tui sung pan le tui taw in kipiangsak hi,","ref":"Pian 1:6-9"},"6":{"text":"tuaciangin tua leitung lui sia tui taw ma in tuipi liimna taw kilalsak hi.","ref":"Pian 7:11"},"7":{"text":"Ahihang tu in a om, vantungte le leitung sia meikuang taw a kilalsak natu in, tua a kibang Pathian thupiak sia ma in keamcingin om nginge hi. Pathian a sel mite thu kikhen natu le a kilalsak tu hun, a ni hong thet tu ngakin kikeam zii hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahizong ka it lawmte awng na khat na mangil heak vun! Topa muna ah ni khat le kum tulkhat sia a kilamdanna om ngawl hi; ama atu in tuate nii sia kibang hi.","ref":"Ps 90:4"},"9":{"text":"Mihing pawlkhatte ngaisut bang hi ngawlin, a kamciamte a tunsak natu in, Topa haisaang ngawl hi. Ama, no tungah a thinsau hizaw hi, banghang ziam cile ama in, kuama lalcipsak nuam ngawl a, a mawna uh pan kisiiksak siat nuam hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahihang Topa Ni sia nguta bangin hong pai tu hi. Tua Ni ciangin vantungte a nging mama khat taw hong bocip tu a, vantung a om nate kuangkeak in, leitung le a sung a om theampo zong bo cimit tu hi.","ref":"Mt 24:43; Lk 12:39; 1 Th 5:2; Tpl 16:15"},"11":{"text":"Hite theampo tuabangin kilalcipsak tu ahile no sia bangbang mihingte na hi tu uh kisamh tu ziam? Na nuntakna uh sia thiangtho tu a, Pathian atu in a ki aaptuam nuntakna hi tu hi,"},"12":{"text":"vantungte kaanghtumin bocip a, vantung a om nate a sa in a tuithapsak siat tu ni — Pathian ii Ni ngakin, hong thet pal thei natu na sep thei tawpin seam in."},"13":{"text":"Ahihang ko ka hi uh le, Pathian kamciam omsa sia ka ngak uh hi: thumaan thutang a om tawntung natu mun, vantung thakte le leitung thak ka ngak uh hi.","ref":"Is 65:17; 66:22; Tpl 21:1"},"14":{"text":"Tuaciangin ka lawmte awng, tua Ni ngakin na om uh ciang Pathian mu na ah na thiantho natu, na sitbaang ngawl natu le ama taw na kilem natu in, ahithei za in hanciam tavun."},"15":{"text":"Ih Topa thin sauna sia ngupna na nga natu in, hunpha hong piakna hi ci in ngaisun tavun. Tua in Pathian piak ciimna zanghin ih it suapui Paul ii hong laithak bangma ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"A laithak theampo sungah tua thulu taw kisai in a at ciang a son thu in hi thu ahi hi. Ama laithakte sungah thu haksa pawlkhat om a, tuate sia heakna nei ngawlte le, kip takin a ding ngawlte in ahi ngawl lalam in son a, Laithiangtho hilna dangte zongh tuabangin son thei uh hi. Tuabangin amate le amate kilalsua uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahihang no ka lawmte awng, hi thu na heaksa uh hi. A muanhuai na dinmun pan na puk ngawl natu le ngeina maan zui ngawl a maitatte ii khialnate taw hong lampui thaak ngawl natu in, kikeam tavun."},"18":{"text":"Ahihang ih Topa le Hunpa Jesus Christ heakna le thuthiamna sungah na khangto suak vun. Ama tungah minthanna, tu le a tawntungin om tahen! Amen."}}}}},"62":{"info":{"name":"John Khatna","shortname":"1John","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kipatciil pan a omsa, nuntakna Kammal huvau note tungah lai kong thaak hi. Tua thu ka za zo uh a, ka mit taw ka mu zo uh hi; hi hi, mu zo khu hi, ka khut uh taw tham zo khu hi.","title":"Nuntakna Kammal","ref":"Jn 1:1"},"2":{"text":"Hi nuntakna sia a kimu thei in hong kilangh ciang, kote in ka mu uh hi; tua ahikom tua thu ka son uh hi, tuaciang koma hong heaksak ahi, Pa taw a omkhawm, tua tawntung nuntakna thu sia no tung zongh ah kong son uh hi.","ref":"Jn 1:14"},"3":{"text":"Pa le a Tapa Jesus Christ taw ka kipawlkhopna sungah nong pop thei natu in, ka mu ka zaak uh teng no tungah kong phuang uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kote lungdamna a pawlcin thei natu in tua thu kong at uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu in a Tapa tung pan ka zaak thu le kong zaaksak uh thu in hi thu ahi hi: Pathian sia khuavak hi a, ama sungah khuazing om ngawl het hi.","title":"Pathian sia Khuavak"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom ama taw a kipawl khawm hi hing ci napi, khuazing sungah ih om veve le ih kampauna le ih ngamtatna ah a leilot ih hi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahihang eite khuavak sungah ih nungta le — ama sia khuavak sungah om ahi bangma in — eite khat le khat a kipawl theite ih hi a, tuasia ciangin a Tapa Jesus ii chisan in ih mawna theampo pan hong thiansua hi."},"8":{"text":"Mawna nei bua hing ih cile eima le eima kitheam ih hi a, ih sungah thumaan thutak om ngawl ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahihang ih mawnate Pathian tungah ih pualaak le ama in a kamciamte keam tu a, tuaciang a maan sia seam hi: ama in ih mawnate hong maisak tu a, ih ngamtat khialna theampo pan hong thiansua tu hi."},"10":{"text":"Maw ngei bua hing ih cile Pathian sia a leilot pa ih suaksak a, ama kammal eite sungah a om bua hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tate awng, mawna khialna na vawt ngawl natu in hi lai kong at hi; ahihang khat po in mawna a vawt le Pa mai ah ei taangin hong ngetsak tu khat — thutangpa Jesus Christ ih nei hi.","title":"Ei Hong Hupa Christ"},"2":{"text":"Tuaciang Christ mama in eite ii mawna bek hi ngawlin a kuama po ii mawna zongh maisakna a pianna pa ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Pathian thupiakte ih zui le tuasia ciangin ama a he ih hi hunlam ih tel hi."},"4":{"text":"Khat po in ama ka he hi ci napi, a thupiakte a zui buale mihing leilot hi a, ama sungah thumaan thutak a om bua hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahihang a kuama po a kammal a zui sia in Pathian a itna kicingtaaksak takpi zo hi. Pathian taw pumkhat ih hina hi thu in hong telsak thei hi:"},"6":{"text":"Pathian taw pumkhatin nungta ing a cite in Jesus Christ ii nuntak bangin a nuntak kul hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka it lawmte awng, tu a kong at hi thupiakna sia thuthak hi ngawl hi; tuasia in thupiak lui hi a, a kipatciil pan ma na neisa uh ahi hi. Thupiak lui sia noma ii zaaksa thu ahi hi.","title":"Thupiak Thak","ref":"Jn 13:34"},"8":{"text":"Ahihang tu a kong at thupiakna sia a thak hi, banghang ziam cile tua ii a maanna sia Christ sungah kimu a, no sung zongh ah kimu hi. Banghang ziam cile khuazing om nawn ngawl a, khuavak tatak sia taang zo hi."},"9":{"text":"A kuama po khuavak sungah ka om ci napi a, a suapuite a ensan le ama in tu dong ma in khuazing sungah om hi."},"10":{"text":"A suapuite a it te sia khuavak sungah teang ahikom ama sungah ngualdang khat khialsak thei natu bangma a om bua hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahihang a suapuipa a ensan khat pawpo sia khuazing sungah om ahi hi; ama khuazing sungah lampai a, khuazing in a mit tawsak ahikom, a zot natu he ngawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka tate awng, na mawnate uh Christ hangin hong kimaisak zo ahikom lai hong thaak ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Pate awng, a kipatciil pan a om pa na heak uh manin lai kong thaak hi. Tangvalte awng, Ngilo Pa zo zo na hi uh manin lai kong thaak hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka tate awng, Pa na heak uh manin, lai kong thaak hi. Pate awng, a kipatciil pan a om pa sia na heak uh manin lai kong thaak hi. Tangvalte awng, note na tha uh hat ahikom lai kong thaak hi; Pathian kammal no sungah nungta hi, Ngilo Pa na zo zo uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Leitung ahizong leitung na khat pawpo ahizong na it heak vun. Leitung na it uh le Pa it ngawl na hi uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Leitung neisa ahi — hong mawsak thei eima atu lungngulnate, mite ii mit taw mu in a dei sia le mihingte kiphatsakpui leitung na theampo — hite sia khat beak zongh Pa kung pan hong pai ahi bua hi; a vekpi in leitung pan hong pai ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Leitung le a sungah a om, mihingte lungngul thei na theampo hong bo tu hi; ahihang Pathian ii deina bangin a seamte in a tawntungin nungta hi."},"18":{"text":"Ka tate awng, hun bo tu hong nai zo hi! Christ ii Ngalpa hong pai tu hi ci in no tungah hong kison zo hi; tu in Christ ii ngalte tam mama hong kilangh zo a, tua ahikom hun bo tu sia nai zo hi ci in ih he hi.","title":"Christ ii Ngalpa"},"19":{"text":"Hi mite in ei kipawlna sungah hong om tatak ngawl ahi hu in ei hong nusia hi; ei pawl sungah hong om hile ei taw hong omkhawm top tu hi. Ahihang eite taw hong kipawlkhawm tatak ngawl ahi hunlam a kithiangtel thei natu in amate in hong nusia hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahihang Christ ii no tungah Thaa Thiangtho hong buak sia na saang zo uh hi, tua ahikom na vekpi in thumaan thutak na tel uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom lai kong thaakna in thumaan thutak na tel ngawl uh hang hi ngawl hi; thumaan thutak na heak uh hang hi zaw a, tuaciangin thumaan thutak sung pan leilot thu hong piang ngeingawl ci zongh na heak uh ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahile a leilot pa sia akua ziam? Jesus sia Messiah hi ngawl hi a ci pawpo in leilot pa ahi hi. Tuabang mihingte sia Christ ii Ngalte ahi uh hi — amate in Pa le Tapa nial khawm hi."},"23":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Tapa a nial pawpo in Pa zongh nial hi. Tapa a saang pawpo in Pa zongh nei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ahiciang a kipat pan na zaak uh ngupna thu sia noma thinsung uh ah na keamcing hamtang tavun. Tua thu na keamcing uh le Pa le Tapa taw pumkhatin na nungta tawntung tu uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tuaciangin Christ ama mama ii eite hong piak tu hong kamciam sia — tawntung nuntakna ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Note hong theam tu a hong kipante ii thu hong at khi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahihang note na hi uh le, Christ in a Thaa no tungah hong buak zo hi. Note sungah ama Thaa a om laitengin hong hil tu kuama dang na kitaangsamh bua uh hi. Banghang ziam cile ama Thaa in na theampo huvau hong hil a, hong hil teng sia thumaan hi a, khial ngawl hi. Tua Thaa ii hilna na ni vun a, Christ taw pumkhat in na om vun."},"28":{"text":"Hi hi, ka tate awng, ama taw pumkhat in na om vun, tua hile ama hong kilangh ciangin eite sia thinletna taw ih kidim tu a, ama ii hong pai Ni ciangin maizum in ih buk a kul buatu hi."},"29":{"text":"Christ sia thumaan thutang hi ci in na he uh hi; tua ahikom na heak tu uh thu sia a maanin a seam peuma Pathian ta hi ci thu ahi hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pa in ei sia bangza in hong it ziam tel tavun! Ama hong itna lian mama ahikom ei sia Pathian ii tate hong kici hi — tuabang takpi ma ih hi hi. Leitung in Pathian he ngawl ahikom leitung mite in ei hong he ngawl hi.","title":"Pathian Tate","ref":"Jn 1:12"},"2":{"text":"Ka it lawmte awng, ei sia tu in Pathian ii tate ih hi hi, ahihang bang suak tu hi ziam ci in kician ngawl lai hi. Ahihang Christ hong kilaak ciangin eite sia ama taw kibang tu ih hi hunlam ih he hi, banghang ziam cile ama sia ahi bang tatakin ih mu tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Christ sia thiangtho ahi bangma Christ sungah hi lametna a nei mihing peuma ama le ama a thiangtho in kikeam hi."},"4":{"text":"A kuama po mawna khialna a vawt peuma in Pathian thukham paltan ahi hi, banghang ziam cile mawna ih ci sia in thukham paltanna ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Mawnate a la keak tu in Christ hong kilangh hi a, ama sungah mawna om ngawl hi ci in na he uh hi.","ref":"Jn 1:29"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahikom Christ taw kipumkhat a, a nungta peuma mawna zom suak nawn ngawl hi; ahihang a kuama po mawna vawt a zom suakte sia ama a mu ngeingawl ahibuale a he ngeingawlte ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka tate awng, kuama in theamsak heak vun! Christ sia thumaan thutang ahi bangma a kuama po thutangin a seamte sia thumaan thutang ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"A kuama po mawna vawt a zom suakte sia Doaimangpa ii neisa ahi hi, banghang ziam cile a kipat pan ma, Doaimangpa in mawna vawt zo hi. Tua hang ma in Doaimangpa ngamtatna teng a susia tu tatak ma in Pathian Tapa hong kilangh hi."},"9":{"text":"Pathian ta ahi peuma sia mawna vawt a zom suak bua hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian pianzia mama ama sungah om hi; tuaciangin Pathian sia ama Pa hi zo ahikom mawna vawt a zomsuak thei bua hi."},"10":{"text":"Pathian ii tate le Doaimangpa tate kilaklaw ah, a kilamdanna in hisia ahi hi: thutangin a ngamta ngawl ahibuale ngual a it ngawl khat pawpo sia in Pathian ta ahi bua hi."},"11":{"text":"A kipat pan ma na zaak uh thu in: eite khat le khat ih ki it hamtang natu thu ahi hi.","title":"Khat le Khat na Ki it vun","ref":"Jn 13:34"},"12":{"text":"Eite Cain taw ih kibang buatu hi; ama sia Ngilo Pa ii neisa hi a, a suapuipa tatak Abel thatlum hi. Banghang Cain in ama thatlum ziam? Banghang ziam cile ama ii ngamtatnate sia maan ngawl a, a suapuipa ngamtatnate maan ahihang hi.","ref":"Pian 4:8"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka suapuite awng, leitung mite in no hong ensan le, lamdang na sa heak vun."},"14":{"text":"Eite in ih suapuite it ih hi hu in, thina nusia a, nuntakna sungah theng zo ih hi hunlam ih he hi. Ngual a it ngawl peuma sia thina vaangletna nuai ah om lai hi.","ref":"Jn 5:24"},"15":{"text":"Ngualdang a ensan peuma sia mihing that hi a, mihing that khat in, ama sungah tawntung nuntakna nei ngawl hi ci in na he uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Christ in eite atu a nuntakna hong piakna hangin eite in ki itna sia bang ziam ci in ih he hi. Tua ahiciang eite zongh, ih suapuite atu ih nuntakna ih piak ngam kul tu hi!"},"17":{"text":"A hau khat in a cimaw, a suapuipa kisapna mu napi hesuak ngawlin a en thong le Pathian ka it hi, bangbangin ci thei tu ziam?"},"18":{"text":"Ka tate awng, ih ki itna sia kam le muk bek ih hisak buatu hi; ngamtatna taw a kilangh ki itna takpi ahi kul hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom thumaan thutak sungah ih om hunlam sia tu a bangin ih he tu hi; Pathian mai ah kimuanna ih nei natu sia hi bang teng hang ahi hi.","title":"Pathian mai ah Thin Hanna"},"20":{"text":"Ih thinsung ah maw ih kisa le, eite ii ih thinsung kitelna sangin Pathian sia lianzaw a, ama in na theampo he siat hi ci in ih he hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ahikom ka it lawmte awng, ih thin sung ah kithasunna ih nei bua nale Pathian mai ah thinhanna ih nei hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama thupiakte zui a, ama diksak bang ih ngamtat manin, ama tung pan ih nget pawpo ih nga hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama hong thupiak sia bang ziam cile a Tapa Jesus Christ ih up tu le Christ ii hong thupiak bangma khat le khat ih ki it natu ahi hi.","ref":"Jn 13:34; 15:12,17"},"24":{"text":"A kuama po Pathian thupiakte a zui le ama sia Pathian taw kipumkhat in a nungta hi a, Pathian zongh ama taw pumkhat in nungta hi. Tuaciang Pathian hong piaksa Thaa hangin Pathian sia ei taw kipumkhatin nungta ahi hunlam, ih he hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka it lawmte awng, Thaa ka nei a ci theampo na um heak vun, ahihang amate nei thaa sia Pathian kung pan hong pai ahile ahi ngawl na sittel tavun. Banghang ziam cile mun theampo ah kamsaang maan ngawlte pai kawkoai zo uh hi.","title":"A maan le A maan ngawl Thaa"},"2":{"text":"Pathian Thaa ahile ahi ngawl sia hi bangin na tel thei tu uh hi: Jesus sia mihing khatin hong pai hi a ci pawpo in Pathian kung pan hong pai Thaa nei hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahihang Jesus huvau hi thu a nial khat pawpo sia Pathian kung pan hong pai Thaa a nei bua hi. Ama nei tua thaa sia Christ ii Ngalpa kung pan hi; tuasia pa hong pai tu hi ci in na za zo uh a, tu in ama sia hi sung leitung ah om zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang ka tate awng, note sia Pathian neisa na hi uh a, kamsaang maan ngawlte na zothal zo uh hi, banghang ziam cile no sungah a om Thaa sia leitung neisa ahite ii sung a om thaa sangin thahat zaw hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua kamsaang maan ngawlte in leitung nate thuson in nei uh hi, tuaciang leitung mite in amate thusonte ngai uh hi, banghang ziam cile amate sia leitung ii neisa ahi uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahihang ei sia Pathian neisa ih hi hi. Pathian a he peuma in ei thuson hong ngai hi. Pathian neisa ahi ngawl peuma in ei thuson hong ngai bua hi. Tua ahiciang thumaan thutak ii Thaa le a maan ngawl thaa kilamdanna sia, tu sia panin ih khentel thei hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka it lawmte awng, eite khat le khat ki it tawng, banghang ziam cile itna in Pathian kung pan hong pai hi. Ngual a it thei pawpo sia Pathian ta hi a, Pathian he hi.","title":"Pathian sia Ki itna"},"8":{"text":"Ngual a it ngawl peuma sia Pathian a he bua hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian in itna ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaciang ama tungtawnin nuntakna ih nga thei natu in Tapa khat bek a nei sia leitung ah hong paisakna taw, Pathian in eite hong itna hong lak hi."},"10":{"text":"Itna ih ci sia in hisia ahi hi: eite in Pathian a it ih hi bua a, Pathian in eite hong it manin ih mawna a mai natu in a Tapa hong paisak hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka it lawmte awng, hi bangin Pathian in hong it ahile, eite khat le khat ih ki it tu ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Kuama in Pathian mu ngeingawl hi, ahihang eite khat le khat ih ki it le, Pathian sia ei taw pumkhat in hong omkhawm a, tuaciang ama ii itna ei sungah hong cialcingsak hi.","ref":"Jn 1:18"},"13":{"text":"Eite Pathian taw pumkhat in kinungta a, ama sia ei taw pumkhat in nungta hi ci in maan takin ih tel hi, banghang ziam cile ama in ei tungah ama Thaa hong pia zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuaciang Pa in a Tapa sia leitung Hunpa tu in hong paisak hi ci in ih mu a, ngual tungah ih son hi."},"15":{"text":"Khat po in Jesus sia Pathian Tapa hi ci in a pualaak le ama in Pathian taw pumkhatin nungta a, Pathian in ama taw pumkhatin nungta tu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuaciang Pathian ii ei atu a nei itna sia eima mama in ih he a, ih um hi. Pathian in itna hi, tuaciang ki itna sungah a nungta peuma Pathian taw pumkhatin nungta a, Pathian zongh ama taw pumkhatin nungta hi."},"17":{"text":"Thukhenna Ni in thinhanna ih nei natu in eite sungah ki itna hong cialcingsak hi; hi leitung ah ih nuntakna sia Christ ii nuntakna bangma ahikom, eite tuabang thinhanna ih nei tu ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Itna sungah launa om ngawl a, a cialcing itna in launa theampo hawlkeak hi. Tua ahiciang, launa sia daan thuakna taw kizom ahikom kiitakna a neite sungah itna kicing om ngawl hi."},"19":{"text":"Pathian in ei hong it masa ahikom eite in ama ih it hi."},"20":{"text":"Khat po in Pathian ka it hi ci napi in a suapuite a ensan le ama sia leilot thusonpa ahi hi. Banghang ziam cile a mu thei a suapuite a it buale a mu thei ngawl Pathian a it thei buatu hi."},"21":{"text":"Christ ii eite hong thupiakna in hi sia hi: Pathian a it peuma in a suapuite zongh a it kul tu hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus sia Messiah hi ci a, a um pawpo sia Pathian ii ta khat ahi hi; tuaciang pa a it khat in a tapa zongh a it hi.","title":"Leitung ih Zawna"},"2":{"text":"Pathian it a, ama thupiakte zuina taw Pathian ii tate a it ih hi hunlam ih he hi."},"3":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile Pathian ih itna ii khiakna sia ama thupiakte ih zui hi cinopna ahi hi. Tuaciang ama thupiakte sia ei atu in a haksa lei bua hi,","ref":"Jn 14:15"},"4":{"text":"banghang ziam cile Pathian ii tate khat simin leitung zothal thei hi. Tuaciang ih upna taw leitung zawna ih nga hi."},"5":{"text":"A kua in leitung zo zo tu ziam? Jesus sia Pathian Tapa hi ci in a um sia bek ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Jesus Christ sia, tui a kiphumna tui le a thina chisan taw hong paipa ahi hi. Ama in tui nguak taw hong pai ngawlin, tui le chisan taw hong pai hi. Tuaciang Thaa mama in hi thu maan hi ci in tetti pang hi, banghang ziam cile Thaa sia Thumaan thutak ahi hi.","title":"Jesus Christ huvau Tetti Panna"},"7":{"text":"Tua atu in tetti thum om hi:"},"8":{"text":"Thaa, tui le chisan hi a; a thum in a kibang tetti panna nei uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihing tetti panna ih um hi; ahihang Pathian tetti panna khozaw lai a, a Tapa huvau sia ama in tubangin tetti pang hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom a kuama po Pathian ii Tapa a umte in ama thinsung ah hi tetti nei hi; ahihang a kuama po Pathian a um ngawlte in Pathian sia leilot pa suaksak hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian ii ama Tapa huvau a sonsa teng um ngawl ahihang hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua tetti in hi sia hi: Pathian in eite tawntung nuntakna hong pia zo a, hi nuntakna ii a naak sia a Tapa ahi hi.","ref":"Jn 3:36"},"12":{"text":"Tapa a nei a kuama po in hi nuntakna nei hi; Pathian Tapa a nei ngawl pawpo in nuntakna a nei bua hi."},"13":{"text":"Pathian Tapa a um note — tawntung nuntakna na nei uh hunlam na heak natu in hi lai kong at hi.","title":"Tawntung Nuntakna"},"14":{"text":"Eite in Pathian mai ah thinhanna ih nei hi, banghang ziam cile ama deina taw kisi in bang khat po ih ngen le ama in hong za hi, ci in ih muang hi."},"15":{"text":"Ih nget simin hong za hi: hi thu, thumaan hi ci in ih heak pan kipan, ama tungah ih nget teng ama in hong pia hi ci thu zongh ih he hi."},"16":{"text":"Na suapuipa in thina dong a then thei tu ahi ngawl mawna khat a vawt le ama nuntakna a pia tu Pathian munah thu ngetsak in. Hi sia in thina hong then thei mawnate ngawl buang atu in a kizangh thei thu ahi hi. Ahihang thina dong hong then thei mawna om a, tua tungtaang ah Pathian munah thungetsak tu kong ci bua hi."},"17":{"text":"Ngamtat khialna theampo mawna hi a, ahihang thina dong hong then ngawl mawna om hi."},"18":{"text":"Pathian ii tate kuama in mawna vawt tan viuveu ngawl hi ci in ih he hi, banghang ziam cile Pathian ii Tapa in ama keamcing a, Ngilopa in a susia thei bua hi."},"19":{"text":"Simlei buppi sia Ngilopa ukna nuai ah om kale, ei sia Pathian neisa ih hi hunlam ih he hi."},"20":{"text":"A maan Pathian ih heak natu in Pathian Ta hong pai zo a, teltheina hong pia zo ahi hunlam ih he hi. Eite in a maan Pathian taw pumkhat hi in — ama Tapa Jesus Christ taw pumkhat in ih nungta hi. Hisia in a maan Pathian hi a, tawntung nuntakna ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka tate awng, a maan ngawl pathiante panin noma le noma na kikeam tavun!"}}}}},"63":{"info":{"name":"John Niina","shortname":"2John","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pawlpi Upa pa tung pan — Ka it tatak a ithuai nupi le a tate tungah lai kong thaak hi. Tuaciang keima bek hi ngawlin thumaan thutak a he theampo in no hong it uh hi,"},"2":{"text":"banghang ziam cile thumaan thutak sia ei sungah om a, a tawntungin om top tu hi."},"3":{"text":"Pa Pathian le Pa ii Tapa Jesus Christ in thuthiamna, hesuakna le thinnopna hong pia tahen; thumaan thutak le itna sungah tua thute ei aa hi tahen."},"4":{"text":"Na tate pawlkhat sia Pa ii hong thupiakna bangin thumaan thutak sungah om hi ci in ka mu ciangin ka lungdam mama hi.","title":"Thumaan Thutak le Itna"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahikom, ka it Nupi nu awng, nang tungah kong nget nop sia: eite khat le khat ki it tawng ci thu hi. Hi kong at thu sia thupiak thak hi ngawl a; a kipatciil pan ih nei thupiak sia ma ahi hi.","ref":"Jn 13:34; 15:12,17"},"6":{"text":"Tu a ka son itna ii khiakna sia Pathian thupiakte zui in ih nuntak kul hi cinopna hi. A kipat pan na zaak siat sa uh bangma note theampo sia ki itna taw na nuntak uh kul hi, ci in thupiakna om hi."},"7":{"text":"Leitung theampo ah ngual theam theite tam mama pai kawkoai zo a, tua mite in Jesus Christ sia mihing in hong pai hi ci in saang nuam ngawl uh hi. Tua bang mihing khat sia ngual theampa hi a, Christ ii Ngal ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahiciang ih sepna sa teng atu taan ngawlin na thaman a cingin na nga natu in kikeam tavun."},"9":{"text":"Christ ii hilcianna sungah om nuam ngawlin, a pai khial pawpo in Pathian a nei bua hi. Hilcianna sungah a kip peuma in Pa le Tapa nei khawm uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom khatpo hong pai a, hi hilcianna hong keng bua uh le na inn sung uh ah tungsak heak vun; “Thinnopna na nga tan,” zongh na ci heak vun."},"11":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile ama tungah thinnopna a om tu, a deisak khat pawpo in ama ii ngamtat siatnate sungah kipawl khawm ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Kong son tu tam mama om ahihang laikung laite taw hong at ngawl zaw tu khi hi; ih lungdamna a kicin natu keima hong haw in maitang kisi a thuson tu ka lamen zaw hi.","title":"A Khakbel Kammalte"},"13":{"text":"Na it na Suapuinu ii tate in paupuina kam hong thaak hi."}}}}},"64":{"info":{"name":"John Thumna","shortname":"3John","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pawlpi Upa keima in — Ka it takpi ka lawm Gaius tungah lai kong thaak hi.","ref":"Sawl 19:29; Rom 16:23; 1 Cor 1:14"},"2":{"text":"Ka it ka lawmpa awng, thaa sungah thahat ci in kong heak bangma — na theampo ah maapai daupai in na ciidam natu thu ka ngen hi."},"3":{"text":"Thumaan thutak sungah a nungta tawntung na hi bangma — Tapidaw suapui pawlkhat hong theng a, nang sia thumaan thutak sungah takkha hi ci in hong son ciang ka lungdam mama hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka tate thumaan thutak sungah a nuntak ka zaak sia sangin hong lungdamsak zaw thei a dang bangma a om bua hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka it ka lawmpa awng, na Tapidaw puite khualmi ahi laitak ngawngawn zong amate a tu nasepna ah thumaan in citak ni hi.","title":"Gaius Pokna"},"6":{"text":"Amate na itna thu teng hi sung pawlpi ah hong ko uh hi. Amate khualhawna sungah Pathian lungkim zia taw a paitan thei natu in na hu in."},"7":{"text":"Banghang ziam cile amate sia Christ ii na seamin khual a haw uh ciang, thu um ngawlte tung pan huna bangma saang ngawl uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahikom ei Tapidawte in hi mihingte ii thumaan thutak a tu a sepna sungah a seppui ih hi thei natu in ih hu tu hi."},"9":{"text":"Pawlpi tungah laithak tomno khat ka at hi; ahihang amate ih lampui a suak nuam Diotrephes in kei ii ci bang sia hong thupi sim bua hi.","title":"Diotrephes le Demetrius"},"10":{"text":"Tua ahikom kong pai ciangin ama ngamtatna theampo: ko thu a cizathuai a hong sonte le a leilotna teng ka pholaak tu hi! Ahihang tua teng bek hi ngawl lai hi; Tapidaw suapuite hong pai ciangin saang nuam ngawlin, tuabang a saang nuamte ngawngawn tho in, biakinn pan hawlkeak tu hanciam lai hi!"},"11":{"text":"Ka it ka lawmpa awng, a pha ngawlte zui heak vun a, a phate zui tavun. Thupha vawt peuma Pathian neisa hi a; thusia vawt peuma in Pathian a mu bua hi."},"12":{"text":"Demetrius sia ngual theampo in phat son hi; thumaan thutak mama in ama phat son hi. Tuaciang ko zongh in tetti ka pang thua uh a, thumaan son ka hi uh sia na he uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kong son nop tam mama om ahihang laikung laite taw kong at nuam bua hi.","title":"A khakbel Kipaupuina"},"14":{"text":"No taw kimu pal tu in lametna ka nei a, tua hun ciangin maitang kisi in ih son tu hi."},"15":{"text":"Thinnopna nga tavun. Na ngualtamhte theampo in nuksetna kam hong thaak hi. Ko ii lawm teng zongh maitang kisi in na nukset sak vun."}}}}},"65":{"info":{"name":"Jude","shortname":"Jude","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesus Christ ii naseam, James ii suapuipa Jude kung pan — Pa Pathian ii itna sung le Jesus Christ ii kepcingna sung a nungta Pathian ii sapsate tungah laithak ahi hi:","ref":"Mt 13:55; Mk 6:3"},"2":{"text":"Hesuakna, thinnopna, ki itna a kicingin note aa hi tahen."},"3":{"text":"Ka it lawmte awng, ih nei khop tek ngupna huvau hong at nuam ing, ka ci laitakin, Pathian ii mihingte tungah a tawntung atu in khatvei a piak upna huvau ngal ih sim kul lai hi, ci in hanthot nopna ka thinsung ah thakhatin hong suak hi.","title":"Thuhilsya Maan ngawlte"},"4":{"text":"Pathian a nei ngawl mihing pawlkhatte ei sungah hong tum ku ahikom, amate ii pheangtatnate a kam zonna in, Pathian ii thuthiamna thute ahi ngawl lamin zeak a, eima bek ii To le Topa ahi Jesus Christ sia nial uh hi. Ngeitawng lai in Laithiangtho in amate puavawkna a thuakna thute sonkhol zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Na heaksa uh ahitazong, Topa in Israel te sia Egypt ngam pan suatak napi, a thu um ngawlte sia a khak sang ciangin, susiacip hi ci in kong phawksak nuam hi.","ref":"Pu 12:51; Mi 14:29-30"},"6":{"text":"Amate thuneina ciaciang sungah a om po ngawl, a teenna a nusia vantunglalangte phawk tavun: amate sia leinuai khuazingna ah tawntung thikkol kibul a, amate tungah thu a kitan tu Pathian ii Ni lianpi ni dong atu in Pathian in koi hi."},"7":{"text":"Sodom, Gomorrah le a kiim khuapite zongh phawk tavun, tua vantunglalangte bangin ngamta a, numei le pa paktatna le ngeina ngawl bangin mawna vawt uh hi: amate sia mihing theampo ii a kidop thei natu in, tawntung meikuang sungah daan a thuak uh hi.","ref":"Pian 19:1-24"},"8":{"text":"Tuasia bangma in hi mihingte in amate ii pumpi mama a khialsak tu mukholnate nei a; amate in Pathian ii thuneina zawngsakin, tung sangah a minthangte nunau uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Vantunglalangte sung pan a lianbel Michael zongh in hi bangin ngamta ngawl hi. Moses luanghawm sia Doaimangpa taw a kituu laitakin, Michael in Doaimangpa sia kamsia taw na lang ngawl a, “Topa in nang hong teih tahen,” na ci bek hi.","ref":"Dan 10:13,21; 12:1; Thkna 34:6; Zec 3:2"},"10":{"text":"Ahihang hi mite in a tel ngawl nate sia nunau in, selno uh hi; tuaciang nganhing bangin, amate ii a pianpui thinsung uh taw a heak thei nate in amate lalsak uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amate atu in bangza in lauhuai ziam! Amate in Cain ii lampi tawn uh hi. Balaam khial bangma in, amate sia sum huvau in puk uh hi. Korah ii a langpan bangin, amate zongh in langpan uh a, ama bangma in kilalsak hi.","ref":"Pian 4:3-8; Mi 22:1-35; 16:1-35"},"12":{"text":"Amate sia a maizumhuai neakna dawnna taw ngualnuamin om uh a, noma ii kipawlkhop anneakpoai uh hong nokkhaksakte ahi hi. Amate in a kaangsung atu bek kin hi. Amate sia vui ii seam nguatui a paai ngawl meeikaaite taw kibang hi: tangngam hun dongin a nga mama a nga ngawl thingkungte le a kizunglok a thicip sa thingkungte taw kibang hi."},"13":{"text":"Amate sia tuipi sung a, tui kihualte taw kibang a, amate ii a maizumhuai ngamtatnate sia, tuiphuante bangin kilangh hi. Amate sia khuazing belna sung, a tawntung a om natu mun Pathian ii a koi kholsak, a vakthap aksite taw kibang hi."},"14":{"text":"Adam suan a khang salina, Enoch in hi bangin, amate huvau sonkhol hi. “Topa sia a vantunglalang thiangtho tul tam mama te taw hong pai tu a,","ref":"Pian 5:18,21-24"},"15":{"text":"mihingte theampo tungah thutanna vawt tu le, Pathian awlmawk ngawl ngamtatnate le Pathian sel mawneite ii Pathian langpanna a lauhuai kam paunate tungah puavawkna vawt tu hi!” ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Hi mihingte in a tawntungin, phunin ngual veu mawsiat uh hi; amate in a ngitlo nopna thinpuakte zui uh hi; amate le amate kisuangtaakin, a dei uh sia a nga thei natu in, ngualdangte sialpok uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahihang lawmte awng, a bosa hun sungah ih Topa Jesus Christ sawltakte ii hong son thute na phawk tavun.","title":"Kidop natu Hilna le Thupiakna"},"18":{"text":"Amate in “Ni tawpkhak hun hong thet ciangin, note hong selno tu mihing hong piang tu a, tua mihingte in pathian sel amate ii deinate zui tu uh hi,” hong ci hi.","ref":"2 Pe 3:3"},"19":{"text":"Hi mihingte in kikhenna a piangsakte hi a, cii le sa deina in amate uk in, Thaa a nei bua uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahihang no, ka lawmte awng, a thiangthobel na upna tungah kikipsak seseam vun. Thaa Thiangtho vaangletna sungah thungen tavun,"},"21":{"text":"tuaciang, ih Topa Jesus Christ ii hesuakna taw tawntung nuntakna hong piak tu ngakin na om uh laitakin, noma le noma sia Pathian ii itna sungah kikeamcing tavun."},"22":{"text":"A um tatak zo ngawlte tungah hesuakna na lak tavun;"},"23":{"text":"midangte sia meikuang sung pan dokin, hun tavun; a dangte tungah hesuakna le kiitakna kithua in, na lak tavun a, ahihang amate paktat mawna taw nin a baang sa puante mama na ensan tavun."},"24":{"text":"Tu in na puk ngawl natu in, hong keam thei a, ama ii minthanna mai ah a sitbaang ngawl le lungdamna lianpi taw hong then thei —","title":"Pokna Thunget"},"25":{"text":"ama bek Pathian ahi ih Ngumpa tungah ih Topa Jesus Christ tungtawnin, minthanna, vaangletna, thahatna le thuneina sia, a bosa hun theampo sung, tu le a tawntungin om top tahen! Amen."}}}}},"66":{"info":{"name":"Thu Pualaakna","shortname":"Rev","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi laibu sia Jesus Christ ii pualaak thute a kitepteena ahi hi. Hai ngawlin, a tung tu thute a naseamte tungah a lak thei natu in, Pathian in hi pualaakna pia hi. Christ in a naseampa John tungah a heaksak natu in, ama kungah a vantunglalang paisak a,"},"2":{"text":"tuaciang John in a mu theampo son siat hi. Hisia in Pathian ii thupuak le Jesus Christ ii a pualaak thumaante huvau thukona ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Hi thubu sungah a ki at laite a simte le maisang thu kisonkholna kammal a zuite in mihing lungdamte ahi hi! Banghang ziam cile hi thute hong tun tu hun hong nai zo hi."},"4":{"text":"Asia ngamkhen sung a om pawlpi salite tungah, John in lai kong thaak hi: A om nginge, a omsa le hong pai pheang tu Pathian kung pan, a kumpi tokhum mai ah thaa sali te kung pan le","title":"Pawlpi Salite tungah Paupuina","ref":"Pu 3:14; Tpl 4:5"},"5":{"text":"a thumaan tetti hi a, thina pan kithosak kik masa leitung kumpite theampo a ukpa Jesus Christ kung pan thuthiamna le thinnopna sia note aa hi tahen. Ama in ei hong it a, ama chisan hangin eite, mawna pan hong suatak hi,","ref":"Is 55:4; Ps 89:27"},"6":{"text":"tuaciangin eite sia a Pathian le a Pa atu a seam tu in thiampi in hong vawt hi. Jesus Christ tungah minthanna le vaangletna sia a tawntung a tawntungin om tahen! Amen.","ref":"Pu 19:6; Tpl 5:10"},"7":{"text":"En vun, meei tungah ama hong pai hi! Mihing khat simin ama mu tu hi, tuate sungah ama a hollette zongh kihel tu hi. Leitung mihing theampo ama hu in khuangaina taw tau tu uh hi. Tuabangin hong piang tatak tu hi!","ref":"Dan 7:13; Mt 24:30; Mk 13:26; Lk 21:27; 1 Th 4:17; Zec 12:10; Jn 19:34,37"},"8":{"text":"“Keima in a masabel le a khakbel ka hi hi,” ci in a om nginge, a omsa, le hong pai pheang tu, Vaanglianbel Topa Pathian in ci hi.","ref":"Tpl 22:13; Pu 3:14"},"9":{"text":"Keima in na suapuipa John ka hi a, tuaciang Jesus nungzui khat ka hina taw Pathian ngam lua tute ii thuak tu vawtsiatna noma taw a kibangin a thuak kenkon na seppuipa ka hi hi. Kei sia Patmos tuikulh tungah hong kikoi hi, banghang ziam cile, Pathian kammal le Jesus ii hong pualaak thumaan thutak ka thansak hang ahi hi.","title":"Christ ii Mukholna"},"10":{"text":"Topa ii ni in, Thaa in kei hong uk a, aw nging khat ka za hi, tua aw sia lemle aw bang hi a, ka nungsang panin hong paupui hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuasia in, “Na mu teng at in a, a laibu sia hi pawlpite omna khuapi sali ahi: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, Laodicea te tungah thaak in,” ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Akua in hong paupui ziam ci in ka nung ka kiheak ciang, khamh meivakna sali ka mu hi,"},"13":{"text":"tuate kawmah mihing taw a kibang khat ka mu a, ama in a peang dong a tualsuk puan khat silhin, a awm kiimkot ah khamh kawngkhau khat vet hi.","ref":"Dan 7:13; Dan 10:5"},"14":{"text":"Ama sam sia tuumul ahibuale vuuk bangin paak a, tuaciangin a mittang sia meikuang bang ahi hi;","ref":"Dan 7:9; 1:14-15; 10:6"},"15":{"text":"ama ii peang sia a kithiangsak, a kinawt taau taw kibang a, a aw sia tuiteautuak hawk bang ahi hi.","ref":"Eze 1:24; 43:2"},"16":{"text":"Ama in a khut ziatsang ah aksi sali toai a, tuaciang a kam sung panin a lang nii hiam namsau khat hong pusuak hi. A maitang sia sun lai nitaang bangin taang hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama ka mu ciangin mithi sa bangin, a peang ah ka puk hi. Ama in a khut ziatsang ka tungah hong nga a, “Lau heak in! Kei sia a masabel le a khakbel ka hi hi.","ref":"Is 44:6; 48:12; Tpl 2:8; 22:13"},"18":{"text":"Keima in a nungta pa ka hi hi! Keima sia ka thi zo a, ahihang tu in a tawntung a tawntungin, ka nungta hi. Thina le mithite khua ka uk hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahikom nungciangin, hong piang tu nate le tu laitak a om nate, na mu teng at in."},"20":{"text":"ka ziatsang khut sungah na mu aksi salite le khamh meivak khuam salite ii a kiphualseal a khiakna sia hi bang ahi hi: aksi salite sia pawlpi salite ii vantunglalangte hi a, meivakna khuam salite sia pawlpi salite ahi hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ephesus khua Pawlpi ii vantunglalang tungah hi bangin at in: “Hisia in a khut ziatsang ah aksi sali toai a, khamh meikhuam salite kawm ah a vakpa ii hong kamvaithak ahi hi.","title":"Ephesus tungah Kam vaithak"},"2":{"text":"Na sep teng kong he hi; bangza in haksa mama in naseam a, thin uai takin na om sia kong he hi. Mi ngilote dual thei ngawlin, sawltak hi ngawl napi ka hi uh hi a cite zongh na sit uh a, ahi ngawl uh hunlam na tel zawkciangin, leilot mihingte hi ci in na mu uh zongh kong he hi."},"3":{"text":"Note na thin uh uai a, kei atu in thuakin, na thin uh na thasua bua uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahihang note kong mawsakna khat sia hi thu ahi hi. A masa a nong it uh bangin, tu in kei nong it nawn bua uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Bangza dongin kiamsuk na hi uh sia ngaisun vun! Na mawnate uh panin kisiik vun a, na vawt phit uh sia vawt kik vun.
